stutrī

bod rgyal mo rong gi lo rgyus rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal rong ba brag b.radapal ldan gyis brtsams/krung go mi dmangs chab grid gros mol chogs 'du 'barakhamasaspyong yu yon lhan khang

ri ) gyu thumi dpa 4 tsho ci sha citsho/ /stemoji — rta 43 sna —— — ri ne rwa ni3— — sna ma lkerterā tsho tho nu citrī cispro canagigyiji ci rtsorme pa po brag bar dpa' ldan gyi 'dra pan/rtsorang/ pe bratsabar dang 'a 3ma nispyi'ikyi 1rka /5lor se sworngarnga ba khula'abaralams rdzi nga brag bar 'u latsha'i'ingaba'icizaduskyeng/ dgung grangasabacuganyis su rab spyobyung/ khongagisabartson pachubo'irgyunaba'imarma do ji gsakyigazhung la thosabasamatshamu gsur rṣa5nga / dgung grangs nyer brgyang du jo nang bla ma dpal ldan zhes/ mtshan snyam rkyal ring yu la kun khyab/ spyi 'o /tsho— ra cang dang hrid gzhung gis skul mar brtem gsar brje'ilasadom lazhugs/ 19 2—— 195(tshobar kto/ nub mi re0 — zla chen tsha 'i chab hricing tsham larga tu trīb drung mdzad/ rjes su'abar khams rdzong srid grosakyi drung yig checha mo dang /rdzo ngajing ri kyi skabs rim byungan me45dang tsur pasamukyo na/ skabs brgyad panasabacusacigabar rdzongasrid gros kyi kru'uzhi tsozhom pa sngedargus chi baḥsna sna sdudzwaru ngaguba'i thecha las uyo na/ 'baralams rdzongarngang bstan mthun chogasakyi chogs gco sazhomang rī tsos ke ngu/ba riru samang rdzi ngahrodagrosakyikru'u'igazhomapa 'i'asamakhuraska/ bas/ skun shim tu bgres ma'angangarṣaritshagar ma'atre2 ngar 0nga pyol ro ronga.i 3byung kungasatshetsho(rgyal rong zlos/gar thadakyi sarngadadocha 'asaspru 'il bshad pa/tsheṭwāṃbod rkya shamañtsar hohu rongagednghasna/rshangatshig mngod8/ tshabalas ba'i'irorgyus 3yibodabargyudanang bstamagyi lorgyus‘3ṭwāṃmathu chema.amyegetu'i 'khrab thazung tsho —bar bamanu ngargo5 nga'i'o rgyus rmo 'idzari'agorigrodakyilorgyus7/ṭwāṃcichu'apho dbonagyi'o rgyus/shlau3rdo〈mtsham nyid dgomagyi lo rgyusatshoso lirna ro5/baphisaneenang rngu/sapa ra duspularongagi yu ladungodakyishes rigal skya chadasngo ldababyung b.rasem sakhre' chenango 'isgotshas 4 tre saurta rsha/sa tudzorwazung zari/trī sa 3brubri sngabacu3/ la dngaldamapa 'i(ribod rgyalamo rdong na lorgyus rab gas la me long 7thesapa grub/ rnga thutshemasnya rngekyige tu 'es rgyalaringagizas garade ni/ rgya' mngagi blosagaralas rig tshigs ngasagangengatshad thobapa mazad/ sdung dhārjos saratshen tre/‘yi ngeb dubaskad/ sna9ṭwāṃlalorargyalayongs mchogagyur rgamarigasakyispeogs mdangam tshan snam thotsa bongasir/ri tshesang bor sna/sa dang rgyu'abras gtsugagi rkyam du 'dzinal/ blo gcig sems gcil gis tang dngaridam nganu/kyirdon la sabarī 3ngetsos byengamakharngacetsayimapas/ rgyal morongagi yu la ri rnam sa dang rmi rilas ga'an das rnams kyisabaribakurablanamengapabob/ ma tharaspyile 2ji〉༷ 2lo'izlakhubarangagung grangasagyabadunapar dargyongasapa rdzogasaso/
lto/ ny-ipyirichi

shād da ༈7 —— ci——tshotsho(( — —rdzud wasked narurdoraḍiritsho )/ rī ci༈༷——sdowad —risnatsho — dngha—/༄wa—༷wawarteriring chiwa//cidngha— ri wa — tsho ༷ — nga rna rīrnaX—༷cicirtswang rīwawa /tweri— 7cityā

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1 )dpe sgrun gsal bshad/ (3 )glong gzhi/ (7 ) le'u dang po/ bod rigasashā 'byungarṣangs dang gnas yul dus rabs la dpyad pa/ (1 )dang po/ ya thog bod mi'i 'byung khungs/ (2 )gnyis pa/ ya thog zhang bod kyi mi rigs ji ltar byung tshul/ (3 )gsum pa/ zhang zhung gi dus rabs ngos 'dzin rags tsam byed pa/ (4 )(1)zhang bod kyi mi rgyud mched tshul/ (8 )(2)gdod ma'i rig dngos/ (9 ) le'u gnyis pa/ ya thog zhang rgyal zhes grags pa'i don tshul/dang po/ 'ang rgyal tshes pa'i nang don/ (11 )gnyis pa/ 'ang zhung gi gnas yul/ (12 )gsum pa/ ya thog zhang zhung nas bon byung tshul/ (14 )bzhi ba/ bon mang bshad pa/ (15 )lnga ba/ 'ang zhung dang rgyal rong gi bon dang rig gnas skor/ (20 )drug pa/ dmag gi 'byung khungs/ (23 )(1)rus chen gyi gtso bo/ (24 )(2)dam pa khyung gi gdung rabs/ (24 ) le'u gsum pa/ zhang zhung dang rgyal mo rong gi rgyal rabs byung tshul/ (26 )dang po/ mi sde dang rje bo'i skor/ (27 )gnyis pa/ 'ang zhung khri sde bco brgyad kyi rgyal po'i skor/ (27 )gsum pa/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal po'i skor/ (29 ) le'u bzhi ba/ zhang bod 'dres ma'i dus rabs/ (30 )dang po/ bod rgyal gnya' khri'i skor/ (32 )gnyis pa/ ming gi mtshan don skor/ (34 )gsum pa/ lig wer nam mkha' rgyal po/ (38 )bzhi ba/ bod rgyal srong btsan gyis 'ang zhung bza' khab tu bzhes pa'i skor/ (41 )— 1 —

le'u lnga ba/ ya thog zhang bod gcig tshor gyi dus rabs/dang po/ zhang bod gcig gyur byung ba'i skor/ (42 )gnyis pa/ sbas pa'i shod chen bco baspyad kyi skor/ (48 ) le'u drug pa/ pyis kyi dus rabs skor/ (50 )dang po/ bod rgyal mnga' ris nas byung tshul/ (51 )gnyis pa/ chu chen rab brtan rgyal po'i skor/ (53 )(1) rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag lor chu chen dang btsan la'i skor/ (54 )(2) gong mas chu chen rab brtan phab dgos pa'i bka' phabs pa'i skor/ (55 )(2) gong ma lhas skyong gis mtha' bde zhes pa'i skor/ (55 )(4) lcags yos lo'i 'khrugs chen zhes bya ba/ (56 )(5) gong ma lhas skyong gis chu chen mnga' 'og tu ma tshud pa'i phyir snying rlung stod 'tshang phog pa/ (56 )gsum pa/ rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad kyi ming / (57 ) le'u bdun pa/ zhang rgyal gyi skad yig dang shes rig byung tshul/dang po/ rgyal rong gi skad dang zhang bod gyi skad gnyis mthun tshul/ (58 )gnyis pa/ zhang bod kyi yi ge byung tshul/ (59 )(1) gsal byed sum cu/ (khyi0 )(2) ka yig dbyangs ldan/ (60 )(2) ka kyisag 'dogs ldan/ (60 )(4) ka yig mgo can/ (61 )(5) ka yig mgo 'dogs gnyis ldan/ (61 )gsum pa/ sgra'i don sdeb/ (61 )bzhi ba/ zhang bod rgyal rong gi shes rig byung tshul/ (62 )(1) pra ltas mo zhes ju thig gi skor/ (62 )(2) phywa gshen skor/ (62 )(2) ju thig gi mdud grangs skor/ (63 )(4) brgyag ces pa'i don/ (63 )(5) ye mkhyen sgra bla'i mngom shes skor/ (63 )(6) ye rje smon pa'i rmi lam/ (65 )(7) yi dbang lha'i bka' babs/ (65 )(ṭwāṃ) snang mthong rgyu gshen legs rgyal thang po (65 )— 2 —

(9) spar kha dang spre ba'i skor/ (65 )(1༷) ju zhag rten 'brel las rtsis zhes pa/ (66 )(11) sbyir stangs rtsis/ (66 )(12) nad gso sman dpyad ces pa/ (66 )(12) dpyad 'bum khra bo/ (67 )(14) 'chi bsku'i gto zhes pa'i don/ (67 )lnga ba/ gto thabs/ (68 )drug pa/ ya thog bod kyi shes rig skor/ (69 ) le'u brgyad pa/ ya thog bod kyi yi ge byung tshul/dang po/ khams chen po brgyad kyi skor/ (71 )gnyis pa/ sngon yod kyi yi ge'i skor/ (72 )gsum pa/ thon mi saṃ bho ṭa'i bka' drin/ (73 )bzhi ba/ spyir bod kyi shes rig byung tshul/ (76 )(1) sgrung dang lde'u bon gsum zhes pa/ (76 )(2) mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ldan lde'u spyod zhes pa/ (77 )(2) bon zhes bya ba/ (78 )(4) gter sbas pa'i skor/ (78 )lnga ba/ gter ston byung tshul/ (79 )drug pa/ chu chen rab brtan dang rdzi 'gag rgyal po gnyis kyi 'brel ba/ (81 )bdun pa/ bstan bdag ston pa gshen rab dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal gshen/ (82 )brgyad pa/ gshen dang bru/ zhu/ spa/ rme'u/ khyung / zhig po'i gdung rgyud/ (85 )(1) gsang ba grol lam soms phyogs kyi skor/ (86 )(2) g.yu zhig gi skor/ (87 )(2) a khrid rtogs ldan nyams rgyud skor/ (88 )(4) g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa snga gyi'i dus su dgon sde'i skor/ (90 )dgu ba/ snang zhig gi lo rgyus rags tsam/ (100 )bcu ba/ rtogs ldan dgon gyi lo rgyus rags tsam/ (103 )bcu gcig zhig po bya ba'i don/ (105 )bcu gnyis/ 'bar khams g.yung drung gling / (106 )bcu gsum/ zung chu'i bya dur dga' mal dgon/ (110 )— 3 —

bcu bzhi/ sngon dus bod mi rnams kyi gnas skabs dang tshul lugs ci ltar yod lugs/(113 )byi ddhi tā/gu ba/ pod yul du dam pa'i chos dbu brnyes shing dar ba'i lha khang rten gsum sogs dang po/ bod du bstan pa snga dar gyi rnam bzhag rags tsam bshad pa/ (116 )gnyis pa/ rgyal bo'i thugs dam las lha jo bo rnam gsum sbyan drangs pa'i skor/ (117 )gsum pa/ rgya bza' kong jo spyan drangs pa'i skor/ (120 )bzhi ba/ rgyal mo rong gi lha skal jo bo thugs rje chen po'i skor/ (127 )lnga ba/ khri lde gtsug brtan dang gyim shing kong jo'i skor/ (129 )drug pa/ mkhan slob chos gsum gyi skor/ (132 )(1) bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi rmi lam la slob dpon gdan drangs ba'i skor/(132 )(2) slob dpon bsam yas has pho rir byon pa'i skor/ (134 )(2) slob dpon padma 'byung gnas has pho rir ting 'dzin la bzhuṭa pa'i skor/ (135 )(4) lcags stag lo la bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rmang gzhi btings pa'i skor/(135 )(5) mkhan slob chos gsum gyis 'grub ston byas pa'i skor/ (136 )(6) mkhan slob gnyis kyis chos gsungs pa'i skor/ (136 )bdun pa/ chos khrims dang rgyal khrims sogs bsgrags pa'i skor/ (137 )le'u bcu ba/ bee ro tsa na'i rnam thar/dang po/ slob dpon padmas lung bstan pa/ (139 )(1) rgyal po la dpal rdo rje sems dpas lung bstan pa/ (140 )(2) gtsang snye mo mkhar la pa gor bee ro tsa na 'tshol du song ba/ (140 )(2) sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas mchod gnas su gyur pa'i skor/ (141 )gnyis pa/ bee ro tsa na rgya gar du bka' rdzogs pa chen po zhus su btang ba'i skor/ (141)le'u bcu gcig pa/ bee ro tsa na bod du byon pa'i tshul/dang po/ bee ro tsa nas lam bar gyi dka' ba khyad du bsad nas rgyal po la mjal 'phrad byung ba'i skor/ (145 )gnyis pa/ rgyal pos bee ro tsa na g.ya' ma lung gi brag phug tu sbas pa'i skor/ (146 )gsum pa/ bee ro tsa nas chos gsungs pa la phra ma byung ba'i skor/ (154 )le'u brdi gnyis pa/ bee ro tsa na rgyal mo tsha ba rong du sprugs pa/

dang po/ bee ro tsa nas rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi gdul byar gzigs pa'i skor/ (156 )gnyis pa/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong nas rgyas pa 'bum gdan drangs te bod khams spyi khyab tu dar ba'i skor/ (157 )gsum pa/ bee ro tsa nas rgyal mo rong du lug rdzi byas pa'i skor/ (159 )bzhi ba/ zhar nas dar mgo la chos 'khor bskor ba dang slob bu g.yu sgra dang mjal 'phrad gnang tshul/ (161 )lnga ba/ bee ro tsa nas ma mgon dam gsum gter nas bton tshul/ (162 )drug pa/ rgyal mo rong la mdo sngags kyi bstan pa spel tshul/ (164 )bdun pa/ bee rdo tsa nas rgyal mo dmu rdo nas sgrub pa mdzad tshul dang gnas chen ri bo de'i chags tshul/ (166 )brgyad pa/ bee ro tsa na'i gso ba rig pa sman gyi skor/ (171 )dgu ba/ bee ro tsa na rgya nag dang bod du slar byon tshul/ (173 )bcu ba/ bod kyi chos rgyal gsum gyis bee ro la sogs pa'i mchod gnas rnams la zhabs tog byas tshul/ (196 )bcu gcig bod du bstan pa phyi dar skabs su mkhas grub dang dgon sde byung tshul/(200 )le'u bcu gsum pa/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i rnam thar rags tsam bshad pa/dang po/ ston pa shākya thub pa sku bltams pa'i tshul/ (203 )(1)sgob sbyong byed pa'i skor/ (207 )(2)sgyu rtsal sbyang ba'i skor/ (208 )gnyis pa/ rgyal gras rgyal srid du mnga'o/ gsol ba/ (209 )(1)skye ba'i sdug bsngal mthong tshul/ (210 )(2)rgas pa'i sdug bsngal mthong tshul/ (210 )(2)na ba'i sdug bsngal mthong tshul/ (211 )(4)'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthong tshul/ (211 )gsum pa/ rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byung tshul/ (212 )(1)chu bo ni ra dza na'i drung du dka2 ba mdzad tshul/ (219 )(2)'dod 'jo'i ba mo'i 'o mas sku lus gsos tshul/ (222 )bzhi ba/ byang chub shing drung du rdzogs sangs rgyas tshul/ (222 )(1)drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su chos 'khor bskor tshul/ (223 )(2)yas hre la skyabs 'gro gsungs pa/ (225 )— 5 —

(2)'khor lnga bcu nga drug bcas dbyar gnas bzhugs tshul/ (226 )lnga ba/ bram ze'i chos la ngo rgol byas nas slob ma stong phrag tsam nang pa'i chos sgor tshud tshul/ (226 )(1)rgyal po gzugs can snying pos sangs rgyas kyi sbyin bdag mdzad tshul/ (227 )(2)bla na med pa'i spyod bzang can la gus bkur zhus tshul/ (228 )(2)dmar mchod 'bul ba dang dka' thub brtul zhugs spyod par ngo rgol byas tshul/ (232 )(4)rmongs dad sel tshul/ (233 )drug pa/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin rab tu byung tshul/ (235 )(1)bzod pa sgom dgos pa'i tshul/ (239 )(2)gdol ba'i rigs kyi bud med nang pa'i chos sgor zhugs tshul/ (239 )(2)'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra slob gsos 'dul ba/ (242 )(4)dka' bcu spyad de dad sems brtan du btang ba/ (244 )bdun pa/ sa la'i ljon shing gi 'og tu mya ngan 'das tshul/ (246 )(1)nyan thos rnams kyis bka' bsdus mdzad tshul/ (248 )le'u bcu bzhi ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sbyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i skabs nas rang rgyal du dar tshul/ (249 )dang po/ bod gangs can du chos dar tshul/ (250 )gnyis pa/ bstan pa phyi dar byung ba'i skor/ (251 )gsum pa/ grub mtha' so sor byung ba'i skor/ (252 )(1)spyir gsar rnying gnyis kyi dbye mtshams dngos byung tshul/ (253 )(2)lo chen gyi skabs/ (253 )(2)rnying ma ba'i grub mtha' ji ltar byung tshul/ (254 )(4)gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur mgo'i skabs/ (256 )(5)rnying ma'i grub mtha'i 'dod tshul/ (261 )(6)gyis kyi byung ba 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ (264 )le'u bco lnga ba/ bka' gdams pa byung tshul/ (266 )dang po/ jo bo rje'i bka' drin 'a/sa bka' gdams kyi lugs byung tshul/ (267 )gnyis pa/ rjo bo chen por brten nas bstan 'dzin gzhan byung tshul/ (271 )gsum pa/ bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i spyi bab bshad pa/ (273 )(1)chos kyi rnam grangs/ (273 )—— 6 —

(2)bka' gdams kyi skyes bu dam pa rim byon gyi mdzad spyod/ (278 )le'u bcu drug pa/ bka' brgyud pa byung tshul/dang po/ bka' brgyud pa'i ming byung tshul/ (280 )gnyis pa/ bka' brgyud sbyi'i byung tshul/ (280 )gsum pa/ bka' brgyud so so'i ming byung tshul/ (281 )(1)shangs pa bka' brgyud/ (281 )(2)dwags po bka' brgyud/ (282 )(2)karma bka' brgyud/ (283 )(4)pag gru bka' brgyud/ (287 )(5)zhang tshal ba (288 )(6)'bri gung ba/ (289 )(7)'brug pa bka' brgyud/ (290 )(rdo)stag lung bka' brgyud/ (292 )(9)'ba' rom bka' brgyud/ (293 )(1༷)g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud/ (293 )(11)khro phu bka' brgyud/ (293 )(12)bka' brgyud pa'i lta sgom gyi rnam gzhag phyogs tsam glong ba/ (295 )(12)bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa byung tshul/ (301 )le'u bcu bdun pa/ kaḥdapalastsogs gsum/ (302 )le'u bco brgyad pa/ sa skya ba'i grub mtha' byung tshul/ (306 )(1)sa skya'i dkar po rnam gsum/ (310 )(2)sa skya'i gdan rabs/ (310 )(2)bye brag tu chos kyi gtso bo lam 'bras sogs byung tshul/ (312 )(4)gangs can gyi skyes bu dam pa rong ston pa'i rnam thar/ (314 )(5)sa skya ba'i lta ba'i bzhed tshul/ (321 )(6)mdo luṭa kyi lta ba'i bzhed tshul/ (322 )(7)sngags lugs kyi lta ba'i bzhid tshul/ (324 )(ṭwāṃ)sa skya'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan/ (327 )le'u bcu dgu ba/ jo nang baji ltar byung tshul/ (329 )dang po/ rjes su mdo smad du ji ltar byung tshul/ (332 )gnyis pa/ dzam thang du jo nang ji ltar dar tshul dang chos rje sku phreng rim byon/ da 7(3 4 )

(1)chos rje sku phreng dang po rgyal ba bzang (338 )(2)chos rje sku phreng gnyis pa rgyal ba seng ge/ (343 )(2)chos rje sku phreng gsum pa bon re shing pa'am kun dga' thub bstan rgyal mtshan seng ge(350 )(4)chos rje sku zeng bzhi ba grags pa 'od zer/ (351 )(5)chos rje sku phreng lnga ba rgyal ba lhun grub grags pa/ (353 )(6)chos rje sku zeng drug pa nges don bstan pa dar rgyas/ (357 )(7)chos rje sku phreng bdun pa 'jigs med dpal gyi seng ge (358 )(ṭwāṃ〉chos rje sku phreng brgyad pa mi pham byams pa/ (365 )(9)chos rje sku zeng dgu ba 'jigs med dbang po/ (367 )(1༷)chos rje sku phreng bcu ba karma bdud 'dul rdo rje dpal bzang po (375 )(11)chos rje sbyangs pa'i sprul sku kun dga' dpal/ (376 )(12)drung pa gang nyid kyi sku phreng rags bsdus sa bon tsam 'god pa/ (397 )gnyis pa/ 'dzam thang tshes bcu sku phreng rim byon gyi lo rgyus/(1)drung dka' bzhi ba'i thugs slob tshes bcu ratna gīrti/ (400 )(2)sku zeng gnyis pa rgyal ba rdo rje bstan 'dzin/ (401 )(2)sku zeng gsum pa sprul sku nus ldan rdo rje/ (402 )(4)sku phreng bzhi ba mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me/ (402 )(5)sku phreng lnga ba karmo 'od gsal/ (403 )(6)sku phreng drug pa kun dga' rab gsal rgya mtsho/ (403 )(7)sku phreng bdun pa kadma nges don bstan 'phel/ (403 )(ṭwāṃ)sku phreng brgyad pa kun dga' rin chen grags pa/ (403 )(9)tshes bcu smad age sku phreng dang po nyi ma 'od zer/ (405 )(10)arge sku phreng gnyis pa nyi ma 'od zer dpal/ (405 )(11)sku phreng gsum pa age karmo don dam/ (405 )(12)sku phreng bzhi ba 'phrin las rab brtan/ (406 )(12)sku phreng lnga ba age bstan pa'i sgron me/ (406 )gsum pa/ dzam thang gtsang ba'i lo rgyus/(1)sku phreng dang po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal / (406 )(2)sku phreng gnyis pa kun bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ (407 )da (rdo)sku 3nga gsum pa dkon mchog 'jigs med rnam rgyal/ (411 )

mchod par brjod cing rtsom pa la 'jug pa/༄7/ /oṃ su sti/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcos ldan 'das/ /dkon pa'i mchog tu gyur ba ni/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /bskal ba bye bar rnyed pa dka'/ /shākya song ge mi yi mchog/thugs rje'i gter chen pad dkar can/ /gzigs na sbyod pa'i lhar bcas kyis/ /thal mo rab sbyar gus pas 'dud/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gter/ /rgyal sus gzhon nu'i lang tsho 'bar/ /shes rab lhag pa'i lha mchog la/ /shes rab stsol phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan yon tan mchog mnga' zhing / /rdzu 'phrul pha rol rab tu byon/ /thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen brnyes pa/ /dpa' po khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /

ring nas rmongs pa'i 'ching bas brdims pa'i 'gro/ /sdug bsngal rims kyis mnar ba'i zug rngu che/ /sel mdzad phan bde'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gter/ /mchog gsum dam pas 'groglu brtse bas stsol/ /gna' dus bod kyi ches gnyan btsan po'i rgyud/ /rim par byon nas bzhag pa'i lugs srol dag/rtags kyis dpag ste sngon tshul 'di 'o zhes/ /gsal cha thon pa'i bden tshig 'di na 'chad/ /las la brtson zhing dpal rtsal che ba dang / /'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas phyag rjes dang / /gsar brje'i srol rgyun ldan pa'i rgyal nong gi/ /lo rgyus rab gsal me long 'di na gsal/ /'dzam gling yang rtse'i dar thod te se las/ /mched pa'i rgyal rong yul du mi yi zas/ /bgrang bya gya bdun ring la zos pa'i rin/ /bsil ljongs gzhon nur dpyad gzhi'i rten du bzhags/ /

dbaiskrun gsal bshad/deng skabs rang rgyal du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can 'dzugs sgrun bya bar 'bas 'degs zhu ched rig gnas kyi bya bzhag sgo kun nas dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel spyas 'gro skabs/ de dag gi nang gses spyi chogs tshan rig gi skor la dpyad gzhi'i lo khyus rig pa'ang nges par du rtogs dgos pa smos ci dgos/de ltar na'ang bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thad chos lugs kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel nas bshad pa sha stag las kher gtsang zhig rnyed du thed par brtend phan la sangs rgyas chos lugs grub mtha' ris med kyi chos 'byung dang lo rgyus ji snyed cig par skun byas yod kyang /ya thog zhang bod kyi rgyal gshen dang bod rgyal mo rong gi zhang rgyal gyi lo rgyus dam dum re las med pa de ni kub mtha'i phyogs lhung lta bur 'gyur gzhi dang / lhag par du bod 'dir chos lugs dang shes rig dar snga ba bon yin gshis rgyal gshen gyi lo rgyus ring ba dang / skabs der rgyal srid bon dang sgrung gis bzung zhes kyang grags pa dang / rje gnya' khri nas bzung rgyal rabs phal cher gyis bon chos bsten pas rje 'bangs kyi 'tshe ba dngos dang 'brel ba che tsam byung yod pa de dag gi gnas tshul la dpyad zhib bya rgyu dgos pa che ba dang / krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas nor mdzod nang bod kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus sogs gal che bar gyur pa'i don la brten nas/ lo rgyus 'di nyid rtsom pa'i khungs gtugs sa ni ban bon gnyis kyi lo khyus dang chos 'byung mkhas chen khag la gtugs pa las phyogs re ba tsam min pa ni/ ban bon chos 'byung ngam lo rgyus che ba phal mo che las gtso bo rtsom rnying 〈 rlangs kyi po ti bse ru〉dang / bka' thang sde lnga〉rdzu ma ṇi bka' 'bum〉ṭwāṃ padma bka' thang〉ṭwāṃ rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉ṭwāṃ bee ro'i rnam thar 'dra 'bag〉tshal pa'iṭwāṃdeb ther dmar po〉'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyi ṭwāṃ deb ther sngon po〉 spyal dbang lnga ba'i deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang brtsams pa'i chos 'byung me tog snying po pang rtsi'i bcud〉 mkhas pa lde'uyis mdzad pa'i ṭwāṃ spya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa〉 ston pa shākya thub pa'i rnam thar〉 blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i thu'u bkwan grub mtha'〉 brag sgom pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i 〈 mdo smad chos 'byung〉dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi deb ther dkar po〉 dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi bod gna' rabs kyi rig gnas chos lugs mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor〉 dpal 'byor bzang po'i〈 rgya bod yig tshang chen mo〉 sbas pa'i shod chen bco brgyad kyi ṭwāṃ rgyal mo rong gi gnas chen dmu rdo g.yung drung srungs rtse'i dkar chag rin chen 'azeng ba〉 mkhas chen dmu dge bsam gtan gyi bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long〉dang ṭwāṃmado smad lo rgyus las rgyal rong gi skor〉 thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i /rdad3 cherji po'i

srid lugs/〉 'jam dbyangs grags 'dzin gyi ṭwāṃ dpa' rtsal stobs ldan lagi'i grong〉 bod mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal〉 ṭwāṃ rdo ring parnyi ta'i rnam thar〉 bon gyi rgyal rabs mu tig 'phreng ba'i g.yung drung bon gyi bka' khams brgyad gtan la phab pa'i stong phrag brgya ba las chu chen nam mkha' rgyal po'i lo rgyus/ dpal tshul gyi g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'byung〉 'dzam gling gangs rgyal te se'i 〈 dkar chag tshangs dbyangs yid 'phrog〉 khyung po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal rabs bon gyi 'byung gnas〉 nam mkha'i nor bu'i spyo ya thog 'ang bod gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus〉 shar rdza bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi 〈 legs bshad rin po che'i gter mdzod〉 dpa' po gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉 slob zur bstan 'dzin rnam dag gi sgyu snga rabs bod kyi byung ba brjod pa'i 'beel gtam lung gi snying po〉 slob dpon bstan 'dzin rnam dag gi rgyal gshen rnam thar〉 bcas dpyad gzhi'i yig cha sum cu lhag la brten yod cing / de rnams phal cher rnying khungs yin pa la bzang ba'i khyad chos gang dang gang yod snyam na de ni da lta 'dzam gling gi lo rgyus zhib mjug mkhan yod do cog gis kyang lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed skabs 'das pa'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa las/ ma 'ongs pa'i lo rgyus zhes pa zhig ga la yod/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus la'ang ci tsam rnying ba'i lo rgyus la de tsam gyis mthong chen bgyi ba yin/ dper na/ lo brgya stong mngapo'i gong gi dngos tshus rdza chag dum bu dang gzi re rnyed kyang de rnams chag kha bsgrigs pa dang gzi rkang gzizlum ci yin dang gzi mig gi grangs kha mang nyung soṭa la rin thang ldan pa zhig tu brtsi ba ni rnying pa kun byin rlabs che bar brtsi ba min zhing / dngos zas de tsho zhib 'jug byas te skabs de'i mi'i lag rtsal sogs rig gnas dang phyi tshogs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i ched du red/ rang re bod kyi lo rgyus la cha bzhag na'ang lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi gong nas byung ba'i yig rigs mang po zhig tun hong zhes pa'i sa 'og nas thon pa la rgyal khab phyi nang gi rgyu mtshan shes mkhan kun gyis ches rin thang ldan pa zhig tu brtsi ba red/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang skabs de'i bod kyi khyi chogs hril po'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i ched du yin pa ma zad snga rabs zhang zhung dang 'ang bod kyi lo rgyus kyang mthong chen byas nas zhib 'jug byed bzhin yod pa red/spyir na rdo'i lag cha dang / rus pa dang / rdza chag dam dum la brten nas zhib 'jug byed pa las yig rigs la brten nas zhib 'jug byed bde ba ni shod ma dgos pa red/ spyir bod du grub mtha' 'dra min yod na yang khong rnam pa'i lo rgyus dang chos 'byung la rang res zhib tu bltas na grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin gyi skyon gyis lo rgyus su bslad skyon ma thebs pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa yin/lo rgyus 'di nyid brtsam pa'i khungs gtugs sa ni ban bon gnyis kyi lo rgyus khag la gtugs pa las/phyogs re ba tsam yang min pa ni mkhas pa rnams kyi snyan du grags pa'i gsungs gtsang ma dang / gtam brgyud ma nor ba dang / rgyal rabs dang chos lugs dang / sprags pa bon lugs/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' lung dang / rgyal po'i bka' chems/ so so skye bo'i bden pa'i ngag nas smra ba rnams 'dri bangang bstan bcos dri ma med pa las byung ba dang / de rnams kyi nang nas btus te nges don gtan la phab —— 4 —

khul byazlo sdu rdzu kyārdo /deb gsum du bgos nas dpe sgrun byed par bsam yang / gron dngul nyung bas deb gcig tu dpe sgrun byas yod/ de'i nang du sngon ya thog rgyal gshen bco brgyad dang rgyal phran bcu gnyis nas btsan po'i gdung rabs sogs kyi lo rgyus bkod pa dang / de las mched pa'i rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad kyi yul gru'i gnas stang dang / snga rabs bon chos kyi lo rgyus/ btsan po'i srid lugs/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos/ (glu gar rol mo/ chas gos rgyan cha/ mkhar brtsig bris cha/ bzo thub 'thag ris/rko bzo 'bur rdung / 'bag bzo lha 'cham/ rdo chas dang shing chas sogs kyi gna' sdas sogs/)rig gnas kyi dar so/ (skad dang yi ge/ sman dang rtsis kyi skor/ zhing 'debs dang phyugs skyong / chab srid dang 'thab rtsal/)yul srol gyi goms gshis sogs mngon gsal du bris yod la/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i rnam thar dang / de dang 'brel ba'i rgyal rong yul du nang bstan ji ltar dar tshul dang grub mtha'i phyogs slong gis 'khrugs rtsod byas tshul/ gzhan yang rje tsong kha ba chen po 'jig rten du byon nas ring lugs dri ma med pa dge ldan pa zhes grub mtha'i rnam pa bzhags nas thub bstan rgyas par mdzad tshul dang /de yi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu shar rgyal mo tsha ba rong du gang gang 'khrungs tshul/ de dag gis bod rgyal rong gi yu la gru chen po 'di na bka' gdams gsar ma ba'i ring lugs ji ltar spel pa'i mdzad rnam/ de dag la brten nas yul gshis kyi 'gyur ldog dang / rlabs chen gyi dmar dmag rgyang bskyod skabs nas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur nas da bar du dus rabs gsar ba'i yar rgyas kyi gnas lugs rnams bkod yo da do/ / bdag la skye thob kyi shes rab dang sbyang stobs kyi yon tan kun gyis dben pas na/ nor ba mi nyung ba yod srid par klog mkhan rnams kyis dag bcos byed rgyur bka' drin yang nas yang du zhu/

gleng gzhi/'jig rten gyi yul 'dir mi sde gang 'dra zhig yin rung dus 'gyur gyi mang du spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur ji snyed cig 'byung srid pa ni mi'i rigs kyi chos nyid yin la/ dus 'gyur dang 'brel yod mi rigs kyi shes rig dang / dus rabs kyi lo rgyus yang dag pa rnams ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyi nor du bcang dgos pa ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs tshang ma la 'khri ba'i las 'gan rlabs chen po zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ 'ga' zhig gi bsam par mes spyal la yul gru rgya che zhing mi grangs mang la lo rgyus grags che ba yin pa'i shes rig dang de dag gi lo rgyus skor la do snang byed dgos pa gal shin tu che snyam/ yin na'ang yul sde de tsam rgya mi che ba la mi grangs yang mi mang ba dang / grangs nyung mi rigs lta bu de dag gi lo rgyus kyang yongs su ma grags pa de 'dra'i rigs la do snang byed mi dgos so snyam nas gal chung du brtsi ba de ni nor 'khrul tshabs chen zhig yin pa gor ma chag rang re ni krung go sa rgya chen po 'di'i thog tu gnas pa'i mi rigs mang po yod pa'i spyal khab gcig gi mi rgyud du song tshe gling 'dir yod pa'i shes rig dang lo rgyus kyi skor thams cad do snang byed 'os pa yin/ de ni sa spya chen po 'di'i thog tu gnas pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs tshang ma la 'khri ba'i las 'gan bsgyur bkod mi btub pa zhig yin pa dang / lhag par du yul gru rgya chung zhing mi rigs grangs nyung gi lo rgyus las yongs su ma grags pa de'i rigs la do snang lhag tsam ma byas na de dag stong brlag tu 'byung sla zhing re zhig na mi rigs dang shes rig gi rnam pa gang 'dra zhig byung myong ba'i lo rgyus tsam yang shes dka' ba dang / de dag gi skor la yongs su bongs pa'i skabs nges par 'byung srid pa ni 'das pa'i lo rgyus dag gis mngon sum du bstan pa ltar yin/ de ltar na ris su ma chad pa'i mkhyen yon ldan pa kun gyis do snang lhag tsam du gnang dgos pa thin tu gal che/bod rigs kyi shes rig dang lo rgyus rnams kyang sa rgya chen po 'di'i thog tu yod pa'i mi'i rigs kyi shes rig dang lo rgyus shig tu song ba ma zad rin thang shin tu che zhing brlags par phangs pa'i shes rig rnam pa du ma zhig bzhugs pa kun gyi thugs la mnga' ba bzhin yin mod/ dus phyis bod mi'i shes rigs gnas stangs shin tu nyag phra ba'i skabs 'dir mkhyen yon ldan pa rnams kyis sgo kun nas bod mi'i snying nor chos dang / shes rig lo rgyus sogs ma lus pa nyams pa sor chud pa dang mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i thabs la 'bad brtson gnang dgos pa'ang shin tu gal che bar mthong zhing / bod mi'i gna' bo'i lo rgyus yang dgapa rnams la 'pho 'gyur mi shor ba dang / bod mi'i shes rig de ni bod mi tsam du ma zad sa rgya chen po'i thog tu gnas pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kun la sman thub pa'i rin thang dpag par dka' ba dang ldan pa 'is—— 7 —

yin mod kyang / de dag mi shes pa'i mun pa smag rum du gnas pa dag la blo gros kyi sgron me 'degs pa'i grogs su 'gyur ba dang / bod kyi shes rig lo rgyus dag gi 'byung khungs bod rang 'ang zhung la thug yod pa de dag mngon sum du gsal thub pa dang / bod kyi lo rgyus 'khyogs por smra ba la brten nas phring dag pa'i lo rgyus kyi khungs stor bar 'gyur ba'i nyen kha sel ba sogs dgos pa du ma'i ched du ngal ba spangs nas 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas bod rgyal rong zhes ya thog zhang spyal dang zhang bod kyi lo rgyus rags tsam bkod khul byas pa 'di ni deng skabs bod kyi rig par zhib 'jug gnang mkhan tshed las mkhas pa rnams dang /mi rigs rang nyid kyi lo rgyus shes 'dod skom pa chu sred ltar byed pa'i bod rigs shes yon can rnams la mkho gal ha cang che bar mthong ba bcas la/ bdag gis lo rgyus kyi dpe rnying 'di nyid 'bad brtson chen pos dpe sgrig dang par sgrun byed pa'i dgos pa rags bsdus tsam brjod pa lags/ de la gong rim gyi 'go 'dzin pa dang 'brel yod sde khag gis 'gro song sogs su rams 'degs chen po thob pa dang / phyogs gang gi thad nas byams brtses bskyangs pas bka' drin shin tu che ba ni smos ma dgos so/ /

le'u dang po/ bod rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang gnas yul dus rabs la dpyad pa/spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung tshul skor la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig yod mod/ deng sang 'dzam gling gi mkhas pa phal mo ches 'dod tshul ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung tshul gyi khungs dang lte ba lta bu ni 'dzam gling sa yi yang rtse gangs chen mo te se'i brgyud nas rim bzhin chad pa yin zhes pa'i 'dod pa ltar na/ri bo chen po de'i nye 'gram du 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i bod kyi mi rigs de ni gdod ma'i mi rigs byung ba nas bzung yul spu 'di nyid du bca' sdod byas yod pa'i mi rigs zhig yin pa smos ma dgos pa zhig red la/yongs grags sprel srin las byung ba ltar na'ang yul gru 'di nyid du byung yod pa de bas kyang gsal por bstan yod/ bod rigs ni rang re'i krung go'i spyal khab kyi lho nub rgyud du gnas shing de gar 'tsho sdod byed pa'i bod rigs kyi mes po rnams dang rgya rigs bar spyi lo'i sngon lo ngo sum stong yar sngon nas 'brel ba byung yo da do/ /gangs kyi rgyal po te se zhes bya ba/ /gangs mthon mthing ga rgyal mo zhes kyang zer/ /chu bo bzhi yang de yi rmang nas 'babs/ / lhun gyis grub pa 'i mchod rten gzugs su gnas/ / lan gsum bskor na mtshams med lnga yang 'dag / ngan song gsum du mi skye mtho ris thob/ / gtan tshig de'i phyir gangs kyi rgyal po zhes/ /thog mar zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum zhes/ /phug te zhang zhung rgyal gshen bco brgyad de/ /bar la dbus gtsang lho byang kun tu shes/ / sgo desum pa gling gi gyim shod du/ / sbas pa'i shod chenabaco brgyad rgyal mo rong / / sa kung 'ang zhung mi rnams zhang zhung grags/ / bar dus stod kyi mnga' ris smor gsum dang / /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yan lag thams cad sogs/ /smad du mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug ces/ /tha mar dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha dang / /mdo stod de ni mi yi chol kha dang / /mdo smad rnams la rta yi chol kha zer/ / gangs chen bod de khams sam mdo smad dbus/ / shar ngos chu bzhi sgang drug la chags te/ / ru dza sgang dang tsha sgang smar khams sgang / / spor 'bor sgang dang rabs sgang rma rdza sgang / /jul chu zla chu 'bri chu rma chu'i rgyud/ /tsha rong kong rong stag rong rgyal mo rong / /rong bzhi shod brgyad khos dgu grags pa la/ /mi rgyud dbra 'bru ldong gsum sgo dang bzhi/ /nu bo dpal zla gnyis dang mi cho drug /zhang zhung skad rigs ngam yang bsdus na ni/ / phug pa'i skad dang sgo pa'i skad dang gnyis/ / bar ba'i skad dang phal ba'i skad bzhi las/ / 'ang zhung smar gyi skad de sgo pa'i skad/ / stod smad dpu /se1 'ol

gsum skad dang bzhi/ /btsan po stag gzig gnyis dang mi tsho drug /g.yor po sum pa 'a zha mi nyag bzhi/ /chen po hor sogs gnyis dang mi tsho drug /de ltar mi tsho drug gsum bcu brgyad /sa/ /chad de de las de grol mi rgyud rigs/ /gling dang cha gar zing sogs bha ra hor/ /mi nyag ku ru spu gur yu gur dang / /'a zha gru gu chung dang g.yor po'i yul/ / 'jang mo mig rgya rtsa mi shing mi sogs/ / de rjes sgom sde dre hor sde dge gling / / mgo log a mdo rgyal rong lho mi nyag / snar khams nyag rong brag g.yab go 'jo dang / /'ba' tang li thang tsha rong lho shod khams/ /grangs mang yul la rgyal rje'ang sna tshogs byung / /smad kyi mdo khams sgang drug zhing ltar zhes/ / skabs rer chol kha gsum zhes mdo stod smad/ / gnyis phyis bod kyi khongs su brtsis pa'ang 'dug /phyis ni phal cher rgya sogs kyis dbang bsgyur/ /skad de bod kyi cha ru phal cher gtogs/ /yig skad 'bod stangs cung las gcig nyid do/ / rgya gar rgya nag bod dang zhang zhung skad/cung zad 'dres ma rgyal mo rong gi skad/ /phal skad khyi khog gcig kyang zer lugs mang / /yi ge rdzab yig gshar yig dkar nag dang / / yig gzugs gzab chen gzab chung 'bru rdzob rigs/ / yig ngo gsal byed sum cu dbyangasdu bsdi sogs/ / bu yig bcu bcas 'phul yig bzhi bcu ni/ / sngon nas zhang bod khams zhikṣiṃ ༵ /nga rnakā rtersha/ bo/da mi'i 'byung khungs/bod kyi lo rgyus rnams nas bskal ba ya thog tu sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' bcas 'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma 'dus pa las/ srid pa'i sgo nga chen po gcig tu srid pa dang / de las rim bzhin sgo nga chen po bco brgyad byung ba'i nang nas/ sgo nga gcig las bod kyi mi rigs byung tshul bshad yod pa red/ nga chos spyir btang 'gro ba mi'i byung tshul de 'dra zhig yin pa dang de dang 'brel yod bod kyi mi rigs thog ma'i byung tshul de tsam du thag bcad dka' na'ang / bod mis lo grangs sum stong lhag gi gong rol nas srid pa'i rnam ba'ag 'di tsam byed nus pa'i blo stobs ldan pa'i tshul des bod rigs ni gna' dus kyi mi brgyud cig yin pa ma zad/ shes rig dang ldan pa'i mi brgyud cig yin pa'i mngon rtags gsal por bstan gyi yod pa red/ mi rigs 'di yi thog ma'i rig gnas dang lag rtsal byung dus kyi skor la dus tshod nges bstan zhig da phan 'khod yod pa ma mthong na'ang / lo sum stong brgyad brgya'i sngon lhag gi dus su zhang zhung yul du gshen rab mi bo che 'khrungs pa dang / des bon dang rig gnas spel tshul la bltas na lo bzhi stong yas mas kyi sngon la mi'i rigs yod pa ma zad rig gnas kyang gang 'tsham zhig dar yod pa rtogs thub/ ces gsungs pa ni lo sum stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam gyi gong du bshad pa'i dpe rgyun rnams la zhib 'jug byas pa'i snying don ha cang ya mtshan po zhig red/ de ltar rang re rnams kyi lo rgyus yun ring dang ldan pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus la 'ib 'jug byed tshe/ ya thog dus rabs gsum dang ma thog dus rabs bzhi ru phye nas 'di dus rabs bdun la zhib 'jug byas na da gzod tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lo rgyus kyi snyingashaṃ na ༵ kau thub kyi red snyam/

gnyis pa/ ya thog zhang bod kyi mi rigasaji ltar byung tshul/zla gzhon lan brgya bzhus pa'i khu bas byugs pa'i man shel gyi lhun po'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba lta bu'i gangs ri'i 'dab ma kho ra 'khor yug kun tu 'khrigs shing / 'dzin ma'i steng 'og kun tu rin po che sna tshogs kyis gtams pa'i yul gru chen po 'dir gnas pa'i skye bo rnams la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang dge mtshan mang po 'dzoms shing / snyan pa'i dza rnga phyogs kyi bu mos brdungs bas 'dzam gling hril po'i khyon 'dir skye bo rnams kyis kyang bsngags pa'i ba dan g.yo sa te se gangs kyi 'dab rol du chags pa'i mi'i 'gro ba rnams kyi rigs rus cho 'brang ni mchog tu 'dzin par byed cing / sngon byon pa rnams kyi gtam dang deb ther du kha ba can dang / gangs can pa/ zhang zhung / bho ṭa/ bon/ bod la sogs pa'i ming gis 'bod srol yod pa dang / deng gi dus rabs 'dir kun gyi snang ngor brtan 'jags su gyur pa dang rjod par byed pa'i tha snyad la ni bod rigs zer ba 'di bzhin no/ /bod rigs zhes pa'i mi rigs 'di ni rigs lnga bcu nga drug 'dus pa'i krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun spyal khab kyi khyim tshang chen mo 'di'i nang gi grub cha gcig yin zhing lo rgyus ha cang ring la dge mtshan ha cang mang po ldan pa'i mi rigs shig ste/ da lta chags yul gtso bo ni bod dzongs dang / mcho sngon/ si khron/kan su'u/ yun nan bcas zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs lnga'i sa khul yin la/ shin cang rang skyong ljongs kyi lho phyogs su'ang bod kyi rigs rus cho 'brang ga'an dang ma 'dres par gnas pa'ang yod/ de yang gnas yul gcig mthun dang skad rigs gcig mthun/ dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba gcig mthun/yig rigs gcig gis mtshon ba'in yod pa'i bsam blo'i kun slong gcig mthun bcas gcig mthun ba'i ldan du spub pa'i rtsa ba'i gzhung dang mthun par grub pa'i bdag nyid can yin zhing / 'das pa'i lo rgyus ring mo'i nang gcig mthun bzhi ldan gyi mi rigs shig tu grub yod/ de'i skor la si tā len gyi mi rigs kyang lo rgyus kyi snang tshul yod tshad dang mtshungs te/ 'gyur ldog gi chos nyid gyisaskul 'ded gtong ba'in yod par brten/ de la'ang thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lo rgyus ldan no/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bod rigs la'ang thog mar byung ba'i go rim dang / bar du gnas pa'i go rim/ mtha' mar 'jig pa'i go rim bcas rang gi lo rgyus kyi dus rabs re re bzhin legs par zhib 'jug byas na da gzod tshan rig dang mabun pa'i lo rgyus gyi snying don de rnyed thub kyi red snyam gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes/ bod khams spyi dang khyad par mdo smad rgyal rong gi lo rgyus yang dag pa zhig dgos par byed pa la chu chen rab brtan nam mkha'i rgyal po'i lo rgyus 'tshol dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar na mdo khams rgyal rong gi lo rgyus de bon nas byung bas bon gyi 'byung khungs zhang zhung yin phyir de nas mgo brtsam dgos pa red/ rlangs dpal gyi seng ge'i zhal nas/ lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na/ nags khung gi spre'u 'dra/ mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'brug zol ma 'dra/ yab mes kyi che dge yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phrug yal bor dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs pa ltar na rgyal mo rong gi lo rgyus ya thog ring po nas bzung 'ang bod kyi mi rgyud — 3 ge

las mched pa'i rus chen gyi gtso bo ni dzibase khyung spru’’zhes su grags pa de yin la/ 'on kyang skye bo 'ga' res rgyal mo rong gi mi cho bod ma red/ ku ru red zer mkhan yod par 'dug de la'ang rgyu mtshan yod pa red/ gang la zer na ku ru zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis yod/ dge bshes chos grags kyis brtsams pas ṭwāṃ bod rgya tshig mdzod〉 las ku ru zhes pa ni sa cha'i dbyibs snam bu'i rgyu sgrim byed lag cha 'phang lo'i dbyibs su shes dgos pa dang ku ru kha gsum zhes don gnyis la go dgos pa red/ yang dzi ku ru ṣe’ zhes de ni 〈 saṃ bod skad gnyis shan sbyar〉 las ku ru ṣe'am ku ru ni byos dang byos shig zhes pa de 'byo ba'i skul tshig ste snod gcig nas gcig tu blug pa'am gnas spos pa la zer zhing / de ltar na rgyal mo rong gi mi rgyud rnams zhang zhung nas mar gnas spos byas pa yin zer srol de ra 'phrod par 'dug go/gsum pa/ zhang zhung gi dus rabs ngos 'jin rags tsam byed pa/spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i lo grangs lnga bcu ba (1857)shing byi gcig dkar gyi lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che de nyid zhang zhung yu la du sku 'khrungs/skabs de zhang zhung gi rgyal po khri wer gser gyi bya ru can zer ba des zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum la dbang bsgyur byed cing yod pa dang / de nas rim bzhin rgyal rabs bco brgyad byung yo da pa de dag gis dus rim bzhin du dbang bsgyur byas yod pa dang dus mtshungs su gshen rab kyis bon dang rig gnas spel te yul 'dir bon gyi shes rig gis dbang bsgyur byed pa'i srol rgyun gyi brgyud pa la bon gyi bla rabs bco brgyad dang ring brgyud bla rabs nyer bzhi sogasabyung yod/ spyi lo'i sngon 417 pa'i shing byi lor gnya' khri 'khrungs pa ltar na de dag ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi bayan chad du byung yod par shes thub/ de rnams ni ya thog zhang zhung gis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i dus rabs su ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo tshe'i bdud khyab pa lag ring sogs bdud rnams 'dul dus su bod du thog mar zhabs bcags nas kong po phon ri sogs rgyal mo dmu rdo'i ri nas stong rgyung sogs bzhugs pa'i gdul zhing du gzigs par mngon no/ / ya thog zhang zhung gi bon dang de 'brel gyi rgyal rabs rnams su grags pa'i lorgyus tsam la brten nas nges shes gang zhig rnyed thub pa de tsam las/ gzhan lo grangs sum stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam brgal ba'i lo rgyus shig la nges pa rnyed pa'i thabs ci zhig kyang mi srid pa yin/ de ltar na'ang zhang zhung du ya thog gi bon nam rgyal rabs kyi brnyes pa de dang 'ang zhung thog ma'i mi rgyud kyi dbu brnyes pa 'di gnyis lo rgyus kyi gzhi rtsa'i thog nas 'dra thabs rtsa ba nas med pa zhig red/zhang zhung gi thog ma'i mi rgyud ji ltar byung yod pa'i tshul 'di ni zhang zhung ya thog gi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i tshe/ yin nges gsal por yod dgos pa zhig ni/ lo rgyus rmang gzhi thun mong ma yin pa de bon lugs su ji ltar grags pa'i lta stangs de las mi 'da' ba zhig dang / rmang ga'i de'i thog nas zhib 'jug gi rkang tshugs pa zhig dgos nges pa de red/ de 'dra zhig ma byung na lo rgyus tshig tshogs mang ba dang /lo rgyus kyi rnam grangs mang po ci 'dra 'ig yod kyang rung / lo rgyus kyi gzhi rtsa ngo ma de nyid rnyed pa'i skabs — 4 —

namayang mi srid cing / lo rgyus kyi snying don nam yang rin thang stong ba'i nyen kha mi 'byung ba'i nges pa ci zhig kyang med/ zhang zhung gi mi rgyud nang nas chad pa'i rus chen gyi gtso bo ni/ pha bso khyung spra’’ zhes su grags pa de yin la/ khyir stangs dzi bse khyung sbra’’ zhes pa de/ rdza la bso khyung zhes pa'i khyad chos kyi tshig sbyar ba'i zol 'dra zhig snang mod/ don sbra'i nang khungs su gtogs pa'i dus chen bye brag pa 'ga'i tha snyad cig yin la/ zhang zhung gi mi brgyud de dag gtso chen tshi khyung ’gi rus chen las gyes pa yin stabs yul la'ang khyung ste/ zhang zhung gi skad dzi zhung’’zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di byung yod pa ni gor ma chag rus chen gyi dbye 'ib mi 'dra ba ci dang ci lta bu zhig byas yod kyang rung / don du sbra'am khyung gi rus tshan las zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum mi brgyud rnams mched pa dang / seng dam/ sga'i rus tshan las/ 'a zha'i mi brgyud rnams mched pa dang / a sro ldong gi rus tshan las mi zhag gi mi brgyud rnams mched pa dang / stong gi rus tshan las sum pa'i mi brgyud rnams mched pa dang / gong du bshad pa ltar sbra'am khyung gi rus tshan las/ shar rgyal mo rong gi mi brgyud rnams mched pa'i shod tshul 'di ni yongs grags shig yin no/ /ya thog gi mi rabs ji ltar srid pa'i lo rgyus phal che ba zhig ni ya thog rdo ba'i dus rabs mi rgyud rnams nas bzung / phas bu la brgyud cing bus tsha bo dang yang tsha la brgyud pa'i ngag rgyun tsam la brten nas ya thog gi lo rgyus rnams brgyud pa yin la/ lo rgyus kyi bye brag de rnams mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dbu brnyes pa'idus skabs nges can rnams su yi ge btab nas rim gyis dar rgyas pa'i tshul 'di ni 'jig rten gyi khams kunal ches thun mong ba'am yongs khyab can gyi chos nyid cig yin/ rang res ya thog zhang zhung gi mi rgyud ji ltar byung yod pa'i tshul la dpyad pa zhig byed pa'i skabs 'dir yang / rang bzhin gyi chos nyid de dang 'bral thabs med pa zhig yin par shes pa dang de dang 'brel yod kyi sgo nas ya thog gi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug gyed dgos pa 'di ni zhib 'jug gi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi med thabs med pa zhig red/ya thog gi dus su gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs chen po 'di nyid mi ma yin gyi 'go ba rigs mi 'dra ba mang dag gis dus yun ches ring po zhig tu dbang bsgyur byas yod pa'i skor/ gna' bo'i lo rgyus rnams gyi snying don gal gnad che ba'i dpe 'gar 'khod yod pa las gsal bor bstan pa ni 〈 rgyal po bka' thang〉las/ dang po gnod sbyin nag pos dbang byas te/ / yul ming bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu btags/ /snga drags gnyen po btsan pa de nas byung / /de nas bdud dang srin mos dbang byas te/ /ming yang lha srid gnyis kyi yul du btags/ / snga drags sha za gdong ba dmar po byung / / de nas klu dang btsan gyis dbang byas te/ / yul gyi ming la bod yul gling dgur btags/ / snga drags dkar bu chu la sbyod pa byung / / de nas ma sangs spun dgus dbang byas te/ / yul ming bon khams g.ya' dug bya bar btags/ / snga drags mda' mdung mtshon cha de nas byung / / zhes pas/ gnod sbyin dang / bdud srin/ klu btsan/ ma sangs rnams kyis rim bzhin du dbang byas yod par gsal ba dang / de dang phyogs 'dra ba zhig ni mkhas pa lde'u mjod pa'i 〈 rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa〉las/ dang po /nod sbyin

nag po zhes bya ba byung ste/ /yul gyi ming yang bzang yu rgyan med bya bar btags/ /lag char mda' gzhu 'phen pa de nas byung / /gnyis pa re lde mgo g.yag bdud kyis byas/ /yul gyi ming yang bdud yul gling dgu zer/ / sta re dgra sta dus der lag char byung / / gsum pa gnya' reng phrag med srin gyis byas/ /yul gyi ming yang nag po dgu 'dus zer/ / lag char srin mo rkang dang snyogs gnyis byung / / bzhi ba dmar 'jam zhes bya lha yis byas/ / yul gyi ming ni lha yul gung thang zer/ / lag char kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum de nas byung / / lnga ba 'dres dbang byas pas lang tang zer/ / lag char rgyug pa skyog can de nas byung / /drug pa ma sangs ru dgus dbang byas te/ /yul gyi ming ni bon khams g.yang drug zer/ /lag char dong rul phub chung de nas byung / /bdun pa klu yi dbang byas bod khams gling dgur btags/ /brgyad pa mi ma yin gyis dbang byas te/ / yul gyi ming ni ngam yul nag por btags/ / zhes pa ni gnod sbyin dang /bdud dang / srin po dang / lha dang / 'dre dang / ma sangs dang / klu dang / mi ma yin rnams kyis rim bzhin du dbang byas par gsal la/ ma sangs ru dgu zhes pa las/ de la ma sangs ru dgu zer yang / ma sangs ru brgyad dang g.yang 'brum si le ma dang dgu'o/ /ma sangs ru brgyad ni/ gnyan ma sangs g.ya' sgrung skyes gcig dang gcig gar ma sangs gtso gar skyes kyi sdig nam tshang dang gnyis/ gnyan ma sangs ngan lam rtsang skyes dang gsum/ tub ma sangs tho gar skyes dang bzhi/ she ma sangs thod dkar nam tshang dang lnga/ me ma sangs pad ma skyes kyi snying nam tsha dang drug mi ma sangs rgya mtsho skyes kyi dra nga 'gur dang bdun/ od ma ma sangs ston nam tsha dang brgyad ces gsal ba rnams yin la/ ma sangs kyi gong du byung ba de dag ni mi ma yin kho na yin stabs/dus skabs de dag tu da dung gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs chen po 'dir mi'i 'gro ba byung med cing /ma sangs ni mi'i 'gro ba dang shin tu nye ba'i 'gro ba zhig yin tshul gna' bo'i lo rgyus mang po las byung ba bzhin dus de tsam zhig na mi'i 'gro ba byung yod srid pa ste ma sangs spun dgu'i nang tshan mi ma sangs rgya mtsho skyes zhes dos mi'i snyad bstan pa dang / 5 od ma’’ zhes pa'i tshig de'ang phal cher 5 od mi zhes bya ba yin las che ba rnams kyis kyang bag tsam zhig shes thub pa yin/ rang re la lo rgyus kyi gzhi rtsa'i skor nges shes yod nges pa zhig ni/ lo grangs sum stong brgyad brgya lhag gi gong der byon myong ba'i gshen rab mi bo che des bstan pa'i g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa byung yo da pa de nas bzung / ya thog zhang zhung gi thog ma'i lo rgyus kyi dbu brnyes pa de yin la/ 'ang zhung ni gangs ri chen po te se'i khog pa'i nang gi snying ltar du chags yod stabs/ zhang zhung thog ma'i lo rgyus ji snyed cig yod pa de ni gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs chen po 'di'i lo rgyus phyogs kun nas mtshon thub pa smos ci dgos/ bon gyi lo rgyus rnams la yongs su grags pa zhig ni bskal ba ya thog gi snod bcud rnams srid pa klong gi sgo nga las grol tshul gyi bshad pa mang du yod pa de rigs red/ de'i tshul bon gyi dpe rnying mang dag las gsal ba ni/ dang po ci yang med pa stong pa'i dbyings las 'byung ba'i khams dang nus pa tshogs pa'i rdul phran gyi phung po las/ srid pa klong gi — 6 —

sgo nga zhig grub cing de las lha dang klu dang gnyan gsum gyi srid pa ste/ de gsum gyis gnam dang sa dang bar snang gi khams la brten pa'i snod bcud rnams mtshon la/ gnyan nam ma sangs kyi rigs las rim gyis mi'i 'gro ba rnams grol ba'am mched par bshad pa'i lugs 'di ni ches grags che ba'i bon gyi lta stangs thun mong ma yin pa zhig red/ lta stangs de nyid mtshon pa'i lung khyad par can zhig ni bod kyi yig rnying 〈rlangs kyi po ti bse ru〉 las/ 'byung ba sna lnga'i snying po las/ sgo nga chen po gcig yong ba/ phyi'i sgong shun la lha brag dkar po chags/ nang gi sgong chu la dung martsa dkar mor 'khyil/ bar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha la/ rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ sgo nga phrum gyi bco brgyad chags/ sgo nga bco brgyad 'bring ba de/ dung sgong gcig tu yar nas byung / de ni smon pa'i mi bo lum lum yin/ zhes sgo nga'i phrum gyi sgo nga bco brgyad byung ba de dag las yul chen po bco brgyad kyi snod bcud rnams chags pa dang / lhag par du dung sgong gcig las zhang bod mi brgyud kyi mes chen po smon pa'i mi bo lum lum zhes bya ba de byung zhing / de las rim bzhin zhang bod kyi mi brgyud rnams mched tshul bstan yod pa de red/ de bas gsal bor dgos na bla chen dran pa nam mkhas mdzad pa'i ṭwāṃ sgra 'grel〉 la gzigs/ spyir btang du mi'i 'gro ba las/rnam pa dang / rang bzhin/ gnas tshul/ khams dang dbang po'i nus shugs sogs tha dad pa'i skye 'gro de rigs la mi ma yin zhes zer srol yod/ mi ma yin zhes pa'i skye 'gro de rigs mi srid pa zhig gtan nas ma red la/ mi las tha dad pa'i skye 'gro yod par ngos 'dzin pa de ni nam rgyun du rmongs dad kyis lha dang 'dre ru bzung ba'i kun rtog gi spros pa dang gzhi rtsa nas 'dra thabs med/ dper na/ nga ches dgong mor nam mkha' dwangs pa'i ngogs su bltas pa yin na/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang nyi khyim gyi rigs grangs bgrang bar mi nus pa zhig rang re'i dbang pos mngon sum du mthong thub/ da dung nga tshos gtan nas mthong mi thub pa'i rgyu skar dang / nyi khyim gyi grangs ni de dag las kyang mang ba ni bshad mi dgos/ nyi khyim dang rgyu skar ji snyed cig yod pa de dag tu rigs mi 'dra ba 'byung ba'i nus shugs dang / khams dang de 'brel dbang po dang nus stobs sogs mi 'dra ba'i sems can gyi rigs kyang ji snyed cig yod nges pa ni tshad mas grub pa dang / skye 'gro de dag gi khrod du blo nus pa dang / yon tan gyi khyad chos sogs rang re spraṭwāṃ ༵/zlo ṭwāṃsna ṭwāṃsdu ༵ ṭwāṃ~X ༵ ṭwāṃsna pa/ 'am dman pa'iganas tshul mi 'dra ba grangs kyis mi langs pa zhig yod skye 'gro su zhig gi khams dbang dang blo'i nus pa sogs rang re mi'i 'gro ba las lhag pa dang / de dag gi bsam spyod sogs rang re las mchog tu gyur pa'am/ legs pa'i cha du ma dang ldan pa zhig yin na/de la lha zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa dang / nga tsho mi'i 'gro ba las blo nus sogs dman pa dang / bsam spyod rnams ngan zhing rtsub pa/ nyes pa'i cha du ma dang ldan pa zhig yin na de la 'dre zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa ste/bzang ngan gnyis la ltos nas lha dang 'dre'i tha snyad byed srol yod pa de ni rnam kun rmongs dad kyi ngos lha 'dre gdon bgegs su 'dzin pa'i lta phyogs dang rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba 'ig yin stabs/—lha/7 'dre'i lta

phyogs tsam la mi 'dod pa'i gu dog byed dgos pa gang yang med/ des na lha las mi ru chad ces pa de thos byung du gnam nas sa la babs pa'i don zhig min la/ mi ma yin las mi ru chad pa'i skor gna' bo'i lo rgyus rnams su bshad yod pa de dag gi don la nga chos bsam gzhig nan po zhig byas na/ rigs lam dang mi mthun pa gang yang med pa'ang shes thub pa yong /(1)zhang podashā mi rgyad rnams mched tshul/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru〉las/ yu ma chulcag rgyal mo khab tu bzhes pa'i sras ni/ lha sras phyi gtsug rgyal ba zhes kyang bya/ srid bu 'dod tsam zhes kyang bya/ 'phrul sras dbang ldan zhes kyang bya/ des dung za dngul mo khab tu bzhes pa'i sras la bko sras skyes shig de'i sras smra mi rabs mched gsum lags/de rnams ni mi la lhar ming btags pa ni srid pa mi rabs mched dgu ni mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu yin 'dug 'di rnams kyi lha'i thugs las grol ba'i sras yin/ mched gsum gyi chung ba phyar rje stag tsha 'al 'ol yin/ lha rabs srid pa'i tha chung de/ mi rabs srid pa'i mgo bo yin/ des 'tshams za khyad khyud ma khab tu bzhes pa'i sras ni/ srid pa lha rabs mched bzhi zhes kyang bya/ mgo gsum tsha zhes kyang bya/de nas mi brgyud du grol ba ni/ sras 'o de gung rgyal/ skas mkhan pa'i yab lha brda drug khri de gsum po/tsha grangs shing dkar po bzhi yin/ yab lha brda drug gis lha sras mo khab tu bzhes pa'i sras/ lha tsha mched sras dgu yod/ snyan mo khab tu bzhes pa la/ snyan tsha mched dgu yod/ rma thang bzhes pa la/rmu tsha mched dgu yod/ lar sras pho sum cu so lnga yod/ de rnams kyi chung ba ste/ sne khrom lag khra des lha lcam dkar mo bzhes pa'i sras ni pha rgyalapo/ des lung kha hril mo khab tu bzhes pa'i sras rgyal bu mthing ge 'thing po/ mthing gnyis gsum du yong / rgyal po mthing ges lha lcam dkar mo khab tu bzhes pa'isras/bod 'byong la brangs/ rmu za mthing sgril ma khab tu bzhes pa'i sras/ rgyal khri la zham/ de'i sras rgyal po che chung gsum dang rgyud brgyad du yo nga / mthing mo khab du bzhes pa la mthing phrug hor srid/ hor la o bo'i hor rabs mched gsum gyes/ 'byong la bram gyi sras/ bor rje/ khri rje/ khri rje thang po/ rje khri rje thang snyan/ bor rje khri rje gtso 'dus/ khri rje thang snyan gyi sras/ a nye mu zi khri to chen po des snyan za sha mig ma khab tu bzhes pa las sras gsum 'khrungs pa la/ che ba spos chu ldong / de 'og se khung dbra/chung ba a lcags 'gru/ dmu za lha mo khab tu bzhes pa 'i sras/ dmu tsha dga'/ brag srin gdong dmar mo khab tu bzhes pa'i sras dbal zla gnyis/ mi chen grol ba'i rgyud gzhir 'khrungs so/ / che ba spos chu ldong / ldong la nga che bco brgyad/ rus chen bco brgyad/ smyug po ldong gi che drug btsun drug yo da/de 'og se khung dbra/ dbra la dkar nag khra gsum yod/ dbra dang po rgyud kyi che dgu/ lha dbra srug po mched bcu/ dgu 'bum dbra'i mched drug yod/ de 'og a lcags 'gru/ 'gru la bu dgu byung / mi 'gyur thar pa'i gnas brgyud yod/ de 'og dmu tsha dga' la dar ma mched bdun yod/ de 'og dbal zla gnyis8/ shaṃl chen mtshams su yo da pas/ bod mi'u gdung drug gi 'khrungs lugs/ da lar gyis/

bod kyi mi'u gdung drug la bshad na ming che ba dang / bzung nas bos na ming mi snyan pa med ces gsal bas 'di dag gis ya thog srid pa klong gi sgo nga las smon pa'i mi lum lum byung ba nas bzung 'ang bod gna' mi'i brgyud khungs mi'u gdung drug tu grags pa de dag gi bar dus rim ji tsam zhig bgal yod pa dang /ya thog zhang bod rdo ba'i dus rabs kyi mi brgyud kyang du ma zhig byung myong yod nges pa'i tshul rnams gna' rabs lo rgyus kyis gsal bar bstan pa ltar/ zhang bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig rdzas gzi'i rigs mi 'dra ba sna chogs pa dang / de 'brel dus phyis dbus gtsang dang mdo smad brag mgo'i sa khul dang rgyal mo rong gi sa khul nas/ gna' mi'i rus sgrom dang de 'brel gyi rig rdzas ci rigs cig sa 'og nas thon pa de dag gis bden dpang gyed du yod pa de red/(2)gdod ma'irig dngos/gnad don der yang dag pa'i nges pa rnyed pa gdod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi rig dngos nas dbye zhib byas na/1978 lor chab mdo sa khul kha rong zhes pa'i sa cha nas rdo chas gsar ba'i rnyigs shul gzhi rgya mi chung ba zhig btsal rnyed byung ba gdod ma'i khang ro nyi shu rtsa baspyad dang / rdo chas la rdo gri dang rdo sta la sogs pa sna tshogs dang / rdza chas la phor ba dang bcas pa'i rdo snod rigs mi 'dra ba/ rus chas la mdzes shing yid snang 'gro ba'i rgyan cha dang / rno zhing phra la ring thung 'tshams pa'i khab dang smyu gu bcas lo ngo 4700 lhag sngon gyi rig dngos phyi rabs pa'i mthong lam du gyur pas/ gna' shul de'i thog nas bod mi rnams sa cha gtan 'khel gyis gnas sdod byas pa dang / de bzhin du rdo chas gsar pa'i dus rabs nas mdo khams spyal rong gi ri lung kun tu mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho gnas skye 'phel yod pas/ 1983 lor 'bar khams rdzong rdzong 'bur gzhung lam skun dus lam las pa chos rus sgrom che chung gnyis rnyed pa'i lhan du gzi'i rigs rkang ring ba'i gzi mig can gnyis yod kyang bod kyi lam bzo ba gcig gis khyer song ba red/ rus sgrom chung ba de lo ngo lnga stong yan chad dang che ba de lo ngo khri tsho yar sngon gyi mi'i rigs kyi shul rus dang / chu chen rdzong sru dam zhes pa'i sa cha nas rdo sgam dur sbas du ma rnyed pa'i rdo leb la bon gyi snying po rnam gsum gyi gzungs brkos ma yod pa dang / yang 'bar khams rdzong kyom kyo'i kho nu dang bro shon zhes pa'i sa cha nas gong bzhin rdo sgam dur sbas du ma btsal rnyed byung ba ma zad gdod ma'i khang ro bcu phrag kha shas dang rdzo chas bsregs sa ga'i spya mi chung ba zhig rnyed byung / 1956 lor nyi khri rdzong brgyad gcig grong brdal gyi phug grong sde'i lho phyogs su gnas pa'i las khungs dang dmag dpung rnams kyis sa rko dus rim ba'in du dur khrod brgya lhag tsam gsar rnyed byung / de'i bzo sgrun byed thabs ni dur khung gi dbyibs gru bzhi nar mo'i dbyibs dang dur sgrom gyi phyogs gnyis gru bzhi'i dbyibs kyi rdo brtsigs te/ phyogs gnyis kyi rtser rdo leb kyis phan tshun brtsegs nas thog tu rdo leb kyis bkab pa/ zhabs la gnad med pa dur khung gi ring tshad dang stod smad kyi zheng tshad dur khrod srung gnyar byed lugs kyi rus sgrom cha tshang gnas par gan rkyal du sbas shing / sngas 'go'i phyogs rdza chas sogs 'jog lugs ni dbu gtsang mdo smad rgyal mo rong sogs la gadzeega~X datram̐bs

'dra mtshungs yin nas ma tshad dur khrod kyi bzo skrun byed thabs 'dra ba yin/ gna' shul de'i thog nas bod mi rnams bon dang shes rig gtan 'khel gyi gnas sdod/ zhing las gtso gnyer thog sgo phyugs gso 'ing rngon pa gyed pa'i don dngos mtshon pa dang / lag shes bzo las kyi lag rtsal yang chu tshad nges can zhig tu glebs yod pa ni mthong gsal lags/ de'i thog nas spyi tshogs kyi las bgos chen po gnyis pa yongs su grub pa dang / ma brgyud spyi chegs kyi 'phel rgyas de rtse mor son yod cing / zhing las dang rngon pa la sogs pa'i 'gan 'bab che ba'i thon skyed kyi rnam pa 'phel rgyas ji cher 'gro skabs/ shugs las che ba rnams mang che ba skyes pas 'gan khur dgos pas rim bzhin dus ma ring bar pha brgyud kyi spyi chogs su smrebs rgyu ni smos ma dgos/ pha rgyud kyi spyi tshogs nang rim bzhin sger sems kyi snang tshul byung ba dang /de dang 'brel dbul phyug gi dbye ba'ang ngang gis byung zhing / thon skyed gsar pa de'i 'og phyug po rnams rang gi bdag dbang yod pa'i rgyu nor dag gzhan lag tu mi shor ba'i ched/ phyug po khag mnyam 'brel gyis rang nor srung ba'i mi ched mngags sgrig btsugs byas nas/ mtshon cha beed spyad de pha rol rgol ba ni dmag mi'i thog ma'i 'byung khungs su gyur/ zhang bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig rjos gzi'i rigs skum po stag log dang rkang ring dang khra chung bcas mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa red/ gna' bo'i dus su mi tshos gzi'i rigs de dag rgyan cha'i ched du bzos pa'am/ mi tshos rgyan du 'dogs kyi yod med shes par dka' na yang / deng dus kyi dngul ltar rin thang ga'al thub pa'i dngos po zhig yin pa ni de dag la chu mig gi grangs mang nyung dang ri mo'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa las shes thub kyi yod/ gzi ni bod kyi yul kho nar byung ba'i dngos po khyad par can zhig red/ de'ang gna' dus kyi bod mi tsho'i mdzod khang nas 'thon pa'am mang zhig ni sa 'og nas rnyed pa dang / yul 'ga' shas su grong shul dang zhing kha sogs nas rnyed pa yang yod/ dper na nga rang lo na chung dus su nga yi a ma'i deng sang 'bar khams rdzong gi khongs gtogs brag bar yu la tsho skon to grong sde'i zhing kha nas snga phyis su gzi zlum stag log can dang chu mig gsum can gnyis rnyed pas nga la ske rgyan byed myong / de min go thos su mdo khams rgyal rong gi phyogs gzhan dag la gna' mi'i rus sgrom nang nas rnyed pa dang / skabs 'gar grong shul dang ri bo mthon po'i rud shul nas rnyed pa sogs mi nyung ba thos myong ba red/ 'on kyang de tsho la ya mtshan dgos pa yang yod pa ma red/ci'i phyir zer na/ lo grangs sum stong lhag tsam 'das pa'i dus su byung ba'i zhang zhung gi rgyal po grags che ba de dag gi rgyal sa dang / dus skabs de dag gi yul grong phal mo che ni deng dus grong shul tsam mam/mang 'ig gi grong shul yang mi mngon pa de 'dra yin pas gna' dus kyi bod mi'i yul grong rnams la chags 'jig mang du byung yod pa ni bshad ma dgos/ spyir btang yul gang 'dra zhig yin rung ri bo dang sgang dang gshongs sogs yul gyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa de tsho'i 'byung rkyen ni/ gna' bo'i dus skabs rnams su rud chen po byung ba'am sa g.yos chen po byung ste/ ri bo dang sgang dang gshongs sogs su gyur cing der rtsi shing dang nags tshal skyes nas yu la gyi bkod dbyibs sna chogs yong gi yod pa ltar/ bod — 10 —

yuladu ri bo mthon po mang du yo da pa de tsho'ang / gnas tshul de dang 'brel ba che zhing dus skabs de dag tu bor brlags song ba'i bod kyi gna' mi de tsho'i dngos po gzi la sogs pa deng dus ri bo chen po'i khrod nas kyang rnyed pa'i skabs srid kyi yod pa red/ gnas tshul des bod kyi mi rigs ni rgya dkar nag sogs kyi mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang phyogs kun nas mtshungs pa bskal ba ya thog nas byung ba'i mi rigs dang zhang bod kyi mi rgyud cig yin pa'i bden dpang gsal bor gyed thub kyi yod pa red/le'u gnyis pa/ ya thog zhang rgyal zhes grags pa'i don tshul/dang po/ zhang0la zhes pa'i nang don/zhang rgyal zhes pa'i don ni rgyal rong gi mi rgyud rnams zhang zhung nas mched pa'i don yin pas/ sum pa glang gi gyim shod shod chen sbas pa'i bco brgyad du grags so/ / de yang / shar phyogs rgyal mo rong chen gyi/ / sbas pa'i rong bzhi shod chen bco baspyad la/ / 'gro don dus gyi sa rtags rim pa gsum/ / sbas pa'i yul der shing khang nyul nyil chags/ / ri klung kun la mi yi gang ba'i tshe/ / zas su ri dwags sha khrag srog la 'tsho/ / de dus sbas pa'i rnal 'abhor re 'ga' yis/ / gnas chen la 'grim bsgrub pa'i tshad ma 'byung / / sangs rgyas mtshan zhes rna bar thos tsam 'gyur/ / de 'og sa gzhir glegs bam gtor 'dra'i gseb/ / rdo mkhar skya ngo khrom tshogs 'dus 'dra yod/ / de dus nges med bon chos gang mang srid/ /gsas khang 'thab khang 'dres ma mang du 'byung / / de min mu ge dmar nag mi phyed 'chi/ / de dus rdo mkhar dkar po tshon gyis bsgyur/ /gdung brgyud rgyal po gdung rus sil bur 'chor/ /lung pa re la yul gyi dpon 'go re/ /nang 'khrugs mna' sdig mthu dug sprin ltar gtibs/ /de la stong rgyung sprul pa mngon myur ba'i/ / drung mi ha ra zhes bya rnal 'byor zhig / sbas pa'i yul der 'byon nas 'gro don mdzad/ /zhes 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis gsungs so/ /gangs chen bod kyi shar phyogs ye smon rgyal mo nas rje yab lha brdal drug gis 'ang bod kyi mi rgyud nas mched pa'i spyal mo dmu rdo'i phyogs bzhir rong chen bzhi la sbas pa'i shod chen bco brgyad du gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams la 'gro don gyi dus sa rtags rim pa gsum bkod yod/ rim pa dang po/ sbas pa'i yul de la shing khang nyul nyil zhes yul nges pa med pa'i 'khyam du 'gro ba'i sil bur mang por chags nas/ ri klung kun tu mi yi gang ba'i ri dwags sogs kyi srog la 'tshe bar sha khrag gis zas su byed dus/ yang dag pa'i lam dbang du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ba 'ga' re byon kyang / gnas chen der 'grim nas bsgrub bya'i chos kyi dus tshad ma byung bas/ sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa sangs shing mkhyen gnyis kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan zhes rna bar thos tsam 'gyur ro/ / rim pa gnyis pa/ sa gzhi kun tu glegs bam gtor ba 'dra — 11 —

ba'i gseb tu rdo mkhar skya bo gang sa gar khrom chogs pa lta bu byung bas dus su nges med kyi bon chos 'dra min sna chogs gang mang byung skabs su/ gsas khang dang 'thab khang 'dres mar mang du brtsigs nas/ de'i dus su bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che dang lam rtogs khyad par can mngon du brnyes te mchog dang thun mong dngos thub thob zhes pa'i gang grags mang tsam byung / 'on kyang skabs skabs su dus kyi 'khrugs pa yang yang 'byung / rim pa gsum ni/ de'i dus rdo mkhar dkar po tshon sna chogs kyis bsgyur dus gdung rgyud rgyal po rnams kyang sil bur 'chor nas lung pa re la yul gyi dpon 'go re byung dus nang 'khrugs mna' sdig mthu dug sogs sprin ltar gtibs pas na/ de'i dus su stong rgyung gi sprul ba mngon du drung mi ha ra zhes bya ba rnal 'byor 'ig byon nas sbas pa'i yul der 'gro don mdzad ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ zhang zhung gi gnas yul/da lta'i dus su zhang zhung zer ba'i ming gi gdags gzhi'i lte ba ni stod mnga' ris kyi phyogs rnams yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang bon lugs thog ma'i 'byung khungs 'khrul ba dang bral ba ni rgyal sa'i lte ba 'ol mo lung ring zhes grags pa/ deng dus gu ge zhes bya ba'i yul gyi dbus/ gangs te se'i mdun/ mtsho ma phal gyi 'gram ngogs su yod pa'i gnas de yin la/ zhang zhung gi yul dbus su yod pa'i gangs chen po te se la rgya gar rnams kyis gangs te se dbang phyug chen po'i gnas ri khyad du 'phags pa zhig te/ dbang phyug pa'i srol lugs de nas byung ba'i gnas thun mong ma yin pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin pa dang / gangs te se dang 'brel mtsho ma pham yang byin can gyi mcho zhig tu ngos 'dzin zhing / mtsho de'i kha 'bab kyi chu bo chen po rnams rgya gar gyi yu la du slebs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar ba rnams nas chu bo de dag tu khrus byed cing gnas mchog gangs te se dang / mtsho ma pham gyi byin rlabs kyis chu bo der/ khrus byas pa la de dag gi sgrib pa rnams 'dag thub pa'i yid ches byed srol yod pa dang / rgya gar gyi gnas skor ba brgya phrag mang po lo re bzhin gangs te se dang / mtsho ma pham mjal bskor du 'grul bzhud byas pa dang byed bzhin pa dngos kyi gnas tshul de dag la legs pa dpyad na/ rgya gar gyi dbang phyug pa'i lugs de bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig yongs rdzogs kyi khungs zhang zhung nas phar dar ba zhig yin nam/ rgya gar nas bod du tshur dar ba zhig yin min tshul la nges shes brtan por rnyed thub pa yin/gna' rabs bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che zhal bzhugs pa'i dus dang de rjes tsam na/ stag gzig gi yul du bon gyi gshen po mkhas pa dang grub pa brnyes pa du ma zhig byung myong ba de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bon gyi 'byung khungs de stag gzig gi yul la gtugs 'dug na'ang / dngos don du bon gzhung rnying ma mang dag las/ ston pa gshen rab kyi 'khrungs yu la dang / khong gis bon bstan pa'i gnas de ni gangs te se'i mdun mcho ma pham gyi 'gram 'ol mo lung ring zhes bya ba de yin zhes gsal bor bshad yod cing /stag gzig gam par sig gi yul du gangs te se dang mtsho ma pham med stabs/ der 'ol mo lung ring yod cesarjo shasdu ༵rjo rtsa ba nas med/

mi lo sum stong brgyad brgya lhag pa'i gong nas zhang zhung gi gna' mi mkhas pa tshos srid pa klong gi sgo nga'i skor go rtogs byung yod pa'i shes byed tshad ma ni/ bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che zhang zhung yul du sku 'khrungs nas been gyi shes rig spel ba'i lo dus kyis nges shes 'drongs dgos pa yin/ de yang / ston pa gshen rab mi bo che'i mdzad mdo'am lo rgyus yongs grags rnams las/ gshen rab mi bo che de/ spyi lo'i sngon dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo grangs lnga bcu(1857 )shing pho byi ba'i lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la bltams pa de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'byung khams kyi thog ma shing dang lo 'khor gyi thog ma byi ba smre ba'i thog ma gcig dkar nas 'go brtsam pa'i lugs de byung ba yin zhes bshad srol yod 'dug gang ltar yang gshen rab mi bo che sku 'khrungs pa'i shing byi lo de ni smre zeng dang bo'i spe ba gcig dkar gyis zin pa'i lo de yin la/ de nas rim bzhin shing mo glang la sme ba dgu dmar sogs lugs ldog tu bgrangs pas/ lo rgan drug cu'i skor 'go dang po de smre ba lnga ser gyis rdzogs shing / de nas sme phreng gnyis pa'i shing byi lo de spe ba bzhi ljang nas brtsam dgos pa yin/ spe phreng gnyis pa de smre ba brgyad dkar gyis rdzogs nas smre phreng gsum pa de sme ba bdun dmar gyis brtsam dgos pa dang / sme phreng gsum pa de sme ba gnyis nag gis rdzogs pa khyon bsdoms lo rgan drug cu'i skor 'go gsum ste lo grangs brgya dang brgyad cu zin pa de la sme 'khor zhes zer srol yod/ gshen rab mi bo che de dgung grangs brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhugs par bshad pa ltar na/ gshen rab mi bo che sku gshegs pa'i lo de ni sme phreng gnyis pa'i me khyi lo spe ba dgu dmar gyis zin pa'i lo de yin dgos / khyung po blo gros spyal mtshan (dus rabs 14 )gyis mdzad pa'i spyobon 'byung〉las/ston pa 'das nas li shu 'khrungs/ de dgung lo nyis stong lnga brgya bzhes dus chu phag lo la khri srong gis bon bsdubs pa'i dbu zug go zhes gsal ba de la dpyad na/ gshen rab mi bo che sku gshegs nas lo grangs nyis stong lnga brgya brgal ba'i chu phag lo de ni smre 'khor bco lnga ba'i smre phreng gnyis pa'i so brgyad lcags glangalo de yin dgos shing / lo des chos rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan sme 'khor dang smre greng gang gi nang du byon yod pa'i tshul gsal por shes thub/ btsan po de lcags pho rta la sku 'khrungs par bshad pa de'i lugs su byas na/khong gi 'khrungs lo de ni sle 'khor bco lnga pa'i sme phreng gnyis pa'i lcags rta deyin dgos la/ de ni gshen gyi 'khrungs lo'i dbang du byas na nyis stong lnga brgya dang don gcig (2571)de yin/ li shus nyis stong lnga brgya (2500)zin pa khri srong gis bon bsdubs pa'i lo de chu phag te sme 'khor gyi 'das lo'i dbang du byas na nyis stongabadun brgya tham pa (2700)yin/ de las li shu'i 'das lo nyis stong lnga brgya (2500)phris pa'i lhag ma lo grangs (200)lus pa des li shu sku 'khrungs pa'i lo dus nges brtan rnyed thub pa de ni sme 'khor gnyis pa'i smre phreng dang po'i nyi shu pa chu lug lo de yin/ li shus nyis stong lnga brgya zin pa'i chu phag lo de ni/ spyi lo'i dbang du byas na brgyad brgya zhe gsum pa (843)de yin la/ de nas da lta sme 'khor nyer gcig pa'i spe greng gnyis pa'i sa 'brug gi lo 'di'i bar lo grangs chig stong chig brgya zhe lnga (1145)phyin yod/ 'das pa'i lo grangs de smre 'khor gyi 'das lo (2700)la bsnan na sum stong brgyad brgya zhe — 13 —

lnga (3845)ru 'gyur ba dang / de ni zhang zhung du gshen rab mi bo che sku 'khrungs nas bon gyi shes rig gi dbu brnyes pa'i lo dus kyi tshad gzhi shin tu 'gangs che ba zhig red/gsum pa/ ya thog zhang zhung nas bon byung chul/bon zhes pa ni bod skad kyi brda shin tu rnying ma zhigaste deng dus kyi skad lugs byas na bzlas zhes pa'i don la 'jug cing bon po'am bzla ba ni sngags la sogs pa bzlas pa'i go don bstan yod pa'i byed tshig yongs su grags pa zhig yin stabs/ gna' dus su sngags bzla ba'am de dang 'brel ba'i cho ga dang rim gro sogs kyi byed las de la bon ces dang byed mkhan de dag la bon po zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di byung yod par mngon/ spyir btang bod skad kyi lugs su byed tshig gi rtsa ba phrad dang bcas pa de la byed tshig gi nus pa ston pa dang ming tshig gi nus pa ston pa bcas byed las gnyis dang ldan pa zhig yin stabs bon ces pa'i byed tshig gi rtsa ba ming tshig tu gyur yod pa'ang shin tu shes sla ba zhig yin/ lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu bon ces pa ni bod kyi brda rnying ma zhig yin la zhang zhung gi skad du gyer zhes pa de dang don gcig par bshad yod/bon ces pa 'di bod kyi brda rnying ma zhig yin pa de la the tshom ci zhig kyang med par ma zad/ gyer ces pa de'ang zhang zhung dang rgyal rong gi skad yin pa dang bon gyi go don dang gcig pa yin lugs 'di la the tshom dgos pa ci zhig kyang med/ gler ces pa'i tshig 'di ni zhang bod thun mong gi brna rnying zhig tu chags nas bod kyi dpe rnying mang dag tu cho ga'i skor sogs gyer ba ste klog pa'am 'don pa'i don du bed spyod byas yod pa de red/bon ces pa 'di ni ston pa gshen rab mi bo ches bstan pa de tsam zhig la ngos 'dzin pa dang gshen rab mi bo ches bon ma bstan pa'i gong der bon gyi lugs med par ngos 'dzin gyi yod 'dug pa de ni nor tshabs shin tu che ba'i lta stangs shig red/ gang la zer na gshen rab mi bo ches bstan pa'i bon de la g.yu nga drung bon ces bon gzhung thams cad du dmigs su bkar nas bshad yod pa de yin la/ gshen rab mi bo che'i gong der bon gyi lugs mi 'dra ba mang dag byung yod pa ni lung dang rigs pa gnyis kas gsal bor ston thub pa red/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo che sku bltams pa'i btsas ston du yod par bstan pa de ltar na/ gshen rab sku bltams pa'i dus der bon gyi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod pa gsal bar bstan pa dang / ṭwāṃ rtsa rgyun nyi sgron/〉 las/ gshen po'i thugs kyi sbrul ba ni/ 'od dmar srug gcig dmu ri srug po'i rtse la babs/ 'od las zil chags sgo ngar 'dril/ rin chen sgo nga 'od zer can/bcag cing rdol ba'i snying po las/ rin po che yi mi pho ni/ rin chen sna lnga'i rgyan cha can/ thod dkar mda' gang bcings pa byung / de la ming dang mtshan btags pa/ mes po dmu phyug skyer zhon yin/ de dang lha mo gang drag ma bshes pa dang / sras dmu btsan bzher gyi rgyal po byung / de dang phya lcam lha mo bshos pa las/ dmu rgyal lan gyi them skas/ de dang lha za 'phrul mor bshos pa las/ sras rgyal po thod dkanee/ 1༵ dang yo phyi rgyal bzhad mar bshes pa la/ tshe lo brgya ba'i dus kyi ston pa gshen rab bstan

pa'i gtso bo byon pa'o zhes gsungs so/ / ston pa gshen rab bod kyi chu bo bzhi 'dus 'gor byon te bod kyi lha 'dre rnams dbang du bsdus te bka' la nyan pa'i chad mdo phul/ de'i tshe bod gyi ri kun gyi rtse mo yang yar la 'dud par gyur to/ /bzhi ba/ bon mang bshad pa/bod kyi bon po rnams la lha gsol ba dang 'dre bkar ba/ yugs phud pa'i lung phog go zhes bya ba 'dir bod kyi bon po rnams zhes pa'i tshig 'dis de dus zhang zhung tsam du ma zad bod du'ang bon gyi rigs mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig yod pa shugs kyis bstan pa dang / da dung de las kyang ches kha gsal ba zhig ni bon gyi dpe rgyun ches rnying ba ṭwāṃ srid pa spyi mdos〉 zhes su grags pa las/ bdud bon gyi dmar thabs la/gshen rab ni ci dgyes te/ khyab pa ni chom la phab/ 'bru dkar gyi gtor mas mchod/ dmar thabs kyi 'dres byung na/ gshen lha la nongasapa mthol/ gdon bon gyi she tshu'i skyems/ gshen rab ni ci dgyes te/ gdon 'dren gi chom la phab/ 'bru dkar gyi yu tis mchod/ she tshu yi 'dres byung na/gshen lha la nongs pa mthol/ zhes pas bdud bon dang / gdon bon rnams gshen skub kyi sngon nas yod pa dang / de dag gis dmar mchod byed srol yod pa la gshen rab ma dgyes nas bdud bon dang /gdon bon rnams chom la phab/ de dag gi spyod tshul du sems can gyi rigs 'gar zhig bsad nas sha rus kyi mchod pa byed srol yod pa de dag gi tshab tu 'bru dkar gyi gtor mas 'thus par byas pa dang / she tshu ste khrag gi skyems 'bul srol yod pa de'i tshab tu yu ti ste 'bru chang gis 'thus par byas pa'i mdos chog gi gsar du btod mdzad pa dang / yang srid pa spyi mdos〉 las/ btsan rje ni ci la dgyes/ bza' ba de sha la rngams/ btung ba de khrag la rngams/ len pa de srog dbugs len/ mthun pa de bgegs dang mthun/ sdong pa de bdud dang sdong / skyobs pa de btsan bon skyobs/ 'tshe ba ni 'gro la 'tshe/gshen rab ni bka' btsan pas/ dzo dmar ni klad la gzer/ khas len ni gshen la zhus/ srog thag ni gshen la phul/ srog glud la nam mkhas brngan/ zhes pas btsan bon gyi skyabs mgon btsan rje yin pa dang btsan rje ni skye 'gro'i sha khrag dbugs la longs spyod cing bgegs dang grogs 'brel byed/ bdud dang gnyen 'brel byed/ btsan bon la mgon skyabs byed cing / de dag las gzhan pa'i skye 'gro yongs la gnod 'tshe byed mkhan zhig yin stabs gshen rab mi bo ches mthu rtsal gyi me chen po btsan rje'i klad la phab pas btsan rjes ci bcol las blangs shing / srog snying gshen rab la phul/ srog dbugs kyi tshab tu skud bsngo'i srol btod par gnang ba'i kor gsal bar bkod yod pa de dag la bltas na gshen rab mi bo tshes sngon du btsan bon sogs yod pa gsal bor bstan pa red/ 〈 srid panywa mdos〉 kyi dbe 'di la yid brtan 'apel ba'i rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig yod pa ni/ rang res na4rgyun sa lo rgyus kyi khungs su byed pa'i dpe ni/ rgyal rabs dang / bon 'byung / chos 'byung / grub mtha'/ skyes rabs/ rtogs brjod/ rnam thar/ gtam tshogs/ sgrung gi skor so gas/ yitsha la nana' rabs kyi lo /bye la 'ib

'jug byed pa'i gzhi tsa'ang de rigs kyi dpe rnams la bcol dgos kyi yod pa de ltar na'ang bod 'dir gna' dus su rgyal po gri gum batren po dus dang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / lhag par chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus rnams su bon gyi bstan pa la nyams rgyad ci rigs shig byung myong yod pa dang / snga mjug bar gsum la gangs te se man chad dang rgyal mo dar rtse mdo yan chod du bon chos mang po gter ru sbas dgos pa byung ba red/ de 'brel rgyal po glang dar ma 'u dum btsan po'i ring / chos kyi bstan pa la nyams rgud rgya chen po zhig byung myong bas mtshon/ dus rabs rim pa'i nang du bod bstan srid la 'pho 'gyur ji snyed cig byung yod pa de dag gi skabs su gong gsal yongs su grags pa'i dpe rnying de dag ni mda' gtad yul gyi 'been dang 'dra rpā zhig tu chags na dpe cha de rigs rtsa ba nas med brlags byas pa'am/ yang na dus skabs de'i lugs dang 'brel ba'i 'phri snon gyi 'pho 'gyur ci rigs 'og gnas thub tsam re byung ba yin stabs/ bon lugs dang ban de'i lugs gang yin na'ang rung / de dag la snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur ram gsar ma dang rnying ma sogs kyi lugs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod 'dug pa ni rang re'i dbang po'i yul du mngon sum du gyur pa 'di red/bon dang chos lugs su grags pa'i mdos chog dang bsang chog g.yang chog rtsis gto'i rigs mi 'dra ba du ma sogs kyis martsan pa phasku rim gyi cho ga’’zhes su grags pa 'di rigs ni dmangs tshogs kyi 'tsho khams bde thang 'byung ba dang / phyi nang snod bcud khams cha snyoms pa/ mi'i nus shugs dang / yul gyi nus shugs bar gyi 'brel ba je bzang dang je brtan du btang ba sogs kyi dgos pa du ma zhig la brten/dmangs tshogs kyi gna' rabs nas da lta'i bar mi rabs nas mi rabs su rgyun ma chad par byed spyod byas yod pa dang / byed bzhin pa dang / da dung yang bya bar 'gyur ba'i dngos po 'ga' zhig red/ dpe rigs de dag gna' bo'i rig rjos kyi mdzod khang nas rnyed pa lta bu mi lo stong phrag mang po'i gong nas yod pa'i dpe rnying de 'dra ba zhig ma yin na'ang / bod kyi yul ljongs phal mo cher mi rabs nas mi rabs dang khyim tshang nas khyim tshang brgyud cing dpe nas dpe ru bshus te/ bon po dang ban de'i chog mkhan su'ang rung ba dag gis bar ma chad par bed spyod byas pa'i dpe zhig yin stabs/ cho ga ni go rim gyi ming /sman bcos kyi cho ga mchod pa'i cho ga dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga cho ga nyams pa/ ji ltar cho ga ltar byed pa/ cho ga'i spyi chings/ dga' ston gyi cho ga sogs/ de dag la dus rim gyi nang du byung ba'i 'pho 'gyur ci rigs la ltos pa'i lta stangs kyi skyon rtsa ba nas zhugs thabs med pa dang / dus 'gyur las byung ba'i bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi shan zhugs thabs rtsa ba nas med pa dang / de rigs kyi dpe phal mo che dag ni thog ma'i 'byung khungs ches snga ba'idus la thug thub pa sogs kyi khyad chos bla na med pa du ma zhig yod pa yin stabs/ dpe de dag tu gshen rabs mi bo che'i gong du bdud bon dang / gdon bon/ btsan bod zhes su grags pa'i bon rigs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod par bshad yod pa de las lhag pa'i shes byed ci 'igarjo nga ṭwāṃ 6dashi/

lo grangs 3845 'das pa'i gong gshen rab mi bo che zhang zhung 'ol mo lung ring du sku bltams nas bon bstan pa'i dus skabs de nas bzung / g.yung drung bon ces bya ba de'i dus rabs kyi dbu brnyes pa yin la/ de ni bon gyi tha snyad tsam yod pa'i lugs thams cad kyi mchog gam yongs rdzogs pa'am/ bon thams cad kyi snying po lta bu zhig tu chags yod cing gna' bo'i bon lugs dmar mchod byed mkhan phal mo che'ang gshen rab kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs te/ de dag gi lta spyod kyang gshen rab kyi bstan pa'i rtsis zin par gyur stabs/ dus phyis yongs grags su bon ces bya ba 'di'i gdags gzhi'am tshad gzhi thun mong ma yin pa ni gshen rabs mi bo ches bstan pa'i g.yung drung gi bon de kho na la ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa 'di byung ba yin/ gzer mig〉las/ g.yung drung bon la rgya che grangs mang yang / sgo bzhi mdzod dang lnga ru phyes nas bris/ man ngag lung gi bon ni nyung la 'dus pas lung / dpon gsas sde ru bris nas gser gyi glegs bam nang du bcug srid pa rgyud kyi bon ni mang la 'brel bas rgyud/ chab nag sde ru bris nas lcags kyi glegs bam nang du bcug rgyas pa 'bum gyi bon ni don las spyas shing bsdus pas 'bum/'phan yul sde ru bris nas zangs kyi glegs bam nang du bcug nag po sngags kyi bon ni don la bsngags pas bsngags/ chab dkar sde ru bris nas dngul gyi glegs bam nang du bcug/ de bzhin gcig la bsdud cing yo la rgyugab pa ni/ gtsang ma tho thog khyi rgyug mdzod kyi bon yin te/ lta ba gcig tu skyel bas mtho thog khyi rgyug ste/ mdzod kyi bon sder bris nas g.yu yi glegs bam nang du bcug go/ zhes dbon gsas kyi sgo dang / chab nag gi sgo/ 'phan yul gyi sgo/ chab dkar gyi sgo ste bzhi dang / mtho thog spyi rgyug mdzod bcas lnga ru phyes yod/ de dag kyang dpon gsas zhes pa ni sems don gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa gtsor bton nas bstan pa bon kun gyi yang snying srog dang 'dra ba zhig yin la/ chab nag ces pa'i bon de la 'phral phan sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i thabs ci rigs shig yod pa dang / de ni srid pa'i lo rgyus gtsor bton nas bstan pa'i bon zhig yin stabs/ khyim pa pho mo sus kyang thun mong du spyod chog pa'ibon cig yin pa dang / 'phan yul zhes pa de ni phyi tshul gyi khrims gtsor bton nasabastan pa'i bon cig yin pa dang / chab dkar zhes pa ni bsnyen sgrub sogasagatsor bton cing sbyor sgrol sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i lta spyod rnams dang 'brel ba'i bon cig yin la/ mtho thog ces pa ni sgo bzhi bo kun gyi snying don gcig tu'adus pa'i bon cig tu ngos 'dzin srol yod pa red/ de ltar na'ang gshen rab kyi mdzad mdo rgyas pa ṭwāṃdri med gzi brjid〉las/ snang gshen theg pa'i bon sgo la/ /spyi ru rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /chab nag chubo sel gyi sgo/ / chab dkar 'dre dang sri yi sgo/ /'phan yul mnyam brje glud kyi sgo/ / dpon gsas phya gnyan gto yi sgo / zhes snang gshen theg par gtogs pa'i bon sgo ba'i ste/ sel gyi sgo dang / sri yi sgo/glud kyi sgo/ gto yi sgo zhes bshad yod pa 'di dag ni gna' dus su bod du dar ba'i bon shes pa canabacu gnyis kyi grangs rnams yin stabs yig rnying rnams su gsal ba'i bon sgo bzhi bo de dag snang gshen gyi bon sgo bzhi la ngos 'dzin dgos pa red/ de lugs su byas na phywa gshen dang / 'phrul gshen dang1 swād gshen

rnams las bshad pa'i bon mang zhig mi tshang ba'i skyon yod pa de ltar na/ yongs grags su rgyu'i bon bzhi zhes bya ba'i snang gshen dang / 'phrul gshen/ phywa gshen/ dur gshen bzhi bo 'di dag la gna' dus su grags pa'i bon sgo bzhi ru ngos 'dzin dgos pa 'dra zhig 'dugamatho thog mdzod ces pa ni bon kun gyi yang snying du gyur pa yang dag pa'i sems bon ces bya ba de rang yin pa ste/ dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i byung ba brjod pa'i spyo legs bshad skal ba bzang po'i mgrin rgyan〉 las/ dpon gsas bon ni theg chen gsang sngags kyi/ /rgyud sde rdzogs chen yin te bdag med kyi/ /lta ba blo chung dman dang thun mong du/ /ston du mi rung bas na nang rgyud de/ / mtshan nyid snying po chen po tshig bor cing / / don la bsgom pa gtsor bton bon sde 'o/ /zhes pas gsal ba ltar gshen rab mi bo ches lha bon yongs su dag pa sogs la bstan cing / de nas rim par brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang bcas pa dngos su bzhugs pa 'di rang la ngos 'dzin dgos par mngon/ gshen rab mi bo che'i bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang mkhan gtso bo ni nyid kyi sras dang slob ma'i gtso bo rnams yin la/ gshen rab kyi sras gang dag byon pa dang de dag gis bstan pa ji
