ltar skyong ba'i tshul ni leskus bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉 las/ hos bza' rgyal med la sras gto bu 'bum sangs dang / dpyad bu khri shes gnyis 'khrungs/ dbo bza' thang mo la sras lung 'dren gsal ba dang /rgyud 'dren sgron ma gnyis 'khrungs/ gsas bza' dang ring la sras 'ol drug thang po 'khrungs/ phya bzang gung drug la rgyal ba'i gdung sob mu tsho ldem drug 'khrungs/ kong bza' khri lcam la dmu rgyal gyi gdung brgyud 'dzin pa'i rgyal sras g.yung drung dbang ldan 'khrungs/ rgya bza' 'phrul bsgyur la rgyal sras 'phrul bu chung 'khrungs so/ de dag sangs rgyas nyid la dang po bka'i gleng gi zhu ba po dang / bar du bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin cing / tha mar bka'i bsdu ba por mdzad pa dang / ston pa'i bstan pa ma rdzogs kyi bar du thugs rjes sprul ba ma 'gags par ston cing sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di dag gis gsal la gshen rab mi bo che'i slob ma'i gtso bo su dag yin pa dang / ston pa'i bka'i bsdu ba po gtso bo su dag yin pa rdzu legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉 las/ sku'i sras brgyad/ thugs sras rma lo g.yu lo/gsung sprul yid kyi khye'u chung dang / tshangs pa gtsug phud gnyis/ mtshan ldan 'a zha rnams so/ / zhes pas gsal ba ltar sku'i sras gto bu 'bum sangs kyi gto rgyud thams cad bsdus pa dang / dpyad bu khri shes kyis dpyad rgyud rnams bsdus pa dang / kong tsha 'phul bus rtsis kyi skor rnams bsdus pa dang / kong tsha dbang ldan gyi chab nag srid pa'i bon rnams bsdus pa dang / yid kyi khye'u chung gis 'phan yul gyi bon rnams bsdus pa dang / rgyud 'dren sgron mas chab dkar gyi bon rnams bsdus pa dang / lung 'dren gsal bas mtho thog mdzod kyi bon rnams bsdus pa dang / lhag par du gdung sob chen po mu cho ldem drugade nyid gasdu~X mkhar sham po lha rtser bzhugs nas sgo bzhi'i mdzod lnga'i bon gyi bstan pa yun ring du bskyangs

par mdzad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus bon gyi bstan 'byung dang / lo rgyus che phra kun nas gsal rgyas su bshad yod 'dug gzhan yang bon 'byung du drangs pa'i mdo 'dus kyi lung las/ de nas 'ol mo lung ring nas/ bka' dang rjes su bstan pa'i bon dang / lo tsā ba drug gis g.yung drung lha skad las/ rang rang yul du skad rigs so sor bsgyur/ de yang stag gzig lo tsā mu tsā tra nye dang / zhang zhung khri thog spar tsha dang / sum pa sku gyi li spar ya dang / rgya gar lha bdag sngags drod dang / rgya nag legs tang dmang po dang / phrom gyi gser thog lce 'byams zhes pa ste/ gdung 'tshob mu tsho'i drung du shes pa'i rgyud sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa chen po 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan drug po de dag gis rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas rgya gar spya nag phrom stag gzig bod dang zhang zhung la sogs skad rigs sum brgya drug cu bon gyi skad du bsgyur cing spel nas dar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag gis shes thub pa yin/ de'ang gna' rabs kyi yig rgyun rnying ma ṭwāṃsrid pa spyi mdos/〉 las/ ya ki'i sbyid po'i yul/ /nyams dga' bag re bro/ /chu rgyal bzhi 'dus mgo /ri rgyal te se'i mdun/ / mtsho rgyal ma pham 'gram/ / 'ol lung g.yu yi mkhar/ /bzhugs gnas ngo re mtshar/ /zhes gshen rab mi bo che gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas de ni chu bo chen po bzhi'i 'go/ gangs te se'i mdun/ mtsho ma pham gyi 'gram/ 'ol mo lung ring g.yu yi mkhar/ zhes gsal bar bstan yod do/ /de tsho dngos kyi dbang du byas na/ lo grangs sum stong brgyad brgya 'das pa'i gong der/ zhang zhung gi yul ston pa gshen rab mi bo che phebs nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bon sgo rnams bstan pa dang / ma zad de'i dus skabs su gshen rab mi bo che bod yul dbus nas brgyud gong po'i bon ri dang shar dung ri rgyal mo dmu rdo g.yung drung spus rtse glang chen 'gying ri sogs la byon nas/ bod kyi bon po rnams la lha gsol ba dang 'dre bkar ba la sogs pa'i bon sgo rnams bstan tshul gshen rab kyi mdzad mdo rnams las gsal bar bstan pa ltar na/ zhang bod kyi mi phal che ba tshos zhing la so nams byed pa sogs kyi shes tshad ni des gong nas dar rgyas byung yod pa de yang nges pa rang thugs su shes thub pa yin/gling chen 'gying rir byon pa la bod gzhung rnam dag las/ 'gying ri tshe dbang rig 'dzin gnas/ /glang chen 'gying 'dra'i ri bo la/ / bla ma tshe dbang rig 'dzin bzhugs/ / de ni nyi ma'i 'od la chib/ /zhes gsungs/ yang sbas pa'i shod chen bco brgyad rgyal mo rong gi gnas chen dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i dkar chags las/ bde mchog g.yung drung srungs rtse gnas chen de/ / 'dzam gling zhing khams gnas chen mang lags kyang / khyad par shar phyogs rgyal mo rgyal yi rong / / rnam dag gling zhes dmu rdo sbas pa'i rong / /bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ /de 'drar gnas chen yon tan mtshungs pa med/ /gnas der bde ba can dang khyad med gsungs/ /gnas der dar gyi yol ba 'dra ba la/ /ri ni lha rgod thog parang ba'inagasal/ khro bo gsas chen rigs lnga rang byon yod/ / mdun du rdo ba yong dwags 'dra ba brgyad/ /dus gsum ston pa'i zhabs rjes rim par gsal/ /sngar 'das ston pa'i zhabs rjesagazhu 'dom gang / /da ltar ston pa'i 'bas rjes gzhu 'dom phyed/ /ma byon ston pa'i 'bas rjes gru — 19 —

gang yod/ /srid rgyal dre'u goms pa'i dril rjes dang / /rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen zhabs rjes cig/rgya bod zeng ba mthu chen zhabs rjes gnyis/ /byams ma nyi shu rtsa gcig rang byung yod/ /zhang zhung mkhas pa mi bzhi'i sgrub phug dang / / mkhas bzhi'i bsgyur ba'i bon gyi gter kha yod/ / mi 'gyur bka' rtags mkhas bzhi'i zhabs rjes yod/ /dbal bon stag lha me 'bar rang byung yod/ khro bo rol ba'i gsang ba'i sngags kyi bskor/ / go mtshon gser g.yu rin chen gter kha yod/ / gnas der zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun thub/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo che byon skabs su ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mo dre'u bzhon nas bsu ma mdzad pa dang rgyal mo rong 'dir gshen rab lha khang zhes gang sa gang du lha khang dang rdo mkhar 'dres ma thog brtsegs bzhi'am lnga nas rim bzhin thog brtsegs dgu ba dang dbyibs gru bzhi dang zur drug zur brgyad sogs rdo mkhar gyi bya ba thog mar de nas 'go tshugs/ de ni bdud la brten mkhan gyi bdud bon dang / btsan la brten mkhan btsan bon de tshos sems can gzhan dag gi lus srog la 'tshe ba'i sha khrag gis dmar mchod byed srol yod pa la/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo ches dgag pa mdzad cing /dmar mchod kyi dod du sems can gyi gzugs brnyan sogs kyis 'thus par gnang ba'i mdos gtong ba dang / sri 'dul ba dang / g.yang 'bod pa dang / ju thig gi mo rgyag pa dang / sman dpyad byed pa sogs dar srol byung yod pa red/ 'on kyang 'khrug rtsod kyang byung ba'i don gyi mdo khams rgyal rong la rdo mkhar shin tu mang po yod pa de ni 'khrug rtsod dgos pas 'thab khang red/ dus skabs de dag du snan spyad dang ju thig dang mdos yas sogs da lta'i dus nang bzhin rgyas pa zhig med par nges na'ang srol gsar du gtod pa'i tshul tshad ldan bon gyi mdos dpe rnams las gsal gyi yod pa red/ston pa gshen rab mi bo che bsu skyel gyi skabs rnams su yang zhang zhung gi yul lugs shon gyi skor zhes pa'i sngar gyi yul skad rnying ba dang zhang skad 'dres ma las dbyangs dang bro 'khrab pa'i lugs mi grangs nyi shu nasabargya skor bar gang yod tsho gsum du bcad de lag bsnol bsgril ma skum skor mi mang na phyi nang rim pagasum du byed cing / shon dpon dang po'i lag g.yas kyis (rdo rang)zhes g.yag dkar po'i rnga ma dngul gyi yu ba can zhig 'phyar bskor byed bzhin rnga che chung dang / dung chen/ sul li sul snyan/ mkhar rnga /spub chal sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ kha nas dbyangs dang rkang pa'i 'gros stangs kyis g.yas skor du bskyod pa'i lha nyid dang mnyam du bgrod cing shon rtsed dam bro 'khrab pa'i lugs de khu nu sogs bod kyi mtha' mtshams mdo khams rgyal rong dang stod phyogasakun tu 'khrab rgyu'i srol byung /lnga ba/ zhang zhung dngasgyul rong gi bon dang rig gnas skor/gshen rab mi bo che'i bon dang rig gnas spel te bod kyi yul 'dir bon gyi shes rig gis dbangabasgyur byed pa'i srol rgyun gyi brgyud pa la bon gyi bla rabs bco brgyad/ ring brgyud bla rabs nyer bzhi dang gshen rab mi bo che'i rig gnas mkhan sras brgyad sogs byung yod pa red/ spyir bod khams zhes pa ni bon khams zhes pa'i sgra zur chags te bod khams zhes grags par snga rabs mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhed la — 20 —

lung gis kyang nges te/ 〈g.yung drung rnam par dag pa'i rgyud〉las/ mkhas pa mi bzhi dang sku srung sde bzhi/ ger mi spun gsum gyi ring la mnga' dbang bon gyis skor 'gyur ba lags zhes pas/ der yang g.yung drung gi bon byung snga ba dang / spyal khrims med pa'i gong du bon khrims yod pa'i don gyi bon khams zhes grags so/ / gong du bshad pa bzhin bon du srid pa klong gi sgo nga las mi'i 'gro ba grol ba'i tshul gyi bshad pa de ni/ bon gyi gna' lugs zer sgros tsam zhig gam bon lugs la yid ches yod pa rnams nas zer sgros de rigs la yid ches byas pa'i mngon rtags tsam yin pa las/ de la cha 'jog byed 'os pa'i khungs ci yod snyam nas mthong chung byas na mi 'grig snyam/ gang la zer na/ bon lugs su 'byung ba sna lnga'i snying po las srid pa klong gi sgo nga grub tshul bshad pa de dang / dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis brtsams pa'i bod gna' rabs kyi rig gnas dang chos lugs mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor gleng ba〉 las/ lo rgyus rig pa'i thad nas mtshon na/ gna' rabs bon chos nang du 'byung ba lnga'i snying po las/ sgo nga chen po gcig las bod kyi mi rgyud rnams mched tshul bshad pas mchon/ bon gyi dpe rnying rnams su srid pa klong gi sgo nga'i bshad pa shin tu mang ba yod pas me'u gdung drug tu grags pa rnams yin tshul gsal por bshad yod pa de red/ nang sgos bar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha'i snying bcud las mi dang dud 'gro sogs srog chags kyi rigs byung ba sogs bshad thub yod pa de ni snga rabs shis la rgyal khab kyi tshan rig mkhas pa hpha tā ko la si dang dus mnyam pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i mkhas pa ā li tri to te las lo sum brgya lhag tsam gyi snga ba red/ de dang 'dra bar bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong du dmangs khrod du khyab che ba'i bshad rgyun 'di 'dra 'ig yod/ bod kyi mi rigs ni thog mar lho kha rtsed thang du byung ba dang /de yang pha spre'u dang ma brag srin mo ste spra mo(de sngon lo nyis brgya tsam gyi gong rol du sde dger dpar basbun byas pa'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum〉dpar rnying 'ig gi nang / brag srin mo zhes thad du spra mo zhes 'khod yod)gnyis 'dus pa las mi min sprel min gyi phru gu drug byung ba de las rigs brgyud khag mang por gyes te khag gcig mon dang / dwags po/ kong po sogs nags tshal mang ba'i sa char gnas spos byas pa dang /khag gcig lho kha'i sa gnas de rang du gzhis chags nas yu na ring song rjes za rung ba'i shing tog dang /'bras bu'i rigs rnams zad de rim bzhin sa la zags pa'i 'bras bu lo tog rnams lo rjes ma slar yang rang bzhin gyis skye bar mthong nas lo tog sa la 'debs rgyu'i myong tshor byung ba nas zhing las byed 'go tshugs shing / ma rmos lo tog dang 'bru rigs zos pa'i rjes su lus kyi spu rnams byi thog mjug ma yang chad de mi ma sprel 'ig tu gyur pa'i mthar mi ngo ma zhig tu 'gyur ba yin zhes bshad srol yod/ deng sang nga tshos tsi na du bshad srol la yang mi'i rigs kyi thog ma'i mes po spra mi yin pa'i chod gtam thog mar 'don mkhan ni dbyin go'i srog chags rig pa mkhas chen tar wen yin pa dang / khong gis spyi lo 1859 lor 〈 skye dngos rig pa'i 'byung khungs〉 zhes pa'i dpe deb brtsams nas srog chagasathi 'phel 'gyur smrab thog mar bton pa dang / de rjes spyi lo5871 lor 〈 mi yi rig4nee 'byungarangs dang pho mo'i rigs bdam ka rgyag — 21 —

pa〉/ zhes pa'i ched rtsom bcoms nas mi'i rigs la legs skyes chen po 'bul gnang mdzad pa yin zhes bshad kyi yod pa ma red dam/ mkhas pa chen po khong ma byon gong gi lo chig stong lnga brgya lhag tsam gyi sngon nas rang re bod kyi mis rang gi mi rigs gyi 'byung khungs smre'u dang spra mo 'dus nas byung ba yin zhes bshad thub pa de ni bod mi rigs kyi gzi brjid yin pa ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi gzi brjid kyang yin zhes bshad chog pa 'dugagangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'di'i mi sde'i rtsa ba'i rus chen bzhi'am lnga'am drug gam bdun sogs rnam grangs ci 'dra ba zhig yin kyang rung / don du smon pa'i mi pho luglu lum mam/ sang pho 'bul khri nas a nye mu zi khri to ste/ rlung lha gnam dgongs bar gyi mi rabs de dag gang du byung ba'i yul gyi lte ba ni 'ang zhung kho na yin par nges te/ ṭwāṃ blon po bka'i thang yig〉 las/ mi'i 'chad khungs rgyal po'i byon tshul ni/ /'dzam gling snying po rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs bcal ba na/ /ri nag dgu 'dus pha rol gangs te se/ / gangs ri'i byang ngos ri bo spos ngad ldan/ / de gnyis bar na ma dros mtsho chen yod/ /ces pas 'ang zhung yul gyi lte bar chags pa'i gangs ri chen po te se dang / mtsho ma pham g.yu mtsho bcas gsal bar bstan pa dang / yang blon po bka'i thang yig〉 las/ phyogs ba'i dag na sems can kha 'dra bzhi/ / chu bo chen po bzhi ni phyogs der 'bab/ / shar phyogs glang chen kha nas gaṅgā 'bab/ /dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing ma dros bskor/ /chu phran lnga baspyar bcas nas shar mtshor 'bab/ /lho phyogs khyung 'dra'i kha nas sind+ra 'bab/ /beeḍūrya yi bye ma 'dren cing bskor/ /nub phyogs rta yi kha nas pas 'bab/ / shel gyi bye ma 'dren cing sngar bzhin bskor/ / byang phyogs seng ge'i kha nas si tā 'bab/gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing gong bzhin bskor/ /zhes pa rnams kyis ma pham g.yu mtsho'am rgya gar na ma sa ro war zhes pa'am ma na sa ro war zhes yongs su grags pa'i mtsho chen de las/ kha 'bab kyi chu bo chen po bzhi ste/ chu bo glang chen kha 'bab bam rgya gar du chu bo gaṅgā zhes pa dang / chu bo khyung chen kha 'bab bam rgya gar du chu bo sin ju zhes pa dang / chu bo rta mchog kha 'bab bam rgya gar duchu bo pakhya zhes pa dang / chu bo seng ge kha 'bab bam rgya gar du chu bo si tā zhes su grags pa rnams 'bab cing / gangs chen po te se dang mtsho ma pham ni chu bo chen po de rnams kyi 'byung khungs yin pa gsal bar bstan yod pa dang / yang lja blon po bka'i thang yig〉 las/ dga' ldan lha yi yul nas lha bu gnyis/ / me tog u dum wa rar brdzus nas skyes/ / tsan dan dri ma med pa zhes bya dang / / smurya dri ma med pa zhes bya la/ / 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams 'chad pa'o/ / zhes pas zhang bod kyi mi brgyud tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling gi thog ma'i mi brgyud ṭwāṃ//sa kyi 'chad khungs kyang gnas 'di nyid yin pa gsal bar bstan pa de dag gis nges shes rnyed thub pa 'ang rgyal ya thog mi brgyud kyi 'chad khungs/ zhang zhung zhes bya ba'i tha snyad de la dpyad na/ tha snyad de nidzo nga 2rting srid pa'i lha klu gnyan gsum dang / de 'brel gyi spyal gshen 'bangs gsum po thams cad

dang 'brel yod pa zhig yin pa'ang shes thub/ de'ang zhang zhung skad du zhung zhes pa de ni bod skad brda rnying du khyung zhes bya ba dang don gcig pa yin/ khyung zhes bya ba'i tha snyad 'di bod kyi brda ches rnying ba zhig yin pa ni/ dus gyis bod du byon pa'i sangs spyas pa'i chos lugs mdo rgyud yongs grags kyi dpe rnams su khyung la nam mkha' lding zhes pa'am/ mkha' lding zhes pa'i tshig 'di rnyed dka' ba de tsam gyis kyang shes thub pa yin/drug pa/ dmag gi 'byung khungs/zhang zhung gi rgyal po rnams kyi sku srung dang sde srung dpung dmag ni/ ye mkhyen dgra bla'i dmag cugs las grol bas/ lja legs bshad rin po che'i gter mdzod〉 las/ zhang zhung la dmag stong sde dgu khri dgu 'bum yod pa'i steng du sum pa stong bu chung yan chad mnga' ris yin la/ sgron legs na re/ zhang zhung girgyal po la dmag sa gzhir khebs pa yod/ zhes smras pas/ khyung ni bon lugs su ya thog srid pa'i lha rabs kyi mched khungs shin tu gal chen po zhig tu'ang ngos 'dzin srol byung 'dug de'i skor kha gsal ba zhig ni/ nam 'kha'i nor bus bris pa'i sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyi gtam〉 las/ ye srid 'phrul gyi sgra bla ni/ sgra bla khyung chen ral chen zhes bya ba de nyid yin zhing / de las ye mkhyen dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnams grol ba ste/ de yang khyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po che las dgra bla yid bzhin lha dbang grol ba dang /khyung ru g.yas g.yon las dgra bla lha gsal dar ma grol ba dang / rna ba g.yas g.yon las dgra bla ngar chen g.yu 'brug grol ba dang / spyan mig g.yas g.yon las dgra bla yod khams kun gsal grol ba dang / khyung mchu bgrad pa las dgra bla khyung nag sha zan grol ba dang / sgro chen sum brgya drug cu las dgra bla sum brgya drug cur grol ba dang / thel gshog gser gyi 'dab ma las dgra bla nyis khri dgu 'bum grol ba dang /khyung sder sa la 'dzugs la las dgra bla klu 'dul khyung chen srid pa ste/ de ni srid pa chags pa'i dus nas srid pa'i na ye nas srid pa'idagra bla zhes bya ba yin zhes gna' bo'i bon shes pa can bcu gnyis las mgon shes lha bon gyi nang ji ltar bshadayod pas mchon/ ya thog lha klu gnyan gyi grol phug kyang khyung chen la brten yod pa red/ dzño thang yig/〉 las/ bod kyi dmag dpung sbra nag phub nas 'gro zhes kyang bshad/bod kyi dmag rnams dbyar phying pa dang dgun slog gyon/ g.yul 'jug tshe gdong la khrag gam tshon dmar po byugs/ re nag po'i gur (spra gur la re sde nag po zer)can gyi dmag de rnams las rigs mched pa mdo khams stod smad phal cher dang / lhag par sngon gyi tshul ma 'gyur ba da bar gnas pa'i 'brog sde khag dang rgya bod so mtshams rgyal rong pa rnams yin cing / de dag gis da dung kyang slog pa dang lu nag phying zhwa gyon nas ru ba dang skyes phan tshun spos pa na yang ru 'gro ba zhes zer la/ ru ni dmag gi ming yin no/ /gdong la khragabyugs nas 'thab zer ba gdong dmar bodaces bya ba sbrung / srin po gdong dmar gyi dmag sogs kyang don de las thogs pa red/ rma rgyal krom ras pyi tho tsāng 'a spyon pa dang rgyal mo dmu rdo'i lu nag phying zhwa khyon pa nas lha mo dpal mos rkang gangab la0 sadus rgyuca pa 'i tho 'ib du ltos da~X / —yul

mi'i rnam par byas ma byas ma'on sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / gong du bshad pa bzhin rgyal mo rong gi dmag dpung khyung las mched pa'i khyung ro 'am khyung ru zhes bya ba de rnams kyis gyon pa'i dmag chas rmog la rgod kyi ldem 'phru dang stod g.yogs kyi gshog pa smad g.yogs steb ma can gyi rnga ma'i tshul las zhang rgyal gyi sku srung daṭā sde srung dāpung dmag ni ye mkhyen dgra bla'i dmag tshogs las grol bas gdong dmar gyi dmag dpung (kto) ༷sduche wa/gyi/ gtsobo/zhang zhung gi mi brgyud nang nas chad pa'i rus chen gyi gtso bo ni/ bse khyung sbra zhes su grags pa de yin / spyir btang bse khyung sbra zhes pa de tha la bse khyung zhes pa'i khyad chos kyi tshig sbyar ba'i zol 'dra zhig snang mod/ don du sbra'i nang khungs su gtogs pa'i rus chen bye brag pa 'ga'i tha snyad cig yin la/ zhang zhung gi mi brgyud de dag gtso cher khyung gi rus chen las gyes pa yin stabs/ yul la'ang khyung sde/ zhang zhung gi skad du zhung zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di byung yod pa ni gor ma chag spyir rgyal mo rong gi rje 'bangs thams cad kyi gdung rgyud dag pa thams cad ni spra kho na yin par bzhed la/ rigs de rnams la rgyal rong rang skad kyis nga shul tsa nga shis tsa ngas pu nye yang zer ro/ /yul la'ang ngas khyung dang gyi dpon la (da ro)yul dpon la (khyung ro)zer srol yod/ tshigs bsdus na 'ang rgyal gdung rgyud yang zer bar mngon pa 'di ltar/ bod mi bu gdung drug gi rdzu rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal zhes bya ba〉 las/ bse khyung sbra ni/sngonaspre'u byang chub sems dpa' rang gis mi tshan bzhir bcad pa'i nang gi bse zhes pa de yin la/ de la bse khyung sbra zhes zer te/ ji skad du/ sbra ming sna can zhes pa phyug dpal che/ / zhes pa dang / gna' sgrung las/ 'gag dog mo gsum ni sbra la thob/ / sbra dpa' rtsal che ba de nas byung / / zhes sgrung glu 'di dag gi don dpe thob kyi glu gnyis dang / don thob kyi glu gnyis/ de bzhi rus chen bzhi la yod pa sbra la don thotna kyi ༵ yin te/ 'im/ kha/sa 'di ni 'di'i rong chen bzhi'i bye brag shar rgyal mo rong sogs rong gi 'gag ( sna )—kā kau zlosdu rsha gaktongasdob/sa/dam pa khyung gi gdung rabs dngos las/ kun tu bzang po'i sprul ba rig snang 'od kyi rgyal zhes bya bas 'gro ba'i don la dgongs nas sku gsung thugs las sprul ba'i bya khyung gsum yas mar 'phur nas zhang zhung gi kha yug me tog mdzes pa'i tshal 'bab/ de la zhang zhung gi mi rnams ngo mtshar skyes nas mthong ma myong ba'i 'dab chags zer ba la rgan po kha cig na re/ rwa co 'dug pas khyung pho yin 'dug zer/ der khyung gsum dbyings su 'phur nas song ba'i shul du bltas pas spar mo sa la reg pa'i drod rlangs las sgo nga dkar nag sogs khag bzhir 'dril ba brdol ba'i nang nas mtshan dang ldan pa'i khye'u re re byung ba'i ming yang khyung pho zhes btags so/ / che ba khyung dkar thog la 'bar/ de 'og khyung ser lha khyung / de 'og khyung sharaphaṭwāṃ~X khri mo/ chung ba dmu khyung rgyan zhes grags/ de dag gis rin chen bla rdo'i pha bong re re/ ma

brtsigs pa'i rin chen sku mkhar re re/ ma skyel ba'i g.yu yi mcho mo re re/ de rnams kyis mnga' bdag tu mdzad cing / khyung po skyed kyi mkhar re re bzhengs te/ che ba khyung dkar thog la 'bar gyis 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i gsas khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ che 'og lha khyung rgyan gyis gsas khang zo bo khyung lag bzhengs/ thang stag khyung 'phags khra mos gsas khang lha rtse gung nam bzhengs/ chung ba dmu khyung rgyan gyis gsas khang brgyad bzhengs/ tshe la rang dbang thob cing 'gro don yang dpag tu med par mdzad do/ / zhang zhung gi rgyal rabs gong ma rnams kyi ring nas dbu yi mchod gnas mdzad cing / bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas seng khri btsan po yan chad kyis bla ru bkur/ gri gum gyis bon bsnubs pa'i rjes su sras spu lde gung rgyal dmu khyung dang lha khyung gnyis sogs bon gshen mang po gdan drangs te bla ru bkur nas slar yang bon bstan rgya cher spel/ mu khyung sras 'khrungs pa ni/ stag sgra don gtsug dang dpal gyi gir te'i/ stag sgra don gtsug stag gzig gi yu la phyin nas bon sde mang po 'ang zhung dang bod du drangs te sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā mdzad nas bstan pa spel/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyis g.yo thabs kyi zhang zhung rgyal po lig mi rkya bkrongs ba'i shul du rgyal sa khyung stag sgra don gtsug gis bzung nas rgyal khrims dang bon khrims gnyis ka mnyam du bskyangs / khyung po dpal gyi gir te'i/ sras mchog sgron ma dpung sgra zer/de'i sras bkra spyal/ de'i sras legs mgon/ de'i sras khyung po gyer chen zla med/ de'i sras ra sangs khri ni dang ra sangs khod ram gnyis/ de'i sras ra sangs klu rgyal lo/ khyung po stag sgra don gtsug gi sras btsan sgra don gtsug de'i sra/sa gyer nam zu rtse/ de'i sras stong rgyung ring ba'i shul tu stag sgra don gtsug gis rgyal sa bzung ba de'i gdan sa sngong rgyung ring mos bzung ba la/ zhang zhung yul stod nas stong rgyal dang smad nas stong dmigs sanyis kyis tsha 'ang gi rgyal sa bzung ba ni mi rigs zer nas 'ong zhung gi dmag khyer nas byung bas / stong rgyung ring mos gdan sa dor nas phyis la bros pa'i lam du grub rtags su/zhabs gnyis dang sba ber gsu ma sa la gar reg sar me tog gsu/ma re skyes / rdo brag la sar reg sar rjes lam byung ba'i rting nas zhang zhung bi dmag mi tshos ded pas long gis mkhyen par gzigs nas mdo kham sarma'i bkra ring lha mtshor slebs pa'i tshe chur brdzus pas rjesarngor te thararo/ / der rnal 'byor la 7ོtsas mi'adod kyang / rtags skuos rnal 'byor 'dod zer ba'i gtam tshigs kyang byung ngo / / stag la skyes kyi sras khyung po rnal 'byor/ de'i sras khyung po mi la grub pa ste shes rab rgyal mtshan yang zer de'i sras mi la thos pa dga' ba ste phyis su mi la ras pa grags pa de'o /thang stag khyung 'phags khra mo yis tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pas 'ang bod kyi rgyal rabs rim byon gyi bla yi mchod gnas mdzad si 'i mthar g.yu/ 'brug sngon mo chibs su zhon te mdo smad rgyal mo rong du byon nas bro za lha mo mdangs ldan ma khab tu bzhes / de las bu ṭwāṃ/ ༵kāspya ༵padīs/ pa/ sa g.yu nga drung bu bzhi ru grags so / / rus rgyud de ni mdo smad dang rgyal mo rong du

le'u gsum pa/ zhang zhung dang༄la morong gizul rabs byung tshul/zhang zhung gi bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i mdzad pas sgra 'grel gyi gzhung las bstan pa ste/ ya thog srid pa'i grol phug sangs pho 'bum khri'am smon pa lum lum nas bzung / dmu rgyal gyi gdung rgyud rim par byon pa'i tshul ya thog zhang zhung gi bon rabs bshad pa'i skabs su gsal bar bstan pa de dag ni/ zhang zhung ya thog gi rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba shin tu che ba yin pa smos ma dgos/ gsas chen hos kyi gdung rgyud de/bstan 'dzin rnam dag gis mdzad pa'i ṭwāṃ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i 'byung khungs nyung bsdus〉 zhes pa las zhang zhung yul gyi rgyal rabs ni dang bo mi lo chig khri brgyad stong tsam gyi sngon du/ gsas chen hos kyi gdung rgyud gcig 'dzam gling dbus su chad pas/ stod la seng gi sa gnas lho byang gangs mu wer dang /phya wer/ pra phud yo cha sogs nas bzung / snad sum pa glang gi gyim shod shod chen bco brgyad yan/zhang zhung sgo ba khri sde brgyad cu la dbang bsgyur ba'i hos rje khri wer gnam thog gi gdung brgyud kyis bzung ba yin te/ gshen rab kyis bstan spel mdzad pa'i skabs su/ zhang zhung rgyal po hos rje khri wer nor 'dzin zhes pa 'dzam gling phal cher la dbang sgyur ba zhig yod par gsungs/ zhes ya thog zhang zhung rgyal rgyud kyi khungs de gsas chen hos kyi rgyud pa las chad cing / de nas hos rje khri wer nor 'dzin nam khri wer gser gyi bya ru can zhes su grags pa de'i bar du gdung rgyud kyi rim pa mang zhig byung myong yod pa gsal bor bstan yod/ mi lo chig khri brgyad stong tsam gyi gong du byung ba'i gsas chen hos su grags pa de nas bzung /zhang zhung srid pa'i rgyal po khri wer gyi lo grangs mang por 'das pa'i dus de snyed kyi ring la/ gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs chen po 'dir mi'i 'gro ba 'phel rgyas ji ltar byung yod pa dang / de dag gi nang du mthu dbang che ba'i dbang sgyur mkhan gang dag byung yod pa'i skor rob tsam ni ṭwāṃ rgyal po bka' thang〉 las/ de nas za ram skyes drug dbang byas te/ /yul ming stong sde bco baspyad bya bar btags/ /snga drags rta zhon rna cha 'dogs pa byung / / de nas rgyal phran bcu gnyis dbang byas te/ / yul gyi ming ni swo kha bco brgyad btags/ /snga drags phyag dang zhe sa de nas byung / /zhes pa'i yul ming 'dogs stangs la dpyad na stong lde bco brgyad yod par mngon pa des ni skabs der mi'i 'gro ba yod par ma zad grangs kyang mang bar yod pa gsal por bstan pa dang / de dang 'dra ba pha swo kha bco brgyad’’ ces pa de don du dgra yi gnod 'tshe 'gog srung thub pa'i rdzong chen po bco brgyad yod par bstan pa dang / der ma zad de dus kyi mi rnams rta zhon nas 'gro ba dang / rna rgyan sogs lus la rgyan cha 'dogs pa/ rgan rim dang che ba rnams la gus zhabs kyi phyag dang zhe sa byed shes pa de dag gis ni ya thog gis ma dul ba min pa ya rabs kyi shes yon dang ldan pa'ang bstan pa red/ de dang phyogs mthun ṭwāṃ spya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa〉las kyang gsungs yod/— 26 —

dang po/ mi sde dngarje bo'i skor/za rid srun drug dag gis dbang byas te/ / yul gyi ming la stod sde bco brgyad zer/ / rgyal phran bcu gagyis dbang skur byas pa'i skabs/ / kun gyi tha ma sil ma bzhi bcu byas/ / yul gyi ming la bzang yul spyad du btags/ /zhes pa de rigs kyis cung zad shes thub la rgyal phran bcu gnyis sam bzhi bcu'am zhe gnyis sogs su grags pa de rigs ni/ zhang zhung gi yul der mnga' thang che ba'i rgyal po khri wer nor 'dzin du grags pa byung nas rim gyis rgyal rabs bco brgyad gtsos pa'i rgyal po mang zhig byung ba de dag gi ring / gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs chon po'i mnga' khongs su mi sde dang rje bo sogs gang dag byung myong yod pa de rnams la zer ba yin te/ gna' rabs kyi byung ba bshad pa'i gtam tshogs su/ mi ma yin dang mi sde'i chags tshul sogs rgya che la grangs mang ba zhig yod nges pa ni bshad mi dgos na'ang /bya ba ngo thog tu rang res ya thog zhang zhung gi rgyal po dang de'i mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i yul sde gang dang gang yin pa sogs kyi skor go rtogs thub pa ni/ lo grangs sum stong baspyad brgya lhag tsam 'das pa'i snga rol du byung ba'i gshen rab mi bo che'i sbyin bdag zhang zhung srid pa'i rgyal po khri wer la rje gu lang gser gyi bya ru can zhes zhang zhung gi rgyal rabs su ches grags pa'i rgyal po de nas lo rgyus kyi dbu 'dzugs dgos pa dang /rgyal po de'i mnga' thang dang 'bril ba'i mnga' ris gang dag yod pa de dag la gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi rgyal khams su ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin/ gang la zer na gna' rabs zhang zhung gi lo rgyus yig thog tu bkod yod rigs las shes thub pa ni gshen rabs mi bo che'i sbyin bdag zhang zhung srid pa'i rgyal po khri wer gser gyi bya ru can nas bzung / zhang zhung gi lo rgyus kyi dbu brnyes pa'i tshul bon gzhung rnying ma rnams las gsal ba de 'dra zhig yin stabs zhang zhung gi rgyal rabs kyi thog ma'ang dus skabs de la ngos mi 'dzin thabs med pa zhig chags yod/gnyis pa/ zhang zhungakhri sde bco brgyadatpaskul po'i skor/zhang zhung gi rgyal khams la dbang sgyur ba'i ya thog zhang zhung gi rgyal po khri wer gser gyi bya ru can nas bzung / zhang zhung gi rgyal khams su grags che ba'i rgyal po bco brgyad rim bzhin du byon myong yod pa'i tshul kha gsal ba zhig ni ka ru rtogs ldan rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i ṭwāṃ 'dzam gling gangs te se'i dkar chags tshangs dbyangs yid 'phrog〉 las/ khyad par zhang zhung khri sde bco brgyad gtsos pa'i yul chen bco brgyad la mnga' dbang che ba'i rgyal po/ srid pa gnam nas bskos pa'i zhang zhung srid pa'i rgyal po/khri wer la rje gu lang gser gyi bya ru can dang / zhang zhung zil gnon rgyal po rlabs chen khyung gi bya ru can dang / hre do gyer sgrungs rgyal po kang ka shel gyi bya ru can dang gsum ni/ gangs rin po che'i mdun spyangs ri g.yu lo ljon pa'i rdzong mkhar du chags so/ /de ltar na'ang khyung lung rgyal ba mnyes yul du slas kra gu ge'i rgyal po rin chen 'od kyi bya ru can dang / g.yung yar mu khod rgyal po gzha' tshon rdad spra 7bya rngi can

dang / kyi le gu ge rgyal po un chen dung gi bya ru can dang gsum mo/ / zhang zhung pu mar hring gi yul du/spungs rgyung gyer gyi rgyal po bye ru 'od kyi bya ru can dang / nye lo wer ya rgyal po phra min 'od kyi bya ru can gnyis so/ / zhang zhung tsi na'i yul du stag rna gzi brjid rgyal po zom shang lcags kyi bya ru can dang / dzwa dmar this spungs rgyal po me dpung 'od kyi bya ru can dang gnyis so/ / zhang zhung ta rog yul du bdud 'dul dpal gyi rgyal ngo nyi shel 'od kyi bya ru can dang / lig wer gyer gyi rgyal po zla shel 'od kyi bya ru can dang gnyis/ 'di gnyis nas gyes pa lig wer nam mkha' rgyal po yin/ zhang zhung sta sgo'i yul du shel rgyud tre do rgyal po dzo dmar 'od kyi bya ru can dang / lig mur nam mkha'i rgyal po sgo bhus 'od kyi bya ru can dang gnyis so/ / zhang zhung kha yu ga yu la du sad hri gyer gyi rgyal po ud pal 'od kyi bya ru can dang / zhang zhung la dwags yul du nye lo wer ya spyal po gnam lcags dpal gyi bya ru can dang / 'ang zhung rgyu thog yul du mu mar thog rgod rgyal po a na 'od kyi bya ru can sogs zhang zhung gi rgyal po bya ru can bco brgyad 'di rnams kyi ring la zhang zhung khri sde bco brgyad kyi mgo bo non pa dang / g.yang drung bon gyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas shing sku tshe yang mi lo nyis stong du bzhugs pa dang / phung po lhag med du sangs rgyas pa'ang yod pa'o/ /'ang zhung zhes pas gsal ba'i rgyal rabs bco brgyad po de dag gis rgyal po so so'i rgyal sa'i lte ba rgyangs ri g.yu lo ljon pa dang / khyung lung dngul mkhar bu mar hri dang / tsi na dang / ta rog sta sgo kha yu gal dwags rgyu thog bcas so so'i 'dod pa ltar mdzad yod na'ang rgyal po de kun gyis zhang zhung khri sde bco baspyad kyi mgo bo non pa zhes pa'i tshig gis gsal ba bzhin/ 'ang zhung gi mnga' sde yo ngas rdzogs dbang bsgyur yod par mngon/ bya ru’ zhes bya pa de ni zhang zhung rgyal po rnams kyi mtshan dbang che ba'i che rtags su/ rin ngo che'i rgyan chas spras pa'i dbu zhwa phal cher rmog gi dbyibs can zo 'dra ba 'ig la g.yas g.yon du sems can gyi rwa co lta bu thung la sbom pa re yod pa/ 'ang zhung me ri dang 'ang zhung snyan rgyud bcas kyi bla ma brgyud pa 'i gwangs su bzhusas pa'i 'ang zhung bi rgyal po 'ga' dang / bon gshem chen po 'ga' 'as kyi bris thang rnying ma rnams su sasal bor mjal du yo da 'dug pa de la zer ba yin/ zhang zhung gi rgyal po de rnams kyis mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i zhang zhung khri sde bcobargyad ces su grags pa de dag ni/ nyer mkho'i snang ba'i lung ya thog 'ang zhung gi bon rabs bshad pa'i skabs su drangs li ltar/ zhang zhung sgo phugasabar gsum du grags pa las/ sngon dus 'ang zhung gi rgyal po khri wer gser gyi bya ru can la sogs pa'i dus skabs de dag tu/ zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum du grags shing / dus der da lta'i stod mnga' ris la dwags dang bcas pa de tsho la zhang zhung phugs dang / dbus gtsang gi phyogs la 'ang zhung bar dang /mdokhams rgyalanong bi phyogs la zhang zhung sgo zhes grags kyiyo da pa red/ dus skabs der gangs ri'i ra bas bsko ra ba'iljongs chen po der zhang zhung las stobs dbang che ba med pa dang / sa ni zhang zhung gi sa yin pa dang mi nizhang zhung gi mi yin zhes pas zhang zhung gis dbang byas/ yul sde sgophugs bar gsum zhes pa des spyi la khyab pa bzhin chags yo da stabs de skad du grags nga4 yin no/ /—— 28 —

gsum pa/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag0la po'i skor/bstan pa'i sbyin bdag lin wer nam mkha' rgyal/ / de nas da bar bzhengs byed sbyin pa'i bdag/dal 'byor stobs ldan rab brtan rgyal po yin/ / gdung rabs lo rgyus mdo tsam bstan pa la/ / sngon tshe rgyal mo rgyal yi rong chen de/ /zhang zhung sbra las mched pa'i rje 'bangs kun/ /ku ru zhes pa 'byo ba gnas spor pa'o/ / brag sgom pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i spyo mdo smad chos 'byung〉 las kyang / zhang zhung sbra las chad pas rgyal rong la zhang zhung gi rgyal rgyud dang rgyal rong gi rgyal po rnams kyang phal cher rab brtan gyi rgyud nas chad pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /g.yung drung bon gyi bka' khams brgyad gtan la phab pa'i stong phrag brgya bar gangs chen shar phyogs rgyal mo rong gi zhing khams bde legs dpal la 'god par dgongs nas ma g.yos ngang las g.yo ba ye shes kyi 'od rab tu spros pas srid pa gnam nas bskos pa'i zhang zhung srid pa'i rgyal po khri wer la rje gu lang gser gyi bya ru can lha dbang brgya byin gyi gdung rgyud 'ang zhung tarog yul nas bdud 'dul dpal gyi rgyal po nyi shel 'od kyi bya ru can dang lig wer gyer gyi rgyal po zla shel 'od kyi bya ru can nas thugs rgyud bskul bas mched par/ skyabs med dkos thag pa shar rgyal mo rong gi 'gro ba'i mgon du 'byon par dgongs nas bka' stsal lo/ / de nas 'od kyi mi dkar po rdzu 'phrul rtsal gyis rgyal mo dmu ri'i rtse la phebs nas gzigs tshe/ 'di ltar gsungs so/ / lha sras nyid dang nyid kyi brgyud pa yis/ / shar rong gdan sa gnam phyed gos/ su mnabs / / sa phyed gdan bting sgang ring dgu dbang ba'i/ / ltas bzang gzigs pas dgyes shing bzhugs par snang / / de'i tshe chu de byang phyogs nas lhor 'bab rgyud kyis ri tshogs gcan gzan khros paltar 'dra ba'i khrod du/ ri gcig khyad du 'phags pa'i mkha' la 'gying ba'i bla ri'i gzhol la srid rgyal gyi bla mtsho'i drung du dar cig mnal gzims tshe/ ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mo mngon sum byon nas srid rgyal gyi phyaya tu gnam gyi yig tshang bsnams mas lha/ sras kyi phyag tu phul nas sa chen ka ling ka la sadan drangs ba'i skabs/ yul mi kun der 'dus thing brtags par dpyad pa byas nas rang skad kyis 'di skad do/ /'od kyi mi dkar 'od 'dom gang tsam gas la/ / 'al ras dkar gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ / srid pa khams kyi 'gran zla yongs bral ba/ khyed ni su yin ci don 'ib mor gsungs/ / khong na re/ nga ni lha sras ye shes mkhyen mnga' bas/ /tshig don thogs med mkhyen pa'i gnam gyi lha/ /sa la skye 'gro'i rje bor byon pa yin/ / zhes sogs gsungs pas kun gyis mgo bos btud do/ /de'i tshe bon gyi bla ma co bon gyim bus lha sras byon pa mkhyen kyang mi mkhyen par brdzus par/ dri bas gsungs pa la khyod mi'amalha/ ya nga na'adra gang rin nam kho na re/ci bdāg ni lha bu mkha' 'gying lha yi mngags/ / dbu nag mi rje sa dang mi ye bdag lesasanyes 'byed pa'i phyag mkhas thig 'dzin no/ /zhes gsu ngas/ co bon na re/ gyim bu bdag dzikhyed dpung gsa.oṃ/ / rgyal khams bon 'khor bskor la mtha' 'khob gling / /dge bsgyur cukas blang dor bams hudzā / /sangs rgyas ston si 'i sku —— 29 —

tshab skyes su gnang / / lha sras phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su bkur/ / dzu 'phrul sman bzhis phul ba'i nor bu bzhi/ /gzi yi sgrom bu gser phyes bkangs pa brgyad/ /g.yu dang mu min byu ru smra med pa/ khal ni nga lnga'i sa bcud gsor du bzhag /lha sras gong bas lha dang srung ma mchod/ /sde brgyad dam 'dus pho brang rmang bting btsugs/ / gyad rdo pha bong rmang ba de yi steng / / rdzu 'phrul mi bzhis pho brang de la brtsigs/ /rgyal po bzhugs pa'i khri yang legs par bshams/ /lung ba'i phyogs bzhi dbus lnga g.yu thog lnga/ /brtsigs pas pho brang g.yu rtse zhes su bsags/ / lha sras gong du kun gyis spyi rje bkur/ / btsan po gnya'aganon nyam thag mtha' nas skyong / / maspyogs kyi sngon bcad dpung gis kha lo bsgyur/ / lig wer btsan na rab brtan rgyal po grags/ / rigs min btsun ma tsung ni khab tu bzhes/ / de'i tshe mi 'gyur 'gran med brtan bcu 'dzoms/ /bla ri mi 'gyur mkha' 'gying lha yi ri/ /bla chu mi 'gyur rgyal mo dngul mdangs rgyun/ /yul ljongs mi 'gyur brtan pa ka ling ka /gnas byin mi 'gyur rnam snang rdo yi sku/ /rten mchog mi 'gyur sku tshab bde 'byung gnas/ /sa gzhi mi 'gyur dpal gyi grong khyer che/ /rgyal rgyud mi 'gyur lig wer gnam gyi spyal/ /mchod gnas mi 'gyur bon mchog rin po che/ /de ltar gnam gyi rgyal po'i bya las de/ / sa dang skye 'gro'i bsod nams bsags pas byung / / co bon gyim bu'i tshan khrus byas nas nam mkha' rgyal po mtshan gsol/ de nas sa pho stag gi lo la yum btsun tsung ma la dus bab dang mthun pa'i tshes bzang dus bzang re la lnga phyi bar gsum gyi khri ming thog pa sras gsum 'khrungs pa/ sras che ba dang po gser khri zhes stod kyi tha thu mdzad pa'i stod kyi yar lung rgyal po zhes su grags/ de dus bod kyi mnga' khongs so sor mi 'dra ba chags yod pa'i rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis dang bzhi bcu zhes bya ba de dag mang zhig ni zhang zhung gi grib 'og 'khod pa dang / 'ga' shas ni rgyal phran rang gis dbang byas nas bsdad yod pa de ni pha sil ma7 zhes pa'i tha snyad byas yod pa de kho nas kyang shes thub pa red/le'u bzhi ba/ zhang pod 'dres ma'i dus rabs/spyi lo'i sngon 417 pa'i shing byi lor gnya' khri 'khrungs pa ltar na/ rgya nag tu kran go'i dus rabs (lorjetshorki)'go tshugs pa'i skabs bod du zhang bod 'dres ma'i srid dbang lam lugs kyi 'go tshugs yod par shes thub cing / skabs de'i sngon du byung ba'i rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang / spyal rabs sil ma bzhi bcu sogs ni mi'u gdung drug gi mi brgyud tha dad pas dbus gtsang khul du zhang zhung gi srid dbang las zur bkol rang lugs kyi srid dbang bzung ba'i lam srol thog mar 'go tshugs pa'i mngon rtags shig red/ rgyal phran bcu gnyis sam bzhi bcu grags pa de dag gi yul gang zhig na yod pa/ rgyal po dang blon po'i ming sogs kyi skor rob tsam zhig ni ṭwāṃ rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa〉 las/ yul 'chims yul — 30 —

nag po dgu sul na/ rgyal po 'chims rje ni gu/ blon po dang dang ding / yul zhang zhung na/ rgyal zhang dar gyi rje li ga shur bzhugs/ blon po sma ra sang rje/ yul myang ro mched na/ rgyal po rtsang rje thod dkar/ blon po ban/ yul snubs yul gling dgu na/ rgyal snubs rje srid pa/ blon po the'u dang 'gro/yul nyang re sham po na/ rgyal po long ngam byi rom/ blon po she'u dang yug yul gyi ra ljang sngon po na/rgyal po yi rje rmongs po/ blon po ngas mi dang 'gro/ yul ngas po khra sna na/ rgyal po gung khri zings po rje khri 'bangs gsum/ blon po mgar dang snyan/ yul 'ol phu yang mkhar na/ rgyal po zin 'brang rje/ blon po go dang sbas/ yul kris sna rdol mo gong na/ rgyal po drang rje gong rnams bzhugs/ blon po sprad dang zhu/yul nyang yul rnam gsum na/ rgyal po nyang btsun glang rgyab bzhugs/ blon po de ru srun gnyis bzhugs/yul dwags yul so mo gru bzhi na/ rgyal po dwags rje lce mang bzhugs/ blon po bla dang kam mo/ yul 'brog rnam gsum na/ rgyal po rgyal mo ser khri bzhugs/ blon po skang re nag po bzhugs/ de dag gis yongs su grags pa'i rgyal phran bcu gnyis zhes bya ba de dag gsal bar bstan pa'o/ /rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni yul dbye mo yul drug na/ rgyal po dbye rje mkhar ba/ blon po sbo rdog yul sreg yul sa mo gru bzhi na/ rgyal po rdog rje tshe'u klu 'brung / yul klum ro ya sum na/spyal po nam sa rtsi ti la sogs pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis dbang byas/ don du sil ma bcu gnyis dang /sil ma bzhi bcur grags pa'i rgyal phran ji snyed cig byung myong yod pa de dag gi go rtogs la brten nas de rnams dang phan tshun ltos spub kyi chos nyid yod pa'i mi sde rnams ji ltar byung yod pa dang / de dag gi gnas tshul ji ltar yin pa gsal por nges byed shin tu 'brel che ba'i lo rgyus shig yin stabs/ tshul 'di ni bod kyi thog ma'i mi rabs 'phel rgyas ji ltar byung tshul la nges shes 'byin byed kyi cha rkyen dmigs gsal can zhig yin pa go dgos pa yin/ dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng ba〉 las/ sil ma bcu gnyis dang bzhi bcu'i spyal phran rnams ji ltar byung myong ba'i tshul gsal bor bkod pa 'di ni gna' mi rgan po 'ga'i zer sgros yi ger bkod pa tsam zhig min pa/ gna' bo'i lo rgyus kyi dpe khungs ldan pa zhig la brten nas bkod mdzad yod pa ni mtha' gcig tu nges te/ de'i shes byed khyad par can zhig ni tun hong nas thon pa'i gna' bo'i bod yig las de bzhin du gsal bor 'dug rgyal phran bcu gnyis la/ ser ri khri dang bcu gsum/ blon po nyi shu rtsa bzhi na/ skyang re gnag dang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mkhar bcu gnyis na/ dbu sde dam pa dang bcu gsum/rgyal dgu'i sngo bcu/ blon dgu'u mchims bcu zhes bya/ zhes pa gsal bor bstan pa 'di dag gis nges shes rnyed thub pa yin/ gnas tshul 'di dag la dpyad na bod 'dir ya thog gi mi brgyud chags pa nas bzung / bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po byung ba'i bar der bod kyi yul khams dang mnga' sde ci rigs la dbang byed pa'i rgyal phran dang / blon po ji snyed cig byung myong yod pa'ang shes thub pa yin/de dus rgyal mo rong chen 'dir zhang zhung dang 'dra ba'i zhang rgyal zhes grags pa'i zhang zhung dzee rgya~X ༵ snga ba khri

wer la rje gu lang saser gyi bya ru can gyi gdung rgyud chu chen li wer nam mkha' rgyal po'i shar rong gdan sa gnam phyed gos su mnabs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de la sras khri ming thog ma de stod yar lung ser khri rgyal po zhes dang / 'bring po khri 'od dam khri 'og de nyid snad kyi rgya nag thor cog rgyal por grags/ tha chung khri ti rgyal po ni pho brang g.yu rtse'i rgyal sa'i mnga' bdag mdzad ces ṭwāṃ bon gyi rgyal rabs mu tig 'phreng ba〉 dang bka' khams brgyad pa〉 gnyis las gsungs so/ / pad〉 las gto phug ltar na bod rje gnya' khri btsan po yan chad kyi rgyal phran bcu gnyis byung ba de rnams yul mi nyag nas ldong rigs dang /de bzhin sum bha nas 'bri/ 'ang zhung nas sbra/ 'a zha nas gi byung ste bod kyi rgyal po re mdzad pa'i mi brgyud mched pa ltar/ zhes gsal bor bshad pa de red/ skabs 'dir bod kyi rgyal po re mdzad pa'i mi brgyud mched pa ltar 'dug ces gsungs pa 'di gsungs stangs kyi thog tu go rim cung zad 'khrugs pa red/gang la zer na/ rus chen de dag las mched pa'i mi brgyud zhang bod kyi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs su rgya khyab tu 'phel rgyas byung yod par brten/ rus chen 'ji dag gi gtso bo'i mi rje rnams kyis bod kyi rgyal po mdzad pa'i don yin dgos pa las/ rgyal po'i gdung las bod kyi mi brgyud mched pa'i don yin mi dgos la/ de 'dra yin yang srid thabs med/ spyir btang yul khams gang 'dra ba zhig yin yang rung / yul der thog mi'i 'gro ba chags/ de nas rim gyis yul der mthu dbang ldan pa'i mi 'ga' zhig byung ba de dag gis mi tshogs la dbang sgyur byas te yul gyi rje bo'am/ rgyal por chags yod pa 'di ni 'jin rten gyi chos nyid cig red/dang po/ bod rgyal gnya' khri'i skor/spyal phran de rnams 'thab rtsod gsod gcod la dga'/ / legs nyes mi brtsi bkyon 'bebs btson rar 'dzud/ / mtha'abazhi'i rgyal pos rtagatu mnar 'ing gtso/ / rgya nag rgyal po shing la sbrul ltar 'khri/rgya gar rgyal po lug sprung ltar tu 'jab/ /stag gzig rgyal po bya khyung khra ltar rgyug /ge sar rgyal po zhing la me ltar 'tshab/ /de ltar bskornga/ pa'i rgyal po phyogs bzhi kha na grags/ bod dbus na rmongs pas khas nyen te/ rgol du mi thub pa'i brag ri btsan po ltar 'dzin skad/ de'i dus su phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po dang /dbang mdzad bcu gnyis sogs mnga' 'og tu 'dus ma 'dod pas rje 'tshol bar 'gro zhes 'bangs mi drug dang / bon shes pa mkhan mi bcu gnyis dang byang lam saya' le gong du u be ra bya ba bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor legs pa/ phyag sor dra bas 'brel ba/ mthu che ba zhig dang phrad nas/ khyod su yin/ sang nas 'ongs dris pas/ nga spu bo'i yul nas 'ongs/ da bod la 'gro zhes pas/ 'o na khyod la nus pa ci yod zer/ de na re/ nga nus mthu che bas yul mi kun gyis sprugs pa yin zer/ 'o na khyod kyis bod kyi rje e nus byas pas/ khyod rang rnams khyis gnya' bar khri la bteg cig dang / mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis gdo/ mi ༵ 2zer ba dang / der ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin gnya' bar btegs nas gdan drangs/ bod

mi kun la bstan pas thams cad 'jigs shing dngangs/ bon gshen gtse ldan mtsho mgron zhes pa bstan pas/ 'di bod kyi rje bor 'os so zhes gsungs te tshan khrus byas te/ mi'i rje gnya' khri btsad por mtshan gsol nas bod kyi rgyal sar bkod do/ / rgyas par lta 'dod na mkhas pa lde'u mdzad pa'iṭwāṃ rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa〉 dang / lcang glang ba rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈 yum bu bla sgang gi dkar chag 'bring po〉la gzigs/ zhes su gsal ba'i lo rgyus kyi khungs de 'ang yang gsang du grags pa'i lo rgyus snying ma las byung ba zhig yin pa mngon gsal red/ bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po'i mtshan la gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags pa'i rgyu mtshan de/ bon mi tshos gnya' bar khri byas te btegs nas gong du bkur ba'i rkyen gyis rgyal po'i mtshan la'ang gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags pa yin tshul gyi shod stangs 'di ni/ bon lugs dang chos kyi lo rgyus tshang ma'i lta stangs yongs grags shig chags yod/ gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs nas bzung yul 'di zhang bod kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi dbang bsgyur byas kyang / gson gshen gyi sku rim dang dge sbyor gyi rigs dang / dngos spyod byas pa'i kun gyi rig gzhung thams cad bon lugs ltar yin pa dang / gshen la skyabs bcol ba sogs gcig gyur du gnas yod/rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po byung ba'i gong der/ bod du gshin po nam mkha'i snang ba'i mdog can bzhugs nas bod mi rnams kyi gshen po mdzad yod pa dang / thog ma'i gnya' khri btsan po'ang / bon gi gshen po gtse ldan mtsho mgron sogs kyis bon gyi tshan khrus nas phyungs te/ gnya' khri btsan po zhes pa'i mtshan gsol tshul bon gyi lo rgyus rnams la yongs su grags pa zhig yin pa dang / gnya' khris bod kyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i dus der rgyal srid skyong byed kyi shes rig ni zhang zhung nas byung ba'i bon las gzhan pa ni med la bon gyi shes rig gi ga'i rtsa ni 'ang zhung gi skad yig dang 'brel ba'i shes rig de tsam du nges pa yin stabs/bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri'i dus nas bzung / dus phyis bod yul dbus kyi rgyal rabs stongs pa'i bar der/ bod kyi rgyal po re la spyal po'i sku gshen gyi bonapo re'ang yod pa dang / rgyal po'i sras rnams sku 'khrungs pa'i skabs su/ rgyal po'i sku gshen gyis rgyal sras de bon gyi tshan khrus nas phyungs te mtshan gso la ba'i srol yod pa dang / mtshan de'ang gna' rabs kyi rang gshis mi nyams pa dang / bon skyong gi rgyal rabs yin pa'i che rtags su/ zhang zhung gi skad las drangs pa'i mtshan re gsol ba'i lugs srol rgyun ma chad pa byung yod/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po tsam du ma zad/gnam gyi khri bdun du grags pa'i rgyal po mu khri btsan po/ ding khri btsan po/ dar khri btsan po/ ye khri btsan po/ seng khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po rnams dang / legs drug tu grags pa'i rgyal po/ a sho legs/ de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ gu rumalegs/ 'brang zhi legs/ i sho legs sogs nas/phyis spyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang mu ni btsan po sogs kyi bar bod kyi rgyal rabs thams cad la zhang zhung gi skad las drangs pa'i mtshan kho na yo da la/ rgyal po de rnams kyi mtshan la bod skad du go don ci'ang med pa 'dra zhig tu snang mod/ don du mi'i rje bo rgyal po rnams kyi mtshan yin stabs/ go don rgya che la gting — 33 —

zab pa sha stag yin nges pa ni sgros ma dgos/gnyis pa/ ming gi mtshan donatsār/zhang zhung gi skad du khri7zhes pa ni bod skad du lha'am lha'i thugs zhes pa'i don yin la/ de bzhin du phamu7zhes pa ni kun khyab/ pha ding7zhes pa ni klong / pha dar7zhes pa ni legs pa/ pha ye7zhes pa ni thog ma'am gdod ma/ phaseng7zhes pa ni song ge/ pha.a sho7zhes pa ni ngag phade sho7zhes pa ni bde ba/ phathi sho7zhes pa ni gsar ba/ phagu rum7zhes pa ni ston/ pha'abrang7zhes pa ni 'ja' tshon/pha e sho7zhes pa ni snyan grags/ phasrong7zhes pa ni thogs med/ phalde'u7zhes pa ni rig pa'am mkhyen pa dang / phamu na7zhes pa ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ tshul de dag gis rgyal po so so'i mtshan don gang dag yin pa'ang gsal bor shes thub pa yin/ pha khri7zhes pa 'di'i don lha'am lha'i thugs nyid kyi don yin stabs/ gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi spyal po khri wer gser gyi bya ru can dang / khri sde lcags kyi bya ru can/zhang zhung gi bon gshen chen po khri 'od gsal dang / ra sangs khri na khod/ khri btsan po 'od lde sogs mang zhig byung myong yod pa dang / gzhan yang / gshen rab mi bo che'i mdzad mdo gzi bajid las/ rje rigs btsun po dang / gtsug lcam dwangs ma gnyis las sras drug 'khrungs te/ khri wer dang / khri ma/khri btsun/ khri brten/ khri rje/ khri'u ra tsa dang drug ste/ de'i mi rgyud shin tu skyed legs mtshan dang ldan pa blon rtsed mi 'chad par byung ngo / / zhes gsal ba ltar zhang zhung skad kyi tha snyad sngon nas yongs su grags pa zhig yin stabs/ bod kyi btsan po rnams kyi mtshan du'ang baid spyod byas pa zhig yin pa las/gnya' khri la khri'i tha snyad byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de rjes su byung ba'i bod kyi btsan po rnams la mtshan de skad du grags pa'i don zhig rtsa ba nas min pa 'di shes dgos pa gal chen po zhig red/ pha nyag ri’ zhes pa ni dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i gter phyon srid pa rgyud kyi kha byang〉las/ nyag ri zhes pa ni khod po blo gros thogs med/ dmu za gnyis mthing ma dang bshos pa la/ yar gshegs su ni yum grongs la/ mar gshegs su ni sras mnol bas/ ltag pa'i sdud sgor skra nyag gcig dang 'khril nas gshegs pa'i sras/ldi nyag ri brtsad po lags so/ / zhes gsal zhing lung 'di'i dgongs don ni gong gsal yo ga lha gyes can gyi skabs su/ yab bla brdal drug dang yum rmu btsun khri sman du bshos pa'i sras khri bar gyi bdun tshigs de mu yul du smyugs pa de dang / zhang mu yul gyi thang thang gi sras mo phu mo dre mu dre btsun mo dang bshos pa'i sras kums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ sras kyis yum la 'di skad du smras te/ yar gshegs na ni yum grongs 'gro/mar gshegs na ni sras mnol bas/ sgal pa'i mkha' gcig phye bar gsol/ byas nas sor phrag g.yas pa nas byon/ zhes de'i don dang gcig cing / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni skabs 'dir rgyal po'i mtshan du5 nyag ri brtsad po’ zhes bshad cing / de'i rgyu mtshan yang yum gyi ltag pa'i sdud sgor yod pa'i skra nyag gcig la 'khril ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyag khri'i tha snyad byung bar bshad yod pa de red/ dzi nyag khri7zhes pa ni ṭwāṃtun hong gi dpe rnying〉las/ khri'i bdun tshigs kyi sras/ khri nyag khri btsan po zhes pa dang / khri'i — 34 —

bdun tshigs kyi sras/ lde nyag khri btsad po zhes sogs kyis gsal ba rnams te/ don du dzi nyag7 ces pa brda rnying ltar nadzi nyag gcig ste gcig pu'am kho na'i don yin la/ zhang zhung gi skad ltar na dzilha mthu bo che7 ste gshin rje dang 'dra ba'i lha drag po zhig gi ming yin/ pha khri7 zhes pa ni lha'am lha'i thugs nyid gang rung la 'jug par brten/ bod kyi brda rnying dang 'azel ba'i lugs su byas na lha gcig ces pa'i don yod par/ zhang skad kho na'i dbang du byas na lha'i thugs nyid ces pa'i don yin stabs/ gnya' khri'i mtshan dngos de rang yin las tshe ba 'dra/ phanyag7 pha nya khri ’ zhes pa ni kong po de mo'i brag bskos kyi yig phreng gsum pa dang bzhi par phywa yab bla brdal drug gi sras las/ nya khro btsan po mi yul rjer/ lha ṛ gyang dor gshegs pa tshun chad/ ces gsal ba dang / gzhan yang blon po bka'i thang yig〉 las/ gnya' khri btsan po zla ba nya la skyes/ nya khri btsan po zhes kyang bya/ zhes zla ba nya la skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis pha nya khri ’zhes pa'i mtshan byung lugs rgyu mtshan dang bcas te bstan yod pa de red/gna' bo'i lo rgyus rnams su rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i mtshan la pha 'o lde spu rgyal7 lam pha 'o de spu rgyal’’ zhes pa'ang 'bod srol byung yod 'dug de'i skor lha sa'i gtsug lag khang mdun ngos rdo ring shar ngos las gsal ba ni/ bod kyi gna' rabs yig cha gces bsdus〉 las/ 'phrul rgya lha btsan po 'o sde spu spyal/ yul byung sa dod tshun cad/ 'ung nas myi'i rjer/ bod spyo rgyal po mdzad pa yang / gangs ri mthon po'i ni dbus/ chu bo chen po'i ni mgo/ yul mtho sa gtsang ba la/ gnam rgya lha las my-i'i rgyal por gshegs te/ gtsug lag chen pos n-i yun gyi srid btsugs zhes dang / 'phyongs spyas khri lde srong btsan gyi bang so'i mdun du yod pa'i rdo ring las gsal ba ni/ bod kyi rdo ring gi yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang〉las kyang / btsan po lha sras/ 'o lde spu rgyal/ gnam gyi lha las sbyi'i rjes gshegs pa zhes dang /ṭwāṃ tung hong gi dpe rnying〉las/ mtha' ma 'o lde spu rgyal gyi dbu rmog ma thob ces pa rnams kyis gsal ba de red/ de las pha 'o lde’’'am pha 'o de’ zhes pa de ni rgyal po nyid kyi mtshan dmigs bsal zhig yin la/khri sru rgyal’’ zhes pa ni phal cher rgyal po de nyid gang nas byung ba'i mtshan zhig yin las shin tu che/ gang la zer na/ pha spu rgyal ’ zhes bya ba'i mtshan de ni thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri tsam du ma zad/ bod kyi rgyal po gzhan dag la'ang beed sbyod byas yod pa ni tung hong gi dpe rnying〉las/ myang dpa'as gnyis zing po rje las 'khrungs te/ btsan po spu rgyal glo ba nye bar bzos nas/ mna' mtho' yang ched bcad do zhes dang /yang (sha27pha13las spu spyal stag bu snyan du bon nas zhes dang / (sha 2ṭwāṃpha83las zing po rje rgyab tu myi dor re/ sgru rgyal pang du myi len re/ btsan po spu rgyal glo ba 'dring re zhes dang / (sha 4ṭwāṃpha163las/btsan po spu rgyal khri srong btsan yab sras dang / gdung rgyud la glo bo 'dring re/ zhes pa lta bu bod kyi rgyal po rnams kyi spyi mtshan nam/ sgos la che bsngags kyi tha tshig tu sbyar nas mna' bskyal ba dang / gzhan yang btsan po 'dus srong gi mgur tun hong dpe rnying〉las/ bod kyi ni yu rgyal du/ sems shing ni re re yang / sgru rgyal ni gdung mi 'chad ces de dag gis shes thub pa yin/ yang de dang phyogs 'dra ba'i — 35 —

tshig gcig ni/ pha spur rgyal’’zhes su grags te/ de'i tshul ni/ ṭwāṃ rgyal po bka' thang〉las/ gzhug tu spu rgyal btsan pos dbang byas te/ /ming yang bod khams ru bzhi bya bar btags/ /bod kyi btsan po 'o de spu rgyal de/ /gnam gyi lha las mi yi rje ru gshegs/ /zhes pas mtshon/ gna' rabs lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gnyis pa'i nang byung ba'i rgyal rabs gnya' khri batren po nas bzung / srong btsan sgam po'i bar rgyal po'i grangs ji snyed cig byung myong yod pa la/ lo rgyus mkhan po rnams zhal mi mthun mod/ de skabs kyi lo rgyus mtha' dag gi rmang gzhi bon po'i lo rgyus kho na la ltos dgos pa yin stabs/ lugs der gzhi tso bzung dgos pa yin nam snyam/ bod la grags pa'i lo rgyus rnams kyi snying don bsdus pa legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉 las/ gnya' khri dang gnam za mug mug gi sras mu khri btsan po ste/ des gsang sngags spyi spungs kyi bon la thugs dam mdzad pas nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyi sman mo bzhi khri res bskor nas byon pa sogs grub rtags ngo mtshar ba du ma bstan/ sku srung ni gce'u lan tshas mdzad/ gsal khang kho ma nee chung bzhengs/ mu khri dang sa sman ting ting ma'i sras ding khri btsan po/ sku srung gce'u smin dkar/gsas mkhar kho ma yang rtse bzhengs/ ding khri dang se za sman gyi sras so khri btsan po/ sku gshen gce'u 'od dkar/ gsas khang mu ru dgu khyung bzhengs/ so khri dang dar za zhang zhung ma'i sras dar khri btsan po/sku gshen mtshe mi zung sman/ gsas khang zo bo khyung lag bzhengs/ dar khri dang dwags kyi lha mo'i sras dbu khri btsan po/ kha cig nas ye khri btsan po'ang zer/ sku gshen dag pa mi chen/ gsas khang g.yung drung lha rtse bzhengs/ dwags khri dang srib kyi lha mo dkar mo'i sras srib khri btsan po/ seng khri yang zer/ sku gshen gce'u 'al dkar gyis mdzad/ gsas khang kho ma ru ring bzhengs so/ /de drug ni sa nas gnam du gshegs pas gnam gyi khri bdun zhes bya/gnyis pa bar gyi lding gnyis ni/ sing khri btsad po'i sras zhes dang / (sha121pha143las/lus la gli rtags yod pas na/ / de yi phyir na gri zhes bya/ / nam gyi gung la btsas pas na/ / de yi phyir na rum zhes bya/ /sku gshen pha ba mtshe'u gtso yis/ /ming yang gri gum btsan por btags/ /zhes byams ma las so/ / de'i tshe stod la sku gshen gce'u tshoms dkar/ gsas khang sa le byu'u tshang bzhengs/ tshe smad la bon log sgrub kyisabaka' chad bab ste spyi gtsug gi dmu thag chad/ 'bangs lo ngam gyis grir bkrongs te gdung yang sa la lus pas phyis ming du gri gum btsan por grags/ de dang bal za khri btsun kyi sras ni/ bya dang rta dang spyang gi gsum gyi sru las sku dang ba sru byas pa zhig byung bas ming yang sru lde'u gong rgyal du btags so/ / de'i sku gshen gce'u gnya' bzhed/ gsas khang khri skor bzhengs/ gri gum dang spu lde gnyis ni bang so sa la btab cing mnga' thang phri bas bar gyi lding gnyis zer ro/ / yin na yang bod rgyal gri gum btsan po'i skabs su bon la nyams chag gang thub zhig byas pa de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de skabs bod kyi bon dang shes rig gang ci'i thad zhang zhung las khyad thon pa zhig med pa dang / bod kyi bon po rnamapya maṭwāṃ ḍibang che zhing / de dag gi rgyab brten du zhang zhung gi rgyal po yod stabs/ bod kyi rgyal srid

de bon po rnams la shor du dogs nas bon po rnams la nyams nyes btang yod tshul ni/ bod gyi dpe rnying rnams las/ rgyal po gri gum btsan pos yul 'dir nga'i rgyal srid dang / khyod kyi bon srid gnyis mi shong bas bon po rnams smyugs shig ces bka' phebs pa'i tshul gsal bor mkhyen thub kyi yod pa red/ de nas rgyal rabs rim gyung du zhang bod bar gyi 'brel ba de skabs 'gar mthun lam dang / skabs 'gar rtsod gleng res mos kyis dus yol ba la mthar chos spyas srong btsan sgam po yan chod du de ltar red/gsum pa sa la legs drug ni/ spu lde dang bum thang smad mtsho'i sras a sho legs rgyal/ sku gshen stobs ra shib shang / gsas khang sa le ljon phyug bzhengs/ de dang dmu lcam dra ma na'i sras de sho legs rgyal/ sku gshen mi mo chung / gsas khang kho ma yang rtse bzhengs/ de dang btsun mo gur sman gyi sras tho sho legs rgyal/ sku gshen 'dzin bon khog der/ gsas khang sa le bang bang bzhengs/ de dang mtsho sman 'brang ma'i sras gu rum legs rgyal/ sku gshen mtshes pa gnam 'dul/ gsas khang rin chen zur mang bzhengs/ de dang sman bu mo'i sras 'brang zhi legs rgyal/ sku srung lha bon ye gshen bdud 'dul/de dang klu lcam mi mo'i sras i sho legs spyal/ de rnams kyi ring la dmu thag chad de/ rgyal po rnams sa la rkang pas leb leb tu 'gro ba byung / 'das dus su pur yang sa la lus pas na sa la legs drug zer ro/ /bzhi ba chu la lde brgyad ni/ i sho legs dang dmu lcam smad legs kyi sras zin nam zin lde/ de'i sras lde 'phrul gzhung btsan/ de'i sra5 se rnol gnam lde/ de'i sras se rnol po lde/ de'i sras lde'u nam 'od/ de'i sras lde'u rnol po/ de'i sras lde'u rgyal po/ de'i sras lde'u thin btsan no/ / rgyal po re re bzhin sku srung gi gshen po re dang / g.yung drung bon gyi gsas khang re re bzhengs/ thugs dam bon sgo re re bzhugs so/ /mnga' thang dar gud med par byung zhing bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab pas na chu la lde brgyad zer ro/ /lnga ba bar gyi btsan lnga ni/ sprin btsan gyi sras to ro lo btsan/ de'i sras khri btsan nam/ de'i srasakhri sgra dpung btsan/ de'i sras thog rje thog btsan/ de'i sras tho ri lung btsan yin zhing / rgyal khrims btsan po yod pas bar gyi btsan lnga'o/ /drug pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bon rgyal bzhi ni/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku srung ni gtso'u g.yang skyes dang mtshe mi 'du 'phro gnyis so/ / rgyal po de la sras med pa la/ sku gshen gnyis kyis sman drangs lung du klu sman bsgrubs pas / sras shig bltams pa bsgrub rdzas ra dkar mo'i 'o mas gsos pas btsad pos ra sha mi za ba des yin skad/ de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po tho tho ri yang sku tshe nyis brgyar bzhugs so/sras de yang klu sman gyi dngos grub yin pas klu gnyan gzung btsan zhes zer/ khri gnyan gzung btsan du'ang grags/ sku gshen 'ang zhung tsha la byung / de'i sras 'brang snyan lde'u/ sku gshen phon po ma rung /de'i sras dmus tsha nga zhig byung ba la gshen pos spyan bsgrubs pas grub ste/ pha ri la ri dwags gnyan 'dug pa sazigs pas/ stag gong gnyan gzigs su btags/ sku gshen ra sangs khri niwa khod3/ 7 rgyal po

'di'i ring la rgyal phran bcu gnyis mnga' zhabs su bsdus/ stag gong gnyan gzigs kyi sras gnam ri srong btsan/ sku gshen za lha dbang phyug go/ rgyal po de bzhi'i ring bon la bkur bsti thin tu che zhing chab srid rgyas pas phun sum tshogs pa'i bon rgyal bzhi zer ro/ /chos spyal srong btsan sgam po'i yab gnam ri srong btsan dang bcas te/ gnam gyi khri bdun/ bar gyi lding gnyis/ sa la legs drug chu la lde brgyad/ bar gyi btsan lnga/ phug sum tshogs pa'i bon rgyal bzhi bcas/ mdor na rgyal rabs sum cu so gnyis phyin yod pa gsal bar bstan yod/ ṭwāṃrgyal po bka' thang〉las/ gnam gyi khri bdun/ gri gum dang spu lde gung rgyal/ sa la legs drug rgyal rabs sil ma bdun/ tshigs la btsan lnga/ 'brong gnyan lde ru/ stag ri gnyan gzigs dang / gnam ri srong btsan bcas rgyal rabs sum cu phyin yod tshul gsal bas mtshen/ de'i skor tun hong gi dpe rnying〉 las kyang de bzhin gsal/ dngos don gyi dbang du byas na/ dzi bar gyi lding gnyis te/ rgyal po gri gum btsan po dang / spu lde gung rgyal gnyis kyi bar der/ lo ngam gyis lo bcu gsum gyi ring bod kyi rgyal sa bzung ba'i tshul legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉las/ ju thig rgyud 'bum las/ de nas lo bcu gsum lon pa'i rjes su spyal po lo ngam rta rdzi bsad/ spu lde gong rgyal gdan sa thob po/ / zhes pa'i lo bcu gsum du lo ngam gyis spyal sa bzung / de nas spu ldes rgyal sa thob ste bon bsdubs nas bon bstan spel ba'i bar du lo bcu bdun song bar bshad do/ /zhes gsal ba ltar na/ thog ma'i spyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bar du/ bod kyi rgyal rabs so gsum phyin yod pa de ni gna' rabs kyi dus rabs gnyis pa'i ring la byung ba'i rgyal rabs rnams yin/gsum pa/ lig wer nam mkha' rgyal po/lig wer gnam gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba de ni sa dang skye 'gro'i bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir du sa pho stag gi lo la btsun mo btsan chung ma khab tu bzhes pa'i sras gsum gyi thog ma khri rje stod kyi yar lung rgyal po zhes su grags/ 'bring po khri 'od ni smad rgya nag thor cog can gyis rgyal po zhes su grags/ tha chung khro ti rgyal po pho brang g.yu rtse'i mnga' bdag mdzad/ khro ti'i sras ye 'bum dkar po 'khrungs/ de'i sras zhal dkar/ de'i sras yul 'khor/ de'i sras gser slong tshangs yig de'i sras bka' rtags/ 'di'i skabs su bka' rje g.yu rtse pho brang bzhengs nas/ sngar yod gshen rab lha khang du khro bo stag lha me 'bar srung ma gsol bas na/ yul bco brgyad du srung dmag dregs pa bco brgyad du bkol lo/ /bka' rtags kyi sras lig wer mtshan can 'khrungs/ lig wer gyi sras ne wer/ de'i sras ting wer/ de'i sras slas wer/ de'i sras drung can/ de'i sras g.yung drung / de'i sras ser 'bum/ de'i sras g.yu rin/de'i sras rin chen/ de'i sras dngul 'khor/ de'i sras gser 'dzin/ de'i sras mang khar/ de'i sras sgom blo/ de'i sras mang khar sgom skyabs zhes pa 'khrungs nas/ lig wer g.yu rtse pho brang dang sngar gshend+ra ra~X ṭwāṃ khang rgyas su btang bas g.yung drung lha steng gnyis po bzhengs nas dran pa nam mkha' yab sras

sogs kyis mchod gnas mdzad cing / de'i tshe bkra shis nyams dga' brag lha'i tshal/ /star ka sdong po'i grib bsil la/ /dpal gyi g.yung drung lha steng la/ /rab gnas dga' ston mdzad pa'i dus/ /dran pa nam mkha' 'chi med gtsug phud la/ / yi shes lha yi ting 'dzin bon bstan pas/ / shis bya'i sgrib byang thogs bod gser khri bzhugs/ /gnyen gyi rgyal po dngul gyi khri'i steng bzhugs/ /dpa' mdzangs 'asaul ldan blon po'i tshogs kyis bsgor/ /bod 'bangs skye bo rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/ kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'i 'ja' yi gur/ /rgyal gshen bzhugs pa'i mkha' la gdugs ltar 'khyil/ /lha rnams me tog char ba rab tu 'babs/ /ro brgya ldan pa lha yi zhal zas tshogs/ nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin zad pa med par spyod/ /khye'u bu dang bu mo thams cad kyis/ /mdzes pa'i chas brgyan lag na rnga ma thogs/ /rnga brdung dung 'bud glu len gar stabs bsgyur/ / g.yag dang seng ge dar sang stag seng dang / / 'brug dang rgya dkar zlos gar mkhan la sogs/ / dpal dang mdzes pa'i phyag mtshan thogs nas 'cham/ / de ltar rgyal gshen sku la mchod pa 'bul/ /spu yi skyo bsang tshogs ni bltar mi lang / /dga' bde skyed pa'i bka' khrims dril tshen sgrogs/ / rgyal gshen bon gyi rnga chen rab tu brdung / / de'i tshe blon 'bangs kun gyi rgyal po yi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mthong bas bstod cing bsngags/ /sbas pa'i bco brgyad dregs pa bco brgyad bkod/ /so sor dga' bde'i dpal la rol bas 'das/ / rgyal rong bde skyid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ / mang khar sgom skyabs kyi sras snad pa ta yod/ de'i sras a skyabs/ de'i sras kha te nyi 'bum/ de'i sras khro bo 'bum rgyal la sras bzhi'i gcen po grags rgyal/ de'i sras a wang / de'i sras g.yung 'bum/ de'i sras gsum gyi 'bring po rnam rgyal grags pa/ rnam rgyal grags pa la sras gsum gyi 'bring po khro bo rgyal po/de'i sras tshe dbang don 'grub de'i sras ya drung / ya drung gi sras lnga 'khrungs bas sku chen grags rgyal/grags spyal la sras gsum 'khrungs bas 'bring po rdo rje rgyal/ de'i sras zla ba la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i gcen po 'bum spyal/ 'bum rgyal la sras sku mched bzhi yi gcen 'og a blo de'i sras gnyis kyi gcen lha spyal la sras med pas/ gcung chung rgyal ba lha 'bum gyis sras ji srung gis rgyal srid skyong ba'i de la sras lnga yi gcen 'og lha dbang rdo je/ lha dbang rdo rje la sras lnga 'khrungs pa'i gcen 'og rdo rje rgyal gyis rgyal srid skyong bas na/ spyal po re la sku srung gcen po re/ /bzhengs pa'i gsas khang mdzad 'phrin mtha' yas pas/ /bron srid rgyal srid skyong ba'i rim pa ni/ /zhib par rgyal rabs mu tig 'azeng bar gsal/ /rgyal po rdo rje rgyal gyi sras lnga las/ /lcam sring a kho btsan lha'i btsun mo byon/ /gcen po mi dbang nam mkha' rgyal po'i mtshan/ /chung ngu'i dus nas thugs sgom blo rtsal rgyas/ /mkhyen rabs rgya mtshe'i gting la dbang 'byor zhing / / zab brling bon gyi sgo mo rgya mtsho la/ / dad pa'i nges shes bcos min yang yang skyes/ /de'i tshe rig 'dzin kun grol grags pa de/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i smon lam las btsan bzhin/ /rong khams spyi dang khyad par rab rgyal gyi/ / snying nas dad pas gtsug tu bkur ba'i tshe/ / thugs gsang ye shes kho ra khor yug dbyings/ /bslu med lung gis zin pas bka' 'di skad/ /rgyal po gsal mchog dam — 39 —

pa'i rnam 'phrul khyed/ /snga 'gyur bstan la dad pa'i dpal kha bstod/ /bstan pa 'dzin dang skyong ba spel dang bsgrub/ / rems shig rems shig des na khyed nas bzung / / rab rgyal phas rgol gdan sa mi brje zhing / /tshe 'dir bsod nams chos srid je spyas 'ongs/ /phyi ma ye shes tshogs kyang je rgyas 'gro/ /zhes sogs blang dor rags zhib rim par gnang / /rgyal po dam pa thugs 'jam zhi dul des/ /sa khams drang thigs mdzad pas bde la bkod/ / rten bzhengs dge bskul dge 'dun rgya mcho bsnyi/ /phongs la sbyin 'byed mthun dpe yid bzhin nor/ / gang yang thugs la 'dod bzhin lhun gyis byung / /bstan sbyin ji ltar mnga' thang rgyas pa der/ / 'jungs can phas kyis rgol ba'i rigs gyur kyang / / lha dbang snyim par rtse brgya 'dzin pa yis/ / sbyin skyes bcom bzhin thugs bskyed yongs su dkar/ /rgyal brgyud sras kyang gong bdag rgyal po dang / / klu dbang rgya mtsho ston pa dbang gi rgyal/ / bsod nams dbang rgyal grags rgyal bstan pa rje/ / de ltar 'khrungs shing sa skyong rgyal bo des/ / dus rgyun brtan g.yo mi rtag chu bzhis g.yeng / / chu shing 'bras bzhin sgyu ma mngon gzigs pas/ / sngon gyi dgra bcom rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bzhin/ / rnam 'dren dam pa kun grol grags pa'i mdun/ khyim bsten dge bsnyen sdom pa nod par mdzad/ /mtshan kyang nam mkha' g.yung drung ye shes dang / /dbang gi rgyal po zhes su gsol ba yin/ / lo grangs bar du gzhung mthun 'dzol med srungs/ / bslab pa gsum ldan bsod nams rgyal mtshan drung / khyim spangs rab byung so zar sdom pa blangs/ / mtshan kyang nam mkha' ye shes zhes su gsol/ /phyi tshul nang khrims dri med me tog dang / / g.yo med dam bca' ches brtan sa'i phur bzhin/ /sngon sbyong 'phro sad 'chad cing rtsom pa yang / / bslab cing sbyong med chu yi mig bzhin brdol/ / bstan dang dge 'dun tshogs pa gangs ri'i spror/ / rnam dpyod lung rigs dam pa yongs phyug pas/ / tshad ma gsum gyi mche sder doms pa'i tshe/ /shes rab phar phyin stong phrag brgya ba yi/ /spar gyi dkar chags srid pa'i sgron me las/ / sbyin bdag rab brtan gdung rabs khyed kyis mdzad/ /de yang lig wer gnam gyi rgyal po de ni gnas ri chen po gsum gyi dbus rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'gram ngo mtshar gyi bkod pas yongs su mdzes pa'i dmar po pho brang g.yu rtse dang bkar rje pho brang g.yu rtse lig weragayu rtse pho phrang chen po dang bon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i g.yung drung lha steng sogs 'di nyid ni/ las la brtson zhing / zad mtha' med pa'i blo gros kyi nor mdzod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i shar rgyal mo rong bod kyi rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis rang rang gi rig rtsal dang lag rtsal la brten nas/ rtsig bzo dang / shing bzo/ brkos ris/ ldeb bris / bzo bkod/ rgyan 'gros/mtho khyad/ spya khyon sogs gang ci'i thad nas skabs de'i rgyal cho/ rong gis sa gnas su yod pa'i bzo rtsal mkhas pa kun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mtha' dgaphyogs gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i ngo mtshar che 'ing lta na sdug pa/ brjid chags pa'i bkod pa de lta bu ha cang mthong dkon pa'i pho brang dang lha khang zhes su grags/ sum pa glang gi gyim shod sbas pa'i shod chen bco brgyad ces 'ang zhung gi dpung dmag las grol — 40 —

bas so dmag gam smad du btang ba rnams rgyal mo rong gis sa khongs bco brgyad du dregs pa bco brgyad dam dpon tshul du dregs pa dpa' bo bco brgyad ces/ da lta'ang sku dpung dmag ces spyal po dang dpon chen gyi sku rim chen po'i dus su sngon gyis dmag chas dang dmag gos gyon nas dmag rtsed dang seng ge dang 'brong/ mi rgod a tsa ra sogs 'cham rgyu'i srol de nas byung / bzher zhes blon chen bzhi dang rjes su g.yung drung bu bzhir zhes grags/ de tshe sa dbang rgyal po'i chab srid la/ / ches cher rngams pa'i brnab sems rlung shugs kyis/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa'i bdud dpung chogs rnams kun/ /spar ba'i ma rung dgra tshogs gnas 'dir lhags/ / mdzes ma'i snying gi ku mud rgod gyed bzhin ras zla ba gsar ba'i lang tshe zhe ldang khrag gis dmar por bsgyur/ khyo shugs lag pa dang phan tshun 'khyud pa'i rtse dga'i me tog rgyas pa'i tshal der gdug pa'i mtshon gyi tsher ma gzengs/ / sdang mig glog zhags dmar po g.yo ldan khro gnyer char sbrin brtsegs pa dpral ba'i dbyings su sdug por bsdus/ / tsub sems drag po'i dri len gyis bskyod smin ma'i nags klong 'khyogs por g.yo zhing sha za lta bur gar gyis rgyug / 'ur 'ur rlung gis lhab lhab bskyod cing rab tu g.yo ba'i ru dar tshogs ni dum bur chad pa'i na bun bzhin/ / bang 'gros rtsal ldan bzhon pa'i rmig pa'i rlung gis bslang ba'i rdul gyi 'tshub ma khams nag dud sbrin 'khrigs pa bzhin/ /sod rgyob ki bswo co dir nga rdo dir dir sgrogs pas gnam sa ral ba khyab 'jug khros pa'i sgra dbyangs bzhin/ / dpa' zhing rtul phod yan lag bzhi ldan bgrang yas dmag dpung 'khrug cing g.yo ba spya mtsho 'khrug pa'i klong 'khor bzhin/ /de tshe sa dbang rgyal po'i bus/ /kyai ho byams ma byams ma zhes/ /grangs med bskal bar tshogs gnyis kyis/ / byams ma'i thugs kyi me long du/ /de yi gzigs brnyan 'gog med 'phos/ / 'gro ba su dar su rgud ces/ /dus kun gzigs pa'i bya ra ba/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'phrin las ni/ /dus las yol ba su yis dmigs/ / de slar rang dmag ma 'jigs zhes/ / brtse ba'i gsung gis dbugs 'byin cing / /byams ldan thugs ni dung nge ba/ /byams pa'i sku mchog bstan par gyur/ /de yi g.yas brkyangs zhabs kyi 'og /'jigs pa'i rlung dmar thon pa yis/ /bye'u'i tshogs rnams khra yis ded/ /glang po'i khyu tshogs seng ge bzhin/ /ma rang dgra sde spur ma dag /skad cig nyid la khyer ba las/ /hor dang chab cha sgo me sogs/ /rab brtan rgyal pos dmag dpung gis/ /bde bar bkod pa'i rang yul skyed/ /bon gyi beer dkar rgyal po yis/ / gnas chung sku lnga srung mar bkod/ / bde bar dbugs 'byin skal ba thob/ /log smra gnyis 'thung chogs ni zhim par gyur/ / rnam dag dge bcu'i mdzad pa nor bu'i 'og /rong chen chos srid bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /bkod pa'i mnga' thang lhab lhub g.yo ba'i tshe/ /skye dgu bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar bar 'gran/ /bzhi ba/ bodargyal srong btsan sgam pos zhang zhung bza'akhab tu bzhes pa'i skor/de nas gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras srong btsan sgam po'i zhang zhung nas zhang zhung bza' lig tig sman blangs/ stag gzig 'ol mo'i gling gi gsas khang dkar nag bkra gsal nas byon pa'i zhang zhung gi lha — 41 —

gshen rab ston pa'i gtso bo dgung lo gcig pa'i sku tshad spyan drangs nas them chen lha khang bzhengs/ bal yul nas bal bza' khri btsun blangs/ bal bo'i lha dngul gyi byams ba 'khor lo sogs spyan drangs nas ra sa 'phrul gyi lha khang bzhengs/ rgya yul nas rgya bza' kong jo blangs/ rgya nag gi lha ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad spyan drangs nas ra mo che'i lha khang bzhengs/ rgya gar nas dge slong ā dkar shī la ma ti bya ba mchod gnas su gteg cing / rgya gar gyi lha tsan dan gyi sku rang byung spyan drangs nas lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal khyad du 'phags pa bzhengs/ rgyal po de'i rdzu 'phul dang mthu rtsal gyi nus pas/ 'jang dang ga gon dang phrom spya gar mon sogs rgyal khams mang po bod kyi mnga' zhabs su bsdus/ phyogs kyi dgra thams cad kyi kha gnon/ lha sa klu'i gling du sangs rgyas mchod cing gsang sngags sgrub pa dang / gsung rab klog bshad dang / sems don bsgom pa dang / mchod rten bzhengs pa la sogs pas lha sa bkang /de dus na gzhan yang snya li shu stag ring / khyung po sgru dang gzu tse dang / gu rub btsan po/ khyung po ra sangs rje rgyal/ phu lu gru 'dzin/ 'gas po he dug 'dul/ stag sgra gyim shang / gnub mang gnyeng gzhu btsan/ phyis yu rgya ra mis ra ba/ 'gar lha bzher tshe gsar/ bon blon gas chen/ was khri zung stong slod de dag la sogs mkhas grub brnyes pa grangs med pa bzhugs / 'on kyang rgyal pos chos spyad pas rje'i mgur lha rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi lha klu rnamasako long che bas lha sa'i mkhar chung thog gis bshigami mang po yang thog gis bsad/ nad mug dang lo nyes byung / rgyal po yang dgu lo bzhi bcu kha lhag tu gshegs so/ / de'i tshe blon po dar na bya bas chos 'di bkra mi shis pa zhig byung zer bsnubs so/ / zhes bshad/ srid rgyud las kyang / rgyal po'i thugs dam chos spyad pas/ / rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum dang / /bod kyi lha gsas gnam du 'phangs/ /mnga' ris mi bde 'khrug pa ni/ /chos dang du blangs pa'i skyon gyis/ / des kyang chos lan gcig bsdubs/ / zhes so/ /le'u lnga ba/ ya thog zhang bod gcig gyur gyi dus rabs/dang po/ zhang bod gcig gyur byung ba'i skor/srong btsan gyis 'ang bod gcig gyur ched du 'ang zhung phal cher mnga' 'og tu gyur/ 'on kyang rgyal po yang dgung lo ran pa'i dus nas gshegs/ srong btsan gyi sras chung dus nas gshegs tsha bo zhig rgyal sar bkod/ de la'ang btsan por 'bod/ de dus khong lo na phra bas srid kyi bya ba rnams mgar stong btsan la bcol stong btsan rus ni mgar yin/ mgar la yi ge med kyang / rang bzhin gyis rig pa rno zhing ngang tshul brtan la/ g.yul gyi bya ba la shin tu mkhas/ bod kyis 'jang ba rnams dbang du bsdu thub pa ni/ bod kyi dbang shugs btsan pa dang mgar gyi blo thabs rno bar brten pa red/ mgar stong — 42 —

btsan la sras lnga mchis te/ che ba btsan gnya' bya ba de sngar nas 'das/ gnyis pa khri 'bring / gsum pa btsan brod/ bzhi ba zi do kan/ lnga ba po lon bya ba'o/ / mgar stong btsan thang dmag dang 'thab dus rgyal mo tsha ba rdong la byon nas mgar thar dang chu chen so ba kyo dang kha rog kyo sogs su byon nas phyag gis rdo bskos mang po mthong rgyu yod pa/ de'i skabs su chu chen rab brtan rgyal po'ang rgyal bran du gyur pas de'i blon chen bzhi'i ya kyal 'phan bzher dang mdo bzher gnyis phyi'i so blon chen mo bskos so/ /stong btsan mthar dmag thog tu bkrongs rjes/ sras khri 'bring spun mched kyis srid bskyangs/ spyi lo 670(lcags pho rta)thang ko tsung li kri/ zhan hin khri lo dang po/ bod dmag li yul ba rnams dang bsdongs nas chig tshi grong khyer gyi pho han mkhar dbang du bsdus/ de nas an zhi sde bzhi bod la shor/ yug we we dmag dpon chen mo zhos rin kos sogs kyis dmag mi 'bum phrag gcig khrid de ta hphin khron du slobs/khri 'bring gis bkag ste pham/ bod dmag gis 'a zha bcom ste sa yang bdag gir bzung / zhan hin gyi khri lo dang po'i zla ba bzhi par zhom rin kos sogs dmag khri tsho bcu lhag dang bcas te bod dmag la 'thab du chas/ dmag dpung ta hphin khron du slebs pa na/ bod kyi dmag dpon blon khri 'bring gis pham par byas/ de nas 'a zha'i sa cha bod kyis bzung / de nas yun ring ma song bar an rong khrin bya ba'i mkhar brtsigs te/ de ga'i 'jang ba rnams kyis dmag la lam khrid de mkhar de yang bcom pa dang dmag mi mngags te bya ra byas/ skabs der bod dmag gis zhang zhung dang / tang zhang / 'jang pa'i sa cha khag rnams dbang du bsdus/ de'i skabs su chu chen rab brtan rgyal po 'bum rgyal bya ba'i sngar sbas pa'i shod chen bco brgyad de dregs pa bco brgyad bcas sa spyod pa bco brgyad du bkod do/ /mdo bzher dang 'phan ba'ir gnyis la ni bod rgyal gyis shar rgya'asnye mo rong gis a zhig sgom khang man chod ta tu'u rdo ring yan chod kyi rang srung 'gag btsan zhes dmag srid dang bya khrims 'dzin pa'i go sa gnang ngo / / shar phyogs su leng krig srung krig mo'u krig sos krig bcas 'brel zhing / lho bal po dang 'brel/ nub tu thang gi chig chi dang / byu'u li sogs sde bzhi bcoms te bzung / byang phyogs su gru gu dang 'brel yo da pas/ mnga' ris bar le bar khri phrag lhag mchis/ han rgyal rabs dang we rgyal rabs kyi dus nasabazung / nub phyogs kyi mi rigs rnams gyi khrod du stobs shugasi 'di ltar che ba ni byung ma myong zhes 〈 thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉las gsungs so/ /spyi lo 679 (sa mo yos)thang ko tshung li kri/ dbyi hphin khri lo bzhi ba/ ti'o khri lo dang po/ btsan po gshegs/ sras khri 'du srong rgyal sa ra bton/ khri 'bring gis srid bskyangs/ spyi lo 689 (sa mo glang)tse then wu'u hig gi dus su/ yun khrang khri lo dang po/ bod rnams man pa dang bsdebs nas skyes 'bul du byon/ gong mas lun khrin yig zhang gi blo thabs mkhas po yod pa we te ca bya ba an zhi ta'o yi byi khyab dmag dpon chen po dang / an zhi tu'u tu'u yi blo rig ldan pa yan wun ku'u bya ba dmag spyi gzhon par bka' phab ste bod la 'thab tu btang /de gnyis kyis dmag ma drangs par bsdad pas/ gcig la srog chad bcad/ sacig rgyang phud btang — 43 ——

ngo/ /lo de'i rjes mar gong mas slar yang lun khrin yig zhang gi blo rig ldan ba tshin khrang chan bya ba de lu'u we ta'o yi g.yul 'degs spyi khyab dmag dpon chen mor bka' phab ste bod la 'thab tu btang yang / lam sked du bsdad nas ma song / lo de'i rjes mar dmag dpon gyi su'u bya bas ge khron tsho ba dang tang zhang pa khri tsho sum cu khrid nas mgo 'dzul du 'ongs/ lu'u hig nas yig yu chan we dmag dpon krang zhon yu bya bar an byu'u (hri'i)cho lo sbyar te/ dmag nyis khri dang bcas bsu bar btang/ ta tu'u chu khar slebs pa na/bod dmag gis hi su'u bzung nas khrid/ tsho dpon tsan khra bya ba zhig gis kyang 'jang ba dang man pa brgya stong khrid nas 'ongs pa la/ krang zhon yu der thug ste khos tsho ba de'i mi rnams dbye krig tu bzhag tsan khra cu hri la bskos shing / ri bo lo hran ta tu'u nas rdo ring btsugs te mdzad rjes bkod yod/ ces so/ /'on kyang spyi lo 699 (sa mo phag)rtse then lu'u gyig lu'u kra'o hrin li khri lo gnyis pa/ btsan po 'dus srong dang blon chen lon yan gagyis kyis skog du blo bsdur nas ri dwags rngon par ljags g.yar nas dmag bsdus shing / khri 'bring la glo ba nye ba nyis stong lhag bzung nas bsad/ pho nya mngags te khri 'bring dang btsan brod gnyis la skad btang yang / khri 'bring gis dmag shugs la brten nas bka' ma rtsis/ der btsan pos ru sna drangs te rgol du phyin pa la/ g.yul ma sprad par khri 'bring dpung 'thor bas/ khri 'bring gis rang srog bcad de shi/ btsan brod kyis rang gi 'khor stong phrag gcig lhag dang gcin pos mang po rje sogs khrid de thang la mgo btags/ zhu tse jin gyis sku srung chibs dmag mkhar gyi phyi rol du mngags te bsu ba byas/ btsan brod la spru'u ko dmag dpon chen po dang / zhon yug spe dmag dpon chen mo/kos te cun wang sogs kyi cho lo sbyar zhing / sne len bzang po dang bcas skyes mang po bstsal/ de nas gong mas btsan brod la rang gi 'khor dang bcas hung yon ku'u bya bar song nas bod dang 'thab dgos pa'i bka' phab/ ma 'gyangs par btsan brod grongs/ gong mas kho la the cin dang / in zhi'i ta tu'u tu'u bya ba'i cho lo gnang ngo / /'dus srong sras khri rje gtsug brtan de'i sras khri srong lde'u btsan/ de'i sras mu nee 'am sad na legs yin no/ / khri rje gtsug brtan yan rgyal po lnga la chos kyi srol 'byed ces zer yang /bon kho na las chos spyod pa cher med pa bsgrags byang las bshad do/ /srid rgyud las kyang / khri rje gtsug brtan yan chad du/ /rgyal srid g.yung drung bon gyis bskyangs/ /zhes dang / de yan gdung rabs sum cu rtsa drug rgyal srid g.yung drung bon gyis bskyangs/ rje yi gdung rgyud mnga' thang ldan/ zhes pa dang /khri srong lde'u btsan yan la rgyal rabs sum cu rtsa brgyad song 'dug pa srong btsan dang khri srong gnyis kyis chos la spyad pas de gnyis mi brtsi la/ de gnyis kyi yab mes gong ma sum cu rtsa drug gi ring la bon bskyangs ba las 'di bde phyi mar thar ba thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na gri gum gyis kyang bon bsnubs pas so zhe na/ de'i tshe stod yan la bon spyod pa tsam la brtsi'o/ / des na khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku tshe stod yan la rgyal po lnga'i ring la 'dren pa'i bon gsas kyang / mthu chen mi dgu dang / gshen dran pa nam mkha' la sogs bzhugs/ de dus kyi bon po rnams la mtshan gyi yig tshang ni/ spyal po'i sku 'tshogs la sku gshen/— 44 —

blon gyi gros 'tsheskus la gshen blon/ rgyal gyi bla na bskur bas bla bon/ srid pa'i gros phug shes pas kun shes/ sangs rgyas bon bstan spel bas bon gshin/ dman la pha ltar mgon pas pha ba/ gshin khrims tshad mar bsrungs pas gshen btsun/ shi ba 'dur gyis skyob pas 'dur gshen/ thar pa'i lam mchog bsnan pas 'dren pa'i bon gsas/ de ltar ming gi yig tshang gnang ngo / /de yan chad bod khams 'dir g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che bar du dar tshul zur tsam mo/ / chos spyal srong btsan sgam pos skabs su 'bangs rnams kyis bon chos la dad pa'i nus shugs de nyams dma' ru btang ched/gdon phud
