dang rim gro byas pas skyabs gnas kyi yul gzhan zhig tu btsal na nus pa thon pa'i thabs shes rnyed de rgya gar nas sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du gdan drangs/ bod du lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong byas te/rgya gzhung rnams 'gyur zhus kyis gtan la phab/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir srong btsan sgam po zhes mtshan snyan gyi ba dan srid rtser bsgrongs/ bzo gso sgra tshad la sogs pa'i thun mong dang thun min gyi rig gnas mtha' dag yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig gi 'go tshugs pa red/ de rjes su gung ru gung btsan/ mang srong mang btsan/ 'dus srong mang po rje/ mes ag tshom bcas kyis rim bzhin gong gi mdzad rjes kyi mjug skyong / lhag par du bod lcags rta (spyi lo 790 )lor chos rgyal khri srong lde batren 'khrungs so/ /de nas srong btsan gyi sras chung gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes nas/ rgyal srid bzung btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas/ sras mang srong mang btsan bya ba me pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs so/ / gung ri gung btsan gyis rgyal srid lo lnga bzung / dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes dus po ta la ru sku gshegs so/ /gung ri gung btsan yab kyi gong du 'das so/ / de nas dpon sras mang srong mang btsan gyis/ dgung lo bcu gsum lon dus rgyal srid bzung / btsun mo 'bro bza' khri ma lod bya ba khab tu bzhes/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal srid lo bco lngar bzung ste/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gtsang gi bar snang sgang du 'das so/ /mang srong mang btsan gyi sras/ 'dur ('dul)srong mang po rje rlung nam 'asbul gyi rgyal po yin te/ yab 'das nas zhag bdun lon dus chu pho byi ba la sgrags phu ru 'khrungs/ mgar gyi sras gnya' btsan ldem bu dang / stag ra khong lod gnyis kyis blon po byas nas rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/mchims bza' btsun mo tog bya ba khab tu bzhes/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su blon po rtsal po che mi bdun byung ste/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgur rgyal srid bzung nas lngang gi yul du 'das so/ / 'dul srong mang po btsan gyi sras/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshem du grags te/ lcags pho 'brug gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu la rgyal srid bzung / blon po skyi bzang stong btsan/ mchims rgyal shugs steng / 'bro chu bzang 'or gsum gyis blon po byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgrur/ ljongs(ljang)mo khri btsun bya ba'i btsun mo khab tu bzhes/ ljang mo khri btsun la sras (lngang)tsha lha dbon zhes bya ba lha'i gzugs byad lta bu shin tu mtshar ba zhig 'khrungs/ so/ /re la bod na khab 'os pa ma rnyed nas/45merji srong

btsan sgam po'i lugs su bya zer/ rgya nag dzung dzung rgyal po'i sras mo kyim shing kong jo la rin dang skyes bskur nas len du btang ngo / /der bod kyi blon pos rgya rje la rin dang skyes phul bas/ rgya rjes sras mo la 'gro'am mi 'gro gsungs pa dang / kong jos legs nyes ston pa'i me long cig yod pa la dmod bor te legs par phyis nas bltas pas/ tshe 'di'i grogs skal bod na yod par shes shing / rgyal bu de ya mtshan zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong nas bod du 'gro bar mos so/ / der rgyachad kyi mtshams su slebs pa dang /bod kyi blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu gdan drangs te/ mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od la thams cad kyis rta rgyugs pa la der rgyal bus kyang rta rgyugs pas/ rtas bskyur te 'das so/ / de ltar btsun mo sleb khar/ rgyal bu grongs nas thams cad mya ngan gyis non no/ /kong jo la glo bur du snying la mda' phog pa'i sdug bsngal 'dra ba cig byung nas/ de ma khad me long phyis nas bltas pas/ sngar gyi rgyal bu gzugs byad mdzes pa de med par rgad po ba'in mi sdug pa byad spus khengs pa cig 'dug nas shin tu yid mug par gyur/ de nas bod kyi rgyal pos pho nya btang ste/ rgya mo dpon g.yog rnams la khyod kyi skyes pa 'os pa'i nga'i bu lha dang 'dra ba zhig yod pa de/ rkyen ngan pas 'das/ da khyed rang yul du log gam/ nged la bltas nas 'ong zhes yi ge btang bas/ der rgya mo na re/ bu mo'i 'dun ma len (lan)cig yin pas skyid sdug ci byung yang bod du 'gro zer nas 'ongs so/ /de nas 'byin phur byon te mes rgyal po'i btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas lo dus 'khor ba na/ rgyal bu lus la zhugs pa dang / lcags pho rta'i lo la brag dmar du sku 'khrungs pas/ nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ / sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshal zer te/ / zhang po rgya'i pang du song ngo / /der yum rgya mo shin tu dga' ste 'di skad zer ro/ /dus de ring lha yi nyi ma shar/ /bu khyod kyis zhang ngo shes pa lags/ / nga a ma'i lus sems mal du bde/ / yul bod kyi zhing khams bde ba 'byung / /sras dgung lo lnga lon dus yum 'das so/ /yab rgyal po mes ag tshom ni/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum la yar 'brog sba tshal mkhar gshegs so/ / de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis dgung lo brgyad ron pa dang / rgyal srid bzung nas rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal po chos la dga' na'ang blon po ma zhang khron pa skyes dang / stag ra klu gong la sogs dbang che bas/ gzhan gyis rgol ma nus so/ / de nas rgyal po sku nar so na te/ rje blon rnams chos bya bar blo mthun te/ thabs sna tshogs kyis mgo bskor nas/ma zhang stod lung brang phu ru gson por bang sor bcug stag ra klu rtsopa byang la smyugs so/ / de nas thams cad chos bya ba'i bka' gnang nas/ thog mar mang yul nas jo bo shākya shing rtar gdan drangs par bsu ba rolar/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te ra sa'i btsan khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/ de nas rgyal blon thams/ cad gros bgyis te/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du/ khye'u gsum gyis smon lam btab pa'i mthu la brten nas/ sba gsal snang rgya gar du mkhan ngo bo lha sa twa gdan 'dren du btang ba/ gsal snang gis mkhan po gdan drangs te pho brang du phebs pa dang / rgyal pos sku rags ma bcings par gseraphye bre gang phyag tu bsnams nas mkhan po bsu ba byon par/ mkhan po'i 'al nas/— 46 —

rgyal po khyed gyi dbu la la thod gsol bar/ sto da mnga' ris zhwa tsam cig la khrims shig chags/ zhabs la chag gsol bas/ smad du mdo khams lham tsam la khrims shig chags/ sku lus la sku rags ma bcings pas( bar 'dir rgyal khrims byur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul bas chos byar btub gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams bsags te/ snga gong bod du rab tu byung ba'i dpe mi 'dug pas/ bod tu rab tu byung ba e 'ong blta ba'i phyir/ blon po dang 'bangs kyi bu blo rno ba bdun/ bo lha sa twa'i drung du rab tu byung ste/ de'ang sba sang shi'i bu ratna/ mchims a nu'i bu shākya bra ba/ ba gor ratna'i bu bee ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma a tsarya rin chen mchoga'akhon klu'i dbang po bsrungs pa/ gtsang legs spub ste bdun gyis rab tu byung bas sad mi mi bdun zhes grags so/ /de bzhin du btsun mo dang blon po 'bangs la sogs pa'i bu sum brgya rab tu byung zhing / rgya gar du blo rno ba rnams batshungs te sgra dang lo tsā slob tu btang / de nas slob dpon padma 'byung gnas gdan drangs te/ bod kyi 'dre srin thams cad dam la btags pa dang / dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/bod rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis zhang bod gcigagyur byung ba/ ṭwāṃ zhang bod snyan rgyud〉 las/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs su phyi blon bcu/ nang blon bcu/ 'phrin blon bcu dang sum cu yod cing /rgyal po mnga' thang che/ stag gzig rgyal po btul/ tshong lam dang mtha' mtshams chu chen pos chod pa la shing zam 'dzugs par khas blangs/ khrom ge sar rgyal po btul/ gnyan lam mtha' bzhi khas blangs/rgya gar rgyal po btul/ yon mchod byed par khas blangs/ zhes pa ltar stobs kyis ma yin kyang las kyis rgyal khams mang po mnga' 'og tu bsdus te dbang bsgyur bas nga rgyal te zhang zhung gi rgyal po gdul bar dran/zhes dang / 'ang zhung gi rgyal po lig mi rgyal bzhugs pa'i dus/ zhang zhung la dmag stong sde dgu khri dgu 'bum yo da pa'i steng du sum pa gling gi gyim shod shod chen sbas pa bco brgyad stong bu chung yan chad mnga' ris yin la/ bod la stong sde bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis stong bu chung gcig dang rtsa gsum las med pas 'ang zhung gi rgyal po bod rgyal gyis dngos su btul mi thub mod/ bod rgyal thugs la brnag pa ngan pas g.yo sgyus btul bar dran te/ de'i dus na zhang zhung gi rgyal po la btsun mo chung shes snang bza' sgron legs bya ba lo bco brgyad pa 'ig yod pa de rpā bod kyi rgyal po'i 'phrin blon zhe ngan la g.yo che ba sna nam legs grub bya ba zhig gis gser phye 'brong ru gang khyer/ snang bza' sgron legs la gyin nas smras pa/ snang bza' sgron legs khyed lta bu zhang zhung gi rgyal po'i khab yum chung byed pa/ bod rang cag ha cang yang che ste/ bod kyi rgyal pos kyang mi bzod par 'dug na/ 'di smad pa 'i thabs yod dam/ yod na bod kyi rgyal pos kyang khab chen mo bya la/ bod kyi mnga' riṭa/ sum gnyis ster bar 'dug go /zhes smras pas/ sgron legs na re/ zhang zhung gi rgyal po la dmag sa gzhir khebs pa yed/ bod kyi rgyalopo la dmag bre mo'i gzhung tsam las med pas dngos su btul mi thub/ ngan limo dang rdzobs kyibyu 'dul ruzhang zhung rgyal po zla ba phyi ma la — 47 —

zhang zhung gi yul nas sum pa gling gi gyim shod du stu rkyen dang bcas 'dun ma la bzhud kyis/ der sgug la bkrongs mdzod/ de'i thabs bdag gis gdod bya'o/ / zhes bud med kyi blo la ltos pa bcar mi 'dod pas de skad smras so/ / de yang tshes 'di la 'ong gi brda la khar 'jog par chad do/ / der bod rgyal blon dmag stong sde mang po chas nas 'ong ste sna nam legs grub dang rgyal po gnyis sngon du la khar phyon nam bltas pas chu slang nga gang gi nang du gser chung dang dung chung gcig dug mdel gcig dang gsum bzhag gda' 'o/ /bod rgyal na re/ chu slang nga gang ni zla ba phyi ma nya la 'ong ba yin/ gser chung dang dung chung ni dang ra'i gser phug dang / dung phug gnyis su dmag gis chod la sgug cig zer ba dang / dug mda' ni brnag pa skyed la sod cig bya ba yin zer te de ltar bsgugs so/ /der rgyal po gnyis mjal nas bodadamag gis zhang zhung rgyal po bkrongs so/ / der zhang zhung 'bum sde ni pham/ bod khri sde ni rgyal/bon khrims dar gyi mdud pa de bshig rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ni chag da ci byed zhes byung ngo / /kong po dang khyung po la sogs pa yang mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ de'i skabs su bod rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis yang bskyar tsha rong kho 'phan la chab shog ces 'phan bzher la thengs gnyis pa'i chab shog zer/chab shog gyi nang don snga gong yab mes kyi bzhed srol bka' yi khrims yig chen po rnam drug mdzad pa ltar/mtha' yi sa mtshams thams cad bu rta hrag bsgrig gis bsrungs te/ bod chen po'i srid lugs zhes pa sa yi khyon 'dir yongs su grags par bstan bsrungs g.yel med mdzod cig ces so/ / chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ mkhan slob rnam gnyis gtsor byas lo tsā ba brgya dang brgyad bod du gdan drangs nas bod kyi lo tsā ba mang po zhig gso skyong byas nas rgya gzhung gi bka' bstan rnams bod du bsgyur te sangs rgyas chos lugs dang thun mong gi rig gnas mang po dar spel btang yang / bon chos la dad pa'i blon 'bangs kun gyis ngo rgol byas stabs/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras mu ni dang mu tig mu khri btsan po'i sras mnga' bdag khri ral ba can dang / glang dar ma bcas kyis rgyal srid skyong skabs ban bon gyi spub mtha'i chags sdang dbang gis 'khrugs rtsod bar ma chad pa zhig byung ba'i don du rgyal rabs rim byung gi sku tsher yang bar chad bzos pa red/ mthar spyi lo 906 (me stag)lor bod rgyal glang dar ma 'u dum btsan po de nyid lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i thabs kyis bkrongs so/ /de nas bzung bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po med par gyur to/ /gnyis pa/ sbas pa'i zhod chen bco brgyad kyi skor/sbas pa'i shod chen bco brgyad rgyal mo rong zhes grags pa che ba de ni/ shar phyogs rgyal mo rong gi gnas yig las/ khyad par shar phyogs rgyal mo rgyal yi rong / / drug cu rtsa bzhi'i zhing khams gnas kyi mchog /rgyal mo dmu rdo g.yung drung sgrungs rtse la/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lung gi bskul bzhin du/ /dus kyi pho nya sa pho rta yi lo/ / hor zla bdun pa'i tshes la bskyod byas te/ / gsang 'gyur lung gi gang skyong thams cad kun/ /zhing skyong dam pa rab brtan rgyal po yi/ /mi dman zhabs legs ches cher sgrub pa'i ngos/ /bstan 'gror khyab pa'i bya ba byed dgos gang / /ma lus thub mthar mkha' 'gro'i — 48 —

lung ji bzhin/ /gnyan rje gab tog gnas su bskyed par bskyed/ /mi g.yo bsam gtan phug tu phyin pa'i nub/ /bka' drin can gyi ma mchog srid rgyal des/ /dbu la rma bya'i phod ldeb gsum gyis brgyan/ /cha lugs grogs kyi tshul gyi 'di skad gsungs/ /bu khyod ma g.yeng snyan gyi dbang po gtod/ / dmu rdo g.yung drung thangs rtse byang chub kyi/ / gnas chen gnyan rje gab tog ces kyang bya/ / rin chen spungs pa'i ri bo zhes kyang bya/ /sha ba ri mchog rgyal po zhes kyang bya/ /gnas mchog shel dkar g.yung rong zhes kyang bya/ /'di 'dra'i gnas mchog e ma ngo mtshar che/ / tshig 'di'i don de khyod kyis ma shes na/ / gnyan rje gab tog grags pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ / gnyan rje gnas pa drag po tsub pa'i gnyan/ / rje ni gnas pa rnams kyi gtsowo rje/ /gab ni gzhan gyi ma mthong sbas pa'i gab/ /tog ni khyad 'phags gnas pa kun gyi tog /de phyir gnyan rje gab tog ces kyang bya/ /rin chen sgrungs pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /gnas kyi phu mda' nyin srib gar bltas kyang / /gang dang mi 'dra ya mtshan rmad du byung / /rin chen mang po gram pa tshul du yod/ /de phyir rin chin sgrungs pa zhes kyang bya/ /sha ba ri zhes btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /sngon tshe zhang zhung dran pa yabasras kyis/ / bsam yas mchid phug gsang ba'i ge'u tshang la/ / bka' brgyad choms bu dgu 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgrub pa'i zhal phyis gsang don sbyor ba'i tshe/ /gnas 'dir klu btsan rgyal po bya ba de/ / nyin par sha ba ri dwags gzugs su ston/ / mtshan mo mi srin lha 'dre'i chas su zhugs/ /rong phab mi la sdug bsngal nad char phab/ / mi phyed kho yi sto ru mid par byas/ / de la zhang zhung dran pa yab sras kyis/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal gnyug ma'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /skad cig thogs med rdzu 'phul chen po yis/ / 'brug khyung seng gsum sprul nas gnas 'dir byon/ / shel gyi rdo ring dkar po'i rtse ru 'bab/ / 'brug skad ldir ldir khyung skad tser tser dang / / seng skad seng seng sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /klu btsan rgyal po sha dmar sbrul nas bros/ / bros nas dbang med thugs rje'i stobs kyis gzir/ /zhang zhung dran pa yab sras la sogs te/ /spub thob rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mang po yi/ /zhabs bcags smon lam rgya chen btabs nas bzhag /de phyir sha ba ri ni zhes kyang bya/ /shel dkar g.yung rong bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /shel gyi rdo ring dkar po mngon pa ni/ /ri brag gzhan dang mi 'dra khyad par 'phags/ /shel dkar mdangs bzhin gsal phyir shel dkar bya/ /g.yung ni g.yung drung bon gyi rgyud sde yi/ /gter kha zab mo yod pas g.yung zhes bya/ / rong ni ri brag gzhan las rong bas rong / / de phyir shes dkar g.yung rong zhes kyang bya/ / thog ma'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid de ltar ro/ / bar du rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /bod kyi khod srungs dran pa yab sras sogs/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho grangs med kyis/ /rgyal tshab dam pa dbang bskur smon lam btab/ /rgyal mo rong du 'gro ba'i don du btang / /rjes su lo chen bee ro gnas 'dir byon/ / zab mo don gyi gter kha mang po sbas/ / lo gsum ting 'dzin bsgom zhing smon lam btab/ /tha ma 'gro don dus la bab pa'i tshul/ /skye mchog rig 'dzin sems dpa'i rnam rol gar/ / drung mi ha ra gling gshen mu med dang / /gter ston yon tan gu ru seng ge dang / khro — 49 —

gnyan rgyal mtshan se gnyan zhig po sogs/ / grub thob rig 'dzin mang po mngon bhon nas/ / gnas 'dir sgo 'byed bstan negro'i don chen byas/ /de ltar rin chen spungs pa'i ri 'di ni/ /phyi ltar dkyil 'khor ling tse bkram pa'i dbus/ /shel gyi bum pa gdan la bkod pa 'dra/ /nang ltar nor bu dbang gi rgyal po gang / / dar gyi nab bza' nang du dril ba 'dra/ / gsang ba rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i snang snyan mchog /thabs shes dbyer med chen po spyor ba 'dra/ /gyi nang gnas kyi chags tshul rnam thar gang / /skal ldan khyed rnams ma brjed dam du zungs/ /dad ldan sbo ba bskyed phyir bshad par gyis/ /zhes bod kyi dran pa nam mkhas gsungs so/ / bod kyi dran pa nam mkha' yab sras sogs ka gung seng ge yang rdzong nas chu chen nam mkha' rgyal pos gdan drangs bas/ me khyi lor bod rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku thog tu rab brtan spyal pos deb ther rin chen phreng ba'i nang sgo sdong zlos gar zhes gsung rtsom gnang nas dregs pa bco brgyad du dum bu re 'cham rgyu'i srol btsugs so/ /le'u drug pa/ phyis kyi dus rabs skor/bod yang bskyar sil bur 'thor ba'i dus te spyi lo 906 (me stag)lo la glang dar ma bkrongs rjes bod yul tha gru kun gyi chab srid skyong ba'i shugs ha cang zhan par chag ste 'bangs mi 'go dpon rnams kyi bar du 'gal ba rim bzhin du je cheri gyur/ spyi lo 929 (sa/ glang)lor bod du 'bangs gyen log bi zing cha chen po zhig langs te bod khams kyi yul gru rnams la gcig gyur gyi dpon po med staci sa/ yul lung re la sde dpon re byas te bod sil bur 'thor/ bod kyi dpal 'byor rig gnas kyi dngos rdzas rtsa 'gangs che shos rnams 'di skor nas gastor brlag dang chud zos chen po song yod pa 'dra ste/ phyis su shad bu stag rtse sogs mi bzhis gros byas nas rgyal po'i bang so rnams bgos te phal cher brus zhes pa'i skor rnams deb dmar dang / gsal me/ sa chen/ gtsug lag zeng ba sogs kyi deb ther las gsal por ston yodapade red/ 'di dag la gzhigs na bod kyi rig gnas gtor brlag byas pa'i le khag de glang dar ma gcig pu la bzhag na 'grig min dpyad gzhir snang / de nas bzung ste yun ring bo'i bar bod yul stod smad bar gsum thams cad du sde shog re la dpon 'go re tsam las bod gcig gyur gyi chab srid kyi nus shugs de rtsa ba nas nyams gud du song yang mi rnams kyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog la bcol ba'i bsam blo shugs chen yod stabs sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs thad la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi bya ba sngar las lhas par zhig 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / dus mtshungs thun mong dang thun min gyi rig gnas skor la'ang rgya dkar nag dang 'brel ba byas te phan tshun zhib 'jug dang bsdu len byed rgyu'i bya ba dar spel btang ba'i nus pa ha cang chen po dzi thoṭwāṃ ༵ga

dang po/ bodasgrul mnga' ris nas zung tshul/der rgyal po glang dar ma bkrong ba'i rjes su btsun mo chung ba zhig la gdung brgyud kyi sras zhig lo dus thim pa dang / gdung rgyud yin nges kyi sras 'khrungs te/ sku shin tu gces pas nyin mo ni nyi ma'i 'od kyis bskor/ mtshan mo ni mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs pas na mnga' bdag 'od srungs zhes zer ro/ /der btsun mo che bas kyang sprang po'i bu chung skyes ma khad cig nyos nas sha la sbyar te/ nga la'ang 'di skyes pa yin no zer bas/ thams cad the tshom za bar gyur kyang / yum btsun mo dbang che bas smra ma nus te/yum gyis ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin brtan du bcug pas/ mnga' bdag yum brtan zhes zer ro/ /mnga' bdag 'di gnyis sku nar ma son kyang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis zhus te/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams mgon rnams sa 'og nas bton nas/ rang rang gi khri la bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa phul/ lha khang zhig pa rnams slar gsos so/ / de nas srid la ma 'cham pas/ 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung nas 'khrugs pa byas so/ / sa mo glang la gyen log byung / me mo bya la bang so rnams bshig go/ /mnga' bdag 'od srungs kyi sras/ rje dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i chen ma'i sras skyid sde nyi ma mgon/chun ma'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa/ 'di gnyis kyi srid gang yod rnams yum brtan gyis phrogs pas/mnga' ris la bros nas mnga' ris rgyal po mdzad pa yin no/ /rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chen ma'i sras/ skyid sde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/spu rangs la'ang dbang bsgyur/ de la sras gsum che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mang yul bzung /bar ba bkra shis mgon gyis pu rang bzung / chung ba lde btsun mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / 'di gsum la stod na bzhugs pa'i mgon gsum zer/ chung ba lde btsun mgon la sras gnyis te/ 'khor re dang srong nge gnyis so/ /srong nge'i sku tshe stod la btsun mo khab tu bzhes pa sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i na ga ra tsa dang / dhe ba ra tsa'o/ / srong nge'i sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung nas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ mthon mthing dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du chos slob pa la btang / parnyi ta tharnya ka ra dang warma ta gnyis spyan drangs te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi po bsgyur cing gtan la phab/'dul ba stod lugs dar bar mdzad/ gcen po 'khor res kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha sde phos parnyita su bha thid dang parnyi ta spe ru spyan drangs/ lha lde po la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba zhi ba 'od/'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba 'od lde'o/ / 'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas/ spya gar parnyi ta gdan 'dren byon pa'i lam du mu stegs pa'i dmag gis bzung nas/ dge phyogs kyi yon tan skyed pa'i rtsa sgo thams cad me btsas bsregs te rmongs par byas so/ / de'i gtam lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gsan ma thag tu/ nor dpag med bskur nas blu ru btang bas/ gser dang ljid mnyam pa dgos zer ba dang / yang gser gang yod bskur bas rgya ma la — 51 —

bteg dus dbu'i cha tsam zhig gser gyis ma long par khong na re/ da ni khyed rnams kyis bdag blus kyang yon tan med/ nga'i rtsa sgo me btsa'i bsregs nas dud 'gro lta bu yod pas bdag shi na'ang legs/ da blu ba'i gser rnams khyer la rgya gar na rgyal po dge ba dpal kyi sras bi kra ma la shrī la'i gtsug lag khang na/rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i parnyi ta lnga brgya ba rnams kyi nang nas gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa/ jo bo rje dī baṃ ka ra zhes bya ba bzhugs yod par 'dug de la gser phul te bod du gdan drangs la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzod cig gsungs te grongs pa dang / pur yul du spyan drangs nas mchod rten du bzhugs so/ / der khong gis lung bstan bzhin/ jo bo gnad 'dren pa la rgya brtson seng kha sogs la gser bskur nas btang ngo / / 'bod du 'byon pa la thabs du ma'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ jo bos kyang bod mnga' ris kyi gdul bya la dgongs/ rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan pa bzhin bod du byon nas/ slob ma nag tsho dang khu jog 'brom gsum lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa mkhas btsun du ma byon te/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad pas na/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od de bod la bka' drin che ba lags so/ /yang bod kyi rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gong du bshad pa ltar rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chun ma'i sras/bkra shis brtsegs pa la sras gsum byung ba dpal lde 'od sde skyed lde gsum yin te/ 'di gsum smad du bzhugs pa'i lde gsum zer/ sras che ba dpal lde'i sras ni sngon po tshom por thugs te/ khab gung ba klu rgyal ba khyi ba lta rtse glang lung btsad 'khor ba rnams te/ la stod man chod pa rnams yin no/ /sras chung ba skyed lde shangs rta nag tu phog sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang du gshegs te/ 'bro'i btsad po dang /g.yas ru ru lag gi gtsang po ba dang / mus pa dang 'dzad nyang stod na yod pa rnams so/ /sras 'bring po 'od lder sras bzhi byung ba/ pha ba de se khri lde khri chung nyag lde'o/ / pha ba de sa'i brgyud snub yul dang rong dang / g.yag sde nyang stod stag tshal na yod do/ khri lde'i rgyud ni shar tsong kha'i rgyal po spyan mnga' don chen la sogs pa mdo smad kyi btsad po da lta bzhugs pa rnams yin no/ / de nas sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i dus su me pho rta'i lo hor yul du byon nas/ rgyal po go dan dang lug lo zla ba dang po la mjal phrad gnang nas/ rgyal po yang shin tu mnyes nas chos dang 'jig rten lugs kyi gsung gleng mang po mdzad skabs su/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gis so blon so mang a yi dang nang nyo gnyis gtso 'khor bcas kyis bod dbus dang shar tsong kha'i yul sogs bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud ma nyams pa zhig gdan drangs te/ de'i dus su hor gyi rgyal po'i ci zer gyi ngag la nyan na khyed rnams kyi yul/ sa phyogs kyi mi sde/ so so'i dpon gang yod pa de dpon du bskos/ sa skya pa'i gser yig pa dang dngul yig pa bos nas/ da ra kha che 'di bskos na 'thad pa yin/ de nas dpon gyi ming / mi sde'i grangs/ 'dang nor gyi tshad yi ge legs po gsum byas nas/ gcig hor rgyal la phul/ gcig sa skyar bzhag gcig rang rang gi dpon gyis bzung rgyu 'di yin/ nged 'dir 'ong ba rnams la hor gyis — 52 —

ci 'dra byed snyam pa'i dogs mi dgos/ thams cad kyi thugs la btags nas bzang por yod pas/nged kyi phyogs nas thams cad blo bde bar bzhugs pas chog 'dab nor la gsor/ dngul/ glang po che'i mche ba/ mu tig rdog po che ba/ mtshal/ btsod/ ru rta/ gi waṃng / stag gzig gung gsum/sram/ bod snam/ dbus phug bzang po/ 'di na de tsho dga' bar 'dug spyir nor la 'dir gtsigs chung yang rang rang gi yul na gang bzang gi nor sdas 'ong bas chog pa yin zhes pas gsal bsgrags thos phral/ lo na phra ba'i so mang rgyal phrug blon 'bangs 'ga' bcas gong ltar 'dab nor gang bzang bsnam nas sa skya pagyi ta dang hor go dan rgyal po gnyis la skyes 'bul thog mar song bas/ sa skya partsi ta'i rgyal phrug la dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyi rlabs pas na dkon mchog skyabs zhes mtshan gsol/ sa skya dang hor rgyal go dan gnyis kyis dar kha che bskos nas cho lo byin 'jags gnang nas/ bstan la phan pa'i bka' lung bzang po 'di/ / thog ma nyid du bstod 'os bsngags pa dang / / yongs su bsngo smon rjes su bgyis pa 'di/ / mi yi dbang pos dad pas bskul nas ni/ / dkon mchog gsum dang rgyal po'i bstod pa rnams/ / srid zhi kun nas 'phags pa thob phyir mdzod/ / ces gsungs so/ / de nas bzung ste sa spyod pa zhes lam lugs ni rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus thog bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyi sa gnas 'go gtso dang chos lugs pa'i 'go gtso bcas la cho lo byin 'jags byas pa brgyud sa gnas de ga'i mi dmangs la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i lam lugs shig chags pa red/ khyad par si khron bod rigs sa khul du yon dang / ming / chin rgyal rabs bcas kyis cung yongs khyab kyi sgo nas sa spyod pa'i sgrig gzhi btsugs pa dang / chin rgyal rabs rjes su sa khongs bcos sgyur dang / gzhung zhabs bsko mngag gi byed phyogs thengs mang lag len bstar rung sa spyod pa sngar bzhin cung mang ba gnas pa'i sa khul zhig yin/ si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi sa spyod par cho lo byin 'jags dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs dang sa spyod pa khag gi bar gyi 'brel ba/ sa spyod pas kha lo sgyur ba'i sa khul gyi spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor chags tshul dang / chab srid lam lugs la sogs che long tsam gsham nas 'chad do/ /gnyis pa/ chu chen rab brtan rgyal po'i skor/chu chen rab brtan rgyal po gong ma'i mnga' 'og tu ma 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis spyi lo 1253 (yon zhan tsung khri lo gnyis pa) chu chen rab brtan rgyal po tshe dbang don 'aspub dang a drung gnyis kyi skabs su yon gyi dmag dpung khag gsum du bgos pas/ yun nan khongs ta li rgyal khab tu dpung 'jug gis deng skabs rnga ba dang / dkar mdzes/ yon ya bcas kro'u khag gi khyab khongs su yod pa'i bod rigs sa khul rnams yon rgyal rabs kyi dmag don stobs shugs kyis bkag sdom byas kyang / chu chen dang btsan la rgyal po gnyis ni stobs dang dpa' rtsal che bas/ hor rgyal po'i dus nas mnga' 'og tu ma chug par grags/rgyu mtshan de'i rkyen gyis rab brtan rgyal sa bon gyi gnas chen de sngar las grags shing /—bospya3 gyi mtshan

nyid dang bon chos kyi bka' bstan sogs dpar shing yod pa'i dgon chen mdo smad rgyal mo rong gi bon thams cad kyi lte gnas g.yung drung lha steng yang grags snyan nam mkha' dang mnyam mo/ / batren la de yon rgyal rabs la 'go ma btags kyang mthar yon gyi dmag dpung gi drag shugs kyis mnga' 'og tu chud dgos pas/ sa skya dang yon rgyal rabs gnyis bdag nyid chen po gyur nas btsan la bdag chen zhes grags/'on kyang / btsan la bdag chen gyi rgyal rgyud med phyir man pa ra rdzi zhig gis rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i mthar rab brtan rgyal po dang gnyen byas nas gong ma lhas skyong la glen ldog byed rkyen 1728 lor (yong krin khri lo drug par) than jon li'u phan kra'o da'o si than jon kra'u la bsgyur pa dang / chan lung gi lo rabs nang dmag dpung 'bor chen brten nas snga rjes su lo ngo nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring la chu chen dang btsan la dang dzra skye sku'i sa spyod pa'i gyen ldog la drag gnon gyis de rmag med bzo ched tun cu'u si yi dbang sgyur las khungs btsugs/ de las 'brug lor 'khrugs chung dang / lcags yos lor 'khrugs chen zhes sanyis yod pa red/(1)rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag lor chu chen rab brtan rgyal po dang mag pa btsan la'i tshe dbang bdag chen gnyis cung ma mthun pas/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos lor lcags la rgyal po dang dge bshes tsa rgyal po gnyis dang chu chen rab brtan rgyal po'i bar sa rtsod byung tshe/ zi khron skor skyod am paṇa ci sran gyis de la kha g.yar te dmag chu chen steng du phud par rab brtan rgyal pos pham rjes/ lhas skyong gong ma (chan lung)yis dpa' dang dpung shed ngom ste/ zi khron tsung ti krang ze gang la khri dmag gsum khrid du bcug nas/ btsan la rgyal pos yang dpung rogs byas te/ phyogs gsum nas chu chen bskor bar ma zad/ lo phyed la chu chen pham rgyu 'char gzhi byas na'ang / chu chen gyi dgra rdzong zhig gtor ba las mkhar grong zhig len pa sla zhes phag sna brag la thug ste/ lo phyed zad de sa 'brug lo'i dpyid gar dmag dpon krung zhin dang / mun khrin zhes pa sogs mi dmag mang po bsad stabs/ gong mas shes ldan na' chen dpung gnon la bzhag cing phyir log ar bhan yo krung che slar dmag dpon du bskos nas 'thab mod/ dpon mi tsho'i nang ma mthun pa dang / btsan la'i dpon mo a kho zhes pa chu chen gyi nang ma yin pa'i rkyen gyis dmag bdag rin ces dang ca kong rid zer pa gnyis bcas dmag mang po slar yang shi lam du bsdus tshe/ tsung ti krang zi kang dang shes ldan na' chen gnyis gong mas bka' chad phog nas bsad/lo de'i dgun la shes ldan spro hun zhes pa dpung gnon du bskos te btsun mo a kho sogs nang ma rnams bsad/ 'thab ra bzung zhing gzhi ra bcom pa'i 'thab rtsal ltar chu chen la rgol bar/ rab brtan rgyal pos ngo ya mang po byas na'ang / dmag dpon yo krung chi yong nas slu thabs kyis rab brtan dang mthun gtam smras par brten/ sa sgrul lo'i dpyid khar mgo bsgur ro/ /de la sa 'brug lo'i 'khrugs chung zer/de nas chu chen rab brtan rgyal po rje rje rgyal/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya lor jun chen gyi dbus dmahūṃ dbye ༵'i dus su/ rgya dpon yo krung chi dang lhan du lho dmag ces chab mdo brgyud nas dbus su

dmag drangs te/ jun gar pa tshe dbang rab brtan pham par byas rjes bzhag pa red/ chu yos dus 'khrugs dang man chen gyis dmag dbus skyod gnyis pa'i skabs su 'ang rogs ram byed myangs stabs/gong ma lhas skyong gis re zhig nyes chad ma gcod par ma tshad/ snga sor mang rgyal rabs kyis krang ka'an si'i go gnas thog tu/ man chen gyis an spru si'i go gnas bzhag ste/ thog mar pho brang nub ri nas rgyal rong lta bu'i dgra rdzong bsgun te/ der rgol bar spyong ba'i skas dmag ces dmag nyis stong lhag yod pa'i dmag sgar btsugs shing / de nas chu chen mthun pa'i rgyal kha tshe dbang drag rgyal zhes rdzong bzhi mnga' ba de/ lcags la dang mgo log dbal shul mdzod dge sogs kyi dmag lag mgor dkris nas bcom mo/ /(2)de nas yang gong nas lhas skyong gis me khyi lor zi khron tsung ti ar the la rgyal rong spyal khag dgus chu chen bskor nas pham dgos bka' phab mod/ 'on kyang / rab brtan rgyal po yang man chen dang cha rgyus che phyir/ de bstun gyi thag pa'i ngo ya thu gus byas zhes daspre ltar/ 'phrang dog sa/ ri btsan sa'i dgra rdzong 'dzing rag je brtan je rgyas su btang bas/ zas dang mtshon cha bsgrig zhor du rgyal sa tsha bo mi dbang nam 'kha' la sprad/ khro skyabs dang gnyen byas/ btsan la dang dpung bsgrigs rjes/ chu chen bsod nams dbang rgyal dus rim gyis dge bshes tsa dbang du bsdus shing / btsan la seng ge bzang bdag chen gyis kyang 'og gzhi rgyal po dbang du bsdus ba'i rkyen gyis/ 'og gzhi'i rgyal po stag lha bros byol gyis zi khron cung tis la dmag rogs zhus te btsan la bdag chen seng ge bzang dang 'thab tshe pham rgyal med par gnas pa la/ gong ma lhas skyong gis dmag shed dang rgyu shed phud de shes ldan lun spru dang ke len gnyis dmag dpon du bskos/ hran zhi/ ke'u kro'u/ zi khron nas khri dmag gnyis kyi dpung mngags la lcags yos lo'i zla ba 8pa'i tshes 7nyin rong rgan zhing las bar 'thab yun med ces/ btsan la bdag chen rgyal por shar lho byang nas rgol ba'i tshe na/ chu chen bsod nams rgyal pos btsan la'i dpung rogs su blon dka' thub dang dmag bdun brgya phud nas man chen dmag dang g.yul ngo mang po bshams/ jang cun 'a'e tsung stong dmag gsum dang lhan du bcom na'ang / mang sne nyung gis ma rten par chu 'brug lo'i dgun btsan la dang 'og ga'i gnyis kyi yu la shor zhing / seng ge bzang / sum mdo'i bon thar sogs chu chen du bros pa'o/ /btsan la blangs rjes/ gong mas wun spru mtha' bde'i dmag bdag zhes pa la bzhag ste chu chen la dmag 'dren pa'i dmag bdag khang btsan la'i chu gar na yod pa'i steng du chu chen bsod nams dbang rgyal bstan pas chu sbrul lo'i zla ba drug par 'jab rgol byed thengs gcig gis dmag bdag wun spu bsad/ khri dmag gcig tsam shi rmas su btang / btsan la'i yul slar 'phrog seng ge bzang gis rmi nga rgyal sa bzung ba'o/ /(2)gong mas slar yang a ke mtha' bde'i dmag bdag la bskos par ma zad/ rgyal sa'i stog dmag stong gcig dang / he long cang / ci len/ yun nan/ hran zhi/ kan su sogs nas dmag rgod chig khri lhag kha snon byas te/ phyogs gsum nas slar yang tshur rgol byed pa'i dmag/ sna ba~Xn la seng

ge bzang gis ma ldog par zla ba bcu pa'i nang btsan la'i yul yang bskyar shor stabs/ seng ge bzang /dmag blon sum mdo'i bon thar dag ni sngar ltar chu chen du yong ba red/(ji)lcags yos lo'i 'khrugs chen zhes/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing rta'i lo 'gor man chen gyi khri dmag mang pos btsan la/ dam pa/ dge bshes tsa phyogs gsum nas chu chen kyis lha steng g.yung drung gling dang kwa leng ka la g.yul gyi dpung bshams pa'i tshe na/ chu chen ni/ rab brtan mi dbang nam mkha' dang / grags rgyal bstan pa/ bsod nams dbang rgyal gsum gyis lo nyi shu'i ring du ri mtho lung zab kyi sa sgang re re nas btsan rdzong mang po brtsigs te/ mi bcu'i stong 'gog pa'i gra sgrig byas stabs/ der rgol ba ni btsan la'i bcu skor gyi bka' yin pa'i phyir/ char zhod dang mtshan mo'i dus su 'jab rgol byed pa las thabs med par 'phrang rer zla re/ ri re la lo re byas nas mi shi rgyu zad kyi sdug 'thab byed dgos pa'i dus su/ 'brug thar zhes pa'i byis pa zhig yod pa'i pha rgan rab brtan bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis bsad pa'i rtsod don chu chen rgyal pos gsang lam gyi sa khri zhig yod pa de a jang jun la phul bas gzod chu chen pham thub ces rgya'i yig tshang na yod pa ltar/ shing lug lo'i khrums zla'i bco lnga'i nub mor rim gyis lha steng g.yung drung gling gtor zhing / me sprel lo'i mchu zla'i nang da gzod chu chen bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi rgyal sa gtor nas/ rgyal po bsod nams dbang rgyal dang / grags rgyal bstan pa/ blon rgan bstan pa 'od zer/ bla ma bstan 'dzin/ nam mkha' g.yung drung ye shes sogs skya ser nyis stong lhag gis mgo bsgur ro/ / de la lcags yos lo'i 'khrugs chen zer ba'o/ /(5)de yang 'khrugs pa 'di'i ched du jur chen dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus kyi gong ma lhas skyong yang lo mang po'i ring du snying rlung stod du 'tshang ste/ chu chen zhes pa'i yul gru lag mthil 'dra ba zhig 'dul ched rgyal yongs kyi dmag gi phyed tsam mngags/ de'i 'u lag gcig por mi chig 'bum lhag yod cing / 'gro song la dngul srang gye ba bdun btang / dmag mi drug khri tsam shi rmas su song / shes ldan gnyis dang /tsung ti gcig drag dpon sum cu lhag shi bar brten/ gong mas bdag gi rgyal srid kyi dmag las su/'di 'dra'i chag nyes shig byung ma myong zhes chu chen pham pa'i rdo ring du bkod pa'o/ / chu chen dus 'khrugs de ni jur chen dar zhing rgyas pa'i chan lung gi dus su/ chu chen gyis mtho dman gnam sa 'dra ba zhig yod rung / rgyu 'bras rgya lam lta bu zhig los yod ces rbad chod kyis jur chen la ngo rgol byas pa yin stabs/des spyir spyal yongs/ nang sgos su lho phyogs su skul ma thebs te/ pad dkar gyen langs nas zhi bde lha rgyal sogs rim par byung bar phan pa lta bu dang / rang rgyal bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lo rgyus na yod pa'i rim byung dmag 'khrugs kyi khrod na/ chu chen lta bu'i mi shi rgyu gyong che zhing g.yul las rgyal dka' ba'i 'khrugs chen zhig mthong dka' ba lta bu red do/ /chu chen dmag 'khrugs ni/ jur chen srid gzhung gis drag thabs kyis mi rigs gnya' gnon byed pa'i log spyod cig yin stabs/ des phyir rgyal mo rong gi bod 'bangs la gnod 'tshe che 'ing / mi rigs kyi 'gal ba je drag tu btang ba red/ chu chen spyal po 'khyer — 56 —

dus mi ser gyis chu'i pha rol nas phyag 'tshal te skyel ma byas shing 'i grong zhes bod mis brjod pa ni che bstod ma yin par 'dra thengs yin pa de ni drag po kho na las bod kyi rig gnas dar yul ma red ces pa ni yul 'di'i rgyu mtshan ma shes pa dang bod skad dang bod yig mi shes shing / rgyal rong gi rang skad kyang mi shes pa 'ga' zhig gis byung rgyal du smra ba'i rtags red/ da dung chu chen gyi 'khrugs pa zhi rjes/ rgyal mo rong gi bod kyi zlos gar dang seng 'cham gyi srol btod pa la gar phrug mang po bcas pho brang du khrid de/ yul de'i glu gar lta bu gong ma'i gser mkhar na'ang med do zhes de'i mi rgyud rnams da lta'i dar dmar sde ba yod cing rgyal rong yin par bcas rgya'i deb ther na yod pa lta bu'o/ /spyi lo 1264 lor (kre yon khri lo drug pa)yon rgyal rabs krung dbyang gis shon krang yon zhes pa'i las khungs btsugs te rgyal yongs kyi nang pa'i dgon sde dang / bod rigs sa khul rnams gcig gyur gyi do dam byas/ bod kyi mtho rim bla ma dang sa gnas kyi 'go gtso rnams la go sa rgyud 'dzin chog pa'i cho lo byin 'jags byas shing / si khron bod rigs sa khul du thengs dang por bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis dngos su cho lo byin 'jags byas pa'i sa spyod pa 'bor chen byung 'dug pa ma zad/ da dung bod rigs sa khul du srol bstun 'jam 'gugs kyi dbang sgyur thabs shes lag bstar thog nang pa'i chos lugs dar spel shugs chen btang ste chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs btsugs nas chab srid kyi dbang sgyur dang chos lugs kyi dmigs bsal nus pa zung du 'brel bas rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs rnams la bkag sdom byas pas/ ming rgyal rabs dang ching rgyal rabs gnyis kyang yon rgyal rabs srol rnying gi rjes su 'brang bar ma tshad/ da dung cho lo byin 'jags byas pa'i sa spyod pa debs mang ba byung 'dug dper na/ spyal mo rong la dregs pa bco brgyad de/ rgyal ṭwāṃdngha /༵ byaX/ paṭwāṃco/ ba/ rgyad ces de rnams la re re nas thob 'os kyi go sa rgyud 'dzin chog pa'i cho lo byin gsum pa/ rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad kyi ming /so mang rgyal po/ rdzi 'gag rgyal po/ cog tse'i rgyal po/ dam pa rgyal po/ khro skyabs rgyal po/chu chen rab brtan rgyal po/ btsan la bdag chen rgyal po/ 'og gzhi rgyal po/ bkra shis gling tshe dbang rgyal po/ mdo li'i rgyal po bcu ste/ deng sang rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul la yod pa'o/ / lcags la rgyal po/ pa wam rgyal po/ brag nying rgyal po/ dge bshes tsa rgyal po/ mda' mdo rgyal po lnga ste deng sang dkar mdzes rang skyong khul du yod do/ / mi phyi rgyal po/ 'gag smad rgyal po/ 'gag la rgyal po gsum te/ deng sang g.yag rnga kran khyu'u na yod pa ste bco brgyad du grags so/ /

le'u bdun pa/ zhangathol gyi skad yig dang shes rig byung tshul/dang po/ rgyal rong gi skad dang zhang bod② skad gnyis mthun tshul/shes rig gi rin thang gtso bo ni shes rig rang gi lo rgyus rang rkya thab pa zhig yod med la thug yod/de dag gi rtsa ba ni skad dang yi ge yin pas/ 'di'i khungs la thugs bsam bzhes dgos pa zhig chags yod do/ /sngon tshe nas bzung da lta'i bar mdo smad rgyal rong gi skad de/ zhang zhung dang bod skad sha stag kho na yin pas brna rnying ma 'gyur ba shas che bas/ zhang bod kyi skad rang yin/ dper na/ lung ba la (gyes kha)yul la (khyung)yul dpon la (khyung ro)bro dpon nam ru dpon la (da ro)byis chung la (hri ta pi tsa)bu pho (ti tsa)rdo la (ju glig)sta re (shi 'bal )yod (bdog)'gro ('dong)sha la (rgya ri)stag lhags (khung bkre)rgas pa (gu bgres)gcig (te)bdun (sne)nyi shu(ni cu)zhes pa lta bu ste/ da dung bod skad dam rgyal mo rong gi skad khrod kyi g.yar tshig nang rgya dkar nag dang sog po'i skad kyang yod de/dper na/ cog tse(rgya)ha'i tso (rgya)kong jo(rgya)zhu lag (sog)em che(sog)seṅge(rgya gar)padma (rgya gar)margad (rgya gar)ces pa lta bu te/ g.yar tshig ni spyi tshogs kyi skad brda'i snang tshul gal chen zhig yin zhing / bod skad khrod na yang yul skad dang / zur chag pa'i skad/ phal skad sogs la zer/yul skad ni rgya bod kyi mi rigs so so'i yul so so'i skad cha (rketshici shā)la zer/ zur chag pa'i skad ni zur chag pa ste nyams pa (rmithustoblo 1jirmithucicha sme)la zer/ phal skad de yongs grags su yul lung so so'i skad(gresnyersārilngazacisdodkusnyend+ra)zer/ yig skad dang phal skad gnyis la khyad par phran pu yod (oṃthohālkokhraglostedzicha: 1)mdo smad rgyal mo rong gi yul skad 'di bod skad ma 'gyur ba yin pas/ siti paṇa chen gyi sum rtags 'grel chen las/ khams phyogs kyi a mdo dang rgyal rong sogs byang shar gyi sa cha rnams su 'khod pa'i skye bo dag la'ang gna' bo'i dus su yul dbus nas byung ba'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin grags pa'i yi ge 'don tshul dang / de dag gi yul skad bcas la'ang cung nyams che tsam las/'phul rten sogs sgra dag par 'don pa byung ba mngon sum gyis grub zhes gsungs so/ / mkhas pa chen po dmu dge bsam gtan gyi mdo smad rgyal mo rong gi lo rgyus las/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yul skad kyi nang brda rnying ches mang ba dang / sgra drag che ba'i dbang gis 'gyur ba dang / 'gyur che ba dang / nyams che drag pa'i dbang gis 'gyur ba dang / 'gyur che ba sogs kyi dbang gis mi 'dra ba lta bur gyur ba'ang yod la dbus gtsang skad kyang rim gyis 'gyur ba'i stabs kyis mi 'dra ba lta bur gyur mod/ ma gzhi rgyal rong gi skad 'di bod skad rang yin pa nged cag bod rang mtshan pa dang / bod yig shes pa dag gis bltas na shin/ tu gaṭwāṃ~X/da bod skad dang bod yig mi shes shing / rgyal rong gi skad kyang mi shes pa 'ga' zhig gis

byung rgyal du smra bas/ dngos don lcags lta bu dag bsgyur ka la nus/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ zhang bod② yi ge byung tshul/zhang bod kyi yi ge byung tshul ni/ gshen rab mi bo che'i sngon du byung ba'i gna' mi de dag gis yi ge 'ga' zhig bed spyod byas yod dam med pa de ni ches lo rgyus shig yin pa dang / lo rgyus de rigs kyi khungs ston byed kyi dpe shin tu mthong dka' ba bcas la brten/ da lta'i dus 'dir shes rtogs shin tu dka' ba'i gnas shig tu chags yod kyang / yi ge ni yig thog gi skad cha yin la rig gnas kyi gzhi rtsa med du mi rung ba zhig red/ de ni bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag kha shas kyi dus nas yod pa red/ de ltar na'ang gshen rab mi bo che byon nas/ khong gis yi ge'i srol gsar pa zhig btod par mdzad pa'i tshul ni bon gyi lo rgyus rnams las yongs su grags pa zhig yin stabs/ gshen rab mi bo che'i dus nas bzung / ya thog zhang zhung gi yi ge byung ba yin zhes nges par du bshad thub pa byung / 〈 legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉 las/ bod kyi yi ge ni dang po sangs rgyas kyis mdzad de/mdo las/ yi ge stam cu bon gyi khog yang phub/ /mgo yis lam drang shad kyis mdor yang bcad/ /tsheg gis bar phye mi 'khrugs gsal bar snyoms/ /gug 'greng na rdo zhags kyu ya sta yis/ /skabs sbyor don du yan lag rgyas par btags/ / zhes pas dang po dag pa lha'i yi ge stag gzig spungs yig tu bsgyur/ de zhang zhung gi yig rgan du bsgyur/ de smrar sbrag tu bsgyur/ ces ya thog zhang zhung gi yi ge ni gshen rab mi bo ches mdzad cing de'ang yi ge'i rtsa ba ka kha sogs gsal byed sum cu yod pa de rnams kyis bon gyi khog phub/mgo yis lam drang zhes pa g.yung drung gi ris la gdan 'bas gyu dza: yis 'di 'dra ba zhig yi ge'i dbu gang na3 'dzugs pa'i rtags bstan pa dang / shad kyis mdor bcad ces pa dung gi 'khyil ris lta bu'i shad pha ’’'di 'dra ba zhig gis skabs don gang du rdzogs pa'i mtshams bstan pa dang / tsheg gis bar phye zhes pa zur bzhi ba'i thig nyis brtsegs mi 'di 'dra ba 'ig gis yig 'bru phan tshun gyi bar phye ba dang /gug 'greng na ro zhabs kyu zhes pas ni bod yig la yongs su grags pa'i dbyangs bzhi ste/ steng na gi gu dang / 'greng bu/ na ro gsum dang 'og na 'bas kyu sbyar srol yod pa de rnams dang / ya sta zhes pas ya 'dog tsam du ma zad/ ra 'dogs dang la 'dogs bcas pa'i 'dogs gsum mtshon pa dang /skabs sbyor zhes pas mgo can (ra mgo la mgo sa mgo)gsum dang sngon rjes 'jug sogs gang la gang 'os skabs thob tu sbyar dgos pa'i don yin/ 〈 legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉las dang po dag pa lha'i yi ge stag gzig spungs yig tu bsgyur zhes gsungs pa 'di ni dus phyis kyicibon po rnams kyis bon gyi 'byung khungs dang gshen rab kyi 'khrungs yul sogs stag gzig la khungs bcol yod pa de'i lugs su byas te/skabs 'dir yang stag gzig gi spungs yig de zhang zhung yig gon gyi khungs su bshad pa tsam zhig yin pa las/ ga'an pa'i rgyu mtshan 'ga' yang med la/ chos kyi lugs su legs sbyar la lha'i skad zer srol yod pa de'i shan zhugs nas 'dir dag pa lha'i yi ge zhes che brjod dang bcas te bshad yod pa gas la por — 59 —

mthong /drotrīdi~Xng/ shod tshul trī ni mngon sumazhi gyi rigs pa daX 'gal ṭwāṃ zhipy-i ste/ stag gzisdu gi spungs yigal dbya~Xs ṭwāṃkāl gyi rtsa ba na tu nyung ngu bye las sumasna'apy-ings—da—nga / zhatrī zhursha rnagargakā la gsalabyed ga do sum ༵ṭwāṃng / dbyaṭālha ske rtags bayi ru sa pa /nga /'ostag gag ru ṭwāṃngasdu ga tu dbyangasdu dnga'agyigs gsarna/sakyi/ralusara~Xnapasdosdung garteturdoraṭwāṃ' la 'odal/zhang zhung / rgan dbyangs dang ṭwāṃgasna gasdu ku/ ga 'gā 'a rgyan dī bangon nga ṭwāṃ garsha sasu 'dogasarshayis padardo/yostakāgag spungapy-i ga /nayalha sa nas gan sazi su rsha da/ spopa la/zheng zhung kta ṭwāṃn /ṭwāṃ sdu zlos ṭwāṃyas sa su 'a dgi/spopa dang / shestag rten/ ṭwāṃngs gogaṭwāṃ dasnag bsal ga ma trī //'alasdud la/tshizhang zhudī py-i rgan du ga dī la ga mami 'a das ṭwāṃ py-ing /briṭwāṃg py-ig spungs ga la gisdu phanastonardzumasa~Xcadasdu malas/ rudachegs ༵sakā kā' phyoladapal/mizhangasnging ga rgaspya la pokā phakā ༄na ṭwāṃyimasna bcad pa' da du meg rsha pa gigs gas kun rshas rto 'dra ba' khya/ thaha cang ṭā ga ṭwāṃ pa la rsha rgyus rtsa ba ṭwāṃsdu dpa yig zhes bltatrī sbyi'ang sade gas thub pa gid/ daṭān/ daskapy-i du/ nitrī baṭwāṃng ṭwāṃr bu shes/ sa bya ba ga sgrub / zhang zhung skad dang ga rgan du/ ga smrar (kyi /ga mar na/ ṅge:lhorya/rngeḥn/:'o/:glu/lhiḍā/:sgoṇḍa:/geryakau'i/sna pa 'di~Xr du 'asdong la/kyizhang zhungagi trīg rgan zhes bya ba 'di laḍing byig tshugs 'dra min du ṭwāṃnaṭā 'isdoṭwāṃtrīsnasakā/yodapaṭwāṃkādīzhuspyatrī rshakāshāgyisnasdokāldadnghasna~Xd sdu sgra don sdeb snang gsal 'bir zhang zlong yigaze rgan gyi dper 'go da pa las / ngas bar bsam nas/ skabs tshoḥhūṃgaṭwāṃlaṅge ṭwāṃrji spyi/༈ṇḍa:'a:ryāḥl༈na:glaḥgi:na༈ldi:gaḥ5ཿmā༈ naḥrpā:mo'iḥrga༈skruḥrteḥhphaḥhre/(:moḥgro'isko༈ 4/:/skru༈2ka yig dbyangs ldan ni/ (1:she'uḥ/sho:skyes/—/0kadig 'dogs ldan ni/ skra'ilpuḥ/glu:

(4)ka yig mgo can ni/ rwardo// : 76ka ཿ 1(yi :(5)ka yig mgo 'dogs nyis ldan ni/ hresgroḥ 52ཿ nt+ra17ཿrtangalnga/:deng dus rang re la yongs su grags pa'i dbe rnyingardzugater ma〉zhes bya ba de rnams kyi nang du gter yig ces bya ba shin tu ya mtshan pa'i yig tshugs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod 'dug pa de dag gi gras su zhang zhung yig rgan gyi 'bru bklag thub pa mi nyung ba zhig yod 'dug pa dang / gter ma'i dpe rnams kyi tshig rkang dang / tshig sgrub rnams rdzogs mtshams su gter tsheg ces bya ba sgor thig nyis brtsegs can zhig gam mang zhig tu sgor thig nyis brtsegs kyi bar du 'phred shad thung ngus mtshan pa pha’ 'di 'dra ba zhig yod pa de dag gis gter ma'i rigs kyi dpe rnams la rnying ma'am gna' bo'i rang gshis yod pa'i mngon rtags gsal bor bstan pa dang / gna' dus su dar ba'i zhang zhung gi yig rgan de khyad par can gyi yig tshugs shig yin pa'ang bstan pa yin/ yig 'bru phan tshun so sor 'byed pa'i tsheg thig gru bzhi'am zlum po gang rung nyis brtsegs rgyag pa 'di ni gna' bo'i dpe rnying mang zhig tu mthong thub cing / deng dus kun gyis tshad mar brtsi ba'i dpe rnying tun hong nas thon pa rnams su'ang de rigs mi nyung ba zhig yod/ deng dus dbu med kyi tshugs su sbrul shad ces bya ba don tshan gsar pa zhig gi dbu 'dzugs pa'i tshe dzi༈’’'di 'dra ba zhiga'abri st+ril yod pa de~Xng zhang zhung yig rgan gyi shad ces pa de dang don gcig cing rnam pa'ang shin tu 'dra ba sna~Xnā dri/ du mabye~X snasna/sdeb/ zhu nyi ma grangs pas mdzad pa'i sgra'i don sdeb kyi dbur yod pa'i dpe de rigs la'ang 'bri stangs mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig byung 'dug la dpe 'gar phaki’ zhes papha ’rgya gar gyi lugs ltar 'bri zhing dzi’ 'di la phake’’ṭī~X/ / sdo dī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༵ shākā ṭwāṃdī ṭwāṃ spya ṭwāṃ/la cher legs sbyar gyi shan zhugs pa zhig yin pa ni smar tshugs dang mi ༄ de smrar sbrag tu bsgyur ces pa'i yi ge smrar’’zhes bya ba de ni/ lha'am dge ba'am/ bkra shis pa rnams kyi don du 'jug cing / dzisbrag’ ces pa ni yig gzugs der mgo bkod kyi 'azed shad med na'ang /yig 'bru dngos la zur dang drang zlum gsum gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i tshugs shig la zer ba yin/ don du dag pa lha'i yi ge zhes bya ba de dang don gcig cing / de bzhin du rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yi ge yang zur dang drang zlum gsum gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i tshugs shig yin/ de'ang yi ge'i rtsa ba ka kha sogs gsal byed sum cu yod pa de rnams kyang bon gyi khog phub/ mdor na dag pa lha'i yi ge zhes pa de la/ zhang zhung gi yig rgan du grags pa mgo bkod 'azed shad yod pa zhigadang / smrar sprag tu grags pa zur drang skum gsum gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i tshugs bcas zhang zhung yig tshugs kyi rtsa ba rnam pa gnyis su grangs nges padīrdo shes thub

pa yin/bzhi ba/ zhang bod rgyal rong gi shes rig byung tshul/gna' rabs su zhang zhung gi yul du khyad par can gyi shes rig ci dang ci zhig dar yod pa ni gshen rab mi bo che'i mdzad mdo rnams kyis mtshon pa'i lo rgyus kyi yig cha rnams las shes dgos pa yin snyam/gang la zer na/ gshen rab mi bo che 'jig rten 'dir sku bltams pa'i dus rabs kyi dbu brnyes pa de nas bzung / khong gis bstan pa'i bon gyi bye brag ji snyed pa dang / de dang 'brel ba'i shes rig rgya che la grangs mang ba du ma zhig dar rgyas byung myong ba dang / de dag kyang gna' bo'i lo rgyus tsam zhig ma yin par shes rig gi rgyun de dag mi rabs nas mi rabs su rgyun ma chad par 'tsho skyong byas pas mang zhig ni da lta'i dus su'ang bod rgyal rong rnams kyi khrod du 'tsho bzhin yod pa dang / bod rnams nas lag len du bstar dang bstar bzhin du yod pa 'di dag las lhag pa'i shes byed ci zhig dgos zhes dang / ṭwāṃ legs bshad skal bzang mgrin rgyan〉las/ gto bu 'bum sangs dpyad bu khri shes zung / /sras 'khrungs gsas chen ru bzhi spyan drangs nas/ /sgo bzhi mdzod lnga'i bon bstan yongs su spel/ /zhes pa de dag gis zhang rgyal ya thog gi bon rabs byung tshul gyi skabs su gsal bar bshad pa'i bsgrags pa gsum gyi dpe'u rtse dang /sgo bzhi mdzod lnga'i bon rnams bstan yod par gsal zhing / slar yang skal bzang mgrin rgyan〉 las/bstan pa'i gzhi ma bzo rig pa gtan la phabs te gar ma li sho sogs 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan drug dpal bstan/ zhes mkhas pa gar ma li sho sogs kyis gtsos pa'i mkhas pa mi drug gis zhus pa'i ngor/gshen rab mi bo ches bzo rig pa'i skor rnams bstan par gsal ba dang / ra rtsis dang sman la sogs/ /'gro la nye bar phan cing gso ba dang / /lkog gyur mngon gsal bon sde du ma gsungs/ /zhes pas gsal ba'i phywa gshen gyi bon sgo thams cad/ pra ltas mo dang snang mthong rtsis/ nad gso sman dpyad/ 'chi bslu gto bcas rnam pa bzhi ru 'dus kyi yo da pa de dag la zer ba yin/(1)pra ltas mo zhes 'di la ye srid 'phrul gyi ju thig dang / ye mkhyen sgra bla'i mngon shes/ ye rje smon pa'i rmi lam/ ye dbang lha'i bka' babs te/ mo'i gtso bo rnam pa bzhi yod/ dzi ju thig’’ ces pa 'di ni mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal (1846 — 1912 )gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 ju thig gi dpyad din snang gsal sgron me〉 (sde dge sha 2 ba 4 )las/(2)phywa gshen legs rgyal thang po sogs/ / skal ldan 'khor gyis zhus pa'i ngor/ / theg dgu'i dang po phywa gshen bon/ /bkrid drang lam gyi sgo ru bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ ju thig gi mo 'di ni gshen rab mi bo ches bstan pa phywa bon gyi yang snying lta bu zhig yin la/ pha bkrid drang zhes pa ni gdul bya rnams bon gyi phyogs su kha drangs ba'i bon sde/ yo ngas grags su drang don zhes bya ba dang don gcig pa yin/ ju thig ni shin tu rgya che la lo rgyus mang ba zhig yin stabs/ ju thig skor gyi yig cha'ang shin tu mang /dzi ju bag ༵ra ba skya drug ces grags pa bzhin/ ju thig gi mo chas su thig gu ring thung drug yod pa de dag

gi thig sne zung re nyis gshib byas pa'i rtser mdud pa re bor bas mdud pa khag bzhi 'byung zhing lha ga ma mo ba'i lag gnyis kyi thig gu zung re dam du 'dzin cing thad kar kha phyes pa na/ mdud pa'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba ci rigs shig 'byung srid pa de dag la zhib 'jug byed dgos pa yin/(2)thu thig gi mdud grangs mi 'dra ba ji tsam zhig yod pa ni 〈 snang gsal sgron me〉las/ da ltar srid pa'i bla mdud la/ /zhib tshags byas na drug brgya yod/ /sangs khri phrag 'bum zhes sogs bshad/ /bab skyen bsdus pas sum brgya drug cu yod/ / brgyag gis bsgyur ba mi 'dra khri tsam yod/ / brgyag gtso bdun brgya nyi shur 'dus/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdud pa'i gtso bo/ deng deng dang / khyung brgyad dang / skyam zhes pa lta bu dwangs ma'i mdud pa dang / mdzangs ma'i mdud pa dang / snyigs ma'i mdud pa rigs mi 'dra ba sum brgya drug cu yod pa ste/ snang gsal sgron mer sgyu ma gser 'bum gyi lung drangs pa las/ mo mdud sum baspya drug cu la/ / dwangs ma brgya dang nyi shu de/ / lha khams srid pa'i bla gnas yin/ /mdzangs la brgya dang nyi shu de/ /mi khams srid pa'i bla gnas yin/ /snyigs ma brgya dang nyi shu de/ / 'dre khams srid pa'i bla mdud yin/ / zhes pas gsal ba de yin/(4)brgyag ces pa ni mdud pa'i gtso bo gang dag byung ba de mo gdan gyi steng du bkod pa'i tshe/bkod dbyibs dang de dang phyogs kyi 'brel ba sogs la dpyad pa'i rigs de rnams la zer ba yin/sangs khri phrag 'bum zhes dpe 'dir 'khod yod na'ang snang gsal sgron mer sgyu ma gser 'bum gyi lung drangs pa las/ brag la khri dang sad la 'bum/ / zhes brag dang sad kyi tha snyad gsal por bstan yod la dpe 'dir sangs zhes pa de dang sgyu ma gser 'bum du sad ces pa de gnyis don gcig yin pa ni shes sla la/phrag ces 'di nyid brag gi don yin pa'ang shugs kyis shes thub/ brag ces pa ni gal che ba'i mo rnams mo thengs bcu gsum gdab dgos pa de dag gi rtsa ba'i mdud pa phan tshun gyi 'brel ba la dpyad pa'i lugs de la zer ba dang / sad ces pa ni/ rtsa ba'i mdud pa phan tshun gyi 'brel ba tsam du ma zad brgyag gis besgyur ba'i 'brel ba phan tshun la'ang dpyad pa ste/ de 'dra'i rigs rnams la zhib cha byas na dpyad gzhi khri dang 'bum gyi grangs su 'gyur ba'i don yin no/ /(5)ye mkhyen sgra bla'i mngon shes su grags pa'i mo 'di'i skor la me long la brten pa'i pra mo dang /lug gi sog rus la sog mo dang / gzhan yang cho lo la brten pa'i mo dang / sho la brten pa'i mo dang /greng ba la brten pa'i mo sogs mo'i rigs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa de rigs la zer ba yin/ tun hong gi dpe rnying ma'i khrod du'ang / lug gi sog rus la brten pa'i sog mo sogs mo'i rigs mi 'dra ba 'ga' shas kyi dpe mi nyung ba zhig kyang yod 'dug de dag gi nang nos ches rnying ba khyad chos dang ldan pa'i mo zhig ni lde'u 'phul du grags pa'i mo 'di yin/ sngon dus phywa legs rgyalalku 'phrul can gyis zhus pa'i ngor bstan pa'i rno mthong mo'i bye brag lde'u 'phrul zhes bya ba zhig byung yod pa des dus phyis su del drug ces zer srol yod/ phyis kyi ming de la bltas na/ pharacher lkortsel drug labarten nas rgyag dgos pa'i mo — 63 —

(6)ye rje smon pa'i rmi lam zhes pa de ni rmi lam la brten nas lkog gyur gyi tshul shes pa'i thabs shig ste/ de ni blo ba nya gang ba'i dus lta bu'am gza' skar gyi 'du 'asbod bzang ba'i dus chen khyad par can la brten nas mi lam sgug pa dang / khyad par can gyi gnas la brten nas mi lam sgrug pa dang / phu līr sogs phywa'i lha bsnyen cing de dag gi thugs rje la brten nas rmi lam sgrug pa sogs kyis mtshon/ mi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang / rmi lam rang thog tu ngo shes thub pa dang / rmi lam la dbang bsgyur ba sogs kyi thabs tshul mi 'dra ba ci rigs shig byung myong yod 'dug pa de rigs la zer ba yin/ a 'us tra li'i yul gyi gnyug gnas mi rigs lo grangs stong phrag bzhi bcu'i lo rgyus yod pa de dag la yongs su grags pa zhig ni rmi lam gyi dus zhes bya ba de red/ khong tshos mi lam la khong tsho'i shes rig gi gzhi rten 'dra zhig tu ngos bzung srol byung 'dug pa de la dpyad na gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi shes rig tu ye rje smon pa'i rmi lam zhes gnad gal shin tu chen po zhig tu brtsis yod pa des/ zhang zhung gi shes rig de ches rnying ma'i rang gshis dang ldan pa'i shes rig khyad par can zhig yin nges pa'ang shugs kyis bstan gyi yod/(7)ye dbang lha'i bka' babs zhes bya ba de ni/ phu wer sogs phywa'i lha zhig gam/ yang na shin tu bka' gnyan pa'i lha zhang zhung mgon po rnam gsum du grags pa ste/ a ti mu wer/ ku byi mang ke/ge khod rnams kyis gtsoso pa'i lha gang yang rung ba zhig mir babs nas legs nyes lung bstan pa zhig ste/de'i srol ma nyams pa dngos su bzhugs pa ni deng dus bod du yongs grags tshi gnas chung chos skyong’ gis mchon pa'i chos skyong mang zhig mir babs nas blang dor gyi gnad gsal bar bstan pa de rigs la ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin/(ram̐)snang mthong rtsis zhes pa ni phywa gshen legs rgyal thang po dang / gshen rab mi bo che nyid kyisras kong tsa 'phrul bu sogs kyis zhus pa'i ngor/ gshen rab mi bo ches gtsug lag rtsis kyi bon sgo rnams bstan cing / rtsis kyi bon sgo gtso bo ni/ gab rtse 'phrul gyi me long / spar kha sme ba'i gling skor/ 'byung ba dus kyi 'khor lo/ ju zhag rten 'brel las rtsis 'di bzhi yin pa'i tshul gshen rab gyi mdzad mdo rnams su gsal ba'i lo zla zhag dus tshod kyi 'byung khams dang / smre ba dang / spar kha dang / de dag la dbang byed pa'i lha klu dang / gnyan nam sa bdag sogs thun mong gi snang ngor mngon sum du ma gyur pas gab pa dang / dus gnad 'di dag ni mtshon cha'i rtse ltar shin tu rno zhing / bzang ngan gyi 'bras bu 'phral du 'byin pa'i gnad kyi rtse mo yin pas rtse zhes bya zhing de 'dra'i gab rtse'i gnad gsang gsal por ston pa'i shes rig de ni 'phul gyi me long dang 'dra bas na ming de skad du btags yod par mngon/ (9)spar kha dang smre ba'i gling skor ni re'u mig dgu'i khongasasu sme ba dgu bkod pa dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad du spar kha baspyad bkod de lo zla zhag dus dang / brtsi bya'i khams rnams phan tshun go bsdur kyis legs nyes blang dor gyi skor gsal por bstan thub pa'i shes rig de lazer ba yin/ 'byung ba dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa ni/ 'byung ba'i khams dang 'brel ba'i lo skorī bcu gadkus/ nam zi baṭwāṃ/5 ba/za'

skar gyi gnas stangs sogs/ lo nas lo dang / zla ba nas zla ba/ zhag nas zhag tu 'khor zhing yang yang du 'khor ba de dag la 'byung khams dang 'brel ba'i 'phrod sbyor gyi rigs mi 'dra ba ci rigs shig 'byung ba de dag gis/ snod bcud la legs nyes kyi nus pa ci rigs shig kyang 'byin thub kyi yod pa'i skor gsal por ston pa'i shes rig de la zer ba yin/(1༷)ju zhag rten 'brel las rtsis zhes pa de ni/ nam rgyun yongs grags su tshe rabs las rtsis zhes su grags pa ste/ su zhig skye dus kyi lo zla ba zhag dus kyi 'byung khams so so'i gnas lugs de la brten nas tshe 'dir legs nyes kyi rkyen ci dang ci zhig yod pa dang / gal te mi mthun pa'i rkyen 'ga' zhig yod pa mngon du gyur na/ de las grol thabs ci dang ci zhig dgos pa sogs rtogs byed kyi shes rig khyad par can zhig yin la/ bag gnyen gyi rtsis dang / gshen po dur 'don gyi rtsis sogs kyang de'i khongs su gtogs pa yin/ gang la zer na/ skye gnas 'chi gsum ni mi tshe'i gnad che ba gsum yin la gnas pa'i ched du gnyen sgrig byed pa de ni gnas pa'i skabs kyi bya ba tshang ma'i nang nas khyad par can zhig yin/(11)spyir btang ris 'di rigs su skyes bu su'ang rung ba de skye dus kyi lo zla zhag dus kyi khams gang yin pa de la dbang thang gi khams zhes bya zhing / khams de ni ju zhag rten 'brel las rtsis kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba zhig tu ngos 'dzin srol yod cing / rtsa gzhi de la brten nas 'byung ba'i khams gzhan dag dang mthun min brtag dgos pa de yin/ gang la zer na/ su zhig thog mar skye ba'i nyin/ ma'i mngal nas thon pa'i dus skabs de ni skyes bu de'i mig dang rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus kyi dbang po rnams yul mdzes mi mdzes ci rigs pa'i gzugs dang / de bzhin du sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya rnams dang thad kar 'du 'phrod 'byung ba'i skabs dus dmigs bsal zhig yin stabs/ dus skabs der skyes bu de'i 'byung khams kyi nus pa dang / phyi yul gyi nus pa'i bar gyi 'brel ba gsar ba zhig gi dbu thog mar tshugs thing / thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag nyid can gyi nus khams rshag tu spub pa des skyes bu de'i mi tshe'i ring la phan gnod kyi cha rkyen gang dag yod pa rob tsam mtshon thub kyi yod par brten/ rtsis kyi rmang gzhi de skyes bu pho mo su'ang rung ba de'i dbang thang gi khams la brten nas brtsi ba'i lugs de byung ba red/(12)nad gso sman dpyad ces pa de ni/ gshen rab mi bo che'i yum hos bza' rgyal med la sras dpyad bu khri shes zhes pa zhig 'khrungs pa khong dang / gzhan yang gshen rab kyi slob ma gto 'bum dang gsal ba'i seng ge sogs drang srong chen po brgyad kyis gshen rab la zhus pa'i ngor/ gshen rab mi bo ches dpyad 'bum khra bo dang / sman 'bum dkar nag de dag rta bstanabya'i snying dad pyad thabs mi 'dra ba nyis khri chig stong yod par grags pa de rnams yin la/ de dag lag tu len tshul ni/ rgyu rkyen mthong la dpyad pa dang / ngos 'dzin rtsa la dpyad pa dang / phan gnod chu la dpyad pa dang / 'chi sos khams la dpyad pa bzhi'i sgo nas thog mar nad de gdon can dang gdon med gang yin shan 'byed/ gdon can zhigarjo na /6/ /mo rtsis gang rung la brten nas gdon rkyen ngos bzung / nad pa dang gdon byed bar kyi

'brel thag mthil 'don/ sgo gsum dang 'brel ba'i snod bcud kyi cha rkyen ci rigs la brten pa'i bcos byed pa 'di gsum la gzhir bzung ba dang / gdon med gyi nad la zas dang spyod lam dang / sman dang me btsa' sogs kyi dpyad rigs gang 'os pa 'di bzhi rtsa ba bzung nas bcos srol yod pa de yin/(12)dpyad 'bum khra bo dang / sman 'bum dkar nag ces bya ba'i dpe de rigs kyi kha byang yod pa zhig da lta'i dus 'dir rang re'i dbang po'i mngon sum du 'gyur dka' ba zhig ste/ lo grangs sum stong brgyad brgya lhag pa'i ring la dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyur ji snyed cig byung myong yod pa de dag gi nang du dpe rnying ma de dag la'ang 'pho 'gyur ci rigs shig byung yod pa ni smos ma dgos la/ dpe gzhung de dag gi mtshan byang dngos su yod pa'i deng dus mthong du med pa tsam gyis dpe gzhung de dag gi don stor ba'am/rtsa med du chags pa'ang mi bsam ste/ deng dus bod yul la yongs su grags pa'i sman gzhung rgyud bzhi sogs kyi 'byung khungs lte ba ni dpyad 'bum khra bo dang sman 'bum dkar nag rnams yin nges pa ni/ rgyud bzhi'i nang gsal ba'i sman ming du ske dres dang da drig ces pa'i zhang zhung gi skad shin tu mang ba zhig yod 'dug pa dang / gzhan yang 'tsho ba'i skor bstan pa'i skabs su'ang rgya gar na mi srid cing zhang bod zhang rgyal kho na la yod pa'i dngos chas ci rigs pa zhig gi ming yang bstan yod pa de rnams kyis shes rtogs thub pa yin/ der ma zad tun hong nas thon pa'i dpe rnying gi gras su gna' bo'i sman gzhung zhig dang me btsa'i dpyad skor gyi dpe rnying gcig bcas dpe tshan mi 'dra ba gnyis yod 'dug de'ang 〈 tun hong nas thon pa'i gna' bo'i bod yig shog dril/〉 (pe cin sha 315 a 188 3las/ dpyad yig 'arda ni phywag sbal na yang myed de/ dpyad yig thams cad las kyang bdus pa'-i steng du/ zhang zhung ge dpyad phugs pa dang / sbyar te brgyas pa lags so/ / zhes pa der zhang zhung gi dpyad phugs pa zhes bya ba zhig yod pa gsal bar bstan pa des kyang shes thub pa yin/(14)'chi bslu'i gto zhes pa 'di ni bon shes pa can bcu gnyis kyi khongs 'grel shes gtad byad ces bya ba'i gyer sgo ste/ mtshan gzhan du dpon gsas phywa gnyan gto yi sgo zhes su'ang grags pa yin/de'ang rang res dbang po'i mngon sum du mthong tshor mi thub pa'i skye 'gro mi las tha dad pa'i rigs/dbyings kyi lha dang gnyan dang / sa bdag dang / klu la sogs pa de dag la gtod ces su grags shing /gtod rnams kyis rang re gang du gnas pa'i rgya khyon de la dbang byed kyi yod par brten/ skabs 'gar rang re'i bya ba dang spyod lam nyes pa'am rang cag gnas tshul de la rmongs pa'i dbang gis gtod kyi rigs rnams la phog thug shor pa dang / gtod kyi rigs rnams khros shing 'khrugs nas/ phog thug byed mkhan de dag la byad kha dang bod gtong sogs bkra mi shis pa'i mthu kha ci rigs pa'ang bstan srid pa yin la/galate mi tshogs sam/ mi tshang ngam/ mi su'ang rung ba zhig la gtod kyi mthu kha zhig bstan yod pa yin na nam zhig tu mi tshogs sam/ mi tshang ngam mthu khas thebs pa'i mi de'i rlung rta'am/ dbang thang ngam lus sbog bcas pa'i 'byung khams kyi nus pa zhan pa'am/ 'khrugs pa'am/ gud pa'i skabs gang rung — 67 ge

zhig na mthu de thog tu smin nas lus ngag yid gsum la rkyen chag ci rigs pa zhig thad kar 'byung ba'am yang na de dang 'brel yod kyi rkyen ngan ci rigs shig 'byung srid pa yin stabs/ de rigs kyi 'khrugs pa bcos pa dang / gud pa rnams gso ba dang / mthu kha bstan pa dang / byad kha'i rigs rnams las 'grol kā'i3 /to thasnakta shā pa ṭwāṃg/ bstan yod pa de dag la zer ba yin/gto thabs la rigs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod mod/ gtsor che ba ni/ srid pa rgyud kyi bon rnams nas/ lha klu gnyan gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams mchod pa dang / mkha'i dbal mo bskang ba dang / klong gi dam can brten pa dang / sa bdag klu gnyan rnams gto yis bcos pa'i tshul gshen rab mi bo che'i mdzad mdo rgyas pa dri med gzi bajid du gsal rgyas bshad yod pa de rnams yin/gzhan yang gshen rab mi bo ches snang gshen gtsug phud sogs kyis zhus pa'i ngor gsungs pa/ snang gshen gyi gyer sgo skad gcong dang / mdos skad/ glud/ shing rtsi'i brngan chog lha gsol ba/ 'dre bkar ba'i thabs rnams dang / yang 'phrul gshen gyi gyer sgo jo'i skor/ dbal gyi skor/ mthu'i skor/ngan sngags kyi skor/ mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyis gtsos pa'i las sbyor ci rigs pa'i bon rnams bstan yod pa'i tshul gshen rab kyi mdzad mdo rnams las gsal bar bshad pa de red/gshen rab mi bo ches bstan pa'i bon gyi rigs de rnams las ches zab pa'am/ bon rnams kyi yang snying du grags pa ni yang dmag pa'i ses bon zhes pa'am/ zhang zhung gi rdzogs chen zhes bya ba de kho na yin pa ste/ 〈 skal bzang mgrin rgyan〉/ las/ btsun pa khyab pa gto bu 'bum sangs sogs/ / dbang rab rnams la tshe gcig sangs rgyas thabs/ / thig le nyag gcig don dam dbyings bstan nas/ / skye ba gcig gis bla med bsgrub pa'i bon/ / rdzogs pa chen po lta ba yas dbub rgyud/ / nyi ma shar bzhin nges don gcig char du/ / bstan pa shes rab rig pa'i blo rtsal rdzogs/ /zhes dang yang (sha135 pha43las/ rdzogs chen spyi ste nyi shu rtsa lnga'i grangs/ / dgung lo nga gnyis nas bzung nga bdun bar/ / blo rab dag pa'i 'khor la rim par gsungs/ /zhes pas gsal ba de dag yin/ zhang zhung gi shes rig 'ga' zhig ni gshen rab mi bo che de zhang zhung du sku ma bltams pa'i gong nas yod srid pa'ang bshad ma dgos/ / dper na ṭwāṃ gshen rab kyi mdzad mdo gzer myig〉 las/ srid bon mu cho dang / skos bon gtsug sras dang / phywa bon the'u legs dang / lha bon thod dkar dang / de nas zla bon tshes pa dang /nyi bon drang ma dang / skar bon tshig gu dang / thin bon ba thul dang / gzha' bon khug tang dang /gshen rab thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ / zhes sogs gshen rab mi bo che sku bltams pa'i dus su bon de rigs yod par gsal ba de ltar na/ gshen rab kyi sngon du rtsis la sogs pa'i shes rig 'ga' zhig yod pa'abye shusdubye kyis shes thub pa yin/

drug pa/ ya thog bodashā shes rig skor/ya thog bod kyi yi ge dang shes rig byung tshul ni/ rang res nges par du dpyad gzhig dgos pa zhig ni/ srong btsan gyi gong der bod du yi ge 'bri ba'i srol dngos bden byung ma myong ba zhig yin nam/gal te de sngon bod du yi ge 'bri ba'i srol byung myong yod na/ yi ge de la bod yig zer gyi yod dam med/sngon gyi lo rgyus mkhan po rnams kyis de sngon bod la yi ge med ces gsungs pa de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa de rigs mngon du thon pa zhig dgos pa 'di ni bod mi'i rig gzhung gi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi med du mi rung ba zhig ste/ dpe'i dbang du byas na mkhar gyi rmang gzhi med pa la mkhar mtho zhan dang / de la ltos pa'i khyad chos 'ga' yang mi srid pa ltar gyi dbang du byas na/ bod la gna' dus su yi ge med pa la/ bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig rgya che la gting zab pa 'di dag gi khungs bod rang la med pa mngon sum du 'thub kyi yod pa de red/ nga tshos drang bden gyi sgo nas dpyad gzhigs byas pa yin na/ chos rgyal srong batren sgam po'i gong der bod la yi ge 'bri srol yod nges pa ni lung dang rigs pa gnyis kyi thog nas bden don thub pa yod/ de'ang drang bden gyi lung shin tu gal che ba zhig ni/ slob dpon bee ro tsa na'i ṭwāṃ rnam thar 'dra 'bag chen mo〉bee ro'i rgyud 'bum las/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku drin las rgya gar mkhas pa li byin spyan drangs/ thon mi mi chung saṃ sgo ṭas yi ge bsgyur/ tsan dan ma ni 'dus pa rin po che'i togadage ba bcu'i mdo la sogs kha shas tsam bsgyur zhes kha gsal gsungs yod pa de ni/ gna' bo'i yi ge 'bri srol yod pa de/ rgya gar gyi skad nas bod skad du bsgyur bde ba dang / sngon gyi yig rnying de 'bri stabs bde bo zhig med pa la 'bri stabs bde ru bsgyur ba dang legs sbyar dang go bsdur byed bde ba sogs kyi dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig la brten nas/ bod yig dbu chen gyi tshugs su bsgyur cing / de dang 'brel ba rnam dbye'i phrad la sogs pa'ang stabs bde bar bcos nas zhib rgyas su gtan la phab pa'i gzhung byā ka ra ṇa sde ba brgyad du grags pa'i bstan bcos rnams gsar du brtsams mdzad pa'i don zhig yin pa las/ de sngon bod du yi ge 'bri srol gtan nas med pa la gsar du bzo gnang ba'am/ de ltar bzos pa'i sgrub byed ci zhig kyang min pa ni mngon sum du mthong thub/ ṭwāṃ legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉 las/ slob dpon pad ma'i 'al nas/ rgya gar chos rnams bod la bsgyur ba'i tshe/ /rgya gar yi ge bod du bsgyur ma btub/ /ka kha sum cu bod la dpe ru blangs/ /lha yi mtshan rnams 'byung ba'i sgra las drangs/ / sngags rnams ma bsgyur rgya gar rang sor bzhag / zhes gsungs pa la yid rton par bya'o/ /zhes lung 'dren drangs gnang 'dug pa de rigs kyis nges shes rnyed thub pa yin/ gzhan yang bod khams kyi grong gseb khag mang nas rnyed du yod pa'i dmangs chogs kyi rim gro'i cho ga srid pa spyi mdos〉zhes su grags pa/ mdo khams sde dge nas thon pa'i dpe gcig dang bal yul khongs gtogs dol po nas thon pa'i dpe gcig bcas/ kho bo rang gi lag tu dpe mi 'dra ba gnyis byung ba dang / de 'brel i ta li'i mkhas dbang jo seb tu ka ci lags bod nub phyogs gu ger phebs dus khong gi phyag tu son pa'i dpe cha tshang — 69 —

ma gcig bcas/ kho bos ma dpe mi 'dra ba gsum mngon mthong byung ba de dag gi mjug byang du gsal por 'khod yod pa ni/ gshen chen po gce 'od nas rim par brgyud pa srid pa'i mdos skong chen mo/sangs po khri na khod bdag gis yi ger btab pa zhang bod dpon gsas bar ma chad pas mthu thon pa/zab mo chig chog ni rdzogs so/ /zhes gshen chen po gce 'od dang / ra sangs khri na khod bcas kyi mdzad byang gsal por 'khod yod pa red/ gshen chen po gcen 'od ni khyung po blo gros rgyal mtshan (dus rabs 14 bar)gyis mdzad pa'i gleng gzhi bstan pa'i 'byung khungs〉 las/ bod kyi rgyal rabs kyi thog mar gnam gyi khri bdun byung ba'i gnyis pa'am bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i sras mu khri btsan po'i sku gshen gce'u 'od dkar yin par bshad yod la/ legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉 las/deng khri dang se za sman gyi sras so khri matsan po/ sku gshen gce'u 'od dkar/ gsas mkhar rmur dgu khyung bzhengs/ zhes bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po gnam gyi khri bdun rim bzhin du byon pa las/ bzhi ba so khri btsan po'i sku gshen yin pa gsal ba dang / ra sangs khri na khod ni/ 〈gleng gzhi bstan pa'i 'byung khungs〉las/ bod kyi rgyal rabs gnam gyi khri bdun/ bar gyi lding gnyis/ sa la legs drug chu la lde brgyad/ bar gyi btsan lnga/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bon rgyal bzhi rnams su bshad pa las/ bon rgyal gsum pa stag gung gnyan gzigs kyi sku gshen ra sangs khri na khod yin par bshad 'dug cing / de'i sras dmus long zhig byung ba la gshen pos spyan bsgrubs pas spub ste/ pha ri la ri dwags gnyan 'dug pa gzigs pas stag gong gnyan gzigs su btags/ sku gshen ra sangs khri na khod/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la rgyal phran bcu gnyis mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ der lho brag gi rgyal po bang ba rje mnga' ris su ma 'dus pa la dmag dang bcas te gshegs pas/ bang ba rjes rgyal po'i stag gong gnyan gzigs btson du bzung nas khri mun dong du bskyur/ bod 'bangs rnams pham/ de dus rje'i bla bon du ra sangs bon po khri de khod bya ba mthu che rtsal drag pa zhig yod pa bya rgod du sprul nas byon te btson srung dang bang rje'i 'khor thams cad myos par mdzad/ rgyal bu babyigs pa'i lcags thag gshog pas mtshams ring gis bcad nas stag gong gnyan gzigs btson dong nas bton pas/ bang ba rje yang gus pa phul nas zhabs 'og tu 'dus so/ /bon la gtsigs su gshen po ra sangs khri nee khod rgyal thabs su phyung ste rgyal gong na bon gnyan par mdzad/ ces pas gsal bar bstan/ de ltar na stag gong gnyan gzigs kyi sras gnam ri srong btsan yin pa dang de'i sras chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yin stabs/ rgyal po stag gong gnyan gzigs kyi dus su gshen po ra sangs khri nee khod kyis yi ger btab ces gsal ba 'di ni srong btsan gyi gong du bod la yi ge 'bri srol byung yod nges pa'i shes byed khyad par can zhig red/ sa skya ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i ṭwāṃ rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉 las/ rgyal blon (spu de gung rgyal dang blon ru la skyes)'di gnyis kyi dus su/ g.yung drung gi bon byung ste/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo che bya ba stag gzig 'ol mo'i lung ring du sku 'khru~X/—khams chen po brgyad la sogs pa bon po'i chos thams cad zhang zhung gi yul nas bsgyur te

dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bon la rigs dgu ru phye ste/ rgyu'i bon po la rigs bzhi/ 'bras bu'i bon po la rigs lnga'o/ / 'bras bu'i bon rigs lnga ni g.yung drung theg pa bla na med pa la zhugs pa ste/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lus thob par 'dod do/ / rgyu'i bon rigs bzhi ni/ snang gshen bal thod can/'phrul gshen bal chon can/ phywa gshen ju thig can/ dur gshen mtshon cha can no/ / zhes sogs gsal rgyas su gsungs mdzad 'dug pa de la'ang dpyad gzhi nan tan du byed dgos pa 'dug spru de gung rgyal ni bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal rabs gnam gyi khri bdun dang bar gyi lding gnyis te rgyal po gri gum btsan po dang / sgru de gung spyal gnyis las phyi ma de yin zhing / dus skabs der khams chen po brgyad la sogs pa sdursha ṣa'i chos thamakā cadazhe zhang zhung sdi yul nas bsgyur te zhes pa'i cug sgrub 'di kho nas kyang de dus bod du rna spod pa gsal ༵ shā spra~Xsna— shā// ya thog bod kyi yi ge byung tshul/dang po/ khams chen po brgyadakli skor/khams chen po brgyad ces bya ba de dag ni bon gzhung rnams su/ srid pa'i khams dang / rgyun gyi khams/ snang ba'i khams/ stong ba'i khams/ gsal ba'i khams/ rig pa'i khams/ g.yung drung gi khams/ mnyam nyid kyi khams zhes gsal rgyas su bshad yod pa de dag red la/ bon la rigs dgu ru gyes pa'i nang tshan 'bras bu bon po la rigs lnga zhes bya ba de dag ni/ dge bsnyen theg pa/ drang srongatheg pa/ a dkar theg pa/ ye gshen theg pa/ yang rtse theg pa zhes su grags pa de rnams la zer ba yin/ de nas khams brgyad dang / rgyu 'bras kyi bon rigs dgu zhes pa de dag rgya che la tshig tshogs mang ba zhig yin pa las/ gna' sgrung ltar blo la zin chog thub tsam re la zer ba min/ ya thog zhang zhung gi shes rig dar tshul bshad pa'i skabs su gsal bar bstan pa bzhin/ phywa gshen lta bu'i bonasgo gcig kho na la mtshon na'ang / pra ltas mo'i skor/ snang mthong rtsis kyi skor/ nad gso sman dpyad kyi skor/ 'chi bslu gto'i skor sogs shin tu rgya che la grangs mang ba zhig yod pa dang / bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po byon pa'i dus su bod la yongs khyab tu dar nas yod pa shes pa can bcu gnyis kyi bon zhes su grags pa ste/mgon shes lha bon/ 'gro shes glud gtong / gtsang shes sela'adebs/ phan shes sman dbyad/ smrang shes gto dgu/ 'phur shes ju thig g.yang shes phywa bon/ 'dur shes srid gshen/ 'gros shes gtad byad/ skos shes rtsis mkhan/ lding shes sha ba/ sgrol shes 'phrul bon rnams kyis mtshon pa'i bon gyi bye brag mi 'dra ba du ma 'ig byung myong yod pa'i tshul ban bon gnyis ka'i dpe rnams las gsal bar bshad yod cing / de dag byung yod myong na de dag dang 'brel ba'i yig cha du ma zhig kyang nges par du yod dgos pa ni rigs pas kyang grub ste/ deng dus rang re bod yig gi go rtogs dang shes yon dī/ pa spru/mas

nas kyang / srong btsan gong rol du bod kyi btsan po rnams ji ltar byung myong ba dang ju thig las bshad pa'imadud grangs/ de dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus can gyi mo bshad ci rigs dang / gzhan dag sman dang rtsis la sogs pa'i shes bya de rigs blo 'dzin byed dgos pa yin na/ shin tu dka' tshegs chen pos sna re sna gnyis zhig blo la zin thub tsam re 'byung ba las/ de kun blo 'dzin byed thub pa ni mi srid pa 'dra zhig chags yod pa ni mngon sum tshad ma'i thub pa red/ rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉 las/ der rgyal bu de nar lon dus bzo dang rtsis dang / sgyu rtsal dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing yon tan dang ldan par gyur pas/ blon po rnams na re/ 'o cag tshe'i rje 'di ni yon tan du ma dang ldan te/ thugs shin tu sgam mo zer bas/ mtshan yang srong btsan sgam po zhes grags so/ / de nas rgyal po dgung lo bcu gsum lon dus yab 'das te rgyal sar byon pa yin no/ / zhes chos rgyal de spyal sar ma phebs gong nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur tshul gsal ba de ltar na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes bya ba de yang /rig gnas che ba lnga ste/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gtan tshig rig pa/ nang don rig pa rnams yin pa dang / rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga ste/ snyan ngag dang / mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor dang / zlos gar/ skar rtsis rnams yin pa ste/ mdor na rig gnas che chung gang zhig yin kyang rung / bod du de sngon yi ge gtan nas med pa la/ rgyal bu de rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par 'gyur ba'i thabs ga la yod/gnyis pa/ sngon yodashā yi ge'i skor/bod kyi yi ge sngon nas yod la/ deb ther dmar por kha gsal du bstan pa ni/ srong btsan sgam po dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i dus rgyal sar phebs te/ de rjes su thon mi rgya gar du btang bas bram ze li byin dang paṇa ṭi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge las yi ge dang sgra sogs bslab tshul gsal bar bstan pa dang / srong btsan dgung lo bcu drug par bal yul nas bal bza' khab tu bzhes pa dang / srong btsan dgung 'o/ bco brgyad par rgya nag nas rgya bza' kong jo khab tu bzhes shing / de skabs su bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rgya nag gi rgyal po thing ge btsan po la 'azin shog dril gsum btang tshul gsal ba dang / de dang 'dra ba rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long du'ang / bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha dang rgya nag gi rgyal po gnyis kar 'phrin btang ba'i lo rgyus yang 'dug pa de dag gis kyang de sngon nas bod du yi ge yod pa dang / de 'brel gyi shes bya rig pa'i gnas rnams yod par thub pa yin/ gang la zer na srong batren gyi sngon du yi ge med thabs rtsa ba nas med pa'i bden don ra 'phrod pa'i rigs pa dang mngon sum tshad ma gnyis kyi thog nas 'byung nges pa yin/bod 'dir chos rgyal srong btsan gyi sngon du yi ge 'bri srol yod nges na'ang / bod kyi lo rgyus de nga tsho'i 'khyog bshad gnang yod pa de'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bo ni/ bar skabs su bod mi rnams rgya gar nas byungarjo 'i ḍi~X chos la dwangs zhen che drags pas/ bod kyi shes rig mtha' dag gi khungs kyang rgya gar la

gtugs shing / gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi lo rgyus dang shes rig gi khungs ni ma chod/ zhang zhung nas byung ba'i shes rig che za'i rgyun 'tsho skyong byed mkhan gtso bo bod kyi bon po rnams yin na'ang bod du dam chos dar rgyas su phyin pa'i dus skabs de nas bzung / bon rnal ma'i bstan pa ni sdum zad pa'i mar me ltar je nyams dang je zhan du gyur cing / dam pa'i chos la che ba 'don pa yin khul gyis/ bod mi phal che ba'i khrod du bon dang bon po rnams la ngan smras byed pa'i srol rgyun ngan pa zhig kyang dar yod pa de dag bod mi phal che ba'i gathis khar 'jags yod pa'i rkyen gyis bon po rnams ni kun gyis mthong mi 'dod pa'am btsog lta dgos pa 'dra zhig tu chags pa dang / dus phyis kyi bon po rnams la'ang chos kyi shugs rkyen thebs nas/bon gyi 'byung khungs yang phyi yul la ngos 'dzin pa dang / chos la gang dar ba de kun bon la'ang yod dgos pa dang / chos pa'i kun spyod du gang yod pa de kun bon po rnams la'ang yod dgos par lta ba'ilugs shig byung ba'i rkyen gyis/ bon rnal ma'i rang garshas rin thang shin tu che ba de dag kyang bag la 'a ba'i dus skabs 'di 'dra ba zhig byung nas yun ring tsam 'das pa yin stabs dus gyis bod kyi shes rig rnal ma'i lo rgyus kyi khungs 'tshol gzhig byed pa la'ang ngal che zhing / su zhig gis srong btsan gyi gong derabod la yi ge 'bri srol med pa dang / rgyal blon bka' drin can de rnams kyi sku drin la brten nas bod du yi ge 'bri ba'i srol byung / bod mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me sbar ba yin no/ / zhes bshad na su'i rna ba la'ang mi 'phrod pa med pa dang / srong btsan gyi gong der bod la yi ge 'bri srol yod pa dang /bon gyi shes rig sna tshogs pa zhig dar rgyas byung myong yod pa 'di skor zhig bshad pa yin na de la dogs pa skye dgos pa 'dra zhig dang / skad cha de la khungs e yod snyam pa 'dra zhig 'byung gi yod la/ de 'dra shod mkhan de la mkhas pa kha shas kyis dran 'phrul rgod po red ces 'phya smod gtong srol yang byung yod/deng dus rang re'i bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig rnying ma'i khungs ci dang ci zhig yod pa dang / de dag girin thang rgyal khyi'i shes yon can rnams kyi slob sbyong gi cha rkyen du spel thub nges kyi lo rgyus yang dag pa la gzhi bzung dgos pa yin stabs/ bod kyi lo rgyus dang shes rig rnying ma'i gzhi rtsa yi ge'i khungs gna' nas yo da nges pa'i tshul 'di gsal bar thos dgos pa de red/gsum pa/ thon mi saṃ bho ṭa'i bka' drin/thon mi saṃ sgo ṭas sangs rgyasapa'i mdo sngags bka' bstan spya che la gting zab pa rnams legs sbyar gyi skad nas bod skad du bsgyur bkod sla ba'i ched/ rgya gar gyi yig gzugs las dper blangs nas dbu chen gyi tshugs su bcos mdzad yod pa ni/ bod yig dbu chen gyi tshugs 'di rgya gar gyi yig rnying rnams dang bzo dbyibs 'dra che ba de tsam gyis kyang shes nus la/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis thon mi saṃ sgo ṭas rgya gar gu lha'i yi ge las dper blangs nas bod yig mdzad yo da pa'i dper/ thon mi dang dus mnyam du byung ba rgya gar gyi rgyal po ku ma ra gu snya (gzhon nu sbas pa)ru grags pa de'i zangs kyi glegs bu'i yi ge ‘ namomahadebaya na mo ma hā de bā ya zhes sogs kyis gsal bar bstan pa de red/— 73 —
