thon mis legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye'i lugs la gzhir bzung ste bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung dngos yod sum rtags gnyis dang dngos med byā ka ra ṇa'i gzhung drug rnams mdzad cing / gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi lugs las byung ba'i brda sprod kyi lugs der phrad sogs tshig chogs mang la spyod mi bde ba du ma 'ig yod pa de kun nyung la beed spyod bde ba'i brda sprod kyi srol rgyun gsar pa zhig gnang mdzad yod nges te/ dper na gna' bo'i 'ang zhung gi lugs su 'brel sgra'i phrad du gi gyi 'i yi ci ti ni pi bi tsi ye ri si bcas bcu gsum tsam yod pa de kun gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga ru bsdus pa dang la don gyi phrad du dzi na la lu le bu cu da du tu tur 'u sur’ bcas bcu gnyis tsam zhig yod pa kunatshi su ra ru du tu na la’’ bdun du bsdus nas bstan pa sogs ṭwāṃsna ṭwāṃ//na/ phyis kyi bod mi rnams la bka' drin bla na med pa zhig gnang yod pa ni bshad ma dgos pa thon mis bod yig gi srol gsar du btod pa'i gong der 'bri srol yod pa'i yi se rnga ra dzi bod yig mizer gyi yo da dam med pa ni dbyad par bya ba'i gzhi zhig red/ bon gyi lo rgyus rnams las yongs grags su bshad yod pa ni zheng zhung gi yig rgan las smar sgrag tu bsgyur/ de smar che chung du bsgyur/ smar chen dbu chen nam gzab tu bsgyur/ smar chung 'bri mar bsgyur zhes bya ba de yin la/ zhang zhung gi yig rgan dang / smar sgrag ces pa de dag ni/ ya thog zhang zhung gi yi ge byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs su gsal bar bstan yod pa de rigs yin la/ bod kyi chos spyal srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod la yi ge 'bri srol yod pa'i tshugs de ni smar chen zhes pa dang / smar chung zhes bya ba'i 'bri stangs 'di dag yin las che/ kho bo rang lo bcu gsum pa'i skabs/ sde dge rmug sangs nas yin pa bod kyi yig mkhan mkhas pa rdi bzod ces bya ba'i bla ma sku bgres shig yod/ ngas khong gi mdun nas nyin 'ga' shas kyi ring la bod yig dbu chen dang dbu med kyi 'bri tshugs la bcos kha zhig zhus pas/ nyin rjes ma der khong gis nga la gsungs gsal/khyed rang lag pa bde bo dang / rig pa shin tu phra bo 'dug gal te khyed rang gis sbyong 'dod yod na ngas snya bab yi ge zhes bya ba'i yig tshugs rnying ba zhig shes kyi yod pa de khyed rang la bslab chog ces gsungs 'dus ngas de bzhin bslab rogs gnang zhus pas/ khong gis thugs brtse ba chen pos nga la nyin hril po gcig gi ring lha bab yi ge'i tshugs cha tshang ba zhig bslabs gnang byung / nam mkha'i nor bu kho rang yig gzugs de la dga' po yod stabs nyin mang po'i ring sbyong rdar byas pas/ de nas lo gnyis 'dasarjes su/ kho rang sga skye rgu mdor gnyen 'phrad du phyin skabs/ skye rgu mdo'i grong dang ha cang mi ring ba'i gnas shig tu/ bod kyi sman pa mkhas pa bla ma tshe rgyal zhes bya ba zhig bzhugs yod 'dug khong ni rgya gar sogs yul gru khag mang du phebs myong ba dang / bod kyi sman rtsis sogs rig pa'i gnas kun la mkhas pa'i snyan grags che tsam yod pa zhig red 'dug nyin zhig nga khong la mjal du phyin pas/ khong gi gzims khang gi gyang ngos der dpar sgrom che la spus legs pa zhig gi nang du/ ngas 'ib nan gyis bltas te bklagaṭwāṃ ༵sa/ tshig skang bzhi po de ni 'di skad du/ 'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ / de kun gzhan

bde 'dod las byung / ṭhajig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /de kun bdag bde 'dod las byung/ /zhes 'phags pa zhi ba lhas spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa'i tshig rkang bzhi de red 'dug ngas lha bab kyi tshugs de bklags pa dang bla ma tshe rgyal khong ha las nas/ khyed kyis ga nas shes pa yin gsungs/ ngas lo rgyus zhib mor zhus pas/ rten 'brel bzang / 'di bod kyi yig rnying gi tshugs rtsa ba chen po zhig red/ 'on kyang tshugs 'di shes mkhan shin tu dkon po red/ khyed kyis ma brjed pa gyis dang / phan thogs pa'i dus yod/ ces lung bstan yang gnang byung / gang ltar yang kho bos rang gi dge rgan bzod pa lags dang bla ma tshe rgyal rnam gnyis las/ yig tshugs 'di mkhyen mkhan su zhig kyang mjal ma myong na'ang /bod yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' khongs su yig tshugs de nyid mkhyen mkhan khong gnyis las med pa ni ga la yim /zhes gsungs so/ / smar zhes bya ba'i go don dang lha bab bam lha las bab pa'i yi ge zhes bya ba'i don gnyis kyang shin tu 'dra ba yin stabs/ smar chen zhes bya ba'i gdags gzhi thun mong ma yin pa de lha bab kyi tshugs 'di rang yin bsam gyi 'dug kho bos lha bab yi ge'i ma dpe 'di khungs dag pa dang nor 'khrul med pa 'ig yin khul gyis 'dir gsal por bkod yod na'ang / lha bab yi ge'i tshugs mkhyen mkhan gang su 'ig yo da pa de kun nas mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs por phye ste/ kho bos ji ltar bkod pa 'dir nor ba'am/'bri stangs 'grig min ci dang ci yod pa la dgongs 'char dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas/ bris tshugs 'di'i khungasri gtsang dag tu thon pa dang / gsal sgros su 'gyur ba'i mthun grogs gang 'os gnang skyong yod pa'ang zhu ma dgos pa red/de bzhin du kho bo rang lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i skabs su 'dza 'gos dgon la 'dug skabs su/ deng sang 'bar khams rdzong rdzong 'bur yi 'gos kyo bla bla ma tshang la snga rabs kyi yig rnying bris ma srid pa bya nag gshog ring dang ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung yig gnyis g.yar nas lta myong / de yang lha bab yi ge zhes pa'i yig gzugs 'di nang ba'in gyi yis 'bru klog 'don dka' ba tshig maphregs po yin pa/ bod kyi rig gnas la mkhas pa bla na dge mchog ces bya zhig yod 'dug ngas khong gi mdun nas yi ge'i klog stangs dang go don rnams mang po 'dri myong tshe/ bla ma dge mchog khong nas/ khyed kyi yi ge 'di gang nas rnyed pa yin gsungs/ ngas lo rgyus zhib par zhus pas/ khong lo mang shas byang chub chos rdzong dgon 'dir 'dug kyang de tshang la yod pa ma shes/ yi ge 'di rigs sbyir bod khams dang khyad par rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yig rnying rtsa ba chen po zhig yin/ 'on kyang tshugs 'di shes mkhan dkon po red/ khyod kyis yag po zhig shāṭī zlo ṭwāṃs pa rnams khong la 'dri na chos 'di nga tshos snga rabs kyis shes rig dang lo rgyus la phan thog che —༄ tre /tshos lha bab yi ge'i tshugs 'di dang / bod yig beebu med kyi tshugs 'di sanyis phan tshun go bsdur te dbya da pa na/ bod yig dbu med kyi tshugs de lha bab kyi yi ge nas byung yorgapa gsal por mthong thub/spyir stangs yi ge'i tshugs gi steng nas gsal por mthong gob pa dang / rdedzwamozad kaungaṭwāṃ5 yirji dang

'dogs rnams kyi sbyor stangs khyad par du dbu med du rtsa zhes dang / stsa dang spya zhes pa rnams kyi mgo can ming gzhi'i sngon du 'bri ba las steng du med pa sogs shin tu 'dra ches pa'i mngon rtags mi nyung ba 'ig yod/rang res do snang nges par du byed 'os pa zhig ni/ bod yig dbu can gyi mgo bkod de 'bri ba po'i g.yon ngos nas g.yas phyogs su 'then dgos pa dang / dbu med kyi mgo bkod de phal cher g.yas phyogs nas sayon ngos su 'thon dgos pa de red/ yi ge'i mgo bkod 'then stangs tsam la gal che mdog byed dgos pa de tsam zhig med na'ang / yi ge'i mgo bkod 'then stangs de ni gna' bo'i gshis lugs su gral gyi mgo g.yas sam g.yon ngos nas 'dzin pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten sogs la g.yas skor dang g.yon skor rgyag pa'i lta stangs mi 'dra ba 'ga' re byung yod pa de dag dang 'brel ba nges can re yod pa yin stabs/dbu can dang dbu med kyi rtsa ba'i 'bri stangs mi 'dra ba'ang de'i thog nas shes thub pa yin/ dbu can gyi khungs de rgya gar gyi yig tshugs gubha'i dpe las blangs pa zhig yin pa dang / dbu med kyi tshugs de snar gyi tshugs las byung ba zhig yin nges pa ni rang re'i mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du mthong thub pa de las lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan 'ga' yang mi dgos/bzhi ba/ spyir bod kyi shes rig byung tshul/bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i gong der/ bod kyi mnga' sde yongs la bon las gzhan pa'i shes rig shod tshul lo rgyus kyi dper 'khod pa ni 'ga' zhig kyang mthong du med/ gnya' khri btsan po'i dus bod rgyal khams kyi dbu brnyes shing / de nas bzung bod kyi btsan po rim pas rgyal khams rgya bskyed pa dang mnga' sde rnams bskyangs pa yin na'ang / rgyal srid skyong byed kyi gzhi rtsa'i shes rig ni bon nam/de dang 'brel ba'i shes rig sna tshogs pa las gzhan pa ni 'ga' yang med pa lo rgyus rnams kyis gsal bar bstan cing / btsan po khri srong lde btsan ma byon gyi bar der bod kyi spyal srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs so zhes rlung ltar du grags kyi yod pa de red/(1)sgrung dang lde'ubon gsum du grags pa las/ thog mar sgrung zhes bya ba de'i tshad gzhi gang yin pa ni/ 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉 las/ mdo sde 'byung ba'i ltas su sgrung rnams dar/ ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang / ma sangs kyi sgrung dang / mchil ba'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad dang zhes sgrung gi dper martsan 'ga' zhig bzhag mdzad pa de rigs kyis mnga' 'bangs blo sgo 'byed pa la phan yon dang ldan pa sgrung gi khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin pa la dgongs nas/ dpe de skad du bzhag mdzad pa zhig yin pa las/ bod kyi gna' bo'i rgyal po tshos blon 'bangs rnams la ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang / ma sangs dang / mchil ba'i sgrung sogs bshad nas rgyal srid bskyangs yod pa'i don zhig ni yin thabs ga la yo da/ de 'dra yin stabs sgrung zhes pa de ni gtso cher gna' rabs kyi byung ba brjod pa'igatam ci rigs rshag yod pa de dag la zer zhing / de'ang bon gyi lugs su ya thog srid pa'i klong gi sgo nga las/— ṭwāṃ /nga kau dang gnyan nam/ ma sangs kyi 'gro ba rnams byung ba ste/ de rjes gnam dang sa dang /

bar snang ste 'jig rten gsum gyi nus 'thu'am stobs shugs de la dbang byed po rnams mtshon zhing / de dag las rim gyis mi'i 'gro ba khyi dang khyad par zhang bod kyi rus tshan rnams ji ltar chags tshul gyi lo rgyus mi nyung ba zhig yod 'dug pa de rigs la ma sangs kyi sgrung zhes kyang grags la de dag 'azel ba 'bangs kyi /ṭāsdu kā kā /na/ blon po'i rabs/ rgyal po'i rabs sogs ji rnyed cig byung myong yod pa de rigs la sgrung (2)lde'u zhes bya ba de'i skor/ 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ / mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ldan lde'u spyod/ srang la them gnyer lnga ba che ci yin/ por mgo mgo can skyed rgyags ci yin/zhes 'dri ba sogs te bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyi tshul lha sa'i gdung rnams la bris nas yod skad ces gsungs stangs 'di la dpyad na deng dus yongs grags su khed zhes pa 'di rigs la ngos 'dzin gnang ba 'dra zhig 'dug la/ de ni mkhas dbang dpa' bo gtsug lag tsam du ma zad gna' bo'i lo rgyus mkhan po phal mo che'i bzhed stangs shig red/ khed kyi rigs 'di mi'i bsam mno'i rtsal kha 'don byed kyi nus pa dang ldan nges rshag yin stabs lde'u grags pa de'i khongs su gtogs pa yin pa ni bshad ma dgos shing / mkhas dbang dpa' bo gtsug lag gis kyang don de la dgongs nas skabs 'dir go stabs bde ba'i phyir dpe zhig bzhag mdzad pa las/ lde'u zhes bya ba de'i go don mthar thugs pa de deng dus su grags pa'i khed kho na la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i sgrub byed ci zhig kyang yin thabs med/ lde'am pha lde'u’ zhes bya ba'i tshig 'di ni gna' dus nas 'ang bod thun mong gi skad du grags che ba'i brda rnying gi ming tshig cig yin la/ ming tshig de'i go don deng dus kyi skad lugs su byas na dpal ldan sa skya pani tas mdzad pa'i ṭwāṃ legs bshad rin po tshe'i gter〉 las/ rig pa nang bar 'chi yang bslab ces gsungs pa'i skabs kyi rig pa zhes bya ba de dang don gcig pa yin/ de'i shes byed khyad par can zhig ni spyi lo 823 la btsugs pa'i lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi mdun gyi rdo ring gi shar ngos su brkos pa'i bka' gtsigs las/ 'phrul gyi lha btsan po 'o lde spu rgyal te bod kyi thog ma'i rgyal po'i mtshan dngos yin pa dang de dang 'dra bar ṭwāṃ tun hong gi dpe rnying/〉 las/lde nyag khri btsan po/ lde phru bo gnam gzhung btsan/ gnam gzhung btsan gyi sras lde gol/ lde gol gyi sras gnam lde rnol nam/ gnam lde rnol nam gyi sras bse rnol po/ se rnol po'i sras lde rgyal po zhes dang /yang de las/ khri snya bzung btsan dang / 'bro za dung pyang bzher du bshos pa'i sras/ 'bro mnyen lde ru las/ slon btsan rlung nam dang / tsher pong za 'bring ma thog dgos su bshos pa'i sras/ srong lde brtsan/ 'dus srong mang po rje dang / mchims za btsan ma thog thog steng du bshos pa'i sras/ khri lde gtsug btsan/ khri lde gtsug btsan dang / sna namaza mang po rje'i ming / gyim 'ing kong jo'i sras khri srong lde btsan/ zhes sogs kyis mtshon/ bod kyi gna' rabs rgyal po rnasmos kyi mtshan du/ lde dang lde'u zhes pa yang yang byung yod pa de dag la gzhigs na/ ming tshig der go don rgya che la gting zab pa zhig yo da nges pa la the tshom ci 'ig kyang med/ nga tsho bod mi dkyus ma mas kyis chudzwa rangarang gi bu dang ༵ mo /mas

la go don yod pa'i ming re 'dogs srol yod pa de ni gna' nas da bar rgyun chad ma myong ba'i gshis lugs shig yin pa de ltar na/ bod kyi btsan po de tsho la go don rgya chen yod pa'i mtshan zhig yod dgos pa ni bshad kyang ma dgos/ lde'u zhes pa ni dper na/ mi chung ngu la mi'u dang / rta chung du la rte'u zhes pa lta bu don du lde yi chung tshig gam dman tshig cig yin pa las dngos don la mi 'dra ba 'ga' yang med/ spyir stangs bod skad du bed spyod yod pa'i ming tshig ni lde'u mig ces pa khang pa'i sgo 'byed byed de la zer ba yin/sgo zhes pa 'di ni khang pa'i sgo tsam du ma zad lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo la'ang go ba'i skabs yod stabs de 'byed ni rig pa las gzhan pa ci yod/ gna' bo'i tha snyad du yongs su grags pa'i lde 'am lde'u zhes bya ba'i go don rnal ma ni zab cing rgya che ba'i rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par du gna' rabs dar khyab che ba gsang gnad bstan pa'i rig pa yang mang po yod/ dper na lde'u 'phrul gyi mo la brten nas lkog gyur gyi gnas tshul gsal por rtogs thub pa'i rig pa de rnams la ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin/( 2)bon ces bya ba de ni gna' rabs nas bod du dar srol yod pa'i bon gyi rigs mi 'dra ba rnams dang khyad par lo grangs sum stong brgyad brgya lhag pa'i gong / gshen rab mi bo che bod yul du phebs pa nas bzung g.yung drung gi bon rgya che la grangs mang ba ji snyed cig byung bas mtshon/ bon snga dar shes pa sna/ ༵ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ dbo/ bye sdo gsuyi shāg/sa pa rnams te ya thog bod kyi bon rabs byung tshul bstan pa'i skabs (4) g.yung drung gi bon gter du bzhugs pa rnams stod smad kyi gter gnas so so nas gdan drangs ba la/ rgyal rong se gnyan zhig pos dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i g.yas zur nas bswe sgrom gsum thon pa'i bon sde la/ sgrom bu gcig las 'dul ba rgyud 'bum la glegs bam drug rtsa 'dul kyi 'bum la sogs 'bum gyi sde dang / rtsi dpyad mdo/ mtha' sel mdo/ g.yung drung spyi phud mdo/ zhi byed mdo sogs mdo yi sde dang rdzogs chen mu med bdal pa'i rgyud/ yang gsang bla med lde mig rgyud/ tanta gsang ba sems kyi rgyud/ thig le kub pa'i me long rgyud/ rin chen spyi spungs rtsa ba'i rgyud/ gting blog gi rgyud/ ma mo'i rgyud/ se shan sgrol byed dpal mo'i rgyud/ myur mgyogs drag po thog 'bebs rgyud/'byung 'khrug phyag cha sum cu'i rgyud/ gsang ba dgu 'dul pra shan rgyud/ bzlas chog rgyud la sogs rgyud sum cu byung / bswe sgrom gnyis la brda tshom skor/ gsas mkhar sum brgya'i byung khungs/ gsang 'dus rtsa 'grel/ gab pa'i skor/ sangs rgyas mdo/ snang gsal mdo/ khams 'grel man ngag bcu drug sbas yig dus kyi rtsis byang / lung dang man ngag kha byang sogs bon sde lnga gsum bco lnga byung /bswe sgrom gsum pa las gyim bu'i snang rabs gto/ srid rabs 'dur/ rdzu 'phrurṣa/ skor gsum/ 'byung sel/ ye ngam rgyud sde/ mu cho'i khrom 'dur/ nang sel skor/ sbyang rgyud bdun skor/ zhi bcos dregs pa dgu'i skor/ gnyem/ chen sde drug sa bdag 'khrug sbyor/ gang co'i gto/ rno mthong / drag sngagarji/ 7ṭwāṃd ḍigu mi mgo skad 'don me dpung rgyud/ gar gsas rgyud/ rdzas sbyor/ 'phrul tshe'i

yastag rgyud sogs bon sde nyi shu rtsa gsum byung ngo / /yang gter ston gu ru ban chung gi zangs 'brug 'khyil pa nas ku bee ra'i sgrub skor/ char 'bebs yang dag ma'i skor dang / rgyal rong 'brug ri khyung mgo nas yongs su dag pa'i skor/ gsas mkhar me ri 'khyil ba dang / khams kyi gnyan tshungs nas mdo dung lo ljon pa/ g.yu lo ljon pa/ gser lo ljon pa/zangs lo ljon pa ste mdo bzhi/ rma chen pom ra nas rab gnas spur chog la sogs rnyed do/ / yang gter ston lhun grub thogs med kyis/ rdo thi gangs dkar dran pa sogs grub pa'i gshen dgus sbas pa'i skye sgo gcod pa'i mdo la sogs zab pa'i bon sde 'ga' zhig dngos grub tu rnyed do/ /rgyal rong dmu rdo'i nub phyogs kyi rdza bo rig pa rang shar la tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis snyan du brgyud pa'i bon sde la rdzogs chen lta ba thog 'bebs kyi klad gzhung mjug la sa bcad bco lnga 'grel ba dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang gsang 'dus khyung sprul sad srung gi skor/ gsang sngags phyi nang gsang gsum/drang mkhan la sogs mang du yod do/ /sbar zhabs brag nas gter thon tshul la/ dang po sbas tshul ni bon dar nub kyi dus su legs tang rmang pos bon sde du ma mdo smad sbar 'bas brag dkar gyi phrag pa g.yas gong brag seng ge'i kha gdangs pa 'dra ba'i gong du gtad rgya kha byang smon lam dang bcas sbas so/ /lnga ba/ gter ston byung tshul/gter ston ni/ srid pa rgyud kyi kha byang las/ zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi rnam 'phrul dbra rigs gyer thogs med bya bas sbar 'bas brag dkar gyi gter sgo phye te/ gter thon tshul la/ rtsa ba dang / yan lag gnyis kyi dang po sbar 'bas brag gi gter thon tshul ni/ dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes tshe tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi lung bstan byung ste/ nyams snang du rnal 'byor ba mang du byung ba'i nang nas a tsa ra'i cha byad can zhig na re/ nged rnams ni zhang zhung yul nas 'ongs/ mdo smad du sbar 'bas brag dkar du bon gyi gsang gter yod pa thon cig zer/ der phyin nas zhugs pas gter srung gi cho 'phrul snatshogs byung skad/de nas ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mos 'al bstan te bras dkar gyi gong / la btsas kyi dkyil du rdo ring la gter gyi kha byang bris nas yod gsungs pa ba'in btsal bas rdo ring gi ngos su 'di nas 'og tu khru gang na gter yod/ 'di drang ba'i mis gter srung la lug nag khyi dkar zhig phul/ gter khung du rin po che sna lnga'i bum pa'i gter tshabs zhog zla ba dgu'i bar du gsang rgya sras rgya u ya u gi zer ba rnyed do/ / de nas brkos pas shog ser rnams byung ste bod yig tu phab pa'i them byang ni/ shes rab rdzogs pa gsang ba'i 'bum/ 'khor ba dong sprug gi mdo/ yid bzhin nor bu gser 'od kyi gzungs/ rdzogs chen mngon rtogs lta ba'i rgyal po srid pa rgyud kyi bsgrags byang chen mo/ rig 'dzin brgyad cu'i mtshan phyag zhi khro bcud dril/ gsang sngags skor tshom/ dpal khyung dmar po'i sgrub skor/ lha rgod sku rdzogs kyi sgrub pa gsang sngags gzer bu bcu ba/ phurapa'i srung zlog stong thun dang bcas pa/ srid pa rgyal mo ༵sa pyi tanta/

dran pa thugs sgrub/ tshe dbang gsang sgrub/ bskal bzang sogs mkha' 'gro rig lnga'i sgrub pa/ thugs rje kun sgrol skor/ spu gri nag po'i bsad pa/ dmod mo bsad pa dgu sgril/ sgra bla ma dang yum sras kyi skor/ dbal bon ram po'i dri khams mnyen po/ mi bdud sum sgril bsad pa'i tanta/ mkha' 'gro'i srog yig bsad pa'i mde'u thung / yum gcod/ ye snying char 'bebs/ bdud rtsi ra sa ya na'i rgyud/phan byed nyer gcig gnod byed nyer gcig a ma dred de khyung nag gi sgrub pa/ yas stag rtsi shing rang 'gros/ mar bon bco brgyad/ gyer bon skor/ lha srin gtad pa rdzong 'debs bcas klu gnyen sa bdag gtad sprug skor klu bdud snying gzer sogs byung ngo / /gter khung nas 'jal pa'i mda' do'i sa na phug pa gnyis kyi bar du mtsho nag zangs kha tsam gyi dkyil na sbrul nag po mdung tsam zhig 'dug mtsho'i 'gram du yas stag rang 'gros kyi skor rnams 'dug ste ma drangs so/ / phug pa'i nang na rin po che'i zhal bu sna tshogs 'dug pas 'gro bsam yang / sbrul des 'jigs tshul bstan pas 'gro ma nus/ phug pa byi ma na gshen rab kyi ring bsrel cha lnga/ zam ze skye bdun kyi thod pa dang bcas gdan drangs so/ / yang rong bon g.yung drung 'od zer la 'od kyi yi ger babs pa'i stag lha sru gri dkar dmar nag gsum dbal chen gsang ba thugs rgyud kyi skor dang / btsan bdud keng gsum gyi skor rnams drangs so/ / ya nga gu ru yon tan seng ges rgyal rong gab tog brag ri nas drangs pa'i char 'beebs g.yu mtsho mer ba'i skor/ tso min char 'beebs dngul g.yu ma'i skor ma 'ongs lung bstan sde drug gter srung srid rgyal skor rnams yod do/ /khyung po bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis tsha rong kha ba dkar po nas drangs ba'i dran pa a dkar dgongs 'dus sogs bee rdo'i bka' 'ga' yod/ g.yung drung tshe dbang rgyal pos tshe spungs gsang sa'i gnas drangs ba'i rdzogs chen gser gyi yang zhun gyi skor dang srid rgyal gyi skor la sogs yod do/ / yang kho bo bde chen gling pa'am phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan gyi snyan pa'i mdo khams stod smad kun du khyab pa de nyid ma 'ongs lung gis zin tshul dang gter gyi dngos grub brnyes pa lung gis bstan pa ni/ gshin rje gshed nag gi rgyud las/ mi rabs bdunatsam song ba'i mtshams/ /slob dpon chen pos byin gyi rlabs pa'i bu/ /gshed bzhi lo ba mi 'gyur mtshan can 'byung / /mkha' spyod yo rgyan yul du dngos spub len/ /gsang ba'i bon sgo bcu gsum dag la dbang / khyad par sngon gyi rtsa 'gag song ba rnams/ /yo rgyan me tog spungs mjos dgon pa ru/ / rig 'dzin rnams dang mjal de dngos thub len/ / chad pa'i bon rnams ma lus spel nas kyang / /bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /zhang zhung ral can mtha' bzhi bum chung sogs/ kha cig ju thug la sogs bon sde 'ga'/ / bsnams te shar phyogs rgyal mo rong du byon/ /de yi bstan pa rgyal rong mi nyag dang / /a mdo sogs la rgyun chags dar ba'o/ /'u za nyi mas brag dkar yang dben gnas/ /bskal bzang mdo sde lde mig skor tshom gsum/ /a thang yon rin 'jing kha ljong khrom gter/ / zhang zhung sgra bla ma ye bon skor gsum/ / rong bon g.yung 'od dngos grub babs si 'ika te~X0/ wa/stag lha spu gri dkar nag dmar gsum sogs/ /gu ru yon seng gab tog brag ring nas/ /

char 'bebs g.yu mtsho mer ba la sogs thon/ /se dor ston pa dngos grub bka' babs gter/ /lta rgod thog pa zhi khro'i sgrub thabs rgyud/ khyung po bkras rgyal kha ba dkar po'i gter/ /dran pa'i a dkar dgong 'dus la sogs dang / /shel zhig sogs dang tshe spungs gsang grags rnams/ /rdzogs chen gser gyi yang zhun la sogs bton/ /drug pa/ chu chen rab brtan dngardzo 'gagasgyul po gnyisatpa 'brel ba/ngasti tshe dbang rgyal po zhes dbus kyi stag rtse rdzong gi rdzong dpon byas/ rgya nag gong ma'i pho brang du skyes 'bul 'gro myong ba'i lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rgya can zhig byung ste/ dbus kyi po ta la gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i rdzong 'gag phun chogs rdzong gsum pa bskrun/ chu 'pho nor bu gling gi dkon je rgyas su btang bas dus 'khor dang bde mchog gi blos bslangs ngo mtshar can bzhengs/ 'dzam thang jo nang chos rje spyan drangs te/grwa ba stong tsam 'tshogs pa'i dus mchod kyi srol btod/ gser bris kyi dpe cha mang po dang dpar khang bsgrun/ chos rje kun mkhyen gyi sku 'dra dang tā ra na tha rgyal ba tshe dpag med padma 'byung gnas sogs kyi sku 'dra tsan dan dang sman phyes sbyar ba'i stong sku re bzhengs/ gnas bkra shis gling(rgya ming li zhan)ni/bod kyi yig rnying na brag sgam nang zhes mdo smad kyi brag sgam ba'i'i nang du 'dren la/ gzhan khog srung stag mo rdzong zhes kyang zer ba'o/ /mi rabs mang po'i rjes su ta ming yung lu rgyal pos rgyal kha a 'phags la zhi byed dpon gyi ming bstsal zhing / tshe dbang grags rgyal dus su rgyal khag bzhi dbang du bsdus shing /rgyal la bkra shis gling du steg thog dgon pa dang dus 'khor sku 'bum mthong grol mchod rten chen po bzhengs/chu yo sa lo'i dus 'khrugs kyi skabs su yo krung chen dang lhan du sgo me/ chab tsha sogs pham myongs nas lhas skyong gis 'an wu'u si zhes go sa cho lo yang gnang myongs/ rjes su tshe dbang rgyal po dang chu chen rab brtan rgyal po gnyis gros byas te/ bdag gis stod nas gnam la bya mi gtong ba dang / khyod kyis smad nas shing dum cig chu nang du ma gtong zhes pa dag gis rkyen kyis/ jur chen lhas skyong gis thog mar a bhan tshe lang dang yo krung chi sogs dpung dang bcas pa phud de phyogs gsum nas rgol ba'i mthar/ 1752 lor tshe dbang rgyal po bzung nas bsad/ dgon pa gnyis jo nang de dge lugs su bsgyur/ rgyal rgyud bcad pa'i de'i tshab tu brag sgam/ kan phug 'bo to ga 'brug kha sogs la khog srung ba zhes bya ba 'jog pa'i srol btod pa'o/ (khog srung rgya skad du hro'u bī)de dag ni bod mi rigs yin stabs drag rtsal spyong ba las yi ge slob pa dang tshong las byed mi chog pa'i khrims jur chen gyis bkod yod/ 1787 lor the wan du mtsho jag bcom par dmag la song zhing lhas skyong khri lo nga bdun pa'i lor/ bal dmag gtsang du yong dus an cang cin gyis dmag phrid de drug 'thab drug rgyal zhes pa'i dus su dpa' rtags 'jog mkhan gtso bo ni rgyal rong rgyal kha'i bod dmag ces pa'i mtshan snyan yod do/ /tshe dbang rgyal pos rig gnas kyi skor gser bris kyi dpe cha mdzad byang dang ldan pa mang po zhig pe cin dpe mdzod khang na da lta yod pa dang / lho nub dge thon slob grwa chen mo na'ang rgyal rong ba'i gna' rdzas mang po da lta mthong rgyu yod pa lta bu'o/ 8/ 1 —

spyir na rgyal rong phyogs 'di rgya che zhing mi rnams blo rno zhing yul 'dir snga rabs dang da ltar mtshan nyid pa/ sman pa/ zlos gar pa/ ri mo ba/ lo rgyus pa bcas rig gnas mkhan dang / 'bag dang gsob/ 'jim bzo/ rdo bzo/ shing bzo/ lcags dang gser dngul mgar ba sogs kyi lag rtsal khyad du 'phags shing bzo rtsal rmad du byung ba ni gso rig chos 'byung dang / mdo smad chos 'byung /gung thang gsung 'bum rnams las yul rgyal mo rong 'dir 'khrungs pa'i gso rig pa dang lag rtsal ba phul byung can mang po yod do zhes gsungs so/ /bdun pa/ bstan bdag ston pa gshen rab dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdagachul gshen/lo rgyus 'di yi brjod don ni zhang bod dang zhang rgyal gyi rgyal gshen byung tshul dang / bon gyi bstan bdag ston pa gshen rab dang / ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pas phagayung drung bon ni sangs rgyas bon ’zhes gsungs/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag zhang zhung gi rgyal po bco brgyad dang chu chen nam mkha' rgyal po nas/phyi rgyud sprul ba'i sku yi 'dul rgyud/ nang rgyud rdzogs pa'i sku yi gsang sngags kyi rgyud pa/ gsang rgyud bon gyi sku yi sems phyogs kyi rgyud pa sogs phyi nang gsang gsum rgyud 'dzin byung tshul rnams rgyas par yod kyang /gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa gshen dang bru/ zhu/ spa/ rtse'u/ khyung / zhig po sogs kyi gdan sar rgyud 'dzin rim bhon/ phyis byung rgyal ba mnyam med chen po gtsor gdan sa che chung khag gi mkhas thub bla ma rim byon gyi lo rgyus/ bka' dang bka' bstan gyi dbye ba/ bka' mdo 'bum rgyud mdzod/ mdo sngags sems gsum sogs lo rgyus du ma zhig yod kyang / deng skabs kha ba can sogs 'dzam bu gling / /'phrul ngag bon bstan 'dzin pa'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / rje btsun chen po dpal ldan sman ri ba/ / yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i mkhan rabs kyi/ / rnam thar rags bsdus mdo tsam bkod pa la/ /dang bo rgyal ba mnyam med chen po ni/ /lung bstan bla chen dran pa'i kha byang las/ /stong rgyud sprul pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ / dbus ru'i dkyil du bslab gsum bstan pa 'dzugs/ / zhes sogs bka' lung du ma nas/ /lan cig min par bsngags pa'i skyes mchog de/ /yul ni mdo khams shar phyogs rgyal mo rong / /rab brtan sa gnas steg cos ces pa ru/ /yab ni rgyu bon bzhi sogs la mkhas pa'i/ /dpra rigs bon po klu rgyal bya ba dang / /yum ni mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags kun ldan ma/ /rin chen sman zhes bya ba'i stangs dpyal sras/ / me pho sprel lo dpyid ra'i tshes lnga nyin/ /'khrungs rtags ngo mtshar mang po rmad du byung / / de tshe sngon gyi mdzad 'phro mngon pa nas/ / yig 'bru sum cu ma bslab rang brdol mkhyen/ /chung nas byams dang snying rje tshad med ldan/ / mi rtag nges 'byung dad brtson shes rab che/ /dgung lo bcu thog phywa bla g.yung rgyal drung / / gtsang gtsug khrims bzhes shes rab rgyal mtshan gsol/ /des bzung sha chang sgog btsong gtan tu spangs/ / dge spyod chab gtor sbyin pa chags med mdzad/ /gzhan yang mdo khams smad phyogs dge ba'i bshes/ / mtha' bzhi bsod rgyan pho tse ye shes rgyal/ / nyag rong bsod rgyal pa wam shes rab rgyal/ / rtogs ldan sher rgyam la sogs mang bsten nas/ / dbang lung— 82 —

man ngag zab don mang du nod/ / de nas dbus su grwa sar byon pa'i lam/ / cha sgang stod du mkhas grub rin blo mjal/ /rtse gcig mos gus skyes te phyag phyir 'brings/ / phyi nang gsang gsum dbang lung man ngag kun/ / rdzogs par zhus thing khyad par theg chen gyi/ / lag len dmar khrid bum pa gang byor zhus/ / mdo khams stod smad lho byang gnas rir 'grims/ / nyams bzhes rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la 'khrungs/ /gzung 'dzin rang dag 'khor 'das rdo gcig mnyam/ /sa bcu chig bsgrod dus gsum sgrib med byin/ /de nas dbus kyi gsang phu nee'u thog phebs/ /rong ston chen po shes bya kun mkhyen las/ /dbus tshad phar phyin 'dul mngon bcas pa yi/ / mtshan nyid gzhung lugs kun la thos bsam sbyang / /lung rigs smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ / de nas dgung lo so gcig bzhes pa'i dus/ / gtsang du byon nas g.yas ru dben sa kha'i/ / sgrigs bzhugs mkhan po tshul khrims ye shes las/ / drang srong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i sdom khrims bzhes/ /'dul khrims bslabs pa mig gi 'bras ba'in bsrung / /me ston sbob dpon kun bzang rgyal mtshan mdun/ / dbal phur sde skor don gsum yongs rdzogs kyi/ / dbang lung khrid gsum man ngag bcas pa gsan/ /gzhan yang rtogs ldan nam mtha' blo ldan dang / /zhang ston bsod nams spyal mtshan la sogs pa/ / mkhasagrub rgya mtsho lta bu'i dgongs bcud blangs/ / de nas mkhas pa'i grags pa cher khyab cing / / rgyal rigs bru yi gdung 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis/ / dbu rtse dkar dmar gdan sa phul bzhes nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bstan don rgya cher mdzad/ /skabs su yab yum mjal phrad 'khrungs yu la phebs/ /yab yum la sogs smin grol lam mchog bkod/ / slar bskyod dar mdor phebs tshe dbeen sa kha/ /'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'jig pa'i gtam/ /gsan nas de phyogs dben pa'i rir bzhugs te/ / phya sras lengs tse'i bsgrub pa dang 'brel ba'i/ / mdo khams skal ldan gdul bya ser skya yi/ ('gro don mdzad tshe dbal mo'i lung bstan gyis/ /gtsang phebs dkor rten 'ga' yi dngos grub rnyed/ /byin can rten gsum phal cher srid rgyal sogs/ /dbal mo'i srung mas phul sogs phyug tu 'byor/ / dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa'i shing bya lor/ / thob rgyal shar ri pho ba ri yi mgul/ /dpal ldan bkra shis sman ri'i dgon btabs tshe/ /mkhar gsil btsugs pas chu mig rang brdol dang / /rde'u bsgrigs par grwa khang rang grub sogs/ / grub rtags rtsal gyis lo der dgon pa nyid/ / gtsug khang rten dang brten pa ra bcas pa grub/ / sgrigs lam bca' khrims gong bzhin gtsang dag mdzad/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan mkhar sna'i dgon sogs pa'i/ / dben khrod rnams su sgom sgrub bstan don bskyangs/ / ma mchog srid rgyal dgra bdud rngam pa sogs/ / bon skyong bstan bsrung bran khol zin las sgrub/ / dmuspyal nyi ma nyid dang grub pa'i rtsal/ / 'gran tshul rta bdun bgrod lam lan gnyis 'phur/ / rtse zhwa nyi ma'i zer la bkal ba dang / / rdo la phyag gis yig bris mkhar gsil dang / /zhabs rjes gsal sogs grub rtasas brjod mi lang / /gab mdzod sa gsum dbu tshad khams sdud dang / /'dul ba che chung theg rim dang bcas pa'i/ /'grel gzhung dgu dang sa lam 'phrul sgron dang / /tshad ma — 83 —

rnam 'byed gsang sngags rnam 'byed bcas/ / rtsa gzhung che gsum gzhan yang phyi nang gsang / / sgrub pa phyag bzhes la sogs bsgrigs rtsom gyi/ /gsung 'bum mdzad pa glegs bam bcu grangs bzhugs/ /rjes 'jug zhal slob bstan 'gro'i don nus pa/ /mchog chen bcu phrag bslab gsum rab ldan brgya/ /'dul khrims don ldan stong phrag bka' 'brel slob/ / grangs kyi mi chod de nang mchog gyur pa/ / gtsang na rgyal tshab rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / / mnga' ris bsod nams rgyal mtshan thugs sras gnyis/ / rgyal rong dar mdo tshul khrims dbang ldan dang / / bsod nams 'od zer gnyis byung yang rgyal na/ /ye shes tshul khrims rin chen tshul khrims bzhi/ /de bzhin stod smad skyes bu rab tu mang / /gzhan yang rgyal rong g.yung drung ye shes sogs/ /spyal rong dge bshes g.yung drung bstan 'dzin sogs/ /skyes bu mang byon rtag 'dzin 'dul bya la/ /ma 'ong lung bstan rig 'dzin kha byang las/ /gsang 'dus sprul ba rad na'i mtshan can 'byung / / gsung ba nyid yin 'khrungs yul mdo khams shar/ / rgyal mo rdong du gdung rus sgo yi rigs/ / lcags pho byi ba'i lo la sku 'khrungs te/ / chung nas bri klog mkhas shing byams thugs ldan/ /mkhor bar blo ldog cher skyes dbus gtsang byon/ /rgyal ba mnyam med chen po dang mjal te/ /dbang lung man ngag bum pa gang byor zhus/ / mdo mdzod 'dul ba'i sde snod thos bsam sbyangs/ / dag pa drang srong khrims blangs tshul mtshan du/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes gsol de nas bzung / /phyi nang sdom khrims phra zhing phra ba yi/ /nyams med mig gi 'bras bzhin gces spras bsrung / /gsang sngags dbang nod rim gnyis mnga' dbang 'byor/ / man ngag nyams brgyud gdams nod nyams bzhes mdzad/ / rtogs pa mngon gyur grub pa'i mchog tu brnyes/ /de rjes rje nyid gshegs khar gdan sar bkod/ / de rjes sku mdun rgyal ba blo gros ni/ /mnyam med bla ma'i rnam 'phrul rgyal rong 'khrungs/ /g.yung drung gling du gsan sbyangs rab 'byams mtshan/ / bzhes te de mtshams sman ri'i gsor khrir 'khod/ / mkhan chen gong mdun drang srong khrims bzhes dang / /mdo sngags dbang lung gsan sgom nyams bzhes bsgrub/ /gdul bskyed bka' 'khor bskor bzhin bde bar gshegs/ /de rjes slob dpon gsum pa tshul khrims dbang / /rgyal rong brag steg gnas 'khrungs sman ri ru/ /thos bsam cher grub mkhas pa'i khyu mchog gyur/ /gdan sar yongs 'dzin khrir byon 'chad spel sogs/ / bstan 'gro'i don mdzad ngang du dge spyod la/ / bar chad ma byung da skabs bod la 'o/ / de slob rnam 'dren phun tshogs dbang rgyal te/ / 'khrungs yul rgyal rong blo ldan sprul ba grags/ /chung nas mkhyen gsal che zhing zhi dul ldan/ / de nas gtsang byon gdan sa gong 'og gi / mkhan slob rnams bsten phyi nang dbang lung dang / / gzhung chen kun gsan thos bsam sbyangs mthar bcad/ /khyad par mkhan chen bskal bzang nyi rgyan dang / /'gro mgon sher g.yung gnyis las drang srong khrims/ / nyis brgya lnga bcu gsang sngags dbang dam sogs/ / mdo sngags sems gsum zab khrid yongs rdzogs bzhes/ /de rjes gong ma'i gser khrir mnga' gsol nas/ / bshad sgrub bka' yi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ /de rjes mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ /spyal rong khro skyabs rgyal po'i blon — 84 ge

rgyud 'khrungs/ / grwa sar byon bzhugs mkhan slob gong ma rnams/ / bsten nas mdo sngags zab khrid mtshan nyid gzhuzu / /kun la gsan sbyangs mthar son mkhas grub gyur/ /de mtshams lha srung lung bskul gdan sar byon/ /bshad sgrub bka' 'khor zin las mdzad skyong ni/ /'gran bral ngang du mdzad pa 'phro can gyur/ /de rjes rgyal mo rong du sku 'khrungs pa'i/ /mkhan po blo gros nyi ma mchog nyid dang / /gsan bsam nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i ngang nyid du/ / ring por ma bzhugs rkyen gyis zhi bar gshegs/ /brgyad pa/ gshen dang dru/ zhu/ spa/ rme'u/ khyung / zhig po'i gdungarghad/gshen gyi brgyud dang me'u sum pa'i brgyud/ / de bzhin bru brgyud zhu brgyud spa brgyud lnga/ / dang po dmu rigs gshen gyi 'dul brgyud ni/ khri thog dang po gshen ston nam mkha' ste/ / de yi rnam thar gong bshad zin dang de'i/ / mkhan bu sku tsha ye shes rgyal mtshan ni/ / klu sgrub ye shes snying po sprul ba ste/ /gshen ston jo rtsi'i sras su lcags byi lor/ /'khrungs te rig pa'i rtsal ldan mkhyen stobs rgyas/ / de nas gshen la blo gros mtshan/ / de nas 'khon la rin rgyal mtshan/ / tha ma kha che'i yul du skyes/ / 'gro don grub nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes te gshen chen jo rgyal sras chung bar/ /shing pho khyir 'khrungs skyes thob mkhyen rtsal rgyas/ khu bo drang srong ye shes rgyal mtshan mdun/ / 'dul khrims rim zhus thos bsam sgom par sbyangs/ /me ston mchog gi bka' rten thams cad dang / / gshen ston nam mkha'i phyag len la sogs pa/ / mdo sngags kun la thugs sbyongs phul phyin mdzad/ / de rjes mdo khams snad du spyan drangs te/ /dgung grangs zhe drug lo la khams su gshegs/ /de nas rim bzhin ri rgyal dgon rtse yi/ /mkhan brgyud na rim gtsang brdol mched pa dang / / slob brgyud zhang (kun mkhyen ye blon)ston bsod nams rin chen nas/ / sga ston tshul rgyal rgyal mtshan mchog legs dang / / rong ston shes rab 'od zer la sogs pa'o/ / de yang sga ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan ni/ / brtse phyir bzang ri'i bzhed rgyun ltar snang yang / / 'dul brgyud gshen gyi slob phyir 'di brjod na/ /'khrungs yul rgyal rong gdung rus sga yin te/ / chung nas rig gsal shes rno byis pa'i dus/ /shig phran mig dang sro ma'i gas srub mthong / / de nas rim bzhin thos bsam sbyangs bar mdzad/ / dbus gtsang stod byon bzhad kyi dar lding du/ / zhang ston bsod rin la brten 'dul khrims sogs/ / mdo sngags bon nod gzhung bshad sbyangs mthar bcad/ /dben sa kha dang dpal ldan bzang po ri/ /dbus kyi gsang phu gtsang gi snar gtam sogs/ /rang gzhan grwa sa kun tu grwa skor mdzad/ /mkhas chen thams cad rtsod pa'i pham par byas/ /'dul mdzod sa lam theg rim phar phyin sogs/ / gzhung dang 'brel ba zab bshad mang du mdzad/ / bzhed pa phyogs 'then grub mtha'i rtsal bton sogs/ / dgag dang ba'ag pa'i rnam gzhag shan 'byed btsams/ / de rjes rdzogs chen pod gnyis nyams blangs te/ / kun spangs bya bral mdzad cing gshegs bskyod che/ mkhar gsil gang tsam sa blar lding sogs kyi/ /lo rgyus yod cing sku tshe tha ma ni/ /sgrub gnas phug par bya 'phur bzhin du gshegs/ / de rjes mnyam med chu chen nas brgyud pa'i/ /lnga ba sku makau dīkā chepri rgyal

mtshan gyi/ /'dul slob mkhas spub tshul khrims 'od zer ni/ /rgyal rong du 'khrungs dbus gtsang grwa sar byon/ / gshen gyi gdan sar rtse yi mkhan po mdzad/ / mdo sngags rgyud gzhung don mkhas phyag bzhes sogs/ / bstan bcos mang mdzad gshen bstan dar rgyas spel/ /(1)gsang ba grol lam sems phyogs brgyud pa'i zhang zhung snyan brgyud bka' bkol gyi bla ma rnams/nga yi phrin las sprul ba a mdo'i yu la/ / shar ba tshul khrims mtshan yang sbas mngon tshul/ / 'gro 'dren stong phrag sanyis kyi la lo bsgyur/ / de slob bya bral shes rab 'od zer te/ / 'khrungs yu la tsha sgang gdung rus go lam bla/ khyung po drang srong nam mkha' g.yung drung las/ khro bo dbang lung khra rgan bkras rgyal las/ /rdzogs chen yang rtse shar ba tshul dpal las/ /snyan brgyud bka' skor ma bu kun zhus te/ /lhodagon zho lung dor bu'i ri khyod dang / / spa gro'i dben gnas rnams bzhugs grub pa thob/ / de slob rtogs ldan shes rab rgya mcho ste/ /yul ni daralding gdung rus res tshang yin/ /go lam sher 'od mjal nas snyan brgyud zhus/ / rta nag dung phor brag la spub pa brnyes/ / de slob sgo dzung blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/'khru baspyad lo la sman rir phebs/ / mkhan chen kun bzang drung du rab byung nas/ / sde snod kun sbyangs thos bsam sgro 'dogs bcad/ / sprul sku rnam dag 'od las rigs rus dang / / rag shi nyi mar snyan brgyud rin sgron zhus/ / sku mdun kun bzang rgyal las a khrid dang / / de ba'in rnal 'byor bla ma rgyal mtshan dang / / res tshang sher rgyam gnyis las snyan brgyud gyi/ / bka' rgyud skor bzhi tshang ba re zhus thing / /nyams rtogs yon tan rtser phyin bon skur rtogs/ / dgung lo nyer lngar gshen rgyal lhun grub kyis/khri brtan nor rtsi'i khrir bskos lo 'gar bzhugs/ / gsang sems bon 'khor bskor zhing slob mang 'phel/ /rig gnas kun mkhas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mang / /gnyan chen thang lha stod lung 'bri dgon sogs/ /'al slob bya bral bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang / / bon grong bstan 'od dpon tshang bstan 'od dang / /bzhas sgom tshul rgyal dang ba'i lung bstan las/ / mu khri btsan dang bi ma mi sprul du/ / sgo risas sras su blo gros rgyal mtshan byung / / 'dul khrims gsang sems yongs 'dzin 'gro don mdzad/ /ces te tham 'brilungadagon par gshesas/ /yang gcig dpon slob gcig chod dad shes dang / /bru ston mnyam med rgyal ba gnyis kyi slob/ / rtogs ldan mtho la shes rab dpal nyid dang / / de slob sgo dzung nam mkha' 'od zer dang / snye de slob rgyal rong g.yung drung ye shes nas/ / mkhas spub rim blo de nas mnyam med che/ /yangagacig la stod ri ba shen blo'i slob/ /bru ston rnam rgyal ka ra des mkhas grub/ /rin chen blo gros shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs/ / mi na ri'i mkhan brgyud rim byon sbyi ltar dang / / yang lacig mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ / thugs sras mnga' ris bsod nams spyal mtshan dang / /chab la kha ba bsod rgyal sanyis la gnang / / de gnyis gnyis kas khra rgan bkra shis la/ / de yi a mchog lhun grub rgyal mtshan la/ de yi stong rje tshul khrims dbang ldan la/ /de yi sgo dzung blo gros rgyal mtshan la'o/—— 86 —

(2)gtsozhig bsgrags skusum dang yekhrisogasardzogs chen gdamasarigasabargyud ba'ibla marnams/zhang zhung rgya gar gnyis brgyud gter lung gnyis/ / dang po zhang zhung bon skor bsgrags gsum brgyud/ / kun bzang gshen lha la sogs dgongs brgyud tshul/ / zhang zhung brag dmar rin chen spungs pa'i khrod/ / bsgrubs pas mchog sku phyag rgya chen por bzhud/ / de slob slob dpon gsang ba 'dus pa rje/klong chen dgongs brdol zhang zhung bye ma la/ / mi 'gyur dum pa tshal gyi sgrub gnas su/ / bsgrubs pas phung po lhag med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de slob zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen ni/ /yar 'brog ra dmar ri yi gong du bsgrub/ /don dgu dpe dang sbyar te se la bshad/ /se bon mal ba sha ri dbu chen gyis/ zhang zhung khyung lung mkhar ba'i khrod du bsgrub/ /theg brgyad rdzogs chen klong grol man ngag gdams/ /mi nyag nai rgyung lce tsha mkhar bu yis/ mang mkhar bon gyi gnas chen phug tu bsgrub/ / lta spyod zung 'brel rdzogs chen klong la bzlas/ /lde bon mkhas pa gyim tsa rma chung gis/ /sum pa glang gi gyim shod gnas su bsgrub/ /de rjes khams su byon khar dmar byang gi/ /gdams pa yang yang ngo sprod gnang mdzad de/ /'khrul zhig khams byon mi chos slog rdul bzhin/ /rgyab bsgyur ri khrod 'grims te smin grol bskyangs/ /de slob rtogs ldan dam pa g.yu zhig ni/ /yul ni rtse gangs ring mo bya ba ru/ /yab ni g.yu la mes po mkha' yi sras/ /dgung lo dgu dus zhang pos 'bri klog bslab/ / bco lngar khro bor dbang chen zhib rgyas mkhyen/ /rgyud sde mang gsan bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad/ / dgung lo nyer gcig rdzogs chen lung drug gsan/ /nyams bzhes drod rtags nyams rtogs legs pa'i dus/ /'khrul zhig ldom bu'i snyan thos drung du phyin/ /gshen sgom gdams pa gzhan la med de zhu/ /byas pa rtse gcig sangs rgyas gdams pa ni/ /kun la yod pa de las nga la'ang med/ / gsungs te gdams pa gnang bzhin dbang bskur mdzad/ / yengs med rtse gcig bsgoms pas grub pa thob/ / de nas hor dmag byung bas mdo stod byon/ / rgyal mo rong stod brag nag tu bzhugs te/ / theg chen don gyi bka' 'khor rgya chen bskor/ / zhal slob rnal 'byor rtogs ldan mang du tshar/ / de slob mtshan ldan 'gru zhig kun dga' ni/ / yabani go gol lha bon dbang zhes dang / /yum ni ber za a 'bel gnyis sras 'khrungs/ /lo ngo dgunas yab las dbang khrid thob/ /debazhin mkhas grub skye bu mang bsten mdzad/ /gdams pa zhus shing sgom sgrub nyams len bskyangs/ /rgyal mo rong byon dam pa g.yu 'ig mjal/ /dmar byang mchog gi gdam pa zhus te gnang / /kun dga' zhig por mtshan btags yar phebs shing / / rma stod sku bla g.yu rtser bka' 'khor bskor/ / smin grol bstan pa'i sa bon mchog tu btsugs/ /sku tshe mthar phyin bde chen dbyings su gshegs/ /me'u shes dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' lhun/ / rnam dag tshul khrims gshen ston rgyal dbang btsugs/ / bstan 'dzin tshe lhun rgyal ba khri bstan sogs/ /dmu gshen skyed gshong gdung la rim brgyud ni/ /kun tu bzang pos dran pa nam mkhar bstan/ / bla chen nyid kyis bee ro tsa nar gnang / / bee ros stag tshang brag la gter du sbas/ /srid pa'i rgyal mos gter srung bya ra mdzad/ / phyis su bon zhig g.yung drung gling ba yi~X/7 // spa gro

stag tshang gnas nas gter bton te/ / bru ston mtshungs med bsod blo nyid la babs/ / de nas bru ston mkhas grub bsod nams dang / / rnam rgyal ka ra mkhas grub rin blo dang / / mnyam med chen po mnga' ris bsod rgyal sogs/ / yang gcig bru ston mtshungs med bsod blo nas/ / rgyal rong g.yung rgyal rig pa rang shar sogs/ / 'og gis yab bcur dril la brgyud ltar ro/ /( 2)akhridartogasaldananyamasabargyud sogs dang sems phyogs spyi'iblargud/dang po a khrid bon sku kun bzang nas/ / bder gshegs zhi rgyas dbang drag lha chegs dang / /dgongs brgyud rnam lnga bla ma che drug dang / / gdung brgyud bcu gsum mkhas pa mi bzhi dang / / lo parṇa gshen brgyad gter bsrung ye shes dpal/ /gshen gyer rma dbyil gru zhu spa me'u bcas/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda' yi brgyud/ / spub thob snyan khung sgra bsgyur lo paṇa brgyud/ zab mo gter brgyud lnga ni gong bshad kyi/ / sngags sems brgyud pa bcas las gsal ltar ro/ drug pa stogs ldan nyams kyi brgyud pa yin/ /thog ma rje btsun dam pa dgongs mdzad ni/ /lung bstan rkyang 'phags gnad byang drug cu bar/ /tshad med 'od ldan sprul ba la/ /the ston dam pa ri khrod ces/ / sku lus thugs la spyan sogs nas/ / 'bum phrag lnga bcu'i thar lam phye/ / thugs sras bka' babs che ba'i gcung brgyad dang / /tha chung gnyis pa lcam gnyis spub thob ni/ /nga brgyad ri 'grim sgom chen sum brgya sogs/ /yang gcig bon sgom bsod nams g.yung drung nas/ / mtho la shes dpal rgyal rong g.yung drung mes/ / gangs lung rnam rgyal rtogs ldan sher seng ge / rtogs ldan sher rgyam ldong 'ig tshul rgyal nas/ / de slob a shag bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes/ / phyosas med rnal 'byor 'gro ba'i don mdzad yin/ / de mched khro chen a tog dkar po ni/ / rgyal mo rdong 'khrungs sems nyid sgro 'dogs chod/ /'dir snang bya ba bden med sgyu mar rtogs/ / tshe gcig kun tu bzang brnyes rnal 'byor lags/ / yab sras bcud dril kun tu bzang po dang / /dran pa nam mkha' tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / / pad ma mthong grol bee ro tsa na nas/ / gter sbas bon zhig g.yu nga drung gling bas bton/ / bru ston mtshungs med bsod blo nyid la babs/ / de las g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis zhus te/ / rgyal mo rong grub mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur/ / de yi rdzibo rig pa rang shar la/ / gnam mcho'i gnas bsgrub tshe dbang lha zhal gzigs/ / de rjes grub thob bstan pa rgyal mtshan ni/ / rgyal morong 'khrungs chung nas yon tan ldan/ /sku bla lha gnyan gnyan chen dmu rdo'i lho/ /g.yung drung ring mo'i gnas bzhugs cher bskyed tshe/ / dbus gtsang du byon sman ri sku mdun dang / / bru zhu spa me'u la sogs dam pa kun/ / bsten nas mdo sngags dbang khrid gdams pa zhus/ khyad par 'bru sgom nyi ma 'od zer mdun/ /theg chen nyams brgyud yongs rdzogs zab bzhes nas/ /stod gnas yongs su mjal skor sgrub gnas ba'ag / de nas lho bragasku 'bum bon ri dang / / she le rgya skar kha ba dkar po sogs/ / gnas chen rnams 'grim rgyal mo dmu rdo'i gnas/ / g.yung drung ring mor rtse gcig sgor sgrub mdzadzee 8 8derjo tshungs 'khrul 'is g.yung drung tshul khrims ni/ / yul ni rgyal rong dmu rdo'i shar gyi

phyogs/ /nyam ze zhes par pho rtse'i gdung las 'khrungs/ / chung nas dad dang brtson 'grus 'phags nor ldan/ /thos bsam mang mdzad 'jig rten la zhen ldog /pha yul spangs te sman rir byon sgrigs zhugs/ / sku mdun bsod yi'i zhal sngar dbang gzhung nod/ / phyi nang bon la sgro 'dogs legs par bcad/ / grwa saramado sngags phyag len sbyangs brtson dus/ / 'bru sgrom nyi 'od mtshan snyan thos dang mos/ / mdun bcar dang bo bya dur nas mjal dus/ /dad pa'i sgru long g.yo bas skyi sha zing / /snying khung mig nas brul ba'i mos gus kyis/ /'bas rdul spyi bos mchod de rir bsten nas/ / theg chen yod rgu'i dbang khrid man ngag lung / / rtsa rlung thig gsum phyag len ma lus zhus/ / lta spyod zung 'brel nyams len rtse gcig bsgom/ /nyams myong rgyud skyes grub rtags mngon du gyur/ /thang mo che ru rta ba mnyam rgyug byas/ /rta chad 'khrul zhig la khar thon te phebs/ / dus shig bru lugs sgrub rtogs 'gas bon la/ / rtsa rlung khrid med brjod pa de bzlog phyir/ /de'i rtogs gsum dang khong bzhir dgun nub gcig /gtsang po'i dar thog bzhugs pa'i rtogs ldan gnyis/ / bros shor gcig dang mnyam bzhugs tho ring khar/ / jul nag zil ba khrom mer bzhugs pa'i skor/ /'khyags pa gru gang re tsam zhu 'dug pas/ khong gsum dad gus bla ma'ang thugs mnyes gyur/ / mtshan du ras rkyang bar chags de nas ni/ / rdzogs chen 'od gsal bcas pa'i gdams zab kun/ / bum pa gang byor gnang ste lho phyogs su/ / 'byon par lung bstan grub thob bstan rgyam dang / / 'grogs te lho brag sku 'bum du byon lam/ / ston pa'i phyag shing rdo sgrom zhig snyed bsnams/ /sku 'bum gnas su mnyam med 'dul ba yi/ /sku gdung mjal 'ing de ru lo gsum bsgrub/ /bon 'khor bskor mdzad sri rgyal lung bstan nas/ /kong por byon te bro gar zhabs rjes su/ / lo gsum bsgrub mdzad sbyin bdag bud med cig /byin rlabs bu skyes dung dkar rdzong gzhis phul/ /de ru dgon pa btab bzhugs zhabs rjes gcig /rtsed mo'i tshul ba'ag skabs shig kong smad na/ /gangs ri nyil te gtsang bkag grong mang brlag khong la zhus te gtor mdos rgyab mdzad pas/ / gangs phug gtsang po lam seng ded la song / / gtsang por mi bying gnam char dbab bkag dang / / mdud pas mtshon rta srung la sogs grub rtags ni/ / brjod kyis mi lang slob ma bstan 'gro'i don/ / nus pa ldong sgom bstan pa lhun grub dang / /rgyal rong rtogs ldan me ri 'bar ba dang / /nyag rong g.yung drung grags pa gsum byung ngo / /lta sgom mngon gyur rig pa btsan sar zin/ /snga phyi'i skye masgon don lnga'i dgung thog gshegs/ /lha bu pad ma 'phrul gyi skye bar grags/ / de rjes nang so g.yung drung ye shes ni/ / yul ni rgyal rong 'gran rdzong rgyal po'i sras/ /gdung rus dpra dkar khyung ste chung nas mkhas/ /bla ma shes rab drung du rab byung zhus/ /bcu drug lo la gtsang phebs sman ri ru/ / mkhan chen bsod g.yu nga mdun du drang srong bsgrub// gzhan yang dre ston bsod nams 'gyur med dang / / bru bla dbang rgyal zhu sgom khri btsun dpal/ / stag bro nam mkha' 'od zer sogs bsten nas/ /phyi nang bon sgo'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs zhus/ khyad par bon rir dam pa blo rgyal mdun/ / a snyan rdzogs gsum theg chen gdams rdzogs gsan/ / mdo — 89 —

dbus sgrub gnas kun tu nyams len mdzad/ / shel zhig gto lung yang dben dpal dgon btabs/ /grub rtags dzu 'phrul thogs med mkha' spyod nyul/ / bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal mgon dam pa'o/ / de slob gter chen tshe dbang grags pa nas/ /shar bkra shis spyal mtshan la brgyud do/ /gong gi kun grol nam mkha' ye shes la/ / thugs sras gshen ston kun dga' phun tshogs dang / / rdzo khog khro tshang bstan 'dzin nor bu dang / /'jang na lcang lung tshul khrims phun tshogs sogs/ /slob brgyud mang po 'gro ba'i dam pa'o/ / bstan 'gro'i don du mdzad pa bsam yas bskyangs/ / rmad byung 'phrin las rab rgyas ngang du bzhugs/ /gzhan yang zung chu rnga yul phan ci dang / /theb chu khod srung reb kong khri ka dang / /rgyal rong mi nyag tsha rong mcho sngon bcas/ / bon bstan 'dzin pa'i skyes bu grangs 'das byon/ / ngos bzung grangs su bkod pa ga la dpog /stod kyi zhang zhung mnga' ris lho byang phyin/ / smad kyi rgya mtshams a mdo spyal rong yan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu nam mkha'i skar tshogs las/ /rags thor byon tshul mdor bsdus sa bon tsam/ / gang rtogs dad mos blo yis zhib dpyad bkod/ /(4)g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pasnga sbyi' dus su dgon sde'i skor/gang gi bstan pa sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon/ /bstan pa'i lha sde 'dzam gling zhang bod ljongs/ /snga phyi bar du ji ltar chags dar ba'i/ /gdan rabs lo rgyus mdor bsdus 'bri bar bya/ /de yang dang po ri mtho sa gtsang ma zhang zhung dang bod kyi sa'i cha glang po'i gtsug ltar mtho zhing phyogs thams chad gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs su mkhas pa dang / grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed cig byung ba las thog mar bstan pa snga dar gyi dus kyi ches snga dar gyi skabs su g.yung drung gi bon rin po che las gzhan pa'i chos lugs mi gcig pa med pas/ zhang bod khams gsum du spyal gshen mchod yon sde gnyis po 'phel rgyas che zhing bshad sgrub rab tu dar te/ de yang sngar ston pa'i skus 'dul dus bod dang rgyal mo rong du 'byon skabs bod khams yongs la lha gsol dang yug phud tsam gyi rgyu bon phran tsheg 'ga'i phud phog slad du rgyu 'bras kyi bon rnams dar ba'i byin rlabs lung bstan gnang / zhang zhung du 'bum chen sde bzhi'i bon gsungs/ de'i rjes su gsung gi bstan pa'i nang thog mar zhang zhung du 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar ba yin te/ deng skabs rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu byi ba'i yan mi lo bzhi stong drug brgya lhag gong du/ stag gzig nas mkhan po rdzu 'phul ye shes phebs nas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes tshul bstan byung du bshad pa ltar la/ de 'dzin 'dul ba'i sde rab tu mang bar 'phel te/ thog mar spos ngad ldan pa'i shar brgyud drag lung na ba dmar lding bon phug tu drung mi khri rtse'i lha sde chen po de ni mkhan chen rdzu 'phrul ye shes dang / ye shes tshul khrims bla slob gyi gdan sa yin cing mkhan po'i zhabs rjes kyang deng sang dgon shul gyi nye ri'i brag steng du yod/ zhang zhung spros ri ngad ldan gyi shar phyogs shel gyi brag dkar rtse rdzong du/ g.yung drung lha rtse'i 'dus sde chen po dgra bcom stong phrag dang ldan pa zhang zhung mkhan po g.yung drung tshul khrims kyis btabs/ de bzhin spos ri ngad ldan gyi nub phyosdu~X dpal phu'i ri ldebs su/ g.yung drung mchog steng gi dgon pa gnas brtan stong dang drug

brgyaldanapa zhang zhung mkhan po khri 'bar gtsug phud kyis btsugs/ lho phyogs drom po dpal gyi ri la g.yung drung brtsegs pa'i 'dus sde chen po dge 'dun stong phrag lhag ldan gtsug phud tshul khrims kyis bzhengs/gdan sa chen po de bzhi'i gtsos gzhan yang shar phyogs hor stod drag chung gi g.yas ri'i lung bar le dur lha rtse'i dgon pa/ ma pang mtshe'i shar se ba lung dgon bkra shis rtse/ gser brag bya skyim can nas g.yung drung bkod pa'i lha sde/ de bzhin khyung mo spug un rung brag dkar/ la dag lhub do/ rtse brgyad ri phu/ gangs ri'i gser lung / sku mchog glang chen rdzong / bye ma g.yung drung / gangs lung lha phu/ lho byang ta gling gnyis/ nyi ma dpal phu/ na snyil gangs/ stag la mkhar/ mdun chu glang chen/ brag dri bda' kros ri/ bya ri gtsag ldan/ khyung lung dngul mkhar/ mda' mkhar/ gu ge shang rtse gzhung /spu rang kang tse phu/ ru thog khyung tshang brag sku lha stag ri spug ge khod gnyen lung gangs/ byang ra bzhi/ shar shel rong / yar rjes gangs/ da rog mtsho/ me rgyung dkar nag blon po'i gangs/stong rgyung skug mo/ khri 'od zur thang / dwang ra g.yu mtsho/ rnam rgyal lha rtse/ shar dum pa tshal/ byang rgyar yis tshal/ nub ba yu'i tshal/ lho khyi tor tshal/ de la sogs zhang zhung khri sde stod smad kun dang /stod la seng bal te'u byin smad nag gtsang glo dol yan lho byang kun du 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde che phra stong phrag grangs nye ba/ bka' lung nyan bshad dang / ri khrod cog phu'i sde dang / brag dkon dgon bka' thub kyi sde bzhi pho mos phye ba'i sa brgyad du chags shing 'phel nas mi lo sum brgya nyer lnga tsam la zhang zhung du bstan pa sngon du dar/ de rjes bod dbus gtsang sogs su'ang rim par 'dul bstan dar te/thog mar dbu ru 'dam shod snar mo ru g.yung drung khri 'dus 'od gling ni ga cu gtsug phud rgyal ba bzhengs/de bzhin g.yas ru rna nag rta 'go sum lag tu khri 'dus gsal ba'i gnas dgon brtsegs shing bon 'khor bskor/ de 'brel dbus gtsang du gnas sde brgyad tsam 'phel/ dbus ru yer klung lha sa'i gnas sde chen po g.yung drung khrims gsas khang gi ya gong ye shes rgyal bas btabs/ bdud pir gdong nag po tshar bcad/ de ba'in yer ba'i brag dgon dang / g.yas ru'i zang zang gnas dgon dang / gram pa lha rtse'i 'du gnas sogs gnas sde nyi shu rtsa lnga 'phel/ ru lag gram pa rgyang gi 'dus 'od kyi lha khang ni pham shin dpal gyi bstan pa btsugs/ de brten g.yung drung rol ba'i gsas khang sogs gnas sde sum cu rtsa brgyad 'alel/ g.yo ru rag za'i 'du gnas g.yung drung khri skos rol ba'i gtsug lag khang ni lde btsun ye shes rab gsal gyis bzhengs/ de bzhin g.yas ru'i rgyud du gnas sde bcu gnyis brtsegs/ de dus zhang bod yul ljongs rnams su phyi'i lha rten gsas khang dang mchod rten gyi rigs rnams gang mos ci rigs bzhengs/ nang gi rten gsum ni sku brnyan bris 'bur rigs ston pa sprul sku'i rnam can 'khor bcas dang /gsung rab mdo 'bum gzungs gsum/ thugs rten sku gdung chags shing hor ru gzhi skur sogs bsgun/rnam dag 'bum dang mdo yi skor klog 'don 'bri ba sogs byed/ mchod pa rnam lnga dang sgra snyan rol mo'i tshogs kyis mchod/ de ltar bon gyis 'du gnas sum cu rtsa bdun mtshan 'go bkod ltar gsal sogs — 91 —

dge 'dun gyi sne brgya phrag grangs su 'phel/ ya gong mkhan brgyud nyer lnga dang / pham shin brgyud pa sum cu'i bar du gnas brtan gyi sde bzang po chags te mi lo stong phrag nye ba tsam ring la dbus gtsang byang gsum/nyang dag rgod gsum/ glo mon lho gsum bcas la bstan pa rnam par dag pa dar/ de nas bstan pa rgud ltas shar te jo btsun ye shes kyis/ lung bstan bzhin sangs spyas kyi sku gdung rnams gter du sbas pa rim gyis mdzad/ mu zig gsal bzang bstan pa'i sa bon du 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ zhang zhung rgyal po mu la mu sang dus 'ang zhung gi 'dul bstan nang 'khrugs kyis nyams/ bod kyi gnas sde rnams rim par lo re bzhin 'gyur ldog sna tshegs byung / nyams gud je dmas su gyur ring lo brgya phrag gnyis gsum song rjes gnas sde bcu drug tsam las stongs/ de rjes gri gum btsad po'i ring la gnas chen bzhi bshig gnas phran bcu to gnyis bsgyur/ rab byung gi sde tshan rtsa lag dang bcas pa gcig kyang med par byas te brlags par gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sngags sems sogs ni zhang zhung sgo pa'i yul du 'dul ba'i bstan pa thog mar dar te lo brgya phrag drug bdun tsam na sngags sems kyi bon rnams dang / mdo sde gzhan dag kyang rim pa dar/ de rjes mi lo lnga baspya lhag song mtshams bod dbus phyogs su'ang sngags sems kyi dbu brnyes nas/ bod rgyal gnam gyi khri bdun ring mi lo drug brgya lnga bcu'i skor bar gsang sngags 'dul ba gnyis ka mnyam du zung 'brel gyis dar/ khyad par gsang ba'i sgrub gnas sum cu rtsa drug gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams su rig 'dzin thub chen dngos slob sgrub pa'i gshen rnams kyis bsgrub cing bstan pas bshad sgrub 'phel/ khyad par rgyal po mu khri btsan pos sngags gyi sgrub sde sum cu rtsa bdun btsugs te/ khyung lung dngul mkhar dang / gangs te se man chod/ kong yul se mo thang dang / rgya nag gi gong bu dme ru dang /gyim shod sbas pa'i bco brgyad gyim shel le rgya skar yan chod bcas bsgrub pa'i sde sum cu so bdun btsugs/de nas rgyal po gri gum gyi tshe stod du rig 'dzin grub pa bsnyems shing dus gsum mkhyen pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams su 'du byas bon rnams dar nub 'pho 'gyur dang / sems can las rkyen dus dag gis legs nyes mtha' gcig tu gnas pa'i nges pa med phyir/ de bskun dam pa'i phrin las ma 'gags pa'i thabs shes spro bsdus mdzad pa'i zab cing rgya che'i bon sde thams cad gter du bcug de dag gi tshul zhib par bstan 'byung zur du gsal/ de man 'dul bstan sngon du dar bas mi lo chig stong bdun brgya lhag dang / sngags bstan rjes su dar bas lo drug brgya lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la bon bstan dar ba'o/ / de rjes su'ang bstan 'byung du bshad pa ltar/ gter du ma song ba'i sngags dang / rgyu'i bon rnams dang / li shu dang dran pa sogs kyis stag gzig dang zhang zhung nas spyan drangs pa'i mdo sngags sems gsum gyi bon rnams rgyal sras spu lde gung rgyal nas bzung khri srong lde btsan bar rgyal rabs sum cu'i ring rgyal gshen bstan pa mnyam gnas kyi lo chig stong bzhi brgya so gnyis su bzhugs/ de'i ring 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun dang bstan pa'i sde ni khyab brdal du ma dar/ 'dul ba stod lugs kyi sdom rgyun zhes pa dwang khri sgras stag nas zhus pa tshig btsad po khri rtse 'bum gyi dus yar lung 'phan thang rtse ru gnas brtan gyi sde zhig chags par bzhed pa — 92 —

yod/ sngags sgrub pa'i sde rnams ci rigs su gnas shing chags na'ang rgyal po khri srong gi dus gsar byung gi rgya chos la thugs zhen che bas zheng bod kyi bon sde phal cher gter tu sbas/ 'bum sde khag gcig dang sngags sems man ngag phon che ba zhig chos su ming tshig bsgyur te bris/ bon bstan dngos ni nyi ma ni nub rir gshegs pa soms can gyi las rkyen bsod nams phra ba dang / 'du byas gshis lugs gsar pas rnying ba zil gyis gnon pa ni phyi lugs su gyur phyir lo brgya phrag gcig tsam bod du bon bstan bsnub pa'i tshul byas/ don du zin las gang zag phal gyis bsgyur bsnubs med par byed pa ga la nus/ rgyal po sras bcas kyang gsang spyod kyi bon sde sna tshogs yod pa dang / rgyal 'bangs mnga' ris su'ang rang gnas su bon sde sna tshogs ci rigs spyod pa yod lugs ban bon gnyis kyi dpe lung du shes/ de ltar sngon rabs kyi dus su bon gyi 'du gnas so bdun/ sgrub gnas so drug gnas chen nyer bzhi/ sgrub phug gnas so bdun bcas kyi ming grangs dang sa tshigs ni/ dang po 'du gnas so bdun ni/ dbu ri na bcu gsum yod de/ 'dam shod snar mo ni gnyan chen thang lha'i mdun 'dam gzhung / ngan lam ral gsum bsam yas nas skyid shod du yong ba'i bar/ 'phan yul brag dkar ni dbu ru byang ngos 'phan po'i nang / mal dro ra ba ni dbu ru shar lho phyogs mal dro'i sa/ mchim gyi brag dmar ni bsam yas mchim phu/ has pho ri thang ni bsam yas has pho ri'i gzhung / lha sa g.yer pa ni skyid chu'i rgyud lha sa'i gzhung sogs dang /mdog gung rgyal mo gnyis dbu ru nang g.yo ru na bdun/ g.yas ru la brgyad/ ru lag na dgu 'di rnams sngar bon gyi 'du gnas sa yin kyang phyis su kha shas ma gtogs dam chos gsar rnying gi dgon pa'am lha khang re yod/ gnyis pa bsgrub gnas so drug ni/ dang po gsang ba'i gnas dgu dang / bla ma che drug gi dngos ni ri rgyal dang ri bdun sogs su yin te/ g.yu lung shel brag ni rtsa gsum lho nub mtshal ri zur gsum gyi lho shar shel brag gsang phug ri nag 'dzoms pa ni mtshal ri'i byang nub bdud 'joms ri'i gsang phug a su ra ni seng ldeng 'dzin ri'i smad gsang ba'i brag phug sogs dang / ri rgyal lhun po ni ri rab gnas sam stag gzig 'od kyi lha ri spo mthon rtse/ lha ri kyang tho ni bon ri'i dbu rtse'am bod yul g.yo ru lho kha'i yar lung btsan thang smo bzhi'i gnas/ mu le khyung mtsho ni zhang zhung la dwags mtsho'i do chen/mon ri zur gsum ni gor bod zhang gi mtshams ri gsum 'dus pa'i rtse/ gangs gnyan te se ni zhang zhung gi dkyil te se gangs dkar/ rgya so dar rtse ni smad spya bod mtshams rgyal mo rong gis dar rtse mdo dang de dang nye ba rgya'i gong bu dme ru zer ba dang / rma ri mdo khams ni shar rma khog gam rma stod rtse bla zhig gi gnas/ shel le rgya skar ni sum pa glang ji gyim shod shod chen sbas pas bco brgyad gyi gnas ri rtse drug go/gsum pa gnas chen nyer bzhi ni sgrub gnas so drug gi khongs su 'dus/ bzhi ba mu khris btsugs pa'i gnas chen rnams rang la btsugs pa mang zhing de las gzhan pa rnams kyang sa cha phal cher shes sla/brag phug rong chen ni stag rong gi gnas/ de bzhin gnas mtshungasamatshal ldazur gsum ni 'brong ri dmar po/ rgya mkhar ba ma bod ni me rgyung dkar nag chu mig brgya rtsani glo chu‘meg de rnams zhang zhung — 93 —

smad kyi sar yod/ khri 'od khyung rtse dang khri 'od ru thang gnyis 'u rub bod kyi byang rgyud dang / ra sa g.yung rol dang / lcim lung brag gnyis bod kyi lho rgyud kyi stod phyogs la yod/ 'gran gyi ri gong ni phyis yar gtsang nyin rgyud bya dur dgon gong gnas la bzhed/ gzhan yang zhang zhung stod smad kyi lha rabs sde bzhi/bar gyi gangs ri mtsho gsum/ snad kyi rgyud rgyu'i gnas/ sman btsun mched dgu yar rje lha dgublon po gong 'og sogs 'ang zhung gi lha gnyan gnas pa'i ri brag sum brgya drug cu/ 'khyil ba'i mtsho dang 'bab pa'i chu'i gnas brgya dang brgyad cu/ bod phyogs na rje'i mgur lha bcu gsum/ bod kyi lha dguganam sman a phyi mched lnga/ sman btsun brtan ma bcu gnyis/ rtse bla bcu gsum/ gangs chen bdun sogs zhang bod kyi gnas chen kun dang / de bzhin du mdo khams kyi rma chen spom ra/ gangs dkar ri bo/ rgyal mo dmu rdo/ shar dung ri sogs lho byang kun la dgon pa dang bsgrub gnas dbeen khang gi khyab par yod kyang rim par 'pho 'gyur gyis phyis dar dus su yul phyogs phal cher gyi gnas rnams la dam chos gsar rnying ci rigs kyi dgon gnas re chags/ byang 'brog shas che ba zhig ni dgon shul gyi khang ro rdo drul mngon dang mi mngon tsam gyi rnam pa ni 'dus byas kyi spyi lugs so/ / lnga ba bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus 'dir bon gnas kyi gdan sa bshad pa la/ spyir de dus grub mtha'i chos lugs gsar rnying mi gcig pa mang po dar zhing de dag rang sdong gi rtsal mngon par bton pa'i phyir la la dar zhing la la rim par bag la zha bar gyur mod/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang phrin las kyis gshen bstan 'dzin pa'i gnas sde snga phyir chags pa dang / gnas pa dang / dar ba dang / nyams te stong pa bcas grangs mang ba stod mnga' ris nas/ smad rgya mtshams rgyal mo rong la thug gi bar ma khyab pa med pa ltar mngon pas thams cad brjod du mi shes kyang / mthong thos kyi lam du gyur pa 'ga' zhis smos na/ thog mar bon rnying ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa bru zhu gshen gsum dang / spa the'u khyung gsum gdung brgyud rgyal po drug ces par grags pa las/dang po rgyal rigs bru yi gdan sa snga ba yul la stod gtsang gi gram pa ga ra ngo mang gi bon gnas ni/spyi lo 990 skor bru chen nam g.yung gi dus na sngon du chags bzhin yod/ deng sang yan 'das lo dgu brgya dang brgyad cu skor song / rten gsum pho brang sogs legs rgyas su yod cing bru chen yab sras sogs bla rabs gsum bzhi la sgom grwa dang sgrub grwa rab tu dar na'ang phyis su rim par 'phos te med/ chos ma brag sprug sgrub grwa ni bru ston khyung rgyal gyis btsugs shing de dus dar rgyas gzi brjid che/ de bzhin dug gdong brag ri dang / shangs rdzong brag ri gnyis su'ang sgom grwa rje de nyid kyis btsugs/ smin grol dang nya mo smon dkar dge lding ni bru chen nam mkha' g.yung drung sku tshe smad kyi gdan sa ste/ bla rabs lnga drug la nya mo bor gnas zhes dar spyas che yang deng skabs ni bon lugs lo rim dus mchod gtong ba tsam las med/gtso bo bru yi gdan sa chen po gtsang g.yas ru ba gor dpen sa kha ni bru rje btsun g.yung drung bla mas rab byung dang po'i chu byi lor btab te da lta'i chu byi 'di yan lo dgu brgya song / grwa tshang gling bzhi gyes shing mtshan nyid dang gsang sngags zung 'brel gyi gtsang grwa sum stong nye ba'i gdan sa chen por gyur/ brgyud pa'i — 94 —

bstan 'dzin ni thog mar rje'i dbon sprul sku nyi ma rgyal mtshan nas sras nam mkha' rgyal sogs gdung rgyud rim byon dang / mkhas thub chen po mi gnyis/ 'gro mgon khu dbon/ bru rje sku mched nas rje mnyam med chen po yan la gdan sa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mkhas spub skyes bu tshen po bco brgyad tsam gyi ring bshad sgrub kyi mtsho chen po brdol te dar rgyas su gyur na'ang bar skabs su rkyen dbang gis/ 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrug ri brdol shing chus 'jig cing mi gnas par gyur mod/ 'on kyang de ma thag nas rgyal ba gnyis pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis (gyi lo 1406 )rab byung bdun pa'i rshang bya lor thob spyal gyi ri la dpal gshen bstan bkra shis snan ri'i dgon sde btab ste grwa tshang gling stod/ gling smad/ gling sked/ gling zur bzhi dang khang tshan grangs sogs sngon ji bzhin par mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar/ bslab pa gsum ldan dge btsun lnga baspya lhag skor re rgyun du bzhugs shing / gdan 'dzin rgyal tshab smra ba'i dbang byug rin chen rgyal mtshan bzung mkhan rabs gnyis skyes grangs ldan ring bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis dus 'da' zhing / rgyal rigs bu'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung ni srid rgyal drel nag can/ mi bdud rta ba dmar nag rgyal po shel khrab bcas yin cing sgrub tshogs kyang rgyun ma chad par spya che/ gdan sa 'og ma dpal gshen bstan rnam rgyal kun grags gling ngam/ rab legs g.yung drung gling ni gangs can rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab skyabs mgon snang ston rgyal mtshan gyis rab yid shing rta lor (spyi lo 1835 )btab ste grwa tshang g.yung drung gling / kun gsal gling / kun khyab gling / kun grags gling dang bzhi sogs la 'dus grwa bzhi brgya lhag re yod/ de yan rgyal rigs bru yi phrin las so/ /gnyis pa dmu rigs gshen gyi gdan sa sba ba g.yon ru'am ru lag lho yi gnas/ 'brim gnyan rtse gad mar gyi lha khang ni/ bstan pa phyi dar thog gshen dpal mgon zin las kyi dus (spyi lo 1060 )su bzhugs te 'das lo chig stong bcu lhag song / 'brim mtshams mang la rtse'i dgon ni sprul pa'i sku mchog gshen klu dga'i gter gnas yin te de dus gshen gyi bon sde chags shing slob ma bru zhu spa cog 'dzi rong mi nyag sogs 'dus sde 'chad nyan bshad sgrub dar rgyas su gyur te da lta yan mi lo dgu brgya lnga bcu tsam 'das/gtso bo gshen gyi gdan sa chen mo gtsang g.yas ru'i bzhed dpal ldan dar lding gser sgo khra mo'i gzhal med khang ni/ gshen kun mkhyen ye shes blo gros kyis (spyi lo 1233 )rab byung bzhi'i chu sbol lor phyag btabs mdzad nas lo bdun brgya lhag 'das/ 'dam snying g.yung drung dgon pa yan/ smad kyi gnam mtsho/bar gyi sra dwang / stod da rog dbal rong gyin byang rgyud dang / lho rgyud stod smad bcas la gshen bru gnyis kyi dgon lag drug cu skor yod par grags so/ /gsum pa dbang ldan zhu yi gdan sa lnga ba ru lag nyang stod skyed mkhar brag gi sgrub gnas ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo bor dbang ldan zhu g.yas legs po'i dus (spyi lo 1016 )nas sgrub sde tshugs te/ da lta'i bar lo dgu baspya lnga bcu lhag song / skyed mkhar re zhing rtsa phu bla brang gi bshad sgrub srol chen zhu skye se chen po dang / khyad par sras sgrol ba gshen rgyal gyis phyag btabs/ da lta'i bar mi lo dgu brgya 'das/ zhu — 95 —

yi gdan sa gtso bo dbang ldan lhun sgrub sgang ni sangs rgyas zhu chen gyis sku thog skor btsugs shing 'das lo brgyad brgya tsam song / sngar dar rgyas che zhing zhu bla khri gdung rim byon gyis bskyangs/ khyad par bstan la bka' drin che ba rtogs ldan shes rab 'bum/ shar chen rgyal mtshan thar/ skyabs ston rin chen 'od zer sogs ni dbang ldan gyi bstan pa la bka' drin che ba yin/ de ltar da lta'i bar brgyud pa'i zam ma chad par bzhugs/ de dbang ldan zhu yi ring lugs 'dzin pa kun mdo sngags yi dam sbyi nang kun dang khyad par byams pa rnam gnyis/ khro dpal gnyis/ stag phur/ ge khod/ spyi 'dul khyung dmar sogs dar ddhidro ṭwāṃb/ gaṭwāṃṭā / ṭwāṃṭwāṃ/ na/ga mi bdud/ a bse gsum dang / zhu'i btsan rgod bcas mchod bstod bzhi bamakhas thub me'u tshang gi gdan sa snga ba/ g.yas ru shangs gur zhog dgon pa ni rab byung dang po'i nang me'u ston lha ri gnyen pos btabs te lo dgu brgya lhag 'das/ deng sang ni gur zhog gi ri sdug der dgon shul che tsam las med kyang dgon sde stongs nas lo sum brgya las ma song / gtsang snye mo the'u gdan sa chen mo dpal ldan bzang po ri ni rab byung gnyis pa'i sked tsam na mkhas mchog tshul khrims dpal chen gyis phyag btabs te 'das lo brgyad brgya brgyad cu song / mkhas btsun stong phrag grangs 'dus phar phyin sogs mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa chen por gyur/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi sgrub mchod kyang rgya che/ de rjes gdan sa 'dzin skyong spa ston 'od gsal rgyal mtshan la gnang ste bla ma nyid shangs sman gong du phebs te bzhuskus/ spa ston zhal slob zhang ston ba thang ba dang / zhang ston bzang po dpal/ gzhan yang mkhas spub rgyal mtshan mchog legs/ rgyal mo rdong ba rong ston shes rab 'od zer sogs bstan 'dzin mkhas grub mang po byon te bstan rgyun da ltar ma nyams par bzhugs/ de rjes 'gro mgon gyi dbon dmar ston rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ sum ston 'dul ba blo gros/ mkhas btsun shes rab blo gros/ dmar ston grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs byon te dar lding dang bzang ri'i bzhed rgyun 'dzin pa'i bshad sgrub kyi 'dus sde chen po lo brgya phrag mang por gnas/ phyis su rim rgud kyis dgon gnas stongs par gyur/ de rgyun chags pa'i brgyud bon gyi rten gsum mchod khang yod pa'i grong khyim mtsho snya rgyal mtsho nang rnam gling rdor chos sogs shangs kyi stod sgad du 'ga' zhig deng sang yang 'dugalnga ba grub thob spa yi gdan sa phyi dar dus snga ba snye nam dwags kyi yang dben dang ('das lo 922skor)sngar gnas zhang zhung rnam rgyal lha rtse sogs la gdung rabs gong ma'i bzhugs gnas sgrub sde yod kyang phyis dus che bar yod par mngon/ de rjes gdan sa che ba la la stod lho'i la phug bde chen sgang ni rab bzhi'i nang skong spa ston rgyal ba shes rab kyi gong 'og gcig tu chags pa 'dra/ kha cig gi dpal ldan bzang po'i btabs kyang zer/ 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi bshad sgrub 'dus sde dar bar tshugs/ bla ma spa ston don grub 'bum bzang / dpal ldan bzang po sogs spa bla bzang po bcu gsum byon cing bstan pa daratram̐ sa ༵6/ tram̐dir stong rgyung phyag bzo a bse'i zhal 'bag sogs nang rten rtsa chin mang po yod/ hor

yulaye tha na spa dgon g.yung drung rab brtan gling ni spa ston g.yung drung nam bzang gis rab yid me lug lor btabs/ spa bla rim byon gyi bskyangs shing khyad par spa ston nyi ma 'bum gsal/ g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags khu dbon sogs kyi bstan 'phel gtsug lag khang rten gsum mchod rten mang po ri brag ltar phan chen bzhengs/ grub dbang shar rdza lugs kyi sgrub grwa bcas btsugs/ sgrub chen lo rim dang dus mchod sna mang bcas dar rgyas shin tu che bar yod/ spa tshang gi gdung rgyud gzhis bris rgyang gi ri la pad brag ri khrod du/ rten khang byin can dang mtshams bzhugs rgyun du yod/drug pa dam pa khyung gi gdan sa ni stod smad bar gsum la shin tu mang bas smos mi shes mod/ 'on te bstan pa phyi dar dus bar khams la chags pa'i dgon sde che ba gcig rgya bod mtshams rgyal mo rong lcags zam nye bar g.yung drung chos rgyal gling yin te gdan 'dir khyung po'i gdung 'khrungs skyes bu mkhas grub shin tu mang po bhon kyang mtshan thar thor las ma gsal/ de bzhin gyim shod stod smad du sngar lha sde 'ga' chags par mngon kyang deng sang de dag gi gnas lha khang nges par ma shes kyang / don du khyung dkar nag ser gsum gyi pho brang nyid dam de 'brel nye bar yod pa mngon gsal bzhin khyung dkar gdan sa brag dmar rir 'dun khyung nag gdan sa rtse drug ri khrod/ khyung ser gdan sa byang ze yong rdzong rnams ni snga dus bzi brjid dang byin rlabs che/ bar du nyag phra ba dar rgud sna tshogs byung deng skabs thams cad dar rgyas ngang yin/ de ste brag dmar ri 'dun nam rgyab ri snar shing gi bang nga bzos te mtshams khang mdzad pa nas bzung da lta'i bar nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ smon lam rgyal mtshan/ sbyin pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sogs bla rabs rim byung mthong grol ri khrod ces sgrub grwa lnga bcu lhag rgyun du gnas pa'i smin grol byin rlabs tshan khag phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i gzi brjid can 'dug rtse drug ri khrod ni sngar nas bzung sgrub phug rten gsum mtshams bla bcas rgyun du yod bzhin byis sangs rgyas gling pa'i dus sgrub sde chags shing sprul bla rim byon bstan pa dar rgyas che/ bya ze yang rdzong ni bsgrub gnas khyad 'phags yin la bar du sprul sku blo ldan snying bo phebs tshe/ yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs kyis phrin las sgrub cing rdzu 'phrul gyis brtsigs pa'i brag ri'i rtser gtsug lag khang bkod mtshar bshad mi shes pa dang rten byin can shin tu mang po yod/ gong sbos kyi dgon pa gsum po gcig tu bsgril te steng chen gyi thang stong rgyab ri'i 'byag rgyal gyi smad zhol 'bur sna zhes par dgon sde btabs/ de na dmag chen khyung yul du gnas te yul dmag dang 'thab skabs/ dmag 'ga' shas dgon par zhugs pa la snyad btags te yul dmag gis mer bsregs te dgon pa rten gsum bcas med par bzos/ steng chen yul dbus rten thang bkra ma zhes pa'i nang rten zhin tu rtsa chen mang po bzhugs/ lha khang de'ang yul dmag gis mer bsregs/ de rjes sbyang sprul tshe dbang bstan rgyal gyis kyang srid khyung seng sgar khong 'khrungs pa spyan drangs dgon pa rgyab ri 'byag rgyal mdun rtsar btabs te da bar dar rgyas su byung / dgon gsum gyi dang po chags nas deng yan mi lo sum brgya lhag skor nges song 'dra/ sgar khong sprul sku dang bdud 'dul sprul sku rirwa byo~X 7kyis skyong /

grwa gtsang sum brgya lnga bcu skor bzhugs/ bru yi lugs srol phyag len ma nor ba yod/ khyung po dkar legs dgon ni nam chags nges gsal ma rtogs rung rab byung bcu gcig pa'i skor yod cing lo sum brgya bzhi bcu nges song la/ khyung po yid bzhin rgyal ba sogs mkhas thub rim byon kyis bskyangs/ bar du gong ltar yul dmag gis me la bsregs/ deng zhag 'dus grwa sum brgya nye ba bzhugs pa'i khrims gtsang dar rgyas de ni/ gong shel zhig nyi ma bstan rgyal sku dus 'phel rgyas btsugs pa'i rnying gtsang gi dgon sde legs pa 'ig yin/ khyung po nag ru dgon pa yang de bzhin dar rgyas che tsam yod/ khyung po ko dgon ni sngon ko bo ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs kyis gdan sa yin min gang ltar yang / dgon rnying byin can de deng sang smon rgyal nam mkha' grags pa nyid kyis gzigs skyong ngang dar rgyas che/ gser tsha bkra shis gling ni chags snga ba'i bon rnying gi dgon sde dar rgyas che ba zhig yin la tshags bstan pa'i mgon pos dge lugs par bsgyur nas deng sang dge lugs dgon zhig yin/ de bzhin sgad sde dge nyag rong / a mdo stod smad/ rgyal mo rong sogs la khyung po'i gdan sa shin tu mang / de nas mdo stod sgad lho byang kun tu dgon sde shin tu mang ba re re nas nam chags 'debs mkhan sogs thos rtogs yod pa'i dgon sde ni/dang po byang gnam mtsho nas mar gsang ba g.yu rtse dgon/ ci 'chag gzhung dgon sogs dang / khyung po nas dmar la rta bon dgon/ sgrul shog mdo chen dgon sogs dang / sde dge shar rgyud du bla ma nam mkha' thog bzung gi gdan sa 'jing bla dbu dgon/ lcang lung dgon/ kha rag dgon/ nyag rong stod du rgya gzhis dgon pa khyung po bla khag gnyis/ mi nyag phyogs nyi ma dpon khongs 'du ra dgon/ dam pa rang grub dgon sogs dgon pa che chung brgya dang sum cu lhag dang / de nas shar rgyal mo rong sum pa gling gi gyim shod shod chen sbas pa'i bco brgyad du sngon rabs ston pa byon yul gshen rab lha khang zhes lha khang re la 'thab khang re gang sar du mang por btsugs nas/ rjes su zhang zhung dran pa nam mkha'i dreg pa bco brgyad la gling bco brgyad kyis dgon sdo gtso bo ni rab brtan du g.yung drung lha steng gling zhes bon gyi mtshan nyid dang gsang sngags zung 'brel bon gyi lte gnas zhig kyang phyis su dge lugs su bsgyur/ 'bar khams g.yu nga drung gling / rdzi 'gag steg 'khyil 'phan bur gling / khro skyabs mtsho mato nor bu gling /btsan lha bkra shis gling / 'og gzhi byams ma'i gling / brag steg dar rgyas gling / rtse mdo g.yung drung gling sogs dang / de min brag steg chu lung rnam rgyal lha rtse/ rong mi'i rgya mtsho dgon/ g.yung drung rong mi'i ri khrod/ po wam brag lha g.yung drung dgon/ dge bshes tsa wa lung dgon/ sba ra dgon/mda' mdo'i stag zung dgon/ yang khro skyabs su nyi shu sprul sku/ de'u sprul sku/ phu du sprul sku khag gsum gyiso sor bla brang dgon pa re yod/ cog tsa'i gdung brgyad tsha lung dgon/ dgon sar dgon/ 'bo la dgon/ so mang gun 'brog dgon/ a mdo phyogs su zung chu dga' mal g.yung drung dar rgyas gling /rkyang tshang phun tshogs dar rgyas gling / rkyang tshang nub grong dgon/ rkyang tshang shar ma'i dgon/ snang 'ig nd+rangu~X ༵ kaun/ rgya mdud dgon/ khri smin 'khor lo dgon/ skyid 'dzom chen dgon/ rin

spungs bkra shis smin grol gling / zung chu nag ri dgon/ chu stod a 'bel dgon/ shar dung ri dgon/rnga ba'i yul du/ rgya mdud snang zhig dgon/ phun tshogs dar rgyas gling la bshad grwa dang sgrub grwa gnyis ldan gyi 'dus grwa bdun brgya lhag tsam bzhugs/ bla ma ni snang zhig skyabs mgon nam mkha' blo gros/bstan pa rab rgyas/ nang chen sprul sku kun bzang bstan 'dzin/ rgya 'ob sku 'phreng rim byon/ dgon gong ma bya 'phur bla brang gi bla ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ dgon 'og ma'i bla ma shes rab blo ldan sogs/gzhan yang gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i bla ma rim byon rnams kyis dpal ldan sman ri ba'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis bstan pa skyongs/ da lta snang zhig gdung rabs 'di ni/ gnyan mkha' 'gying gi brgyud pa nges te/ mkha' 'gro'i brdas bstod pa las/ bon dbyings spros bral 'du ma byas pa'i ngang / /g.yo ba'i cho 'phrul mkha' 'gying lha mchog gi / mkhyen dang brtse ba'i thugs rjes byin rlabs sras/ / stag gzig gnyan rigs rgyal po'i thugs sras mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gnyan mkha' 'gying brgyud pa gnyan khyung rums rgyal ba/ de'i sras gnyan rje 'od gsal 'od ldan la sogs gdung rabs rim par byon pa'i/ tshe lo brgya pa'i ston pa gshin rab skabs su/ gnyan gyi rgyal po rig snang 'od rgyal bya ba de/ rtsal dang rdzu 'phrul che ba bstan 'gro'i don la sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i mdzis khye'u rnam bzhi zhang zhung gi kha yug me tog gi tshal du babs pa'i ming la/ chi ba khyung dkar thog la 'bar/ de'i 'og khyung ser lha khyung dang / de'i 'og khyung 'phags khra bo dang / de'i 'og khyung nag mu khyung rgyan zhes btags so/ /de bzhis zhang zhung gi yul chen bzhi la/ rin po che'i bla rdo re re dang / ma rtsigs pa'i sku mkhar re re dang / ma bskyil ba'i g.yu mtsho re re'i mnga' bdag byas nas gdung rgyud spel te/ de ltar sras bzhi'i 'bring po thang stag khyung 'phags khra mo tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pas zhang bod kyi rgyal rabs rim byon gyi bla yi mchod gnas mdzad pa'i mthar mdo smad rgyal mo rong du byon nas lha mo mdangs ldan ma khab tu bzhes/ de las bu 'bor g.yung drung bu bzhi grol te kun nas bstan pa spel/ sras bzhi'i chung ba khyung nag mu khyung rgyan gyi brgyud pa/ yab zhang zhung rgyal mtshan bde ba dang / yum rgyal bza' klong yangs gnyis las/ sras sad rna ga'u zhes bya ba sku stod rgod kyi gshog pa/ sku smad stag gi shams thab/ rked par 'phul yig bzhi bcu/ tshe la rang dbang thob pa zhig chu mo phag gi lor sku 'khrungs te/ 〈 legs bshad skal bzang 'grin spyan〉las/ sad nee ga'u zhang zhung sgo pa'i gshen/ /dwang ra gser ljong brag phug gnam skas 'dams/ /yab ni rgyal mtshan bde ba dang / /yum ni rgyal bza' klong yangs gnyis kyi sras/ /chu mo phag gi lo la sku 'khrungs shing / /zhang zhung mkhas pa se sad ni gu dang / /dpon gsas chen po a nu 'phrag thag sogs/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho lta bu'i thugs bcud blangs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ / mdo sngags rdzogs gsum gyi gzhung la blo gros rab tu yangs pa'i mkhas pa'i yang rtser son kyang / zhang zhung rgyal po lig mi rkyal bkrong ba'i shul du sde 'khrugs kyi rkyen gyis bon gshen rnams/ mkha' spyod mtha' 'khob 'dren pa'i dpal du shar ba'i tshe/ sad nee ga'u'i lung bstan ci bzhin du/ rgyud 'dzin stong rgyung ring mo rdang ḍi~X kau rdzu

'phrul gyis rma chen bom ra'i bkra shis lha sgang du byon nas bstan pa spel te zhig mo'i rnam thar las/ de rjes zhang zhung gshen gyi lugs ci bzhin/ / rma rgyal bom ra'i mdun du bstan pa chags/ / sngags 'chang zhwa nag phur thog 'dzin pa'i sde/ /chags med gzhol 'gro'i rgyun ltar bon la spyod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/rma rgyal bom ra'i mdun du sgrub pa mdzad cing bstan pa spel tshe/ bla ma zhu sgoms pa 'khrul zhig byon nas/rgyud 'dzin zhig po bco brgyad sogs bu slob rgyu skar gyi tshogs pa lta bu la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gdams ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba ste/ grub brnyes rig 'dzin gong ma'i zhal nas/bskal stong sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ / bstan pa'i dpal gyur zhu sgoms 'khyul zhig la/ /smin grol rgyud 'dzin zhig po bco brgyad byung / / 'gro don mthar gyin mdzad la su mi dad/ / ces so/ /dgu ba/ snang zhig gi lorgyus rags tsam/de'i skabs su sad de ga'u'i rnam rol sprul ba'i sku mchog dam pa snang zhig ces bya ba rus ming btags pazhig gis/ bla ma zhu sgoms 'khrul zhig gi zhal lung ji bzhin du lo dgur sgrub pa mdzad pa'i thub rtags du ma byung bas mtshan la 'khrul snang dbyings su zhig pa'i blo gros bzang ba bon gyi rgyal mtshan phyogs kun tu bsgrengs pa 'ong / zhes bsngags pas snang zhig blo gros rgyal mtshan gsol/ de dang nyi ma 'bum smad/nyi ma sgron gnyis la rab byung dang po'i sa 'brug lor sras 'khrungs/ ming la yon tan rgyal mtshan
