gsol/sras yon tan rgyal mtshan de nyid kyis 'dzam gling gnas chen kun tu zhabs bskyod de rig 'dzin du ma'i zhal mjal gdams ngag mang du gsan/ stod smad phyogs mtshams kyi gnas chen thams cad du sgrub pa mdzad/khyad par du dwang ri'i do gling du grub pa brnyes pas do 'phags zhes gsol/ rig 'dzin du mas ma 'ongs lung gis bsngags te/ gshen chen klu dga'i gter lung las/ de'i tshe 'chi med khod srungs rol ba'i gar/ / sprul sku do 'phags snang zhig chen por 'khrungs/ / shel la shel zhig 'bru la 'bru zhig gis/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skye dgu gtan bder bkod/ / ces dang / bla chen gyi zhal nas/ nga yis byin gyis rlabs pa'i sras/ /do nyid 'bum gyi mtshan can 'byung / /spyod pa brtul zhugs dgongs pa yis /gtso 'khor sprul nas bon bstan spel/ / zhes dang / lung bstan gsal byed 'khor lo las kyang / ma 'ongs bon bstan nyi 'od shar ba'i tshe/ /dbang ldan rma rgyal mdun du bstan pa chags/ / bstan sbyin a yi ming gis zhabs nas 'degs/ /mdo smad sprul sku snang zhig ces su grags/ /de'i rgyud 'dzin skyes chen phreng bstar bzhin/ / lha dang rgyud ngan bar chad gtan mi 'byung / / bstan 'gro'i phan bde don gnyis rlabs chen mdzad/ /ces gsungs bzhin/ shar rnga ba zung chu 'the bo sogs dang / byang reb kong chab cha chuhwa sogs dang / lho rgyal mo rong gi rgyal khag bco brgyad/ a mdo khri skor mang pos bstan sbyin byas nas bstan pa dar ro/ / de'i nang nas stod kyi snang zhig bar du brag zhig smad du g.yu 'ig snang zhig gtsor sba dang g.yu gsum gyi bon bstan spel lo/ /de nas mdo snad a ma zhig mo sgrub pa'i grogs su bsten te/ srid rgyal sprul ba rkyang za g.yu sgron nam a ma zhig mo/ mchod zhing dkyil du rma bya'i gdugs bu la — 100 —

bskor 'dra'i sa ru mi rgyab khyim pa'i sar gzigs nas khyim thab bzung / g.yon mdun du dngul gzhung dkyil du za bya 'dra ba'i sa dbyibs snyan grags g.yu 'brug dgung nas grags pa ltar/ sa bdag klu gnyan gtod sogs kyis mtha' nas skyor ba'i sa ru snang zhig rgyal bstan phun tshogs bla brang gi sar gzigs/de'i g.yas ri ye gshen sgang gi mdun du rin chen mand+ral zhungs 'dra'i steng du phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis g.yung drung gling gi dgon sar gzigs pa'o/ / de bzhin du do 'phags dang a ma zhig mo gnyis kyis khyim bzung bas sras gsum 'khrungs te/ che ba bya chen dang / 'bring lcags mdud/ chung ba dngul sku gsum byung bas/ mdo sgad stod smad bar gsum gyi dbu yi mchod gnas su gyur/ de yang bya chen nyi ma 'dzin gyis rab byung gnyis pa sa byi lor gong ltar yab do 'phags chen po'i gzigs dgongs bzhin dngul gzhung dkyil du snang zhig rgyal bstan phun tshogs bla brang bzhengs nas grub sde ser tshogs kyi gzhi bzung /la las phyis su ma dgon zhes/ la las spya tis dgon zhes kyang / don la rgya mdud dgon zhes grags/'bring po lcags mdud 'dul ba rgyal mtshan rnga stod smad du song nas grub sde ser tshogs kyi gzhi bzung ste bla brang bzhengs pa da lta a mchog khang dmar lha khang yin par grags/ chung ba dngul sku shar khog tu byon nas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ro/ / 'bring po lcags mdud kyang phyis su 'gro don shar khog tu che bar dgongs nas mthar der gshegs so/ / des na snang zhig do 'phags nas/ bya chen nyi ma 'dzin sogs gdung rabs shel dkar sgyu phreng ba ltar brgyud pa/ gdung rabs nyer bzhi ba snang 'ig tshul khrims dbang mchog dbus gtsang du phebs nas dbus kyi mkhan slob rnam gsum gyi mdun nas dag pa drang srong ngam bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa blangs nas phyir phebs te snang zhig rgyal bstan phun tshogs gling gi thub sde ser tshogs kyi sde la/ lha shes grong bon gyi sde dang / rab byung 'dul ba'i sde gnyis su phyes nas/ bon gyi 'du gnas so sor bgos/ bon sde shog khag bdun brgya lhag gi dbu bla ru bkur ste/ dus dus su sgrub mchod dang / dus mchod chen mo smon lam gyi srol btsugs/ de rjes do 'phags nas gdung rabs nyer dgu ba/ snang zhig rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ do 'phags chen po'i dgongs pa ba'in/ g.yas ri rin po che zhungs pa'i sa dbyibs mand+ral lta bu'i steng du phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis g.yung drung gling gi dgon sar dgongs nas gzigs mor byon tshe/ phyogs gang du bltas kyang chu ma mthong bar yar ye gshen sgang du snebs dus/ g.yon mdun nas klu mo zhig gis chu zangs zo gang bstan nas klu mo bgad nas khyed grwa tshang stong phrag lhag yod kyang chu bdag gis 'bul zhus nas/ sa 'og tu rub ma thag tu chu mig rang brdol du byung ba dang / 'brug grags shing char 'bab 'ja' shar ba sogs rten 'brel gang legs 'grigs so/ / sngon snang zhig rgyal bstan phun tshogs bla brang rab byung gnyis pa'i sa byi lor btabs pa'i spub sde ser tshogs kyi gzhi las gyes pa'i rab byung 'dul pa'i sde'i dgon gnas sasar spo mdzad/ mtshan la phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra rshas gling btags/ de rjes gdung rabs/ so sum pa g.yu nga drung bsngan pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba de nyid/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gser khri rnam ba'i'i ya gyal kung thang gserakhri rim rīo/— 101 ge—

che'i sangs rgyas sku 'dra rgya nag ma lus tshad gcig dang / gsung rten skal bzang gser bris ma/ thugs rten du bka' gdams mchod rten gyis gtsos srid 'byor gyi mchod sprin mi dman pas sna drangs gdan sar 'byon par gsol ba yang yang btab kyang dgon 'di'i khri 'dzin dang bon sde spyi'i dbu bla yin stabs 'byon par ma gnang na'ang / phyi nas snang zhig tshang dang gung thang sku rabs rnams da bar du phan tshun thugs nang shin tu mthun por gyur te/ 'tshams rtags dang 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba zab mo rgyun mi 'chad par yod/dam pa des ye gshen sgang du sku gdung mthong grol lha khang bzhengs/ de'i skabs su nang chen che ba rgya 'obs tshang dang kun bzang tshang gnyis las yod par ma grags/ mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud las/ snang la rig 'dzin rnam 'phul rje/ / lung rigs rtsod pa'i spyal mtshan phyar/ / gang mjal ngan song gtong mi srid/ / ces dang / rdo spub lung bstan las/ rnga ljongs dkyil du bon gyi bstan pa gnyis/ /bon po gcig tu mdo sngags bstan pa gnyis/ / sprul pa'i skuglu nam mkha'i mtshan can byung / / de dus bon gyi bstan pa yar la dar/ / de dang 'brel tshad ngan song gtong mi srid/ / ces gsungs pa sogs bon chos kyi lung bstan du mas mdun nas bsus te/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i bong bu zhes pa lcags mo yos kyi lor/yab skal bzang phun tshogs dang yum mo ba bza' bsod nams 'bum skyid ces bya ba dkon mchog gsum la dad gus che ba nor la sor sna med cing mchod sbyin la dga' ba gnyis la ngo mtshar gyi rtags du ma dang bcas te sras gcig 'khrungs so/ /de'i tshe g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ mkha' 'gying khyung gi gdung rgyud lnga/da ma shor/ / kun bzang gtso mchog thugs sras thang ma 'od/ / sad ni ga'u zhu sgoms byin rlabs bu/ / gar gshogs stag shams 'phrul yig bden rtags gsal/ / da ni nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'dren pa'i dpal/ / blo gros nyi ltar gsal ba'i sras gcig byon/ / nam mkha' blo gros mtshan yang de ring 'bul/ / bskal brgyar 'bas brtan don gnyis lhan grub shog / ces pa'i mtshan gsol bkra shis smon lam bden tshig brjod do/ / de ltar gdung rabs so lnga ba nam mkha' blo gros kyi sku ring la/ grwa tshang lnga brgya lhag tsam dang grwa shag brgya lhag tsam 'phel bas/ 'du khang yang ka ring brgyad can du bsgyur/ grwa tshang yang tshan khag bzhi ru bgos te/ shar dus 'khor grwa tshang / byang kun rig grwa tshang / nub sman pa grwa tshang / lho rnam rgyal grwa tshang zhes gling tshan bzhi byas/ dbu bzhugs nang chen re re dang spyi rdzas bca' yig bcas so sor bzhag de dus nang chen gong 'og bya 'phur gnyis dang / paṇa tsa bcas snang ston nam mkha' blo gros kyi slob chen gyur nas dgon pa'i nang du nang chen bzung mkhan/rgyal rong khro skyabs rgyal po'i dbu bla mdo sprul sku rin po che/ mchog rtse ba dbus phug sku zhabs dang / ja rong nam mkha'/ lcags mdud rin chen rnam rgyal/ rkyang nag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ dung ri nam mkha' bstan 'dzin/ mkhar yag shes rab/ reb kong sdong skam a lags/ rgyal rong mdo chen sprul sku lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ brag steg gi bla ma shes rab dbang rgyal/ rong mi'i dpon bla/ rtse dbus sprul sku/gser zhing sprul sku/ skyang sprul gyi yang sprul shes rab dbang rgyas sogs 'gro don dang bon bstan la nus pa — 102 —

yod pa brgya phrag las brgal sto/ /dbus nas mkhan po shes rab grags pa gdan drangs te/ bka' pod rnam lda'i rtsod grwa btsugs pa sogs rig 'dzin gong ma'i lung bzhin grub ste/ dran pa'i zur byang bka' rgya ma las/ mdo 'am rnga ba'i yul ljongs suḥ mu la'i mtshan gyis dge 'dun bsduḥ lung rigs rtsod ba'i gzhi ma 'deng0 zhes so/ /de rjes gdung rabs so brgyad pa skyabs mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyi sku ring la/ grwa tshang bdun brgya lhag tsam dang grwa shag nyis brgya lhag tsam 'phel bas 'du khang yang rgya che ru btang ste/ mdor na grub dbang nyi ma 'dzin gyis grub sde ser tshogs kyi gzhi 'am/ snang zhig ma dgon rshag/ sa na/ sa rab byung bcu drug pa'i7 stag lo yan chod du mi lo brgyad brgya bdun cu don dgu'i lo rgyus yod zhar byung bstan pa'i rtsa lag gyes tshul/ stod dbus gtsang gyi phyogs su snang zhig zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btabs pa'i ru lag g.yung drung gling ngam rnam rgyal kun grags gling zhes/ bar du khyung po dang rkong bu'i phyogs su snang zhig gi dge bshes gong skor tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis rtsod grwa btsugs pa'i dkar leb dgon pa/ yang snang ston nam mkha' blo gros kyi dngos slob dam pa dbus phug sku zhabasarin po ches bdag gir bzhes pa'i stag rtse'i ri khrod du 'du grwa brgya long tsam/ sde dge'i phyogs su snang zhig dngos slob stag zhig seng ge nyi mas btabs pa'i stag zhig dgon/ de la snang zhig gi mkhan zur tshul khrims bstan 'dzin gyis sgrig lam dang phyag len snang zhig dang 'dra bar byas/ rnga smad cog lu'i dgon rnam rgyal bsam gtan gling zhes grags/ de la snang zhig gi gzhis ka dang bla brang lha sde bcasayod/ mchog rtse tsha lung phyogs su snang zhig gi dngos slob ja rong nyi mas bdag gir byas pa'i tsha lung dgon pa stag lung bdud 'dul gling zhes 'dus grwa brgya lhag tsam dang gshen tshang gi sman rgyud ma nyams pa yod/ 'bar khams phyogs su snang zhig gi dngos slob bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang tshul khrims mthar phyin gnyis kyis bdag gir bzhes pa'i 'bol la stobs ldan gling chen dgon zhes/ so mang la kun 'brog g.yung drung gling zhes/snang zhig gi rtogs ldan kun gsal tshul khrims kyis bdag gir byas pa'i snang zhig grub sder gyur/ der mazad maro smad zung chu'i phyogs dang co rna/ mtsho sngon khri gshog rgyal mo'i nye 'gram du kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btabs pa'i dung dkar smin grol sogs bon gyi 'dul ba bzhin spyod cing rgyal ba sman ri ba'i ring lugs skyong bzhin yod do/ / bcu ba/ rtogs ldan dgon gyi lorghas rags tsam/rtogs ldan smin grol bkra shis 'khyil du bslab pa gsum ldan 'dus grwa sum brgya las mi dman pa/dgon 'dzin pa'i bla ma thog mar bon slob rin po che zhes pa dang / skyabs mgon bsod nams phun tshogs/skyabs mchog tshul khrims ye shes/ rtogs ldan g.yung drung tshul khrims/ yongs 'dzin yon tan rgya mtsho/mkhas chen tshul khrims bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bstan 'dzin 'chi med dbang po/ tshul chen yang srid theg mchog bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho/ bon slob nam mkha' 1dī~Xn ḍidzin/

yongs 'dzin bzod pa spyal mtshan/ dge bshes nges don mthong ba don yod sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu du mas sgrub grwa'i srol btsugs te bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bon bstan dar rgyas suspel bzhin mchis/ gzhan yang tshab lung stag 7nga dgon/ gdung legs dgon/ se zhig dgon/a mdo phan chu nang / mdo chen dkar mo dgon zhes rkyang sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa yin/'dus grwa bdun brgya lhag yod pas dar rgyas che/ a skyid rkyang tshang dgon/ stag ra chags ri dgon/spyal rong rab brtan dgon/ yang rong chen bzhi'i ya gyal snyi stag rong gi sa yi dzig ler reb gong gser mo smongs su/ gsang sngags kyi spub sde dang mdo sngags gang rung gi dgon sde chags tshul ni/ bod du glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes/ zhang zhung sgo ba khyung po'i yul nas dbal ram 'bum pa'i bskyed rdzogs la mnga' brnyes pa'i grub pa'i khyu mchog gyi steng 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ ngo bo ye shes cha tsho rgyal/ khyung po khyung dkar tshangs pa gsum/ gser dzongs stod kyi sa 'bal tsha'i nyag dmar sna zhes par byon nas/snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ste dbal ram 'bum pa'i bskyed rim bzhugs nas/ yul khams kyi klu bdud btsan gsum dam la btags/ brgyud 'dzin sngags 'chang phur thog stong dang dgu brgya 'byon pa'i rten 'brel byung / de'i rgyud 'dzin la/ yar nang bon sde khag gsum zhes/ bon brgyad/ dmag gsar ldong de gsum byung / mar nang bon sde khag gsum zhes/ bon tshang/ ba lung / lho ba gsum byung / gzhan yang phyi rting khag gsum/ ngo mo/ khyung po/ la rting gnyis/ gling brgya'i bon tshang /the bu'i bon tshang / zho 'ong nyin tha/ dar grong / stong chen/ hor nag gyang ri sogs gsang sngags kyi skrub sde mang du byung / sbyis su grong bar gyur kyang / sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i srol ma nyams pa gnas pas reb gong bon sde bco lnga la lha khang chen mo re re yod/ dgon sde khyi rting kun khyab g.yung drung gling zhes dang /da dung reb gong yul du grags che ba'i sgrub gnas brgyad kyi nang tshan/ dran pa nam mkha'i sgrub gnas byin can yod de/ ji skad du/ byang phyogs gong mo gur khang na/ /bon ston dran pa nam mkha' grub/ /ces kyang yongs su grags so/ / mcho sngon khri gshog rgyal mo'i nye 'gram du/ rtse zhig stong nyid bya 'phur gyi yang srid/ rong chung zhabs drung bstan 'dzin g.yung drung gyis btabs pa'i dung dkar smin grol gling du/khong gi thugs bskyed dang rkyang ston lung rtogs skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zin las kyis 'dul ba'i sde rnam par dag pa byung ste rgyal rong tsha kho'i dge bshes rnam gnyis kyis dpon slob mdzad/ snang zhig kun bzang rin po che'i yang srid bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis bdag gir mdzad de bstan srol legs par bskyang bzhin yod/ de nas rgya nag glang chen 'gying rir tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sgrub gnas/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo che'i bzhugs gnas/ (rgya skad du wan nyan zer)dgon chen du snang ston zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi rnam rol mchog gi sku dmar gdung bzhugs/ phyis mkhan chen shes rab blo ldan rgya nag du phebs skabs bdun zhag cig bzhugs shing sgrub 'brel dang gnas 'dzin mdzad/ rgya yig bod yig 'brel ba'i deb yig dang /rdo la brkos pa'i yi ge bcas yod/ ri de'i mgo la tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi lha khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad yod/— 104 —

bka' rtags rang byon mang zhig dang / de na bod kyi grwa ba rgya dang mthun pa thar thor bzhugs/ bla ma zla ba rgyal mtshan dang g.yung gling zhes/ de phyogs rgya mi rnams kyis brjod shes pa bcas yod/yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ bod spyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa cung tsam bsnubs rjes/rma dbyil sogs gter ston rig 'dzin du mas/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i sgron me sbar te/ stod na bru zhu spar rma gshen dang lnga/ bar na khyung pho dkar nag ser dang gsum/ smad du zhig po bco brgyad dang / 'phags pa rnam gsum sogs mkhas pa'i gdan rabs dang / grub pa'i gdung rabs zung 'brel gyi sgo nas/ stod na zhang zhung dang bar na bod yul smad na rgya nag sogs rgya bod hor gsum phyogs kun tu g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas so/ /bcu gcig zhig po bya ba'i don/de yang mdo smad spyal rong la stod kyi snang zhig bar du brag zhig smad du g.yu zhig zhes gig po bco brgyad kyi nang tshan spa tshang dgon gsar nor bu gling gi chags rim rags tsam bshad na/ thog mar spa tshang gi gdung rabs grol tshul ni/ a sangs sngon gyi dus nas/ 'od gsal lha las babs pa sangs pho 'bum khri dang / chu lcam rgyal mo gnyis kyi gdung las grol ba'i khye'u spa la mdzes pa zhig steng sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su babs ste/ lha rnams la bon gyi 'khor lo bskor/ de nas lho gling zhang zhung gi yul du g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa spel bar dbongs te/ zhang zhung rnam rgyal lha rtse bya bar babs/ sprul ba dang rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan de nas te se gangs kyi shel phug tu byon nas lo gsum la sgrub pa mdzad pas/yi dam mgon po rnam gsum dang dbyer med du gyur te/ khri smon lcags kyi bya ru can zhes grags so/ /de'i dus su/ sa la 'ang zhung rgyal po dbang che/ / gnam la lha bu spa ba gzugs mdzes/ / zhes sogs gleng ba byung / grub thob spa tshang grags pa de nas byung ste/ dam pa de las spa tshang gi gdung rabs mu tig gi phreng ba ltar byon pa rnams/ zhang zhung dang bod rgyal rim byon gyis bla ru bkur zhing / bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su/ bla yi mchod gnas su ci khroms dkar por bzhugs/ de'i rjes bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su/ spa ston dpal mchog rgyal ba snyon nas/ bla ma gshen chen po dgongs rdzogs khar mjal nas/ khyod gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag po 'ong gi gsungs te/ khro bo dbang chen la sogs gsang sngags kyi bon sde mang po shog dril dbang lung cha lag dam thos bcas gnang nas/ zhib pa 'ji ston la zhus gsungs/ spa ston gyis kyang de bzhin dgon long du byon nas/ 'ji ston dbang gi rgyal mtshan bla mar bsten te/ zhi ba'i don skor 'grel dang bcas pa dang / 'chi med gtsug dang man chad nas/mkhas pa mi bzhi yan chad gyi rig 'dzin rnams kyi phud gta' snan phabs dang / gar mdud bse yi ga'u yan chad/ pha nor bu la gtad pa bzhin gnang ba'i rnam thar rgyas pa gzhaspro du gsal la/ de'i sku sras spa ston dar ma ni/ khu bo'i mdun nas khro bo dbang chen sogs sngags phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sngags gyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ spa ston dar ma'i sku sras/ spa ston khyung 'bar/ de'i slob mched gyur pa — 105 —

zhig po kun rtse/ de dang khyung 'bar zung slob khro chu 'bar ba/ de'i slob mched gcung sangs rgyas spyal dang bzhi/ bla ma de bzhi sku mched du byon nas/ zhig po kun rtse zur ru bzhugs/ gzhan gsum lhan du bzhugs/ khyung 'bar sogs la sras bdun byon pa'i nang tshan/ sangs rgyas g.yang 'bum gyi sras rgyud mi rabs nyung shas song rjes/ spa ston mkhas grub nam mkha' bzang po/ dpal chen bzang po/ rin chen dpal bzang / g.yung drung dpal bzang sogs bzang po bzhi dang / zhig po kun rtse'i sras khyud/spa ston don 'grub 'bum bzang / dpal ldan bzang po/ nyi dpal bzang po/ bla rgyal bzang po/stobs chen bzang po/ bsnan rgyal bzang po/ de yang bstan rgyal bzang po ni skye ba grangs med du tshogs bsags shing spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad mngon du gyur pa zhig lags te/ dang po thos bsam sgom gsum spub par zhugs nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa'i dar chen btsugs pa'i rnam thar skye rgu yongs kyi rna ba'i bcud dutshochags pa bzhin no/ / de'i dbon po dpal mchog bzang po dang /dpal 'bar bzang po gnyis sku mched du byon/ de'i sras lhun grub dpal bzang sogs/ bzang po bcu gsum song rjes stong ba phug tu spa tshang gi gdung rgyud phra bar song ste/ gdung 'dzin 'ga' zhig mdo smad rgyal rong du 'ong ba'i rgyud pa spa ston g.yung drung rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas/ spa tshang dgon gsar nor bu gling 'di btabs/ snang zhig gi bla rabs rim byon dang phan tshun 'brel ba yod pas gong bsgrigs mi lo sum brgya'i gong nas yod par nges pa rnyed/ de na spa tshang gi bla rabs dang / snang zhig gi bla rabs rnams phyi ma phyi ma nas 'brel ba je zab tu song bas/ spa tshang gi dgon 'go snang zhig tshang la 'bul zhing snang zhig ni spa tshang gi bla rabs rnams kyi dbu blar gyur/ snang zhig ma dgon nas spa tshang gi bla rabs rnams la sger thob tu dbang ba'i gzim khang zhig gnang bar spa tshang gzim khang zhes grags pa da lta yang yod do/ /rjes su snang ston bstan pa rab rgyas kyi sku ring la/ snang zhig gi gdung rabs su byon pa'i nam mkha' rin chen spa tshang dgon pa'i bdag por bskul te/ 'gyur med gsor gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol zhing khong gis bdag gir bzung / de'i dus na bstan pa dar tshul dang 'grig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa bcas gang ltar yin pa rgan rim rnams kyi thugs la yod pa bzhin no/ /bcu gnyis/ 'barakhams g.yung drung glinganasnyigs ma lnga bdos mun pa'i gling chen du/ / mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab sbar bas/ / skal ldan thar ba'i go skabs 'byed pa'i bshes/ /rgyal ba mnyam med yab sras rnams la 'dud/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas bshad pa dam bcas te gang gi gleng mol bstan pa ni/ bon dgon 'bar khams g.yung drung gling zhes thog mar btags pa'i ming gi rnam gzhag lung rigs chu shel dbang po'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi dngos don rnam pa mthong thos 'ga' zhig bshad na/ lung brtsan gshen bon srol 'byed ston pa gshen rab mi bo tshe byon nas mdzad 'phrin dang / mang ldom stag btsan gnas ri'i btsan mkhar mdun du gshen bstan dar tshul de 'dzin skyes bu dam pa'i gdung brgyud zhig po bco brgyad las grol tshul lo/ /— 106 —

da lta tshe lo brgya yi skabs 'dir/ yul gshen yul stag gzig 'ol mo lung ring gling du yab dmu rigs rgyal po thod dkar dang yum yo phyi rgyal bzhad ma'i sras/ ston pa gsal ba gshen rab mi bo che byon te mdzad bskyangs log pa'i bdud thams cad btul/ bon gyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bstan pa spel sdulha// g.yung drung bon gyi sgron me btsugs nas/ gangs can bod kyi mun pa thog mar gsal ba'i sgron me gnyis pa mang ldom stag btsan gnas ri btsan mkhar mdun du gshen bstan de las zhig po bco brgyad zhes pa'i ya gyal mdo smad du khro zhig dang / g.yu zhig bha zhig snang zhig spa zhig de lnga'o/ / de yang bru lugs dang / gshen lugs/ spa lugs/ rma lugs/ zhu lugs zhes grub mtha'i lta ba yang lnga yod pas/ stod la snang zhig bar la bha zhig dang / grag zhig smad la g.yu zhig ni 'bar khams g.yu dge khag gnyis zhes yongs su grags pa de la lo rgyus kyang lo sum stong brgyad brgya lhag yod par snang / deng sang yang krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid 'og rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang rigs rang skyong khul gyi gnas gzhi ste 'bar khams zhes yongs grags chen po'i grong khyer 'di yin no/ /snga rabs 'bar khams g.yung drung gling zhes g.yu zhig bla ma khri rgan gyi gdan sa bla brang dang dge 'dun 'du khang chen po yod pa dang / btsan mkhar brag dmar rtsa la bon bla grags can bcu phrag gi ri khrod dang sku gdung mchod rten rnams bzhugs/ dgon de zung chu tshun chad lun khron yan chod dang rdzi 'gag cog tse sogs kyi rtsa rlung thig gsum phyag len ma lus pa lo gsum chos gsum grwa sa zhu sa'i dgon chen zhig yin pas/brag dmar de'i nang bka' rtags gsal ba dgu 'dzab zhes gter sbas bzhugs zer srol yod/ de min lo gsum la bon gyi theg pa rim dgu nyams su blangs nas/ de yang phywa gshen dang / snang gshen/'phrul gshen/ srid gshen te rgyu'i theg pa bzhi'o/ / gzhung don la rgyu'i theg pa bzhi yi 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyu dang gsum/ thog mar yul mchog gnas bzhir skyabs su 'gro/ gzhan phan byang chub sems dang ldan pa yi/ rgyu ni bslab byar mkhas shing dad pa dang kun phan lhag bsam snying rje la 'jug ste rgyu yi bon rnams gzhung don so sor bya'o/ / rig pa khu byug gi gsung las/ phywa gshen mo la sgrogs pa'i khu byug kyang / / gto dpyad mtshan ma med de cir mi dmigs/ / snang gshen gyer la sgrogs pa'i khu byug kyang / /gyer sgo mtshan ma med de cir mi dmigs/ /'phul gshen mthu dbang sgrogs pa'i khu byug kyang / / dzu 'phrul mtshan ma med pa'i cir mi dmigs/ / srid gshen 'dur la sgrogs pa'i khu byug kyang / /'dun spyod mtshan ma med de cir mi dmigs/ /rtsa rgyud gsang ba bsen thub las/ rang rang lta ba'i lugs kyi rta la zhon/ /'khor ba'i sa las yang gong gnas su 'degs/ : btegs nas theg pas yang dag sa ru skebs/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i don rgyud las/rgyu cibon bzhi chab nag rgyud/ /gzung 'dzin rtogs pa cha bzhi spang / / zhes dang / srid gshen theg pa'i mdorṣa sa kyang / mthar yang don dang 'bras bu ni/ khams gsum sa dgu yar brgal na7/ /cho sa par spyodardzo' sa la gnas/ /zhes — 107 —

so/ / des na 'di dag snyi rol mu stegs dang lha mi gzhan brten pa'i theg pa las khyad du 'phags pas/dkon mchog skyabs gsol byang chub sems bskyed pas rgyu 'bras theg pa chen po'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ /gshen klu dga'i gter slob gra nas/ grub thob spa yi lugs/ dam pa gshen gyi lugs/ rgyal sras zhu yi lugs/ mkhas pa the'u'i lugs/ mkhas chen bru yi lugs/ 'di rnams bon rnying gi gtsug rgyan spyi rje lta bu yin no/ /de'i nang nas deng dus bar ma nyams pa sra brtan yod pa de/ bru dang gshen gnyis yin no/ / gzhan yang yul lugs la/ hor mu khri'i lugs/ dkar ru yid bzhin lugs/ mdo smad spyang sprul lugs/ dge bshes nang so'i lugs sogs mang ngo/ / de min gsar bon zhes sangs rgyas gling ba byang chub rdo rje'i lugs/ mi shig rdo rje gter ston gling pa'i lugs/ kun grol 'ja' tshon snying bo'i lugs sogs dang / phyis su nyag gter gsang sngags gling ba'i/ yig cha sngags chog sogs bon rnying dang 'dra min ci rigs yod/ 'di'i sngags chog rnams kyi brgyud pa'i gtso bo sku gsum sangs rgyas/dran pa yab sras gsum yin zhing / de yab dran pa nam mkha'/ yum 'od ldan 'bar ma/ sras tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang padma mthong grol yin/ phyag len gyi srol rnying ma dang mtshungs pa mang ngo /gsum pa de 'dzin skyes bu dam pa'i gdung brgyud zhig po bco brgyad las grol tshul ni/ zhang zhung bon skor bsgrags gsum brgyud pa/ kun bzang gshen lha la sogs dgongs pa'i brgyud tshul/ zhang zhung brag dmar rin chen spungs ba'i khrod/ / bsgrubs pas mchog sku phyag rgya chen por rpāzhud/ / de slob slob dpon gsang ba 'dus pa rje/ / klong chen dgongs brdol zhang zhung bye ma la/ / mi 'gyur dum pa tshal gyi sgrub gnas su/ /bsgrubs pas phung po lhag med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de slob zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen ni/ / yar 'brog ra dmar ri yi gong du bsgrub/ / don dgu dpe dang sbyar te se la bshad/ / se bon mkhas pa sha ri dbu chen gyis/ /zhang zhung dngul mkhar khrod du bsgrub pa mdzad/ /theg brgyad rdzogs chen klong grol man ngag gdams/ /mi nyag nee rgyung lce tsha mkhar bu yis/ /mang mkhar bon gyi gnas chen phug tu bsgrub/ / lta spyod zung 'brel rdzogs chen klong la bzlas/ / lde bon mkhas pa gyim rtsa rma chung gis/ /sum pa glang gi gyim shod gnas su bsgrub/ / de rjes khams su byon khar dmar byang gis/ / gdams pa yang yang ngo sprod gnang mdzad de/ /'khrul zhig khams byon mi chos slog rul bzhin/ / rgyab tu bskyur pa g.yu zhig ni/ / yul ni rtse gangs ring mo bya ba ru/ / yab ni g.yu la mes po mkha' yi sras/ / dgung lo dgu dus zhang bos 'bri klog bslab/ /bcom ldan khro bor dbang chen zhi rgyas mkhyen/ /rgyud lde mang gsan bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad/ /dgung lo nyer gcig rdzogs chen lung drug gsan/ /nyams bzhes drod rtags nyams rtogs legs pa'i dus/ / 'khrul zhig ldom bu'i snyan thos drung du phyin/ / gshen sgom gdams pa gzhan la med de zhu/ / byas pas rtse gcig sangs rgyas gdams pa ni/ / kun la yod pa de las nga la'ang med/ /gsungs te gdams pa gnang bzhin dbang bskur mdzad/ /yengs med rtse gcig bsgom pas thub pa thob/ / rgyal mo rong byon brag dmar tu bzhugs te/ / theg chen don gyi — 108 —

bka' 'khor rgya chen bskor/ /zhal slob rnal 'byor rtogs ldan mang du tshar/ /rgyal mo rong byon dam pa g.yu zhig des/ /gdung rgyud ma nyams g.yu dge khag gnyis byung / /de nas g.yu dge dkar nag zhes su grags/ / bon gyi theg dgu'i rgyu 'bras khyad par gyis/ / phar ngos de la g.yu dge nag po zhes/ / tshur ngos de la g.yu dge dkar po grags/ /g.yu zhig bon bla khri rgan nas bzung ste/ /brgyud 'dzin ma nyams phreng sgrig lta bur byung / / khyad par bon bla khri ba bzang po de/ / man chen gong ma'i dbu yi bla ru gyur/ /'gan sru si yi cho lo go sar gnang / /thob nas bon srid nyis skyongs mkhan du grags/ /bod kyi rab byung drug pa me bya lor/ /gshen nyi rgyal mtshan 'bar khams 'dir byon nas/ /ma 'ongs pa na chu 'jig yod par dgongs/ / so mang dpal thang 'bar khams dgon mtha' ru/ / mchod rten rnam gsum bzhengs pa'i nang bzhugs su/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i na bza' dang / /khong gi zhabs lham la sogs bzhugs su gsol/ / g.yu zhig dang ni rab brtan rgyal po yis/ / dbu yi bla ma mchod pa'i gnas su bzhugs/ / zang zing gis ni dpal 'byor mang du phul/ / rgyal mo rong gi dam pa g.yu zhig gyis/ / de slob mtshan ldan 'aspu zhig kun dga' ni/ /yab ni go gol lha bon dbang zhes dang / /yum ni beer bza' a 'beel gnyis sras 'khrungs/ / lo ngo dgu nas yab las dbang khrid thob/ / de bzhin mkhas grub skyes bu mang bsten nas/ / gdams pa zhu shing sgom sgrub nyams len bskyangs/ / dmar byang mchog gi gdam pa zhus gnang nas/ / kun dga' zhig por mtshan btags yar phebs shing / / rma stod sku bla g.yu rtser bka' 'khor bskor/ /smin grol bstan pa'i sa bon mchog tu btsugs/ /mchog gsum lha dang srung ma'i nus mthu dang / /sman g.yung mkhar gsum bla ma'i thugs rje yi/ /nad mug dus 'khrugs sdug bsngal kun zhi nas/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med klong du sangs rgyas shog /gsungs nas tshe mthar bde chen dbyings su gshegs/ /de rjes g.yu zhig bon bla g.yung drung rgyal mtshan ni/ /sgan g.yung mkhar gsum grwa sa 'byon pa'i skabs/ / g.yu zhig bon bla g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dang / / gser khri mnga' gsol blo bzang lhun 'grub gnyis/ / ban bon bstan pa mnyam chags 'bar khams su/ / gros mol mthun pa'i dam tshig 'gal med byas/ / de nas g.yung drung rgyal mtshan mar du phebs/ / skya ser kun 'dus gros byas gsal por gsungs/ /lha sa'i bka' gros rgyal rong long mi 'os/ /zhes pa'i khas len ma byas dam tshig 'gal/ /g.yu bla 'u thug yar la yi ge phul/ / yi ger gzigs tshe gser khri'i thugs ma rangs/ / da ltar ma grub ma 'ongs thugs dgongs su/ / spyal sras skye ba bzhes pa'i smon lam mdzad/ /yul ni rgyal mo tsha rong bya ba ru/ /yab ni cog tse'i spyal po bkra shis 'bum/ / yum ni rin chen dbang mo gnyis kyi sras/ / dgung lo bdun nas 'bri klog phul du byung / /bcu drug se 'bras dge dgon grwa sar byon/ /lo rim bzhin du mdo sngags nyams su blangs/ /de bzhin mkhas sgrub skyes bu mang bsten nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad/ / dge ldan gser khri'i yang sprul ngos 'dzin nas/ / mkhyen rab bstan pa'i rgya mtsho mtshan gsol lo/ / rgyal mo rong gi dgon chen lha steng du/ / mkhan po byon nas dgon pa'i bdag — 109 —

por bzhugs/ /rgyal khag bco brgyad dbu yi bla ru gyur/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing slob ma mang du 'phel/ /lo'anar dzes su grwa dmag phud nas 'ongs/ / gcig stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya lnga dang / / rab byung bco lnga shing mo bya yi lor/ / dan cab khan to'u byang ba'i dmag 'go khrid/ / 'bar khams g.yung drung gling ni dmag gis bcoms/ / bon gyi grwa ba mang po mtha' ru sprugs/ / khri ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan bros byol lo/ /khri spyang bla khag kun gyi rgyal tshab mdzad/ /de nas 'bar khams g.yung drung gling dgon ni/ /dge lugs bsgyur nas dge ldan dar rgyas gling / khri 'don byed pa'i rgyud bla 'ga' ri ni/ / sku nar ma son sku gegs gshegs pa mang / /ci'i phyir zhe na bon srung phog thug shor/ /rje btsun bla ma'i lung bstan gsungs pa las/ /bon srung srid pa'i rgyal mo bstan srung bkod/ /de nas bzung ste da bar dge bstan 'phel/ /dgon 'dis zhi ba'i bcing 'grol ram 'degs che/ /de phyir tang gis srung bskyobs byas pa'i dgon/ / bar skabs mi bzhi'i shog khag sprin nag gis/ / kun dang 'dra ba'i chag sgo rab tu byung / /'on kyang krung u tshang 'dzoms bcu gcig pa'i/ /thengs de gsum pa'i byed phyogs srid jus drin/ /sngar las lhag pa'i rdzong yongs dgon par gyur/ /gzhan yang masgon rab bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /lcam sring de ni dme tshang bdag mor bzhes/ /de nas bzung ste dme rgyal cher grags pa'i/ /a zhang cog tse'i yang zhang rdzi 'gag 'bod/ /tsha khos dmag phud zhes pa'i 'jigs skul las/ /'brog sde mang po kho bos dbang du bsdus/ /bcu gsum/ zung chu'i bya dur dga' mal dgon/zung chu bya dur ba'i gnas mdun du dpal gshen bstan dga' mal kun khyab bde chen gling zhes bstan pa dar tshul gyi lo rgyus sam dkar chag don btus te 'chad parabya ba ni/ thog mar bstan pa 'di nyid ji ltar lung gis grub tshul dang / gnyis pa bstan pa'i dbu brnyes te ji ltar byung tshul dang /gsum pa bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu'i rnam thar mdo bstan no/ / dang bo la'ang gnyis te/ gnas ri khyad par can 'di nyid lung gis grub tshul/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa 'di nas dar ba'i smon lam lung gis zin tshul lo/ / dang bo la gsum te/ ngo bo nges tshig ngos bzung ngo / / ngo bo ni ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha gsang mchog mthar thug spyal po'i gnas chen sum brgya drug cu'i nang tshan/ de yang ma rgyud sangs rgyas rgyud las/ 'og min gnas chen brgya dang nyi shu/ dga' ldan gnas chen nyi shu/ 'dzam gling gnas chen brgya dang nyi shu/ nang tshan rgya nag gong ma'i mkha' 'gro 'ug gdong lnga'i byang phyogs mkha' 'gro 'ug gdong zhes pas/ ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi ri bo lhun po grub pa'i dbyibs su mdzes shing ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bka' rtags yod pa bon gshen rig 'dzin spub chen brgyad cu'am/ brgya rtsa'i sgrub gnas dang phyag zhabs rjes rdzu 'phrul gyi sprul ba'i bya gcan ri g.yung gi rjes sogs yig 'bru g.yung drung grangs med kyis bkra la gsal ba rnams mjal rgyu yod pa ste sangs rgyas lung gis mngon sumatram̐ spu~X1 ༵/ —nges tshig ni zung chu byu dur gnas ri zhes pa'i don ni/ zung chu zhes pa'i gtan tshig

gang zhe na/ rig 'dzin thub chen brgyad cu nang gi mthu chen mi dgu'i gras su/ rgya bon zung ba mthu chen gyis gter chu klu mo dung skyong dkar mo'i gter bdag bkod pa'i zung chu dkar mo ru grags/ chu mdog dwangs pa shel dkar ltar spub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis chu mig dkar mo ru 'bod/ gong gi lung de bya dur dkar chag las so/ / bya dur zhes pa ste gnas ri'i rtse la bya rgod sogs rgyun du lding bskor byed pa ma rgyud dur khrod kyi dur bya'am bya yi dur khrod yod pa'i gtan tshig go / gnas ri zhes pa'i don de ma mkha' 'gro 'du gnas yin pa/ blo rig 'dzin 'phags grub rnams dben ri sgrub gnas mdzad pa'i gsang phug mang bas rgyu mtshan no/ / de yang gnas ri'i bka' rtags dang thog ma ri 'di gnas ri yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ bya dur dkar chag dwangs 'dren las/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten las thugs rten yin te/sngon tshe tshe lo brgya yi ston pa rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo che de nyid gyis rnam par 'dul mdzad ston skabs/ ston pa'i sku yi 'od zer gyi stong gsum 'jig rten phyogs bcur 'phros nas/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog tshad sems can dpag tu med pa sangs rgyas/ bdud srin mu stegs 'jig rten dreg pa can thams cad la 'od zer phog tshad tshar bcad de gdug tsub zhi nas dga' bde byams sems ngang la gnas/ sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing sogs 'byung ba lnga la phog tshad byin gyis brlabs te gnas ri sogs dzu 'phrul bka' rtags grangs med du gyur nas stong gsum bde zhing du bkod zhes byung / de yang sngon tshe skyang 'phags kyis bya dur ba'i gnas sgo ma phyes gong rol dus/ ri brag g.ya' spang nags tshal gyi tshang tshing gtum la 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas bdag btsan pa'i gcan gzan mang ba/ rgya stag khra mo mi zan gzan pa sogs yod pa'i lo rgyus yod kyang phyis su spyang sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis rgya stag dam la btags te brda rtags su mtha' sngon brag la stag gi spar rjes mthong rgyu yod/ gnas sgo ma phyes sngon na bka' rtags dzu 'phrul rjes bzhag sogs yod kyang rgyu mtshan rnyed mi thub gter srung gis gnas bdag byas/gter ston skyang 'phags kyis gnas sgo phyes pa'i bskor lam phyi nang gnyis dod nas byin gyis brlabs te gsang phug dang bka' rtags yig 'bru g.yung drung sogs rang shugs kyi che 'phags mig lam du gsal/dkar chag yi ger bris nas 'gro 'dren khyad par can gyi gnas ri yin pas lo rgyus su shes so/ / bya dur gnas ri 'di kun gyis mos gus bskyed pa'i tshogs bsags sgrib sbyongs byas na byin rlabs kyis mi mthun rgud tshogs zhi zhing 'di phyi'i bde gnas thob pa'i dkar chag phan yon las gsungs so/ /bstan pa'i dbu nam zhig nas btsugs she na/ dga' mal gong nas dgon pa yod skad/ dus re zhig tsam na/ bla ma thogs med sprul sku zhes pa'i snang 'ig bya 'phur gdung las 'khrungs pa'i bla ma mtshan snyan grags pa zhig byung ba/ khong gis dga' mal gong du khri spyang dgon khag lnga bo'i grwa sa che ba zhig tshogs sa gtsug lag khang ka ba brgya yod pa zhig bzhengs rgyu byas pas thog mar grags/ gtam 'di deng sang rgan rabs la nyan rgyu snang / de yi bya ba bar chad kyis ma 'thub skad/ rab byung bcu drug me phag lor zung chu dgon khag lnga bo'i lhan du 'tshog rgyu'i gros mol byung ste/ de'i lor sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la/ skyabs rje — 111 ge

dam pa rin srungs sprul sku shes rab rnam rgyal gyis dgon khag 'tshog chen khri ba'i las thog gnang nas/rin spungs dpal gshen bstan bkra shis smin grol gling du bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs/ bla rgan khong gis dgon khag la thugs sems rgya cher bzhes nas bstan pa dar ba'i smon lam btab/ de rjes khyung tshang g.yung drung bstan rgyal gyis khri ba'i gzhung 'dzin gnang ste/ dga' mal g.yung drung dar rgyas gling du sems dpa' stong phrag gi 'dul sde 'phel/ de rjes skyang btsun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis khri ba mdzad de/skyang tshang phun tshogs dar rgyas gling du g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i 'brug sgra grags/ de rjes snang zhig lcags mdud bskal bzang rgya mtshos dgon khag khri ba gnang nas/ sna sting g.yung drung bkra shis gling du bstan pa'i ba dan mkha' la phyar/ de rjes snang zhig shes rab bstan 'dzin rin po che dang / a to bla ma tshul khrims bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis snang zhig rnam rgyal kun grags gling du 'du khang chen mo ka ba brgya yod pa zhig bzhengs te dgon khag gi khri ba'i gzhung 'dzin gnang nas rnam rgyal kun grags gling du bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas/ de ltar rim bzhin bla khag nang chen so so'i bstan pa'i 'gan 'os gnang /de nas rab byung bcu drug lcags byi lo (1948 )lor/ zung chu dgon khag lnga bos gtsug lag khang bzhengs rgyu gros mol gnang nas/ gang sar dgon sar bltas nas/ bya dur gnas ri'i mdun dga' mal la dgon khag lnga bos dgon pa bzhengs rgyu'i thugs mthun byung nas gros thag chod pa byung / de'i skabs bla ma dang tshogs khang gi sku thog chen po bla ma ni rin spungs mchog sprul shes rab rnam rgyal/ bla ma lcags mdud skal bzang rgya mcho/ skyang tshang dbon po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ chab tsha dpon po g.yung drung bstan rgyal/ snang zhig shes rab bstan 'dzin/ mkhar yags bla ma shes rab blo gsal/ a to bla ma tshul khrims bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bya 'phur mchog sprul ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ brag dgon dbon po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ the bo dpon slob g.yung drung nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ hor ba dge bshes bstan 'dzin blo gros/ gtso tshang bla chung / thogs med rgyal tshab rgyal mo tsha kho bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes bla khag bcu gsum gyi sku ring la/ dgon khag gi 'tshog 'du rgan pa bzhi bcu dang / 'tshog 'du gzhon pa brgyad cu yod pas dgon khag lnga bos do dam bzung ste las sna mdzad/ rin spungs sprul sku shes rab rnam rgyal sogs bla khag rnams kyis dgon pa dga' mal rin chen zhungs 'khyil du gzigs mor gnang ste rin sgrungs sku zhog rin po che sogs bla ma rnams kyis dgongs rtags kyi rten 'brel snang ba gsum mtshams sbyor bas g.yung drung bon bstan phyis su rgya chen dar ba'i thugs rtags dang bka' lung mang du gsungs/bla ma skyang sprul dang / bla ma nyi zhig bla ma nag tshang zhig pa rnams kyis kyang bstan pa dar ba'i lung bstan mang ngo zhes dgon gnas khyad par 'phagasapa mngon sum tshad ma'i snang ba'ang grub/ gang zhe na gnas ri'i thugs rje ma 'dra ba'i phyogs bcur khyab pa'i mtshungs zla bral ba'i sa gnas ches 'phags so/ /de ltar byas nas dgon pa'i sa rtags bzhag nas grwa mang chos grwa ba res rdo khal lnga re phab nas/ ar las kyi 'go zin kyang las mtha' 'gyang ba'i rkyen gyis/ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dbang du song ba kun gyis shes — 112 —

gsal ltararo/ /deng dus bstan pa 'di'ang gsar du bslun pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i myugs sprel(1980 ) lor krung gung krung dbyang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i kung u tshang 'dzoms grosaglu 'tshogs thengs gsum pa'i khyab bsgrags byas/ rgyal gces chos gces dang / mang tshogs chos dad rang mos chos sgo phye rgyu sogs deng rabs can bzhi 'dzugs skun las don la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu bcas kyi thad la dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus stobs skyed dgos pa'i nang don ltar gyi mdzub khrid 'og zhing chen dang rang khudzirang rdzong nang bstan mthun tshogs sogs kyis chog mchan gnang nas lcags bya lor zung chu dgon khag lnga bo lhan du yang bskyar dgon pa bzhengs ste/ dgon khag gi bla ma shes rab mthar phyin 'dems bsko byas/dpon slob skal bzang dar rgyas bzhag ste zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes bcu nas bco lnga'i bar/ bla grwa sum brgya lhag 'tshog 'go song ngo / / rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyi (1982 )lor tang gi yig cha don tshan bcu dgu'i nang don ltar/ tang gi bka' drin 'og tu hor zla dang bo'i tshes bzhi dang lnga la rje mnyam med chen po'i dus mchod/ dang bo'i tshes lnga'i dgung mo nas bco lnga'i bar ston mchod smon lam la ma dṛ'i sgrub pa 'tshogs/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la dge tshul drang srong ba'i dbyar gnas dang zla ba'i tshes bcu nas bco lnga'i bar sgrib sbyong mun sel sgrub/ dgon pa 'di yi bsgrig tshul ni/ tang gi rgyal gces chos gces dang deng rabs can bzhi'i bcos bsgyur dang sgo 'byed kyi srid jus gzhir bzung ba'i chos khrims rje mnyam med chen po'i grwa ba'i sgrig srol dang bstun te/ mkhan slob rnam gnyis gtsor/ tshogs chen dge skos che chung /dbu mdzad chen mo/ tshogs 'du rgan gzhon sogs kyi chos khrims dam/ rgyun 'dug grwa ba ni nyi shu tsam/mtshan nyid 'dzin grwa gcig dang / rig sbyong gi 'go rab byung bcu drug gi shing glang lor tshugs rgyu'i 'char gzhi byas/ brna dag skor rig sbyong da ltar bslab sbyang sgang yin/ ri mo lag rtsal/ gso rig sogs so so'i slob gnyer 'bad bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas nas/ bstan 'gro bde skyid kyi snang ba'i dpal la longs su spyod pa'i bkra shis pa'i nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer yongs la shar ba'i rnam dkar lhag bsam 'di 'grub par gyur cigabacu bzhi/ sngon dus bod mi rnams kyi gnas skabs dang tshul lugs ci ltar yod lugs/sngon gyi dus su bod rnams kyi gnas skabs dang tshul lugs ci ltar yod par bsam par bya ste/ lus rtsal che zhing g.yo sgyu chung ba/ ngang tshul brtan cing mna' la brtsi ba/ snying stobs che zhing rang rigs la sha tsha ci bas che ba/ rje la gus pa che zhing 'khor g.yog la brnyas pa chung zhing byams brtse sogs ya rabs kyi spyod pa shin tu mang zhing / mkhas par bgrang ba rnams ni/ smra brjod gtsang zhing / gtam ring po dpe sna tshogs dang sprel te lab nus pa dag yin/ brda thabs yin khul mang po zhig smra ba la dga' bar byed/blon chen lta bu zhig gis/ 'di byas na shar gyi ri nur te (ring du song ba'i don)nub kyi mtsho kha bcad yong zhes smras pa la/ rgad mo rig pa can rnams kyis de'i don ci yin zhes nyin mthag ponee 1༵sam mno

gtong ba sogs byed cing / bod kyi sa las lhag pa'i yul bzang po med pas rgyal po yang lha yul nas bod du byon pa thag gcod/ lung stong re'i phu na rgyal po'i pho brang yin zer ba'i khang ba chen po re las/ de'i mtha' la bskor ba'i grong khyer dang / tshong brdal sogs ni mi 'dug pho brang gi sgo la snebs pa dang /byang thang la glebs pa dus mnyam yin 'dug phyis chos rgyal rnams kyi dus su gtsug lag khang rnams yul gyi mi rnams kyis mjal sa dang ltad mo blta sa che shos de yin/ dmar po ri'i pho brang de ni khang brtsegs kyi rtse la mda' mdung gis brgyan pa da lta'i btsan khang rnams dang 'dra se yin la/ ri rnams kyi rtse la yang mda' mdung gi phung po btsugs te/ lha rnams der bzhugs par byed/ 'bangs khyim rnams kyi khang thog dang sgo la yang dar mdung re slong ba 'di da lta'i bar bod kyis (kyi) rtags lta bu yin te/ stod phyogs su rgya gar gyi yul na yod pa'i bod rigs su gtogs pa tshun nas/ smad phyogs su rgya nag gi so mtshams kyi bod rigs tshun chad kyi sbra sgo dang khang thog la dar slong ba byed/ sngon gyi mi rnams khang ba dgu thog bya ba de shin tu mang / grong khyer zhig pa'i shul sogs cher mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas/ phal cher 'brog khyim gyi rnam par chags yod par 'dug 'dre la sogs pa la dpral ba na mig gcig dang / 'dre mo rnams la zangs kyi mchu ring po yod pas mi'i klad pa phug nas za bar smra/ gtam rgyud 'di gnyis bod kyi mi'i bsam pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin/ lha rnams la dung gi rgyan cha mang / g.yu yi smin ma yod/sha rtsi skug po la mdzes par brtsi/ bud med gzugs phra la ring ba/ skyes pa rgyags shing gzugs rags pa la mchog tu 'dod/ dmar po ri'i 'dabs kyi thang na rgyal po yab yum gnyis la khang brtsegs mtho ba gnyis yod cing / thog gsum bzhi'i mtshams nas lcags zam gyis sbrel yod/ 'on kyang phur mdo lcags zam gyi lugs su yod pa'i nye tshan bsre ba zhig yin tshod 'dug dus ston sogs kyi tshe mi re'i mdun du mi gsum gyi skal ba tsam long ba'i zas chang sogs 'dren/ snod dang yo byad sogs che zhing thug pa gang yin bsod nams kyi rdzas su byed/ 'on kyang 'di tsho zhib tu bshad nas mtha' mi chod de/ da dung yang mdo khams stod smad sogs su sngon gyi lugs phal cher ma 'gyur bar gnas pas/ de dag las dngos su shes par nus/ lung khug 'gol po na yod pa'i mi yul gzhan pa'i rigs kyi shan ma zhugs pa de dag la ltos nas sngon gyi tshul mang po dpag nus pa yin te/ dper na/ dbus gtsang phyogs ni yul gru che bas spyod lam dang skad lugs chas gos sogs mang du 'gyur zin cing / skad kyang mdo khams dang mi 'dra/chas kyang mi 'dra yang / stod mnga' ris dang rgya gar mtshams kyi mtha' na gnas pa'i yul chung mang po zhig gi skad kyang mdo khams kyi skad dang shin tu mthun/ bud med rnams kyi chas kyang spyab tu ras lteb zhig dbyangs te der g.yu byur sogs bsgrigs pa mdo khams dang 'dra/ tha na glu len stangs kyang dbus pa'i gzhes lta bu ma yin par/ khams dang a mdo rgyal rong bzhin gdangs ring po 'then te len/ glu kho rang yang / dpe tshan gnyis la tshig bcad skor gnyis/ de nas don tshan pa gcig tshig bcad skor gcig ste/ khams rgyal rong dang a mdo kun la rtsom stangs de 'dra red/ dbus gtsang du deng sang glu — 114 —

gzhas rnams tshig rkang bzhi tsam re'i nang du bsdus pa sha stag yin/ byang ku lu ta'i yul du nyin gcig char ba chad 'phro la nyi ma tshar lam zhig shar/ nged sdod sa las mi ring bar phyugs rdzi zhig gis gdangs 'then te khams brag g.yab phyogs na len pa'i glu de 'dra mngon sum zhig len gyin 'dug nged ya mtshan la skyo gdung de bas byung / kho yod sar byin pas spya gar gyi byis pa snam bu gyon pa zhig 'dug glu'i tshig kyang de phyogs kyi rgya gar ba'i skad rang du 'dug phyis gar zha nas 'ongs pa zhig gis yul 'di yang sngon bod kyi sa yin cing / mnga' ris chos rgyal zhig gi skabs shor ba yin zer/ kye ma gtam de bden thang ba la/ des na smad du sdod pa'i rgyal mo rong a mdo rnams dang / stod rgya gar gyi sa mtshams na gnas pa'i mi sde 'di tsho la zla lam du mas chod pa'i bar na skad lugs dang cha lugs mi gcig pa'i yul thu 'di tsam gnas shing phan tshun 'brel ba med pa lta bur 'dug mod/ 'on kyang thun mong du gyur pa'i skad lugs dang / spyod lam/ chas gos sogs byung ba sngon gyi pha mes kyi dus su byung ba'i srol min na gzhan ci srid snyam nas rjes su dpag ste gna' bo'i tshul lugs 'di 'dra'o zhes cung zad bris pa yin gyi/ 'dis mngon shes smra tshul byas so zhes bsam par mi bya'o/ /lar rgyu mtshan 'di 'dra la brten nas dpag pas kyang skabs 'gar nor 'khrul cung re 'byung srid kyang / sngon gyi tshul lugs sogs dabhod pa la rjes su dpag pa'i rten 'di tsam las rnyed pa ma yin pas/'di yang da bar mthong nas glegs bam zhig tu gsal por bris pa rnams la bltas te rgyu mtshan gang yang med par blo bde ste sdod pa yang / blun po nyal la dga' ba rnams kyi lugs kho na yin pas spang bar bya la/'di tsho shes pas ci la phan/ ma shes pas ci zhig 'chor sogs smra ba yang / rig pa 'tshol ba la mi 'os pa'am/ phrag dog gis ldong ba rnams kho na'i kha nas 'ongs par mthong bas/ shes rab 'dod na blun po'i rjes su 'brang bar mi bya'o/ / de nas lo rgyus smra bar 'dod pa rnams kyis/ 'di lta bu'i gnas la dbyad pa zhib mo byas pa la col chung gi las shig tu ma bsam par rtsad gcod legs par byas na/ skabs 'gar lo rgyus dang spyal rabs su grags pa'i glegs bam 'ga' zhig las kyang rnam pa gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan mthong rgyu yod pa dgongs par gyis shig ces gsungs so/ /masdi ris thar ba'i ṭwāṃngos trī trī gād ciX / /ṭā(kā da/ ṭwāṃ rshardo ṭwāṃ kātrī ṅge wa da dā sdo ji/ga//kun gyis bor kyang kho bos zhib tu dpyad/ /gangs ri can gyi yul ljongs 'chi med lam/ /bstan pa nyi zla'i 'char nub 'groci ba'i'i tshul/ /dpe lung mkhas ldan ngag las legs nyan te/ /gzhan la bzlos pa'i mchu 'dab cung tsam bskyod/ /

le'u dgu ba/ bod yul du dam pa'i chos dbu badhes shing dar ba'i lhakhang rten gsum sogs kyi skor/dang po/ pod du bstan pa snga dar gyi rnam bzhag rags tsam bshad pa/bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sbrul bar grags pa'i rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan zhes bya ba dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa'i tshe/ dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin te/ rgyal po pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi rtse na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ parnyi ta blo sems 'tshel dang lo tsā ba li thi se gnyis kyis mdo za ma tog dang dpang skong phyag rgya ba/ gser gyi mchod rten gcig dang ma ṇi'i skol phor khyer 'ong nas chos dar bar bzhed kyang / skad kyi rkyen gyis ma thub par spyal po la phul bas rgyal pos gnyan po gsang ba zhes btags nas mchod pas sku tshe ring ba byung zhes so/ / de nas rgyal rabs lnga na dam pa chos kyi dbu dngos rnyed mkhan chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po phyon pa yin te/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la bsten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas par/ / rgyal po mi yi lha zhes bya/ / li tsā wi rnams rigs su 'byung / / de yang sngags kyi don grub ste/ /longs spyod che dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod che ldan zhes/ /mi yi bdag pos de yang spub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid byed/ /des ni rkun ma rnam par spangs/ /rgyal po de yi srog spangs nas/ / de yi sngags ni myur thub ste/ / zhi dang rgyas pa'i las byed pa'o/ / 'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan don brtson/ /rtag tu yid mi skyo ba 'o/ / de bzhin rgyal po mang po ni/ / rnam pa du ma mang po dag / kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs gzigs/ /kha ba can rnams kla klo'i rgyal/ /de yang ston pa mchod byed pa/ /khyu mchog khyu mchog bzang po dang / / sa 'og de bzhin sa 'og bzang / / de bzhin pha rol gnon nyid dang / / rkang pa'i 'gros zhes bstan pa yin/ /sa spung dang ni bee'u dang / /'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ /de 'og lags ni rnam zhig cing / /phyi rol skye dgus nye bar spyod/ /ces rgyal sa ma nges pas 'dzin par gsungs pa dang /de yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas rim par lung bstan pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo ni bod du dar bar gsungasapa yin no/ / de lta bu'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po de'i dus/ bka' yi blon po baspya phrag gsum dang / bod yul rus chen lnga dang dbang ris bco brgyad du bcad/ rgod kyi stong sde drug cu rtsa gcig sogs bgos/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims bcas/ de nas thon mi a nu'i bu thon mi sasgo ṭa zhes yid gzhungs pa dbang po rno ba/ yon tan du ma ldan pa zhig yod pa la/ gser mang bo bskur — 116 —

nas rgyagar du yi ge slob tu btang ngo / /blon po spya gar lho phyogs su phyin te/ yi ge sgra la mkhas pa bram ze tha byin zhes bya ba dang parnyita lha rigs pa'i seng ge gnyis nas/ sgra bstan bcos thams cad bslabs nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur te/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog dang mdo za ma tog dang spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bod du bsgyur/ mdor na blon po thon mi de nyid bslab shes kyi yon tan du ma la mkhas par gyur/ de nas blon po bod du byon pa'i dus su/ bram ze la gsol ba/thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras/ / bka' drin che'o ngo mtshar che/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /rig pa dri med nam mkha' la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyu skar shar/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu 'dzina'akhriṭa/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i nyi ma shar/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bde gsal yid kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rig pa blo yi chu bran 'khor/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu bya lding / /sgra tshad yi ge'i nor bu bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i dbul 'phongs sel bar byed/ /rgyu lus dri med sdong po la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi yal ka rgyas/ /bslab shes yon tan me tog shar/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i 'bras bu smin/ /bdag cag blon po thon mi la/ /ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags/ /rgya gar yul du phyin pa yin/ /mkhas spub khyed dang mjal ba yin/ /yon tan gzhi ma yi ge yin/ /ma lus khong du chud pa yin/ /bod yul dbus su 'gro ba yin/ /rgyal pos dga' ston mdzad pa yin/ / rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yin/ /rgyal pos dbu mdzad blon 'bangs la /sgra tshad yi ge spel ba yin/ /kun la rgyas par byed pa yin/ /thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes brjod de zhabs spyi bos blangs/ theg pa chen po'i chos du ma dang bcas te bod du phebs par bsu ba dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/gnyis pa/ rgyal po'i thugs dam las lhajo bo rnam gsum sprun drangs pa'i skor/de nas sprul pa'i spyal po chen po de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag gis mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/ sems can gyi don byed pa la yi dam gyi lha cig bzhengs dgos dgongs pa dang mnyam du lha rnams kyis lung bstan nas mgrin gcig tu rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ / sprul pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems/ /mgo nag yongs kyi rje khyed kyis/ /mos gus bsod nams bsages pa'i rten/ /yi dam lha cig spyan 'dren na/ /rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs su/ /segi la yi rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /rang byon kharsā pa ṇi'i rgyab/ / glang chen nyal ba'i bye ma'i 'og / tsardon sbrul gyi snying bo las/ / thub pa'i rang byon spyan ras gzigs/ /ngo mtshar can zhig de na bzhugs/ /de ni rgyal po'i yi dam yin/ /zhes zer te mi snang bar gyur to/ / de nas rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la/ yi dam gyi lha de spyan 'dren pa la mis mi rnyed pas sprul pa cig btang dgos dgongs pa dang / de ma thag tu rgyal po'i sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shī la zhes pa/ dbu la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa cig yi dam de spyan 'dren pa la btang ngo / / de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des 'phags pa lo ge sha ra 'di khyer 'ongs ba'i da lta po ta la'i rtse la bzhugs/kharsā pa ṇi spyan drangs te/ bod kyi yul du phebs nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la phul bas/ da ni — 117 —

sems can gyi don byed pa la tshegs med do dgongs so/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong a kar ma ti shī la zhes bya ba de'ang slar 'od du zhu nas rgyal po'i smin mtshams su thim par gyur to/ /de nas yang sgrul pa'i rgyal po de'i thugs dgongs la/ bdag gis kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/ theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar byed pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gcig rgya gar na bzhugs gcig bal yul na bzhugs/ gcig rgya nag na bzhugs/ sku de gsum gang rung zhig ji ltar byas la gdan 'dren—dgongs te/ tsardon gyi sku rang byon de la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis 'phros te gcig shar du song ba dang gcig nub tu song / nub tu song ba de la brten nas gzigs pas/nub phyogs bal bo'i yul na rgyal po de ba lha zhes pa la sras mo lha gcig khri btsun zhes pa/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas ha ri trerdon gyi dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad mnga' brnyes pa cig bzhugs par gzigs/ de spyan drangs na bcom ldan 'das dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad bod du gdan drangs pa gzigs so/ / shar du song ba de la brten nas gzigs pas/ shar phyogs rgya nag gi yul na/ rgya rje tha'i dzung rgyal po bya ba la sras mo lha gcig kong rjo bya ba/ sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas utpal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad mnga' brnyes pa zhig bzhugs par gzigs so/ / de spyan drangs na bcom ldan 'das dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dang / theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad bod du spyan drangs par gzigs so/ / de nas rgyal po de 'jig rten las khyad du 'phags shing / blon po mkhar la snga sor bal yul gyi lha gcig spyan 'dren pa dang / rjes sor rgya nag yul gyi lha gcig spyan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba'o/ / rgyal pos spya bal rgyal po gnyis la zhu rten gyi bka' lung dang / rin po che'i khrab la padma rā gas phra brgyab pa re bskur nas lha gcig rin du phul cig gsungs/ yang gser phye bre gang re bskur nas 'di gar dgos su thongs rshag gsungs so/ / rgyal po rnam gnyis kyi bka' lung mi 'dra ba lan gsum re bskud mar gsungs su 'ong bas/ de'i dus su 'di gsum re re bzhin gtod cig gsungs nas/ bka' shog gi shog dril gsum re bskur ro/ / de nas blon po mgar gyis rje la phyag byas te rdzongs dang yo byed rnams khyer cing khal rnams ded nas/ blon po rta ba brgya tham pa bal yul du song /rjes sor rgya nag yul du chas/ thog mar bal bza' na re/ kye yab gcig rgyal po chen po lags/ / kha ba can ni mtha' 'khob kla klo'i yul/ / dam chos ma dar bod yul mun pa'i gling / / mi ni rigs ngan gdol pa sha za'i rigs/ /bkra shis dbul ba yi dwags spyal khams 'dra/ /de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo 'gro dgos na/ / yab kyi mchod gnas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i lha/ / mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab/ / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje bdag la zhu/ / thub pa'i rgyal tshab byams mgon rin po che/ / mtshan dpes rab brgyan phan bde 'byung ba'i gter/ /byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo bdag la zhu/ /tsandan jo mo sgrol ma thugs rje can/ /'gal rkyen bar chod sel phyir bdag la zhu/ /rin chen stag sha de dang ratna de/ /— 118 —

bod yul dbul ba sel phyir bdag la zhu/ / rin tshen 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i longs spyod dang / / zas skom bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod pa'i gzhi/ /beeskurya yi lhung bzed bdag la zhu/ /kha ba can ni bkres shing skom pa'i gnas/ /rin chen bang mdzod mang po bdag la zhu/ /kha ba can ni bsil zhing grang ba'i yul/ /tshe gcig dros pa'i gos kyang bdag la zhu/ / de ltar mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams der/ / bdag gi spyod lam bya ba ji ltar bya/ /yab gcig rgyal pos bdag la bka' stsol cig / ces gdung ba'i skad kyis mchi ma phyung nas zhus pas/ yab kyis thugs kyi dkyil du brtse ba'i tshi) phyung nas gsungs pa/ nga yi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ / bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ / ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ / bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / /ngo mtshar rmad byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ / chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ 'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna chegs 'byung /rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ rgyal po lha yin 'khor rnams byang chub sems/ dam chos med kyang rgyal po'i bka' khrims yod/ de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo khyod song zhig /bdag gi yi dam mi bskyod rdo rje dang / / rje btsun byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo 'di/ / 'dzam bu gling ba tshe lo nyi khri'i dus/ / rgya gar chos rgyal kro kro'i thugs dam du/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'dus pa'i phung po la/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs dag gis rab gnas mdzad/ sprul pa'i lha bzos lugs su blugs pa las/ /thog mar byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo bzhengs/ / de yi rjes la mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ / ngo mtshar dpag med mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas dang ldan rten du bzhengs/ /mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sa steng 'gran zla kun dang bral ba 'di/ /ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams gsog pa'i phyir/ /lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal po de'i/ /dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad du lung bstan mdzad/ /de yi dus su 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab/ / lha rnams kun gyis me tog char ba phab/ / de ltar yon tan ldan pa'i rten mchog 'di/ /bdag gi mig gi 'bras ltar gces na yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /tsardon jo mo sgrol ma rang byon 'di/ / 'jigs pa brgyad sogs bar du gcod pa rnams/ / nye bar zhi nas dge legs rgyas pa'i phyir/ /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /rje btsun byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo 'di/ /'gro kun dge la bkod phyir bdag gis brdzangs/ /rin chen stag sha de dang ratna de/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel phyir khyod la bskur/ / rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i longs spyod gter/ /beezurya yi lhung bzed chen po 'di/ / zas skom sdug bsngal sel gyir khyod la bskur/ / rin chen gser dngul dar zab rgyan dang bcas/ / glang chen rnga mong drel dang bcas pa'i khal/ / gzhan yang mkho ba'i yo byad zas gos rnams/ /gang la ci 'dod bu mo khyod la bskur/ /rigs bzang yid 'ong mdzes pa'i bu mo bcu/ /khyod kyi skyo grogs byed pa'i 'khor du brdzangs/ /e ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod/ /gtam gyi rting ma yin no yid la chongs/ /kha ba can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang der/ /blon po bod 'bangs rnams dang 'grogs pa'i dus/ / khyod kyi spyod lam bya ba 'di bzhin gyis/ / zhes gsungs te 'jig rten mi chos la — 119 —

dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /gsum pa/ rgya bza'akong jo sprun drangs pa'i skor/rgya bza' kong jo 'dod pa la slebs pa'i spya gar dang / ge sar/ stag gzig lha ta hor sogasporta ba blon po bcas brgya re slebs yod pas/ bod la mthong chung byas kyang rig pa 'gran tshe blon po mgar gyi blo rig sna tshogs kyi sgo nas rgyal khab gzhan rnams pham par byas/ bod blon rgyal kha thob nas rgya nag rgyal po de'i thugs la nga'i bu mo 'di 'dod mkhan mang yang / phugs su bod kyi rgyal po 'di la ster dgos pa 'dra bsam mod/ 'on kyang bod yi dwags kyi rgyal khams yin snyam nas ster mi 'dod pas/ rgyal po'i 'al nas da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin shar sgo'i thang la/ bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa sum brgya rgyan gyis brgyan nas gral byed/ de'i khrod du lha gcig yod la de ngo sus shes pa la bskur ba yin gsungs so/ / de nas mgar gyis gnas mo la gser phye bre gang bo de brngan pa la byin nas/ der gnas mo na re/ lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo 'di/ nga'i dpon mo yin pas rgyus nga la che ste/ rgya nag rtsis la mkhas pas/rtsis kyis ngo shes na nga gsod 'ongs pas/ ngas 'chad mi nus zer ro/ /der mgar na re/ rtsis kyis ngo mi shes pa'i thabs nga la yod zer nas/ khyim gyi nang sgo bsdams te/ sgrod pu chen po gsum btsugs/de'i steng du zangs nga chen po chus bkang ba gcig bzhag chu de'i steng du bya sna tshogs kyi spu gtor/ phub dmar po cig gis kha bcad/ de'i steng du gnas mo bzhag gnas mo'i mgo la rdza mas g.yogs/ rdza ma'i mgo la dra bas g.yogs/ tshu ma la bug pa phug bug pa dang dra mig gi nang du zangs dung bcug nas/ 'di nas tshur bshad pas rtsis kyis zin kyang yid ches mi 'byung bas/ khyod kyis legs par shod cig byas so/ /der gnas mo na re/ blon po chen po legs par yid la zungs shig lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de/ bu mo gzhan pas che rgyu med/ skye gzugs ga'an pas bzang rgyu med/ rgyan gos gzhan pas legs rgyu med/ de la mo yi khyad chos ni/ sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags yod/ zhal nas utpal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ lus la dri 'im 'thul bas g.yu yi sprang ma gcig 'khor gyin yod/ mkhur tshos g.yas pa'i steng na cho lo ris/ g.yon pa'i steng na padma ris/ dpral ba'i dkyil na sichu ra'i thig le'i steng na ārya tā re nas tsam cig yod/ so la so zho yod/ og ma la og zho yod/ lha gcig kong jo de/bu mo sum brgya bsgrigs pa'i tha mar yang mi 'ong / dkyil du yang mi 'ong / g.yon gral nas bsgrigs pa'i drug gi gong du 'ong / lha gcig de lus dang gos la bsrung ste/ lus dang gos la reg sa med pas/mda' gsar pa cig la dar le brgan kha gang thogs la/ lha gcig gi rtsal sleb pasnyedang / mos dar gos sham lnga brtsegs steng na dri ma lcam me ba cig gon yo da pas de'i gong ba nas mda'i ltong gis bzung la 'then cig zer ro/ / de nas zhag gsum gyi nyin par bu mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa sum brgya shar sgo'i thang la bsgrigs so/ / rgya nag gi mi thams cad ltad mo la 'tshogs/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po rnams sngaraci go rim bzhin bdoms shig gsungs so/ / der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/— 120 —

gral gyi dkyil nas bu mo chas bzang zhing mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas gcig min kyang gcig yin te 'ong zer nas/ 'u sgra dang bso sgra 'debs kyin song ngo / / de'i rjes la stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas sngar ltar byas nas song ngo / /de'i rjes la ge sar dmag gi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ bu mo mjos ma gnyis khrid nas/ snga ma ltar byas nas song ngo / / de'i rjes la bha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas snga ma ltar byas nas song ngo/ / der blon po mgar gyis bltas pas/ de rnams thams cad ma yin par shes te/ rab tu dga' nas 'dzum mul gyis shor ro/ / der mkhar gyis mda' de lag tu khyer/ bod blon rnams khrid de g.yon gral du phyin nas/ gral gyi mtha' ma'i bu mo de la/ mgar na re/ 'di ni bshan pa'i bu mo 'dra/ /lag pa 'di yi dmar lugs sam/ /de'i gong na 'dug pa de/ /rdza mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra/ /lag pa'i ser kha mang lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /shing mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra/ /gos log 'di yi skya lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /khrab mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra/ /steng gos 'di yi snum lugs sam/ / de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /phyis mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra/ / 'breng bu 'di'i mang lugs sam/ / de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ / mgar ba cig gi bu mo 'dra/ / gos kyi thu ba'i nag lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /dar 'thag bu mo yin pa 'dra/ /dar zab lus la gon lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /lha gcig kong jo yin pa 'dra/ /sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs chags/ /zhal nas utpal sngon po mnam/ / dri zhim g.yu yi sprang ma 'khor/ / mkhur tshos cho lo padma res/ / dpral ba rje btsun sgrol mas mtshan/ /so tshags dam zhing so zho can/ khaphrul chen bu mo gzhan pas mdzes/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brjod nas/ lha gcig gi gos kyi gong ba nas/ mda'i ltong gis bzung nas 'then pas/ lha gcig ngu 'ing blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /der lha gcig bshum pa la/ blon po mgar gyis spro ba bskyed pa'i glu blangs par thon mi sasmyoṭa dang 'bri se ru gong ston gnyis kyis rams bu btegs nas 'di skad do/ /e ma ngo mtshar che/ /lha gcig kong jo khyed/ /bdag gi tshig la gson/ /bkra shis nyams su dga'/ /bod kyi rgyal khams na/ /rin chen lnga las grub/ /rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad/ / srong matsan sgam po de/ / rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid/ / mthong na soms yid 'phrog /thugs rje chen po lags/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ /'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/ /rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/ /dga' skyed glu re len/ /chos kyis nyi ma shar/ /dpal gyi sgron me bteg / ri la shing sna tshang / / sa gzhi yangs pa la/ / 'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/ / go mtshams med par skyes/ / gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ / rin chen du ma yod/ / gnag rta lug gsum rgyas/ /dga' skyed de ltar yod/ /e ma ngo mtshar che/ /lha gcig kong jo gson/ /zhes glu blangs pas/ lha gcig gi bsam pa la/ de ltar bden na rang gi yul darda 'a~X 2rdor ḍidug

bsam nas/ mchi ma phyis te blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /blon po mgar gyis lha gcig la/ /da ni bod du 'gro thabs kyis shig ces btang ngo / / de nas lha gcig pho brang du phyin tshe/ yab rgyal po'i zhal nas/khyod bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gro dgos gsungs/ der lha gcig gis yab la phyag 'tshal te gsol ba/yab gcig spyas pos bka' gnang ngam/ / a ma yum gyis gnang lags sam/ /jo jo ming pos tshig shor ram/ /e ma mi srid ngo mtshan che/ /bod kyi yul der bdag gtong na/ /kha ba can gyi yul phyogs der/ /bsil zhing grang la sa rong tsub/ /lha klu 'dre srin gdug pa mang / /gangs ri gcan gzan mche ba 'dra/ /brag ri 'brong gi rwa dang 'dra/ /nyams mi dga' zhing blo mi bde/ /'bru sna mi 'khrungs mu ge'i gnas/ / gdol ba sha zan srin po'i rigs/ / spyod pa rtsing ba kla klo'i mi/ / mtha' 'khob sangs rgyas 'bas ma bcags/ /chos med ma rig mun pa'i gling / /mchod pa'i rten dang gnas med cing / /bsod nams gsog pa'i rten med pas/ / yab kyi mchod gnas yi dam lha/ / shākya mu ni bdag la zhu/ kha ba can ni bkres pa'i yul/ / rin chen bang mdzod bdag la zhu/ kha ba can ni bsil zhing grang / / tshe gcig dros pa'i gos shig zhu/ /bod ni gdol ba gtsang btsog med/ /g.yog mo'i skyo grogs bdag la zhu/ /de ltar mtha' 'khob yul phyogs der/ /bod kyi mi dang 'grogs pa'i dus/ /bdag gis spyod lam ji ltar bya/ /zhes mchi ma gyis nas zhus pas/ yab kyi thugs brtse bas bka' gnang ba/ nga yi mig dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ / bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul/ / yul las khyad par 'phags pa de yin te/ /gangs ri rang ba'in mchod rten grub pa'i gnas/ /mtsho bzhi g.yu yi martsel bkram pa 'dra/ /ya mtshan gser gyi me tog rgyas pa'i gling / / bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / / chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / /rkang bzhis kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ /de ltar ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas mchog der/ / rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i pho brang na/ / mi rje lha yi mdzad pa'i rgyal po de/ / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos su 'dug thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal po yin/ / mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu'i khrims la gnas/ / mnga' thang dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i dpal la spyod/ / yo na tan mtha' yas rgyal po lha yi sras/ / dpa' mdzangs kun 'dzoms 'khor rnams byang chub sems/ / de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo khyod song shig / mdzes ma khyod kyi bsod nams bsags pa'i rten/ /bdag gi mchod gnas ston pa'i sku gzugs 'di/ /yon bdag lha dbang brgya byin khong gis mdzad/ / rgyu ni rin chen rnam pa bcu las grub/ / 'di yi bzo bo bi sha karmas mdzad/ / rab gnas sangs rgyas nyid kyis mdzad pa lags/ / de ltar 'gran med rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di/ /mthong thos dran reg gsol ba btab gyur pas/ /sangs rgyus myur du thob par spyal bas gsungs/ /de ltar phan bde 'byung ba'i jo bo 'di/ /bdag gi snying dang 'dra bar phangs na yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /rin chen bang mdzod mang po no ra gyi gter/ / bdag la gces pari rin chen mang po yang / / mjes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i ge 122 —

yig tshang chen mo dang / / gtsug lag yi ge sum brgya drug cu dang / / gser g.yu rgyan gyi rnam pa mang po yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis badzangs/ /g.yo sa sna zas kyi rnam pa mang po dang / /btung ba skom gyi sbyor thabs mang po dang / /gser sga g.yu yi ka leb can la sogs/ / mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ / za 'og stan thul seng ge bya brgyad ma/ /ljon shing cho lo nor bu ris su bris/ /rgyal po ngo mtshar skye phyir khyod la brdzangs/ /rgya yi gab tse gtsug lag sum brgya bo/ /legs nyes ston pa'i las kyi me long yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /bkod pa'i rig byed mdzes par byed pa yi/ /yid 'ong rgyan gyi khyad par 'phags pa dang / /bzo yi rig byed drug cu tham pa yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman/ /brtag thabs brgya dang dpyad lnga spyad drug dang / / sbyor sde bzhi la sogs pa bdag gis bskur/ / tshe gcig dros pa'i dar gos za 'og sogs/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa'i rgyan gos kyang / / stong phrag nyi shu bu mo khyod la brdzangs/ /rigs gzhugs lta na sdug cing mdzes pa yi/ /sems mthun skyo grogs byed pa'i bu mo yang / /nyi shu rtsa lnga khyod kyi 'khor du brdzangs/ / e ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod/ / brtse ba'i snying gtam yin pas sems la zhol la ba can gyi mi rnams 'dul don du/ /khyod kyis bya ba spyod lam 'di bzhin gyis/ /lta ba yangs shing spyod lam zhib par mdzod/ /phyi nang bya ba kun la mkhas par mdzod/ /ngag 'jam smra mkhas ga'i ma legs par mdzod/ /rje la gus shing 'khor la byams par mdzod/ /khrel yod ngo tsha bag dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces pa la sogs pa 'jig rten mi chosal dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /yab kyis phyag gis 'jus zhing 'bral mi phod pa ltar byas na yang / bod du 'gro dgos par dgongs te/lha gcig la rdzongs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ / de nas lha gcig g.yog mo de dang 'grogs te blon po mgar gyi rtsar byung nas/ blon po chen po khyed kyi yul du jo bo shākya yang gdan 'dren/ nor dpag tu med pa'ang khyer nas khyed kyi yu la du 'gro/ gyed kyi yul na sa lam nga/ dang / rdo srin zan shing se ba/rtsa dred ma/ yung ma sogs klo da dam/ zer ba la/ mgaran re ga'an pa rnams rngo da/ yung ma med zer nas yung gi sa bon khyer/ shing rta'i 'khor lo'i steng du jo bo shākya mu nee bzhugs/ 'khor lo de rgya nag na stobs cheba'i gyad lha dga' dang klu dga' sanyis la 'dren du bcug go/ga'an yang rin po che dang /dar gos dang rgyan sogs 'phral kyi yo byad rnams bkal ba'i rta dang dre'u rnga mong la sogs pa mang po brdzangs so/ / bod blon rnams la'ang ston mor gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /lha gcig kong jola'angarin po che'i rgyan mang bos brgyan nas/ mdzes pa'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'khor dang bcas pa rang rangagirta la chibs nas/ yab yu ma blon po'i tshogasadang bcas kyis skyel thung byas/ yab yu ma gnyis kyi thugs la 'phreng ba'in du/ 'jig rten mi chos la phan pa'i bslab bya gal che ba dpag tu med pa mdzad nas bod du chas so/ / der skyel thung la byon pari gral la/ blon po 'bre se ru gong ston zer ba des/blon po mgar la phras dog byas nas/ 'dir lha gcig gi tshab tu/ blon po rig pa can cig bsdad nasnye— 123 —

rgya bod gnyis mthun 'ongs zer nas/ blon po mgar la mig cer cig bltas pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ khyed bod kyis thob pas nga la mi tshab tu mgar sdod dgos gsungs/blon po mgar gyis kyang se ru gong ston gyis phrag dog byas par go nas/ rgya bod gnyis mthun pa ngas byed do zer nas sdod par byas so/ / der mgar gyis thon mi dang nyang gnyis zur du khrid nas/ nga rgya nag tu zla ba lnga las mi 'dug de'i bar khyed rnams kyis dzus ma'i sprang po zhig nga'i rtsar thongs shig zer/ de cinas blon po thams cad jo bo dang lha gcig bskor te bod du song ngo / / mgar gcig pu rgya nag lus te/na tshul byas nas lus sngo la rid par byas/ mal 'og tu ko ba rul ba ba'ag lus la dri mi zhim pa yod par byas/ 'gram pa g.yas g.yon du mtshal dang rams bcug nas/ mal gyi phyi rol rnag khrag gi lud pas bkang ste ba'ag go / der chung ma rgya mo de na re/ blon po chen po khyed kyi lus la dri mi zhim pa snom gyin 'dug mdog kyang sngo bar 'dug pa ci nyes zer/ blon po na re/ nga la tshad pa'i nad byung ba khyod kyis ma tshor ram zer bas/ der mos rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po yang thugs ma bde bar blon po'i rtsar bhon te/ blon po chen po ci byung gsungs/ blon pos gong ltar zhus/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ sang sman pa mkhas pa ci yod pa khrid la 'ong zhig gsungs nas bzhud do/ /de'i sang spyal pos sman pa rnams re re bzhin khrid nas/ sman pa des rtsar bltas pas/ sman pa na re/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad 'khrugs par gyur pas na brtag par dka' ste/ rlung mkhris bad kan dang 'dus pa'i nad min te/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco brgyad/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i nad kyang ma yin te/ 'byung po'i gdon gyi nad kyang ma yin/ sems ma bde ba snying gi dkyil du phog pa'i gcong zhig 'dra ste/ sman dpyad rim gro gang gis kyang phan par dka' zer ro/ / der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po chen po khyed rang rig pa can yin pas thabs e yod/ de'i thabs gang 'grub byed gsungs pas/ blon po'i bsam pa la/ de ni glags rnyed par 'dug bsams nas/ rgyal po chen po lags/ nga'i nad 'di khyed kyis nga bzung bas/ bod kyi lha srung ma dga' ba yin/ nga bod kyi ri mtho ba zhig gi khar phyin nas lha gsol na phan/ de'i rdzas la/dar zab bsregs pa'i thal ba dang / lug bsad pa'i mtsher pa'i khrag sol ba'i mdung shing 'dom gsum/ rta mog ro mgo dmar zhig rnams dgos zer/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rdzas gzhan rnams ma rnyed/ rta mog ro mgo dmar de rnyed do gsungs/ blon po na re/ rdzas gzhan rnams ma rnyed na thabs zad/ rta mog ro mgo dmar la nga'i ro rta gyis la nga bskyon/ rgya yul na bzang ba'i rta 'ig la nga'i ro zas dang / ro gos bkal nas bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sar lha gsol du 'gro'o zer ro/ /der lha gsol bar 'gro grabs byed kyin yod tsa na/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po chen po nam zla dpyid kar song / so nam byed ran pas ji ltar byas na legs/ der blon pos bkod pa bzhag nas/ blon po rang gi lus gud pa de sos/ lha gsol bar 'gro ba'i grabs byed kyin yo da dus/ bod blon rnams kyi rdzus ma'i sprang po zhig btang byung ngo / / der blon pos log pa'i skad byas te/ thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes mi bya'o/ kha — 124 —

rog sdod la ku co thong / / nag mo lcags mkhar thug nas yod/ /lung ba phu brdugs mda' brdusas su/ /tha ru co brags khong la zhog /dar dkar dril la dar nag bskyod/ /zla bas nyi ma'i rtsa ru sleb/ /zer nas der sprang po de log go / sprang po des khong rnams la bshad pas ma go bar/ rgya mo kong jos go nas 'di skad zer te/ blon po des rgya nag tu ngan byas yod par 'dug thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes ma byed zer ba de/ khong rang rgya po sma ra can la lab ma shod bya ba yin/ da len kha rog sdod la/ bod blon rnams la shod bya ba yin/ nag mo lcags mkhar thug nas yod zer ba de/ sa bon yos su brngos nas 'debs bcug bya ba yin/ lung ba phu brdugs mda' brdugs su/ thu ru co brags khong la zhog bya ba de/dong par mda' mang bo chug bya ba yin/ dar dkar dril la dar nag bskyod bya ba de/ nyin mo bsdad kun mtshan mo 'ong zer ba yin/ zla bas nyi ma'i rtsar slob zer ba de/ ngas khyed rnams kyi rtsar mgyogs par sleb bya ba yin zer ro/ / de nas blon po mgar bod kyi ri mgo mthong ba'i sar lha gsol du 'gro ba'i chas la rta mog ro mgo dmar zhon/ rta gzhan zhig la rgyags dang gos bkal/ sha skam la tshwa chu byugs pa mang po khyer/ rgyal pos blon po bod du bros dogs nas/ gyad mi bzhi bsrung du btang / der blon po bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sa ru skebs/ lkog tu chang mang bo nyos nas sbas/ sha skam yang zhim po byin nas/nga'i nad la phan pa yin pas zos shig ces lha gsol lo/ / de nas gyad bzhi bo'i kha skom nas bzod thabs med par byung ba dang / chang mang bo byin pas/ khong rnams ra ro ste dbang bo med par gyur pa dang /blon pos khong bzhi bo'i rta'i sug pa brags/ mtshon cha bcag khong rang rta mog ro mgo dmar la zhon/rta ga'an de khrid nas/ rta la lcag baspyab ste song ngo / / bod du bros pa srid zer ba'i gtam rgyal po'i snyan du thos nas/ de bden par nges sam snyam nas/ rgya'i rta ba rtsal che brgya tham pa 'dzin du btang / der spyad bzhi po yang bzi sangs te 'di snyam du bsam mo/ /rta zhon rgyu med/ mtshon cha yang mi 'dug yul du log na ngo tsha la/ spyal po'i chad pa yang byung nges pas/ blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ / de nas rgya chu khug pa'i rtsar sleb dus/ rgya nag gi 'ded mi rnams kyang nye bar sleb po/ /der blon pos gyad bzhi po bran du bskul nas/ baspyad chu khug pa'i 'gran du rta'i sbangs dang rta rjes kyis bkang / gyad bzhi bo mda' rgyag bcug nas mda' sgro mtshams bar phud ba'ag go / de rnams 'ded mis mthong nas 'di skad zer/ kho bsu ba'i rta ba mang la rtsal che ba byung 'dug nged rang rnams kyis mi thub/ log par 'thad zer nas phyir log go / de'i bar la rgya bza' kong jo la sogs pa'i bod blon rnams ldan ma brag rtsar phebs nas/ sdog la byams pa khru bdun pa zhig dang / bzang spyod tshar gnyis brkosamar bzhengs/ der zla ba gcig bsgug blon po ma byon/ de nas phung po ri yi padma shang du chag phebs/ zhing btab cing rang 'thag chu 'khor btsugs/ der zla ba gnyis bsgug brag steg dgon gyi bla ma rin chen gyis jo bo shākya mu ni yang ljid tshad ma theg pas zla ba gcig bsgug tshe blon po byon nas jo bos nga ni mi 'gro nga 'dra bzhengs nas 'gro zhes gsungs 'byon pas/ blon pos jo bo nga 'dra ma zhig bzhengs — 125 —

nas/ deng sang rgyal rong mi nyag lha sgang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdo khams rgyal rong sogs kyi lha skal jo bo nga 'dra gsungs 'byon ma zhes ches grags che ba 'ji la mjal nus na lha sa'i jo bo mjal bar 'dra zhes gsungs so/ / de nas sgo dong sgo mo'i rtsar phebs/ rgya nag gi phywa g.yang nyams pas/ rgya nag gi lha srung rnams kyi mthus sgo mo 'gags pas der zla ba gnyis su lus/ de nas sgo dong sgo mo 'gags pa de/ rgya nag gi lha srung ma dga' bas len par shes nas/ shing sna'i dud pa chen po btang / zas chang gi phud gtor nas 'di ltar byas so/ /gsol lo gsol lo lha la gsol/ /rgya nag spyal po'i lha la gsol/ /grong khyer zim shi'i lha la gsol/ / rgya rje btsan po'i lha la gsol/ / bkra shis khri sgo'i lha la gsol/ / nags ma gyen la long du gsol/ / bod blon rnams kyi lha la gsol/ kha ba can pa'i lha la gsol/ / rgya bza' kong jo bsu ru shog / ces gsol mchod di ri ri byas pa'i nub mo nags thams cad gyen la langs te 'gro thub pa byung ngo / /de nasabod du gegs med par sleb byung ngo / /bsu ba dang dga' ston rgya chen po zhus so/ / lcags mo glang gi lo la rgya bza' kong jo bsus nas/ chu mo glang gi lo la ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs so/ / de nas khri btsun dang kong jo gnyis kyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang /rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyis kyi ri cho/ gang dang jo bo rnam gnyis bzhugs gsol sogs yo ngas su rdzogs pa rnams zla ba bcu gnyis re 'gor te lha/na du tshar ro/ / spyal pos kyang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ smar khra 'brug tu phebs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la bkur sti dang phud dud mdzad/ de nas yu ma drug pa mang bza' khri lcam bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sras gung ri gung btsan zhes pa rgyal po'i gdung brgyud 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig lcags mo sprul gyi lo la brag lha bkra shis kyi ga'al rmi sa khang du 'khrungs te/ btsas ston rgya chen po mdzad nas thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ / de nas rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams dge ba bcu'i khrims la gnas pa'i phyir/bka' yi khrims yig chem/ ngo drug kyang mdzad de/ phri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims/ 'bum saser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/ rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims/ mdo lon zhu byed kyi khrims/ dbang chen bcad kyi khrims/ khab so nang pa'i khrizu/sa bcas khrims chem po drug bcad/ de la mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug zhes/ mnga' 'og gi bod 'bangs thams cad bka' khrims btsarnga por gnas la 'da' ba med pa rang rang gi rigs rus cho 'brangs sogs 'os bab thob stong gi las ka las pho rgod dang mo ham gyi rgyu lam bcad de/ btsan po gnya' nas mnan 'ing nyam chung mtha' nas skyong ba'i srol bzang gi lugs de dar spel btango nas/ yul gru so sor blo thabs dang shes rig lngan pa'i yul dpon gsar du bskos/ dpon chen ru ngan gyi dbang du mi 'groba'i ched du/ dpe tshan gong 'os dang len tshan gong 'og du ma gsar 'dzugs gnang / khrims lugs rer khrims dpon re khrims kyi las ka byed pa'i mi sna mang bo zhig gso skyong byas/mtha' yi sa mtshams thams cad bu rta hrag grub kyis bsrungs te/ bod chen po'i srid lugs zhes pa sa yi khyon 'dir yongs su grasas pa 'ig byung yod pa red/ de'i skabs su rgyal mo tsha ba rong yang 'phan bzher — 126 —

dngamado bzher zhes sa gnas 'dir rgyal khrims dang 'bangs khrims/ dmag khrims bcas dbye ba mtshon thub pa ma zad/ khrims lugs dang mthun pa'i dmag mi dang dmag shugs kyang dbye ba matson thub/de nas sras gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bcu gsum la rgyal srid bzung btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas/sras mang srong mang btsan bya ba me pho khyi'i lor 'khrungs so/ / gung ri gung btsan gyis rgyal srid lo lngar bzung / dgung lo bco brgyad dus po ta la ru gshegs so/ / de nas dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyi dgung lo bcu gsum dus rgyal srid bzung / btsun mo 'bro bza' khri ma lod bya ba khab tu bzhes/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ 'di'i dus su rgya dmag btang / jo bo shākya mu nee gdan 'dren zer ba la sogs kyi gtam byung ba la skrag nas/ jo bo ra mo che nas lha sar gdaskodrangs/ lho sgo me long can du
