bzhugs nas sgo lag zhal bgyis/ rgyal srid lo bco lnga bzung ste/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gtsang gi bar snang sgang du 'das so/ /mang srong mang btsan gyi sras 'dur ('dul)srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phul gyi rgyal po yin te/ yab 'das nas zhag bdun lon dus chu pho byi ba la sgrags phu ru 'khrungs/ mgar gyi sras gnya' btsan ldem bu dang / stag ra khong lod gnyis kyis blon po byas nas rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/mchims bza' btsun mo tog bya ba khab tu bzhes pa'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan lcags pho 'brug gi lo pho brang ldan dkar du 'khrungs/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su blon rtsal po che mi bdun byung ste/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni rgyas/ stobs dang mthu rtsal gyis ni mtha' ba'i las rgyal te/ lha sar mes po srong btsan sgam po'i dgongs dus kyi mchod nga/ btsugs/ mtha'i rgyal po yang dbang du 'dus pa tsam byung nas/ snga gong bod kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa rnams las mthu stobs che ba cig byung ste/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu rgyal srid bzung nas ljang gi yul du 'das so/ /bzhi ba/ rgyal mo rong gi lha skal jo bo thugs rje chen po'i skor/mkhas chen dmu dge bsam gtan gyis rma dzad pa'i 〈 thugs rje chen po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus pad dkarachun po〉las/ rgyal mo rong khyo skyabs thugs the chen po zhes mtshan snyan g.yu 'brug gi rnga sgras phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i las can gyi dad ldanadag giskyabs yul dam pa 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus mdo tsam 'god pa la/ sku 'di nyid blon chen lo tsā ba chen po thon mi saṃ sgo ṭa zhes yongs su grags pa des/ciraphags yul gyi mi 'jigs rin chen bye ma srung ba'i gling nas spyan drangs par bshad de/ 'di gter yig las/ sngon tshe rgyal po srong btsan sgam po yisaḥ thon mi saṃ bho rgya gar yul du btang ཿ paṇḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge'i mdunaḥ nā ga ra 'am ’ ñdza dper byas nasaḥyig rigs mi 'dra sna tshogs bod la bsgyuraḥsum rtags la sogs bstan bcos bco brgyad mdzadaḥ sher phyin snying po rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum mdzadaḥ sangs rgyal phal chen 'dul ba ka ri kaḥ sbyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig dang ཿmi 'jigs rin chen bye ma a drung giḥ lnga ldan jo bo 'di nyid bod du drangasaḥ zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal blon thams cad kyis brtan bzhugs dang rab gnas mdzad/ de'i tshe sku'i zhal nas 'od zer sna — 127 ge

tshogs 'phros/ ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas thams cad la khyab/ 'od zer tshur 'dus nas sku la thim/sku'i zhal nas gsung byon te/ nga ni rigs drug 'dul ba'i dpa' bo cheḥ bod khams srin po 'dra ba'i yang mtha' naḥ pre ta yi dwags 'dra ba'i grong khyer dbusaḥ nga 'gro lung bstan gdul bya'i dus la babaḥ ces gsung byon/ de nas blon po mgar gyis gnas 'dir gdan drangs te/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du gter du sbas te/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ / gnas ri bor thugs rje chen po 'khrungs ba'i rnam thar las/ bod rje lha tho tho ru gnyan btsan gyis lung bstan srong btsan sgam po dang blon chen mgar gyis bzhengs pa'i jo bo rnam lnga'i nang tshan/ sa 'og klu yi 'gro don skyong nus mthong grol lnga ldan jo bo zhes pa de yin zhing dgos pa'i dbang gis sa 'og nas ri zhig bzhugs na'ang rjes su bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i dbus nas bong bu zhig la ma ṇi bka' 'bum bkal te/ rgyal mo rong du byon tshe bong bu ri 'dab kyi sa srung nang nyal/ bla ma de 'gram gyi khyim tshang klu 'khyil tshang du slebs tshe spun gsum yod/ gnyis bla ma gcig skya bo yin/ skya rgyud des sa zhing la mdzo dor rmos nas zhing dkyil du slebs tshe/ jo bo'i dbu la thong gshol 'thog nas thong so lan gnyis chag slar khyim du 'ongs nas de ltar smras pas/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan dga' nas sa 'og nas jo bo blangs zer/ de'i sngon nas bee ro tsa na byon nas gnas 'di byin gyis rlabs te gnas mchog bde chen gling gi ming btags/ zhes gnas ri bor thugs rje chen po 'khrungs pa'i rnam thar mdo tsam zhes pa na yod la/ lha sa'i rang byon lnga ldan/lho mtsho'i thugs rje chen po/ khro skyabs thugs rje chen po gsum ni spun gsum/ zhes gsungs so/ /gter nas byung ba'i lo tshigs ji bzhin mi shes mod/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum ni gter ston chos 'grub dang mnga' bdag nyang ral gyis gter nas bton pa yin pas/ de la bltas na rab byung bzhi ba'i nang 'ig tu e yin snyam/ jo bo 'di'i khyad chos ni skabs 'gar zhal mdzes shing gzhon pa'i rnam pa can du mthong zhing / skabs 'gar sku sha nyams shing cung zad rud pa'i rnam pa can du mthong / 'jig rten 'dir bde sdug gi rtags thon pa dang / rje 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug ces bya ba/ khri gung thang rin po che sku 'phreng drug pa phebs skabs/ zhal nas bdud rtsi mang tsam bab pa mjal ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa dang / dga' ldan byang rtse'i mkhan po blo bzang sbyin pa phebs skabs yang zhal nas bdud rtsi bab cing de dang bsres pa'i sman sku zhig kyang bzhengs 'dug rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs chag sgo byung kyang / mi ser snying stobs can rnams kyis sbas pa/ slar blangs nas nyams gso byas te sngar gyi go sar bzhugs dus 'ja' shar ba sogs dge mtshan mang po shar/ deng skabs phyogs mtha' dag nas ༵sdordo ba/ rgyu/ na mi 'chad par 'ongs nas mjal ba dang / gnas khyad par can 'di la phyag skor byed bzhin

lnga ba/ khri lde gtsug brtan dang gyim shingakongajo'i skor/khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom can/ dgung lo bcu la rgyal srid bzung / blon po skyi bzang stong btsan/ mchims rgyal shugs steng / 'bro bzang 'or gsum gyis blon po byas/ bod khams la dbang bsgyur/ ljongs (ljang)mi khri btsun bya ba'i btsun mo khab tu bzhes/ rgyal po des 'byin phu nas mes po srong btsan sgam po'i zhal chems zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa rnyed par gzigs te/ nga nas gdung rabs lnga na rgyal po khri dang lde zhes bya ba'i dus su dam pa'i chos dang / paṇḍita mang po byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur zhes pa de rgyal po khong rang yin dgongs nas/ bran kha mu le sho ka dang gnyaṭa snya nam ku ma ra gnyis pho nyar bsdangs te/ pagyita sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis spyan 'dren du btang yang gdan ma drangs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs te/yi ger bris nas glegs bam lnga bzhengs nas de rnams kyi bzhugs sa la lha khang lnga brtsigs te/ brag dmar ka ru/ kha che 'brin bzangs/ lha sa kha brag 'phyin phu nam ral/ mang gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul ke ma shi nas mdo gser 'od dam pa dang / 'dul ba las rnam par 'byed pa bsgyur ro/ / pe tsi tsarnga shrīs sman dpyad mang po yang bsgyur rdo/ / de rnams kyi yon tan gyis btsun mo ljongs (ljang)mo khri btsun la sras ljongs (ljang)tsha lha dbon zhes bya ba lha'i gzugs byad lta bu shin tu mtshar ba zhig 'khrungs so/ / de la bod nas khab 'os pa ma rnyed mes sbong btsan sgam po'i lugs su bya zer/ rgya nag gi rgyal po dzung dzung rgyal po'i sras mo kyim shing kong jo la rin dang skyes bskur nas len du btang ngo / /de nas bod kyi blon pos rgya rje la rin dang skyes phul/ rgya rjes sras mo la 'gro'am mi 'gro gsungs pa dang /kong jos legs nyes ston pa'i me long zhig yod pa la dmod bor te legs par phyis nas bltas tshe/ tshe 'di'i grogs skal bod na yod par shes shing / rgyal bu de yang mtshar zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong nas bod du 'gro bar mos so/ / de yang rgyal po des rdzongs dpag tu med pa bskur/ bu mo sems la 'azeng bas rgyal pos kyang 'khor mang bo dang mnyam du/ zhing phing hin zer ba'i mkhar rtsig chen po gcig yod pa'i sa cha bar du skyel thung mdzad do/ / der gur chen po phub cing bod kyi gser yig pa rnams la ston mo chen po byas/ rgyal po'ang spyan chab mang bo phyung nas/ sras mo la bslab bya mang po mdzad/ mkhar de la gtogs pa'i nyes pa can thams cad thar du bcug go /lo gcig gi bar la dmag dang 'dab nor thams cadamed par mdzad de/ mkhar de'i ming kyim shing hin bya bar btags so/ / de nas blon po che ba gnyis dmag dang bcas pa'i skyel ma btang ste bod du 'ongs so/ / der rgya bod mtshams su slebs pa dang /bod du blon po rnams kyis rgyal po gdan drangs te/ mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od la thams cad kyis rta rgyugs pa la rgyal bus kyang rta rgyugs pa dang / rtas bskyur te 'das so/ / de ltar btsun mo slebs khar/ rgyal bu grongs nas thams cad mya ngan gyis mnar/ kong jo dpon g.yo ga rnams rgya bod kyi mtshams su slebs pa dang / kong jo la glo bur du snying la mda' phog pa'i sdug bsngal 'dra ba zhig byung nas/ de ma khad me long — 129 —

phyis nas bltas pas/ sngar gyi rgyal bu gzugs byad mdzes pa de med par rgad po bzhin mi sdug pa byad srus khengs pa zhig 'dug nas shin tu yi mug par gyur rte 'di skad zer ro/ /me long brna chad mthong ba na/ /bu mo'i snying la gcong zhig zhugs/ /rang yul du logs shul thag ring / /bu mo'i pha ming snying ring po/ /bod du 'gro ba'i re thag chad/ /bod kyi blon po sdig po che/ /cha med yul du rgyus med 'khyam/ /las kyi me long bsru ba mkhan/ / zer te me long la bdeg cing ngus so/ / de nas bod kyi rgyal pos pho nya btang ste/ rgya mo dpon g.yog rnams la khyod kyi skyes pa 'os pa'i nga'i bu lha dang 'dra ba zhig yod pa de rkyen ngan pas 'das/ da khyed rang yul du log gam nged la bltas nas 'ong zhes yi ge btang bas/ der rgya mo na re/ bu mo'i 'dun ma lan zhig yin pa skyid sdug ci byung kyang bod du 'gro zer nas 'ongs so/ /der bod du slebs pa dang / rgya mo na re/ nga'i a na'i lha khang blta'o zer te/ ra mo cher phyin/ de na jo bo mi bzhugs pas 'phul snang du 'ongs pa dang / jo bo lho sgo me long can na bzhugs par shes nas sgo phye ste/dzo bo de nas bton nas btsan khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/ lha zhal mthong gis mchod pa btsugs/jo bo gdung rabs gsum gyi bar la mun khang du bzhugs pa la/ rgya mos mchod pa btsugs pa yin no/ /de nas 'phyin phur byon te/ mes rgyal po'i btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ / de nas lo dus 'khor ba na/rgyal bu lus la zhugs pa dang / btsun mo che ba sna nam bza' bzhi stengs zer ba zhig yod pa phrag dog skyes nas/ nga la'ang rgyal po'i gdung brgyud lus la yod do zhes rdzun smras/ der rgya bza' la rgyal po khri srong lde btsan lcags pho rta'i lo brag dmar du sku 'khrungs/ sna nam bza' rgya mo'i rtsar byung / shin tu blo nye ba ltar byas nas rgya mo'i bu chung 'phrog ste/ nga rang la skyes pa yin no zer bsnyon byas so/ /der rgya mo'i nu ma bstan/ smre sngags bton/ cho nges bos kyang bu chung ma btang bas/ blon po rnams la sbran/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ der sna nam bzas kyang rang gi nu ma la rang babs kyi rdzas byugs te/ nu zho 'ongs ba byas nas blon po rnams la bstan pas/ blon po rnams kyang the tshom du gyur nas ma shes so/ /de rnams zin pa dang / sras kyis lo 'khor te zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la/ btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rgya dang sna nam nas bos so/ / der sna nam pa rnams kyis bu chung dga' bar byed pa'i yo byad rgyan dang / gos/me tog gi greng ba rnams khyer 'ongs so/ / der spya dang / sna nam gnyis nas/ btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rnams bod du slebs so/ / der rgyal po'i pho brang du rgyal po gser khri'i steng la bzhugs/ g.yas na sna nam pa rnams bsdad/ g.yon na rgya rnams bsdad/ der yab rgyal pos sras rgyan du mas brgyan te/gser skyogs 'bras chang gis gang ba sras kyi phyag tu gtad nas/ yab na re/ ma gnyis las skyes pa'i bu gcig po/ /lus chung yang lha yi rnam 'phrul can/ /snod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di/ /bu khyod rang gi zhang po'i lag tu gtod/ /ma gang yin yid ches de la byed/ /gsungs te/ dmod bor nas sras gom pa thub tsam de btang nas/ der sras kyi gom pa bor nas byon pa dang / sna nam pa rnams kyis gos dang / rgyan dang / me tog gi greng ba la sogs bstan nas bos kyang / 'gror ma nyan par rgya rnams kyi — 130 —

tsurabyungaste/ gser skyogs rgya la gtad nas 'di skad zer ro/ /nga ni khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ /sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshol/ /zer te/ zhang po rgya'i pang du song ngo / /der yum rgya bza' shin tu dga' ste 'di skad zer ro/ /tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /nga rgya las 'ongs ba'i bu mo la/ /rje 'gran med kyi rgyal po'i sras shig 'khrungs/ / las gang yang srid pa'i sngon chad la/ / bu rang la skyes pa ga'an gyis 'phrogs/ / gtam bden pa'i tshig la ma nyan zhing / / brang nu ma bstan kyang ma btang bas/ / nga rgya mo'i lus sems gzhob tu thal/ /sems khong khro'i na tsha ma bzod par/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams su bcug /dus de ring lha yi nyi ma shar/ /bu khyod kyis zhang ngo shes pa lags/ /nga a ma'i lus sems mal du bde/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams pa de/ /ri de rnams skyon med bcos su yod/ / ces zer ro/ /der rgya mo'i sras yin par ngo shes nas/ /dga' ston gyi ston mo chen po byas so/ /der sras dgung lo lnga lon dus yum 'das so/ / yab rgyal po mes ag tshom ni/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum la yar 'brog sba tshal mkhar du gshegs so/ /de nas chos spyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dgung lo brgyad lon pa dang / rgyal srid bzung nas rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal po sku nar ma son pa'i dus su ma zhang khron pa skyes la sogs pa blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis chos byar mi gnang ba'i khrims bcas nas/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che slar rgya yul du skyel grabs byas na'ang / mi stong gis kyang ma drangs/ mkhar brag tu sa thams su bcug pas/ blon po chos la mi dga' ba la la ni smyo 'bog byung nas shi/ la la rgyab gas nas shi/ mu ge dang nad yams dang bkra mi shis pa'i ltas mang po byung / ltas mkhan thams cad kha mthun par rgya'i lha bye thams su bcugs pas lan 'dug zer nas sa 'og nas bton/ rgya gar du skyel bar bsam ste dre'u gnyis kyi theg nas mang yu la du pheb pa'i dus su lam la ma thar zhes gleng nas/ jo bo mang yul du lo bcu bzhir bzhugs/ jo bo mi bskyo da rdo rje rgya yul du skyel rgyu la/ shar phyogs do mo'i thang la bskyal/ der 'ag bdun lus pas na/rgyal thang zer (chos lung mda')slar ra mo cher bzhugs su bcug go / rgyal po chos la dga' na'ang /blon ma zhang khron pa skyes dang stag ra klu gong la sogs dbang che bas/ gzhan gyis rgol ma nus so/ / de nas rgyal po sku nar son te/ rje blon rnams chos bya bar blo mthun te/ thabs sna tshogs kyis mgo bskoranas ma zhang stod lung brang phu ru gson por bang sor bcug stag ra klu gong byang la sprugs so/ / de nas thams cad la chos bya ba'i bka' gnang nas/ thog mar mang yul nas jo bo shākya shing rtar gdan drangs/bsu bar rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te ra sa'i btsan khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/dus der kha che skyes bzangasakyi bu ā nanda zer ba de ra sa dang ramo che kanyis byidkur na/ dar tshags dgung seb kyi chong dus sar/ tshong byed gin yod pa bos nas lo sdo bco ཿ/ nge/ / tsās dang bon gnyis rtsod pa 'gran pas/ bon khungs ngan par brtsis nas/ bon gyichos zumar cadzwa brag dmar la sogs par gter du sbas so/ / la la chu la bskyur/ dran pa nam mkha9 dang lngu ba4 ṭwāṃsporadzin rnam1 kā/sa tram̐gs

kyang rgyal mo rong du pheb dgos byung / 'phral gyi 'gal rkyen bzlog pa tsam min pa ma gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal blon thams cad gros byas te/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du/ khye'u gsum gyis smon lam btab pa'i mthu la brten nas/ sba gsal snang rgya gar du mkhan po bo rnyi sa twa gdan 'dren du btang bas/gsal snang gis mkhan po gdan drangs te pho brang du phebs pa dang / rgyal pos sku rags ma bcing bar/gser phye bre gang phyag tu bsnams nas mkhan po bsu ba la byon pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi dbu la la thod gsol pas/ stod mnga' ris zhwa tsam cig khrims shig chags/ zhabs la chag gsol pas smad mdo khams la lham tsam la khrims shig chags/ sku lus la sku rags ma bcings pas/ bar 'dir rgyal khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul bas chos byar btub gsungs/ de nas kha che ā nandas lo tsā bgyis te/ rje blon rnams la chos gsungs so/ /drug pa/ mkhan slob chos gsum gyi skor/de nas rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la nga'i thug dam gtsug lag khang 'gro ba sems can gyi 'dren pa dam pa gcig bzhengs pa ji lta bu zhig la blangs nas bzhengs snyam pa dang / der mkhan po sto1rnyi sa twa dang mkhan slob gnyis gleng pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas ri rab kyi steng nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gtsug lag khang la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa la/ de'i sa gzhi mkhan po sgo rnyi sa twa shan ta rakṣi tas byin gyis brlabs te/rgyal po la khyed kyis sa rkos shig gsungs nas rgyal pos sa brkos pa dang / sa'i zhag dang sa lu mang po byung ba rgyal po'i zhal du gsol/ dbu la yang byugs so/ /de ltar btsan po dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig stag gi lo la rmang bting nas bzhengs pa la/ rgya gar nas mkhan po sgo rnyi sa twa byang chub sems dpa' de spyan 'dren pa la/ rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan ag tshom gyi ring la bod kyi lo tsā ba snyags dzha na ku ma ra dri med zla shar bya ba dang g.yog po gnyis la gser phye bre gang zhu rten du phul nas byon pas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs kyang /bod lha 'dre gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams gdug pa che bas rtsig tu mi btub pa las rgyal pos slob dpon chen po lags/ bdag gi yar dkon mchog gsum gyi mchod pa'i rten gtsug lag khang ji ltar bzhengs pas 'grub pa lags/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ da byang chub sems kyis zhi bas 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed pas mi thul bas/ 'di la nged rang rgyal po dang skye ba snga ma la smon lam lhan cig tu btab pa'i o rgyan gyi rgyal po int+ra bo rnyi'i sras mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i sku pad ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ rgya gar yul gyi tshur mtha' dang bal po'i yul gyi phar mtha' na/ yang le shod gyi brag phug na mchog gi sgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa de spyan drangs na lha 'dre gdug tsub can thams cad 'thul zhing rgyal po'i bsam pa 'aspub par mchis/ de yang ngas smras pa skad ma zer zhes rgyal po la smras so/ /(1)de nas rgyal pos nang 'khor blon 'bangs rnams la/ mdang gsum nga'i mi lam na rgya gar dang bal po'i so mtshams yang le shod kyi brag phug na yo spyan spyal po'i sras mdzad pa'i slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas bya ba mthu rtsal che ba dgongs pa zab pa sprul pa'i sku gcig bzhugs pa de spyan drangs na/— 132 —

nga'i bsam pa 'grub par rmis pas/ de spyan 'dren dgos la khyed bang chen mi gsum gtong zhes bka' stsalab/blon 'bangs rnams kyang de 'thad do zhes thag bcad do/ /bang chen pa khas len pa ma byung bas rgyal pos bka' stsal te/ sras mang rje gsal snang dang / se 'og lha lung gnyis g.yog po gsum dang bcas la gser gye bre gang bskur/ bar gyi lam rgyag dang bcas lam du zhugs pa dang / slob dpon gyi spyan sngar srung ma rnams kyis bskul ba dang thugs kyis mkhyen pas/ bod yul has pho ri'i rtser bod kyi rgyal po lha sras btsan pos gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs su gsol bas slob dpon chen po myur du mjal bar sgron lam btab pas na/ slob dpon chen po'i spyan sngar bang chen pa 'ong bas de rnams thang chad nyon mongs pa mkhyen nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la byon nas mang yul gung thang la bzhugs su gsol/ bang chen pa rnams de nas mjal tshe slob dpon mkhyen bzhin du khyed su yin/ gar 'gro gsungs pa dang / sras mang rje gsal snang gis nged bod kyi lha sras btsan pos slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas spyan 'dren tu btang ba lags khyed rang lags sam zhus pas/ 'o na de nga yin/ zla ba gsum gyi gong nas srung ma rnams kyis bskul te/ khyod lha sras btsan po'i bang chen pa rnams nyon mongs kyis dogs nas 'dir bsdad pa yin/khyed la sku yon 'bul rgyu ci yod pa phul cig gsungs pas/ phyag 'tshal skor ba byas te gus pas gser phul lo/ / da ci yod phul cig gsungs pas/ rgyal pos ni de las ma bskur lags/ nged bang chen pa gsum gyis lus ngag yid gsum yongs su dag par 'bul zhes phyag 'tshal skor ba byas/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas zhu ba phul/ slob dpon chen po lags/ bdag cag bod kyi lha sras btsan pos thugs dam 'gro ba sems can yongs kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs pa la slob dpon sgo lha sa twas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ bod khams kyi lha srin gdug tsub che bas bzhengs su ma btub par/ bod kyi rgyal po'i thugs dgongs sgrub pa dang / gdug pa can tshar gcod pa dang 'dul ba'i don du gsheṭa par zhu 'tshal zhes zhu ba phul bas/ slob dpon thugs dgyes te nga khyed kyi dad pa dang gus pa g.yo zol med pa la gser du yod gsungs nas/ phyag g.yon pa nub phyogs su bskyangs pas sa rdo thamasacad gzi dang mchong rin po che gser g.yur bsgyur nas bang chen pa kun la'ang byin no/ / nga'i rdzu 'phrul 'di ltar che ste/ khyed rnams yid ches te 'ong / yid ches par gyis thig rgyal po'i bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi gser gyis nga la bya rgyu med/ 'on kyang mnga' bdag gi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir re zhig blang gin gsungs nas/ mang yul dang bal yul phyogs su gtor bas dus phyis bod kyi gser dngul thams cad bal yul phyogs su 'dor bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ der bsgyur ba'i gser g.yu bang chen pa kun la byin pa kun rdzun yin nam snyam/ so sos kha phye nas balnga sa tshe bden par snang ste thams cad yid ches so/ / slob dpon pad ma'i thugs rjes bod yul du gyin sgadang mang yul don khar phyags phebs te/ de la stod mnga' ris nas bzung ste bod kha sprus yo ngapa /sa srin mthu bo che dang rgyal ragong the'u rang thams cad 'dul nas dam la btags so/ / 4 — 133 —

(2)de nas bsam yas has pho rir byon pa dang / bod kyi mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang rgyal blon kun bsu ba la byon pa las/ rgyal po rje 'bangs kyi thugs dgongs la nga sa bdag rgyal po yin/ rgyal khrims dang chos khrims gnyis kyi bdag po nga yin pas slob dpon gyis nga la phyag byed snyam/slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la nga sprul ba'i sku yang yin/ rgyal pos nga la phyag byed snyam pas phyag la ma 'dum pas/ de la slob dpon gyis nga che nga btsan gyi mgur bzhes pa/ khams gsum sems can 'chi la rtag /yo ga tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /nga 'chi med pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ /khams gsum dbang sdud kyi gdams ngag bdog / snang srid 'khor 'das kyi dpe cha la/ /drang don nges don gyi bshad pa byed/ /nga dge bshes pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ / 'khor 'das shan 'byed kyi gdams ngag bdog /sems nyid rnal ma'i shog bu la/ / sgra tshig dang bral ba'i yi ge bris/ /nga yig mkhan pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ /chos yi ge med pa'i gdam ngag bdog / 'di ltar gnang ba'i gyang logs la/ / don gnyis su med pa'i ri mo bris/ /nga lha bzo pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ /snang stong gsal ba'i gdams ngag bdog /mi dug lnga'i nad kyis gzir ba la/ /zag med sman gyis gso bar byed/ /nga sman pa pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ / bdud rtsi 'chi sos kyi gdams ngag bdog / mi dad pa bskyed pa'i 'dun ma byas/ / mi tshe phyi ma'i bde skyid byas/ / nga gtso bo pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor ba rtsad gcod kyi gdams ngag bdog/shes rab snying rje'i go mtshon thogs/ / rnam rtog logs lta'i dgra bo btul/ / nga dpa' bo pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor ba g.yul bzlog gi gdams ngag bdog /dug lnga gdon lnga dgrar langs kyang / /ye shes lnga'i dbyings su brgyab/ /nga mthu chen pad ma 'byung gnas yin/ /dug lnga rtsad gcod kyi gdams ngag bdog/ khyed gdong dmar srin po bod kyi rje/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i khengs sems can/ / nga rgyal 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /bod kyi mnga' bdag lha sras la/ khyed mnga' thang che la glo ba dga'/ / rgyal po nyid la phyag mi 'tshal/ rgyal pos na bza' bzhes phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs nas phyag g.yas pa deng mdzad pas rgyal po'i na bza' phyag gi 'od zer gyi zul rtser tshigs nas rgyal blon rnams bred de rgyal pos yas kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas slob dpon pho brang du spyan drangs nas gser khri la bzhugs su gsol/ zhal skyems dang 'jig rten gyi zhal zas sna chogs drangs so/ /za 'og gi skug beer sku la gsol/ rgyal pos phyag rten dang bcas nas zhus pa/ e ma/ na mo ma hwa gu ru rin po che/ /bdag ni gardang dmar srin po bod kyi rje/ / bod kyi mi ni gdul bar dka'/ / dam pa'i chos kyi rten gcig 'dzugs/ /slob dpon sprul pa'i sku bzhugs pas/ /ma rung lha srin 'dul du gsol/ /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes zhu ba phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bod kyi mnga' bdag rgyal po lags/ / bod 'di gnod sbyin pho mo'i yul/ / gnod sbyin lha srin dam la btags/ / 'di na bod kyi klu rgyal yod/ /gsungs nas/ klu gdug pa can de la klu gtor 'jug dgos gsungs te/ de nas mal gro'i mda' byon nas 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi cho ga mdzad/ dpal ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor 'al phye — 134 —

nasamanga' bdag rje 'bangs kyi sgrib pa sbyangs so/ / de mal gro gzi chen la klu gter bcug pas cho ga ma‘dado/ /(2)de nas has pho rir byon chab gtor gzi'i phor ba gang la brten nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed nas byin gyis brlabs te/ slob dpon gyis lha 'dre thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyag rgya mdzad nas mgur bzhes pa/ hūṃ nga ni pad ma 'byung gnas te/ /mang la gyi dri mas ma gos mtsho skyes rdo rje yin/ /lus la gnod pas mi tshugs sgyu lus rnam pa dag /yo ga tshe yi rig 'dzin grub pa brnyes/ /nga'i lus ngag yid gsum lha ru gsal/ / 'jig rten lha 'dre thams cad zil gyis gnon/ / 'jig rten lha srin dregs pas sdigs su med/ / nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'byung chen bzhi bo shong yang shong / /shong yang shong du yangs kyang yangs/ /sems nyid stong ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lha srin sde brgyad shong yang shong / / shong yang shong la yangs kyang yangs/ / sems nyid stong pa dmigs med la/ / lha yang med de 'dre yang med/ / nga la cho 'phrul ci bstan yang / / nga la gnod pa rdul tsam med/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya che 'di/ / mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed/ / so sor thob pa sngags kyis byas/ / phyag rgyas 'thab rtsod rgyal pham med/ /cugs bcad bden pas bkram ste bsngo/ /'di zhes sa gzhi gnang ba byin/ /khri srong lde btsan bsam pa sgrub/ /sngags 'chang nga yi bka' ma gcog gum gum chum chum las la chums/ /lha khang rtsigs shig lha 'dre rnams/ / las la 'dus shig lha 'dre rnams/ / zhes gsungs nas mchod spyin rgya chen po mang por bsngos te byin pas/ lha 'dre thams cad slob dpon gyi bka' 'og tu 'dus/(4)de nas spyal po'i stag gi lo la rmang btings nas brtsigs pa/ slob dpon bo rnyi sa twa dang chos rgyal nyid kyi dbu rtse rigs gsum (ri rab)tshul du byas/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad du byas te/ dbu rtse yang thog rgya gar gyi lugs su bzhengs/ bar khang rgya nag gi lugs su bzhengs/ 'og khang bod kyi lugs su bzhengs te/ rta'i lo la 'byongs te/ dpal gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa bzhengs/ mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / ga'i che dpangs mtho rgyu bzang bkod legs pa/ bkra shis byin che kun nas 'gran zla med pa dga' ldan sum cu rtsa gsum gyi khang bzang la dpe blangs pa/ dpal nā len dra dang mtshungs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhugs/ brtsig pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra ste mdo sde ltar stong gsum gcig gi lugs so 'dul ba ltar theg pa'i skabs dang rim pa bzhin/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'jig rten bstan pa dang yang bstun no/ / de ltar btsun mo gsum las tshe spong bza' me tog sgron gyis khams gsum zang khang gling rtse rigs gsum dang 'dra ba gcig dang / pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis bu 'tshal gser dkung gling bzo sna khyad par can bcu gsum yod pa gcig 'brom bza' byang chub sman gyis dge rgyas bye ma'i gling sogs bzhengs/ lha khang thams cad kyi rgya 'ibs ka gdung / ka gzhu lcam sgo gligs ru bzhi thamasacad la gser gyi sbar kab la/ nor bu rin po che'i phra bcug pa/ bzo dang bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa 'dzam bu gling na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ lha yul gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang 'a~X3 kā bkaings

so/ /de nas rab gnas zhes rten gsum sogs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba da brtan por gnas byed cho ga mdzad/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang / mkhan po bo rnyi sa twa bsam yas lhan gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas mdzad pas/ bkra shis pa'i byin rlabs ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul dang ltas mang po byung /(5)de nas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang / mkhan po bo rnyi sa twa gnyis gser gyi khri la gsol te/ 'jig rten gyi spyan gzigs sna tshogs drangs te gtang rag chen po phulalo/ /dga' ston chen po yang byas so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po la yang sbyin gtong rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang mkhan po sgo rnyi sa twa gnyis rgya gar ru bzhud par dgongs nas/rgyal po la rgya gar yul du 'gro gsungs pa las/ rje mnga' bdag rgyal pos bzhugs par zhu ba phul/ rgyal pos slob dpon gnyis la gser bre re/ dngul skyogs bkang nas phul/ 'jig rten gyi zhal zas sna tshogs drangs/ phyag phul skor ba byas/ spyan chab bton nas zhu ba nan tan du phul ba/ e ma ho/ za hor u rgyan yul nas byon pa yin/ /slob dpon rnam gnyis bdag la gson/ /skye ba sngon yang smon lam btab/ / rgya gar yul du skyes nas ni/ / yang ni smon lam btab pa yin/ / slob dpon rnam gnyis rgya gar gyi/ /chos kyi yul du skyes pa yin/ /bdag ni kha ba can gyi ljongs/ /gdong dmar bod kyi yul du skyes/ / las kyi dbang gis rgyal por skyes/ / bdag gi yi dam bsam yas 'di/ / nyi shu rtsa gcig stag la rmang bting nas/ / bo lha sa twas sa gzhi byin gyis rlabs/ / bod kyi lha ma srin gyi gdug tsub che/ /bgegs kyis bar chad brtsig tu ma btub nas/ / slob dpon bo rnyi sa twas lung bstan nas/ / sbrul sku pad ma spyan drangs grub par na/ /dngos grub thugs dam dbang gis btsan nas byon/ / stag nas rta yi bar la lo lnga'i 'byongs/ /sngar yang sku drin shin tu che mod kyang / /spyal po khri srong lde batren ma gum bar/ /bzhud par mi zhu bzhugs par dgongs su gsol/ / thugs dam brtse ba'i dgongs pa gnang bar zhu/ /zhes zhu ba phul bas/ slob dpon gnyis kyis bka' bkros pa/ slob dpon pad ma'i zhal nas rang cag gsum tshe skye ba snga ma'i las 'brel yod par rgyal po'i zhal ngo mi bamyungs gsungs so/ /slob dpon bo rnyi sa twa'i zhal nas de shin tu legs pas de bzhin bgyi'o gsungs nas/ der slob dpon gnyis kyis rgyal po la bka' gnang ba la/ skye ba gsum gyi smon lam gyis/ /las kyi 'phros kyis bod du 'dzoms/ / sngar yang btsan po dgyes par bgyid/ / da yang btsan po'i 'al mi bskyungs bar bgyid/ / ces gsungs nas bzhugs par bkas gnang ngo / /(6)de nas rgyal pos slob dpon gnyis la chos gsungs pa'i zhu ba phul/ gser gyi khri la za 'og gi 'bol gsum brtsegs dang gab rtse'i gdan la slob dpon pad ma bzhugs/ dngul gyi khri la za 'og gi 'bol gsum brtsegs dang gab rtse'i gdan la mkhan po bo lha sa twa bzhugs/ gong gral la rgyal po nyid bzhus/sa/ g.yon gral la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang ska bu dpal brtsegs gnyis gab rtse'i khri la bzhugs/— 136 —

de nasaslob dpon gnyis la gser gyi maṇḍal khru gang ba re la g.yu'i me tog gi chom bu gling bzhi ri rab gling sdon nyizla'i brgyan pa phul/ lo tsā ba gnyis la yang rin po che'i maṇḍal re phul nas chos gsungs par zhu ba ni/ e ma ho/ rgya gar chos kyi yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i/ / dam chos rin po che la mnga' brnyes pa/ /mkhas pa chen po paṇa ṭi tar gyur pa/ / slob dpon chen po rnam gnyis kyis/ / gsang sngags dang ni mtshan nyid kyi/ /chos ni gsungs par zhu ba 'bul/ /lo tsā gnyis kyis bsgyur bar zhu/ /bod yul mun par 'thibs pas na/ / chos kyi sgron me sbor bar zhu/ / zhes zhus pas slob dpon gnyis kyis gnang ba/e ma ho/ rgyal po chen po bod kyi mi rnams la ni dad pa med/ blon po chen po rnams ni chos la gnag pas/rgyal po nyid kyis bka' khrims dam po dar gyi mdud pa 'dra ba bca' dgos pas 'chos shig gsungs nas/rgyal po shin tu dgyes pa'i phyag 'tshal/ lug gi lo gzhug nas spre'i lo gzhug yar bcad la/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa ltar bsdams/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing bzhin lci ba ni mes po rnams kyi phyag len ltar byas so/ /de nas slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis sngags kyi chos rgyud sde bco brgyad gsungs nas cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/ mkhan po bo rnyi sa twas rig sngags phyi ma rnams dang kri ya'i chos bya ba spyi'i rgyud drug gsungs nas lo tsā ba 'bro ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ro/ /bdun pa/ chos khrims dngargyal khrims sogs bsgrags pa'i skor/de nas rgyal pos yang chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'jam dam gnyis su sprel nas/ bod mnga' 'og tu 'dus tshad bsdus pa/ khrims shog ma bu dkar nag gi tshig bsgrags pa/ khrims la chos khrims rgyal khrims thang khrims gsum du bsgrags nas/ 'di skad gsungs/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/ /da nas chos kyi rgyal po nga yin pas/ /legs byas nyes byas rnam smin 'bras bu bskyed/ /legs par byed pa dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /rab byung sde 'jug sngags pa 'jug shing rung / /chos lugs gnyis po gang mos ci dgar gyis/ / mi skya pho mo kun gyis rig gnas slobs/ / chos bris chos thon chos slobs chos bshad kyis/ /byis pa brda 'phrod 'bri klog yon tan slobs/ /btsas par btsas ston sngags pa'i mchod gnas bsten/ /na bar sman bcos rim gro nad g.yog rem/ /rgas pa yi mug ma bcug bkur stis skyong / /shi bar bum cog chos ston sngags ston gyis/ /yo da pa med la bu lon skyed 'phel thong / /med pas 'jol la smrar skyin drin du khur/ / ma 'khor ba la zhu 'jal byed 'chag gis/ / dgra la zon chug gnyen la nang gshen gyis/ /gzhon pas 'pham long rgan pa'i ngag la nyon/ /bza' mi kha dum ma byed pha mar dris/ /sngar long phyi nyal bya ba mtha' ru thon/ /mi la mthar 'ded ma gtong bzang 'grogs kyis/ / khrel gdong ngo tsha med pa'i ya ma stong / kha nyen mi rnams sdod lugs mkhas su gyis/ / ma brku ma 'phrog ma brdung ma bsad cig / ma nus pa la thams cad snying rje bskyed/ / dbul ba'i mi la sbyin pa tsam thongs byin/ kha nyen mi la skyabs kha tshig grogs thong / / zer lo 'dug lo mang po btang snyoms zhog / rab byung mkhan pos sdom phog khrims byas bzhin/ /sde snod gsum nas ji ltar bshad bzhin gyis/ /dge 'dun skom dus — 137 —

dkar dang ja gsol cig / zas su 'bru dang bur sprang mar thud gsol/ / gos su mthang sham ngur sgrigachas mdzod cig gnas su gtsug lag khang sde'i nang du bzhugs/ / 'khon rtsod yod na dbyen 'dugamathun 'grigs kyis/ / chang nag sha dang lhad zas ma bren cig / sngags pa bla ma dam tshig bsgrags pa dang / /rgyun nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du gyis/ /skom du ja gsol dge 'dun dkor ma 'bags/ /zas su ci dgar longs spyod dug ma za/ /gos su dkar nag dmar po sngags chas kyis/ /gnas su sgrub khang gzung la yon tan spel/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir sgrub pa dang du longs/ /rab byung dge bar mdo sde ser ston gyis/ /sngags pa'i dge bar dkyil snyerakhor sngags ston gyis/ /mi nag dge ba bstan gnyis dge la thong / / chos 'chad gang 'dug mos phyag rgyang nas 'tshol/ / bstan pa ma bsre rang rang chos lugs kyis/ /nga yi chos khrims bsdams ltar ma byas na/ /nges par gcod pa rgyal po'i khrims yin pas/ /sdom bus mkhan po slob bus slob dpon dang / /'bangs kyi rje bo bu tshas pha dang ma/ / nu bos phu bo chung ma'i khyo bo la/ / mi 'tshams las byas bsad dang do bsdos pa/ /'di rnams me la bsregs gam chu la bskur/ /ngan byas an lcags btson dong khrims 'jug 'beebs/ / rgyal khrims med na ngan byed rgyags pas 'joms/ / ber ka shag shag gcer phyung rke thag khyigs/ / khrims lugs bzhin du sus kyang 'gal byung na/ / thob bya gang yin gzugs phung steng du smin/ / bsad na stong 'don phrog na mig skyed 'dreg /brkus na 'jal 'don byi byas byi rin len/ khra mar 'bon 'gel 'thab pa btson dong 'jug / brdung na gses 'ded mi nyan rna ba 'dreg /chos lugs mthun par mi byed khyu nas 'bud/ /rdzun gtong mthar sprug mi 'jal gta' ma len/ / mi bden pa la thams cad yo log thong / / mi chod bred pas 'dzin chug ces bsgrags so/ / nas la bre tshad ljid la srang tshad tshugs/ / zong la gong spyob gser la na tar thegarkun srung khyi gsos nam tshod byas 'dzin chug /kha 'og lus chug mi la mgo sdud dgos/ /chos srid sngags srid blon srid srid du bcad/ /gcig mgo gcig thon mi dge bskyar la thon/ / la dang 'phrang 'jam yul na mi ngan med/ / mi dge bcu spangs dge ba bcu po 'phel/ kha nyen chags bde dud 'gro gnya' yangs mdzod/ /yod pa bzhag chog med pa tshol slong bcug /chos khrims rgyal khrims bsdams pa kun gyi thugs 'jog 'tshal/ / de nas bod kyis rgyal pos 'bangs phru gu rig pa can kha spro bsang zhing skye mched dwangs pa shes rab che zhing kha lce bde bo rnams bsags nas/ 'di ltar zhus/ mkhan slob rnam gnyis lags/ nged bod 'bangs kyi phru gu rig pa can rnams 'dir bsag don la rgya gar yul du sgra bsgyur slob tu gtong ched 'phral skad dang chos skad thams cad slob pa la bka' drin mi chung bar zhu lags/ mkhan slob gnyis kyis lags so/ / rgyal po dang blon po tshos phru gu rnams tsho gnyis bgos nas/ mkhan pos sgra bslabs par zhus mkhan slob gnyis gzim khang re la gdan khri re bkod nas bod 'bangs kyis phru gu tshos mkhan slob gnyis la kha dar re dang phyag 'tshol bcug nas pus mo sa la btsug pa'i gus 'dud slob pa'i dbu bzung / mkhan pos/ na mo byu dhā ya/ na mo bhārma ya/ na mo sargyu ya gsungs nas/ bod — 138 —

phrug kha lce mi dag pas ma mo spud pa ya/ ma mo spad ma ya/ ma mo pha pa ya/ sgra de bod kyi skad du bsgyur nas bslabs pa la/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ / dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ /bod phrug tshos lce yis ma 'gyur bas 'di skad zer/ zar 'gal thag tham mo sbrabs hu hi/ chos la thag tham mo sbabs hu hi/ le 'un ya thag tham mo sbabs hu gyi/ mkhan po bzhad cing thal deb mdzad/ slob dpon pad mas/ na mo gu ru steḥ na mo de wā yeḥ na mo ṭā kyi 5ཿ gsungs pa la/ bod phrug tshos ji tsam bslab kshing ma shes te/ ma mo sru'u ya/ ma mo 'dre bha ya/ ma mo bha khyi ya/ rgya gar skad de dag bod skad du bsgyur nas bslab tshe/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ / mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ /bod phrug tshos de yang ma shes te/ mna' ma ya thag tham mo sbabs hu hi/ byi bam ya thag tham sbabs hu rnyi/ sha 'bo thag tham mo sbabs hu hi/ slob dpon yang bzhad cing thal mo deb/rgyal pos sgo phag nas nyan tshe thugs mug pas na mang du bshum/ sha wags rus dum bzhes kyang dus mi 'gro/ gsungs zhor du mkhan slob gnyis la rgyal pos phyag re phul nas/ mgur 'di gsungs so/ /chos med mtha' 'khob bod yul mun gling 'dir/ / mi la sangs rgyas thob pa bya don du/ / mkhan slob rnam gnyis spyan drangs lha khang bzhengs/ / bzhud par bshol btab chos gsungs zhu ba phul/ / thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhugs par bka' yis gnang / / chos khrims bsdams nas gang mtshams byis pa bsdus/ /sgra tsam mi shes lo tsā mi 'gyur bas/ / chos bstan mi tshugs ji ltar bya na phan/ / dus gsum mkhyen pa slob dpon pad ma lags/ / slob dpon gyi 'al nas/ thabs shig yod kyi na rgyal po'i thugs glod lags/ gsungs so/ /le'u bcu ba/ bee ro tsa na'i rnam thar/dang po/ slob dpon pad mas lung bstan pa/rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa nas/ / shākya thub pa'i nyer gnas kun dga' bo/ / tshe 'phos longs sku'i zhing khams mang myul nas/ /mi lus chos ldan skye bdun tha ma ni/ /gtsang gi snye mo bye mkhar bya ba yi/ /gnas gzhi zhig gi brang khang dmig bu na/ /pha ming pa gor sgye 'dod bya ba la/ /ma ming phran ka bza' sgron skyed kyi bu/ / gan jag thang ta zhes pa lo brgyad tsam/ /pha ma gnyis la bslangs na ster bar mchis/ /sprul pa'i lo tsā rtsod med grags pa 'byung / /dbu ru phan yu la ska ba pa 'es byar/ /yab ming ska ba blo ldan zhes bya dang / /yum ming 'bro bza' rdo rje lcam gyi bu/ /shākya thub nyer gnas tsunda tshe 'phos pa/ /skyes mchog ska ba dpal brtsegs zhes bya ba/ / pha ma gnyis la bslangs na ster bar mchi/ / ru lag sha~X9 kyi dar ma

sgang bya bar/ / yab ni cog to klu yi rgyal 'byung dang / / yum ni 'bring bza' mdzes ma gnyis kyi bu/ /dge bsnyen li myu byi ni tshe 'phos pa/ / cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ / pha ma gnyis la bslangs na ktor/ /bar mchi/ / lo tsā gsum de spyan du drangs bar lags/ / rgyal po dgyes bzhin du lags ni lags (1)de nas rgyal po'i mnal lam du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' la byon no/ /rgyu 'bras la zla ba rtogs grol dus gcig la yong ba'i chos bka' rdzogs pa chen po bya ba yod pas/ bod kyi dge slong mi gnyis tshol du thongs shig bya ba'i lung bstan byung nas/ spyal po khyed kyis pa gor nye 'dod kyi bu dang rtsangs thog legs kyi bu legs grub gnyis bod du shes rab che bar grags so zhes rmis nas/ rgyal po blon po dang bcas dpon g.yog bdun dang / rkang thang nyer lnga rta phyir khrid nas chibs bsgyur gnang song /(2)de nas snye mo mkhar gnas gzhi'i mdun du thon byung la/ der byis pa phyag dang zhe sa mi shes pas mjal bar ma nus par sgo phyir rgyu 'grul byed skabs/ lus bskyod bzhin ngag gi glu len rkyed la 'breng ba 'khor gcig bcings nas 'dug yod pa/ rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di la gtam zhig dris shig gsungs nas blon po zhig mngags/ blon pos byis pa'i mdun phyin nas/ rgyal po'i mdun du khrid nas 'ongs/rgyal pos khyod kyis pa gor nye 'dod shes sam gzhi ru yod dam dris tshe/ byis pa'i lan/ yod pa yod de da lta gtam tshol song yod/ 'o na bran ka bza' sgron skyid de shes sam/ shes pa shes te da lta mig tshol song ba'i gzhi ru mi 'dug ces/ rgyal pos khyod sus bu yin dris par pha yi bu yin zer/ khyod kyi pha ma'i ming la ji zer dris pa na/ lan/ khyod rang da lta ming nas 'bod shes pa de ka yin zer/ yang rgyal pos dris pa/ khyod kyi khang ba gang yin zhes/ lan/ khyim yin zer bas/ rgyal po dgyis bzhin 'dir shog phyag 'tshol gsungs pas/ lan/ khyod kyis slob dang zer ba'i bslabs pas shes nas rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal po dgyes bzhin du byis pa'i mgo la phyag gis byil byil mdzad nas thugs dgongs la slob dpon gyi gsungs pa'i bu de 'di ka rang yin kha la brtag na nye bzang spyang po 'dug dgongs nas/ nga yi phyi la e 'grogasungs tshe phyin chog khyod kyi rta zhon skyon cig zer dus/ phar ngos nas pha des chang khur nas 'ong / ma des mar nag zhig khur nas 'ongs ste/ byis pa de'i de gnyis la a pha a ma zhes 'bod pas na/ spyal pos 'o/ gtam khungs chang dang mig ni mar mes sel ba'i thugs dgongs su shar ba'i go brda 'phrod song / bu de rta la bskyon nas rkang thang nyi shu'i dkyil du bcug nas sngon la btang / rgyal blon rnams phyi la thon byas bsdad pa'i tshe/ pa gor lha 'dod sngon du byung ba'i spyal blon 'khor bcas khyim nang du sbyan drangs nas/ zhun me sgron drung mas gsol ja drangs zhor du/ mnga' bdag rgyal po lags 'dir byon pa'i zhabs don ci bdog zhus/ rgyal pos 'dir mchis don gzhan med khyod kyi bu 'di slong du 'ong ba yin cis kyang bu 'di nga la byin cig lo tsā bslab nas chos bsgyur dgos gardi1sa/140 —

(2)pha ma gnyis ma dga' bzhin du ngu zhing mgur 'di gsungs/ de ltar ma gsungs rgyal po chen po lags/ /rgan rgon gnyis la snying brtse gcig pu 'di/ /gcig pu 'di las bu gzhan nged la med/ /lo yang brgyad las ma lon ci mdzad dgongs/ / lo brgyad lon pa'i chos bamyur mi 'ong bas/ / rgya gar yul du rtol kyang ga la rtol/ /de skad ma gsungs spyal po chen po lags/ /zhus nas phyag byas/ de nas mnga' bdag rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ yid zhum ma byed yab yum gnyis po lags/ / bod phrug gzhan gyis lo tsā ma shes pas/ /lo tsā bslab nas bod du chos bsgyur 'jug /slob dpon chen po pad ma'i lung bstan yin/ /khyod kyi bu 'di min pa'i mi 'ong gsungs/ /lo brgyad lon pa'i bu 'di lo gzhon yang / /da lta 'di ka bzhin du gtong ba min/ /longs nas 'gro ba 'ong dus gtong ba yin/ /rgan rgon gnyis kyi skyid sdug ngas shes pas/ / bu 'di nga la mi sbyin med thabs med/ / gsungs nas/ bu byin yab yum gnyis kyang khrid nas 'ongs/ yul dbus gang bzang 'doms la sdod cig gsungs de nas khong gnyis yul dbus gang la bltas kyang yar klungs bzang bar shes pas yab yum gnyis yar klungs nog pa rtsa ru bzhag go /de nas rgyal po chen po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ /thad ka thad kar mthun rkyen legs sbyar nas/ /bod kyis sdom gsum gsungs par e thub snyam/ khrus khang gling du mkhan po gdan drangs nas/ / sba mi gsal snang dpal dbyangs rgyal mchog dbyangs/ / lha lung dpal rdor rma rin la sum rgyal/ / mkhas pa bee ro tsa na rab tu byung / /sad mi mi bdun bla yi mchod gnas gyur/ /nam mkha'i snying po kru gu e bag sha/ /ru gyod bīrya glang chen dpaspru seng ge/ /rgyal ba'i blo gros rnams kyang rab tu byung / /dbu yi mchod gnas bkur bar bka' la btargos/ /sad mi mi bdun dge slong mi lnga la/ /dbu la rin po che yi brog zhu bskon/ /zhal du li khar lha yi skyems drangs nas/ /'o skol mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams su/ /mdo sngags bstan pa dar bar mdzad du gsol/ / zheso so/ / gnyis pa/ bee ro tsa na bka' rdzogs pa chen po zhus su btang ba'i skor/bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ / ya rabs blo dang ldan pa'i bee ro dang / / blo gsal rtsangs sngon legs grub ces bya gnyis/ / rgya gar yul du chos 'chol gtong ba yin/ / gser gyi pa tra bdun dang gser bre dgu / phyag tu snoms la bod du chos sgyur cig / de skad gsungs nas rgya gar yul du brdzangs/ /zla ba gnyis na rigs ngan gcan 'phrang sleb/ /gcan 'phrang ba yis mi gsod gser 'asrog pas/ /bee ro tsa nas rdzu 'phrul byas pa las/ /rin chen za ma tog cig nang du ni/ /lcags kyi spu gri zhig tu sprul nas bsdad/ /'phrang srung ku mā ra ni ngo mtshar skyes/ /legs grub gsod 'dod mtha' mi spyi skum sprul/ / gcan 'phrang ba yis ma sod ka re lus/ / de nas bee ro tsa nas mgur 'di gsungs/ / gsal khyab nam mkha' lha bu'i lus 'di la/ /bsad dang ma bsad shi dang ma shi med/ /srog 'di bcad na khyod la sdig pa 'ong / /sgyu ma'i gser phye brngan pa 'di bzhes la/ /lam sna ji ltar yin pa bstan du gsol/ /de skad gsungs nas gser phye tshom cig byin snye / 'phrang srung dga' nas sa lam drang por bstan/ / de nas — 141 —

rgya gar rdo rje gdan du rtol/ /spya gar yul rnams ma lus khyi bzhin 'khyams/ /phrad tshad mi la dam chos su mkhas dris/ / rgya gar mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa lnga rnyed/ / pra bsto dang shīlend+ra po rnyi/ /dzi na mitra sto na sna tra dang / /ā nasto dang su nd+ra bornyi dang / /dha māshī dā na ma shī la dang / /tsachu go mi palca 4 na dang / /ka na ka dang shākya shrī phra lha/ / /pradzñā wasto kā la ga la bha/ / bi ma mi tra guspya bugle dang / /ārya de ba ka ma la shī la/ /dha mā girti shānta de ba dang / /shrī ledha ra tsi tra ma ṇi dang / / shārnyi gisgo shī la mdzi dang / /burwa gubha nyi shu rtsa lnga 'di/ /sku la khro ba mi mnga' byang chub sems/ /paṇa chen kun dang mjal tshul zur tsam ni/ /chu len pa la 'phrin bskur lan ma byung / /ta la'i lo mar sgra 'di bris nas bskur/ /ma hā kya ru ṇa burnya dha sagi dzñā mo ya/ /bo rnyis twa ka ru ṇa sa ma ya/ /dzñā na gabha ku ru bha smin/ /zhes bskur sgra la mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgyur/ /'phags pa'i 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' khyod/ /'gro ba rigs drug bsod nams mi lus sku/ / rin chen 'bar ba sde snod gsum gyi dbyig yid bzhin nor ltar thugs rje'i stobs mchog can/ / gsal khyab nyi ma lta bu'i sku lus la/ / skye ba brgyud nas mi lus thob pa yi/ / bod kyi dge slong dngos ngan bdag dngos kyis/ /sgrib pa sbyang phyir dkon mchog rin chen la/ /rtag par mchod cing yun du zhabs 'khor bas/ /mun pa bsal nas bsod nams tshogs bskyed na/ /thugs rje ma bskyed smon lam ma dag pas/ / 'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas sems can gnas su 'gyangs/ / sdug po nyi zhal 'phags pa'i 'thibs gsal 'khums/ / ston pa'i thugs rje'i zhags pas gzung gsol go / de nas sgra lan bskur ba 'di lta ste/ /sa ma ya ā pā ra mi ta dzñā na/ /zhes bya ba bskur bee ro tsa nas bsgyur/ /sngon gyi dam tshig chen pos bdag bskul na/ / khyod dang mi 'phrad pa yi rang dbang med/ / 'gro ba'i sems nyid de bzhin gshegs pa yin/ / srin bu padma yan chad sangs rgyas rgyu/ / rigs drug 'gro ba sangs rgyas mnyam gyur kyang / / 'phags pa'i 'phags pa ston pa khyod kyis rnyed/ / dkon mchog rin chen bla med mchod gnas la/ / bsngags pa mthong ma tshogs rnams skye ba'i rgyu/ /sems kyi rus pas yan lag thang bcad nas/ /dka' bas byon pa bdag kyang dga' ba'i mchog /shes pa bsdur la khad kyis 'phrad byar go /de nas gser gyi pa tra gser phye phul/ /bod kyi rgyal po'i lo rgyus zhib tu bsnyad/ /dge slong chen po bo rnyi sa twa dang / / sngags pa padma 'byung gnas bod na bzhugs/ / rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis kyi chos sgo nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyis ldan gsal bar mdzad/ /rgyal po rgyu 'bras chos kyis ma tshim zhing / /ci ga la dang nyo ga thos se las/ /lung drangs pa yi chos tsho tshol du btang / /thugs la gdags par zhus pas rab tu mnyes/ /paṇa chen rim pa bzhin du chos bka' bsgo/ /legs grub ngo so 'dod nas sngon la song / /ma de ma shi'i gong du chos 'chad zer/ / bsam pa lam lus gcan 'phrang dam pos bsad/ / bee ro tsa na bsdad de chos la sbyangs/ /bla mas tshims sam gsungs kyang ma tshims zhus/ /lag pa sngas bcug kha sgrub nyal nas bsdad/ / na 'am gsungs pas na zhus ci na gsungs/ / bee ros na ba bzhi yi mgur 'di gsungs/ /bdag ni mthong ste ma 'phrad rang sems na/ /myong ste ma tshims da dung rang sems na/ /cha — 142 —

tsamathosate ma go rang sems na/ / nad ni rdzogs chen sems sde ma bus na/ / nad de mtha' ru phyin pa'i sman cig zhu/ / bla mas dgos pa bdag gis kun bstan na/ / khyod kyis ci la brdugs nas ma byung gsungs/ /bee ros brdugs pa bcu yi mgur 'dir gsungs/ /phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba de/ /la shan gnyis kyi 'phrang la brdugs/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa de/ / bying rgod gnyis kyi 'phrang la brdugs/ /'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub de/ /brda don ma 'phrad 'phrang la brdugs/ /rdzogs chen bya bral lhun grub de/ / don dang bral ba'i 'phrang la sdug sangs rgyas spyod yul rang dbang de/ / spyi glugs tshangs pa'i dbang la brdugs/ / spyod pa blang dor bral ba de/ / 'dod rtsol gnyis kyi 'phrang la brdugs/ / lam la bgrod du med pa de/ / lung rigs gnyis kyi 'phrang la brdugs/ / ye shes rang byung zang thal de/ / bag chags 'thug po'i 'phrang la brdugs/ / man ngag sems sde ma bu 'di/ /zung du ma 'brel 'phrang la brdugs/ / bee ro tsa na 'gro ba la/ / 'gro dang 'gro ste 'phrang la brdugs/ /zhes gsungs bla ma rab tu dgyes par gyur/ / sngar gyi steng du byang sems rmad byung bshad/ / mdo tsam mdo lung mdo 'grel la sogs pa/ / rdzogs pa chen po sems sde ma bu cibashad/ /rdzogs pa chen po 'khor ba rtsad gcod rgyud/ / rgya mtsho'i klong dang klong khra klong nag bshad/ / man ngag thugs thag chod pa mang po gnang / /blo la zin tshad bzung zhing ma zin rnams/ /ta la'i lo mar bris nas yang chab byas/ /de nas bod du 'gro bar dgongs༄ la/ /tha rus khyod gyi grogs po legs spub gum/ /khyod kyang bsad 'gro rkang mgyogs sgrubs shig gsungs/ / rkang mgyogs mkhan po ku mā ra la zhus/ / sku sha lcags kyi sdong po can gnas su/ /ri tī lcags kyi dre'u rta rkang gsum bsgrubs/ /yul de'i mi rnams khyod 'dir ci byed zer/ /lan du bee ro tsa nas mgur 'di gsungs/ /bdag ni lo tsa bee ro tsa na te/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /ya mtshan rmad byung bdag gi lus 'di rnyed/ / mkha' klong rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nas 'ongs/ / 'jig rten 'di yi dgos pa'i gtam bgyis te/ / kun gzhi ma bcos bde chen lhun rdzogs pa'i/ / mkha' ltar dag pa'i byang chub sems nyid 'di/ /rig pa'i klong nas thugs rje'i nyi ma shar/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bdag gis rnyed/ /skye med mi dmigs yi ge a gcig las/ / dgongs pa'i don du bya ba de las med/ / a ni ye nas mi dmigs skye med de/ / skye med cho 'phrul dgos dgu 'byung ba'i phyir/ / de las byung ba'i bod ni 'di rnams so/ / nor ni ma mchis mkhas pa'i man ngag 'chang / / bla ma ma mchis paṇa chen nyi shu lnga / /'khor ni ma mchis lha srin sde brgyad bskor/ / chung ma ma mchis kun tu bzang mo yin/ / grogs ni ma mchis ma mo mkha' 'gro'i grogs/ /rta ni ma mchis chogs brgyad yid khyi rta/ /bu ni ma mchis rig pa'i ye shes bu/ /lha ni ma mchis rang sems don gyi lha/ /mthu ni ma mchis dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /rten sa ma mchis do nub rten sa mdzod/ / ces gsungs 'dus pa'i tshegs rnams byung / / de nas rkang mgyogs grub ste chas rnams khur/ / yul ni ko sha tsardon gling du byon/ /da ko'i rgyal po rā hul byi byi — 143 —

'ongs/ /ras kyi par ka ta zhig gus phul nas/ / bod kyi bande skye med chos bya ba/ / ji lta bu la zer mi gsungs dang zer/ / par ta sku la gsol nas mgur 'di gsungs/ /bdag ni rnam par snang mdzad de/ /'gro ba rnam pa sna tshogs la/ / gsal bya'i nyi ma bya dgongs nas/ / dka' ba bcu drug dka' la bgyis/ /sgyu ma'i phung po lus bshig nas/ /ston pa'i thugs rje bdag la shar/ /kun la snang bar mdzad pas na/ /ming yang rnam par snang mdzad yin/ / ming dang don du bdag mthun te/ / chos dbyingaspomakha' ltar dag pa'i gting rdzogs pas/ / sangs rgyas ngo bor ma gyur gcig kyang med/ / ston pa'i zhal skyen bdag gis bshad pa 'di/ / rgyal po'i thugs la dgongs la bag tsam nyon/ /dmigs su med pa'i byang chub sems/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis dang bral/ /tha snyad tshig gi sgra spangs nas/ /de nyid gsal la ma yongs pa/ /skye ba med pa'i chos dbyings yin/ / dgongs pa'i don du de bzhag go/ /de nyid ma nor sgom pa na/ /skye ba phyi ma mi len nges/ /zhes gsungs rgyal po rab mnyes gyur/ / 'phags pa byams sku gser las byas shig phul/ /de nas bod du 'gro bar chas pa la/ /rgyal blon panyi ta kun rmi ltas log /grong khyer ser skya'i shī la nā land+ra'i/ / sgo drung tshogs nas bgros shing pra mo phab/ / ya gi rdzogs pa chen po man chad nas/ /ma gi nyan thos theg pa yan chad kyi/ /mdo sngags chos rnams bod du khyer bas lan/ /de nas rkang mgyogs btang ste gsod par byas/ / rkang cimagyogs mkhan pos bee ro'i gan du brgyugs/ /mkhas pa bdun po'i rmi lam bzlas pa ni/ / kye / grogs po byang chub sems dpa' snyan gson dang / /rgyal po ku ku rā dza 'di skad zlo/ / theg pa'i rgyal po man dag bde chen 'di/ / rdo rje'i yang theg man ngag don gyi bla/ /tshe gcig 'bras bu thob pa'i man ngag chos/ /gab pa'i man ngag sems la sbas pa las /dgongs pa'i nyams su bdag la 'di ltar byung / / kun la snyoms pa'i nyi ma mchis pa las/ / sa brgyad byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ni/ / sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i gnod sbyin mgo can gnyis/ / 'o skol rgya gar yu la du mchis pa las / / nyi ma smin phrag bcug nas khyer ba rmis/ /rdo rje gdan gyi man ngag ma shor ram/ /partsi ta yi rkang mgyogs la 'ur thong / / de skad gsungs nas spyan sngar mchis pa lags/ / dngos grub thob nas da ni gshegs par rigs/ / 'jam pa'i dpal bzang nor bu khyer ba rmis/ /bdag nyid ma yi mig phyung khyer ba rmis/ / shrī sedha'i snying phyung khyer ba mis/ /kun dga' mo yi byang chub shing bcad nas/ /bod du khyer ba rmis pa la sogs bshad/ /de nas bee ro tsa nas lan btab pa/ /mi ru skyes pas skye ba gzhan las 'phags// /smon lam dag pas rgya gar yu la du rtol/ / dngos grub thob pas rdzu 'phrul rkang mgyogs grub/ / bla ma mchod las cho rigs btsun par skyes/ / dam tshig bsrung bas 'di ru bsam dgu 'grub/ / sgrib pa byang bas mkhas pa'i bka' bgros pa/ / gzhung lugs bzang po kun gyis bstan par 'khur/ / dgos dgu lus la tshang bas bdag gis grogs su btsal/ / lus srog pha nas bskyed kyang srid srog grogs pos bton/ / khyod dang 'grogs pas bdag gis yang dag byang chub brnyes/ / bod kyi rgyal khams ma rig mun pa kun sel bas/ /'gro ba ji ltar smin cing grol bar bya ba'i don/ /ku mā ra la dge — 144 —

ba'i rtsab yongs su bsngo/ /rkang mgyogs legs par grub pas da ni bdag kyang 'gro/ /bal yul tsam du snying gtam zla yi grogs pos skyob/ / ces gsungs gser gyi pa tra gcig byin no/ / de nas ku mā ra yis gcan 'phrang bsgral/ / 'phrang srung ba la brngan pa byin nas bkrol/ / rkang mgyogs byung nas bande 'dri ba na/ /ma mthong gnod sbyin sha ba'i yib zhu can/ /glang mkhar skya bo lag na thogs shing song / /da tsam bod yul mthil du sleb bgyis shig /ku mā mna' dag bcug nas ser skyar brgyugs/ /bod ban gsod byas rkang mgyogs zla sbran yongs/ /gcan 'phrang bar dris ngag bcug bzhin du zer/ / de nas bee ro tsa na bal yul slobs/ / gser sku 'phags pa shing kun la phul nas/ /'bul ba bzhes pa'i ched du mgur 'di gsungs/ /sgrib rkyen mi mnga' dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku/ /thugs rje'i bka' btsan 'dzam gling nam mkha' 'dra/ / ston pa'i thugs rje phyogs lhung mi mnga' yang / / 'khor ba'i lam ni mtha' med rgya mtsho 'dra/ /thugs rjes 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /zhes pa'i mgur gsungs 'phags pa'i sku phul lo/ /le'u bcu gcig pa/ bee ro tsa na bod du byon pa'i tshul/dang po/ bee ro tsa nas lam bar gyi dka' ba khyad du bsad nas rgyal po dang mjal 'phrad byung ba'i skor/de nas bod du byon pa'i lam ka ru/ / spya gar brtan ma re lcam kha ba btang / / bka' 'di bden rdzun brtag pa'i mgur 'di gsungs/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas rang gi sems nyid de/ /skye rsha med pa dus gsum sangs rgyas so/ /ya rabs blo dang ldan pa'i skal ldan la/ /sems kyi nyi ma gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ / bsam pa bzang pogaser dang 'dra ba yis/ / bod kyi yul nas rgya gar yul bar la/ /dka' ba bcu drug bsdoms nas man ngag btsal/ / dka' ba gcig gis bar du ma chod pas/ / bka' 'di bden na kha ba 'di chod cig / ces gsungs re lcam lha mo dmar mo'i tshul/ /sprin gseb sku bstan phyag byas bran khas blangs/ / de nas bsam yas byon pas rgyal po nyid/ / za 'og gur khyim 'dab na bzhugs pa la/ / rje dang mjal ba'i 'azin bskur bas/ / rgyal po dgyes nas lam la sne len mdzad/ /bee ros gur 'dab byang ngos slog nas byon/ /rje yis bka' rtsal dam chos lon nas bdog /rgya gar phrag dog phra mar mi gsan zhu/ /gsol pas rgyal po dam chos lon pas dgyes/ / dbu skra them par bkram nas nang spyan drangs/ /'bangs nas yar bton dbu yi mchod gnas mdzad/ /rgyal po 'e chibs pa mtsha' lu me stag la/ /stag lpags stan steng seng lding sga gtad nas/ /gser gyi srab bcug g.yu yi mthur btags phul/ / rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan phyag 'tshal nas/ / kye hoḥ dgongs shig slob dpon lags/ /ge 145 ge

mtsha' lu me stag 'od zer 'phro/ /khra bo stag gi sga stan gtad/ /gser gyi srab la g.yu yi mthur/ /khri srong lde'u btsan gus pas phul/ / bee ro tsa nas rab bzhes la/ / lta ba'i rgyal po bshad du gsol/ /zhes pa bee ro tre na yi/ci lta ba'i rgyal po nam mkha' tshe/ /dud 'gro'i rgyal po rtar mi 'tshong / /dud 'gro'i rgyal po rtar btsongs na/ / dus gsum spyal ba'i thugs kyis khrel/ / zhes gsungs bshad par ma bzhes so/ / de nas gser dngul phyag mang phul nas zhus/ /nam gyi dgung la gsang sngags chos rnams rkogasungs/ /nyin pa'i dus su mdo chos mang du bsgyur/ / bar skabs man ngag zab dgu'i chos rnams gsungs/ / de yang man ngag chos rnams gos dper blangs/ /nam mkha' che ni legs pa'i stod gos la/ /yul rnams kun la 'jug pa'i sham bu btags/ /khu byug dang ni rtsal chen phu dung la/ /byang sems don grub gong bas brgyan nas bshad/ /rgyud lung chos la gshen rje'i gtam rgyud dang / /rin chen 'od rgyud dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud/ / nam mkha' tshe la sogs pa'i rgyud lnga dang / / rmad du byung ba kun byed rgyal po dang / /mdo bcu dang ni rgya mtsho'i klong rnams bsgyur/ /nang sngags tand+ra sde ni bco brgyad sogs/ /ma hā yo ga'i rgyud sde bcu drug bsgyur/ / bee ro tsa na nyid kyis mdzad pa'i chos/ / snyan rgyud thugs kyi snying khu la sogs gsungs/ /de ltar chos gsungs 'dug pa rgya gar thos/ /rgya gar parnyi ta yis phrag dog byas/ /bod kyi chos la bar gcod gtong ba'i ched/ / bod la the tshom bskyed pa'i ngan sgrog btang / / bod kyi bandes dam chos ma rnyed par/ /khro chu phra men ngan sngags mang po khyer/ /bod phung 'gro bas bka' khrims sbyor cig zer/ / bod rnams phra ma snga btsan dga' ba dang / /rgyal po'i blon phyed bon blon yin pa dang / /bon chos gnyis po chags sdang che ba yis/ / rgyal pos bon sprugs chos kyi kha bzung bas/ / bon blon li stag li thi khra mi sogs/ / blon rnams bsdus nas rje la gros btab byas/ / pa gor gan jag thang ta bya ba 'dis/ /tshol du btang ba'i chos ni ma rnyed par/ /mi gnyis btang bas legs spub lam du bsad/ /bod yul phung ba'i ngan sngags sbyongs 'dug pas/ / rgyal po pho brang bzhugs la dgra mi yong / / bslu ba mkhan gyi nag nyes can 'di yod/ / me chu rlung gi khrims kyis tshar gcod zhu/ /gnyis pa/ rgyal pos bee ro tsa na g.ya' ma lung gi brag phug tu sbas pa'i skor/de ltar mkhas pa bee ro tsa na nyid/ / lo gsum g.ya' ma lung gi brag phug tu/ / rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan btegs nas bzhugs/ /dgongs pa mdzad cing sangs spyas bstan pa spel/ /yul khams gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kun/ / sdig pa bcu spong dge ba bcu spyod do/ / de tsho de dus phyir yang bod khams kyi/ / sems can thams cad 'dod pas rgyal lags so/ / de na bud med rigs byed thams cad kun/ /chags pa che zhing 'dod pa drags pa lags/ /de yi nang nas mnga' bdag rgyal po yi/ /btsun mo tshe spong bza' ni dmar spyan las/ /'dod chags che ba 'jig rten khams na med/ /de nyid mkhas pa bee ro tsa na la/ / bstan pa'i chos dang bden pa'i tshig mi nyan/ / slob dpon la ni 'dod chags sems skyes nas/ / btsun mo bsam pa ngan pa sems la 'gyus/ / slob dpon grogs la lan cig 'grogs par — 146 —

smon/ / yid kyis smon lam btab cing sems la gab/ / slos dpon nang par dro la byon pa la/ / rgyal po grong khyer sku 'chag btang nas su/ / bu tsha ming sring gnyis kyang rtsed mor btang / / 'khor ba rnams kyang phar la bsgrad nas su/ / sems can phyi mas bsu ba'i rting la ni/ / mo rang gcig pus slob dpon bsus nas 'ongs/ / mkhar 'bar mal gong sgang sngon rtse dgu yi/ / spyal sa yang thog slob dpon spyan drangs nas/ / zhal zas ro mchog ldan pa sna tshogs drangs/ / slob dpon zhal zas drangs rnams gsol nas su/ / bzhengs nas g.ya' ma lung du gshegs pa la/ / btsun mo ba ni dmar rgyan gyis gsol ba/ / slob dpon sgang sngon rtse dgur gdan 'dren pa/ / bdag ni chags pa skyes so slob dpon dgongs/ / slob dpon khyod ni ci bltas ci ru mdzes/ /ci gsungs ci ru bden pas chags pa skyes/ /'di la mi brten gang yang ma mchis so/ / 'di la ma brten khyed kyang sku mi 'khrungs/ / de skad zer nas slob dpon sku la 'jus/ / slob dpon shin tu dngangs par gyur pa'i na/ / thugs kyang byis pas sgo nga bskyur ba bzhin/ / yar 'phar mar deb sku lus 'dar 'dar ro/ / bsam blo 'bad nas btang nas gnos gzhibs pas/ / blo zhig rnyed nas btsun mor bka' stsal pa/ / 'khor ba rnams kyis mthong ngam rig pa na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nub ste 'gro bas su/ /bdag gis bya ra byed cing phyi sgo bcad/ /de nas log nas 'ong gi zer nas gshegs/ / btsun mos snyam na slob dpon bden snyam btang / / slob dpon sgo ru cur gyis byung nas bros/ /btsun mos 'ong du re nas bldad dang thung / /ma byung sgo phyir phyin nas bltas pa na/ / slob dpon bu tshal steng du slebs nas song / / btsun mo'i bsam pa shin tu snying na nas/ /slob dpon khyod kyang 'jig rten mi yu la 'dir/ /nga yis bstan pa sdub kyi zer nas su/ /tshig ngan smras te khyim du log nas song / /lha babs skad zer 'dre babs nas zer smyo/ /sgrog bu bcad de sham bu phral nas su/ /'dzings pa'i tshul du lus po sen rjes byas/ /'phrig cing ngus pas 'khor rnams drung du byung / / btsun mo ci nongs ci nyes ci la bshums/ / 'khor pa rnams kyis de skad gsol ba dang / /btsun mos 'khor pa kun la lan smras pa/ /da lta mi la ma byung nga la byung / /khyed rnams myur song rgyal po spyan drongs shog / 'khor pa rnams ni rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyin/ / chos rgyal chen po 'khor pa'i ngag la gson/ /btsun mo'i zhal nas rgyal po spyan drongs gsungs/ /da lta mi la ma byung nga la byung / / rgyal ngo byur bar spyan drongs shog cig gsungs/ /rgyal po myur bar yar la gshegs par zhu/ /rgyal po shin tu ma dgyes khab tu byon/ / btsun mo de ni kha bub ngu zhing 'dug / rgyal posabatsun mo la ni 'di skad gsungs/ / du zhing rab tu ngu ba ci nongs pa/ / mi la ma byung ci byung mgo theg dang / / rgyal po'i phyag gis btsun mo'i mgo btegs pas/ /btsum mo yar 'a ljog byas 'phrig cing ngus /gtam yang mi 'byin pa bzhin byed byed nas/ / nyid kyis 'bas nas 'ange gas rin rug pasri gda'/ / da nang mi med sa ru gsol drangs pas/ /slob dpon bdag la ca/chongs na sdo 'dzin da byung /stsos bubacad dang sham bu phral la gzigs/ / lus po 'dzings pas secha rjes 'aḍi ltar /7shrīhwa za za nga ces pa btsun mos smras pa — 147 —

dang / /rgyal po'i blon po 'khor pa thams cad kun/ /gros ma byas par blo ni phyogs gcig mthun/ /'gini gsod pa'i 'os yin bsad pa 'thad/ / mi gsod na yang rngon bya'i rigs yin no/ / rngon mi byegana'ang brag phug nas phyung la/ / brdungs shing btogs la tho les thob las thong / /de skad blon po 'khor pas gsol pa dang / /rgyal po chen pos 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /mi yi mchog gyur skyes bu de la yang / /'khor ba'i 'dod chags sems kyi ma spangs nas/ /yon bdag mo la 'dzin du 'ong ba 'di/ /sems can phyi ma thams cad blta ba'i yul/ /dge 'dun bstan pa nub tu tho ba yin/ /'o cag bsod nams tshogs ni dum yang med/ /re ma dga' 'o ji lta bu yang srid/ /de skad gsungs nas dbu gtums nas bzhugs so/ /btsun mos 'khor la ngag bcug rbad pas kyang / /slob dpon sku la bdo thabs re ba yang / /grigem 'gom pa gcig kyang ma byung ste/ / khong rnams thams cad mgyogs par song bas na/ / de nas sang nyin dbu rtser byon pa la/ /dro dus dro la byon kyang bsu ba med/ /sras lcam rgyal po yab yum bsu ba med/ /de nas rgyal po'i pho brang byon pa dang / / sgo phyin 'khor pa rnams kyang myos nas snang / / slob dpon dgongs pas btsun mos lto long rig / slar log brag dmar g.ya' ma lung du gshegs/ / gnas su ma tshugs slar yang sgor byung nas/ / byol song rig pa yod pas bsur 'ong ba/ / pha rir ngu zhing 'gre zhing 'dug par gzigs/ /shin tu ma dga' ba yis sems 'khrugs so/ / /bsam yas yul 'dir mi 'dug 'gro sems skyes/ /yig chas dang ni dpe cha khur nas phyin/ /lung pa'i phu la zhugs phyin dgod shor bas/ /la kha de la dgod dkar la khar thogs/ / la khar zhal ni phyir gzigs dmod btsugs pa/ / ngas kyang dge la dad skyes chos bshad na'ang / /bod rnams nyon mongs sgrib pa ma 'byongs pas/ /mang zhig sems can cha la gnas pa 'dra/ / bstan pa spel bas bstan pa nub ste song / / rgyal pos btsun mo dug lnga me 'bar ma/ /bee ro tsa na rgod po dkar po yin/ /btsun mo las kyi rnam smin tshe 'dir shog /nga la mtshang 'khris med pas bstan pa dar/ /bee ro tsa na tshad mar 'dzin par shog /de nas la brgal lung la babs nas byon/ /lam kha zhig na ba zhig shi nas 'dug/ khang ba zhig na mgar ba bzo byed snang / /shin tu bkres nas mgar ba'i sgor phyin te/ / rdo la rin cen mkhyen pa'i mgar ba lags/ / bzo rig kun mkhyen yo mnyes dpon bzang lags/ /nang dro ma myong gdugs kyi phyed la thug /gsus ldogs nga la nang gi dro zhig drongs/ / mgar bas thos nas chung ma la smras pa/ / sgo phub 'di na shin tu ngag 'jam zhig / dro slong ba ni su yin ltos la shog / chung mas bltas nas mgar ba la smras pa/ / gsung ngag 'jam pa bas kyang zhal ras legs/ /bande spyi skum chos khur ba zhig gda'/ /de skad gleng bas bzo 'phro bcad nas bltas/ /zhe sa lugs bzhin phul nas nang spyan drangs/ /mgar mo skra 'khru rgyan cha rang 'thag bzhag /gsol zas drangs nas slob dpon dro btab po/ / mdo bsngo smon lam btab nas 'di skad gsungs/ /lam kha ya na ba zhig shi nas 'dug /yon bdag khyed kyi min nam gsungs nas gshegs/ /lung ba de la ba lam zhes su btags/ /slob dpon gshegs rting mgar ba ba bshar song / /mgar mo'i rgyan chas stor nas ma snyed — 148 —

do/ / mgar mo na re gzhan ni su yang med/ / da nang bande de yis brkus pa yin/ / do nub mi smreb la 'ur rgyugs cig zer/ /bzo byed mgar ba shin tu snying na nas/ /mda' gzhu khyer nas phyi la rgyugs song ste/ /lung ba'i mda' la rjes zin khril gyis slebs/ /mgar bas slob dpon nyid la 'di skad smras/ /da nang zugs su bcug nas zhim dgu byin/ / de yis lan du chung ma'i lus rgyan brkus/ / khrel med po khyod lings kyis btang ngo zer/ / mda' ltong bcug nas mer gyis bkang nas byung / / slob dpon ga shegs pa'i long ni med pas de/ /slob dpon zings kyis btang nas 'dzings pa yis/ /mda' ni dpe cha bzed pa'i steng du phog /slob dpon ma rmas mda' ltong 'jug long med/ /mgar ba'i lag pa g.yas g.yon bzung nas su/ /de nas slob dpon bden tshig mgar bar gsungs/ / nga ni rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /thugs ches mchod gnas dam pa byed tsa na/ /btsun mo tshe spong bza' ba dmar rgyan la/ /sdom gsum rtsa ba dam tshig ma nyams par/ / nga yis mi tshangs par yang ma spyad la/ / nga yis khyod kyi khyim du phyin pa'i dus/ /nang dro sbyar ba rnams ni zos pa las/ /khyod kyi chung ma'i lus kyi rgyan cha la/ /sdom gsum rtsa ba dam cug ma nyams shing / /ngas ni ma byin pa ni ma blangs so/ /sems can khyod kyi 'dod pa bskang ba'i phyir/ / bdag gi srog la tshad pa'i mda' dang gzhu/ / gzhu nyid gser dang mda' nyid g.yu ru gyur/ / de skad gsungs nas rtse mo gtug byas pas/ / mgar ba'i mda' gzhu gser g.yu lings kyis song / /mgar ba skyengs nas bzhin log tug ger snang / /khyod kyi chung ma'i lus rgyan byis pas khyer/ /thog kha'i nyal nyil gseb nas chung mas rnyed/ /nga ni ma byin mi len bande yin/ /khyod kyi chung ma'i rgyan cha rku srid dam/ / de skad gsungs nas slob dpon phar la gshegs/ / yul de la ni ba glang brlag mdar btags/ / de nas mgar ba yang ni phyir log go/de dus rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan ni/ /shin tu thugs mug dbu gtums gzims pa las/ /nyi ma tsug snying phyung bzhin ma dga' nas/ /sku bzhengs bee ro tsa na spyan 'dren du/ /brag dmar g.ya' ma lung du byon pa'i tshe/ / gnas na ma bzhugs shul ni ha re bzhud/ / gcan gzan ri dwags 'dab chags mi rnams kun/ /byang gi phyogs su kha bltas ngu bar byed/ /chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yang / /sha rus bye ba tsam du ma dga'o/ /rgyal po btsun mo'i rtsar 'ongs gyod btab pa/ /slob dpon dgongs na ci gsungs nyan pas chog bdag gis rgya la slob dpon rnyed 'khugs na/ / khyod nyid bzhed na gtan tu 'bul lo gsungs/ / shugs ldan la zhon slob dpon 'tshol du gshegs/ / dgod dkar la rtsar mi nag mgar ba cig/ /dgod cing 'dzum zhing byung ba cig dang 'phrad/ /rgyal pos mi khyod re dga' zhig 'dug pa/ /ci rnyed pa zhig yin nam ci la dga'/ /'di ni phar la mi zhig song mthong ngam/ /de skad ces nispyal pos gsungs pa dang / / mi nag mgar ba des ni 'di sad smras/ / mi khyod rta rngul chu ba'in byung byung nas/ /gar rgyug sus bda' 'di ru ci dngha/da pa/ /'de phar me 'ig shem tu ring par song/ /nga dga' ba ni mda' gzhu 'di byin pas/ /de la dpe ra zhing dargod pa yin no rshar /rgyal pos mgyogs — 149 —

par gcum nas bdasapa yis/ / skye chu'i rtsa ru lhan du phyin tsa na/ / slob dpon chu la gom gsum gzhig byas/ /pha ri phyogs la yud tsam thal nas song / /nyi ma rtser gyis rgas nas ma zin te/ /spyal pothokhus btab g.yabs pa'i pha gi nas/ /slob dpon spyan gyis gzigs kyang chu che bas/ / brgal du ma thar thu ko mnyan pa med/ / mun rub grong khyer btsal ba'i long med do/ / rta las babs nas lha phyag 'tshal nas zhus/ / nga yis bla mchod bee ro tsa na lags/ /'khor ba'i sems can mtho ris drang ba dang / /sangasporgyas chos kyi bstan pa spel ba dang / / bdag gi mchod gnas dam pa spyan drangs na/ / nged bu bor nas gang du gshegs pa lags/ /btsun mo bzhed na gtan gyi grogs su 'bul/ /bdag gi mchod gnas dam pa gshegs par zhu/ /de skad ces pa spyal pos gsol pa yis/ /slob dpon skyi chu'i byang nas bka' stsal pa/ /dad pa can gyi rgyal po rje gcig lags/ /bud med bya ba las kyi srin mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i 'dam rdzab yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor ba'i 'dam la 'dzin/ / bud med bya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ / gang gis 'bags kyang thar ba 'thob mi srid/ / bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal chad med myong / /bdag gi sems la 'dod chags sa bon med/ / sems la med pas lus la ci la skye/ / 'o skol 'grogs su btsun mos lto long btab/ / ma nyes su ni nam zhig mtha' dag 'ong / / slar log rgyal po'i yul du nga mi mchi/ / mchod gnas gzhan nas 'tshol la lugs bzhin spyod/ / ces gsungs slob dpon gar song cha med gshegs/ /rgyal po mi chad rta ngal ga mug tsha/ /mun sros yul de tsha ba gru ru grags/ /rgyal po der lus mgar ba slar log ste/ / nyi ma dmar thag chod nas khyim du slebs/ / chung ma mdun du byung nas 'di skad zer/ /khyod kyi bande de nyid ma bsad dam/ /nga yi rgyan cha bu tshas thog khang khyer/ /nyal nyil gseb nas rnyed nas yod do zer/ /mgar ba khros nas chung mar lan btab pa/ /ci gu thams cad brtasas nas mi zer bar/ /bandes brkus so rgyug cig zer zer nas/ /lung pa'i mda' ru bande khril gyis zin/ / mda' gzhu bkang nas lings btang bzhag snyam pas/ / chos dper phog nas kho bo gsod par zin/ /nga rang gsod pa'i las shig da byung bsam/ /shin tu 'jigs shing rab tu bred pa la/ /gsod pa'i tshul du de nyid mi 'dug par/ /tshig bshad 'di skad bgrangs nas gsungs pa yin/ /bdag ni rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ / thugs ches mchod gnas dam pa byed tsa na/ / btsun mo tshe spong bza' ba dmar rgyan la/ / sdom gsum rtsa ba dam tshig ma nyams shing / / ngas ni ma byin par yang ma blangs so/ /sems can khyod kyi 'dod pa bskang ba'i phyir/ / bdag gi srog la tshad pa'i mda' dang gzhu/ / gzhu nyid gser la mda' ni g.yu ra gyur gsungs/ /nga yi mda' gzhu gser g.yur lings kyis song / /khyod kyi chung ma'i lus rgyan byis pas khyer/ / thog kha'i nyal nyil gseb nas chung mas rnyed/ / nga ni ma byin mi len bande yin/ / mgar mo'i rgyan cha rku ba'i lugs yod dam/ /de skad gsungs nas yar la bzhud de song / /des ni tshur 'ongs mda' gzhu bstan pa yis/ / mgar mo 'gyod pa skyes nas shin tu ngus so/ /— 150 —

de nas nang par nam langs gung sangs nas/ / rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan tsha ba grur/ / chab kyi thor kar slob dpon bzhugs sam bltas/ /ma bzhugs chab kyi kha 'grim gru phab ste/ /mirta'i dro blangs cha bsgral mnyan pa bslog chab kyi pha kar byon nas dris mthong med/ /rjes bcad pas kyang rjes ma chod par brgyal/ / phyir 'ongs mgar ba'i sgor babs de la dris/ kha sang khyod phrad bande gar 'gro zer/ /khyod la gser g.yu'i mda' gzhu byin zer ba/ /khyod kyis bande de la ci byas pa/ /mgar bas rgyal po nyid la gsol pa ni/ / bande 'dir 'gro bya ba ye mi gsungs/ / gar 'gro cha med bdag gis ma dris so/ /brkus btsugs mda' brgyab shin tu ngo tsha nas/ / rgyal po la gsang gser gzhu g.yu mda' ni/ / gsol zas bda' dgu skyel ma zhabs tog byas/ / de yi drin lan gser gzhu g.yu mda' byin/ / de ni mi min mchog tu gyur pa gda'/ /rigs ni gar gtogs ming ni ji skad bya/ /nyid 'ded pa ni ci phyir 'ded pa lags/ /rgyal pos btsun mo'i tha snyad gsang nas su/ / mi las mchog tu gyur ba'i skyes bu de/ /rigs ni dbus kyi rnam par snang mdzad lags/ / ming ni bee ro tsa na zer ba yin/ /bdag phyi bsnyegs pa mchod gnas spyan 'dren yin/ /'byon du ma bzhed rgya nag gshegs yin nam/ /da lta yi mug khyim du 'ongs pa yin/ / de nas dgod dkar lar byon bsam yas phebs/ /btsun mo 'khor pas rgyal por dris kyin smras/ /rgyal pos bdag gis rjes bsnyegs kho nar bcug / nyi ma rgas khar skye chu'i 'gram du slebs/ /skyes bu de nyid rdzu 'phrul ldan cag gda'/ / ki yis btab cing g.yospro kyin bos tsa na/ / spyan zur tsam gzigs bdag gis lha phyag 'tshal/ /'byon par zhus pas gshegs su ma bzhed par/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams bdag la gsungs/ /de skad ces pa rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ /btsun mo 'khor pa blon po de rnams kyang / / mi dge'i sems ni shin tu kun skyes so/ / de dus de tshe bai ro tsa na yis/ / yer pa gtsug ri spungs pa'i nags la gshegs/ / thugs dam mdzad pas klu btsan lha mo 'dus/ / spre'us shing thog sman sna 'thus nas 'dren/ /lha mo klu mo btsan rnams sgor mchod 'bul/ /slob dpon mnyam gzhag mngon par shes pas gzigs/ / bsam yas mi rnams nyid la shin tu 'phya/ /sdig las byed cing sbyin pa gtong 'phro bcad/ / tshul khrims 'chal cing sdom pa nod pa shor/ /slob dpon de tsug byed na chos rdzun yin/ /slob dpon sdig pa sna tshogs spyod cing snang / /slob dpon shin tu mi dge'i sems skyes nas / 'di ni bu yis bzlog par tsa na dgongs/ /de nas u rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dus gsum thugs la sa ler mkhyen na yang / /'gro ba da lta'i don dang ma 'ongs don/ /bdag gi slob ma bee ro tsa na nyid/ / sgrub pa gang na byed kyin yod ces gsungs/ / rgyal po thin tu ngo tsha gnong nas su/ / lo rgyusagatam ni smra ma phod pa ru/ / lcam dral 'chol du btang ba la re nas/ /u rgyan padma nyid la 'di skad gsol/ /bee ro tsa na bu tsha ming sring gnyis/ / shin tu do gal che ba gnyer du thal/ / zhas gsu ma tshun laspyan sngar 'khor te mchi/ /de nas nang bar gdugs kyi rtse la ni/ /sras lcam 'awor ba mang po slebs nas byung / / rgyal pos sras la dris pa sras kyis gsol/ / bdag cag byang phyogs kun dang kun phyin te/ /— 151 —

btsal zhing pho mo smra shes kun la dris/ /mi gcig gis kyang mthong ba ma byung bas/ /shin tu yi mug ga masad lta tshebs/ / yab rje rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /rgyal khams de tsam zhig nas ma rnyed pa/ shā grongs nas pur yang bya yis zos par shes/ / de skad gsungs shing rgyal po shin tu bshums/ / mchi nas tsam sran tsam rgyun du byung / / lcam dral 'khor bcas rgyal po lhan du bshums/ / de nas bshum pa'i mchi ma phyag gis sbyis/ / rgyal po lcam dral gnyis kyi sna mtshon te/ / u rgyan chen po nyid la bskor glebyas/ /lha phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ /slob dpon chen po padmas bka' stsal pa/ /khyegacag lcam dral gnyis ni 'dir phebs na/ /bdag gi slob ma bee ro ga ru song / /de la yab rje rgyal pos 'di skad gsol/ /bstan pa'i sgron me rgyal sras chen po lags/ /bee ro tsa na gar song lo rgyus ni/ / bdag gi btsun mo ba dmar rgyan ma la/ / cha mchis pas na snyan zhur 'tshal gyis gsungs/ / yab sras gsum po langs nas bzhud do skad/ /btsun mo'i sar byon rgyal pos 'di skad gsungs/ /btsun mo nad ngan 'di yi 'ong lugs dang / kha sang mo ma de yis zer lugs dang / /slob dpon bee rdo tsa na'i zhal nas kyang / /nga yi sems la 'dod chags sa bon med/ /sems la med par lus la ga la skye/ /yon mchod 'grogs subatsun mos lto long btab/ / bla mchod ga'an nas 'tshol gsungs bzhud pa yin/ / skyes bu de la 'dod chags med par nges/ /de ni sdom pas rdzun spangs bya ba yin/ /skyes bu chen po rdzun mi gsungs par nges/ /btsun mo khyed kyis slob dpon 'degs par dga'/ /skur pa chen po btab pa ma yin nam/ /da yang u rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /lha phyag 'tshal nas drang po'i tshig smras te/ /mthol bshags byas na nad 'di sos par 'añtsar/ /lcam srang gnyis kyang rgyal po'i gsungs dang mthun/ /yum la shin tu nan tan bskyed nas smras/ / yum kyi legs par bsam zhing dgongs pa las/ /nad ngan tsi tsi dzwa la 'di sos na/ /bdag ni ci ni 'dra na'ang 'dra snyam sems/ /da ni drang por smra bar khas blangs so/ /de nas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /u rgyan chen po rgyal sar spyan drangs nas/ /mchod rjos sna tshogs pa ni bshams nas su/ /nang blon phyi blon 'khor pa thams cad dang / /sems can dam pa 'bangs rnams bsdus nas su/ /btsun mo khrid nas gu rur zhu 'bul bcug/ yid gnyis byed bzhin btsun mos phyag 'tshal zhus/ /bstan pa'i sgron me u rgyan chosakyi je/ / bdag ni sems can gang la'ang chags pa ni/ / mi skye ba zhig yin pa lags na yang / / slob dpon dge slong bai ro tsa na de/ / ci bltas pas na ci ru mdzes pa'i sku/ / ci gsungs pa ni ci ru bden pa'i gsungs/ / de la bdag ni chags pa shin tu skyes/ / yid kyis smon lam yang yang btab na yang / / bdag gis 'dod bzhin ma bzhed phebs nas thal/ / de la bdag ni shin tu snying na nas/ /rdzun gyi sdeb sbyor le'u bsdebs nas su/ /skur pa btab pas slob dpon 'khor ma btub/ /nyi ma byang du 'khyams te song ba lags/ / rgyal pos bdas nas slar la sbyan drangs pas/ /'byon du ma bzhed bdag gi ngan mtshang sgrogs/ / bstan pa'i sgron me sprul sku chen po lags/ / nongs pa thams cad kho mo dngos kyis bgyis/ khadi yi chad pa yong dam sems la 'phrig /bstan pa'i sgron me u rgyan rin po che/ /— 152 —

slob dpon stor ba rgyal khams bu tshas btsal/ / btsal bas ma rnyed gang du thal ba lags/ / lto long btabapas mthol bshags byed pa lags/ /de nas u rgyun padmas bka' stsal pa/ /btsun mo khyod ni mir rgyurapal yang / /nyon mongs pa ni shas che ba zhig 'dug khyod ni 'dod chags chu ltar 'khol ba yis/ /sdomagasum srung ba'i slob dpon 'ju phod yin/ khyod ni zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba yis/ /skur pa de lta bu ni 'debs nus yin/ /khyod ni gti mug mun ltar 'thibs pa yis/ /spyo nas las 'bras ngo ma shes pa yin/ /slob dpon spyan drongs bskong mthol ma bshags na/khyod kyis dzwa la'i nad kyang sos mi 'gyur/ /phyi ma ngan song gsum 'khor mnar med skye/ /rdo rje'i dmyal ba dmyal ba shom pa la/ / thugs dam rtsa bar bskong bshags sbyan sngar bgyi/ / rje'i rgyal po'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir du/ / bee ro tsa na gar song gar yod ni/ /bdag gis mnyam gzhag lha bsgom byas nas su/ /mngon par shes pas gar 'dug blta bar bya/ /de skad bka' stsal gu ru thugs dam bzhugs/ / mngon shes gzigs nas gu rus bka' stsal pa/ / slob dpon dge slong bee ro tsa na de/ /btsun mos ma nyes lto long chen pos 'gams/ /shin tu yi mug rab tu ga chad nas/ / bsam yas dag gi nub byang mtshams shed na/ / ra sa myang bran dor sde dwags srib kyi/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bar ba'i sked pa na/ / nags tshal mang po 'thibs pa'i dgon pa ru/ / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i brag phug na/ / ri rtse 'dus pa'i lha khang phyogs bzhi na/ / 'greng mi mi phrad thugs dam bzhugs 'dug go / lha dang klu dang btsan gyis sdong grogs byed/ /lha mo klu mos khrus byed mchod pa 'bul/ /spre'u byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ / sman dang shing tog thams cad de la 'dren/ /shin tu so gsod skyed par snang ngo lags/ /gser g.yu mu tig len phran btsan po khyod/ /chibs pa nag po bzhon la khug las shog/ de skad u rgyan chen pos gsungs pa las/ / slob dpon yod pas shin tu 'tshengs shing dgod/ /de nas mu tig btsan po 'gugs su byon/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bor ba'i nags tshal phyin/ /slob dpon bee ro tsa na nyid dang mjal/ /chibs pa nag pos slob dpon ngo shes nas/ /bskor zhing lces bldag mchi ma sran tsam byung / /rgyal sras mu tig btsan pos gsol ba ni/ /slob dpon nyid la skur pa 'debs pa'i mi/ /a ma btsun mo mdze nad dam pos zin/ nyid la skur pa btabs pas lan par ni/ /mo ma kun shes thengs pos ngos kyang bzung / / mo bdag 'phrigs nas gu ru'i spyan sngar mchis/ /drang por tshig smras mthol bshags byas pas ni/ /gu ru rin po che yi zhal nas su/ /da yang thugs dam rtsa bar bskong mthol dgos/ / slob dpon dge slong bee ro tsa na ni/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bar ba'i dgon par 'dug/ spyan drongs shog cig gsungs nas bdag kyang 'ongs/ /da lta gshegs par zhu ba 'bul ba lags/ /de skad gsol bas slob dpon shin tu dgyes/ /dga' ba'i mi rta gnyis dang 'phrad do dga'/ /snyan pa'i gtam yang mang du thos pas dga'/ / btsun mo de la de phan de ran 'jebs/ / gu ru padma 'byung gnas bzhugs yod na/ / ngan bu cis te mi 'gro gsungs nas gshegs/ / yul de'i lha phran brgya dang klu phran brgya/ / lha mo brgya dang klu mo brgya rnams dang / /spre'u byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis — 153 ge

kyang / /slob dpon nyid la skyel ma byas nas su/ / slob dpon rta nag gzhon nas bsam yas phebs /skad snyan bya dang gcan gzan ris bkra dang / / ri dwags tha sdug glang po khyu mchog dang / / cang shes rtadang khyi ris rnams kyis ni/ /slob dpon mdun nas bsus te bskor ba byed/ /lha phyag 'tshal nas mchogapa sna tshogs phul/ / rgyal po yab sras 'khor dang slob bu mang / / yul khams mi rnams mdun bsu bskor ba byas/ /de nas bee ro tsa na 'khor bcas kyis/ /u rgyan chen po padmar bskor ba byas/ /lha spyag 'tshal zhing marngal lan gsum phul/ / yer pa gtsug rum 'bar ba'i nags tshal gyi/ /lha klu spre'u rnams gislar log song / /de la mnga' bdag rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes/ / cugs su bcad pa'i snyan ngag 'di skad gsungs/ /dam tshig ma nyams mi mchog skyes bu ni/ /mi med yul du song yang lha klus mchod/ /sbri'u dad skyes sman dang shing tog 'bul/ / dam med skyon can dbyen can btsun mo ni/ / grong sprer dbus gnas 'dug kyang nad mdzes bzungs/ /dam las nyams pa btsun mo bgyid bgyid nas/ /skyes bu dam pa
