mjal long ga la yod/ / de skad ces gsungs zhabs la spyi bos gtugs/ / gus pas lha phyag lan bdun 'tshal nas 'bul/ / gu ru bdag ni 'di ru mi sdod do/ / 'chims phu yang dbeen sgrub pa'i gnas 'tshol 'gro/ / nga yi tshab tu slob bu bee ro bzhugs/ / zhes gsungs bod khams thams cad zhabs kyis bcags/gsum pa/ bee ro tsa nas chos gsungs par phra ma byung ba'i skor/de nas bon chos gnyis po chags sdang che/ / rgya gar parnyi ta rnams phrag tog byas/ /dmar rgyan ma yi snying nad ma zhi bas/ / rgyal po pho brang bzhugs la dgra yin pas/ / bsru ba mkhan gyi nyes can 'di sod cig /rgyal pos mi bden phrag dog yin brjod pas/ /bon blon rnams kyis yang nas yang btugs te/ /rgyal pos chu la bskur bar zhal gyis bzhes/ /g.yor phyogs gra pa'i ldom bu ba zhig bzung / /bee ro tsa na'i zhwa gos lham bskon nas/ /'phral la dgos pa'i 'tsho ba zas skom bskur/ / bsam yas rka chu'i 'og nas rje yis bos/ / kwa'i/ nga yi bod 'bangs thams cad 'dir 'dus shig / de skad brjod pas thams cad 'dus pa dang / / phra men ngan sngags mkhan po gsod byas te/ / chu la bskur ba 'di nyid yin no gsungs/ /dmangs rnams drung du nye bar ma gyur gong / /zangs gnyis kha sbyar nang du sprang po bcug/kha la lcags gzer btab nas chu la bskur/ / de nas blon 'bangs yid gnyis the tshom nas/ / bee ro min re'i dbu skung bzhes dgos zer/ / de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ / mi de bee ro min ri brag btsan dpang / /de nas blon po thams cad kho thag chad/ /mkhas pa bee ro tsa na'i thugs dgongs la/ /nga yi glud du mi de sdug ge song / /snying rjes ma bzod smon lam rgya cher btab/ /bee rdo tsa nas sbyangs pa'i yo na tan gang / /de dag sprang po'i yul du rgyas par shog /skabs su mkhas pa sprul skur 'byon gyur cig/sprang po mis bzung bsten pa'i yul phyogs der/ / bkra shis bde legs longs spyod 'byor ldan shog/ sprang po 'ol ka 1༵dīr tram̐g khol mar chags/ / de nyid khol gyi bdag po zhig gis rnyed/ / nang du ci 'dug

bltas pas btsun pa byung / /khol bdag kho rang bu byas khyim phog pas/ /'ol ka rgyug thang ldom mi'i grong tsho chags/ /de nas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /bee ro tsa na gzhan gyi mthong dogs nas/ /rgyal po nyi ma bsro pa'i gdug khang gi / bya khang ka ba'i logs la chol brus te/ / de la phyogs bzhir ka ba bzhi btsugs nas/ / de yi nang du bee ro tsa na bzhugs/ / de nas 'bangs la mar nag khral bkal nas/ /mtshan mo gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bsgyur/ /nyin par mtshan nyid thams cad bsgyur du bcug/de yi dus na mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid/ /nub kyi res la gar song cha med nas/ /jo mo tshe spong bza' ba dmar rgyan gyis/ / mig ser che bas bud med gzhan yod bsam/ / rgyal po'i phyir 'brangs gang du gshegs bltas pas/ /glo 'bur nang du slob dpon tsha dro drangs/ /zhwa thob phud nas bkur te byed pa mthong / /bee ro tsa nas mdo bsngo gsungs pa thos/ /btsun mos bltas dang rgyal po'i spyan zur 'dres/ /btsun mos blon 'bangs kun la bshad gyis dogs/ /rgyal pos bltas byas bdas pas mo ma zin/ /de dus dmag la 'gro na zangs dung 'bud/ / tsha dro'i dus su dung dkar 'bud pa dang / / snyaṇḍi brdungs na chos la byon zer yin/ / rnga bo che brdungs 'dun mar 'dus shig zer/ dmar rgyan rnga bo che la brdungs ba yis/ / phyi blon nang blon gros dbang thams cad 'dus/ /'dus pa rnams la jo mos 'di skad brjod/ /chu la bskur de sprang po yin 'dug pas/ / ngan thabs mkhan de phug na sbas nas 'dug/ bod phung mi dga' rje la gros thob song / /de skad zer ba'i rgyu mtshan dmar rgyan gyis/ /bee ro tsa na nan tar mtshar drags pas/ /jo mos dus bting slob dpon ma bhon nas/ /de yi snying nad byas pa yin no skad/ /de nas phyi blon nang blon bcu bzhi yis/ / gros la dbang ba'i 'dun gros mkhan tsho bsags/ / 'bangs 'khor yongs ni jo mo bden zhes zer/ /mnga' bdag drung du lha bzang klu dpal btang / /'bangs rnams yo 'bog lcam me'i thang la tshogs/ /rje la zhu ba bdog pas sku bskyod zhus/ /de nas rgyal pos 'bangs kyi gseb tu byon/ /'bangs rnams rje la zhu ba 'di bzhin byed/ / mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid las col chung ba/ / lha khang bzhengs zer mi tsho sdug tu 'jug/lha yin zer nas gser tsho 'jim par byugs/ /chos bsgyur zer nas ngan sngags dug sbyor slob/ /bla ma yin zer 'bangs la lha phyag 'tshal/ /'phan gdugs mdzad zer dar zab dum bur gtubs/ / chos mdzad zer nas sprang po chu la bskur/ / gdugs khang yin zer bod phung sped sa byed/ /chos dang ci'i chos da dung bande sod/ /de skad gsol bas rgyal po ma dgyes te/ /rgya bod lo tsā mkhas pa gcig pu 'di/ / blon 'bangs kun gyis gso da dgos khar thon pa/ / zhes gsungs sa rdab rdo rdab thal mo brdabs/ / thugs brdungs 'al du sa 'gams sme sngags bos/ / klu dpal la sogs gros dbang gros byas nas/ /bod phung 'jug pa'i bande mi gsod na/ /rgyal por yo log btang nas 'don par byas/ / glo 'bur nang nas bee ro sgor phyung ste/ / rgyal pos slob dpon phyag la 'jus nas bshum/ / de dus mkhas pa bee ro tsa na yis/ / dka' ba bcu drug bcad pa'i mgur 'di gsungs/ / thugs rje ldan pa'i khri srong sde btsan gyis/ / dam chos tshol ba'i bdag por bdag bskos nas/ / spyon par dka' ba'i — 155 —

gser gyi pa tra gyon/ /bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar yul du bgrod/ /'dzeg par dka' ba'i mtha' lam gzar mo 'dzegs/ /gshag par dka' ba'i kha ba bu yug gshags/ /gsos par dka' ba'i mtha' nad mig ser bsos/ /bza' bar dka' ba'i mtha' zas mang bo zos/ /mthong bar dka' ba'i mkhas pa'i zhal rnams mthong / /shes par dka' ba'i sde snod mang po shes/ /thos par dka' ba'i byang sems rnam lnga thos/ /gnang bar dka' ba'i thugs kyi man ngag gnang / /rtogs par dka' ba'i rang byung ye shes dnghartogs/ / phrad par dka' ba'i drag sngags kun dang phrad/ / 'grub par dka' ba'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal 'grub/ / thob par dka' ba'i rkang mgyogs dngos grub thob/ / gyon par dka' ba'i zom lham phyir log spyon/ / thar bar dka' ba'i gcan 'phrang gsod las thar/ / do shi do chad yang nas yang du byas/ /rtol bar dka' ba'i bod yul dbus su brtol/ /'di la su mos thugs rje shar bar smon/ /de skad gsungs pas mnga' bdag rgyal po yis/ /blon 'bangs rnams kyi de ltar ma yin te/ /'u cag sngon yang de 'dra'i 'khor bar 'khyams/ / bsad pas mi yong mtha' la sprugs kyi zer/le'u bcu gnyis pa/ bee ro tsa na rgyal mo tsha ba rong du sprugs pa/dang po/ bee ro tsa nas rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi gdul byar gzigs pa'i skor/bee ros rgyal mo tsha rong gdul byar gzigs/ /de nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /slob dpon chibs pa bzang po zhig la bskyon/ /gser dngul jus bkang chibs gong gshegs skyems drangs/ /slob dpon gang la 'byon par dgyes zhus pas/ /slob dpon zhal nas rgyal mo tsha ba rong / /tshe rabs snga ma'i las 'phro zhig yod pas/ / rgyal mo tsha ba rong du 'gro bar zhu/ /rje yis ga bur la sogs bsil sman bskur/ /rgyal blon 'khor bcas kun gyis skyel du phyin/ /dbu ru kyi tshang la ka brgal ba'i dus/ /slob dpon 'gyod mchis bdun gyi mgur 'di gsungs/ /za hor yul nas byon pa'i mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/ /u rgyan yul nas byon pa'i padma 'byung gnas dpal/ / rgya gar mkhas pa paṇa chen nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ / 'di na mchis pa'i bee ro tsa nas phyag 'tshal lo/ / lo brgyad lon nas lo tsā bslabs pa'i mtha' 'dir mchis/ /bco lnga man chad skad sna stong dang drug brgya sbyangs/ / rgya gar gsang mdzod brtol nas dam chos bod du bsgyur/ / bod kyi mun sel khri gdugs nyi ma 'dra ba sprugs/ / go rtogs blo'i pad 'byed tshe mgyod pa'i dus shig mchis/ /bco lnga lon nas lnga bcu rtsa bdun ma lon bar/ /'gro ba mi 'dor phyir du rgya gar yul kun 'grims/ / bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad dkar por yongs bsgyur te/ / phung po yon tan brgyan pa bod kyi bande sprugs/ /bod sprugs rgya gar 'khor tshe 'gyod pa'i dus shig mchis/ /bod skad ma byang lo tsā shes pa ga la srid/ / ri mtho sa gtsang kha ba can gyi spyal khams 'dir/ / mi je lhas mdzad 'dod yon — 156 —

phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /rin chen gser gling gser gyi ngang khyu tshogs pa na/ /dngos mchis sprul sku lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di/ / ngang mo gcig pur rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong du sprugs/ / mdo sngags 'chad nyan byed tshe 'gyod pa'i dus shig mchis/ / thun mong dngos grub grub pa'i ya mtshan mang po 'byung / /rje 'bangs thams cad snyan gsang spyan gsal thugs dwangs kyang / /rgya gar chos skad saṃ skyi ta yi skad mi go/ /chos gzhi gtsug lag khang ni rgya chen bzhengs gyur kyang / / sbyangs pa can gyi bee ro tsa na mtha' la sprugs/ / che ba'i yon tan dran tshe 'gyod pa'i dus shig mchis/ /las dkar spyad kyang nag por 'gro ba'i rje 'bangs rnams/ / dam chos spyod kyang rlom pas ma khyer bee ro tsa na tsam/ / sangs spyas 'phags pa'i thugs rje phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /rang rgyud mi dges spyags pa'i bdud rigs rgyas gyur pas/ /yid la ci bsam 'aspub bam rje 'bangs thugs la zhogs/ /dag pa'i mkhan slob 'byon tshe 'gyod pa'i dus shig mchis/ / bod du dam chos nyi ma lan cig shar ba 'di/ / phyi blon nang blon btsun mo bcas pas bsnub par byed/ / ma myong dgu myong shi ba ma myong tsam gyi mi/ / chags med gcig por 'gro ba'i bee ro tsa na nga / /snang tshad chos skur rtogs pas rdzogs chen don dang ldan/ /sdom gsum rgyu 'bras shes pas mdo sngags don dang ldan/ / dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen phung po gang ba sprugs/ / sku phyir ma 'khor tsa na 'gyod pa'i dus shig mchis/ / de nas rgyal pos phyag 'tshal smre sngags gdungs/ / 'bangs tshos byas pas yon mchod 'bral dgos byung / / bdag la brtse ba'i zhal ta tshig gsum zhu/ / slob dpon zhal nas rje la phyag thong gsungs/ /nga yang ma shi rje nyid sku khams bzang / /smon lam dag pas myur du mjal dus 'debs/ / rgya gar yul gyi grong khyer ser skya na/ / rgyal po ind+ra bolha'i bla mchod pa/ / paṇa chen lnga brgya'i dbus na mkhas pa ni/ / bi ma mi dra budha gu hya gnyis/ / bod la spyan drongs dad mos gsol ba thob/ /de dus nga yi chos 'di gtug tu btang / / gzhan yang paṇḍi ta ni mang du bos/ /cachos la bzang ngan ma byed thams cad bsgyur/ /ces gsungs rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong du gshegs/ /chibs rta de yang dbul po zhig la sbyin/ /de nas klu gong la sogs gros byas pas/ /rgyal mo tsha rong khrims 'dzin mdo bzher la/ /bod kyi mnga' bdag rgyal po'i chab shog ltar/ /bod yu la phung ba'i bande mi rta gnyis/ /bslu ba mkhan gyi nag nyes can de sod/ / me chu rlung gi khrims kyis tshar gcod zhu/gnyis pa/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong nas rgyas pa 'bum gdan drangs te pod khams sbyi khrab tu dar ba'i skor/rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong du glang khams pa go cha rgyas pa 'bum gdan 'dren du btang tshe/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis kyang / rgyal mo tsha ba rong kho 'phan la chab shog ces bod kyi rdzogs pa chen po'i rtogs ldan pa de rgyal mo tsha rong gdul byar gzigs pa'i phyir nam zhig byon skabs sku tshe'i 'gal rkyen myur skyob kyi 'os 'gan khyed la gtad pa la rem shig ces ba~Xkā/ rjo rgya

bod yig tshang chen mo〉 las/ gsang sngags kyi chos rnams ni/ ston pas lung bstan pa bzhin/ rgyal po dza'i khang steng du byin gyis rlabs las/ char ltar bab par byed do/ /sde snod gsum po'i bka' bsdus tshar nas/ thams cad po ti dang glegs bam du bkod yod pa'i mtshams su/ lha ma srin sde baspyad sogs gsung rab gi zhabs tog dang bdag 'dzin la ma 'cham par/ sku gdung bzhin du bgo ra thob khyer byas pas/ khri brgyad stong ba lhas thob/ shes rab khri ba lha min gyis thob/ nyi khri mis thob/ lang kar gshegs pa srin pos thob/ tog bdud kyis thob/ gzungs ma mos thob/ 'bum klus thob ste/gza' khyab 'jug gis skal ba chad/ gzhan thams cad mi yul du 'dus/ 'bum klu yul nas ma lon pa'i skabs su/ klu'i rgyal po rakṣa bya bar nad ci ji tsha mas thebs pa/ sus kyang 'chos ma thub ste/ sman pa 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i bu/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bcos pa'i gtang rag la 'bum phul nas/ mi yul rgya gar lho phyogs nas rim par rgya bod mtshams rgyal mo tsha ba rong nas dar/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ glangs khams pa go cha gdan 'dren du btang / bsam yas su phebs nas gzod bod khams yongs su dar zhing rgyas par gyur pas/ rgyas pa 'bum zhes grags so/ / 'bum la sho lo ka 'bum yod pas 'bum zhes zer zhing / le'u bdun bcu rtsa gnyis/ bam po sum brgya/ shad bzhi khri bzhi 'bum/tsheg bye ba bzhi khri/ gzhan yang / bka' thams cad la (50 ba)'di bzhin du rgyas bshad yod cing /mdor na skabs chen brgyad/ skabs bu chung bdun cu tham pa ni/ bka' rgyas pa 'bum nas bsdus pa/yi ge gcig ma yan chad la tshang ngo / /'bum bod yu la du sgyur ba po sngon ma ni/ mkhas pa bee ro tsa na yin no/ / rgyal mo tsha ba rong nas phyir bod du phebs pas bsam yas la mkhas pa bee ro tsa na dang slob bu g.yu sgra snying po gnyis nas bsgyur ro/ / da lta sho lo ka 'bum ma tshang ba ni/ mtha' dum gcig klu'i yul du lus par byed na'ang / chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i le'us 'jug bsdus pas/ don la tshang bar ka cog zhang gsum la sogs lo paṇa mkhas pa rnams bzhed (pa)mthun no/ /yang 'bum sde lnga bya ba ni/shes rab kyis pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bum ni/ rgyus pa 'bum la zer te/ zab cing rgya che ba'i phyir na 'bum/ sho lo ka 'bum yod pas na 'bum zhes bya'o/ /dkon rtsegs la smon lam 'bum yod pas na 'bum zhes bya'o/ /phal po che la sangs rgyas 'bum yod (51 na)pas na 'bum zhes bya ste/ mtshan dgu brgya ma tshang ba/ 'phags pa glang ri lung bstan yod pas tshang ngo / lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo ni/ srin yul lang ka phu ring bzhengs su gsol te/ srin po btul ba'i rnam grangs 'bum yod pas na 'bum zhes bya'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bum ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' khar zhal chem 'bum yod pas na myang 'das 'bum zhes bya'o/ / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ brgyad stong 'grel ba/ snying bo mchog las/ mdo'i sde/dbyangs snyan/ lung du bstan/ tshigs bcad/ ched brjod/ gleng gzhi dang / rtogs brjod/de lta bu byung ba dang / skyes rabs yan lag bcu gnyis yin no/ /— 158 —

gsum pa/ bee ro tsa nasargul mo rong du lug rdzo byas pa'i skor/slob dpon bee ro tsa na gzhon nu'i tshul bzung nas rgyal mo dmu rdo'i nye 'gram brag steg yul gyi sum pa tshang gi thab rdo sum tshom zhig la tshe rabs sngon ma'i ma yum dmyal ba nyi 'tshe ba'i skye bar mkhyen nas/ lo gyedayan chod sum pa tshang la lug rdzi byas/ ma yum gyi sdig bshags dzu 'phrul gyis mchod rten brgya bzhengs pas mchod rten 'ga' da ltar kyang mjal rgyu yod/ mthar 'gro la nye ba'i dus skabs su gzhan ma dang mi 'dra ba'i dogs pa skye yul gyi skyes bu dam pa zhig ngo zin kyang zer ma nus pa'i gla zas sprang rgyu'i gra sgrig byas tshe/ khong la gla zas dgos pa med kyang gla zas tshab tu khyed kyi thab rdo ma snyed de nga la gnang dgos gsungs tshe/thab rdo byin nas sgo khar thon tshe sum pa tshang la gros pa'i thab rdo 'di bcag na chog gam zhus pa'i khyed rang gi thugs dgongs bzhin mdzod/ ces zhus phral thab rdo bcag pa'i nang nas bye ma leb cig 'phur song ba kun gyis mthong ngo / /de nas sum pa yul tsho thams cad dang ba skyes de nan dan gyis bzhugs zhes byas kyang / khong slob dpon gyi 'gro ba'i dus byung nas 'gro dgos/ khyed rnams dad pa yod na lo re bzhin sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la tshe sgrub kyi tshogs 'khor phul nus na de'i tshe nga rang mngon sum 'ongs ngo gsungs nas/ sum pa nas tshogs 'khor deng sang yang lo rer 'bul gyin yod/ 〈 rin chen gter mdzod〉 las/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong rdzi 'gag 'phan bzher dbang chen rgyal po tshe dbang mgon po zhes grags/lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sprul ba mdo bzher 'di gnyis la btsun mo bdun dang / blon phyi blon brgya dang nang blon bcu yod kyang 'phan bzher tshe dbang mgon por sras med pa'i mdo bzher la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba lcags mo khri dpon la 'phan bzher gyi rgyal srid gtad chung ba khro bo skyabs de khro skyabs la song ba'i sa'i ming yang khro skyabs zhes grags so/ / de'i dus su bee ro tsa nas rang ga phug tu bya tshogs dang sprel chegs rnams la chos gsungs dus/ mdo bzher gyis blon po ngag dbang dpal ldan 'khor dang bcas 'dzin bzung du btang ste/ bdun gsum btson du bcug go/ de nas rang ga'i sgrub phug tu bzhugs skabs phyugs rdzi 'ga' re dang rngon las pas mthong nas/ bod yu la phung ba'i ngan sngags mkhan bande mi lus rdo dkar ri rgyud rang ga phug pa zhig gi nang du 'dug zhes mdo bzher nag por zhus phral pho nya btang nas 'dzin bzungs kyi khrims las sbyar bas thog mar sbal dong sbrul dong nang du bcug kyang ci yang ma nyes pa'i zil ba phrom mer bzhugs nas mgur 'di gsungs/ skye ba 'di yi gong rol tu/ /yul khams 'di yi ni'u ler skyes/ /sbrul dang sbal pa mang po 'chos/ /de yi rnam smin 'di ru byung / /lan chags de yis 'khor gyur cig / gsungs nas sbal sbrul gyi dong nas bton te/ yang mi shig khyi shig ra shig 'dre shig gildang nang du bskyur nas 'gur 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba 'di yi gong rol tu/ /dge slong purtse'i las blangs te/ /chos gos shig za bya 'thur bcag/ de yi rnam smin 'di ru byung / / lan chags de yis 'khor gyur cig /ces gsungs ba'i snga phyi bdun gsum nas yul mi rnams kyis skye ba sngon dus dge slong pulko yin par ngo shes nas blta ru byung / ci yang ma nyes pa'i zil ba phrom me bzhugs par mthong phral yul mi mang pos lha ltar — 159 ge

bkur nas nyes byas su bzod par gsol zhing bshags pa byas pas/ yul grong de la mang bkur zhegagrags/ de nas yul kun gyis mdo bzher la nyes khag med pa'i dge slong 'di gtong dgos pa'i smon 'dun che ba dang / chabs cig snga gong nas khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chab shog rdzi 'gag 'phan bzher dzeebaskur ba'i nang don ltar slob dpon bee rdo tsa na nag med nyes 'gel phog par shes pa'i phyir/ nyes 'gogalegs spel zhes/ nyes pa thams cad 'gog pa dang / legs pa thams cad spel bas ched du 'phan bzher dang mdo bzher gnyis kyis cog tse las gros byas pa'i bden rdzun gang yin 'khrun thag gtsang mar bcad ma thag tu/ so mang chu bos 'gram nas chu shing sdong po gcig gis phyag rten byas pa dang chu rdo pha bong zhig mchan 'og tu bcug nas de'i ri ngos 'od gsal sgrub phug tu phebs nas skabs zhig bzhugs/ pha bong la sku lus tshang ma dbu bcas kyi sku rjes dang ngo mtshar can gyi gnas ri der zhabs rjes dang phyag rjes sgrub chu mkha' 'gro'i bro ra mkha' 'gro'i brag lam slob dpon bee ro tsa na'i rang nyid gzugs sku rang 'byon sogs du ma zhig mjal rgyu yod/ bee ro tsa na'i 'od gsal phug ces grags song na khyi le bcu tsam gyi ri ngos na yod/ rgyal dbang drug pa phebs nas re zhig bzhugs par grags/ bar skabs shig nas sems dpa' chen po bkris lhun blo bzang 'jam dpal/ bon gyi lta ba dor nas dge ldan ring lugs 'dzin pa 'bras ye shes yar 'phel/ sgrol mas 'jigs pa las bskyab cing / padma lha ru ka grub pa phor mkhan bla ma grags pa'i rnying ma ba ste gsum dge sbyor la yun ring gzhol/ snga ma gnyis kyi bka' drin gyis phyogs 'dir smyung gnas kyi srol dar/ sngon nas da lta bar ma chad pa dad sems can gyi skyes bu dam pa mang po gnas ri der lo dang zla rer bzhin sgrub sbyangs su bzhugs pa dang / skye bu pho mo mang po mjal skor la yong ba yin/ bod kyi srin po gdong dmar rnams 'dul ba'i phyir rtags dang rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan pa de las/mdo bzher kyang 'gyod sems skyes pas pho brang du gdan drangs nas bshags pa byas nas bzod gsol gyi mgur 'di phul/ bod la mi med rgyal po 'dod pa can/ /skye mang mkhyen pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyod/ /'gro ba'i don la 'dzam bu'i gling du byon/ / khyad par du yang srin po gdong dmar rje/ / bod kyi don mdzad blon po nag po rnams/ /'dul ba'i dus la ma bab 'dir byon te/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'gro don mdzad pa la/ / spyod pa gnyis mdzad byang chub mthar phyin pas/ / 'gro ba'i don la cir yang ston mdzad pa'i/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyod la bzod par gsol/ / zhes brjod pa'i phyag ni gyang 'gyel ba bzhin du 'tshal/ de nas bzung ste mdo bzher nag po yab sras kun gyis zhabs pad spyi bor blangs so/ / de nas bka' kod seng ge'i yang rdzong du phebs nas sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi 'jam dpal sku/padma gsungs/ yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur ba 'phrin las kyis ma gza' dam gsum dam la btags nas srung mar bkod/ mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum gyis sri mnan pa/ gdon bgegs bsregs pa/ gtor zor 'phangs nas bdud srin ma rungs pa rnams tshar bcad/ sgrub pa ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i sgom bzlas kyis bar chad thams cad phyir bzlogs/ der yang sku dang — 160 —

phyag rjes zhabs rjes shin tu mang po mjal rgyu yod/bzhi ba/ shar nas dar mgo la chos 'khor bskor ba dang slob bu g.yu sgra dang mjal 'phrad gnang tshul/mdo bzher nag po yab sras kyis shar nas dar mgo la rgyal mo rong gi pho lus thob tshad bsags nas slob dpon bee ro tsa na chos gsungs par gdan drangs/ de nas slob dpon gab rtse'i steng du bzhugs nas/rgyal po'i sras mo g.yu sgras lo tsā bsgyur bas/ rgyal po mdo bzher nag pos gser gyi dong rtse grangs med phul nas 'di skad do/ / rig drug don mdzad byang chub sems dpa'i sku/ / gang la gang 'dul theg pa ston pa'i gsung / / yin bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i thugs/ / mi snang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa pho brang na/ /sde snod gsum gyi spyi mes chen po la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsum lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /gnyis med mnyam nyid 'gro ba'i mgon po la/ / gser dang dngul gyi dong rtse'i me tog 'bul/ / thugs rjes dgongs nas srid pa'i mtsho bsgral 'tshal/ /ye shes thugs rje'i zhags pa'i bzung du gsol/ /zhes thog mar stoms ste stams sta stoms sta tha gsungs pas shes par ma byung nas/ gral mthar mchis pa'i phrug gu gcig gis rdo rje sems dpa' che zhes zer ba/ slob dpon gyi de ye shes pas pha ma dang spun zla sogs gnyen tshan ci yod/ byis pa 'di la sgra bslabs na myur du shes pa sla bar 'dug gsungs/ mdo bzher nag po na re/ khong gi pha ma rgyal rigs kyi khyim rgyud yin kyang da lta med par song ba'i kho rang gcig pu min pa su yang med pa'i lto gos nged tshos byas na chog sgra slob rgyu bka' drin zhus/ zhes pas byis pa de nyid slob dpon drung du phul/ slob dpon gyis byis pa la dris pa/ khyod yu la gang nas/ lo na tshod ji ltar/ming la ci zer zhes gsungs/ lan ming la g.yu sgra zhes bya ba/ na tshod lo brgyad yin/ yul ni brag steng zhes bya'o/ slob dpon gyis sngon rtsang legs grub de yi skye ba yin par mkhyen nas glo bur du ming nas bos ༵rsha ṭwāṃ ༵/ra bas lan btab pa/ de la sgra bslabatsonas mkhas par gyur pas mtshan la g.yu sgra snying po zhes ༄ de nas rgyal mo rong gi 'bangs mi thams cad la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras sogs blo ldog rnam pa bzhi zhib tu gsungs nas/ thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod pa'i lus kyis phyag 'tshal/ ngag gis skyabs 'gro bton/ yid kyis bla ma la dad gus nyin 'ga' byas 'phror/ shar rgyal mo tsha ba rong du thub pa'i bstan pa thog mar dar 'go 'dzugs pas na shar nas dar 'go dang / de'i skabs su der dgon pa zhig bzhengs pa'i ming la yang thub bstan dar 'go dgon zhes grags/ da lta yang dgon gyi shul ro gsal bo yod/kun gyis chos kyi dga' ston la dga' ba'i glu dang / skyid pa'i mchod bro dang 'dzom bro kaub1 kāṭwāṃ/ geslob

dpon gyis kyang glu dang gzhas/ bro sogs sku rtsal ston pa'i ched mang po gsungs/ g.yu sgra snying por bstod bro zhig gnang ba ni/ shar nas shar phyogs 'jems 'jems/ / lho nas lho phyogs 'jemasaglu'ajems/ /sgo gnyis bu tsha steng yul shas/ /yag legs bu tsha dbu bkur bstod/ /ces gnang ngo / /yang kun gyis phyag 'tshal me tog gtor nas chos zhu ba gsol/ nyin mo dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i 'bum sde lnga dang / phyi rgyud sde gsum la sogs pa gsungs/ srod la gsang sngags nang gi chos gsungs/ de nas g.yu sgra snying pos rta bzang po gcig la gser sga dang g.yu khras brgyan nas/ dar yug bcas slob dpon la phul nas man ngag gi chos zhus par/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ lta ba'i rgyal po nam mkha' che/ /dud 'gro'i rgyal po rtar mi 'tshong / /bstan pa'i snying po rdzogs pa che/ /sgyu ma'i nor la bdag mi 'tshong / /btsong na rgyal po'i bka' chad 'byung / /snod ldan tshul khrims bzang la sbyin/ /gsungs nas ma gnang ngo / / der g.yu sgras slob dpon bee ro tsa na la phag nyan byas pas/ slob dpon gyis nam mkha' che zhal 'don mdzad pa rnams g.yu sgras blo la zin/ slob dpon gyi dpe cha'ang brkus nas nga la yang yod to byas pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab 'jam dpal gyis/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i gsang sngags nges pa'i don/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu gting zab pas /yig nag tshig gis byang chub lam mi rnyed/ / ces gsungs so/ / g.yu sgra snying pos phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas/ zhabs khyi bos blangs te/ mig nas mchi ma phyung nas/ slob dpon chen po lags/ bdag gis slob dpon ci ltar gsungs pa bzhin bka' nyan cing bsgrub pas/ man ngag gi chos thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ zhes yang yang zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs la 'dis tshod lta bar mi 'dug gam/ ci nas kyang chos 'dod par thugs la dgongs nas/ der snod sbyang ba'i ched du sbyang ba dgu dang / phod pa bcu gsum byed du bcug ste/ man ngag gi chos gsungs so/ / slob dpon gyis g.yu sgra la 'di skad gsungs/rtsol med bde chen thob 'dod na/ khyod kyi nga la sbyang ba dgu dang phod pa bcu gsum gyis shig gsungs nas/ g.yu sgra na re/ ma hā gu ru ci ltar gsungs pa bzhin nyan par bgyis/ zhal nas bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gnang bar zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas gsungs pa bzhin phod pa bcu gsum dang sbyang ba dgu re re nas sgrub pa'i rtsol med rdzogs pa chen po'i bka' lung skyed par 'gyur ro/ / g.yu sgras phyag lan stong mdzad nas/ bla ma bshes gnyen dam pa lags/ bdag cag gis ma lags so/ /ma lags so/ / mgon lags so/ / mun pa sel ba'i sgron me lags so/ / 'khor ba dong nas 'dren pa'i thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyu lags so/ /ji ltar gsungs bzhin byed lags na/ thugs jes 'khor ba'i dong nas 'dren du gsol/ zhes gsol ba yang yang btabs/ de nas 'bum zhu dag mdzad/lnga ba/ bee ro tsa nas ma mgon dam gsum gter nas bton tshul/slob dpon bee ro tsa na'i mgon po tshogs bdag gi gsang sgrub dngos sgrub 'byung gter 'di bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i lo rgyus la gnyis te/ sngon byung gi lo rgyus dang / rjes sor bod yul du dar ba'i lo — 162 —

rgyus so/ / dang po sngon byung gi lo rgyus de yang bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid dur khrod chenapo'i byang shar na bam ro brtsegs pa'i gnas/ mdung dang ral gri gshib pa'i pho brang nas/ dregs pa can dbang du bsdu ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ 'khor ye shes kyi khro bo chen po dang / rdo rje khro bo rol pa la sogs pa thabs gcig tu bzhugs nas/ de'i tshe 'khor de dag gi nang nas gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon rnams dang thabs gcig tu stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ rang byung ye shes chen po'i kun la khyab gyur kyang / / de'i don nyid ma rig ma rtog 'khrul dbang gis/ / bstan pa 'jig cing 'bras bus dmyal khams 'khor/ /de sgrol lam bstan 'phrin las bshad par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang des/ bstan dgra las ngan gyi dbang gis khams gsum du 'khor te bstan pa la bar du gcod/ 'bras bu dmyal ba dang khams gsum du 'khor te/ de dag thugs rje chen pos sgrol zhing thar lam bstan pa'i phyir/ ma hā ka la dregs pa can dbang du bsdus pa'i yang snying 'di dag ched du gsungs so/ / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hū phaṭaḥ gnad kyi gdams pa rig chod 'di dag brjod pas/ sngags kyi dregs pa can brgyal bar 'gyur ro/ / de nas 'khor de dag gi nang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs rje can/ / gsung tshig dam tshig rngams pa'i gsungs sgra sgrogs pa ngo mtshar che/ /dregs pa 'khor bcas rab tu skugs cing brgyal/ / lnga 'dus dang po 'od kyi gong bu nas/ / rtsa 'dus las kyi 'brel ba'i srog snying 'bul/ /zhes gsol pas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad ci yang ma yin pa zhes bya ba mnyams pa nyid sems can kun la khyab par mdzad do/ / de'i byin rlabs kyis dregs pa can de dag slar dran pa rnyed de rang rang gi srog gi snying po de nyid bcom ldan 'das la phul lo/ /āoṃ shrī ma hā kā la dha na gu ti ka pa la shrī nag mo ti la skyo/ / ces phul bas/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi sgrub thabs kyi rgyud 'di gsungs nas dha na saṃ skyi ta'i bar du brgyud do/ /gnyis pa man ngag gam ngan sngags 'di bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i lo rgyus/ rje btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ ba gor bai ro tsa na dang rtsang legs grub gnyis rgya gar gyi yu la du chos dang man ngag 'tshol du btang ba la/ shrī sing ha la bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i chos thams cad zhus/ dha na saṃ skyi ta la man ngag gam ngan lngags kyi rgyud thams cad gsan nas/ ngan sngags thams cad kyi nang nas mgon po tshogs bdag gi gsang sgrub bzlog pa'i rgyal po dgra chos kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum yod par/dbang chen brtsegs pa'i rgyud dang / spu gri klad gzer gyi rgyud/ khrag mtsho khol ba'i rgyud gsum mo/ /dbang chen brtsegs pa'i rgyud 'di la/ phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub gsum yod pa la/ 'di ni gsang sgrub sbog gi spu gri zhes bya'o/ / man ngag phyi nang gsang gsum stod snad las byang sgrub pa mang du zhus nas 'ong ba la/ bod kyi blon po gdug pa can rnams kyi rgyal khrims la btsud pas/ bee ro tsa na rgyal rong du sgyugs pa'o/ / nye rgyud ni bee ro tsa nas rgyal rong brag lha mgon po zhes gser gyi 'brong ri skug po nas ma ge 163 —

mgon dam gsum gter nas drangs nas/ dngos spub gter du sbas pas/ rdo grub chen 'jigs med 'azin las 'od zer gyi rnam thar las/ mgo log gi zo dor/ gnyan po g.yu rtse'i lho phyogs/ mdo khams zal mo sgang gi nub byang na/ mgo log gser thal zhes bya ba'i gnas la 'go ba'i yul skyongs shar rgyal mo rong gi 'phru tog khams gser gzhung mi sde'i rten phur/ gnas las ming btags pa gser gyi 'brong ri srug po ste/ mtshan nas brjod na rgyal rong brag lha mgon po/ g.yung drung rnga la stag rtse zhes gsungs so/ / chu 'pho rtog ldan gyis bton nas/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la gsungs/ des mdo shel ye shes rgyal la/ des ye shes 'bum la/ des gser pa rgyal mtshan rdo rje la/ des bdag nam mkha' rin chen la rjes gnang bka' ltar sgrub pa'i lag len dang bcas pa bod gangs chen khrod du khyab pa gnang ba lags so/ /gsum pa rgyud las brten pa'i phyir sgrub thabs la/ skyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes so/ /gsol 'debs ltar ni/ chos sku mgon po kun tu bzang po/ ye shes mgon po rnam par snang mdzad/ longs sku'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku'i mgon po ma hā ka la/ nor lha'i mgon po rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ kun bzang sprul ba dha na saṃ skyi ta/ snang mtha'i sprul ba bee ro tsa na/ 'jam dpal sbrul ba khri srong lde'u btsan/ spyan gzigs sprul ba rgyal mo g.yu sgra/ phyag rdor sprul ba mdo bzher nag po/ tshogs bdag sbrul ba sha mi go cha/ mkha' 'gro'i sprul ba dha ra sing ha/ bee ro'i skye mtha' chos kyi grags pa/legs grub skye mtha' g.yu sgra snying po/ mgon po'i zhal mthong rol pa rdo rje/ sku mgon zhal mthong gu ru thi pa la/ gsung mgon zhal mthong shākya rin chen/ thugs mgon zhal mthong chos kyi rdo rje/ mgon po'i bka' bab blo gros rgyal mtshan/ nag 'gyur bka' bab shākya ke tu/ dkar 'gyur bka' bab shes rab seng ge/ gsum ka'i bka' bab mang blang chos rje/ bsnyen bsgrub bka' bab chu 'pho rtog ldan/yongs rdzogs mnga' brnyes brag seng gu ru/ khro bo'i bka' bab rgyal mo dpal ldan/ bstan bsrung chen po sirnyi ke tu/ thams cad bka' bab pha bla ke tu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i brgyud rim ṭwāṃḍi ro/ / /g.yu sgra snying po dang / chu 'pho rtog ldan/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho lha bla ke tu sogs slob chen du ma drug pa/ rgyal mo rong la mdo sngags kyi bstan pa spel tshul/yul rgyal mo rong du mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa'i phyir gling gsum zhes thog mar chu 'pho thub bstan gsang sngags nor bu gling dang / gnyis pa khro bcu mdo mkhar thub bstan bde chen gling /gsum pa rgyal kha steg thog phun tshogs bkra shis gling zhes dgon chen gsum bzhengs nas/ bstan bdag slob dpon chen po bee ro tsa na dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'phan bzher dang mdo bzher nag po sogs kyis zhus nas sku rdzi ri ngog bla ma dong sgrub phug tu zhugs pa'i da ltar yang bla ma dong zhes grags pa der bee yig rang tram̐n ༵dī mgon po'i bla shing bla rdo rgyal nag lcags mgon la gnang ba'i ma mgon dam gsum sogs

bzhugs pa'i gnas yul dang bod kyi yul 'dir man ngag rdzogs pa chegapor grags pa la sems sde dang klong sde dang / man ngag gi sde zhes rnam pa gsum du 'chad pa la/ sems sde ni lnga de bee ro tsa na dang / klong sde yang bee ro tsa na las byung ba'i man ngag go / man ngag gi sde la rjes su snying thig ces grags pa ste/ ji ma mi dra las byung zhing / theg pa rim dgu zhes nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems te mtshan nyid sde gsum mam phyi kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg gsum/ kri ya u pa yo ga ste byi rgyud sde gsum mam nang dka' thub rig byed theg pa gsum/ ma ha a nu a ti yo ga ste nang rgyud sde gsum mam gsang ba dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum la sogs 'chad do/ /khro bcu bdud 'dul sngags bde chen gling zhes gsang sngags rnying ma'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum gyi rgyud gzhung gtso bo rnams te/ mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa/ rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste dpal gsang ba snying po/ sems mdo ma bu brgyad sogs mdo rgyud sems gsum 'chad/ mdo mkhar phug brag phug tu bka' brgyad sgrub nas gtum zhing rngam pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis gdon bgegs thams cad 'jigs par byed pa'i khro bo bcu bran du bkol bas na yul der khro bcu (khro chu)zhes grags so/ /rgyal kha steg thog phun tshogs bkra shis gling zhes bkra shis 'byung ba'i bde gshegs mchod rten bzhengs pa dang mthun pa'i gso sbyong las dus ma nges pa'i gso sbyong rab gaskes sogs bkra shis dus dang /char dang than pa rgyal po ngan pa sogs bkra mi shis pa rnams shis par bya ba'i dus su gso sbyong byed pa na bkra shis gso sbyong zhes grags/ slob dpon ra ba ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i da lta'ang ri khrod de mjal rgyu yod par de gsum la gling gsum grags so/ / de min khong gis phyag btab kyi dgon bran du ma yod par dper na sher drug dgon dang / sku 'dug dgon/ ban dhe dgon sogs grangs las 'das pa yin/ ban dhe dgon ni sngon bon dgon de ban dhe bsgyur bas na ban dhe dgon zhes da lta cho bdun dgon zhes/ slob dpon bee ro tsa na der bzhugs dus slob dpon padma 'byung gnas mngon sum du zhal gzigs pa'i phyir sa cha der padma 'byung gnas zhes ming thogs/ sku 'dug dgon ni sngon brag bar tsho ba brgyad kyi dgon pa zhig tu slob dpon bee ro tsa na deralo bar cha shas bzhugs pa'i phyir sku 'dug khang zhes da lta yang lo rer sgrub mchod 'tshogs kyin yod par khong gi phyag thel kyang mjal rgyu yod pa'i da dung yul gyi ming la yang bee zhes zer ba'i ming thogs pa yod/sher drug dgon ni shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa drug 'chad pa'i phyir sher drug (so mang rang skad du sher drag dgon)ces su grags so/ / shar dung ri dang zung chu'i rgyud du yang mang po bzhugs nas thub pa thob pa'i rtags mtshan du ma bstan/ gab tog gnas ri dang rgyal mo dmu rdo'i gnas ri chen po mang por bzhugs shing / e ma mkhyen brtse gnyis ldan yab gcig po/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgyal ba sras bcas la/ / kun gyi thugs sras 'gran zla bla na med/ / dus tshod mar grib lnga brgya'i dus kyi mthar/ / bod khams yongs la bde ba med pa'i dus/ /sbas pa'i rong chen shod chen bco baspyad la/ /'dzam gling zhing khams gnas chen mang lags kyang / / gnas der bee ro'i byin rlabs thugs rje zer/—/ ṭwāṃ ༵sa bde ba

can dang khyad med gsungs/ / bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ khyad par shar phyogs spya mo brgya yi rong / / rnam dag gling zhes dmu rdo sbas pa'i rong / / de 'dra gnas chen yon tan mtshungs mi med/ /bee ro khyed kyi rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin basbob/ /bee ro khyod ni gnas de ru song la/ /sgrub pa bskya la spub rtags mang du zhog/ lha 'dre mi la bka' bsgo bden tshig brjod/ / ma 'ongs don du zab mo gter rnams sbas/ / de dus skye mchog bee ro tsa na khyod/ / khrom dkyil mdung thogs lta bu 'gro don mdzad/ /sbas pa'i rong chen shod chen bco brgyad sogs/ /rten 'brel log pas gzhan dbang ma song na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyan du mngon 'phags shing / /bod yul 'gro ba kun gyi sman du 'gyur/ /zhes 'chi med padma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan pa ltar ro/ /bdun pa/ slob dpon bee ro tsa nas rgyal mo dmu rdo nas sgrub pa mdzad tshul dang gnas chen ri bo de'i chags tshul/gnas chen ri bo de yi chags tshul ni/ / phyi ltar yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ / dar gyi yol ba'i nang du sbas pa 'dra/ /pha rol gdug pa'i gdon gyis mi tshugs so/ /nang ltar dkyil 'khor ling rtse'i bya ma ru/ / mthing gi bum pa gdan la bkod pa 'dra/ / ngo mtshar gnas chen byin rlabs 'byung ba 'o/ /gsang ltar gdugs kyi rtsibs shing lta bur gnas/ / ri bo drug cu zhing khams chags pa 'o/ / phyi nang gsang gsum gnas kyi chags tshul ni/ / rtse mor gnas chen bzhi la las bzhi'i dbyibs/ / yan lag gnas chen brgya dang yan lag bcu/ /de yang gtso bo g.yu sgra phug rtse ni/ /ri bo chu bzhi 'dus pa'i la phug tu/ / rtsa ba chu 'brag lcags sgrog dpyangs 'dra las/ / grong dang grong khyer grong brdal bsam mi khyab/ /za 'og dar gyi kha phye bzhin du yod/ / rkyed pa brag dang nags ri sbrag ma ni/ / sna tshogs dar gyis 'phur ma 'tshub pa las/ / gnas chen bzhi yi pho brang chags pa yin/ /rtse mo gangs brag nor bu spungs 'dra las/ /sna tshogs g.yung drung rdo rje 'dra ba'i brag ri mchog/ri bo drug cu las mngon 'phags pa'i / /ri bo de yi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la/ /chu bo brgyad ni gdugs kyi rtsibs shing ltar/ /chu sna thams cad ri bo de la 'dus/ /lung ba brgyad ni padma bzhad pa 'dra/ /chu bo brgyad ni padma'i yu ba 'dra/ /dbus su dmu rdo ri bo mchog rab ni/ / rin chen yid bzhin nor bu spungs pa 'dra/ / rtse mo ri bo bang rim bcu gsum ste/ /yi dam mkha' dbyings dkar po rang bzhin gsal/ /ri bo de las ye shes lha tshogs tshang / /rtse mo phyogs bzhi rdo ba rigs dwags gzugs/ / shar phyogs sangs rgyas byang phyogs tshe dbang dang / / nub phyogs o rgyan lho phyogs 'od ldan me/ / mi 'gyur bka' rtags zhabs rjes re re yod/ / rnga gshang 'dra ba'i 'og la gong btegs der/ / kun bzang shel gyi sangs rgyas 'dzub gang yod/ / de la bee ro'i phyag rjes zhabs rjes bzhugs/ / ri bo de yi phyogs bzhir gsang mtshe ba'i/ / shar phyogs yum chen mkha' 'gro'i bla mtsho ni/ /mthing mdangs 'od 'bar padma lta bu gnas/ /de ni zhi ba'i tshogs chu ngo mtshar ba'i/ /— 166 —

padmamakha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rtag tu bsrung / /byang phyogs rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i ri bo'i zhol/ /ma mchog bla mtsholjang nag mu ldan la/ /grub pa'i zur gsum rnam pa 'khor 'khyil yod/ /ri ni lha thod thog pa rang bzhin gsal/ / khro bo gsang chen rigs lnga rang byon yod/ /nub phyogs seng ge ma bu rtse 'dra la/ /kun snang khyab pa'i lha chogs rang byung yod/ / las kyi mkha' 'gro'i chogs rnams rtag tu gnas/ / baspya dang rtso brgyad mkha' 'gro rang byung yod/ / rin chen 'bru sna mang po'i gter kha yod/ / ri brag mchul 'dra ba'i yang gong na/ /tshogs bdag mkha' 'gro chogs kyi bla matso yod/ /padma mkha' 'gro lnga yi zhabs rjes yod/ / nor bu yid la 'grub pa'i gter kha yod/ /gnas der phyin na dbang gi las rnams 'grub/ /lho phyogs rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ri bo'i rtse/ / seng gdong mkha' 'gro'i bla mtsho dkar mo yod/ / zla gam dbyibs la hūṃ gi rang gzugs shar/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rtag tu srung / /dbang gi mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi zhabs rjes lnga / / o rgyan yab yum rdzu 'phrul zhabs rjes re/ / brag ri dar gyi yol ba 'dra ba la/ / o rgyan rje 'bangs nyer lnga mngon sum bzhugs/ /gnas der phyin na drag po'i las rnams 'aspub/ /mtshams bzhir ngo mtshar gnas kyi tshal bzhi yod/ /shar lho 'chi med o rgyan rin po che/ /lho nub ja yab gling du byon tshul dang / /bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'dra ba'i brag ri la/ /gu ru mtshan brgyad rang byung gsal ba yod/ /byang shar ar mu ṇi ka rdo leb las/ /mthing gi ri bo bzhi yis skor ba'i tshul/ /sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig rang byung yod/ / nub byang sman mo rnam dag khug ces la/ / rang byung bdud rtsi 'thung chog rang brdol la/ / ma pa ma ti ngag sgra rang sgrogs yod/ /brgya dang nyer gcig mchod rten skor ba'i tshul/ /thar ba'i lam la bgrod chog gnas ri yin/ / bee ro'i gsang sngags sgrub pa'i byin rlabs che/ /dbu rtse bee ro mkha' la gshegs pa'i lam/ /zhabs rjes gnyis dang mkha' 'gro'i bro ra yod/ /de ru thun cig bsgoms na mngon shes 'char/ / dbu rtse zangs mdog dpal ri 'dra ba la/ / dbang phyug lha gnyan gnas kyi rked pa la/ / las bzhi'i gnas kyi pho brang so sor gsal/ / kun bzang 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs rnams/ / mngon sum brag la rang byung gsal po yod/ / dbus su g.yu sgra phug ces bya ba la/ /dbang drag bde mchog dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i gnas/ /g.yu sgra snying po thub pa thob pa'i gnas/ /bee ro tsa na'i dgongs pa brda yi gsung / / o rgyan padmas byin rlabs thub pa'i ri/ / g.yas phyogs thugs rje byams pa'i gnas chen ni/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i phug ces bya ba yod/ /g.yon du gsang ba 'dus pa'i gnas chen ni/ / ri bo seng glang 'gig khyung rtse 'dra la/ /gsang ba 'dus pa bka' yi lha tshogs 'bar/ /gsang sngags rigs brgya'i lha tshogs bskor ba'i gnas/ /ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i mjal rgyu yo da/ /mdun du bde chen mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug yod/ / de 'og spyal ba rigs lnga rang byung yod/ / g.yas g.yon brag ri me lce 'dra ba la/ / 'jam dpal rigs gsum mgon po rang byung yod/ / rigs gsum mgon po bsgrubs pa'i ke'u tshang yod/ /de 'og khro bo ches mchog yab yum la/ /khrag 'thung khro bo tshogs kyis bskor ba'i tshul/ /de'i mdun rdo ba skyed pa'i dbyibs 'dra la/ /u rgyan padma rji po~X /brdzu rjes

yod/ / ye shes mtsho rgyal gsang ba'i sgrub phug la/ / bdud rtsi khrus gyi chu bo rang babs yod/ / dbuspokyi ri bo thugs khar 'dra ba la/ / 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams bkod pa dang / / kun bzang rgyal ba spya mtsho rang byung yod/ /mdun du g.yu sgra'i phug ces bya ba la/ /bee ro rje blon gnyis kyi zhabs rjes yod/ /g.yon phyogs brag ri rus sbal 'dra ba'i gseb/ /gom pa spos chog gsang lam sbas tshul yod/ /de'i steng7gsang phug rngam pa g.yu 'jug ces/ / sbas pa'i yul du 'gro ba'i gsang sgo yod/ / ri rab khong gsong nyams dga' ga'al yas khang / / brgya dang drug cu'i zhing khams bkod pa dzogs/ / sum brgya drug cu mkha' 'gro ma tshogs 'dus/ /las can skye bu dam pa ma gtogs pa/ /ma dag pa rnams gnas der phyin pa dka'/ /kun bzang rgyal ba rgya mtsho rang byung dang / /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams rtag tu gnas/ /de la chogs kyi 'brel ba gang thub rnams/ /sa bcu gnon pa'i rig 'dzin gral du skye/ /bde mchog phug gi g.yon phyogs nye ba'i sar/ / g.yu sgra'i phyag gis bris pa'i bee ro'isku/ / mi 'gyur bka' rtags yi ge dzaḥzhig yod/ /g.yas phyogs sgrub phug nyi zla kha sbyor zhes/ /bee ro'i zab mo'i gter kha sbas pa'i gnas/ /zab don lnga dang rin chen gter kha yod/ / gsang mchog mthar thug rol pa rang byung dang / / phyag gi bhanda las babs bdud rtsi dang / / pha bong dbus su bgrod chog thar lam yod/ / mi 'gyur gnas kyi bkang rtags gsal po yod/ /bee ro tsa na'i phyag mdzub rtse drangs ba'i/ /bdud rtsi chu mig badzrar rang sgra yod/ /khrus gsol 'thung bas tshe rabs sdig sgrib dag /gnas der phyin chad skye bcu'i sgrib pa sbyang / /smon lam gang btab 'grub la the tshom med/ / de yi mdun du lho phyogs nye 'dabs la/ / brag ri mthing nag mdung ring langs 'dra na/ / gsang mchog khro bo rgyal po mngon du gsal/ / mi 'gyur bka' rtags khyung chen rang byung yod/ / lha mo dre'u nag mo rtag tu 'khor/ / shin tu rngam 'jigs dbang gi pho brang mchog /de yi g.yon phyogs snang gsal sgang zhes bya/ /ri brag ral gri gyen du bstan 'dra bajid/ /gom pa spos chog rig 'dzin gter lam yod/ / mi 'gyur bka' rtags g.yu sgra'i phyag mdzub rjes/ / de 'og bee ro'i phyag rjes zhabs rjes dang / /phyag mkhar rjes sogs ngo mtshar che ba yod/ /de 'og brag ri padma 'dra ba'i ngor/ /bai ro'i sku gsung thugs kyi chu gsum 'bab/ khrus gsol byed na dug gsum sdig sgrib dag/ de 'og brag ri dung shog 'dra ba'i ngor/ / gnas chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis phul ba la/ / bkra shis chu mig dkar mo rang grol yod/ / sgo mo'i nang gi paka' rtags gsal ba yod/ / dung sna 'dra rdor bee ro'i zhabs rjes gnyis/ /grogs mchog g.yu sgra snying po'i zhabs rjes gcig /de 'og sa gzhi gri gug 'dra ba'i khug/rigs mchog rgyal tshab bee ro tsa na la/ / gnas chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis phul ba yi/ / sa yi lha mos rdo yi yol ba dang / / shing gi lha mos shing gi bsil gdugs dang / /chu yi lha mos khrus kyi chu bo dang / /me yi lha mos bon bhar phul ba yis/ /mi 'gyur gnas kyi bka' rtags bzhags pa mdzad/ /bee ro'i phyag gis bris pa'i sprin lo ris/ / ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas kyi sgo mo yin/ / de 'og pha bong dom dred 'dra ba la/ /yo rgyan padmas sde brgyad dam btags pa'i/ /rdo rje gro lod zhabs rjes khru gang yod/ /rdo ba sngon mo — 168 —

ga5las grub pa la/ / sna tshogs khrus kyi lha mo rang byung yod/ / g.yas su dung dang mthing gis rang grub las/ / rin chen zhags pa rkyang 'dra'i dbu dkyil na/ / mkha' 'gro'i brda yig baṃḥzhig 'od gzugs yod/ / bee ro tsa nas sbas pa'i gter kha yod/ / de 'og gnas chen sgo mo phyi ma la/ / g.yas su mi g.yo bsamagatan phug ces bya/ / bee ros lo gsum sgrub pa bskyal ba'i gnas/ / de yi mdun du rdo ba chos 'byung dbyibs/ /rgyal tshab bee ro tsa na'i zhabs rjes gcig /mi 'gyur bka' rtags hūṃ chen 'khyil 'dra yod/ /gzhan yang padma ral gri dril 'dra la/ /gnas chen mkha' 'gro lnga yi zhabs rjes yod/ /bee ros drangs pa'i chu mig 'thung chog yod/ / gnas der ting 'dzin bsgom pa shin tu bzang / /g.yon du kun snang bde ba phug ces la/ / rgya bod zing ba mthu chen sgrub phug yod/ / dpal bon stag lha me 'bar rang byung yod/ / zing ba mthu chen yab yum zhabs rjes gnyis/ / byang ba'i brag la bdud rtsi rang brdol yod/ / byang phyogs dpal chen bzhengs 'dra sku smad la/ / zhabs gnyis g.yas pa bskums pa'i zhabs rting la/ / mi g.yo brtan ma phug ces chags pa yin/ / g.yon pa brkyang ba'i ri yi sbrul rgyug ltar/ /zhabs gdan bam chen 'dra ba'i pha bong la/ /ma rungs sde brgyad srog gi sa bon yod/ /sku smad stag sham 'dra ba'i mjug ma la/ / dam can gter srung gnas pa'i pho brang yod/ / chu gnas 'dra rdor bee ro'i zhabs rjes yod/ /g.yas phyogs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhabs rjes yod/ /gnas chen ri mchog g.yung drung zhungs rtse la/ / phyogs ba'ir zhi rgyas dbang drag gnas chen bzhi/ / ngo mtshar rmad byung 'gran med byin rlabs che/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las gang yang 'grub/ /ri bo de la bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /skye ba gcig la mngon sangs rgyas thob nges/ /sbas pa'i rong chen shar phyogs rong / /dbang phyug ri bo'i nub phyogs su/ /yum chen mkha' 'gros byin rlabs gnas/ /grong khyer pi pi ling zhes par/ /mchod rten lhun po brtsegs pa 'di/ /bee ros bzhengs pa'i mchod rten yin/ /ri mchog bam chen tshal ri 'di/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen yin/ /de la bam chen tshal ri 'di/ /dbu rtse khyung chen lding 'dra braga'achi med dran pa yab sras gsum/ /rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i zhabs rjes re/ /bee ro khyung du sprul nas su/ /klu bdud dam la btags pa yi/ / khyung chen 'bas kyi sbar mo'i rjes/ / klu bdud gzil byed rjes rnams yod/ /de yi lho phyogs rdo gsum rtser/ /bee ros bsgoms pa'i sgom khang yod/ /mi 'gyur gnas kyi bka' rtags ni/ /bee ro'i zhabs rjes gnyis ka yod/ /'og tu g.yu sgra'i zhabs rjes gnyis/ /sa gnad gur yol 'dra ba la/ / thugs rje kun grol rang byung yod/ /nub phyogs bee ro tsa na yis/ /klu sman bsgrubs pas mtsho brdol nas/ /da lta mtsho yi rjes shul yod/ /mi 'gyur brag la sku rjes bzhags/ / pha wang ba glang 'dra ba'i 'og drung mi ha ra'i sgrub phug dang / / bee ros gnas lugs skyong ba'i phug/ bka' rtags phyag rjes 'bas rjes yod/ / bka' thang sde lnga las/ sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa la/ / sems kyi ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba ni/ /sems kyi dwangs ma'i bdag nyid ldan/ /nges tshig yod phyir mi 'brang the tshom bral/ / dbye na snang ba dkar dmar phyi yi sems/ / rig pa 'gyu byed nang gi sems dang gnyis/ / sgo — 169 —

lnga dbang po bar gyi sems dang gsum/ /gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog lung ma bstan dang bzhi/ /mdun du laspobazhi 'dra ba'i dbyibs/ /gnas chen mkha' 'gro brgya yi gnas/ /zhabs rjes che chung rnam pa gsum/ /shar phyogs brag dmar bum pa'i gzugs/ /tshe dpag med sku rang byung gsal/ / rdo ba ri dwags 'dra ba la/ / rig lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i zhabs rjes gsal/ / gnas chen de yi mtshams bzhi la/ / lo paṇa bee no tsa na dang / / grogs mchog g.yu sgra snying po dang / / rgya bon zing ba mthu chen dang / / 'chi med dran pa yab sras gsum/ / spub thob a mchog dpal chen sogs/ / phyag rjes dang ni zhabs rjes dang / / stu rjes la sogs bsam mi khyab/ / gnas de'i byin rlabs khyad par 'phags/ / ri bo bam chen tshal ri'i mdun/ / thang dkar phyag mthil 'dra ba'i 'phreng / / bee ro tsa nas bzhengs pa yi/ / mchod rten lhun po brtsigs pa 'di/ / sku gsung thugs tshul mchod rten yin/ / rjes su drung mi ha ra yis/ / zhig gso mdzad pa'i mchod rten 'di/ /sku gsum byin rlabs khyad 'phags bzhugs/ /'di la zhig gso phyag skor dang / / mchod 'bul gang byas yon tan ni/ / gnas chen bya ri gtsug ldan dang / / dbyer med yon tan lung las gsungs/ /skor ba brgya dang lnga bcu la/ /dung phyur re yod bdag gis bshad/ khyad par sprel zla'i tshes bcu dus/ /tshogs 'khor phyag 'tshal skor ba dang / /spos dang zhal zas yon chab dang / /dar cog rlung rta gang btsugs kyang / / dge ba dgu 'gyur stobs yod de/ / de phyir skal ldan skyes bu rnams/ / gnas chen yod tan thugs la zhog / rjes su 'brang zhing gsol ba btab/ / mchod bstod legs byas gang yang rung / / e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung / / gzha' tshon phug gi dbu rtse la/ / bee ro mi g.yo bsgoms pa'i gnas/ / bee ro nyid gyi sku rjes dang / / dbu rjes la sogs gsal ba yod/ /gzha' tshon phug pa'i rtse mo la/ / brag ri glegs bam 'dra ba'i steng / / bee ro tsa na'i zhabs rjes gcigaslob dpon chen po bai ro tsa na yi/ /zhi ba'i tshul gyi dgos pa bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ma tshogs sprin bzhin gtibs nas su/ /byin rlabs gzha' tshon 'khrigs kyis gang ba'i phyir/ /mtshan yang gzha' tshon phug ces bya ba'o/ /mi 'gyur bka' rtags mkha' 'gro'i zhabs rjes yod/ /dug lnga rang sar zhi ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / g.yu sgra snying po dgos par bzhugs pa'i gnas/ / sgrub phug 'khor ma dam zhes bya ba la/ / mi 'gyur bka' rtags g.yu sgra'i zhabs rjes yod/ / sku gsum zang thal phug gi g.yon phyogs su/ /slob dpon chen po bee ro tsa na yis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /pha rol sde brgyad g.yul ngo bablogs pa'i thog / klog pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes shul yod/ / 'jigs pa kun las skyob pa'i smon lam 'grub/ /dbang phyug ri bo'i lho phyogs su/ /lho lung mu la 'od ka ste/ /chu bo chu phran 'dus pa'i gong / /slob dpon bee ro tsa na yis/ /zla bdun sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas/ /ma rungs dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs/ / dbang du bsdud pa'i dbang bsdud phug/ sgrub phug sku gsum brda mtshon la/ / mngon par dga' ba'i gnas mchog yin/ / mchog thun dngos thub 'byung gnas so/ / gzha' tshon phug pa'i rtsa ba la/ /slob dpon bee ro tsa na dang / /grogs mchog g.yu sgra snying po yis/ /gus pas — 170 —

zhu ba'i tshul gyi ni/ / rdzu 'phrul brag tu dbu rjes yod/ / bar chod zhi ba'i sgron lam 'aspub/brgyad pa/ bai ro tsa na'i gso ba rig pa sman gyi skor/gso ba rig pa'i smran gzhung de sman dpyad kyi thabs ston pa'i rig gzhung ste/ rgya gar gyi yan lag brgyad pa dang / rgya nag gi zla ba'i rgyal po/ bod kyi dpal ldan rgyud bzhi lta bu'o/ / sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po de dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su rgya nag gi hā shang ma hā ya na dang / lo chen bee ro tsa na gnyis kyis bsgyur pa'i rgya nag gi sman gzhung zhig ste/ lo chen bee ro tsa na'i sman de dang yan lag brgyad pa'i sman gzhung dang / dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i nang gi man ngag gis spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar gyi nad thams cad lag len dmar khrid kyi sgo nas btsun mo dmar rgyan ma tsi tsi dzā zhes pa mjo nad las thar bar bcug go / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis lo chen bee ro tsa na la 'di skad gsungs so/ /nad kyis zin pa sman gyis gso ba la/ /sangs rgyas sman bla 'tsho byed gzhon nu yin/ /rgya gar padma can gyi yul khams nas/ / bdud rtsi snying po'i rgyud dang man ngag rgyud/ / bka' ni yan lag brgyad pa'i rgyud bstan rgyud/ /drang srong rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sman rgyud 'bum/ /klu sgrub mdzad pa'i so ma rā dza dang / /bdud rtsi thigs pa bdud rtsi bum pa dang / /pha gol ma gol yan lag brgyad pa dang / /o rgyan padmas mdzad pa'i be bum skor /gsal byed me long snying po 'dus pa dang / / o rgyan lugs dang mkha' 'gro'i lugs/ / mi lus 'di la rgyu rkyen nyon mongs pas/ / bskyed pa'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yod/ /gnyen po gso dpyad stong dang rtsa gnyis yo da/ / gso thabs yan lag sum brgya drug cu yod/ /dang po nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la/ / rlung gi nad rigs rnams la brgya dang drug / mkhris pa'i nad rigs rnams la brgya dang drug / bad kan nad rigs rnarma sa la brgya dang drug ldan dang 'dus pa gnyis la brgya dang drug gzhi la lus dang grib ma bzhin du yod/ / gnyis pa gso sman stong dang rtsa gnyis la/ / sa steng sman du ma gyur med pa'o/ / 'di dag sman sbyor rnams kyi ming du bshad/ / gsum pa yan lag sum brgya drug cu la/ / rlung la gso thabs brgya dang nyi shu tham/ / mkhris pa gso thabs brgya dang nyi shu yod/ / bad kan gso thabs brgya dang nyi shu yod/ / ba'i ba 'al gdams drug cu rtsa gnyis la/ / skye ba'i sgo gsum 'jug pa'i sgo drug dang / / rten pa'i gnas gsum rgyu lam bco lnga dang / /yul dang dus dang sa sne rnam pa dgu / ldog rgyu bcu gnyis gnyan pa rnam pa gsum/ / srog gcod nad dgu bsdus pas mdo don gnyis/ / lnga ba lag len bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad la/ / brtag thabs rnam pa brgyad dang smin rgyu lnga/ / gso thabs bcu bdun phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis/ / gtar mi rung bzhi bsgeg tu mi rung gcig /bzang khra0 dbyung gnyis ngan khrag ba'ag nad gnyis/ /grang ba gtar gnyis tsha ba bsreg nad gnyis/ / mi 'dra'i bcos thabs gsum gyis nyams su blangs/ /sman gyi mdo don nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/ /ro drug rjes gsum dang ni nus pa brgyad/ /sbyor sde lnga dang yan lag drug tu bstan/ /u rgyan padma'i bka' lung las/ / lo chen bee ro tsa na khyod/ / skye ba bzhi nas lnga brgyar khrims ge 171 —

bsrungs pas/ /khrims nyams no le snurṇa sna tsang ni/ /rgya gar bram ze smad 'tshong ma yi bu/ /rgya gar yul nas tshe 'phos bod du skyes/ / sa brgyad non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ / rdo rje sems dpa' sku sgrul nas/ / rgyal mo pu ri'i tshal nyid du/ / mdo bzhi dum lnga bka' bstsal nas/ / kun du 'dus pa'i rig pa'i mdo/ /sems lung dang ni chen po'i mdo/ /ye shes rngams pa glog gi 'khor lo'i mdo/ /dur khrod khu byug rol ba'i mdo/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo/ /de la yo ga'i theg pa ni/ /kun tu bzang po'i che ba rang nas rgyud/ / byang sems kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud/ / nam mkha' yongs su rgyas pa'i rgyud/ / sa mā ya nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud/ /nya mo bag nyal che chung la sogs pa/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs kyi/ / chos sde thams cad bka' bstsal to/ / gtsang ni the len dra bu nyid/ / rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po khyod/ / lho brag gtsang sngon legs grub tshe 'phos te/ / tshe lo brgya dang lnga ni thub par 'gyur/ / sa drug non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'di na mchis pa'i lha dpal ye shes khyod/ /rgya gar bram ze smad 'tshong tshe 'phos te/ / lo ni brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thub par 'gyur/ / sa lnga non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /tsha rong rgyal po mdo bzher 'di/ /za hor yul nas btsun 'phol nas/ /snyi ta nag po tog rtse ba/ /ma 'ongs ngas sbas gter la mos/ /bla ma mchog rab ces pa 'byung / /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /zhes gsungs so/ / de nas gong du bshad zin pa ltar bee ro tsa na tsha ba rong du smyug ma thag nas/ khri srong lde btsan gyi thugs la/ rin po che'i mchod sdong lta bu gsang sngags kyi sdong po bee ro tsa na ni/ blon po gdug pa can dang / rgya gar gyi phra ma mkhan gyi ring la tsha ba'i rong la sgyug nas med/ da rje bee ro tsā na'i chos 'di rnams ma nor ba'i dbang po dang / rin po che rje bee ro tsa na che ba 'don pa dang bod du bstan pa dar bar bya ba'i phyir du/ rgya gar nas spyir rgyu 'bras thams cad dang khyad par du man ngag gi chos la mkhas pa'i paṇa ṭi ta gcig spyan drangs nas bla'i mchod gnas bya bar dgongs nas/ der blon 'bangs kun bsags pas/ 'o cag rnams kyi bod mun pa'i rmag rum lta bu la rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang / khyad par man ngag gi chos la rtsol bar med par tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas par byed pa'i sgron me lta bu ni tsha ba rong du sgyugs te/ da bod yul 'dir 'o cag rnams rgyu 'bras dang/ man ngag gi chos la mkhas pa'i paṇa ṭi ta gcig spyan 'dren dgos pas su 'gro zhes gros so/ / der rje blon kun gros mthun par 'khor klu'i dbang po btang bar gros 'cham nas/ gser phye bre do dang pa tra 'ga' zung du bskur te/ g.yog gnyis dang gsum btang nas/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po la gser phye bre do dang pa tra bdun skyes su phul nas/ skyes lan la rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang man ngag gi chos la mkhas pa'i paṇa ṭi ta gcig rdzongs par zhu/ zhus pas rgyal pos paṇa ṭi ta rnams la gser phye phul nas/ de rnams kyi nang nas mkhas pa bi ma la mi ṭa bod du brdzangs nas/ der bee ro tsa na sprugs nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la blon po klu gong /rgyal po khri srong lde btsan yang bi ma la ma byon par zla ba gsum nas 'das so/ de la sras gsum yod pa las/de rnams kyi ring la bi ma la bod du byon nas/ dpal gyi bsam yas na chos gsungs shing bzhugs skabs — 172 —

su/ de bee ro tsa nas gsan nas/ g.yu sgra snying po la bdag dang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gnyis kyis/sbyir bod du bstan pa dar bar bya ba dang / khyad par du man ngag gi chos dar bar bya ba'i phyir khyi sems bskyed nas/ bdag gi dka' ba sna tshogs rgyad de/ skad rigs mi mthun pa mtha'i yul lha srin byol song lta bu brda mi 'phrod pa'i las rnams gshags/ rgya gar mkhas pa rnams kyi man ngag gi chos rnams gting gyin pa rnyed/ ngo so ston nas 'ong ste rgyal po nyidathugs tshim par byas/ rang gi las kyis 'phen pa'i stobs dang / rgya gar gyi phra ma mkhan dang / bod kyi blon po gdug pa can rnams kyis 'dir sprugs kyang /bdag dang rgyal po gnyis ka la/ bod du man ngag gi chos dar bar bya ba dgongs pa yod pas khyed tshags la ma lta bar bod du 'gro dgos la/ bod na da lta mkhas pa chen po bi ma la mi ṭa bya ba byon yod gda' bas/de dang dgongs pa bsdur la nga'i chos kyi che ba thon la/ bod du man ngag gi chos dar bar gyis/ thugs rje'i mdzad pas btsun mo dang sras dang / blon po gdugs pa can rnams la/ 'gyod pa drag skyed la bshags pa byed du chug rigs chad mos pa med pa'i gang zag rnams la dkar po'i sa bon thob/ smon lam gyi 'brel ba zhog mos pa med cing sgren pa kha spyad mkhan rnams la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang g.yangs sa ston/ dad pa dang ldan 'ing blo gros zhan pa rnams la drod pa skyed pa rim gyis khrid/ tshe 'di gtsor 'dzin cing dam pa'i chos la 'dun ma che ba rnams la/ gzhung 'brel ṭi ka dang bcas pa rgya cher shod/ tha snyad tshig la dga' ba'i gang zag la sgra tshad dang gasnyad slobs/ sgom nus pa'i gang zag byung na ngo sprod kyi skor kha re tshang bar byin la/ don gyi dmar khrid kyis/ skal ldan theg chen gnyis la yongs su rdzogs par byin la gtad rgya thob/ tshig tha snyad la nges par 'dzin pa rnams la/ thabs sgo dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas khad kyis drongs/ lar nga'i bod long ba dang 'dra ste/ shes rab kyi mig bu med pa rnams la/ thugs brtse bar dgongs par mdzod la yal bar ma 'jog par zhu/ zhes gsungs/ g.yu sgra snying po ni rgyal mo rong gi tshong ba dbus la 'gro mkhan rnams dang 'grog nas bod du byon no/ /dgu ba/ bee ro tsa na rgya nag dang bod du slar byon tshul/de nas bee ro tsa na tsha ba rong nas rgya nag tu byon par dgongs te/ e ma bdag 'dra 'khyams po bee ro tsa na yis/ /sngon gyi las dbang drag pos tsha ba rong du 'ongs/ /tsha ba'i spyal khams chos kyis bkang nas ni / / rgya nag mkhas pa rnams dang dgongs pa bsdur du 'gro/ / zhes gsungs nas spya nag tu phebs te/rgya nag gi ku su lu bhi tika rbas dang mjal te nges don skor lnga gsungs te/ ye shes spyi blugs su 'char ba nyi ma lta bu/ chos nyid thugs phrad du 'char ba rgyal po lta bu/ rnam rtog ye shes su 'char ba nags la me mched pa lta bu/ tshad ma rang shar rang grol mam mkha'i klong lta bu/ ting nge 'dzin 'byung 'jug med pa gser gling du phyin pa lta bu/ zhes don skor lnga bstan pa/ dang po nyi ma ni/ dus thams cad du gsal grib med par gnas pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems la shar tshad/ dran tshad/ snang tshad/ bzang ngan dang / blang dor gyi mtshan ma med de/— 173 —

rig pa rang shar chen po ye shes spyi blugs su shar ba'o/ / gnyis pa rgyal po mthong bas gnyen po'i semamithugs zad du skye ba ltar/ rnal 'byor pa la yang / dbang po lnga la shar tshad/ dran tshad/ snang tshad/sems nyid du rang snang rang shar yin pas/ chos nyid thugs phrad du shar ba rang snang ngo / gsum pa nags la me shor na skam pa dang / rlon pa dang / chedku/ chung ba/ sems can dang / sa rdo la sogs pa thams cad me'i grogs su 'bar ba bzhin/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems nyid du shes pas/ lus kyis byas tshad/ byung tshad/ ngag gis byas tshad/ byung tshad/ sems kyis bsam tshad/yin pa dang min pa dang / snang ba/ stong ba/ byas tshad/ shar tshad/ dran tshad/ skyes tshad kun chos nyid du rang shar ba'o/ / de las gzhan med do/ bzhi ba nam mkha'i klong las sprin dang / na bun dang / 'brug dang / glog dang / 'od dang / 'dzo' tshon dang / thog dang / ser ba/ char ba dang / rlung dang / nyin mo dang / mtshan mo dang / dkar nag thams cad rang shar rang byung rang snang rang grol nam mkha' nyid las rdul tsam yang med/ de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems nyid kyang /sangs rgyas sems can/ 'khor ba myang 'das/ rigs drug kun byang chub kyi sems las skye ba med/'khor 'das/ bde sdug nyon mongs kun byang chub kyi sems yin/ ye nas grol lo/ /lnga ba gser gling du phyin na che chung dang / nar mo skum po/ phra ba sbom pa/ gru bzhi la sogs bsko rlob byas kyang gser ma byas kyang gser/ thams cad gser du yod pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye nas sems rang byung gi ye shes/ bcos slad kyi rgyu rkyen dang bral nas 'dug sems las gzhan pa'i chos med pas/ting nge 'dzin nyams su blang bya dang len byed gnyis ka med de/ ting 'dzin la 'byung 'jug med pa'o/ /dgongs pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ba la ye shes spyi blugs su shar bas/ gol sgrib med par thag chod/ chos sku thugs phrad du shar bas/ spang len med pa thag chod/ rnam rtog ye shes su shar bas/skyon yon la spang blang med pa thag chod/ mtshan ma rang grol du shar bas/ blos bsgom mi dgos par thag chod/ ting 'dzin la 'byung 'jug med pas/ 'bad rtsol mi dgos par thag chod de/ / zhes gsungs so/ / ku su lo sgo ti sarba dang mjal yang dgongs pa de las dpag du med pa yin no/ / yang rgya nag gi mkhas pa ku su lu dharma bho lhas/ dge slong bee ro tsa na la rtsol sgrub las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje'i tshig drug pa gsungs te/ lta ba la zlos na mun pa'i smag las 'dres/ bsgom pa la zlos na rang srog chod/spyod pa la zlos na gtad med 'chal ba bu chung 'dra/ skye shi la zlos na sems can gyi srog chod/ 'bras bu la zlos na ri dog bi thag pa chod/ rgyu rkyen phyags mas btabs pas ye shes kyi la zlos so/ / zhes bee ro tsa na la gdams so/ /dharma sgo lha nyid dang mjal yang dgongs pa de las dpag du med do/ yang bee ro tsa na spya nag gi mkhas pa ku su lu badzra su ka dhe bas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i gdams pa 'di gsungs nas/shar ba sprul sku/ zad pa chos sku/ sanyis med longs sku/ sgo lnga'i yul du sems kyi dran rtog gang byung yang sbrul pa'i sku nyid shar ba yin/ gang shar ci snang yang rang bzhin med do/ / chos skur zad pa dang /— 174 —

shar ba dbyer med de/ longs skur ye nas gnas pa yin/ rang shar rang snang rang zad gsum/ dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa yin/ skye med 'dus ma byas su 'dug pas sgom pa'i blo dang bral/ ci shar sku gsum cog bzhag tu 'dug pas spyod pa'i blo dang bral/ sku gsum lhun grub ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu'i blo dang bral lo zhes gdams so/ / badzra su ka dhe wa nyid dang mjal yang dgongs pa de las dpag tu med pa'o/ / yang bee ro tsa nas rgya nag gi ku su lu paṇa ṭi ta bar ma la zhus pas/ rig pa gcer 'dzin gyi gdams pa gsungs pa/ rang gi sems la ltos dang / rgya rkyen kha dog dngos po gda' sugs sam skye shi dang 'jig bral ma mthong ngo / / nam mkha' lta bu'i don la gzigs dang / phyi'i yul la phar ltas pas/snang tshad rang gi sems su 'dug nang du lta sa pas nga dang bdag ma rnyed/ nyams su bya mi gda'o/ /cir snang rang shar de la dgag bsgrub med/ thob bya thob byed med pa'i 'bras bu'o/ gza' gtad phyogs ris med pas lta ba'i la chod pa yin/ zhe 'dzin dmigs gtad med pas sgos pa'i la chod pa yin/cir snang rang shar chos skur shes nas/ spyod pa'i la chod pa yin/ 'khor 'das rgyu 'bras re dogs dang bral na 'bras bu'i la chod pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ / paṇa ṭi ta bar ma nyid dang mjal yang dgongs pa de las dpag tu med pa yin no/ / yang bee ro tsa nas rgya nag gi mkhas pa tsan dha ri khrod pa la gdams pa zhus pas/ lan du/ rtogs pa khong du chud par bya/ snang ba dbang du 'dus par bya/ rang dbang thob/ rang sa zin 'khor ba'i rgyun de dran pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs/ tsan dha ri khrod pa dang mjal yang dgongs pa de las dpag tu med do/ / yang bee ro tsa nas mkhas pa ku su lu ma hā sgo lhas/ 'gyu ba dang sangs kyi gdams pa gsungs pa/ 'argyu ba de dag 'gyus pa dang / ltas pas dngas pa shar ba dang /sangs pa grol ba dus mnyam mo/ / dus ji ltar snyam na/ 'gyu ba ni thol gyis byung ba'i tshe/ 'gyus pa ni rig pa rang shar yul la khyug gis shar ba'i dus/ ltas pas skye med zang thal le/ bzhag pas 'dzin pa rang sar gros/ shar dang snang ba sangs pa gsum/ grol bas ma skyes zang thal le/ de ltar thams cad ngo bo nyid du grol te/ chos sku blo yul du byar med blo 'das chen por sangs rgyas zhes gsungs so/ /ma hā sto dhe nyid dang mjal yang dgongs pa de las med do/ /yang bee ro tsa nas mkhas pa ku su lu thi a ni la zhus pas/ rlung gsum rang sar dngas pa'i gdams pa gsungs pa/ spyi 'tshub byed kyi rlung snang ba 'gyu ba/'dzin mkhan rang sar dngas pa/ nang 'tshub byed kyi rlung gsal 'gyu ba/ 'dzin mkhan rang sar dngas pa'o/ / gsang ba 'tshub byed kyi rlung stong ba 'gyu ba/ 'dzin mkhan rang sar dngas pa'o/ de ltar ma shes na nang nas phyi ru rlung 'tshub pas 'gyus pa/ 'dzin pa/ chags pa/ rlung rang dngos su ma shes na khams gsum du 'khor ro zhes gsungs so/ / mkhas pa shrī a ni nyid dang mjal yang / dgongs pa de las dpag tu med do/ yang bee rdo tsa nas mkhas pa ku su lu ha shang bhi ti la gdams pa zhus pas/thag chod rdo rje'i tshig drug gsungs pa/ snang srid thams cad nam mkha'i ngang du 'dug pas/ dngos po la rang ba'in med par thag chod/ 'khor 'das kyi snying po sems su 'dug pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan — 175 —

nas med par thag chod/ bde ba sgyu mar snang bas/ sdug bsngal la rang bzhin med par thag chod/stong pa'i 'od la bsam du med pas/ ye shes rang byung du 'bar ba thag chod/ ye shes skye 'gags med pas/ 'chi 'pho la 'jigs pa med par thag chod/ 'khor ba'i snying po sems su 'dug cing rgyu rkyen zad pas/ skye ba mi len par thag chod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bee ro tsa nas rgya nag gi mkhas pa ku sulu dharma bho rnyi la gdams pa zhus nas/ dge slong rang nam mkha' la ltos dang / thin glog 'brug char rang byung dang dngas su 'dug pas/ de ring gi sbrin 'di kha sang gi sprin min/ nang par de ring gi sprin 'di mi 'ongs/ dge slong rang gi sems la ltos dang / dran rtog rang gi sems rang byung rang dngas su 'dug pa/ kha sang gi dran rtog de de ring zhe min/ de ring zhe dran rtog nang par mi sdod/ nang par gyi dran rtog ni de ring mi sdod/ dran rtog rang byung rang dngas su 'dug pa/ blo re dogs su ma 'dzin/nyon mongs dang ye shes rang byung rang dngas yin/ nam mkha' stong pa la ri mo bri ba'i sa med/ rig pa stong pa la sdig pa bsogs pa'i gnas med/ chu bran chu bo ji snyed kun/ rgya mcho ro gcig bye brag med ces gsungs so/ /yang bee ro tsa nas mkhas pa ku su lu surya sgo lha la gdams pa zhus pas/ rig pa thugs phrad/ rig pa cog bzhag rig pa rang rdol/ rig pa tshig chod/ man ngag bzhi dang ldan par bya/thugs phrad rgyal po lta bur dran rtog ye shes su ngos bzung / cog ba'ag me long lta bu'i rnam rtog ye shes sungos bzung / rang rdol ko mo'i chu lta bu 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug mnyam par rtogs/ rang grol gyi dgongs pa rnyed pa yin/ tshig chod la ngar sdubs pa lta bus thams cad ngo bo nyid du rtogs so zhes gsungs so/ /yang bee ro la mkhas pa ku su lu sha ta sa tis/ dngos po yin lugs kyi de kho na nyid gsungs pa/ thams cad sangs rgyas nyag gcig bsam du med pa'i 'od gsal/ 'gyu ba chad pa'i brdal ba/phyi nang med pa'i zang thal/ thams cad rang byung ye shes/ gcig rtogs zang thal chen po/ zhes gsungs so/ /yang bai ro la malas pa ku su lu go ni dur khrod pa'i gdams pa/ snying po byang chub kyi sems ji bzhin par rtogs par bya/ rtogs pas chog gam snyam na/ rtogs snyam pa de yid kyi rtogs pa yin/yid ches kyi gding rnyed na re dogs kyi thag pa chod dgos/ de tsa na gnyis med brjod 'das bsam med/bgrod du med pa ngos bzung dang bral ba chos nyid blo yul du ma gyur pa'o/ / yang bee ro la mkhas pa ku su lu pa ti pas/ de kho na nyid kyi rtsad gcod gsungs pa/ dang po sems kyi byung sa tshol/ bar du sems kyi gnas sa chol/ tha mar sems kyi 'gro sa tshol/ dang po sems kyi byung sa med pas rgyu rkyen med pa gcig yin/ bar du sems la gnas sa med pas lam med pa gcig yin/ tha ma sems kyi 'gro sa med pas 'bras bu grub med gcig yin/ de ltar rtogs pa lta ba/ de la gnas pa bsgom pa/ de la yid ches pa spyod pa/ de thob bya thob byed med pas 'bras bu'o/ / des na ye dag chen po/ ye grol chen po/ khyab gdal chen po/ skye med chen po/ yan pa chen po/ gzhi nas sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /zhes gdams so/ /yang bee ro la mkhas pa ku su lu yo gi bar mas 'di skad gsungs so/ /lta ba yin pa med sar thag chod/— 176 —

de la bsgom du ci yang med par thag chod/ spyod pa spong len med par thag chod/ 'bras bu la thob bya thob rgyu med par thag chod/ rnal 'byor rab kyi dgongs pa yin no/ / yang yo gi bar pas blo gsar bu la gdams pa/ skyes bu blta byed la brten nas blta mkhan ngos zungs/ brjod 'das yin gyis bsgom bya bsgom byed la brten nas/ bsgom byed mkhan ngos zungs/ bsgom snang la brten nas/ bsgom mkhan maspathong gis dngos po'i 'dug tshul la ltos dang blo yul las 'das so/ / spyad bya la brten nas spyod mkhan ngos zungs dang bral lo/ / zhes gsungs so/ / yang bee ros mkhas pa ku su lu yo gi grong khyer ba la gdams pa zhus pas 'jug sgo gsum gyi man ngag ga sungs te/ snang lugs/ shar lugs/ yin lugs/snang ba rang shar du shes pas gyi'i 'jug sgo gtan la phab/ shar ba rang sher du shes pas nang gi 'jug sgo gtan la phab/ yin lugs ma skyes skyes med du shes pas gsang ba'i 'jug sgo gtan la phab/ lus rang gis btsal du med pas/ lus sems gnyis 'brel mkhan med/ 'gro sa sangs spyas las med pa yin/snang ba rang snang du shes pas/ rkyen rang las byung ba'i ma rig pa sangs/ shar ba rang shar du shar bas/rgyu rang las byung ba'i ma rig pas sangs/ rlung rang gi rtsal du non pas/ gnyis can las byung ba'i ma rig pas sangs/ lus sems gnyis kyi 'brel thag chad pas/ sgrib pa gsum las grol te/ 'gro sa sangs rgyas las med do/ / zhes gsungs/ yang bee ro la mkhas pa ku su lu lha sa na rtus skye 'gags gnyis med kyi gdams pa gsungs pa/ 'gags pa med pa'i rtag mgo dgu ba de'i pha rol du ltos thig skye med du thag chad nas gda'o/ / de gnyis kyi bar du ltos dang / de las brjod du gda' ye/ blo las 'das pa yin/ 'dzin med/ 'gags med/ khungs med/ brjod med/ blo 'das/ a ha la rtsig ces gsungs so/ / yang bee ros mkhas pa ku su lu yo gi ni la gdams pa zhus pas gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas par 'dod na rtsol ba zhog sems blta bar 'dod na rang gi bugs la ltos/ yi shes 'dod na dran pa rtag tu brten/ bde ba 'dod na dran pa dug lnga'i ngo bo rnyed dam ltos/ sangs rgyas par 'dod pas phung ba yin/ zhes mkha' 'gro mas gdams pa'o/ / yang bee ros mkhas pa ku su lu bradzña snyi rti la gdams pa zhus pas gsungs pa/ gnas lugs shes pa/ ma 'dres par shes pa/ yin par shes pa/ ma byung ba shes pa/ ma skyes par shes pa/ ma g.yos par shes pa/ mi dmigs par shes pa/ dngos po med par shes pa/ rang dag shes pa/ zhes dgu dang ldan na grol nas gda'o gsungs so/ /yang bee ros rgya nag gi ri khrod ma chu dun la nges pa'i don ji ltar lags zhes dris pa/ rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa/ mkha' ltar dag par rtogs pas na/ / dge sdig gnyis ka tha dad tsam/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba gdod nas med/ /skye med chos la rtsol ba med/ / rnam grol med de bcings ba med/ / byang chub snying po bya ba gdod nas med/ /gang zhig byis pas de ltar ma rig ste/ /don med par dgra phyir 'brings pa rnams ni dge ba'i chos kun rnam par spangs nas/ 'khor ba'i chos la chags shing 'dzin pa che/ / des na de rnams 'thoms te ngan 'gror 'gro zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar mkhas parnams dang grub rnams dang / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams — 177 ge

dang / rtogs ldan rnams kyi gdams pa 'di ni/ tshe zad sgrib pa zad pa rnams dang phrad par smon/ de nas bee ro nyid slar rgyal mo tsha ba rong du phebs te g.yu sgra snying po la gdams pa/ nyang chab rtsang chab 'dzom pa'i rtsar/ / sba'u gan cag bee ro tsa na ngas/ /skad rigs mi gcig sum brgya drug cu shes/ / yig rigs mi gcig sum brgya drug cu shes/ /rgya gar rgya nag o rgyan yul/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi thugs mdzod rtol/ /'di ni rgya nag yul khams nas/ /ha shang garba la sogs pa'i/ /ri brag shing drung dur khrod nas/ /rnal 'byor rnams las zla ba re/ / bai ro tsa na bdag gis zhus/ / skal ldan mos pa 'ga' tsam las/ /'di don rtogs pa shin tu dka'/ /rgyal ba'i yig 'bru dang po las/ /ka shing kha par gsungs pa'i sngon/ /rang gi blo nyid ma rtogs par/ / rtogs ldan rnams la sgro bkur btag sdig sgribs gol pas dmyal bar 'gro/ / bskal ba 'bum du mi thar te/ / na rag chen po nges par lhung / / de phyir rdzogs chen man ngag rnams/ /g.yu sgra snying po khyod la gtad/ /shin tu gsang te thugs la chongs/ /sa ma ya ni dam tshig rgya/ /dam tshig gis ni mnan la sba/ /skal ldan las can ma rnyed na/ /srog la bab kyang sba bar bya/ /kha nyams sad kyi brid de lta/ /thabs kyis dpe sku thob la re/ /mos pas mi zhu thabs gyis 'brud/ /bla ma mi 'khur phyag dang zhe sa med/ / gces pa'i nor mchog mi phod par/ / zhen chags ser snas bcings pa mi'i/ / lag tu thob nas gzhog ngom byed/ / zung du 'chang zhing kha tshig bshad/ / de 'dra'i lag tu shor srid na/ /bdag gzhan gnyis kar phung par 'gyur/ /chos skyong lha srin 'khrug par 'gyur/ /lo nyes sad ser la sogs pa/ /bskal pa phra mo glo bur 'ongs/ /nang rigs mi mthun dpe ngan 'ongs/ /des na a ti'i man ngan shin tu sba/ /'di rnams kun tu 'phel gyur na/ /dam nyams rnams kyis sgrubs pa yis/ / ma grub bstan pa 'jig par 'gyur/ / mu stegs la sogs sgrub pa rnams/ / snod ngan lag tu song nas ni/ / spyon pa'i lag tu mtshon bskur ba/ / 'dra ste bstan pa 'jig pa'i grogs/ / des na man ngag sba bar bya/ /g.yu sgra snying po nga yi bu/ /zhes rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi g.yu sgra snying po la/ rgya nag gi mkhas pa rnams las rje bee ros zhus pa'i gdams pa rnams gnang ba'o/ / g.yu sgras gnyag snyo na ma ra la/des sangs spyas ye shes/ des sog po dpal gyi ye shes sogs la gnang ba'o/ / der spyal bu g.yu sgra snying po nyid kyis ni sgra bsgyur sum cu rtsa drug shes pa/ mngon par shes pa du ma dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul sna chogs ston nus pa yin te/ g.yu sgra snying po dpal bsam yas su byon nas bi ma la mi ṭa dang pra ka ra na sde brgyad 'chad pa'i tshul/ gong gis bshad bzhin ltar g.yu sgras rje'i gsung la nyan nas/ dpal bsam yas su byon pa dang / slob dpon bi ma la mi ṭa khyim gyi nang na/ pra ka ra na sde brgyad 'chad pa'i dus la bab pa la/ g.yu sgras nang du thal gyis byon nas/ bi ma la mi ṭa la gdong btsu gsu cer gyis gzigs te/ka ka pa ri ka ka pa ri zhes gsungs nas/ yang mnga' bdag rgyal po la spyan cer gzigs nas/ a ka pa ri mi tha zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod pas/ bi ma la dbu dma' zhig mdzad nas dha thim dha thim gsungs pa dang /g.yu sgra phyir thon nas song ngo / / der rgyal pos bi ma la mi tra la/ mtha' mi de 'dra ba gcig byung nas/— 178 —

de 'dra'i sgra tshig brjod pa de ji skad zer ba lags/ slob dpon gyis ci skad bgyis pa lags zhus pas/rim pa'i zhal nas/ kho na re/ wa spe ngag gis sgra sgrags kyang / /sergo'i gdangs su cang 'gyur nam/ /bya rog dag gis 'gros skyod kyang / / stong gsum sa gzhi cang 'khor ram/ / nyan thos byis pa'i chos bshad pas/ / rtsol med 'bras bu cang thob bam/ / bya ba lags/ bdag gis de la/ chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du 'dra mor byas pa lags/ a ka pa ri mi ta ni/ bod kyi mnga' bdag rgyal po'i spyan lam la/ /skye med lhun chogs byang chub chen po'i sku/ /rgya gar mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa gsum gyis/ /man ngag bde chen btsal du med pa'i chos/ / tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa/ / man ngag snying po tsha ba rong du sprug /ma rig rmongs pa'i rje blon snying re rje/ /zhes bya ba yin te/ 'o cag rnams la khrel nas 'phya ba'i tshig yin gsungs so/ /yang skabs shig na/ gnyag snye na ku ru 'chags pa'i shul tu/ ka pa sla ru/ rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che/ kun bzang yangs pa chos kyi sku/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig bzhi bris nas 'dug go / der dzña nas ka pa li bltas pas/ tshigs ngo mtshar bar 'dug nas/ 'dir su byung byas pas/ 'dir kha sang tha mi de byung nas ka pa li slong ste/ zhes 'o cag rnams chang ma la chang sko zer zhing log nas song / ga'an su yang ma byung zer ro/ / sgra de ni bod skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che zhes bya ba byung ngo / / der gnya' nas zhal phyogs ba'ir gzigs te phyag 'tshal/ yi ge spyi bor blangs so/ / de nas gnya' nas g.yu sgra rtsad bcad pas/ chang ma gcig gi khyim na chang nyos nas gsol gyin 'dug de min ma mthong zer ro/ /der gnya' yis chang ma la chang rgyu gtong nas chang 'dir sleb pa nas mtha'i mi de byung ba dang / nga la skad kyis shig byas pa dang / de nas g.yu sgra byung bas skad btang ba dang / gnya' nas g.yu sgra la phyag 'tshal/ na bza' phud nas gdan bting / g.yu sgra gdan khar bzhugs pa la/ gnya' nas gser gyi phra yol chang gis bskang te drangs nas lo rgyus zhus pas/ rje bee ro tsa na'i lo rgyus rnams byung ngo / / der ṅge na shin tu mos nas/ man ngag gi chos zhu 'tshal/ zhes zhus pas/ g.yu sgras khyed la bi ma la 'dug pas chog mod gsungs/ der dzñā nas mkhas pa bee ro tsa na'i chos rnams la bdag zhin tu mos pas/ thugs la 'dogs par zhu 'tshal/ bi ma la yang zhus pas/ gnyis ka la stabs gcig tu zhu 'tshal/ zhes zhus pas/ de nas bshad par 'al gyis bzhes nas/ slob dpon gnyis po dpal gyi bsam yas su tshogs pas/ slob dpon gnyis pos phyag dang gral la ma 'cham ste/der ṅge na dang rgyal blon kun na re/ mkhas pa chen po bi ma la mi dra rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po yin pas/g.yu sgras phyag 'tshol cig zer ro/ /g.yu sgra'i zhal nas/ bdag ni rgyal rigs yin la/ dga' rab la sogs rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi/ man ngag gi chos lhas ma med par thugs la rdzogs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bee ro tsa na yin la/ de'i chos thams cad bdag la rdzogs pa yin pas/ sgra bsgyur du ma shes zhing yon tan du ma dang ldan pas phyag 'tshal mi rung zer nas nyan du ma 'dod de/ yang dzha na la sogs pa'i rje blon kun na re/ 'o na bhi ma las g.yu sgra la phyag 'tshol cig zer ba la/ bi ma la'i zhal nas/ nga rgya gar — 179 —

gyi rgyal rigs zhig dang rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa paṇa ṭi ta chen po zhig gis/ rgyal po'i phru gu cig la phyag 'tshal ba mi 'ong zer nas nyan du ma 'dod/ der dzha na dang rgyal blon rnams na re/ da chos gang mkhas nus pa gang che ba cig la phyag 'tshal lo zer nas/ de nas slob dpon gnyis sgra la gang mkhas byas pas/ g.yu sgra mkhas par byung / don gyi chos rnams la rtsod pa byas pas kyang g.yu sgra mkhas par byung/der bi ma la'i 'al nas/ rdzu 'phrul 'gran dgos zer nas rdzu 'phrul 'gran par byas pas/ g.yu sgra bye'u chung zhig sprul nas lcang ma'i rtsen gyis 'phur song / ji ma la bya khra zhig sprul nas nam 'phangs bcad de zhung ngas bye'u chung la brgyab pas/ bye'u gser gyi tho lum gcig byas te/ nam mkha' la beer gyis byung /bi ma la sdong po'i phag tu yib pas/ der mi kun na re/ chos dang rdzu 'phrul sogs g.yu sgrar 'dug pa/bungs bi ma la btsun zhing / bgres par 'dug pas phyag rtse sprod du gyis/ gral g.yas gral dang g.yon gral du gyis/ chos kyi go ba dang dgongs pa mnyams su bsdur bas/ nam mkha' la dkar po'i phyogs kyi chos skyong dang lha rnams kyis me tog 'thor ba dang / sa g.yo ba dang / nam mkha' la 'od zer gyi dra ba dra phyed byung / de la thams cad mos te/ slar thams cad la ma bshad pa'i man ngag gi chos khyad par can yod par 'dug pas/ de zhu 'tshal lo zhes zhus so/ / de nas slob dpon gnyis kyi chos khri mnyam por g.yas g.yon du brtsigs/ de gnyis bar du dzha na'i khri chung zhig brtsigs nas/ slob dpon gnyis kyis dus gcig tu chos gsungs pas/ dzha nas rna ba'i sho brag gis nyan pas/ dus gcig la khrigs khrigs shes so/ / de yang g.yu sgras nam mkha' che la sogs pa/ sngar khri srong lde btsan la gsungs pa'i chos gsungs nas snga 'gyur zhes grags shing / bi ma las rtse mo byung rgyal la sogs bcu gsum gsungs pas phyi 'gyur zhes grags so/ / de gnyis khram bu sdebs pa bzhin byung nas thams cad yid ches/ de nas bee ro tsa na sgyugs pa la 'gyod pa skyes nas thams cad 'dus nas/ der rgyal blon thams cad dang / dge 'durnga sdesanyis dang / mkhas pa gnya' na la sogs pa'i/ thams cad mgrin gcig tu bstod pa byed cing yon tan brjod pa/ ston pa'i zhal sbyin bla med mchog gi sku/ /bee ro tsa na'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa 'igasungs gis bstan pa rgya mtsho sgrogs/ /bee ro tsa na'i gsungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen ye shes bde chen rgyal ba'i thugs/ /bee ro tsa na'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa byed cing yon tan bgrangs pas/ skye ba snga phyi shes shing sems can gyi don la brtson pas/ thugs rje byang chub sems dang ldan pa yang dag btsal gyis mi rnyed pa'i man ngag rnams lhag ma med par rnyed pas/ sprul pa'i sku yin pa yang dag lo bco lnga las ma lon par bod nas rgya gar du lam rgyus med par phyin pas/ lha'i spya na dngaldan pa yang dag bar gyi lam 'phrang la mi rgod dang gcan gzan gdug pa can la sogs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par 'khor bar mi ldog pa'i rtags yin pa yang dag rgya bod bar la zla ba bcu gsum la/ nyin 'ag gcig la sleb pa'i rdzu 'phul bstan pas rkang mgyogs dngos grub thob pa yin pa yang dgasbal sbrul dang shig dong du bskyur kyang zos shing nyams pa med pas/ bzod pa'i brtson 'grus thob pa yin — 180 —

payang dag man ngag gi chos thos pa tsam gyis mkhyen zhing rtogs pas/ chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba yin pa yang dag mtha' bzhi rgyud nas sgra bsgyur mkhas pas/ sgrib gnyis byang ba yin pa yang dgargya gar mkhas pa kun gyi man ngag gces dgu thob pas/ bde gshegs kyi dngos grub thob par yin pa yang dag sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rtags nas theg pa thams cad mkhyen pas/ ston pa'i zhal skyin yin par yang dag rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bzhi dang ldan pas/ byang chub sems dpa' yin pa yang dag ces yon tan brgyad dang sku gsungs thugs la bstod de/ tsha ba rong du kha bltas nas thams cad ngu ing phyag
