gyang 'gyel ba bzhin du byas so/ / der dzha na'i thugs la/ slob dpon gnyis ka las sems sde bco brgyad la sogs pa mang du gsan nas/ slob dpon gnyis kyi gdams ngag nga la yod pas/ nga bas lhag pa bod na med do snyam nas yod pa la/ slob dpon gnyis kas thugs kyi mkhyen te/ dzña na la bum pa re re gtad de/yar gtsang gi chu la 'di re re 'chus la shog cig gsungs nas/ dzha nas chu bum pa de gnyis blangs nas/slob dpon gnyis kyi phyag tu phul bas/ slob dpon gnyis kyi dzha na'i phyag mthil du chu thig re blugs nas/bi ma la'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i chos ni yar gtsang gi chu lta bu yin la/ nged gnyis kyis bum pa gang po 'di tsam re shes pa yin/ khyed kyis lag mthil gyi thig pa de tsam rdo shes pa yin gsungs pas/ dzha na'i rtog pa la/ slob dpon gnyis kyis mngon par mkhyen 'dug snyam ste nga rgyal chag go /de nas snyo nas gsang sngags nang gi chos dang / khyad par a ti'i chos mang du gsan no/ / deyang bi ma la las gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mang po dang / bye brag du ro sregs dang / dbang dang rab gnas dang /sgyu 'phrul gyi rgyud dang man ngag bcas mang du gsan cing zhus so/ / g.yu sgra la dzha nas snga 'gyur lnga dang /phyi 'gyur bcu gsum kyang gsan te/ sems sde bco brgyad rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa/ kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud snga ma dang phyi ma'i phyi ma dang / mdo rtsa dang mdo lung / mdo 'brel dang bcas pa rnams dang /klong sde'i skor la klong sde bzhi rgyud dang man ngag dang bcas pa la sogs pa mang du gsan cing bzhugs so/ /de la snyo na'i rna ba'i sho brag gis chos nyan nus cing sgra bsgyur la mkhas/ bka' babs gdod rnams kyis yang chos phal cher la mnga' brnyes shing rgyu 'bras kyi chos la mkhas/ mchog tu bstan pa'i snying po rtsolamed a ti'i don la mos shing / blo che bar 'dug pas man ngag bstan pa'i snod du rung snyam nas/ g.yu sgras dzha nar gsungs pa/ skal ldan yang rab ye shes mtshan/ / sgra tshig don spyi tsam min par/ / rang grol mngon sum brda sprad pas/ / gus par nges pa'i gdam ngag yod/ / ces gsungs so/ / snyo na rang gi rig pa dang / sgra dang mkhyen pa'i chos kyi grags pa dang gsum gyis sgribs te/ chos paragadams ngag nga rang gis shes pa 'di rnams las lhag pa med/ da tung gdams ngag yod pa skad zer ba mtha'e mi nor 'dod par 'dug snyam nam/ dzña nas smras pa/ chos rnams kun gyi brjod pa'i ga'i/ / rang sems sangs rgyas dngos gzhi can/ / brgyud pas bsnan du ci zhig yod/ sngar gsungs ngon las lhag par 'gal/ / zhes zhus pas/ g.yu sgras man ngag gi snod med par mkhyen nas gsungs pa/ tshig min ge 181 ——

thugs nas brgyud pa'i don/ /rang grol mngon sum bar ma chad/ gser la nag tshur dug gi rtsi/ /snad dang ldan pa 'ga' tsam la/ /zhes gsungs nas/ nam mkha' la mi snang bar gshegs so/ / der snyorna'agyod de/ mchi ma phyung nas phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab pas/ g.yu sgra byon nas khyod de tsam ngus nasalibyed gsungs par/ dzña nas smras pa/ bdag la rang grol mngon sum 'char ba'i gdams pa zhu 'tshal gsol pas/g.yu sgra'i 'al nas/nga rgyal dregs pa'i ri bo yis/ /dngos thub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bkag /bla mas legs gsungs 'gal mthong bas/ / rang grol man ngag drod tshad 'chugs/ / 'dun pa drag pos mos gus kyis/ / nam zhig mjal bas gsol ba thob/ / gsungs nas mar rje'i drung du gshegs pa las/lam du spam sangs rgyas mgon po dang mjal nas/ der gtad pa gsum pa'i lugs rgyud dang / man ngag dang bcas pa lung tshang ba gcig byin nas smin par byas so/ / de nas g.yu sgra mar bhon/ spam gyis g.yu sgra la/ rje bee ro tsa na'i che ba dang yon tan mang du thos pas shin tu dad do/ / bee ro'i drung tsha ba nong du byon rgyu'i zhu ba phul/ gsol ba btab nas/ phyis man ngag ge zer spros/ rgyud gdams ngag rnams gter du sbas te/ tsha ba rong du rje bee ro tsa na'i zhabs drung du byon no/ / de nas g.yu sgra dang rgya blo grogagazhon nu dang 'phrad de/ las can du gzigs nas rgyud sde nyi shu rtsa lnga dbang gdams ngag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par btad do/ / de nas g.yu sgra yang mar byon/ rgya blo gros gzhon nu skal ba dang ldan pa la man ngag gi skor 'ga' sbyin nas smin par byas/ rgyud man ngag dang bcas gter du sbas/ la la bsnams te rtsa mi'i yul du dgongs pa la bzhugs/ dgongs pa zag pa med pa mngon du gyur te/ mdo smad du skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga' la spel lo/ / de nas yang g.yu sgra mar byon nas/ mdo khams smad du sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang 'phrad de/ sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyang 'ga' tsam shes pa/khyad par phur ba'i chos la sgrub pa bag tsam byas pa gcig gis/ phyugs kyi zhal lta dang / 'bru slog byed kyin 'dug pa la/ g.yu sgra'i jo jo sngags pa khyod la 'phrul kyis ma lto ba'i nyams su len pa'i chos mang ngam/zhes gsungs pas/ sbas kyi 'al nas/ las kyi mi lto ba'i nyams len nga la med/ de 'dra ba su la bdogaci 'dra ba lags/ zhus pas/ g.yu sgra'i zhal nas/ snyan brgyud gdams ngag bdud rtsi yis/ / rang snang rig pa ngo shes nas/ /dran pa rang snangalta sgom yin/ /rang sar bzhag pas snying po 'char/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sbas kyis ngo mtshar can gyis gdams ngag tu 'dug snyam nas/ phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs nas gdams ngag zhu byas pas/ g.yu sgras las can du gzigs te/ khyod 'jig rten 'di'i grags pa dang 'dun pa thams cad bor nus sam/ 'byor pa thams cad chos phyogs su gtong nus sam/zab mo'i gdams ngag gi rtogs pa'i don nyams su len nus sam/ zhes gsungs pas/ sbas kyis/bla ma'i ci ltar gsungs pa ltar nus pas/ cis kyang man ngag zhu snyam nas/ thugs la 'dogs par zhu 'tshal zhus pas / g.yu sgras gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes te/ spyir a ti'i rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa mang du gnang / khyad par du rgyal thabs spyi blugs rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /der sbas kyis nor rdzas — 182 —

yong sa su rdzogs par bla ma la phul te/ gser sbyang gi rdo rje rtse dgu ba gcig gis mgo byas pa'i nor rdzas stongagasum dang lnga brgya phul lo/ / de nas dbang dang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ste/bskul pa'i rkyen gyi man ngag ni/ / rang sang rig pa'i ye shes la/ / sgom dang mi sgom ci 'dra sems/ /thams cad btang bas 'dzin pa med/ dran pa rkyen gyis ma shor tsam/ zhes gtad do/ /de la sbas rdo rje rgyalamatshan gyis/ /rtogs pa dbang gi dus su shar te/ /phyi nang gi chos kun rang rig pa'i mngon sum du mthong ste/ rang grol mngon sum du shar nas/ /rje la rtogs pa phul ba las/ / bskal bar bsags pa'i sgrib pa ni/ /byis pas khang bu brtsigs par zad/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rang sems rtogs/ /mun khung sgron me rang gsal mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas phyis spam sangs rgyas mgon po dang / rgya blo gros gzhon nu gnyis dang yang mjal nas/ de gnyis kyis kyang man ngag gi bdag por gtad do/ / der sbas kyis g.yu sgra'i thugs kyi bcud man ngag dang bcas pa rnams lon nas/ rtogs pa mngon du shar ba'i ngang nas/dan tig dgon par lo gsum bskyangs pas/ dgongs pa zag pa med pa bde ba chen po'i ngang las 'du 'bral med par mngon du gyur te/ des mdo khams kun tu dar zhing spyas par gyur to/ / de nas g.yu sgra rgyal mo tsha ba rong du/ rje bee ro tsa na'i drung du byon nas/ sngon gyi lo rgyus yang dag bcu gcig gis/ rje bee ro la bstod pa la sogs pa zhib par snyan du gsol bas/ rje bee ro tsa na shin tu dgyes nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ / bdag ni dge slong bee ro tsa na ste/ /yang dag bcu gcig don dang ldan pas na/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa bag tsam ma 'byongs shing / /skal ldan 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs phyir/ /tsha ba'i rong du bee no bdag sgyugs pas/ /skal ldan mchog tu gyur pa khyod smin byas/ /tsha ba rong gi rgyal khams dkar por bsgyur/ / byang chub sems kyi myu gu ljon thing la/ / bla med byang chub 'bras bu me tog smin/ da ni log nas bod yul dbus su 'gro/ /zhes gsungs nas/ bod du byon pa thugs la dgongs so/ /dus de tsam na bod yu la gyi rje 'bangs la sogs pas/ rje bee ro tsa na tsha ba'i yul nas spyan drangs nas bshags pa bya ba dang / chos grwa chen po bzung bar gros 'cham/ rje bi ma la'i zhal nas kyang / rje bee ro tre na spyan drongs shig ces gsungs so/ / de yang rje khri srong lde btsan la sras gsum yod pa/ mu tig btsan po ni sne dmar gyi rin la zhang btsan po dbu rings bsad pas/ mnga' ris stod du sprugs nas med/ mu nee btsanapo ni gtsang na mnga' bdag mdzad pa las/ yum gyis dug drangs nas bkrongs/ khri lde gtsug btsan zhes bya ba/ bla dge sad na legs 'jing yon gyi sku ring la rje blon 'bangs rnams mthun pas/ mu ne btsan po'i shing dang chos 'khor bya bar gros 'cham nas/ rje mu pa de sha dang / thang bzang dpal gyi rdo rje dang /gang dpal gyi snying po gsum/ bee ro tsa na spyan 'dren du btang / tsha ba rong du byon nas bai ro tsa na dang mjal/ bod du 'byon pa'i zhu ba phul bas/ rje dgyes nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ de khyed kyis nga spyan 'dren ma zer bar bod du bros shig ma bros na khong rgyal mo rong gis rje 'bangs kyis tshor na khyed rnams gsod du 'ong / der bang chen pa gsum sngon la yar btang / rje bee ro tsa nas rkyal mo tsha ba rong gi rje — 183 —

blon rnams dang / chos kyi 'bangs su gtogs pa rnams bsags nas/ nga bod du 'gro bas khyed rnam rang rang gi chos gang dgos pa dang / the tshom ma chod pa rnams spyad par bya'o/ / dris shig gsungs nagachos rnams kyis 'gro kun rdzogs par byas so/ / de nas slob dpon bod du chas pa la/ rgyal mo spu sogs pa rnams kyis/ rin po che gser dngul g.yu dang dar zab bzang skyems la sogs pa phul/ spyag 'tshal mchi ma byung nas/ slob dpon chen po lags/ bod kyi rgyal po gdug pa che/ phyogs gang naspokyang ngan pas mi 'byon par zhu/ zhes gsol ba yang nas yang du btab pas/ bee ro tsa na'i zhal nas/bdag dang rgyal po khri srong sde btsan gyis/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /bod du brtsolīmed bstan pa dar ba'i phyir/ /rgya gar bar nas bod kyi yul b.radra/ /de shi do tshad dgag pa brtsol med byang chub btsal/ / 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs 'dir mchis kyang / / da ni bod 'dul dus la babs pas 'gro bar zhu/ / zhes gsungs nas/ phyogs la bzang ngan med par lan btab pa/ chos rnams thams cad byang chub sems yin te/ nam mkha'i dpe ltar phyogs ris kun dang bral/ / sems nyid mkha' ltar dag pa'i gting rtogs pas/ / sangs rgyas nga bor ma gyur gcig kyang med/ / phyogs ris bzang ngan 'dzin pa snying re rje/ / zhes gsungs so/ / yang bdag cag rnams thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes lan du/ /chos dbyings mtha' dbus med pa la/ /bee ro tsa na'i rig pa'i nyi shar te/ /tsha ba rdong gi ma rig mun pa bsal/ / rje 'bangs rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par byas/ / chos nyid mkha' la ye shes sprin bsdibs te/ / dri med bdud rtsi'i chos kyi char rgyun phab/ / tsha ba rong du byang chub myu gu smin/ /dad ldan skal ldan rnams kyis gsos mdzod cig / ces gsungs nas/ yar chas pa la/ rgyal mo thu la sogs pa rnams kyis rin chen sna lnga dang / dar zab rin po che bzang skyems la sogs pa mang po phul nas/ rjes cis kyang bdag cag rnams thugs rjes bzung nas bzhugs par 'tshal/ zhes yang dang yang du gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ bdag bod 'dul ba'i dus la bab pas cis kyang 'gro 'tshal zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal mo gru la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang / lan gcig 'byon par thugs kyi bcang nas/ rje'i bka' bcag tu mi 'ongs/ rje yar gshegs pa la rin po che gser dngul dar zab dang / chib rta la sogs pa mang po phul nas/ bdag cag rnams la gdams ngag zhal bkod du bcug pa/nyung la 'dus pa zhig kyang zhu 'tshal/ bod kyi ban sde sangs rgyas mgon po/ bdag cag rnams kyis tshogs dpon dang mchod gnas su zhog par zhu 'tshal/ rje la slar lan gcig 'byon par zhu ba phul bas/rje bee ro'i 'al nas/ bka' dang gdams ngag sngar gsungs pa de tsho las lhag pa med do/ / 'on kyang 'di ltar du mdzod cig ces gsungs nas/ gdams ngag zhal bkod du bcug pa/ tshe 'di'i longs spyod gnyer 'dun bde sdug rnams/ / mi rtag sgyu ma lags pas zhen pa thongs/ / kun gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang / / 'gro ba'i bla mas mdzad pa dran par gyis/ / snying rje chen pos kun la bu bzhin skyongs/ / rgyu 'bras chos la rang sems dpang du tshugs/ / gang shar rang snang rig pa'i 'char — 184 —

lugs las/ / phyogs ris med par rang gsal ngang la ltos/ / 'byung 'jug med par dran pa rgyun du brten/ / rang byung thugs rje spyod pa ga bder mdzod/ / sangs spyos gzhan na med de re dogs chod/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas spam sangs rgyas mgon po chos dpon dang mchod gnas su bzhag rje bee ro tsa na yang lan gcig 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes so/ / de nas bee ro yar byon pa la/ rgyal mo rong gis rje 'bangs rnams kyis gser dngul la sogs pa 'bul ba skyes su bskur bas/ nga la gser la sogs pa'i nor gyi dgos pa med gsungs nas thams cad phyir gtad kyang / yang yang zhu ba phul bas/ dngul gyi dong tse gsum dang / gser phye bre to/ rje'i bla g.yu 'od 'bar rnams bsnams nas byon no/ / de nas rgyal mo'i mi rnams kyis so mang la thog tu skyel thung mdzad nas/ thams cad kyis phyag dang bskor ba mang po byas/ 'bas sbyi bor blangs nas byin rlabs zhus so/ /der rje g.yu sgra dang / bee ro gnyis glog 'khyug pa ltar gshegs so/ / de nas rgyal mo rong gi rje 'bangs la sogs pa thams cad/ bod yul la kha gtad nas gdung ngag ngag tu ngus nas phyag gyang 'gyel ba bzhin 'tshal/ zhag gsum bar du bod yul du kha gtad nas gsol ba btab cing phyag 'tshal nas/ slar rgyal mo tsha ba rong yul du log go /rje rnam gnyis bod du yar byon pa'i lam ka zhig na lo brgya lon pa'i rgan mgo dkar/ spam mi pham mgon po bya ba'i sar zheg phog pas/ rgad po na re/ ban dhe khyed gnyis gang nas 'ongs/ da gar 'gro zer bas/ g.yu sgras rgyal mo tsha ba rong nas 'ongs/ da bod du 'gro zhes pas na/ rgad pos mgron po khyed gnyis 'khrul ba ma red dam/ rgyal mo rong na mkhas pa chen po bee ro tsa na bzhugs/ chos kyi nyi ma shar ba bzhin 'dug ces thos pas/ der chos nyan nas mi 'dug par khyed gnyis 'dra ba zer bas/ bee ro tsa nas de nyid nga yin gsungs pas rgad pos de ma thag nas mig la mkhar ba btsugs nas bltas te bee ro'i mgul ba la 'khyud nas yun cig dus kho na re/ nga rgas shing khog par chos med stong log byas nas mchis ma btub pa'i nyon mongs sdug bsngal ba rgan po nga 'dra snyam ste/ rje khyed dang mjal ba skyed rgan a re dga' 'chi khar phan pa'i chos shig zhu zer bas/ bee ros las can tu gzigs te phyag spyi bor bzhag ste brda brjod pas ma grol bas thugs la 'di las can gyi slob bur 'dug ste/ bod sa dman pas lan dgongs te sgom rten mkhar pa lus la btsugs sgom thag skad la bsdams nas gdams ngag btab pas/ de ma thag tu rtogs grol dus mnyam du gyur te sangs rgyas mgon po de lo bcu drug gi na tshod du gyur/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs nyi zla lta bur mdzad pa zhig byung ngo / /de la dang po bee ro spyan 'dren pa'i mi gsum ni/ slob dpon ma byon par 'o cag phyin pa mi 'ong zhes/'o cag rje'i drung du slob dpon dang dus mnyam du sleb par bya dgos zer nas ga ler byon/ rje bee ro dpon slob gnyis ni rdzu 'phrul gyis thog mar nas bsam yas mchim phu'i yangs dben du phebs byung nas/dus de tsam na rje mu ni btsan po'i shid kyi dus su thug ste/ bi ma la dang gnyag ku ma ras las mkhan mdzadanas/ shid kyi mi mang po tshogs kun yod tsa na/ ban dhe gnyis byon te khro chu'i me stag 'phro 'phro byung nas/— 185 —

'di lta bu'i ban dhe su yin zer bas/ ku ma ra snyo na langs te bltas tsa na/ rje bee ro dang g.yu sgra yin par shes nas phyag 'tshal/ rje blon rnams la rje bee ro byon no gsungs par bsgrags so/ /der slob dpon bi ma la mi ṭa dang / bee ro tsa na rnam gnyis zhe sa hab thob du byas/ bod kyi dzha na la sogs pa mkhas btsun rnams dang / dge 'dun sde gnyis dang / rgyal blon rnams kyis phyag gyang 'gyel ba bzhin du 'tshal/ thams cad rang rang gi rgyan dang / rin po che gser g.yu rta gos la sogs pa hab thob du phul te/ rje bee ro'i dpon slob gnyis mdun du ri spungs pa lta bu byung ngo / /dus der sngar gyi spyan 'dren pa mi gsum yang slobs so/ de nas gos la sogs pa de rnams la khri chen po bshams nas/ slob dpon bee no bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon gnyis la khri chung re byas nas bi ma la dang g.yu sgra gnyis bzhugs/ mkhas btsun rnams dang dge 'dun sde gnyis/ rje blon 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mdun du mchi ma phyung nas phyag 'tshal/ la las bskor ba byed/ la las gdugs phub/ la las ni dung 'bud/ la las rnga la sogs rol mo bkrol/ la las ni klu len bro brdung / la las shon byed/ thams cad kyis dga' zhing bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mang po byas so/ / de nas bee ro tsa na dang bi ma la mi ṭa dgongs 'dun mdzad/ g.yu sgra dang snye na dang bang chen mi gsum la sogs las mkhan mdzad nas/ rje mu nis kyang rgyas par mdzad do/ /bee ros zhe blo bde ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /zhabs tog rnam gsum bla ma bsten pa 'di/ / bee ro tsa na paṇa chen 'dzoms pa 'dra/ kho bo 'dug pa 'di rnams dgyes pa na/ /gzhan dag su ma mgu yang zhe blo bde/ /shes rab rnam gsu ma mdo rgyud lta ba 'di/ /rin chen gling du cheng dpon phyin pa 'dra/ /lus srog longs spyod chos phyogs song ba nga/ /tshe 'dir sdug cing phongs kyang zhe blo bde/ /bslab pa gsum gyis legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /rgyal po'i lha gcig bag ma phyin pa 'dra/ /rang gi chos tshig drang por zin pa nga / / gzhan gyis ngan smras brjod kyang zhe blo bde/ / sde snod gsum la ltad mo blta ba 'di/ / mun pa'i gling du sgron me bteg pa 'dra/ /rkyen skul dgra la bzod pa bsgom pa nga / /gzhan don ma pher zer yang zhe blo bde/ / lus ngag yid gsum chos la 'khor ba 'di/ / thag ring mgron po pha yul slebs pa 'dra/ / rtag tu dge spyor dag la ma g.yengs nga / / mi rjes ma slebs zer yang zhe blo bde/ /dus gsum gnyen por ye shes gtong ba 'di/ / tshad pa'i nad la ga bur gtong ba 'dra/ /bsam rgyud dam pa'i chos las med pa dang / /blo sho rgod do zer yang zhe blo bde/ / thos bsam sgom pa phyogs med byas pa 'di/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du mdung skor byas pa 'dra/ /phyi nang chos kyi sgro 'dog chod pa nga / /chos kun mi shes zer yang zhe blo bde/ /a ti rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor 'phyo ba 'di/ /ga'an dring med pa'i khri mun thar pa 'dra/ / nyan 'chad sgom la mkhas pa gyur pa nga / /mi chos mi mkhas zer yang zhe blo bde/ / rang bas gzhan la gces par 'dzin pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge sbyor skyes rabs 'dra/ /ngo bsrung phyogs su gdams ngag mi ster nga / /mi sems ma zin zer yang zhe blo bde/ / sbyin pa stsesum gyi brgyags phyi bsgrub pa 'di/ / dbul bos yid ba'in nor bu rnyed pa 'dra/ / ci yod bla ma'i — 186 —

phyogs su 'bul ba nga / /ltogs gri 'khyags grir shi yang zhe blo bde/ /tshul khrims gsum gyi skyel ma khrid pa 'di/ / 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la lam brgya btsugs pa 'dra/ / bzang ngan 'bring gsum gong du 'khur ba nga / /'khes man nyams chung zer yang zhe blo bde/ /bzod pa gsum gyi go cha gyon pa 'di/ /btsan po'i mkhar la rus sbal 'dzeg pa 'dra/ /'jig rten bya ba thams cad blos btang nga /khas nyen dbang chung zer yang zhe blo bde/ /brtson 'grus gsum gyi rta bzang rgyug pa 'di/ /'chad can ma dang yus chen 'phrad pa 'dra/ /smyug pa'i yul du mi skyo tshugs pa nga / /'gro sa ma byung zer yang zhe blo bde/ /bsam gtan gsum gyi sa mkhar 'dzin pa 'di/ / sbrin med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /sems kyi gzhi rtsa legs par chod pa nga / /lta log chos min zer yang zhe blo bde/ / bslabs gsum ldan zhing spobs pas khyogs pa 'di/ / ri rab rtse nas ri bran mthong ba la/ /theg pa'i 'jug sgo kun rdzogs rdzogs chen nga / /mu stegs phra men zer yang zhe blo bde/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas chos grwa btsugs te chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ro/ /chos gsungs pa'i dus su nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dang lha yang mang po byon pa mthong ba dang / lha'i me tog sna tshogs mang po 'thor ba dang /sa chen po g.yo ba la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul mang po byung ngo / /de la thams cad kyis ngo mtshar skyes nas 'gyod pa yang drag po skyes so/ /rje bee ro tsa na lags tsha ba rong du sgyugs pa 'o ma brgyal lam/ tsha ba rong gi mi rnams rje dam pa'i chos la chud lags sam/ rje khyed lta bu sgyugs pa 'ong ba ci ltar lags zer zhing thams cad ngus nas 'gyod bshags mang po byas so/ / de nas slob dpon bee ro tsa nas/ da khyed rnams kyi sgrib pa dag pas/ ma ngu zhes yang yang gsungs nas/ lan du mgur 'di gsungs pa /mya 'di nas bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa sde gnyis dang / /rje blon 'bangs dang bcas pa kun gson cig/bdag ni dge slong bee ro tsa na ste/ /chos nyid mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong chen na/ / rang byung rig pa rgyal po'i khyung chen 'phyo/ / nyams nga re dogs rtsol spub mtshan ma med/ ldag bsngal ma mchis bde ba chen por gnas/ /zhes pa dang / kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi 'od zer las/ / bee ro tsa na'i las 'phro smon lam gyis/ / tsha ba rong du bstan pa'i nyi ma shar/ /ma rig mun pa ye shes zer gyis gsal/ /skal ldan skyes chen byang chub don dang 'phrod/ /dad mos skal ldan rim gyis smin par byas/ / ris chad rnams la dkar po'i sa bon bzhag / tsha ba rong gi rgyal khams chos la bsgyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ / 'jam dpal sprul pa thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs/ /mi la drin can khri srong lde btsan gyis/ /ye nas sangs rgyas rtsol med bde chen don/ /rgyu 'bras chos las shin tu khyad 'phags pa'i/ / ma yis bu skye skyes chen btsan po yis/ / legs grub bee ro bdag gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /ga'an gyis btsal bas rnyed par yongs ma gzigs/ /thugs je ldan pa'i khri srong lde btsan gyis/ / dang po man ngag 'tshol bar bskos pa'i tshe/ khas blangs dka' yang bdag gis 'gro bar blangs/ /rgya gar mkhas pa mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ / nor la dkon pa risachen gser phye bskur/ /bsgrod par dka' ba'i gshul ring lam la bsgrod/ /thar bar dka' ba'i 'dzi5sa pa'i 'phrang las thar/ /— 187 —

phyin par dka' ba'i rgya gar yul du phyin/ /brid par dka' ba'i bram ze rgan mo brid/ /bskal par sbyangs kyang mthong ba dka' ba yis/ /dga' rab 'jam dpal sa sogs zhal yang mthong / /mnyes par dka' ba'i rgya gar 'phags pa mnyes/ / rnyed par dka' ba'i man ngag rgyal po rnyed/ / rtogs par dka' ba'i rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs/ / rdzogs par dka' ba'i bstan pa thugs la rdzogs/ / sgrub par dka' ba'i rkang mgyogs rdzu 'phrul 'grub/ /brtag par dka' ba'i nyams dang mi lam brtag gon par dka' ba'i zom lham phyir log gon/ /bros par dka' ba'i shul ring lam nas bros/ /ngo so bstod nas rje yi spyan sngar phyin/ /bstan pa'i snying po thugs dgongs tshim par byas/ /bod khams 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs te/ /rgya bod rgyal blon gdug pa'i phra ma yis/ / las 'phros smon lam 'phags pa'i thugs rje yis/ / tsha ba'i rong du bee ro bdag sgyugs pas/ / bstan pa tsha ba rong du dar ba dang / / snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can blo chung ba/ /chos phyir 'bad pa'i dka' ba phra mo la/ /nga rgyal rloms sems dregs pa zhi ba dang / /chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i dad ldan skyes bu la/ / ma nyes kha yogs mi 'os sdug bsngal bsags/ /yid byung sgyid lugs yid chad mi gus phyir/ / dka' ba sna tshogs sdug bsngal ltar snang ba/ / ma 'ongs rnal 'byor rnams kyi don phyir tu/ /thugs rjes blangs nas bstan pa dar bar byas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /o rgyan yul nas spyan drangs padma 'byung / / za hor mkhan po sgo lha sa twa dang / /kha che'i paṇa chen bi ma mi ṭa dang / /dbu yi mchod gnas lo paṇa brgya rtsa brgyad/ / bdag ni chos skyong spyal por zhal bzhes pas/ /rgya gar yu la nas bzhugs pa dam pa'i chos/ /bka' dang bstan bcos rgyud lung man ngag rnams/ /gcig kyang ma lus bod du bsgyur du gsol/ / zhes zhus nas/ / de nas lo paṇa rnams sgra bsgyur gling du byon nas/ /dang po nyan rang chos la mdo sde legs nyes bstan pa/ las brgya ba/ rnam 'byed rnam par thar ba las rnam brjod/ gang ba'i rtogs brjod/ bram ze bla ma tshoms gyi mdo/ dran pa nyer bzhag mdo mdzangs blun/ tshul khrims ngan pa tshar gcod pa'i mdo/ drin lan bsab pa ste drang don mdo bcu/'dul ba lung rnam ba'i/ bar ba byang sems la/ pha rol tu phyin pa yum sras bcu bdun/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bum/ sher phyin stong nyid gtso ston mdo mang / tha ma nges don snying po bstan pa/ sa snying 'khor lo bcu ba/ yon tan mdzod/ phal po che/ dkon brtsegs/ lang kar gshegs pa/padma dkar po/ myang 'das/ dgongs pa nges 'grel/ rgyan sdud/ gser 'od dam pa sogs du ma bsgyur/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs 'grel/ bstan bcos skor la/ 'dul gzhung mdo 'grel mang du bsgyur/ bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo/ mngon pa'i bstan bcos sde bdun/ dbyig gnyen gyis phung po'i rab dbye/ nyi shu ba'i rab byed/ sum cu ba'i rab byed/ las rnams grub pa'i rab du byed pa/rnam bshad rig pa'i rang rgyud lnga/ chos mngon mdzod la sogs pa'i gzhung 'grel mtha' yas pa dang /byang sems kyi bstan bcos klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rig pa'i tshogs/ bstod tshogs/ gtam tshogs/ ārya de ba'i dbu ma bzhi brgya ba/ bha bya'i rtog ge 'bar ba/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi budha pā li/ zla ba grags — 188 —

pa'i dbu ma mjug pa/ ye shes snying po'i bden gnyis rnam 'byed/ zhi ba lha'i dbu ma rgyan/ ka ma shrī la'i dbu ma snang ba/ rta dbyangs kyi mdo sde'i skyes rabs snyan ngag dang / chos skyabs kyi ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ phyogs gling gi rab byed brgya rtsa brgyad/ chos grags kyi sde bdun rnam 'grel/ dbang sde rab 'byed gtan tshigs/ 'i ba lha'i spyod 'jug bslab btus/ thogs med kyis blangs pa'i byams chos sde lnga/ sa sde lnga/ sdom gsum la sogs pa'i bstan bcos du ma dang / nges pa don gyi mdo sde'i 'grel bshad/ dbyig gnyen gyis sa bcu'i 'grel ba/ padma dkar po'i sa'i rtsa lag dgongs 'grel/ṭī ka bam po drug cu la sogs pa'i rgya gar mkhas grub mang po'i gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa bsgyur kyang 'di rags bsdus tsam mo/ / de nas rdo rje theg pa'i skor ni/ za ma tog bkod pa/ rtswa ma ṇi/ 'dus pa rin chen tog gzungs gra lnga/ gzungs phran brgya dang drug cu/ kto ya'i skor sku rgyud gtsug tor/gsung rgyud don zhag thugs rgyud rig pa mchog bshad rgyud dpung bzang / su ti ka ra'i rgyud/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gnyis te rtsa ba'i sde drug bya ba spyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ bye brag cho ga zhib mor ston pa'i rgyud/ lta rgyud gzungs ring bsam gtan phyi ma/ 'od zer 'phro rgyud/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/dbang bskur rtog pa spyal po'i rgyud dang / rigs gsum la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ 'jam dpal gsang rgyud/ 'jam dpal rigs drug rgyud/ phyi ma 'jam dpal gsang ba bstan rgyud/ bshad rgyud yig bkod pa las rgya mtsho dpa' bo gcig sgrub/ bstod pa glur blangs sogs dang / spyan ras gzigs la mdo rgyud nyer gcig padma dra ba/ don zhags/ yid bzhin 'khor lo/ phyag stong sbyan stong /gzungs senee sgra/ padma cod pan rgyud/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rtog pa sogs dang / phyag rdor skor la gtum po rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma bcas dang / rdo rje sa 'og rdo rje sa gsum 'dul ba/ rdo rje bde khros/ rdo rje gdengs rgyud/ rdo rje snying po bab pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje ri rab khang bu brtsegs pa sogs dang / ga'an yang gzi ldan sgrol ma'i 'bar ba'i rgyud/ tsun rta'i rgyud/gshen rje nag po'i rgyud la sogs rig pa'i gzungs sngags mtha' yas pa dang / spyod rgyud u pa'i rgyud kyi skor la rtsa rgyud snam snang mngon byang / bya rgyud nye ma gzi brjid rtsa rgyud dang phyi ma phyi ma'i rgyud/ khams gsum rnam rgyal sras khog snang ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod le'u khri stong me dpung 'bar ba/dam tshig gsum bkod lag na rdo rje dbang skur ba'i rgyud sogs dang / yo ga'i rgyud la rtsa ba ta thā sa ma gra ha/ bya rgyud rdo rje rtse mo byin gyis brlab pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ kha skongs dpal mchog dang po rig pa mchog 'jig rten gsum rgyal/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud rnams dang /de dag rnams kyi 'grel bshad/ sgrub thabs/ gdam ngag lag len dang bcas pa mtha' yas par bsgyur ro/ / ma hā yo ga'i skor la/ rtsa ba tanta sde bco brgyad/ rnam snang gtsos pa'i sgyu 'phrul sde bzhi/gsang ba rdor sems/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad/ spyi rgyud sgos rgyud 'jam dpal sku'i rgyud zla gsang nag po/ padma gsung gi rgyud rta mchog rol ba/ yang dag thugs kyi rgyud he ru ka gal — 189 ge

po/ bdud rtsi yon tan rol ba che chung / phur ba zin las kyi rgyud byitya tta ma la/ ma rma 'bum tig dang sgrub sde drug tan gan sman gtor rakta'i rgyud la sogs pa dang / nang lung a nu yo ga'i skor la/ rtsargyud ye shes phyag rgya rol ba'i mdo dang / dbang bskur rig 'dzin drug ting 'dzin mchog gsangasgo'agrel ba/ rdo rje ma gol sgrol ma brtsegs pa'i mdo sde rtsa ba'i mdo bdun dang / lung chen rtsa ba nang gi mdo bdun ni/ dgongs 'dus/ kun 'dus rig pa/ sems lung chen mo/ ye shes jam glog khu byug rdol ba/ gal po che 'jig rten 'das pa'i mdo dang bdun bsgyur/ rgyud la sku mchog bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i rgyud/ gsung dbyangs khro rgyal dbang chen 'dus pa/ thugs mchog purtse ri ka yon tan lhun rdzogs lha mo ma gol/ zin las sgom don drug pa/ bla med 'dus rgyud/ khyi rgyud la sogs pa bsgyur/rdzogs chen a ti yo ga la rtsa rgyud sde lnga yan lag sde bdun/ bshad rgyud bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa/sems smad bco brgyad/ klong sde dkar nag khra gsum/ ma bu'i skor/ man ngag sde la bka' gter snyan rgyud gsum/ de dag re re la'ang skor lnga 'grel bshad sgrub yig phyogs mthun gyi bstan bcos bsam gyi mi khyab par bsgyur te slob dpon rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis lha klu gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas o rgyan nā lertse'i gtsug lag khang sogs nas blangs te/ da lta bsam yas dkor mdzod rnams su rgya dpe tshobazhugs pa 'di dag go / gzhan yang bee ro tsa nas rtsis sman 'dris mar bsgyur pa dang / mdo sngags 'dres mar bsgyur/ mdo bsgyur nang du ye shes sde zhes bris/ /sngags bsgyur nang du bee ro tsa nas bris/ /bon bsgyur nang du gnas 'jags thang tas bris/ /rtsis bsgyur nang du in ṭa bee ros bris/ /sman bsgyur nang du chos 'bar bya ba bcug / chos mdo ma lus phal cher bod du bsgyur/ / sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' la snga ba shes pa brjod pa nas/ phyi ma mya ngan las 'das pa yan chod du/ bden pa bzhi dang mtshan nyid theg pa dang / /mtha' ma nges pa don gyi chos la sogs/ /ma lus rdzogs par ye shes sde ngas bsgyur/ / gsang ba sngags kyi nang ge 'gyur byang ni/ / kun bzang rigs lnga rdor 'chang rigs gsum mgon/ /bka' brgyad khro bo bcu la sogs pa dang / gsang sngags lha ni nyis stong drug brgya yi/ /rgyud la 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis byung / / dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing ha dang / o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i/ / 'ja' lus 'thub pa'i mkhas pa nyer lnga bsten/ / rgyud sde stong dang man ngag bye ba rnams/ /bod kyi don du bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ /gzhan yang bdag las lhag pa'i bshes gnyen ni/ / rgya gar yul nas shrī sing hā tsam/ / 'dzam gling bod na padma 'byung gnas tsam/ / 'gran dang bral ba bee ro nga tsam la/ / yon tan mi mthong skyon gyi rang bzhin lta/ / sku ni 'ja' bzhin mkha' la 'gro dus su/ /lo tsā ba dang grub thob paṇa chen dang / /rgyal po blon po rje 'bangs thams cad rnams/ /bee ro tsa nas sbyang pa'i yo na tan rnams/ / chu thigs tsam zhig shes la mkhas par 'dod/ / tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'ja' lus yid smon gyis/ / zhes gsungs nas/ / sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur batshengs nas/ chos nyid kyi nam mkha' la thim par/ 'khor rnams kyis smre sngags kyi gsol ba btab — 190 —

pas/ skad cig la mdun du khri gdan gyi steng du byon no/ / de nas rgya gar nas byon pa'i paṇa chen rnams dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba grub thob rgyal blon rje 'bangs thams cad kyis/ tshog4dang gser gyi maṣṭal phul/kun gyis rjel 'di skad bstod/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta thams cad du/ / bee ro tsa na 'dra ba'i lo tsā ba/ /sngarayang ma byon rting la 'byon re dka'/ /mchog thun dngos spub 'ja' lus rdo rje 'grub/ /rig 'dzin spub thob 'di tsam 'byon re dka'/ /sde snod gsum nas theg chen a ti'i bar/ / mkhas pa'i dbang po paḍachen 'di lta bu/ /sngar yang ma byon rting yang 'byon re dka'/ /ma 'ongs rgya gar 'phral skad shes tsam la/ /lo tsā bzhud srid bee ro'i char mi rnyed/ / lo tsā btigs kyang don la paṇa ṭi ta/ / 'di yi chos drin yod do bod khams tsho/ /rje la bstan chos chos log dar tsa na/ /bee ro tsa nas bsgyur la dpang po gyis/ /mun pa chos kyi gsal 'ongs bod khams tsho/ /zhes bstod nas phyag dang bskor ba grangs med pa byas so/ /der chos 'khor tshar te rje bee ro dang g.yu sgra 'khor thun mong ma yin pa 'asa' mchim phu'i dbeen gnas su lo gcig la bzhugs so/ /de nas yang rgyal mo tsha ba rong du lan gcig 'byon te tsha ba rdong gi rgyal blon rje 'bangs rnams dang mjal nas chos kyis 'gro don mdzad/ snod dang ldan pa rnams la man ngag gsungs bzhin bzhugs so/ /de tsa na bee ro tsa na tsha ba rong na bzhugs pa thos nas khams su spyan drangs/ rje bi ma la la sogs pa paṇa ṭi ta gsum yang spyan drangs nas/ khams dung byams chen gyi yang dben du bee ro tsa nas lo tsā mdzad nas sngags don la sogs pa sgrub sde'i chos bsgyur ro/ /yang bee ros spam sangs rgyas mgon po dang /sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang gsum dgongs pa lhan du mdzad/ gzhan 'khor thun mong ma yin pa rnams la a ti sems sde'i skor la sogs pa/ rgyud dang man ngag mang du gsungs te/ man ngag sems sde bco brgyad brda dang ngo sbod bcas pa yang gsungs so/ de la rgyud pa dang po ni bee ros/ khri srong lde btsan la snga 'gyur lnga dang /man ngag rgya mtsho'i klong dang / sazhan yang rgyud dang man ngag bcas skog gyur du gsungs pa rnams so/ /brgyud pa bar ma ni rje g.yu sgra snying pos/ gnya' dzñā na dang / sma rin chen mchog la gsungs pa rnams so/ /tha ma ni rgyal bu g.yu sgra snying pos/ spam sangs rgyas mgon po dang rgya blo gros gzhon nu dang / sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gsungs pa rnams yin te/ phyis khams dung gnas nang dang dung byams chen gyis yang dben du rje nyid dang mjal nas/ dgongs pa mdzad kyin gsungs pa rnams yin no/ /de nas yang yar bsam yas su byon nas has pho ri'i kha la bzhugs te/ 'khor thun mong ba rnams la drang don gyi bstan bcos dang / rgyu 'brasakyi chos bag re dang sngar gyi mjug ma tshang ba 'ga' sprung gsungs/thun mong ma yin pa la a ti'i man ngag khyad par can 'ga' yang gsungs ba'in bzhugs/ g.yu sgra dang mnga' bdag rgyal po gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i 'ja' lus grub pa'i slob ma bdun gyis/rje btsun chen po'i drung du/ zab mo chegs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ g.yu sgras gtsos pa'i slob bu rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol pa/ ston pa'i zhal skyin rgyal ba kun 'dus sku/ gsung rab rgyud sde rgya mtsho 'dus padi 9/sungs/ /

bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs klong nam mkha' che/ / mun pa gsal mdzad rin chen 'od po che/ / bdag sogs bod khams rnams la gzigs nas kyang / /ma 'ongs rjes 'jug nges shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rje yi snyan brgyud rdo rje zab lam 'di/ /nyams su len pa'i grub thob du tsam byon/ /zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon dgyes pa'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /legs par gson dang rje 'bangs bu slob cho/ /nga yi thugs dgongs nam mkha' g.ya' dag bzhin/ /gang 'dod re ba skong ngo nga nyon dang / /rje yi bu chen mi pham mgon po 'di/ /mi lo lnga brgya 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ /phung po lhag med chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /da lta'i mkhas pa g.yu sgra snying po khyod/ /sum brgya bdun cu mi yul 'gro don skyong / /slar yang zhing khams nga dang lhan cig 'gro/ / bzang po rin chen dbyings kyi bya ba la/ / 'byung ste lo yang nyis brgya bdun cu gnas/ /phung po lhag med chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/khug 'gyur gsang ba mchog zhes bya ba 'byung / /lo yang brgya dang dgu bcur gnas pa ste/ / phung po lhag ma med pa dbyings su gshegs/ / rig 'dzin de rnams gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin ni/ /ngan lam pa ni byang chub rgyal mtshan 'byung / / lo ni baspya dang bdun cu don brgyad gnas/ / phung po lhag med chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ / de'i sras bzang po rin chen skyed lo ni/ /lo ni brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe bzhir gnas/ /de yang phung po lhag med chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /de nas nyang gi byang chub legs par bya ba de/ /dpon slob gsum po lo ni brgya re bzhugs/ /slar yang tshogs kyi gral nas lhag med gshegs su gsol/ /nyang gi shes rab 'byung gnas zhes bya 'byung / /lo ni brgya dang gsum du gnas pa ste/ / dpon slob mchim phu'i brag nas lhag med gshegs/ / nyang gi byang chub grags pa bya ba 'byung / /lo ni brgya dang bdun du gnas pa ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung du gyur pa'o/ /bha ni ye shes byang chub bya ba 'byung / /lo ni dgu bcu go baspyad gnas pa ste/ /sku gdung med par dkar hril nam mkhar gshegs/ / gdams pa sa ta bya ba gcig 'byung ste/ / lo ni baspya dang bcu gsu ma bar tu gnas/ /phung po kha dog lnga ldan 'gyur par 'byung / /de nas nga yi snyan brgyad 'dzin pa'i brgyud/ / tshe lo mthar phyin thub thob mang du 'byung / / dharma sing ha lags na rdo je dang / / snye na la sogs snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i bu/ / rgya bod gnyis dang tsha ba rong la sogs/ / lhag med grub pa brgya dang bdun cu 'byung / / tshe lo mthar phyin dgongs pa mngon gyur pa/ /rnal 'asnyor chen po grangs med brjod las 'das/ / zhes gsungs nas/ thig le sngon po'i dkyil du yi ge a dkar por gyur nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /der 'khor thams cad kyi smre ngag 'don cing gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'di skad ces pa'i sgra zhig byung ngo / /i 'gyur med lhun 'thub chos dbyings zhing khams 'di/mtho dman bzang ngan blangs dor med pa'o/ / chos dbyings ye shes 'char sgo de che'o/ / zhes gsungs nas/ nam snang chos dbyings bkod pa'i zhing khams bstan nas/ rje btsun nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur bzhengs nas/ rigs lnga bder gshegs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khor gyis bskor te/ 'dus pa'i bu slob rnams la/ nam mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul byung / de nas gsol ba rtse — 192 —

gcig tu btab pas/ rje btsun sku drang por zil ba khrom mer/ 'ja' 'od 'byil ler byas nas/'khor rnams gyi mdun byon no/ / mnga' bdag spyal pos gtsos pa'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis/ rin chen lha mi'i nor bu dpag tu med pa'i phrabakod de/ rje la phul nas 'di skad ces gsol ba/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rnam par snang mdzad de/ /'gro ba'i don du bee ro nyid du bhon/ / mun pa'i smag rum dam pa'i chos kyis sel/ / 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta thams cad du/ /sku drin che yang bod khams snying med pas/ /thugs rje chen po'i dgongs pas bzod par 'tshal/ /zhes gsol/ dus de tsa na/ rje nyid khri gdan gyi steng na/ skabs rer sku 'od du 'bar ba/ skabs rer sku rnam snang du bzhugs pa/ skabs rer shaka thub du bzhugs pa/ skabs rer kun dga' bo/ skabs rer glegs bam rdo rje dril bu nor bu padma la sogs pa/ 'byung ba lnga la sogs pa sprul bsgyur dpag tu med pa mdzad par snang bas/ rgyal mo g.yu sgra la sogs slob bu bdun gyi rje btsun chen po la gsol ba/ snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams la blo yi mun pa sel ba'i phyir dang / bod khams 'dir rje nyid kyi sprul pa ji tsam 'byung / de rnams kyi mtshan bdag cag la bstan du 'tshal lags/ zhes zhus pas/ rje bcun bee ro ye shes spyan ldan gyis bka' stsal pa/ kyai gson dang rgyal blon yon mchod rnams/ / nga yi rig pa'i ye shes spyan ldan gyi/ / phyogs lhung med par gsal ler mkhyen pa ni/ / nga yi sprul ba za hor yul dag tu/ / byang chub sems dpa' bod kyi bstan pa spel/ /a ti sha zhes 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon 'byung / / nga yi gsung sprul sde snod rgyud sde 'dzin/ / paṇa chen ming la rig pa'i mkhyen brtse rgyas/ /bod khams 'di ru bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /nga yi phyogs sgrul gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i bu/ /grags pa mngon shes gar gyi dngos spub rnyed/ /bdag gi sprul ba padma'i bstan 'dzin pa/ / rdo rje gling ba gter gyi bstan pa skyong / /bdag gi sprul ba ras chung rdor grags zhes/ /rgya bod gnyis la rlung ltar 'phyo byas nas/ / mkha' spyod gnas su mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon byed/ /nga yi sprul ba kun mkhyen jo nang zhes/ /bod khams 'di na mkhas shing grub brnyes pa'i/ / bstan pa'i srog 'dzin mdo sngags bdag por 'gyur/ /nga yi sprul ba bar sde g.yag gi ming / / bod 'dir mkhas pa'i dbang po shes rab rnam gnyis mdzes/ /nga yi sprul ba zang dkar lo tsā zhes/ /chos 'khor lha sar bstan pa'i bya ba byed/ / bdag gi smon lam dbang gis skyes bu ni/ / grub thob mkhar nag gdams ngag brgyud pa spel/ /bee ro'i byin rlabs u rgyan thugs kyi sras/ /kun skyong ming can gter chos bstan pa skyong / /zin las sprul ba phag mo gru zhes pa/ /dbus gtsang khams gsum mgo nag rje ru 'gyur/ /nga yi sprul ba spyo sgom ras pa zhes/ /tsha ba rong dang mdo khams phyogs su yang / /'gro don mthar phyin mkha' spyod gnas su byon/ / gzhan yang sprul ba dpag med brjod las 'das/ / mi mjed 'jig rten drug gi zhing rnams su/ / mkhas pa bee ro'i sprul ba grangs las 'das/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro don der byed do/ /ba spu'i bu gar 'od zer bye ba 'gyed/ /'od zer re la sprul ba re re 'gyed/ /paṇa ṭi ta dang lo tsa dgra bcom dang / /gter ston grub thob rnal 'byor dge slong dang / /rgyal po blon 'bangs btsun mo bud med dang / /zas — 193 —

dang skom dang gos dang longs spyod dang / / mdor na 'gro ba'i yid kyi smon pa la/ / gang la gang 'dod 'gro don rdzogs par byas/ /de ltar yin no bod 'bangs rjes 'jug tsho/ /da ni bdag kyang ring por mi gnas pas/ /rdzon thing steng nas bya tshogs 'phur ba bzhin/ /skad cig mi sdod chos kyi dbyings su 'gro/ /dgung sngon dbyings la nyi zla bzhud pa bzhin/ / skod cig mi sdod 'gro don skyong du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs nas/ spyan nam mkha' la har gyis gzigs pa/ de nas 'khor rnams kyis dga' ston gting rag gi mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul dus/ de tsa na li yul lcang ra sprug po na btsun mo li tsa tshul khrims sgron gyis/rje bee ro bsam yas su byon pa thos nas/ btsun mo mjal zhing spyan 'dren du byon nas/ slob dpon dang mjal te dgongs pa bsdur te dgongs pa gcig tu gyur pas slob dpon shin tu mnyes so/ / btsun mo li tsha tshul khrims sgron ni/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems kyi bde ba zag pa med pas rgyas pa/ gnas lugs snying po'i don la dgongs pa klong du gyur pa/ de la rje bee ro yun gyi dgongs pa la gshegs par dgongs nas/ 'khor rnams la zhal chems su gsungs nas/ dgongs pa la gshegs par chas pa la/ rje g.yu sgra snying po dang spam sangs rgyas mgon po/ rgya blo gros gzhon nu/sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje sad na legs 'jing yon gyi sras la sogs pa rje blon 'bangs 'khor rnams kyis/rje bee ro la bstan pa'i snying po tshal du phyin pa la bod du bstan pa ji ltar byung tshul dang / bstan pa rgya gar du ji ltar rgyas pa dang / rje ji ltar nyid nas bod du byon tshul/ rjes bsam yas su ji ltar gsungs pa dang / tsha ba'i yul du bstan pa ji ltar dar bar byas pa dang / da lta rje bzhugs pa yan chad kyi rje'i lo rgyus rnams sngar bdag cag rnams la rjes su gsungs pa dang / da skabs kyi rje'i mdzad pa dang / dkar chag gi dpe yang bdog pas rjes bdag cag rnams la da dung lo rgyus de rnams dkar chag tu gdab par zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ rje nyid kyi kyang 'bag gsum zhes zhib rgyas su gsungs so/ / der sngar gyi spam la sogs pa/ g.yu sgra dang / gnyag dzña na sogs la rje bee ros gsungs pa dang / sngar gyi dkar chag rnams phyogs gcig tu drilanas yi ge bris su btab pa'o/ / der rje bee ro'i zhal nas/ dkar chag gi lo rgyus 'di ni rgyal ba rnams gyi dgongs pa'i bcud dang bla ma rnams kyi nyams dang dgongs pa mngon du phyung nas bstan pas dgongs pa'i spyi mdzod yin/ sangs rgyal kyi bstan pa ji ltar byung zhing ji ltar brgyud pa'i lo rgyus gsal bar ston pas lo rgyus don gyi bshad thabs zhig yin no/ / lo rgyus 'di dang phrad pa rnams rgyal ba sku lnga dang / bka' brgyud kyi rig 'dzin rnams dang rje bee ro dngos su mjal ba dang 'dra bas 'dra 'bag chen mo zhes bya ba yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa byung tshul gyi sgo nas lo rgyus don gyi bshad thabs tsol med bstan pa'i dkar chag zhes kyang bya ba yin no/ / de nas yang bee ro la 'khor rnams kyis phyag ratshal zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/ bdag cag rnams thugs rjes gzigs par zhu 'tshal/ gdams ngag rnams ji ltar byas la nyams su blangs ces zhus pas/ je bee ro'i 'al nas nam mkha'i khams dang nyi zla gzatram̐ skasdu ༵༵ rjol med pa ltar nga dang khyed rnams kyi mos gus byed pa rnams dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings

las 'du 'bral med pas/ nam yang mi 'bral bas thugs rjes zungs zhes gsol ba yang yang thob cig gsungs pa/ khyed rnams 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la sgrub bya ma byed/ snying rje chen pos gdul bya la yal bar ma 'dor/ mos gus chen pos bla ma dang skad cig kyang 'bral bar ma byed/ shes rab chen pos dus nam yang rang las gzhan du ma lta zhig gsungs nas/ slob dpon chen po de nyid bsam yas has pho ri'i rtser/ g.yu sgra gtsos pa'i bu slob bdun dang / rje mnga' bdag gtsos pa'i rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga /btsun mo li tsha tshul khrims sgron nam mkha' la glog rgyug pa bzhin du byung ste/ de dus rje nyid spyan nam mkha' la gzigs shing phyag dang zhabs gar stabs dpag med babyur/ nam mkha'i dgyings phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas/ rigs lnga bde gshegs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ nam mkha'i khams su char sprin bzhin du 'dus/ 'ja' 'od lnga yis je nyid bskor bar 'dug de dus rje 'bangs bu slob rnams kyis/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po dpang mtho ba/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa dpag med bshams/ rje g.yu sgra gtsos pa'i bu slob thams cad kyis/ mgrin gcis dbyangs gcig gis rje btsun nyid la 'di skad ces gsol to/ i chos dbyings ye shes rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po bee ro chos kyi rje/ /bdag cag 'jigs rung g.yang la ma bskyur mdzod/ /long ba'i tshogs la long khrid mi mdzad par/ /thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs ma bskyur mdzod/ /skyabs mgon med pa'i bod khams mun pa'i gling / / thugs rje chen pos mun pa mi sel bar/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun mi 'bab par/ /bkres skom tshad pa'i sdug bsngal su yi sel/ /skyabs dang bral ba'i sems can su la re/ /bod 'bangs rjes 'jug thang la ma bor mdzod/ /rje khyed mkha' spyod gnas la 'byor dgongs na/ /skyabs gnas blo gtad su la 'tshol/ /chos mdzad bar chad su yis sel/ / dad ldan zhabs tog su la bgyi/ / smin grol dbang mchog su yis bskur/ /rgyal po'i mchod gnas su yis mdzad/ /bar chad rkyen ngan su yis sel/ /nam mkha' sprin dang 'ja' 'od dkyil/ / bla ma yi dam dam can rnams/ / bdag gis bla ma spyan ma drangs/ / a cag dor nas 'byon dgongs pa'i/ / thams cad mkhyen pa rin po che/ / bu slob snying 'dra ma bskyur cig /ces pa la sogs pa'i 'o dod dang smre ngag mang po phyung ste/ phyag dang bskor ba grangs med pa byas/ rje 'bangs thams cad rje btsun spyan sngar 'dus te/ slob dpon chen po bee ros bka' stsal pa/ gson dang bod kyi rgyal blon rje 'bangs tsho/ / bee ro nga yi gtam cig gson/ /lo brgyad lon nas bcu gsum bar/ /skad rigs mi gcig sum brgya drug cu bslabs/ / bcu bzhi lon nas rgya gar yul du byon/ /dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing ha sogs/ /'ja' lus grub pa nyi shu rtsa lnga bsten/ /mkhas grub mnyes pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis bsten/ / do shi do bral dka' ba sna tshogs spyad/ / michos lhag med ma lus bod du bsgyur/ /bod kyi rgyal po khri thog lnga ru yang / / bee ro nga yis 'gro don rgya chen byas/ / da ni lo yang sum brgya kha la gtad/ / 'di nas li yul lcang ra smrag por 'gro/ / de ru mi lo nyi shu 'gro don mdzad/ / de nas chos ge 195 ——

dbyings bkod du yun gyis bde bar gnas/ / da lta khyed rnams mya ngan 'don mi 'tshal/ / bee rdo sda 7 'gro sdod gnyis su med/ /'dus byas dbang gis kha lo bsgyur ba tsam/ /nga 'gro khyed rnams sku khamasatsho bder mdzod/ /nga dang 'bral med dad gus mos pa gyis/ /zhes gsungs nas/ phyag g.yas seng ldistso‘ gi ṭa ma ru bkrol te/ skad cig gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bteg ste/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la/'ja' 'od spungs su byas nas 'khyil le bzhugs te/ bod kyi rjes 'jug rnams la 'di skad ces gsungali so/ /tshig la mkhas pas mkhas pa min/ /tshig don 'gran na yar la shog /sgom la chags pas zhi gnas min/ / rig pa rtogs na yar la shog/ yul sems 'grel ba'i nyams yod kyang / / rlung sems 'grel na yar la shog/ grub pa thob pa mang lags kyang / / 'ja' lus grub na yar la shog/ rig 'dzin 'ja' lus brgyudapa yin/ / ro gong bzhag na 'cha' mi mthun/ / da lta bod na brgyud 'dzin mang / / yin par 'dug na de ltar gyis/ / yar shog yar shog skal ldan kun/ / zhes gsungs nas ṭa ma ru sgra dang chos gos kyi g.yang g.yug spyab pas/ g.yu sgra dang li tsha tshul khrims sgron gyis gtsos pa'i bu slob bdun/ nam mkha' la glog rgyug pa bzhin mi gsal bar mkha' la gshegs so/ /mnga' bdag rgyal blon thams cad kyis 'o dod smre ngag 'don zhing phyag mang du 'tshal/ slob dpon ma bzhugs bod khams mun gling gyur/ / da ni chos min bya rgyu ma mchis pas/ / rje yi rnam thar skyong bar dam bcas so/ /zla re ngo re mi chad mi chag cing / /tshes brgyad byung dus rje btsun dran par bya/ /nyi nub skom pa'i chu yang chad bzhin du/ / bod kyi rje 'bangs gtsug lag khang du gshegs/ /rje yi gdams ngag nyams su blangs bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos pa'i lhag med 'grub pa bdun/ grub thob dang mkhas pa mang du byung bas/ dus kyi mchod pa 'dzin pa'i dus su/ yang rje btsun nyid kyi slob bu g.yu sgra snying po gtsos pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor nas/ mngon sum du mjal nas brna chos mang po gnang bar byung / da ṭwāṃ /bod/ kyigadulabya rnams rdzogs kyang / zhing khams la gdul bya byon pa'i skabs te ma rdzogs zhes gsungs bcu ba/ pod kyi chos rgyal gsum gyis bee ro la sogs pa'i mchod gnas rnams la zhabs tog byas tshul/de nas khri srong lde btsan gyi sras chung ba khri lde srong btsan sad na legs 'jing gis rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sngar med pa'i mdo dang sgra bsgyur/ mchod gnas bee ro tsa na dang paṇḍi ta bi shwa ka ra mchog ka ma la shī la g.yu sgra snying po la sogs pa'i mchod gnas rnams la zhabs tog rgya chen mdzad pas/ snga gong yab kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa dang mar me phul/ dgung lo bcu dgu la btsun mo lha rtse bya ba khab tu bzhes pa'i sras lding khri 'khrungs nas dgung lo bcu kasusdu ༵na dus yaba'adas/ sras lding khri'i dgung lo bcu bzhi la rgyal srid bzung / btsun mo

gsumakhab tu bzhes pas btsun mo chung ba cig la/ sras lha rje lhun thub bcas lnga 'khrungs so/ / des kyangadage 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la zhabs tog rgyas paramadzad nas/ rgyal po de dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga me mo bya lo la sgrags kyi phur la 'das so/ / der sras che ba gtsang ma ni chos la dga' ste rab tu byung / dar ma ni sdig la dga' ste rje 'os min/ bar ba ral ba can la srid gtad do/ / rgyal po mnga' bdag ral ba can de rgyal sar bton/ bka'i blon po bran kha dpal yon tan gyis byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul la sogs btsun mo che chung lnga khab tu bzhes/ dge ba bcu'i khrims btsugs/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dzi na mi dra/shī ladri bo lha/ dā na shī la la sogs pa spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ bande ye shes sde rnams kyis chos bsgyur te/ chos thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bka' bcad rnam pa gsum du mdzad do/ / tha na bre srang dang zho la sogs pa thams cad kyang spya gar dang bstun/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgom grwa btsugs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ chos sde sum cu tham par dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi 'dul grwa btsugs/ rab tu byung ba re re'i 'bas tog la 'bangs mi khyim bdun cu phul/ dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ li'i yul nas rig byed la mkhas pa'i bzo ba bos/bal po'i yul nas lha bzo dang rdo bzo ba mang po bos nas lha khang dgu thog tu mdzad pa la/ 'og gi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa rdo las grub/ bar gyi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa so phag las grub/steng gi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa shing las spub/ spya phub dgu brtsegs yod pa/ rgya phub re re'i bya 'dab bar na/ rab tu byung ba chos nyan bshad byed pa bzhugs/ de la steng gi thog gsum na rje'i thugs dam bzhugs/ bar gyi thog gsum na mchod gnas dge 'dun bzhugs/ 'og gi thog gsum na rje blon 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / de ltar rgyal po khri gtsug lde btsan ral ba can de/ mkhyen pa ni 'phrul gyi tshul chags/ mdzad pa ni lha'i lugs dang mthun/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang mnyam/ dbang dang mthu stobs kyis ni bdud sdig can skrag par byed pa/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal/ de ltar yang snga gong nas rgya bod kyi 'brel tshul/ btsan po dbon zhang rim bzhin bhon pa rnams kyi lo rgyus thog mthun nas skyes 'bul res dang / 'khon nas dmag 'dren res mdzad pa'i rnam grangs mang du mdzad/ de'ang rgya'i deb ther chen potwa thu han chan bya ba na/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya drug cu rtsa drug lon pa'i dus rgya nag gi rgyal po thang zhes bya ba byung ste/ bod kyi rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan dang dus mnyam/ de'i sras tha'i dzung rgyal po'i dus/ bod kyi spyal po srong btsan sgam po dang dus mnyam ste/ bod kyi rgyal pos rgya rje'i sras mo slong ba'i pho nya btang bas spya rjes bu mo ma byin par bod du log ste/ rgyal po la rdzun zhus nas/ rgya rje de nged rang la shin tu dga' nas bu mo ster bar yod pa la/ hor ser thu lu hun gyis rgya rje la phra ma zhus pas lan zhes zhus pas/ bod — 197 —

kyi rgyal po khros nas bod dmag 'bum phrag gcig khrid te/ zung ci'u bya ba'i sa cha bar du byon/ denarnablon po g.ya' thung bya ba la dmag bskur nas/ thu lu hun gyi yul 'joms su btang ba la/ thu lu hun rnams tsong kha'i mtsho sngon phan la bros/ de nas bod kyi rgyal pos blon po mgar dang se le stong btsan rna gnyis la rin po che sna chogs bskur nas/ rgya rje'i sras mo slong du btang bas/ 'un shing kong jo dang rjo bo shākya mu ne sogs rdzongs mang po dang bcas pa bod du slebs/ lcags pho khyi'i lo la rgyal po srong btsan sgam po 'das nas/ rgya yul nas bang so'i mchod pa la nor mang po khyer 'ongs ba'i pho nya byung ngo / de ltar rgyal po mnga' bdag ral ba can des/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dgongs nas/ dbang dge 'dun la gtad/ chos khrims dang / spyal khrims gnyis gtan la phab/ lha sa/ bsam yagadakar chung la sogs pa'i yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang rnams la zhabs tog mdzad/ bod 'bangs thams cad la dge ba bcu'i khrims bkod/ rku dang / jag dang / g.yo zol sogs byed pa med par gyur/ de ltar rgyal po chos la shin tu dga' ba de la/ sbas stag rna can la sogs pa sdig blon rnams shin tu ma dga' nas/ chos khrims 'jig pa'i gros byas nas/ rgyal po ma bkrongs na chos khrims 'jig mi thub zer/ la la na re/ rgyal po bkrongs kyang / lha sras gtsang ma dang / blon po bran kha dpal yon gnyis chos la dga' bas chos khrims 'jig mi thub zer/ der snga sor lha sras gtsang ma dang / bran kha dpal yon gnyis med par byas/ de'i rting la rgyal po bkrong bar thag bcad/ mo rtsis pa rnams la brngan pa byin nas/ thams cad kha mthun par lha sras gtsang ma 'dir bzhugs na/ sku tshe la bar chad 'ong zhing / rgyal srid 'jig par 'gyur zhes gleng nas/ lha sras gtsang ma gro mon la myugs/ de'i rjes la rgyal po la sbas stag rna can gyis phra ma zhus te/ chos blon chen po bran kha dpal gyi yon tan dang /btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul gnyis mi 'os pa'i spyod pa byas so zer nas/ chos blon chen po nyes med la skyon phab nas bkrongs/ de rjes rgyal po dgung lo sum cu so drug pa lcags mo bya'i lo la/rgyal po 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa la/ sbas stag rna can dang / cog ro lha lod gnyis kyis rgyal po'i ltag pa bskor nas bkrongs so/ 'di yan la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum dang /shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga zer/de nas sbas stag rna can la sogs pa'i sdig blon ngan pa rnams dbang che bas rgyal po glang dar ma dbu dum can bdud kyi sprul ba/ chos la mi dga' zhing sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa de rgyal sar bskos te spyal khams la dbang byas so/ / dus der paṇḍi ta dān shrī las lha sa'i shar smre ru lha khang du mtshams bcad nas/dzam lha bsgrubs pas dka' bar byung ba dang paṇḍi ta khros te/ dzam lha 'jim gzugs de'i grod par mkhar sil gyi rting pas brgyab pas/ grod pa nas gser mang po byung ba dang / de la rgyu byas te sku'i rten du kha sar pa ṇi/ gsung gi rten du gser khri/ thugs kyi rten du dngul bya khun bu can rnams bzhengs/de'i nye gnas kha che utpa las dngul kyi byams pa bzhengs/ dgongs dus kyi mchod pa btsugs/ dus — 198 ge

der sad dang ser ba dang / btsa' dang / mu ge dang / mi nad phyugs nad la sogs pa byung bas/de la snyad byas nas/ rgyal po'i thugs la gdon gsol nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsdubs so/ /rab tu byung ba rnams shan pa bcol/ la la rtags dang phral/ la la ri dwags bshor du bcug ma nyan pa rnams srog dang phral/ lha khang 'jig pa'i sngon ma lha sa la byas te/ jo bo rnams gnyis chu la bamyur dgos gsungs pa chos blon rnams kyis thabs byas te/ rang rang gi khri'i 'og tu sbas/ nang gi lder sku rnams chu la bamyur bsam nas/ phyag na rdo rje'i mgul la thag pa btags pas/ 'dogs mkhan che skad cig nas khrag skyugs nas shi bas lha khang 'jig 'phro bcad/ lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs pa'i sgo rtsig (the ru ma gtogs)gzhan lha khang chung ba thams cad bshigs/ glegs bam la la chu la bamyur/ la la mer bsregs/ la la gter bzhin sbas so/ / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po'i thugs la gdon gsol bar shes nas mya ngan drag tu byed cing mgrin gcig tu rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che smad par mi rigs/ sngar srol bzang po la dgongs nas/ yab mes kyi yig tshangs rla gzigs shig ces thams cad ngus so/ / dus der chu bo ri'i sgom grwa na/ g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/dmar shākya mu ni gsum sgom gyin yod pa la/ btsun pa cig gis sham thabs brdzis/ lag tu mda' gzhu thogs/ mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas 'phral du khyi khrid nas ri dwags bshor gyin 'dug pa g.yo dge 'byung gis mthong nas/ ban man 'khrul lam/ btsun pa smyo zer nas ri dwags pa de bstan nas khong gnyis na re/ khyed ma 'khrul/ btsun pa smyo 'dug zer te/ btsun pa de rtsar bos nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/btsun pa na re/ khyed cag gsum po rgyal po'i chad pa ma phog pa nyen re che zer nas/ chos bsnubs pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par bshad pa dang / khong gsum po shin tu skrags par gyur nas/ skad cig kyang sdod pa'i longs med par 'dul ba'i po ti drel rgyab gsum khyer nas/ byang lam la gyin nas mdo khams su bros te/dan tig shel gyi brag phug tu bzhugs/ so/ /de'i rjes la ka 'od mchog grags pa dang rong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis mngon pa dang mdzod kyi po ti mang po khyer nas khams la bros te/ san chung gnam rdzong gi brag khung du bzhugs so/ de'i dus su lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes yer ba'i brag khung na sgom byed kyin yo da pa la/ nam phyed na lha sa'i bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo byung nas da lta bod na grub thob khyed las mi 'dugaspyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar gcod byas/ rgyal po sdig can gsod ran kho mos grogs bya bas snying ma chung zhig zer ro/ / sang nye gnas la rgyu mtshan dris pas bden par 'dug nas rang gi srog blos btang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bsam ste/ rgyal po gsod spro'i spobs pa bskyed nas thabs sna tshogs byas te/ rta dkar po 'a/ sol babyugs nas nag po byas/ beer phyi nag po nang dkar po byas te gon/ mgo la zhwa nag po gon/ gdong la sol snum byugs/ ci phu thung 5 mda' gzhu bcug rta nag zhon te/ bdud nag po bkrag med yin no zhes zer te dzosar 'ongs so/ 6/ der rgyal pos rdo ring gi yi ge gzigs kyin 'dug pa'i drung du phyin te/ phya0 byed tshul byas nasmo yi dam lta darngo ba btsu/sdu te—/ phu

thung nang nas mda' gzhu bton/ phyag dang po la mtheb sprad/ gnyis pa la mda' bkang / gsum pa la rgyal po'i dpral ba la mda' brgyab nas bros so/ /rgyal pos phyag gnyis kyis dpral ba'i mda' la 'jus te mod la grongs so/ (rgyal po glang dar ma glang lo la 'khrungs/ bya lo la rgyal sa bzung / lo lnga'i bar du chos snubs/ dgung lo sum cu so brgyad lon pa'i stag lo la grongs pa yin)der ra mda' la phyogs bzhir rgyugs pas/ shar phyogs pa rnams na re/ zin la khad yod pa la dga' mo gdong nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor song zer/ lho phyogs pa rnams na re/ grib kyi chu 'gram nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ nub phyogs pa rnams na re/ shun gyi 'phrang nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/byang phyogs pa rnams na re/ mdong mkhar gdong nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ nges pa can du grib kyi mdar gdong gi chu la lte nyal byas pas/ rta la sol ba byugs pa dag ste dkar por song / zhwa nag bskyur/ gdong gi sol sdums bkrus/ beer dkar po phyir bstan nas gon te/ nga ni lha gnam thel dkar po yin no zer nas song so/ / der phyogs bzhir rgyugs pa'i ra mda' ba rnams kha ma 'cham par so so'i mdun du sprul pa re re byung bas/ 'di ni lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yin nges zer nas yer ba'i brag la 'tshol du btang ngo / / der dpal gyi rdo rjes brag khung der/ bsam gtan la yod pa'i lugs su byas/ phug ron cig bzung nas sa rdul 'bebs su bcug de'i steng du mug ma dang grog sbrur la sogs pa btang bas de rnams kyi rjes mis mthong ba dang min par shes nas log go /mi rig pa dang ldan pa cig nang du byung ste/ khong gi snying gar lag pa bzhag pa dang / snying 'dar ba shes te/ spyi'i tha ma la/sgos su shol mi gcog zer nas song ngo / / de nas shin tu skrags par gyur te/ skad cig kyang sdod pa'i longs med par yang khams phyogs su bros nas/ khams dang rgyal mo rong gis sgrub phug re re la rgyal po glang dar ma bgrongs ba'i 'gyod bshags su lha khang brgya dang mchod rten brgya dang brgyad bzhengs pas dam bca' byas/ mthar rgyal mo tsha ba rong ra hu mdo rdzongs gnya' ltag sgrub phug tu mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa brgya dang brgyad tshang par byas pas na phug pa de la brgya rtsa brgyad zhes grags so/ /bcu gcig bod du bstan pa phyi dar skabs su mkhas grub dang dgon sde byung tshul/e ma ho/ chos rgyal mes dbon mkhyen brtse'i nam mkha' la/ /thub bstan nyi ma'i bod yul gsal ba'i dus/ /sdig rgyal dar ma'i sgra gcan gdong ba yis/ /chu mo phag nas drug cu rtsa brgyad bar/ /mun pa'i rgyal khams bzhin du nag por sgrib/ /bod khams phal cher bstan pa'i sgra mi grags/ /bstan 'dzin thams cad gab dang 'bros dgos bcom/ / dbus gtsang mthil du chos min sna tshogs dar/ / rgyal khrims chen po'ang rang kha sil bur thal/ /de la rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bzod par/ /mnga' bdag tshwa la na yis thugs rgyud bskul/ / bla chen spyan sngar chos zhu rim par brdzangs/ / bstan pa'i me ro smad nas blangs tshul dang / / phyi dar byung bar 'byung lugs 'di ltar snang / / zha lu bu ston chen po'i chos 'byung las/ bod yul kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phyi dar byung tshul/ 'dul ba smad dngha 200 —

'dul grags pa 'di'i bshad rgyud ni/ ston pa sangs spyas/ nye bar 'khor/ kun dka' bo/ sha na'i gosacan/ nyer sbas/ lhar ti ka/ nag po legs mthong / blos mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/spyokya 'od/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ che chung gnyis/ de gnyis ka/ seng ge'i gdong can/ des dha na she la dang / dzi na mi dra/ des cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des g.yo dge 'byung / gatreng rab gsal/dmar shākya mu nee gsum la bshad do/ /de mtshams bod rgyal glang dar mas/ bstan pa snubs pa'i skabs su/ g.yo gtsang dmar gsum gyis dpal chu bo ri nas 'dul ba drel khal gcig bkal nas/ stod phyogs la bros/ hor yul bskor nas/ mdo smad an chung gnam rdzong / dan tig shel gyi lha khang du thebs dus/ bon rgan mu zi gsal bzang gi bu mu zi gsal 'bar bya ba lo bco lnga lon pa zhig dang mjal/de shin tu dad nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ 'dul ba'i las chog kar ma sha tam gyi dpe bstan nas/'di ltar nus na rab tu byung ngo gsungs pa la/ 'di bzhin cis kyang nus pas/ rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ shin tu dad nas mchi ma byung ngo / / der gtsang gi mkhan po g.yos slob dpon nas/ dge tshul gyi ming mkhan slob sbyar nas dge ba gsal du btags so/ / phyis zugs rab che bas/ dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ de nas lo gcig song ba dang / bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas/ dge slong lnga ma tshang ba'i mi yong gsungs nas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes ni/ ngas rgyal po bsad pas byar mi rung pas gzhan nas btsal zhes gsungs te/ rgya nag ha shang gyi wang dang / gyi wan bye ba btang byung ba dang / sngar gyi mkhan slob kyi mkhan po dang dmar gyis gsang ston byas/ spya'i dge slong gnyis pos kha skongs byas te/lnga'i tshogs kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad pa'i mtshan la dgongs pa rab gsal du grags shing / de rting mkhan slob gnyis la/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa man chad rnams zhus/ las slob gtsang rab gsal la/ bra ka ra sde brgyad zhus/ de nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi slob ma snga ba khams kyi zog po drug tu bya ba byung ste/ ya gong ye shes g.yung drung dang / par rin chen gsal/ 'al ba rdo rje dbang phyug gnubs phag shi te/ rjo bo ye shes seng ge cog no shes rab byang chub rnams yin/ dang po mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas/ gzugs btsun byas/ 'dul ba la sogs pa'i chos rnams ni gnang / bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba/ zhwa theb kyi mu thums sa dang / bla gos kyi mtha' tshems/ gtor bu/ ka li'i nang rnams sngon por byas pa yang / khong drug po la gnang bar byed cing / de ni bla chen/ dang po bon po'i ba da par song ba'i thugs zhen brda' mazan du byas pa'o/ / yang par gnyis kyi slob ma/ drum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des drum g.yung drung spyal mtshan sheng lag can la bshad do/ —/de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan/ bsam yas su yum brtan brgyud kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag tshwa la na yab sras kyis tshor skus/ dbus gtsang gi mi drug gam bcu bla chen dpon slob la rab byung dang chos zhus pa la gtong dus/ tsāshing lag can la los ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshong btsun shes rab seng ges 'dul ba zhusarṣa gasdong du dar bar bya'o/ / klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang / sum pa ye shes blo gros kyis zhus nas/ dzābus stod smad du dar bar ’ — 201 —

bya'o/ /ya 'a btsun shākya spyal mtshan gyis zhus/ dbus su dar zhing / de nas/ lo ston na re/ khyodamitsho 'di kar sdod cig nga dbus gtsang du phyin la/ bstan pa dar nus mi nus brtags pas/ nugaspyo bldad kyi/ khyed rnams yar byon/ mi nus na nga yang mar la log yong gsungs nas/ ldan ma'i tshorna dang 'grogs te byon pas/ tshong ba rnams gsum 'azang du tshong sprad nas/ phyir bzlog par 'dod 'dug pa la/ khyod rnams 'dir tshong ma sprad pa gtsang du song la/ 'gur mo rab kha bya ba na lo nag gtsug san bya ba yod kyi/ de la khyod kyi bu rab tu byung nas/ dbus na yod gyis shig byas nas btang bas/ 'azin 'phrod/ tsheng yang legs su byung bas/ deng sang bar du 'gur mo'i tshong 'dus byung ge 'di'ang lo ston gyi drin yin no/ / thams cad dbus su 'dus pa dang / sngon mkhas btsun rnams kyi gdan sa lha sa yin yang / chad pa gcod pa'i sa yin pas/ 'gro ma nus par bsam yas su byon/ 'bre ston tshul khrims gzhon nus gtsang du 'dul ba dar bar byas/ rma byang chub 'od kyis kyang khams su bug nas/ smad tshe dar bar byas pa la sogs pa de phyin/ 'dul ba'i bshad rgyun so sor zhes pa mang ngo /de ltar bod yul 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyi/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bstan pa la ni/ deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhing / a mes bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang / bod rgyal yum brtan rgyud kyi mnga' bdag tshwa la na yab sras/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu dang bcas pa de rnams kyi thugs rje dang mdzad 'azin la brten nas/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas blangs/bod yul mun pa'i snag rum gsal te dgon pa mang po btab/ bshad nyan gyi bstan pa dar zhing spyas par mdzad pas na/ bka' drin shin tu che'o/ /'dul ba smad 'dul grags pa 'di'i bshad rgyun ni/ ston pa sangs spyas/ nye bar 'khor/ kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ lhar ti ka nag po legs mthong / blos mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/ chos kyi bshes gnyen sogs dang / gzhan yang song ge'i gdong can/ des dha na shi la dang / dzi na mi dra/ des cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rabagasal/ dmar shākya mu nee gsum la bshad do/ /gsang sngags kyi bstan pa de la/ partsi ta smreti byon pa'i yan chod la gsang sngags rnying ma zhes bya'o/ / spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku su ra sogs gdan drangs nas thon mi bcas kyi gsang sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur/ de rjes dus rabs baspyad pa'i nang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs rgya gar nas slob dpon pad ma sam bha ba dang de'i slob ma bee ro tsa na'i lung bstan pas/ paṇa chen ji ma la mi dra sogs spya gar nas gdan drangs nas slob dpon bee ro tsa na sogs lo tsā ba mang po dang lhan du gsang sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur/ de nas dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug parnyi ta smri ti bod du rsābs pa'i bar bsgyur ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams la gsang sngogs rnying ma zhes zer ro/ /— 202 ge

le'u bcu gsum pa/ ston pa'i rnam thar/༄7/ /'phags yul rin chen gling nas dgos 'dod 'byung / /shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dbang gi spyal/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa ded dpon bka' drin las/ / gangs ri'i mu khyud can gyi ljongs 'di la/ /legs par drangs te skye rgu'i dad pa'i zhing / /rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon par mchod pa'i gnas/ /phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus char rgyun 'babs/ / ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rags tsam gleng / /dang po/ ston pa shākya brab pa sku bltams pa'i chul/ston pa shākya thub pa zhes pa de yang skyes bu ga 'dra zhig yin pa dang / khong gis nang pa sangs spyas pa'i bstan pa ji ltar 'dzugs par mdzad pa/ khong gis rgya gar sogs lo rgyus thog tu nus pa ga 'dra zhig thon yod ce na/ sa bcad dang po/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i rnam thar rags tsam dang / gnyis pa/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de spyir rang rgyal du ji ltar dar ba dang bod dbus su dar rgyas byung chul/gsum pa/ grub mtha' so so byung tshul lo/ sa bcad dang po/ ston pa shākya thub pa sku bltams pa'i skor/'dzam gling thog ha cang mtho ba'i ri bo hi ma la ya zhes shin tu che ba'i srung yol zhig dang mtshungs par rgya gar skam sa chen po'i byang phyogs su ke rer langs pa te/ rang spyal bod ljongs kyi yar klung gtsang po de gangs ri'i byang ngos kyi ri klung chen po rgyud nas/ lho ngos rgya gar shar rgyud kyi chu bo gang gā dang 'dres nas mthar bhang ga la'i mtsho khug nas rgya mtshor 'bab/chu bo gang gā'i dkyil smad rgyud du sa gshis gathin po le dbar stong las 'das pa/ char chu 'dzoms shing gnam gshis dro grang snyom po/ skye dngos thams cad dus bzhir lo 'dab rgyas pas/ glang chen dang /sha ba/ ba glang / ra lug sogs sems can sna tshogs phyogs bzhir rgyu ba/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo ngo stong gi ring la yul 'dir gnas pa'i ā rwa'i li dang / da lo pis tho'i mi rnams gnas tsher shing tshang tshing bcad de mer bsregs btang rjes sa rgod rnams sa zhing gshin por bsgyur/spyi lo'i gong gi lo lnga brgya drug brgya'i skabs rang rgyal gyi khrun chi'u dus smad tsam la spya gar du rgyal khab bcu drug tsam tshugs yod la/ de'i nang snyan grags che gras la mang gha rsā/ ko sa la/ anā ka sa 'dzin/ li tsa byi(yangs pa can)sogs kyi rgyal phran 'di tsho'i bar rang rang gi mnga' khongs dang / rgya gar yongs la dbang sgyur byed pa'i dbang cha chen po 'phrog res byed phyir dmag 'khrugs yang yang byung /de dus rgya gar ni gral rim gyi spyi chosas su slebs zin pa'i rkyen gyis yul mi'i nang du rigs rim pa bzhi ru dge/ rigs mtho shos la bram ze'i rigs zhes mchog ces bya ba ni rgya gar gyi chos lugs rigs — 203 —

shig yin/ khong tshos rang nyid lha yi sku tshab yin pa'i snang ba 'char nas rigs rus kyi go gnas mtho zhibagatsang ba zhig yin snyam/(rgya gar gyi chos lugs kyi ming la bram ze zer zhing)de dus rgyal khab kyi srid don nam yang na khyispotshang gi 'cho ba tshang mar chos kyi cho ga re ci nas kyang byed dgos pa dang / cho ga de tsho bram ze'i rigs kyimibadag 'dzin byed pa las/ gzhan gyis byas na khrims lugs dang mi mthun par brtsi gi yod/rigs gnyis pa ni rgyal rigs zhes pa'i dmag dpon rigs yin/ (dpung las skyes kyang zer)khong tshos rgyal po dang zhi drag dpon rigs kyi go gnas bzung ste/ bram ze dang 'dra bar khong tsho yang ṭāpy-idī trīṭwāṃ /gral rim gyi khongs su gastogs shing / ngal rtsol mi dmangs la bshu gzhog byed pa la brten nas rigs gsum pa ni rje rigs te/ gtso bo zhing pa daca / lag shes bzo las pa/ tshong pa sogs las grub/ khong tshor khral bogs 'jal rgyu dang / 'u lag rgyug rgyu'i 'os 'gan yod/ rigs bgi pa ni dmangs rigs te gtso bo bran g.yog dang / gla pa/ khyim stong zhing pa sogs las spub/ khong tsho'i go gnas ha cang dma' zhing / rang gi bdag po'i zhing rmo ba/ lo tog brnga ba/ phyugs 'tsho ba/ khyim las ci ba bcas byed rgyu'i las 'gan yod/ de min da dung ha cang mthong chung byed pa'i dman pa zhig yod pa der gdol pa'i rigs zer/ khong tshos bshas las byed rgyu dang / gsang spyod 'don rgyu/ gad rgyag rgyu sogs kyi las ka kho na yin cing / gdol rigs tshos rigs gzhan gyi mi dang thug 'phrad byed mi chog der brten phathug 'azad mi chog mkhan7yang zer/ gdol pa'i rigs ni grong khyer byi rol dathen pa'i lung kyog tu ma gastogs dong mi chog la grong pa'i khrom lam du 'gro na dang po shing sgra brdungs nas mi rnams zur g.yol byed du 'jug dgos/ gong gsal gyi rigs mtho dman tshor so so dang mtshungs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas dang / dbang cha 'os 'gan/ 'tsho ba'i spyod tshul sogs 'dzin nas phan tshun bar gnyen mi bsgrig pa'i srol de mi rabs rim brgyud du dar spel byung yod/bran bdag sku drag gis rus rigs kyi rim ldan lam lugs de gtan gnas yong ched mi sems sbrid pa'i bram ze'i chos gsar du spel/ bram ze tshos pha tshangs pa7 (bram ze chos lugs kyi lha zhig gi ming)ni 'jig rten sbrun mkhan gyi gtso bdag yin/ bram ze ni tshangs pa'i zhal nas 'khrungs/ rgyal rigs ni de'i phrag pa nas 'khrungs/ rje rigs ni lte ba nas 'tshongs/ rkang mjil nas dmangs rigs skyes zer/der brten rigs rus kyi mtho dman byung / mi tshang mas tshangs pa'i dgongs par bskun dgos pa ste/de ni bram ze'i chos kyi don la bskun dgos pa'ang yin/ bram ze'i chos tshul khrims dang mthun par byas na shi nas mtho ris su skye/ de las ldog na daskyal bar lhang / mi lus skyes nas shi ba'i bar 'khor lo bzhin khyun mi chad par bskyar du 'khor bas/ 'di'i ming du dzi 'khor ba7zhes zer/ der brten mi ni skye ba sngon tram̐'i ༵༵ kyirji bskos pas/ skye ba snyi ma bde bar yong bsam na bshu gzhog dang bran bkol dang du

na dgos tshul sgrogs/ bram ze'i chos ni de ltar byas nas mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'ching bar byed pa'i bsam pa'i lcags sgrog zhig tu gyur/spyi lo'i gong gi lo lnga brgya lhag tsam la/ shākya'i mi rnams kyis ri bo gyi ma la ya'i lho ngos su rangagi rgyal khab cig btsugs te de'i ming la ser skya zhes zer/ de ni deng skabs bal po rgyal khab kyi lu min tha'i mtshams g.yin la/ shākya thub pa'i 'khrungs yul yang yin/ sor skya'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal po zas gtsang ma go'u ta ma'i rigs yin pa de ni shākya thub pa'i yab yin/rgyal po zas gtsang ni dmangs kyi bde sdug rtogs pa dang / mi dmangs kyi snug bsngal la sems 'khur gnang ba zhig yin cing / rtag par sku ngo ma zhing rmo sar beebs nas zhing 'bangs la thon skyed legs par gnyer dgos pa'i skul ma gnang gi yod/ khong gis blon 'bangs rnams la khog yangs gnang zhing byams skyong che ba dang / btson pa rnams la drag po tsub spyod kyi khrims mi gcod par/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis rgyal srid bskyangs nas bang mdzod 'bru yis bkang / ra bar myugs kyis khengs/ mi 'bor myur du 'phel/ stobs ldan rgyal khab cig tu gyur nas sa phyogs kun tu snyan pa'i grags pas khyab par gyur/ser skya'i rgyal khab kyi khyim mtshes rgyal khab ni lhas bstan zhes pa de yin stabs rgyal tshang gnyis bar sngar nas bzung phan tshun gnyen lam 'brel cing rgyal po zas gtsang mas sngar rgyun ltar lhas bstan rgyal po'i bu mo gnyis mna' mar bsus/ bu mo rgan par sgyu 'asrul ma dang bu mo gzhon par skye dgu'i bdag mo zer/gcen gcung 'di gnyis mdzes sdug che zhing gshis khyud 'jam po/ rang bzhin bzang ba/ 'du tshogs bsrun zhing dben pa'i nags tshal du gnas par dga' ba yin/spyal po zas gtsang dang btsun mo'i bar phan tshun mdza' brtse gting zab ldan na'ang / btsun mor sras ma 'khrungs pas rgyal por rgyal rgyud 'dzin mkhan med la/ khyi tshogs thog tu'ang bu rgyud la rtsa chen b.ri ba'i srol rgyun yod pas yid mi bde ba skyes pa dang / bram ze'i chos las bu la brten na 'jig rten dbang du 'du/ bu tsha la brten rnam shes rdzogs pa med/ yang tsha la brten dag pa'i zhing du bgrod ces 'khod pa ni rgod bro'i dzun gtam tsam las ma 'das rung / chos lugs kyi bkyig bldam dam por byas pa'i gna' bo'i rgya gar gyi mi tshos der yid ches 'jog stabs rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang rtag tu spyod bzang snyan ldan rdo /// bram ze rgan pa dang grub thob nus ldan rnams gdan drangs te myur du bu gnang ba'i smon 'dun btsun mo sgyu 'phrul ma dgung lo banee bcu zhe lngar son skabs su dkar gsal bla 'od 'phro ba'i mtshan dgung zhig tu/ khong gzim khri'i steng du 'phred nyal mdzad nas spyan btsum ma thag bar snang nas rab mdzes thal dkar glang chen gzhon nu zhig zla 'od dang mnyam du mar babs te khong gi brang khog g.yas par thim par mis/ de nas bzung khong mngal dang ldan no/ /de'i skabs rgya gar du chos kyi cho ga spel rgyur mthong ha cang chen po bzhag nas mi tshe'i ri~X ༵ garji che'i

don chen rer mchod 'bul gyi byed sgo re spel dgos/ gal te mchod 'bul dang kha bral na nyin gcig kyasda 'tsho ba mi 'khyol ba snang / btsun mo mngal chags rjes rgyal po'i pho brang du rnam pa bsnyen bkur sna tshogamisdoshāshā /de mngal zhugs la 'tshe ba mi 'ong ba dang bde ldan ngang btsa' zub pa'i smon lam zhu khyu ni sgrogaci de dus kyi yul goms ltar na/ bud med sprum nas zla ba kha shas long mtshams su a ma'i khyim du log nas skye bsu byed/ der brten bu btsa' ran pa'i skabs su btsun mo sgyu 'phul ma ser skya'i rgyal po'i pho brang nas zhal gyis te lhas bstan gyi yul du 'byon par brtsams/ nam sros so khong ser skya'i grong gi nye 'dab lum ji na'i skyed mos tshal du 'byor/ 'di ni mo'i yab kyis khong gi ched du bajin pa'i mdzes sdug yid 'ong skyed mos tshal zhig yin/ de'i nang du drang zhing ring ba'i thang shing mdzes rtsag sgeg mos g.yural ngoms/ ngo mtshar dri bzang can gyi sna mang me tog tshon mdangs 'gran/ dwangs pa'i mtshe'ur padma rigs can sna tshogs rab tu bzhad/ mtshe'u nang nas rgya lcang mar gad nor bu ltar gyi myug phran 'char/dmar po'i me tog sngon po'i lo 'dab phan tshun 'od zer 'phro/ btsun mo sgyu 'phul ma sku ngal nas shing sa ༵sdi /ṭī/ po zhig gi 'og tu bzhugs te mal gso zhing zhal ta ma rnams kyis bkur sti zhabs tog spya noms dus 'di ni yid dbang 'phrul pa'i dpyid mjug gi mtshan mo zhig ste/ skyed tshal khrod du lhag par dpen zhing / rlung bser bus phyogs yongs nas me tog gi dri zhim 'thul ba/ zla gsar shin tu mtho ba'i nam mkhar dpyangs pa ltar shar/ ljon shing rnams kyi yal 'dab ni g.yo 'gul tsam yang med stabs btsun mo sgru 'phrul ma'i yid lhag par sbri zhing bag phebs par gyur/ tho rings skar chen 'od chem chem 'phro ba'i nam sgad du khong gi phyag g.yas pas ljon shing mya ngan med kyi yal gar 'tham rte zhi lhod ngang bzhugs skabs glo bur du rlung bsil bu zhig g.yos pas btsun mo sgyu 'phrul ma'i lto bar cung na zug gi tshor snang zhig shar te/ cung ma song bar khye'u zhig 'khrungs so/ /de'i dus ni spyi lo'i sngon lo lnga brgya drug cu re lnga so nam lo yi zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad yin la/ nyin der ston pa shākya thub pa sku bltams/ sku bltams ma thag pa'i shākya thub pa ni/ lang tsho'i mtshan sdug rdzogs shing / sku lus stobs dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing dul ba'i dpal nyams dang ldan pa yin cing / yum sras gnyis zhal ta ma rnams kyis bskor nas ser skya'i grong gi pho brang du phyir phebs/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis bram ze kha shas gdan drangs nas bde skyid yong ba'i phyag dbang gnang nas sras kyi mtshan du don grub ces btags so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang bgres po la sras 'di lta bu 'khrungs par dga' spro rab tu skyes te sras 'tshar long byung rjes rang nyid kyi rgyal rgyud 'dzin pa dang bya bzhag gsar du bsgrun te rgya gar dbang du bci ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa bcangs/ der brten/ bu de rgyal por mnga' gsol/mdzes sdug shes rig ldan pa'i zhal ta ma bdam nas ma mar bzhag rgya gar gyi grang dus (lo ltar zla ba — 206 —

bcu pa nas lo rjes ṭā'i bla ba gnyi/ga pabar)rdo'idus(zlabagasum pa nas lnga pa'i bar)char du sa ( ba sprapy-isnasan sdosad shā dī treb /༵ ṭwāṃṭā byetādhi 3/ṭwāṃ ༵la ga/nam gshis kyi khyad par la gzhigs pa'i pho brang gsum rgyal sras don thub 'khrungs nas nyin bdun song ba'i rjes su yum sgyu 'phrul ma sku gshegs/ sru mor rgyur ba'i btsun mo skye dgu'i bdag mos de nas bzung rgyal sras gso skyong mdzad pa'i 'khur bzhes/btsun mo skye dgu'i bdag mos rgyal sras la snying brtse che zhing rang nyid kyi lus nas skyes pa'i phru gu bzhin skyong /su mo'i slob skyong gi 'og spyal sras chung dus nas rang rgyud zhi zhing dul ba dang / gshis rgyud 'jam pas/pho brang gi zhal ta ma rnams kyis khong la ha cang dga' ba zhus/bram ze tsho'i chos las phru gu lo bdun du smrebs skabs gzhi nas slob sbyong byed khyu'i gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar rgyal po zas gtsang gis rgyal yongs su snyan grags can gyi bram ze mkhas pa srin bu go cha rgyal bu'i slob dpon du bkur/ de dus nges par slob sbyong byed dgos pa ni/ rig byed〉bzhi phud da dung tshad ma/sgra/ yi ge/ brtag pa/ rtsis rig skar rtsis/ mchod sbyin/ smon lam/ sgyu ma/ bzo rtsal/sgrul dasnaṭā //snasbya nga shādi sdu rdo // ga/nas dang rgyu rtsal yin pas de dag la sbyangs par mdzad/de skabs slob sbyong jed dus slob deb med par tshang ma slob dpon gyi ngag slob la brten dgos/rgyal bu don thub ni rang bzhin gyi shes rab ldan pa ma zad/ dka' spyad snying rus kyis slob sbyong mdzad de khong gis slob dpon gyi ngag slob mdzad pa'i shes yon rnams mi brjed par blor bzung thub pa ma zad/ da dung der rnam dpyod kyis rig 'ded mdzad nas dus tshod 'ga' tsam gyi 'bad brtson gnang rjes bslab bya'i sde tshan rnams khong du chud pa ma zad/ bsam zhib rnam daphyod kyi goms pa chags nas bsam pas don 'tshol rigs 'gres yon tan yang rtogs/ khong dus rtag tu me tog gi tshal gyi ljon pa'i bsil grib tu bzhugs nas ci yang mi smra bar dgongs pa bzhes pa'i skabs der phyogs bzhir sgra med 'jam theng der yod skabs khong gi dgongs pa ni 'dab gshog gnyis brkyangs pa ltar rgyang ring du 'phur/rgyal bu yon tan la thos bsam byed pa'i 'dod pa che stabs slob dpon gyis bslabs pa rnams phud/da dung ngoms pa med par de skabs khong du chud thub pa'i yon tan gsar pa yongs rdzogs la sbyong bar /rā//sa 'oṭā ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃkton/ khong gi yon tan rgya yangs shing gting mtha' bral bar gyur par slob dpon gyis kyang nyin gcig slob dpon gyis rgyal bu la 'jig rten du yig rigs ji tsam yod ces dris par/ rgyal bus yig rigs drug cu re bzhi yod ces gsungs pa dang mtshungs/ yig rigs drug cu re bzhi'i ming ci yin gsungs pa ma zad/ pha o ’dang pha ang7 zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis chos dpe'i mgor 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang mkhyen par gsal/ — 207 —

de yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab nang 'khod par gzhigs na/ chus lu zhes pa gna' rabs rgya gar gyi yi ge gsar gartod byed mkhan zhig yin/ des yig 'byu bdun cu don gagyis bzos te chus lu'i yi gozhes zer/ de skabs mi tshos pedaspyod byed ma 'dod pas chus lus khong khros te yig 'byu rnams gyir brtsaspote khog nang du mid/ de dus pha o7dang pha ang7zhes pa'i yig 'bya gnyis kha khug nas phyir don pas mi rnams kyis der rtsa chen yin pa bsam nas yi ge'i rgyal por brtsis nas ṭwāṃ rig byed chos〉 sogs kyi mgor bzhag ste/ chus lu'i yi ger gus bkur byas par mtshon/ sangs spyas kyi gsung rab nang 'di 'dra
