'khod pa de'i thog nas shākya thub pa gzhon nu'i dus su shes bya'i rigs la mkhas shing byang chub pas/ snyan 'jebs yid 'phrog pa dang / ngo mtshar sne 'dzoms kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud mang po mkhyin par mchon/des na de'i rjes su khong gis dmangs khrod du gson nyams ldan ging / go bde ba'i sgo nas rang gyid kyi chos do/ /sdu /pya /sgra/ṭwāṃ shāsdo/ par rogs ram chen po byung /rgyal po zas gtsang gis rang nyid kyispas 'di slad mar gnam 'og tu 'gran zla bral ba'i pha 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po7zhig tu 'argyur ched/ 'gran rtsal rtser son gyi sku rtsal dpa' bo yang gdan drangs nas rgyal bur/ rta rgyug mda' 'phen/ gri g.yug mdung rtsal/ khu tshur sogs kyi dmag 'dzings 'thab rtsal rnams bslabs te dka' spyad kyi skyong brdar rgyud rgyal bus tshang ma re re bzhin khong du chud/ rgyal bu'i dpung shugs kun las che bas dus yun mi ring bar 'thab rtsal kun la byang chub pa'i mkhas par gyur/rgyal po zas gtsang gis rang nyid kyi rgyal sras zhi drag gnyis 'jon du rgyur pa mthong ste yid rab tu mgu/ rgyal bur snyan grags yong ba dang / spyal khab kyi zil nyams ngom ched bka' phab nas 'gran rtsal rgya che zhig btsugs/ rgyal bo don thub khong gis shākya'i rigs kyi sku drag bu phrug dang / 'bangs khrod kyi rtsal chen rnams dang lhan du 'gran/ go thos ltar na/ rgyal bu grong khyer gyi sgor thon skabs glang po che zhig gis lam du bkag don thub glang chen gyi gam du bskyod nas phyag gis glang po che bkyags nas lam zur du bzhag khor yug tu gnas mis mthong skabs tshang mas bsngags pa 'dzad med brjod/'gran rtsal mgo tshugs skabs/ mtha' skor du ltad mo bas khengs/ mda' 'gran byed skabs su slob dpon kyis gzhu thad par don grub kyis gzhu de 'gug shugs chung thal bas gzhu bdun mnyam du bsdoms nas mda' gcig gis lcags slang bdun phug spe ga 'gran skabs lhas byin dang gcung po gnyis ka mnyam du sar brnabs/ de min gyi 'gran rtsal tshang ma rgyal bu'i 'gran rtsal khyad du 'phags par dga' spro'i thal sgra mtshams mi chad/ khong tshos phyin chad rgyal khab kyi rten sa yod do zer ba'i sgras khengs so/ /de ltar don grub dgung lo bcu bdun gyi skabs su phul byung gi sbyang 'bras kyis slob pa'i las 'gan bsgrubs nas/ zas gtsang gis bu na tshod lon pa dang bstun nas/ shes rab dang dpa' rtsal gnyis 'dzoms sdurdzu ༵la rgyud 'dzin pa'i ཿ thun rkyen 'dzoms par mthong ste/ blon chen rnams dang bka' bgros

te spyal sras yin par dngos su mnga' gsol/ gna' rabs rgya gar gyi goms srol gzhir bzung nas rgyal gras mnga' gsol ba la dbang bskur gyi bya bzhag bsgrubs/ mnga' dbang skur skabs rgyal ja dril bu mnyam du dkrol/ sku dbyangs zhabs bro mnyam 'khrab byas nas bram ze dang arya'i blon chen rnams gyis rgya mtsho'i chu blugs pa'i rin po che'i bum pa rigs bdun rgyal por phul/ rgyal pos rin po che'i bum pa'i nang gi rgya mtsho'i chu rgyal sras kyi dbu la stor rjes nor bu'i tham ka bdun phul/ de ltar don spub dngos su ser skya'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal sras su mnga' dbang bkur/ rgyal sras don grub la bsu ba rgyal po zas gtsang dang yum btsun mo gnyis blon bcas kyis gzugs byad mtshar sdug dang / yon tan shes rab yongs su thogs pa'i mdzangs ma zhig 'tshol rgyur thag bcad/ lhas bstan grong gi rgyal po legs pa rab sad kyi bu mo grags 'dzin ma ni nyams bzang zhing gshis spyod drang ba/ rgyan cha sbam zhing mams pa/ mdzangs ma'i yon tan rjogs shing bzhin byad rab mdzes kun las 'phags pa'i bu mo zhig yin/ nyin gcig grags 'dzin ma 'khor mo snan dang bcas grong khyer gyi phyi rdol du bskyod skabs grong khyer gyi sgo rtsar langs bsdad pa'i don spub kyis mthong bas na kho mo'i mtshar sdug gis yid dbang 'phrog ste de ni dngos 'brel rgyun ring bral ba'i snying gi grogs po dang bskyar du phrad pa ltar phan tshun 'dzem bag med par gleng mol byas/grags 'dzin ma dang rgyas sras don grub gnyis mdza' sems gcig tu bsgril te dga' res byas/rgyal po zas gtsang dang btsun mo gnyis kyis kyang rgyal sras la bu mo 'di bsu rgyur ha cang mos kyang /lhas bstan gyis rgyal po'i sras don grub kyi yon tan dang sgyu rtsal la gdeng ma khel te/ ci nas kyang 'gran tshol thengs shig bsdur nas/ dngos su rgyalasras kyi sgyu rtsal dang dpa' stobs la lta dgos rgyu mthar bskyal/rtsal 'gran tshogs sa de rgyal po zas gtsang gi pho brang gi rgyal rwar tshogs/ rtsal sna ni khu tshur 'gran pa/ral kha 'gran pa/ mda' 'gran pa/ mdung 'gran sogs yod/ rgyal po'i sras dang rgyal rigs kyi tsha bo mang po yod pa sud/ de min 'bangs kyang zhugs chog par byas/ 'gran rtsal thang du gser gyi 'khar rnga bdun bzhag yod par rgyal sras kyi nye du lhas byin gyis mdas gser gyi 'khar rnga gsum phug nas thal mo'i sgra yis do rwa yongs rdzogs khengs/ rgyal sras don grub la res mos 'khor skabs khong ni da dung gzhu shugs chung drags nas mes po'i gzhu chen sus kyang bkug mi thub pa de len par mngags nas blangs/don spub kyis shugs kyis bkug nas 'phangs bas mda' thengs gcig gis gser gyi 'khar ja bdun phug nas rtse sa'i nang du 'dzul ba dang glo bur du chu 'go zhig brdol nas chu bo 'bus/ de min gyi 'gran rtsal khag tshang ma rgyal sras rnam par rgyal/ rgyal po legs pa rab sad kyis 'gran rtsal bltas rjes blo bde sems skyid kyis gnyen bsgrig gtam 'dun la khas blangs so/ /gnyis ba/ rgyal srasargyal grid du mnga' gsol ba/don thub rgyal srid du mnga' gsol/ 'jo sgeg yid 'ong gi btsun mo dang mnyam du 'grogs/rab mdzes gzhon nu mas zhabs stog legs po bsgrubs/ dngos 'brel 'phyor phyug gzi stobs rgyas pa'i — 209 ge

'tsho ba'i khrod du gnas/'on kyang don grub ni 'dod pa'i yon tan dang longs spyod la zhe 'dzin med pa 'asnyor phyug dngakaudabang shugs snyan grags sogs ma bzi bar/ 'jig rten 'di'i bar dang mtshams bcad pa'i pho brang gyinang du 'tshar longs byung ba'i rgyal sras chen po zhig yin par brten/ chung dus nas bsam zhib byed paranyi goms shing / khong pho brang gi phyi rol tu byon skabs gang mthong ba thams cad gsar pa gsar skyung gi snang ba 'byung ba ma zad/ tshor snang gting zab skyes nas bsam zhib sna tshogs yang yang byed dgos pa byung /(1)rkye ba'i rdzug bsngal mthong ba'i skor/dpyid 'go'i nyin gcig rgyal po rgyal sras dang / blon chen dang dpa' rtul rnams kyis mtha' bskor nas grong mthar rgyan gzigs su phebs/ mig mdun du brel 'tshab can gyi dpyid 'debs kyi nam dus shar ba dang tag tag 'phrad/ rgyal sras kyis zhing pa rnams khog stod gcer bu byas te lcag tshan gyis ma lhar brabs nas sa zhing rmo slog rgyag pa dang / thong gshol gyis slog pa'i sa'i nang nas 'bu phra mos 'gul tsam 'gul tsam byed pa/ de 'phral 'dab chags khyu zhig 'phur yong nas 'bu de rnams mchu tosagason por sgrug zos pa gzigs te khong 'phral mar 'bu de rnams la snying rje'i sems bskyed/ khong gis yang glang rgas pa zhig thang chad nas dbugs hal bzhin du thong gshol 'then/ lus yongs nas jul chu 'dzin pa/ da dung lcag tshan yang yang gzed dgos pa gzigs skabs spyal sras kyis glang rgan de'i chag sgo la yang snying rje skyes/ de nas rmo 'debs byed mkhan gyi zhing pa la gzigs skabs/ khong tsho'i spyon pa hral byul yin pa/ tsha gdung che ba'i nyi 'od kyis 'tshigs shing / ngal rtsol byed thal drags pas sked pa sgur/stod sgal 'bur/ gos med zas nyung gis gdong ser po gyur/ nyam thag pas lus sha skam nas rus mgo pags btum ltar gyur/ rgyal sras kyis rnam dbyibs de ltar gzigs skabs yid rab tu skyo nas/ ljon shing zhig gi 'og tu bzhugs te/ 'jam dzing thing ngang nas ji ltar byas nas 'jig rten steng gi sems can(mi'i rigs dang srog chags thams cad)rnams sdug bsngal las thar bar byed thub bam snyam pa'i dgongs pa bzhes/ rgyal pos rgyal sras thugs mi bde zhing bzhin mdangs dman pa mthong nas pho brang du phyir phebs rjes/ gos chen gyi na bza' dang zas rigs zhim mngar mang po gnang / da dung pho brang glu gar la shin tu mkhas pa'i zhal ta ma mang po btang nas rgyal sras spro bar byas na yang / spyal sras ni 'di tshor yid mi 'gro bar mu mthud du sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar thabs la dgongs pa gtad/(2)gsami'i sdug bsngalasngathong ba'i skor/ser skya'i grong khyer gyi shar lho nub byang gi sgo bzhir ljongs dbyibs legs shing yid 'ong mdzes sdug can gyi me tog skyed tshal re yod/ nyin gcig rgyal sras sku 'khor mang po dang bcas grong sgor shar phyogs kyi skyed tshal du spro 'cham la pebs pa'i lam bar du rgad po zhig phrad/ de ni sma ra dang dbu skra tshang ma dung ltaraka ka~X 1dīng —/ sked pa gug cing stod sgal 'bur ba zhig 'khar rgyug btsugs nas dka' ba'i gom

'arjog gis lam du 'gro bzhin yod/ rgyal sras kyi dgongs par/ mi 'di lo na gzhon dus sha 'phar khrag 'phar blo gros rab tu rgyas pa zhig yod pa gor ma chag na'ang / dus yud tsam zhig gi skabs su mig ni rab rib rna ba 'on/ lus po rgas shing shes pa rmongs/ 'gro skyod dal zhing dka' ba yi/ sdug bsngal thar thabs ci zhig yod/ yang dgongs par mi tshang ma lo na rim gyis rgas 'gro ba ni yud tsam ltar yin/ rgyu rnor dpal 'byor yod dgu ldan yang rgyun ring mi gnas/ 'jig rten pa rnams longs spyod kho nar zhen pa las/ 'dir ci phyir mi skrag gam/ rgyal sras kyi thugs la de dag dgongs pa'i skabs su spro sengs dga' snang gi zhen pa yongs su yal nas/ pho brang du phyir log gi bka' phab ste thams cad log par byed/(2)na ba'i rdzug bzalasathong ba'i skor/nyin shas song rjes rgyal sras kyis yab la grong khyer lho sgo'i phyi rol tu spro sems su 'gro chog pa'i gnang ba zhus te lho sgo nas thon ma thag lus sha brid nas rus pa 'bar 'bur don pa/ bzhin mdog ser skyar rgyur pa'i mi zhig lam zur du 'khun sgra 'byin bzhin 'dug pa dang 'phrad rgyal sras kyis mi 'di ga 'dra zhig red song zhes dris par/ zhabs 'bring bas 'di ni nad pa zhig red ces lan btab/ rgyal sras kyis snying rje'i spyan ras kyis nad pa der yun ring gzigs te dgong par/ nad gzhi mang che ba ni 'dod yod longs spyod kyi tshad las brgal ba/ bza' btung tshod 'dzin med pa dang / tsha grang mi snyom pa sogs las byung / nad kyis mnar ba'i rjes su lus kyi nus stobs tshang ma shor/ rkang lag tshang ma yod na'ang rang gis 'tsho bar spyod mi thub/ 'di 'dra'i snying rje ba la ang / khong gi yang dgongs par/ mi tshang ma la nad phog rgyu las 'gog thabs med/ nad kyis mnar nas sdug bsngal 'byung nges yin/ bde thang can gyi gzugs gzhi de gzer zug drag po rub 'dzoms byed yul du gyur/ na ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i thabs ci zhig yod dam/ khong gi dgongs pa yang yang bskor kyang / de 'phrod pa'i thabs zhig ma rnyed/spyal sras pho brang du phyir log phebs rjes sun snang gi dgongs pa bzhes nas skyo ba'i mdangs dang ldan/de skabs lo na phra ba'i bram ze 'dun pa zhes pa zhig yod pa spyang grung 'dzom zhing / 'dri mkhas bshad mkhas can zhig yin pa de/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis pho brang du spyan drangs te/ khong gis rgyal sras pa / rdo/ ring gi dga' skyid rol ba'i bro can gyi gtam snyan gsungs nas khong gi gdung ba sel thabs nga (byeṭwāṃ/ sdu ba/'i rgyag bsngal mthong ba'iskor/nyin shas song rjes rgyal sras kyis yab rgyal por nub sgor bro 'cham byed rgyu'i gnang ba zhus/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis rgyal sras kyi rogs pa 'dun pa yod pa dgongs nas lam seng bde ba'i ngang nas bka' 'khrol/ rgyas sras dang 'dun pa/ zhal ta ma 'khor g.yog sogs nub kyi skyed tshal gyi phyogs su bskyod/grong khyer las don nas mi ring bar mi bzhis ro zhig bkyag yong ba dang gdong 'phrad/ shi bo'i nang mi dang / gnyen bshes grogs po bcu grangs tsam rjes su ngu bzhin 'gro ba'i smre sngagasashaṃ ha2 sdu~X skyo zhing /

ya nga ba'i sgra 'byin/ rgyal sras kyi dgongs par/ mi ni 'jig rten du skyes nas she mi dgos pa ga kyang med/ shi dus lus soms gdung bas mnar/ nang mir skyo shas bzod glags med/ 'jig rte gyi mi rnams shi ba'i sdug bsngal las g.yol thabs ci zhig yod dam/'dun pas rgyal sras yang dgongs par bzhugs pa mthong skabs/ rgyal sras la gsol bar spyal sgochen pos nga mchog nyid kyi grogs su mngags pas/ grogs po zhig byas na/ nges par mdza' beem bcangs dgos/ dang po ni grogs po'i mi legs pa'i skyon lhag bsam gyis bshol 'debs gyed dgogaganyis pa/ grogs po'i spyod bzang la bsngags brjod ram 'degs jed dgos/ gsum pa/ grog por dka' ngal byung skabs sdod rgyu med pa/ ngas da lta khyed la snying gtam tshig kha shas zhig zhu/ khyed kyis nga la dgongs 'tshom ma mdzod/ lo rgyus thog gi rgyal po tshang mas gser dngul dang / padzes ma/bza' bca'/ dbang cha bcas ni sbyid po'i bro ba zhig rtsis kyin yod/ 'di ni rgyal po'i mnga' dbang zhig red/ mchog nyid skabs su bab pa'i gzhon nu zhig yin pas ci'i phyir longs su mi spyod dam/ mi tshe 'di'i nang thob par dka' ba ni 'byor phyug dbang grags bzhi po de yin pas/ khyed kyis de rnams dor gni ha cang 'phangs sems skye dgos pa zhig red ces/rgyal sras kyis lan 'debs don ngas 'don yon lnga la longs su spyod khyur mi shes pa min/ ngas mitshang mar skye ba dang / rga ba/ na ba/ 'chi ba/ sdug pa dang bral ba/ mi sdug pa dang 'azad pa/gang 'dod pa de btsal kyang mi rnyed pa/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i sdug bsngal bcas kyi sdug bsngal rigs brgyad myong dgos pa 'di mthong bas nga 'don yon lnga la longs spyod pa'i bde ba mi 'dod/ngas mi rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar ba'i thabs lam zhig rnyed na ci ma rung snyam/ gal te thabs lam de 'dra zhig rnyed nas sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar thub na/ rang nyid rgyal po'i 'cho ba'i nang du ra ro ba las lhag pa ma yin nam zhes gsungs/de nas pho brang du phyir log rjes 'dun pas/ da res bro 'cham byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams rgyal po'i spraṭwāṃ / /tram̐ trī/ ṭwāṃd/ rkyenargya zlo sbya ༵ deg ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ tram̐ shā /rgyal/ sras kyis khong gi rgyal srid 'dzin thub bam mi thub snyam gsum pa/ rgyal khrid spangasanas rabatwa byung ba/shākya thub pa 'khrungs pa'i dus kyi spyi tshogs ni zing zing long long dang / bsam blo gsar rnying mthud res 'brel ba'i dus rabs shig yin/ de dus rgya gar ni khrun che'u dmag rgyal dus skabs kyi thung go dang 'dra bar tshang ma nga zhed kho rgod kyi rnam pa zhig chags yod/spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor gong 'apel 'gro ba dang chabs cig 'di dus gyi rgya gar du char shul smyug rgyas pa ltar bram ze'i chos la ngo rgol byed pa'i grub mtha' dgu bcu go drug tsam byung ba de'i nang nas skad grags che shos shi~X1 /la rjo pa'i chos lugs yin/ de'i bzhed srol ni chos khrims dam pa dang / dka' thub la

nanagyis spyod dgos pa de red/ chos lugs gzhan zhig la pha rgyang 'phen smra ba7 zer/ des rnam shes dang / lha tshangs pa sogs gang zhig yod khas gtan nas mi len par/ mi tshe'i dmigs yul ni gdos thacas lus kyi phung po'i 'dod yon rnams khengs par byed rgyu kho nar 'dod/mig lam gyi gnas tshul la yid ma rang stabs/ de skabs kyi mi mang po nang gses su bram ze re zung yangatshud pa tshang ma 'jig rten la skyo snang yid 'byung gi bsam pa skyes te/ khong tsho 'ga' shas ri khrod du btsul zhugs spyod pa la gyin/ 'ga' shas phyogs bzhir kun tu bskor nas thar lam rnyed pa'i re 'dun rdoshā /mngo//kya thub pa'i mi tshe sdug bsngal mang ba'i lta ba ni/ dus rabs de'i bsam tshul snang ba zhig yin shākya thub pa grong khyer nub phyogs kyi skyed tshal nas byir log phebs rjes yid mug cing / skyo snang yid 'byung de bas che ru phyin/ thar ba thob pa'i re 'dun de bas je cher 'phel/ mi ring ba na/ spyal po'i snang ba thob pa ltar rgyal sras byang sgo'i phyi rol gyi skyed tshal du spro sems su byon/ skyed tshal gyi rwa bar 'dzul ma thag zhabs 'bring pa rnams phyir slog nas gcig pur rdzon shing chen po zhig gi drung du tsog pur bzhugs nas dgongs pa bzhes/ skabs der baspyol zhugs spyod pa zhig tshur yong nas rgyal sras la thar ba thob pa'i lam ni rgyal po'i pho brang du yod pa ma yin/ ri bo'i khrod du yin zhes brjod/ rgyal sras kyis mi de'i gtam thos ma thag da ni nags tshal stug po'i khrod du phyin nas 'gro ba sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar ba thob pa'i lam zhig 'tshol bar bya'o snyam nas blo thag bcad/ de dus spyal sras dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgur tshebs/ grags 'dzin mar sbrum nas mi 'gyang bar bu btsa' ran 'duganyin zhig rgyal sras don spub yab rgyal po'i drung du snyon nas phyag dang bcas rgyal po zas gtsang la gsol bar drin chen dga' ba'i tshogs rnams lhan 'dzoms kyang / /nam zhig mi gnas phan tshun gyes par gyur/ /'gro rnams sdug las thar ba'i lam 'tshol phyir/ /yab kyis bdag la rab byung gnang ba rtsol zhes pas/ rgyal po zas gtsang mas rgyal sras kyi gtam thos ma thag yid rab tu gdung nas rgyun ring por rgyal sras kyi phyag la 'jus kyang smrar ma btub/rgyal sras rab byung byed 'dod pa'i gtam phyi rol tu thos rjes/ mi mang pos rgyal por thabs bton nas/ rgyal sras mi gtong ba'i jus byas/ bram ze mo pa zhig gis rgyal po zas gtsang la zhus par/ nyin bdun rjes su rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i gza' skar bzang / nyin sngon du rgyal sras nyar bar nus na de nas rgyal sras rab tu byung mi thub zer/ yab rgyal po rab tu dga' ste/ myur bar brda yig btang nas phyogs bzhi'i lcags ri'i grong sgor sgo bsrung dmag mi 'phar ma btsugs te rgyal sgo dam por bsrung thog nyin bdun nang du rgyal grong gi lcags ri'i sgor don mi chog pa'i bka' btang / yang grags 'dzin ma mdun du bkug nas/ khyod kyi spyal sras nyin mtshan med par mi 'bral ba byas te/ rgyal sras nyin bdun nang pho brang gi phyi rol tu phebs su bcug mi rung zhes mngags/ — 213 —

tshang mas dngangs skug gis nyin drug bsrungs/ spyal sras kyi spyod tshul ni ha cang tshul ldan dul sko2 gzhi lhod zing med du gnas/ — dzo nyin bdun pa'i nub mor/ pho brang nang gi zhal ta ma rnams nyin mtshan sbril ba'i ngal bas dug tshang ma dal bur gnyid du song / grags 'dzin ma yang nyin mtshan bsdud mar sems khral bcangs na rgyal sras kyi drung nas gom gang ma bral gnas/ de dus khong yang ha cang gnyid kyis nyob cing gnyid cog rgyag bzhin du/ khong gi mig btsum ma thag mu mthud mi lam gsum rmis/ zi lam dang por zla ba gnaminas sar lhung ba zis/ gnyis par rang nyid kyi so bud nas nags tshal khrod du zags pa mis/ gsum par rang nyid kyi dpung pa g.yas pa med par gyur par rmis/ grags 'dzin ma gnyid nas had kyi0'drogs te myur bar lag pa brkyangs nas rgyalasras myul bas/ rgyal sras ni rang gi 'khris su gzim yod pa mthong skabs gzhi nas blo lhod par gyur/ khong gis rig pa rnal du phab nas rgyal sras la mi lam gyi don rnams zhus pas rgyal sras kyis zla ni da lta gnam la 'dug tshems ni khyed kyi zhal nang du 'dug dpung pa gnyis ni bde thang yin pas na khyed skug par ma byed par bag phebs nas nyol cig yid gso bar mdzad/grags 'dzin ma yid bde bo'i ngang mgo bo kyog tsam byas nas hur hur zhes gnyid du song /nam smad du smrebs skabs rgyal sras kyis grags 'dzin ma dang zhal ta ma rnams gnyid mthug po khug skabs/ ga ler gzim khri'i steng nas bzhengs te na bza' gsol nas sgo ra'i nang du phebs skabs/ zla 'od gsal zhing skar tshogs bkra/ kun tu sgra med 'jam thing nge / shing rtse'i rma bya'ang gnyid cog spyag pa'i dus su/ rgyal sras shing rta 'jog khang du phebs te/ kha lo pa gnyid las bslangs te rta mchog bsngags ldan 'khrid shog gsungs/ kha lo pas rgyal sras pho brang nas phyi rol tu phebs pa thos skabs skrag nas lus po kun 'dar bzhin par rgyal sras la de ring ni spro sengs kyi nyi ma ma yin/ dmag 'thab kyi dugakyang ma yin pas mtshan phyed du rta mchog 'khrid nas ci mdzad pa yin/ rgyal sras kyis bdag ni da lta dmag 'thab las kyang da dung gal che ba yin pas myur bar rta 'khrid gsungs par brten/ bka' dang du len rgyu ma gtogs thabs med pas/ chibs rwa'i nang nas rta mchog bsngags ldan phyir khrid nas byung /der rgyal sras kyi phyag gis rta mchog bsngags ldan gyi ske la byil byil mdzad de bshad don/ khyod kyis yab rgyal po dang lhan tu phyogs mtha' yongs su rgyug 'gros spos nas/ dgra 'dul g.yul las rgyal ba'i byas rjes mang po bzhag nged da lta bskyod nas thar lam 'tshol du 'gro bar khyed slar yang byas rjes 'jog pa'i dus su bab pas lhod g.yeng spu tsam byed mi rung zhes gsungs rjes chibs thog tu thon nas lcag tshan dbyug cing mig hril tsam gyi ring du byang sgo'i 'gram du phebs/de skabs grong sgo dam por brgyab nas yod/ go tshul du rta mchog shugs bsgril nas mchongs pas grong khyer gyi lcags ri las brgal/ grong gi phyi rol tu skebs 'phral rgyal sras kyis gsung skad chen pos/ngasaka la ṭwāṃ 1dīms can yongs kyi skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba gcod ma thub na nga pho brang du phyir mi log

gol te sangs rgyas ma thob na yab rgyal po'i zhal mi mjal/ gal te 'dod pa'i zhen pa ma chod na/ nang rdu log nas sru mo skye dgu'i bdag mo dang / tshe rogs grags 'dzin ma mi mjal gsungs nas rta mchog ga gis bskul te rgyang ring du gshegs/ kha lo pa yang chibs pa'i rjes su dam por 'brangs so/ /nam gsar rjes rgyal sras ni rgyal mtshams las brgal nas yud tsam phebs/ de nas yul ljongs ha cang mdzes pa'i nags tshal gyi ri bo zhig tu tshebs/ rgyal sras kyis chibs kha bkag nas kha lo par gsung ṭwāṃ//pho braspya kā kā rsha trī rsha shā/ tram̐ /byung song / da lta nga ni 'di'i rgyud du brtul zhugs su gnas pas/ khyod kha lo pas 'dir ni mi med lung stong / dug sgrul dang gcan gzan phyogs bzhir rgyu ba'i gnas 'dir ngas mchog nyid rang dgar bamyur nas/ nga gcig pu pho brang du phyir ci la log nus zhes/rgyal sras kyis nga ni sems can rnams par thar ba'i lam 'tshol ba'i don du/ spyang sgrul stag gzig tshang ma nga yi grogs po yin pas skrag dgos don med gsungs/kha lo pas mchog nyid sku chung dus nas rgyal po'i pho brang nang du 'tshar long mdzad de mal stan 'jam zhing 'bol ba dang / 'tsho ba skyid po bskyal 'ing / da lta ni tsher mas khengs ba'i lam du bgrod dgos pa/ljon shing 'og tu nyal dgos pa'i dka' sdug can gyi 'cho ba 'di 'dra khyed kyis bzod par ga la nus zhes/rgyal sras kyis rgyal po'i pho brang skyid po yin mod kyang / der bathad nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal gcod par ga la nus gsungs/spyal sras kyis de ltar gsung bzhin par gser 'od chem chem 'phro ba'i nor bu'i gtsug rgyan de phud nas/ ba lo par gsung don khyod kyis 'di yab spyal por phul/ khyod kyis nga'i tshab byas nas yab rgyal po la ngas pha mar srid zhu bkur sti mi zhu ba min/ 'gro ba sems can sdug bsngal las thar ba'i lam rnyed pa'i ched du rab tu byung ba yin/ yab spyal po thugs ngal mi mdzad par zhu zhes zhu rogs kyis gsungs/ rgyal sus kyis yang sku steng du g.yogs pa'i nor bu'i dra ba phud nas kha lo par sprad de gsung don khyod kyis 'di nyid btsun mo mchog la phul nas nga'i gtam 'di khong la zhu rogs kyis/ rgyal sras gso skyong gnang ba'i bka' drin zab mo gnang ba ni ngas mi tshe hril por mi brjed/ nga de ring thar ba don du gnyer phyir rab tu byung nas chos sgrub byed/ mchog nyid thugs ngal mi mdzad par zhu zhes zhu rdogs mdzod gsungs/ rgyal sras kyi sku lus nas nor bu ga'an dag rnams bkrol nas gsung don khyod kyis 'di cho grags 'dzin mar phul nas mi 'jig rten du gnas ring brtse ba'i mi dang tha dad du gyes pa ni sdug bsngal che shos yin kyang / nga ni soms can rnams kyi sdug bsngal 'di rigs gcod pa'i ched du rab byung chos sgrub byed pas khyed dus rgyun du sbya ngan ma skyed cig zhu zhes zhu nogs gyis gsungs/kha lo pas nor bu'i gtsug rgyan dang / nor bu/ dra ba na bza' rnams lag tu blangs kyang da dung kha gyes su mi 'dod/ rgyal sras kyis spu gri bton nas rang nyid kyi dbu sku breg cing sma ra ag ༵kā bzhar te

rang gyid rab tu 'byung bar yid gagyis med pa mngon par byas/de dus gyon pa tsab hral gyon pa'i rngon pa zhig byung bar/ rgyal sras kyis gos gser na bza' khri hrīsud nas jon pa'i spyon pa ral pa dang brjes nas sku steng du gsol te chos gos kyi tshul mdzad/ chos go gsol zhing dbu spa bsil ba'i rgyal sras des kha lo par zhal bskor nas gsung don ngas chos byas nas dornaspub rjes nang du yong nas tshang mar zhal mjal chog ces gsungs nas byi ltas med par lebs so rgyal sras kyis nyin sgyed lhag tsam phebs nas nags tshal skug po'i khrod cig tu phebs/ 'dir shing nags mthug cing ri dbyibs mtshar bajid tshe ba 'dir 'dod blo'i snying stobs shor ba'i bram ze phag ka zhe ༵ //sa gnas tshul dngos las g.yol byun mi khyu zhig 'khrid de 'dir brtul zhugs bsgom par byed bgin phag kas byad bzhin 'drongs bzhin bajid chags pa'i gzhon nu zhig yong ba mthong nas nang mi dang lhan du mdun du bsu ba byas/rgyal sras brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gnas su gdan drangs/ khong gis phyogs bzhir legs par—gzigs pas/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bram ze mang po'i nang nas kha shas sog mas bzos pa'i spyon pa spyon/kha shas ni shing gi lo 'dab dang wags pa'i gyon pa spyon/ khong tsho'i zas ni rtswashing gi 'bras bu yin zhing)'di 'dra zas zos kyang da dung 'grangs mi byub stabs 'dir rang ltogs sdod thabs zhes zer/ kha shasakyis me dang chu la mchod pa 'bul ba/ kha shas kyis nyi ma dang zla bar mchod/ nyal dus tsher ma'i steng du nyal ba dang / kha shas me dang chu'i 'gram du nyal yod/rgyal sras kyis 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul gzigs skabs/ de lta bu ga la yin dgongs nas/ phag ka la dris don khyod tshos 'di 'dra'i baspyol zhugs spyod stangs ni dngos 'brel ngo mtshar che/ yin na yang /dmigs yul gang zhig thob pa'i ched du yin/ phag kas lan du lha yul du bgrod pa'i ched du yin/ rgyal sras kyis lha yul yang 'khor ba las ma 'das/ de'i bde skyid zad rgyu yod pa dang / der yang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bsags nas sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu don du gnyer ba zhig ma yin nam/ yud tsam song rjes yang rgyal sras kyis tshong pas nor dang dngul gyi don du thag ring gi rgya mtshor brgal pa dang rgyal pos rgyal khab gzhan gyi mnga' khongs sa cha bzung ched/ dpung bkye nas g.yul bshams pa red/ da lta khyod tshos lha yul gyi bde ba longs su spyod pa'i ched du/ 'di lta bu'i dka' thub spyod pa ni/ dbugs ring gtong dgos pa ngo ma zhig red/ zhes gsung bzhin du rjon shing chen po zhig gi 'og tu bzhugs/ phag kas de ltar gsung pa thos rjes dris don byams skyong snying rje can lags khyed kyis da lta gsungs pa'i don snying ji ltar lags/ nga tsho'i brtul zhugs de da dung dka' ba spyad pa zhig ma yin nam/ rgyal sras kyis lan du ngas khyod tsho'i brtul zhugs dka' ba ma yin zer ba min/ ngas brjod pa ni khyod tsho'i brtul zhugs kyi 'bratram̐ bu ༵ 1ṭwāṃg bsngal dang kha bral thabs med/ gal te brtul zhugs spyod pas bde ba thob na bde ba kho

na longs su spyod mkhan rnams brtul zhugs spyod par mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yin nam zhes gsungs/phag kas 'dir phebs pa'i mi 'di ni spyir btang ma yin pa'i lta ba khyad 'phags can zhig yin pa mthong nas khong dang mnyam du bsdad nas snying gtam zhu res byas/ de'i dgong mor rgyal sras brag khung nang du bzhugs su gsol nas nam bskyal/nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs par/ rgyal sras kyis 'dir brtul zhugs spyod rgyu ni thar ba'i lam dngos gnas shig ma yin pas 'dir rgyun ring 'dug par mi rigs dgongs nas/ rgyal sras kyis (phag kas)phyiphyag mdzad/ phag ka dang brtul zhugs can gzhan rnams kyis rgyal sus la chos mi 'dra bas bzhugs su ma gsol/ khyod snyo phyogs su a lo lo ka lan gyi drung du byon dang / khong ni lo mang po brtul zhugs can zhig red ces zer/ rgyal sras kyis phag kas bstan pa'i kha phyogs ltar lho phyogs su phebs so/ /de nas grags 'dzin ma nam langs nas gnyid sad skabs rgyal sras med par mthong bas yid rab tu skyo zhing ngu bzhin myur bar btsun mo'i drung bcar nas don de snyan du gsol/ btsun mo yang thugs gdung bas mnar nas brgyal bar nye ba na/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis mkhyen rjes yang yid ha cang gdung nas khong gis mi stong phrag kha shas mngags te rta la zhon nas phyogs bzhir btsal kyang rjes shul yang ma rnyed/ nyin shas song mtshams kha lo pa log rjes gzhi nas rgyal sras kyi phebs phyogs shes song /rgyal po zas gtsang gis myur du dmag dpon dang blon chen/ de bzhin rjes 'brang ba mang po btang nas/ kha lo pas lam khrid/ bram ze phag ka'i brtul zhugs nags tshal du rgyal sras 'tshol bar phyin/'dir 'byor rjes phag kas bstan pa'i lho phyogs su rjes 'ded byas te mang snya dha'i rgyal khab tu 'gro ba'i lam zhig tu song mthar rgyal sras kyi rjes zin/ dmag dpon gyis rgyal sras la gsol bar thar lam 'tshol sa gnas klung ri'i khrod du yin si 'i nges pa med/ pho brang nang du yang de bzhin brtul zhugs mdzad chogargyal srid kyi go gnas su bzhugs pa rnams khyis brtson pas sbyang 'ing bar mtshams ma bzhag na thar lam yang dag rtogs par nus zhis/ rgyal sras kyis lan du rgyal srid dang thar ba gnyis ni me chu ltar mnyam bsre mi thub/ ngas 'gro ba sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i blo thag snga sor nas bcad zin pa de/nyi zla thang la lhung ba'am/ gangs ri 'khor 'gul byung na yang 'gyur ba med gsungs shing / der 'dus dmag dpon dang blon chen rnams kyis spyal sras kyi blo stobs la 'gyur ba ye nas med par mthong skabs/da dung ngal ba chen pos bshol kyang phan nus med par shes te ko'u ṭī ṇa sogs mi lnga rgyal sras kyi rjes 'brang du ba'ag nas de dbyengs pho brang du phyir log nas bka' lan phul/spyal sras dang bo'u ṭī ṇa sogs mi lnga pos rba rlabs lang long du 'phyur ba'i chu bo gang gā brgal nas mang gha dha'i rgyal khab tu 'byor/ mang snya dha'i rgyal khab ni zhing sa ha cang gshin po/ 'bras kyi thon khungs zhin tu mang po/ de'i rgyal sa rgyal po'i khab yin pa de spyal khab kyi lte ba'i gnas su chags/ de'i nang bya rgod phung po'i ri bo ni mtho zhing gzar la rab tu mdzes pa/ shing nags mthug po tram̐ṭwāṃ | de 'ang

brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dben gnas snyan grags can zhig yin/ spyal sras 'khor bcas bya rgod phung risaciphebs skabs sku ha cang mnyel te/ rdo zhig gi steng du bzhugs nas ngal gsos/mang gha dha'i rgyal po'i mtshan la gzugs can snying po zer/ de'i nyin gzugs can snying pos mi 7mang po khrid de bya rgod phung ri'i nye 'gram du jon la bshor skabs su ser skya'i rgyal po'i rgyal sras go'u ta yodon grub rgyal srid bskyur nas rab tu byung ste chos 'tshol du phebs pa'i lam bar rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer brgyud nas da lta bya rgod phung rir sku ngal gsos gnang ba thos skabs byur bar blon po dang bcas rgyal sras tsog pur bzhugs pa'i gnas su 'byor te/ rgyal sras ni kun las 'phags pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i ngang tshul mthong skabs rgyal sras la gus pas 'dud de mtshams 'drir gsol par mchog nyid ni 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyi rgyal srid thob khyur ci'i phyir du blo thag bcad nas dor/ ri bo khrod du yong ba dang / nyal sa 'dam la byas nas/ dka' thub kyi 'tsho ba la 'bungs pa ci zhig yin/ gal te mchog nyid kyi yab chen rgyal po bzhugs par brten lha yi rgyal srid 'dzin par mi bde na/ nga'i rgyal khab kyi phyed ka khyod kyis skyong bar mdzod/ gal te de nyung bar snyam na ngas go sa bshol te khyed kyi blon chen zhus chog gal te khyed kyis phran gyi rgyal khab skyong bar ma 'dod na/ ngas khyed la mi dang rta/ mtshon cha g.yar nas khyed kyi bka' bzhin g.yul bkyes te pha rol ba'i rgyal khab gzhan 'phrog par byas chog ces zhus/rgyal sras kyis rgyal po'i gtam de thos rjes zhi dul khengs myung thog zhe sa dang ldan pa'i lan du nga la rgyal po chen po'i dam pa'i thugs khur zab mo nod pa ni dngos 'brel dpe ga la srid/ ngas rgyal srid spangs zin nas da dung rgyal po chen po'i nor bu'i khri la brnabs sems ci la byed/ rgyal po chen pos dang blangs kyis nga la rgyal gnas nas zur bshol gnang yang / nga la ci yang mi dgos na/ dmag dpung gi bya ba'i rigs ga la byed du rung / ngas pha ma bza' zla rnams dang kha bral/ skra dang sma ra rnams bzhar ba ni 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa gcod par byed pa'i 'gro lam 'chel ba'i ched du yin/ de ring gus lam zhor du nyid kyi rgyal khab brgyud skabs rgyal po sku mchog nas bzhugs rogs kyi bka' spyi bor phebs par thugs rje'i bka' drin gting zab snying la bcangs/ nga ni nub phyogs su slob dpon btsal nas thar lam gnyer rtsis yod ces gsungs/rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bzhugs par mi bzhed par shes rjes lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas rgyal sras khyed kyis slar du thar lam thob skabs thog ma sngon du rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du chos gsungs par phebs rogs zhu/ ngas nges par du bsnyen bkur zab mo zhu rgyu yin zhes zhus pas/ rgyal sras kyis cang ma gsungs pa'i ngang nas zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas yang nub phyogs su bskyod/rgyal sras chu bo ni ra dza na brgal te chu 'gram du brtul zhugs spyod sa'i gnas ka kras ri bor 'byor/gnas 'di ni ri tshogs kyis ra ba bskor ba'i bar nas yon tan brgyad ldan chu rgyun lhung lhung 'bab/ shing dang me tog sna tshogs kyis khengs shing / 'dir bram ze ma yin pa'i chos lugs khag mang po baspyol zhugs — 218 —

spyod cing / brtul zhugs la zhugs mkhan tshos shin tu ngal ba'i dka' thub kyi 'tsho ba spyad de ri skyes kyi sngo tshal za ba dang / kha shas kyis ba glang lci ba dang / sha ba'i lci ba za ba ma zad thabs sna tshogs kyis rang nyid sdug spyong ste mnar gcod gtong ba/ dper na/ kha shas langs bldad nas rang nyid kyi ral ba bteg pa/ kha shas gum tsog brgyab nas 'gul tsam mi byed pa/ kha shas tsher ma dang yang na lci ba'i steng du nyal ba/ kha shas skang ba ya gcig bkyag nas gzugs po nyi ma'i phyogs su gtad nas kha bskor ba/kha shas tsha ba chen po'i dus su da dung lus po mer bsro ba/ dgun dus su slebs skabs 'khyags gong pang du nyar nas nyal sdod pa sogs byed mus yod/rgyal sras don grub kyis a lo lo ka lan btsal nas 'tshams 'dri zhus/ khong ni chos lugs gsar pa'i ston pa yin/ zer srol du khong lo bcu bzhi nas 'dir baspyol zhugs spyad nas da lta'i bar dgung lo brgyad cu dgu bcu tsam baspyol zhugs ngang du dus yun 'das/ snyan grags chen po ldan pa'i mi zhig yin/rgyal sras kyis a lo lo ka lan mjal 'phrad skabs khong la ji skad du khyed ni mir spro sems che ba dang /slob par mi bsun pa yin zhes kun gyis khyed la bstod bkur chen po byed kyin yod cing / nga ni da lta mtshan mor 'gro mkhan la sgron me mkho ba dang / lam nor mkhan la lam ston pa mkho ba/ rgya mchor 'gro mkhan la ded dpon mkho ba ltar ched mngags khyed la slob ston zhu ru yong ste sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar ba dang / pha rol tu phyin lam zhig thob pa'i re ba yod ces gsungs/a lo lo ka lan gyis rgyal sras kyis rgyal srid spangs nas gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ba'i snying stobs dang / slob par 'dod pa'i sems shugs la bsngags brjod byas pa dang srugs/ na re ngas slob pa la zhugs 'dod mkhan tshor ga dus yin kyang de'i yon tshad la bltas nas 'tshams pa'i bslab bya ston/ khyed lta bu'i slob par nus pa'i skyes bu la nga'i shes yon yod tshad khyed la bslab par bya'o zer/'on kyang rgyal sras a lo lo ka lan gyi drung du zla ba gcig tsam gyi slob la 'bad kyang gal che'i gnad 'gag de yin 'di yin ma rnyed cing / khong nyid thag gcod par 'dod pa'i gnad don la ci yang thag chod mi yong stabs/ khong rim gyis 'di 'dra'i brtul zhugs kyi dka' thub spyod pa la the tshom par gyur/mi ring ba zhig na rgyal sras kyis yang dge sbyong gi gtso bo g.yu ka ta lo lo tse zhes bya bar bsten/ khongagi bzhed srol yang a lo lo ka lan dang khyad par che ba med par khong gi rjes 'brang gis dka' thub spyod pa rnams la yang lus sems mnar gcod byed pa'i dka' thub spyod stangs kho na re/(1)chu bone radzana'i drung du dka' ba lo drugamadzad pa/mthar rgyal sras khong tsho dang zhal gyes te ko'u ṭi na sogs rogs pa mi lnga dang lhan du nee ra dza na'i chu 'gram g.yu li bin lo zhes pa'i grong gi nye 'gram du 'byor/ der ni ha cang dbeen pa'i gnas mchog dwangs gsal chu bo me long ltar dwangs shing / chu 'gram du sngo ljang can gyi nags tshal gyi tshom bus gtams/ ri dang chu klung nags tshal rnams phan tshun snol zhing blta na mtshar bas nags tshal rnams rnam par bkra/— 219 —

rgyal sras kyis gnas 'di'i yul ljongs la dang ba skyes nas der bzhugs/rgyal sras kyis dgongs par/ deng dus lam la slob pa tsho tshang ma dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs la sbyod/ngas de ltar gtan nas mi 'dod kyang / gal te ngas 'di 'dra'i thabs ma spyad na gzhan gyis nga ni bde skyid la zhen chags pa dang / dka' thub spyod pa la 'tsher ba zer yong / tha na nga ni rgyal rigs yin cing/bde bar longs su spyod rgyur goms nas ri khrod du lam la gnyer rgyu zer ba ni ming skam po'i grags pa 'gugs thabs tsam red ces khrel dgod byed nges red/ de ltar byas na ngas thar ba thob pa'i lam rnyed kyang sus yid ches par 'gyur zhes snyam/rgyal sras kyis dgongs pa nan tan gyis bzhes rjes/ dka' thub spyod rgyur gtan 'khel gnang /thog mar zas spyod kyi brtul zhugs nas 'go btsugs/ de yang thog mar nyin re la zas rgya shus gi 'bru tsam thengs re/ de rjes rim gyis nyung ngu btang nas nyin gnyis re la dus thengs re/ yang na nyin gsum re la dus thengs re za rgyu/ mthar nyin bdun re la thengs re gsol/ gsol ba mdzad pa'i dus ma yin pa ga'an tshang mar ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par ba'ag khong gis sku lus la sha ba'i pags pa/ de nas shing lpags gsol ba/ 'dam dang / sha ba/ ba glang gi lci ba'i steng du gzims pa sogs kyang mdzad myong /dgongs mor khong nags khrod du bzhugs skabs/ nags chil chil gyi rnam pas khong la skrag snang skye zhing /khong gis dgongs par thabs gang la brten na 'jigs skrag gzhi nas 'dul thub bam snyam/ nye 'gram gyi brtul zhugs spyod pa pos khong la zhu don/ mtshan mo nyin mor blta ba dang / nyin mo mtshan mor bltas te blo rgya che bar byas na 'jigs skug rgyang ring bral bar 'gyur zhes zhus/ rgyal sras kyi dgongs par mtshan mo ni mtshan mo rang yin/ nyin mo ni nyin mo rang yin pa sus kyang gsal por mthong bzhin pa'i don dngos shig yin/ mtshan mo 'jigs skug skye ba ni sems nang skrag snang tshor bar brten nas byung bas/sems nyid kyi nang nas de ji ma ji ba'in phar bskrad nus na sazhi nas mtshan mo'i skug snang de ring du bor thub snyam bzhin du thabs 'di ga'ir bzung nas byang bas na/ dus tshod gang tsam song rjes mtshan mor skug snang skye ba de mngon sum du med par gyur ro/ /rgyal sras dang mnyam du brtul zhugs sgom mkhan ko'u ṭī na la sogs mi lnga pos dkar thub spyod par lta tshul tha dad cing / kha shas kyis blta sa na sdug bsngal yin pa ngos 'dzin/ kha shas kyis bltas na bde ba yin pa ngos 'dzin cing / khong tsho rtag tu yang yang rtsod/ rgyal sras kyis rgya shig gi 'bras bu gsol ba'i brtul zhugs 'go brtsams pa'i rjes/ dka' thub spyod pa ni nges par du bde bar longs su spyod dgos zeramakhan de gnyis kyis rgyal sras la mi ni 'jig rten 'tsho ring / dus thog tu bde ba longs su spyod rgyu ni lam yang dag yin/ khyed kyis 'di 'dra'i dadku' thub spyod na/ nga tsho khyed kyi rjes su mi 'brang ngo zer nas khong tsho rgyal sras dang kha bral nas/ wa ra na si'i rgyal khab la phyin/—de ṭwāṃ~X 0gsum gyi nang nas gnyis kyis rgyal sras dang dka' spyad zhugs/ mi gcig ser skya'i rgyal

khab la log phyin nas/ rgyal sras kyi brtul zhugs spyod tshul rnams rgyal po dang btsun mo'i snyan du gsol/rgyal po zas gtsang dang grags 'dzin ma rnams kyis rgyal sras kyis dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs spyod tshul rnams thos rjes/ 'bru rigs dang / gyon chas/ 'tsho ba'i nyer chas rnams sta gon byas te kha lo par shing rta 'khor lo chen po kha shas nang du byur bur blugs nas/ ka kras ri bor skyel du btang /kha lo pa yong rjes rgyal sras ljon shing drung du bzhugs te bzhin mdangs ser phag ge mkhur rus 'bur ba/ sha skam zhing rid pa/ sku lus yongs rdzogs sog ma skam po'i yal ga ltar rgyur 'dug pa mthong skabs mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs bzhin du gsol bar spyal po chen po dang / lha lcam grags 'dzin ma bcas kyis nyin mtshan med par/ rgyal sras dran nas zas kyang mid par mi 'gro/ nyal kyang gnyid du mi khug da lta nga dngos po 'di tsho skyel bar btang byung / khyed phebs nas mi ring bar grags 'dzin mar sras shig 'khrungs/ mtshan du sgra gcan 'dzin zhes gsol nas da lta gtam smra shes par gyur yod ces/rgyal sras kyis kha lo par gsung don ngas pha yul dang rgyang ring bral nas ri brag dbeen pa 'di'i phug tu snebs/ nyin rer spya shig gi 'bras bu re dang 'bras 'bru res/ nga'i lus 'tsho thub thag chod byung /khyed kyis yab rgyal po dang lcam grags 'dzin ma bcas la khyod tshos nga la yid 'phrang bar ma mdzad cigakhyed kyis nga la bskyal yong ba'i dngos po 'di rnams kyis bdag la phan rgyu med par gnod rgyu yin pas/phyir dbor cig gsungs pas/ kha lo pas yang dadwa yang du bzhes par zhus kyang / ma bzhes stabs kha lo pa rang 'jag phyir dbor phyin/ rgyal sras don grub ri khrod dben pa'i sul gcig tu mu mthud de dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs la spyod cing / khong gis dang po bzod par dka' ba'i zas gcod sgom nas/ nyin bdun ring kha zas ma bzas na yang mu mthud 'gul bskyod thub/ khong gis sha ba dang / ba glang gi snyi ba'i steng du gzim pa dang /sku lus la shing wags dang / shing gi yal ga gsol/ brag phug ni khong gis lhags char la g.yol ba'i gnas su byas/ chu mgo'i chu ni khong gis btung ba kya noms shos yin pa/ khong gis 'jigs bral gyi ṭwāṃdri/sa la brten nas/ mun nag po dang / chu log gcan gzan gtum po tshang mar bag mi tsha bar dus tshod ni mda' ltar mgyogs shing / nyi ma zla ba 'gro ba ni thag ring gi 'gron bu ltar gyur/rgyal sras rab tu byung zhing / dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs spyad nas lo drug phyin/ 'on kyang khong gis skom pa chu 'dod ltar gyi yang dag pa'i chos ni da dung rnyed par ma byung /nyin gcig dwangs gsal gyi zhog pa snga mor/ rgyal sras chu bo ni ra dza na'i 'gram du chu gsol bar phebs skabs khong gis chu nang du 'char ba'i rang gi gzugs brnyan ni skam zhing rid nas ngo yang mi shes par gyur stabs ha mi las ka med cig gyur/ long slar yang nags gseb tu phyir log phebs rjes dgongs par/ ngas nyin rer rgya shug 'bras bu gcig re dang 'bras rdog gcig re byas pa nas spran ༵༵na bar rgya

shig 'bras bu gcig la brten/ nyal sa ni brag dang lud kyi steng du byas gzugs byad skam zhing rid/dbyibs ni sdong skam ltar gyur/ 'di ltar dka' thub spyad nas lo drug song yang da dung 'bras bu med pa ci yin nam/ gal te dka' spyad bor nas de snga khyim du sdod pa ltar smon shing drung du mnyam par bzhag na/gcig byas na thar ba'i lam thob thub mi yong ngam dgongs/rgyal sras kyis chu bo ni ra dza na'i nang du bzhugs nas dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chus lo drug ring gi mi gtsang ba'i dreg pa rnams gtsang mar baspus te/ sku 'khrus gsol rjes sku yi stobs ha cang skyo bas ljon shing zhig gi yal gar 'thab pas gzhi nas chu khar 'dzegs thub/de dus legs skyes ma zhes pa phyugs 'tsho'i grong gi bu mo zhig chu 'gram du yong ba dang 'phrad/ mos 'bud shing ltar skam pa'i rgyal sras mthong skabs ha cang snying rje skyes te khong la 'o ma phor pa gang phul/(2)'dod 'jo'i ba mo'i 'o mas sku lus gsos pa/rgyal sras kyis 'o ma phyag tu bzed nas bsngo sgron tshar gcig mdzad rjes dbugs thengs gcig la gsol/ ko'u ṭi ṇa sogs mi gsum gyis rgyal sras kyi mdzad tshul 'di mthong skabs rab tu ha las shing dngangs skrag skyes/ mi gcig gis zer don sbyong brdar pham zhing grub 'bras shor/ lam dkyil slebs nas phyir la log lo drug dka' ba spyad pa de/ zhogs pa gcig la rtsa brlag btang / ha cang 'phangs ba la zhes/ gzhan zhig gis zer don lo drug gong du khong rgyal po'i pho brang nas thon te/ mi med ri khrod du phebs/ nor bu'i gyon chas phud de sha ba pa'i gos gsol/ 'bad 'bad 'bungs 'bungs dang /lhad med gtsang dag gi sgo nas dka' ba spyad de yang dag pa'i 'bras bu yong ba'i re 'dun bcing / da lta ni phyugs rdzi bu mos phul ba'i 'o ma btung 'dug ngas bltas na khong dbu thon yul med pa'i mi zhig yin shas che zhes/ yang mi gcig gis zer don khyod kyi lta tshul de ni phyis drags pa red/ ngas snga sa nas rgyal sras 'di skugs rtasas tsha po'i mi zhig yin bsam gyi yod/ rgyal po'i pho brang nang longs su spyod pa mi tshar ba'i rgyu nor 'byor phyug gzi stobs ldan na yang khong gis 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi rgyal srid dor nas/ ri khrod du gcig pur gab nas dka' thub spyod pa tha shal ba zhig byas pa rbad de rang sdug rang gis nyos pa zhig red/ nga tsho da dung drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'gro na mi legs sam zer skabs gzhan gnyis kyang yi rangs/ de nas log 'gro ba'i gtam yang smras par drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su dong ngo /rgyal sras /sngar bzhin 'gyur ba med lha'i blo stobs kyis 'gro ba sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar ba'i lam la shāwangarngo/ pa maṭwāṃsdu ༵kā dzñosdu dru nga/ dustsogs sangs rgyas pa/rgyal sras kyis phyugs 'tsho ba'i bu mos phul ba'i 'o ma gsol rjes su stobs shugs sor chud/ ni ra dza na'i chu 'gram gyi shar la bskyod/ mi ring bar byang chub snying po'i ljon shing gi drung du phebs/ gnas 'di ni deng ska~X2 hin rdu'i 'bi har zhing chen khongs kyi ka yas grong gi lho ngos nye 'dabs su yin/

byang chub rdzon shing 'di ni mtho tshad khre tse brgya lhag tsam yod/ rgyal sras kyis shing drung du rtswa ku sha bting zhing / zhal shar du gzigs/ zhabs skyil krung mdzad de gsung don ngas gal te da dung yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bla na med pa zhig ma thob na lus 'di gye ma zhib mor gyur kyang rung / stan 'di las yar ldang bar mi bya'o zhes dam bca'i bro bor nas spyan btsums te ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhagade dus gnam gshis glo bur du ngan par gyur/ glog dmar dang thog brgyab/ 'brug skad rim bsres kyis char rlung drag po 'babs/ nam gung du stag dang spyang kis khong la ngar sgra 'byin/ dug sbrul rnams khong gi phyogs bzhir nur 'gros byed/ nyin gnyis par lam du 'gro ba'i mjos mas chos bsgrub par bar snashākṇi ༵ ༵ ṭīr/ bslu brid la sogs pa byas na yang / de tsho tshang mas shākya thub par g.yo 'gul sru tsam yang rgyal sras byang chub ljon shing gi drung du stan thog gcig tu nyin bdun mtshan bdun bzhugs te bkres skom sdug bsngal sna tshogs la bzod bsran theg par byas te/ ji ltar gti mug ma rig pa las thar bar byed snyam pa'i ting 'dzin la mnyam par bzhagakhong gis rjes su gsungs pa ltar na/ khong mnyam par bzhag pa'i nyin drug pa'i thog dgongs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus te thugs la mnga' bar de dus khong gis 'jig rten steng gi dngos po rnam pa sna tshogs pa tshang ma 'gyur sdog nges med yin pa rgyu dang 'bras bu yod pa/ skye ba sngon gyi dge sdig bsags pa la brten nas skye ba 'di la rnam smin gyi 'bras bu thob pa/ tshe 'di'i rang gi bya spyod gang yin la brten nas tshe phyi ma'i las dbang thag gcod pa/ mi'i skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi 'byung rtsa ni pha ma rig pa’’ las byung zhing / de ni 'dod yon la sred pas nyon mongs skyes pa yin pa dang / gal te dzi ma rig pa’ de spangs thub na 'dod yon la sred pa yang spangs thub pas/ de ltar byas na dngos su thar ba thob thub/'di'i don nyid ni khong la tshad mar gyur pa'i yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin dgongs so/ de nas bzung spyal sras don spub de sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur te/ de'i don ni pha thams cad mkhyen pa’’yang na pha rig pa dang ldan pa yin cing khong ni shākya'i rigs las 'khrungs pas 'jig rten pa rnams kyis gus bkur chen po'i ngang mtshan du shākya mu nee zhes 'bod/ (mu ni thub pa dang rgyal ba/ rig pa dang ldan pa'i don yin/)de'i nyin ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo lnga brgya sum cu pa so nam lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad yin la/spyal sras dgung lo sum cu so lngar slobs/ dgon sde dang / rang rgyal dmangs khrod du zla ba bcu gnyis ṭwāṃdri ṭwāṃsdu ṭā/rsha la 'bras thug zhes pa skol srol yod pa de ni shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i dran gso nyin yin (1)drang srong dzing ba ri dwags kyi nags su chos 'khor bskor ba/drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags ni deng skabs rgya gar gyi wā ra ṇa si grong du yod—/ ṭwāṃ ༵ shārji thub

pas chos 'khor dang po bskor ba'i gnas mchog yin stabs/ rjes su nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'phags pa'i gnas chen bzhi yi gras shig tu gyur/shākya thub pa der phebs skabs su/ ko'u ṭi na la sogs pa'i 'khor lnga po rnams drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su ljon shing chen po zhig gi drung du bsnad yod skabs khong tshos rgyang ring po nas rgyal sras phebs yong ba mthong nas mgrin gcig gis gros byas don rgyal sras kyis dka' thub spyod pa dor nas zas skom gyi bde bar longs su spyad/ snga sa nas chos sems shor zin par/ da ltar 'dir phebs don gang byi/ /ma/ da nga tshos sus kyang kha ya mi bya zhes/ gros byas rjes rang rang ci yang mi smra bar mnyam par 'on kyang de ltar bshad na'ang ngo mtshar skye dgos pa zhig ste shākya thub pa 'jem bag med par beebs yong dus/ khong lnga po ma gros gcig mthun gyis stan las ldang ste bsu ba zhus/ kha shas kyis phyag gi lhung bzed blangs/ kha shas kyis 'bas bsil gyi chu len pa sogs byas/ shākya thub pas ngas da lta khyed rnams gros byas nas ngar kha ya mi byed rgyu byas pa'i tshul lta bu mthong byung rung / da lta khyed rnams glo bur du 'gyur 'gro ba ci yin nam/ yang gsungs don khyed rnams la zhu rgyu/ ngas byang chub shing drung du nyin bdun mtshan bdun du bsam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas te/ mngon par sangs rgyas so gsungs/mi lnga bos myur bar brel 'tshab kyis phyag dang bkur bste byas te gsol bar nga tshos de snga byed kyi dka' spyad dang brtul zhugs dor nas don chen 'grub mi thub bsam byung zhes zhus/shākya thub pas khong tshor gsungs don khyod tshos phyi tshul gyi rnam pas/ mi la tshad gzhal mi rung / kha shas phyi tshul du bltas na dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs spyod rung / don dngos thog sems kyi gting du rnam rtog gis khengs/ kha shas sha khrag gi lus kyis 'dod yon sna tshogs la longs su spyad kyang bsam pa'i nang ha cang sdug bsngal gyis mnar/ tan tan tig tig gis 'bad brtson lhod med thog gong nas gong du bskyod mkhan la gzhi nas 'bras bu thob thub/ yang gsungs don de skabs 'jig rten pas bram ze'i chos kyi 'ching rgya las grol te/ thar ba thob par byed par mtha' gnyis kyi phyogs su 'gro ba ste/ gcig ni bde bar longs su spyod pa'i ring lugs te/ 'di ni mig dang rna ba'i 'dod pa rdzogs pa ni mi tshe'i dmigs yul yin par snyam/ 'di ni ngo tsha ba dang tha shal ba zhig yin/ gzhan zhig dka' spyad brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ring lugs te khong tshos lus la sdug sbyor mnar gcod kyi lam brgyud nas mi tshe'i dus gtan gyi phugs 'dun mtho shos de mngon du 'gyur snyam/ thabs 'di'i lus por gnod skyon gtong ba las/phan 'bras cung zad kyang med/ dngos su thar bar 'dod mkhan gyi mis nges par du mtha' 'di gnyis rgyang ring du spangs nas lam dbu mar bskyod dgos/ nga ni dbu ma'i lam gyi brtul zhugs la brten nas gzhi nas yang dag par sangs spyas pa yin zhes gsungs//'a~X ṭwāṃ pos gsung 'di thos ma thag tu yid rab tu dga' zhing myur bar khong la yang dag pa'i sangs

rgyasazhes pa'i don gang yin nam zhes dris/ shākya thub pas 'khor lnga po'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa de gzigs te khong tsho la khong rang nyid byang chub shing drung du rtogs pa bsgoms nas thob pa'i bden pa bzhi'i chos don gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'grel bshad ltar na/ bden pa zhes pa ni ngo ma rang yin pa dang / dzun ma gtan nas ma yin pa'i don yin/ bden pa bzhi zhes bya ba ni rgyu mtshan ngo ma bzhi gnas lugs yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ kun 'byung gi bden pa/ 'gog pa'i bden pa/lam gyi bden pa'o/ / 'di ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhi rtsa'i nang don yin/shākya thub pa'i dgongs par mi tshe gcig la/ skye/ rga/ na/ 'chi/ dga' ba dang bral/ldang ba dang 'phrad/ 'dod don mi 'thub pa sogs ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa zer/sdug bsngal yong ba'i rgyu rkyen ni 'dod sred yin/ ('di nyon mongs pa dang ma rig pa yang zer)'dod sred la dbye na/ mdza' sems dang / 'tsho gnas dang / gser dngul dbang cha bcas la 'dod sred byed pa'i rigs gsum yod/ 'dod pa 'di tsho'i don mi 'grub skabs/ khro 'gyed dang /sdug bsngal skye zhing / 'di ni kun 'byung gi bden pa (kun 'byung zhes pa rgyu yi don)yin/'dod sred ni mi yi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin par shes rjes thabs shes kyis de rnams 'gog par byas te sdug bsngal med pa'i gnas su 'gro ba ni 'gog pa'i bden pa zer ba yin/'di nispya ma ༵ dṛde ṭwāṃd pa sdu/ ga/ nas de thob par byed dgos na nges par du yun ring por chos bsgrub dgos/kun shes ko'u ṭi na la sogs pas shākya thub pas bskor ba'i chos 'khor nyan rjes sems 'gul rab tu thebs nas mu mthud de shākya thub pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas chos bsgrub pa'i re 'dun zhus par shākya thub pas tā dngha ṭwāṃtrī / ṭwāṃ tnaṭī / trī sdis/ bzhes te/ der brten khong tsho ches snga shos kyi shākya thub pa'i nyan thos 'khor de skabs wa ra ṇa si'i grong nang shes rab ldan zhing lang tsho dar la babs pa'i sras shig yod pa'i mtshan la yas hre zer zhing / skye khungs ni tshong pa phyug po zhig yin/ khong nyin ltar mdzes shing bkra ba'i gyon chas gon pa dang / nor bu'i dra ba phyed kyi rgyan btags/ mdzes ma mang po'i zhabs tog dang bcas bag med longs su spyod pa'i 'tsho ba dang ldan/ je ring je ring du song rjes khong gis 'di lta bu'i 'tsho bar zhen par log ste gring khyer nas thon te drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su yong skabs shākya thub pas 'khor lnga sde bzang por chos gsungs pa dang dus mtshungs/ khong yang zur nas chos nyan/ chos nyan sbyardzu / ṭwāṃ dṛ/ ṭwāṃ bye ṣṭṛ'i/ dbu rgyan dang / gos chen gyi na bza' phud/ skra dang sma ra bzhar/ khyim nas (2)yasahrel skyabs 'grogasungasapa/yas hre'i phas bu 'tshol bar yong nas drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su slebs ska~X ༵ yul du

med par khong gis shākya thub pas chos gsungs pa nyan skabs/ rab tu mos te/ de 'phral khong la skyabarnasu 'gro ba (yid ches sa dang rgyab brten sa'i don) gsum te/ dang po sangs rgyas la skyabs su mji/gnyis pa/ chos la skyabs su mchi/ gsum pa/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi/ (dge 'dun ni grog kyi mchog tu brtsi ba/) khong gis da dung spang bya lnga dang du blangs pa ste/ dang po srog gcod spong ba/gnyis pa/ ma byin pa len pa spong ba/ gsum pa/ mi tshangs pa spyod pa spong ba/ bzhi ba/ rdzun tshig spong ba/ lnga ba chang 'thung spong ba bcas so/ / khong ni ang dang po khyim la gnas pa'i chos sgrub mkhan gyi skye pa'i slob ming du g.yu pho sad dam dad gsal skyes bu yang zer/ khong gis shākya thub pa nang du gdan drangs nas khong gi chung mar chos gsungs par zhus pas khong gi chung ma rab tu dga' nas skyabs su 'gro ba gsum dang / spang bya lnga yi sdom pa zhus te khyim na gnas te chos sgrub pa'i bud med kyi slob ma snga shos sugyur te mtshan du g.yu pho dbyi 'am dad gsal bu mo yang zer/( 2)'khor lnga bcu nga drug bcas dbyar gnas la bzhugs tshul/yas hre la grogs lnga bcu yod pas gnas tshul de thos rjes/ drang srong lhung ba ri dwags nags su yong ste nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos sgor zhugs so/ /rgya gar du zla ba drug pa nas dgu pa'i bar ni char dus yin pa dang / 'bu srin dar 'phel gyi dus tshigs kyang yin stabs/ 'bu srin rnams rdog rdzis mi thebs pa'i ched du shākya thub pas khong gi 'khor lnga bcu nga drug rnams 'khrid de drang srong lhung ba ri dwags nags su rtsa yi sbyil bu brgyab ste/ mnyam par ༵/ṭī /nas chos bsgrubs/ lo ltar de bzhin mdzad pas lam lugs su gyur te der dbyar gnas zhes dbyar gnas tshar rjes/ shākya thub pas khong gi 'khor slob rnams rgya gar sa gnas kun tu chos bshad par btang / khong rang nyid mang snya dha'i rgyal khab tu spyal po gzugs can snying por chos gsungs par phebs so/ /skabs der mang gha dha'i rgyal khab ni cung dar rgyas che zhing / der ha cang 'khrug pa'i grong khyer mi nyung ba zhig yod pa de tsho'i nang skad grags che shos ni rgyal po'i khab ces pa'i grong khyer de yin/ grong khyer de tsho'i nang du bram zer ngo rgol byed pa'i bsam blo gsar pa dang / rig gnas gsar pa thon zhing /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bsam blo gsar pa dang rig gnas gsar par dga' bsu dang srung skyob kyi rnam pa 'dzin par brten/ mang gha dha'i rgyal khab de rig gnas gsar pa'i las 'gul gyi lte gnas su gyur/tshad palnga/ ba/ bram ze'i chos la ngo rgol byas nas slob ma stong zag tsam nang pa'i chos lugs su ༄ —ma~X ༵ /'i rgyal khab tu bram zer ngo rgol byed pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' ha cang mang zhing / de'i

nang du rigs 'od srungs yin pa'i spun mched gsum yod pa dang / khong tshor slob ma stong phrag tsam yod/khong tsos mer dad gus byed cing / der brten nyin ltar chu bo rna ra dza na'i 'gram du pha phags pa'i memi ṭwāṃshā /rdzu / tā dhi drordzu dazhi/nga / shākya thub pas mang gha dha'i rgyal khab tu 'byor rjes sngon la khong tsho blo 'gug shākya thub pa 'od srungs kyi brtul zhugs spyod sar phebs nas khong tshor ci'i sbyir me mchod 'bul zhes dris/ 'od srungs kyis lan du dag zhing du 'dren thub zer/ shākya thub pas snang med du zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad de lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas me mchod phul bar phan pa med tshul gsungs pa dang dus mtshungs khong chor bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi gnas lugs thengs gcig gsungs pas/ 'od srungs ni lo mang brtul zhugs spyod myongs dang yon tan chen po ldan pa zhig yin pas shākya thub pa'i chos gsungs par gnas lugs chen po yod par shes te slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdus nas tshang ma'i 'dod mos dang bskun nas yongs rdzogs nang pa'i chos lugs su bsgyur ro/ /'od srungs dang khong gi slob ma rnams sdom pa zhus nas rab tu byung rjes me mchod 'bul byed yo byad rnams chu bo ni ra dza na'i nang du bskur nas chu rgyun gyis 'khyer/ 'od srungs kyi gcung po gnyis nee ra dza na'i smad rgyud du re rer 'khor slob nyis brgya lnga bcu re yod/ khong chos chu gzhung du me mchod 'bul byed kyi yo byad 'khyer yong ba mthong skabs kho bor bkra mi shis pa'i bya ba zhig byung bar snyams nas tshang ma lta bar sdirji ljitrīs 'od srungs kyis skul ma dang bslab bya byas nas khong tsho yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs rsha sgyursha1/ )rgyal po gzugs can snying pos sangs rgyas kyi sbyin bdag mdzad pa/rgyal po gzugs can snying pos rgyal sras don grub sangs rgyas zin pa'i gtam thos ma thag tu yid rab tu mgu zhing / zhogs pa snga mo nas khong gis bram ze'i tshogs dang blon chen gyi tshogs kyis bskor nas pho brang gi nang du shākya thub pa gdan drangs nas chos zhus/ rgyal pos chos nyan rjes sems 'gul rab tu thebs nas gsol par khyed kyis gsungs pa'i chos ni tshig 'bru re re la yang don zab mo mngon sum du ldan no/ /de ring nas bzung ngas sangs rgyas dang dge slong rnams kyi sbyin bdag bgyi bas/ sangs rgyas dang dge slong rnams nga'i rgyal khab tu bzhugs nas mang gha rnyo'i rgyal khab dar rgyas bde skyid yong ba'i thugs 'dun zhu bar 'tshal zer ro/ /rgyal po'i khab nas le dbar gcig gnyis mtshams su 'od ma'i tshal zhig yod pa de ni khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi pha gzhi yin pa yul ljongs mdzes shing 'khor yug dben pa/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis 'od ma'i tshal de shākya thub pa la phul/ rgyal po gzusas can snying pos bzo rigs mi 'dra ba mang po bskungs nas de'i nang du kun dga' ra ba bzhengs te/ 'dir sprug ma mang bas 'od ma'i tshal gyi pho brang yang zer/ pho brang bzhengs grub rjes rgyal po gzugs can snying pos shākya thub pa dang /bong ༵2 kākhodri slob

rnams gdan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol nas der chos bsgrubs pa dang / chos gsungs pa dade/bgro gleng mdzad pa bcas1 'di ni 'dzam gling thog gi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ang dang po'i dgon pa yin/shākya thub pa dang khong gi 'khor nyan thos rnams kyi 'tsho ba ni ha cang stabs bde yin cing / bza' btung gi thad shākya thub pas nyin rer 'cho ba dus gcig las mi gsol ba'i gtan 'beeb mdzad pa dang / des ma zad 'tsho ba ni dkar skyong dang / gsol tshigs yang na sbyin bdag gi bsnyen bkur dang / yang na phyi rol du bsod snyoms slong nas gsol/ de skabs mi tshes bsnyen bkur ni dge sgrub bsod nams gsog par rtsis nas ser sna mi byed/ rab tu byung bas bsod snyoms slong ba ni 'os shing rigs par rtsis nas mthong chung mi byed/ der brten nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'khor slob rnams kyi 'tsho ba ni de tsam dka' ngal che bar tshor gyi med pa dang / dge slong rnams rgyun du dgon nang du bzhugs sheng / gal te phyi rol phyogs kun tu bskyod skabs mi ser gyi khyim du gnas tshang g.yar nas bzhugs chog 'di 'dra'i chos byed pa'i cha rkyen ni ri khrod dang / rong shur du gcer bur sder thang du dka' thub spyod tshul las yar spyas ha cang chen po byung ba'i rtags mtshan yin/dge slong rnamasakyi kun spyod la 'dul khrims dam por bsdams yod/ shākya thub pas khong gi nyan thos rnams la nor rdzas dang / dngul dang / sa zhing thon rdzas dang / bran g.yog dang bud med nyar mi chog pa dang / nyan thos 'khor bcas kyis mi la 'thab mo dang / lag 'dzing / gtug bsher/g.yar po skyi len/ bun lon gtong ba sogs gtan nas bya mi chog khong rtsas phyi rol pa'i phyag mchod mi byed pa dang / brtag pa dang / mo btab mi byed pa/ rab tu byung ba dang skya sar 'bab pa gang byed rang mos yin pa gtan 'khel byas so/ /'di lta bu'i chos kyi nang don dang chos khrims gsar pa rgyal po'i khab tu gtan nas byung ma myong ba des/ bram ze'i chos la mi 'dod pa dang stobs shugs nyin bzhin 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i arya dang / rje rigs pa/ de bzhin dmangs rigs kyi nang du brag cha chen po zhig 'khor stabs khong tsho'i 'od ma'i tshal du yong nas shākya thub pa'i chos nyam cing / deri nang gi nyan mi ha cang mang po zhig chos nyan rjes nang pa'i chos sgor zhugs nas nang pa'i chos kyi slob ma dag tu gyur/ tha na rgyal po gzugs can snying po yang nang pa'i chos pa zhis tu gyur pa des shākya thub pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i las 'gul khyab par stabs bange'i cha rkyen che ru gtong ched/ shākya thub pa dang khong gi nyan thos rnams 'od ma'i tshal gyi bzhugs yul nas thon te rgya gar sa gnas khag la nangapa sangs rgyas kyi chos khyab gdal du btang ba'i 'go tshugs so/ /(2)blanamed pa'ispyodabazang canal gus bkurabyed 'os pa/rigs rus bar gyi 'gal ba ni de dus rgya gar gyi gtso che shos kyi spyi tshogs 'gal ba 'ig yin/dper na/ bramaze'i chos dpe'i nang du gsal por gtan 'beeb byas gsal du/ bram ze'i go gnas ni mchoka —tu ༵༵parji rigs mtho shos shig yin par/ rgyal po arya'i rigs kyis kyang khong tshor do med ces

'khod/ shākya thub pa'i chos kyi don nang du tag tag de khas ma blangs par/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi skye slongs tshang ma gcig mtshungs yin pas mchog dman gyi dbye ba med pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal por bsgrags/khong gi chos gsungs skabs su rtag tu gting zab yin pa dang go bde ba'i rgyu mtshan thog nas bram ze'i rigs rus lam lugs kyi khungs med lung med kyi bab col gzhung lugs la dgag pa mdzad/thengs gcig rgyal po'i khab kyi bram ze gnyis rang mos kyis sku dang sma ra bregs/ chos gos gyon/khyim spangs te chos la zhugs pa bcas bram ze ga'an gyis de mthong skabs khong khros te ngan ngan ngar ngar gyis cug tsub po brjod don bram ze'i rigs rus ni go 'phang mtho zhing rtsa che shos dang / dkar po'ang yin/ gzhan gyi rigs rus rnams ni tha shal dman zhing nag po'i rigs yin/ bram ze'i rigs rus kyi skye khungs ni tshangs pa'i sras yin par ma zad/ tshangs pa'i zhal nas 'khrungs pa yin pas/ tshe 'dir bde skyid dpal yon la longs su spyod rgyu dang / shi rjes rnam shes de'ang bde ba'i zhing khams su 'gro/rigs rus gzhan rnams ni tshangs pa'i phyag dang / rkang pa lte ba sogs las skyes pas tshe 'dir sdug bsngal nges med myong dgos pa dang / phyi mar dmyal bar lhungs/ khyod chos 'di lta bu'i rigs rus bzang po dor nas log lta 'chal gtam la dad pa byas te mgo bo ril ril gyi dge slong byas pa 'di ni pha rabs bu rgyud chad pa yin pas rabs chad pa zhig ci'i phyir byed/ 'di ni rang gis rang nyid rtsa brlag gtong ba zhig ma red dam zer bas/ bram ze de gnyis shākya thub pa'i chos gsungs/ dad gtsang tshal du yong nasasnyebram zes khong tshor tshig tsub gdug pa can smras pa rnams lab cor brgyab nas zhus/shākya thub pas long tshor gsungs don bram ze rnams kyis chos bshad yongs rdzosas ni gtan tshigs khungs lung gang yang med pa'i bab col rdzun gtam 'ig red/ khyed tshos bas ma blo zhig thongs dang /bram zes bud med dang gnyen bsgrigs nas phru gu 'khor/ de rjes gzhi nas skyes/ rigs rus ga'an rnams kyang de ltar ma yin nam/ 'jig rten thog tu kha las skyes pa/ phrag pa lasi skyes pa/ rkang pa la sa skyes/ lte ba las skyes zhig dang / de 'dra'i rgyu mtshan zhig ga la yo da/ bram ze rnams kyis rang nyid skye khungs mtho zhing rigs mchog tu gyur pa dang rtsa ba chen po yin par rlom nas mi la 'jigs zel ngoms pa des khong tshos sger sems rngam btsog can gyi rang gshis ngo bo phyir bton pa zhig tas tag yin/ den dngos thog rigs rus bzhi yi mi rnams kyi dge sdig gi 'bras bu smin stangs gcig mtshungs yin/ srog gcod pa/ rku byed pa/ log g.yem spyod pa/ rdzun bshad pa sogs kyi nyes pa ba'i/sas mkhan zhig yin phyin/ de bram ze dang / rgyal rigs/ rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs su yim kyang ma ra dbye ba med par rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / srog mi gcod/ rku mi byed/ ro ga g.ye ma mi byed rdzun mi smra/ 'dod pa mi byed pa/ ham pa mi byed pa sogs kyi dge ba skubamalar baju rigs rus gang yim kyang tshang mar 'bras bu bzang po thob par 'gyur/ nga'i chos kyi nang du skye khungasagang yin rung yong pa sangs rgyas pa'i rus gcig yin pas rus kyi dbye ba 'byed par tshang ma 'dra mtshungs/ /ri/da/ ༵༵ 9 te di 'ig

gis khyod tsho rigs rus gang yin zhes brjod na/ khyod chos dge sbyong shākya'i rigs yin zhes lan thob cig gsungs shing / mi de gnyis kyis shākya thub pa'i bka' gnang ba thos rjes the tshom sel zhing / rtse gcigatu chos bsgrubs pas/ slar yang bram zes tshig tsub brjod rgyur mi 'dzems par gyur/shākya thub pas kha gsal go bde'i gnas lugs gsungs nas rigs rus lam lugs kyi phyogs res kyi lta ba tshar gcod par ma zad/ bram ze rnams kyi bag med rul sung gi 'tsho ba spyod stangs ther 'don byas nas khong tshor 'gyod sems skye 'jug pa bcas mdzad/thengs gcig shākya thub pas 'khor dge slong chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcus bskor nas ku sa li'i rgyal khab kyi dbyin phras ning zhes pa'i bram ze'i grong zhig yod pa'i nye 'dabs kyi nags gseb tu byon nas mtshan mor der bzhugs/ grong nang gi bram ze ming la phu ga ru pho ru zer ba zhig yod pa kho la slob ma lnga brgya yod pa de tshos brtag pa byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa la brten nas rgyu nor chen po 'phel ba yod/ phu ga ru pho rus shākya thub pa'i mtshan snyan chen po yod pa thos myong yang yid ches la ma ches thog rang nyid ngo ma phar mjal phrad dgos min thag gcod byed pa'i ched du sngon la sbob ma zhig gtam nyan par mngags/nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs par kho'i slob ma de nags gseb kyi khrod du slebs/ kho'i bsam par nga ni skye khungs kyi rigs mthon po yin snyams nas shākya thub pa mjal skabs khengs dregs chen po'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa dang / tha na khos shākya thub par 'jig rten pa'i mi tshang mas bram zer gus bkur zhu ba yin pas khyed tsho dge sbyong shākya'i rigs kyis de ltar min pa ci yin zer bas/ shākya thub pas kho'i gtam ni tshig tsub ngan tshad bshad pa gzigs nas kho la gsungs don kun spyod bla na med pa dang ldan mkhan la gzhi nas /sdu dṛshārsha ༵dī tram̐/sa/ khyod tsho bram ze'i kun spyod de 'dra min pas mi tshos ci'i phyir gus bkur byed dgos khos shākya thub pa la dris don khyod kyis bshad tshul ltar na mi ga 'dra zhig la kun spyod bla na med pa zhig brtsi gi yo da dam zhes/shākya thub pas gsungs don sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon/ mi rnams kyi don du chos gsungs/tshig 'bru re re bzhin gyis mi rnams la dge ba'i bslab bya mdzad/ chos don nyan pa'i mi rnams kyang mig dang rna ba dwangs shing gsal/ sems la ye shes blo brtan thob/ 'dul khrims bsrungs la bya ba byed/sems ldan 'gro ba'i srog mi gcod/ bu mo'i 'dod yon la sems mi chags/ stobs chen la brten nas nyam chung la brnyas mi bya/ bab col mi smra/ chang mi 'thung / gang dran gang 'dod mi byed/ gser dngul nor rdzas la 'dod rngam yang spang bar bya/ bran g.yog mi nyar rgyu dngos spangs/ dus bab shes bzhin du spyod par bya/ lto bar dpag nas zas za tshod 'dzin dgos/ lus la tshad nas gyon tshad 'dzin dgos/ 'di lta bu byed mkhan yin na kun spyod bla na med pa ldan pa yin zhes gsungs/ shākya thub pas gsuḍis ṭwāṃrdoṭwāṃs cung ba'ag nas/ yang kho la 'on kyang khyod cag bram ze tsho ni/ /zas gos chod med gang

'dod byed/ /rgyan 'dzug sbag rgyag rlung ltar dang / /khyim bya 'thab pa'am khyi 'dzing rtsis/ /bud med la dbang yod brnyas bcos byed/ / dmag la dga' zhing srog rtsa gcod/ /mi rtsis rgyag dang brtag pa byed/ /rgyu nor bsrus nas ham za byed/ kha mchu rgyag rgyu'i 'gan gtsang len/ ya med lugs med khrims la mi brtsi ba/ zhwa gos gzab mchor spras sa har po gyon/ gang sa gang du ham bshad mgo skor gtong ba bcas/ 'di tsho tshang mar mi rnams kyis zhe bsun pa dang / ngo tsha khrel rgod kho nar byed rgyu las/ ches shā~X tnashārsha /rdzu ༵ trī /gra/sa su ji ltar tshud thub bam/ gang 'dra byas nas mir gus bkur byed du 'jug nus mi des de ltar thos pa'i rjes su ngo tsha 'gyod sems skyes nas sems 'gul thebs shing grong nang du log rjes rang nyid kyi slob dpon la brjod don shākya thub pa zhes pa mi de ni kun spyod bzang po yin par grags pa de don dngos red 'dug khong gis mir sdig sprong dge sgrub byed dgos pa'i bslab bya re mdzad dus mi tsho'i dang ba 'dren nas lus kyi gnas lnga sa la btud dgos par gyur zer/ phu ga ru pho rus thos rjes kyang de bzhin sems 'gul thebs par gyur/nyin gnyis par phu ga ru pho rus 'khor lnga brgya 'khrid de shākya thub pa mjal bar phyin nas zhus don nyi ma de ring nas bzung nga yang nang pa'i chos la zhugs rgyu yin/ phyin chad kyang de ltar srog mi gcod rku mi byed/ mi tshangs pa mi spyod/ rdzun mi bshad/ chang mi 'thung bar byed do zhes zer/ gnyen sgrig byed pa'i riṭa rus kyis dbye mtshams gtor ba/ shākya thub pa'i chos kyi nang don du gnyen sgrig byed par rigs rus kyi dbye ba'i mtshams 'gag de gtor dgos pa dang / gser dngul go gnas gnyer rgyu med pa'i py-i/ rsha shāsdu ṭwāṃ rdo/ /gyi yod/ de thengs gcig chos gsung skabs shākya thub pas ngo mtshar can gyi gtam rgyud wa ra ṇa si'i grong nang lag rtsal phul du phyin pa'i lcags bzo ba zhig yod pa de'i rigs rus ni dmangs rigs yin/ khong la bu mo zhig yod pa ni mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba ma zad/ las ka 'jon po dang sems rgyud drang po bcas zhig yin/ grong khyer nang gi bram ze gzhon nu khyim du 'byor pa chen po lngan pa zhig yod/ thengs gcig lcags bzo'i bu mo khang pa'i thog kha'i steng du langs sdod skabs/ gzhon nu des mthong zhing / de nas bzung gzhon nu des mor dga' brtse'i 'du shes chags te pha mar mi zhig btsal nas gnyen 'dun gtam rogs zhus par/ pha nas der bshad don khyod kyis khyim tshang 'di 'dra'i bu mo de btsal mi chog nga tsho'i khyim tshang gi zhabs 'dren zhu gi red/ nga cho'i khyod la rigs mthun khyim 'dra'i bu mo zhig btsal chog zer bar/ gzhon nus gal te lcags bzo'i bu mo chung mar ma blang na/ nga shi na dga' ba yin zer bas/ pha mar thabs shes med par lcags bzo ba de gdan 'dren drangs nas bshad par khyed kyi bu mo gal te nga'i bu'i mna' mar ster na dngul nor 'dzad med dang / gyon chas rdzogs med spyod rgyu yod zer mod/ 'on kyang lcags bzo bas dngos po'i cha rkyen de rnams la yid mirjo cho~X ༵ra—/ bu

mo ster sa de lag col shes mkhan kho na 'tshol dgos pa las/ khyim tshang dbul phyug ga 'dra zhig yod kyasmokhyad par med cing / gzhon nu 'di de snga lag rtsal shes mkhan zhig yin pas/ soms rtse gcigacabasgrims nas khab spus legs mang po bzos nas lcags bzo ba'i sgo 'gram du tshong bar song / bu mos thokaukha'i steng nas khab tshong mkhan mthong dus der yid dbang 'chor nas pha mar sems nang gi 'khor don rnams gsal bar bshad/ lcags bzo bas thos rjes khab tshong mkhan gzhon nu de nang du gdan drangs tshebartag dpyad tshod blta byas rjes/ khab ni dngos 'brel spus legs yin thag chod/ lag shes bzo rtsal yang spus dag po yod pa mthong / lcags bzo bas khab tshong mkhan gyi gzhon nu de 'byor pa can gyi khyim shāng/ /de'i bu yin par shes kyang khos da dung dga' spro'i ngang nas bu mo mna' ma ster ba red ces gsungs shākya thub pas gtam rgyud 'di gsungs pa'i rjes su slar yang gsung don khyed tshos dgongs pa thongs /ṭwāṃ tram̐shā/sa bzo ba'i bu mo'i gnyen bsgrigs kyi spyod tshul de bsngags par 'os pa zhig ma yin nam zhes (2)dmaramachod 'bulab dang dka' thub brtul zhugs spyod par ngorgol byas pa/bram ze'i chos kyis rang nyid kyi g.yo 'gul thebs pa'i dbang sgyur go gnas bsrung skyong byed ched mu mthud dmar mchod kun thub ring lugs lag len bstar nas/ tshangs par gus pas mchod pa byas nas skye ba phyi rmi ra bde skyid thob rgyu'i skor gyi dzun gtam bed spyad nas mang tshogs la mgo skor btang / de skabs rgyal po'i pho brang nas khyim tshang dang them dud khag gi bar/ lo ltar dang zla ltar re bzhin rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dmar mchod dang / smon lam phyag 'tshal bcas byed cing / skabs re khong tshos ba glang / ra lug rta sogs srog chags gsod pa dang / skabs re khong tshos mi bsad nas mchod rdzas byed pa'i ha cang gi kla klo dang / drag tsub spyod ngan tshad las 'das/ bram ze rnams ni 'di lta bu'i dmar mchod 'bul ba'i thog nas rgyu nor 'phon chen zhig thob kyi yod/ shākya thub pa'i chos gsar pas tshangs pa dang /brgya byin gyi lha'i rigs la phyag 'tshal mi byed pa dang / khong gi slob ma rnams kyis khong gis gsungs pa'i chos kho nar dad pa byed pa dang / chos dang mthun pa kho na bsgrubs/thengs gcig shākya thub pa dang 'khor nyan thos chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu ku sa li'i rgyal nang du chos 'khor bskor bar phebs te mtshan mo zhig grong dang nye ba'i nags gseb cig tu bzhugs/ grong cho 'dir mi 'khor skye 'phel che zhing / thon dzas 'bol po yod pa/ me tog dang zhing rigs sne 'dzoms kyis yul ljongs ha cang mdzes pa 'ig baspyan/ rgyal po si ni ci'u lo than thu'u yi sgo sazhis su gnang ba/ ci lo than thu'u zer ba ni snyan grags can gyi bram ze'i mi zhig yin/ khong ni dmar mchod dang phyag 'tshal la dga' shos shig yin/ khos shākya thub pa grong tsho'i nye 'dabs su bzhugs yod pa'i gtam thos rjes grong mi dang mnyatram̐ du spra 3༵ra dzi / ngo mjal ba'i rjes su shākya thub par brjod don nga'i go thos su khyed kyis rim gro'i

mdzad sgo chen po'i rigs gsum yon tan mkhyen gyi yod pa dang / mchod sdas yo byad rigs bcu drug zhib brabyang du chub yod pa thos byung / ngas dmar mchod ha cang rgya chen po zhig byed rgyu'i don glang lnga brgya/bzhon ma lnga brgya/ pho be'u lnga brgya/ mo bee'u lnga brgya/ ra pho lnga brgya/ ra mo lnga brgya bcas gra sgrig byas ṭwāṃ/ /zhesade/ ring ched mngags khyed kyi mdun bcar nas phyag mchod ji ltar byed dgos slob pa zhu bar yong ba shākya thub pas khong la gsung don gna' rabs su rgyal po arya zhes pas dmar mchod cig 'bul snyams pa red/ blon chen dang / btsun mo/ rgyal sras/ gnyen grogs/ dmag dpon bcas tshang mas rgyab skyor chen po byas pa dang / da dung ched mngags mchod khang chen po zhig kyang gsar du bsgrun/dmar mchod chen po'i nyin der/ rgyal po sha ba'i wags pa nyeb gyon rgyag pa dang / lus la dri zhim mar gyis byugs te mchod khang du 'dzul nas lci ba spungs pa'i sa steng du bzhugs te dmar mchod kyi 'go btsugs pa red/ khyod kyis bsam blo thongs shig rgyal pos mar kho na byugs pas 'grigs pa yin na khyod kyis mchod rdzas de 'dra'i mang po byed don ci yod zhes gsungs/ci'u lo than thu'u thos rjes cang mi smra zhing / yud tsam bsam blo btang rjes bden pa cung brnyes nas gra sgrigs byas pa'i gsod rgyu'i ra lug sogs tshang ma tshe thar btang ba red/(4)smongs dad sel ba/bram ze tshos dus rtag tu skabs bsnan bsnyad 'dogs kyi cha rkyen bzos nas mgo bskor bslu brid byed cing / khong tshos bshad srol du chur mchongs nas rang lcebs byas na rang nyid kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag thub pa dang / me dpal 'bar gyis rang bsregs btang na rnam shes dag zhing du 'gro thub ces pa'i cal co bsgrags/ khong tshos da dung skar ma brtag pa dang zi lam 'grel bshad byed/ shākya thub pa dang khong gi slob ma rnams kyis mi tsher de rigs la yid ches ma byed zhes gsungs/lo zhig la shākya thub pa gnyan yod rgyal khab tu chos gsung skabs rgyal po spo si nir rmi lam ngan pa thengs bcu mis pas nyin gnyis par khong gis g.yas g.yon gyi blon po'i tshogs dang / bram ze rnams bskungs nas bshad par mdang nub nga'i mi lam du don tshan bcu rmis byung / sus der 'grel bshad rgyag thub gsungs nas mu mthud mtshan mo'i rmis pa'i don tshan bcu rnams gsungs pas/ der bram ze zhig rtag tu mgo skor gtong ba'i sgyu rtsal can zhig yod pa des mi lam bcu de thos rjes bshad don mi ring bar rgyal po grongs nas spyal gzhi stong rgyu red zer bas/ rgyal po rab tu skug/ bzhin mdog shor nas myur bar dris don de ldog pa'i thabs yod dam zhes smras pas/ bram zes bshad don ldog pa'i thabs yod/khyed kyi rgyal sras dang / mdza' ba'i chung ma bkrongs/ pho brang gi mdzod khang khag mer bsregs btang nas tshangs par mchod pa byas/ bram ze rnams la bya dga' chen po sbyin na gnod pa zhi zhing bde bar 'gyur zhes brjod pas/ spo si nis khos de ltar bshad pa thos rjes/ skyo snang 'jigarji skra~X ༵da de yid

sdug po'i ngang gcig pur sbyang gnas khang du phyin nas gang 'dra byas na legs snyam ste ci bya gtol med du gyur/ smo li zer ba spo si ni'i mdza' shos kyi chung ma yin pa des gtam 'azin thos jes smyung gnas khang du yong bas rgyal pos mtshan mo'i mi lam dang bram zes rmi lam gyi 'grel bshad bcas mgo mjug bar tshang 0mo la gsung bar phud/ da dung rang nyid da lta ha cang skrag cing ga 'dra byas na drags gsungs pas/ smo lis 'jigs mi dgos/ da lta sangs rgyas rgyal byed tshal na bzhugs yod pas khyed der byon nas sangs rgyas la bka' slob zhus zer/nyin gnyis par rgyal po spo si nis blon po rnams 'khrid de rgyal byed tshal gyi kun dga' ra bar phebs te shākya thub par sngon rjes kyi gnas tshul rnams zhib par zhus te gang drags bka' stsal du gsol zhus pas/shākya thub pas skug dgos don med/ 'di ni gnas tshul phra mo zhig yin/ rmi lam 'di tsho dang dngos yod kyi bar la 'brel ba gang yang med/ de khyed la chag sgo chen po zhig yong ba'i snga ltas gtan nas min/ bram ze'i gtam la khungs lung rtsa ba nas med/ de ni ngan sems zur bcangs byas pa 'ba' zhig yin/ khyed der mgo ma 'khor/ g.yo 'og tu ma tshud gsungs pas/ rgyal po spo si nis 'phral du don rnams gsal bar rtogs te shākya thub pa la ha cang dad sems skyes/ pho brang du log rjes btsun mo smo lir bya dga' chen po gnang ba dang dus mtshungs/ pho brang nang blon chen rnams kyi phogs thob nyung du btang /mgo skor gtong mkhan gyi bram ze de grong khyer gnyan yod nas mthar skrod btang ngo / /de skabs spyi tshogs thog tu dka' thub spyod pa'i ring lugs dar srol chen po yod/ mi mang pos rang gi bsam blo'i nang nas byung ba der lhag bsam gyis dad pa byed cing / thabs lam 'di brgyud nas rnam shes gtsang mar 'gyur ba'i re ba byed/ yin na yang dka' thub dngos su spyod mkhan kha shas ni snyan grags gzi brjid g.yo gnyer byed pa'i don du 'ba' zhig yin pas/ shākya thub pas dka' thub tu spyod pa'i gnod pa ngan pa de gsal por mkhyen nas dgag pa shugs chen mdzad/thengs shig shākya thub pa dang dge slong chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu po bcas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs skabs/ khong gis bram ze'i dka' thub spyod pa ni cus ta tho zhes pa des 'khor slob ma lnga brgya 'khrid nas nags khrod du bsgoms su zhugs yod par gsan nas/ khong rang nyid nags khrod du phebs nas der dka' spyod mkhan la gsungs don khyod tshos chos byed skabs su tshang mas lus gcer bur gang yang ma gyon pa 'di sdig pa las thar thub bam/ khyod tshos ri skyes kyi tshal dang zhing tog rtsi tog sogs bzas pa dang / tha na ba glang dang sha ba'i lci ba bzas pa 'dis rnam par shes pa gtsang mar 'gyur thub bam/ khyod tshos lag pa bsgrongs te langs pa dang / yang na sar sgur tsog gis sdod pa/yang na tsher ma'i steng du nyal ba/ gcer bur lci ba'i steng du nyal ba sogs 'di 'dra'i dka' thub spyod pa des gzugs por mnar bcod nas rmas skyon bzos pa ma gtogs/ de min gyi phan thogs gang 'ig yong sridashaṃ ma py-ipy-i4 gsungs pas/ brtul zhugs spyod pa mi nyung ba zhig gis/ de ltar thos rjes bden par go

nas shākya thub par dngos 'brel gyis chos sgrub tshul ji ltar byed dgos tshul slob rogs zhus so/ shākya thub pas khong tshor gsungs don dka' thub dngos 'bril spyod na/ sha wags la sdug po myong rgyu'i dka' ba spyod pa ma yin par/ rang gi sems nang gi mnyam par bzhag pa la brten nas 'dod sems spangs shing /gyin ci log pa'i bsam blo mi skye bar/ sems rtse gcig tu dge ba la phyogs/ srog mi gcod/ rku mi byed/mi tshangs ba mi spyod/ phrag dog mi byed/ sems pa rnam dag gis chos de ltar bsgrubs na/ gzhi nas btsog dreg gam mi gtsang ba'i rigs thams cad dang rgyang ring du bral te chos grub nas sangs rgyas par ṭwāgyu/ ra/ zhes gsung pa/ de tshos thos tshe rgyu mtshan yod par rtogs nas nang pa'i chos lugs la dad par gyur drug pa/ sgra gcan 'jin khrim spangs nas rabatwa byung ba/rgyal po zas gtsang gis bu sangs rgyas thob nas da lta gang sa gang du chos gsungs kyi yod pa dang // shā ༵ zlosdu ༵pro /snas trīnashā pyirdo ba/ zhin pa'i tshul rnams thos skabs dga' skyo gnyis 'dzoms kyis bu dran nye bsdo 'khor zer ba'i g.yog po zhig de snga rgyal sras kyi 'bas phyi byed myong ba zhig yod pa der rgyal pos gsungs don khyod phyin nas rgyal sras rang rgyal du tshur gdan drongs shig khong khyim dang kha bral nas ṭwāṃ ༵zlo tāspraṅgi /ṭwāṃ tram̐ṭwāṃ /rno sa// nga tshos nyin mtshan kun tu dran nas sems skyo bas khong mjal 'dod ni nye bar 'khor rgyal po'i bka' dang bskun nas 'od ma'i tshal du slobs nas rgyal po'i bka' mngags rnams zhus pas/ shākya thub pa'i dgongs par khyim dang kha bral skabs su ngas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob rjes gzhi nas nang du log nas gnyen bshes rnams dang ngo mjal dga' thug byed rgyu khas blangs pa yin pas/ da lta dus la 'bab par dgongs nas khyim du phebs rgyu'i tshes grangs gtan 'khel mdzad nas nye bar 'khor sngon du rgyal por zhu ru btang /rgyal po dang btsun mo grags 'dzin ma/ pho brang gi mi sna dang rgyal yo ngas kyi blon 'bangs bcas kyis rgyal sras rgyal khab tu phyir log phebs gtam thos nas tshang ma sems pa rab tu dga' bar gyur/shākya thub pa phebs yong ba'i nyin der spyal pos blon tshen dang arya bram ze rnams grong khyer nas le dbar bzhi bcu'i sar dga' bsu zhu skabs mi ser grangs med kyang rjes su 'brangs/shākya thub pa 'khor nyan thos rnams kyis mtha' skor nas ser skya'i rgyal khab tu phebs shing / rgyal pos rgyal sras mjal skabs dga' skyo mnyam du skyes pa dang / blon chen dang dpon rigs tshang mas gus 'dud phyag 'bul sna chogs yang yang byas/shākya thub pa pho brang du 'byor skabs ma sgrun dang grags 'dzin mas khong khyim spangs pa'i rjes su 'khrungs pa'i sras sgra gcan 'dzin 'khrid de mdun du mjal bar yong skabs shākya thub pas2 rdoṭwāṃ tsho re re

bzhin la 'tshams 'dri mdzad/rgyal po zas gtsang gis rgyal sras dang dge slong rnams kyi ched du dmigs bkar kun dga' ra ba gsar ba zhig brgyab ste/ nyin ltar re bzhin ro bcud ldan pa'i gdugs tshod drangs/ yin na yang shākya byā~X ༵ shā// khong gi 'khor nyan thos rnams sngar bzhin srang lam du bsod snyoms su phebs te chos gsungagargyal rigs dang blon chen rnams kyi bu phrug mang pos shākya thub pa'i mdzad spyod la dang ba lhag par skyes te gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyi khyim spangs nas dge slong gi sdom pa zhus/ shākya thub pa'i gcung dga' bo dang spun gyi bu kun dga' bo dang lhas sbyin sogs kyang khyim spangs rab tu byung / gsar du khyim spangs rab tu byung ba rnams kyis sngon la dge slong re re bzhin tshang ma'i zhabs la gtugs te gus pas 'dud/dga' bos sngon ma'i g.yog po nye bar 'khor gyi drung du slebs nas gus 'dud byed grabs mdzad skabs khong the tshom skyes te bsam par kho ni de snga nga'i nang gi 'khor g.yog zhig yin stabs kho la gus 'dud byas na ga la 'grigs snyam/ shākya thub
