pas gnas tshul 'di mthong rjes gsungs don sangs rgyas chos kyi mdun du mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin/ chos kyi nang du khyim spangs rab byung la sngon rjes yod pa las/drag zhan mtho dman gyi khyad par med/ khyed rab tu byung na chos khrims brtsi bsrungs zhu dgos gsungs pas/ dga' bos gcen po'i slob ston rnam par dag pa thos rjes sgrob nyams bcag ste nye bar 'khor la gus 'dud zhus pas tshang mar sems 'gul thebs/ de nas bzung sngon la rab tu byung ba ni bslab pa bgres pa dang rjes su rab tu byung ba ni bslab pa gzhon pa yin pa'i sgrig lam btsugs so/ / du phyir /ṭā shāb/ pa khyim du nyin bdun bzhugs te 'khor slob mi nyung ba zhig bsdus te slar yang 'od ma'i tshal de nas rgyun ring ma song bar shākya thub pa'i dgongs par sras sgra gcan 'dzin dgung lo bco lngar beebs pas slob gso byed dgos pas khyim du rang dgar 'khyam du bcug rgyu med dgongs nas mogil gyi bu ser skya'i rgyal khab tu btang nas phyogs gcig tu yab yum gnyis lta ba dang grags 'dzin mar 'tshams 'dri byed pa/ phyogs gcig nas sgra gcan 'dzin khyim spangs nas rab tu byung phyir khrid par btang /monal gyi bu bka' spebs pa ltar ser skya'i spyal khab kyi pho brang tu 'byor nas rgyal po zas gtsang la yong don zhus rjes/ grags 'dzin mas shākya thub pas sgra gcan 'dzin rab tu byung phyir khrid mkhan btang ba thos rjes sgra gcan 'dzin thog khang nang du sbas nas sgo dang sge'u khung rnams dam por brgyab ste rang nyid sgo 'gram du bsdad nas ched mngags kyi bsrung bya mdzad/ monal gyi bu lcam gyi pho brang du 'byor te grags 'dzin mar sgra gcan 'dzin rab tu byung dgos tshul gyi gnas tshul gsal bar brjod rjes/ grags 'dzin mas shākya thub pa rgyal bo byed skabs nga khab tu blangs nas zla bo mdzad/ ngas rgyal sras lha dang 'dra bar brtsitram̐ na~X ༵ 'dzis pa spu tsam yang byas med/ 'on kyang khong nam phyed pho brang nas bros te lo bcu phrag

ring go thos tsam yang ma byung / na ning nang du phebs skabs su nga la rnam 'gyur grang mo 'khyag rum lta bu mdzad/ snga ma ltar gyi brtse dung dang dga' sems gtan nas med pa lam bzhud kyi mgron po las kyang zhan/nged ma bu gnyis grogs med gcig pu'i gnas su gyur zhing / da lta yang nga'i bu khrid par yong ba 'di dngos 'brel mir snying rje med pa'i btsan gshed 'di las che ba yod dam/ rgyal sras kyis khong ni byams dang snying rje can gyi chos yin gsungs pa de ltar byams dang snying rje'i chos yin na/ mi tshang mar skyid po yong ba mdzad dgos nges yin mod/ 'on kyang khong gis nged ma bu gnyis kha bral ba ni sdug bsngal gyi nang nas sdug bsngal che shos shig red gsungs kyang khong gis 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal de mi'i thog tu btsan 'gel gnang ba 'dir bltas nas bshad na khong la byams sems shig yod pa ga la shod thub/ khyed rang phyir phebs nas nga'i gtam 'di tsho ji ma ji bzhirna'ajig rten mgon po khong la zhu rogs kyis zer/mogil gyi bus thabs brgya'i zhu ba phul kyang 'bras bu gang yang ma byung bas/ gong gsal gyi gnas tshul rnams zhib gsal rgyal por zhus pas/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis btsun mo skye dgu'i bdag mo gdan drangs nas zhus par bu sgra gcan 'dzin rab byung sgrub pa'i donadu mi bsu bar btang 'dug de ni khong la dam pa'i chos bslabs pa'i don du red/ grags 'dzin ma bu'i brtse dung gis myos nas u tshugs kyis 'al la mi nyan 'dug patshokhyed kyis khong la zhu rogs mdzod zhes/btsun mo dang lhan du zhal ta mang po dang bcas grags 'dzin ma'i pho brang du phebs nas yang nas yang du zhu nan mdzad pas grags 'dzin mas gsung don khyim nas ma yong gong du rgyal khab brgyad kyi rgyal pos 'tshang kha brgyab nas bag mar slong kyang pha mas ma ster bar shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal sras sgyu rtsal che stabs pha mas de la ster zhing / rgyal sras dang po nas khyim spangs rab byung mdzad rgyu'i dgongs bzhed yod na ci'i phyir nga khab tu bzhes nas gnyen sgrig gnang / nged gnyis mnyam du byung ba ni phan tshun brtse ba'i rkyen gyis byung zhing de ni dga' spro mnyam 'dzom byas nas rigs rgyud spel skyong bya rgyu yin mod/ 'on kyang rgyal sras kyis de las ldog ste mi'i mdza' brtse'i gzhung don srol rgyun la mi lta bar khyim spangs pa 'di kho na'i sdug bsngal gyis nga la yid pham byung thog slar yang nga'i bu 'phrog dgos pa ci yin nam zer bas/ btsun mos de skad go rjes lan yang 'debs rgyu ma rnyed/ 'on kyang grags 'dzin mas mthar spyal po dang btsun /trī ṭwāṃ // bzlo bar yi mug khog bcug gis bu sgra gcan 'dzin khyim spangs rab tu byung bar gtong dgos sgra gcan 'dzin rgyal byed tshal du rteribyor rjes shākya thub pas morgal gyi bu de khong gi dge rgan byed du ba'ag sgra gcan 'dzin gyis mi dge ba bcu spongs pa'i chos zhus te dge slong byas/ (lo na ma son pa'i chos pa)sgra gcan 'dzin lo na phra bas rtsed mor dga' zhing / dgon nang gi sgrig khrims nan po'i 'tsho bar mi goms pa dang / chos shod pa dang dge sgrub la brtson pa ni de bas kyang dga' po ma byas/nyin zhig mnyam par bzhag ste ting nge 'dzin sgom skabs su sgra gcan 'dzin ga ler phyi rol du bros te — 237 —

rtsed mo rtser song bas shākya thub pas mi mngags khong bos yong skabs/ bka' bkyon mdzad par khyod 'gilta bu'i le lo byed cing bsgrubs la mi dga' ba ci yin gsungs pas/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas gyichos ni gting zab cing rtogs dka' bas/ ngas go thub kyi mi 'dug de bas nga 'dod pa khengs pa'i gang dga' 'khyams su 'jug rogs gnang / lo na cher song skabs de dus chos zhus chog zer/ shāspya thub pas 'dus byas kyi chos rnams mi rtag cing gzugs kyi phung po yang bsrung bar shin tu dka'/ khyosku nyid 'tshar nas tsher longs pa'i 'gan len byed par nus sam ci zhes gsungs/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyimings 'gan len par mi nus/ khyed kyis rang nyid kyi bu'i srog kyang 'gan len thub bam zhes/ shākya bub pas ngas rtag tu rang gis rang la'ang 'gan len mi thub na khyod kyi srog 'gan len gang 'dra byed byub/sgra gcan 'dzin gyis gtam de thos ma thag yid thang rab tu chad de bshad don la gal te de ltar yin na chos bslabs nas dgos pa ci yod khyed kyis nga pha ma lta bur nang du slog rogs gnang zer/ shākya thug pas nan pos gsungs don chos zhus nas gzhi rkang tshe 'dir rang bsrung mi thub kyang lus sems la phan thog tshe/ngas de snga khyod la bshad myong / sangs rgyas kyi chos ni sbrang char gyi zil pa dang / sman gyi mchog zam pa/thu chen dang 'dra bar zhes brjod yod khyod kyis dran nam/ dge slong kha shas ni kha zhe gcig tu mi mthun pas dper na mi 'ga' shas bza' btung thob phyir dang yang na tshe ring lo brgya thob phyir khyim spangs nas rab tu byung / kha shas ni khral 'ul la g.yol phyir rab tu byung zhing / 'di ni kun slong rnam par ma dag pa'i rkyen gyis dka' thub chen pos chos bsgrubs mi thub cing / skye ba phyi mar sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu myong los dgos/ der brten thog mar rab tu byung ba'i kun slong rnam par dag pa dgos pa dang chos zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan shes dgos zhes brjod pa dang dus mtshungs/ shākya thub pas mu mthud nas sgragacan 'dzin la gtam rgyud zhig gsungs/gnas snga mo bud med zhig yod pa'i ming la thi 'do zer/ rigs rus bram ze yin/ khyim du dngos zog grangs med yod pa/ gzhon nu'i dus nas mo hrings su gnas/ der bu dang bu mo/ pha ma/gcen gcung pho mo tshang ma med stabs/ brten sa 'khor sa gang yang med/ bram ze mang po mo'i sar yong nas zer don/ khyod la sdig sgrib che bas sngon la nang gi rtsa che'i rgyu nor rnams bram ze lnga brgya po tshang mar 'gyed btang nas bram ze'i chos kyi mdzad sgos khyod kyi don du sngags dang smon lam bton na tshe 'dir bde zhing skyid/ gal te shi rjes zhing khams su skye bar 'dod na/ chu bo'i gang gā'i 'gram du me shing sbar nas rang bsregs gtong dgos zer bas/ thi 'dos yid ches te khyim nang gi g.yog po chor shing rta 'khor lo lnga brgya bsgrigs su bcug chu bo gna'i 'gram du me shing dbor nas rang bsregs byed rgyu'i gra sgrigs byas/skabs der chos bsgrubs mkhan zhig ming la pen tshe zer bas gtam de thos rjes snying rje drag po skyes te thi 'do la gsungs don sems can gyi bde sdug thams cad ni bsam pa la brten nas byung bas/ bsam pa bzarji na ༵༵ skyirji thob/ bsam pa ngan na 'bras bu ngan/ khyod kyis rang bsregs stong phrag tsam byas

na'ang des sdig pa ji ltar dag cing bde ba ji 'dra thob par 'gyur ram zhes gsungs pas/ thi 'do yisarang bsregs kyi bsam pa tshur bskor kyang sdig pa dag pa'i thabs shes da dung ma rnyed/ pen tshes bshad don/ khong la chos shig yod/ dngul skar li cig kyang mi dgos par sdig nyes dag thub pa dang nyen kha bzlog thub ces brjod pas/ thi 'do rab tu dga' zhing bran g.yog lnga brgya po mnyam du rug rug bzos nas/ 'jam dzing nger sdig bshags kyi chos nyan/ pen tshes gsungs don sngon chad kyi sdig 5 'gyod sems rab tu skyes pa'i thog phyin chad slar yang sdig pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' de ltar byas na sdig pa dag cing ngan song las 'gog thub ces gsungs shing thi 'do yis de nas bzung chos lugs bsgyur nas nang pa'i chos su zhugs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad nas tshe gang bde skyed thob ces gsungs/shākya thub pas gtam rgyud 'di gsungs tshar ba'i rjes su sgra gcan 'dzin la gsungs par khyod nang la log nas bram ze'i kha la nyan te glin skugs chags nas gang yang mi shes mkhan zhig byed bsam pa yin nam ṭāṭwāṃ /gsu/ ngas/ gtam rgyud 'di thos rjes sgra gcan 'dzin gzhi nas chos bsgrubs par brtson 'grus bskyed thengs gcig sgra gcan 'dzin dang slob ma rgan gras ga'an zhig mnyam du chos gos gsol zhing lhung bzed bsnams nas grong khyer nang du bsod snyom slong bar phebs/ mi ngan gcig gis btsun chung gnyis mthong skabs rdo zhig gzhus pas sgra gcan 'dzin gyi spyi bor phog ste bzhin yongs rdzogs khrag gis bkang / slob ma gzhan zhig gis chu 'gram zhig tu 'khrid de khong la khrus gtsang mar byas/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyis gal te yab sangs rgyas kyis rang bzod pa sgom dgos pa'i bslab bya ma mdzad na/ ngas ral gri rnon po bton nas kho dum bu gnyis su ma btang na ga la 'grigs zhes zer/(1)bzod pa sgom dgosapa'iskor/khong tsho dgon par tshur log rjes shākya thub pa la don rnams ji bzhin zhus pas/ shākya thub pas mi ngan la 'bras bu bzang po mi yong / kho'i skabs gcig gi rnam 'gyur la blta rgyu med/ rjes su nyen gegs 'phrad nges red/ bzod pa bsgom rgyu ni bla na med pa dang stobs che shos shig yin/ des gtum drag can gyi dgra bo gang 'dra zhig las kyang rnam par rgyal te nyen kha grogs su bsgyur thub ces gsungs/de nas bzung / shākya thub pas 'khor nyan thos slob ma tshor dus rtag tu brnyas khur bzod sgom mdo klog pa dang / 'gro ba chor bzod pa sgom pa'i spyod bzang dril bsgrags mdzad/(2)gdol pa'irigasakri bud medanang pa'i chos sgor zhugs pa/skabs der bram ze'i chos ni bram ze dang / ar ya rgyal rigs dang rje rigs bcas rigs gsum gyi mi kho nas chos byed chog pa dang lha 'dre mchod pa/ shi rjes dag zhing du skye rgyu'i dbang cha yong pa bcas ngos 'dzin gyi yod stabs/ de tsher dzi skye 'pho ba'i rigs zhes zer/ de'i don ni kho tshos chos la brten nas shi rjes rnam shes rigs ni chos kyi byed sgo gang la'ang zhugs mi chog cing / bram ze'i chos dpe'i nang du — 239 ge

dmangs rigs kyis gal te rig byed kyi chos klog pa thos na rna ba 'on par 'gyur/ rang gis klog pa yin na lce 'gas par 'gyur zhes bkod yod/ rig gyed de ltar yin na rigs bzhi las 'das pa'i gdol pa'i rigs ni de bas kyang chos byed mi chog pa dang mchod pa 'bul mi chog kho che ni chos kyis mi skyob pa'i 'bangs dman zhig yin par brtsis nas der pha skye ba gcig pa'i rigs7 zhes zer/ 'di lta bu'i chomilugs thog gi gnya' gnon gyis ngal rtsol mang tshogs la bsam blo'i thog gi sdug bsngal chen po ster ro/ /de las ldog ste shākya thub pas khyab bsgrags byas pa'i nang don ni sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin te bde gshegs snying po yod/ rigs rus ga 'dra zhig gi mi yin rung gang ltar des chogadang mthun pa'i bya ba byas na sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur yong zhes kun la sgrogs par mdzad/ rang nyid kyi phug re mngon du 'gyur ched/ shākya thub pa dang khong gi nyan thos rnams kyis mi tshos mthong chung byed yul gyi rigs rus dman pa'i dbul phongs rnams la chos gsungs par ma zad/ khong tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos su zhugs chog par mdzad/thengs shig la sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos kun dga' bos skyems bzhes bsam pa'i skabs su chu len bzhin pa'i gdol pa'i rigs kyi bu mo sbo ji thi la chu slong bas sbo ji this rgyal po dang bram zes gnod 'tshe gtong bar skug te kun dga' bo la chu 'bul ma nus pas/ kun dga' bos mo la/ rigs rus ga 'dra zhig yin rung mi tshang ma ni gcig pa red gsungs pa'i khar da dung mo bsus nas dge slong mar zhugs bcugs gnas de ga'i bram ze tshos gnas tshul de shes 'phral/ rab tu khros te spyal po spo se ni btsal nas bshad don dman pa'i rigs khyim spangs te rab tu byung nas chos bsgrubs pa de ltar ga la rung / nga tshos khong tshor bsod snyoms phul na/ nga tshor nag po zhig bzo rgyu ma red dam zer te spyal po spo se ni dang khong tsho mnyam du shākya thub pa'i drung du bcar/ shākya thub pas khong tsho yong dgos pa'i brjod don rnams tshar gcig gsan rjes khong tshor gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig gsungs/snga mo snga mo zhig na chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du skyed tshal zhig yod pa de'i ming la a nyi mu sto zer/ der ri bo sngo thing nge'i 'od mdangs bkra zhing chu bo dwangs sang nge yin la me tog rtsi tog sna tshogs bzhad cing rgyas/skyed tshal de'i dkyil du rgyal po zhig yod par/ ming la thi hring kha zer/ gdol pa'i rigs khongs kyi mo ting kha'i rigs shig yin/ khong dang gdol pa'i rigs kyi mi grangs stong phrag mnyam du dga' dga' skyid skyid skyed tshal de'i nang 'tsho bar spyod/ ji hring kha zhes pa ni shes rab rno zhing 'jon thang mtho la dpa' ngar can zhig kyang yin/ khong la bu zhig yod pa de'i ming la seng ge'i rna ba zhes zer ba spyang grung kun las lhag pa dang shes yon gnyis 'dzoms yin/ thi hring khas slob dpon mang po gdan drangs nas phu gur shes bya dang rtsal rig rigs 'dra min la sbyangs/ der brten seng ge'i rna ba'i mthong thos rgya je cher gyur ba dang 'jon thang mtho ru song bas nang gi pha dang dbye ba de tsam med par gyur/ thi hring kha'i bsams par/nga'i bu phrug ni gzugs byad dang 'jon thang gnyis ka phul du gyur ba zhig yin pas mi tshang mas bsngags — 240 —

brjod gzengs bstod byed/ da lta lo na dar la bab pas nges par du yon tan dang gzugs byad kun las lhag pa'i bu mo zhig mdun mar bsus na gzhi nas ram 'degs ran po yong srid snyams so/ /de dus skad grags can gyi bram ze zhig yod pa de'i ming la pad ma dngos zer ba khyim du 'byor pa chen po ldan pa tshi rig byed chos ’ mthar phyin shes shing spyod pa bla na med pa zhig yin/ der bu mo zhig yod pa'i ming la rang bzhin zer ba rnam pa mdzes sdug brjod kyis mi langs shing kun spyod yon tan skor ni kun las lhag pa zhig yod/ thi hring khas rang bzhin zhes pa'i bu mo 'di kho nas seng ge'i rna ba'i zla bo byed thub pa las gzhan cang med pas ngas nges par du bu'i don du mna' ma yong ba'i re 'dun zhu dgos bsams nas thi hring kha pad ma dngos kyi khyim du phyin nas bshad par nga la bu zhig yod pa ni zhi drag yon tan mchog gyur gnyis 'dzom ste spyod yon kun lhag yin/ da lta ni gnyen sgrig gi lo dus su sneb/ khyed kyi bu mo mdzes sdug yon tan yang 'gran zla med pa zhig yin pa nga'i rna bar thos/ nga'i bu dang zla mtshungs/ ngas sems shā /khye/da dang nga gnyis gnyen tshang zhig bsgrigs na snyams pas/ khyed la de ltar yong ba'i re smon zhu zer pad ma dngos kyis gtam de thos rjes/ 'gog mi thub pa'i khong khro skyes te rlung 'tshang bzhin du mdog dkar por gyur te khong khro'i ngar sgra'i sgo nas bshad par gdol pa'i rigs mi tshang mas mthong chung byed yul red/ nga ni bram ze'i rigs mtho zhing gtsang la 'gran zla bral/ khyod kyis nga la ci'i phyir brnyas bcos byed pa yin/ nam mkha'i dkyil gyi zla ba dang srin bu me khyer gnyis bar la mig ldan kun kyis mthong gsal bzhin mi rnams kyis khyad par yod pa shes/ bram ze dang gdol pa'i rigs gnyis bsdur na zla ba dang srin bu me khyer bsdur pa nang bzhin red/ ngas rigs rus dman pa zhig gis nga'i gtsang zhing mtho ba'i khyim tshang btsog pa bzo ru bcug na ga la 'grig ces/thi hring khas gser/ g.yu/ sa/ shing bar gyi khyad par ngas shes/ 'on kyang bram ze dang gdol pa'i bar khyad par yod pa gang nas bltas kyang shes ma byung / bram ze dang gdol pa tshang ma ma yi khog nas skyes/ tshang mar skye rga na 'chi 'dra 'dra yod pa las khyad par cang med pas/ khyed tshos gdol pa ni gdug tsub gtum drag che ba/ srog gcod par yang snying rje med pa red ces zer mod kyang / don dngos su sdig pa'i las ngan de tsho ni tshang ma bram ze byed tshos byas pa sha stag yin/ khyed tshos dmar mchod byed pa'i skabs su ra lug bsad nas sngags bzlas pa dang ra lug dag zhing du skye ba'i smon 'dun byed/ gal ṭwāṃ / dṛsdu ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ trī dhiṭā / ༵ py-iṭwāṃsna ṭā// ༵/sa nas dag zhing du skyes thub pa yin na khyed tshos rang nyid kyis pad ma dngos kyis thos rjes khong khro thog baspyab pa ltar langs nas 'jig rten steng gi rigs bzhi po tshang ma tshangs pa las skyes shing / khyod tsho gdol pa'i rigs ni rigs rgyud bzhi'i gras su tshud pa'i thob thang gang yang med zer/ — 241 —

thi hring khas gal te bram ze tsho mtho zhing gtsang ma'i rigs shig yin na bram ze la gzhan dang mi'asnaba'i khyad par med dgos don gang yin nam/ lang/ 'dug nyal sdod/ gtam gling / dgod gtam sogs kyang tshang ma mi gzhan dang gcig pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/ der brten 'jigarten thog gi rigs rus gang yin yang tshang ma gcen gcung pho mo skyung rkyang yin pas/ nga'i bus khyed kyigamo'i zla bor byed pa tag tag 'os so zhes so/ /thi hring khas pad ma sa la lan 'debs rgyu med par bzos nas slar yang smras par dper na mi zhig la bu bzhi yod/ re rer ming re yod/ yin kyang rigs rus gcig pa yin pa de ni pha gcig gi bu ded/'jig rten steng gi rigs rus bzhi po de yang yin pa de ni pha gcig gi bu red/ 'jig rten steng gi rigs rus bzhi po de yang 'di dang gcig mtshungs yin pa dper na ma gcig gi spun zla lta bu gcen gcung pho mo nang ltar yin/ rig byed chos kyi nang nas smras pa'i rigs bzhi'i 'byung khungs la don dam yin pa'i khungs dang lung drangs thub pa'i dpang rtags gang yang med/ khyed rang da dung rmongs gnyid ma sad pa gnang rgyu med/ khyed kyi bu mo dang nga'i bu gnyis gnyen bsgrigs byas par blo 'gyod skye dgos don ci yang med/ gnyen bsgrigs byas rjes gser dngul rgyu nor mo rang gang 'dod du spyod chog zer/pad ma dngos kyis nyan rjes thi hring kha'i gtam la rgyu mtshan ldan par shes te mthar thi hring khas bton pa'i gnyen sgrig gi re 'dun khas blangs so/ /shākya thub pas gtam rgyud 'di gsungs pa'i mthar rgyal po spi se ni la gsungs don pad ma dngos des bden don rtogs thub nas bu mo de gdol par mna' ma ster ba red na/ khyed chos da dung phyogs re ba'i lta ba'i 'dam du rgyun ring lhung ste/ da dung gdol ba'i bu mo rab byung bar ya mtshan can gyi ma nyes kha g.yogs brjod pa gang yin nam zhes gsungs/(2)'dzig rten skyong ba'irgul po ma rkyes dgra slob gsos 'dul ba/shākya thub pas chos lugs gcig pu'i thog nas de dus kyi gnad don thag gcod mdzad rgyu kho na'i 'dun pa ma yin par/ khong gis mi tshor gyi tshogs kyi kun spyod brtsi bsrung zhu dgos pa/ khyim tshang 'cham mthun 'dzugs dgos pa/ yang dag pa'i sgo nas bdag skyong byas te rgyal khab stobs ldan bde gnas dang ༵sdo/ngas rnams spro skyid yong bas gnam 'og thams cad gong bu gcig gyur yong ba'i re 'dun mdzad bzhin nyin zhig shākya thub pas chos gos gsol te 'khor nyan thos chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang bcas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du bsod snyoms slong bar phebs pa'i lam du legs skyes zhes pa'i gzhon nu zhig lus po yongs rdzogs chus rlon par byas te/ shar lho nub byang steng 'og bcas kyi phyogs drug la re re bzhin res mos kyis thengs du ma phyag 'tshal bar gzigs te shākya thub pas khyed kyis phyag 'di ltar 'tshal bar ci yin gsupa'is ༵ṭwāṃ2/ /legs skyes kyis nga'i pha grongs khar kha chems bzhag yod/ gus srol shes mkhan zhig

jed dgos na nges par du zhog pa snga mor/ lus yongs rdzogs chus sbang nas/ phyogs drug tu phyag 'tshal dgosazer byung / ngas pha'i kha chems ltar byed pa yin pas/ de la 'gal mi rung zer/shākya thub pas 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i nang du phyogs drug tu phyag 'tshal dgos tshulagasungs yod kyang khyod kyi phyag 'tshal stangs de 'dra zhig ma red ces gsungs/legs skyes kyis 'o na khyed kyis nga la 'phags pa byang chub sems dpas phyogs drug tu phyag 'tshal stangs de slob par 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ shākya thub pas legs skyes la gsungs don phyogs drug tu phyag 'tshal stangs ni pha ma ni shar gyi phyogs dang / slob dpon ni lho yi phyogs/ bza' zla ni nub kyi phyogs/gnyen grogs ni byang gi phyogs/ byang chub kyi spyod pa ldan pa ni steng gi phyogs/ g.yog bu phrug ni 'og gi phyogs bcas yin/ bu phrug byed mkhan gyis pha mar gso skyong dang slob dpon gyi bka' dang mi 'gal ba/mi la zhi zhing 'jam pa/ mdza' grogs su lta ba/ zas gos la chog shes ldan pa/ slob pa la le lo med pa/dge bar dga' zhing gtong bar spro ba/ rang don spangs nas gzhan don 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pa/ 'di ni phyogs drug tu phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyu mtshan yin gsungs/legs skyes kyis thos rjes shākya thub par khyed kyis gsungs pa ni rab tu legs so/ da lam la rmongs ༵'i/ /dus 'dir kha phyogs shes par byung / ngas de ring nas bzung khyed kyis gsung pa ltar bgyi'o zhes shākya thub pa'i rtsa don ltar na/ skabs de'i chab srid la the jus mi byed pa/ dbang char mi brtson pa/kun rdzob kyi rtsod gleng mi nyan pa bcas yin kyang / khong la dad pa byed mkhan gyi slob ma'i gras su/ rgyal po dang blon po yang yod pas khong chor chab srid kyi rtsod gleng byung skabs/ rtag tu shākya thub par bka' slob zhu zhing / der rten khong gis chab srid la the jus mi byed gsungs pa ni ci nas kyang sgrubs thub thabs med pa zhig red/thengs shig la/ shākya thub pa dang khong gi nyan thos rnams bya rgod phung po'i rir bzhugs te chos gsungs skabs/ 'jig rten skyong ba ma skyes dgras kha che'i rgyal khab la g.yul bshams par brtsam kyang /kha che'i rgyal khab kyi mi ni dpa' zhing snying stobs che ba la skrag nas bram ze'i blon chen yus hre'i bskongs nas kho la brjod don khyod kyi nga'i ming thog nas ston par bskun 'dri zhus pa'i thog da dung ston par zhu rgyur/kha che'i rgyal khab kyi mi ngar zhing stobs che bas/ nga'i khar mi nyan/ ngas g.yul bshams nas 'dul dgos snyams pas/ ji ltar bgyis na dga' yong ston pas bka' stsal du gsol zhus/yus hre'i 'khor lor bsdad de bya rgod phung po'i rir slebs te shākya thub par yong don zhus/ de'i dus su kun dga' bos shākya thub par rlung g.yab g.yob bzhin yod par shākya thub pas kun dga' bo la gsungs par khyod kyis kha che'i rgyal khab kyi mi dmangs rnams yang dang yang du rug 'dzom byas nas/ chab srid la gros byed tshul thos byung ngam gsungs pas/ kun dga' bos lan du thos myong zer2/43shārji thub

pas gal te rgyal khab gcig gi gong 'og tshang ma phan tshun brtsi 'jog bkur res byas na/ mi dmangargornams la mthun sgril nges par du yong thub/ 'di 'dra'i rgyal khab 'dul thub mkhan gcig kyang yod pa red zhes gsungs/ yus hre'i pho brang du log nas shākya thub pa'i bka' slob rnams zhib par zhus pa 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras lan gcig kha che rgyal khab g.yul gyis 'dul rgyu bzhag pa red/shākya thub pas 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi gzhis dor nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsugs/ khong gis gsungs pa'i chos la brten nas dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog gtong thog phan tshun 'dra mnyam byams brtse ldan pa kun spyod bla med can bde skyid zhi lhod kyi spyi tshogs zhig btsugs nas/ midamangs rnams sdug bsngal las thar ba'i dgongs pa bzhes par mdzad cing / khong gi dgongs pa ha cang yag po yin mod/ 'on kyang gral rim dang gral rim 'thab rtsod gnas pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu/ 'di 'dra zhig ga la yong srid/ khong gis dbang bsgyur gral rim la chos gsungs pa ni ba glang la sgra brnyan bsgrags pa bzhin yin pa phud ngal rtsol mi dmangs la chos gsungs nas des bsam blo'i kun slong gi nus pa thon zhing / shākya thub pas khong gi bstan pa'i chos 'di la ha cang mang po'i yid ches mdzad kyin yod/(4)dka' bcu spyad de/ dad sems brtan du btang ba/shākya thub pas gzhir rkang nang pa'i chos pa de lta bu'i mang po spel kyang khong gi sku tshe'i ring ni gru g.yor rlung gis 'ded pa lta bu'i bde blag ngang grub thub pa ma yin par khong la dka' ngal rnam pa sna tshogs 'phrad myong ba ste/ dper na/ 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal 'khyol thabs dang nad ngan gyi mnar gcod/ de min da dung mi ngan gyi gnod 'tshe dang nang khongs kyi kha bral bcas byung myong ba red/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi stobs shugs de je che je cher 'gro bzhin pa dang / shugs rkyen nyin bzhin nyams dmas su 'gro ba bram ze rnams kyis mthong ba dang thabs shes ji yod kyis sangs spyas chos par dka' ngal bzo ba dang shākya thub par dma' 'bebs bskur 'debs byas pa red/ bud med cig dang lhas sbyin gyi chos la bar chad kyi skor/ nyin zhig shākya thub pa khrom srang du mi ser la chos gsung skabs bram zes ngan skul byas pa'i bud med cig gis/ am phrag tu lud phor zhig bcug ste/ phru gu sbom mar badzus te shākya thub pa'i mdun du yong nas gshe 'bod btab ste zer don khyod kyis 'dir yin mdog byas nas gtam snyan po bshad pa dang rang nyid ni dga' bar byed/ khyod kyis nga'i sdug bsngal la bsam blo mi gtong ngam/ khyod kyis mtshan mo yong ba dang nam phyed thon nas nga la phru gu chags 'dug da lta nga'i phru gu skye ran pas khyod kyis mar tog tsam 'khyer shog phru gu dmar 'byar gso thabs byed dgos zer bas/jir yug gi mang tshogs rnams ha las te kha gdang mig bgrad de/ phan tshun blta res byas de dus bud sdotā /sbya ṭwāṃ bye //༵ ṭwāṃ ṭārsha ṭwāṃl chabyer nasnar lu/da phor de tang lang gi sgra dang bcas par zags nas mi tshang mas —ba~X twe~X che shos ni pha srun gyi bu lhas sbyin gyi sa nas byung zhing / lhas sbyin gyis shākya thub par snga sa

nasaphrag dog gi bsam blo yod pas khos 'chal gtam log cug mang po bkram ste khos gnam 'og tu dge sdig zer ba med/ sangs rgyas chos kyi nang don yang de bzhin yang dag pa ma yin/ chos bsgrubs thabs shes la dka' spyad ji ma ji bzhin mi 'dug pa sogs khyad par brjod skabs/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i bu 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i sems nang rang gi yab nas rgyal srid snga tsam rang la ma sbodapa bsam nas zhe sdang snying nas skyes pa dang dus mtshungs su lhas sbyin gyis go skabs rnyed de/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la bshad don mi 'jig rten du gnas pa ni lo brgya las mi brgal zhing khyod kyis da dung rgyal po'i khri la bzhugs med par gal te de'i ring du nad kyis mnar nas shi na blo ha cang pham pa zhig ma yin nam/ nga'i blta tshul byas nas bshad na/ khyod kyis yab rgyal po thabs kyis bkum nas rgyal po gsar pa byed pa dang / ngas sangs rgyas gsar pa zhig byas na/ ha cang yag po yong gi ma red dam zhes brjod par brten 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras yab rgyal po gzugs can snying po lcags /sdu rno sdoṭwāṃ ༵/ ༵/ ṭwāṃ/ do/nga du bcug nas gson por ltog shir btang ba dang / btsun mo yang btson du sto lhas sbyin gyis dge slong rnams kyi khrod du lkog g.yo ngan jus spel shugs che ru btang nas/ mthar smag rum gyis gtibs pa'i mtshan mo zhig tu khong gis bslu khrid byas nas dge slong lnga brgya 'od ma'i tshal nas kha bral te/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du bros te grub mtha' gzhan zhig btsugs nas 'jig rten skyong ba'i shā dī ༵ /ma skyes dgra'i don du smon lam 'debs pa mdzad nas rgyal pos kyang gsol ba'i bsnyen bkur bzang sto de nas khyun ring ma song bar lhas sbyin gyis shākya thub pa bya rgod phung po'i ri nas bab nas phebs par thos skabs ri rtse nas rdo chen zhig bsgril nas khong rbab 'og tu bsgril dgos bsam kyang / stabs legs pa zhig la rdo de brag khung zhig gi nang du lcang ste shākya thub pa rbabs kyis bkrongs ma thub/lhas sbyin gyis ngan thabs de ma 'grub pas/ slar yang ngan thabs gzhan zhig dran te/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i spyal po ma skyes dgra la khro gtum rab tu che ba'i glang chen zhig yod/ khong tshos shākya thub pa dang nyan thos rnams rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la phebs pa'i skabs der glang chen la chang blud nas sna zhags kyi rtser sru gri rnon po zhig btags te glod yong skabs/ khrom srang gi mi dang dge slong rnams kyis glang po che khro gtum can de mthong skabs rab tu spag nas phyogs bzhir byer 'gro skabs kun dga' bos glang ṭwāṃ/ /gtum po de mthong skabs myur bar shākya thub par bsrung skyob mdzad pas shākya thub par gnod 'tshe ma shākya thub par gzhi mung bar chad sku ngal sna tshogs yang yang byung kyang khong gis chos gsung dang chos rgyun spel ba'i chos sems la g.yo 'gul gang yang thebs ma thub/

bdun pa/ sa la'i ljon shing gi 'ogapho mya ngan las 'das pa/spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo bzhi brgya brgyad cu gya bdun lor shākya thub pa dgung lo bdun cu don dgur mthon por glebs/ khong gis drang srong lhung ba ri dwags su chos gsung pa nas lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi phyin zhing /dus yun de'i ring khong gis ngal dub la ma 'dzem par sa phyogs kun tu phebs nas chos kyi don rnams ston par mdzad rkyen khong gi chos lugs gsar pa de rgya gar gyi mi mang che bas dad pa byas te sa gnas khag la dgon pa bzhengs te chos la dad pa byed mkhan nyin bzhin mang du phyin/ bram ze'i chos kyi dbang skur 'dzin gnas bsnubs nas phyir log rgyu med par ñtsar/bsam blo'i thad la rigs rus lam lugs kyi gnya' gnon de'ang zhi lhod du gyur/ khong gi sku tshe'i mtha' ma'i lo der/ rang nyid kyi chos ldan gyis skyong ba'i zhing khams 'dir slar yang mtha' ma'i bskor ba zhig skyon rtsis mdzad/dpyid kar shākya thub pa dang khong gi nyan thos rnams rgyal po'i khab nas gyes te rdog thon te byang phyogs su bskyod cing mang ga dha dang mu 'brel mtshams kyi 'khris su gnas pa'i yangs pa can gyi grong du phebs/(deng skabs rgya gar pe har zhing chen gyi khongs)'dir shin tu mdzes pa'i zhib cing mtshar ba'i dgon pa zhig yod/ shākya thub pa char dus dang 'phrad pas 'dir dbyar gnas mdzad rgyur gtan 'khel/sa cha 'dir than skyon chen po zhig dang 'phrad pas mu ges gang sar khyab nas zong rdzas gong shin tu mtho/ rjes 'brang nyan thos mi grangs ha cang mang bas/ 'atso ba rnyed par ha cang dka' bas/ shākya byāzlo snaṭā/ nyan thos rnams sa gnas khag tu kha bkrams nas kun dga' bo gcig pu khong dang mnyam du dbyar gnas pa'i ring shākya thub pa'i sgal pa'i skung gzhi slar yang ldang / khong gi nyan thos rnams lhan du med pas nus shugs gang yod kyis gnas thabs mdzad bsams shing / char dus yol rjes nyan thos rnams rim bzhin phyir log phebs te shākya thub pas u tshugs kyis snying rus mdzad de/ slar yang nyan thos rnams dang lhan du nub byang gi phyogs su byon/lam du khong gi skung gzhi mu mthud sdug tu phyin nas/ sro pho grong gi nye 'gram gyi grong gseb cig tu mgar ba khrun tho yis nad la phan pa'i tsan dan shing gi mog ro shākya thub par phul/ khrun thos re 'dun /shā /rsha ḍi/sa rjes shākya thub pas zhal du mchod/ go thos ltar na 'di ni khong gi mtha' ma'i zas shig yin shākya thub pas tsan dan shing gi mog rdo mchod rjes nyan thos rnams la gsungs don khyed rnams yid skyo bar ma byed cig gnam sa 'di'i yod dgu tshang ma skyes nas ma shi ba gcig kyang med/ nga 'das rjes khyed rnams kyis nga 'jig rten 'dir gnas pa dang 'dra bar/ 'dul khrims dam po bsrungs te brtson 'thurji ga~X ༵ba kyis chos sgrubs shig bag med kyi spyod pa nam yang byed mi rung / tshe 'di dang phyi mar

ཿga bsngal yong nyen la 'gog thabs byed dgos/ bsnyen bkur len skabs su dus skabs kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs nas len dgos pa las mi la ca zing bzo mi rung / gzhan gyis khyod tsher phul bkur byed par snang med dang gtor bshig byed mi nyan/ khyod tshes nyin mtshan kun tu brtson pas 'bad dgos pa las skyid 'dod sos dal la zhen rgyu med/ khyod tshos gtam brjod tsub po mi shod pa dang bzod pa sgom rgyu ni nga tsho'i spyod tshul yin/ bzod pa sgom mi nus na thar ba thob mi thub/ snyi rol du bsod snyoms la bskyod skabs skra bzhar ba dang lhung bzed thogs pa chos gos legs po gyon pa bcas byed dgos/ 'gro ba 'dug pa nyal ba bcas kyi skabs su phyi tshul gyi rnam pa tshul dang ldan dgos/ gnas tshul dang 'phrad skabs phyir 'aspyangs byed mi rung / phyir 'aspyangs bgyis na gnod 'tshe khyer yong ba/ dngos rdzas gsog 'jog mi byed/ chags pa dang bral na nyon mongs las grol thub/ khyod tshos dam bca' brtan por bsrung ba las khrig khrug byed rgyu med pa dang / 'bad brtson lhod med kyis gong du spel dgos zhes gsungs/spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo bzhi brgya brgyad cu gya drug pa'i zla ba gnyis par khong rnams ku sha'i grong gi pha sbi chu bo zhes pa'i 'gram du smrebs/ (deng skabs rgya gar gyi mnyam 'brel zhing chen gyi ku sha'i grong /) kun dga' bos phyogs bzhir sa la'i ljon shing gnyis re yod pa'i gnas shig tu thag pa'i gzims khri bldams bsgrigs byas/ shākya thub pas chu bos sku 'khrus rab tu gsol rjes phyag g.yas sngas su mdzad/ zhal nub /ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ/ gzigs/ dbu byang phyogs su bstan gzhogs g.yon sngas nas thag pa'i gzims khri'i steng du sku mtshan mor shu pa tho lo zhes pa'i bram ze'i mkhas pa zhig gis shākya thub pa mjal dgos pa'i re 'dun bton te/ kun dga' bor nga ni lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mya ngan las 'das (sku gshegs pa)ba'i dus la bab pa'i sems khril gyi ched mngags mtha' ma'i zhal mjal bar yong ba yin zhes zer bas/ kun dga' bo yid rab tu sun snang dang 'tshab 'tshub byas shing skabs der bram ze yong ba ni sems la ma rung ba zhig bcangs yod par nges snyams nas khong gi re 'dun zhal gyis ma bzhes pas/ shākya thub pa mkhyen rjes gsung don yong ba po'i re 'dun ldog tu mi rung bas yong du cug gsungs bas/ shu pa tho lo shākya thub pa'i drung du 'khrid skabs shākya thub pas da dung kho la chos gsung rgyu mtha' 'khyongs mdzad pas/ shu pa tho la rab tu dga' zhing lus kyi gnas lnga sa la btud nas khong gi mtha' ma'i slob ma zhig tu gyur ba yin/kun dga' bos shākya thub par gsol bar 'di lta bu'i mi med dbeen pa'i gnas su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar mdzod/ ser skya'i rgyal khab tu mi tshogs mang bas/ khong chos rgya che zab rgyas kyis khyed kyi sku phung la srur 'jug byed 'ong zhes zhus pas/ shākya thub pas ma gnang ste gsungs par sa cha 'dir mi 'dod pa ma byed cig 'dir nga dur 'jug byed sa yag thos shig yin zhes gsungs/nam gyi phyed smad du shākya thub pas nyan thos rnams la gsungs don khyed tshos nga dang bral rjes/ rgyab brten shor nas srung skyob bral song ma snyams shig ngas bstan pa'i chos 'di ni khyod tsho'i srung skyob dang — 247 dngha

rgyab brten kho yin zhes gsungs thog de nas slar yang khyod chos snying rus chen pos 'bad brtsonabya nas lus sems la rang gis sbyongs dgos/ bya ba gang zhig bsgrubs par zab nan byed dgos pa las baglecol du gtan nas byed mi rung zhes/ khong gi 'khor slob nyan thos rnams la mtha' ma'i bka' slob di mdzad rjes de 'phral du sku gshegs so/ /'di'i dus ni so nam lo rtsis kyi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga yin/'khor slob rnams yid rab tu skyo ba'i ngang nas khong shākya thub pa'i sku gdung de ku sha'i grong du gdan drangs/ phyi rol thag ring sar bzhugs pa'i 'od bsrung chen pos shākya thub pa sku mya ngan las 'das pa thos skabs 'phral byur tu yong ste/ nyin bdun gyi rjes su khong tshos shākya thub pa'i sku gdung spur bzhus btang /gdung thal gser gyi bum pa'i nang du blugs te rgyal po'i pho brang gi kun dga' ra bar bsgrigs te gdung rten bsgrun nas de'i nang du bzhag rgyu'i grabs gshom mdzad do/ /shākya thub pa sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul rgya gar sa phyogs kun tu khyab pas mang gadha'i rgyal po 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras blon po mngags te ku sha'i grong du 'byor de gdung thal cung zad bgos nas gdung rten nang du gdung thal 'jug rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang gal te mi bgo na ku sha'i grong de gtor brlag btang nas thang stong zhig tu bzo rgyu yin zhes 'ur sgrog byas/ da dung mu mthud po pho rgyal khab/kras lo po rgyal khab/ lo mo ka rgyal khab/ pis li'u thi rgyal khab/ ser skya'i rgyal khab bcas kyi blon chen rnams kyang snga rjes su 'byor rkyen/ ku sha'i grong gi rgyal pos gnas tshul mi legs par mthong sto/ shākya thub pa'i gdung thal khag kha shas su mi bgo ka med byung nas rgyal khab khag la bgo skal phul dgos byung /(1)nyanathosarnams kyisabaka'abasdusamadzad pa/shākya thub pa 'jig rten du bzhugs skabs lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i ring chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad/de tshang ma zhal nas gsungs pa sha stag yin pas yi ger bkod pa med/shākya thub pa dgongs pa rdzogs rjes dge slong tshang mas 'od srung chen po ston pa'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol nas dge 'dun yongs kyi sne khrid mdzad/ dge slong zhig gis bshad par ston pa 'jig rten du bzhugs skabs/ nga tshor 'dul khrims dam por bsdams te/ 'di yang gyed mi rung / de yang byed mi rung zhes gsungs skabs/ mthar kho rang gis gsungs pa'i chos rgyun yang thor bu 'god rgyu ma byung zer ba'i gtam de 'od srung chen pos thos rjes/ khong gi dgongs par gal te ston pas gsungs pa'i bka' rnams glegs bam du bris thub na dus nam yin kyang dad ldan slob ma rnams kyis bka' bzhin sgrub par nus snyam nas der dge slong rnams kyis yid mos par gyur/ der brten shākya thub pa dgongs pa rdzogs nas zla ba bzhi song mtshams spyod pa dang yon tan khyad du 'phags pa'i dge slong lnga brgya bdams te rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs a su ri'i brag phug tu gzhi nas bka' bsdu ba dang rtsom sgrig mdzad/rgyal po ma skyes dgrar 'gyod sems drag po skyes nas sdig pa bshags rjes rnam par dag pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos sbob tu gyur nasagang sa gang du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bslang bar mdzad/ khong gis — 248 —

dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' bsdu bsgrigs mdzad dgos pa thos rjes yid rab tu mgu zhing khong rnams kyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas 'tsho ba dang / gzims chas/ chos don 'bri sa'i ta la'i lo 'dab sogs kyi dngos po mkho 'don du phul/skabs 'di'i dge slong lnga brgyas sangs rgyas kyi chos la go rim bsgrigs pa 'dir bstan pa'i lo rgyus kyi thog tu bka' bsdu ba dang po zhes brjod/ de'i bya thabs ni yon tan shin tu che ba'i dge slong gis shākya thub pa 'jig rten du bzhugs skabs su gsungs pa'i chos rnams blo thog nas bskyor zhing / der tshang mas gros byas nas gtan la dbab ste/ gzhi nas yi ger phab/kun dga' bo chos la mkhas shing thos rgya che bas/ chos don gyi gnad 'gag zab mo rnams la rtogs pa phul du byung bas/ sngon la khong gis bskyor ba'i gzhi rtsa'i bstan pa'i chos don dang chos bsgrubs thabs shes sogs dang bka' gang zhig shākya thub pas gnas gang du/ yul dang gang zag gang dang gang yin pa/'khor nyan thos ci tsam yod pa bcas gsal por gsungs pa dang sprags mi gzhan gyis khong gis ngag skyon mdzad pa'i tshig sgrub la dri ba sna tshogs bkod/ khong gis re re bzhin lan 'debs mdzad/ tshang mas nyan rjes mgrin gcig tu ji ltar gsungs pa rnams de bzhin du lags pas nor ba ma mchis so snyams skabs gzhi nas glegs bam du gtan la dbab te zin bris su bkod pa/ nye bar 'khor 'dul khrims mchog tu gtsang bar dge slong rnams kyi gus bkur chen po thob cing khong gis 'dul ba'i sde snod ngag skyor mdzad par thengs grangs bsdoms brgyad cu tham pa mdzad pas khong la 'dul klog brgyad cu yang zer/de las sangs rgyas kyi chos ni don dngos su thun mong du bsgrun pa zhig yin pa mthong gsal red/sangs rgyas kyi chos nang du rgya gar gyi gna' rabs spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs dang / gral rim gyi 'gal ba/ chab srid/ mtshan nyid rig pa/ chos lugs/ rig gzhung / sgyu rtsal sogs kyi thad la zhib 'jug byed par gal 'gangs che ba'i ga'i 'dzin sa yod/ deng skabs nga tshos spya gar gyi gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus kyi shes bya'i skor yang dag shos ni sangs spyas kyi chos nang nas thob pa yin/le'u bcu bzhi ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i skabs nas rang rgyal du dar tshul/sangs rgyas kyi chos spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i skabs nas rang rgyal du dar rjes thog mar tung hān gyi rgyal po'i pho brang nang nas dad pa thob cing / de rjes dmangs khrod du dar/ lho byang rgyal rabs dang sung dang thang spyal rabs su ha cang dar rgyas che ba ma zad/ khra'o shan dang ri pin du dar/ rang rgyal gyi tung hān dus rabs nas sangs rgyas kyi chos bsgyur 'go tshugs pa nas bzung yon rgyal rabs kyi bar sangs spyas kyi chos bsgyur bar glegs bam khyon bsdoms brgyad stong bzhi brgya bcu drug yod/ bsgyur tshig snyan — 249 —

zhing 'jebs pa/ tshig sbyor don dang mthun pa ni 'dzam gling thog ngos 'dzin gcig tu gyur/ nang donatsāha cang phun sum chogs pa'i rtsom yig 'di ni 'dzam gling thog gi rtsa che'i nor bu'i rig gnas gyi shul bzhag yin la/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyi rig gnas kyi shul bzhag gi cha shas shig kyang yin/shākya thub pas chos gsung chos rgyud spel bar/ tshad mtho'i skad yig gi sgyu rtsal ldan pa dang /dmangs khrod kyi 'beel gtam dang dpe mtshon sgrung gtam sogs sbyor mkhas pa yod cing / ston pa'i gsung rab kyi nang du snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gtam rgyud mang po yod pa de cho'i nang du khong gis rang srog blos btang gi snying stobs dang / zhi bde'i byams brtse la dad mos snying rje'i ngang nas phan tshun mdza' res sogs kyi dam pa'i spyod bzang la bstod cing bsngags pa/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gdug tsub la kha rdung gtong dgos pa bcas mer gyis khengs yod/ gtam rgyud kyi nang du las rgyu 'bras thad kyi ṭwāṃgag phyo/sa /da lug gi dngos po yang lus yod/ da lta 'dems bsgrigs byas pa'i kha shas yod kyang 'awadī ma rno/ da rted/ /gangs can du chos dar ba'i tshul/bod gangs can du bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung rgyal rabs nyer baspyad pa bod rje lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su spang skong phyag brgya pa dang mdo za ma tog sogs dbu brnyes pa nas bzung dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku shā ra sogs gdan drangs nas gsang sngags gyi chos mang po bsgyur/ bal po nas bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo bal bza' khri btsun te bod spyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo blangs nas/ khong shing rta lor sangs spyas shākya thub pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang rang byon tsan dan gyi sgrol ma sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang lha sa'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya nag rgyal po thang tha'e tsung gi sras mo wun shing kong josasangs rgyas shākya thub pa dgung grangs bcu gnyis la phebs pa'i sku tshad rten skal la bod du gdan drangs te da lta lha sa gtsug lag khang bzhugs pa'i sku ngo mtshar can zhig yo da pa de yin/ lha sa gtsug lag khang gi khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor mdun du yod pa'i ljon shing rgya lcang gi sdong bo chen po/bod mi dmangs kyis rgya bza' kong jor dran gso byed ched kong jos dngos su btsugs pa red zer ba'i rgya lcang 'dir gces skyong ha cang chen po byed pa ma zad spya lcang 'di nyid kong jos bod du gdan drangs pa'i shākya mu ni'i dbu sku sar lhung nas skyes pa red ces zer srol yang yod/ de rjes dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs spya gar nas slob dpon pad ma sam bha ba dang / paṇa chen bi ma la mi dra sogs gdan drangs nas gsang sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur/ de nas dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug paṇḍi ta smri ti bod du phebs pa'i bar bsgyur ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams gsang sngags rnying ma zer ro/ /

gnyis pa/ bstan pa phyi dar byung ba'i tshul/bstan pa phyi dar byung tshul ni/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe/ dpal chu bo ri nas/gtsang rab gsal/ g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya mu na gsum/ 'dul ba dre khal gcig bkal nas mnga' ris su bros/ gar log nas hor yul bskor te/ mdo smad du an chung gnam rdzong du sleb pa dang / bon po'i bu mu zu gsal 'bar dad nas/ gtsang gis mkhan po g.yos slob dpon byas te dge tshul byas/ mtshan dge ba gsal du btags/ phyis dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ lo gcig na sngar gyi mkhan slob dang / dmar gyi gsang ston byas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po bsad nas/ kha skong mi rung gsungs nas/ rgya'i ha shang gnyis btang ste/ de lnga la bsnyen rdzogs byas/ de nas lo lnga nas mkhan po dgongs pa rab gsal la/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ snubs dpal gyi dbang phyug gis rab tu byung / de rnams kyi lo rgyus bsam yas nas mnga' bdag tsha lan ye shes rgyal mtshan yab sras kyis gsan nas/ dbus kyi mi drug rim par rdzangs te/ dbus nas klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ gtsang nas tshong btsun shes rab seng ge/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug rnams kyis/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal la sdom pa blangs/ dba' btsun blo gros dbang phyug rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes 'byung gnas kyis grum sdubs gnyis la sdom pa blangs te/ de rnams la/sba rag gnyis gcig tu bgrangs pas mi drug zer ro/ /de rnams las kyes pas dbus gtsang du gtsug lag khang rnams dang / dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / de rnams bod du thon nas gnas gzhi bzung zhing sdom pa spel bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i me ro smad nas gsos te/ slar yang bstan pa dar ba'i mgo tshugs te rim gyis 'phel bas dbus gtsang gi phyogs thams cad dge 'dun gyi sdes bkang ste bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ de ltar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la dan tig tu snyon/ lo sum cu rtsa lnga dan tig tu bzhugs/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa shing mo phag gi lo la dga' ldan du gshegs/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsdubs nas/ dbus gtsang mi drug gis bstan pa ma btsugs bar du/ bstan pa med pa lo bdun cu rtsa lnga song / des na bla chen po dang / klu mes la sogs pa gangs can pa la bka' drin mchog tu che'o/ /stod nas gsos tshul ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po rgya gar du chos slob par btang bas mkhas pa chen por gyur te mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur/ 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phabs/ bstan pa rnam par dag pas kha ba ri pa rnams la sku drin gyis khyab par mdzad/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis bstan pa snga dar las phyi dar sngags kyi bstan pa bod du dar ba yang phal cher lo tsā ba 'di kho na'i bka' drin zhes gsungs te thugs mad par snang ngo / /sku tshe'i smad du sgrub pa 'ba' zhig mdzad de mkha' spyod du gshegs/ lo chen 'di'i lta ba ni rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma ba yin par bshad do/ /gzhan yang lha bla ma 'dis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta ṅgārma — 251 —

pā la dang / de'i slob ma'i gtso bo saṅga pā la/ gu ṇa pā la/ praṅge pā la ste pā la gsum du grags pa dang bcas spyan drangs te/ de dag las zhang zhung ba rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis sdom pa blangs/ slad nas bal por byon te 'dul 'dzin bre ta ka la 'dul ba'i lag len dang bshad pa zhus/ de'i slob ma dpal 'byor shes rab dang / zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ge la sogs pa nas brgyud pa la stod 'dul ba zhes grags/ga'an yang mnga' bdag lha sde'i ring la kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī spyan drangs/ mdo dang bstan bcos mang du bsgyur te bstan pa rgyas par mdzad cing / de las brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun la paṇa chen sdom rgyun zer ro/ /bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi rnam gzhag ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhi ma dam pa'i chos 'dul ba yin pa'i dbang gis sdom rgyun dang 'dul ba'i lag len dar tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin par ṭwāṃṭā /ngo/ / bstan pa dar tshul mdor bsdus pa ni de tsam ste/ zhib par chos 'byung rnams las shes par bod yul gdul bya'i bsod nams nor 'dzin gzhir/ / skyes mchog du ma'i thugs bskyed 'bab stegs las/ / bka' bstan lha chab gtsang ma'i rgyun mang po/ / zab spyas rang sgra sgrogs bzhin babs pa las/ / bslab gsum nor bu'i drwa ba rab 'khrigs shing / /lung rigs rlabs phreng stong gi 'du 'god can/ /bgrangs yas mkhas grub gdengs can rol pa'i gnas/ /thub bstan rgya mtshos yongs su gang bar 'gyur/ /e ma mtha' 'khob ljongs 'dir 'phags yul gyi/ /ya mtshan ma tshang med par rdzogs pa yi/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa rim byon rnams kyi drin/ / bsam gyin lag pa'i padmo snying gar zum/ /gsum pa/ grub mtha' so so'i byung tshul/de ltar rgyal ba sras bcas kyi 'phrin las dang / chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin dang / bod kyi skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi mthu las gangs can gyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che gong nas gong 'phel du dar zhing rgyas pa la brten nas spub mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma zhig dar bar gyur ro/ /de yang bod kyi grub pa'i mtha' tha snyad mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa rnams ni/ bye brag smra ba'i sde ba bco brgyad ltar yul gyi ming dang slob dpon gyi ming las btags pa yang snang la/ kha cig ni rgya gar gyi paṇa grub re las gdams pa sna re zhus shing / de nyid gtso bor nyams su len pa la gdams pa de'i ming gis grub mtha' zur bar btags pa yang snang bas/ 'phags yul gyi grub mtha' tha ba ltar lta ba kho na'i sgo nas grub mtha'i ming btags pa'i nges pa mi snang ste/dper na/ sa skya ba/ jo nang ba/ shangs pa/ 'bri gung ba/ zhes pa lta bu yul gyi sgo nas ming btags pa mang 'ing / karma ba/ bu lugs pa zhes pa lta bu slob dpon gyi sgo nas ming btags pa dang /bka' gdams pa/ rdzogs chen pa/ phyag chen pa/ zhi byed pa zhes pa lta bu gdams pa'i sgo nas ming btags par snang bas so/ /—de ༵ṭwāṃ sdu tshul mdo tsam zhig rim pas brjod na 'di la gnyis/ bub mtha' gzhan gyi byung tshul dang /

dge lugs pa'i byung tshul lo/ dang po la bdun/ rnying ma ba dang / bka' gdams pa dang / bka' bsgyud pa dang / zhi byed pa dang / sa skya ba dang / jo nang ba dang / nyi tshe ba 'ga' zhig byung tshul lo//tta ṭwāṃ ༵ //ra gsar rnying gi dbye mtshams ngos bzung ba dang / bye brag tu rnying ma ba'i byung tshul bshad pa (1)sbyir gsar rnying gnyisatpa dbye mtshams ngos bzung ba/mdo khams dang rgyal rong phyogs la gsar rnying gi dbye ba ma byung bas/ rnying ma dang / gsar ma'i rnam gzhag ni gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin/ de la'ang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba yod kyang grags che ba ni/ parnyi ta smṛ ti byon pa yan chod du bsgyur ba'i rgyud rnams la gsang sngags rnying ma dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po phyin chad du bsgyur ba rnams la gsang sngags gsar ma'i tha snyad byed do/ /gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur mgo ni lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas ngos 'dzin mod/ 'on kyang 'brog mi dang / 'gos dang / mnga' bdag mar pa rnams kyang yin no/ /(2)lo chen gyi skabs/srong btsan 'khrungs nas lo sum brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu 'das pa rab byung dang po ma shar sngon gyi lo drug cu re dgu sa rta lor lha ye shes 'od sras su mnga' ris gu ge'i cha waṃ raṇḍa ru lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po 'khrungs/ khong gis lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i tshe mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung zhes bya ba/khri thang dzha nas bkod pa'i rnam par thar pa na 'dug de lta na ni lo tsā ba rab tu byung ba'i lo de/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas lo bdun cu pa yin te/ bstan pa byung ba yang dbus gtsang las mnga' ris snga bar mngon no/ / bcu bdun thog 'phags yul du byon nas lo bcu bzhugs/ jo bo nā ro pa sogs parnyi ta bdun cu rtsa lnga bsten nas mdo rgyud sogs rig gnas gang la 'chad rtsod rtsom bsgyur thogs pa med par gyur te bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su gsar ma'i lo tsā ba thams cad kyi thog mar gyur/ sangs rgyas skar rgyal btul/ mdo sde'i skor gzhung grangs bcu bdun dang mngon pa'i gzhung so gsum/ rgyud kyi le tshan brgya rtsa brgyad sogs rgya gzhung bod du bsgyur ba dang 'gyur bcos mdzad pa shin tu mang zhing / khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i skor la slob dpon dpa'abos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa dang / de'i 'grel ba kha che paṇa chen zla ba mngon dgas mdzad pa'i zla zer sogs legs par bapar cing gtan la phab pas bod yul du dar rgyas gyur pas ma tshad/ dpal phag mo spu pa'i dus su rgya nag tu'ang dar bas rgyal po hwang the'i hu'i i ci'i dus/ yar klungs mchig sman gyis bskul nas pho brang ta'i tung du ye shes dpal gyi zhus dag mdzad de brkos pa'i rgya dper yang yod/ lo chen 'di nyid la gso rig gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i thu bo ru gyur bar spu rengs kyi sman pa mi bzhi'i gtsos bod yul kun tu khyab par gyur te mdzad rjes shin tu che/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa yang saṃ skyi ta'i skad du 'bum phrag gcig bod kyi skad du 'bum phrag gcig gzhan la yon byin te 'bum phrag gcig rnams bton/—ma~Xḍi 3jo rji rjes

sgrub la btsud de/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol na sgo sum rim yod pa la/ tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa da narang don yid byed kyi rnam par rtog pa dang / tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa rnams skad cig ma re skyes na/bstan srung rnams kyis kho bo'i mgo bo khos chod cig ces bya ba'i sgo yig sbyar nas/ rtse gcig tu bsgrubarnapas mchog gi spub pa brnyes te/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad pa shing mo lug la khra tshe wing gir du byu ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan no/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar byon pa'i lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug las bstan pa 'phel bzhin pa'i skabs/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyis ru lag gi sa char rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i sras dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde bya ba mched gsum byung bas/ snad kyi lde gsum du grags/ lo ston la bstan pa spol bar nus pa'i mkhan slob zung gcig gnang bar zhus pas/ mkhan po shākya gzhon nu dang / slob dpon yi shes brtson 'grus gnyis btang bas dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs/ mkhan slob de bgros nas/ 'brog mi dang stag lo gnyis la bstan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas 'dul ba/ snying po yin pas sher phyin/ nying khu yin pas gsang sngags nyon zhes bsgos nas rgya gar du btang / stag los gnas skor gtsor byas nas slob gnyer cher ma byas/ 'brog mis bsgos pa bzhin bsgrubs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ 'dis ma rgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ lo chen rin bzang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu byin pa dang / pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka'i bshad bka'/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor rgyud gsal bar mdzad/ rje 'gos kyis gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad bka' spel/ mnga' bdag mar bas pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud ma hā mā yā/ snying po dgyes pa rdo rje/ yang snying 'khor lo bde mchog bka' srung can gyi gdan bzhi la sogs pa'i dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ man ngag gi bka' rnams rgya cher spel bas mkhas grub kyis bod yul bkang / gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur te/ lo tsā ba chen po 'di rnams gsang sngags gsar ma'i bstan pa'i dbu tshugs pa yin no/ /(2)rnyingam ba'igrub mtha'adziltar byung tshul/thog mar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos thugs rje chen po skyed rdzogs sogs kyi gdams pa spya cher gsungs shing nyams su len pa yang mang du byung / bod khams thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs shing yig drug bzla ba 'di thog ma 'di nas dar/ de dus rgya gar nas slob dpon ku sa ra dang / bram ze zhi ka ra/ bal po'i slob dpon shī la mdzi sogs spyan drangs nas rgyud kyi cha lag mang du bsgyur ces ka khol mar byung / de nas mi rabs lnga na rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis pagyita chen po shāsto rakṣi ta spyan drangs/ mkhan pos dge ba bcu dang / khams bco brgyad la brten pa'i chos gsungs shing yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims phog pas yu la lha mthu bo che rnams ma dga' bar gnyan chen thang lhas dmar po ri la thog phab/ yar lha sham pos yar klung phang thang gi pho brang chu la bskur/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis mi nad da~X sdugarji nad mang du btang ba la/ mkhan pos thog mar bod kyi lha srin ma rungs pa rnams

'dul dgos pa 'dug pas/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas spyan drongs gsungs pa bzhin rgyal ngo/sa pho nya ba mngags pas/ slob dpon gyis mngon par shes pas mkhyen nas rgya gar nas tshur byon pa dang lam du mjal te bod du gdan drangs/ lha srin gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags/ nam mkha' la rdo rje'i 'gros dang bcas te sa 'dul mdzad nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang ༵ṭwāṃtādī/ thob gā spya kā ṭwāṃdāngapy-i/ nyer lnga sogs snod ldan mang por yo ga rnam pa gsum gyis smrin grol la bkod nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la chibs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur bu 'debs/ / rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad thengs gsum thon/ /mkhar chen mtshe rgyal bsad pa'i mi ro slong / /dpal gyi ye shes ma mo mngon sum 'khol/ / dpal gyi seng ge lha srin bran du 'khol/ /bee ro tsa na yi shes rgyan dang ldan/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po ting 'dzin mi g.yo grub/ /g.yu sgra snying po rtogs pa'i mchog dang ldan/ /tsā na ku ma ra ni dzu 'phrul ston/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms rlung ltar thogs pa med/ /ye shes dbyangs ni mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ / sog po lha dpal gcan gzan gnya' nas 'dzin/ / sna nam ye shes mkha' la bya ltar lding / /dpal gyi dbang phyug phur ba gdengs tshad 'gum/ /ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzung rnams thob/ /ska ba dpal brtsegs gzhan gyi sems rnams shes/ /shud bu dpal seng chu bo gyen du ldog /rgyal ba'i blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur/ / khye'u chung lo yis nam mkha'i bya rnams zin/ / dran pa nam mkhas byang nas g.yag rgod khug /'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'dzul/ /rma thang rin chen pa wang zas su za/ /dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs pa med/ /lang gro dkon mchog thog chen mda' ltar 'phen/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub mkha' la skyil thung 'cha'/ / zhes so/ /sngags 'chang dharma kirti/ ji ma la mi dra/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ shīrnya ga sogs rgya gar gyi parnyi ta gzhan yang mang po bhon pas/ dharma kyirtis kyang yo ga rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sogs mdzad/ ji ma la mi dra sogs slob dpon gzhan rnams kyis kyang snod ldan re gnyis la gdams pa ci rigs bstan/ de dag gis mtshan nyid kyi gzhung chen mo'i bshad pa mdzad skad mi 'dug cing / gsang sngags kyang bka' shin tu dam pas khyab bdal che ba ma mdzad/ 'on kyang bee ro rma gnyags gnubs sogs kyis kun byed rgyal po/ mdo dgongs 'dus/ sgyu 'phrul sgrub sde brgyad kyi lung man ngag sogs gsang ba'i tshul gyis bsgyur nas khyab par mdzad/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis ma 'ongs pa'i don du ri brag mtsho sogs la gdams pa zab mo du ma gter du sbas te/ lho nub rnga yab gling du gshegs so/ de lta na gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus nas thor bu tsam byung mod kyang / rgya che ba ni spyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs nas yin la/skabs 'dir slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar rgyas par brjod 'os kyang / yig tshogs che bas 'jigs nas ma bkod do/ — 255 —

(4)gsang zags gsarama'i 'argyurasgogo'i skabs/gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur gyi mgo jo bo smre tis btsugs so zhes bya ba yod mod kyi/ des dbumigatsang du ni 'gyur ma mdzad la/ khams dang khams kyi nye log rnams su dus phyis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sgeg pa rdo rje'i skor dang / dpal gdan bzhi pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la sogs pa mang du bsgyur mod kyi/ de bas lo chen rin chen bzang pos gsang sngags kyi 'gyur mdzad pa snga bar snang ste/ 'brom ston pa jo bo se btsun gyi g.yog byed pa'i dus smṛ ti la lo tsā bslabs so zhes 'byung la/ de dang nye bar 'brom gyis mnga' ris su byon pa'i tshe/ lo chen gyis lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i phyir no/lo chen gyis de nyid bsdus pa dang gsang ba 'dus pa sogs rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud shas cher brgyud la/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams ni lo chen gyi lo lnga bcu nye ba na bla chen 'brog mi byung ste/ de nas ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnasnaṭā dṛzlo byekta / py-i/ra bar gyur to/ / gsar ma'i 'gyur mgo'i skabs so/ /bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bod du gdan drangs te rgyal bo dang 'bangs mang por gsang sngags kyi chos gsungs te grub pa thob pa'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga ste/ 1 gnub nam mkha'i snying po/ 2 bsgrags pa sangs spyas ye shes/ 2 ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyings/4 mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal/ 5 sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ 6 rlang dpal gyi seng ge/ 7 pa gor bee ro tsā na/ 8 mnga' bdag rgyal po/ 9 rgyal mo rong g.yu sgra snying po/ 1༷ snying tsā na ku mā ra/11 sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ 12 sba mi ye shes dbyings/ 12 sog po lha dpal/ 14 zhang sna nam ye shes sde/ 15 mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug 16 ldan ma rtse mang / 17 mchan bu ka ba dpal brtsegs/ 18 shud pu dpal gyi seng ge/ 19 'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros/ 2rkya lo ki chung dran pa nam mkha'/ 21 bran dpal gyi dbang phyug 22 rma rin chen mchog 22 lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 24 lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ 25 la sum rgyal ba byang chub bcas/de'i nang nas khyad du 'phags pa'i bod kyi grub chen brgyad/1 'jam dpal sku'i bka' bab snub sangs rgyas ye shes/ 2 dbang chen gsung gi bka' bab ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 2 yang dag thugs kyi bka' bab gnub nam mkha'i snying po/ 4 yon tan bdud rtsi'i bka' bab nyag dzñā na ku mā ra/ 5 'phrin las phur sa/'i bka' bab ye shes mtsho rgyal/6 srid pa ma mo'i bka' bab sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ 7 'jig rten dregs pa'i bka' bab rlangs dpal gyi seng ge/ 8 stobs ldan nag po'i bka' bab bee ro tsā na ste brgyad do/bod kyi 'jam dbyangs rnam gsum/ bod kyi skyes bu dam pa rnam gsum ste/ 1 sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 2 kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams dri med 'od zer/ 2 rje tsong kha pa blo bzang gragarji pa py-ipy-i~X kaum mo/

slob dpon padma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas shākya thub pa las lhag pa'i yon tan gsum/nga las lhag pa'i skyes bu 'byung zhes pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan thams cad yab yum la brten nas mongal las skyes/ slob dpon ni pad sdong las badzus te 'khrungs bas sku skye ba sangs rgyas las lhagasangs rgyas gzhan chos drang nges rnam ston/ slob dpon tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i gsang sngags ston pas dgongs pa sangs rgyas bas lhag sangs rgyas gzhan thams cad sku mya ngan las 'das/slob dpon ni 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar sems can gyi don du 'das grongs med par bzhugs pas gdul bya sangs rgyas gzhan las lhag pa'i yon tan gsum dang ldan no/ /skabs 'dir slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar rgyas par brjod 'os kyang / yig tshogs che bas kyang 'jigs nas ma bkod do/ rnying ma'i lugs la theg pa rim dgu'i rnam gzhag byed de/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems te sprul sku shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i thun mong gi theg pa gsum/ kri ya/mu pa/ yo ga ste longs sku rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa'i gsang sngags kyi phyi'i theg pa gsum/ bskyed pa ma hā yo ga lung a nu yo ga rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ste chos sku kun tu bzang pos gsungs pa'i nang gi theg pa bla na med pa gsum bcas dgu'o/ yang phyi'i rgyud sde dang nang gi rgyud sde gnyis las/ phyi kri ya'am bya rgyud rnams ston pa shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ u pa'am spyod rgyud dang / yo ga ste rnal 'byor rgyud rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs/ nang bla med kyi rgyud rnams ni rdo rje 'chang chen pos chos 'byung yangs pa'i zhing khams su gsungs par bshad/ de dag las bla na med pa'i theg pa ni gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang po lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs pas dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i gdul bya la rtsol med lhun grub tu rgya cher phyogs lhung dang bral bar dus bzhir dus med du ston par byed cing / de lta bu'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pas tshad bzung dang bral ba ste/ de las nyung zad tsam zhig 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dga' rab rdo rje dang / thi sedha dang / snyo na sru dra dang / bī ma la dang / pasgyu ka ra sogs mchog gi dngos spub brnyes pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis gsal bar mdzad do zhes 'chad/brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud gsum dang / yang bka' bab lung bstan gyi brgyud pa/ las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa/ smon lam paspra rsha gāṭwāṃ dīshā kā rā kto dīrgyu/ da pa drug gi rnam ga'ag kyang byed do/ de dag zhib tu bris na mang bar 'gyur rnying ma'i chos la ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi brgyud pa gsum du dbye bar snang bas/ de dag bod du ji ltar byung ba ni/ bka' ma sgyu 'phrul/ 'dus pa mdo/sems phyogs te mdo sgyu sems gsum zer ba las/sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i skor ni/ bī ma las rma rin chen mchog la bshad bsgyur/25ṭwāṃs katsug

ru rin chen gzhon nu dang / gye re mchog skyong gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kyis dar rje dpal gyi grag pa dang / zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan gnyis la bshad/ zhang nas brgyud pa rnams la man ngag brgyud mi~Xtrīg/ sa/dar rjes dbus gtsang khams gsum du mang bor spel bas dbus lugs dang khams lugs gnyi yang bī ma la'i slob ma gnyag tsā na ku mā ra/ de'i slob ma sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ de'i slob thoslob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes yin pas de dag las brgyud pa'ang byung ba 'dra/ gnub sangs rgyas ye shes la so ye shes dbang phyug sogs thugs zin gyi sras bzhi/ sras kyi dam pa khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang lnga/yon tan yab sras la dang po'i slob ma myang shes rab mchog de'i slob ma zur po che shākya 'byung gnas/de la slob ma rtse mo bzhi/ rtse skog dang lnga/ sgom chen brgya rtsa baspyad sogs byung / rtse mo bzhi'i mchog zur chung shes rab grags sam bde gshegs rgya bo ba/ de la slob ma ka bzhi/ gdung brgyad/ lcam bcu drug/ gral ma so gnyis/ sgom chen gnyis/ yus po che gcig dkyus pa gnyis/ sta gu ra gnyis/go ma chod gsum bya ba byung / zur chung gi sras phyag rdor gyi sprul par grags pa rje sgro phug pa chen po shākya seng ge de la slob ma me bzhi/ nag bzhi/ ston bzhi ste bcu gnyis kyi nag bzhi'i mchog lha rje lci ston rgya nag bya ba dbu tshad sogs sde snod la sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur te/ rgya brtson seng sgro phug par rtsod du 'ongs pa rtsod pas pham par byas pas sgro phug pa mnyes nas gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang /de la slob ma bzang la mang ba byung yang / gtso bo dbon po bla ma chen po yon tan gzungs/ de la slob ma ches mang yang thugs sras dam pa sprul sku zhig po bdud rtsi/ de'i slob ma'i gtso bo drug gi mchog tu gyur pa rta ston jo yes te/ 'dis gsung sgros thams cad yi ger bkod pas phyi rabs la drin che'o/sgro phug pa'i slob ma gtsang pa spyi ston dang / nye ston gnyis/ gtsang nag 'od 'bar/ mes ston mgon po/ bla ma sro/ de la pakṣi shākya 'od dang / rta nag bdud 'dul gyis gsan/ bdud 'dul nas zur byams pa seng ge de la g.yung ston dang 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rjes gsan cing 'phel/g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ni mkhas spub chen po'i rnam par thar pa can gsar rnying gnyis ka'i grub thob rtsod med cig go yang sgro phug pa'i slob brgyud dang po'i sangs rgyas gong ba la nas khams su rgya cher 'phel/gzhan yang rog gi gdung brgyud dang slob brgyud rnams la'ang dbang dang rgyud bshad mang du byung / dan 'bag dang / gtsang stod mang 'gar dang / la stod byang phyogs su dar la/ sgro phug pa shākya seng ge ni/gsang sngags rnying ma'i slob dpon zur mes dbon rnam gsum du grags pa'i ya kyal/ zur chung spya bo ba'i sras yin la/ yab 'das pa'i lo de nyid rab byung dang po shing stag la 'khrungs/ yab kyi dngos slob ka bzhi bya ba bsten nas mdo rgyud sems gsum gyi gdams pa mthar phyin pa sbyangs/ sgro phug dgon pa bzhengs te slob ma stong 'dus par grags/ sgro phug pa'i slob brgyud ka dam pa bde gshegs su grags pa mtshan dngos shes rab seng ge dang / spobs pa mtha' yas bya bas/ 'bri chu'i 'gram spom 'bor dang nye — 258 —

bar ye shes ka 'dra ba'i sa char dgon pa btab pas kaḥthog tu grags pa der yang dar ro/ sgyu 'a phrul gtso bor gyur ba'i skabs so/ sa yos lo dam pa bde gshegs kyis kaḥthog chos sde dgon pa btab po/'dus pa mdo ni rtsa ba'i rgyud kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo dang / bshad pa'i rgyud mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa gnyis te/ dha na rakṣi tas bal po dharma bo rnyi dang ba su dha ra la bshad/ 'bru sha'i yul khram du ru che btsan skyes la bshad de bsgyur/ de gsum gyis jo bo sdubs sangs rgyas la bshad/ jo bo yon tan rgyu mtsho sogs las rim bzhin brgyud de lha rje shangs pa dang / tho gar nam mkha' lhas lha rje 'ug pa lung pa bstsal te rim par 'phel bar gyur/ mdo'i skabs so/ /skabs shig tu slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i sku'i skye ba rong zom lo tsā ba chos bzang zhes bya ba zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig byung ste/ des kyang mdo sgyu sems gsum ka'i gsan pa dang nyams bzhes gzhan la legs 'doms kyi 'phrin las spel te/bskyed rim gyi gtso bo ni/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad du grags pa ste/ 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung /yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur ba 'phrin las rnams la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sde lnga dang / ma mo bod gtong dang / dmed pa drag sngags dang / 'jig rten mchod bstod rnams la 'jig rten pa'i sde gsum zhes grags so/ de dag las rta mgrin dang phur ba gnyis slob dpon chen po nyid kyis/rgyal po la rta mgrin dang / jo mo dang / 'bre a tsa ra sa le la phur ba bstsal pas de dag las rim gyis 'phel/ 'jam dpal skor ni/ slob dpon shīhaṃ gasgodang / yang dag skor ni hūṃ ka ra/ bdud rtsi'i skor ni/ bi ma la mi dra rnams kyis bshad cing dar bar byas so/ ma mo la sogs pa ni/ slob dpon gyis bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can btul ba rnams dbang bskur te dam tshig la bzhag nas ris su bcad pa'i sde gsum po 'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i rtsa lag tu sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa bstan pa ste/ spyod rgyud 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor dag dang rnam gzhag mtshungs pa'o/ /rnying ma'i chos kyi snying po gyur pa ni man ngag rdzogs pa chen por grags te/ de la yang sems sde dang /klong sde dang / man ngag gi sde gsum/ sems sde ma bu bco brgyad las lnga bee no tsā na dang / bcu gsum ṭwāṃ / ༵sa la rdong rdo ro// / klong lde yang bi ma las byung zhing / man ngag gi sde la snying tig ces grags te bee ro rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs su grags pa ni/ bee ro tsā na dang / g.yu sgra snying po la/ gnyags ṅge nas zhus/ bod la bka'i chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus shing slob ma'i dam pa bcu la sogs pa las/ sog po sangs spyas ye shes la rim par brgyud do/ yang bai ro'i slob ma spang sangs rgyas mgon pos rba rakṣi ta la bshad/ de nas ya zi dar ma shes rab sogs la brgyud pa dang / bee zo/ jo mo sgro mo/ mar ba shesarab 'od sogs las brgyud pa'ang yod do/ sems phyogs kyi ṭwābs so/ rdzogs pa chen po klong gi sde'i skor la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ( rgyud zung ba'i do~X5 ṭwāṃng tram̐gus

bstan pa dang / ye shes gsang ba la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten pa rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag rnams beero spang mi pham mgon po la bshad pa rim gyis jong dharma sgolha dang / de las myang carma seng ha sogs thangor rje dang / 'dzeng jo sras sogs kyis zhus pa las mang du 'phel lo/ rdo rje zab mo'i skabs so/ /shin tu zab par grags pa rdzogs pa chen po snying tig ni/ slob dpon bi ma la mi dra snga mas mnga' bdag rgyal po dang / myang ting 'dzin bzang po gnyis la bstan/ myang ting 'dzin bzang po ni bod spya khri srong lde'u btsan byis pa'i dus kyi sku rdzi yin zhing / phyis rab tu byung / lo bdun du ting nge 'dzin gcig la mnyam par bzhag mngon shes mnga' bas myang ban sha'i spyan can zhes grags/ paṇa chen ji ma la mi tras snying thig gi man ngag rdzogs par gnang / sad na legs mdzing yon dang khri ral pa can gnyis kyi skabs chos blon mdzad/ dbu ru zha'i lha khang bzhengs nas der gdams ngag rnams gter du sbas/ yul spu de'ang myang bam la dbang ba rdo ring la bka' brtsigs bskos/ phyis su glang dar mas bkrongs so chig brgyud rnams 'brom rin chen 'bar la bshad/ des sbas blo gros dbang phyug la bshad/gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal bya bas gter bton te/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug dang kha rag sgom chung gnyis la bshad/ lce btsun gyis myang bka' gdams pa la bstan cing / gdams pa rnams gter kha gsum du sbas/ rong snar mda'i rtse sgom nag po dang / lang gro chad pa stag nas shangs pa ras pa dang /yar 'brog gi snubs mtsho gling dgu'i bla dor 'khrungs pa'i zhang bkra shis rdo rje rnams kyis gter bton/phyi ma 'di'i lce btsun rang la'ang thug des sras nye 'bum/ de nas rim bzhin jo 'ber/ 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa/ me long rdo rje/ rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza/ klong chen rab 'byams pa la'o/ klong chen rab 'byams pa 'di ni rnying ma ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi khrod du mkhas pa'i rtse mor son pa gcig pu ste/rig gnas dang / mdo phyogs dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi brtsams chos shin tu mang ngo / slob dpon klong chen pa dri med 'od zer zhes pa dbus lho g.yo ru gra'i cha stod grong du rab byung lnga pa'i sa sprel lor 'khrungs(1308—1363)rab byung drug pa'i chu yos lor 'das/ ta'i si tu byang chub dang dus mnyam yin/ khong gis mdzad pa'i mdzod chen bdun te/ thub mtha' mdzod/ theg mchog mdzod/ yid bzhin mdzod/ man ngag mdzod/ chos dbyings mdzod/ gnas lugs mdzod/ tshig don mdzod dang / snying thig ya bzhi/ ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum sogs chos baspya phrag gnyis lhag tsam gsungs so/ / mkha' 'gro snying thig ces grags pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la dga' rab rdo rjes gsan nas/ rig 'dzin shrī seng ha la gnang / de las slob dpon padmas gsan te/ yum ye shes mtsho rgyal la gnang zhing /phyi rabs kyi don du gter du sbas pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bton nas/ rgyal sras legs pa rgyal mtshan dang / kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal sogs la brgyud pa'o/ /—ga~Xsdu / byung tshul ni/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la sogs pa tshad ma'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis

nde'ongs pa'i gdul bya'i don du mchog thun 'grub pa'i gdams pa mang po gter du sbas te chud mi za bar gyin gyis brlabs shing gter srung la gnyen du gtad/ skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab/ dus nam gyi tshe 'don pa dus der 'don ran pa'i ltas mtshan 'byung tshul/ gter ston gang gis 'don pa de'i ming rus mtshan rtags dang bcas pa gter gyi kha byang du btab/ nam zhig gnas dus ṭwāṃng/ /zag thams cad 'dzom pa na gter de thon nas skal ldan mang po la spel bas gter chos zhes grags spyir gter chos rgya gar du'ang byung zhing / bod kyi grub mtha' la'ang yod pas gter chos thams cad rnying ma'i chos su byed pa ni thos rgya chung ba'i skyon no/ gter ston du grags pa 'ga' zhig gis rang gis bcos nas sbas te bton pa'i brdzus ma'ang yod mod kyang / rnam dag yin nges kyang ches mang bas mtha' gcig tu smod mi rung ngo / gter ston tshad ldan gtso cher thang yig nas lung bstan pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma nas bzung bde chen gling ba'i bar dang / lung gis dngos su ma zin pa'i rtsod bral gyi gter ston kyang mang tsam zhig byung ba rnams phyis su chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas gter ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs brtsams pa ltar la/ de dag ni chos dang gang zag gnyis ka rnam par dag pa'o zhes chen po rnams gsungs so/ /de dag gi khrod nas mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer dang / gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gnyis la gter ston gong 'og gnyis zhes nyi zla lta bu'i gter ston gyi rgyal por byed la/ gter ston grwa ba mngon shes 'bar gyis gra thang gis gtsos pa'i gnas gzhi brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa dang / gter mang po ṭwāṃṭā trīd/ pa/ra sman gyi rgyud bzhi sogs gso dpyad skor mang po bton pas bka' drin dang 'phrin las che bar zab mo dag snang gi brgyud pa ni/ grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa 'ga' zhig la lhag pa'i lhas zhal bsdukā nas dngosarti gshāngs pa'i ga/mas pa ste/ 'di yang grub maza' thams cad la yod cing / rnying ma' dngha/༵) rnyi dridī shā ṭāsbyi ṭwāṃdī rted/ tshu/ la/rnying ma ba'i grub mtha'i 'dod tshul la/ yan lag thams cad zhib tu 'god pa yig tshogs kyi ngal ba che bas mi 'bri la/ 'dir lta sgom gyi rnam ga'ag mdo tsam bsnyad par bya'o/de yang he ru ka gal po'i rgyud la sogs par gsar ma'i spyor drug rim lnga/ lam 'bras sogs dang mthun pa'i lam gyi bgrod tshul bshad cing / rgyud dra'i rim drug rim gsum sogs grol lam dang /gsang thig sogs thabs lam gyi man ngag dang / 'dus pa mdo'i ngang sgom/ bka' brgyad kyi rim lnga sogs su'ang gsar ma dang phyogs mthun gyi bshad pa ci rigs mchis kyang / phyis kyi rnying ma ba rnams kyis de dag la 'chad nyan dang nyams len gtso bor mi byed par snang / — 261 —

rtsis cher byed pa de rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom yin 'dug cing / de yang dri ma dang bral ba'i da lta'i rig pa gsal stong rjen pa 'di la rdzogs pa chen po zer/ de'i sgra bshad kyang / snang srid 'khor 'daḥkyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rig pa stong pa 'di'i nang du rdzogs pas na rdzogs pa dang / de las lhag pa'i 'khor ba las grol ba'i thabs gzhan mchog tu gyur pa med pas na chen po zer ba yin skad/rdzogs chen la nang gses kyis phye na/ sems sde/ klong sde/ man ngag gi sde gsum las/ sems sde ni cir snang sems yin la sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes su shar bas rang byung gi ye shes las gzhan du gyur ba med pa ste/ 'di'i lam gyi sne khrid tshul tsam phyag chen dang 'dra shas che yang / phyag chen pas yul la phar rgyas 'debs pa yin la/ sems bas yul can sems nyid rig stong ka dag tu gtan la 'beebs pas don la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par che zer/klong sde ni chos nyid kun tu bzang po'i klong nas 'gro sa gzhan med pas chos nyid kyi klong las gzhan byung 'gog pa yin/ 'di'i 'od gsal rtsis po cher byed pa gsar ma'i rim lnga dang cha 'dra yang don khyad par che ste/ rim lnga ni rlung lnga'i byed chings kyi gnad las sgyu lus stong gzugs kyi snang brnyan nyid ril 'dzin dang / rjes gzhig gis 'od gsal du dwangs su 'jug pa yin pas bya rtsol dang bcas pa yin/klong sde ba ni dmigs gtad bral ba'i gnad zab mo bya rtsol med pa'i ngang du 'dzog pa zab gsal gyi ye shes zung 'jug gis 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku sgrub pa'i thabs zab pas/ lam 'dir zhugs pa'i rig 'dzin gong ma rnams ye shes kyi skur gshegs pa sha stag byung ngo zhes rdo rje zam pa ba rnams zer ro/ /man ngag gi sde ni/ spang blang bral ba zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid stong 'dzin dang bral ba'i ngang du skyelaba'i gnad kyis 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma phye ba'i rig pa nyid chos kyi yul mngon sum du shar nas/ rang rig lu gu rgyud kyi skur smin cing grol bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni gnad thog tu grol ba gnad la thebs pa me btsa' dang 'dra'o/ 'dis lam thod rgal gyi snang ba gtso bor byed pa gsar ma'i sbyor drug dang 'dra mod/ don la khyad par che ste/ sbyor drug ni rlung lnga dbu mar bcings pa'i gnad kyis stong gzugs kyi snang ba shar ba byed rtsol gyi bde ba chen po'i lam la rim gyis bkri ba yin la/ 'dir ni yid dpyod thams cad bcad nas gnas lugs rang gsal mngon sum du gtan la 'beebs pas khyad par du 'phags shing / lam 'dis ye shes kyi sku 'ja' lus su grol ba'ang klong sde sogs kyis bsgrubs pa las 'phags te/ 'dir ni rags pa'i sgo gsum phra ba dwangs ma'i skur dwangs pa tsam ma yin par/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthar phyin pas sgo gsum phra rags thams cad sku dang ye shes kyi ngang la gzhi med dwangs pa yin pas so zhes zer ro/ /gzhan yang ngo bo ka dag rang bzhin lhun grub/ thugs rje kun khyab gsum gyi tha snyad byed de/thog ma'i gnas lugs gzhi skye ba med pa'i stong pa la ngo bo ka dag dang / stong pa nyid de'i mdangs 'gag pa med pa de la rang bzhin lhun grub dang / de'i col dag ma dag ci yang 'char ba la thugs rje kun khyab — 262 —

ces zer zhing / dang po la rig stong dbyer med/ gnyis pa la gsal stong dbyer med/ gsum pa la snang stong dbyer med/ zer ro/ sems dang rig pa'i khyad par ma rig pa'i dbang gis mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur dran pa'i glo bur gyi rnam rtog la sems dang / ma rig pas bslad pa ma zhugs pa'i dbang gis gzung 'dzin gyi sbos pa dang bral zhing / gsal stong 'dzin med kyi stong pa ngo shes pa la rig pa zer/sems kyi rnam pa snang ba'i cha de 'khor ba yin/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa'i cha de myang 'das yin/ 'khor ṭwāṃ /py-i / ༵ sdo trīdri /gnyis rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong pa'i ngang du dbye sgyu med pas 'khor 'das dbyer snang ba sems su thag bcad/ sems stong par thag bcad/ stong pa gnyis med zung 'jug tu thag bcad nas chos thams cad rig stong rjen par rtogs pa ni rim gyis rig pa 'phrod pa'i tshad dang /tshe 'dir rig stong rjen par mngon du ma gyur kyang sgom stobs kyis bar dor de'i rtogs pa gsha' ma zhig 'char ba thod rgal ba'i rig pa ngo 'phrod pa'i tshad yin/ mdor na da lta'i rang gi rig pa dri ma med pa gsal stong 'dzin med 'di kha yan du glod cing / rnam rtog snang ba gnas 'gyur gang la'ang bzang ngan dgag sgrub mi bya bar rig stong rjen par skyong ba 'di rdzogs chen sgom tshul gyi snying po slob dpon chen po'i dgongs bcud bla na med pa yin no zhes zer/gzhi lam 'bras bu 'dod tshul ni/ thog ma'i gnas lugs 'khor 'das kyi blos ma reg cing 'khrul ba'i g.ya' yis ma gos pa/ gnas lugs rjen pa 'khrul ma myong rtogs ma myong cir yang ma spub la cir yang byung du ma btub pa la gzhi dang / da lta'i rig pa 'di lhod de bzhag dus bzang rtog ngan rtog lung ma bstan gsum dang bral ba'i stong sangs nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu zhig 'dug pa lam dang / lam gyi yon tan thams cad mngon du gyur te ma rig pa dang 'khrul ba rang sar dag nas chos dbyings mngon du gyur pa la 'bras bur 'dod do/ rdzogs chen gyi lta sgom gyi rnam gzhag 'di rnams lugs 'di'i tshad thub kyi yig cha rnams su bshad pa las snying por bsdus te go bde bar bris pa yin no/ /ga'an yang rnying ma'i rgyud rnams dang / lta sgom spyod gsum dang / gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag gang dang gang la yang slad zhugs pa mang du snang mod kyang / rgyu mtshan des 'di ni log pa'i chos so zhes skur ba 'debs mi rung ste/ g.ya' zhugs pa'i gser la ra gan zhes zer mi rung ba dang mtshungs so/slad zhugs pa ni rnying ma gcig pur ma zad kyi/ rnam dasnyod can gyis zhib tu brtags na bod kyi grub mtha' thams cad la yod par snang bas/ tshul 'di legs par shes na rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i ring lugs 'ba' zhig thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs skyon med du rigs pas drangs pa'i nges shes skye bar 'gyur te/mdo tsam 'og tu bshad par bya'o/des na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ snga 'gyur gsang sngags rnying ma ni/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od dang / 'gos khurnge pa ༵ṭwāṃ3 btsas la

sogs pa rnams yang dag ma yin par smra la/ kho bo'i bla ma skad gnyis smra ba nyi ma'i mtshan can dade༈ rig ral la sogs pas bsam yas nas rgya dpe rnyed pa'i phyir dang / phur bu rtsa ba'i dum bu'i rgya dpe ba bor yang snang bas rgyud yang dag go zhes gsung ngo / kho bos ni/ yid kyi nyes pa rang bzhin gdug4ste/ /mi rigs pa yi gzugs la'ang mi rigs na/ /the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos/ /de phyir btang stoms bzhag legs nyes pa med/ / ces 'byung ba dang / chos yin pa la ma yin zer ba dang / ma yin pa la yin zer ba las 'bras mnyam par bshad pa dang / chos kyi mtshan nyid gang la yod med dag / mi shes mthong ba med pa rgyu bzhi yis/ /rnam dbye smra ba'i kha ni bdud kyis phye/ /chos la brnyas smod thub pa'i gzhung las bkag / ces zer ba bzhin du btang snyoms su bzhag go zhes gsungs so/ /(6)phyisatpa byung ba 'ga' zhigabarjod pa/phyis kyi byung ba 'ga' zhig brjod pa ni/ bka' gter gyi gdams pa 'dzin cing spel ba'i gang zag khyad par can sngon byon pa mang po zhig gi byung ba ni brjod zin pa ltar la/ dus phyis su byung ba 'ga' zhig smos na/ slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sprul pa lnga 'byung ba'i stu'i sprul nyang /gsung sprul chos dbang / thugs sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ yon tan gyi sprul pa byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ 'phrin las kyi sbrul pa slad nas dus babs su byung ngo zhes zer/ de las mnga' ris paṇa chen ni mkhas pa dang thub thob gnyis ka 'dzom pa zhig ste brtsams chos kyang mang la/ de'i skye ba byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde'o/ paṇa chen gyi gcung rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can nam dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyi skye ba legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje dang / de'i skye ba rdo rje brag sprul sku rig 'dzin padma 'phrin las so/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ sde ba zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo
