rje dang ma mthun pas/ kho dang byang ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bsdongs nas bkras stobs pa yul bton te/stobs zhes bya ba'i stobs med 'khyams po khyod/ kho bo bre ta pu re'i 'gram du bskrad/ ces snying tshims smras pa la/ bkras stobs pas/ zhing zhes bya ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba khyod/ bdag gis rwa hu la yi 'al du gdab/ ces zer nas/ gshin rje dang gza' yi las sbyor gyis 'ing shag pa stos bcas bsgral/ rgyu mtshan des bkras stobs pa re zhig gi b.radu byes snar byed pa'i dbang gis lhan du 'khod pa'i sngags grwa e waṃ lcog sgar zer/ phyis su dbus phyogs su grwa tshang btsugs nas stan chags pa thub bstan rdo rje brag tu grags pa'o/ grwa ba mngon shes kyi skye brgyud mdo sngags gling ba'i skye ba chos rgyal gter bdag gling ba 'gyur med rdo rjes o rgyan smin grol gling btab/ de'i gcung lo chen dharma thi bya ba mdo sngags gsar rnying / tha snyad rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa 'ig byung bas bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams so/ /nyang ral pa can nyi ma 'od zer ni/ rab byung gnyis pa'i shing 'brug ( 1124—1192) la —'khrungs pa'i rnying ma'i gter ston brgya rtsa'i nang du gu ru chos dbang dang 'di rnam gnyis la gter ston gong 'ogaka nyi~X spya~X grags snyan shin tu che/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu byi lor 'das/

gong sa lnga ba chen po ni mnga' bdag nyang gi sku'i skye ba yin pa dang / legs ldan rje dang / chos snyol dbang po'i sde dag snang la mjal bar brten/ de las brgyud pa'i chos rnams zur chos dbyings rang grol dang / grwa tshang ba blo mchog rdo rje las yongs su rdzogs pa gsan nas nyams bzhes 'chad spel yig 'jog ci rigs mdzad/ rnam par rgyal ba phan bde legs bshad gling du rnying lugs kyi sgrub 'azin mang po 'dzugs par mdzad cing / rnying ma'i dgon pa yang mang po zhig 'debs par mdzad do/ /dus skabs der rnying bstan dar rgyas che bar byung na'ang / mi ring bar jin gar ba'i dmag gis dgon pa gsum ga gtor/ rdor brag sprul sku/ lo chen dharma shrī/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ gter bdag gling ba'i sras padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho rnams nyes med du bkrongs/ ser 'bras sogs la zhus dag byed khul gyis spu rgan mang po phud pa sogs dge lugs pa'i zhabs 'degs su rlom pa'i ṭwāṃsna~X byi ṭīkā shākā po/ ci/ yang byas/ 'on kyang mi ring bar rdor smin gnyis sor chud/ rnam rgyal gling dge dus phyis rje drung sprul sku blo bzang 'phrin las kyis gter bdwag gling pa'i gter ma gsang ba ye shes kyi chos skor rtsal 'don gyis gsar rnying bsres pa'i yig cha mang po brtsams/ de'i sgo nas bdud rtsi mchod pa dang rig ma mchod pa phyogs thams cad rjes su 'brangs/ dge lugs pa'i sbrul stu dang dge bshes 'ga' zhig kyang de la zhugs/ chu lho byang gi gtsang dgon mang po ser khyim du gtong la khad byung ba/ bdag cag gi 'dren mchog dam pa mi dri'i mtshan can gyis chos dang mthun par nyams smad cing tshar bcad pas rtsing chos de bag la zha bar gyur to/ /rje drung sprul sku nyid rtogs pa mthon por byon pa zhig ni yin nges pas dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa khyad par can yod srid kyang / snang tshod la gsar rnying thams cad gcig tu bsres pas gnyis ka'i gral du mi chud pa dang / mdzad pa de bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshangs spyod la gnod pa chen po dang / sems can mang po dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyur song ba lta bu byung snang ngo /bka' gdams rnying ma ni/ 'brom ston rje nas rje tsong kha pa'i bar gyi bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan gyi brgyud 'dzin snga rabs/ bka' gdams gsar ma ni/ rje tsong kha pa nas bzung bka' gdams ༵/ / sdu / / tā~X dṛtram̐// spyod gzhir bzhag thog dbu ma'i lta ba dang gsang sngags kyi thabs bsnan pa'i dge shāsnaṭwāṃ rshaldakākā dasnaṭā zlo /ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' las yig 'bru gcig kyang ma lus par tshang ma gdams ngag tu go ba'i grub mtha' zhig ste/ jo bo rje a ti sha nas dbu brnyes/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis srol gyes/ po to ba dang / spyan snga ba/ phu chung ba bcas sku mched gsum gyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ glang ri thang pa dang sha ra ba gnyis dang / bya yul ba sogs kyipya de ༵༵ kyarji rgyas

par mdzad/ bka' gdams pa'i slob brgyud yongs su grags pa la gzhung pa dang gdams ngag pa gnyi sam/ yang na man ngag pa dang gsum du gyes so/ / bka' gdams gdams ngag lta ba gtso bor ston pa jo bo'i gdams ngag spyan snga ba nas brgyud pa'i bden bzhi'i khrid/ phu chung ba nas brgyud pa'i rten 'brel gyi khrid/ rnal 'byor pa brgyud padzi bden gnyis kyi khrid bcas/bka' gdams gzhung drug bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis nyams len mdzad pa'i gzhung gtso bo drug ste/ skyes rabs dang ched du brjod pa'i tshoms gnyis dad pa'i gzhung dang /༵ṭwāṃ sna byedro sna/sa trī rgya/ na/ gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhung dang / spyod 'jug dang bslab btus gnyis spyog bka' gdams rtsa gzhung / lta ba gtso bor ston pa ngo bo rjes mdzad pa'i bden gnyis la 'jug pa dang / dbu ma'i man ngag sogs dang / spyod pa gtso bor ston pa spyod bsdus sgron me dang / spyod bsdus sogs/ gnyis ka ston pa byang chub lam sgron bcas/bka' gdams pho brang ni/ rwa sgrong dang bkra shis lhun po'i gzims chung re'i ming /bka' gdams lha chos bdun de/ thub dbang / spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ mi g.yo ba ste lha bzhi dang / sde snod gsum ste chos gsum bcas bdun/bka' gdams gleg bam/ bka' gdams pha chos dang bu chos kyi po ti/bka' gdams pha chos bu chos ni/ jo bo yab sras kyi gsung chos bka' gdams gleg bam du grags pa'i man ngag ste pha 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa la pha chos/ bu rngog lo legs pa'i shes rab dang / khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gnyis kyis zhus pa la bu chos su grags/(kha) bka' gdams rnying ma/ 'brom ston rje nas rje tsong kha pa'i bar gyi bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan gyi brgyud 'dzin snga rabs/ dus rabs bcu gcig nas bcu gsum bar/le'u bco lnga ba/ bka' gdams pa pyung tshul/sems mchog yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po can/ / dpag yas rgyal sras spyod pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /mkhas grub gdengs can stong gis rtsen pa la/ / bka' gdams par grags grub mtha'i byung ba gleng / /bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' byung tshul mdo tsam zhig bshad pa la gsum/ jo bo chen po'i bka' drin las bka' gdams kyi lugs srol byung tshul/ de la brten nas bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gzhan byungatram̐ la/26༵da' gdams kyi bstan pa'i spyi bab bshad pa'o/ /

dang po/ jo borje'i bka' drin las bka' gdams kyi lugs srol byung zul/de yang bla ma gong ma rnams bka' gdams pa zhes pa'i sgra bshad la mi 'dra ba 'ga' gsungs kyang /rje rin po ches spyan snga rin chen 'phel la bka' gdams zhes bya ba'i don de ci yin zhes gsungs pas/spyan sngas rgyal ba'i bka' las yi ge na gcig kyang bzhag tu med par gdams ngag tu go ba la zer ba yin zhus pas/ de yin de yin zhes mnyes pa che ba mdzad/ chos grwar thebs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin chen 'phel gyis kho bo la dam pa'i chos kyi skyes chen po khyer byung / khong de skad zer te/ / de shin tu yin pa 'dug ces gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi bka' sde snod gsum gyi don thams cad ma lus pa a ti sha'i gdams pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim du bsdus nas nyams su len pas na bka' gdams pa zhes bya ste/'brom gyi zhal nas/ ngo mtshar bka' ni sde snod gsum yin te/ /gdams pa skyes bu gsum gyis mdzes pa //sa so//py-i ṅgi //ṭwāṃ~X // shā/na /gser gyi phreng ba la/ /'gro ba gang gis bgrangs kyang don yod 'gyur/ /bka' gdams kyi lugs srol khyad par can de ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ dzo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas dbu brnyes/ ston pa rin po ches srol gyes/ sku mched gsum gyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/glang shar gnyis dang bya yul ba sogs kyis de las kyang rgyas par mdzad pa'o/ /chos 'aṭwāṃsbya // ༵/'ipa byen thabye ༵ rgya/ sa par gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar la/ che ba'i yon tan mdo tsam ni/shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i sras su bltams/ / phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas/ /bslab gsum rnam dag gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin/ / rtsa ba'i sde bzhi gyes pa bco brgyad kyi/ / lugs rnams so sor ma 'dres thugs chud pas/ /kun gyis bkur cing khyod gsung tshad mar len/ rnam gnon ngang tshul la sogs ma ga dhā'i/ /gtsug lag gnas chen kun gyi bdag po mdzad/ /yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs shing / /sde snod rgyud sde'i chos la mi 'khyen med/ /gser gling zhal gyi bum bzang las 'ongs pa'i/ / byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi rdzogs par gsol/ / sgrub dang sun 'byin rigs pa'i nga ro yis/ /rgol ba ngan pa'i glang chen myos mdzad cing / /skal bar ldan rnams rang rang bsam pa dang / /mthun par dam pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ /bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes/ /jo mos lung bstan jo bo nā ro bas/ /bstan pa'i bdag po nyid du mnga' gsol ba/ /de ni dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal lo/ / zhes pa ltar/ /jo bo rje de nyid bod du byon tshul ni/ de yang gangs can gyi ljongs su bstan pa 'phel 'grib mang du snang ste/ mkhan slob chos gsum kyis bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa hwa shang gis bslad par byas/ de ka ma la shī las tshar bcad nas lta spyod rnam par dag pa dar rgyas su yod pa rgyal ngan glang dar mas bsnubs nas lo bdun cu tsam gyi ring la bod mun gling du gyur/ de nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi~X6 kādo tram̐ms

smad nas bstan pa'i me ro bslangs/ lo chen rin bzang gis mnga' ris stod nas gsos pas dbu gtsang gi ljongs su dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel bar gyur mod kyang / 'ga' zhig 'dul ba la mos blos sngags khyad du gsod/ 'ga' gig sngags la mos blos 'dul ba khyad du gsod pas bstan pa phyogs re bar sornakaphal mo che grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gyi bshad pa tsam las thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa nyams len du khyer shes pa lta zhog phyogs mthong gi go ba chags pa'ang dkon par gyur/ lhag par glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa'i bar der/ sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis rgyud tshig blo la yod pa rnams yi ger bris par/ bar skabs kyi tshig brjed nas ma thon pa rnams la blo bzo'i bslad bcug brna khyad gang byung sbyar/ yang la las rgyud kyi ming btags pa'i rtog bzo'i yi ge grong tshig 'ba' zhig gis gang 'dod du bris/ sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis rang gi chung ma la de ring chang zhim po bzos dang / ngas rgyud po ti longs pa zhig rtsom pa yin zer ba'ang byung / rgya gar nas a tsarya dmar po zhes bya ba dang / partsi ta sham thabs sngon po can bya ba la sogs pa 'ga' zhig byung nas bud med spyod pa la sbyor ba dang / dgra la sogs pa'i sems can gsod pa la sgrol ba zhes sbyor sgrol du grags pa'i chos log dang / gzhan yang sngags la snyad btags pa'i rtsing spyod mang po zhig dar bar byas/ de dag gi dbang gis lta spyod rnam dag 'dzin pa nyung zhing chos log spyod pa mang du gyur pa la/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od dang / lo chen rin bzang sogs kyis chos log sun 'byin gyi yi ge bris nas bkram pas kyang pham pa ma byung / dus der mnga' ris kyi rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis/ bod kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshul de ltar gyur pa thugs kyis ma bzod pas rgya gar nas pasnyi ta chen po bstan pa la tshad mar gyur pa zhig gdan drangs nas dag ther mdzad pa las phan thabs gzhan med par dgongs nas/ rgya brtson 'aspus seng ge sogs la gser mang po bskur nas a ti sha gdan 'dren par btang yang spyan ma 'drongs/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rang gi rgyal srid btang zin kyang dmag gi dpon po mdzad de/ gar log dang 'thabs pas pham ste gar log gis btson du bzung nas ma btang /ye shes 'od kyi dbon po byang chub 'od kyis gser mang po btsal nas khu bo blu bar phyin kyang gtong ma nyan/de nas ye shes 'od gar log gis bkrongs/ khong gi zhal ta bzhin byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba gser mang po dang bcas paṇḍi ta sbyan 'dren par yang bskyar rgya gar du mngags/ nag tsho dang rgya brtson seng gnyis 'dzoms nas a ti sha la bod kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshul dang / ye shes kyis dka' spyad byas tshul rnams zhib tu zhus te bod du 'byon par gsol ba btab/ snga mo nas jo bo bod du byon pa'i lung bstan mang po yod kyang / de nub yang bskyar gyis rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab nas brtag pa mdzad par mkha' 'gro ma zhig yod pa la dris gsungs pa bzhin dris par/ bod du byon na bstan pa la phan thogs shing khyad par u ba si ka cig la brten nas phan thogs pa'i lung bstan byung ste bod du 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad do/ bla ma chen po de ni/ rgya gar ba rnams sa hor ra zhes zer zhing /bod rnams za hor zhes 'don pa'i yul 'khor chen po de'i rgyal po dge ba'i dpal zhes bya ba/ mnga' thang — 268 —

rgya nag stong khun rgyal po dang mnyam pa/ pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can zhes bya bar bzhugs pa de dang /btsun mo dpal gyi 'od zer can zhes bya ba gnyis la/ sras che ba padma'i snying po/ 'bring po zla ba'i snying po/ chung ba dpal gyi snying po ste gsum mnga' ba las/ rje btsun 'di ni 'bring po zla ba'i snying po yin no/chung ngu'i dus nas tshe rabs kyi yi dam bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma mngon sum du gzigs/ de'i mthus rgyal srid la ma chags par yul gzhan du bla ma tshol du mchis pa las/ bla ma mang po'i mdun nas dbang dang rgyud man ngagadang bcas gsan zhing / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'khor nyan thos mang po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gsung gis/ khyod ci la chags rab tu mi 'byung zhes bya ba mnal lam du gsan nas/ rab tu byung na bstan pa la phan pa chen por 'gyur bar dgongs te/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas rang lo sum cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa'i bar du/ sde ba bzhi ka'i sde snod gsum phal cher gsan zhing / lag len la mkhas pa chen po gyur bas sde ba thams cad kyi dri ba'i gnas su gyur ro/ / bstan pa la 'phel 'grib dang bsre slad zhugs tshul dang / de'i don du lha bla khu dbon lo tsā ba rnams kyis dka' spyad chen po byas tshul gyi zhib cha shes na de dag gi bka' drin dran pa dang /gyu tshom du mi 'jug par rnam dbye shes nas 'jug pa sogs kyi dgos pa che bas zhib tu 'bri bar 'os kyang /yi ge lci bas 'jigs nas 'dir phyogs tsam las ma sbos pas gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bod du phebs nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul ni/ lam rim chen mor jo bo rje'i che ba gsungs ba'i skabs su/ mnga' ris stod du phyag phebs pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dag ther mdzad par gsol ba btab pa la brten nas mdo sngags kyi gnad thams cad bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i rim par dril ba gzhung byang chub lam gyi sgron ma mdzad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzad de/ de yang mnga' ris su lo gsum/ snye thang du lo dgu/ dbus gtsang gzhan du lo lnga'i bar du skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la mdo sngags kyi gzhung gdams ngag ma lus pa bstan nas bstan pa'i srol nub pa rnams gsar du btsugs/ srol cung zad yod pa rnams 'phel bar mdzad/ log par rtog pa'i dri mas sbags pa rnams legs par bsal te bstan pa rin po che dri ma dang bral bar mdzad do/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te gsung 'di la zhib tu bsams na shin tu gnad che ba'i go rgyu mang po zhig yod par snang ngo / bod du lo bcubadun bzhugs nas/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa chu pho rta'i lo dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la snye thang du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul mdzad nas dga' ldan du rje btsun byams pa'i drung du byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' dri ma med pa zhes bya bar thur to/ jo bo chen po la rgya bod gnyis char du slob ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang du byon na'ang / gdams ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis gnang zhing bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul/ a ti sha rang nyid la sgrol mas lung bstan cing / sangs spyas phal po che dang / snying rje pad ma dkar po'i mdo las dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes lung bstan pa/ 'brom rin po che rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin la/ ston pa rin po — 269 —

ches bka' gdams kyi srol phye ba dang / sku mched gsum sogs kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad tshul rnamasau'adir zhib tu brjod na ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas bka' gdams chos 'byung sogs las shes par bya zhingasgomado tsam ni chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me las/ de nas lo ngo bcu yi bar dag tu/ / dge bshes storna pas tshogs kyi dpon mdzad de/ / dzo bo'i gdan sa dpal gyi rwa sgring btab/ / yongs su dag pa'i sbogle 'khoratsān par mdzad/ /de nas lo grangs nyi shu lhag tsam na/ /sku mched gsum gyi 'azin las klong rdo te/ /dbu ru byang du bka' gdams nyi ma shar/ /gangs can ma lus 'od kyis gang bar mdzad/ /drang srong chen po po to ba la ni/ / lta spyod yongs su dag pa'i slob ma ni/ / dus re la yang nyis stong lhag tsa0dang / /spyan snga ba la brgyad brgya dgu brgya 'dus/ /phu chung ba yis tshogs pa mang bskyangs kyang / /sbagapa'i tshul du dpag med smin par mdzad/ / khams pa lung ba'i thun baspyad ma la yang / / rnam grol don gnyer brgyad brgya 'dus par grags/ /sku mched gsum gyis legs par bskyangs pa'i sras/ /glang thang ba la stong phrag re tsam dang / / dge bshes chen po sha ra ba la ni/ / rnam thar gtsang ba sum stong lhag re 'dus/ /dge bshes ya gad pa la stong lhag dang / /bya yul ba la nyis stong bdun brgya sogs/ /'phrin ༵trī drosding/sa/ pa'i bshes gnyen mtha' yas te/ / de dus kho na bstan pa'i gdal che'o/ / zhes gsungs de ltar mnga' ris kyi rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od khu dbon gyis bstan pa 'ba' zhig thugs la brnags te lus srog longs spyod gang la'ang ma ltos par dka' ba chen pos jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod du gdan drangs pa la brten nas/ sngags la snyad btags pa'i rtsing spyod sogs log par spyod pa rnams dang / mdo sngags gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i log rtog rnams nyi ma shar bas mun pa rang sangs la song ba bzhin du gyur/ bla chen po'i brgyud 'dzin sogs bstan pa phyi dar gyi lta spyod rnam dag 'dzin pa thams cad kyang jo bo'i bka' brgyud la zhugs pas/ dbus gtsang gi sa'i khyon thams cad rnam thar phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad ma'i sbubs lta bu dang ldan pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyis yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /bka' gdams kyi lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon sde du mas dbus gtsang gi ljongs thams cad khyab par gyur pa las/ deng sang gi bar du ma nyams par yod pa ni byang rwa sgrong dang / gtsang gi snar thang byang chub chen po'i dbeen gnas dang bcas pa rnams so/ /'di rnams bka' gdams glegs bam las rgya chen lung bstan cing / rwa sgrong ni bka' gdams kyi chu mgo dag pa'i zhing khams 'brom rje spyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi ye shes kyi rnam 'azul las byung ba yin la/snar thang ni sha ra ba'i slob ma gtum ston blo gros grags pas btab nas mkhan brgyud gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu zam ma chad par byon no/ gdan sa gzhan rnams ni dus kyi dbang gis phal cher stongs shing mang po 'igand+ra lta 2kāṭwāṃn mas 'dzin par snang ste/ bka' gdams rnams bud med la shin tu 'dzem ste/ mkha'

'gro'i rnam 'phrul gyi bud med cig dgon par 'ongs pa drag 'dzin gyis phyir bton pa la da lta khyed rnams nged kyi rigs la 'dzem ste/ slar dgon shul rnams bud med kyis 'dzin no zhes dmod bor bas/ de'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis yin no zhes dam pa 'ga' zhig gis gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ jo bo chen por brten nas bstan 'jin gzhan byung tshul/bka' brgyud pa dang / sa skya ba dang / jo nang ba dang / dge ldan par grags pa 'di rnams kyang jo bo rje'i 'phrin las la brten nas byung ba sha stag yin te/ bka' brgyud kyi mes po lho brag mar ba lo tsā rgya gar du lan phyi ma byon dus jo bo rje dang mjal nas gdams pa gsan cing / khyad par du mnyam med dwags po lha rjes/ dang po jo bo'i dngos slob rnal 'byor ba chen po'i slob ma rgya yon bdag las bka' gdams gsan/ de rjes rje btsun mi la las phyag chen gsan nas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi gdams pa lam rim thar rgyan mdzad/ de'i slob ma 'gro mgon phag mo grub pas dge bshes dol ba las bka' gdams gsan cing bstan rim gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ de bzhin du 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos glang lung pa dang / stag lung thang ba chen po 'chad ka ba dang / karma ba dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sha ra ba'i slob ma rnal 'asnyor ba shes rab rdo rje las bka' gdams gsan nas/ spyod phyogs kyi nyams len thams cad bka' gdams lugs bzhin mdzad pas/ des na bka' brgyud pa'i chos kyi snying po phyag chen dang / chos drug gdams pa theg pa chen po'i chos su byed pa chang gi phab rtsi lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems kyi man ngag rnams bka' gdams kyi chos brgyud las byung ba kho na'o/ /'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis sne'u zur ba'i slob ma spyi bo lhas pa las bka' gdams gsan cing /khong gi gsung rab rnams su yang theg chen thun mong ba'i lam gyi nyams len thams cad bka' gdams lugs kho na mdzad pas/ rjes 'brang gi sa skya ba rnams kyang srol de bzhin byed do/ /dol po ba shes rab rgyal mtshan kyang dgung lo so gcig bar du karma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku zeng gsum pa karma rang byung rdo rje dang sa skya pa bsod nams spyal mtshan rnam gnyis las bka' gdams dang lam 'bras sogs gsan cing kun khong du chud pa ste legs par rtogs pa'i na chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i mtshan thog khong gi gsung 'bum nang du yang theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa thams cad bka' gdams lugs ltar mdzad yod pas so/ /rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po don dngos gnas la jo bo rje dang thugs rgyud gcig par tshad ma'i lung gis grub cing / thun mong gi snang ngor yang mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang chos skyabs bzang po gnyis las bka' gdams kyi lam rim gsan nas/ dus kyi rim pas jo bo'i gdams pa la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dri ma zhugs pa rnams bsal te sngon med legs bshad kyi bstan bcos lam rim che chung sogs mdzad pa dang / ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs srol nyid kyang jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar gzhir bzhag la dbu ma'i lta ba dang gsang sngags kyi bsnon pa btab pa lta bu yin pas bka' gdams la~X ṭwāṃ 1'das la/

chos 'byung rnams su dge ldan ring lugs la bka' gdams gsar ba'i ming gi tha snyad kyang mdzad do/ /bka' gdams pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' las yig 'bru gcig kyang ma lus par tshang ma gdam ngag tu go ba'i grub mtha' zhig ste/ jo bo rje a ti sha nas dbu brnyes/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byubaganas kyis srol phyes/ po to ba dang / sbyan snga ba/ phu chung ba bcas sku mched gsum gyis dar zhing spyaspopar mdzad/ glang ri thang pa dang sha ra ba gnyis dang / bya yul ba sogs kyis de bas kyang rgyas par mdzad/ bka' gdams pa'i slob brgyud yongs su grags pa la gzhung pa dang gdams ngag pa gnyis sam/yang na man ngag pa dang gsum du gyes so/ /de'ang bka' gdams gligs bam las lung bstan pa ste/ pha chos le'u nyer drug pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ tha mar bstan pa'i me ro dag /grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ /du ma'i phan bde sgrub par byed/ /de yang gnas mchog dam pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lo tsā na re/ yan lag gi ming 'di ma mo la btags na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba yin/ lus las yan lag rgyas bya ba'i lugs yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis rje bla ma dang gdan sa dga' ldan lung bstan cing / lo tsā ba'i gsungs de bka' gdams pa lus lta bu las/ bka' gdams gsar ba dga' ldan pa yan lag lta bu de dar rgyas che zhes pa'i don du snang bas so/ /bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ jo bo yab sras kyi gsung chos bka' gdams glegs bam du grags pa'i man ngag ste pha 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa pha chos dang / bu rngog lo legs pa'i shes rab dang / khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gnyis kyis zhus pa la bu chos su grags so/ /gzhan yang zul phu bas/ jo bo'i lo rgyus chen mo yi ger btab cing / stod lung pa las bka' /rsharshas/ ga/ san pas/ khong gi rgyud pa 'dul 'dzin mang du byon pa thams cad kyang bka' gdams pa sha der ma zad mtshan nyid kyi gzhung chen mo'i bshad rgyun rnams kyang jo bo rje'i bka' drin las byung ba ste/de'i tshul ji ltar zhe na/ bod 'dir dbu tshad byams chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag por gyur pa ni rngog lo chen po slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa yin cing / rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab ni jo bo'i dngos slob tsam du ma zad yer ba lha rir gsang chos bka' gdams glegs bam gnang ba'i thugs kyi sras po gcig yin la/ de nyid la jo bo nyid kyis gsang phu 'debs par lung bstan pa bzhin btab/ de'i slob ma dang dbon po gnyis ka yin pa blo ldan shes rab kyis jo bo'i chos rnams khu bo las gsan nas bstan rim kyang mdzad/ de'i slob ma gsung rab kun la mkhas pa gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ phar phyin mkhas pa 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar/ tshad ma la mkhas pa gangs pa she'u/ dbu ma la mkhas pa khyung rin chen grags/ dngos kyi gdan sa zhang tshe srong sogs byung / gro lung pa gzhon nu'i dus jo bo rje dang 'brom las bka' gdams kyi chos gsan/ jo bo'i gzhung chung rnams gtsor gyur pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa la don — 272 —

khog 'ching ba'i ṭī ka dang / bstan rim che chung gnyis mdzad/ bstan rim chen mo ni lam sgron gyi dgongs 'grel bla med yin pas rgyal ba tsong kha pas kyang 'di'i glegs bam gzigs dus su mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bsu ba mdzad cing / lam rim chen mo yang phal cher 'di dang mthun par mdzad/ gro lung pa/'bre/ gangs pa/ khyung / zhang rnams kyi slob brgyud la mkhas pa gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu rim par snyon pa rnams kyis bshad grwa mang du btsugs pa'i 'chad nyan gyi rgyun da lta'i bar du gnas pa 'di'o/ /mdor na 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis deb sngon las/ dus phyis bod du byon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang / rnal 'byor ba grub pa'i spyod pa can rnams kyi rnam par thar ba phal che ba ni bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen re la gtugs pa kho na snang bas/ 'brom yang rgya che zhing rgyun chags pa'i 'azin las can zhig ste/ de dag gis ni dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i 'bras bu phyogs tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ zhes gsung pa ltar/ gangs can gyi ljongs su rnam par dag pa'i chos lugs sam grub mtha' ji snyed byung ba thams cad jo bo chen po bod du snyon nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'bras bu yin par shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa/ bka' gdamasatpa bstan pa'i sbyi bab bshadapa/smo kāka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i sbyi bab bshad pa la/ chos kyi rnam grangs dang / gang zag gi mdzad da gabye~X dhikā/spyirnam grangs/'brom gyi zhal nas/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes pa dang /rnal 'byor ba chen pos gdams ngag la nang byan chud pa ni/ bee'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyi/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba la zer ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang / sgom pa rin chen bla mas/ 'dul ba sngags kyi grogs/ sngags 'dul ba'i grogs su 'khyer shes pa ni nga'i bla ma'i bka' brgyud min pa med/ ces gsungs pa ltar/spyir rgyal ba'i gsung rab la spong len mi byed par thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du 'khyer ba bka' gdams pa'i khyad chos yin pas/ bka' gdams su ma 'dus pa'i chos med na'ang /yongs su grags pa la gzhung dang gdam ngag gnyis sam/ yang na man ngag dang gsum du dbye'o//ḍirsha sdu tram̐ 3 gtso bor ston pa dang / spyod pa gtso bor ston pa dang / gnyis ka zung 'brel du ston pa — |ma lda/nga/ po ni/ jo bos mdzad pa'i bden gnyis la 'jug padang / ༈ gnyis pa ni/ spyod sdu/ pa ṭī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ / dī 'o// /sems bskyed dang / sdom pari cho ga sogs deng / slo gsum pa ni/ byang ༄ 'di ni rgyal ba'i bka' sde snod gsum dang rgyud rṣari bzhi/ ci dgongs 'amul ṅgeng bcas ༵ ḍi~X ye ge ni

thocig kyang dor du med par gang zag gcig gi nyams len gyi rim par dril nas ston pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba ste/ rje bla ma'i byang chub lam rim 'i sa/ jo bos mdzad pa'i gzhung mang du yod kyang rtsa ba lta g.yo ngas su rdzogs pa ni lam sgron yin te/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i gnad bsdus nas ston pas brjod bya yo ngas su rdzogs pa dang / sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor byas pas lag tu blang bde ba dang / shing rta chen posanyis kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i bla ma gnyis kyi gdams pas brgyan pas lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa ni/ sa rgyan gnyis/bslab spyod gnyis/ skyes choms gnyis te drug yin la/ de las bslab spyod gnyis lta spyod zung 'brel/ga'an rnams byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung yin no/ /rjo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsar grasas pa'ang bka' gdams kyi gzhung yin la/ rtsa shes dang / stong nid bdun cu ba dang / rin chen phrengab rnams kyang yin no/ gdams ngag la'ang gsum las/lta ba satso bor ston pa ni/ jo bo nyid gyi man ngag spyan snga ba las brgyud pa'i bden bzhi'i khrid ngang /phu chung ba nas brgyud pa'i rten 'brel kyi khrid dang / rnal 'byor ba nas brgyud pa'i bden pa gnyis kyi phrid rnams yin te/ bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi khrid kyis ni thun mong ba'i gang zag gi bdag med dang / bden gnyis khyi khrid kyis ni shin tu phra ba'i chos kyi bdag med la 'khrid par mdzad pa yin no/ /jobo'islob ma bden gnyis la shin tu mkhas pa ni rnal 'byor ba chen po yin la/ des gro lung pa dang spyan sngab la gsungs/ spyan sngas kyang stod lung pa bya yul ba gnyis la lkog chos su gsungs/ stod lung pa sa lkog chos dang / chogs chos gnyis kar gsungs rshang brtsams chos kyang mang du mdzad/ slob ma shu nga khams kyis kyang mang du gsung sa pas dar zhing rgyas/ sangs rgyas dbon gyis kyang yig cha spyas sposdus du ma mdzad/ 'chad kha bas mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i bstan bcos dang / de'i 'grel ba lha lung dbang phyugagis mdzad par phyi nang gi grupa mtha'i 'dod tshul rnams bkod nas/ klu sgrub kyi dbu ma chen mo rab tu mi gnas pār 'khrid par mdzad de bka' gdams pa'i lta ba'i le lag go/ /denas jo bo checha po ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba 'dzin pa lam sgron rtsa 'grel dang / dbu mi ྅ rme na ngag rtsa 'grel sogs kyis shes shing / 'brom gyis kyang jo bo la slob dpon zla grags lugs kyi rtogs pa phul bas thags dgyes nas phyag thal mo sbyar/ ngo mtshar che/ da lta rgya gar shar phyogs na lta ba 'di kho na 'dzin zhes gsungs pa ra bshad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba sogs sku mched gsuca du gags pa rnams kyi lam rim dang gsu nga sgros su dbu ma'i lta ba zla grags lugs dang mthun shas che ba 'byung zhing /jog lo yab sras ni legasaldan dang blo ba'i gzhung khungs su drangs pa mang du snang na'ang lca ba skyong tshul zhi ba 'tsho yab sras dang mthun pa zhes che'o /spyod pa gtso bor gyur ba'i gdams ngas ni theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa rnams te/ bdag bas ga'arda gaṭwāṃṭwāṃ 4si di shang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang skyes zin gong 'phel du byas pa'i sgo nas

sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul yin la/ theg chen gyi mdo sde spyi dang / khyad par du mdo sde phal po che dang /dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung klu sgrub kyi rin chen phreng ba dang / rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam dang /seca sa can mgu ba'i tshigs bcad dang / zhi ba lha'i bslab spyod gnyis rnams gdams pa'i khungs yin cing / mdo bstan bcos de dag gi man ngag snying por dril pa/ jo bla ma dharma rakṣi tas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong mchon cha 'khor lo dang / rma bya dug 'joms/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor gyi gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu/ṭāsnasdo spra tā ṭāṭwāṃ bye/ma/sa dpa'i rim pa dang / rtog pa 'bur 'joms la sogs pa gdams ngag yi ger don bdun mar nye bar bkod pa'i blo sbyong gi man ngag ni/ gser gling bas ngo bo la gsungs/des dge bshes ston pa la skog chos su mdzad/ des sku mched gsum la lkog chos su mdzad/ sku mched gsum gyi ring la lam rim tshogs chos su mdzad kyang / blo spyong skog chos nyid du mdzad par mngon la/po to bas kyang glang shar gnyis la sogs pa la lkog chos su gnang ba las/ glang thang bas dmigs pa'i sa ༵shāṭwāṃ /rgya/ da/ du mdzad pa la blo sbyong tshigs brgyad mar grags shing / de nyid tshogs chos su mdzad par yang glang ri thang bas zhang dang gnyen/ sha bo sgang ba rnams la gsungs shing / de dag gi gdams pa trīsdosdu sna ṭwāṃ byi hāṭwāṃ kāko/ da/ pa la ni be'u bum khra bo zhes zer te/ sha bo sgang ba'i blo sbyong zhes grags pa yang de 'ang sha ra bas ni bya 'chad ka ba la lkog chos su mdzad de/ gzhan la gsungs pa'i gtam ni mi snang ngo / 'chad ka bas ni gtso bor rang nyid kho nas thugs nyams su bzhes shing / re re gnyis gnyis la lkog chos su mdzad pa las/ phan cher thogs par gzigs nas 'gre phur tshogs chos su yang gsungs/sngon 'gro rten gyi chos sems pa/ dngos gzhi byang chub gyi sems sbyong ba/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshigablo sbyong gi bslab bya ste/ don bdun du sa bcad/ rtsa ba'i tshig yi ger bkod pas blo sbyong don bdun mar grags pa yin no/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa rnams dang / glang thang ba'i tshigs brgyad ma/ sha bo sgang ba'i blo spyong rnams su'ang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul legs par bstan kyang /don bdun mar snga ma de dag tu mi 'byung ba'i gtong len rlung la bskyon pa sogs dmigs pa'i 'phrul zab mo dang / 'khrid rim kyang gzhan las rgyas pas 'di nyid khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /snar thang ba sangs rgyas sgom pas kyang 'chad ka ba'i rtsa tshig 'di dag la go rim bsgrigs pa'i 'chad tshul blo sbyong tshogs bshad ma zhes bya ba yod la/ rje bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos kyang ngon bdun ma'i gdams pa 'di mchog tu gzigs nas slob ma rnams la rgyas par gsungs pa byang sems ra sgrong bas zin bris su mdzad pa dang / khyad par du hor ston nam mkha' dpal bas blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od ger dzees ༵ ༵ mchog tu

zab pa zhig mdzad snang ngo / /dge bshes ston pa'i man ngag thun brgyad ma ni khams pa lang pas rtsal du bton te 'chad pas kham pa lung pa'i blo spyong thun brgyad ma zhes grags so/ thun brgyad ni zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong dang / gi bzhin du dbugs la brten pa dang / lus gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed du sgrul pa dang / sha khrag la brten pa dgagator ma la brten pa dang / 'byung ba la brten pa dang / lus yid bzhin gyi nor bur sprul te blo spyong ba dang / 'chi kha ma'i man ngag ste dmigs thun brgyad du dris nas ston pa'o/ kha rag sgom chung ba dab0phyug blo gros kyis kha rag skor gsum bya ba'i chos gsungs/ gdams pa de ni a ro nas sba sgom la brgyud pa'i sems phyogs kyi gdams pa dang / jo bo'i gdams pa rnal 'byor ba dang / dgon pa ba la gsan pa'i blo sbyong gi gdams pa'i chu bo gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa ste/ byang chub sems sbyong zhes mtshan gsol te/ang yig bdun cu ba zhes pa'i lam rim gyi man ngag tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dge bshes ston pa nas brgyud pa'i rten 'brel snying po'i 'khrid kyang snying rje chen po bsgom tshul khyad par du ston pas spyod pa'i gdams ngag yin pa/ jo bo'i gzhung la brten nas zhang sha ra bas mdzad pa'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga sogs kyang yin no/ /lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa'i gdams pa'i rgyal po ni/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa zhes grags pa ste/ gzhung ni byang chub lam sgron yin la/ sngar bshad pa'i spyod pa dang lta ba'i gzhung dang man ngag so so ba de dag kyang lam rim gyi ya spyal yin pas/ lam rim gyi khungs su de thams cad 'du ba yin la/lam rim ni jo bo rje la rgya chen spyod rgyud dang / zab mo lta rgyud kyi man ngag gnyis mnga' ba lam gyi lus snaṭwāṃkā shā /3 sdus/ nya/mas su len tshul cha tshang ba'i gdams pa yin pas lta spyod zung 'brel gyi gdams pa de lta bu'i lam rim gyi gdams pa ni jo bos 'brom la lkog tu 'khrid par mdzad de/ ngas khyod min pa gzhan la gtod sa ma rnyed ces gsungs nas/ man ngag 'di dge bshes ston pa la gtad de khong bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis brlabs pas/ 'brom 'azin las kyi khyab bdal che ba yang des yin zhes—sasungs/ gzhan yang nag tsho la gnang bas/ de'i slob ma lag mor ba las brgyud pa'i lam rim gyi yig shātrīsdo byiṭā sdu /chung kāshā rshashe/ sa/ gsang phu ba la gnang ba thugs sras 'phrin las pa'am gro lung pa'i mdzad pa'i jo bo yab sras nas dge bshes dgon pa ba/ de nas sne'u zur ba sogs la rim gyis brgyud pa dang /'brom rin po che nas dge bshes spyan snga ba/ de nas bya yul ba sogs la brgyud pa la bka' gdams man ngas pa nas brgyud pa grags shing / 'brom rin po che nas dge bshes po to ba dang / de nas sha ra ba sogs la brgyud pa la bka' gdams gzhung ba zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ gnyis ka'ang don la 'dra yang gardirji baṭwāṃ~X ༵ spros pa rgya che ba byed mi byed kyi sgo nas so sor bgrangs ba tsam mo/ /

las kyi sne 'khrid tshul la mi mthun pa mang yang gnad gcig par gsungs la/ rje bla ma'i bee'u bum sngon po las/ man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i mgo ni/ bshes gnyen dam pa mi gartang ba yin/ zhes pa khungs su mdzad nas bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas 'khrid par mdzad do/ /bka' gdams pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i lam rim gyi gzhung mang du snang yang grags che ba ni be'u bum sngotsha po dang / dpe chos gnyis te/ snga ma ni dge bshes po to ba'i gsung sgros dol ba shes rab spya cha/tshes bsgrisas pa la lha 'bri sgang bas 'grel ba mdzad pa yin la/ rje'i zhal nas/ dge bshes yin na be'u bum sngon po la lta dgos zhes bsngags pa mdzad cing / lam rim du khungs kyang mang du drangs snang ngo / dpe chos la ne gsum byung ste/ thog mar grab pas bsgrigs pa ni bsdus pa dang / brag dkar bas de gzhir mdzad nas khong rang nyid kyis dge bshes la gsan pa'i dpe yang mang du bsnan te bsgrigs pa ni rgyas pa ṭwāṃdus/ pa mee / ༵'o rdzo/nga/ bas snga ma gnyis las go bde snyerabring bo zhig mdzad de/ de la dpe chos rin chen gong du sazhung dang / gdams ngag dang / yang na man ngag ste gsum du byed ces pa'i man ngag ni/spyir gdams ngag dang man ngag mi 'gal yang gsum du byed pa'i man ngag ni/ jo bo yab sras kyi gsung chos bka' gdams glegs bam du grags pa ste/ man ngag de ni jo bo chen pos yer ba lha ni snying po'i mgul du khu rngog 'brom gsum la gnang ba ste/ pha ston pa rin po ches zhus pa la pha chos dang / bu rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gnyis kyis zhus pa la bu chos su grags/ khu ston dang po ston pa rin po che la mi mos pa'i tshul bstan kyang / 'di dus khu chen pos nga rgyal gyi ri bsnyil to/skyun/ /pa rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs pa ste/ glegs bam gyi khu dang dag snang 'brel ba'i tshoms na gsal 'di'i man ngas rnams jo bo mya ngan las 'da' lar dge bshes ston pa la/ gtso bor sprul pa'i sku mched gsum po la/ / gzhung dang man ngag gsum byin la/ /zhes zhal chems byon pa'i man ngag de yin cing / sku mched gsum las phu chung ba la yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gzhan gnyis pa la phal che ba dang /phyogs tsam mnga' ba yin te/ slob dpon nam rim gyis/ yongs sugerdzogs pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan yin/ /phal cher 'dzin pa tshul khrims 'bar du gda'/ /phyogs tsam gsal ba rin chen gsal ba yin/ /deng sang dus na kho ba nyid du zad/ / ces gsungs/phu chung ba la ji ltar byon pa ni/ rngog legs shes kyis mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang /des phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan la gtad pa'o/de nas rim gyis 'brom ku mā ra ma ti'i bar du byon/ de yan chig brgyung yin pa la de nyid kyis bka' rgya bkrol te re gnyis la spenu / de nas rim gyis brgyud pa lo chen thugs rje dpal ba las rgyal bdage 'dun grub kyis gsan pa nas dbus satsang thams cad du rgya cher 'phel lo/ ge 277 —

'di'i nyams len ni rjes dran lnga ste/ skyabs bla ma dran par mdzod/ lus ni lha yi rang bzhi te/ /ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mdzod/ / 'gro ba ma lus pha mar soms/ / sems kyi gnas lug stong par dpyad/ /lnga bo de yi skye bar nas/ /dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod/ /ces pa'o/ snying por gyur pa ni thig le bcu drug gi nyams len yin la/ nyams su blangs pa'i yon tan ni/ 'dul gnas rdo rje theg pa'i bar stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa mkhas pa/ lta ba mtho la spyod pa zhib pa gig 'byung gsung / lha ni bzhi ste/ thub pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ mi g.yo ba'o/ /chos ni sde snod gsum ste/ de rnams la lha chos bdun ldan zhes bya ba'o/ /bka' gdams pa la sngags kyi gdams pa med dam snyam na/ bshad ma thag pa'i thig le bcu drug gi man ngag kyang mdo sngags zung 'azel yin la/ gzhan yang thub pa dam tshig bsum bkod dang / mi g.yeba'i skor dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i sprung bar gnas pa sogs bka' gdams pa la dar rgyas che zhing / jo bo'i man ngag thor bu ba mang po zhig mchims kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa snar pa snar thang ba rgya rtsar grags pa dang / jo bos dge bshes lag sor ba la gnang ba'i snyen ras gzigs kyi gdams pa dang / ga'an yang lha bzhi'i khrid sogs bka' gdams pa'i sngags kyi man ngag mang po'i rgyun deng sang gi bar du bzhugs so/ /jo bo bod du ma byon gong du sngags la bsnyad pa'i rtsing chos cher dar bar nyams snad pa'i ched du rjo bo rjes do ha glu mgur gsungs par bzhed pa yang 'brom gyis bod du 'di mi 'tshams zhes bkag pa'i tshul sogs bka' gdams gong ma rnams gsang sngags spyi dang / khyad par bla med la shin tu dam dog che ba mdzad na'ang / dngos tshod la jo bo rjes 'brom rin po che la rgyud sde bzhi'i man ngag thams cad dang /khyad par pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog bla med spyi'i man ngag mthar thug kub snying skor gyi man ngag rnams gsang ba'i tshul gyis yongs su rdzogs pa gnang bas 'brom rje mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa yin la/ rgyu mtshan de bas na gsang sngags khrom bsgrags su mi mdzad pa ma gastogs bka' gdams pa la gsang sngags kyi gdams pa med pa ma yin te/ so so'i rnam thar la zhib tu bltas pas shes par snang ngo / /der ma zad chos kyi gtso bor byang chub lam sgron gyi nyams len la'ang gsang sngags yod dgos te/de med na bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / lam sgron rang gi tshig la'ang dngos su thon pa'i phyir dang / lam rim chen mo las kyang lam sgron gyi khyad chos la/ mdo sngags gnyis kā'i/ ga/ nad bsdus nas ston pas brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa dang / zhes gsungs pas shes par snang bas (2)bka' gdamasatpa rkyes bu dam pa rim phyon gyisgodzad spyod spyi'i sdom/—ba~Xkā ṭwāṃdams kyi skyes bu dam pa rim par byon pa rnams kyi mdzad spyod spyi'i sdom ni/ chos 'byung

gsal ba'i sgron me las/ gang zag phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dge bshes ston pa nas nye bar brgyud de mi brgyud bzang zhing brtan la/ snyoms shing dkyil che ba'i ngang nas grub mtha' dang rnam thar gzhan dang mi mthun pa med la ma 'dres pa dang / sems can su dang yang bsre slad chung la/ thams cad la phan sems che ba dang / mas 'dzeg gis slob la lta ba mtho ba dang / sdug na skad ngan mi 'don zhing skyid na 7ོ shas che ba dang / blo sbyong thams cad mngon tshan chung la don gyi sa chod che ba dang / ngan ngon gyis 'tsho ba bzang rgya la spyod kyang mi g.yeng ba dang / go gsal la gting mi rtogs pa dang / 'grogs bde la mig sus kyang mi khengs pa dang / bkur bar yang zhing ljid che ba dang / snyan ngag shas chung la chos skad la brten pa dang / brgal lan dang zer sgros zhung la don gtan la phebs pa dang / gshags ral dang zur za nyung la don rna bar skyel mkhas pa dang / gzhung lugs thams cad ma 'dres la 'gal ba med par ston pa dang / man ngag gi rgyab brten sde snod la byed cing man ngag la sbyor lam rnam bzhir sems pa dang /chos dang gang zag la nyes pa mi brjod cing sdeg grogs mi nyan pa dang / rig pa dang man ngag gi rnam grangs mang po mi zlos shing shes bya thams cad la byang che ba dang / sde dgon la phyogs res mi byed cing dad ldan la dgyes pa dang / bla ma sangs rgyas su shes shing grogs la dag snang che ba dang / rtse rig dang dam dog che yang 'dzin chags chung ba dang / rtag tu dpyad bdar cing phyir rjes su blta ba dang / dman sa bzung nas bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag po mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba ngan pa spangs nas sde snod la rdzogs par slob pa'i skyes bu chen po sngar ji snyed bstan pa rnams so/ rnam par thar pa de dag dang ldan pa la jo bo bka' gdams pa zhes kyang bya/ lha chos bdun ldan zhes kyang bya/ drang srong chen po'i bka' brgyud ces kyang bya ste/ de lta bu'i mdzad spyod kyi rjes su 'brang zhing snying thag pa nas lhur len par bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa 'di dag la zhib tu bsams na re re la'ang go rgyu chen po re yod par 'dug gopo to ba yab sras kyi mdzad spyod kyi sdom tshig rnam thar mdzes pa'i padmo las 'byung pa yang bka' gdams pa thun mong gi mdzad spyod yin pas/ shin tu ngo mtshar ba mchis kyang 'dir mang dogs nas ma bkod pas chos 'byung gsal sgron las shes par bgyis te dad pa bsgom zhing smon pa'i gnas su bya'o/ /rang don yid byed spros pa dbeen gnas su/ / ngo tsha khrel yod ka shi'i gos klubs te/ / bag yod kṛkṣi sā ra'i pags pa'i steng / / dran dang shes bzhin brtan po'i sbyil kung bcas/ / gtsug na ritsha chen rnam gsum thor cog bcings/ /lus la lha bzhi'i tshangs skud dkar po 'chang / /ngag nas sde sngod gsum gyi gsang tshig 'don/ /sems kyi ril ba bslab gsum bdud rtsis gtams/ /kun rdzob byang chub semasakyi thab khung du/ /don dam byang sems byin za 'bar ba la/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i yam shing dang / /'jig lta'i mar khu bsregs pa'i mchod sbyin brtson/ /phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad ma'i sbubs 'drab/ / bka' gdams drang srong tshogs kyi rnam par thar/ /thos pas yid rab 'phrog 'di gleng ba yi/bdag gi lce yang skal ba bzang snyam sems/ /thub mtha' kun dang mnyen gshin pas/ /chags sdang rtsod — 279 —

pa yongs bral bar/ / gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin gyed pa/ / de yi byung ba mdo tsam smras/grub mtha' thams cad kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul ston pa legs bshad shel gyi me long las/ bka4gdams pa'i grub mtha' byung tshul bshad zin to/ / —le'u bcu drug pa/ bka' brgyud pa byung tshul/nges don zab mo'i bdud rtsis cher myos pas/ / gzhug ma 'od gsal don dam gshis kyi ngang / /ldang 'jug spros pa med par rtag mnal ba/ / bka' brgyud par grags grub mtha'i byung ba gleng / /bka' brgyud pa byung tshul la gsum/ bka' brgyud pa so so'i byung tshul dang / de dag gi lta sgomasogs kyi rnam gzhag de las dgon pa byung tshul/dang po/ bka' brgyud pa'i ming byung tshul/dus gyis kyi 'brug pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig na/ mar mi dang / gling ras pa sogs na bza' dkar po gsol ba tsam la bsams nas dkar brgyud ces bris pa'ang snang mod/ bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa 'thad de/ bka' babs kyi gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin pas/ de skad du grags pas so/gnyis pa/ bka' brgyud sbyi'i byung tshul/bka' brgyud pa la/ mar pa'i brgyud 'dzin dang / khyung po'i brtsed 'dzin gnyis byung ba las/rdo rje 'chang nas te lo nā ro'i bar du byon pa'i bka' babs kyi gdams pa rnams mar ba la mnga' bas/de'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa rnams la bka' brgyud pa zhes zer rdo/ /bka' babs kyi gdams pa byon tshul ni/ te lo ba la bka' babs bzhi'i gdams pa mnga' ste/rdo rje 'chang / rgyal ind+ra sna ti/ klu las gyur ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ sa bdag lha su kaspa/ sa ra ha/klu sgrub zhabs/ te lo ba ste/ gsang 'dus dang / gdan bzhi dang / chos drug gi sgyu lus dang /'pho ba'i bka' babs dang / rdo rje 'chang / yi shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ tsayo pa/ tai lo ba ste/ sgyu ma chen po dang / chos drug gi mi lam gyi bka' babs dang / rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ṭosnyi nye ru ka/ bhi na badzra/ lu ba pa/ til brdung zhabs te/ bde mchog sogs ma rgyud mtha' dag dang / chos drug gi 'od gsal gyi bka' babs dang / rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ padma badzra/ ṭā ki ma skal ba bzang mo/ tai lo ba ste/ dasgyus pa rdo rje dang / chos drug gi gtum mo'i bka' babs rnams so/ bka' babs bzhi'i ngos 'dzin dang go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yang snang ngo / /mkhas grub khyung bo la yang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis sogs las byung ba bka' babs kyi gdams ༵ 8dīngarji bas de'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la'ang bka' brgyud par 'bod do/ de lta na bka'

brgyud pa la gnyis te/ shangs pa bka' brgyud dang / dwags po bka' brgyud do/ /gsum pa/ bka' brgyad so so'i ming byung tshul/(1)shangs ba bka' brgyud/snga ma gong la zer ba ni mkhas grub khyung po las brgyud pa ste/ de ni rus khyung bo gzhon nu'i dus been la zhugs pas thugs la ma 'thad pas rdzogs chen bslabs/ de la'ang thugs blo ma khel bar bal bor su ma ti la lo tsā bslabs nas chos kyi 'byung khungs rgya gar ru byon/ lo lja bcu tsam gyi ring la rgya bal bod gsum du 'byon bzhud mdzad/ rgya bal du bla ma mkhas pa dang grub pa thob pa brgya dang lja bcu bsten nas/mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang man ngag mtha' yas pa thugs su chud/ thun mong gi bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po/mi dri ba/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ rwa hu la ste bzhi/ thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nee gu ma/su kha si lha ste drug po de gtso bor mdzad/ ni gu ma ni nā ro ba'i lcam yin la 'ja' lus brnyes nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon la 'byor pa dang mjal/ sgyu lus kyi lam gyi dbang dang / chos rdo rje'i tshig rkang /sgyu ma lam rim sogs gdams pa mang du gsungs/ mi tri ba las ye shes mgon po'i chos skor gsan/bod du byon nas glang ri thang ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'phan yul 'jog po ri la bzhugs skabs/ spya gar nas bla ma rā hu la gupā badzra chos sgo skyel du byon nas rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dang / mgon po'i skor sogs spyi la grags pa dang ma grags pa'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa gnang / mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa bzhin g.yas ru shangs su byon nas lo gsum gyi nang du zhang zhung gi dgon pas gtsos dgon brgya rtsa brgyad btab/sku lus kyi bkod pa brgya rtsa baspyad de phyin nas shangs pa bka' brgyud du grags/ grwa pa khri brgyad 'dus/der lo sum cu'i ring 'gro don mdzad/ gcig car ston pa/ ri brag la thogs med du bzhud pa/ bum pa'i nang du zhag bdun bzhugs pa/ nam mkha' la bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rnam thar mang / slob ma bsam kyis mi khyab kyang gtso bo ni/ sbe'u ston pa/ g.yar bo spya mo che/ rdul ston rin dbang / la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ zhang sgom chos song rnams yin/ rmog lcogs pa'i slob ma skyer sgang ba chos kyi seng ge/ de'i slob ma gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab/ de'i slob ma sangs spyas ston pa ste de yan chad la brgyud pa rin chen bdun brgyud zer/sangs rgyas ston pa'i slob ma a'i seng ges gdan sa bskyangs/ shangs ston gyis 'jag dang /mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyis bsam sdings btab pas 'jag bsam gnyis su gyes/ thangs ston gyi slob ma rgyal mtshan 'bum/ de'i slob ma 'jag tshen byams dpal la rje bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos kyang /shangs chos 'ga' zhig gsan cing / 'jag pa'i slob brgyud mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'phyor ba la mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor sogs gsan no/ pha rgod kun dga' bzang pos rta nag rdo rje gdan btab cing / de'i sras dran chog don yod rgyal mtshan dang / de'i sras rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yab rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / phyis kyi grub chen thang stongarda la ༵༵ grags pa

yang shangs pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa 'dra bas lcags zam phyogs su'ang shangs chos dar bar snang ngo / /shangs chos gtso bor gyur pa ni/ bde mchog mya rdor/ ma hā mā yā/ gsang 'dus/ rdojica'ajigs byed de rgyud sde lnga'i so so'i dbang dang / sdom pa'i dbang / sgyu lus dbang mo che/ mkha' spyogabaka' lnga/ nee gu'i chos drug sgyu ma lam rim/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor/ lam khyer su kha'i skor sogs/phyag chen ga'u ma/ ye shes mgon po'i chos skor/ bde mchog lha lnga/ phag mo gsang sgrub/ spyan ra gzigs/ rnam 'joms/ phyag rdor/ mi g.yo ba sogs kyi dbang bka'/ skyer sgang lugs kyi rgyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin sogs te/ grub mtha' thams cad la khyab che'o/ /phyag chen ga'u ma zhes pa bde ba dang / stong pa ga'u kha sbyor bzhin dbyer med du bsgoms nas 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i gdams pa ste/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi phyag chen dang gnad gcig par snang /mkhas grub khyung pos mdzad pa'i gzhung che rigs mi 'dug pas/ lta ba'i bzhed tshul zhib tu ma shes la/bla mgon dbyer med kyi sgrub thabs su rtogs pa skyes tshad sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin thag chod na zhes dang / tresnang srid rang ṭāl zhes dang / yid la byar med ces sogs kyi cug ris ni phyag chen dag gi sgros dang mastaṭwāṃpya /dī kṣiṃ bawa/'bargyud/dwags po bka' brgyud ni/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros las byung ba yin te/ dang po 'brog mi'i drung du lo tsā bslabs/ phyis su spya gar du lan gsum bal por lan bzhir byon/ paṇa chen nā ro ba/mnga' bdag mi tri ba/ dpal ye shes snying po/ grub chen zhi ba bzang po la sogs pa'i mkhas spub kyi bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad la gtugs/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pha ma'i rgyud kyi bshad pa gdams ngag lag len dang bcas pa zhib tu sbyangs/ mi tri ba la brten nas phyag spya chen po'i rtogs pa mthar thug pa thugs la 'khrungs/ bod du byon nas slob ma mang du bskyangs pa las/ gtso bo ni ka chen trīṭīṭwāṃ ṭwāṃg/ sa/ pa ste/ jog ston chos sku rdo rje/ mtshur ston dbang nge / mes ston tshon po/ mi la ras pa de dag las mes rngog mtshur gsum la bshad rgyun gyi bka' babs bas/ slob rgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyis/ gsang bde/ dkyes rdor/ gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā yā sogs kyi dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa rgya cheraspel zhing / mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje las brgyud pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po la bhon pa yin no/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa la sgrub pa'i bka' babs pa yin la/ de nyid mnga' ris gung thang du 'khrungs/yab gshegs snga bar brten a khu dang a nees shin tu mnar bas ma bzod pas mthu bslabs nas dgra mang po bsad/ slad nas sdig pa la 'gyod de mar ba'i drung du byon/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i ched du re zhig chos ma gnarji ba~X ༵khar las sogs dka' spyad mang po byed du bcug pa'i mthar dbang dang gdamasacingag rdzogs

par gnang / mod la snying rus dang dka' spyad drag pos bgoms pas sku tshe de nyid la mchog gi dngos zub brnyes/ slob ma grub thob ras rkyang gyon pa bya khyung 'phur ba lta bu byon pa las gtso bor gyur pa ni/nyim lta bu dwags po lha rje dang / zla ba lta bu ras chung ba gnyis so/ /rgyas par gzhan du shes so/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i rjes 'brang rnams dwags po bka' brgyud zhes zer zhing / de la yang nang gses kyis phye na/ karma bka' bakhyud dang / de bzhin du/ phag gru dang / tshal pa dang / 'bri gung ba dang / 'brug pa dang / stag lung dang / 'ba' rom dang /g.ya' bzang dang / khro phu'i bka' brgyud rnams so sor gyes so/ /(2)karma bka' baspyad/de/ karma bka' brgyud ni/ dwags po lha rje'i slob ma dus gsum mkhyen pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud karma dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag(1110da /193)lo mdo khams dre shod gangs kyi ra bar 'khrungs/ lo bcu dgu pa nas bzung dbus su dbu tshad dang bka' gdams pa'i lam rim sogs mang du gsan/ rang lo sum cu par sgam po ba khu dbon las gdams pa du ma mnos/rab byung gsum pa'i me yos (1139)lor khams ri bo cher karma pa'i gdan sa btab pas karma pa zhes thogs shing / phyis su lha sa'i nye 'dabs stod lung du mtshur phu dgon pa btab pas karma pa'i gdan sa /sdo ṭwāṃ/ga gnyis zhes grags/ rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang(1147)lor dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi pa la karma pakṣi chos kyi bla ma ni sog skad du slob dpon zer ba yin pas hor yul du byon skabs de ltar grags pa las mtshan dngos ni chos kyi bla ma zhes pa yin no/ khong rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi (1204—1283)lor khams 'bri lung du sku 'khrungs pa 'di nyid karma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yang srid du ngos bzung bas bod la bla ma'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed srol thog ma de nas 'go tshugs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yang slob spom brag pa bla mar bsten/ me lug (1247)lo nas mtshur phur phebs te lo drug bzhugs/ (1253)lor se chen rgyal po'i gdan drangs pa gser yig pa dang mjal phrad byung bas/spyal mo rong se stod mkhar bzhi zhes zhag mal byed dgos byung bas/ yul phyogs su chos gsung / khong gi chibs pa 'brong (g.yag)gis rwa sa la btsugs nas sa 'og nas chu rdol bas deng sang kyang yul mi kun gyis spyod bzhin yod/ ming yang karma 'brong rdzong thogs so rdzu bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo〉las rong yul gser stod gnas yul si khron spyal rong sa khul phyogs skyod chos spel ba dang / nying zha dang 'brel ba'i nang sog sa mtshams su 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ zhes bris 'dug rab byung bzhi pa'i me 'brug (1260)lor mong gor rgyal pos gdan drangs te gu shi'i gser tham dang zhwa nag gser mdongs can gnang bas karma pakṣi zhes grags/ lcags sprel lor gor rgyal po 'das/ go nge le //ṭwāṃn ba/cung

gnyis nang ma 'chams pa dang 'brel tshul gyi dbang gis btson du bzung zhing rgyang 'bud btang / shing snyi lor gu yangs byung ste dbus su phebs pa'i lam bar mdo khams su bstan pa lo brgyad spel/ de nas mtshur phur byon/ dgon pa rgya chen bskun/ rab byung lnga pa'i chu lug lor 'das so/ /karma rang byung rdo rje/ karma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku rpāng gsum pa'i mtshan te/ rab byung lnga pa'i thing sprel (1284—1339)lo la 'khrungs/ karma pagi'i slob ma mu spyan pa rin chen dpal gyi slob ma yin/khams dang dbus phyogs su gtsug lag khang du ma gsar bzhengs dang nyams gso/ zam pa gsarasnye'adzugs sogs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ rab byung drug pa'i lcags lug (1288)lor pe cin la phebs te rgyal po dang btsun mo la dus 'khor gyirabang chen bskur/ shing khyi (1334)lor ri bo rtse lnga brgyud nas dbus su byon te bsam yas gtsug lag khang du bzhugs/ bka' bstan bod du 'gyur ro cog gsar du bzhengs/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi bstan bcos dang / rtsis gzhung kun btus sogs mang du brtsams /me byi (1336)lor rgyal po'i bka' ltar slar pe cin du phebs/ sa yos lor pe cin du 'das/ de'i slob ma grags pa seng ge ni zhwa dmar ba'i sku zeng dang po yin/karma de bzhin bshegs pa ni/ karma bka' brgyud zhwa nag pa'i sku phreng lnga pa 'di rab byung drug pa'i rshang byi(1384—1415)lor 'khrungs ste mtshan dngos chos dpal bzang po yin/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa bskyangs/ rab byung bdun pa'i me khyi lor tā ming rgyal pos gdan drangs pa ltar lan cin la byon te rgyal po'i yab yum gyi 'das mchod la ris med kun sgrol gyi rim gro rgya cher bsgrubs pa'i yonadu rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen chos rgyal zhes pa'i 'ja' sa shel tham bcas phul/ shing lug lo la 'das/karma mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ karma zhwa nag pa'i sku zeng brgyad pa/ rab byung dgu pa'i me yos (1507—1554)lo la 'khrungs/ dpa' po gtsug lag phreng ba'i slob dpon yin/ rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pas legs bshad gsung rtsom shin tu mang / shing stag lo la 'das/de lta na karma pa'i gdan rabs dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa pakshi/ de nas sprul sku rim par byon pa ste/ gsum pa rang byung rdo rje/ bzhi pa rol ba'i rdo rje/ lnga ba de bzhin garshags pa/ drug pa mthong ba don ldan/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mcho/ brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ dgu ba dbang phyug rdo rje/ bcu ba chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje/ bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje/ bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul grags pa rdo rje rnams rim par byon no/ /zhwa dmar can ni/ rje btsun timi pa'i slob ma khol po dga' zhes pa las tshe 'phos nas/ rwa ro ba'i slob ma dza laca rar skyes pa bram ze kun rig bya ba 'ig bod du 'ongs nas rje btsun mi la dang mjal/ bal bod mtshams su dka' thub la gnas pa tshe 'phos te/ tshul khrims dpal zhes par 'khrungs/ rje sgam po ba dang ras chung ba'i slob mar gyur/ de'i skye ba dge slong nam mkha' rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob mar gyur/ de'i skye ba bkra shis grags pa pakhri'i slob mar gyur/ de'i skye ba rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge ste/— 284 —

rje rang byung rdo rje sogs bla ma mang po bsten/ mdo sngags kyi gsan pa rgya che zhing / lung rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga'/ slob ma yang g.yag sde paṇa chen sogs mang du thon/ de'i skye ba zhwa dmar sprul sku mkha' spyod dbang po/ de'i sku skye chos dpal ye shes/ de'i skye ba zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bgi ba chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ de nas dkon mchog yan lag gar dbang chos kyi dbang rgyug dpal ldan ye shes snying po/ chos kyi don grub/ de nas skye srid yin rgyu 'ga' zhig byung / yang rgyal tshab dang / dpa' bo dang / si tu rnams kyi skye brgyud kyang snang ngo / /zhwa dmar nag gi skye rgyud de rnams phal che ba mkhas pa dang / spub pa'i rnam thar can te bstan bcos brtsams pa'ang mang la/ rang byung rdo rjes rtsis kyi bstan bcos dang / sangs rgyas skyes rabs sogs brtsams pa dar rgyas che/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ rnang don rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pas legs bshad kyi rtsom pa mang / mi bskyod rdo rje'i slob ma dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'ang mkhas par bgrang du rung ba zhig ste/ spyod 'jug 'grel chen dang / rtsis kyi bstan bcos/ chos 'byung sogs mang du brtsams/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sam chos kyi nyin byed bya bas khams sde dge dpal spungs dgon pa thub bstan chos 'khor gling zhes pa/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug (1727)lor btab/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi chos grwa btsugs te bka' brgyud kyi grwa sa'i lte bar gyur/ dus gyis tha snyad rig gnas la 'di las mkhas pa ma byung ba lta bu snang / gsar 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos mdzad pa dang / rig gnas kyi rtsom pa'ang shin tu mang / 'on kyang de'i rnam thar ni si tus dang po dbu ma'i lta ba 'dzin pa la/rnying ma ba zhig gis jo nang ba'i lta ba la zhugs na sku tshe ring bar lung bstan pas/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du phyin chad dbu ma'i lta ba dor nas gzhan stong gi lta ba 'dzin par dam bcas so mtshan gzhan karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba ste/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags 'brug (1700—1774)lor mdo khams sgang drug gi ya gyal 'bri zla zal mo'i bar du sku 'khrungs/ sku nar son pa dang karma pa sku greng bcu gnyis byang chub rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar brgyad pa chos kyi don 'grub/de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ zur mkhar ba'i slob ma slob brgyud 'dzin pa ye shes sogs slob dpon du ma bsten nas rgyud sde bzhi dang / sde snod gsum/ sgra dang / bzo/ gso ba sogs dpyis gyin par sbyangs te bod tsam du ma tshad rgya bal hor sog gi yul du tā'i si tu ma sgyu parnyi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes mtshan snyan gyis khyab par gyur/ bod kyi yul spu kun dang / rgya gar/ rgya nag bal yul bcas su phebs nas yul de dag gi mkhas pa rnams dang rig gnas kyi bgro gleng gnang / gsung rtsom yang nang don rig pa'i skor dang / gtan tshigs rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ skar rtsis rig pa sogs dang / khyad par du bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs kyi sku dus su ji bzhin ma 'gyur ba'i spya rtsis gsara'agyur dang / 'brum bcos sogs gsar 'gyur sman gyi skor sna tshogs/ sgra pā ṇi pa dang dbyangs can sgra mdo/ mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod bcas gsar du bsgyur ba'am 'gyur bcos mdzad pa — 285 —

sogs mdzad rjes dang / rang lo sum cu tham pa'i skabs sum rtags 'grel chen mu tig zeng mdzes thogamar brtsams/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug (1736—1744)lor rang lo sum cu so bdun par slar yang brtsams mgo tshugs nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing byi lo rang lo zhe lnga par brtsams tshar/sum rtags 'grel chen 'di las rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yul skad 'di la bod kyi brda rnying ma 'gyur ba shas che g.yin te/ khams phyogs kyi a mdo rgyal rong sogs byang shar gyi sa cha rnams su 'khod pa'i skye bo dag la'ang gna' bo'i dus su bod yul dbus nas byung ba'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par grags pa'i yi ge 'don tshul dang / de dag gi yul skad bcas la'ang cung nyams che tsam las/ 'phul rten sogs sgra dag par 'don pa byung ba mngon sum gyis grub ces gsungs/ de ni bod kyi sum rtags 'grel ba'i nang nas skad grags che shos kyi gras shig red/ rab byung bcu gsum shing sbrul (1785)lor rgyal mo rong chu chenaglu'akhrugs chen gyung ba'i skabs su/ a ca'ang gyin gyi 'khrugs pa bsdus pa'i sbyir/ rje nyid beebs dgos pa'i spyan 'dren pa bya ma rta zhes (pho nya'am dbang chen)bzhi yi ger bcas gdan zhu thengs gsum pa 'byor mthar/ sde dge rgyal po la bla ma si tu btang dgos/ ma btang na gong mas rtsad gcod mdzad bka' bcas 'byor bas/ sku nyid mi bzhugs pa'i rtags mtshan gsal por thon kyang sde dge'i sku chus don dang /rgya nag gong ma'i bka' la bzlog tu med gsungs nas rang nyid blos btang ste gzhan phan thugs kyis gdan sa nas btegs/ rje nyid spyom khrir rgya mis gdan drangs/ dkar mdzes klu gang du 'byor skabs rgya yul la phebs mi thub pa'i tshul gsung shog bcas bang mi brjong ba gnang / de rjes slar spya dpon mdun nagaṅgā hwa lo yes dang / lu lo ye'i bu gnyis baphyun 'drir 'byor/ de nas bskun khams je ljid du song ste ṭwāṃsdoṭwāṃ ṭāṭwāṃdī /ṭādī byesdo/ /cu /don drug par/ deng sang gi brag mgo rdzong khong gyo ru dgon du mya ngan las 'dazlo rjes kyang gong ma chen pos si tu chos 'byung dgung grangs mtho/ bskun gzhi lji/ mo rtsis sogs mi legs pa bzhin sku srog blos btang gis/ gong ma'i bka' ltar byon pa dang / bla mchan bee lo tshe dbang kun khyab dang / drung yig gu ru 'phel gnyis kyang dmag don la lugs gnyis thad zhabs 'degs legs por bsgrub pas/ si tu sprul sku gsar du 'khrungs dus gong ltar snyan zhu 'bul dgos pa sogs bsnyen bkur rgya chen thob bo/ /karma ba rim byon de re re la'ang slob ma dang yang slob mang du byon pas mtha' dbus thams cad du karma gi tshang chos brgyud dang dgon sde mang du 'phel lo/ / karma mi bskyod rdo rje dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ 'brug pa padma dkar po sogs kyis dus la babs shing don du 'gyur bar gzigs pa lta bu'i rig gnas sogs kyi spros pa rgya cher mdzad par brten/ de phyin chad kar 'brug phal cher tha snyad kyi rjos pa la dbu 'khor nas sngon gyi sgrub cugs bzang po de cung zad nyams par sems//sde ༵ ༵na sprangs pa'i brgyud pa nor bu bzang po/ sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog pas snyin

bdag mdzad nas/ byams chen du byams sku chen po bzhengs pa sogs dge ldan pa dang yon mchod yin na'ang / de'i rjes ma kun bzang don yod rdo rje sogs srid sde kha shas dge lugs pa la shin tu mi mos pas skyi shod du dmag yang yang bshams pa sogs dge ldan pa lhag med du gtong ba'i spyor ba mang du brtsams/snyan dngags mkhan 'jig rten dbang phyug 'bangs gyen log gis srid shor bas/ karma tshe brtan/ de'i bu phun chogs rnam rgyal/ de'i bu karma bstan skyong dbang po rnams rim pas sde srid byas te/ dge ldan pa mchod yon shin tu 'o brgyal bar byas pa na/ legs bshad las/ me ni thur du kha bstan na/ / ston pa po yi lag pa 'tshig / ces pa'i dpe bzhin/ gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal mtsho kha nas bod du byon te/dpung shugs kar srid lhag ma med par bcom/ de dus bstan 'dzin rnams grub mtha'i nye ring mi mdzad par chags ldang re dogs sogs kyi spros dang bral ba'i phyag chen po'i ngang la bzhugs yod na sbyin bdag gi srid nyams kyang / kar bstan la 'phel 'grib cher mi 'byung ba gdon mi za'o/ /bod mkhas pas/ phyag chen bsgom pas phyag las je mang song / zer ba bzhin/ karma bstan skyong sogs kyi gros ngan la phug 'tshang zhe gtogs ci rigs mdzad mkhan byung bar brten/ de nas bzung kar bstan nyams dmas par gyur/ lhag par byis su bkra shis lhun por sdig can gor dmag gis 'tshe bar byas pa'ang zhwa dmar sprul sku yin pas rgyu ba chos 'grub spya mtsho'i 'dun gros yin tshul gyi dbang gis/'jam dbyangs gong ma'i bka' chad kyis yangs pa can sogs zhwa dmar ba'i sde dgon rnams ro med du gyur nas/ da lta'i dus kar bstan cher nyams pas mtshur phu na zhwa nag sprul sku dge spyong gi chos bzhi dang du len cing bzhugs pa tsam mar lus so/ /gong gi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal zhes bya ba te/ sngar a mdo sog rigs tsho ba ho yod kyi 'go dpon zhig yin pas gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal grags pa 'di nyid rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags 'brug skeglu (1640)lor dpung tshogs dang bcas pa bod du 'byor/ chu rta lo paṇa chen sku zeng bzhi ba dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba rnam gnyis dang lhan cig tu da lta'i grong khyer hren dbyang zhes par man ju'i rgyal po tshang dang 'brel lam (1643)'debs ched du sku tshab btang / chu lug lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bar bkur bzos kyis chos srid gnyis ldan dga' ldan pho brang gsar du btsugs te gong ma'i bka' 'brel bod kyi rgyal ḍi4 /rdorsha/gru /rsha sdi rā rshacu/ gcig pa'i shing rta lor lha sar 'das/phag gru'i bka' brgyud ni/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i sras kyi thu bo bka' brgyud kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba rgyal ba phag mo gru pa las brgyud pa ste/ de ni mdo khams lho rgyud du 'khrungs/ lo bdun lon pa'i tshe gnas lnga rang 'khrungs su gyur/ dgung lo dgu ba la bya khyi lha khang bya bar mkhan po snying nge yan thub su tshul khrims bya ba dang / slob dpon snying nge 'od zer rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / mtshan rdo rje rgyal por gsol/ yi ge dang lha bris ma bslabs par mkhyen/ khams su bzhugs ring slob da~Xspya7 bcu drug

tsam bsten/ spyod 'jug la bshad pa 'ga' re yang mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu ba la dbus su snyon༈stod lung du dge bshes rgya dmar ba dang / phywa ba chos kyi seng ge la chos gsan/ nyi shu rtsa lnga ba la zu—sur bya 'dul gyis mkhan po/ rgya dmar gyis slob dpon/ ar gyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob la 'dul ba/ gsang ston la phar phyin/ myang bran la spyod 'jug sogs gsan pas mkhas pa chen por grags/ gzhan yang dmar chos rgyal dang / dpal chen rga lo dang / sa chen kun snying dang / 'byims lo tsā ba dang / byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan sogs bsten nas mdo sngags gyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ de nas sgam por byon nas mnyam med dwags po'i drung du gdams ngag gsan pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mchog tu gyur te/ sngar gyi chos thams cad phyi shun dang sbrun pa lta bur gyur sto zhes grags/ phag mo gru par kun bzang nags khrod du gdan sa mdzad pas 'gro mgon phag mo spu pa dang / rin chen spungs pa'i brag rtsa la bzhugs pas mtha' rtsa bar yang grags/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang ngo bo gcig par yang zhal gyis bzhes/ slob ma bskyangs pas grub pa'i skyes bu mang du thon/grwa ba brgyad brgya la gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya byung zhes grags/khyad par du 'phags pa'i bu chen ni/ mos gus mthar thug stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal natshobazung / spyan snga dpal ldan bzang po sogs nyer gnyis rin po che mang du byon no/khyad par du chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i slob mar gyur cing / chos drug gi gdams pa rnying ma dang / rje'i bzhed srol chos drug gsar ma'i gdams pa gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu dril te do ha dang rim lnga sogs kyi khungs dang sbyar ba'i khrid yig bde chen gsal ba'i 'od zer stong ldan ces bya ba nyams len mkhan la shin tu mkho ba zhig mdzad 'dug go pha do ha zhes pa ni spub thob kyi nyams glu mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i bstan bcos shig dang / rim lnga ni klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gsang sngags // shā dī/dri ༷//sa shig go’’zhang tshal pa ni/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa las brgyud pa ste/ de ni skyi shod du 'khrungs/mtshan dar ma zhes btags/ dgu nas bco baspyad kyi bar la mdo sngags mang du gsan/ dgung lo nyer drug pa la bsnyen par rdzogs te brtson 'grus grags par btags/ rga lo'i drung du gdams ngag mang du gsan/ dwags po'i slob ma sgam po ba tshul khrims snying po dang mjal te phyag spya chen po gsan pas bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi ngo bo rjen par gzigs/ gung thang gi gtsug lag khang lha chen dang bcas pa bzhengs/ dgos pa chen po la dgongs nas 'khrugs pa mang por mdzad pa la skye bo tha mal ba du mas sdig bsogs pas karma dus gsum mkhyen pas bshol btab pas/ de phyin chad 'khrugs pa ma mdzad/ gnas bdun du sku'i 'gyur ba bdun bstan nas mtshan bdun du thogs/ chos skyong bya rog gisashaṃ baṭwāṃ8 /ba—/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'azin las mtha' yas shing don gnyis pa la 'das/ slob ma

mang du byung ba'i gtso bo ni nam mkha' dang / kha rag pa 'dul ba 'od/ lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od/ 'bri ra spyokya 'od de bzhi kas dgon pa re btab cing / 'dul ba 'od kyis kha rag tu klu btul dgon pa btab pas/ de'i dbon po'i ring la grwa ba khri tsam tshogs zer/ gdan sa dngos mnyam med shākya ye shes dang /ṭwāṃsna zlo ṭwāṃ/da/ sogs brgyad kyi bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i skyes bu rim par byon pas tshal pa bka' brgyud ces shāzlo /kāzi / rdo/ pa/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po las brgyud pa ste/ de ni 'khrungs yul 'dan ma/gdung rus myu ra/ chu mo phag gi lo la sku bltams/ gzhon nu'i dus nas 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i drung du byon/ mtshan rin chen dpal du btags/ gdams pa gsan pas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i ye shes chen po thugs la 'khrungs/ mdzi nad kyis bskungs pa la snying rje chen po bsgoms pas klu gdon de yang 'khor dang bcas pa sku lus las thon nas song ba gzigs/ de nyid du nad kyang drag dgung lo nyer lnga la sum thog pas mkhan po mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ sum cu rtsa bdun la 'bri gung du phebs nas dgon pa btab/ rim gyis je rgyas su gyur te dge 'dun mtha' yas pa 'dus/gnyos spyal ba lha nang bas chos ston drangs pa'i dus su 'khor lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyer lnga 'dus tshe/ dus gcig la dge slong 'bum phrag gis tshul shing len pa byung zhes grags/ snyan grags kyis 'dzam gling khyab/klu sgrub kyi sprul bar yang gleng / dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga ba la gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ slob ma yang spyan snga bzhi/ gnyos 'gar chos gsum/ dpal chen bcu gnyis sogs mtha' yas kyang / gdan sa skyong ba ni/ rje spyan snga rin po che dang / dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ gnyos rgyal ba lha nang ba/ mgar dam pa chos sdings pa/ dpal chen chos ye/ dbon sher 'byung sogs so/ /sher 'byung ni skyob pa'i rus dbon/ bla ma'i zhabs tog dang / mkhyen pa la mtha' med/ skyob pa'i bzhed pa khyad chos brgya dang dgu bcu ba dgongs gcig tu grags pa yi ger btab po/ de nas kyang gdan rabs mang po rim par byon cing / dus phyis rin chen phun tshogs dang / chos kyi grags pa gnyis rnying ma'i sngags 'chang chen por gyur pas gong sa lnga ba chen pos kyang bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad do/'on kyang 'bas drung spru lung pas bka' brgyud kyi chos rnams bzhag nas rnying ma'i lcags sdig skor nyams len gtso bor byas pas mi shes pa byung tshul karma mi bskyod rdo rjes gsungs 'dug cing / rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshor yang mthu byad kyi sbyor ba bgyis par/ thams cad mkhyen pa sku mtshams mdzad nas 'jig byed kyi drag po'i 'khrul 'khor zhag bdun sgrub pa gnang bas/ 'bri gung 'di'i dus chad nas gtan med byung snang la/ da lta ni dge 'dun nyung zhing gdan sa yang rgya lam dang nye bas lha rten rnams kyang 'o brgyal bar bzhugs so/ de dag las gdan sa'i gnas kyi ming gis 'bri gung ba zhes grags so/ /— 289 —

(7)'drug ba bka' brgyud/'brug pa ni/ rgyal ba phag mo gru pa'i slob ma gling ras padma rdo rje dang / chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras pa las brgyud pa ste/ thub thob gling ras pa ni/ nyang stod du 'khrungs/ mtshan padma rdo rje zhes btags/dgung lo dgu ba la klog bslabs/ bcu gsum la yon tan mkhas par mkhyen/ bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe slob dpon gling las dge bsnyen mdzad/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad pa la phag mo gru pa dang mjal/ khrid gsan te bsgoms pas zhag gsum la rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ rtogs pa phul bas 'gro ba'i mgon po yang thugs dasgyus/ phyogs thams cad du 'gro ba'i don rgya chen mdzad/ de'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rje btsun gtsang pa rgya ras te/ nyang stod khu le'i char ru 'khrungs/ mtshan g.yung drung dpal du btags/ bcu gnyis la yab kyis gcen po'i sar ba'ag nas slob gnyer mang du mdzad/ bcu gsum la sku bcad de mtshan shes rab dpal du btags/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis la rje btsun gling ras pa ra lung na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ tshwa bre gang tsam gyis phyag rten mdzad nas gsung gleng mang du zhus/ de nas dbus su byon/ sna phur gling ras pa la slar yang mjal nas chos drug dang / lhan cig skyes sbyor la sogs pa'i gdams pa gsan bas zhag bdun nas ras thub pa byung / dgun 'dag sbyar mdzad derkobasgoms pas rlung phyi nang bsre nus pa dang / rtsig pa la thogs pa med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gsal stong nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'khrungs/ rje btsun ras chung bas gter du sbas pa'i ro snyoms skor drug bton/ bla ma zhang gis lung bstan pa ltar klong rdol gyi dgon pa btab/ yi dam gyis lung bstan ltar ra lung btab/ gling gis lung bstan pa ltar 'brug btab/ 'di gsar du rgyag dus 'brug sgra drag po thang 'ga' grags pas dgon pa'i ming 'brug tu btags/ de la brten nas rgyud 'dzin rnams la 'brug pa zhes thogs so/ slob ma khri tsho lnga tsam 'tshogs zer/ 'gro don shin tu che zhing nā ro pa'i sprul par grags/de'i slob brgyud kyis bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad du khyab par byung ste/ mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob tu kun la rlung ltar grags so/ /slob ma mang du byung ba'i gtso bo ni/ dang por che ba spa rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis/ gzhan ras pa gsum/ rnal 'byor gsum/ zhig po gsum sogs mang du byung / gdan sar dbon ras dar ma seng ge bzhugs shing / de nas dbon bakhyud rim par byon pa las 'phrin las che ba ni rgya dbang chos rje yin/ de'i slob ma lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po dang / de nas snyan ngag mkhan sangs rgyas rdo rje/ bod mkhas pa sogs slob brgyud bzang po mang du 'phel/ khyad par du mkhas par grags pa padma dkar pos bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ de'i skye ba dpag bsam dbang po sogs byon/ gzhan yang gtsang smyon/ dbus smyon du grags pa gnyis dang / 'brug smyon kun legs sogs grub thob ya mtshan can yang 'ga' zhig byung ste/ de rnams la bar 'brug ces grags so/ /—lo ṭwāṃ~X py-inyis kyi rnam par thar pa ya mtshan che zhing / khyad par du sgrub pa snying por byed pa dag gis

dmigs ltos su byed dgos pa mang du mchis pa las gtso bo ni dka' spyad dang snying rus kyis rkyen ngan rāsbya~X shāpy-i sdo~X hā tram̐ṭwāṃ shā // sgrub pa mthar phyin pa ste zhib tu so so'i rnam thar gyi yi ger blta la/ 'dir sa rgyal ba lo ras pa ni skyor mo lung du mkhan po sbal ti las rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ dam bca' chen po drug zhar byung gi dam bca' drug khyad par gyi dam bca' gcig ste bcu gsum gyi rnam thar can/ thub pa lnga ldan gyi gdams dag la rtsal 'don du mdzad/ de la dbon brgyud pa slob ma 'jam dbyangs mgon po sogs mkhas pa gsum༈ tsā ri ras chen sogs ras pa gsum/ ā lo shākya gsum ste rnal 'byor ba gsum sogs mtha' yas pa las/ 'jam dbyangs mgon pos gcod kyi gdams pa zab don thugs snying dang sgo 'byed bcu ba nas dar rgyas che/ tsā ri ras pas 'azin las rgya chen bskyangs pas slob ma yang mang du byung / de la smad 'brug ces grags so/ /rgod tshang ba mgon po rdo rje ni/ dang po'i dus mtshan don grub seng ge gtsang pa rgya ras las rab tu byung bas mgon po rdo rjer btags/ thugs dam bcu gnyis/ go cha dang bcu gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam bca' gsum/ 'phral gyi dam bca' bdun/ khyad 'phags kyi dam bca' lnga la sogs pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / slob ma spyal ba yang dgon pa/ grub thob o rgyan pa/spyil dkar ba/ nee rings pa bzhi/ gzhan yang mang du byung ba las yang dgon pa'i slob ma spyan snga rin ldan/ de'i slob ma zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang / de'i slob ma 'ba' rab rgyal mtshan dpal ṭwā/dī ṭwāṃg/ ceṭwāṃ ṭwāṃtrī ṭwāṃ /spu /skor gsum sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad/ slob ma mang du byon/ de la grub thob o rgyan pa rin chen dpal ni/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dza ladzha ra/ o rgyan rnams su byon/der mkha' 'gro ma mang pos byin gyis brlabs pas rtogs pas rgyud grol/ hor rgyal po ju pi las spyan drangs bas der yang byon/ karma rang byung rdo rje/ rtogs ldan zla seng sogs chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob sna /ṭwāṃ kya/nga /sdo'i lo slo rdo spya /rdo //tshan/ dang blo brtan sogs kyang slob mar gyur/ rgod phrug grags pa 'byung spyil dkar bas slob ma ma bskyangs/ nee rings pa la gangs can shākya dpal du grags shing nee rings dgon pa btab/ dbon brgyud bzang po rim par byon/ rje rin po che'i rnam thar rtsom mkhan ni rings pa 'chi med rab rgyas kyang de'i dbon brgyud do/ /de ltar lo ras nas brgyud pa la smad 'brug dang / rgod tshang dbon slob nas brgyud pa la stod 'brug zer zhing kha skad la stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma/ smad 'brug sa'i rtsi ming zhes mang bro'i tshad du grags so/'brug pa stod smad bar gsum sogs da lta'i dus su yang dar rgyas bzang neeng chos myun rnams kyang phal cher ma chad tsam yod pa 'dra'o/ / — 291 —

(ra)stag lungabaka' brgyud/stag lung bka' brgyud ni/ stag lung thang ba chen po las brgyud pa ste/ 'di ni gdung gagigayang shod bong ra steng du 'khrungs/ mkhan po na ston bla sgang ba shes rab rdo rje las rab byung dge tshulamadzad/ mtshan bkra shis dpal zhes gsol/ spya gar du 'byon par lan kha shas chas kyang zla bo sogagakyis ma btang / de nas phag gru'i snyan pa gsan nas dgung lo nyer bzhi'i dus phag mo gru pa'i drung du phebs nas nye gnas mdzad/ thugs rtsis che zhing gdams pa rdzogs par gnang / lan cig thel gyi spangajigashong gcig tu skyo sang la byon pa'i sar ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par ba'ag pas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ der 'gro mgon byon nas phyag mkhar thugs kar gtad de/ 'o skol gyi jo bo nā ro ba'i zhalanas/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong ging bdag med par bsgom/ de'i ngang la tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas thabs sna tshogs nyams su len pa zhig byung na mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i lam yin gsung bya ba sogs ngo sprod zab rgyas shig stsal ba la brten nas phyag rgya chen po sgom med kyi rnal 'byor thugs la 'khrungs/ phag mo gru pa gshegs nas mal gror byon 'chang ka pa las bka' gdams gsan/ zhang sha ra ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo so dgu la dar sbas rong gsum dang bod mdo bas stag lung du gdan drangs/ 'gro ba'i mgon gyis lung bstan pa ltar gnas der dgon pa btab pas/ stag lung thang ba zhes grags/ brag btsan mthu bo che yang dam la bzhag rab tu byung phyin chad khyim pa'i khang bar ma byon/ sha chang gsol ma myong / sha chang gi mgron mi byed/ gling gseb tu bud med mi gtong ba sogs 'dul ba'i phyag len zhib par mdzad/ sku 'da' khar grwa ba sum stong lhag tsam 'dus/ ngo mtshar ba'i dzu 'phrul du ma bstan/ drug cu re dgu la gshegs/ dbon rin chen mgon po gdan sar bton/'dis mchod khang chen mo bzhengs shing dgon sde dar rgyas mdzad/ de'i rjes su sangs rgyas yar byon gdan sar bzhugs/ de la gdan sa 'phel ba'i dbon bkra shis bla ma dang sangs spyas dbon gnyis byung ba'i sangs rgyas dbon po grags pa dpal 'od zer bzang po khams su byon nas ri bo che'i dgon pa btab/de nas bzung stag lung ya thang ma thang gnyis su gyes/ gnyis kar grwa ba sum stong brgyad brgya re 'tshogs/de nas dbus gtsang mdo khams sogs su stag lung ba'i grwa sa dang chos brgyud mang du 'phel/ dbon brgyud rim par byon pa thams cad skyes mchog ya mtshan can sha stag la/ khyad par du dus phyis stag lung ngag dbang grags pa zhes bya ba mkhas grub chen po zhig byon/ snyan pa che bas dbus gtsang gi che dgus btud/ 'bri stag gi chos rgyun chad la khad pa rnams gsos pa sogs 'azin las rgya che'o/ /zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal bya bas gsung rab mtha' dag la gsan bzhes che zhing / mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan grags can des chos 'byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho sogs brtsams chos mang du spel lo/da lta ni ga zi'i gdung brgyud dang ya thang ma thang gi sprul sku'i skye brgyud gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun mi nyungarjo ma ṭwāṃ 9༵nga ḍi/ chos brgyud sogs ji ltar gyur yod pa cha ma mchis so/ /

(9)'ba' nom bka' basprud/'ba' romya bka' brgyud ni/ baspyol zhugs spyod pa nag po pa'i skye bar grags pa 'ba' rom pa dar ma dbang phyugs las brgyud pa ste/ 'di 'phan yul du 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus sngags chung gzhon pa zhig rtsad byung nas sgam po'i bsngags pa mang du brjod cing de'i drung du phyin pa 'thad zer bas kho dang 'grogs nas sgam por slebs pa na sngags chung gar song cha med du gyur pas/ de sgam po'i sprul par shes/de nos sgam po bas rjes su bzung zhing khrid gnang ba bskyangs pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur/ byang 'cha' rom gyi dgon pa btab/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po la bsre 'pho dang / gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po la gseb lam rig pa rkyang 'ded kyi mtshan gsol bas slob ma mang du 'dus pa la khrid btab/ sras kyi thu bo ni ti shrī ras pa yin cing / gdan sa snyi khong gi gdung brgyud rim pas bzung / slob brgyud ha cang dar spyas che( ba1 sdu ṭwāṃrsha sdu ༵/ sbyang ba/ka'akā rdo pre /ji 'dra yod cha ma 'tshal lo/ /g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud ni/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob
