ma skal ldan ye shes seng ge las brgyud pa ste/ de ni mon 'gar du 'khrungs/ sku na gzhon nu la mjal bar phyin pa'i tshe/ ri kha nas phag mo gru pa'i dgon pa'i ri mthong ba tsam gyis sgom rang du shar/ de nas 'gro mgon dang mjal/ ngo sprod cig btab pas skal ldan ye shes seng ger btags/ de'i slob ma ni g.ya' bzang chos rje ste/ gdung rus gnubs/ mkhan po chos ston bya ba las rab tu byung / mtshan chos smon lam du btags/ sha mi smon lam 'od kyi slob ma klub dkar tshul khrims grags las 'dul ba gsan nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len la gtso bor mdzad pas gnubs 'dul 'dzin du grags/ skal ldan ye shes seng ge'i snyan pa gsan nas mjal du byon/ 'al mthong ba tsam gyis bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ so brgyad pa la g.ya' bzang gi dgon pa btab/ drang srong rā hu las dngos su mjal te //sdo /srung ṭwāṃg mapy-ipy-i py-i ldursha ṭwāṃ/dī ca/na phul/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la slob ma bu rān bzhir grags pa ni/ gnyal smad dpal ri ba sangs rgyas bya sgom/ go ra gdong ba sangs rgyas lha sgom/ gser lde ba sangs rgyas le sgom/ dgon gsar pa sangs rgyas rgya sgom/ de nas rim par brgyud pa rnams la g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud ces grags so/ deng sang ni gdan sar gtsug lag khaḍi ṭā~X) /khrophuX ༷nā ༷ rdo sdir/ bar grags pa'i lha mo'i sku brnyan bzhugs pa tsa4mo/ /khro phu bka' brgyud ni/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rin po che rgyal tshadang / kun ‘ldaska ras pa sku mched las brgyud pa ste/ rin po che rgyal tsha ni/ shab smad du gnubs na / mkha'i snying po'i gdung brgyud du 'khrungs/ lo lnga nas yig rtsis bslabs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas cho la don ayo) ri — ḍing ༵py-i3 par gyur/

gnur nyi ma sogs bla ma du ma las chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu dgu la dbus su byon/ pu hrangamutsā ba'i dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal po sogs dang mjal/ bla ma dmar gyis zhal bkod ltar phag mosaupa'i drung du byon/ gdams ngag gsan pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ thogacig lab sgron gyi sras po thod smyon bsam 'grub bya ba la gcod zhus/ bdun cu rtsa brgyad la gshegs/kun lngan ras pa ni/ de'i gcung yin la phag mo spur gcen po'i rgyags skyel du byon pas/ rje btsun mi las rnam thar gsung ba dang thug de 'dra ba zhig ngas kyang bya snyam nas chos grwa der mgo spyog lan gsum byas/ 'gro mgon la gdams pa zhus te bsgoms pas rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/ spub thob chen por gyur te mu ge byung ba'i tshe khro phu'i mchod khang gi sgo la phyag mkhar gtug mdzad nas rnal 'byor ma rnams de ring rnal 'byor ba la bsod snyoms shig zhu'o gsungs pas/ mchod khang gi sgo bar nas byin nas mang du byung / yul mi thams cad kyis blangs kyang zhag lnga'i bar du nas ma zad pa'i grub rtags kyang bstan/ dgung lo bdun cu ba me mo glang la gshegs/ rgyal tsha dang / kun ldan ras pa sku mched kyi dbon po khro phu lo tsā ba yin te/ de'i yab jo 'phan dang / yum sreg mo gsal byed gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ lo drug pa la klog bslabs/ brgyad pa la rgyal tsha dang mjal/ bcu pa'i skabs su spyal tsha dang kun ldan gyis mkhan slob mdzad de dge tshul sgrub/ mtshan byams pa dpal du btags/ bcu dgu la bsnyen par rdzogs/ kun ldan dang rgyal tsha gnyis la gdams ngag lugs mi 'dra ba brgya dang sum cu tso drug bka' babs bcu gsum yod pa gsan/ mi dra dzo ki bod du spyan drangs/ khro phu'i gnas gzhi'i sa byin gyis brlabs/ de ting budha shrī yang spyan drangs/ de rjes beeskurya chogs 'dus su byon nas kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī sbyan drangs/ lha mo che khri brgyad cu ba bzhengs/ sras sems dpa' chen po byung / 'gro don dang 'azin las mtha' yas pa la mnga' brnyes/yang rgyal tsha dang kun ldan gyi slob ma lce sgom dang / ma gcig re ma ti/ de dag las rim par brgyud pa dag la khro phu bka' brgyud ces grags so/ /'on kyang byams pa dpal nas byings dang ma 'dra ba'i spub mtha' zur ba zhig skyong bar mdzad 'dra snyam/ de lta na'ang khro los gsungs pa'i man ngag 'bru dgu/ snying gtam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis/phyag rgya chen po don dgu ma sogs na lta ba'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa rnams bka' brgyud pa'i phyag chen kho nar snang la/ der ma zad khro phu'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i nang tshan paṇa chen shākya shrīs yul 'khor rnams su thor bu gsungs pa'i skor dang / rdo rje gdan pa niṣka larna de was gsungs pa'i 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos sogs kyi lta ba'i 'gros kyang phyag rgya ba dang mthun par 'dug go/khro lo'i rjes su bla chen bsod dbang dang / sems dpa' chen po/ de'i slob ma yang rtse ba rin chen ṭāng/ ge/ de'i slob ma bu ston rin po che rnams byon/ bu ston gyi lugs zur ba bzung tshul 'og tu 'byung — 294 —

khro phur skabs shig nas gzhung chen po'i 'chad nyan dar ba 'dra yang hū gi zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar rim bzhin thim nas/ da lta'i dus su 'brug pa'i rab byung gzugs kha shas res skabs skabs su byams chen gyi drung du mngon rtogs rgyan tshar re 'don pa tsam lhag mar lus so/ /de ltar bka' brgyud pa zhes grags che bas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i gsang sngags kyi gdams pa'i bka' babs kyi chos brgyud 'dzin mkhan zhig ste/ bod du de'i ring lugs srol 'byed spub tshen khyung po mkhas grub nas brgyud pa la shangs pa bka' brgyud dang / lho brag mar ba nas brgyud pa la dwags po bka' brgyud zer/ dwags po la'ang nang gses phye na karma dang / tshal pa/ 'ba' rom/phag gru bcas bzhi/ phag spu la yang 'bri gung dang / stag lung / 'brug pa/ g.ya' bzang / khro phu/shug gseb/ yel pa/ smar tshang rnams so sor phye yod kyang / nang gses kyi ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyis so so ba mang zhig byung ba de dag gi khyad par 'byed chos ci zhe na/ stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi chos 'byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las/ mdor na nyan thos kyi nges 'byung / theg chen gyi sems bskyed/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnam par dag pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du bka' brgyud rin po che'i khyad chos mar rngog gi rgyud bshad/ mi la'i snying rus dang gdams ngag sgam po ba'i ngo bo'i gad dar/ karma ba'i rlung sems dbyer med/ zhang gi lam mchog mthar thug 'ba' rom pa'i bsre 'pho gseb lam/ phag gru'i gsang sngags/ stag lung pa'i rnam thar so dgu/ 'bri gung ba'i sdom gsum gnad gcig gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rten 'brel dang ro snyoms/ lo rgod kyi mos gus dang zhen log rnams ni cha mthun khyad 'phags zhes re re la'ang thams cad tshang bar yod mod kyi/ gang la rtsal du bton nas slob ma 'khrid cing skyong bar mdzad pa'i phyir khyad par gyi 'byed chos su bzhag tu rung zhing / yongs rdzogs trī dhityā/ ba/ka' brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa zhes 'jig rten gsum du snyan par grags so/ zhes bshad pa (12)bka' brgyud pa'i lta sgom rgya rnam gzhag phyogs tsam gleng ba/dwags po bka' brgyud kyi 'byung khungs mar ba'i lta ba ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba yin te/ denyid kyi bla ma'i gtso bo nā ro ba dang mi tri ba chen po yin zhing / lta sgom spyod pa dang rgyud kyi bshad pa gang gi skabs su yang de gnyis gtso bor mdzad pa dang / khyad par du lta ba'i sgro 'dogs chod pa'i bla ma mi trib yin par mar ba rang gi gsung mgur las 'byung ste/ shar chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du phyin/ rje mi tri chen po'i bka' drin gyis/ gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs/ sems stong pa nyid la spar zin byas/don spros bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong / sku gsum ma dang mngon du mjal/ mi kho bos spros pa de nas bcad/ ces mi tri ba'i drin las sems don dam par skye ba med par rtogs pas/ sems kyi gnyug ma'i ngo bo zhes pa bden pas stong pa'i sems kyi chos nyid la spar zin byas te/ de nyid rdzogs rim gyi lam zab mo dang sbrel nas bsgoms pas spyir sku gsum dang khyad par chos sku'i ming can 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa— 295 —

byung bas sbos pa thams cad de brten nas chod do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i sbyir ro/ /spros bral zhes mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dang / stong nyid dam chos nyid/ dbu ma thal 'gyur bamistong nyid kyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa na sbos pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba ste/ skye/ 'gag rtag chad/'gro/ 'ong / gcig tha dad bcas dang bral ba ste med pa'o/ /mnga' bdag mi tri ba ni dbu ma tsathodu ma zad/ dpal ldan zla ba'i lugs gtso bor mdzad pa zhig ste/ de nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid bcu ba las/ de bzhin nyid ni shes 'dod pas/ /rnam bcas ma yin rnam med min/ /bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i/ /dbu ma'ang 'bring po tsam yin no/ /zhes rnam bcas mdo sde ba dang / rnam med gye brag smra ba ste nyan thos sde ba dang / rnam bcas rnam bden pa dang / rnam med rnam rdzun pa ste sems tsam pa gnyis kas de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs pa min pa dang / der ma zad bla ma'i man ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i dbu ma'ang dbu ma 'bring bo tsam zhig yin par gsungs shing / bla ma'i gdams ngag ni dpal ldan zla ba'i shā~Xṭwāṃ ༈ sprapy-ishāṅgi /ngag/ kho na yin par de nyid kyi dngos slob parnyi ta lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje'i 'grel bar paṇa chen nā ro ba yang zla grags kyi lugs kho na 'dzin pa ste/ de nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel bar/phyi ma'i rgyud kyi 'grel ba 'di/ /sgron ma gsal ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /spu sgrub man ngag bshad pa yin/zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub 'phags pa lha/ / klu yi byang chub shākya'i bshes/ / zla ba grags pa la sogs pa'i/ / man ngag rim pa la brten nas/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang / lta ba'i bshad pa yang de kho na ltar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun mi la'i mgur rnams su yang lta ba phal cher thal 'gyur ba dang mthun par gsungs te/khyed blo dman rnams kyi bsam ngo dang / bskun na kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyis/ thams cad yod ces gsungs pa yin/ don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /bgegs pas sangs rgyas nyid kyang med/ /sgom pa po med sgom bya med/ / bgrod bya sa dang lam rtags med/ / 'bras bu sku dang ye shes med/ /de phyir mya ngan 'das pa med/ /ming dang tshig gis btags pa tsam/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bar bcas/ /gdod nas ma spub skye ba med/ /gzhi med lhan cig skyes pa'ang med/ /las dang las kyi rnam smin med/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i ming yang med/ /mthar thug don la de ltar gda'/ /zhes gsungs nas rnam mkhyen gyi chos thams cad don dam par med pa'i tshul dang / e ma sems can med gyur na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ci las byung / /rgyu med 'bras bu mi srid pas/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /thams cad yod ces thub pas gsungs/ /zhes bden par ma spub kyang tha snyad 'khor 'das bya byed rgyu 'bras thams cad yod pa dang / /de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis/ / rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong / /sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong / /chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong / /zhes 'phags paḍi sdanyasdu ༵༵ga ye shes kyis stong nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i gzigs ngor rnam shes 'khrul ba la snang

ba de ma mthong / ye shes ma 'khrul ba la snang ba de mthong / ye shes kyis chos nyid gzigs pa'i gzigs ngor chos can sems can mad/ sangs rgyas te chos sku'i ming can gyi chos nyid yod ces lta ba 'jog sachams dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang shin tu mthun par gsungs so/ /'on kyang mar ba la mkhas grub kyi bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad yod cing / de dag gi gdams pa mtha' yas pa mnga' bas na/ slob ma 'ga' zhig gi rgyud chod shā/ gzigs nas sems tsam dang mthun pa'i gdams pa phog pa'ang mchis la/ mi la'i gsung mgur 'ga' zhig tu'ang / rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngo sprod mdzad cing de dag la yang dbu sems kyi lta ba'i bshad pa ci rigs par snang ngo / des na mar mi sogs tshad ldan gyi dam pa gong ma rnams slob ma bkri ba la mkhas pa'i slob dpon yin pas/ zhu ba po'i blo tshod la gzigs nas lta sgom spyod pa gang 'tshams re gsungs pa las shes tshad mtha' dag lhug par 'chad pa'i deng sang gi 'chad pa po rnams dang mi 'dra bas lta ba gang dag gsungs pa thams cad mtha' gcig tu dbu ma'i lta ba yin pa'i nges pa mi 'dug go/phyag rgya chen po'i ming 'dogs ni/ rje btsun gyi mgur du'ang / phyag rgya chen po lta ba'i rdzong /zhes sogs phyag chen gyi sgra sgros tsam 'byung na'ang / grags che bar mdzad pa po ni dwags po lha rje yin te/de nyid kyi gsung las lta ba'i ngo sprod la phar phyin theg pa'i lugs dang sngags kyi lugs gnyis 'byung zhing /gnyis ka la'ang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag gi ming 'dogs par mdzad cing / phar phyin theg pa'i lugs la stong nyid la phyag spya chen por gsung pa yod tshul mdo lung mang du drangs nas bsgrubs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ / dkar po chig thub ces pa'i tha snyad 'ang tshal pa yan la de 'dra'i tha snyad grags mi che zhing / 'ang gis dkar po chig thub la gtso bor byas pa'i bstan bcos mdzad nas de phyin chad la grags che bar gyur to/ / byag rgya chen po ni/ 'bras bu mthar thug gam mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / de la rgyas 'debs pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs skad cig dang por thob pa de las bri ba dang gang ba med par ye ji bzhin pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi nam mkha' ji srid pa de srid du rtag tu gnas shing gzhan yang de las 'dar mi spyod pa nyid kyi phyag rgya yin la/spong ba dang rtogs pa dang sems techen po gsum dang ldan pas na chen po ste phyas/ rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na mar ba/ mi la/ sgam po ba rnams dang / de dag gi slob ma/ phag gru/ 'bri gung skyu ra/ gling ras pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ stag lung pa sogs lta ba'i bzhed pa mthun cing / snang phyogs rten 'azel la gtsigs su mdzad pa dang / so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad pa mi 'dor ba'i lugs su snang ngo / / 'on kyang de dag gi gsung 'bum rnams su slob ma mkhas mi mkhas du ma'i zin bris nyag nyog mang po bcug pa la yid brtan mi snang ngo / / zhes gsungs so/ /'o na rje btsun mi las sgam po bar gsungs pa'i mgur du/ rang sems stong par rtogs tsa na/gcig dang du mar ma sbrel cig chad pa'i stong par 'gro nyen yod/ bu spros pa med pa'i ngang la zhogaces pa ci ltar drang zhe na/ sems rang ba'in med par gtan 'a phab par nges pa 'drongs te de'i ngang la — 297 —

rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'i dus su gcig tu bral gyis dastsod pa mi byed pa'i don yin te/ rang sems stong par rtogs tsa na/ zhes mtshams 'dzin mdzad 'dug pas so/ /bka' bakhyud gong ma de dag gi phyag chen la/ mdo sngags kyi dbye ba gnyis bzhed pa'i snga ma ni sem4kyi ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'i mi rtag pa bsgoms te gnas pa bsgrubs/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dmigs pa la gnas pa'i soms gsal gsal rig rig po de lus kyi gyi na 'dug gam nang na 'dug pa sogs kyi sems 'tshol rgyab pas sems kyi ngo bo gcig kyang ma brnyed pa'i bden med du nges pa'i tshe/bden med des khyad par du byas pa'i sems kyi ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu 'jog pa stong nyid ma yin dgag gi tshul du bsgom pa yin zhes bzhed do/ /sngags lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas jim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i bde chen gyi 'od gsal la bzhed cing / de ni grub pa sdo bdun dang / snying po skor gsum du grags pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo rnal 'phyor bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag gi snying po'i snying po nyid do/ /de sgom pa la thog mar gnyug sems mngon du byed dgos shing / de la rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum dgos pas/gnyug sems kyi ngo bo gtan la phab ste de'i steng du rtse gcig tu bzhag pas/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum 'byung / de'i stobs kyis lte gsang gi gtum mo 'bar ba la brten nas zhu ba des drangs pa'i dga' bzhi skyes te gnyug sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor skye/ de yul stong pa nyid dang dbyer med du gyur ba'i bde stong gi ye shes la rtse gcig tu bzhag pas rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyis bgrod de mchog 'grub par ṭwāṃ/ ṭwāṃ~X /ces rdo spra ṭītrī sdoṭwāṃ kā /sdo/ sto/nga pa thabs shes zung du 'brel ba la phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dkar po phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i gang zag la dbang po rno rtul gnyis las/ rlung dbu mar sdud pa'i lam sgom mi nus pa'i dbang rtul gyis re zhig pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi phyag chen sgom par byed pa yin la/dbang rnon la'ang gnyis te/ tshe sngon ma'am tshe stod yan la lam snga ma snga ma la sbyangs nas rlung dbu mar 'jug pa byang ba zhig yin na/ dang po nyid nas sems kyi ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu bzhag ste bsgoms pa nyid kyis rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pas gnyug sems mngon sum du nyams su myong bar 'gyur la/ 'di la gang zag cig char ba'i tha snyad mdzad de/ kā dpe las/ gang zag sbyangs pa'i 'azo can la/ /cig char ba ni bstan par bya/ /zhes dang / rin chen them skas las/ cig char ba yi gang zag de/ chogs bsags bsags pa'i gang zag yin/ rgyud sbyangs sbyangs pa'i gang zag yin/ blo btul btul ba'i gang zag yin/ nyams skyes skyes pa'i gang zag yin/ gang zag mchog tu gyur pa yin/zhes so/ 'di ni rje bla mas kyang bzhed de/ rlung dbu mar 'jug pa la byang ba zhig gis dmigs pa ci la gtad kyang rlung dbu mar 'jug pa zhig snang ngo / zhes gsungs so/ /dba~X ༵rgyutram̐ gong ma 'ga' zhig gis/ phyag chen gyi lam la rnal 'byor bzhi'i rnam gzhag mdzad de/

sems rtse gcig tu dmigs pas rtse gcig dang / sems spros bral du rtogs pas spros bral dang / snang sems ro gcig tu rtogs pas ro gcig dang / mtshan bcas kyis sgom du med pas sgom med de bzhi yin la/ sa mtshams rje rgod tshang bas ni dang po mos spyod/ gnyis pa mthong lam/ gsum pa sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar/ bzhi pa dag sa sogs kyi ngo bor bzhed/ zhang rin po che ni/ phyag rgya chen po chig chod la/ rmongs pas sa lam rtsi ba 'khrul/ 'on kyang rloms pa dka' ba'i phyir/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i sa lam rnams/ 'dir yang ngo bo brtsi bar bya/ gsung zhing rje rgod tshang ba dang 'dra bar bzhed do/ /bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis dngos phyag chen gyi nyams len gzhir ba'ag la/ las dang po pas de rgyud la skye ba la med mi rung gi yan lag mang po zhig dgos par gzigs nas 'khrid lugs kyi rnam grangs mang po zhig mdzad 'dug ste/ rje sgam po ba ni/ lhan cig skyes sbyor dang / 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos ni lnga ldan dang / gtsang pa rgya ras pa sogs kyis khrid chen brgyad/ ro snyoms skor drug ri chos rnams 'doms pa'i sgo nas slob ma 'khrid par mdzad do/ /de dag las lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi sgra don ni/ 'gro mgon gyis/ sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum/ dang po lhan cig skyes pa de/ gdams pas gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir/ lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes su bshad/ ces gsungs shing / sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od/ snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don mos gus dang zhen log gtso bor byas pa'i ngos nas sngon 'gro sbyor ba bzhi ldan/ dngos gzhi ngo sprod rnam gnyis/ rjes nyams myong snang thog tu skyong ba gsum gyis 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro sbyi dang mtshungs shing / dngos gzhi gnyis ni zhi lhag gnyis la ngo sprod pa'o/ /lnga ldan ni/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po seng ge 'dra ste/ / lnga ldan med na mig med yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag spya chen po nyams su len pa la lnga ldan med mi rung ba yin pas bka' brgyud phyogs la gdams pa 'di 'phrin las shin tu che zhing / 'jig rten mgon pos rtsa ba mgur du bzhes pa ni/ byang chub sems kyi rta pho la/ /gzhan phan gyi dkyus thog ma bcad na/ /khrom lha mi 'od che mi 'byung bas/ sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan tan 'dzod/ /rang lus lha sku'i rgyal po la/ 'gyu med kyi gtan sa ma zin na/ / mkha' 'gro'i 'khor 'bangs mi 'du bas/ lus yi dam lha la nan tan bskyed/ /bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ /mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas/ sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod/ sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la/ rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dwangs na/ / mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi bkra bas/ sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod/ / tshogs gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la/ smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na/ / dgos 'dod kyi 'phrin las mi 'byung bas/ rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ / ces pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ rang lus lhar bsgom pa/ bla ma la mos gus bsgom pa/ mi rtog pa'i lta ba bsgom pa/ bsngo — 299 —

smon gyikhri kau 3/༵rdzusdo ṭwāṃ/nga lngaṭwāṃ /ma /sku gsum gyi khrid/ byams snying rje'i khrid/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi khrid/ lnga ldan bdud rtsi thigs pa'i khrid/ lhan cig skyes skyor gyi khrid/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ chos brgyad mgo snyoms kyi khrid/ gsang spyod ldog sgom gyi khrid rnams so/ /spyan snga chos drug ni rgyu 'bras rten 'brel dang / lnga ldan bdud rtsi thigs pa mi bgrangs par/ de'i tshab tu dag snang zhing sbyong gi khrid ces 'dug de lta na bdun las ma byung bas byams snying rje so sor rgyad pa yin nam brtag go ༈ gsang spyod ldog sgom ni/ gtso bor gtum mo la sogs pa'i lam gyi bogs 'byin pa'i spyod pa nyid yin la/ gzhan rnams ni shes sla'o/ /ro snyoms skor drug ni/ rnam rtog lam khyer/ nyon mongs lam khyer/ na tsha lam khyer/ lha 'dre lam khyer/ sdug bsngal lam khyer/ 'chi ba lam khyer ro/ de las dang po lnga phyag rgya chen po dang byang chub ṭī ṭwāṃ/ma/sa kyi lam khyer yin la/ 'chi ba lam khyer zhes pa chos drug gi bar do'i gdams pa las 'phros ri chos ni zab chos rgyan bzhi skor gsum zhal gdams kyis brgyan pa zhes bshad pas/ rgyan bzhi ni// tram̐ ༵ ༵ṭwāṃ/ ta/na kun 'byung / gsang ba dbang gi gru bo che/ rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad/ bar do'i khrid dang po yon tan kun 'byung ni/ brjod bya'i dngos gzhi skyes sbyor dang chos drug gi rgyab chos yin /༵ sa/ so/ga/nga du bsgom pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang rim gnyis kyi sngon 'gro sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag dbang khrid ni/ bde mchog nag po ba gtso bor ston pa'i dkyil chog dang / gzhan yang skyes sbyor ṭādī rdo~X hā/ga la mkho ba'i dmigs skor mang du yo da/ sbas bshad kyis ga'i dngos po'i gnas tshul gtan ci bar do'i khrid ni/ rje btsun gyis tshe ring ma la bar dor drug tu phye nas gsungs pa'i 'grel ba'o/ /skor gsum zhal gdams rgyan la/ dmar khrid gegs sel gyi rgyan/ mgur 'bum dkar chag gi rgyan/ sil bu'i sde tshan phran tshegs kyi rgyan gsum las/ dang bo ni/ gong gi gdams pa de rnams kyi gegs sel dang / gnyis pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo chos drug dang skyes sbyor/ phyi ma ni gsung sgros thor bu rnams so/ nā ro chos drug ni/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen nā ro ta pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa ste/ 'di la chos drug 'dren lugs gnyis las gcig ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang / 'od gsal/ rgyu rdzu sa/bar do/ 'pho ba/ grong 'jug bcas drug yang gcig ni/ gtum mo dang / 'od gsal/ rgyu shus/ zung 'jug 'pho ba/ grong 'jug ste drug go/ /— 300 —

(12)bka'abasprudakyidagon pabyungatshul/bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa gyes tshul ni/ mdo khams dang dbus rgyal rong sogs sngon rjes su mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i bu slob rje dus gsum mkhyen pas rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya (1189)lor btab pa'i stod lung mtshur phu dgon pa zhes karma bka' brgyud kyi dgon chen zhig ste/ lha sa grong khyer gyi nub byang gi phyogs su yod/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa ni/ rgyal ba gangs pa/ rang byung sangs rgyas bla ma rgya martsa ba/ gdan sa rin grags rnams kyis rim par bskyang te/ rgyal ba gangs pa'i dbon brgyud yin no/ /de nas karma pakhris da nga rang khams su mi phyin/ mnga' ris man chad 'dul dgos snyams tsa na/thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas gdul bya'i phyed khams na yod/ da rung yong ye zhes gsungs/ skabs der rgya nag ke jur yod dus/ 'jam dpal chen po zhal bcu gcig pa/ phyag stong / phyag re na lhung bzed lhung bzed re na sangs rgyas re bzhugs pa/ zhabs stong yod pa cig gzigs/ dus phyis rgyal mi nyag la sogs rgya mtsho la thug par khyod kyis 'dul bar 'gyur gsungs nas/ phyis mi nyag yul gyi sprul pa'i lha khang na bris yod gsung pa ni chos rje phyi ma gnyis kyi 'gro don gyi ltas su snang / rgyal bu'i sar yun ring du bzhugs na/ yon mchod ma 'phrod par yod pa la/ der bar chad dang / chags sdang mang po 'byung ba'i ltas byung zhing / spyan ras gzigs kyis bskul ma btab/ sngon grub thob chen po nyid mi nyag yul du lha legs par bkur ba'i rgyal por skyes pa tshun chad kyi rgyal bu slob rnams da lta yul de nyid du skyes shing 'dul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas mi nyag la sogs 'gar bhon/ lha khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs/ mi nyag sogs rgyal khams thams cad du lha khang sum stong tsam dang mchod rten zhig pa kun gsor bcug lha khang dang gdan sa mang po btab/ de nas rim gyis bod du mtshur phur gdan sar byon no/ /bod kyi rong chen bzhi yi ya gyal 'dir/ /rgyal mo rong gi dpal gyi me tog las/ /mi nyag pho brang lnga brtsegs gang 'od gnas/ /lho ka 'bur gnas stong ra mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ / thugs rje chen po ka kong seng ge'i rdzong / /rgyal mo dmu rdo la sogasaganas mchog gi/ /gnas dang gnas lag so sor sgrub gnas bkod/ /dpal gyi rdo rjes 'jam dpal lung du bstan/ / gsungs pa'i sngon bee ro tsā nas mi nyag 'khor lo lnga brtsegs kyi yon tan gyi gnas yin par lung bstan pa dang sgrub gnas bkod/ khyad par du spyi lo 970 skor la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gnas de ru snyon nas sgrub gnas mdzad/ ri khrod 'ga' re btab/der bzhugs kyi sgrub pa po rnams chos kyis tshims par byas pa dang gnas 'di 'jam dpal gyi gnas yin gsungs so/ phyis su rab byung bzhi pa'i spyi lo 1254 skor la grub chen karma pa pakshi der byon nas dgon pa zhig btab/ nang du karma pa'i sku 'dra gtso bor byas nas rten gsum mang du bzhengs nas chos brgyud du bsgyur/ der bzhugs kyi sgrub pa po brgya phrag kha shas yo da pa byung / de nas rab byung drug pa'i lcags byi lo 1360 lor karma pa rang byung rdo rje byon nas gtsug lag khang zhig gso dang rab gnas la sogs mdzad/dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes nyi zla lcar grags shing rtsod med du gyur bas spyi lo 1164 la kai po gnas nang — 301 —

du dgon pa btab/ rab byung gsum pa'i shing sprul 1185 lor kam pa'i dgon pa btab/ rab rgyusda gsum pa'i sa bya 1182 lor stod lung mtshur phu'i dgon pa btab bo/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/mtshan gzhan karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i dgung grangasponyer brgyad par khams la phebs pas/ sde dge chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gis dpal spungs su dgon pa 'debs dgos pa'i gsungs cha rkyen mdzad nas dpal spungs thub bstan chos gling btab/ gzhan yang dkar mdzes khul dang rnga ba khul du dgon pa rnams mi bzhi'i shog khag gis sngon yod dgon pa rnams gartor bshig btang rkyen chag nyams mang du song ba rnams kyang / deng skabs tang gi skabs bcu gcig krung rtsatshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i srid jus bzang po'i 'og nyams gso dang sgo phye ba'i bka' drin gyis gong gi mtshur phu dang dpal spungs gnyis las bka' brgyud dgon pa rnams dar mdo na/ gangs dkar dgon/ dkar mjos na/ ban rgan dgon dang / mkhar sgang jo mo dgon/ dgon gsar dgon/ ri brag dgon no/ sde dge na dpal sprungs dgon dang / tshab tsha dgon/ chu ngogs dgon/mar dgon/ bstan 'phel dgon/ pad snying dgon/ ri mgul dgon/ dpal 'bor dgon/stag 'phel dgon/ rnga chu dgon/ ge sar dgon bcas so/ /dpal yul na/ rdzong shod dgon/ser shul rdzong na/ rtse re dgon dang / gling gying dgon/ dran thang dgon/ rnam rgyal gling dgon no/ /nyag chu rdzong na/ phag mo gling dang / rnam rgyal gling dgon gnyis so/ /'dab pa rdzong na/ spang phug dgon dang / 'brug zhig dgon gnyis so/ /sde rong rdzong na/ seng ge dgon dang / dbang rgyal dgon/ sngo ljongasaṃ dgon/ bsam 'thub dgon bcas nyer dgu yod/ rnga ba khul 'dzam thang rdzong na/rdo stod g.yu thog dgon dang / rdo smad 'gab ma dgon/ mdzi rong rgyal rong bla ma'i ri khrod do/ khabar khams rdzong na/ sngon rdzi 'gag chos rgyal tshe dbang drag rgyal gyi cha rkyen mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal steng dgon pa dang / ri khrod/ gyom kyo gzi bro dgon bcas so/ /khro bcu na/ khyi pa dgon dang bdun no/ /'di rnams da lta dar rgyas 'byung bzhin yod do/ /le'u bcu bdun pa/ kaḥdapal rdzogs gsum/dbus gtsang du rnying ma'i dgon sde che ba rdor smin gnyis dang / chung ba mi nyung ba tsam 'dugakhams su kaḥdapal (pe)rdzogs gsum zhes dbyar rnga bzhin du grags che bas thog mar dam pa bderkogashegs kyis/ rab byung gsum pa(1192)sa yos lor khams dpal yul du kaḥthog dgon btab nas/rgyal mo tsha ba rong du byon pas nang gi dpal bzhi phyi'i dpal bzhi zhes sde dgon brgyad du grags/ nang gi dpal bzhi ni/ tsha kho dar rmo dpal/ pha bla drongs po dpal/ lcags mo bzhengs shag dpal/ me tog mu me tog dpal/ phyi'i dpal bzhi ni/ 'o bun chos sgrub dpal/ ka la rnam rgyal dpal/ te we — 302 —

bkra shis dpal/ sum mdo ma ni dar rmo dpal sogs brgyad las/ gzhan mtshams nag dgon 'di sngon pe yul ba yin rjes su kaḥthog phyag tsha'i slob ma/ 'a le dang / cho 'go rgo lo bla ma gsum gyis ri khrod zhig btab nas/ lug rgyal bla mas je rgyas su btang bas ka ba bzhi pa zhig btab/ de nas pi li mkhan po'i ka ba bcu gnyis pa bzhengs kyang / mi bzhi'i 5shog khag7 gis gtor brlags byung / skabs bcu gcig pa krung u tshang 'dzom gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i jus bzang gis dgon 'di sngar las khyad—'phags zhig bzhengs nas rgyud sde'i bslab grwa sogs tshugs yod do/ /shing sbrul lor kun bzang shes rab gyis/ dpal yul rnam rgyal chos dgon btab/ dper na/ rdzong 'bur 'gram dgon dang / 'brong rdzong 'od zer dgon pa/ dgon gsar dang / pan sde dgon/ brag bar du mnyam kha'i dgon/ dbu mgo dgon/ 'bum khur dgon/ ti 'bog dgon/ lha bla kun thabs dgon/ brag rol dgon/se ri dgon/ 'bur rtse dgon/ bstan pa'i stobs bcu dgon rnams yin no/ /yang dpal yul kun bzang shes rab kyi slob chen rnying ma'i grub thob thor cog rnam gsum gyi ya gyal 'khrungs yul brag bar zer ba'i sde khrod rong po cog tshang la 'khrungs rgyal rong gi mi rnams kyi po cog rong po zhes grub rtags kyi rdo pha bong chen po jul gzan gyi khrid nas zam phug tu phabs par da ltar yang mthong rgyu yod pas brag rol dgon 'ani yang khong gi bzhugs gnas yin/ phu skor bla ma dgon grags pas bla ma nor bu zer ba lo bdun la skyil spung ma bshigs pas slob ma dpal ldan lhas skyong gi de thi gnang ba'i go gnas thob pa'i gdan sa yin par bshad do/ /dpal yul dar thang dgon gyi sprul pa'i sku mchog rin po che ni rdzi 'gag tsha ba rgyal pos sku rus su rji 'gag dang cog tse mtshams dpon a drig tshang la thog mar 'khrungs/ sku zeng gnyis pa rgyal kha 'bo to yul nas 'khrungs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pas dgon sde shin tu mang / rgyal kha 'bo to dgon/ khog srung bsam gtan dgon/ so mang sher gragasaragon dang gam spyo dgon/ cog tse'i sa'i so dgon/ chab me dgon/ 'od 'dus kun thabs dgon/ cog tse'i dar rgyas gling dgon pa/ sgo yag ri shul 'khyil dgon/ rdzi 'gag 'bo kyo'i 'bo stu dgon/ mdo g.yas dgon/ kyom gyo dgon gsar dgon/bstan pa stobs bcu dgon/ khro skyabs thugs tshen dang zi 'go dgon sogs mang ngo /rdzogs chen dgon ni/ khams rdzogs chen dgon pa rṣargyan bsam gtan chos gling zhes rnying ma'i dgon pa skad grags can de khams nde dge'i sa char rab byung bcu gcig pa'i (1685)shing mo glangagi lor spub dbang padma rig 'dzin gyis phyag btab/ rdzogs chen shrī sedrwa zhes par gzhung chen bcu gsum rgya gzhung thog nas 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i bshad grwa'i rgyun btsugs te mdo sngags rig gnas bcas shin tu dar/ 'ju mi pham dang / dpal sprul sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang du byon/ klong sde zhes pa ni/rdzogs tshen a ti yo ga'i nang gses bya bral klong gi sde ni klong sde rdo rje zam pa/ slob dpon shrī serwa dang lo chen bee ro tsā na las brgyud cing / 'di'i lta grub ni rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid kun tu bza~X ༵'i kau du

chos can gyi snang ba thams cad rang snang bkod pa'i rgyan tsam las 'ching grol dang / shar bya shar gyed du sna// ༵ ṭwāṃbe/bsayo/da med dang / yin min gang du'ang mi dpyod par ye grol phyogs 'byams chen por snang ba bzhi ni/ gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po'i lam nyams su blangs pa las thob pa'i slob lam nas mi slob lam bar gyi lam gyi snang ba ste/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba/ nyams snang gong 'phel gyi snang ba/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba/ chos blo 'das kyi snang ba rnams so/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa ni/ sngags rnying ma'i chos skad de/ sems kyi rang bzhin la ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku ste sku gsum gyi yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub par rdzogs pa ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin pas chen po'o/ /klong chen rab 'byams pa zhes rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen pa dri med 'od zer zhes pa dbus lho g.yo ru gra'i cha stod grong du rab byung lnga ba'i sa smrel (1308—1363)lor 'khrungs/ rab byung drug pa'i chu yos lor 'das/ ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dang dus mnyam yin/ khong gis mdzad pa'i mdzod chen bdun dang / snying thig ya bzhi/ ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum sogs chos tshan brgya phrag gnyis lhag tsam yod pas/ dus rabs bocu bzhi par mdzad pa'i bstan bcos bdun te/spub mtha' mdzod/ theg chen mdzod/ yid bzhin mdzod/ man ngag mdzod/ chos dbyings mdzod/gnas lugs mdzod/ tshig don mdzod rnams so/ /ba'i dalhadā ṭwāṃ / ṭwāṃdro ṭwāṃsna ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i gter chos shig ste rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling 'ju mi pham ni/ rnying ma'i mkhas pa chen po 'ig ste/ mtshan dngos mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho zhes rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me rta(1846—19/2)lor rdza chu khar 'khrungs/ mdo rgyud kyi gzhung 'grel sogs nang don rig pa'i skor dang / bstod tshogs dang gtam tshogs/ 'don chog skor bcas pod grangs so gnyis yod/ dgung lo drug cu re bdun bar bzhugs nas rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu byi lor 'das/ de yang bstod tshogs ni/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma sogs yul gong ma rnams kyi che ba'i yon tan tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa byas pa'i gsung skor phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa zhig dang /gtam tshogs ni/ rgyal blon dang / bla grwa 'bangs 'khor sogs yul mchog dman bar sasum la rang rang gi ngo skal dang 'tsham par spang blang gi bslab bya rnams tshigs bcad lhug ci rigs kyis gtam du byas pa'i gsung skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa zhig go/ /dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa 'brug(1808—1887)lor byang rdza chu khar 'khrungs/ dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi yang sprul ngos 'dzin byas nas mtsharda 'aṭwāṃṭā~X med chos kyi dbang por btags/ khong sku tshe hril por bya bral gyi mdzad pa bskyangs/

khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs nyams len dang / zhal gdams kyi skor dang / byams chos kyi 'grel ba sogs gzhung bshad kyi skor/ gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi blos gar sogs gtam tshogs skor bcas pod grangs bdun tsam yod la/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me phag lor 'das ༈ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ mtshan gzhan kar dbang blo gros mtha' yas rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu bya(1813—1899)lor mdo khams 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi padma lha rtse'i mdun rol rong rgyal sbas pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/khong gis rin chen gter mdzod/ gdams ngag mdzod/ bka' brgyud sngags mdzod rnams bsgrigs par mdzad cing / shes bya mdzod/ thun min gsang ba'i mdzod brtsams pa dang gter nas bton pa bcas mdzod chen lnga dang / de 'brel sman dang gtam tshogs sogs gsung thor bu sna tshogs bcas po ti brgya la nye ba zhig rtsom sgrig mdzad/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa phag lor 'das/ kong sprul zin tig zhes/karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos rab byung bcu ba'i ba'i nang mdzad pa'i nad sman sprad pa'i nyams yig cig ste/ de'i gtso che ba ni nad re re bzhin rtags dang bcos thabs sogs gnad du dril nas kha gsal zhing don tshang ba bstan yod pa dang / de bzhin sman dug 'don byed thabs sogs nyer mkho'i don rnams ma 'dres par bkod pa'i sman gzhung sogs gsungs so/ /'jigs med gling pa ni/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur snying thig gi slob dpon 'di nyid rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya (1729—1798)lor dbus kyi 'phyongs spyas su 'khrungs/ yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel dang / rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi rtogs brjod/ dgongs 'dus rnam bshad/ klong chen snying thig gi gter chos sogs gsung chos po ti dgu yod/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta lor gshegs/ 'jigs med gling pa'i slob chen bzhi ni/ 'jigs med 'phrin las 'od zer/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i byu gu/'jigs med ngo mtshar/ 'jigs med go cha/ rdo kun bzang gzhan phan zhes mdo khams su dbyar rnga bzhin du grags pa de yang khong gis slob chen rdzogs chen shri seng ha la thub pa thob pas na rdo grub chen rin po che zhes rdo grub chen dgon thog mar ka ba bzhi pa can khong gis phyag btab/ de'i yang sprul 'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas kyis rgya cher btang / mthar lcags la rgyal po'i dbu bla mdzad nas rtse mdor gshegs/ de'i yang sprul 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sprul pa'i sku mang kyang / gtso bo ni 'jigs med bstan pa'i dpal bzang zhes rgyal mo rong deng sang gser rta rdzong sho reb yul du 'khrungs so/ dgon 'di mi bzhi'i tshi shog khag’ gis gtor brlags byung yang tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i byed phyogs dang / srid jus bzang po'i 'og tu/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i dpal bzang gi slob ston dang rog skyor la brten nas sprul sku 'jigs med 'od gsal dang rdo grub kyi sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin rdo rje'i yang sprul klong yangs gnyis kyisaphung po'i khur dang / brtson 'grus kyi khur/ nyon mongs pa'i khur/ dam bca'i khur bcas lci ba bzhi'i 'gan khur nas mdo sngags gnyis kyis 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang sgom sgrub kyi rgyud sde'i bslab grwa — 305 —

sogs bstan pa 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod do/ / des ma lag dgon de/ rnga ba khul la gsang lude dgon dang / g.yag tshe dgon/ brag dmar dgon/ 'di bgi ni deng sang 'dzam thang rdzong na yod/chu chen rdzong la a lor dgon ni sngon kaḥthog gi bu dgon zhig yin la bla rab brgyad kyi rjes su/ rdo spub gyi slob ma a lor rdo rje dpal bzang nas bzung / 'gyur med rdo rje/ kun bzang rdo rje/ rig 'dzin rdo rje/tshe dbang rig 'dzin sogs kyi ring la rdzogs chen snying jig gi thub chen dgon lag tu gyur/ ka kong beeng ge'i yang rdzong gi nye 'gram du rdo rga dgon/ sbar bkra shis chos gling dgon/ sang sang dgon sngon kaḥthog yin kyang rjes su gzhi chen gyi bu dgon du gyur/ a kho re dgon pa yang de dang 'dra/ gzhi chen zhes pa ni/ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po/ sngags rnying ma'i chos skad de/ gzhi gnas rang byung gi ye shes so/ /de yang rig pa'i ngo bo la/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rdzogs pa ste/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad zi lam ltar med snang nyag gcig yin kyang rig rtsal bdag tu bzung ba las gzhan med pa dang / sbya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ni nyi ma dang zer bzhin lhan gyis thub pa'i tshul du thogs pa de nyid srid zhi kun khyab kyi ye shes yin pas chen po'o/ /'bar khams rdzong brag bar zhag dpal 'bum khur dgon/hong yon rdzong spre dgon ni mdo rin po ches btab/ dkar mdzes khul brag 'go rdzong du mkhyen brtse'i ye shes rdo rje'i btab pa'i lcam lung dgon/ mtsho sngon du reb kong dgon/ gser sprug smongs kyang zer/gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sngags pa snying thig gi dgon pa zhig/ rdo thub kun bzang gzhan phan gyis/gser ja dam lha yi bla lung du/ /dpal o rgyan gyi sprul ba 'jigs med mtshan/ /'khor rnam bzhi'i byang sems sde tshogs la/ /chos mdo sngags kyi bstan pa nyin bzhin gsal/ /khong 'gro don sa brtan sngo la reg/'khor dag pa'i gdul bya phyogs bcur khyab/ /der 'brel kun bde chen sa la 'god/ /zhes gsungs so/ /le'u bco brgyad pa/ sa skya ba'i grub mtha' byung tshul/mdo dang rgyud sde'i cha shas yongs rdzogs shing / bshad sgrub dri ma med pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ bub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ sa skya bar grags spub mtha'i byung ba gleng /dpal ldan sa sbya ba'i grub mtha' byung tshul la gsum/ sbyir sa skya ba'i spub mtha' byung tshul/ bye brag tu chos kyi gtso bo lam 'bras sogs phyon tshul/ sa skya ba'i lta ba'i rnam gzhag dang dgon pa'i gdan rabs rnams so/ /sa skya ba zhes yongs su grags pa ni 'khon dkon cog rgyal po nas byung ba yin la/ de yang 'khon gyi gdung brgyud ni 'od gsal lha las chad pa ste/ spyi ring / g.yu ring / g.yu se ste/ gnam lha mtshed gsum dang / de nas g.ya' spangs skyes kyi bar la gnam lha'i brgyud par grags/ g.ya' spangs skyes kyis/ srin // ṭwāṃ rings khrag med btul nas chung g.ya' 'brug se le ma khab tu bzhes pa las sras shigaglu

'khrungs pa srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas 'khon bar skyes su grags/ de nas bzung ste gdung brgyud rim byon la 'khon rigs zhes grags shing / 'khon dpal po che'i bar du gdung lha rigs ngang tshul bzang zhing mthu che ba bsod nams kyi dpal dang ldan pa phal ba las khyad du 'phags pa 'ba' zhig byon/dpal po che'i sras 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i nang nas shes rab che shos de yin cing / slob dpon padma bsten nas gdams pa nyan/ de nas bzung ste snashā/ /ga/ shes rab tshul khrims kyi bar du gdung rgyud rnams gsang sngags rnying ma nyams len byed pa 'ba' de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po bya ba sngags mtshan nyid thams cad la mkhas pa zhig gis/ khrom dkyil du sngags pa mang pos dbang mo nyer baspyad kyi 'bag spyon nas 'cham byed pa mthong nas bla ma gcen la zhus pas/ gcen gyi zhal nas/ da ni gsang sngags 'chol ba zhes par dus byung ba yin/ da snyin chad bod du sngags rnying ma la brten nas grub thob tshad ldan mi 'ong / rang re la yod pa rnams gter du sped/ nga ni na rgas khyod gzhon pas mu gu lung na 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes bya ba shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod 'dug pas/ der song la gsang sngags gsar 'gyur slobs shig gsungs/ rnying ma'i lha rten/ dpe cha/ dam rdzos thams cad mchod rten chen po gsum bzhengs nas der bcug pas/ chos skyong gi 'khu ldog dang cho 'phrul byung bas/ rdo rje phur ba'i skor dang / dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral gyi gtor chog sogs nyung shas shig bton nas gcung la gnang / de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po 'brog mi'i drung du byon/gsang sngags phyi 'gyur rnams la sbyangs/ gzhan yang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ kha che'i parnyi ta hang ngu dkar po/ rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog 'dzim pa lo tsā ba sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten/dpon po ri sa dpyad legs par gzigs nas/ sa dkar dbus kyi logs su dgon pa btab pas de phyin chad nas sa skya ba zhes grags so/ /de ltar spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rje sa skya ba chen po sogs rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa'i gang zag sa phyogs 'dir rgyun mi chad par 'byon pa dang / de dag gi bsti gnas gdan sa chen po bstan srung dang bcas pa 'byung tshul jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod du byon nas mnga' ris stod sogs su lo gsum bzhugs/ 'brom ston pas spyan drangs te dbus su phebs pa'i mar lam 'brong du la'i rtser phebs pa dang /dpon po ri gzigs pas/ de'i ngos la 'brong chen po gnyis rtswa bza' zhing yod pa gzigs/ 'khor rnams la 'di ltar 'dug gsungs/ de ci'i ltas lags zhus pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su ma hā kā la gnyis der 'phrin las mdzad pa'i ltas su 'dug gsungs/ de sa skya nga 'i chos skyong gur zhal rnam gnyis la byed pa 'di lung bstan/ de nas phyag 'tshal sgang du phebs pa dang chibs pa babs/ nas 'khor rnams la mchod pa shom gsungs nas sa dkar logs la phyag mchod spyas par 4dzad pal/ 'khor rnams kyis de ltar mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ khyed rnams kyis ma mthong ba yin cam/ sa/ darkar po pha gi'i logs la — 307 —

: yig bdun dang / trīḥyig gcig hūṃ yig gcig rnams 'dug pa la phyag mchod byas pa yin—gsungs/ de ci'i ltas lags zhus pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun/spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa gcig phyag na rdo rje'i sgrul pa gcig ste dgu thog mar 'byon zhing / gzhan yang rigs gsum mgon po'i sbrul pa rgyun mi chad pa gnas pha gir byon nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rtags su 'dug gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang slob dpon padmas klong gsal mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lung bstan las/ kun dga' snying po sa skya lo tsā dang / bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes/rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa gtsang du 'byung / zhes dang / sa skya lo tsā kun dga' ming / 'phags pa'i ming can gnyis byung nas/ bod 'bangs sems can bde la bkod/ sangs rgyas bstan pa lnga bcu 'dzin/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ de dag gi don slob dpon rin po ches sa chen la bstod par/ mgon khyod nges par rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / 'jam pa'i dpal las gzhan du yod ma mchis/ zhesadang / rje btsun chen pos/ 'jam pa'i dpal yang mi yi gzugs 'dzin cing / /rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam mgon dbyer med pa'i/ / bla ma mchog dang dam pa khyod nyid la/ / khyad par 'ga' yang bdag gis yod ma shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rje sa chen gyi yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po rang lo bzhi bcu pa rab byung dang po'i chu mo glang (1073)lor dpal ldan sa skya btab pa yin/ de la lho byang gnyis yod/ byang ma de dpon po ri'i sa dkar gyi dbus logs dang / lho ma de khrom chu'i lho 'gram na yod/ de nas dar ba'i chos lugs la sa skya pa zer/ der gdan sa yu na ring du mdzad de bla ma 'brog ma nas brgyud pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa shin tu dar bar mdzad/ gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad nas chu pho rta'i lor drug cu re dgu bzhes pa'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas nas sgo rum du bde bar gshegs so/ / gshegs khar zhal chems la/ sa skya 'di klu'i pho brang steng na brtsigs yod cing / dus phyis 'byor pa rgyas/ sbyod pa rtsing pas klu'i gnod pa byung nyen yod pas/ grog po mdung tshugs kyi steng du nga'i pur 'di ma nyams pa ril por mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs su chug gsungs pa'i zhal ta byas pa ba'in/ da lta 'khon sku 'bum du grags pa 'di yin no/ /bla ma des gong du bstan pa ltar btsun ma gnyis khab tu bzhes pa las/ chen ma rdo rje phyug mo la sras ma byung zhing / btsun mo chung ba yul kha'u'i mdo dkar gong lung ma/ pha ming zhang zhung gu rab/ ma ming ma gcig zhang mo/ de la sras gcig 'khrungs pa sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po ste de nyid 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni rgyas par gong du bshad pa ltar yin la/ skyes chen dam pa 'di nyid bltams pa nas brtsams te rim gyis longs spyod dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par gyur nas mtho ris yon tan bdun la mnga' mdzad pa yin no/ de lta bu'i bla ma chen po de nyid la lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la gnyis las/—shaṃkā ༵༵ gi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba ni/ dang po nyid nas klog yig rtsis la sogs pa la byang zhing

lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams dang / skyes pa/ bud med/ dud 'gro/ nor bu brtag pa/ sgyu rtsal/sman dpyad/ sgra/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor la sogs pa la mkhas par gyur pa'i tshul de dag gi sgo nas 'jig rten pa kun gyi yid tshim par mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan la/ spyir gsan sbyong mdzad tshul ni/ thog ma kho nar yab las kye rdo rje'i dbang zhus te/ de'i thugs su chud pa'i chos rnams ci rigs par gsan no/ /de nas dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa na yab bde bar gshegs te rtsis byas pas/ gshegs rdzong byed pa/ phyi rten gyi 'gram 'ding ba/ gdan sa ba 'tshud pa rnams nyin gcig la grub na shul du phun sum chegs pa yong zer bas/ yum na re/ nyid kyi yab kyang lo tsā ba dang 'brel shin tu che zhing chos 'di rdzun chung zer nas mnyes te/ yab kyi slob dpon kyang lo tsā ba yin pas nyid kyang lo tsā ba cig la chos slob dgos shing /nyid chung bas 'o cag gi dgon pa mi zin/ gdan sa yang ba ri lo tsā ba la gtad pa drag zer nas/ ba ri ba g.yu mkhar mo na yod pa spyan drangs te 'phrang brag dmar gnyis bsags nas chos 'khor byed pa/ phyi rten gyi 'gram 'ding ba/ ba ri ba gdan sar ston pa rnams nyin gcig la byas te/ zhing mo che ma gtogs pa'i gzhis tsho bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba gtad do/ / bla ma'i zhal nas khyod pha jo sras kyi bu la slob gnyer byed dgos pa yin/ de la shes rab dgos pas de'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin zhing / a ra pa tsa na 'di sgrubs gsungs nas bsgrubs pas/ res 'ga' dung gi mi chen po cig yong / res 'ga' seng ge chen po byung ba bla ma la zhus pas/ 'byung po pe dkar khos bar chad bya 'dod pas/ bar de jo bomi g.yo ba'i bsgom bzlas kyis gsungs nas/ de'i rjes gnang dang chu'i bsrung ba sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ste/ de ltar mdzad pas bar chad zhi nas zla ba drug nas 'grub ste 'jam dpal sdi /zha/la gzigs rshang / de'i sgrub khang 'jam dpal brag khung du grags pa bla brang shar gyi dkyil na yod gnyis pa rtogs pa'i yon tan ni/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa phra 'ing phra bas kyang ma gos shing / byams pa dang thugs rjes rgyud brlan pa/ dngos po gang la'ang mi chags pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma rnams mnyes par mdzad de/ nang du rten 'brel thams cad bsgrigs pas yi dam lha'i 'al gzigs pa dang / de nas bka' rgya lo bco brgyad thim pa dang / bla ma a seng gis lam 'bras khungs chod nas/rnos/ /thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa dang mngon shes dang dzu 'phrul la sogs la thogs pa mi mnga' ba yin sa skya gong ma zhes grags pa'i mtshan snyan de/ chos rgyal 'phags pa man chad 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud rim byon tshangs par spyod pa'am rab tu byung ba rnams kyi che ming dang de la bdag chen yang zer/gong ma rnam lnga zhes/ sa skya dkar po rnams gsum dang sa skya dmar po rnam gnyis/ so/ /— 309 —

shā ༵ ṭā// tāsnaṭā ṭwāṃ spya /shāṭwāṃ /lnga'i nang nas kun dga' snying po dang / bsod nams rtse sna/grags pa rgyal mtshan bcas sngags 'chang gsum ni gos dkar lcang lo can yin pas dkar po rnam gsum bo/sa skya dmar po rnam gnyis ni/ sa skya 'khon rigs kyi bla dpon lnga las kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang/'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis rab byung ngur smrig can yin pas dmar po rnam gnyis so/ /sa skya bdag chen bzang po dpal ni/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gcung po ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras/ rab byung lnga ba'i shing 'brug lor sa skya gdan sa'i khrir phebs/ chu byi la spyi lo (1312)la gu thi'i rgyal sa bzung / chu khyi lor 'das/ sa skya ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long rtsom pa po/ (shākā /khro sna pashā shā spra //ra 'khrungs/ rab byung drug pa'i shing yos lor 'das so/ /'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos rab byung dang po'i chu glang lor sa skya dgon pa btab ste gdan sa bzung /rab byung gnyis pa'i chu rta lor gshegs/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis gdan tshab mdzad/ de nas lcags yos lo nas sa chen kun dga' snying po lo zhe bdun/ rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag lo nas bsod nams rtse mo/ chu 'brug lo nas grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rab byung bzhi ba'i me byi lo nas gapakho kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lcags pag lo nas 'gro mgon 'phags pas gdan sa mdzad kyang rgyal sar byon pa'i shul du gcung po phyag nas sku tshab mdzad/ rab byung lnga ba'i sa 'brug nas dharma pā las lo bdun/ me phag nas shar pa 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pas lo bco brgyad/ shing 'brug nas bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyis lo bcu dgu/ chu phag nas bar stong lo gsum/ shing glang nas mkhas btsun chen pos lo bcu dgu/ rab byung drug pa'i shing sbrul bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lo gsum/ me phag nas tā dben blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gdan sa mdzad pa'i lo gsum pa la sa skya pa'i srid dbang nyams/lo ngo nyis brgya don drug gi ring la gdan rabs bcu gsum byung zhing / de rjes gdung rgyud rim byon gyis rang gi mnga' ris tsam skyong bar gyur/sa skya ba/ rab byung dang po'i dus su 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po zhes pas srol gtod/ sa chen kun dga' snying po sogs gong ma rnam lngas dar rgyas su btang zhing / gsung ngag lam 'bras chos kyi snying por byed pa'i ring lugs 'dzin mkhan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa/ de la chos brgyud dang gdung rgyud gnyis yod/ rab byung bzhi ba ra sa paṇa khu dbon hor gyi rgyal po dang mchod yon du 'brel ba la brten sa skya bas lo grangs brgya lhag tsam gyi bar du bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur te tā dpen gong ma rgyal po'i bka' bzhin bla mas chos kyi bya ba mdzad cing / chos dang mthun pa'i 'jig rten gyi bka' gnang /dpon chen gyi bya ba mdzad pa de/ tā dbeen rgyal rabs skabs su chos rgyal 'phags pas ming byang bton pa bzhicad se ṭwāṃsdu rgyal po go be las sa skya dpon chen la son thin si'i 'ja' sa gnang ste dbus gtsang khri skor

bcu gsum la khrims kyi byed por bsko ba'i lam de gtan 'jags su gyur/ de'i dpon rabs dang po shākya bzang po/ gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po/ gsum pa zhang btsun/ bzhi ba phyug po ban dkar ba/myub byang rin/ drug pa kun gzhon/ bdun pa gzhon dbang / brgyad pa byang rdor/ dgu ba ang len/ bcu pa legs pa dpal/ bcu gcig pa seng ge dpal/ bcu gnyis pa 'od zer song ge bcu gsum pa kun rin/ bcu bzhi ba don yod dpal/ bco lnga ba yon btsun/ bcu drug pa 'od zer seng ge/ bcu bdun pa rgyal ba bzang po/ bco brgyad pa dbang phyug dpal/ bcu dgu pa bsod nams dpal/ nyi shu ba yang rgyal ba bzang po/ nyer gcig pa dbang brtson/ nyer gnyis pa nas mkha' dam pa bcas kyis rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags sprel lo nas rab byung drug pa'i sa glang bar lo dgu bcu tsam gyi ring la dbang sgyur byas mthar srid dbang phag mo thu pa ta'i si tu'i lag tu shor ba red/sa skya pasnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'di nyid sa chen gyi sras bzhi pha 'khon dpal chen 'od po'i gras su rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag lo gtsang du 'khrungs/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan las sa skya gong ma'i gsung bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad ma lus pa gsan/ dgong lo nyer gsum nas bzung kha che paṇa chen mkhan slob las rig gnas che chung bcu la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pas paṇḍi ta'i mtshan snyan thob pa 'di bod ljongs kyi pani ta dang po de yin/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing 'brug lor hor rgyal o go ta'i sras go dan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin khong rang dang / sku tsha 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang gnyis bcas lung bcu sde bzhi ste deng sang kan su'u zhing chen gyi lu'u we sa char phebs nas rgyal po dang mjal/ yon mchod kyi 'brel ba chags/ bod du dpon rigs bsko lugs dang / khral 'ul bskul tshul sogs la zhal 'chams te/ bod kyi bka' gros la dbang ba'i bla dpon ser skya rnams la yi ge snga phyi lan gnyis btang nas dbus gtsang gi sa phyogs rnams hor rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su bcug sdom gsum rab dbye dang / tshad ma rigs gter/ mkhas 'jug legs bshad rin po che'i gter sogs mang du brtsams/ 'phags pa 'khrungs ma thag sa paṇa gyis 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yong / lug lor skyes pas 'phags pa lug skyes thugs thog nas gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar te/ 'di ni nges par 'phags pa'o zhes phyogs kun tu grags pas de nas 'phags pa zhes grags/ dgung lo brgyad pa la skyes rabs dang /dgu pa la brtag gnyis gsungs shing chogs kyi gtam bshad mdzad pas/ mkhas pa rnams kyi nga rgyal chag cing / phyogs kun tu grags pas khyab/ dgung lo bcu'i dus lha sar jo bo'i drub du sa paṇa las rab tu byung / skyor lung mkhan po sher song las bslab bya sogs chos mang du gsan/ bcu bdun pa la sa paṇa gyi phyag phyir hor yul du phobs te/ chos rje paṇa chen la mnga' ba'i phyi mtshan nyid/4 nang gsang sngags kyi yon tan phal che ba thugs su chud/ sa paṇa thugs dgyes nas chos dung dkar ṣpesgrongagrags sogs gnang nas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ sa paṇa rang lo bdun cu pa rab byung bo pa'i lcags phag lor gshegs nas/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas hor spyal po se chen la dgyes pa rdo rje4 2bang bskur bas tī shrī'i — 311 ge

mtshan gsol/ dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/khri skor bcu gsum ni/ lho byang gnyis/ chu byang gnyis/ lha shangs gnyis te gtsang la drugagaya' phag gnyis/ rgya tshal gnyis/ 'bri stag gnyis te dbus la drug yar 'brog khri skor dang bcugasum phul ba yin par bshad pas/ 'di nas bzung ste bod khams thams cad mnga' 'bangs su gyur te sa skya ba lugs gnyis char gyis mngon par mtho bar gyur/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba la hor yul nas chibs bskyod de rgya hor gyi yul mtshams su mkhan po snye thang ba grags pa seng ge/ las slob jo gdan bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gsang ston yar lung ba byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs dpal ldan sa skyar phebs nas chos dang zang zing gi 'byor bas mchog dman mtha' dag tshim par mdzad/ slar yang gong mas gdan 'dren gyi gser yig slebs pa bzhin hor yul du phebs nas rgyal po la dbang gnang ba'i yon du/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha gsum zhes kyang / sa skya'i gdung rabs ngo mtshar bang mdzod las/ de yang stod mnga' ris skor gsum nas sog la skya bo yan dam pa chos kyi phyogs khag sog la skya bo man nas rma chu khug pa yan chod mgo nag mi'i phyogs khag rma chu khug pa man nas rgya mchod rten dkar po yan chad spyad gling rta'i phyogs khag zhes grags shing /zhing zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang khang ba ka ba drug gi sa yod pa/ mi bza' mi gnyis/ bu pho mo gnyis/g.yog pho mo gnyis te drug phyug rta bong gnyis/ ba glang ra lug rnams dang / zhing hor son khal bcu gnyis kyi sa yod pa rnams la hor dud chung gcig zer ba yin te/ de 'dra nyer lnga la dud chen gcigade gnyis la rta mgo gcig zer/ de gnyis la baspya skor gcig de bcu la stong skor gcig de bcu la khri skor gcig de bcu la klu gcig de bcu la 'ing gcig zhes bya ba yin cing / hor se chen rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu zhing bcu gcig yod cing / phyogs khag gsum la zhing gcig cing mi longs kyang / bla ma bzhugs sa yin pa dang bstan pa dar sa yin nas zhing gcig tu brtsis nas phul ba yin no/ /de nas slar yang sa skyar phebs/ gtsang chu mis ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la gser/ ja/gos dar sogs kyi rnyed 'bul bcas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ dgung lo zhe drug pa la zhi bar gshegs/'di nyid kyi slob ma man ngag gi bka' babs gnyis/ rgyud kyi bka' babs gnyis/ mgon po'i bka' babs bzhi/ nus pa'i bdag nyid gnyis/ che ba'i bdag nyid drug sogs mang du byon/ gcung 'gro mgon phyag na shi ba gso nus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bdag nyid can phyag na rdo rje'i rnam 'phul du grags so/ /(2)rgya bragatu chosakyigatsobolam 'bras sogasabyungatshul/lam 'bras byung tshul ni/ sa skya ba'i chos kyi snying por gyur pa ni gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste/ dngos ga'i dgyes pa rdo rje'i rim gnyis lam yan lag dang bcas pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa la/ snang gsum gyi skabs su thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pa'ang cha tshang ba 'byung bas mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi lam cha tshang la ma nor ba nyid do/ /— 312 —

de nyid byung tshul ni/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi slob ma shākya bshes gnyen/ de'i slob ma 'bar ba'i gtso bo/ de'i slob ma gnas brtan dpal ldan chos skyong / de nyid spyod pa la gshegs pa'i mtshan birlu par grags/ de'i slob ma ṭosnyi lha ru ka/ de'i slob ma mi thub zla ba'am pratsā ind+ra ru tsi/ de nyid la bla chen 'brog mis lo bzhi'i bar du gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur/ khyud bshad/ man ngag spya cher gsan cing rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bras shig kyang gsan/ 'brog mi bod du byon nas rgyud rnams dang /bsam mi khyab la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du gnang bas slob ma mang du thon/ 'gos lo tsā ba dang mar ba lo tsā ba gnyis kyang khong gi slob ma yin no/ /'brog mi'i gsung ngag tshang ba ni/ lha btsun ka sla/ 'brom do pa ston chung / se ston kun rig ste gsum la gnang / cha shas re slob ma gyer sgom se bo sogs pho gsum dang / stod mo rdo rje mtsho sogs mo bzhi la gnang bas bdun gyis grub pa thob/ gzhung bshad tshar phyin pa lha rtse'i lngang bu dkar ba sogs lnga la gnang / bla chen 'brog mi 'di ni gzhung dang gdams ngag mang du gsan pa'i yon tan dang / bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka la brtan pa thob cing / rlung gi stobs kyis nam mkha' la skyil krung 'cha' ba 'chi ba lam du byas nas sku de nyid ma spangs par 'tshang rgya bar bzhed na'ang / sras rnams kyis spur sbyong ba sogs byas pas rten 'brel cung zhig ma 'grigs te bar dor phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa zhig go/'brog mis gsung ngag tshang ba slob ma gsum la gnang ba'i gzhan gnyis las gdams pa ma 'phel/se ston kun rig la/ zha ma lcam sring la brten nas gdams pa 'phel bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ ma gcig 'a ma dang / 'khon phu ba chos kyi rgyal po lcam sring gis se ston las gsung ngag zhus/ nyams su blangs/ grub pa thob/ gzhan la phan pa yang rgya chen po mdzad do/ /spyir bla chen 'brog mi nas lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa rim gyis 'phel ba la bka' srol mi 'dra ba bco brgyad tsam byung zer yang / gtso bo ni rje btsun sa skya ba la bka' babs pa ste/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos 'brog mi las gur brtag gi bshad pa gtso bor gyur ba'i bshad bka'arnams gsan/ se ston gyis rgyud kyi bshad bka' bla chen dngos slob mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po las blangs thing / 'khon dkon rgyal la yang gsan/ se ston 'di nyid thugs dam mtho zhing dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad bar du bzhugs/ brgyad cu rtsa bdun gyi dus sa chen kun snying mjal du byung bas dgyes ches te/ gdams ngag sbyin gyi shog cig gsungs ba la/ gegs cung zad cig gi dbang du gyur te ma gsan pas phyi lo se ston chen po gshegs/ phyis su sa chen gdams ngag gis thugs gdungs te/ se ston gyi gdams ngag rnams su la yod dris pas dgon pa ba sku mched la yod zer/ gcung gshegs/ gcen po'i drung du byon pas rten 'brel 'grig dka' se ba zhig la zhang dgon pa bas dgyes pa dang bcas te lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang / de phyin chad la dpal ldan sa skya ba rnams gzhung dang gdams ngag gnyis bdag por gyur pa yin no/ /— 313 —

sa skya ba nang phan tshun la yang lam 'bras 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba snang zhing / ngor ba yan la tshogamiṭwāṃ/ spya/ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ trī / ṭwāṃsna ṭwāṃ so/ / /ngor ba kun bzang gis tshogs bshad slob bshad kyi rnam dbye byas pas deng lam 'bras kyi gdams pa'i bzhugs tshul rgyas par spros na'ang mang dogs nas mdo tsam ni 'di skad ces zer te/ sbyang gzhi'i nam mkhar sbyang bya'i sprin 'thibs pa/ / sbyong byed rim gnyis rnal 'byor dri gzhon gyis/ /rang shar rang grol dpung chogs 'dir spros tshe/ /sbyang 'bras nam mkha'i dri med rang zhalabastan/ gzhi la gnas pa dbang gis ngo sprad nas/ lam bsgoms lta bas myong ba grub mtha' shar/'bras bu mngon rgyur mi zad bang mdzod 'di/ gzhan gyis ma tshor bi rū'i khyad nor yin/ gdod ma'i dkyil 'khor nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ rten 'brel dbang bzhi'i chu lud kyis bran pas/ sku bzhi'i 'bras bu kun gyi re skong ba'i/ so nam tshul 'di bi rū'i thabs mkhas yin/ rtsa yig so sor rlung sems rol rtsed las/ phyi rol bgegs kyi cho 'phrul cir snang yang / 'khrul snang lcags zangs gser du 'gyur ba yi/ gser 'gyur rtsi 'di bi rū'i zab khyad yin/ gdon nas spros bral stong pa'i rang zhal dang / rtsa yig khams rlung so sor zung 'jug la/ snang stong gsal stong bde stong rig stong zhes/ dbang gis phye ba bi rū'i lta ba yin/ 'khrid tshul 'di la yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i lam/ tshang zhes dbyangs can dga' tnasbya ṭwāṃ/ bla/ngas pas/ kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dang che/ bi rū pa des bdag la byin nam snyam/(4)gangs can gyi skyes bu dam pa rdong ston pa'i rnam thar/gzhan yang skyes mchog dam pa'i sprul pa ni/ / rnal 'byor mi 'gyur shākya'i mtshan can de/ / yul ni mdo khams shar gyi phyogs yin te/ / 'gro don bod yul mthil du legs par mdzad/ / ces gsungs pa dang / dad pa'i sde dpon pang mtsho dang / nyin mor byed pa mkha' la bzhin/ snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyang / mtho dang gtsang ba'i rigs su 'khrungs/ zhes bya ba 'di la bdag nyid chen po 'di'i 'khrungs yul ni/ sprul pa'i lo tsā bee ro tsa nas dus yun ring mor bzhugs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa/shar rgyal mo rdong gi rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'gram gyi yul ljongs dge mtshan ldan pa/ rigs ni rus chen rga zhes bya ba/ yab ni bon theg pa rim dgu la mkhas par sbyangs shing rdzu 'phrul ston nus pa ge god dam brag steg po wam rgyal po zhes pa/ yum ni byang chub kyi sems thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa/ rgya gar sman gnyis las/ me pho rta'i lo la ltas khyad par can dang bcas te yum gyi lhums su zhugs shing / me mo lug gi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te 'khrungs pas/ kun ngo mtshar bar gyur nas mched gsum yod kyang bla mar 'os pa ni bar pa 'di'o zhes zer zhing / yab kyi chos lugs la mkhas par sbyangs nas/drang srong gi brtul zhugs yang dag par len du bcug ste/ mtshan shes rab 'od zer zhes bya bar btags so/——/sngokā /༵ bla ma chen po'i brgyud pa yin pas/ yul ljongs de'i skye bo kun gyis phyag byed cing bla mar

khur la/ lugs de la brten pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba yang mang du mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'khor ba mtha' dag dug gi rgya mtsho chen po lta bur gzigs te/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la dmigs pa'i thugs khyad par can 'khrungs nas dpal gsang phu nee'u thog gi chos grwa chen por chag phebs so/ /de'i tshe gling stod khyi gdan sa ba sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal dang mkhas pa'i dbang po kong ston blo gros dbang phyug rnams kyi drung du/mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / tshad ma rnam par nges pa dang / rigs pa'i thigs pa sogs gsung rab mang du gsan zhing / shin tu mkhas par gyur/ gsang phu de'u thog ni/rab byung dang po'i chu glang (1073)lor a ti sha'i dge phrug rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis btab cing /rjes su a ti sha'i dge phrug blo ldan shes rab kyis bskyar 'debs byas pa'i dgon pa zhig go/khong dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i tshe tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i ṭī ka mdzad cing / dus de nyid nas bzung ste slob ma shes rab can mang po la bshad nyan gyi dbu btsugs te/ slob dpon rong ston zhes snyan pa'i grags pas sa'i steng ma lus par khyab par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i tshe 'phan yul mthong smon gyi gtsugs lag khang du/ dpal gro sa'i mkhan po chen po/ mkhas btsun kun dga' rgyal pos rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po mdzad/ dmar ston thams cad mkhyen pas las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po yon tan 'od bzang bas gsang ste ston pa mdzad/ gzhan yang dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad cing / cugs snga ma rnams kyang gnas dang dus de nyid du rdzogs par mdzad de/ mtshan yang shākya rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol lo/ de nas mkhas pa chen po 'di/ mdo smad pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis spyan drangs nas rje phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa thil na/ bshad nyan mdzad kyin yod pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dgung lo nyer bdun lon pa/ chu mo bya'i lo yin la/ de'i tshe pho brang chen po sne sdong du rdzong ji rgyal mtshan bzang pos gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas mkhas pa chen po/ g.yag phrug sangs spyas dpal sbyan drangs nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba yod do zhes bya ba'i gtam gsan ma thag tu/ rje btsun chen po 'di'i ba spu rang dbang med par g.yos/ thugs la dga' ba dang bde ba'i nyams dpag tu med pa shar/ ngag tu a la la ho zhes pa la sogs pa'i gsung nyams dpag med dang bcas te/ de ma thag tu mjal ba la rings par mdzad nas byon pas/ yar lung bya sa'i gtsug lag khang du zhal mjal lo/ /de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ de las dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrun/ zhes dang / yul 'di gang gi rna lam du grags par gyur pa de sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa'o/ /zhes pa'i skabs dang 'grig pas/ dpon slob gnyis ka thugs shin tu dgyes shing / sku skye ba dpag tu med pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin par nges pa'i dgongs thugs rgyud la 'khrungs so/ /e ma rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ / gtsug tor rgyal mtshan mthon po la/ / 'bas rdul pad phreng lnga gso ba'i/ /zhabs de rgyal ba nyid kyi yin/ /yang na khyod kyi spyi gtsug gi /bdud rtsi'i — 315 —

chu gter mdzes byed pa'i/ / yid 'ong padma'i zeng ba de/ / thub pa'i zhabs skyes las gzhan su/ / de nas bdag nyid chen po 'dis mkhas grub dam pa de nyid la/ spyir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag dang / khyad par du yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu gyin pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa drug dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos du ma dang bcas pa dang / tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus pa/ 'grel ba 'grel bshad dang bcas pa/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel 'grel bshad dang bcas pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa dang / rtsod pa'i rigs pa rnams rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo/ sa skya pasnyi ta nas legs par grags pa thams cad kyis kyang bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba yin no/ /skabs de nyid du/ bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/ ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros ba rnams kyi drung du/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab man ngag dang bcas pa ma lus par gsan zhing / skabs gzhan zhig tu/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa gsan/ chos kyi rje bla ma dam pa'i sras kyi thu bo yar lungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa rgyas par gsan/ yang gangs can gyi mkhas pa chen po/ lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po dang / lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan pa gnyis kyi drung du/ rig pa'i gnas du ma dang / mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mang po'i sgro 'dogs legs par bcad/ kun mkhyen sher 'od kyi drung du/ lung dang gdams pa khyad par can mang du gsan/ snyan ngag pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kha che'i drung du/ tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long 'grel ba dang bcas pa dang / mngon brjod dang sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rnams gsan/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen gyi drung du/ sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa dang / byings dang nyer bsgyur gyi mdo rnams gsan/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mang du gsan/ karma pa dkon mchog gzhon nu'i drung du/ rje btsun byams pa'i chos lnga sogs mang du gsan/ 'tshal min pa bsod nams bzang po'i drung du/bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa dang bcas gsan no/ /thang po che ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba dang bcas pa/yo ga de nyid 'dus pa/ rdo rje 'byung ba sogs kyi bshad pa rgyas par gsan zhing / ga'an yang rdo rje phreng ba la sogs pa'i dbang bka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan no/ /chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen rin rgyal ba dang / dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros kyi drung du/ dbang dang gdams pa mang du gsan/ snar thang mkhan po grub pa shes rab kyi drung du/ 'dul ba me tog zeng rgyud dang /bka' gdams kyi chos skor mang du gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma so so'i drung du/ dbang dang / gdams pa/ phyag len phran tshegs kyis mtha' rten pa gsan pa ni shin tu mang ste/ spyas par gsan yig sogs lasashaṃ sa ṭwāṃ~X byarngi/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i 'bas sen dmar 'od can/ /

blochen khyod kyi cod pan la 'chang ba/ /yongs 'dzin de dag nyin mor byed pa'am/ /khyod gtsug ya mtshan shar gyi ri bo'ang ci/ /slob dpon mkhas pa'i chos kyi rgya mtsho las/ /rnam daphyod hub kyis legs bshad kun sdud pa/ /blo gros mig stong ldan pa'i slob ma kun/ /nyid rang gcig pu'i bdud rtsis gso bar nges/ /de la brten nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul de ni/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i nyi ma cher gsal ba/ /dad brtson rnam dpyod ldan pa'i khrir blangs nas/ /nam yang grags pa'i mkha' la 'dren mkhas pa/ /gangs can nyin mor mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la don gsum ste/ mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang ba'i yon tan ji ltar brnyes pa'o/ /dang po la/ tshig la mkhas pa dang /don la mkhas pa'o/ dang po ni/ bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i dbang po de dag gi drung du mang du gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / gang dang gang gsan pa de thams cad kyi tshig gi cha dang por 'dzin pa dang /bar du 'chad pa dang / tha mar kun chub par mdzad pa la/ brtson pa rab kyi mthar phyin par gyur pa ni bdag nyid chen po 'di lta bu gzhan la med pa yin te/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni/ rnyed pa dang /bkur sti dang / bza' ba dang / bgo ba dang / gnyid thugs la sogs pa'i ro myong ba mi mdzad cing /'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa gang yang mngon du mi mdzad par tshad ldan gyi gzhung lugs rnams kho na la tshig phyed kyang ma 'khrul bar sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum gyi mther son pa'i tshe yang / gzhung lugs shin tu chen po dag gi tshig phyed kyang ma 'khrul par thugs nas gsung ba la thogs pa med par mngon sum gyis grub pa yin no/ /gzhung lugs gang dang gang 'chad kyang / /de yi tshig la sbyangs snyam byed/ /skabs 'gar don las tshig rnyed pa/ /khyod las gzhan pa sngon ma byung / /gnyis pa don la mkhas pa ni/ khyir mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ba la/gzhung lugs gang dang gang yin pa de'i don phyin ci ma log par khong du chud nas de'i dbang du byas pa'i mdo rgyas kyi bstan bcos rtsom shes pa la bya ba yin la/ de'i tshul yang bdag nyid chen po 'di lta bu ga'an la med pa yin te/ 'dis ni phal cher tshig thugs su chud ma thag tu don mkhyen zhing / don ma mkhyen pa de srid du tshig tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa ni 'di la mi mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gzhungalugs gang dang gang gsung ba na/ de dang de'i snying po'i don ni 'di yin no zhes 'chad pa la/ 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan med par mngon sum gyis grub cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa gang mdzad kyang tshig la ma 'chol bar don kho na gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/ / mdor na sgra dang / tshad ma'i bstan bcos dang / theg pa che chung gi mdo dang / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mtha' dag dang /rgyud sde gong ma gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa'i bka' dang / bstan bcos bod yul du 'gyur ba ji snyed pa de dag las/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis thugs su ma chud pa ni ci yang med do/ / de la 'di skad ces/khyod kyi mkhas pa'i yon tan ni/ nam yang sba bar mi nus par/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khrir 'khod nas/gangs can bstan pa'i mkha' la 'char/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir bdag nyid chen po 'di sngon skye ba dpag tu — 317 —

med par goms pa'i shugs kyis sgo gsum gyi kha na ma tho ba ci yang mi mdzad cing / dad cing gus pa rnam lta zhog mi dad par rlom pa de dag gis kyang bdag nyid chen po 'dis kha na ma tho ba 'di lta bu zhig mdzad do zhes mthong pa dang / thos pa dang / dogs pa'i yul du gyur pa nam yang yod pa ma yin la/ khyadapar du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyesaupa phra mos kyang ma gos shing / gzhan rab tu byung ba grangs las 'das pa dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong stong phrag gcig tu nye ba'i mkhan po mdzad do/ /yang byang chub kyi thugs gnyis sku skye ba mang por goms pa'i shugs kyis rang chas su mnga' zhing / khyad par lugs gnyis la brten pa'i tshul khrims kyi sdoyopa bla ma so so'i drung du mnos nas/ skad cig kyang nyams pa mi mnga' ba yin te/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don du dgongs nas bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba 'ba' zhig mdzad pa ma gtogs/ mdzad pa gzhan ci yang mi snang ba'i phyir dang / dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa gting nas zhig pas 'jig rten chogabargyad kyi rnam par rtog pa rang sar grol nas/ 'jig rten gyi chos lugs gang la yang / spang blang dang /dgag sgrub dang / 'di yin dang 'di min gyi mtshan 'dzin gtad thub pa gang yang med pa byis pa gzhon nu'i spyod pa lta bu rtag tu mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta mod kyi gsung rab kyi don la dasnyod pa dang / dgag sgrub mdzad pa'i che ches shin tu sgrin por mdzad cing bstan pa 'ba' zhig lhag par dgongs so/ yang gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa legs par mnos nas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pa cung zad kyang ma gos shing / dgyes pa rdo rje dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ zhag gcig kyang g.yel bar mi mdzad do/ de dag la 'di skad ces/ khyod kyi btsun pa'i yon tan 'od dkar can/ tshul 'chos nag po'i sprin gyis ma sgribs par/ rang byung goms pa'i shugs stabs drang po yi sa/tshul khrims rnam gsum yangs pa'i mkha' la shar/ gsum pa bzang po'i yon tan ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ thugs rje chen pos rtag par rgyud phyug cing / mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/bstan la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam mthon po can/ sa thob sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ mtshan mo zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnam 'byor la g.yel ba mnga' zhing / nyin mo stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi ngang nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/mtho dman thams cad la lhag par byams shing / sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i las cung zad kyang mi mdzad/ gzhan la tho 'tsham pa dang / phrag dog gi rnam pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'/ rnyed bkur dang che thabs kyi rtsol sgrub cung zad kyang mi mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gzhan dag bla ma khong la mi chos med cing /'jig rten mi mkhyen pa med ces zer/ de lta mod kyi kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di chos nas ji ltar 'byung ba ba'in du khong zhal gyis bzhes shing phyag len du khel bar mdzad pas/ 'jig rten dang mi chos ni de yin par nges so/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di gang na bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs der/ nad yams dang /mu ge dang / dus kyi 'khrug pa mi 'byung zhing / yon gyi bdag po rnams la bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan kho na — 318 —

'byung zhing / 'khyor ba che ba dang / skye bo tshogs kyis gang ba dang / thag ring po nas 'ongs ba'i grwa bu slob rnams rang gi ngang gis 'du ba la gegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba cung zad kyang mi 'byung ba yin no/ /de'i khyu mtshan gyis/ mkhas pa'i daskeng po 'dis bshad nyan mdzad nas mya ngan las 'da' ka'i bar/ sku la bsung ba'i tshul bstan pa ni nyin gcig tsam yang byung ma myong ba kun gyis mthun snang du grub cing /gangs can gyi ljongs 'acidir bshad nyan gyi rgyun ma chad par mdzad pa la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di las rgyun ring ba'i slob dpon su yang med do/ /yang mkhas pa gzhan dag ni 'chad pa kho na gtso bor mdzad cing bstan bcos rtsom pa mi mdzad/ la la ni bstan bcos rtsom pa la gtso bor mdzad cing 'chad pa dang /rtsod pa lhur mi len/ mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum cha mnyam par mdzad cing / gsum ka la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros mnga' ba ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dang mnyam pa kha ba can 'dir gzhan byon pa med do/ /yang mkhas pa la la ni thos bsam gyi bya ba kho nas dus yol nas rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la g.yel/ la la ni thos bsam gyi bya ba bshol nas dbeen pa'i sanas su sgrub pa kho na la gshegs par mdzad mod/ dus rtag par 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su bzhugs nas thos bsam gyi mdzad pa cha mnyam du mthar byin par mdzad pas grub pa'i sa brnyes pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di las gzhan kha ba can 'dir sngon byonar med do/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di la sher phyin gyi mdo las gsungs pa'i skyor lam pa dang /mthong larmi pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags rnams dang / sa dang po nas lnga pa'i bar gyi yongs sbyong du bshad pa de thams cad tshang ba bzhugs par mngon sum gyis spub pas sa thob pa'i sems dpa' chen por gdon mi za'o/ de dag la 'di ltar/ khyod kyi bzang ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /mi srun phrag dog rta gdong mes mi non/ / lce brgya ldan pa'i chu 'dzin gyis blangs nas/ phrin las char chen rtag par 'bebs la brtson/ / lngapa mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam daphyod kyi/ /gdong mdzes mtshar ba'i me long g.yo ldan pa/ / thub bstan dngul dkar dwangs pa'i me long du/ gsal bar shar ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'di la don gsum ste/'chad pa tshangs pa'i rnga chen gyis skal ldan gyi slob ma ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul/ rtsod pa seng ge'i nga ros phyir rgol gyi glang po ji ltar bcom pa'i tshul/ rtsom pa nor bu'i do shal gyis thub bstan gyi khang bzang ji ltar brgyan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rigs shing grol ba'i spobs pa ma dros mtsho/ / grags pa'i chu bos phyogs brgyar drangs gyur kyang / /zad pa med cing ches cher 'phel gyur pa'i/ /gsung rab kun la sbyangs ba'i thugs mnga' khyod/ /bcu phrag drug gis/ nges par nyir 'khyud nas/ /mig stong ldan pa'i snying la bde ster ba'i/ /dam chos 'chad pa'i dbyang sa kyis lha rnams kyang / /'khor du bsdu ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//'di la gsum ste/ dus ji tsam gyi bar du chos gsungs pa'i tshul/ chos gang dang gang gsungs pa'i rnam grangs/ de nyid nyams su blangs bas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi slob ma ji ltar byung b.ri tshul lo/dang po ni/ dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la rngog lo chen po'i gdan sar slob dpon blo gros chos skyong la sogs — 319 —

pashes rab can lnga la tshad ma rnam par nges par gsungs pa nas brtsams te/ brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa la sbya ngan las 'das pa'i bar nyin re la tha na slob bu gcig tsam la yang gtsug lag gi tshigs su bcad pa gcig yan chad kyi chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad par dam bcas te/ mdor na lo drug cu re gnyis kyi bar du/ dam pa'i chos kyi nyan bshad rgyun ma chad par mdzad pa'i gnas ni/ shar phyogs su phag mo gru dang / 'bri khung thel tshun chad/ nub phyogs su la stod ding ri glang 'khor dang / byang ngam ring man chad/ sto phyogs su yar klungs g.ya' bzang dang / yar 'brog sa dkar rtse tshun chad/ byang phyogs su byang rwa sgrong dang / gnam rtse lding gi gtsug lag khang tshun chad du gnas nges med sna tshogs su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad do/ de yang rtsa ba'i grwa sa dang / bzhugs gnas kyi mthil ni/ rdo rje gdan gnyis pa gsang phu ni'u thog gi chos grwa chen po yin la/ rje btsun nyid kyis dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa/ bstan bcos ba ltar na me pho 'brug (1431)gi lo la chos grwa chen po 'phags yul dpal nā leṣṭa'i gtsug lag khang gi 'gram bting nas gdan sa de nyid du lo bcu bzhi'i bar du phrin las bskyangs so/ / gtsug lag khang de nyid du rong ston nyid nas gdan sa rim pa bdun song ba'i mtshams su ga'an phyogs kyi bstan 'dzin gyi gzugs su rlom pa'i ma rungs pa'i sems can 'ga' zhig gis grub mtha'i kun slong ngan pa zhe la ba'ag nas chos grwa der bla ma/ slob dpon/ mi sna drag gtogs/ mdor na khang khyim tshun chad ma rungs par byas te nyam thag pa'i tshe/ sa skya blo gros rgyal mtshan dgung lo so drug bzhes pa sa mo phag gi lo la rje 'di dang rdo ring kun spangs pa gnyis gsang thabs su phebs nas mkhas grub chen po mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub dpal bzang po rong ston chen po'i tshab tu mnga' gsol/lhag par de'i skabs su phrag dog gis rang nyid shin tu myos shing rang dbang mi thub pa'i gzhan phyogs khyibashes gnyen du khas 'che ba'i chos rje smon lam pa bya ba des ngan g.yo'i sbyor ba mngon mtshan can 'ga' byas shing / rje 'di la yang deng sang nā laṣṭa na sa skya pa'i btsun chung tshe zad cig slob yod 'dug zer ba sogs rloms sems kyi tshig ngan 'brug sgra ltar sgrog pa'i tshe/ de dag la thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te rje nyid kyis gnas der ched du gtad pa'i thugs dam mdzad cing / dro sa'i phug ser du mgon po'i gtor chen mdzad pa'i tshe nub cig mnal lam du phug pa'i rtsa bar/ nged 'di lta bu'i mi drag pa dang bcu gnyis shi song zer ba'i dung mo'i sgra lhang lhang ba byung zhing / rje 'di nyid kyi thugs dam gyi nyams snang la mgon po'i las mkhan rnams kyis gser kyi mchod rten chen po 'od 'bar ba zhig dum bur gtubs kyin 'dug pas nang thams cad sol ba dang lham krad kyis brgyangs 'dug pa cig byung ste/ de'i tshe dgun shin tu grang ba'i dus yin kyang / nam phyed zin la khad pa tsam gyi tshod la dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi cho 'phrul gyi spyin nag po shin tu 'jigs su rung ba dpag tu med pa glo bur du nam mkha' la 'dus te skyed 'phan gnyis char du tshor ba'i 'brug gi sgra shin tu grags pa dang / glog gi 'od 'khyug pa dang bcas rbod gtong byed pa'i byang ma de'i mgo la gnam lcags kyi thog chen po mi bzod pa babs nas las — 320 —

ngan pa'i sbyor ba byed byed pa'i lus dang bral nas/ sems nyid dag pa'i zhing du skad cig de nyid la spor bar mdzad pa dang / ga'an yang chos grwa chen po de nyid du zab rgyas chos kyi sgron me te rong ston thams cad mkhyen pas bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzugs par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang yid ches pa'i mched po dam par gyur pa/ rje nyid kyi nye gnas chen mo slob dpon nam mkha' dpal ldan pa'i gsung las thos pa rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te gsal bar bris pas/mgon khyod nges par yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /la lar dag pa'i sar bzhugs sems dpa'i tshul/ /gzhan du so skye'i slob dpon mkhas pa'i
