bkur/ /ston mdzad dge ba'i bshes khyod phyag gi gnas/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed padma'i ngang tshul nyid/ /spub pa'i sar bzhugs rje btsun rgya gar dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom mkhas kun mkhyen rong po'i zhabs/ / tha dad gsum min thugs rgyud gcig pa'i sku/ / sngon tshe sprul pa'i lo tsā rin chen mchog / bar du bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri'i zhabs/ / tha mar smra ba'i seng ge rong ston rje/ /so sor snang yang gsung rgyun gcig pa'i sku/ /bcu phrag brgyad dang gsum gyi lor bzhugs nas// mtshan nyid theg pa'i gzhung chen drug cu dang / / dbang dang gdams pa rgyud chen bzhi bshad pas/ /bstan pa 'dzin khyod gangs can mkhas pa'i gtso/ /bu slob bstan pa'i ka chen rnam pa bzhi/ /gangs can mdzes pa'i rgyan brgyad mchog rnam gnyis/ / thugs kyi bu chen rnam pa bco brgyad kyis/ / bstan pa 'degs khyod rgyal ba gnyis pa yin/ /lha min gyis sbyar log pa'i gzhung lugs kun/ /yang dag lung dang rigs pa'i dpung tshogs bzhis/ / mi mngon rgya mtsho'i dbyings su rab bcings nas/ / rgyal sa 'dzin khyod bstan pa'i baspya byin yin/ / rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhas par rab mkhyen nas/ / gzhung lugs bzhi bcu'i rnam bshad rgyas pa sogs/ / gyed bcas sum brgya'i rtsom gyi phreng ba yis/ / dbyangs can mgrin par byas khyod panyi ta/ / bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos sde 'o ma'i mtshor/ / zhabs zung ngang pa'i sde dpon gnas bzhin du/ / sa skyong ral pa'i stegs la ngal bso ba'i/ / mgon khyod gangs can bod kyi rgyal po yin/ lus phyes thin gyi gseb nas rab phyung ba'i/ lha bu rnams kyis mchod greng gis bsu nas/ /brgya byin gzhu yi shing rta la zhon te/ / lha yul du gshegs byams pa'i rgyal tshab yin/ / zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dis thams cad kyi don bsdus pa yin no/ /(5)sa skya ba'i lta ba'i bzhed tshul/dpal ldan sa skya ba'i lta ba'i bzhed tshul ni/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa dang rong ston sogs mang po zhig dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba gtso bor mdzad/ rje btsun red mda' ba thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba 'dzin/ shākya mchog pa ni dang po dbu ma/ bar du sems tsam/ mthar jo nang ba'ilta bar zhen/ ga'an mang po rdzogs chen gyi lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'ang snang mod/ sa skya'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba ni lam 'bras kyi lta ba gsal stong 'dzin med dam/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la sped dgos pas/ de'i rnam gzhag la mdo sngags kyi dbye ba gnyis dang / mdo lugs la'ang klu sgrubarjes 'angangarda ṭwāṃ~X 1ngaX rdang /

byams pya/) kā sdu rshatrīkau zloṭwāṃ shā dzi kṣiṃ //bsod nams min pa dang por blog /bar du bdag ni zlog pa dang / /tha mar lta zhig kun zlog pa/ /gang gis shes de mkhas pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar rim pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ las 'bras/ byams snying rje sogs bsgoms pas bzlog la/ bar du bdag snardo/ ༵ /dngha sa/ la// mar lta ba kun bzlog pa la bden 'dzin gyi spros pa gcod pa dang bden med kyi spros pa dang po ni/ rang rgyud kyi phung po lnga bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin ngos bzung / rang gi phung po bden par grub na/ rgyu rkyen gang la'ang ltos med du thog ma nyid du grub pa yin dgos pa la/ 'di dag rgyu rkyem/ las skyes/ pa 'ga' zhig tu 'dug pas/ bden par grub pa mi 'dug snyam du thag rbad kyis bcad nas/ de la sems gtad de/ dang por bsgrims te bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog tshar bcad/bar du lhod de lta thog tu sems lhod kyis klod pas/ 'dzin pa thams cad rang grol gyi sgo nas rjes su bzung / mthar res 'jog gam/ yang na rang so bzung ste/ lta ba'i dran shes ma nyams pa'i ngang la had de phyad de bzhag de ltar yid ches rnyed pa na/ 'phags pa lhas/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad bden med du khrol gyis 'gro/chos kyi gnad thams cad cig car du go ba zhig 'byung / 'di ni bar du bdag ni zlog pa dang zhes pa de yin/ dbang po rab la lta rim dang po 'di bsgoms pas gnyis pa yang cig car du skye ba'ang srid/ sngar 'i gnas skyes nas zhi lhag zung du chud pa ma skyes na yang 'dir lta ba'i gnad zin pa'i steng du zhi gnasakyi sems zin te/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi lta ba rgyud la skye'o/ /gnyis pa/ bden med kyi spros pa gcod pa ni/ las nyon gnyis bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog las 'byung la/ bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog de yang spros pa'am mtshan 'dzin las 'byung bas na/ de bcad dartsos pas/ tha mar lta zhig kun zlog pa/ zhes gsungs/ des na chos thams cad bden med du gtan la phab rjes su/ bden med yin snyam pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi cha de yang bcad dgos pas/ rten 'brel gyi gnad las chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i lta ba la nges pa drangs/ nges pa rnyed rjes de'i rgyun mthud pa ma yin par bden med yin snyam pa'i zhen pa de yang btang ste/ yul stong pa nyid de ni yod med sogs gang du yang gzung du med de/ de ni gnyis 'dzin gyi blo gang gi yang spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro snyam du thag rbad kyis bcad de/ yul spros pas ma reg pa la blo'i lhad kyis ma bslad par 'dzin pa dang mtshan ma dang spros pa thams cad btang ste 'dzin med kyi ngang du phyam me bzhag des na/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ zhes gsungs pa'i 'dzin pa yang / lta rim dang po'i tshe bden 'dzin dang / gnyis pa'itram̐ maṭwāṃ~X2 'akau la sbyor bar byed/

gnyis pa byams pa'i man ngag ltar bsgom pa ni/ lugs 'di la gzhi dus kyi ye shes sems dpa' rang bzhin 'od gsal 'di nyid 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gzhi yin la/ de ngos ma zin par gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'khrul ba'i gnyis snang mngon gyur pa bag la nyal dang bcas pa 'di 'khor ba'i rtsa ba lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa yin pas/ 'di'i rtsa ba bcad de dbyings su bstem dgos/ de la gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul snang bcad pa la gnyis las/ dang po gzung ba'i 'khrul ba bcad pa la/ drod snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin tshol ba/ rtse mo snang ba mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin tshol ba/ bzod pa gzung med rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin tshol ba gsum las/ dang po/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba gsal la mi rtog pa zhig rang gi sems la gnas kyang / de ni mthong ba ni/ phyi rol gyi yul 'di dag rang sems las logs su bden par bzung ba 'dis bsgribs pa yin pas/ sgrib byed 'di bsal dgos/ bsal tshul yang 'di dag sems gyi 'khrul snang tsam yin gyi/ sems las logs na bden par grub pa med ces thag bcad nas myong ba thon gyi bar du 'bad/ de ltar 'bad pas phyi rol yul snang 'di dag sems kyi 'khrul ngo tsam las phyi rol na bden par mi 'dug snyams pa'i don la yid ches kyi gsal snang cung zad 'byung ste/ de ni drod snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba yin/ slar yang bsgoms pas sngar gyi sems kyi gsal snang ches cher mched/ snga ma bas yid ches pa'i myong ba gsal bo 'byung ste/ de ni rtse mo'i snang ba mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba yin/ de bas kyang 'bad nas bsgoms pas/ rang rgyud kyi sems 'od gsal sgrib byed kyi gzung bya'i 'khrul snang mngon gyur pa dag pa'i rang sems la gsal snang gi dwangs cha dang bde ba sngar bas ches lhag pa 'byung ste/ de ni bzod pa gzung med rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyi 'khrul snang ma nub kyang / phyi gzung byar snang ba'i 'khrul snang nub ste/ phyi yul snang la bden par zhen pa cung zad mi 'byung bas/ don snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes kyang bya ba yin/gnyis pa gtso bor 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang bcad pa ni/ slar yang 'bad pas/ nang 'dzin byed sems kyi 'khrul snang de yang nub ste/ rang sems 'od gsal la gsal snang ches cher dod pa de mngon sum du mthong ba lta bu'i nyams 'char te/ de ni chos mchog bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin la/ de'i tshe lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa ma dag kyang lhan skyes de las mched pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul snang mngon gyur pa phal cher dag pa'i 'od gsal shar te/ mthong lam sa dang po'i ye shes skyes pa la bar chad med par bde blag tu 'grub pa yin/ slar yang bsgoms pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi spro gzhi lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa'i bag la nyal ba dag kyang mngon gyur pa dag ste/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi sems rang bzhin 'od gsal rjen ni yer re mthong ba lta bu'i gsal snang dang ye shes skyes te/ snang mched thobagasum gyi 'khrul snang mngon gyur pa nub/ de'i gnyen po snang mched thob gsum gyi gsal snang rim ba na shar ba'i sbyor lam gsum dang / de'i rjes su lhan skyes kyi rig pa mngon gyur pa rags pa yang nub waṃ re rdad ༵༵༵ chen po

'jig rten chos mchog gi skabs so/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i mjug thog tu/ lhan skyes ma rig pa sa bon dang bcas pa'i cha shas gcig dag pa'i rang soms 'od gsal gyi cha shas gcig mngon du lhag gis mthong gleni/ sa dang po'i mthong lam zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas sa bcu'i skabs su rang sems 'od gsal de'i sgrigebyed ma rig pa'i cha shas re dag pa'i gsal snang ji cher gyur te/ sa bcu gcig par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe ni/dag pa( dzo)trī snanā spyashāsdu trītrīdī trīX rsha /kā kās/la sgrib med du mthong ba yin zhes 'chad do/ /sngags lugs kyi lta ba ni/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba yin pas/ de la myong ba 'don pa la khyad gzhi sems ngos zin dgos pas thog mar sems btsal/ de gsal stong zung 'jug tu ngo sgrad/de'i nang nas gnyug ma'i ye shes lhan skyes kyi sems mdzub tshugs su ngos bzung / de'i don sgom pas nyams su blangs te/ sems 'khrul 'byams su mi 'chor bar ci snang ye shes kyi rol bar 'char ba dang /'khrul snang shar srid na'ang lta ba'i dran 'dun gyis chab rom chur zhu ba ltar/ 'khrul snang thams cad ye shes tsam du 'char bar byed pa ni gsang chen slob bshad lugs kyi lta ba'i bzhed tshul lo/ /de yang sems btsal tshul ni/ blo kha nang du phyogs te bka' brgyud pa'i sems tshel dang dbyibs mtshungs par/ rang gi sems gang du 'dug mdog dbyibs ci lta bu 'dug ces btsal bas/brtags na nges pa mi rnyed pa'i tha snyad du sems gsal tsam rig tsam 'gyu tsam myong rig sa le ba ngos zin nas nang nas rang byung gi nyams cung zad shar na/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ces pa sems kyi yon tan sum cha gcig rtogs pa yin/ de ltar btsal bas sems skye 'asag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i stong nyid la nges pa rnyed pa na/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zhes pa sems kyi yon tan sum cha gnyis rtogs pa yin/ de ltar stong par nyams su myong ba'i tshe/ ci med cang med kyi chad stong nam mkha' lta bur song ba ma yin par/ ci yang 'char du rung ba'i gsal tsam rig tsam du 'dug pa de'i rang ngo la cer gyis bltas pas rang bzhin gang du yang gzung du mi 'dug pas stong pa nyid du thag chod/ de lta bu'i gsal stong gnyis kyang ya bral du ma yin par sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa/ stong pa tshol mkhan gyi 'gyu se ba ni gsal bayin pa/ gsal ba'i dus na stong pa/ stong pa'i ngang nas gsal ba rang shar du byung ba'i gsal stong zung 'jug tu thag chod pa la zung 'jug la zlo ba zhes zer/ de la go yul tsam min pa'i myong ba gsha' ma zhig nang nas shar dus cir snang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rol bar 'char/ de ltar myong ba thon tsa na bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya ba sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi yon tan cha tshang bar rtogs pa yin na/rig pa 'di la thun mong ba'i ngo sprod ces zer/thun mong ma yin pa ni/ gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ye shes ngo sprad pa ste/ ye shes de ni rang gi sems spyi tsam pa 'di dang / 'khrul snang gi sems 'di la ngos 'dzin pa ma yin par/ gzhi dus kyi gsal stong zungaX juṭwāṃ ༵khrul med kyi sems zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos shing / de la mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams su

rnamabyang gi sems dang / bde gshegs snying po dang / rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems dang / sems kyi rdo rje sogs ming gi rnam grangs du mar btags shing / kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ces kyang bya'o/ rang rgyud la snang ba'i lhan skyes sems 'khrul ba ni glo bur ba 'khor ba sbyang bya yin la/ de'i rang bzhin yang yin la de dang thog ma med pa nas 'grogs kyang sngar ngo ma 'phrod pa'i lhan skyes ye shes ni myang 'das dang / de gnyis ngo bo'i cha nas 'byed mi shes pa ni dbyer med de/ de lta bu ni rgyu 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya la/de ngo 'phrod pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug la mnyam par 'jog pa'i lta ba ni lam 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta bar bzhed do/ /lta ba de nyams su blangs pa'i gnad gsum gyis brtan cing bogs dbyung bar byed dgos pas/ṭāṭwāṃ/da /gsum ni snang ba sems su sgrub pa/ sems sgyu mar sgrub pa/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub dang po ni phyi rol yul snang 'di thams cad rang sems ma rig pas bslad pa'i 'khrul snang kho na las bden par grub pa med tshul lung dang dpes gtan la phab ste bsgoms pas yul snang sems su thag chod pa'i nges pa rnyed pa na gsal stong zung 'jug gi lta ba'i steng du 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa byas te gsal la rnyog pa med par ba'ag de ltar snang ba sems su thag chod pas/ phyi rol yul snang bden med du rtogs pa rnams sdo/den/ pa'i lta ba dang na mnyam pa tsam ste/ rang bzhin gsal ba'i cha la brtan cing bogs 'byin par byed gnyis pa sems sgyu mar sgrub pa ni/ phyi rol gyi yul gzung ba 'di 'dzin byed sems 'khrul bsabaslad pa'i 'khrul snang yin la/ gzung ba spub pas 'dzin byed sems kyang ma grub par lung dang dpes gtan la phab nas bsgoms pas rang bzhin stong pa'icha la brtan cing bogs 'byin/ de ltar gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i cha bden med du rtogs kyang / gnyis stong gi sems gsal stong la bden 'dzin ma chod na rnam rdzun pa'i lta ba dang na mnyam pa tsam yin pas/ de las gong du bogs dbyung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa la rten 'brel gyi sgo nas sgrub pa dang / brjod bral gyi sgo nas sgrub pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa thams cad bden par grub pa'am snyam na/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ 'dus byas thams cad rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis bden par ma grub/'dus ma byas rnams kyang 'dus byas la ltos nas bzhag pa yin gyi/ de las logs na bden par grub pa zhig med de/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'dus byas rab tu ma grub pas/ 'dus ma byas lta ga la 'grub/ ces gsungs/ des na rten 'brel gyi gnad las chos thams cad rang bzhin med par sgrub/ de las lung tshad ma dang / kha ton mar me me long spya/ zhes sogs kyi dpe don bsams nas/ chos thams cad bden stong du thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod/ sgom byung gi nyams myong skyes pa ni pharda phyiṭwāṃ ༵bu 1 dang

ma mnyam pa'i lta ba zhes bya la/ de lta bu'i bden stong de yang gnyug ma lhan skyes sems gsal ba dang ri 'jug tu nyams su myong ba ni 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba ste/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las rtag chad mtha' dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam bzang mchog go/ gnyis pa brjod bral du sgrub pa ni/ de ltar gong du bshad pa rnams nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/yul snang soms su rgya chod/ sems snang sgyu mar rgya chod/ sgyu ma rten 'brel du rgya chod de/ 'gal bar snang ba lta bu'i chos rnams mi 'gal bar nyams su myong zhing nges pa skye la/ skyes pa de'i rabyo bzhin 'di ltar yin zhes ji lta ba bzhin du brjod du med pa'i phyir/ brjod bral zhes btags pa tsam mo/ tshig gi brjod du med pas don la bsam du med/ bsgom bya sgom gyed med pas dmigs pa sgom du med/ blta bya lta byed med pas shes rab kyis blta rgyu med/ mthong bya mthong byed med pas bltas pas mthong rgyu med/dgrol bya 'grol byed med pas don la grol rgyu med/ 'o na ma brjod na tshig mi go ma bsam na don mi rig ma bsgoms na nyams su mi myong / ma bltas na gnas lugs mi mthong / ma grol na 'tshang mi spya bas/ ji ltar bya zhe na/ don dam gshis kyi gnas lugs la go bya go byed sogs gnyis chos su snang ba'i cha yod pa ma yin kyang tha snyad kun rdzob tu brjod du med pa de ga brjod pas go ste/ gnas lugs kyi don rang ngos nas brjod du med kyang nges don zab mo'i lung dang / bla ma'i gdams ngag gis rnam par nges pa la brten nas sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gnyug ma don gyi gnas lugs su go bar byed pas so/ /bsam du med pa de ga bsams pas rig ste/ brjod med kyi go yul de nyid la bsam bya sems byed kyi rnam rtog med par bsams pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings la nges pa skye bas so/ /bsgom du med pa de ga bsgoms pas myong ste/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar bsgom pa de/ de kho na nyid kyi sgom tshul gyi mchog yin pas so/ / blta rgyu med pa de ga bltas pas mthong ste/ gnas lugs gyi don mthong bya mthong byed med par mthong ba nyid mthong ba'i mchog yin pas so/ /grol rgyu med pa de ga rtogs pas grol te/ gnas lugs la bcings pa med la/ bcings pa med par rtogs pa de nyid grol ba yin pas so/ /de ltar shes na 'tshang rgya ru med par 'tshang rgya ste/ sems kyi gnas lugs gdod ma nas gang du'ang ma dmigs shing / spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa de nyid la sangs rgyas zhes ming du btags pa tsam las/ don dam par sangs rgyas dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ 'o na sems can gyi don ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ don dam par sems can dmigs su med phyir/sems can gyi don byed pa yang med mod kyang / kun rdzob tu yid bzhin gyi nor bu las dgos 'dod ༵༵sdo ṭwāṃsdo ṭwāṃ sprazlo zlo spra ṭwāṃn/ no/rna/ma par rtog pa med bzhin du smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can gyi don don de dag la dgongs nas/ / rje sa skya parnyi tas kyang / / chos kun gdod nas skyes pa med/ /skyes rjo nyi~X2 dīng rji skyes la/ / skye med nyid kyang skye bar ston/ / des na skyes dang ma skyes dang / / rtog

pa dang ni rtog med dang / /snang ba dang ni stong pa dang / /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa yang / /dam pa'i don du dbye ba med/ /dbye ba med las dbye ba byung / /dbye ba'i dbye ba 'byed shes na/ /'khor 'das kun gyi de nyid rtogs/ /shes bya kun gyi de nyid go /bzang ngan kun gyi de nyid shes/ /rtogs rgya med pa'i don rtogs pas/ / grol rgyu med pa'i sems nyid grol/ / shes bya med pa'i shes bya shes/ / 'chad rgyu med par 'chad la mkhas/ 'dod pa med par 'dod don 'grub/ /shes bya kun la bzo byed pas/ /chos kun gyi ni spyal por 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ /de dag gi don gtan la dbab pa na/ rje btsun rin po ches/ gsum pa'i gnyis pa brjod bral bstan par bya/ /gzhon nu dgod dang skugs pa'i mi lam dang / /gnad la 'phrugs dang dbang po'i bde dro rshadro lo/'o///gsum pa'i ye shes gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug dang / / longs spyod rlabs dang dkyil 'khor zhes go rim bzhin du thun mong gi dpe bzhi dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dpe bzhi ste brgyad kyis ngo sprod tshul gsungs shing / dpe dang po bzhi yan chad la brten nas chos thams cad sems dang / sgyu ma dang /rang bzhin med pa tsam du legs par rtogs na/ spang bya dang po ma rig pa'i dug thon pa tsam las/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba tha mal rnam rtog rgyun chags rtsol ba'i dug mi thon pas/ rgyu dus kyi lta ba dug can zhes bya ste/ yul rtogs pa tsam la lta bar bzhag pa yin no/ /brjod bral kyi dpe phyi ma rnams la brten nas gles ba dang / dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i skyon med kyi ye shes rnams kyis rnam rtog rgyun chags rtsol ba'i dug 'don nus pas/ lam dus kyi lta ba dug med ces bya/ don gyi ye shes mtshon nus pas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes kyang bya ste/ nyams myong ting nge 'dzin la lta bar bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad de/ rgyu dus kyi lta ba bzhag pa de dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta bar ma son 'dra bas/ dbu sems thun ming ba tsam dang / de nyid lam dus kyi lta bas mthon por na 'phar bar byed pa'i tshul du snang ngo / / gong du bshad zin pa'i snang gsum ni/ sa skya'i lam 'bras kyi nyams len gyi gzhi ma'am sngon 'gro/ thog mar pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang thun mong ba snang ba ṭwāṃ/sum/ gyi lam ste/ ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba bcas gsum dpal ldan sa skya ba rnams kyi 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i bzhed tshul de tsam mo/(ra)sa skya'i grub maba' 'dzin mkhan/sa ngor rdzong (tshal)gsum zhes bya ba dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin mkhan ngor chen kun dga' bzang po dang / sems dpa' dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdzong pa kun dga' rnam spyal dang / dkon mchogalhun grub sogs nas brgyud pa'i lugs so/ /rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i dgon pa ni khams sde dge'i shar phyogs sman shod cerji pa~X ༵ charji rab

byung bzhi pa'i chu glang (1253)lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas phyag btab/ 'jam dbyangathomakhyen brtse dbang pos gdan sa mdzad pa'i sa skya'i dgon pa skad grags can zhig yin no/ /khams sde dge dgon chen dpal lhun grub steng gi chos grwa zhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa 'brug —(1448)lor/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos phyag btab/ sde dge rgyal po rim byon rnams kyis mchod gnas su gyur cing / par khang chos mdzod chen mo bkra shis sgo mang zhes rig gnas kyi shul bzhag chen po yod pa'i sa skya'i dgon pa grags can zhig yin/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya (1729)lor/ sde dge'i rgyal rabs zhe gnyis pa chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gi sku dus su bzhengs pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur dang / de'i dkar chag rnam gnyis bcas/ sa dge rnying gsum gyi bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum sna tshogs sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i par shing 'bor chen yod pa'i par khang zhig yin no/ /lha sgang dgon mthong grol bsam 'grub gling chos sde chen mo zhes pa si khron zhing chen dkar mdzis bod rigs rang skyong khul dar mdo rdzong mi nyag rab sgang gi char gtogs shar rgyal mo rong bzhag bra dkar po'i mdun zhol du/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sgo mig rgya nag tu bstan pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa'i tha mar mi nyag rab sgang du yongs rdzogs rab dga'i lha sgang 'di nyid bzhengs par grags la/ rgya bza' kong jo bod du byon skabs yul 'dir bzhugs te jo bo shākya mu ni'i zhal skyin du lha sgang jo bo 'di zlozhe/ nga/sa par grags/ chos brgyud thog mar bka' brgyud pa yin zhing / phyis su sa skya ba chags pa yin de nas rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa 'khrungs yul shar rgyal mo rong spyal mo dmu rdo'i 'gram brag steg rgyal pos sras kyis 'debs par mdzad pa'i sa skya'i chos grwa chen po dpal nā lend+ra gtsug lag khang nas brgyud pa'i rong ston gyi slob rgyud 'brom ston sprul pa chos grags bzang po'i dus su ljong 'dir bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de'i dbon po 'jam dbyangs byams pa dkon mchog bzang pos nyid kyi dgung lo so bdun pa rab byung brgyad pa shing byi lo la a le chos rje'am dhī phug chos rjes dgon pa bshad sgrub nor bu chos 'phel gling btab/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ mgon po'i rnam 'phrul dam pa kun grags/ klong chen rab 'byams pa sogs kyi sku'i skye bar grags/ gter lung las/ mdo khams smad nas dkon mchog ming can 'byung / zhes sogs gsungs pa'ang 'di la ngos 'dzin/ de'i sprul sku bkra shis bzang po sogs bzang po rnam lnga dam pa'i skyes rab zam ma chad par byon pa las byams ngag dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs da ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis bskyangs bar gnas/ 'on kyang bod yul rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa nas dpon slob rim byon kyis bskyangs pas sa skya'i phyag len gyi 'cham sogs dang / rig gnas du ma'i slob rgyun bcas gong 'phel gnaṭasdo shing /'brom ston sprul pa chos grags bzang po'i dus mdo smad ljongs 'dir tsha ba khag gsum du sa skya'i bstan pa 'phel phyir khro bcu'i gzhung du spyi pa dgon sa skya la grwa grangs stong phrag lhag 'tshogs pa zhig phyag — 328 —

btab/ so mang pa pad zhabs rda rtsa'i dpon dang bla ma rim byon kyis skyong / rjes nas bka' brgyud pas bskyangs so/ 'bar khams la phar pa dgon/ 'byar dgon/ shug sgang dgon sogs sngon jo nang yin na'ang rjes su sa skya'i bskyangs/ rnga ba na mkhar mda' dgon/ rag tsha dgon/ mdo dge legs gter mdzod gling / sa sgang dgon/ lan peng la skyo ba dgon/ stag lo pus mo dgon/ dpal ldan thang ga dgon/ khog po sba yog dgon/ mdzo dge'i chos rje dgon/ dpal skyid ban yan dgon/ a skyid rgyud pa dgon/ kan su the po gdong ti dpe dgos dgon pa bcas so/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron me mthor btegs nas/ /phyogs kun chos kyi snang bas 'gengs byed pa/ /dpal ldan sa skya ba yi ring lugs ni/ /skal ldan gdul bya thar lam 'chol ba'i mig / nyon mongs gcong nad sel ba'i snan gyi mchog / gang 'dod re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam shing / /'chi med go 'phang ster ba'i bdud rtsi ste/ /khyad par rab 'byams rgyud don gces nor tshogs/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nyams len sgrom gcig tu/ /bsdus pa'i gdams pa gsung ngag ces grags pa/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod skal ldan spyi dpal yin/ /rnam dag srol 'di bsrung ba rang nyid kyi/ /las su ye shes spyan gyis nyer gzigs nas/ /bstan srung sde dpon gur mgon 'phags yul nas/ /bse 'bag 'phur shes zol gyis byon pa snyam/ /de lta'i byung ba brjod pa'i gtam/ /lha yi rol mo ltar snyan cing / /mu tig phreng 'dra'i yid 'ong ba/ /gzur gnas rna ba'i rgyan du spel/ /grub mtha' thams cad kyi shāng/ sa/ dang 'dod tshul ston pa legs bshad shel gyi me long las sa skya ba'i grub mtha' byung tshul bshad zin le'u bcu dgu ba/ jo nang ba ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/kun mkhyen zhes su grags pa'i ba dan dkar/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sa kun tu cher g.yo ba/ /dol po ba yis rgya chen phye ba'i srol/ /jo nang grub mtha' grags pa'i byung ba gleng /jo nang ba'i grub mtha' byung tshul la ba'i/ ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / lugs de'i ga'an stong gi lta ba'i 'dod tshul/ jo nang ba'i lta ba'i rnam par bzhag pa dang / de'i lta ba bod gangs can dang sog yul 'jang yul sogs la khyab pa'o/ /dus rabs bcu gcig par yu mo mi bskyod rdo rjes sngags kyi ga'an stong gi srol btod/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis jo mo nang du dgon pa btab/ phyis dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang /tā ra na tha sogs las brgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'di rgya cher spel bas de nas bzung brgyud 'dzinarnams la jo nang ba zhes grags/jo nang gi grub mtha'i rtsa ba'i khongs ni/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje ste/ rab byung dang po'i dus su phyon/dang po rnal 'byor pa/ phyis su rab tu byung nas mtshan dad pa rgyal po btags/ kaug ༵༵la tram̐dzin

sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ kha che paṇa chen zla ba mgon po las chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ zla mgon gyi slob ma sgro ston gnam brtsegs las dus 'khor rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa dang / sgron gsal man ngag dang bcas pa zhib tu gsan/ de nas 'u yug tu snyon nas bsgom pas rtogs pa brnyes/ gzhan stong si lta ba thugs la shar/ mngon shes mnga' zhing / bya rog dang skya kar sprul pa sogs sgrul bsgyur du thomadzad pas grub thob kyi grags pa che/ dus 'khor sogs kyi yig cha 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad pas dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis pa la gshegs/slob ma mang yang latso bo ni/ sras dharma sha ra ste/ grub chen la mnga' ba'i gzhung gdams ngag thams cad dgung lo nyi shu tshun la thugs su chud/ mkhas pa mang du bsten nas dbu tshad dang / gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor la sbyang ba rtsal du thon/ mkhyen rab shin tu che zhing 'jam dbyangs kyi sbrul par yang grags/ brtsams chos kyang thar thor yod pa 'dug de'i bu chen nam mkha' 'od zer/ de'i slob ma dharma sha ra'i sras mo sprul sku jo 'bum/ de la ming po se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de la 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ 'di yan chad dus 'khor bka' dog kyang / 'jam gsar nas bzung yangs su song zer/ de'i slob ma kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ de'i slob ma kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ 'dis sbyor drug gi yig cha mdzad/ de'i slob ma byang sems spyal ba ye shes/ de gnyis ka'i slob ma mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ de'i slob ma kun mkhyin du grags pa dol po ba shes rab rgyal mtshan te/ rab byung lnga ba'i (1292—1361)chu pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ rab byung drug pa'i lcags glang la 'das/ bla ma sum cu lhag tsam las mdo sngags kyi chos rgya cher gsan cing / khyad par du skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan las phar tshad mngon pa zhib tu sbyangs nas/ dbu gtsang rnams su grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas grags shin tu che ba byung / skyi ston las/ dbang bskur rang yang zur bka' bdun cu tsam gyis mtshon sngags kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ chos lung chegs pa'i mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'di yan chad du khong sa skya'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa yin kyang / dgung lo so gcig du jo nang du pebs nas/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mcho las dbang dang gdams pa du ma dang / khyad par dus 'khor gyi dbang khrid gsan/ de nas bzung jo nang ba'i chos brgyud la zhugs/ sbyor drug bsgoms pas srog rtsol mthar phyin pa'i rtags byung / de nas jo nang gi gdan sar bzhugs nas sku 'bum mthong grol chen po bzhengs/ rab byung drug pa'i shing khyi lor thugs sus sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen dang / lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gnyis dus 'khor rgyud kyi bod 'gyur la zhu dag mdzad du bcug cing / 'grel dri med 'od kyi ṭi ka dang don bsdus mdzad/ gzhan stong gi lta ba la thugs nges shin tu 'drongs te/ gzhan stong jo nang pa'i lugs gzhung nges don rgya mtsho dang / bka' bsdu bzhi ba/ rgyud bla'i ṭi ka/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel ba/ bstan pa spyi don/ dbang bskur cho ga dang sgru~X 3/brji/ rtsis gzhung sogs mang du brtsams pas/ ri bo brtsegs pas rgya macu rdol zhes zer

ro/ mkhas pa mang po la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / gzhan stong gi lta ba rtsal du bton nas gsungs/ lha du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang / sku'i bkod pa gsum dus gcig la bstan pa sogs grub rtags bstan pa dang / slob ma mang po la mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad man ngag gnang ba/ bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs mkhas pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ gyir tshogs pa nyis stong tsam re yan chad dang /sbob pa snying por byed pa rang yang stong tsam ri 'du ba byung / mchims blo bzang grags pas spyan ras /drokādri su/ gzigs pa/ nye gnas nam mkha' byang chub kyis 'jam pa'i dbyangs su mthong ba sogs kyi lo slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa las/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal dang / sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gnyis thugs sras su byed/ phyogs las rnam spyal sogs 'azin las kyi rgyun skyong ba'i mkhas pa mang du byon/phyogs rgyal ba ni/ sa skyar slob gnyer mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ thog mar gzhan stong gi lta ba thugs la ma 'thad nas jo nang du rtsod par phebs pa dol po ba chen pos lung rigs kyi 'beel gtam mdzad pas thugs la mi bde ba med par song nas slob mar gyur te mdo sngags kyi bshad pa du ma dang khyad par du dus 'khor gyi dbang khrid rdzogs par gsan/ kun mkhyen bu ston la yang chos mang du zhus/ ngam rings kyi chos dpon mdzad cing / phar tshad kyi gzhung mang po brtsams/ de'i sbob ma nya dbon kun dga' dpal zhes grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po de byon/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha pas kyang /phyogs rgyal ba las dus 'khor dang / nya dbon las phar phyin sogs gsan/ de byin chad nas dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyun rgya cher 'phel yang / gzhan stong gi lta ba ni bag la zha bar gyur na'ang /phyis su jo nang kun dga' grol mchog dang / khyad par du grol mchog gi skye ba tā ra nā thas skyar gsos kyis gso bar mdzad nas 'chad spel dang yig 'jog kyang mang du mdzad/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha mchog (1575—1635)ni/ rab byung bcu pa'i shing mo phag gi lo'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la/ yab rā lo'i gdung brgyud rnam spyal phun chogs dang / yum rdo rje bu dga' lha mo gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid du mnga' gsol/ yi ge 'bri klog rnams tshegs med du mkhyen/stag lung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung ste/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan gsol/ bshes gnyen rgya gar ba dzwa la nā thā mchog gis khong la tā ra nā thā zhes su mtshan gyi cod pakho bstsal ba'i gzigs snang byung bas de ltar grags pa byung / mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub dang / rje rdo ring pa chen po/ rje brag stod pa chos sku lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan lung rigs rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ye shes dbang po sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma du mar bstenā/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung mtha' dag la gsan bsam mdzad/ sa skya dang / jo nang / shangs pa/ zha lu/ 'brug pa/ kai tshang sogs kyi dbang khrid man dag dang bcas pa yongs su mnos/ lhag par du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid man ngag dang bcas pa byin rlabs don brgyud du thob/ spya gar spub chen sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po las rgyud — 331 —

sde'i dbang dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan te bod 'dir sngon med kyi blo skyedardzo brgya tsam byung bar gsungs/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi slob dpon purna badzra sogs bsten nas/ sgra sog phyi nang gi rig gnas mang du gsan pas mkhas pa'i rtser son/ sgom sgrub la gus rtag sbyor bas sa lamagyiyon tan rdzogs pas grub pa'i sar gshegs/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang mchod yonasa'abrel bas rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes pa'i gnas gzhi gsar pa bzhengs rte gdan sa'i mthil mdzad/rje 'di nyid kyis rjes su bskyangs pa sgrul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtshe sogs jo nang gi spub mtha'i rang rkang ma nor bar 'dzin thub pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang du snyon/rgya gar chos 'byung dang / sher snying / dus 'khor sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung 'grel skor/ gzhan stong gi lta grub skor gligs bam bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi rtsom pas bstan rgyun bzhag ste/ rin spungs sde pa karma bstan skyong dbang po sbyin bdag bsten nas jo nang dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su rtag brtan phun tshogaspogling phyag btab/ rgyal dbang bzhi pas me tri bya ba'i mtshan gsol/ sog po khal kha'i yul kha bong du lo grangs nyi shu'i ring la bstan pa spel dgon pa du ma btab/ dpal ldan jo nang pa'i mdo sngags zung gi bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gnam tu bsgrengs par mdzad/ sog yul du rje btsun dam pa zhes su grags/ mthar dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag lo'i nag zla'i tshes nyer brgyad la sku'i bkod pa bsdus te sman pa'i rgyal po'i zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan no/de'i yang srid mong gol rgyal po thu she thu han gyi sras su rim par 'khrungs/ spyal dbang lnga pa'i skabs rtag brtan phun tshogs gling dge lugs par bsgyur nas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes btags/ de nas bzung dbus gtsang du grub mtha' de 'dzin pa'i sde rim gyis nyams par gyur kyang / tang gis chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi srid jus yang dag pas phyir du (1991)lor lha sa'i srid gzhung gi sgo gye chog pa'i chog mchan thob nas deng skabs jo nang rang lugs kyis rtag brtan phun tshogs gling dang sku 'bum mthong grosmu mchod rten sogs sngon bzhin zhig gso gyed bzhin 'dug go/dngabo/ rjes su mdosmad du jiltar zung tshul/mdo smad du jo nang gi bstan pa byung tshul la/ thog mar kun mkhyen chen po sku bzhugs dus su byams pa kha bo ches dngos su mjal te khong gi drung du lo drug la phyi nang gi chos skor zhus nas mthar chos rje'i zhal nas/ khyod khams la song dang bstan pa la phan thogs 'ong / zhes gsung tshe/ byams pa kha bo ches phyag phul nas kho mi 'gro/ pha khyed dang 'bral mi phod/ ces zhus pa na/ khong gis dung gcig dang /bka' bsdus bzhi pa'i glegs bam zhig gnang nas lung bstan pas/ khams yul skyes pa'i lhag bsam las 'phro can/ zhes pa nas dmyus ltar gyi 'gro ba ran/ lam stabs mi dgos bde bar phyin par 'gyur/de la thon 3kā~X 'ani yis bshad ston gyis/ /de dus rtse mdo'i sa char 'ong ba yi/ /tshong pa brgya phrag chos grwar

'ardus pa'i tshe/ /lha mo'i sprul pa bud med sngo nag gis/ /bong bu ga pa sogs 'dab g.yas g.yon la/ /dpal bo'u nor bu gnyis kyi spu rtags can/ /ja mar sbrang rtsi dar 'bogs bkal nas kyang / /khyod la phul tshe thag thog med par longs/ /chos kyi grogs bzang gter tshen rdol ba lags/ /rgyal gyi nyin zhig bong bu zhwa pa de/ /gligs bam 'di nyid bkal cing rgyab tu ded/ /kho rang gar song song la 'gro ru chug /bong bugar nyal sa la dung 'di bus/ /nga la gsol ba thob dang dgon pa gyis/ /bstan pa'i ba dan mkha' la 'phyar bar 'gyur/ /nga yi chos byed dge slong mang du 'byung / /skye bo du ma smin grol lam la 'jug rdo rje mched drug ming can gnas bdag gis/ /de tshe khyed kyi bka' bsrung byed par 'gyur/ /thos pa 'di tsam yin gyi byams pa khyod/ /khams su song shig gzhan phan mtha' yas 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin bka' ldog tu ma btub ste byams pa kha bo che mdo khams rgyal mo rong gi phyogs rim par brgyud de byon nas chos rje'i lung bstan ltar rdo rje mched drug gi gnas 'ob gangs dkar gyi rtsa bar legs par slebs tshe der nges don gyi chos gzhi dgon sde btab nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa de lugs ltar rgya cher spel zhing rtse mdo'i sa cha de phyogs su dgon sde yang rgyas tsam dang jo nang gis chos lugs 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde mang tshod du 'dug la/ de skabs re gig gi tshe dgon bdag khong nyid kyi nub gcig tu mi ltas kyi mtshan ma mi legs pa la brten slar yang jo nang du chos rjes mchog gi drung du lan cig phebs snyam yod tshe/ nyin de'i snga dro tsam na rdo rje mched drug gi dur khrod der chos rje kun mkhyen chen po gang nyid song ge la chibs nas gshegs byon mdzad pa mngon sum du mjal skabs su dgon bdag pa khong nas thugs gting nas dad mos shugs drag gi gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsang mgur dang bcas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas der chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa gang gi zhal snga nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i mdo yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig gsung bsgrags kyis legs gnang mdzad rjes chos rje nyid gar song cha med du phebs song ba sogs dgon gyi zhal bdag byams pa kha bo che khong la ya mtshan pa'i gsang gsum gyi rnam thar mang zhing sku tshe gang bor rdo rje mched drug gi gnas bdag dam can sde rigs kyis rtag par mdzad 'phrin skyong ba'i bka' bsrung gi g.yar dam lhod med kyi ngang nas mdzad pa mthar phyin skad do/ /de rjes jo nang kun mkhyen chen po gzugs sku chos dbyings su jim pa la nye ba'i skabs su nyid kyi bka' chems su ma 'ongs pa na mdo khams phyogs su rang re'i chos brgyud 'dzin pas rigs ldan drag po'i sprul pa/ khams dzam thang dgon chags 'debs mdzad tsha rong du 'khrungs nas nges don zab mo'i lta grub yang dag gis mdo khams phyogs der gsang chen sgrub brgyud cher spel 'byung tshul 'di gzhan yang lung bstan man ngag gis ji bzhin gsal brjod legs gnang mdzad pa ste/ de yang lung bstan gi tshig 'ga' / gāsna dṛ/ song bas 'dir mi spro/ de lhag gi lo rgyus dkyus su ma 'dus pa nyung bsdus 'dir bsnyad par bya

gnyas pa/ 'dzam thang du jo nang ltar dar tshul dang chos sku zeng rim blon/thog mar rigs ldan sprul pa sku phreng dang po drung rasna thi'i lo rgyus/ dus gang gi tshe sngon gyi spubar slob dpon chen po bod gangs ri'i krongs kyi 'gro phan rlabs chen sril mdzad gsang sngags bskul zhuge mchog spub pa'i o rgyan slob dpon pad 'byung gis rje 'di nyid 'gyur med rdo rje'i lung gis cher bsngags me tog dus salegs par 'thor ba ste/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba'i blo gros lhag bsam stobs dang ldan/5/thog mtha' bar du bstan pa'i gnyer kha ba/ /lan gcig bskal ba dus kyi tha mar yang / /mdo khamagaphyacerong zhes bya ba na/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ratna'i mtshan can zhig / gsang sngags bstan 'dzin 'gro nee dpag med 'dren/ /dgyes pa'i mdangs ldan dpa' bo'i gzugs stobs can/ /yig bdun bsnan pa 'gro ba skyong byed cing / /kun kyang gsang sngags mchog la 'god byed 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo/— /dus mthar gsang sngags bstan pa'i dpal gyur mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa gang de thog mar sku 'khrungs pa'i tshul yang 'dzam gling stong khun rgyal po'i yul mtha' mdo khams rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong zhes bya ba'i yul bye ma thang du (spyi lo 1350rab lo 624)lcags pho stag la rab dkar sngon las kyi stobagache ba'i rigs rus mthon po'i zon nee tshang yab pan 'de thar dang yum nam mkha' lcam pha ma ya rabs kyi srasasu 'khrungs nas sku'i skye srid bzung skabs yum gyi rmi lam du mchod rten ngo mtshar can legs baspun mdzad pa'i snang ba sogs dge mtshan du ma mngon du gyur cing / phyogs de'i yul smongs rnams su lo legs 'asgru bcud phun sum tshogs pa sogs dpal dang 'byor ba'i 'apel kha rgya che ba grong khyer gyi gnas khang dkor mdzod rnams la 'od zer gyi phung pos khyab pa sogs thun mong gi yul sdi'i snang ngor ches ya mtshan pa kun nas 'phyur bar gyur te/ de nas tha shes rang mgo thon pa'i skabs tsam na 'jig rten 'di snang la snying po med par dgongs nas yab yum sogs las skog tu bros te/ mngon shes mchog mnga' ri pa shes rab dpal zhes bya ba thag ha cang mi ring bar bzhugs pa de nyid kyi drung du sbobs pa/ ri pa blo gros sngon nas mngon shes kyis ji bzhin mkhyen nas rang gi nye 'khor dag la de ring skyes bu dam pa zhig 'byon par 'dug pas rang cag gis dga' bsu dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar khong dpon slob kyis bsu bkod mdzad nas bla ma de'i mdun nas thog mar yi ge bslabs pas 'bad med klog bzang phul phyin du mkhyen pa byung / de nagare zhig gi tshe 'dul 'dzin dam pa shes rab dpal sogs mkhan slob grangs tshang gi drung du srid las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi bsam pas cug snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs nod mdzad nas mtshan rin chen dpal bya bar gsol/de nas dgung lo bco brgyad steng dbus gtsang du phebs te mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas zab chos re zhig bar zhus skabs su mkhan chen byang chub rtse mos mkhan po dang gzhan slob dpon du 'os pa sogs kha skong dang bcas pa'i grangs legs 'dzom gyi mdun nas tshig sbyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdomashaṃ le~X4 par zhus te gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byang chub sems sdom yang mnos pa nas bzung sha chang

gi nyes dmigs thugs dgongs su bcings te sku tshe hril por sha dang chang gtan spangs byas pa ma zad gzhan mo mang po la de lugs ltar spong du 'jug pa'i gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad/de dag gi skabs su dbus gtsang du chos ji ltar zhus na/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ chos rje phyogs las rnam spyal/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ 'azin las bzang po/ byang chub seng ge mkhan byang chub rtse mo sogs kyi drung nas skyor ba yan lag drug cha lag dang bcas pa/'grel chen dri med 'od/ rdo rje snying 'grel/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ 'jam dpal lta 'dod/don dam bsnyen pa ste sems 'grel yan lag dang bcas/ byams chos nde lnga / thogs med kyi sa sde lnga dang / sdom rnam gagyis/ dbyig gnyen gyi sum cu'i rab dbye/ nyi shu'i rab dgye/ las rnam 'byed pa/ phung lnga'i rab dbye/ rnam shes rig pa dang lnga tshan gcig yang mdo rgyan 'grel pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed 'grel pa/ rten 'brel mdo 'grel dang gsum tshan gcig ste byams pa dang 'azel ba'i chos sde nyi shu/ gzhan yang mngon pa sde bdun mngon pa gong 'og dang bcas pa dang / tshad ma sde bdun tshad mdo dang bcas pa/ 'dul lung sde bzhi gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag bcas gsan bsam rang byan tshud de thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gang dag la tshul ji bzhin goms par byas pas thugs rgyud 'dres nges kyi nyams myong gi sgo yang phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu'i ches kun nas rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang 'bri gung lo tsā/ chos rje chos dpal mgon po sogs kyi drung nas kyang 'azeng ba skor gsum/ gshin rje gshed skor/ yo ga bya spyod man ngag bcas gsan te tshegs chung ngus thugs su chud par mdzad de 'di dag gang thad nas kyang sngon goms bzang po'i dbang gis lan re gzigs tsam gyis gzhan phal pa gang las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i gzhung lugs kyi don thugs su chud stobs che ba khyad par drang nges ji bzhin gzigs pa'i shes rab mchog gis rang stong gzhan stong gi lta ba'i gnad la nges shes zab mo 'khrungs nas mdo sngags spyi la mkhyen pa'i sgo rlabs che ba rgyas te byams pa 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub sogs shing rta chen po gang dag gi dgongs pa'i don dpyis snyin par thugs nyams su bstar nas phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs chod nges kyi mkhas thub gnyis ldan ches ṭwāṃrdoṭā shā/ gyur te/ de dag ni bshes gnyen las mang thos btsal te zab don thugs la legs 'byor gyi de nas ma gi dzi ska zhes pa'i sa phyogs su/ /skye bo dmu rgod dar ba'i yul dbus su/ /gnod sbyin nor bdag zhig gi dgon pa byung / dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad sgrub dge legs rgyasa'as chos je'i kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' lung ltar/ khong dgung grangs sum cu bzhes tsam na kun mkhyenaphyogs rgyal ba sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso che ba gang dag gi zhal nas kyang da ni sngonachosarje mchog gi lung bstan bzhin khyod khams phyogs su phebs dang sgo gang thad nas bstan 'gro la phan tho khorarabyung nges lags pas deng skabs khyod la rten skal du bka' gdams mchod rtetshacig dang chos dung mge lod pas de dag bong bu — 335 —

la 'gel bzhin mdo khams su legs phyin mdzod dang nam zhig bong bu gar nyal dang dung dkar rang gragargo kye dus na khyod gtan tu sdod gnas rang re'i nges don gyi bstan pa'i chos gzhi'i dgon sde 'debs gnas saus cha de nyid kyis mdzod dang bstan 'gro la phan pa yun du 'byung ba'i bka' lung gsal po yod tshul giglergyas su gsung te bka' pod bzhi'i gzhung lugs kyi don la gzhi nas byang chub pa ma zad mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i spobs pa kun nas gzengs mtho bar gyur te/ skabs de mtshams rnas kyang drung dka' bzhi rin chen dpal zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gyi grags pa rgyas bzhin khams phyogs su rim par phebs pa la chas pa ste/ de yang mdo khams smad phyogs su gnya' ri chos rdzong sogs dgon sde du ma chagaga'adebs dang zhal bdag mdzad pa mang tshod du 'dug kyang lo rgyus zhib mo'i khungs ma rnyed/ de las khams dzam thang phyogs su chags phebs mdzad tshul stod dbus nas sngar bzhin bong bu khal bcas ded de 'jam dpal mtshan brjod zhal 'don mdzad bzhin rim pas phebs pa na 'dzi ka'i dzam thang gi pha ki bag ges leb zer ba'i gnas der thon tshe sngar gyi lung bstan bzhin bong bu nyal zhing dung dkar rang grags kyi mtshan rtags dang zhal 'don gyi tshig mtshams kyang sdug gu 'jig rten gsum gyi mchog / dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug par/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs zhala'adon mtshams sleb phyir khong gis gang ci'i thad nas rten 'brel bzang po'i dge mtshan du mkhyen nas der zhag mal byas te phar phyogs kyi dzam lha'i thang der bon dgon chags pa la sba mkhar dang zom lham bzang po zhig thor skyes su bskur lan tshur dung dkar gcig dang stan dkar gyi gdan zhig legs 'bul byas pas gnas der khong bzhugs nas bon rnams gzhan du 'gro ba'i rten 'brel 'grig go/de nas drung dka' bzhi ba ni 'azin las rnam bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa yin pas khong gis pha rol gyi bon rnams la nangs snga mor thabs tshul drag pos bka' bsgo ba/ khyed cag gnas 'di nas byur du ma song na stobs chen dmag dpung gis bskrad par bya'o/ zhes gsung gis khyab bsgrags byas shing sprul pa'i dmag dpung gi skya rjes ches mang po grong gseb kun tu snang ba sogs 'jigs gzugs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba du ma nye bar bstan pas de'i ma bzod pas bon rnams yul gzhan du spo ba'o/ /de rjes khong nyid dzam thang gi gnas der phebs nas nges don gyi chos gzhi dgon pa chags 'debs pa'i dbu 'dzugs legs bsgrigs kyi (khyi lo 1425 rab lo 739)shing mo sbrul gyi lo la dpal dzam thang gi chos sde rgya che legs bkod kyi khyad par dang bcas dbu brnyes gsar pa'i dpal yon shar te nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa zab mo'i gzhi tshugs nas bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi che ba sgo kun nas rgyas pa'i mdzad bzang gis mdo khams phyogs su rmongs mun gyi yul gru 'dir theg mchog rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i chos kyi 'od snang cir yang brdal bas snga na med pa'i dge mtshan rlabs po che skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du rnam pa kun nas tshad bzung dang bral ba'i ngo mtshar khyad 'phags mchog gi gnas su gyur te/ dgon sde/ rten khang /chos ra/ 'du khang / rgya sgribs/ lcags ri sogs phyi nang gi khyad bkod ngo mtshar che ba dang bcas dge — 336 —

'dun 'dus pa'i sde tshogs kyang de lugs bzhin rnam dkar 'khor gsum stobs che bas dus nye bar 'da' bzhin 'beel rgyas dbyar gyi dga' tshasde la 'gran 'os su gyur nas yun ring khong gi zhabs pad 'jigs med rdo the'i khri la brtan pa nas bzung 'gro phan rgya che ba'i thugs sras kyi mchog rags bsdus tsam brjod na/nyid kyi rgyal tshab mkhas pa'i dbang po bla ma dpal sku mched gnyis dang / mkhan dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/tshes bcu'i rarna kyirte/ a ge nyi ma 'od zer/ yo bo nam mkha' dpal/ rag khrom kun dga' dpal/tshad ma ba rgyal ba bzang sogs mkhas shing grub brnyes kyi skye bu dam pa du ma dang dge slong gi dge 'dun rab tu byung ba'i rtags kyi spyal mtshan legs par 'chang ba ches mang zhing 'dus pa stong phrag gi grangs su longs pa rgyun du 'tshogs te lung rtogs kyi bya ba rlabs chen kun nas spyod pa 'ba' zhig ste/ gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag du ma la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par thun mong mdo phyogs kyi gzhung lugs dang thun min gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag sogs sgo gang thad nas chos char zad med legs phabs mdzad pa'i 'azin las 'jug pa rgya che zhing /de yang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs gang 'chad tshe rgyal ba'i dgongs pa drang nges bden gnyis kyi tshul la mkhas shing rnam par dag pa'i legs par bshad pa mchog gis mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed pa rmad byung lung dang rigs pa che rno bas rang lugs 'jog pa'i rtags sbyor yang dag dang pha rol rgol ba la rtsod pa'i thal 'phreng bzlog med kyis lta ba ngan pa'i som nyi kun nas gzhom par mdzad pa/gsung sgros mdzes pa'i tshig gis rdzod byed nyung la don rab tu gsal ba'i go bde yid la 'thad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi rtsom pas mkhas dbang gzu bor gnas pa'i thugs la dgyes pa cir yang ster ba'i sgo nas nyid kyi rtsom chos yang / gsung rab spyi 'grel/ legs bshad rdo rje 'phreng ba/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gsal gyed/ sbyor drug gi khrid gzhung / gong ma mchog gi bzhi'i cho ga 'khor lo sdom pa che chung / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ gsang 'dus rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ dus 'khor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/ dus 'khor gyi cho gdus 'khor mngon rtogs rnam bshad/ blo sbyong 'brel pa/ lung sbyor rin chen 'phreng ba/ mkhan grags rdor gyi rtsod lan che chung sogs mdo sngags rnam bshad dang / cho ga'i rigs sogs ches mang yod rigs su ṭwāṃṣṭṛ ga/ kyang deng skabs dus dbang gis dkon pa ltar song ngo / de dag ni bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa khong gis rnam dkar las kyi 'khor lo yang / lha khang phyi nang gi bkod pa yongs rdzogs ches khyad can dang / gzhal yas khang sogs sku'i rten mang po dang / dus kyi 'khorolo'i rgyud dang rgyas 'grel brgya rtsa'i grangs dang / bka' bstan 'gyur sogs gsung rten khyad 'phags mang po dang / mchod rten bkra this sgo mang legs pa'i thugs rten yang mang po legs bzhengs mdzad nas sbyir rgyal b.ri 0stan pa dang khyad par nges don snying po'i rang lugs skye phan dang bde ba kun gyi ga'ir gyur spyog gcig 4rde de dus mthar snyigs 'gro'i rgud pa kun nas sel ba'i gnyen mchog tu yun ring mo'i bar dzasod namos/ mizhirji du ༵༵ pa1 spel

ba'i mdzad sgo rgya chen gnang ba'o/ /de 'dra'i rgya chen mdzad 'azin gyis bstan 'gro ring zhig tu legs par bskyangs mthar ljongs 'dir re zhig gdul bya rdzogs pa la brten gang gi dgung grangs gya drug tu son skapas pha khyim bu 'gro ba ltar gang bzhed rang dbang gis dag snang 'ba' zhig la ci dgar spyod pa'i 'od gsal nam mkha'i rnam 'byor nyag gcig gi ngang nas (spyi lo 1435 rab lo 749)shing mo yos lo'i smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin gzugs sku chos dbyings su dzim par mdzad do/ /de ltar skabs don mdzad tshul gyi rnam par thar pa nyung bsdus sa bon tsam spub pa'i rigs ldan gyi sbrul pa mdo khams smad kyi nges don bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che ba dpal dzam thang bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling chags 'debs mdzad pa po drung dka' bzhi rin chen dpal gang nyid kyis bstan chas 'azin las sgo rab tu yangs pa legs bskyangs mdzad pa'i dus skabs na dbus gtsang gi rang re'i chos sde ri khrod jo nang dpal du gdan sa mdzad 'phrin skyong mkhan 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po yin zhing / 'di dag dang dus mtshungs sa skya'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob mkhas grub dge legs dpal yab sras/ dge 'dun thub sogs dang / bod ljongs 'dzam gling gir ba rgyal dbang karma zhwa nag pa na rim drug pa mthong ba don ldan dang / bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i sku dus dang / zhwa dmar gsum pa chos dpal ye shes sogs dang / gnam bskos gong ma twa ming rabs yung lo rgyal po dang /bod kyi dbang 'dzin spu'i rgyud pa hwa wang grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs dang dus mtshungs tsam du mngon no/ /drung dka' bzhi pa khong gi thugs sras slob ma mchog gang dag gi sgrub brgyud phal che ba dang / nyid kyi sku brgyud 'ga' re dang bcas pas nges don gyi chos sde 'di ring mo nas da bar legs bskyangs kyi bka' drin mdzad sgo rgya che ba'i phul byung gi rnam thar shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas gang dag gi cha 'dir cung tsam bsdu ba la thog mar thugs slob mchog mkhas shing spub brnyes kyi skye bu chos rje rgyal ba bzang / tshes bcu rarna kyirti dang / a ge nyi ma 'od zer gsum gyi sku brgyud gang dag gis dzam thang dgon 'dir phan pa'i bya ba rgya che ba ci rigs mdzad cing / chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis kyang 'dzi stod du nges don sgrub brgyud kyi chos gzhi dang bcas bstan 'gro'i don la mdzad sgo mi dman zhing nyid kyi sku brgyud 'ga' res 'gro phan che ba byung tshul yod na'ang 'di'i lo rgyus kyi khungs rnyed dka' bas re zhig spro mi nus la/ gong ma gsum ༵dī kya/ nga ches mdzad rgya che ba ni spyal ba bzang ste/ spyir na de gsum gyi lo rgyus ci nus re 'dir yang 'god (1)chosarje sku zeng dang boskul ba bzang po/thog mar drung dka' bzhi pa chen po'i thugs kyi bu chen chos rje rgyal ba bzang gang nyid ni/ 'dzam thang gi chos gzhi 'di la ches mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar ba'i sgo du ma nas bstan 'gro la phan pa'i legs spyod rgya shinatram̐ tshe 3༵༵ spyoḍi pa rlabs po che gzhan gang gis kyang 'gran zla dang bral bas ji bzhin nges par skyong ba'i

g.yar dam nam yang mi lhod pa'i 'gro 'dren mchog gi skyes chen dam pa ni/ mdo sgad kyi char gtogs rgyal mo rongazha yul spur gnas pa'i skye bo dmu rgod dag gdul zhing du gzigs nas bzhag shod dpal mo 'dzoms zhes bya bar bzhag rwa sman rtse'i mdun gyim ngos zhes rigs rus gtsang pa'i yab rdo rje dang yum dpal mo gnyis las (spyi lo 1419 rab lo 733)sa mo phag gi lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/dgung lo brgyad tsam nas klog sogs rig gnas 'ga' sbyang brtson mthar gyin/ de nas rim pas sngon sbyangs zab mo'i mthu las chos la don gnyer gyi blo mig yongs su rgyas par brten 'dzam thang bsam grub nor bu'i gling gi chos grar phyin rte rigs ldan drag po dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi zol la brten pa drung dka' bzhi pa'i zhabs drung du bsnyegs nas gang nyid spyi bos bla mar bkur te thog mar rab byung tshig snga gyi'i sdom pa legs mnos mdzad nas mi pham rgyal ba bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ de nas bla ma mchog gi drung du thos bsam gyis zhugs te sdom gsum blang dor rab gsal spyod 'jug nas bzung mdo phyogs bka' bod lnga la rim pas gsan sbyang mthar sbyin mdzad/ de nas dbang lung zab mos rgyud sbyang bzhin dus 'khor rtsa 'grel sogs sngags kyi gzhung lugs phal mo cher bslab sbyang nan tan gyis mkhas pa'i gnas thob/ de nas rang re'i me tog lha bab kyi chos skor dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs gtso bor gyur ba'i zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag gis nyams len la gnad smin bgyis pas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gnad la thebs te sgom pa'i klong du gyur nas grub 'bras kyi rtags mtshan khyad par ba kun gyi snang ngor legs par mngon pa'i grub pa mchog gi go 'phang la slebs shing / gzhan yang bshes gnyen du ma las gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang lung man ngag bshad bka' mtha' klas pa nod de zab don nor bus thugs mjod legs spyas byas mthar/ bla ma drung pa rin po che'i bka' bzhin rgyal tshab dam pa'i khri la mnga' gsol gyi sgo nas 'dzam thang chos sde'i dge 'dun pa yongs la rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i zab bka' rgya cher bstsal cing khyad par bka' pod kyi gzhung lugs lnga'i mtshan nyid kyi 'dzin grwa btsugs te yang sgos tshad ma mdo sde bdun bcas la rtsal thon gyi rigs lam ches bzang pos mdo sngags mtha' dag gi zab gnad gting dpog pa'i lugs srol pad mo'i 'azeng ba ltar gtsang zhing dri ma med par ga dar legs 'byed kyi dgag bzhag ha cang rno bas khong la tshad ma pa rgyal ba bzang zhes grags pa'i mtshan snyan khyab brdal du song /de 'dra'i mdzad bzang gis lo 'gar chos gra bskyangs mthar snyigs dus 'dir bshad pa bas sgrub pa gtso che ba la dgongs 'dun bzhes nas ri khrod dben ri 'grim ste bya btang rnal 'byor gyi ngang tshul bzung nas thugs sgrub pa rtse gcig pa la kun nas gzhol bar gyur te/ de lugs ltar khong nyid nges med kyi sgrub gnas rnams su legs phebs mdzad nas sgrub pa la rtse gcig rim pa lhur len gyi skabs re zhig rang yul dang nye ba'i gnas shig na bzhugs pa'i dus su nyin cig khong gi sgrub gnas kyi mdun thad pha gi na pha bong zhig yod pa'i rtsar skya mi mdung dar can zhig glo bur du thon te mdung rting gis pha bong la brgyab pas de'i zhabs nas nag po zhig thon byung ba la tshig 'ga' zhig bshad nas gnyis ka gar song cha med par yal mas — 339 ge

thal ba na/ khong nyid pha bong rtsar phebs te phyag gis mtshan mar bcing ba'i rdo rjes pha bong la brda byas pas slar 'ong ba'i mi nag gnas bdag de la/ yin lugs dris tshe/ khos da gzod 'ong ba de bzhag ra sman rtses mngag pa red/ kho bo dam can mgar ba'i rigs yin pas rang la gnam lcags mas rigs cus rno ngar can bzhu brdung gi nyer mkho byed dgos pa'i bka' phebs byung ba lags/ zer bas/ khong gis de dgos pa gang gi ched red gsungs pas/ de na re sang nyin yul 'di'i sor bsrung la 'phen pa'i ched du'o/ zhes zer nas de yang mi snang bar song /skabs der yul de'i ser bsrung ba khong gi yab rig sngags la nus pa thon pa'i sngags 'chang de yin pas de la/ khong nas gsung pa/ sang nyin ser smrin 'khrigs tshe khyod kyis sngags chas myir phud de skas mgor bskon la khyod nyid rang khyim phug gi chos bka'i glig bam dag gi 'og tu gab nas sdod dang re zhig ser ba dang gnam lcags dbal zer zil che ba smrebs rjes de ma thag khyod rang phyir bud la nus pa gang drag gi mthu sbor zhig ces gsungs pa ltar phyi nyin yab kyi de lugs ltar byas nas bsdad skabs ser ba gnam lcags bcas kyis sngags chas dzorlags ste tshul de ka bzhin byung ma thag nas yab nyid phyir thon te yungs dkar sngags ma byin can mkha' la gtor bas de ma thag ser ba yang gi song /de'i phyi nyin tsam na rgyal ba bzang bzhugs gnas kyi sgrub phug sgor/ sngar gyi skya mi des 'brug cig khrid nas thon byung bas/ des na re nged ni bzhag ra sman rtses khyed kyi drung du mngag pa yin/ kha sang yul 'dir nged cag gis ser ba phabs nas ser bsrung ba gsod phyir gnam lcags 'phangs pa na/ kho bo gzhom thub snyam byas kyang / rjes nas yungs zor rbab rdo ltar des drag cing bzod dka' ba ches mang pos nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab ste nged cag gi 'khor sde gtogs par gang mang shi rmas su btang ba ma tshad bzhag ra'i sku sras kyi spyan 'bras la rdul phra mo zug pas da lan na zug bzod dkas gdung yod pas de skyob ched khyed spyan 'dren 'ong bas 'byon gnang gi zhu ba phul tshe/ khong nas de ltar zhal bzhes nas the chom med par rdzu 'phrul gyi g.yu 'brug rtsal ldan la chibs te bzhag ra sman rtse'i gnas yul phebs par mdzad tshe lam bar kun tu mi min gyi sde rigs mang po bsad rmas pa rnams gzigs te thugs snying rje byang sems kyis de dag zug rngu las legs skyob mdzad pa dang / de nas bzhag ra'i gnas kyi pho brang chen por che bsu dang gser khri la 'khod nas sku sra sa kyi spyan la gzigs che yungs rdul ha cang phra mo gog la khad pa ci yang mi gnod ltar 'dug pas khong gis phyag 'dzub kyis dka' tshegs med par bsal te bsrung ba legs skyobs byas pas bzhag ra sman rtse'i dang sku sras sman pa don grub rnam gnyis gtsor bka' blon sde rigs rnams kyi kyang mchod yon zab mo'i 'brel che ba de nas bzung dus ji srid du bka'i bsgo ba thams cad nam yang mi 'dor ba'i dam bca' phul/ khong nyid la bzhag ra'i pho brang gi phyi nang gi bang mdzod rnams kyang gzigs mor phul tshe mdzod khang mang phyogs bsang dud kyis gang 'dug pa ches nyag phra ba tsam nyams pa rtsis 'dzin gyis ser sna cher byed pas/ khong gis dud mdzod gang dag sngar las brgya 'gyur gyis legs bkang mdzad/— 340 —

de nas khong nyid rang gnas sgrub phug tu phebs te yun ring bzhugs skabs su sngar ser bas lo thog bcom pa'i skyin pa la phyis su ser ba mi gtong ba dang 'bru rigs 'bul rgyu khas blangs pa ltar de phyin yun /kā ༵ṭwāṃ /bzha/ga ra'i rtsar brag gshong du nas mang po mi su yin kyang len du yod pa kun gyi mthong thos su gyur de min ngo mtshar ba'i spub rtags dang bcas nges med kyi dben gnas rnams su sgrub pa snying por byas nas bzhugs pa ste/ snye ma'i gnas mdun du bzhugs skabs/ khong gis sngar mchod rten chen po zhig ri ngos mtho sar bzhengs pa de ma yum gyi bskor thag ring drag pas mi bde gsungs nas sku gzan gyis khur te chu khar bskor thag nye sar phab ste bzhag pa da lta'ang yod/ mchod rten 'di'i tshad med steng nas shug sdong ya mchon pa rjes sor skyes nas deng sang yod pa de chos rje'i bla shing du grags/ yang lan cig 'dzi stod du phebs te dgon leb kyi ma mthar ba g.yag mtsho zhes pa gzhung lam la yar mar rgyu 'aspul la gnod 'jigs rngam pa'i rang bzhin du yod pa de nyid mtshan gcig la chu gnas dang gnas bdag kun gyi ku co lhang lhang dang bud med kyi khyi 'bod pa sogs sgra sna tshogs dir dir sgrog pa nye 'khor na yod pa dag gi mngon sum gyis thos bzhin par lung pa de'i ngos gcig nas brgyud de lung phug gi rdza ri'i khrod du bskyil nas ba g.yag mtsho zhes deng sang lung stod rdzo ris bskor ba na yod pa 'di ga ltar dang /mtshe yar khrid pa'i shul la mtsho shul 'phongs zhes da lta'i bar du grags pa yin zhing / mtsho khrid pa'i phyi nyin shul rnams su sram la sogs pa'i chu gnas 'ga' re'i ro der gnas dag gis rnyed zer ba'i bshad srol yang yod/ yang de dang ha cang mi ring bar tsha kha'i ri btsun rdo rje drag mo rgyal gyi sgrub gnas su bzhugs skabs rnam 'phrul bkod pa'i sku rtsed kyis shar phyogs rjo ri'i rtse la mda' 'phangs pas sda ri'i rtse 'bug pa'i lam seng bu ga khra sgor ba deng skabs mthong yul du yod pa ltar dang / gnas der mtsho gcig yod pa'i nang du mar me 'od dkar kyi snang ba can gter du sbas pas nyin mtshan kun la 'phel 'grib bral ba'i dkar sgo re ba phyogs gcig na rtag par gsal 'tsher du yod pas mtsho de'i ming la da lta mtsho dkar ma zhes grags pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang pha bong thog brtsegs dang a nar dang ba g.yag mtsho gnyis rgyud gcig pa'i tshul du dngos dzas phan tshun skyel 'dren mdzad pa sogs deng skabs kyi bar du phal cher mthong yul thun mong du yod pa'i grub rtags mang po rgyal mo rong yan chod du bzhugs pa'ang yin no/ chos rje 'dis nges don sgrub rgyud kyi chos gzhi'i dgon chags 'debs mdzad pa'ang / gco bo bzhag shod kyi dgogi pa lnga zhes grags pa ste/pā la bzang ldan dgon/ khang gsar dgon/ dpal ldan bkra shis sgang / tsag dge ba dgon/ 'bo lnga 'bro'i dgon dang lnga bcas/ tsho bdun ban 'de lam lha khang dgon sogasazul rong bo kyo dang chu phug da tshang dgon bcas brgya rtsa 'debs par mdzad do/ dgon gnas de dag yis gtsos gnas so sor sku gsung thugs rten grangs mang dang / khyad par mchod rten brgya rtsa yang bzhengaspopar grags ༵4/1 nyid kyi

thugs slob yang sngar drung dka' bzhi pa'i mdun nas phan tshun mched grogs dang bu slob tu gyur pa/ tshe bcu rarna kyirti/ chos rje'i gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ khri smon bkra shis dpal/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rdo rje/ bla ma khro bcu pa/ o rgyan rin chen sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa bstan 'gro'i dpal gyur mang po byung ngo / /chos rje gang gi sku tshe smad 'di mtshams shig nas bkod pa lus kyi dzu 'phrul la ches dbang bar gyur rte gang 'dul gyi gdul bya mi dang mi min gyi mthun snang ngor gang gi thugs chos kyi sku'i rang gzugs rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i gsang gsum gyi che ba rgyan gyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i 'phrul ltar gyi rnam bkod ya mtshan pa'i dag snang mchog gi ltad mo dus rtag par bkye bas skal ba bzang po'i dpal la nges par rol pa ma lus pa'i gdul bya gang dag gi yid kyi re 'dod ji bzhin skong bar mdzad pa'i mthar nyid dgung grangs re bzhi son skabs (sbyi lo 1487 rab lo 836)chu pho stag la ches ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma kun nas bkra zhing rab tu 'bar bzhin khong nyid kyis gzugs sku'i bkod pa legs bsdus thabs tshul gyi mdzad bzang nye bar gnang ste thugs dam bzhugs bzhengs gdung chog sogs sgo gang thad nas rlabs chen 'gran zla dang bral ba'i spyod pa khyad par du 'phags ngos nas chos rje mchog gi sku dmar gdung longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas dang bcas dngul gyi mchod rten thog tshad ma sngar bzhag ra sgan rtsis kyi gnang bas rin po che gtsor bcas phra rgyan du mas nye bar mdzes pa gang gi nang gzhug tu mnga' gsol te 'gro ba gang der gnas pa thams cad la mthong tsam gyis grol ba ster ba'i bsod nams ging mchog dam par gyur pa ste/ de 'dra'i gdung rten khyad mtshar can de da lta bzhag ra sgan rtse pā la dgon du bzhugs yod pa de ka ltar ro/ /chos rje 'di dang sku thog mnyam pa ni/ sa skya'i sngags 'chang dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan/ dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i dpal gnyis/ 'dzam gling sgar ba zhwa nag sku phreng drug pa dang bdun pa gnyis dang /zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos grags ye shes/ rje'i dngos slob dge 'dun grub dang mkhas spub rje sogs dang /gong ma tā ming yung lo'i lo dang / bod rje phag gru grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs so/ 'di'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag yang rdo'i dkon rgyal nag po'i gdung brgyud dkon rgyal ba 'od zer dang / tsha ba rgyal po da ra dkon mchog skyabs sogs yin la/ chos rjes btab pa'i bzhag shod dgon lnga las/ bkra shis sgang du bstan 'dzin skyes bu phyis su byon rim bla ma mtshan legs dar rgyas zhes pa mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa byon zhing / de'i thugs sras sngags 'chang rin chen mnyam bzhag ni/ sgom stobs las grol ba ste/gdan thog gcig la rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi rtags snang yongs su rdzogs shing gcig shes kun grol gyi nus mthu mchog brnyes te las gang sgrub kyang rlung gi rnal 'byor kho nas chog pa khyad par rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sgrub pa rnam gsum dang dam can chos spyal kyi sgos sgrub bcas la rang byang tshud de las bzhi'i mdzad 'phrin gyi khyad par la dbang thob cing chos skyong nag po chen po'i sgo nas kyang bstan dgra gcod thabs sna tshogs ༵༵ bstan pa la rlabs chen gyi bya ba mdzad de bkra shis sgang du mgon khang sogs sku gsung thugs

rten mang du bzhengs/ 'di'i brgyud 'dzin yang shang dar bla ma blo bzang rgyal mtshan sogs mang du byon/tsag dgon du'ang skyes bu dam pa dge ba rgya mcho/ rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa du ma dang / sa ra dgon par bla ma dag pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs kyis mtshen de phyogs kyi dgon sde chos rje 'dis chags 'debs mdzad pa las byung ba gang dag tu phyis yin ring bar sgrub bakhyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes tshen dam pa tshes mang por byon pa'o/ /(2)chos sku zeng gnyas pargyal ba seng gede nas chos rje rgyal ba bzang gi sku 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa nas yang srid gnyis pa'i tshul byang sha la sngags rigs 'dzin pa'i zhing du sgrul pa'i chos rgyal rdo rje snying po'i drung nas bka' blon kun skyobs kyi gras blon chen kun dga' 'phags zhes bya ba'i skye ba bzhes te chos spyal gyi mdun nas zab dgu rgya mtsho lta bus rgyud legs byug mdzad cing chos rgyal mchog gi zhal snga nas blon chen khyed ma 'ongs pa na bod yul du 'gro don la phebs dgos tshul gyi lung bstan gnang / de nas mi ring bar ṭā ki gsang ba ye shes kyis bskul rkyen bod du 'gro don la mkha' 'gro khong dang mnyam du phebs lam/ u rgyan phyogs nas 'ong ba'i mkha' 'gro gri thod 'dzin pa brgyad dang phrad nas de dag gis bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa gtad de gar brna mdzad pa na blon chen rang dang 'grogs pa'i mkha' 'gros da lan bdud rtsi ma 'thung zhes pa'i brna la brten nas blon pos bdud rtsi ma bzhes/ de nas so sor phegs lam byas te mkha' 'gro gsang ba dang 'grogs nas blon rigs sngags 'chang ba nyid bod yul phyogs su pebs lam du mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i zhal nas/ da sngon khyed kyis bdud rtsi de 'thung na u rgyan du 'gro dgos pa la/ de ma 'thung bas rang cag lhan du bod phyogs su 'ong ba'i skal ba 'grig deng skabs khyed la u rgyan las bod kyi 'gro don che'o gsung / u rgyan yul nas byon pa'i mkha' 'gro'i satso mo sku mdangs dmar nag tu 'bar bas gri thod 'dzin pa can gyi zhal lung las kyang / khyed nyid 'dir bsdad na bstan 'gro'i don mi 'ong bas re zhig mdo khams su byon dang bstan 'gro la sman par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin thabs tshul sna tshogs pa'i skye srid 'ga' zhig gi mthar gu ru pad ma'i lung bstan bzhin pad ma nyid kyi rnam par rol pa las byung zhing sngon 'brel zab mos mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes dang nam yang 'bral med kyi grogs dang bcas mdo khams smad rdo rong du thugs rje'i legs smon dus su smin te don gyi yin lugs na rgyal tshab byams mgon dang 'phags pa ye shes dbang po zung gi dgongs chen gyi dbyings gcig pus bsdus kyang rnam pa mi'i sha tshugs sprul pa'i sku 'gro 'dren dam pa'i gzugs su rnam par bzhad pa ni chos kyi rje rgyal ba seng ge dpal 'byor bzang po ste/ khams phyogs 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/chos rje 'di'i sku rus yang lha'i rigs bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs sum bcu (so gsum) pa srong btsan sgam po/ de'i sras gung ri gung btsan/ de'i sras mang srong mang btsan/de'i sras 'dus srong mang rje rlung nas 'phrul gyi rgyal po'ang lce zhes grags pa de'i rigs pyas ༵༵ 3pa rngi mdo

khams smad kyi char gtogs rdo'i shug chen gyi pho brang rdo'i stag mo'i dur rdzong du rgyal khab bya mkhan sgyu zibazhir mgon rgyal nag po zhes pa de yin zhing / de'i brgyud pa stag thog gong rgyal ni rta nag gis bsrung 0 brgyan pa dang / gzugs chos kyi gos bkra ba'i sbra nag dgu stong yan gyi bdag por grags pa dang/de'i brgyud pa dkon mchog skyabs ni shar lung chen bco brgyad khri skor bcu gnyis kyi bdag por gyur rte/rdo'i rtsang chen mchod rten sogs mchod rten bcu gsum/ gser 'bum dang dngul 'bum bcu gsum ri bzhengs pa sogs khams 'dir dbang chen gyur/ 'di dus hor se chen rgyal pos 'jang gi thog tu dmag drangs skabs hor gyi las ka len/ phyi lor lo bcu dgu'i dus dbus su song ste lo bdun bcur nye tsam bsdad nas mdo smad du 'ong skabs sog dmag gi dus su sog gi las ka'ang len/ de'i gdung las chad pa ni yab skya pi le'am dkon rgyal ba 'od zer/ de dang yum dpal skyid sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su chos rje 'di nyid (spyi lo 1509 rab lo 903)u rgyan pad ma'i lung bstan bzhin sa mo sbrul lo nag zla'i tshes gsum la lhums su zhugs nas mgo zla'i tshes nyer gnyis su ltas bzang bcas bltams par grags so/ de yang sku na chung ngu nas chos la dad cing bla ma dam pa mang du mjal ba ste/ dgung grangs gsum son skabs sngags kyi chos sgor zhugs nas pad 'byung gis zhal bstan te khams gsum zil gnon du byin rlabs mdzad/dgung lo lnga rig gsum mgon po'i zhal gzigs nas ma 'ongs pa na 'gro don 'byung bar lung bstan/dgung lo brgyad du yi ge 'bri klog sogs thun mong gi rig gnas la tshegs med du mkhyen pa rgyas shing pad 'byung gis pod dbang bskur nas chos la blo mthu rgya che bar byin gyi rlabs/ dgung lo bcu'i skabs so thar gyi gzhi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos la/ dgung lo bcu gsum du thog mar tshes bcu rarna kyirti dang mjal nas chos rje'i sku skyes su ngos 'dzin mdzad pa nas bzung rim par khri ston legs byas kyi sgo nas mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i mdun nas so thar rab byung tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob cing / dgung lo bco lnga skor spub pa'i dbang phyug lcags mdud sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen du ma'i drung nas mdo phyogs bka' pod rnams dang sngags phyogs rgyud sde gang dag gi gzhung lugs la sbyang brtson ches rab mdzad skabs sngags gzhung dus 'khor rtsa 'grel bcas lan cig gsan pas dgongs don ji bzhin thugs su byang chub/ nang don mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs phal che ba khong gis gzigs pa tsam gyis don kun thugs nyams su 'khrungs/ sngar ma sbyangs pa'i thun mong rig gnas 'ga' zhig gzhan la dri ba tsam byas pas kyang ji bzhin rtogs nus pa'o / /zab chos kyi sgo nod nas nyams su blangs pa'i tshul yang / 'di skor dang snga phyi mang por rtse thog rgyal ba'i gter gnas sogs sgrub pa'i gnas chen du mar sgrub pa nyams len la gus rtag gi brtson pa lhod med shugs drag gis sgom sgrub che bar mdzad pas grub 'bras dag snang gi ngor sangs rgyas byang sems mtha' klas pa'i gzigs mor rtag par 'du 'gog res 'jog dang bral ba'i dge mtshan ngom pa sogs nang rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa sgo kun nas rnam par 'phel te rtogs ldan grub pa chen po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin — 344 —

pamachog gi go 'phang bdag gir bzhes pa'i ngang tshul gyis nye bar bzhugs shing /gzhan gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/ ches mdzad pa rlabs che ba'i sgo nas gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa ste/ de yang thog mar dgung lo bcu bdun gyi steng nas dus 'khor rgyud rgyal rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa'i dgongs don 'dus pa mang tsam la lung rigs yang dag pa'i lam nas 'ib rgyas su legs par rtsil cing de mtshams dgung lo nyer gsum par mkhan dkon spyal ba sogs kha skong dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus su tshig phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa nod de 'dul 'dzin dam pa'i mchog tu gyur pa nas bzung rim bzhin gdul bya rjes su bzung ba la dzam thang dgon 'dir sngon slob dpon padmas lung bstan pa bzhin ngur sgrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing spub pa'i rtags mnga' ba sprul pa'i sku chen po bcu gsum gyis gtsos dge 'dun 'dus pa dge tshul slong gi sde stong phrag du ma rjes su bzung ste rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i dbang lung man ngag mdo sngags gzhung lugs kyi rnam par bshad pa sogs gang thad nas mkhas dbang dang mthun pa'i chos char rgya cher legs 'bebs mdzad pa rgyun mi chad bzhin khong gis nyin re la dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od tshar re zhal 'don 'chag med sku tshe gang bo la mdzad par grags shing / de dag gi bar bar 'chad nyan gyi grwa cher skyong ba bzhag ste/ rdo'i yog gi gnam lung ri khrod/ snye ma'i gnas mdun/ bud khang dgon lung / a mgon brag sngon phug pho dri'i dgon lung gnas sogs su phebs te sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad bzhin bzhugs shing / de dag tu bzhugs skabs yul lha'i spyal po rtse lnga sogs bka' srung ci rigs la tha tshig g.yel med kyis dam bzhag dang / khyad par brag sngon sgrub phug tu bzhugs dus khong gi gser zhwa'i tog gi rjes zab mo brag gi ngos su dod pa da lta'ang mjal du yod/de las gzhi khyon phal cher dzam thang du bzhugs te chos grwa skyong bzhin rnam dkar gyi mdzad bzang che ba du ma'ang mdzad cing / skabs de dag tu gang gi thugs sras kyi gtso bo dang 'dra bar dpal gyi mtshan can bcu gsum ni/ chos rgyal gzhon nu rgyal mtshan sku skyes smon lam dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dpal/ tshes bcu ratna kyirti'i yang sprul gnyis pa rin chen dpal/ yongs 'dzin rtogs ldan grags pa 'byung gnas dpal/ rgyal rong ba nam mkha' bzang po dpal/ drung dka' bzhi pa'i yang sprul gnyis pa rin chen bzang po dpal/ lha sgang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal/ bshul yag bsod nam dpal/ a ge'i yang sprul gnyis pa nyi ma 'od zer dpal/ yo bee bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal/ rig 'dzin dge 'dun seng ge dpal/ rag khrom 'od zer rgyal mtshan dpal/ mkhan chen don yod rgyal mtshan dpal/ khang sar nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal rnams yin zhing / ga'an yang byang chub rgyal mtshan dpal/ chos kyi spyal mtshan dpal/ a ti nam mkha' dpal/ sangs rgyas dpal ldan/ lha sras grub chen dpal sogs rang lugs nges don sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang po yod la/ de las kyang ga'an yang gang gi chos kyi slob mar gyur pa bod rdzongs kyi skad grags che ba karma zha dmar na rim lnga pa dkon mchog 'bangs dang / 'dzam gling sgar ba karma zhwa nag dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje dang / gu shrī bzhi pa rgyal tshab grags pa — 345 —

don thub sogs dang / sog po'i nang so karma bla ma/ mi nyag tu bzhugs pa sa skya'i bla ma nam mkha' spyadzeematshan sogs phyogs kyi chos brgyud gzhan 'dzin pa'i skyes chen gyi slob ma yang mang tshod du 'dug go/ /chos rje 'di'i gsung chos yang zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag gi gzhan stong dris lan don bsusgrorab gsal sogs mdo sngags kyi rnam bshad mang po dang / dus 'khor rnying ba'i brgyud 'debs dkyil chog bcas sogs rgyud sde'i cho ga mang po dang / chos skyong gi bstod bskang du ma dang khyad par rong kyirti'i lha dmag gis khong gi rjes su bsnyegs pa dang nus mthu 'gran skabs thag skya'i lung khog nas thog mar khong gis rdzu 'phrul rta la chibs te pu ṭa'i bstod bskul myur ba'i las mdzad ma rta pho'i rkang 'gros dang bskun nas mdzad rjes sprul pa'i rnam bkod kyis gnas gzhan du 'añtsar te rtsal chen gdong lnga'i dbang bo la chibaspote bar snang du skug char 'thibs pa'i gseb nas rjes bsnyegs dag gis mi mthong bar byas te mkha' lam du byon bzhud mdzad pas rgyal ba seng ge zhes grags so/ /yang skor cig tu rgyal rong khro bcu'i dbu blar phebs skabs cho 'phrul gyis mkha' lam nas nyi ma bzung zhing de skabs gser zhwa ngogs pa'i nags de nyid kyi rtse mo bzang shing shug par gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag du mas 'bas 'degs byed tshul yang ches khyad mtshar ba ste/ de yang chos rje rgyal ba seng ge dpal 'byor bzang po gang gi sku tshe stod kyi dus tsam nas mdzad 'azin gyi sgo phyogs thams cad du khyab pa'i grags snyan sa skyong mi'i dbang po dag gis gsan nas rgya nag gnam skos 'jam dbyangs gong ma tā ming rgyal rabs khrin hwa rgyal po'i lung gis chos rje nyid dbu blar phebs dgos pa'i gser yig la brten nas gong ma'i rgyal sa pe cin gser mkhar ru gong ma khrin hwa nyid khrir 'khod nas lo brgyad dang zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin chos rje gang nyid der phyag phebs te gong ma rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi thugs bzhed ltar gyi zab bka' rgya che bas dgyes pa bskyed de gong ma'i bka' lung gis tā'i hran hwa wang zhes pa'i mtshan dang ba sos tham ga stag nyal 'brong rgur bcas dang g.yang ṭi'i tham ga rus sbal bcas dang gser shang shang dngul gor gor sogs bka' rtags cho lo las zhwa las gos bcas legs par gnang bar mdzad de gong ma nyid kyi phyag bris bka' yig chen mo'i nang du/ bdag gnam skos rgyal pos kyang chos rje rin po che 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma ches mchog tu 'dzin pa yin/ zhes sogs kyi bsngags brjod gus bkur rgya che ba dang / gzhan yang gnang sbyin la/ sku rten bde gsang 'jigs gsum gtso 'khor lha dgu pad sgrom can dang / thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten lha dgu ma dus 'khor thugs dkyil zab gos 'thags ma bcas dang / gong ma'i nang 'dzod nas rol chen dkar mo rgyang grags dang sil snyan nyi ma 'brug grags sogs dngos tshus khyad mtshar ba chos srid la nyer mkho'i rigs rgya che ba'i legs skyes dang bcas te bod mdo khams kyi thang chen brgyad la chos srid zung 'brel gyis mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i bla med chos kyi rgyal po chen poraka soṭwāṃ ༵nga mdo khams thang brgyad kyi mnga' bdag dang lha bsrung rtse bla lnga yis bka' ji bzhin bsgrub

pa'i yongs kyi bla ma gtsug gi nor bu gcig pur gyur pa ste/ de yang thang chen brgyad ni/ rnga ru ru thang /skong gser zha thang / 'dzi rka'i lha mo dar thang / smra se le thang / mi thag gser thang / gser sgo rgan thang / pho dre'i bye ma'i thang / pā la rje mo'i thang rnams dang / rtse bla lnga ni/ shar gyi gnyan po g.yu rtse/ṭwāṃkā ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ ga/nyan rtse/ rdo rgyal sku bla lcags rtse/ bzhag shod bzhag ra sman rtse/ mi nyag bzhag bkra lha de lta bu'i chos rje 'di'i sku tshe'i smad tsam la gnam skos gong ma wan li nas kyang gser yig pa btang ste legs skyes 'ja' sa sogs kyi las ka gnang sbyin dang bcas pas brtsi bkur che mdzad/ gzhan yang chos rje 'di nyid sog po'i rgyal po yongs shu'i bu dus bying gis gdan 'dren zhus te gus pas bla mar legs bkur mdzad nas rgyal ba mi pham mgon po zhes mtshan gsol zhing dngul srang lnga bcus legs bsgun tham ga dang bka' yig sogs kyi gnang sbyin mdzad/ sog rgyal a sbal dang / be thu spyal po chin rgyal sogs kyis kyang gus bkur bcas kyis zhabs tog legs po byas nas nang so karma lha khang gi karma bla ma sogs grwa slob yon bdag kyang cher mang / zi lang mkhar bdag sogs rgya sog bod kyi che dgu 'bangs sde kun gyi gus 'dud zhus shing skyes 'bul mang por mdzad/ byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal po dang / lho phyogs yun nan 'jang sa dam rgyal po dag gis gdan 'dren gyi sgo nas dbu blar bkur te bka' yig sogs kyi 'ja' sa gnang / btsan lha bdag chen spyal po dang chu chen rab brtan rgyal po sogs khong dang sku thog mnyam pa'i sa dbang ches mang pos bkur ste legs skyes de lugs bzhin mdzad/ nang gi bstan pa'i gnyer kha ba bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud tsha ba rgyal po'i rigs rus las byung ba rang re'i nges don sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la zhabs 'degs byed pa de dus mang tsam byung ba sogs phyi nang gang thad la lugs gnyis kyi dbang cha ches kun nas mtho bar gyur to/ /rnam dkar mdzad sgos rten bzhengs dang chos sde btab tshul khyad par ba yang dzam thang du khong nyid kyis bzhugs gnas gzims khang bde chen bshad sgrub dpal gyi pho brang gsar bsgrun mdzad de der gang gi zhabs pad chos khrir 'khod de/ yongs kyi 'dus sde mang chogs gyi bzhugs gnas lha gsar nges don bshad sgrub gling yang gsar bzhengs dang / khyad par rgyal ba'i rten khang chen mo yongs rdzogs bzhengs grub pa'i nang rten gyi gtso bo ston pa dgung grangs bcu drug pa'i tshad zangs gser las bsgrun pa mtho tshad thog tshad gsum yod pa'i mgrin pa yan chad rang byung legs 'khrungs kyi khyad mtshar can nang bzhugs byin ldan bcas dang / rgyab phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas thog tshad phyed gnyis dang / sgo'i g.yas g.yon du phyag rdor mi g.yo ba bcas bzhengs pa nang gi legs bris cha tshang bcas grub pa dang / rten khang de'i g.yas su byams khang nang byams pa gtsor thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong /nyer sras baspyad/ rta mgrin lcags ral can sogs thog tshad phyed gnyis pa nang gi spyang ris bcas dang /de nas rim par mgon khang du gur mgon lcam dral cha tshang dang / 'al bzhi pa/ rnam sra~X/47'jigs

mdzad/ phyag drug pa sogs gyang ris sna tshogs bcas pa ste/ rten khang g.yon gyi lha khang du rdo rje 'amatha/kun mkhyen dol po/ drung dka' bzhi pa sogs bla brgyud 'ga'/ gzhan yang gos yug du mas 'dra 'tshem drub ma byams chen lha mgron 'ga' dang bcas pa'i gos thang rgya dpangs shin tu che ba thog tshad magle po can dang / dam can chos rgyal gyi zab thang khyad mtshar phul du byung ba/ de'i sgrul rgyan bzhag ra snan rtsis phul bar grags pa'i mi'i lag bzo las 'das pa'i bzo khyad can/ de min zab thang du ma dang/rgya gar shar nub kyi gser sku li ma mang po dang bal po rgya nag ma'i gser sku rdor 'chang / byams pa sogamidang / dus 'khor 'jigs mdzad sogs rgyud lde'i gser sku bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang phyogs so so nas spyan drangs te mchod khang du bzhugs su gsol ba dang khyad par nang rten du byang sems chos 'phags kyi tshems dang dbu thod khyad mtshar can dang / bla ma sa skya pa'i thugs sras rga a gnyan dam pas rgya gar dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas spyan drangs par grags pa'i srug ldan ma hā ka la gur mgon gyi sku brnyan ches ngo mtshar can zhal mdog 'gyur zhing zhal nas khrag rlangs 'bab pa'i byin can khong dang 'bral med kyi thugs dam rten sogs mang por bzhugs la mgon sku 'di 'dra ni sngon rgya nag gi byang shar grong hrin yang zhes pa na gcig bzhugs zhes thos pa ma gtogs 'dzam gling na de 'dra dkon par grags so/ /gsung rten yang rgyal ba'i rten khang du thub pa'i sku brnyan g.yas g.yon du bka' dang bstan bcos rgya gar nas bod du gang 'gyur tshad kyi glegs bam gsor dang dngul gyi khu bas legs bris byas pa dang / thugs rten yang 'dzam thang du mchod rten chen mo phyogs rer 'dom brgyad re yod cing lha khang gsum re dang bas steng 'og tu sgo khang du mas mdzes khyad yongs su rdzogs par/ gzhan yang sa skya'i bla ma nam mkha' rgyal gyis chos rje nyid 'ba' lha sgang du gdan 'dren zhus skabs rnam rgyal mchod rten phyi nang gi bkod pa yongs rdzogs bzhengs par bskul te legs grub kyi dus su nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad skabs mchod rten gyi dbus su nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu 'khyug
