cing nam mkha' nas mkhar rnga dang dril bu 'khrol ba lta bu'i sgra gdangs snyan pa der gnas skye bo dag gis mthong su gyur par ngo mtshar dge mtshan che ba dang / de la sogs gnas so sor mchod rten brgya dang bcu gsum bzhengs par grags/de skabs chos rje gang gi srid dbang gi che ba'ang mgo log gi dpon phag thar gyi bu 'bum yag padma 'bum 'dzi rka stod snad thams cad kyi sde kun sa cha de'i bdag po byas pas padma 'bum tshad zhes grags/padma 'bum gyi bu nag thar gyis chen po gdong mkhar mgo nag ma'i gser 'bum po ti bcu drug ma bris te/des rab gnas la dzam thang chos rje gong ma dang / ri khrod pa dge ba rgya mtsho gnyis gdan drangs te/'bul chen la/ 'dzi rka'i myi nag shos mda' man chad dang / bse mda' yan chod kyi sa cha dang grwa ba rnams dang rwa dzong pho brang dbang sdud rab brtan rnam rgyal rtse ches khyad yongs su rdzogs par phul nas/de'i nang khong nyid kyi nang srid sku tshab dbon bkra shis rgya mtsho dang phyag mdzod rgyal ba dpal sogs lugs gnyis la rnam daphyod kyi sgo yangs pa du mas gtsos che rgu drung 'khor ches mang gis mnga' 'og gi 'bangs sde — 348 —

kun la chab srid lhag par snyoms pas mtho dman thams cad la phan pa'i legs sgo ji bzhin ster ba'i srid dbang dang bcas te mdun thang shog khang zer ba der phyogs nas 'ong ba'i dpya khral bsdu gnas su mdzad cing mdo smad thang chen brgyad la'ang spyi rdzong brgyad dang sa mdo re la rdzong phran re dang bcas de dag kun la rdzong bdag las tshan pa bsko bzhag mdzad pa sogs srid kyi dbang cha ches dar ba'i kha rjes dpal kha nye bar thob pa ste/ 'di'i sku dus su sku gong ma'i rgyal ba bzang gi dgon pa brgya chags 'degs mdzad pa'i nang lha yag dgon pa khong gis zhig gsos mdzad skabs su slar yang dgon pa brgya dang bcu gsum chags 'debs dam bca' byas pas dgon lag yang / smra lcags ri 'od 'bar dgon/ rdo'i lha khang sum mdo/rdo stod dgon gsar bkra shis gling / rdo smad dar rgyas chos rdzong dgon/ rag khrom dgon/ ljags mda' dgon/ nyig rje dgon/ 'ba' lha sgang dgon/ lho cog steng dgon/ 'ob gangs dkar dgon/ rgyal kha bkra shis gling gi thub bstan bshad sgrub gling / sog yul karma lha khang dgon/ smra lha khang sum mdo/ 'dzi ka'i lha khang thang gi dgon pa sogs dgon ma lag brgya dang bcu gsum btab pa de dag tu rten gsum khyad mtshar can du ma re dang bcas rlabs po che'i byas rjes rgya che ba mdzad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i mdzad 'phrin zla dang bral bas bstan 'gro yun ring bskyangs pas/ chos rje khong nyid 'di 'tshams skor nas sa skyar phebs te yun cung ring tsam bzhugs nas slar yang rang gi gdan sar phebs pa na dgung grangs bdun cu tsam la smrebs ma thag tsam ste khong gi thugs sras dag la zab bka' ri gnang rjes lo gnyis su byang phug rdo rje gdan du sgrub pa la bzhugs nas nyid dgung grangs don gnyis su (spyi lo 1508rab lo 10 19)lcags pho 'brug lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad nyin gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu tshul mdzad cing / gang thugs chos dbyings su thim skabs mkha' la 'ja' 'od sna tshogs pas gang ste/ sa rnam pa drug g.yos shing nam mkha' las me tog gi char babs pa dang dus tshigs legs par 'jam pa sogs dge mtshan rnam par bkra ba'i mdzad sgo rgya cher gnang zhing / skal ldan gyi thugs slob dag gi snang ngor/bla ma chos rje gang nyid mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas mu rgyan du gshegs pa dang / gzhan yang ngur smrig 'chang ba'i dge slong gi gzugs dang / spub pa'i dbang phyug gi rnam rol la sogs pa dag snang tha dad kyi sgo sna tshogs pa'i gzigs snang du ma byung la/ de nas sku gdung rin chen gyi phung po gang de bsod nams kyi bsags sgo rgya chen zla dang bral bas zhag du mar gdung chog rgya kun nas mnyam pa med pa'i tshabs chen 'dus pa stong phrag du mas legs bgyis kyi sgo nas rnam par dkar rten de nyid chas bzang pos nye bar klubs bzhin nang gzhug byin rten khyad 'phags bcas mchod rten ba'i bsod nams mtha' yas pa'i ngang gdung zangs gser las sgrun pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra rgyan gyis nye bar sprus pa'i mtho khyad thog tshad ma'i nang du sku dmar gdung bzhugs su gsol te rgyal ba'i rten khang steng gi gtsug lag khang du mchod bkod kyis bsod nams zhing du legs bzhugs mdzad do/ /de ltar mdo khams dbang bsgyur yongs kyi 'dren pa chen po chos rje rgyal ba seng ge dpal 'byor bzang — 349 —

po gang gi sku tshe'i stod tsam dang thog mnyam pa ni jo nang dpal du rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bzhug skabs dang / sa skya'i sngags 'chang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / nam mkha' bkra shis gyejomatshan/ 'dzam gling sgar ba rgyal dbang karma zhwa nag brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ de'i sku skyes dgu pa dbajo phyug rdo rje rim par byon pa gnyis dang / zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag dang / stag lung thang pa brgo shis dpal bzang gi sku dus dang / sngags rnying phyogs kyi gter chen padma gling pa/ mang ris rig 'dzin legs ldan rje/ thugs sras byang bdag bkra shis stobs spyas sogs dang / dge lugs phyogs kyi 'bra spungs sprul pa'i sku dge 'dun rgya mtshe/ de'i yang sprul bsod nams rgya mtsho dang bsod nams phyogagagyi glang po dang / dbeen sa blo bzang don 'grub sogs kyi dus tsam dang snga phyi ci rigs dus mtshungs shingakabod smongs srid 'dzin rin sbrungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal sku mched kyi dus tsam du gsal/ chos rje 'di'i sku tshe smad mdzad pa rdzogs pa'i dus mtshams su rang re'i jo nang du rje btsun rin po che tā ra nā tha nyid sku 'khrungs nas dgung grangs drug tsam gyi steng du slebs pa dang / gtsang stod rgyal po zhang shag pa kaza tshe brtan rdo rjes bod kyi srid dbang bzung nas lo bcu lhag tsam song bar mngon no/ /(2)chosatsā sku phreng gsumapa bonage gingapa'amakun dga' thub bstanasgyul mtshan seng ge/rgyal ba seng ge 'das nas lo 'ga' shas song rjes su sprul pa'i sku phreng gsum pa bod ljongs dbuspogatsang phyogs kyi bon re shing gi sku skyes kyi lo rgyus ni/ sku 'di nyid 'khrungs yul stod dbus gtsang gi mnga' ris kyi char gtogs gtsang byang gi mtshams bon re shing zhu tshang zer ba'i gnas yul de yin cing /sku skyes de 'khrungs nas lo bcu lhag skor tsam na gnas tshul de lugs chos rjes gsan nas ched mngags grwa rigs nang so kun dga' bkra shis sogs dang / mdo khams nyig rje dgon gyi ka bzhi rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sku skyes 'khor bcas dang / a mdo ba kun dga' lhun grub sogs jo nang dpal du rje btsun tā ra nā tha bzhugs pa'i sku drung du phyin te bon ri shing gi sku skyes dzam thang chos rje'i yang sprul yin min gyi thugs rtags zhus tshe/ rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas de rgyal ba seng ge'i yang sprul yin kyang 'dzam thang phyogs la phan thog mi yong gsungs kyang / khams phyogs nas 'ong ba de dag gis sku skyes yin nges la blo gtad byas nas re thing sku skyes nyid blus nas jo nang du khri ston mdzad de rje btsun las shis brjod me tog 'thor ba bcas dang sku skyes gzhon nu chos grwa la legs 'jug mdzad pa'i bka' drin kyang zhus/ rje btsun khong nas de lugs ltar gyi so thar bsnyen rdzogs bcas kyi sdom pa dang rang lugs kyi zab bka' dus 'khor dbang yongs rdzogs sbyor drug myong khrid/ ni gu'i chos bka' cha tshang / thams cad rig pa'i dbang lung / blo sbyong khrid lung bcas sogs nyer mkho'i zab bka' du ma legs gnang mdzad/ 'di dus su rtag brtan dam chos gling gsar 'debs kyi skabs dang rje btsun yang dgung grangs bzhi bcu lhag tsam yin/ /de nas re shing sku skyes 'khor bcas khams phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te chas pa na bod gyi srid gtsang stod rgyal pos bzung skabs yin zhing / zhang shag pa'i spun sde kun spangs drung dang / zhang shag pa rang — 350 —

gi bu chung ba/ sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ 'bring ba mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ che ba kam bstan basbung rnams yin zhing / de las sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis bod smongs kyi chab srid yongs rdzogs la mnga' dbang bsgyur te rje btsun rin po che'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag che ba mdzad skabs yin pas sde srid nyid rgyal sa pho brang bsam 'aspub rtser bzhugs pa'i dus der rgyal ba seng ge'i sku skyes dpon slob chibs bsu dang gdan 'dren bcas kyis chos bka' ci rigs zhus shinga'abul ba gzab ldan dang mdo khams chos kyi rgyal po'i 'ja' sa bka' yig sogs kyi gnang snyin kyang mdzad/de nas dgung lo nyer brgyad steng rim par gtsang bkra shis lhun po dang / thub bstan gser mdog can dang / lha sar ra mo che sogs la rim pas mjal zhing khams phyogs su phebs chas mdzad pa na 'bri gung du thon tsam la sku skyes bskung bas tshur log ste skyid shod brag dkar du gzugs sku'i me tog 'phral du yal lo/ de nas sku 'khor dag gis dgongs rdzogs kyang legs sgrub mdzad cing / 'di dus su sa skya'i sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan bkra shis/ de'i sras kun dga' rin chen/ zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug dang / dge lugs la paṇa chen chos kyi spyal mtshan sogs kyi sku dus dang / stag lung sdu /ga / /ma ṭwāṃ shā sdo // da/bang rnam spyal sogs dang / gnam skos gong ma tā ming wan lis khri bzung ba'i (4)chosarje sku zeng bzhi ba grags pa 'od zer/sprul sku 'di ni mdo khams lho phyogs 'ba' khog stod sde dge'i yul smad tshab tsha'i brgyud la rab byung dgu pa'i shing byi (1513 )lor wa shul gyi ras su 'khrungs/ sku bltams pa'i de ma thag zhal gsung las/nga ni dzam thang spyal ba seng ge'i sku skyes yin zhes gsungs bzhin zhal 'dzum pa'i ngang spyan hrig hrig gis byang phyogs su gzigs par mdzad ces grags/ de nas lo shas song mtshams su de lugs kyi grags snyan dzam thang chos rjes gsan te drung dka' bzhi pa'i yang spul gnyis pa rin chen dpal bzang sogs sku 'khor yongs rgyas bcas rdo gser shul gsum brgyud nas rim pas 'ba' li thang phyogs su mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bzhugs yul du phebs te dngos rjos 'bul ba sogs dang bcas lhan rgyas zla gcig tsam bzhugs mthar sprul pa'i sku nyid sku dbon rab dkar sogs kyi phebs skyel bcas rim pas legs phebs mdzad nas 'dzi ka'i lha mo dar thang du slebs skabs bsu bkod rgya che ba'i sgo nas dgung grangs thog dpal 'dzam thang chos rje'i pho brang du khri ston legs rgyas mdzad/ de nas rim par chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi yang sgrul dam pa'i drung nas klog yig sogs rig gnas bslab sbyang mdzad/ de rjes lo shas nas drung dkaspru ba'i pa'i yang sprularṣarin chen dpal bzang sogs kyi mdun nas so thar dge bsnyen sngon du 'gro ba'i rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom 0zhus/ mtshan rgyal ba grags pa 'od zer du gsol/ de nas bzung jo nang pa rang lugs kyi zab bke' dus 'khor gyi dbang lung man ngag bskyed rdzogs bcas dang gzhan yang rgyud cedu ma'i zab chos yurnatshoring bar3 ṭwāṃ spyad cing /

a ge'i sku skyes nyi ma 'od zer dpal gyi drung nas blo spyong / sdom gsum spyod 'jug sogs sbyang brtson mi dman pa byas/ de'i skabs tsam a ge'i sku skyes kyis tshe bcu smad du pho brang bzhengs nas nang du sku gsungs thugs rten gyi gang bar mdzad/ grags pa 'od zer nyid rim bzhin spyor ba yan lag drug mthar phyin cing / de rjes mi ring bar jo nang rtag brtan nas rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i dngos slob mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal 'dzam thang 'dir chags phebs mdzad nas gang drung du grags pa 'od zer khong gtsor a ge'i sku skyes dang / bla ma don yod dborte/ rab dkar sogs kyis zhus ngor tshe dbang / rta mgrin/dus 'khor dbang chen yongs rdzogs/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi zab khrid rgyas pa bcas sngar dam po 'debs pa'i srol mi 'dug kyang 'di dus nas dam po lag len zhib par gnang ste tshul de ka ltar phyag bzhes gnad du khel nges mdzad/ de min yang blo gros rnam rgyal gyi drung nas chos rje 'dis yi dam lha'i rjes gnang dang rdor 'phreng sogs rgyud sde mang po'i zab pa'i dbang bka' zhus shing / bsnyen rdzogs yang de nas zhus/ de 'dra'i tshul gyis lo bcu gnyis bar gtsang blo gros rnam rgyal khams phyogs su bzhugs nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad rjes yang dbus gtsang du phebs so/ /de nas chos rje 'dis thugs dam mthil yan lag drug gi rnal 'phyor nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad nas mun khang du sgrub pa kho na la gzhol bas yan lag drug gi rang rang lam rtags khyad par can gyi drod tshan la gdengs tshud cing / mi lam 'od gsal gyi snang bar thub pa chen pos chos kun gyi bdag por bskos pa dang / jo bo rje dang / kun mkhyen dol po pa/ drung dka' bzhi pa sogs brgyud ldan bla ma rnams zhal gzigs kyi snang ba yang yang byung nas thugs gnas lugs mchog gi dgongs klong rdol te/ yi ge drug ma dung phyur gcig dang gyed lngags bzlas mdzad cing gshin gyi 'gro don yang rdo 'dzi smra gsum/ rnga rong sde lnga/spyal mo tsha ba rong sogs kyi skye 'gro gson gshin mtha' dag la rlabs chen gyi phan bde spel te mdzad bzang gis kun la snyoms pa'i brtse gzigs nam yang ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro don rgya chen mdzad skabs su spub pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rlabs mtho bas me chu g.yang sa sogs 'byung ba'i gnod pa gang gis glags mi rnyed cing 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor chen pos 'jigs pa gang la'ang bag tsha ba med pa'i mi 'jigs pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa zhig ste/gang gis rnam dkar gyi mdzad sgo yang rang re'i bstan dgon 'dzam thang gi lha gsar rnam rgyal gling gi 'du khang sogs gtsug lag khang nyams pa gang dag slar gso dang / sku rten byams pa'i zab thang gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / gsung rten yang rin chen gser dngul gyi khu bas bka' chos sha chung ma zhes grags pa sogs gsung rab du ma legs par bzhengs pa dang / khyad par thugs rten ngo mtshar ba rgyal kha bkra shis gling gi rtag brtan mchod rten zhes jo nang sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo'i chags tshul dang mthun pa nang du lha khang brgya rtsa can ches ya mtshan pa mdo smad du 'gran zla bral ba'i rten mchog khyad par ba gsar bskun mdzand+ra pa ༵༵sa dang / gzhan yang de skabs su 'dzam thang 'dir 'dus pa ches mang pos dbang lung

sbya kāṭwāṃ rsha/kā / trī drirdo ri/ ma/ gnyis kyi zab mo nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i sgo gtsang dag kho na kun gyi yid smon khong gi mdun nas chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa yang ches mang zhing / skabs der bstan pa'i snyin bdag yang gnam skos 'jam dbyangs gong ma tā ming rabs khrin krun gyis srid khri bzung ba'i mjug tsam la gong ma nyid nas chos rje 'di'i drung du gser yig pa sngon bzhin mngags te bka' yig dang kān tang gi thi'i las kas cho lo 'ja' sa sogs gnang sbyin dang bcas gus bkur che ba mdzad cing / bod sngongs yongs kyi mnga' bdag gtsang stod rgyal po sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi sku sras kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'am karma bstan skyong dbang po zhes su grags pa gang gis yang khong la 'ja' sa sogs legs skyes gnang /khams phyogs 'di'i rdo'i wa shul dpon yab sras dang / bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud tsha ba spyal po sangs rgyas 'bum sogs sku thog dang mnyam pa'i sa chen skyong ba gang dag gis bla mar bkur te khong dgungs grangs drug cu re gnyis tsam nas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te gshegs mchod dgongs rdzogs gdung rten bcas legs grub bgyis so/ /'di'i sku tshe'i stod tsam na sa skya'i sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / rjes sor rim pas de'i sras sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams byon pa dang / chos rje'i sku tshe stod du/ 'dzam gling sgar rgyal dbang karma zhwa nag bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar drug pa'i sku tshe'i smad tsam dang /go thi lnga pa mi pham grags pa mchog dbyangs/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal grub/ 'bras spungs sprul sku blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs dang / bod kyi chab srid dbang 'dzin gtsang pa rgyal po kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po dang / sku sras rgyal bu dbang chen dpal 'bar sogs kyi dus yin na'ang rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags sprul lor dus kyi 'pho 'gyur che ba byung ba'i dbang gis chos rje 'di'i sku tshe smad tsam la bod gtsang pa rgyal po'i srid dbang nyams pa nas bzung karma pa sogs re zhig bod ljongs nas gzhan du phebs song zhing / 'di dus bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel la dbang mdzad pa po ni sngar 'bras spungs sprul sku blo bzang rgya mtsho gang la sog gi las ka mtho ba'i srid dbang gi go sa gnang nas de phan du rgyal dbang gong sa lnga pa chen po zhes yongs kyi bla mar bkur ba de nyid yin zhing / 'di nas bzung bod ljongs su spyir na bka' brgyud karma gam tshang gi bstan pa cha lag bcas la chag 'jig che ba dang de'i zhor byung du rang re'i bstan pa'i chos gzhi sogs kyang chag god kyi sgo rim pas byung bar brten chos srid de dag kyang da bar du nyams je rgud du song ba 'di ka ltar ro/ de dus su paṇa chen yang blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan kyi sku tshe'i snad dang / blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang 'khrungs tsam dang / zhwa dmar bdun pa'ang 'khrungs tsam dang / gong ma chin rabs drun kru'us srid bzung ba'i dus su mngon no/ /(5)chos skuzeng lnga btwal ba dzin grubagragasab/chos rje 'di nyid rgyal mo rong go spyal zhes pa'i yul du rshang stag lor bya smad ces shaṃ'i ṭwāṃhūṃs rus su

yum gyi mngal nas dar dkar lta bu'i phru ma'i sbungs nas sku mngon par bltams ma thag zhal nas gri khyi'i gsang sngags kyi sgra dag gsal can lan 'ga' gsungs/ de nas cher bskyed de dgung lo gsum tsam na rno la zhabs rjes gsal por bzhag de nas rim pas glog sogs rig gnas 'ga' la sbyang ba mdzad/dgung lo dgu lon dus 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon pos zhal bstan te sku las 'od zer spros pa gzhon nu khong la thim bzhin zhal nas/ 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig ces pa'i lung bstan gnang /dgung lo bcu gsum gyi dus su chos rjes sku bdag byas pa'i khri ston legs rgyas mdzad/ yi dam lhag pa'i rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi bsten sgrub tshad ldan byas pas lha'i gsal snang brtan pa'i dngos grub kyang thob/chos rje'i sku dbon dam pa sogs kyi mdun nas thun mong so thar gyi sdom pa zhus te/ mtshan rgyal ba kun grub grags pa zhes gsol nas kun masgon jo nang pa'i rang lugs dus 'khor gyi dbang lung man ngag bshad khrid mtha' dag gsan te rim gnyis lam gyi chos tshul sbyang brtson gyis nges pa ji bzhin 'drong bar byas nas dgung lo bcu bdun skabs nas bzung dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gnad khel nyams len gyis rtogs pa klong du gyur te rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings nas chos nyid stong pa'i gzugs kyi snang cha ches gsal ba la nar son par byas pas ma dag pa bem po gdos bcas kyi khams dag pa sgyu ma'i lus kyi lha sku rags pa dus 'khor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam can du gnas 'gyur te lcags khams la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis gser du bsgyur ba bzhin ma dag bem tshus dag chen stong gzugs kyi skur bar bar du rang gzhan thun mong gi mthun snang ngor rang snang la rnam bkod ches gsal zhing gzhan dag gis ji bzhin blta bar mi nus pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur 'gro ba can zhig ste 'di skabs nas kyang rtogs pa phul du byung ba mnga' brnyes shing /de mtshams skor re zhig nas khong gis rang re'i nges don sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa sgo kun nas ches spel ba la dgongs bzhed mdzad nas gtsang grub chen cha lung sku dbon gang 'dzom zhig khams phyogs su bstan don la phebs dgos tshul gyi snyan zhu legs 'bul gyi pho nya btang nas cha lung ba khong nyid phebs kar ma 'dzom sa kyang sku dbon gatreng ngag dbang rnam rgyal khams 'dzam thang du gdan drangs nas thog mar chos rje go rgyal ba khong gis gtsang ba dpon slob la tshe dbang dang sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis kyi dbang bka' yongs rdzogs sogs zab chos du ma gnang nas chos kyi spyal po mnga' gsol te nyid kyi gzims khang bde ldan pho brang du bzhugs su bcug nas khong gis bla mar bkur te dus 'khor dbang chen dang / sbyor drug gi zab khrid cha tshang /rin 'byung / rdor 'azeng / mi dra baspya rtsa/ de nyid lnga pa sogs dbang lung man dag ches mang po gsan/go rgyal ba khong nyid kyi bzhugs gnas gsar pa zur du bla brang khang gsar rnam rgyal gtsang pa'i mdun nas chos zhu ba dang / rang gi gzims khang du mtshams sgrub mdzad pa dus mnyam pa'i bkod pa cig char ba nye gnas dag gis bar bar mthong chos su gyur pa'i rnam par sprul ba dus dus su ston pa sogs mdzad bzang de 'dra'i ngang nas re zhig bar gnas mthar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mtshungs med rin chen mnyam bzhag gi mdun drung nas rdo je 'jigs byed kyi chos skor dbang lung man ngag spyi dang khyad par rwa ba'i snyan bhe 354 —

brgyud dang bsnyen chen gyi gdams pa sogs lha 'di'i zab khyad du ma go rgyal ba rang gis zhus pa bzhin gnang ste/ chos rje khong gis de lugs bzhin bsnyen sgrub mdzad skabs bsnyen chen gyi sdas sna bya bzhad kyi sha ma rnyed pa la nyin gcig khong gi sgrub khang gi nye skor du bya bzhad cig 'ong nas shi ba'i ro rnyed pas rdzas sna tshang bar byung zhing / de ltar dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi bskyed rim sgrub pa rnam gsum la lan gsum yang bskyar mdzad de nan tan chen po'i sgo nas zla ba bco brgyad du bsnyen sgrub gzab ldan kha skong las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bcas mtha' rgyas 'grub rtags khyad par ba dang bskyed rim la ches gdengs tshad brnyes sheng 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rdzogs rim kros bral rnal 'byor gsum gyi rim pas rlung sems kyi dwangs ma gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs las mkha' la skar tshogs ltar rtsol med rang shar gyi don dam zung 'jug nges pa don gyi 'jam dpal khro bo'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i sku rim pas ji bzhin mngon du bya ba'i nye lam la dbang 'byor te mngon rtogs mchog gi rtser son/'di skabs rjes thob thun mtshams kyi dus su khong nyid 'jigs byed rwa rtse la me 'bar ba'i sku dngos su bar bar nye dag gis mthong nas 'jigs zil bzod dka' bas skrag 'jigs kyis sku mdun nas phyir bros pa yang mang du byung ba grags skad/ de nas bzung 'dzam thang pa la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bka' babs par grags pa ltar don la'ang gnas shing nyid kyis hrīkhyi dung phyur ljags bzlas mdzad pa dang khyir na'ang ma rungs 'tshe ba'i rigs kyi srog la mnga' dbang bsgyur zhing yang sgos su lho kha'i rgyal gdon gyi kha gnon du bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa ma zad nyid mnyam bzhag las thabs mi mkhas pas bslangs na tshe'i gegs su gyur cing / khong gi sgrub chas na bza' mthong ba tsam kyis kyang rgyal gdon 'gog par byed thub pa'i nus mthu che zhing / nyid thugs slob yang bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ snying po rab 'byams/ kun dga' ye shes sogs gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa nus mthu mchog mnga' ches mang po byon/go rgyal ba nyid kyis rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi rnal 'byor mchog la mnga' brnyes pa nas bzung 'dzam thang sgar khag rnams su lha 'di'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i gtor sgrub zor gyi las mtha'abacas kyis sku rim da lta'i bar du byung la/ 'di skor ci rigs su sog dmag gi dus zing byung skabs khong nyid kyis yi dam rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi drug cu'i lcags mkhar bsgrub pas zor rtse la me 'bar ba sogs tshams rngam 'jigs zil che ba dang bcas te gtor zor 'phangs pas pha rol dgra rnams la ltas ngan gyi mtshan ma dang nang 'khor byung bas dmag nang 'thor dkrugs kyis kha bral nas dus kyi dmag dpung zlog par mdzad pa dang / yang lan cig khro skyabs kyi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa rtsang rong phyogs nas sngags rgan bu ra le zer ba'i sngags 'chang phur pa'i rnal 'byor la mnga' brnyes pa zhig yod pa de dang mthu nus 'gran tshe kho bos mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten phur de ye shes lha'i byin rlabs la brten nas skad cig gis nam mkha'i dbyings nas mngags te chos rje go rgyal ba'i sku thog tu slebs tshe khong gis 'jam dpal khros pa'i skur bzhengs te phur bu'i mthu stobs zil gyis mnan bzhin phur bu de nyid phyag tu bzhes nas rten phur du byin — 355 —

gyis rlabs pa da lta rten khrod du yod pa 'di ka ltar ro/ de sogs mthu nus ches khyad par ba'i mnga' bdag zhig ste khong la bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs zhu ba po yang gnam skos gong ma chin rabs khang shis spyal po hri tsu'us kyang bla mar che bkur gyi sgo nas bka' yig tham ka sogs kyi 'ja' sa gnang / sog po shog thu'i ji spyal po'i lung gis mngon par mtho ba'i 'ja' sa yang gnang / khams phyogs 'dir yang rdo'i 'bum skyabs yag gis bstan pa'i sbyin bdag byas te chos gzhi phul zhing / a skyong mi dbang bstan 'dzin drung gis yang bla mar bkur nas de phyogs su jo nang pa'i chos tshul rgyas par byas shing / gzhan yang rdo 'dzi smra gsum/ rnga rong sdesnga/ spyal rong rgyal khag rnams nas kyang gus bkur gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag che bar mdzad/khong nyid sku tshe smad tsam la rdo stod dgon gsar bkra shis gling du rgyun bzhugs lta bur mdzad nas rdo'i 'bum skyabs yag la zab bka' du ma gnang bzhin chos kyi sbyin bdag dang slob mar yang wa shul dpon de nyid gyur te ches dad gus dang bla blag sngar las 'phel zhing / 'di skor ci rigs su khong nyid rdo'i gnam lung ri khrod du'ang khor tsam bzhugs nas mtshams sgrub mdzad la/ de mtshams shig nas chos rje khong 'dzi rka'i smad kyi char gtogs snye ma'i gnas lung byang chub rtser gzims khang dang bcas phar yun ring sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i tshul gyis rgyun bzhugs mdzad skabs gnas der rdo la zhabs rjes gsal po dang gdugs shing gi rjes de lugs ltar gyi ya mtshan pa rdo ngor bzhag pa sogs grub pa'i rtags kyi mtshan ma ches mang po mthun snang du da dung mjal du yod ces grags skad/'di skor ci rigs su 'dzi rka'i lha mo dar thang du sog rgyal bya sna can gyi dmag dpung lhags te chos rje la gtug 'ong dgos tshul gyi bka' phebs drag po'i sgo nas chos rje dang sog rgyal mjal 'phrad kyi skabs chos rje nyid rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sku'i rnal 'byor bzhengs pa'i gzi brjid sog rgyal gyis ma bzod nas khong nyid khri steng nas lhung ste sa la 'gyel nas bla srog phrogs te snying la gzer nad kyis she bas bstan pa la ldang ba tshar bcad de chag sgo che ba dang bcas sog dmag rnams phyir log de rjes su chos rje khong gi sbyin bdag mgo log nag thang zer ba sngar sog dmag gis bsad pa'i dge rdzogs su mchod rten nag rgyag zer ba bzhengs skabs su de'i 'og tu sog rgyal gyi ro dum mnan pa dang / de'i glo snying phyung ste 'dzam thang khang dmar mgon khang du pu ṭa'i phyag tu bzhes yod pa dang / der ma zad sog rgyal gyi rta yi ske 'khor sogs chas 'ga' re da lta'i bar du mgon khang der yod pa mngon gsal ltar ro/ /'di'i rnam dkar gyi bya ba rten bzhengs yang go rgyal bka' chos su grags pa gser dngul gyis—bzhengs pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten yang mang tsam du bzhugs/ 'di yan la 'dzam thang dgon yang grong nag dang ma 'dres pa'i gtsang dag go tshul de lta bu'i sku tshe mthar phyin gyi mdzad 'azin 'dir re zhig rdzogs mthar dgung grangs re gsum me 'brug lo'i ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan dang bcas gzugs sku chos dbyings ༵ sbya6ma gi/ gshegs rdzogs gdung rten bcas legs par bsgrubs shing / 'di dang dus thog

mnyam pa sa skya'i sngags 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug de'i sras kun dga' bkra shis gnyis kyi dus dang / de'i sras bsod nams rin chen 'khrungs tsam dang / bod ljongs rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mcho/skal bzang rgya mtsho gnyis dang / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang gi sku tshe smad tsam dang / karma zhwa nag bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje dang / bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje gnyis dang / zhwa dmar bdun pa'i dus dang / gong ma chin rabs khang shis sogs kyi dus tsam du mngon no/ /(6)chos sku zeng drug pa nges don bstan pa daraskus/chos rje 'di ni mgo log smra yul yo stag tu a lcags kyi rus su 'khrungs/ de nas dgung lo lnga'i dus tsam na sngon gyi chos rje'i chas 'ga' ngos 'dzin dang rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag khong gis khang thog nas dkar yol 'o mas bkang bzhin 'phangs kyang gas chag ma tshad 'o ma tsam yang phyir ma 'pho bas kun gyi ngo mtshar skyes/ dgung lo brgyad tsam zhig nas chos rjes sku bdag byas te bsu bkod kyis gong ma'i gdan sar rdo rje'i khrir bkod/ klog yig dang rig gnas 'ga' zhig la sbyang brtson mdzad/de nas rim bzhin dam pa du ma bsten nas thun mong gi sdom pa sngon song gis mtshan nges don bstan pa dar rgyas zhes gsol nas rang lugs dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim gnyis kyi zab bka' mtha' dag mnos te ji bzhin gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin nyams len mdzad/ nges don gyi dgongs 'grel byams chos sogs mkho tshe ba'i gzhung la'ang thos bsam mi dman pa bgyis pa sogs mdo sngags kyi zab bka' rnams rang re'i rgong ma'i phyag srol ltar thos bsam 'chad nyan sogs gang ci'i thad nas dam pa gong sku skyes su nye bar 'os pa'i mdzad bzang mtha' dag tshags su tshud nges byas shing / mtshams zhig nas chos rje sprul pa'i sku khong gis bsnyen sgrub spyi dang khyad par rigs brgya'i rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa'i skabs bar bar du dkyil 'khor phyogs mtha' la mchod rdzas rigs 'dra min sna tshogs pa gang nas byung ba cha med par rang byung gi tshul du thun mong mthun snang la byung ba dus dus su yod par grags/ de nas re zhig gi khong nyid rgyal rong thugs rje chen po'i gnas mjal la phebs skabs jo bo'i mdun nas phyag mchod byed skabs/ jo bo'i zhal nas gsung byon te/ 'phags pa'i sku khyed bde bar byon nam/ zhes pa'i gsung gsal po der gnas kun gyi rna ba'i lam du mngon gsal gyis thos pas de kun ngo mtshar du gyur te ha las so/de rjes mi ring bar khong gis rdo la rdo dkar las grub pa'i yi ge drug ma rang byon ches khyad mtshar can dang / shing la gru gsum 'bur du dod pa'i chos 'byung gi gzugs khyad legs sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gter rdzas du ma phyag tu son zhing / de nas re zhig tu gter ston gyi rnam pa'i sngags 'chang gi spyad tshul mdzad nas gling za ma yum bzhes te khong gi pho brang khang gsar gyi zur du gling hwa tshang zhesadkuzhis ka bzung ba na der brten rim gyis 'dzam thang gi chos sde yang sngar bzhin 'grig khrims dam po de spun nas lhod par gyur te de phan chad nas dgon 'di dude nag dang 'dres mar 'gyur ba'i mgo bzung ba yin la/ de'i phyir chos rje 'di nyid khong gi ngos nas rigs mtho skyes chen yin yang dpal 'dzam thang 'os/ grwa'i mdzes rgyan la rma — 357 —

dbab tu song gshis de skabs nyid du'ang chos rje 'di'i mdo khams phyogs kyi rang re'i dgon lag rnams sngon nas yod pa gang mang 'dzin bdag ye nas ma byas stabs rang lugs kyi chos bzhi grwa rgyun kun gzhan du shor te nyams je dma' ru rim gyis song zhing / yin na'ang khong gi rang ngos nas phyogs rer 'gro 'duladus babs gyi gter ston mkha' 'gros lung bstan thob pa'i skyes chen yin gshis rjes sor mkha' 'gros lung bstan bzhin khong nyid dbus gtsang du byon te zab chos kyi gter kha re blang pa'i sgo nas 'gro phan rlabs chen mdzad cing legs nyes 'byung 'gyur lung bstan thog tu khel ba sogs sgo gang thad nas mdzad pa khyad du 'phags ches mngon du gyur pa'i cha nas bod ljongs su mtshan snyan grags kun tu khyab cing rgyal ba sku 'phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos de lugs kyi bka' yis bsngags brjod dang lung bzang po'i bka' yig sogs kyi gnang sbyin mdzad/chos rje 'di la'ang chos kyi 'brel zab sgo kun nas mnos pa'i thugs slob rang yul 'dzi ka dang phyogs gzhan nas 'ong ba mang po yod cing / gnam skos gong ma chan lung gis srid khri bzung ba'i mjug tsam la gong ma'i gser yig pa 'dir 'byor nas chos rje 'di la lung gis bsngags brjod dang bka' yig sogs kyi 'ja' sa gnang / khams phyogs kyi a skyong dmag zor mgon po dang rdo'i lhan grub sogs kyis bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs ches rab tu yang byas/ khong nyid kyi rnam dkar gyi bya ba'ang sku rten byams chen dang /thub pa/ dus 'khor/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zab thang gi sku brnyan du ma dang / gsung rten gser dngul gyi nges don bka' chos sogs rten mchog bcu gsum bzhengs par mdzad pa sogs bstan pa la byas rjes mi dman pa tsam dang bcas mdzad pa rdzogs/ mthar dgung lo so lnga'i thog tu sku chos dbyings su thim nas dgongs mchod gdung rten sogs kyi mdzad srol yang 'os ltar gyi legs sgo nye bar thub zin byas/'di dang dus mnyam pa sa skya'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang / de'i sras kun dga' sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dus dang / rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa'i smad tsam dang / paṇa chen sku zeng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dang / karma zhwa nag bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i sku tshe'i mjug dang /zhwa dmar sku phreng brgyad pa'i dus dang / gong ma chan lung sogs kyi dus tsam mngon zhing / 'dzam thang 'dir gtsang ba ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi yang sprul kun bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang dus mnyam la/'di skor ha laṭwāṃ mnyam pa ༵ma la rdo'i rtag brtan dgon dang / bkra shis chos gling dgon sogs kyang rim pas gaḍi~X kābyetrī bye ṭwāṃng ba/ du/na pa 'jigs med dpal gyi seng ge/chos rje 'di ni khyir rus chen a lcags mgo log la gangs gnyan chen bcu drug las gnyan chen rdo rje dgra 'ardzoms rtsal gyi bu rigs mgo logs a 'bum dang / de'i bu gnyan mo phag thar gyi rigs su skyes pa a skyong 'bum gyi brgyud pa la a skyong dbon log ces bya ba byung zhing / de'i bu tshe rgyal 'bum gyi chung ma wa shularwa 'i sdu 5rdo rje tram̐bum zhes bya ba de smra shod yo stag tu 'ong nas gzhis ka bzung ba de'i rigs rus las chad

pa yab skal bzang 'bum dang / yum sbya ngan med ces bya ba'i sras su sa smrel lor 'di nyid nam mkha' nas lha'i sgra sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas legs par 'khrungs ste/ 'khrungs ma thag tu zhal nas/ nga ni chos rje yin/ zhes yang yang gsung la/ de nas lang tsho rim gyis smin par byas skabs su sku na shin tu phra na'ang mtshan snyan phyogs kun tu khyab pas 'dzam thang chos rjes de lugs gsan pa na sku skyes legs brtags kyi dgongs gtad nye bar zhu skabs sprul pa'i sku gter chen bdud 'dul gling pa gang gi zhal snga nas/chos rje 'di nyid pad 'byung gi rnam 'phrul thabs shes kyi mdzad pa 'chang ba sngar med rten mchog bzhengs nas bstan 'gro la phan pa rlabs chen spyod cing gzhi dbyings dgongs chen rgyal ba mi pham mchog gi chos sku dang gcig pas da lta khong dang 'brel tshad dga' ldan du byams pa'i gdul zhing du skye nges kyi bka' lung rdo rje'i tshig 'gyur ba med pas lung bstan che bsngags mdzad pa 'di lta ste/ gang gi gter lung las/mgon pad 'byung gi sprul pa gdung lnga'i mtshan/ /khong mu ṭa la spyod cing bstan 'gro skyong / /mgon de yis sngar med kyi thugs rten bzhengs/ /de dang 'brel tshad byams pa'i zhabs drung skyes/ /zhes chos rje 'di'i mtshan dang bcas mdzad spyod kyi tshul gsal bar gsungs shing / karma zhwa nag sku zeng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rjes sku skyes ngos 'dzin bka' lung gsal bsgrags ltar 'dir chos rje'i sku skyes 'dzam thang sgar nas sku bdag mdzad skabs ngo mtshar yid ches kyi rtags mtshan de lugs ltar legs par 'dzoms ngos nas mchog dman kun gyis yid gnyis dang bral ba'i ngang dad gus che bar brtsi bkur legs zhu mdzad/de nas sku skyes gzhon nu nyid kyang sku na phra ba'i dus nas dag snang gi 'char sgo che zhing sngon gnas 'al 'ol dran zhing 'khor ba la skyo shes dang che mi rtag pa'i tshul sogs la nges shes dang gzhan phan gyi lhag blo ngang gis rang byung gis 'byung ba sems dpa' chen po'i tshul 'chang ba'i sngon goms bzang po'i rtags mtshan nye bar mnga' ba zhig ste khong gi dgung lo brgyad steng nas rdo la zhabs rjes gsal po ngo mtshar ba bzhag de mtshams shig nas sku skyes gzhon pa de nyid 'dzam thang chos rje sgar gyis che ba bkod pa dang bcas gong ma'i gdan sar khri ston rgya cher mdzad skabs rtogs ldan gyi bla ma 'ga'i thugs snang dag pa'i ngor sprul pa'i sku skyes nyid phebs dus su o rgyan pad 'byung gi sku'i rnam pa seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa nam mkha'i dbyings nas byon bzhud mdzad par mthong ba sogs ya mtshan ltas bzang yang mang skad/de nas dgung lo brgyad steng nas yongs 'dzin dam pa'i mdun nas klog sogs rig gnas sbyang zhing de skabs su rjes gnang gi byin rlabs du ma zhus nas bsnyen tshad kyang btang / dgung grangs bcu bzhi son skabs gong bla kun dga' rnam rgyul gang gis gtsos 'dus pa grangs tshang gi mdun nas tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa legs mnos mdzad nas mtshan kun dga' 'jigs med dpal gyi seng ge zhes gsol/de nas dam pa gang gi drung nas rang lugs dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zab bka' dbang lung man ngag bshad khrid yongs rdzogs gsan nas ji bzhin nyams len gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar lag blang du thebs nges mdzad skabs rtogs pa'i drod tshad spyas shing lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs kyi snang ba'i dge mtshan — 359 —

byung /chos rje 'dis gong bla'i mdun du snga phyi gnyis su chos mang gsan la/ dgung lo bcu bdun skor khams sde dge'i chos grwar phebs te zur mang tshe dbang kun khyab kyi mdun nas mdo sngags rig gnas du gsan sbyang mdzad/ dpal spungs dgon du tā'i si tu pad ma nyin byed dbang po'i sku drung du rang lugs kyi chos bka' spyi dang shangs chos sogs bka' brgyud dang rnying ma sa skya dge lugs bcas kyi zab chos du ma legs gsan mdzad nas de dus su mtshan karma shākya 'od zer du gsol zhing bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par rgyal tshab mchog tu mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas dzi rgar gter chen rdo rje grags pa'i mdun nas nyid kyi dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i gsang sgrub kyi dbang lung man ngag yongs dzogs zhus te gter ston khong gis chos rje nyid dgongs gter sgrol ma'i chos bdag tu mnga' gsol yang mdzad/ gzhan yang sngags rnying phyogs kyi zab bka' du ma legs par gsan nas rang gnas 'dzam thang dgon du slar phebs par mdzad de spub chen dus zhabs pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul par grags pa lha tshe bla ma rgyal mtshan gyi drung du slar yang dus 'khor dbang chen sbyor drug yongs rdzogs kyi khrid lung man ngag bcas sogs gsang sngags kyi zab bka' du ma dang / sa bzang gis mdzad pa'i blang dor rab gsal dang rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam rim bdud rtsi'i nying khu blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid bcas mdo phyogs bshad dmigs kyi khrid ci rigs dang / khyad par rin 'byung dang rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pas thugs rgyud dul ba'i zhing sa ltar gsang chen mngon rtogs kyi myu gu ches kun nas rgyas shing spel thabs kyi legs sgo cir yang bsgrun par mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad skabs chos rje'i pho brang du lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa'i la rgya la thugs khur nye bar bzhes te chos srid zung 'brel la dbang bsgyur ba po mchog gi go sa bzhes ngos nas de lugs ltar gyi mdzad sgo dang nye bar bstun nas sku dbon bsod nams chos kyi grags pa dang mi rgyab 'jigs med sogs drung 'khor 'go blon mdzod gnyer sogs rim rgyas lhan 'dzom kyis srid dbang che ba'i sgo bskyed cing khyad par khong nyid kyang lugs gnyis gang thad la skyong mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod gyi rtsal nye bar bkra ba zhig ste 'di skabs chos srid kyi legs 'byor ches kun nas dar zhing mnga' thang che tsam du gyur te rdo 'dzi smra gsum rnga ba rgyal rong mgo log gser rta wa shul khro kho bcas yongs la chos srid kyis dbang bsgyur zhing khong nyid sku zil gnon che stabs mdun nas dpon grags pa can tshos ci yang smra mi phod pa lta bu dang bar skabs der sku mdun du 'ong ba rnams 'phral du chos rje nyid kyi zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal ba med par phyi nas zhu yig gis snyan 'bul byed dgos lta bu'i khyad dbang ches mtho ba'i tshad du rdzogs shing / chos rje bar skabs rer gang du byon bzhud mdzad skabs gtsang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon rgyal tshab dge slong zhabs pa gang gi thugs dag snang ngor rgyal ba seng ge nyid yar mar gang du phebs skabs khang gsar pho brang sgo chen mdun nas dpa' bo duratram̐ da ༵// pe zung gis rgyun du skyel bsu byed par gzigs shing de 'dra'i chos rje 'di ba ni spyir na lhag

pa'i lha du ma dang khyad par rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhal yang yang mjal zhing yang sgos rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa las rdzogs rim rtsa rlung thig le la dbang thob pa stobs che zhing de las kyang thig le dwangs ma 'dzag med du sdom pa'i dga' bzhi'i mthu rlabs po che brnyes pa'i dbang gis phyi rtags su khong gi sku'i gsang ba nor bu'i bu ga nas dri chu phyir lud pa yar drangs pa dang 'o chu bsres pa las 'o ma so sor ma 'dres par bsal te drangs nus pa'i thig le dbab bzlog la brtan pa thob pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug gi che ba'i yon tan mchog legs ngom mdzad pa'i gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi lam rgya chen smin pa'i skyes bu dam pa yin phyir 'di 'dra'i dus la ni bud med bsten na dga' bzhi'i bde chen sngags bla med kyi rtogs pa spel ba'i lam grogs kho na ma gtogs nyes dmigs su 'gyur ba'i skabs med cing las rgya'i rig ma dang sbyor ba'i lam mngon byed kyi dus su bab pa yin pas chags sred kyi sgrog gis bcings pa'i skye bo phal pas baspya'i char yang bsgun par mi nus pa'i grub pa mchog gi baspyol zhugs kyi mdzad sgo la chos rje khong gis dbang byas te mtshams re zhig nas rig ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba 'jig rten pa'i mi te tsa za byams li sgron dang tsi mo le zhes bya ba'i bud med mtshan ldan gnyis yum du bzhes nas sku rigs kyi gdung brgyud yang da lta'i bar yod cing /swārno /ṭwāṃ/sa kyang mkha' 'gro'i rigs rnam par dkar ba'i chos la gzhol zhing rten gsum yang mang du chos rje khong nas yun ring bar dgongs gter sgrol ma'i sgo nas lo dus bzhin sad bsrung mdzad de skye dgu'i 'tsho ba 'bru rigs la sad kyi nyes skyon kun nas bzlog par byas pas 'tsho ba'i rkyen dka' yang ljongs 'di'i lus can gang dag gis ci dgar spyod dbang thob/ dus bar skabs rer chos rje gang nyid dgos dbang gis phyogs su gdul byar phebs skabs ches kha rje dar ba'i dpal 'byor gyi sgo rgya bskyed pa'i tshul gyis khong gi sgar snyon bzhud kyi dus su chos rje nyid kyi sku 'khor bla grwa dbon bsod nams chos grags sogs brgya bog lhag tsam re yod cing / de dag las byings 'dren skad grwa ba lha rje rdo rje ye shes sogs bcu phrag tsam dang ches kha rje dar ba'i lha cha mchod tshus khyad mtshar ba'i bkod pa rgya che ba dang bcas sgar gzhi legs bsgrigs kyi mdzad sgo skyong bzhin pa'i ngang khong nyid kyi nab bza' sku spyod sogs sgo gang thad nas che ba'i khyad dbang gi mdzad tshul gnang zhing sgar thog gi 'grig lam tshun chad yang mchog dman yongs nas mig ltos ya rabs kyi spyod bzang gtsang dag dam pa'i ngang tshul dad ldan dang ba 'dren byed 'ba' zhig tu nges pa ste/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas chos rje dpon slob bcas wa shul gser rta'i mi dbang dpon gyis gdan 'dren legs zhu che ba'i bsu bkod dang bcas te 'brong ri sprug po'i gnas mdun du sgar btab ste rje 'bangs kun la bsrung rim mchog gis mgon skyabs gnang /de nas mgo log tu phebs te de phyogs su gdul zhing rgya cher mdzad cing 'di skabs rgya'i a ni jo dmar ma bcom skabs dang thug pas dngos tshus khyad mtshar can ches mang gi 'bul ba mtha' klas byung la/de nas wa shul khyo ko'i tsho dpon/ wa shul bkra lo dang gdong nor ko zer ba gnyis kyis gdan 'dren zhus ge 361 —

nas de phyogs su 'gro don la phebs te dngos mas kyi 'byor pa ches mang dang bcas 'brog sde tshe zhig mi'abangs su dang sgo gser zhwa'i khams mdo yan gyis che ba legs 'bul byas/ 'di skor zhig tu chos rje khong dang byang bla brang gi rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang zhal 'dzoms dus phan tshun chos bka' grags dzirgyal mtshan dang zhal 'dzoms mdzad dus phan tshun chos bka' gsan des kyis thugs mnyes chen po'i ngang chos rjes rgyal mkhan po la chos skyong spyal po sku lnga'i gsol bsdus rtsom bskul mdzad gnang ltar mkhan pos sku lnga'i gsol bsdus brtsams te chos rje la bka' gtad bcas kyis 'bul gnang mdzad pa nas bzung chos rje sgar gyi bsrung mar bskos te bar mchod gsol gyi srol yod pa de ka ltar dang / de nas chos rje dpon slob der lo gsum gyi ring tsam la 'gro don 'phel ba byung zhing / de mtshams nas mee'u rgyal pos gdan drangs nas de phyogs su bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad rjes rang gnas 'dzam thang du phebs pa sogs de 'dra'i mdzad sgo rgya che zhing / khong gi thugs slob yang drung dka' bzhi pa'i yang sbrul gsum pa blo gros rin chen dpal gyi snying po/ gdong khang dbon bsod nams chos kyi grags pa sogs bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa'i skyes chen yang mang du byon/chos rje 'di'i dus bstan pa la zhabs 'degs mdzad pa gnam bskos gong ma chin rabs han hu'u'i rgyal pos bka' yig tham ga sogs kyi lung bzang po'i 'ja' sa gnang / khong nyid khrin tu'i sa sgor phebs te zi khron tsung tu'us chos srid zung gi lung bzang po'i 'ja' sa gnang zhing / kyang la tā lo ye nas kyang bla mar bkur nas 'ja' sa dang lha 'bangs su yul ba khag gsum ri 'phongs shi 'gam sogs 'os srid zung gi sder gtogs mi khyim brgya dang lnga bcu tsam gnang sbyin mdzad/ 'di skor chos rje'i lha 'bangs su gtogs pa gyi nang thams cad la dud tshang bdun brgya lhag tu longs/gzhan yang khams phyogs kyi mi dbang a skyong dpal chen mgon dang dbon nor bu dgra 'dul rmi'u rgyal po lcags thar 'bum sogs sa skyong mi dbang che ba gang dag gis dad gus rgya che bas chos kyi zhabs 'degs bla blag pa sgo kun nas bgyis shing / chos rje khong la gnam skos 'jam dbyangs gong mas gnang ba'i las zhwa nyid kyi dbu la rtag par mnabs pas de phyogs yul sde kun gyis bla dwags su chos rje pog li can/zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ khong gi sku tshe'i thog cig la mgo log snying rgya 'bum dus las 'das pa'i gshin po rjes 'dzin du chos rje phebs pa la gshin gyi dgongs rdzogs yon 'bul 'gam stod srib lung bcas kyi sa cha legs par phul bas sribs lung gi dben gnas der chos rje nyid kyis bzhugs gnas ri khrod mdzad de yun /zlo zlo ṭī/ dī ṭwāṃzlo/sa gnas bsrung a snye khyung mgon rdo rje drag rtsal bka' tha tshig gis dam la bzhag nas 'di skabs 'dzam thang du chos grwa mang 'tshogs dus 'dus sde stong phrag tsam dang nyung dus su'ang brgya phrag lnga tsam las mi nyung bar grags la/ lo bstar bzhin dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde mang po'i chos grwa dus su 'chag ༵༵ darji lo mjug kun tu drug bcu skang mdos res mos kyi gto sgrub zor chen las mtha' drag

po'i 'cham sna 'dra min gyi sgo nas tshams rngam gzi bajid che ba lo dus su ngom pa dang / gong ma'i las gos bka' rtags sogs kyi chas dang bcas mngon par mtho ba'i lung gi dril bsgrags kyi sgo nas zab sku chen po'i bshams ston rgyas spros dga' ston ngo mtshar ba'i der gnas lus can dag gire ba ji bzhin skong ba'i mdzad sgo bar bar dus su ngom zhing rgya 'cham dang seng 'cham sogs rtse rigs sna tshogs pa'i zlos gar 'khrab pa'i ltad mo ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa dang bcas skyid dga' chen po'i las kyi srol ka de lugs bzhin gnas la/chos rje 'di'i rnam dkar las kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba yang / khang gsar pho brang gzhi nas gsar bzhengs kyi sgo nas nang du gser khang / gdung khang / rgyal khang / mgon khang / mdzod gnyer khang sogs kyi legs bkod dang / lha gsar 'dus khang zhig gsos/ de dag gi gnas bzhugs rten gsum khyad 'phags du ma dang mchod cha'i rigs rol mo tshang dbyangs dpal 'bar/ 'dzi sgar gser bum/ gser dngul gyi martsel rgya nag ma sogs srus legs khyad mtshar can grwangs mang bcas dang / khyad par sku rten dngul gyi sgrol dkar khru gang ma dang rgya dkar nag gi gser sku li ma mang po dang / yang sgos su sngon o rgyan rin po ches bod la khong gi sku tshab nyer lnga bzhag pa las slob dpon gyi sku rten rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos gter nas gdan drangs pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba de chos rje 'di'i phyag tu 'byor ba dang /byams pa'i zab thang chen mo lha 'khor kun mkhyen rje btsun dang sgrol ma dmar mo dang ljang mo bcas zab thang byams gsar zhes grags pa'i gos sku thog tshad dgu ma dang / slob dpon pad ma'i sku thang zung gi rgyan gser 'gu gnyis kyis byas pa lha 'khor chos longs sprul gsum bcas gos thang thog tshad drug pa can dang gos thang khyad mtshar ba snga phyi gnyis legs bzhengs mdzad de sgyud sde du ma'i sgo nas rab gnas kyi cho ga rgya cher sgrub ste ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan dang bcas dga' ston yon 'bul dpe bral gyi mdzad chen gnang zhing / khyad par zab thang gyi ma la rdo'i grub dbang kun bzang gzhan phan gyis rab gnas mdzad pas dge legs kyi mtshan ma me tog gi char dang gu ru'i sku mdangs sha mdog tu gnas 'gyur te yongs kyi mthun snang du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang gis ljongs 'di'i skye dgu'i yid la dwangs pa'i sgo dbang med spel nas snang ba ha las par gyur cing / gsung gi rten yang rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang po'i bka' bod du 'gyur ro cog khams sde dge'i mtshal spar ma glegs bam brgya phrag lhag gis gtsos gsung rab mang dag bzhengs pa dang /thugs rten yang 'dzam thang chos sde'i nub kyi char dpal gyi mchod rten chen mo phyogs rer 'dom brgyad re yod pa ches mtho khyad yongs rdzogs mtshar bkod can gyi nang gi rten yang seng khri'i nang lho nas rim bzhin lha khang bcu gnyis 'jum sku ston pa gtso 'khor gsum rgyan drug dang bcas mtho khyad rdzogs pa/ de nas lha khang re re bzhin rim pas nye ba'i sras brgyad thog tshad re dang / 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum dang /slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum sogs lug ma legs mjos kyis bkang zhing / de mtshungs kyang ris yang sangs rgyas skyes rabs/ sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs sna tshogs pa/ bsam lhun rnam thar sogs dang / bang rim dag gi nang du stong sku mang po dang bum pa bre bcas kyi nang bla rgyud dang rgyud sde sna tshogs — 363 ge

sogs ngo mtshar gyang ris ches mang zhing tha na dgon 'di'i chags tshul yon bdag bkod pa tshun chad spyade legs 'dzoms rgyas spros mdzad pa ma zad nang bzhugs rten gsum khyad 'phags du ma gnod sbyin 'khor chabacas kyi srog shing khyad mtshar can dang dngos sa kyi bye brag sna tshogs pa'i mdzod du mas phyur bur gtamamipa sogs sgo kun nas legs cha rgya bskyed pa dang rab gnas dga' ston yon 'bul sogs kyang gzhi khyon legs rdzogs mdzad nas 'phros cung tsam gyis drung bas sku phreng gsum pa dang sku dbon sogs kyis mthar rgyas su gtsang dag byas shing de 'dra'i rnam dkar gyi legs sgo la gang 'azel bde ba can du skye ba'i mtshan ma byung ba sogs ches dge ba'i ltas bzang mang po yod ces grags skad/de ltar mdzad pa rgya che ba'i chos rje gang nyid kyi gdul bya smongs 'dir re zhig rdzogs pa la nye skabs nyid dgung grangs zhe brgyad steng shing lug lor mgo log a skyong dpon dpal tshen mgon rnga bas sku bgrongamipar brten chos rje gshin po rjes 'dzin du gdan 'dren 'ong bas sngon tha tshig che stabs thugs mi mos bzhin phebs dgos byung / der bla grwa 'khor bcas byon nas dpon la gshin chog gi gnas 'dren rlabs che ba'i thugs rjes khong nyid lha gnyan g.yu rtse'i 'khor du skyes zin pa skad cig la gnas spar ba'i 'gro phan che ba mdzad cing shul 'dug mi dbang 'khor bcas la dbang bka' zab mo'i byin rlabs kyi bsrung skyobs dang bcas te tshur rang gnas su phebs skabs lha gnyan 'khor bcas kyis sngar gyi mdzad pa la ma dga' bas 'khu ldog gis chos rje dpon slob tshur lam rmar chu la brgal skabs khong gi dbon yon tan phun tshogs chu skyon la thebs nas mchod sgam sogs bca' lag 'ga' re chus khyer/ de rjes chos rje 'khor bcas rgyal mtshan lung par thon tshe khong nyid glo bur sku bskung tshul bstan pa nas bzung rim pas rang gnas 'dzam thang du slobs rjes grwa tshang yongs kyis zhabs brtan rgya cher phul ba'ang khong gis da lan las nyid sku mi bzhugs par mkhyen te zhal nas drung 'khor dag la/ 'brong dar ma'i snying de bye mas bskam du bcug nas mchod rten gyi nang bzhug tu bzhag na bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher 'byung ba red/ ces pa'i brda tshig gis khong nyid kyi sku dmar gdung byas na bstan 'gror phan pa'i gsung zur dang dgon gyi 'dzin bdag sogs zhal chems 'ga' dang bcas dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis thugs dgongs chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med du gyur te 'ja' 'od dang sa g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar legs dge'i mtshan ma dang bcas sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan te/chos rje 'di dang thog mnyam bod ljongs rgyal ba sku phreng dgu bcu gnyis dang / bcu gcig pa 'khrungs tsam dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa dang / karma zhwa nag sku zeng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i sku dus dang / gong ma chin han sogs dang / khams 'dzam thang 'dir gtsang pa'i sprul sku 'azin las rnam rgyal gyi yang sprul 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi sku tshe'i mjug dang / de'i dngos slob gtsang pa dge slong gi sku tshe yang dkyil smad tsam du smrebs pa nas bzung rjes su byon pa sgrub brgyud kyi rdo rje slob dpon ngag dbarji choṭwāṃ ༵༵la gyi sku dus tsam du'ang mngon no/ /

(ra)chosarje sku zeng brgyad payipham byamasapa'i lo sa/de yang mgo log yo stag rmog gdong zer ba'i grong der a lcags rigs rus kyi brgyud pa sngags 'chang nam mtha' rang grol yab yum gyi sras su sa lug lor ngo mtshar ltas bcas chos rje 'di sku 'khrungs pa yin la/de nas rim pas sku na son pa'i skabaga'adzam thang chos rje'i sku skyes su ngos 'dzin dang bcas sku bdag gis gong ma'i gdan sar che ba'i khri ston byas shing rim gyis dgung lo baspyad snebs skabs yongs 'dzin rtogs ldan mkhas mchog gi drung nas klog yig sogs bslab te tsheg med du mkhas par mkhyen/ de nas re zhig gi tshe rdo rje 'chang bslab gsum mchog gi dbang phyug skyabs rje ngag dbang bsam gtan zhabs pad drung du sdom pa zhu ru phebs skabs/ khong gis thugs dgyes shin tu rgya che ba'i ngang sku chas legs pa'i rten 'brel bzang po nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung gi sdom pa gnang ste/ mtshan ngag dbang chos kyi seng ge mdo rgyud bstan rdorsha ṭīrdo/ gsol/ de nas byang chub sems sdom dang / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs zab bka' du dgung lo dgu tsam steng nas skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi mdun nas zab lam yan lag drug gi dbang lung man ngag bshad khrid yongs rdzogs dang / gzhan yang khong gi 'al nas/ khyed bstan pa ri mnga' bdag yin pas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa skyong dgos shing / de yang kho bo yod pa'i dbang lung man ngag khrid rgyun sogs legs par nyams bzhes mdzod cig gsung nas zab bka' rgya cher stsal/ de lugs bzhin nyams len gnad smin gyis rtogs pa'ang mchog tu gyur cing / de nas dgung lo bcu gcig gi dus tsam na skyabs mgon rin po ches dag zhing gajigs pas chos rje 'di'i gdung mchod phyag smon gzab ldan dang gser dngul gyis gdung rten khru gang legs bsgrun mdzad/ snosogs 'di phyogs kyi bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas zab bka' mang du zhus/dgung lo bcu bzhi'i skabs dpon slob dang bcas sde dge'i dpal spung du phebs nas/ 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan spya mtsho'i drung nas jo nang rang lugs kyi chos bka' ci rigs dang shangs chos sogs bka' rnying gsar dge'i zab chos mang du zhus te/ mtshan kun dga' mi pham chos kyi byams pa zhes gsol nas chos bka' de dag gi mnga' bdag tu legs bskos mdzad/ gzhan yang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs dang rig gnas yang mang du gsan sbyang byas shing / de dus su kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan rgya nag nga 'dra ma khyad legs can khong la gnang snyin mdzad pa de da lta rten khrod du yod bzhin pa dang / de skabs sde dge phyogs su lo mang tsam bzhugs nas zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i sku mdun nas kyang chos bka' zab dgu'i gdams pa ches mang bo gsan te phyogs der bzhugs ring du de dag la nyams len gnad khel nan tan gyi sgo nas legs sgrubs mdzad rjes 'dzam thang phyogs nas dbu chos gnyer ba mi rgyab sogs 'ga' zhig khong 'byon dgos pas bsu mar 'ong bar brten rang yul 'dzam thang dgon du slar legs phebs mdzad de dgung lo nyi shu'i steng tsam la gong ma'i gdan sa 'dzin bdag byas nas — 365 dngha

chos srid zung 'brel skyong ba'i thugs khur bzhes te bstan 'gro'i don gyi bya ba rgya cher spel ba'i sgor zhugaminas mdzad bzang de lugs ltar re zhig ji bzhin bskyangs skabs chos srid la zhabs 'degs mdzad mkhan gnam skos gong ma chin hri keng shu'i rgyal po srid khrir 'khod nas bgrang bya nyer drug tsam song ba'i dus rtsa'ajam dbyangs gong mas sngon bzhin gyi bka' yig 'ja' sa 'phyor gnang gis chos rje 'di ba la legs skyemi'abul sgo mdzad cing / gzhan yang khams phyogs kyi a skyong khang rgan dpon o rgyan pa dang / gong ma'i dpon karma mthu stobs sogs mi dbang mang dag gis kyang bla mar bkur te bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad la/chos rje 'di nyid rig gnas la thugs dasnyod rgyas pas phyag bde ba'i dbang gis bzo ras kha gang tsam gyi gzhi la dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor thig tshon legs mdzes kyi bkod pa kun ngo mtshar ba'i gnas bzhengs spub bgyis shing / de sogs rig gnas bzo las sogs mkhas khyad thon pa nyid kyi gsung rtsom yang jo nang rang lugs kyi sngon 'gro ngag 'don gyi rim pa dang / gtor ma'i cho ga rgyun khyer gyi tshul sogs bka' dang dgos gter du gtogs pa glig bam gcig lhag tsam yod cing gsung chos de dag la 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po ches kyang thugs dgyis spro rgya che bas bsngags brjod legs gnang mdzad pa sogs skyes bu dam pa'i spyod bzang gis bstan 'gro'i don re bskyangs mthar khong nyid chu lug dgung lo nyer lnga'i stod tsam na rnga ba gyi 'brog sogs su phebs nas de phyogs kyi ser skya yongs la tshe dbang dang mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang ches bka' du mas 'gro don mdzad cing / skabs der phar mtha' rdo rje 'chang dang zhal 'dzoms mdzad nas sku phyogs phar mtha'i sgar du chos rje 'di gdan 'dren zhus te phan tshun chos kyi bka' mol zab khyad can dang bcas thugs mnyes chen po'i sgo nas zangs dkar bla brang la chos rje 'di'i yang sprul rjes su 'khrungs nges kyi gnas g.yar dang khong rnam gnyis da lo mnyam gshegs kyi dus bgo dang gzhan yang mdzad sgo spya che ba'i ngang zhag 'gar bzhugs rjes tshur rang gnas 'dzam thang du phebs/de nas mi ring bar khong gis krongs 'dir mdzad pa rdzogs pa'i dus su gzigs te sku dbon bstan 'dzin nor bu chos srid zung gi mnga' bdag nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu bsko bzhag mdzad nas sku tshe tha ma'i bka' 'phros kyang ci rigs pa gnang /de nas dgung grangs nyer lnga'i smad tsam na sku dbon rin chen dpal gyis khong da lo smra rong du nas bsod la phebs dgos tshul zhus pa na/ khong gi zhal nas/ da lan byon na tshur rang gnas su slebs dka' tshul gyi yin lugs yang yang gsungs kyang sku dbon nas bka' nan ma chog stabs mi byon thabs med byung bas de ltar smra rong la phebs dgos byung nas yul de phyogs su thon tsam nyid nas glo bur du sku bskun gyis zin te zhag shas las ma mgor bar ya mtshan gyi ltas bcas gzugs sku'i me tog gi lang tsho 'phral du yal bar gyur to/ de rjes 'dus sde yongs kyis dgongs rdzogs mchod pa gdung rten bcas sgo kun nas mi dman par tshogs bsags kyang legs sbrun mdzad cing / 'di dang thog mnyam pa bod krongs rgyal ba'i sku phrengarjo cu sdu~Xg kau dang bcu gnyis pa dang / gong ma chin rabs keng shu'i rgyal po dang / 'dzam thang

'dir gtsang ba'i gdan rabs pa 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi yang sprul tshab 'jam dpal mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob dpon kun dga' dpal ldan zhabs kyi sku dus tsam yin no/ /(9)chos skya zeng dgu ba 'dzigs med dbang po/sku zeng dgu pa 'jigs med dbang po'am bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes pa'i lo rgyus ni/ 'di yang mdo khams rgyal mo rdong tsha ba khag gsum so mang rgyal po'i mnga' zhabs zangs dkar bar ma'i sa char gong ma'i lung gis mngon par mtho ba sku phyogs phar mtha'i gdung rus las chad pa yab dmu dge nor bu dang yum bkra shis skyid gnyis la rigs sras sprul sku gsum dang lcam gcig yod pa las na rim gnyis tsam shing bya'i lor yab yum gyi mi ltas legs pa sogs dang bcas sku bltams/ de yang sku na chung ba'i dus nas zil che ba smad la stag sham gyi ri mo'i sha mtshan bkra ba thugs rig phal pa gzhan las ches dwangs pa zhig stochung ming bstan pa dar rgyas su gsol/ sku ma bltams gong du'ang phar mtha' rol pa'i rdo rjes ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi tshul du sku skyes rigs bzang du lung gsal por bstan/ gzhon nu bskyed bsrings pa'i skabs smra shes tsam nas nga nyid 'dzam thang rmog gdong chos rje yin tshul yang yang gsungs/ de skabs khong gi thugs snang la 'dzam thang dgon spyi dang khyad par chos rje pho brang dang tshes bcu stod sogs bkra lam du wal wal shar ba byung / tshul de 'dzam thang chos rjes gsan pas rnga stod du byis pa rigs can zhig yod pa de dang 'di gnyis sku skyes gang yin gyi thugs brtag ges gter khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje la zhus tshe/ gter ston khong gi zhal nas/ rnga stod kyi gyis pa de lug rdzi zhig 'ong shas che/ phar mtha'i sku skyes de/ rma bya sngon mo dug 'thung ma/ dug re 'thung na mdangs re gsal/ zhes gzhan gyi gnod pa gang gis mi tshugs pa'i chos rje'i sbrul pa'i sku skyes su lung bstan pa ltar 'dzam thang chos rje sgar gyi sprul dbon 'ga' shas sku bdag tu thon skabs chos rje gong ma'i phyag dril 'azeng ba sogs ji bzhin ngos 'dzin gsal pos kun gyi yid ches dad gus ngang sku skyes mchog la na bza' gsol/de nas rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang tshan lcags yos lor dgung lo bdun son skabs sprul pa'i sku nyid blu yon che bsu'i bkod pa dang bcas khang dmar dbon bsod nams bstan 'dzin grwa 'khor phebs nas 'dzam thang chos rje'i sgar du gdan 'dren zhus nas khri ston rgya cher mdzad skabs lam bar du mkhar dgu nga ro yab sras dang / bkra shis sgang dgon gyi bla grwa yul mi bcas dang / rdzong 'gag sa stod kyi dpon sde/bzhag shod dgon lnga sogs kyis zhabs 'degs che bkyag gi bkur snyi legs pa'i sgo nas de lugs ltar gyi khri 'don byas/ de nas dgung lo brgyad steng nas mkhas pa'i dbang po 'bras rab 'byams pa dge bshes blo bzang mchog grub rgya mtsho dang / sman pa thogs med rnam gnyis yongs 'dzin du bsten te dza 'go'i ri khrod du rgyun bzhugs mdzad nas thog ma klog byang bar bslabs rjes rim pas thos bsam gyi sgo la zhugs te spyod 'jug sogs gzhung lugs 'ga' la sbyang brtson dang / rta phyag khyung gsum sogs kyi byin rlabs kyang zhus/dgung lo bcu gnyis la skyabs mgon sbyangs ba rin po che kun dga' nges don zhabs ༵sbya 7drung nas/

tshangs spyod dge bsnyen dang rab byung gi sdom pa legs mnos mdzad nas/ mtshan kun dga' 'jigamimed bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes mtshan gsol/ 'di skor khyo kho la gdul byar byon nas mdzad 'azin che bar gyur/dgung lo bcu gsum la 'dzong bo bla ma dang drung sprul gnyis kyis zhus ngor skyabs mgon sbyangs ba'i mdun nas 'dus pa brgya phrag gsum lhag gi gral du sgrub thabs rin 'byung dbang bka' yongs rdzogs gsan/ de nas bzung sgrol dkar la yi dam mdzad nas bsnyen pa rgyun bzlas dang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi rgyud zhal 'don mdzad pa'i dbu tshugs/ de nas dge bshes rin po che'i mdun nas/ mngon mdzod rtsa 'grel/ rgyu 'bras dbu ma'i thig le rtsa 'grel/ blang dor rab gsal/ bser bsdus/ phung lnga sogs mdo phyogs skor 'ga' zhig dang / khyad par phyi'i dus 'khor la gal 'gangs che ba dkar rtsis kyi rigs/ gza' lnga/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin/ gnam gyi go la/ rgya nag rtsis kyi sgo mo/ dbyangs 'char sogs dang / bzo dang sman gyi rigs sogs rig gnas sna tshogs la gsan sbyangs mkhas par mdzad cing /gzhan yang yig rigs mkhas pa'i slob dpon du ma'i drung nas/ snga gyi ci rigs su yig rigs lañdza wa spyol/bod kyi yig chen/ yig 'bring / 'khyugs yig sogs la mkhas par byas/ yang mtshams shig tu kirti'i yongs 'dzin sangs spyas zhes pa'i drung nas kyang / rgya rtsis/ dmag rtsis/ dbyangs 'char sogs la zhib rgyas su thugs slobs byas pas ji bzhin khong du chud do/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun gyi steng du dge bshes rin po ches zhu grogs mdzad nas sbyangs ba skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi mdun du/ dus 'khor rdzogs rim yan lag drug gi zab bka' zin byed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas khrid mthong ba don ldan/ lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba/ rnam bshad zung 'jug rab gsal sogs kyi chos khrid che ba dang bcas rang lugs kyi zab chos legs zhu mdzad nas slar yang 'dza' 'go'i ri khrod du byon nas dge bshes rin po che dang mnyam du bzhugs nas gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin nyams len mdzad skabs nyams rtogs kyang bzang rab byung bas thugs mngon shes gsal snang gis 'dzam thang sgar nas gro skyel 'ong ba dang / dge bshes khong la bar skabs nyer mkho dgos pa re yod pa tshun chad sogs lkog gyur 'ga' zhig mngon mkhyen gsal po byung ba'i lo rgyus yod/ dge bshes rin po che'i khong nyid la gsung don ri khrod kyi sa 'di ni sa sgod rtsi shing gis gang ba'i sa yin kyang sngar khyed gyi 'khor pa 'dza' 'go'i smad tshang gi rmo zhing yin rabs yod pa'i chos rje sgar gyi thob dbang thog tu de tshang la sa rin sbyin dgos pa'i bka' gnang / de ltar rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi nyams bzhes mdzad rjes nas khong gi spyon cung tsam bskung rkyen grwa 'khor dang bcas rang yul zangs dkar du byon nas re zhig tsam bzhugs/ de nas rnga yul kha shas dgon du phebs nas nyid kyi sku zhang bla ma dam pa phar mtha' chos rgyan gyi drung nas zab chos gcod kyi skor yongs rdzogs kyi chos bka' zhus nas der tshogs brgya la nyams len phyag srol ji bzhin legarji gru~X ༵gyis te gnyan sa chu mig kyang mang du 'grim par mdzad nas lhung tshad du ma byung ba'i lo rgyus

bshad / ༵ sdu sdo // ṭwāṃ/ nyer gnyis kyi dus na khong nyid chos rje sgar gyi thob dbang gi chos srid la ji bzhin bdag gir mdzad pa'i mnga' bdag tu mi pham 'jigs med dbang po'i mtshan gyi snyan grags phyogs su rgyas bzhin 'dems bskos byas nas sngon gyi gnam bskos gong ma'i bka' thob 'ja' sa sogs dang bcas chab srid yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'go tshugs pa ste/ 'di lo nas khang gsar mgon khang du gur mgon gyi 'dra sku thog tshad ma lha bzo lha mchog la bzhengs su bcug nas rab gnas dga' ston sogs legs bgyis mdzad nas sngar dge bshes rin po che'i bka' gsung ltar 'dza' 'go'i smad tshang la rmo zhing rin zhegarta myugs dang dngul lnga bcu ma bcas rdo tshad gsum gnang sbyin byas nas ri khrod du brag dkar sku phyogs sngon ma byon dus gdan 'dren zhus nas chos skyong gsol mchod bsdus ma zhig dang dgon pa yang byang chub chos rdzongs zhes mtshan gsol/ lo 'di'i zla ba bdun pa'i nyer brgyad nyin sbyangs ba skyabs mgon gyi gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i dgongs mchod gzab ldan 'dra sku gser tshon ma dang bcas legs grub mdzad cing 'di lor smra rong phyogs kyi dpon sde la gdul byar byon te dpon sde kun la 'gro phan kyang che bar byung / dgung lo nyer gsum par sbyangs pa'i dngul gdung thog tshad du longs pa bzhengs shing lo phyi mar rab gnas dga' ston rgya cher byas shing 'di lor ma hā tsi na'i rtsis kyi tshul la 'jug pa zhes pa'i rtsis gzhung yang brtsams/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa nas lo bstar gyi skar rtsis dang rtsis mgo bskung nas rtsis khog brtsam pa'i dbu bzung nas 'di lor khang gsar rwa nang du phur pa'i dung 'khor khang pa bcas bzhengs/dgung lo nyer drug par dbyangs 'char sogs rtsis skor kha gsal can re bsgrigs shing de'i phyir lo chos rje'i bla brang zhes pa byams khang zhig gsos mgo bzung ste rim gyis phyi bkod legs grub bgyis pa'i nang du dgung lo nyer dgu skor nas gyang ris bla rgyud dang / rgyud sde sna tshogs/ sman bla'i zhing bkod/ bde chen zhing bkod/ ras ris mthong ba don ldan/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ sgung bshags kyi lha so lnga/ chos skyong cha tshang sogs dang / lug ma 'jum sku byams pa thog tshad gsum ma gsar bzhengs dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas zhig gso sogs lha khang 'di'i nang du snga phyi ci rigs su rten bzhengs mang po dang rab gnas dga' ston bcas mdzad do/ /dgung lo sum cu skor dge bshes rin po ches dag zhing gzigs nas phyag mchod gzab smon dang khong grwa 'khor thugs chen gnas mjal la phyin nas phyag mchod kyang bgyis shing de'i phyi lor nyid kyi sku bskung bas dngos rdzos yod tshad kyis zhabs brtan rgya cher bsgrubs 'di lor phar ngos sgrub khang gong du spos/ dgung lo so gnyis skor gtsang pa grub chen byams pa chos 'dzin gyi mdun du phebs nas zla shas bzhugs skabs/spub chen gyi zhal nas/ chos rje la khyed kyi phrag pa g.yon steng du dzam lha nag po'i sku bzhugs par mthong bas ches ngo mtshar can dang / rgyal ba seng ge dang khong gi bla ma phar mtha' rol pa'i rdo rje gnyis ka'i ngo bo khyed yin pas kho bos khyed kyi sku bskung la phan los thogs/ gsungs nas der bzhubs ṭwāṃ~X 9du 9tshis

sngags 'debs bzhin mtshon bcos re yang byas pas nyin cig nad mang tsam skyugs pas phan pa rab tu byungarkade nas tshur rang gnas su phebs nas khang gsar du bzhugs skabs shig la nub cig khong gi smri lam du ban de zhig gis khyed byon ran zer bas khong nyid ga shed du 'gro snang shar ba na bla ma zhig gis byon rgyu min zer bas khong nyid rang gnas khri steng du bzhugs skabs bla ma des khyed kyis 'jigs byed sgom la sdod cigazer nas nyid kyi gzims chung sgo lcags spyab song ba zhig rmis pa'i rkyen gyis dbon dam pa 'gyur med kyi mdun nas/ 'jigs byed mngon rtogs 'bru non dang rta mgrin gsan te dge 'phel ri khrod du bsnyen tshad sbyin srig kha skong rgyas pa bcas kyi legs spub mdzad pas gnod byed thul ba'i rtags mtshan byung /dgung lo so gsum skor sku dbon rin chen dpal grongs pa'i rjes kub dgongs rdzogs rgya cher mdzad cing de rjes lo der bla brang du rta 'grin bsnyen tshad kha bskang sbyin sreg bcas zin pa na slar yang dbon dam pa'i drung nas rwa ba'i man ngag 'jigs gyed snyan brgyud kyi khrid zhus nas mu ri'i lung 'khyogs nang du snyan brgyud dmigs skor nyer lnga yan tshang bar du bzhugs shing kha skong bcas kyis mtha' rgyas su thub cing de'i phyi lor dbon dam pa'i drung nas phur pa 'khon lugs stod las kyi dbang dang bcas spros med bsnyen rkyang gi khrid dang / 'byung 'dul sogs kyi khrid legs par mnos te lo der de dag gi bsnyen tshad kyang legs par btang / 'di skor zhig tu yang bskyar brag dkar sku phyogs byon pa'i mdun nas dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi bklag lung gsan/ khong la bka' 'gyur yi ge blu rgyu'i nyo thabs byol bas rjes sor bka' chos sde dge'i mtshal sbar ches khyad du 'phags de gdan 'dren legs bzhugs mdzad pa'i skal bzang thob/ de rjes shig tu slar yang chos rje grwa 'khor bcas gtsang grub mdun du byon nas kub chen gyi zhal nas khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku gegs sel bas skyid dga' zhes gsungs nas dgyis spro chen po mdzad bzhin nyin cig khong dang chos rje gnyis nyin skor gyi ri lung zhig tu phebs te grub chen gyis chos rje la khyed 'dir sdod cig gsungs nas khong nyid byon song 'phral brag pha bong zhig rbab kyi tshul du chos rje'i dbu thod tsam thon byung ba na chos rje nyid kyis thugs g.yo med kyis bag tsha ba med par sku gzan brdabs pas de ma thag brag rdo chen po de sil bur 'thor song tshe grub chen phebs nas chos rje la nus mthu khong dang 'dra nges gyi che bsngags mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod/ de nas chos rje 'khor bcas grub chen gyi mdun nas tshur byon khar spub chen mchog gi snyan rgyan hādro / ṭwāṃ tram̐dro/ 'khor mo ngo mtshar 'phrul chen blor shong dka' bas gnang sbyin dang bcas rang yul 'dzam dgung lo so lnga par khong gis sngar gdan drangs ba'i bka' chos kyi yi ge'i zhal khebs glegs shing gdung dar sogs kyi zhabs 'degs legs byas dang / dbon dam pa 'gyur med kyi mdun nas dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang sogs zhus shing de'i phyi lor dge 'phel ri khrod du bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan mdzad cing 'di'i phyi lo tsam na rtsis skor zla nyi gza' 'dzin sa glang brtag tshul sogs po ti bzhi long ba tsam las phal cher legs grub zin pa'i dus dang / dgung lo ṣkagacig tu khang gsar pho brang nub ngos gsar — 370 ge

bzhengs kyi mgo bzung ba nas lo drug gi ring trem la gser khang khyad bkod can legs bzhengs dang /py-iṭātā/ bye spya ṭwāṃ spyatrī tāṭwāṃgā sdon/ dga' gun tshogs dang bsod nams zhabs pa rim pas brje bskos sogs dgung lo zhe bdun par lha sar 'du khang sngar las gsar bzhengs dang sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul gyi gzims khang bcas la bkod 'dzin dang / de'i sbyi lor khang gsar pho brang bzo bkod legs grub kyi dus gser tshon srus bzang / nang gi rten gsum jo bo thog tshad ma gtso bo rgya dkar nag gi gser sku gcig stong nye bar khyad mtshar can du ma ya mtshan pa'i bkod legs bcas rnam dkar mdzad sgo rgya che zhing /dgung lo lnga bcu'i skor du gung khrin tang gis ri min 'gog ched dmar dmag rgyang bskyod skabs chos rje 'di nyid lugs gnyis gang thad nas ches mkhas pas bsrung rim dang 'gro lugs gang gi thad nyen kha cher ma byung bas khyo kho dang zangs dkar phyogs su byon nas gdul bya'i mdzad sgo yang mi dman pa byas te mthar rang gnas 'dzam thang du bde bar bzhugs kyi skal ba byung /de'i skabs su rgyang bskyod dmar dmag gis chos rje la ma 'ongs pa'i mthun grogs bzang 'gyur rtags mtshan du pho brang phyi'i rwa skor ngos la pha sang phod sos kha thon sos kha'o’’ zhes rgya bod gnyis kyi sbyar yig bris par yod/ dgung lo nga bzhi par spyan gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul ma ṇi bla ma pad ma sirnyi 'dzam thang du phebs pa'i chos 'atsogs che ba chos rje 'di nyid nas dad gus bkur ste rgya che ba dang bcas bla ma bkur bzhin zab chos mang po legs zhu mdzad pa nas bzung rtag par 'dren pa mchog tu khur zhing / de'i phyi lor yang ma ṇi bla ma na thang du phebs skabs kyang chos rje gang gis gdan 'dren zhus nas chos mang gsungs pas ma ṇi'i chos 'tshogs mdzad/dgung lo nga brgyad skabs sbyangs pa mchog sprul gyis dol po ba'i 'dra sku zangs gser las bsgrun dus kyi gser nyo ba chom pos bcom pa sogs kyi thad chos rje rnga khog tu byon lam smra chu'i phar 'gram a sa par tsa argam zhes par tsha gro 'debs skabs glo bur ser sprin cher 'khrigs kyi ser ba drag po 'beebs par chas tshe khong nyid gzims pa'i tshul gyis thugs dgongs gtad tsam gyis de phyogs ri lung kun la ser ba gangs rim chags bzhin cher babs kyang khong dpon slob kyi steng tsam kho nar zil char 'jam po las ser ba shugs drag kun nas 'phral du bzlog par mdzad pas sku 'khor dag gis ngo mtshar zhing khong gi thugs snang ngor sngar gsor nyo mkhan jag pas bsad pa rnams mi min gzhi bdag gzugs su der ji bzhin gzigs shing rjes nas gcod dang 'pho dmigs kyis gnas 'dren mdzad pa sogs gzhan phal pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mdzad pa ches mang la/ dgung lo drug bcu skor slar yang gtsang pa grub chen mjal ched phebs skabs grub chen gyis deng dus bu ser skya yongs la gnyan nad gyi kha gnon seng ge sgra'i dung 'acar dang nā ga raka'i bskyed bzlas gal che tshul gsungs pa ltar chos rje khong gis 'bangs snge yongs de lugs ltar gyi dung 'khor gnyis sogs rnam dkar bya ba bsrung rim gang dgos legs grub snyed du rpā ga pa'i ḍigro ṭwāṃḍi 1spel bar

mdzad cing / 'di skor du'ang bla ma pad ma silhas 'dzam thang du ma ṇi'i 'chogs chos skabs khong nasalegs zhu'i bci bkur byas/dgung lo re gcig skor la'ang bla ma 'od zer khyo kho bla tshab tu mngags shing lo rjes ma'i nang tsam du khong nyid gtsang grub mdun du'ang zhal mjal gsung thos la dad mos kyis beebs nas re gig bzhugs la/'di lor drung dka' bzhi pa'i yang sprul lnga pa kun dga' rin chen dpal gyi snying po khri 'don dang de'i yongs 'dzin bsko bzhags dang grwa tshang 'dus khang gi rgyal chen sde bzhi'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i zhal bkoṅka mdzad/ dgung lo re gsum skabs khang dmar dbon rgan gshegs pa'i dgongs bkrol khrus chog mdzad cing / de'i lo'i rgyal rong rdzong 'gag dang khro bcu'i dmag gi dus zing byung ba na/ chos rje nyid kyispomadzad sgo gang thad nas rang 'dzi rka dang gzhan rgyal rong gi sde 'bangs gnyis la phan bdes phan tshun zhi 'jags su gnas pa'i byed las rgya cher gyi phan 'bras byung / de lo'i khang dmar rdo rje slob dpon gshegs pas dgongs mchod kyang rgya cher bsgrubs/ de'i phyi lor khang dmar rdo rje slob dpon dbon yon tan spya mtsho dang sgan pa bla ma dkon 'phel gnyis rim pas lo gsum rer bsko bzhag dang 'dus sde yongs rdzogs kyis bsrung rim rgya che ba'i bkod 'doms dang / chos rje'i pho brang du chos skyong rgyal chen sku lnga'i gzab thang gser bris ma spus legs shig kyang bzhengs grub mdzad cing 'dilor dung dkar dgon nas mchog sprul nges don rgya mtsho dang ma ṇi bla ma pad ma bde chen grwa 'khor bcas legs rtsebs mdzad nas 'dzam thang du mchog sprul rin po che'i gsung dbyangs drug 'gyur gyi mdzad pa rlabs che bas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi bklag lung yongs rdzogs bka' drin du mdzad skabs chos rje 'di nyid kyi dad gus che bas bka' lung mtha' dag legs gsan byas te 'di skor zhig tu girti'i chos skyong rgyal pos mi'i gzugs su bzung nas dngos su gos chen gyi na bza' legs po bzos te chos rje la phul bar grags skad/dgung lo re lnga pa'i skabs thig la rwa rdzong stobs ldan shi ba'i khrus chog mdzad dus su chos rje nyid kyi thugs dgongs su nye 'khor na yod pa'i mi zhig gi mi bzod pa'i so na ba'i rkyen gyis khong la byin rlabs zhu snyam yod tshe de ma thag ji bzhin mkhyen te nyid kyis ljags sngags btab pa byon pa tsam gyis so nad 'phral du sangs khyer byas pa sogs de 'dra'i khyad 'phags kyi mdzad sgo yang 'ga' re'i lo rgyu'i yod cing / lo 'dir mchog sprul nges don rgya mtsho slar chos rje sku drung phebs skabs nyid kyis mdzad pa'i spyal chen sku lnga dang dam can bstod gsol skor sogs mchog sprul gyis gzigs pas thugs ngo mtshar bas dgongs gter tshad ldan gyi che bsngags kyang mdzad/ 'di skor dbon bsod nams grags pa cher bskung tshabs che ba la chos rje khong gis thugs rjes chen po'i rjes gnang mdzad pas zla gsum tsam la bskung zug zhi ba'i bde skabs su gnas shing / 'dis phyi lor dgon sde'i nub ngos su sgrib sel mchod rten phyogs rer la 'dom bzhi re yod pa phyi nang yongs rdzogs kyi bkod 'doms bcas de lugs kyi bsrung rim rgya che ba'i sgo nas legs grub dang de skor ci rigs sbya 7༵dus sde yongs kyi 'du khang chen mor gsor tshon khyad mtshar can brgyab pa'i mgo 'dren sogs

thostan 'gro'i don gyi mdzad bzang sgo gang thad nas mi dman pa yang byas so/ /dgung lo re brgyad skor nas grwang hwa mi dmangs khyi mthun rgyal khab kyi 'od zer stong ldan phog pa'i 'og tu chos rje khong nyid mong shan du zi khron nub byang gi bod rigs rang skyong ljongs 'dzugs rgyu'i gros mol du thebs dgos pas ha'i kho cang zhes kyi dru yan gtso bor rdzi 'gag dpon dang bla ma 'ga' lo tsā ba bcas kyi gsal bsgrags dang slob ston la brten nas chos rje nyid thabs mkhas gyi mdzad pa gang dang gang gis bstan 'akro'i don du khong nyid sku sha rgyas che bas dka' ngal sogs khyad bsad kyi thabs ci drag la rem pa lhur blangs pa'i sgo nas kyi cu yan dpon 'khor dang chos rje grwa 'khor bcas mar 'bar khams du smreb pa'i nyin 'ga' bzhugs nas/ de nas yang 'dzam thang chos rje sbyangs ba ma 'das sprul pa'i sku drung du da skabs drang khrin 'u gtsor 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa rnams la sne len dang zhabs 'degs legs zhu dgos pa'i phyag bris dang bcas yar 'dzam thang du song / khong nyid mar mong shan du byon nas bod rigs rang skyong ljongs kyi gra sgrig u yon gros tshogs du zhugs pas chos rje gang nyid u yon 'dems bskos byas shing de skabs lam bar gyi rgyal kha bkra shis gling gi sngar chos rje lho kha bas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten mthong grol chen mo zhig gsos kyi cha rkyen dngul rdo tshad bcu lhag gi gnang sbyin dang bcas rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa'ang byas shing 'di'i lo phyi mar yang 'dzam thang zhi ba'i bcings 'grol don du bcings 'grol dmag dang las byed tshogs pa rnams dga' bsu rgya cher byas pas khong nyid mi 'ga' res 5 rgya dga'’ sprul sku zhes grags/ de nas rnga yul du dmag srid kyi 'tshogs 'dus su phebs te pha shin drin u yon lhan khang zhes srid jus gsar ba 'dzugs rgyu'i gros tshogs su 'dzam thang stod snad kyi bla dpon 'ga' shas rnga ba'i dpon dpal mgon phrin las mnga' 'og tu tshud thabs byas ched nyin cha shas gros mol thog chos rje nyid kyi khong sngon rgya nag gong ma'i mnga' 'og tu gnas pa'i 'dzam thang chos rje yin nges/ deng skabs su'ang krung go gung khran tang mgo khrid 'og tu 'dzam thang rang gi sa khul du las khungs gsar 'dzugs byed rgyu ma gtogs gzhan g.yam du gtan nas 'brangs rgyu med zhes bsam 'char de tang gi dang du blangs nas deng skabs kyi 'dzam thang rdzong 'dzugs pa'i rmang gzhi tshugs pa'i thabs gang drag gis ho pe'i byu dang khong rnams pas legs sgrub mdzad/dgung lo bdun cur son skabs chos rje gang nyid la krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi gtso 'dzin kru'u in la'i tsung li zhes pas si khron zhing chen nub byang gi bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi u yon bka' yig tham can 'ja' sa dang las gos las zhwa sogs gnang sbyin bcas kyis che bkur khyad par ba byas shing (ma yig gi mchan gzhan chos rje 'di ba 'dzam thang rdzong gi kru'u rin u yon dang zla re la gla phogs dmangs dngul brgya phrag gsum lhag re gnang ngo )lo 'dir chos rje dpon slob rgyal mo rong gi 'phru tog gnas gser gyi 'brong ri srug po'am rgyal rong brag lha mgon por gnas skor phebs dus su lam gyi 'phral rkyen nyi tshe ba'i gnas tshul skog gyur bar thugs kyis mngon sum mkhyen cing khyad par chos rje khong gis sku tshe gang bor yi dam sgrol ma'i bsnyen sngags dung phyur gcig dang phyed phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod rgyud ge 373 —

'bum ther bdun cur nye ba zhal 'don mdzad pa sogs kyi grub 'bras dus su legs par mngon pa yangarnyokhu dpon slob 'brong ri'i gnas su phyin skabs grwa 'khor kun gyi mthong snang mnyam por rje btsun 'phags ma'i thugs rje'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma lngang gsal 'od bzang gi phung pos sa gzhi dang grwa 'khor la ljang laglemer khyab cing de skabs sku 'khor re'i lag tu legs byang ri mo mang dag gis kun nas mdzis pa'i g.yu rdordzomadangs can dngos su rnyed de chos rje la phul ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mngon gsal du ma yongs kyi mthun snang du gyur te gnas der bzhugs skabs gsol mchod kyi tshe thang rer chos rje'i sku mdun du mtshan mor skya mi mang po sogs mi min gyi mjal phrad du ma dngos subyung ba dang / lam bar du byon skabs chos rje'i dbu thog tu 'ja' zer skum po kun nas 'khor ba legs pa'i legs mtshan ltas bzang khyad par ba bsnyon med zol bstod tsam ma yin par der gnas dag gi dbang po'i spyod yul du ci dgar mngon du gyur pa brdzun dang bral nges su 'dug cing / gzhan yang gdon 'dre la 'phral du khrus gcod bka' sgo tsam byas pas 'dre ngan gtan bral byed pa dang 'tshe byed 'byung po'i rang gzugs mngon sum mthong ba 'byung 'gyur ma 'ongs pa'i tshul du ma sngon nas thugs la ji bzhin gsal bas mtshon de rigs kyi gzhan phal pa las ches 'phags pa'i yon tan gyi cha mang dag re sku 'khor nye gnas rgyun sdod dag la tshad mas nges su yod pa'i lo rgyus mang la/ chos rje 'di'i sku tshe gang bor bka' chos dag tshar mang po/ sgrol ma 'bum ther/ dusa'akhor stong chog gdug ring khri/ tshe bsnyen dung phyur sogs gsung sgrog du ma'i yon bcos ches mang po bgyis shing khong gi slob tshogs kyang tshe bcu'i sku zeng brgyad pa la dus 'khor bsdus rgyud gyi bklag lung dang /bla ma mkhyen rtse sogs grwa pa mang dag la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang lung khrid bcas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi lung sogs rim pas gnang bas slob tshogs de dag dang / nyid kyi mdun nas dkar rtsis kyi rig slob pa bla ma dge mchog bla ma blo chos/ bla ma kun dga' snyan grags/ mtsho skyes sprul sku/ phur rtsa bla ma chos blo/ sher blos sogs mang tsam yod cing / rnam dkar gyi mdzad sgo gzhan yang dgung grangs don gcig skor nas sbyangs pa mchog sprul gyis bzhengs dol po'i zab sku'i lha mgron du gtsang pa spub chen sgrol ma dkar ljang bcas kyi sku brnyan mi tshad re re legs bzhengs kyi cha rkyen bskrun pa dang / nyid kyi gsung chos yang rtsis pod bzhi/ 'jigs byed mngon rtogs dur khrod bdag po/ chos skyong sku lnga/dam can mgar nag sha za hor mo sogs kyi bstod gsol las tshogs bcas yongs sdom gleg bam lnga lhag tsam yod la/ nyid de rtsis kyi mkhyen rgya che bas rtsis mkhyen yang grags/ chos rje gang nyid lugs gnyis la mkhas rgya che bas chos phyogs ma zad srid phyogs kyang phyi nang gi dme 'khon 'khrugs long gi sgo legs bsdus mdzad nas gyod kha che chung mang po chod gras gtsang dag mdzad nas yul gru rgya che bar phan bde'i sgo legs spel mdzad pa sogs rlabs po che'i rnam dkar bsod nams kyi byas rjes sgo gang thad nas mi dman pa'o/ /de 'dra'i sgo nas nyid dgung grangs don bzhi sa khyi'i lo'i bar bstan 'gro'i don du 'tsho gzhis su legs bzhugs mdzad nas sku tshe'i mdzad pa tha ma'i tshul la zhugs te lo de'i zla ba gsum bzhi'i skor nas — 374 ge

khong gi sku cung zad bskung ba nas bzung kun gyis zhabs brtan 'bul ba sogs byas kyang nyid kyi zhal nas/da ni rang yang na tshod mtho bas ci 'gyur mi nges sngon chad nas drung pa'i yang sprul rgyal tshab bskos tshul/nyid gyi dbon dpal 'dzin dang drung 'khor sde 'bangs sogs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la brten nas thung go gung khran tang gi mgo khrid 'og 'gro lugs bcas kyi zhal chems zhib rgyas kyi sgo nas gsungs bzhin lo de nyid kyi zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes bcu pa'i nam langs dus kyi dus tsam na sku seng ge nyal stabs sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas kyi steng nas zhi bar gshegs te nyin zhag
