lnga'i ring thugs dam du bzhugs mthar de las legs bkrol gdung mchod zhugs 'bul sogs sgo kun nas rgya cher byas skabs kha ba me tog gi dbyibs dang 'ja' sbrin dang sa g.yo ba sogs dge mtshan re dang bcas dgongs rdzogs mtha' rgyas su spub la/khong nyid dang thog mnyam ni bod smongs su tā la'i rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku tshe'i smad dang / paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng brgyad pa chos kyi nyi ma dang dgu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis dus dang / karma zhwa nag sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje dang bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje gnyis sku dus dang / chos rje 'di'i dgung lo nyer brgyad skor nas gong ma chin rabs kyi mjug rdzogs shing krung hwa dmangs rgyal nas rim bzhin zhe dgu lor thung hwa mi dmangs gyi mthun rgyal khab tshugs nas gtso 'dzin mo'u ku'u zhi dang tsung li thu'u in la'i sogs da bar yan dang / 'dzam thang 'dir gtsang pa'i gdan rabs sku chen 'jam dpal mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ sku 'bring 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal/ se sprul kun dga' phun tshogs zhabs pad sogs dang / sgrub brgyud slob dpon ngag dbang chos kyi dpal 'byor/kun dga' mkhas spub dbang phyug ngag dbang bstan pa gsal byed sogs gyi dus tsam mo/ /(1༷)chos sku zeng bcu bkarma bdud 'dularo dpal bzangapo/sku phreng bcu pa katha bdud 'dul rdo rje dpal bzang po zhes pa'i lo myus ni/ chos rje 'jigs med dbang po sku gshegs khar sku'i yang sprul gang rung la skyes rgyu yin na yang khong gis yang sprul pha mes kyi gdung rus bzang po rgyal rong khro bcu tshang la 'khrungs nges zhes zhal chems ltar gsang sngags bstan pa'i dpal gyur dam pa de krung gung rnga ba khul yul 'bar khams (spyi lo 1985 rab lo 17)shing pho byi ba lo'i zla ba 11tshes 19 nyin gdung rus ma nyams pa yab khro bcu bdud 'dul dbang drag dang / yum byang bla brang tshe ring sgrol ma gnyis la gza' skar gyi 'phrod sbyor bzang po ma yum gyi mi ltas legs pa sogs dang bcas sku bltams/ de yang sku na ches dwangs pa zhig ste chung ming la gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis bdud 'dul rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/ nyid sku ma bltams gong du g.yu thog sprul sku karma bsod nams kyi mi ltas legs po ma 'ong lung bstan tshul du chos rjes gong ma'i yang sprul yin nges lung gsal bo dang / ma yum gyi mi lam du mchod rten dkar po la mchod 'bul dang yum gyi a ma bkra shis skyid kyis kyang nam mkha' nas 'brug gcig phyag tu babs pa sogs rmi ltas gang legs bcas sku bltams/ gzhon nu bskyed bsrings pa'i dgung grangs bdun son skabs khong nyid 'dzam thang du 'gro dgos zhes chos rje yin tshul yang yang — 375 —

rdzusbyang/sa/ khong gi thugs snang la spyir 'dzam thang dang khyad par du chos rje'i pho brang sogs bkra lam du shar de nas khong gi thags 'dun bzhin (spyi lo 1992 )bod rtsis zla ba 12 tshes 30 nyin phyag phebagaganang nas deng skabs 'dzam thang rdzong gi rgyab phyogs lung ba'i la khar thon tshe nyid kyi ma yum la nga rang gi sa 'dzam thang zhes bya ba 'di red gsungs/ de'i nyin 'dzam thang dgon chos rje'i pho brang mdun thang la rlangs 'khor thog nas 'bab ma thag tu pho brang du nyid kyi phyag mdzub btsugs nas khong gi pho brang 'di red khyed rnams tshos shes gi 'dug gam zhes gsung bzhin nang du phebs pas 'di rnams lta dgos lde mig pa 'bod nas lde mig khyer shog zhes sngar chos rjes gong ma'i bzhengs pas mgon khang dang gser khang gnas chung khang sogs zhib mor gzigs nas da gzod gzims khang gong mar 'gro gsungs nas/ der byon ma thag tu chos rje gong ma'i chas rnams mi nyung ba zhig ngos 'dzin byas/ cho 'azul zla ba dang po tshes 1nyin snga dror 'dzam thang dgon bsam 'aspub nor bu'i gling du grwa tshang gis gdan drangs skabs su nam mkha' nas 'ja' sna tshogs dang sa gzhir drod chags pa sogs kun gyi mthong snang du shar/ de nas 'du khang nang phebs zhor du rang bsams kyi chos rje rgyal ba seng ge'i gos ber mnabs nas dkon mchog spyi khri'i thog tu bzhugs nas kun kyis ngo mtshar du byung / rdo rje slob dpon khang dmar dbon pos gsungs pa/ sngon a khu dbon po bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis chos rje gong ma 'jigs med dbang po dgung grangs bdun son skabs su rgyal rong so mang zangs dkar bar ma'i phar mtha' tshang nas khong gis khur nas blu'i 'ongs bas sprul pa'i sku yin pas/ da res kyi bdud 'dul rdo rje sku skyes kyang dgung lo bdun dag dag thog tu phebs kha'i bkra shis pa'i gsol ston gyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa sogs gang thad nas rtags dang rten 'brel 'grub song gsungs/ rjes su (spyi lo 1994)lor spyal ba karma pa sku phreng bcu bdun pa'i 'dzam thang chos rje gong sdusbya ṭwāṃ rsha ༵༵/ 'khrul med yin nges kyi ngos 'dzin byas nas karma bdud 'dul rdo rje dpal bzang po zhes de nas karma bdud 'dul rdo rje dpal bzang po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i zhabs zung bkra shis kyi ri mo rab gnas shing phag lor tang dang srid gzhung gi chog mchan gnang nas khyi lo 1995 lor zla ba 3tshes 16 nyin/ khong gi gdan sa shar 'dzam thang bsam 'aspub nor bu'i gling chos rje dgon du legs byas kyi dge mtshan mngon par bzhad pa'i mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i rdo rje'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i dga' ston rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rgya chen por mdzad do/ de nas dgung grangs bcu gcig steng nas mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jig rten gyi bya ba bral ba'i bla ma dpal grags yongs 'dzin du bsten te glang po che'i ri khrod du rgyun bzhug| ༵dzāḍi /sdus swātsu sdo /ga kārsha sdi~X ba/ zhin thos bsam gyi sgo la zhugs bzhin no/ //rje ༵ṭwāṃspya gang gi thugs slob dag las rang lugs kyi bstan pa la mdzad rlabs can 'dir bshad bya

gnyis pa sbyangs pa ma 'das mchog sbrul kun dga' dpal gyi lo rgyus dus su babs pa gang zhe na/ de yang sbrul pa'i sku gang nyid kyi tshul ljongs 'dir rnam pa gsum du grags pa ste kun mkhyen dol po'i rnam 'phul sbyangs pa ma 'das sprul sku zhes yongs su grags pa dang / pad ma'i rgyal tshab gter chen o rgyan 'azin las gling pa'i rdo rje'i bka' lung ltar na/ 'jam mgon ni mi yi sha tshugs can/ rje tā ra nā tha dpal gyi ming / rang lugs kyi bstan pa ga dar byed/ ces sogs bzhin sku 'di nyid rje btsun rin po che'i rnam par rol pa'i sku skyes su la lar smra ba dang / sbyangs pa mchog sku dngos bzhugs kyi dus su zhal snga nas bka' lung 'dzi stod tsha kha phyogs kyi bla ma rdzogs chen snying thig gi rnal 'byor ba 'jigs med dge ba'i mtshan can gyi sku skyes su'ang lung bstan yod pa dang gsum las da lan gyi skabs 'dir sprul pa'i sku rang nyid gyi zhal bzhes yongs su grags pa sbyangs pa ma 'das mchog sprul thabs mkhas 'gro 'dren dam pa'i mdzad tshul mdo tsam 'chad pa la'ang thog mar sku 'khrungs yul dpal 'dzam thang nor 'dzin gyi gzhi der (spyi lo 1906 rab lo 15)me pho rta la rab dkar sngon las stobs kyi rigs rus mthon po yab tshes bcu gong ma'i mi rgyab chos yag dang yum tsha za 'dzam lo ya rabs gnyis kyi sras su nye bar bsgrun skabs yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i dus yum gyi mi lam du rin po che gter rnyed pa'i snang ba sogs legs pa'i dge mtshan ci rigs pa'ang dus su byung la/ de nas me pho rta yi lo'i hor zla dang po'i yar tshes la 'dzam thang sbyangs ba gong ma'i khyim du yab yum gnyis kyis sras su sku bltams pa na yum gyi lhums nas 'o ma lud pa'i legs mtshan bcas na zug sogs mi bde ba cung zad tsam med par khye'u dkar mdzes yid du 'ong ba bzhin ras 'dzum gyi le'i rnam pa can zhig 'asbongs/ de skabs nam mkha' nas 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i khyim gzhi de nyid du zugs pa sogs kyi rtags mtshan khyad par ba'ang byung zhing / 'di skor skyabs rje mkhar ba rin po che'i dngos slob rnal 'byor ma sha rgya'i mkha' 'gro zhes phyogs nges med rnams su byon pa las re zhig 'dzam thang du phebs skabs/ zhal nas/ 'o da lan sbyangs pa bla ma 'khrungs pas skyid ta yin na'ang / zhes gsungs pa la der gnas dag gis bla ma khong nyid ma 'das pa la mkha' 'gros gsung tshul mi legs pa 'di ci/ zhes sogs skyo ba byas tshe/ yang mkha' 'gro'i 'al nas/ o ya o ya/ sbyangs pa bla ma ma 'das par 'khrungs na de ma 'das sprul sku los yin/ zhes sogs bka' lung sna tshogs pa re mdzad kyin 'dug pa nas bzung rim pas yongs la sku skyes de nyid sbyangs pa ma 'das sprul sku zhes kun nas grags pa chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas zla re song tsam na sbyangs pa skyabs mgon nyid rang khyim du phebs skabs shig na khong la de lugs kyi lo rgyus zhib tu zhus pas khong gi thugs dgyes pa'i ngang nas/ gsung pas/ da lan gyi bu chung gang de bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu zhig sbyis su 'ong na thang / cung zhig nas bu chung de 'dir khyer shog dang rang gis bsrung ba zhig byed/ gsungs pa ltar sku mdun du bu chung de 'ong ba'i skabs su skyabs mgon khong gis bu chung de la khrus gsol dang / khrus byab bsrung gsum/ zhal 'debs bcas kyi sgo na~X ṭwāṃs ngasarjod

legs gnas stsal te/ byis pa chung skyes de nyid la/ khyi gu thar zhes ming gsol/ de phan khong gi thugs brtse ba'i ngang nas bsrung ba ci dgos pa mdzad pas/ me lug lo'i dus su bu chung rang gis gta ci yang smra mi shes pa lta bu yin kyang nyin cig sbyangs dbon kun dga' phun tshogs rgya mtsho bzhugs pa'i pasru du bu chung de nyid byon te zhal nas thugs rje chen po'i snying po yi ge drug ma sgra dag gsal bo'i sgo nas larna'aga' rang byung kyis 'don pa byung bas de gnas kun gyi yid ngo mtshar skyes te snang ba ha las pa byung zhingakau'adi skor du sku skyes byis chung de nyid bar bar rnams su rang khyim mchod khang dra mig dag las zang thal sabud pa yang nye skor ba dag gi mthun snang du gyur pa'o/ /dgung lo gsum pa sa zel lor dza 'go'i dge bshes rin po tshe 'dzam thang chos rje'i khang gsar saphebs skabs sku skyes chung ba de nyid la khong gis byin rlabs bsrung ba bcas kyis kun dga' dpal zhes pa'i mtshan brje ba mdzad bzhin khyod ma 'ongs pa na chos rje nya dbon pa lta bu'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen zhig 'ong ba'i rten 'brel yin/ zhes gsungs pa sogs kyis gzengs bstod dus su gnang zhing / de dang mnyam du chos rje sku phyogs nas kyang byin rlabs bsrung ba bzhes spros gnang sbyin bla blag tu mdzad la/ 'di skor ci rigs par chos rje sgar gyi lha bsrung gis bdag gnyer byas pa'i ltas mtshan sku skyes chung ba'i mi lagadu chos rje'i pho brang nas a tsa ra'i rnam pa dang ga'an mgo brnyan sna tshogs pa can du ma 'ong nas sku skyes rang nyid dbang med du 'khrid par mdzad pa'i snang ba yang yang byung ba dang / bar skabs shig tu rang stim khang pa'i gral phyal gyi wa kha byang ngos phyogs su yod pa'i steng du sku skyes nyid phar byon te wa kha de'i sne phyogs su nyid kyis gos bya gshog ltar brgyangs te tsog pur bzhugs nas 'phur la khad byed pa der gnas 'ga'i mthong chos su gyur tshe mig gis blta mi bzod pa lta bu'i de lhung gi dogs pa skyes nas ku co sogs kyis bag zon nyer bskul gyi skabs su sku skyes rang gi zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas phyag gnyis kyis gos gshog pa ltar byas te phyogs thams cad du gzigs mos bya bzhin bag tsha ba spu tsam med par slar khang steng du phebs 'gro ba dang / yang lan cig khong nyid zhag 'ga' la gar song cha med du bor ba nyin cig khang thog tu de 'phral thon nas bzhugs yod pa dang / sngon chad rang mgo mi thon pa lcogs ra'i nang du bzhugs skabs kyang 'al nas ma ṇi gsung 'ing phyag gis pad skor gyi phyag rgya mdzad bzhin rang thog gi dngos po bsal 'gebs ci dgos kyang nus pa dang bar bar rnams su rtsogs ra de nyid kyi steng 'od dkar po zhig gzhan ngor mthun snang du byung ba dus dus su bsnyon du med pa'i legs mtshan dang / rang khyim gyi nye 'khor na yod pa 'ga' la khong gis da tshod ma ṇi 'don pa gal tshe ma gtogs nam zhig phyi mar ngan song du lhung nyen yod tshul gyi blang dor chos gtam gyis go brda yang yang sprad pa sogs sgo gsum gang thad nas gzhan phal las khyad mtshar can zhig go sku skyes nyid 'di skor rtsed mo'i gnas skabs kun kyang khong gis 'dus sde mang po bsdus nas chos 'chad pa sogs bstan pa chos gzhi legs skyong gi mdzad sgo'i snga ltas su 'os pa'i zlos gar rtsed 'jo ci rigs pa rgyun du mdzad kyin 'dug pa zhig go/— 378 —

de nas dgung grangs brgyad pa chu glang gi lo'i dbyar zla 'bring bo'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin chos rje'i dbon rin chen dpal bzhugs gnas mchod khang du brtan mkhas kyi yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i dge slong chen po je dbon thub bstan 'gyur med rgya mtshos mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ yongs 'dzin dam pa lung rigs spya mtsho sbyangs dbon phun chogs rgya mtsho gnyer ba bla ma kun dga' chos bzhin sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang gi mdun drung nas/ sku skyes dam pa 'di bas tshangs spyod dge bsnyen dang / bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro ba'i dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag pa legs non mdzad/ de'i ston khar chos rje'i grwa tshang 'du khang du rje dbon 'gyur med rgya mtsho gang nyid kyis/ grwa tshang yongs nas zhu ba'i ngor shangs chos nee gu'i nang gi sgos bka' drug dang / phyi'i bka' dbang cha tshang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / rgya gzhung gi bklag lung bcas gang mdzad yongs su rdzogs pa legs par gsan zhing / de rjes khang dmar rten khang du ṭwāṃ /da/bon mchog de nyid kyis sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis kyi dbang bka' gsungs pa kun kyang ji bzhin mnos de nas dgung grangs dgu ba shing stag lo'i hor zla bcu pa'i tshes skor nas rje dbon dam pa nyid sku skyes kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang du gus pas legs bsten gyi sgo nas zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro chos khrid rim par zhus te glang po'i ri khrod der chos mched thub dbang dang lhan cig gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin skyabs sems yig brgya dang phyag 'bum bcas kyi sgom bzlas rnam par dag pa gnad 'khel rim pas mdzad mthar/dgung grangs bcu pa shing yos kyi lor rten khang du sbyor drug pa rnams dang lhan du dbon rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi drung nas sku skyes rang gis 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang bka' dang / dus 'khor gyi mchog dbang khyad par can gsan pa re dang bcas malkol bla rnam lhan skyes sgom bzlas dbeen gsum dag gi zab khrid legs zhu la brten rim pas de lugs nyams len gnad smin gyi skabs myong rtags kyi rim pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dus su ji bzhin thugs nyams su deng dus dang bstun pa'i rtogs pa bzang rab tu gyur pa'i tshul 'dir zhib par bshad pa ngo ma thogs kyang dngos ga'i sor bsam gyi zab khrid de lugs bzhin gsar sems kyi mnyam bzhag skabs thugs nyams su 'od gsal stong pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i sku 'byams klas pa'i gzigs snang dang zi lam 'od gsal gyi ngang nas gnas kyi yul 'ga' zhig sgrib med je bzhin mngon du gsal ba sogs sku skyes nyid kyi gsung zur las thon pa sogs kyis mtshon nyams rtogs gyi 'char sgo gzhan mnyam phal dang ye mi 'dra ba'i mdzad khyad gzhir bzhag gis dngos gzhi srog rtsol rlung sbyor bcas de lugs kyis zab mo'i khrid zhu ba'i go don nyams len gnad khel rgyun ldan gyi skabs/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa me 'brug lo'i zla ba dang po'i nang du rje dbon dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa gang nyid kyi mdun nas/ sku skyes rang la mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang sta gon dngos gzhi khrid lung bcas dang / dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang / thams cad rig pa'i dbang rtand+ra ngoṭwāṃ 7kā phyarnge khyung

gsum/ the brtsegs rnams kyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig kun rig mi 'khrugamib/dus 'khor lha dgu bcas kyi mtshams sbyar sogs kyi lung / 'pho ba ngo sprod sna tshogs pa'i lung khrid gabadagos dag kyang legs par thob cing / lo de'i gnyis pa'i mgo nas khong rnams kyis srog rtsol lus skyosda 'khrul 'khor gang dag gis rlung sbyor gyi mgo bzung ba nas sbon zla ba'i tshes bcur dga' ston tshogs 'khor gyi rjes su 'pho ba'i man ngag sgom pa'i phyag bzhes kyis chos mtshams mdzad pa'i dus su 'dzam thang chos rje'i sgar 'dzin sku phyogs gang gis sprul pa'i sku skyes de nyid sku bdag mdzad nas spyal tshab mchog tu mnga' dbang gsol ba'i sku skyes grwa 'khor bcas rang gi lha sde rnams la gdul byar gnang sgo mdzad nas sku skyes 'khor bcas kyis de dag la rjes gnang sna chogs dang tshe dbang g.yang 'bod bsur bsngo sogs gshen gson rnams la rim gro phan pa ci dgos thams cad mdzad cing / de nas chos rje'i sku phyogs kyis bka' bkod ltar sku skyes mchog sprul de nyid la sgar gzhi grwa 'khor legs bsgrig gis mgo log a skyong gong ma'i nang du gdul byar phebs dgos byung ste/ khong rnams kyis de phyogs kyi 'brog sde gyi la bsrung rim rkyen sel ci dgos kyis re ba dus su legs bskang mdzad ngos nas yul de'i mi khyim zhig gis khong grwa 'khor gdan 'dren skabs lug mang po bsad pa'i sha khrag gis dmar mchod zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad dgos la thug tshe sprul pa'i sku skyes nyid kyi thugs la shugs chen snying rje bzod dka' ba nges par skyes nas nyid kyis bsad sha bzhes 'dod kyi bsam pa gting nas log ste nyi ma de nas bzung sku tshe gang bor bsad sha bzhes pa spangs pa'i brtul zhugs mchog la nye bar gnas pa yin la/ de nas mchog sprul sku skyes dam pa 'khor bcas a skyong ra lo'i sde shog nas gdan 'dren byung bar brten der phebs te khong dpon slob kyis ri sde so so la bsrung rim rkyen sel ci dgos dang / khyad par dpon mo sang la khong rnams kyis mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang mdzad skabs glog dmar 'brug sgra drag po zil shugs lhag par che ba char drag 'phral du 'bab pa'i ltas mtshan kyang byung zhing / 'di skabs sprul pa'i sku nyid bzhugs gdan las khru gang tsam mngon par 'phags pa der gnas kun gyi mthun snang du gyur pa sogs kyis snyan pa cher rgyas kyi grags pas khyab spya nges par che la de skabs dngos mas kyi 'bul 'byor kyang ches mang po dang bcas slar 'dzam thang du phebs nas lo de'i rje dbon dam pas dgun khrid kyi dus zla mgon lugs kyi srog rtsol man chad nas bzung sngar gyi 'phros chos khrid sku skyes khong gis legs zhus te rjes dran 'khrul 'khor gyi mgor skebs par khong nyid lha rje dkon mchog 'phel dang mnyam du chos rje'i khang gsar pho brang du bzhugs nas nyid kyis nyams len gnad smin mdzad rjes/ dgung lo bcu gnyis me sbrul lo'i gnyis pa'i mgo tsam nas rten khang du rjes dran 'khrul 'khor gtso bor byed pa nas bzung rnal 'byor yan lag drug po stan thog gcig ma bcas rim pas gong ma'i phyag srol ji lta ba bzhin legs grub kyi mthar lo de'i nang du rje dbon dam pa'i drung nas 'byung 'dul gyi dmigs khrid khong gis zhus te khang gsar pho brang du bzhugs nas bsnyen tshad gnyis dang kha bskang gi sbyin sreg bcas legs par mdzad/ de nas khong 'khor bcas rma rong phyogs su gdul byar byon dgos byung ste — 380 —

der 'gro phan gyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad cing / skabs ci rigs par yul sde phyogs kyi gnas bzang por grags pa gsor ri'am bse ri zhes pa'i gnas su mchog sprul dpon slob gnas mjal du byon nas gnas brag de'i ngos shig la sbrul pa'i sku nyid kyis phyag gi mdzub mos āḥyig cig gsal bor bris pa der gnas grwa 'khor dag gi mthong chos su gyur skad/yang de skabs shig tu rgu bso zhes pa'i mag pa chus khyer te shi ba'i ltas su khong rnams gdan drangs nas 'pho lung gsungs skabs nyid kyi sku ni grib ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin dwangs gsal du der gnas yon mchod dag gis mthun snang du bsnyon med nye bar mjal ba'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / 'di skor ci rigs shig tu khong dpon slob rang yul du 'ong ba'i dus su de 'phral khong gis thugs la don chen med pa khong khro langs pa'i tshul gyis mi dgyes pa'i nyams dang bcasu sku gzims par bzhugs pa na sku lus jul chu mang po byung ba dang chabs cig thugs kyi khro ba gting nas budasong ba'i snyam 'ong phyin sku tshe gang bor thugs gting nas khong khro tshe ba gtan nas skye rgyu med tshul nyid kyi zhal gsung las byung la/ lo de'i chos rje'i sgar khog gi sku rim 'tshogs pa'i mdzad sgo khong gis mdzad do/ /dgung lo bcu gsum pa sa rta'i lo'i sos kar rje dbon dam pa chos rje'i sku phyogs kyis bla brang du gdan drangs nas zhu ngor/ dbon dam pas phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang bka' cha tshang sbos med bsnyen rkyang lung khrid gnang ba thams cad sprul sku khong la legs par thob pas lo der khong gis phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan la skong bcas legs grub mdzad cing de'i dbyar smad du rten khang chen mor rdo lung bla ma lha ldan gyi drung nas/ kun mkhyen dol po'i bka' bod drug rnam thar bcas kyi bklag lung gsan nas ri khrod du rje dbon gyi sku mdun du/ spyod 'jug brtson 'grus le'u yan gyi 'bru 'grel tsam gyi bshad khrid sku skyes rang gis zhus ste rgyug 'bul kyang 'phrod parwa byas/ de dus dbon gyi zhal ta la/ ci rṣa thug kyang rkyen theg dgos tshul/ rgod bag gi bya ba rgyud ma dul ba'i spyod pa tsub mo gtan nas mi rung ba'i yin lugs yang yang gsungs shing / lo de'i brgyad pa'i nang chos rje'i khang gsar du dung 'khor 'og gi mnan pa bor ba la rtsang mdos kyi mthu sgrub zhag bdun pa'i gral du khong yang phebs dgos byung rjes su slar ri khrod du rje dbon gyi drung nas khong gis spyod 'jug bsam gtan le'u man rdzogs par thugs slob mdzad la/ 'di skor brag dkar sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'dzi stod dgon leb tu phebs nas gang gis bstan bcos 'ga'i bklag lung gsungs rjes mar byon lam chos rje'i 'du khang du chags phebs skabs khong gi zhal snga nas/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi bklag lung / thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang / dus 'khor bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi lung rnams nyid kyis legs gsan gyis skal ba dus su byung ngo / /dgung lo bcu bzhi lug lo'i sos ka tsam na rje dbon mchog gi drung nas/ nyid kyis rta mgrin skye sgang lugs kyi bdag bskyed dmigs khrid zhus nas de lugs bsnyen pa tshad ldan kha bskang bcas legs grub dang /de'i ston khar chos rje'i grwa tshang 'du khang du rje dbon gyis/ grwa tshang yongs kyi ngor bde maṭwāṃ~X narji po'i

lugs kyi dbang dang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung cha tshang gi dbang bka' dang / dus 'khor dbang che dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i zab dbang rnams gsungs pa'ang legs par gsan/ dgung lo bco lnga ba lcags zel gyi lo'i dbyar kha la tshes bcu sku dbon pad ma dpal gyi mdun narikhong gi rje btsun rin po che'i gsung 'bum las sgra pod ma gtogs cha tshang po ti bcu bdun gyi bklag lubadang / 'go ba bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i drung nas/ sgra pod/ chos spyod kha tshang / sngon 'gro chospobadun rnying pa/ dus 'khor rnying pa/ gdugs dkar che chung / snan bla che chung / rnam 'joms khro nag dbang yig bcas/ snang zhi/ sde mchod/ rgyal gsol/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung gter gzhung cha lag mang po bcas/ mgon po lha brgyad bskang mdos/ ma ti'i gter snyon seng gdong rnamamidang / rtsang mdos/ sgrol ma ma la bzhi pa zhabs drung dang / tshe dbang nor bus mdzad pa gnyis dnganatshe dbang nor bus mdzad pa'i rta mgrin las byang gzhung khrid rnams kyi lung yang gsan/dgu lo bcu drug pa lcags bya'i lor rje dbon gyi mdun nas/ sprul sku nyid kyis 'jigs byed 'asgru non gyi khrid gsan nas sbyangs pa'i mtshams khang du bzhugs te bsnyen tshad btang skabs lo de'i nag zla'i nyer bdun la rje dbon dam pa'i dgongs pa dbyings su thim pa'i phyag mchod dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba'ang bsgrubs/dgung lo bcu bdun pa chu khyi'i lor sngar yang yi ge slob pa dang sbyor drug gi skabs dang bsnyen skub du ma'i rigs bka' drin lhag par che ba'i yongs 'dzin dam pa bla ma lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ sprul pa'i sku rang gis kun mkhyen chen po'i 'pho ba khyad 'phags/ gsung 'thor 'tshogs chos bden bzhi gsal ba/ kong sprul gyis mdzad pa'i thun mtshams nyer mkho/ sbyangs pa bla mas mdzad pa'i rab gnas snying po mdor bsdus dang thugs rje chen po'i 'pho ba rtsa bskyed bcas gnyis dang / byams chos sde lnga/mngon mdzod/ skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa sogs dang / sgrol dkar jo lugs/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa/ dmar khrid tshom lugs brgyud 'debs bcas zhabs dkar gsung gi rang gnas sa phyogs ma/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud gyi bsdus don rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ sgrol ma rnam 'byor ma'i rgyud dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma gnyis rje btsun gyis bsgyur ba mchan bu bcas sogs kyi lugs khrid gsan la/phung po lnga'i rab dbye'i rnam par bshad pa la slob gnyer mdzad cing / de skabs su khong gis sems byung nga gcig gi bshad pa rtsom bsgrig kyang mdzad/ sgrol dkar jo lugs kyi bsnyen tshad kyang btang ngo / /dgung lo bco brgyad pa chu phag lo'i ston kha tsam na chos rje'i 'du khang du tshes bcu'i sku dbon pad ma dpal gyis mchog sprul 'di nyid kyis gtsos grwa tshang yongs la/ 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang / ni gu bka' nang ma cha tshang / gnyan sgrol rjes gnang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / tshe sgrub mda' 'phel mar grags pa lha bcu bdun gyi dbang / tshe dbang lha kaug 3༵༵ gatram̐g thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang / dus 'khor dbang chen dang / lha dgu'iglu

dbang rnams gsungs skabs dbon dam pa'i spyan stong gzugs kyis bsgribs nas yi ge mi gzigs pa lta bu red tshe dbon nyid kyis bka' bkod ltar ma 'das mchog sprul gang gis phur pa 'khon lugs kyi dbang bskur cha tshang / mi 'khrugs pa dang / thams cad rig pa'i dbang / ni gu'i bka' phyi ma yongs rdzogs/bo dong tshe sgrub bcas kyi dbang bka' grwa tshang yongs la legs gnang mdzad/ 'di skor nas chos rje sku phyogs kyis bka' gsung bzhin khang dmar du bla ma dam pa chos kyi dbang phyug bzhugs pa de nyid sgrul sku khong gis chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsten te de'i mdun nas rim par thos bsam slob gnyer gyi dbu tshugs de nas dgung lo bcu dgu pa shing byi'i lor rdo rje 'chang chen po ngag dbang tshegs gnyis rgya mtsho'i sku drung du/ rgyud sde rab 'byams yongs su rdzogs pa zab dbang gi chu bo chen pos slob tshogs de dag gi thugs rgyud lam rim pa gnyis kyi sa bon smin ma rag tu mdzad la/ gzhan yang sprul pa'i sku nyid kyi lo der snga phyi ci rigs par ri 'phongs bla ma chos rab kyi mdun nas/ chos bka' du ma zhig dang / khang dmar du se dgon gyi bla ma gsang mtha' byon pa'i mdun nas rje btsun rin po tshe'i gsung 'thor ba'i rigs sngon nas dpe yod tshad rnams dang / gtsang pa'i gajims khang du rdo rje slob dpon ngag dbang smon lam bzang po'i drung nas rje btsun gyi gsung 'thor phyis su byon pa rnams kyi bklag lung kun kyang legs gnang mdzad/ nyid chos ston pa'i slob dpon mchog gi drung nas/ 'ba' mda' bla mas mdzad pa'i bsdus grwa sogs la slob gnyer gyis thos bsam mdzad par mngon pa ste/ 'di skor gong 'og ci rigs par rten khang du sku nyid dgung lo bcu dgu pa'i dus su dam pa'i gsung las khol du byung ba'i bsdus grwa'i spyi don rnam bshad kyang nyid kyis gsung rtsom nye bar mdzad pa'i phyir/dgung lo nyi shu pa shing glang gi lo'i nag zla'i bco lnga la nyid kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa sku gshegs shing yongs 'dzin nyid sku bzhugs gshegs gang thad la bgyi ba gang dgos thams cad sku sprul rang gis mdzad cing de'i sos ka tsam na slob dpon chen po chos kyi dbang pos sprul ba'i sku nyid pha ri'i sgrub khang du chags phebs mdzad par byas te sku nyid kyang sgrub po bsam 'grub ces pas phying dkar gsum brtsegs thog sna tshogs rdo rje mtshal ris kyis bris pa la bzhugs su gsol ba'i legs mtshan bcas khong nyid kyis sgrub po gang dag la zab mo chos khrid kyis legs skyong gi dbu 'dzugs pa'i rten 'brel legs bsgrig kyang mdzad/ de'i dbyar smad du yongs 'dzin gyi dgongs rdzogs su sprul pa'i sku mchog gis chos rje'i 'du khang chen por 'dus pa nyis brgya lhag la rje btsun rin po che'i bka' 'bum las byung ba'i rgyud sde rab 'byams yongs su rdzogs pa'i zab dbang legs bskur mdzad skabs nyin cig bde mchog gi dbang gi dus bum chu bum pa gang gis dbang nyan mtha' dag la 'grims yang da dung ma zad pa'i rtags mtshan kyang byung / de dus su rtogs ldan lha mchog rang yang dbang nyan du 'ong ba'i skabs mchog sprul gyis thog ma dbang gi lo rgyus gsungs pa'i skabs nas kyang lha mchog la ye shes phebs pa'i nyams gsal po kun nas byung la/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa me stag lor khong grwa 'khor dang bcas mgo log tu gdul byar phebs dgos byung ste de phyogs su mdzad 'phrin — 383 —

rgya che bas 'gro don mtha' rgyas kyi ngang 'bul nor ches mang 'byor zhing sku sgrul khong dad zas 'bul nor tswa cang 'du che bzhin 'dod yon la zhen log gis chos rje'i khang gsar pho brang zhig gsos kyi cha rkyen byas shisda 'di skabs gong 'og thams cad du nyid la thags skabs gang yod kun rten khang du slob dpon dam pa'i drung nas chos la slob gnyer rgyun ma chad du khong gis mdzad pa yin/ lo der tsha rong phyogs bzhag shod dgornalnga sogs su khong dpon slob bcas phebs nas mchog gi sprul skus mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang dang / duspo'akhor dbang chen sogs zab bka' mang pos 'gro don mdzad bzhin 'bul nor rgya cher bsdus/dgung lo nyer gnyis pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i thog ma me yos kyi gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dus na ri khrod du khong gis mi 'khrugs pa'i bsnyen mtshams zhal zas kyi bya ba gdan gcig gi ngang nas lha bsnyen tshad ldan kha bskang sbyin sreg bcas legs thub mdzad cing / 'di skor 'dzi rong g.yag tshe'i phyogs su bud med 'gog thag gis grir shi ba ro langs la khad par khong gis 'pho ba mdzad pas bam ro de nyid las chu ser byung nas ro shub ste rang sar song / yang shi bo 'pho ba thebs dka' ba zhig la sprul sku nyid kyis 'pho lung gzab nan gyis no mgo'i thod rus bcag ste tshangs bug gsar rdol byung ba'i sku rtags khyad mtshar ba dus su thon pa'i mthu nus mnga' zhing / lo der chos rje'i khang gsar pho brang gi nub phyogs zhig gsos gsar grub bcas kyis gser khang yang de phyogs su gsar bzhengs phyi bkod kyi rnam pa'ang klub la/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa me 'brug lor khong gis ri khrod du dbon yon tan rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i khang brtsegs mchod rten la rab gnas dang dbon de nyid kyi drung nas grol mchog khrid brgya'i khrid lung yang gsan par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'dzi sribs dgon gyi rdor slob bla ma bla ba grags pa'i mdun nas/ dus 'khor 'grel chen bklag lung / khyung khri rgyud dang man ngag lugs kyi rjes gnang khrid lung bcas/ gzungs gra lnga'i dbang chab chog khro nag dbang / sbyor drug khrid sogs chos bka' du ma dang / khang dmar dbon rgan gyi drung sbyor drug cha tshang yang legs mnos mdzad/dgung lo nyer bzhi pa sasbrul lor sprul sku khong gis ri khrod du yon tan rgya mtsho sogs la dol po'i bka' pod drug rnam thar bcas dang / byams chos sde lnga sogs kyi bklag lung / dbon chos grags sogs la sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang / de'i rtsa rgyud dang rgyud phyi ma mchan bu can gyi bshad lung / rje btsun gyi gsung thor du ma'i lung sogs gnang zhing / khong gis 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i gzims khang du gdung yangs bla ma smon lam gyi mdun nas/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel phyogs mchan can gyi bshad lung ji bzhin nod par mdzad ngos nas lo de'i chos rje'i sku rim dus zab thengs mang po'i zhal phye mang 'tshogs la mjal kha'i skabs sprul pa'i sku nyid kyis de kun la dam rdzas myong grol 'gyed bzhin dge bskul rgya che ba'i 'gro don kyang mdzad do/ /dgung lo nyer lnga pa lcags rta'i lo'i nag zla'i yar tshes bco lnga la brtan mkhas kyi yon tan mchog mngaḍi baṭwāṃ ༵ dmar dgon gyi slob dpon kun dga' snyan grags kyis mkhan po dang / ngag dbang bsod

nams bzang pos las slob/ bla ma thugs rje dpal gyis gsang ston pa mdzad pa sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang gi drung nas/ mchog sgrul nyid kyis tshes bcu'i sgrul sku sogs dang chabs cig tu bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong dngos po legs thob mdzad cing / de skor zhig tu byang chub sems sdom yang gsan/ lo der khang rgan bla ma mkhas dbang sogs las 'jigs byed snyan brgyud kyi zab khrid khong gis legs nod kyi sgo nas bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan kha skong bcas kyang spub pa sogs chos la nyan sems ci rigs pa'ang mdzad la/de yan du bar bar long skabs gang yod rnams su slob dpon chos dbang ba'i mdun nas/ sprul sku rang gis 'ba' mda' bla mas mdzad pa'i yum ṭika chung ba/ blo rig gi bshad pa/ dza 'go'i dge bshes kyis mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i rnam bshad/ mngon 'dzod 'bru 'grel/ bla chen gyis mdzad pa'i theg mchog ṭika zin/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa/ dus 'khor bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid bshad cha tshang sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs mkho che ba dag la brtson pa lhod med kyis sbyang ba thos bsam gnad khel bcas kyi mthar slob dpon chen po gang gi bka' bkod kyis sprul pa'i sku nyid la 'dzam thang pha ri'i sgrub sde ba zab chos kyis rtag par rjes bzung dgos tshul gyis rdo rje slob dpon chen po mnga' gsol ba'i bka' lan thabs gang nas bzlog thabs med par gyur cing sngon sbyangs pa skyabs mgon sku dngos bzhugs kyi zhal snga nas kyang / khong gi shul tshab 'dus sde yongs la chos kyi rjes bzung byed mkhan phyis su yod tshul gyi bka' lung yang yod pa de lugs ltar 'dir slob dpon mchog gis rgyal tshab bsko bzhag kyang de ltar gnang ste zhal ta bka' 'phros ci dgos bcas kyi mthar ring po ma lon par slob dpon khong nyid kyang zhi dbyings su gshegs shing / tshul de ji lta ba bzhin gong chos rje'i sku dbon gang dag gis sbrul sku mchog nyid sgrub sde ba dang grwa tshang yongs la chos kyi slob dpon dam par ci nas kyang bzhugs dgos nges kyi thad nas bka' phebs ldog med byung ba la bzlog thabs bral tshe/ sprul pa'i sku khong nas kyang / gal te nges par dgos na 'du sde yongs kyis bya ba gang ci'i thad kun spyod yang dag gi 'grig khrims dam po legs par dgos pa'i chad mdo 'dra nyis kyi bka' shog yi ge 'gyur med bcas de phan nas chos kyi lam lugs la gang thad nas thugs 'gan bzhes dgos byung la/de nas dgung lo nyer drug lcags lug lo khong gis/ sgrub khang bdag la chos khrid ci dgos gnang zhing lo der ri khrod du nyid kyi gzims spyil gsar du grub pa dang / ri khrod de'i 'du khang yang gsar bzhengs kyis gzhi khyon legs par grub la/dgung lo nyer bdun chu sprel la khong gis 'dzam thang du khang brtsegs mchod rten la rab gnas dang /'dus sde yongs la sbyong rgyud kyi dbang bskur kyang mdzad/ dbon yon tan spya mtsho'i drung nas ni gu'i khrid skor brgyud rim dbang gis zhu ba'ang byas nas/ dgung lo nyer brgyad chu bya la sprul sku gang gis bla ma kun 'phel sogs la rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang zhing lo der ri khrod du kun mkhyen dang rje btsun gyi skye rabs rnam thar gyi bris thang bcu gsum gsar bzhengs dang / bslab pa yongaṅkaspyong gi dge 'dun gyi dbyar gnas kyang btsugs/ khong gis chos skyong sku lnga'i mdos bskang rtsom skadzasadarmi tram̐ma~X ༵ rgyal po'i

rang gzugs kyis gus 'dud lan gsum 'bul ba'i gsal snang byung zhing / 'di skor 'dzi yul du stod sprul zhes gter ston zhig tshebs pa thog ma sngon nas ma 'das mchog sprul gyis gter ston ji bzhin min pa thugs kyis mkhyen pas de lugs khong gis rang tshugs bzung ba'i ngang tshul mdzad la/ de dang mnyam dumigater byon pa la de'i mdun nas/ khong gis gter ston nyid kyi gter byon thang stong rgyal po'i sgrub skor/rje btsun sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bka' bsrung lha lnga'i stod las/ 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs dbang chog bcas/ gu ru yab yum gyi rnam thar/ sgrol ma martsel bzhi chog bsam lhun rnams kyi baglag lung legs par gsan no/ /dgung lo nyer dgu shing khyi la khong gis bris thang de dag la rab gnas mdzad skabs dol po'i sku 'dras me tog legs bzhes bsnyon med kyi rtags mtshan byung zhing khong nyid kyis gzhan yang chos ldan gyi bya ba yul sde spyi la bsrung rim dang slob ma 'ga' la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa 'bog pa dang / la lar phung lnga'i bshad khrid sogs kyang mdzad/ 'di skor lha bzo sang jo mo dbus gtsang du gnas mjal song ba mar lam grogs dag gis bskyur nas de shi ba skad du brjod pas rang yul du gshin chog la bla sgar du ma drangs mthar ma 'das mchog sprul drangs nas khong gis khrus chog gi mthar tshe 'gugs yang yang gsungs te 'bul ba gang yang ma bzhes par phebs song ba ltar phyis su jo mo de nyid gson por smrebs 'ong ba thog tu khel/dgung lo sum cu shing phag lo zla ba dang po'i nang nas khong gi ri khrod gzims sbyil du bzhugs te nyid kyis sbyor drug mgo nas skyabs 'gro 'bum ther phyag bcas song mtshams gzims khang de nyid du rten gsar tshad ldan legs sgrub kyi rjes sems bskyed/ yig brgya martsel/ kun mkhyen bla rnam la brten pa'i gsol 'debs rnams re re nas 'bum ther 'gro nges dang / hakṣa 'bum ther bcu dang bcas kyi mthar/dben gsum/ sor sdud rim pas nyams len gnad smin mdzad skabs nas ri khrod de'i dbyar gnas la'ang bzhugs te khong gis der gnas 'dus pa rnams la byang chub sems sdom yang gnang zhing de skabs dge bshes ting 'dzin phebs pa'i drung du dbu ma theg mchog gi bshad pa'ang legs par gsan pa'i sgo nas sbyor drug cha tshang nyams len mdzad pa dang / dza 'go'i ri khrod du bla ma rig mchog gi mdun nas/ khong dang tshes bcu sprul sku sogs kyis rdo rje 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang yongs rdzogs kyang nod/dgung lo so gcig me byi la dmar dmag rgyang bskyod skabs su khong gi sku mdun du thugs slob jo mo zhig 'ong nas da lan dmar dmag thon nam mi thon zhus tshe/ zhal nas ku re'i tshul du/ da lan dmar dmag myur du thon nges yin zhes gsungs pas/ de lugs ltar gyur nas dmag zing gi skabs khong dang chos rje'i sgar khog lha sde dung tshang bzhi bcu lhag tsam bcas rgyal mo rong zangs dkar phyogs lebs skabs rgyang bskyod kyi dmar dmag khri gsum lhag der 'dus nas dmu dge phyogs su 'gro skabs chos rje'i sgar dang lha sde'i phyug nor rgyu rdzas mang tsam skyel 'bul byas nas/ sprul pa'i sku'i da lan nga tshos 'gal rkyen sel ba dang rgyang bskyod dmar dmag rnams 'dod pa cum song bas zhin tu legs song / zhes gsungs myongs/— 386 —

nyid gyi thugs la spyir chos kyi mthu nus bsam gyi mi khyab pa lta ci tha na chos gos kyi tshal bu tshun la 'di phyi'i bsrungatshoskyobros che ba'i nus pa yod pa thugs yid gting nas ches pa sogs dang / lha chos skyong gi 'asgrin las kyis rgyu sa re chag god byung ba ma gtogs khong mchog sbrul rnam gnyis gtsor grwa 'khor lha sde rgan gzhon kun bcas nyer 'tshe'i skyon dang bral nas bde skabs su gnas pa byung ngo / /dgung lo so gnyis me glang la rdo khog phyug shul ri khrod du nyid kyis tshe mtshams pa bla ma mthu dpal dang /'jigs med ye shes sogs la sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis kyi dbang dang / dus 'khor dbang chen sogs chos bka' du ma legs gnang mdzad cing / 'dzi stod tsha kha'i brag dmar dgon du rnal 'abhor ma'i sgrub mchod rdul tshon la brten pa'i 'tshogs grwa 'dzugs pa'i dbu bzung ba dang de lugs kyi 'tshogs thebs sogs nyer mkho thams cad dus su mdzad/ lo der khong gis dza 'go'i dgon kyi slob dpon gshegs pa'i dgongs mchod dang / chos rje'i sgar gyi sku rim/ ri khrod kyi rgyud sde'i sgrub mchod 'ga' re dang / dbyar gnas dang de'i mjug tu thar chog 'dzugs pa sogs bgyi ba ci dgos maba' dag kyang mdzad la/ de nas lha tshe'i mchog sprul gyis mdun nas/ khong gis snying thig nang sgrub rtsal dbang / tshe dbang yum bka'i dbang /thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol dang / rarna'i gsang 'dus/ kar gling zhi khro/ rarna'i gu drag dang phur pa/ gu ru chos dbang gi bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ ma cig rigs lnga/ khros ma lha lnga/tshogs bdag mgon po'i gter gzhung gi dbang bka' sogs gsan pa dang / bla ma lhun po'i drung nas/nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa sogs dang / sngon dus shig nas 'dzong bo skyabs mgon gyi mdun du byang shā/ba /sems sdom/ sbyor drug khrid lung sogs de thams cad khong gis snga phyi ci rigs su legs par zhus dgung lo so gsum sa stag la khong gis ri khrod du rmad byung sogs la ni gu'i chos bka' ci dgos gnang ba nas bzung lo 'gar de'i rgyun tshugs la/ ma ṇi bla ma pad ma sirnyi byon pas de'i chos 'tshogs la'ang bzhugs shing / de nas khong dpon slob bcas bkra shis sgang du phebs nas der gang gis rten gtor 'dzugs pa dang / dgung lo so bzhi sa yos kyi dus su yongs la dus 'khor dbang chen sogs chos bka' ci dgos gnang ba dang bsrung rim byin rlabs kyang mdzad la/ bzhag shod dgon lnga sogs su kun mkhyen chen po'i drug mchod kyi thebs bzhags sogs rlabs chen gyi mdzad pas de phyogs su lo legs shing bde skyid kyi dpal kha sngar las che ba byung / de nas rang yul du khong gis chos ldan gyi bgyi ba 'ga' dang khyad par 'dzam thang du kun mkhyen gyi drug mchod dus 'khor sdom pa chen po'i sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs mchod bkod khyad par ba dang / khang dmar rten khang du rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi 'dzin grwa rgyun 'dzug gi nyer mkho dag kyang legs bskrun bcas kyis rgyud sde'i rgyun 'tshogs bya ba'i dbu tshugs/dgung lo so lja lcags 'brug la chos rje'i 'du khang du khong gis/ lha lung mtshams pa sogs kyi ngor rin 'byung cha tshang gi dbang gsungs shing sribs lung khang brtsegs mchod rten la rab gnas dang / khang — 387 —

dmar du rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang gi mgo bzung ba'i mdzad sgo gnang zhing lo der ri khrod kyi dbyar gnas 'dzam thang du spros pa'i tshul gyis dbu tshugs shing ra shug ri khrod du ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho dgongs pa dbyings su thim pa la gshegs mchod phyag smon mdzad pa la khong yang phebs/ de nas dbang 'phro ci rigs gsung bzhin 'dzam thang sbyangs pa'i sngar gzims khang du rten thang du ma 'bri bzhengs dang bcas lo 'di nas kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas kyi 'dra sku blug ma sprul pa'i sku rang gi sku tshad tsam zangs gser las nyer bskrun gyi dbu bzung / khong dzi rong du phebs nas grub chen mkhan po gang rnam gyi drung nas/ nyid kyis dri med rnam gnyis kyi dbang chog bsod nams mchog grub gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas dbang lung sogs rten bzhengs la mkho ba'i chos mang po gsan/dgung lo so drug lcags sbrul la khong gis kun mkhyen sku brnyan rag rim tsam spub pa la ma ṇi bla ma pad ma sirnyi gdan 'dren gyis rab gnas zhus shing skabs der sprul sku khong la sku ngal che ba byung ste de slad gshin don de dge rdzong stobs chen khong gis mdzad ngos nas gshin po tshe 'das dag gi rnam shes thugs snang du byung ba la 'phags mchog snying rje'i dbang phyug dran bskul gyi sgo nas rnam shes de nyid mngon dga'i zhing du lam bstan pas 'gro phan mdzad pa dang / 'di thad kyi shul du mkhon pa legs bsdum gyi ched dang /rang re'i bstan pas chos gzhi'i sde bsdu sogs bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi don du khong dpon slob ja yul gyi dme rgyal la gtug pas gnod byed jag pa gang yin gyi rtsad chod pa ma tshad/ chom po re yang lag tu lon pa byung zhing de nas wa shul khro ko phyogs su phebs lam a mchog rin po che mjal 'phrad kyis phan tshun chos bka' gnang res bcas thugs nang gcig 'dres su gyur cing de'i phyogs kyi lha sde chos rje ma bsdu grabs kyi 'char gzhi tsam dang bcas rten bzhengs cha rkyen gser kyang bzang rab 'byor/dgung lo so bdun chu rta la khong gis sngar gyi rten bzhengs 'phro rtsam bzhin khong bzhugs gnas kyi khang pa sribs lung du yod pa dus 'khor yongs rdzogs bsnyen mtshams pa de phan lo bstar gyi bzhugs gnas su mdzad de lo re bzhin gyi bsnyen mtshams pa byung ngo cog la chos bka' ci dgos thams cad kyang mdzad cing /sribs lung khang brtsegs mchod rten nang du lha ris cha tshang 'di lor grub pa sogs kyi mdzad sgo dang bcas kun mkhyen chen po'i 'dra sku khyad mtshar ba sku rgyu zangs khal gcig dang / byugs gser zho brgya dang nyer gsum lhag sogs cha rkyen gang dgos 'dzoms pa'i ngang nas nang gzhug rab gnas dga' ston rgya che zhing tshad ldan legs grub kyis rten sku gzugs kyi mdangs lhag par rgyas shing mkha' la 'ja' smrin dang yul sde'i phyugs nad chad pa sogs legs mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dus su byung ngo / /dgung lo so brgyad chu lug la chos rje'i 'du khang du khong gis sngar rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang 'phro 'dus pa mang po la gsung bzhin 'du khang de nyid du dol po'i sku rten mchog bzhugs pa'i rgyab yol mdzes rgyan drug yab sras bco lnga'i skus legs par brgyan pa sogs mdzes khyad kyi bkod lugs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing / skabs ci rigs par rje btsun gyi sku brnyan gser zangs las bsgrun pa bskyangs khru gang — 388 —

lhag yod pa legs bzhengs kyi bkod 'doms bcas kyis 'grub par mdzad pa sogs rlabs po che'i spyod bzang la nyer bar gnas ngos nas khong dpon slob rnga yul se dgon phyogs su phebs bzhin der drung pa'i yang srid gsum pa'i sku skyes la sku bdag blu yon gyi mdzad sgo dang bcas khro kor khong gis lha sde bsdu skabs thog mar phyogs re tsam las cha tshang bsdu skabs ma 'grig la de phyogs su khong gis mang tshogs la chos bka' sna tshogs pas 'gro don mdzad pa las nyin cig thugs rje chen po'i dbang gi dus nyan pa'i nang nas rgad po zhig la tha mal 'di snang 'gags nas 'phags pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs gnas po ṭa la'i gnas tshul dag snang gi rnam par shar te ngang de gar yud tsam du lus pa byung /dgung lo so dgu shing sprel la lha sde chung tsam 'dus shing khong dpon slob the ba'i nang du bsrung rim sogs kyi ched gdan 'dron gyi skabs sgrul pa'i sku nyid bsrung rim pa bla sprul gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i yi dam lha ru ka'i sku dngos kyi 'jigs rngams che ba'i zil shugs kyi gzi mdangs 'bar zhing mdzad 'azin zla dang bral ba'i grags pa byung la/ de nas khong rnams khro bcu so mang rgyal po'i khab tu phebs nas der bsrung ba rkyen sel ci dgos mdzad nas lha sde bsdu ba la mi 'os pa byed mkhan gyi thad la mi dbang yab sras blon bcas kyis drang mos gzi bzhag chod khra'i bka' shog gis nye bar bsdams te skabs de'i dgos don legs grub mdzad sgo'i ngang nas khong gis de phyogs su ma ṇi'i chos 'tshogs rgya che ba'i 'gro don gyi skabs de'i chos gral a mchog dge bshes du ma sogs gsar rnying gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po byon pa bcas la chos bka' sna tshogs dus su stsal bas dam pa de dag gi thugs ngo mtshar zhing dad gus kyis bla mar bsten pa sogs mtshan snyan gyi grags pa kun nas rgyas pa'i ngang der thugs rje chen po'i dbang gi dus dbang nyan pa stong phrag kha shas tsam la bum chu bum pa gang tsam gyis khrus sogs gang dgos thams cad byas phyir der gnas kun ha las pa'i ngo mtshar skyes so/ 'tshogs de skabs su khong gis 'dod yon bsur bsngo mdzad pa'i me rjes sor zhag bdun phrag gsum gyi ring du ma zhi bas de la'ang ya mtshan skyes skad/ de 'dra'i swāṭwāṃ/ sdi~X ༵zlo zlo/ sna ༵ mgā/sa/ phan gyi bgyi ba gang dgos dag dang khyad par bsrung rim phur pa'i dgung lo bzhi bcu thing bya la khong gis de phyogs su drung pa sku skyes kyi khri ston dang / rgyud sde ba la 'tshogs gdan rtse zhwa'i cha rkyen kyang mdzad/ de skabs su sku phyogs de la mchog sprul gyis rang re'i bstan pa la nyer bcol nan zhus mdzad cing / de skor skyabs tshang gi bud med smyon ma gzhan dag gis phan thogs dka' ba sprul sku nyid kyis phyag nas gtor zhing brab pa tsam gyis de ma thag smyon ma de nyid brgyal song nas ja sbyor tsam la ma sangs de nas slar sangs phan chad smyo nad gtan bral du gyur pa dang / yang khong gis rgyo shes sang la 'od dpag med dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang gsungs dus sgo khyim thams cad 'od dmar pos gang ba yon mchod dag gi mthun snang du bsnyon med byung ba sogs kyi mthu nus kyi mtshan ma phyir mngon la/de nas khong dpon slob rnga yul se dgon du phebs nas nyid kyis der sbyor drug gi zab khrid kyi 3༵kār rdagon

po khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi dus glog 'brug drag char byung ba dang mgon po sku las sbos dud dang bdudartsi 'dzag pa mngon gsal du'ang byung la/ de dus khong gis bla ma gsang mtha'i drung nas gza' dbang srog gtad bcas dang / ri khrod pa sangs rgyas kyi mdun/ mkha' spyod ma'i dbang sogs dang / dpa yul mchog sprul gyi mdun nas/ bka' brgyad dpal 'dus kyi dbang rnams gsan/ de nas khro kaur byon skabs sgyu mdo'i bkra shis thang du gzims gur phubs nas bzhugs skabs rlung 'tshubs kyi dbus namidapal ldan lha mo'i rnam 'phrul bud med sngo nag 'jigs gzugs can nu gcig ral pa sa la 'khyil ba bzhin phyag gnyis kyis thod pa nas bdud rtsi stob pa'i tshul gyis gus 'dud bcas mchog sprul nyid bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du dngos su thon 'ong ba grwa 'khor gyis mngon gsal du mthong / de skor yag shul tshe bkra jag pa song nas zla shas 'gor bas rang khyim gyis shi gson gang yin cha ma gyed skabs su sprul pa'i sku nyid drangs tshe khong gis de ma shi gson por gnas par ma zad don chod tshul gsal por gsungs nas da zhag gnyis tsam shāsna // ༵/ ༵/cad pa bzhin phyis su de kho na ltar thog tu khel ba sogs khyad 'phags kyi mdzad sgo mang po dgung lo zhe gcig me khyi la khong gis rgyud sde ba rnams la nyer mkho'i zhwa gos sogs dang bcas tshur rang gnas chos rje'i sgar du phebs nas drung pa'i sku skyes chibs bsu rgya che bas khri 'don dang nyid kyis mtshams sgrub chos bka' 'chad nyan ci rigs pa dang / srib lung du khong gis khang brtsegs mchod rten nang gi lha ris la brtan bzhugs dang der gto sgrub cig gi dbu bzhugs dus bsgral las kyi tshe gnod byed gzugs kyi ling ga 'gul nas bla 'og bsgyur la khad du byung ba der gnas grwa 'khor gyis mthong ba'i mthu nus bstan pa dang / drung pa sku skyes sogs la sbyor drug myong khrid kyang gnang / 'di skor pha rol phyogs gyi 'tshe byed la nyes pa mngon gsal du byung zhing / khro ko phyogs kyi lha sde dag la bla tshab kyang nam dgos dus su brdzangs pa yin/dgung lo zhe gnyis me phag la slar khong dpon slob khro kho phyogs su bhon te khong nyid kyis bla tshab sgar la mgo 'dzin ci dgos dang / rdo grub sprul sku dang khong gnyis mjal phrad chos bka' gnang res mdzad cing /gtsang grub mjal bar phebs lam du 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi skye bar grags pa zhu chen sprul sku'i drung du/khong gis dpal sprul sngon 'gro'i khrid lung / sku lnga'i srog gtad kyi dbang / zab tig sgrol ma'i khrid rnams gsan/ de nas 'bri ngam mdor gtsang grub chen sku dngos mjal skabs grub chen mchog gis sku nyid la mnga' ba'i nang rtogs kyi yon tan ji bzhin mkhyen te bsngags brjod che bas gzengs bstod nye bar mdzad/ de nas khong rnams a sug mas gdan 'dren gyi sgo nas bsrung rim chos bka' ci dgos kyis 'gro donadang bcas mthar 'brog sgar du bzhugs nas nyin cig byon bzhud kyi skabs shig tu sprul pa'i sku nyid chibs gong du bar bar mi snang ba grwa 'khor 'ga'i mthong snang du byung bas re zhig na khong gi 'al nas/ da lanashaṃ ma py-i~X0 nas bla ma zhig shambha lar phebs 'dug pas de lam la bzhag dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar dus

tshod de mnyam du khang dmar rdo rje slob dpon kun dga' bsod nams mgon pos dag zhing gzigs la/rā /ma/tshams shig nas khong dpon slob slar 'dzam thang du phebs skabs grwa tshang la phyag 'bab rgya cher bcas dgung lo zhe gsum sa byi la khong gi srib lung ri khrod dang rten khang tshun gyi mtshams sgrub pa dag la chos khrid ci dgos mdzad bzhin rten khang du sgos kyi bsrung rim phur sgrub dang bcas de lor sprul sku nges don rgya mtsho phebs drung nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' chos yongs rdzogs kyi bklag lung dbyangs drug 'gyur gyis legs mdzad pa kun kyang gsan rjes su rten khang du khong gis sngar gyi rdor slob gshegs pa'i dgongs mchod byin che ba mdzad pa'i mthar slob tshogs rnams la kun mkhyen dol po'i bka' pod drug rnam thar bcas dang / rje btsun gsung 'bum cha tshang gi bklag lung / dus 'khor 'grel chen phyogs mchan dang / rtsang mdo'i sogs gtod pod 'ga'i lung bcas legs par gnang / de nas khong gis/ lha tshe mchog sprul gyi mdun nas/ klu sgrub lugs kyi sems bskyed dang / rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter kha pad ma 'od 'bar sgo nas tshe dbang sogs dang / bya yur dgon gyi rdor slob bstan pa rab rgyas kyi drung / zab mdo'i bsrung bzlog bsad gsum/ sbyor drug gi zab khrid sogs drung pa'i sku skyes bcas kyis legs gsan mdzad/dgung lo zhe bzhi sa glang la skabs ci rigs par khong dpon slob rgyal mo tsha rong phyogs su phebs nas sprul pa'i sku nyid kyis bla ma tshul khrims sogs 'dus pa mang po la tshe sgrub mnga' 'phel ma'i dbang gnang skabs tshe mda' sor lnga tsam bskyed 'phel gyi legs mtshan dus su byung ba dang / 'ba' wa 'bro dgon du khong gis dol po'i bka' 'bum gyi bklag lung dang / khang gsar dgon du phur pa'i dbang / dza 'go'i dgon du sbyor drug chos khrid ci dgos mdzad pa dang / khyad par lha mo rig byed ma'i dbang bskur ba'i skabs 'dus sde brgya dang bdun cu lhag la bum chung ngu gang gis 'grim yang da dung ma zad pa'i grub rtagasabyung / de nas dzam thang du khong gis/ bka' chos sprul sku nges don rgya mtshor ngor/ dus 'khor dbang chen dang / sbyor drug cha tshang gi chos khrid kyang mdzad/ de nas khong dang drung pa'i sku skyes grwa 'khor bcas khyo ko'i lha sde 'ga' la mi bsad rkun jag byung ba la 'dzin bdag byed phyir phebs dgos byung ba'i lam du sku chas bkal ba'i sgar mdzo rma chus nyin phyed tsam khyer kyang ci yang ma gnod par phyag tu 'byor/khong rnams khyo kor slobs nas der lha sde la rkun jag gi don gtso che ba lam du zhog cing mi ngan zhig gis ji bzhin ma nyan par 'phral du mtshon grir shi ba sogs byung / de'i skabs de phyogs su gung thang rin po ches dus 'khor dbang chen gsung pa khong gis gsan zhing yul shog 'ga' la 'gro don ci rigs kyi mthar sngar ltar lha sde la mi bsad mkhan dag kyang ltas ngan cho 'phrul gyis 'jigs snang che bas dbang med du bskul te mi bsad stong 'jal gyis gtsang chod 'ong zhing der khong gis gsar rnying bar gyi grwa 'khor legs bsdum bcas bsrung rim sna tshogs dang khyad par khong gis bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs gto sgrurjo maṭwāṃ~X1 skabs kyi

dngos spub kyi sa mar khyung gis bud med skun nad can snga gyi gnyis kyi lus la nye bar byugs pas de gnyimi skun nad gtan nas zhi ba dang gzhan yang nad sna tshogs pa can dag la nyid kyis zhal 'debs dang gyirnarten blud pa sogs kyi sos par mdzad pa mang ngo / /dgung lo zhe lnga lcags stag lo 'di skor khong gi zhal nas rang gis da lan sbyor drug gnyis nyams len zin nas gsum pa'i lhan skyes sgom bslas kyi skabs tsam yin/ sngar gung thang gi mdun nas dus 'khor mchod chog stong mchod khas blangs pas 'grub dgos/ gsungs nas de phan lo gsum ring thog mar rtswachog nas mgo bzung nyin re sgrub dkyil 'chag med kyi mthar las chen bcu gnyis kyis bsreg blugs spyang mdzad cing 'di gung thang gis skyes gnang 'byor lan bcas legs grub kyi sgo nas lo de'i chos ldan bgyi 'os khong gis mdzad nas dgung lo zhe drug lcags yos la'ang khong gis chos rje'i 'du khang chen mo'i shing bskos gser tshon bcas legs grub mdzad ngos nas de'i phyi lo dgung grangs zhe bdun chu 'brug la khong dpon slob rdo khog tu lebs phyug shul bla ma tshe mtshams pa rnam gnyis sogs kyi ngor dus 'khor dbang chen dang sbyor drug mgyogs khrid 'dus pa mang tsam dang / ser skya yongs la dus 'khor lha dgu'i khrom dbang mdzad skabs de phyogs su gnod pa'i yul 'dre khug pa'i rtags mtshan bcas gshen chog lam bstan zab mo'i stobs kyi mtshams khang la khong gis pha ri nas rab gnas mdzad pas mtshams khang de nyid kyi steng 'og kun tu nas 'bru'i me tog 'thor ba dngos byung ba sogs kyis ngo mtshar skyes/ de phyogs su 'gro phan rgya chen byung mthar rang gnas dzam thang du khong gis dus 'khor las chen bcu gnyis kyi sbyin sreg rlabs che bas bstan 'gro yongs la bsrung rim yang mdzad/ lo 'di nas sngar rtsis nang bla ma mtshan bzang gis legs bskul ltar sprul pa'i sku gang gis rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum gyi spar bskos mdzad chen gyi dbu 'dzugs pa la chas te/ khong 'brog sder gdul byar phebs skabs su khang dmar dbon pos ma glo bur grib rkyen gyi shi ba ltar gyur tshe khong nyid kyis de la rkyen sel khrus byab sogs dang rjes gnang kha shas mdzad pas mo yang rim pas sos par gyur ro/ khong la 'di skor slob 'gas bla rnam rtsom bskul gyi skabs bka' las/khong nyid kun mkhyen chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyi gsung zur re yang byung zhing / nyid kyis rgan mo zhig la 'pho lung mdzad pas rgan mo de nyid dar cig la brgyal bzhin dag snang gi 'char sgo sna tshogs pa byung skad/dgung lo zhe brgyad chu sbrul la skabs ci rigs par khong gi bka' gsung las rje rang nyid kun mkhyen rje btsun gang gi rnam par 'phrul bar byas kyang rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gyi rnam rol la mi 'gal tshul gyi brjod zur slob 'ga' la gnang byung zhing / lo de'i bdun pa'i tshes gsum la rje btsun mchog gi bka' 'bum las slob dpon pad ma'i rnam thar rgya gar ma dang / dus 'khor sdom chen sogs bsko ba'i dbu legs par zug cing 'di skor khong gi nye skor du bla rgan re gshegs de 'chi sems las ldang ma ldang nyid kyi 'pho lung thugs dmigs skabs ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa dang / yang mi khyim zhig gi bu mo bor song ba mi min gyigobyedarjo sa ṭwāṃ ༵gas thag chod pa sogs lkog gyur ji bzhin gzigs pa'i lo rgyus mang ngo / /

dgung lo zhe dgu shing rta la khong gis chos thun pa dang slob gnyer ba rnams la rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i chos khrid ci dgos 'dir ma zad snga phyi kun tu thugs skabs nam yod du rgyun spyod kyi mdzad bzang la 'jog dus med cing / bar 'ga' la thugs slob 'ga'i sems kyi 'gyu rtog rags pa ji bzhin mkhyin nas de lugs gsung ba'ang yod/ 'di skor khong gis don rgyam sogs la rta phyag khyung gsum sogs dang /'dus pa mang po la ni gu'i bka' phyi nang gi zab dbang sogs gsungs shing / rten khang du tshe bcu'i sbrul skus dus 'khor dbang chen gsung pa'ang khong gis gsan/ lo de'i drug pa'i bcu bzhi la ri khrod du khong gis mkhan po mdzad nas drung pa sku skyes sogs la dge bsnyen bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro ba'i dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang ba dang / sa dmar rdor slob bla ma ngag dpal gyi mdun nas/ khong gis dus 'khor dbang chen sogs gsan bzhin gzhan dag la 'dod chos ci dgos kyang gsungs la/ de'i skor khong gis par bsko dag la yon 'bul gzab ldan re bcas lo der spar shing stong phrag gcig dang bzhi tsam legs bskos zhu dag bcas grub pa dang / mgo log phyogs su rgyal ba'i bka' chos kyi yi ge blus thabs mkhan grwa pa gnyis mngag cing de'i skor khong gnyis kyis thag ring gi mgron po'i gnas tshul mngon shes kyis gzigs bzhin de lugs 'jigs skyobs bsrung ba mdzad la/ gzhan yang rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i ris bris cha tshang grub pa sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba mang ngo / /dgung lo lnga bcu shing lug la khong nyid kyis sngar bzhengs spar shing 'phro brko thabs la cha rkyen bsrung rim gang dgos mdzad pa'i sgo nas spar rshang ka ring stong phrag gnyis lhag ka 'bring bzhi brgya tsam ka thung brgya phrag gcig zhu dag bcas brko zin de lugs kyi yon thang yang sprad pa dang / khong dpon slob khro skyabs sogs su phebs nas chos bka' sna tshegs pas 'gro don che rab gyi mthar khong gi ma yum skung gyis zin pas nyid rang gnas su slar byon nas khong gis rim 'gro rkyen sel sman sogs gang drag dang / phywa mu lung bstan 'di phyi phan pa'i dbang chog sgrib sbyor sna tshegs pa dang / pha ma'i drin gso thabs gang mang byas kyang mthar dus las 'das pas khong dang bla grwa mang pos zab lam 'pho lung gi sbyor bas rig pa phyi bo nas spar ba'i rtags mtshan khyad par ba mngon gsal du gyur pa nas bzung rim pas dgongs rdzogs rgya cher zla dang bral ba'i mdzad sgo nges par bskyangs pa'o/ /dgung lo nga gcig me sprel la ma yum 'das pa'i dge rtsa sgo gang thad nas rim bzhin pa las khyad par khong gis zhu ba'i ngor chen gyis grwa tshang yongs bcas la dbon 'gyur med nas brgyud rim ltar bla ma dam pa legs byams kyis rgyud sde rab 'byams yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bka' gsung bskul mdzad nas gsungs pa ji ba'in ma lus pa'i zab dbang legs gsan yon 'bul rgya cher bcas dang / khong gis 'di skor grwa btsun rnams la dbang khrid sogs gang dgos dang khyim pa pho mo rnams la bar bar du bskung gnas kyi gso sbyong gnang ba dang / de skabs 'khon ci rigs legs bsdum dang sngar gyi spar bskos bya ba'i 'phro skyong ba dang chos rje'i sgar khog gi rten zab thang rnams zhig gsos gang dgos dag de lugs bajin mdzad pa'i sgo — 393 dngha

nas yojas la mjal kha dus dus su gnang ba dang / khyad par kun mkhyen chen po'i zab thang srid du gzhi 'dom bdun dang zhing du 'dom bcu gcig gi tshad dang / gtso lha kun mkhyen chen po/ lha mgron dadi po'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang / dus 'khor/ shākya thub pa/ sgrol ma dkar ljang rnams dang/thugs sras bcu bzhi/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas/ thang stong rgyal po/ gtsang grub/ mgon po gur sogs te de dag gi sku sha phal che ba rgya gser dang na bza' sogs nor chab dang zab gos rgyu sgrus bzang phun sum chogs pas nye bar basbun pa'i mdzad sgo dang / de nas mee dpon rkang 'bam nad kyis zin pa la sprul pa'i sku dpon slob der gdan 'dren gyis rkyen sel bsrung dbang rta phyag khyung gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs mdzad pas nyin mo nas bzung rim pas dpon gyi rkang nad legs par sos shing / shug chung sbrul sku tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang khong mjal phrad kyis phan tshun chos bka' seng gdong ma'i dbang dang sbyor drug sogs gnang res dang / pa sun gter ston gyi drung nas/ rta mgrin na ga klu 'dul gyi dbang lung sogs kyang gsan no/ gzhan yang lo der khong gis dzam thang sbyangs pa'i mchod khang du rten bzhengs mchod bkod du ma dang / yul sde spyi la dus 'khor gyi bsrung rim che ba dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i zab thang la rab gnas sogs byi ched du rdo grub rin po che dang g.yu shug gi bla sprul mang po gdan 'dren zhus pas khong gis zab thang gi rten la gnas dang dgon spu tshang lha sde bcas bsrung rim gto sgrub sna tshogs pas rkyen sel chen po mdzad du bcug pas yon 'bul kyang rgya cher byas shing / khong gis yul sde spyi la rta mgrin dbal chu sogs kyis rim gro dang / nyid kyi zhal bkod la rten 'du khang sgo thog gi seng thod legs par grub cing /rten khang du sngar rdor slob lha rje dkon 'alel 'das pas de'i gdung rten du rgyud sde de nyid lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi blos bslangs bzhengs pa 'dir che rim tsam thub mtshams sprul pa'i sku nyid dzam thang sbyangs pa'i mtshams khang du legs bzhugs dang khong gis mdo sngags kyi zhal gdams bde stong glu'i 'od 'azeng zhes pa gsung rtsom du mdzad zhor kun la chos bka' gang mkho dag kyang legs par gnang zhing / khyir na khong gi gsung rtsom gyi rim pa gong smos las gzhan/ rtsis nag gi skor 'ga' re/ sbyor drug zhal gdams mthing sngon ma/ kun mkhyen rnam thar skye 'azeng yab sras bcas kyi gsol 'debs/ rje btsun sku phreng gsol 'debs/ rje dbon sogs bla ma 'ga'i gsol 'debs/ spyi la sbyar rung gi bla rnam/ bsod nams mgon po'i gsol 'debs rnam lnga/ khang dmar dbon rgan gyi gsol 'debs rnam gnyis/ bla rnam rgya gar lugs sogs/ tshe dpag med bdag skyed/ tshe g.yang kha sprod bsdus pa/ dmar khrid chom lugs kyi dmigs rim/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzhung khrid/ sngon 'gro'i khrid bsdus/ dzam lha'i chu gter/ rnam sras g.yang sgrub/ sku lnga'i gser skyems bsangs skor/ dmigs med bsngo tshul/ rdzogs chen sems khrid skor/ rig mchog rnam thar/ rnam grangs mdo slob 'grel ba sogs mang tsam mchis/ 'di skor rgan mo zhig gi rnam shes sogs bar srid pa'i yin lugs 'ga' re nyid thugs la gsal zhing khong gis sprul sku kun bzang nyi ma gdan drangs te rten khang du/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dbang lung / kar gling — 394 —

thos grol gyi dbang / tshe dbang nor bu'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs 'dus pa mang tsam la gsung bskul mdzad pa sogs 'gro phan che ba'ang legs par gnang /dgung lo nga gnyis me bya la khong gis khang dmar du dbon 'jigs med rgya mtsho rdor slob tu bsko bzhag gi sgo nas chos bka' ci dgos kyis lam la bzhag cing spar bskos kyi 'phro yang bskyang / 'di skabs khong la sman gyi cha rkyen 'byor bas nyid kyis 'gro phan ched gso rig gi gzhung zhib gzigs bcas kyis nad pa gang dag la phan thogs mdzadapa ma zad tha na bum rdzas g.yang tshus gter sdas sogs legs bandeb tshun gyis 'gro phan spel bzhin 'di lor dus 'khor sgrub mchod skabs cho ga'i gar 'cham gyi srol btod pa dang rten khang du blos bslangs spyang ris bcas dang / 'du khang sgo nang gi gser tshon sogs bya las dang klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo zab mo chos sbyin bcas che rab legs spub mdzad pas sngar gyi bka' chos yi ge cha gnyis legs blus kyis 'byor zhing de dag la zhabs phyis gang dgos bcas kyang legs zin gyi mthar bcu pa'i yar tshes drug pa'i zab thang zhal 'byed skabs khong gis mang tshogs la chos sbyin zab mo dus su stsal ngos nas sprul sku kun bzang nyi ma la/ zab tig sgrol ma'i byi nang gi sgrub dbang gsung bskul gyis kun la chos phan mdzad rjes nyid cung tsam bskun yang zhabs brtan rim gro sogs kyis legs dwangs byung /dgung lo nga gsum sa khyi la 'di skor yan nas khong gis sbyor drug nyams len lan gsum rdzogs par mngon la 'dir phur pa 'khon lugs kyi blos bslangs gsar bzhengs dang / kun mkhyen zab sku'i mjug legs grub bgyid skabs zung 'jug mgo mjug log pa'i skog gyur gyi tshul ji bzhin thugs shes la gsal ba dang / skabs gong 'og ci rigs par mdo sde skal ba bzang po grangs tshar bcu gsum mtshan spungs mang po bcas rdo la legs bsko byed du bcug pa dang / phyir spar shing gi tshul ldeb grangs sum brgya la pod tshang byas pas rje btsun gsung 'bum glegs bam brgyad la nye ba tsam legs par grub pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten gang bzhengs thams cad la rab gnas dga' ston yon 'bul sogs mtha' rgyas dang bcas dge rtsa de kun ma lus pa'i sems can gang dag gis don du rdzogs byang du bsngo bas rgyas thebs nges mdzad mthar kun mkhyen chen po'i zab sku yongs la mjal kha gnang skabs sku lus 'bur du dod cing zhal ras dgyes gzigs kyis spyan g.yo ba sogs kyis mtshan ma byung la/ de nas lo de'i ston zla tha chung gi dus su chos rje'i sku phyogs kyi dgongs pa dbyings su thim pas des thugs dam khong gis legs bkrol sogs bgyi ba gnad 'gag phal cher mdzad rjes tsam na dus kyi 'gyur ldog che ba'i grags cha je cher 'gro skabs sprul sku mchog nyid thugs la ma 'bab bzhin du thugs slob sogs mang pos da khyed kyang phyogs gzhan du bros bcos du byon dgos pas nan zhus skabs zhal nas/ da gang ltar byas kyang thar dka' ba 'dra yang / khyed cag gi bsam pa rdzogs phyir 'gro bar bya/ zhes zhal bzhes mdzad nas khong gis nye gnas slob bu dag la/ da ni yi ge dang bca' lag gang dgos khyed rang tshos khyer/ rang gi mgo bud pa'i dus skabs slebs byung / zhes yang yang gsung gnang dang bcas rdo yul phyogs su khong dpon slob nyung shas shig phebs 'gro ba'i lam du zhal — 395 —

nas/ da ni rdo yul phyogs su'ang rgya'i dmag dpung gis gang bar 'gyur tshul kyang gsung nas rang sar 'dug na legs so/ / zhes gsungs/dgung lo nga bzhi sa phag la khong rdo khog phyug shul ri khrod du re zhig bzhugs nas/ tshe mtshams bla ma rnam gnyis kyi drung du/ rdo grub kyis mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen skor dang / khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs rnying phyogs kyi chos bka' du ma re yang gsan bzhin nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi 'al gdams nyi zla'i 'od 'phreng gi steng nas slob chogs 'ga' la spyor drug bsgom du bcug cing / gzhan 'ga' la sdom gsum sogs chos khrid ci rigs bcas dang gso thabs snan gyis phan pa'ang legs par mdzad bzhugs skabs su gzhan dag la zhal gdams ci dgos re dang / mdo slob 'grel pa rtsom 'phro yang 'grub re rtsom pa mdzad cing / de dus rdo grub yar lung sprul sku'i drung nas kyang / rigs 'dus kyi dbang sogs chos bka' 'ga' re khong gis gsan bzhin pa'i skabs shig nas rdo yul gyi sde sne la bcing bkrol dmag thog mar byung ma thag khong rnams tshur dzi yul phyogs su 'ongs nub la khong gi zhal nas/ mdang mi lam legs po ma byung yang re zhig phar rang yul du 'gro'o/ / zhes gsungs nas de phyogs 'ong bar brtsams pa'i phyir nyin grwa pa gnyis gnas tshul de bzhin gyi kha skad bcas 'dzi yul nas thon byung ba dang mnyam du khong rnams rdo chu'i phar phyogs ngang khog tu snebs tsam na dmag dpung dang phrad paracitshur rang yul dmag sgar du rim pas phebs te rang cag dang mnyam du bla sprul rnams zla 'gar slob sbyongs bzhugs skabs kyang dus rgyun thugs la 'tshubs long med bzhin nye 'khor ba dag la chos gtam 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bzhin bros byol du song ba'i sde 'bangs rnams kyang srid jus bzang po'i gsal bsgrags 'og tshur srid gzhung du 'khor/ khong nyid mtshan mor gzims pa'i tshe bar bar du gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi mdzad sgo yang yang gnang bzhin sku rgyal sras sems dpa'i ngang tshul gyis rtag par bzhugs so/ /dgung lo nga lnga lcags byi'i lo 'go tsam na sgad phyogs cog tse'i rgyal sar khong rnams phebs dgos byung nas der lo bzhi tsam gyi ring du bzhugs skabs kyang khong gis nye 'khor ba grwa btsun 'ga' la sbyor drug yo ngas rdzogs kyi chos bka' legs 'doms kyis nyams len kyang kha tshang rim pas byed du bcug cing gzhan yang de phyogs su bla sprul mang dag la chos khrid gang dgos mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas sngar gyi mdo slob 'grel mjug yongs rdzogs kyang legs grub kyi dus tsam na rim pas sku bskung lo shas ring bar bar 'khrugs shing de skabs su khong la zas gos sogs dngos rjos gang bdog kun kyang dbul bo nyam thag rnams la ster ba sogs khong gis dka' thub ha cang brten drag pa sogs kyis nyid dgung grangs nga baspyad slebs pa'i dus chu yos kyi lo la skun nad kyang sman sogs rim gro gang gis phan pa ma byung ba'i re zhig 'gro don rdzogs pa la nye ba'i skabs su khong gis sku mdun pa dag la sku'i yang sprul ji ltar 'byon tshul sogs nyid gsang gsum che ba 'ga' re dang bcas ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gsal po'i bka' 'phros zhal chems rim pa chesarwa nga ṭwāṃ9 dīgs gnang gi mdzad sgo bcas khong ni skye 'chi rang dbang yod nges kyi rnam pas lo de'i dgun

zla 'bring po'i mtha' tsam la 'bar khams dgon thog kheb tu sku bzhugs stang khyad par ba'i sgos thugs dgongs chos dbyings su thim mnyam du gyur pa'i tshe dgun 'bring grang ngar lhag par bdo ba'i dus na'ang dpyid dus sos ka lta bu'i drod mched cing rang gnas kyi ri mgo sogs su me tog ches mang skyes shing dpal gyi dzam thang sogs la na bun zil phung gi rnam pa phyogs mtshams kun 'thibs pa lo der ma zad phyi lo'i dus cugs rnams su yang yang byung ba deng dus la ltos na shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan mang po bsnyon med dus su legs par shar ba'i dge mtshan zla dang bral dgongs mchod legs grub dang phyis su gdung rten yang de lugs ba'in gyi bgyi ba mi dman pa thugs slob gang dag gis 'bad khul gyi skal ba tsam las cher rgyas dus dbang gis byung skabs ma yod pa'o/de ltar bshad pa rnams ni rje dbon dang sbyangs sprul zung gi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus tsam ste rgyas pa ni dbon gyi rnam thar rgyas pa dang sbyangs sprul mchog gi rnam thar rtsom gzhi sogs su gsal zhing de las phyi ma'i rnam thar rgyas pa re rjes sor skal ba 'grig tshe rang gis kyang 'bri 'dod yod pas 'dir de tsam las ma spros la/ chos brgyud 'di phyogs nas 'phros pa tsha ba rong dza 'go'i dgon chags 'debs mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa 'bras rab 'byams pa blo bzang mchog grub pas rjes su dgon de nyid du rang lugs kyi bstan pa skyong mkhan kun dga' rig mchog zhabs pa yang gang nyid kyis thog mar dam pa bsten nas zab chos gsan sgom gyis rang lugs legs thub rjes su bar du chos dgon der khong gis zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gtsor gyur pa'i rang lugs sgrub brgyud kyi nges don bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum rgya cher mdzad ngos nas mtshan snyan grags pa che rab byung 'ing / tha mar gdul bya re zhig rdzogs tshul dang bcas pa'i rnam par thar pa rgyas tsam logs su yod pas de'i lo rgyus re dang / dgon de'i rjes 'dzin kun dga' mkhyen rab tshul khrims dang / kun dga' dge mchog dang sprul pa'i sku kun dga' rgya mtsho 'bas pa gsum gyis kyang rim par byung bas de gsum gyis kyang don gnyis ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul sogs 'di skor la bshad bya yod na'ang ha cang yi ge mang bas re zhig bzhag go/ /(12)drung pa gang nyidashāsku phreng rags bsdusasabon tsam 'god bar bya ba/drung pa sku phreng dang po raṇḍa thi 'am rin chen dpal (gong du song zin) drung pa sku phreng gnyis pa rin chen dpal bzang po ni/ chos rje rgyal ba seng ge dpal 'byor bzang po'i zhal snga nas rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa mchog gi zab bka' ches mang gsan te de dag gi don la thos bsam kyis sgro 'dogs chod de sgom pas nang gi mngon par rtogs pa rgya che bas thugs mdzod phyur bur gtams pas phyi rab byung ngur smrig gi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing nang smin grol gyi chu tshad mthon por smrebs te grub rtags mngon gyur la thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad cher brnyes pa'i 'gro 'dren gyi mdzad pa bzang po can rang lugs kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel phyir chos rje dpal 'byor bzang po sku zhing du gshegs rjes khong nyid kyis chos rje rgyal ba seng ge'i yang sprulashaṃ ba~X khri rjidon

rgyal tshab du bskos bzhag sogs gang thad nas 'dzam thang chos rje'i chos srid zung 'brel la phan pa'i bya ba rlabs che'ang mdzad mkhan zhig go༈ /drung pa sku phreng gsum pa blo gros rin chen dpal gyi snying po sku tsha rong du 'khrungs chos rjes sku bdag byas te rim pas dbon bsod nams chos 'phags kyi drung du klog sogs slob sbyangs nas bzung chos sgor zhugs te sku dbon chos grags rgya mtsho'i mdun nas mi 'khrugs pa dus 'khor sogs kyi zab dbang mang po dang chos rje 'jigs med dpal gyi seng ge'i sku drung nas dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang lung man ngag legs par gsan pa sogs chos la sbyang ba dang bsam sgom reb tsam byas rjes su khong nyid chos rje'i gdan rabs kyi rgyal tshab tu bzhugs te bstan 'gro skyong bzhin khang dmar rten khang du yun ring mtshams sgrub dam po mdzad cing bar skabs lo shas der sad srung gis 'gro phan yang spel ba dang / dpal sbrul rin po che 'dzam thang du phebs skabs spyod 'jug rgyud bla ma sogs la gsan sbyang byas shing / dpal sprul gyis gsung bkod ltar de rjes mi ring bar mkhar ba rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi zab khrid rnams legs par zhus nas lo 'gar nyams len gnad 'khel bgyis pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa'i re zhig na glo bur du khong gi sku bskung pa'i tshe skyabs mgon mkhar ba gdan ṭwāṃṭākā ktasna /byi ༵ ṭwāṃ dī ṭwāṃrdo/ kha'i gdams ngag yang dag gi sgo nas mtshams skyor bzang po bcas gzugs sku zeng bzhi pa grub rtags can yang tsha rong phyogs su 'khrungs shing drung pa'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin dang bcas 'dzam thang sbyangs pa skyabs mgon gyi slob mar gyur te zab dgu'i gdams pas thugs rgyud legs smin mdzad cing khong gi sku'i steng du 'ja' gur 'khyil ba nye 'khor gzhan dag gis mthong ba sogs khyad 'phags kyi mdzad sgo can yin na'ang nyid kyi sku spyod kun nas mdzes par ma gyur pa sogs kyis chos sdes gnas dbyung mdzad de ja yul phyogs su byon dgos byung nas de phyogs su sku tshe smad la bzhugs dus su khong gi sku la gri sogs mtshon gyis gnod pas mi tshugs shing gsol chang zhal phor gang gi nang du rten phur 'dzer ba sogs grub rtags kyi mdzad spyod yang dus dus su ngom pa na mtshan kyang grub rtags can gsol/sku phreng lnga pa kun dga' rin chen dpal gyi snying po ni/ sbrugs shul dme skor du sku 'khrungs gtsang pa grub chen gyis drung pa'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin mdzad nas chos rje'i sgar kyis khri 'don dang bcas rim pas chos la sbyang ba sogs dam pa'i kun spyod gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin khang dmar bla ma kun dga' bsod nams 'bas pa dang / sbyangs pa ma 'das mchog sprul sogs dge ba'i bshes su bsten nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab bka' sogs ji bzhin nod de nyams len gong ma'i rjes zhugs kyi tshul mi dman pa byas nas chos rje'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol nas tang dang srid gzhung gis kyang krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros mol rtsags 'du si khron zhing chen 'dzam thang rdzong u yon gyi go gnas gnang na'ang spyod tshul dang dus sogs kyi dbarji gi~X ༵dzad pa ji bzhin ma byung nas na tshod lang tsho ma yol ba'i skabs 'phral du 'gal rkyen gyis sku

gshegs so/ /jo nang ba'i gzhan stong gi lta ba'i 'dod tshul/gzhan stong gi lta ba'i 'dod tshul ni/ de yang nges don rgya mtshor grags pa der 'di bzhin du bzhag ste/ chos thams cad yin lugs don dam pa'i bden pa de rtag pa ther zug pa/ de nyid kun gzhi la rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis su yod pa'i ye shes yin cing / de nyid don dam chos nyid kyi dkon mchog gsum dang / de nyid brtan g.yo kun la khyab par bzhugs pa'i dbyings rig dbyer med kyi lha tshogs dang /de nyid bde gshegs snying po dang / rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang / rgyud sder gsungs pa'i rigs brgya sogs dang don gcig cing / de nyid gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi rgyud du bzhugs tshul dang /de nyid chos sku'i gnas skabs gsum du yod tshul dang / de nyid gzhi la rtag tu bzhugs kyang rnam shes la gtan mi snang bar 'dod cing / gzhi'i gnas tshul de ltar yin pa de nyid rnal 'byor drug gi rim pas nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu chos nyid kyi sku mngon du 'gyur tshul sogs rgyas par bstan cing / de rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo dang / rnga bo che'i mdo dang / ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo dang /dpal phreng seng ge'i nga ro'i mdo dang / 'aṣpel ba dang 'grib pa med par bstan pa'i mdo dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo dang / phal mo che dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang / gser 'od dam pa sogs las gsal bar gsungs shing / bka' tha ma'i dgongs 'grel rgyud pa la rtsa 'grel sogs dang /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis dbu ma la bstod pa sogs kyis kyang rgyas par gtan la phab pas/ 'di ni shing rta chen po rnams kyis bkral ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bzhed pa phyin ci ma log pa yin gyi/ kun rdzob kyi cha 'di rnams ni rang stong / chad stong / dgag stong / nyi tshe ba'i stong pa ye nas med pa thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang rnam pa thams cad du dor bar bya ba yin/gzhan stong ni phra zhing rtogs dka' ba drang srong chen po'i lam bzang kun rdzob rnams rang ngos nas grub pas stong yang don dam pa'i chos nyid ni nam yang rang ngos nas mi stong bar gnas lugs mthar thug tu ye nas 'gyur ba med pa'i rang mdangs la gzhan kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyi spros pas stong bas na ga'an stong zhes brjod cing / kun rdzob bden par med kyang don dam gnas lugs mthar thug tu bden mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i nges don dbu ma'i lam bzang chen mo de yang gtso bor 'khor lo tha ma'i sde snod du bstan kyang spyir ni 'khor lo dang po dang bar ba gnyis kyi'ang dgongs pa mthar thug tu nges shing de lugs kyi tshul du bstan par gsungs la/ 'di dag gi skor la bshad bya mang yang re zhig de tsam mo/ /sbyang pa ma 'das mchog gi sku'i yang sprul ji ltar byon tshul nyid kyi 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gsal por ltar (spyi lo 1963 chu yos la yab smri go dang yum sgron dkar gnyis las rigs rus las 'khrungs bas shes rab rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gsol ba dang spyi lo 1967 lo me lug la yab a lu dang yum tshe 'dzom gnyis las 'khrungs bas mtshan la bstan 'dzin nyi ma gsol ba'i 'di gnyis ni ma 'das khong /da ṭwāṃ9 sdul tram̐gs

rigs rus sogs lung bstan pa'i sku dang gsung gi sku skyes rnam gnyis ngo mtshar ltas bcas 'khrungs pa yin la/ de nas rim pas sku na son skabs 'dzam thang chos rje'i sku bdag gis gong ma'i gdan sar che ba'i khri shā/na /sogs byas shing yang sprul bstan 'dzin nyi ma ni khang dmar du rdo rje slob dpon du bzhugs su gsol gnyis pa/ 'dzam thang ches bcu sku zeng rim byon gyi lorgyus/(1)drung dka' bzhi ba'i thugs slob sabacu rasna kyirti/drung dka' bzhi pa'i thugs slob mchog mkhas shing grub brnyes kyi skyes bu thog mar chos rje rgyal ba bzang dang / tshes bcu rasna gīrti dang / a ge nyi ma 'o da zer gsum gyi spyir 'dzam thang sgar khag gsum gyi bya las la grags chen kyi mtho ba chos rje de nas tshes bcu sgar yin te/ de yang rje jo nang pa chen po gang nyid kyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa tshes bcu rin chen grags pa 'khrungs yul rdo'i smad rgyal mo rong gi char gtogs dar sku 'byor 'gos thang ste der gdung rus bse khyung gi rgyud las chad pa'i mi rigs su sku bltams tshe nam mkha' nas yi ge drug ma'i sgra dbyangs rang grags su byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang zhing /de nas bskyed bsrings te sku na son skabs klog yig sogs kyi sbyang ba byas rjes shig nas dpal 'dzam thang bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling du ched kyis phebs te rigs ldan drag po'i rnam rol drung dka' bzhi rin chen dpal nges don bstan pa'i bdag por bzhugs pa de nyid sgo gsum gus pas bla mar legs bkur mdzad nas khong gi mdun drung nas thun mong mdo phyogs kyi sde snod ci rigs dang thun min sngags phyogs kyi zab bka' dbang lung man ngag bshad khrid zhib rgyas legs gsan mdzad de zab mo'i don gyi tshul la thos bsam gyis dus 'da' bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad la zhen pa gting nas chod pa'i kun spangs kyi tshul du bzhugs pas thugs la mdo sngags kyi mngon par rtogs pa khyad par ba 'khrungs te sgom pa'i klong du gyur zhing rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mchog gi rtser son pa'i go 'phangs legs bzhugs mdzad pa'i rang don mthar phyin gyi chos sgo rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid byi slob dpon gdul bya 'dul ba dus su babs kyang da dung rnal 'byor mchog la rim tshul gyis sgrub khang du bsam gtan mnyam bzhag la rtse gcig lhur len gyi mdzad sgo'i ngang bar skabs zhar byung tsam la gdul bya mchog rjes su bzung rim chos rje dpal 'byor bzang po sogs thugs sras skal ba dang ldan pa 'gro 'dren gyi mdzad bzang can ches mang tshod du 'dug pa sogs 'gro phan yang bar mdzad la/ nyid kyi gsung rab kyi rtsom chos legs gnang mdzad pa'ang drung dka' bzhi pa'i rnam thar dang /dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga sogs gsang chen nges pa'i don la nyer mkho'i yig cha'ang ci rigs legs 'jog gi byas rjes dang / rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad sgo dpal 'dzam thang gi chos sder mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang ches khyad rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba phyi bkod mdzes cha kun dang nang rten lug ma sku brnyan sna tshogs kyang ris lha yi bkod rim bcas gang thad nas khyad chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs rten legs grub rab gnas dga' ston sogs kyi skabs grub pa'i dbang phyug chos rje rgyal ba bzang po gtsor rang gi chos kyi mched grogs — 400 —

gang dag gis mdzad bzang ya mtshan pa'i grub rtags mchod rten gyi las mjug grub la nye skabs dang de spub zin dus su mkha' lam nas nyi ma bzung zhing rab gnas mchod pa'i dus su thag ring nas brtan bzhugs mdzad pa'i nas 'bru gug ron tsam pa char ltar mchod rten gyi thog tu 'bebs pa dang / rgyang ring nas chos gos kyi gos 'bul phul bas mchod rten gyi chos 'khor ser lham mer khebs pa sogs dge mtshan khyad 'phags ches kun nas 'dzoms pa'i rten bzhengs zla dang bral ba 'di sogs gzhan yang rnam dkar gyi mdzad sgo che ba dang / khong gis sku dus bod ljongs 'dzam gling sgar ba rgyal dbang kārma zhwa nag sku zeng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje 'dzam thang du chags phebs mdzad skabs 'dus stong phrag lhag gis chibs bsu che ba dang / khong nyid tshe mtshams las bzhengs te phan tshun chos kyi bka' mol chen po'i sgo nas thugs snang gcig 'dres su gyur te chos gyi zhabs 'degs stong rta sogs kyi dngos 'bul rgya cher dgon sde yongs nas mdzad pa sogs zla dang bral ba'i mdzad bzang gi sgo kun nas yangs shing rgya che ba mnga' zhing / khong gi rnam dkar mdzad chen legs sgrub skabs sngon chad rang yul gyi spun gur mgon dang zhing skyong zhes pa gnyis kyis chos ston gsol ched 'dzam thang du lhags pa nyid kyi bka' ltar rjes sor 'dzi ka'i lha mo dar thang gi nye skor ka thog ces par srun de gnyis kyis gzhis ka so sor bzung nas gcig gis 'bos za ma dang cig shos phroṃ ṭwāṃtrī/ zlo ṭwāṃd ba/ga mar blangs pa'i rigs brgyud tsho sde da lta yod pa la ka thog 'bos sman dang mkhar skor gzhan yang gang gi thugs chos dbyings gnyug ma chen po'i gshis lugs rjen char du song stabs rnam 'phrul mngon shes rgya che ba'i mthu dang snang srid la dbang bsgyur mchog thob pas rang snang dag pa'i snang ba mtha' thas shing gzhan snang ngor dag snang sgyu ma'i mtshar bkod dang lkog gyur gyi don ji bzhin mkhyen cing dregs ldan mi min gyi sde rigs ci dgar dbang du bsdus te bka' dam la bzhag pa sogs mdzad pa gang thad nas zla dang bral ba zhig ste/ de 'dra'i mdzad pa re zhig ljongs 'dir mthar phyin tshul gyis 'o mtshar ltas bcas dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su legs par bsdus nas dgongs mchod sogs rlabs chen gyi mdzad sgo dang bskun nyid kyi gzugs sku'i gdung rten da bar bsod nams zhing gi skal bar bzhugs pa 'di ka ltar ro/ / deng sang tshes bcu stod kyi pho brang gi gzhi ma ni ran kyirtis bsnyen sgrub mdzad gnas kyi sgrub khang de yin cing / der lo bstar gyi o rgyan rin po che dngos su byon pa'i yar ngos tshes bcu byung ngo cog la dge 'dun mang 'tshogs kyi drung du spos dang mar me tshogs mchod rgyun ja zhal 'debs gyi mchod ston btsugs pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad pas tshes bcu tshang zhes ming du chags so/
