/ (2)sku zeng gnyis pargyal brdo rjebastan 'jin/mdo smad bzhag shod kyi bzhag ra sman rtse'i zhos pā la rje mo'i thang du sku 'khrusas/ cher bskyed sku na son skabs chos rje dpal 'byor bzang pos tshes bcu ran kyirti'i yang sprul gnyis par ngos 'dzin mdzad nas sku bdag dang bcas tshes bcu'i gdan sar mnga' gsol de nas bzung yi lhaslob sbyong so~X0rdo kyi rdathar

chos rje dpal 'byor bzang po'i mdun nas mdo sngags kyi zab bka' bshad khrid man ngag yongs rdzogamigasan te thugs sgom sgrub la brtson pa lhur len bzhin du skabs skabs su chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan sogagagazhan dam pa mang po'i drung nas kyang zab mo chos kyi sgo du ma nod nas de don nyams len gyis gnad khelatshags su tshud cing / sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid kyis sgrub gnas 'dzi stod kyi ri khrod sogs dben gnagadu mar mtshams sgrub thugs dam rtse gcig mdzad pas nyams rtogs phul byung grub pa'i yon tan la mnga' brnyes te yi dam lhag pa'i lha mang po'i rnal 'byor dang / khyad par 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du mdzad nas tshes bcu sgar gyi mnga' bdag tu bzhugs/ nus mthu rlabs che bas chos skyongagagi bdag gi sde rigs bran du bkol zhing mi dang mi min gyi 'gro phan rgya cher mdzad cing 'dzi yul mchog dman yongs kyi bla mar bkur te bstan 'gro la sman pa'i mdzad sgo kun nas rgyas pa sogs chos srid kyi mnga' thang mi dman pa'i tshul gyis mdzad 'phrin mthar rgyas byung rjes 'dir 'gro don re zhig rdzogs pa'i bkod pa bstan nas sku zhi bar gshegs te dgongs mchod sogs kyis rjes sgrub mdzad/'di nas yang sprul gsum tsam gyi ring la rgyal ba rdo rje bstan 'dzin gang gi sku dbon rgan mnyam nyid rdo rje zhes pa sngar sku tshe stod du mu rdi'i stod phyogs su rdo lung zhes der dgon pa btab nas bzhugs pa la/bar skabs shig nas khu bo'i gdan sa skyong dgos byung bas 'dzam thang tshes bcu stod du phebs nas rgyun bzhugs mdzad de tshes bcu sgar gyi lugs zung la thugs rtog dang bcas gtso bor nyid kyi nyams bzhes rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i bsnyen sgrub la thugs brtson lhur len gyi sgo nas bzhugs shing / kaḥthog gter chen gyi slob brgyud sngags rnying ma'i nus ldan slob dpon lhun grub rgya mtsho zhes pas dbon 'di nyid la bka' gtad byas pa'i gter bsrung sha za kha mo che bran ltar bkol zhing rtags dang cho 'phrul nam dgos dus su ngom par mdzad cing rsha/ sku bye mdzad pa mthar phyin gyi bar bzhugs nas tshes bcu'i gdan sa bskyangs rjes zhing gzhan ḍi sna)sdus ba ༵/'i/ skuzeng gsum pa sprul skunus ldan rdorje/mkha' ras zhes pa'i sde srid du 'khrungs shing / sku chung ngu'i dus nas thugs rig gsal ba dam pa'i chos la mos spro che ba sogs ches dbang po rab kyi yon tan mngon par mtho ba'i sku skyes legs phun sum chogs pa ya mtshan bkur bar 'os pa zhig ste/ tshes bcu sgar gyi sku bdag dang bcas 'dzam thang du legs phebs mdzad nas re zhig bzhugs rjes mi ring bar pha yul du slebs pa la dam grib sogs rkyen ci rigs pa'i dbang gis 'phral du gzugs sku chos dbyings su gshegs so/ /(4)tshes bcu'i sku phreng bzhi ba mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me/rgyal mo rong snar 'dus zhesapa'i sa char sku 'khrungs/ de yang rigs bzang po'i mtshan ma kun naga~X/ga/ sa/ pa zhig yin na'ang sku na gzhon dus dgung grangs bcu gsum skor zhig nas gzugs sku'i me tog yal — 402 —

(5)skyi zeng lnga ba karma 'od gsal/ri shul sprul sku zhes pa sku skyes sngon goms bzang po dus su smin la nye ba'i ya mtshan pa zhig yin kyang de kṣiṃdro / gā dī ṭwāṃ snaṭwāṃ ṭā/ sko/ra tsam gzugs sku'i lang tsho lhag par bdo ba'i dus nas 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi (6)sku zeng drug pakun dga' rab gsal rgya mcho/rgyal mo rong go rgyal gyi gdung rigs su 'khrungs tshe nam mkha' 'ja' thin zlum po'i gur khyim phubs dbus nas lha rnams kyis gling bu'i skad sogs rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa der yod kun gyi mthong thos su gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan che zhing / de lugs kyi sku na rim pas son skabs tshes bcu sgar gyis sku bdag sogs kyi sgo nas rig gnas la sbyang brtson dus bab dang bstun rjes dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa skyabs mgon mkhar ba rdo rje 'chang dang / sbyangs ba kun dga' nges don zhabs pa sogs dad gus rgya che ba'i gtsug gis bla mar bsten te zab bka' rgya mcho lta bus thugs rgyud legs phyug mdzad nas mkhas thub gnyis ldan gyi go gnas thob cing mtshan snyan gyi grags pas phyogs kun gyis che dgu gang dag gi yid dbang med du bskyod de dad pas spu long g.yo bzhin lag pad snying gar zum bzhin spyi bo'i gtsug gis bla mar bkur te bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa sogs tshes bcu'i gdan sar legs skyong gimadzad chen dang bcas dgung grangs lnga bcu tsam nas sku chos dbyings su thim mo/ /(7)sku zeng bdun pa karma nges don bstan 'phel/dbang mda' nas sku 'khrungs shing / de nas chos la zhugs pa'i skabs su skebs pa na karma a lo sprul pa'i sku nas gtsug phud bzhes te sdom lung stsal/ de nas tshes bcu sgar du khri 'don dang bcas te rim pas sbyangs pa rin po che sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas zab dgu'i gdams pa rgya cher mnos te gdams don ji ba.in nyams len kyang mdzad pas thugs kyi rtogs pa klong du gyur cing / sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid gtsang pa'i rdo rje slob dpon kun dga' dpal ldan 'bas pa sogs skyes chen du ma'i thugs das snang ngor 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru mthong zhing / khong dang 'brel ba thogs tshad kyi tshe 'das pho mo dag ing du 'dren pa'i mthu nus kyang legs pa ra gzigs pas de lugs kyi che bsngags dam pa de dag gis yang yang mdzad pa sogs zab chos kyi mngon par rtogs pa mchog gis thugs rgyud legs par gtams pa ma zad 'jig rten la'ang mkhyen rgya tshe tshul gyis mchog dman yongs kyis bkur ṭwāṃsdo ṭwāṃ ṭāsdo/ ṭwāṃdṛ tna ṭwāṃdhis pa ṭwāṃ/ ba/zhugs pa sosas mdzad sgo che ba dang bcas dgung lo drug cu tsam gyi skor du (ra)sku phrengabargyad pakun dga' rin chen grags pa/'dzi rong pa sin zer ba'i sa cha nas 'ong ba rgyal rong bstan pa legs gter rgyal po'i gdung brgyud las chad pa skabs der mgo log phyogs su re 'ig gnas bya ba'i yab dbang po rab brteton ༵༵3 yum skal

bzang dbang skyid gnyis kyi sras su me rta lor legs dge'i mtshan ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ sku skyes 'di lo na shin tu phra ba byis pa'i skabs nas kyang thugs rig gsal ba sogs gzhan las khyad chos can zhig ste/sku nar son dus shig tu sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor gyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa rdzo mi ra rin po che'i drung du slebs skabs khong gis thugs dgyes spro tshad med pas dkon mchog dpal ldan rgya mtsho zhes pa'i mtshan gsol nas 'dzam thang phyogs kyi sku skyes su ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / de mthun 'dzam thang sbyangs pa skyabs mgon gyis kyang tshes bcu'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin gsal po bcas rim pas tshes bcu'i sgar du gdan drangs nas bla ma lhag bsam gyis yongs 'dzin byas te klog legs slob mdzad rjes mi ring bar tsha kho bla ma 'jigs med chos ldan gyi drung du skyabs 'gro sogs la sbyang brtson sngon du btang ste dbon dam pa 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i sku drung nas rang lugs dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi zab bka' smin byed dbang lung man ngag bshad khrid yongs rdzogs gsan te nyams len gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin mdzad cing de dus su tshes bcu sku thog ma'i mtshan yang bskyar gsol/ gzhan yang dus 'khor dbang chen sogs rgyud sde du ma'i zab bka' dang spyod 'jug sogs mdo phyogs kyi gzhung lugs 'ga' dang bcas gsan sbyang mdzad/ de nas rim par bla ma mkhas dbang gi mdun nas theg mchog rgyas pa'i rnam bshad dang bla ma chos dbang gi drung nas phung lnga sogs dang / dge bshes ting 'dzin gyi mdun nas mngon mdzod sogs la sbyang brtson lhur len sogs dam pa'i yon tan mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi dpal mnga' zhing / gzhan don 'azin las kyi mdzad sgo yang tshes bcu'i yig brgya'i mtshams grwa ba sogs grwa slob du ma la rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i chos khrid gnang ba dang / rang yul 'dzi gzhung dang gzhan mgo log mtsho sngon sogs su bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad cing / rnam dkar gyi bya ba tshes bcu'i pho brang gsar bzhengs nang byams chen gyis gtsos nye sras brgyad kyi lug ma zhig gsos dang gser khang rten gsum bcas gsar bskun sogs dang / mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang phyi nang yongs rdzogs zhig gsos legs pa bsod nams kyi bgyi ba gzab ldan gyi sgo yangs pa dang bcas nyid kyi gsung rtsom rgyal bstan spyi'i chos 'byung / jo nang chos 'byung dang khong nyid kyi rnam thar sogs yig cha gsar 'jog yang 'ga' res bstan pa'i zhabs tog legs mdzad kyi che ba sogs sgo kun nas dam pa mchog gi mdzad bzang ji bzhin skyong nges nas gung khran tang gi gzigs skyong 'og rang khul 'dzam thang rdzong chab srid gros mol u yon lhan khang gi mu yon gyi go gnas bcas gnang nas dgung grangs drug cu tsam gyi skor du nyid kyis gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim/da lta bstan 'gro'i dpal du sku 'cho bzhes su khong gi gdung brgyud las chad pas sprul sku bsod nams bzang grags pa'i lugs gnyis mnga' ba krung hwa mi dmangs sbyi mthun rgyal khab si khron zhing chen rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul mi dmangs 'thus mi 'tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi dang 'dzam thang rdzong nang bstan mthun rtsags kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa sogs kyi go gnas dang / chos kyi sgo nas kyang jo nang rang lugs kyi dus 'bor gyi yan lag drug nyams su blangs nas mdo sngags kyi zab bka' mnos pa'i dam pa gong ma'i phyag srol —— 404 —

bzhin tshes bcu'i pho brang zhig gsos dang nang bzhugs bka' bstan bcos tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum kun mkhyen gsung 'bum sogs gsung gi rten dang / sku rten zhal thang mang po dang gser zangs las grub pas dus gsum sangs rgyas thog tshad ma gzhan rgyud sde bzhi dang chos skyong skor sogs lug ma gsar bzhengs/thugs rten gser dngul las bskun pas sku rin chen grags pa'i sku gdung thog tshad ma dang de min khru gang las mtho tshad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad sogs gser khang rten gsum bcas gsar bsgrun dang / mchod rten bkra shes sgo mang phyi nang yongs rdzogs gsor tog bcas zhig gsos legs pa bsod nams kyi bgyi ba gzab ldan mdzad nas da dung gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin tshes bcu'i yig brgya'i mtshams grwa sogs slar gsos bstan pa'i zhabs tog legs par mdzad bzang ji bzhin skyong nas bstan 'gro'i dpal du sku 'tsho gzhis su rjo rje khri la bzhugs bzhin yod do/ /(9)ches bcu smada.age sku zeng rim phyon gyilojus/ ageskuphreng dngapo nyis 'odazer/drung rasna thi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs zab bka' du ma la thos bsam gyis gsan spyang nyams len bcas kyis mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen par gyur cing tshul de lugs ltar gyis gdul bya rjes bzung ste gzhan la phan pa'ang rgya cher mdzad bzhin bzhugs shing khyad par nang rlung sems la dbang thob nas phyi yul snang ci dgar bsgyur nus pa'i mthu dang ldan te khong gi chos kyi mched tshes bcu ratna kyirtis mchod rten bkra shis sgo mngabazhengs skabs legs par spub pa la nye ba'i dus rshag gi tshe de'i nyin gyi nyi ma dgong mor nub la chas tshe age khong gis phyag gris nyi grib mtshams su 'dzer nas nyi ma rang sar sdod du bcug nas las ka'i mjug ma zin gyi bar nub kha'i nyi ma phyir yol bar byas shing de nas mchod rten gyi las mjug grub pa na phyag gri nyi grib mtshams nas phyungs tshe mtshan mo'i gyed tsam song zhing phyag gli phyungs shul grub chu bton pa da lta'i bar yod pa sogs ṭwāṃs ṭwāṃ mtshar ba~X grub rtags la thogs pa mi mnga' bas de lugs ltar gyi khong gi mtshan la'ang nyi ma 'od —ra ḍi ༵3)kā wa/ sku/ phreng gnyis pa nyi ma 'od zer dpal/khong gis 'dzam thang du chos rje rgyal ba seng ge dpal 'byor bzang po bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi zab bka' rgya cher mnos shing nyams len kyang mdzad/ de nas dbus gtsang du phebs te rje btsun tā ranā tha'i zhabs drung du mjal nas zab mo'i chos kyi sgo 'phar phyes te gdams zab rgya mtshos thugs rgyud mngon rsha/ sna/tam/ sa shing / rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la sgo gang thad nas rlabs chen gyi mdzad pa bzang po can (11)sku zeng gsum ba agekarma don dam/bstan 'gro la mdzad 'phrin gyi sgo rab tu yangs pa zhig ste 'di'i lo rgyus kyi khungs ma rnyed la/ 'di skor zhig tu age glo med zer ba zhig kyang byung bas de ni dbugs thengs gcig la 'jam dpal4 ༵rdon rjirjod

chatshang zhig shad kyis klog 'don byed thub pas mtshan la glo med du grags shing / khong gi lhag bzo rtemanyen lag mthil tsam gyi nang ngos su stung bshags kyi lha so lnga dang phyi ngos su gu ru rin po che rje 'bangasanyesdolnga'i sku brnyan legs mdzes 'bur du dod pa sogs ngo mtshan 'phrul gyis legs bsgrun spub rtags kyis rgyu rjes ches mang ba dang / tshe ldan gnas spar ba sogs khyad 'phags can zhig kyang byon chod du 'dug pa de sku zeng 'di dang gcig yin min rtsar ma chod do/ /(12)sku phreng bzhi ba 'azin las rab brtan/skyabs mgon mkhar ba rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas zab dgu'i gdams ngag rgya che ba ji bzhin legaganod mdzad nas nyams len rtogs pa mchog tu rgyas shing gzhan gdul bya slob tshogs kyang mang tsam 'duglepar grags kyang de yang de las khungs ma rnyed do/ /(12)skuzeng lnga ba.age bstan pa'i sgron me'am rab gsalasgyu mtsho/sbyangs pa skyabs mgon gyi thugs sras su gyur te zab chos kyi bdud rtsis thugs rgyud legs phyug mdzad nas nyams len gyis mngon rtogs mchog brnyes shing gdul bya 'dul ba'i mdzad bzang gi spyod sgo yang ches khyad par ba zhig ste gang gi thugs dgongs snang ba dbang bsgyur gyi rtogs pa zab mo'i klong du gshis lhug par 'byor tshabs che bas ya mtshan grub rtags kyi bkod pa rdo la phyag gris mar bcad pa ltar byas 'phral phyag mdzub kyis hrī ༷yig gser gyi rang bzhin ser lam mer legs 'bri mdzad cing sku'i zhabs mthil du dung dkar gyi sha mtshan dang sku la dug gi me mda' dbal tsha ba du mas bsnun kyang 'jig bral rdo rje lta bu'i ngang tshul gyis mtshon gyi gnod pa med pa dang 'tshe byed kyi mi stobs can du mas sku g.yo 'gul tsam yang mi nus shing 'byung ba chu la bskur kyang ma khyer ba sogs mthu nus zla bral gyi lo rgyus bsnyon med ches mnga' ba'i sprul pa'i sku zhig go 'di'i yang sprul sku skyes chung ba gnyis da lta mcho sngon du 'khrungs yod cing / de dag la dus phyis su tshes bcu smad ces pa'i ming chags so/ / gsum pa/ 'dzam thang gtsang ba'i lo rgyus/(1)sku phreng dang po ngagadabang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/thog mar 'dzam thang du chos rje lho kha ba'i sku ring la jo nang rje btsun rin po che'i dngos slob mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal chags phebs mdzad nas khams phyogs su lo ngo bcu gnyis tsam la rang lugs kyi chos bka' rgya cher spel/ de rjes chos rje go rgyal gyis blo gros rnam rgyal gyi yang sprul ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gdan 'dren zhus nas khong gis rang nyid kyis bzhugs gnas gsar pa zur du bzhengs nas khang gsar zhes grags/ khong nyid rang gi gzims khang du ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal bzhugs su gso'/ bas gzims khang ngam gtsang nas gdan 'dren zhus pas gtsang pa zhes grags/ gtsang pa'i gdan rabs thog ma ngag dbang rnam rgyal khong gi sku gong ma mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal dang nyid kyi khu bo cha lung grubatram̐ na ༵sdu dbang 'phrin las dang / gtsang pa khong nyid dang gsum gyi lo rgyus gzhan la gzigs rog

sngon gyi dus na rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal ba shākya seng ges 'bras spungs mchod rten chen mor dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs gsungs skabs kyi gsang chen rgyud sde mtha' dag zhu ba po gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi nye gnas nyan thos chen po kun dga' bo/ gangs rdzongs su pad ma 'byung gnas kyi sku dus lo tsā bee ro tsa na/ rje jo nang pa chen po'i bu chen zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/ 'jam mgon kun dga' snying po'i dngos slob mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams kyi sku'i rnam par nol pa rim pas legs par bzung ste bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad rjes su slar yang sbrul pa'i sku'i rnam par dus mthar snyigs 'gro'i bsod namos kyi zhing du legs par bhon te rang re'i nges don sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa mdo smad du slar cher spel dar rgyas mdzad pa ni gtsang pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal te/ gang nyid chos rjes go rgyal gyi sku drin dpal 'dzam thang du gdan 'dren zhus/ skabs der lam bar du mgo log a skyong dpon khang gis kyang che bkur dang bcas dpal 'dzam thang du phebs te gyang ra khar chos gzhi spya cher btsugs nas chos rje'i sprul dbon sogs 'dus sde ches mang la rang lugs kyi chos bka' zab mo'i sgo 'phar phyes nas smin grol la bkod pa nas bzung tsha rong rnga yul gser khog sogs yul spu rgya che ba du ma nges don zab mo'i chos mchog gis ches skal ba bzang po legs mdzad kyi mtshan snyan kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po slar yang byon pa lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi zil che ba sogs sgo gang thad nas ya mtshan bsngags par 'os pa mang po grags pa mdo khams spyal rong sogs khyab par mdzad bzhin khong nyid kyis bstan 'gro'i legs sgo rgya cher spel te dgung grangs zhe brgyad tsam du slebs skabs ljongs 'di'i gdul bya re zhig rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis thugs dgongs 'od gsal gnas lugs kyi dbyings su ro gcig par gyur te gzugs sku'i bkod pa nyer bsdu byas shing nyid kyi slob chogs mkhas btsun dar rgyas chos trīphel zung gis gaṭwāṃs skyes chen du ma byon pa sogs ji bzhin chos 'byung gzhung gi nyid kyi rnam thar las snaḍi) trītā dī snarshaṭwāṃ/ pa/kun bzang 'azin las rnam rgyal/gtsang ba'i sku thog ma gang gi yang sprul sku zeng gnyis pa'i tshul ni sprul sku kun bzang 'phrin las rnam spyal te rang gi sku gong ma'i rtsa ba'i bla ma kun bzang dbang po dang khu bo dag dbang 'azin las dang gong ma ngag dbang rnam rgyal gsum gyi mtshan gras nas ming gsol ba yin cing / de yang rgyal rong bag ko zhes par yab za la bon skyabs dang yum lug gu thar gnyis kyi sras su (spyi lo 1740 rab lo 12ci54)lcags spel lor khang steng du kha ba mi 'jog pa sogs kyi ltas dang bcas sku bltams shing zhag 'gar song rjes sku skyes na phra de zhag gsum bor nas mi mthong bar gyur slar mal du bzhugs nas nyid kyi phyag tu rgya gar 'bras kyi snye ma gsar pa zhig bzung bzhin zhal nas nga ni gtsang pa yin zhes zer/ de nas dgung lo gsum cam la 'dzam thang sgar gong 'og gis rang rang gi sprul pa'i sku skyes su kha ma 'cham pa la rten dpang du byas te bden brjod bcas rdzi 'gag rgyal pos sku skyes la rang gi gsol dkar rdo bcas steng latram̐ pha~X ༵ bcug ste

dkar yol bcag na 'dzam thang sgar 'og ma dang ma bcag na gong ma'i sku skyes su thag bcad de tshul de ltartswabyas tshe gsol dkar chag sel med par kha gyen la bstan pa dang gtsang ba gong ma'i rten lha cha sogasardzibazhin ngos 'dzin byas pas kun gyis de lugs ltar thag chod byung nas 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i sku skyes su khri 'don byas te rim pas slob dpon kun dga' dar rgyas kyi drung nas klog sogs bslab sbyang gis tshegs med mkhyen cing / sku dbon don thub rgya mtsho dge slong chos 'phel sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i mdun nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang sbyor drug gi chos skor mtshan gsol gong smos bzhin dang slob dpon kun dga' dar rgyas kyi drung nas rin 'byung gi dbang bka' rnams legs gsan mdzad/dgung lo bcu skor du tsha kho nas cha lung pa'i yang sprul phebs pa 'das pa'i gshegs mchod dang khong gis rab ka'i thang du dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs zab bka' du ma 'dus sde che ba la gsungs pas 'ja' sprin sogs kyi ltas bzang bcas gzhan yang chos bka' ci rigs 'dzam thang du'ang gsungs/dgung lo nyer gsum skor nas yar thang nas brgyud rnga yul phyogs su phebs lam kun tu rang rang gi mos 'dun bzhin gyi zab chos legs phye mdzad skabs mkha' lam nas 'ja' spyin dang chos nyan mig har long song ba 'ga' zhig gi mig thon pa sogs ngo ma lhun grub pa'i mdun nas sbyong rgyud kyi dbang dang kun dga' bkra shis kyi mdun nas rdor 'phreng gi dbang res mos mnyam zhu dang gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po bdag chen gyi dbang dang drug cu dmar chen rtsang mdos las tsogs bcas dang sgra mtshams sa sukāshā //na ci rigs kyi mthar slar 'dzam thang du phebs nas dgun mtshams dang gzims khang zhig gsos de nas ri khrod du sbyor drug la lo mtshams su bzhugs skabs rtogs pa'i klong rdol te rnal 'byor yan lag drug srog 'dzin man chad kyi nyams myong mtshan nyid pa skyes shing rang snang stong pa'i gzugs kyi 'char sgo ches chen mched de dag ma dag gi snang ba rab 'byams dang rmi lam 'od gsal gyi 'char tshul mtha' klas pa dang dus dus su dag snang gi ngor rdo rje 'chang / dus kyi 'khor lo/ sgrol ma dkar lngang / thugs rje chen po/ thub dbang / gnas bcu/ kun mkhyen rje btsun/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad sogs lhatshogs kyi snang ba rab 'byams dang / ha kṣa/ yig drug sogs yi ge'i gzugs snang du ma dang / shambha la sogs zhing khams kyi bkod pa du ma dang / gur/ zhal/ rnam sras sogs chos skyong gi rigs du ma dang /pha cig dam pa/ ma cig lab sgron/ bka' brgyad che mchog gshin rje keng ka pad ma dbang chen/seng gdong dmar mo/ lha mgon tshogs bdag sangs rgyas stong rtsa sogs khra lam mer mthong ba'i dag snang rgyan gyi 'khor lo la mnga' dbang 'byor zhing / 'di skor khong nyid byams pa 'bum gling du byon lam rnga yul stod smad sogs su 'gro don rgya cher bcas byang mjal du byon skabs kyirti thogs med zhabs kyis che bkur rta dang dar gos phyag rdor gyi gser sku khyad mtshar ba sogs kyi gnang sbyin dang / de phyogs kyi gong gras rgya rigs mi sna dag gis bka' yig legs pa sogs dang bcas de phan byang mjal gnas lam phye ba'i — 408 —

sgo nas skabs don legs thub dang khyad par de dus su phar mtha' rin po ches gtsang sbrul 'di nyid gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i byin gyis rlabs shing bstan 'gro'i don chen 'ong ba'i skyes chen du lung bstan yang yang mdzad/ de nas slar rnga yul du phebs te skor mda' thang du 'dus pa ches mang po la dus 'khor gyi py-idrordo trī/༵ /bar mdzad skabs khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la bka' yi tha tshig gis dam la bzhag nas chos de phan chad nas gtsang pa'i brgyud 'dzin dag gis drang srong gza' mchog chen po sgrub pa'i chos skyong gi gtso bo nyid du da lta'i bar gsol mchod byed pa yin cing / de nas tshur rang gnas su phebs nas dngos rdzas gang dag gis rnam dkar bgyi ba don ldan kho nar bcas thugs dam la gtso bor mdzad/ 'di skor zhig tu karma zhwa nag bdud 'dul rdo rje tshab tshar byon skabs der gtsang pa beebs nas mkhar rnga rgod ma brgya rin sogs sne grangs brgya 'bul dang bcas rtogs 'bul bkyag tshe/ karma pa'i zhal nas/ che bsngags kyis mdo smad bla sgar stong phrag gi gtsug gi nor bu mchog tu mnga' gsol mdzad cing karma nga 'dra sprasbya ṭā/ brnyan/ phyag dril sogs gnang sbyin rgya che bas brtsi bkur bla med byas pa sogs kyis rang gnas su dgung lo so lnga skor rdo rje g.yu brag tu gnas mjal la phebs skabs lam nas 'bri chu sogs rdza dkar nag gi chu rnams la dar gang nas zam med pa 'phral du dar chags pa'i steng nas phebs lam mdzad rjes slar yang chad pa'i sgo nas 'bri gong / yer pa/ lha sa sogs la rim pas mjal nas mtshur phur karma pa bzhugs pa'i drung du sngar gyi rtogs 'bul gyi 'phro legs zhu mdzad pas karma pa nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ che brjod gnang ba/ bla ma'i thugs su rtags bcu'i yon tan sogs/ gsar par 'chad 'di shin tu legs tshogs che/ slad ma'ang rnam kun mchog ldan gong 'phel cher/ gegs med yongs su spyod pas smin gyur cig ces sogs gzengs bstod rgya che ba mdzad cing / bkra shis lhun po/ jo nang sku 'bum sogs la mjal mchod dang / rtag bstan nas spar yig rgyab khal blus nas slar rim pas lha sa'i bar phebs te jo bo shākya mu nee sogs la gser chab phul nas khong gis tsan dan gyi bcu gcig zhal/ pad 'byung gtso 'khor/ kha sar pa ṇi/ rnam sras sogs kyi 'dra sku blus te snga phyi ci rigs su 'bri gung sprul sku/rgyal ba rin po che/ zhwa dmar bcu pa chos grub rgya mtsho sogs la legs mjal gyi sgo nas mar phebs lam ngam chu khar gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje dang rtogs 'bul yi ge bskur res kyis phan tshun thugs nang gcig 'dres su gyur/ sde dge nas rgyal ba'i bka' chos chen mo'i gsung rab kyi yi ge legs blu bcas rang gnas 'dzam thang du 'byor zhing rab gnas dga' ston rgya che ba dang 'gro phan gzhan yang mang dag mdzad/gtsang ba sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid kyi phyag tu dpal ldan lha mo'i ral gri bdud sde ma rungs pa tshar gcod byed kyi phyag mtshan de yang legs 'byor gyi tshul du rten gyi skal ba mchog tu thob bam snyam la/ dgung lo zhe gsum skabs chu chen lha steng mkhan pos gong ma'i gser yig gis 'dzam thang chos lugs brje dgos pa'i bka' — 409 —

nan byung ba na gtsang pa khong dang rdzi 'gag phun tshogs rdzong rgyal gnyis chu chen du byon te yin lugs legs zhus kyis ji bzhin go brda 'phrod nas zhwa ser kha bsgyur tsam las chos lugs sngar bzhin chog pa'i bka' gnang dang bka' rtags bzang po'i skyes bcas rang re'i bstan pa la phan thogs byung /dgung lo zhe drug tu ma yum 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs su 'khor lo drug cu lhag sogs rnam dkar bsags sgo rgya cher mdzad/ de nas nyid kyi dgung grangs zhe bdun nas zhe dgu'i bar lo gsum gyi ring la sku mtshams dam po mdzad nas bzhugs shing dgung lo lnga bcu slebs pa tsam na khong nyid tsha kha'i 'brog sde la dkar bsod du phebs skabs mi nag gi ser sdes zhus ngor spub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang gsungs pa'i tshe 'phral du sa drod dang mkha' lam nas 'ja' sprin dang mtshan mo sprin med par char zil dang nyin mo kha ba me tog ltar 'bab pa sogs kyi ltas byung tshe khong gi zhal nas/ da ni nga rang la sku gong ma'i tshe gegs las lhag lo gnyis tsam song bas gang gis phan pa med par 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa yin/ zhes gsungs nas (spyi lo 1789 rab lo 14ri31)sa mo bya lo de'i tha skar zla ba'i bco lngar zla ba sgra gcan gyis sgrib cing tshes de'i nyer brgyad nam gung du gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'phral du bsdus nub rwa rdzong du gdung shul sa mtho gang tsam skya mor song ba'i shul dod cing de'i nub gdar tshang du rol mo'i sgra ldir ba dang de zla ba phyi ma'i tshes gcig tu nyi ma yang bzung ba'i sgo nas tshes bzhi'i nam gung sa g.yo ba dang bcas sku gdung bzhu skabs bud shing cher med pa'i rang 'bar du song zhing zhe dgu'i ring 'ja' sprin rgyun ma chad pa dang gdung dus la tshe dpag med kyi sku sogs dang ring bsrel che chung du ma sku sha tshig pa'i thal ba mgar khung tshwa la lta bu'i sra mkhregs dang ldan ༵ sna/trī dro ṭwāṃ/tshar ba'i rtags mang po bcas dgongs mchod gdung rten sogs rgyas par rnam thar logs na gang gi thugs slob spub tshen dus zhabs pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul skur grags pa nang nyams rtogs kyi klong rdol zhing gtum mo'i bde drod kyis dgun khar gzims khang steng la kha ba 'jog mi thub pa sogs grub pa'i rtags dang mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga' ba lha tshe bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan zhabs pa dang / nyid kyi sku dbon lhun grub rgya mtsho ste/ de mthu nus kyis bstan bsrung bran du bkol zhing drag po mngon spyod kyi las tshabs chen grub pas sdang dgra gdug can chom la 'beebs nus pa'i sngags rig 'dzin pa chen po zhig yin phyir skabs shig tu khong nyid smra yul phyogs kyi 'brog sder bzhugs skabs nyin cig ri ngos nas 'brong g.yag rgod po ches stobs dang ldan pa zhig rang shed kyis 'brog pa'i ri thog tu rgyug byung ba na der gnas mi thams cad kyis ci bya gtol med 'jigs skrag gis bya thabs zad tshe/ dbon nyid kyis skad cis la/ chos skyong skul rbad kyis dmod bcol dang bcas sku gzan sa la brdabs pas de ma thag 'brong rgod ngar ba de 'phral du sked par dral nas kha spub tu shi song bas kun ha las par gyur pa sogs nus mthu che sdu'i lo rgyus mang po can 'ig go de la sogs pa'i thugs sras bu chen skyes bu dam pa'ang mang tsam yod —da tram̐ gtweḍi0 'o/——/

(2)sku zeng gsum pa dkonasachog 'jigs med rnam la/gtsang ba'i sku zeng gsum pa dkon mchog 'jigs med rnam rgyal ni/ yo stag tu yab mgo log snying rgya 'bum dang yum sdong za lug mtsho gnyis kyi sras rigs su lhums la bzhugs skabs yum gyi mi lam du zla ba khang steng du babs pa dang / 'dzam thang nas 'od zer ba'i bla sgar sgo drung du smrebs pa dang / nam mkha' nas gser gyi rdo rje snyan pa'i sgra ldan zhig rang gi pang du sang ba sogs rmis shing / yab kyi 'ang mnal lam du dung dkar 'bud pa'i sgra gdangs kyis yul gru chen po kun yom yom byed pa'i snang ba sogs dang / khyad par khyim gyi du ba gnam du song ba'i dbus su lha sku dkar po rgyan ldan bzhugs pa dang / bla ma dpon g.yog drug re gtsang ba yin zer bzhin khang thog tu thon pa dang / zhing rwa rnams su me tog sna tshogs 'od 'bar bas khrig mer gang ba dang / grong khyer kun tu dri bzang gis khyab pa dang / khang steng du gur gyi shul tsam la dgun khar kha ba mi 'jog pa dang / sku gong ma rnga khog tu phebabs dus mchod skong zhig stor song ba bya rog gis khyer nas 'dir khang thog tu bzhag pa dang / chos skyong khyab 'jug chen pos gzugs che chung sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas dus dang dus mel tshe byed pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan ches mang zhing / de nas sku snga ma gshegs nas zla ba drug dang zhag bcu dgu song mtshams (spyi lo 1790 rab lo 13ci44)lcags khyi'i lo'i bla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin sku lhams nas bltams ma thag zhal nas/hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa'i sgra gsal po sgrog cing mkha' lam nas rnga sgra lta bu byung ba'i rkyen gyis 'dzum mdzad dang bcas pa'i rgod bag ngom pa zhig ste sngon sku gong ma'i pus mo'i mtshams su seng ge'i gzugs 'dra'i ri mo sngo bkra'i sha mtshan yod cing de 'dra 9 mtshan de sku bar ma'i dpyid mig mtshams dang sprul sku 'di nyid kyi mkhal khung g.yas par yod pa'i legs mtshan gyi rten 'brel ji bzhin mngon no/ /dgung grangs bzhir son tshe/ 'dzam thang gtsang pa sgar gyis khri 'don dang bcas rim pas klog sogs bslab sbyang dang dgung lo bcu skor nas bzung dbon lhun grub rgya mcho'i drung nas dge bsnyen sdom pa zhus nas mtshan dkon mchog 'jigs med rnam rgyal du gsol zhing gzhan yang dus 'khor dbang sogs zab bka' ci rigs dang / slob dpon chos 'byor zhabs pa'i mdun nas sbyor drug gi zab bka' zhus nas nyams len gyis rtogs pa'i rtsal yang rab tu gyur cing / 'di skor gzhan la'ang dbang bskur mdzad thub cing / dgung lo bcu bzhi par si tu pad ma nyin byed dbang po'i drung nas kyang rab byung bsgrubs te/mtshan karma chos mchog bstan gsal zhes gsol zhing / de skabs su sku dbon sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i drung nas kyang rin 'byung sogs dang / kun dga' chos dbyings kyi mdun nas kun 'khyen gsung 'bum/blang dor khrid lung / rtsis dkar nag sogs phyi nang gi rig gnas du ma la gsan sbyang phul byung mdzad/sku dbon lhun grub pa'i drung nas sbyong rgyud kyi dbang sogs zab bka' du ma gsan zhing lhar yag ri khrod pa sogs la dbang lung khrid gsum ci rigs kyang mdzad/ 'di skor gzims khang du ston pa'i skyes rabs kyi spyang ris gsar bzhengs dang / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i mdun nas mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang khrid zhus nas — 411 —

bsnyen sgrub kha skong bcas dang / dus 'khor lha dgu'i sbob thabs kyi steng nas dbang khrid kyang zhus te lha bsnyen bye ba kha skong bcas kyi mtshams sgrub dang / rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi mdun nas slar yang yan lag drug gi zab khrid zhus te zla ba zhe bzhi'i bar nyams len gnad smin mdzad pas rtogs pa gshis nas mngon du gyur te 'od gsal don dam pa'i 'char sgo mtha' klas pa dang bcas nang dbyings gdod ma nyid kyi gnas lugs la ji bzhin thugs nges chen po 'khrungs shing / dgung lo nyi shu skor du dbon sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i drung nas thub thob brgyad cu/ rjes gnang brgya rtsa sogs dang / slob dpon dri med kyi mdun nas bka' babs drug ldan gyi zab khrid zhus te zla ba bcu bzhi'i bar nyams len gnad khel bcas kyis mtshams sgrub dang / lhar yag blo gros rgya mtsho sogs la mi 'khrugs pa dang dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang bskur kyang mdzad/dgung lo nyer bdun steng khong nyid 'khor tshogs rgya cher bcas dbus gtsang du phebs te/ gzhung dga' ldan pa sogs la 'bul rkyen/ jo bo sogs rten khyad 'phags la gser chab bcas paṇa chen rin po che'i mdun du dngos 'bul gzab ldan gyi sgo nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus shing / khong gis gtsang pa la gnang sbyin/ rje'i gsung 'bum/ byams mgon sku brnyan/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum/ na bza' cha tshang sogs dang / khyad par rje btsun nga 'dra ma'i gser sku/ rje btsun gyi dbu zhwa/rje btsun nyid kyi sku 'dra'i spar shing phyag bzo ma sogs legs skyes kyi mdzad sgo spya cher byas shing / jo nang rtag brtan gyi slob dpon sku phyogs spo ra ba blo bzang mthu stobs kyi drung nas zab lam ni༄'i chos bka' yongs rdzogs zhus nas yon 'bul dgon la khyi thebs gya nom dang sa skya sogs kub sde so sor mchod 'bul ṭī ṭwāṃ// sduṭwāṃ / shā ༵ shāsdo/ gnas su 'byor zhing mtsho sngon phyogs kyi gtsang sgar du'ang phebs nas chos bka' dgung lo sum cu skor la thugs chen du gnas mjal dang ni gu'i zab chos la nyams len nyer drug bar mdzad pas sngar las nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal 'bar te phyag rgya chen po'i don la dbang 'byor/ 'di skor du gser ni zog dgon la rgyal gdon gyi gnod pa che stabs gtsang pa bsrung rim du byon dgos byung bas lam bar du se dmar zhes pa'i gzhi bdag gdug can khong nyid gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par bzhengs te stobs nus kyis ci dgar las la bkol nas bka' dam du legs bzhag mdzad cing gnod pa can gyi dgon der khams gsum zil gnon gyi gtor sgrub zab mo'i bsung rim skabs dkyil 'khor du mchon cha'i phur bu 'khrab pa dang zor cha phal cher dgung rtsed byed pa sogs ches rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i zil bzod dka' ba'i rtags mtshan dus su ngom bzhin dgon de la 'tshe ba'i rgyal gdon tshar bcad nas zhi 'jags bde skabs su btang zhing / rnam par dkar ba'i bya ba khong gis dngul rdo tshad bcu gcig gis yon sbyin mdzad de so mang rgyal khab nas 'khor brgya phrag lhag dang / yang dngul rdo tshad bcu gnyis lhag tsam gyis ra rgya shing ༵༵ sgar nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi yi ge yongs rdzogs gdan 'dren legs blus mdzad

sgo dang / 'di skor byams gling du phebs te sgo mang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang mjal 'phral bcas 'bul ba gzab ldan grwa tshang la mang ja sogs dang 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung 'bum zhig kyang blus/gyir gtsang pa 'di nyid kyis 'dzi ka stod smad kyi 'dus sde yongs la zab mo'i chos char phabs pa sogs mgo log ja ba/ wa shul/ tsha kho'i phyogs khag so sor zab chos kyis rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma ches mang zhing khyad par gang nyid kyi thugs sras bu chen du gyur pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnas su 'os pa brgya phrag du ma yod la/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag yang gong smos kyi yul spu so sor skyong ba'i mi dbang sde bcas gang dag dang gdul bya bstan 'gro'i don de phyogs kun tu snga phyi ci rigs mang por byon zhing / khong nyid ri khrod gdar tshang du 'jigs byed bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs skabs rtags mtshan khyad par ba'i lo rgyus kyang mang /'di skabs ci rigs la bya bral klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i mdun nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi bathag lung gsan/dgung lo bzhi bcu skor rje klu spub zhabs pa de nyid kyi drung nas 'dzi sgar dgongs gter sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi zab bka' zhus te zla ba bdun gyi bar bsnyen mtshams kha skong bcas grub cing / de rjes sum 'jigs gyed snyan brgyud kyi rim pa'ang mtha' spyas mdzad nas de mtshams shig tu bla ma chos mchog gis zhus ngor 'dus pa mang po la 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang dang chos skyong 'ga'i rjes gnang bcas gsungs shing / khyad par drakkad gnyos lugs kyi rjes gnang bka' gtad bcas nang slob dam tshig dag pa 'ga' la gnang skabs glog 'od 'khyug cing 'brug skad drag po ldir bzhin lce 'beebs dbang ngar chos 'jigs snang bskul ba sogs gnyan cha che ba'i rtags mtshan byung la/ sku 'di dang gong ma ci rigs kyis dkor bdag rnam sras mchod sgrub dang gzhan rgyal po'i rigs bkol ba'ang mdzad/ de nas bla ma dri med kyi mdun nas mgon po brag rdzong ma'i dbang khrid gsan nas bsnyen mtshams dam rgya bcas kyis 'grub rtags thon nges dang / mchog rtse dang rdzi 'gag gi rgyal po rnam gnyis kyis gdan 'dren zhus skabs rim pas bkra shis sgang / rgyal sa rna dag lhar yag dgon sogs la brgyud nas phebs lam thams cad du chibs bsu rgya che bas mkhar rnga dang spub chas sgra ldan sogs dngos rdzas kyi 'byor pa gya nom pas che 'bul bcas de phyogs dpon sde mtha' dag gi dad gus bla blag pas bla mar legs bkur byed skabs khong gis gson po la 'pho lung gis rnam shes dbyings su spar ba dang 'jam dpal khros pa'i nga rgyal ngang me zhags kyis gdon bgegs ring du bskrad tshul 'dre khog zhugs dag gis lab pa sogs yon tan mthu nus kyi snyan pa kun nas ldir bzhin bsrung rim dbang bka' rgya che bas 'gro don dang de phyogs dgon sde la zab chos re 'dod bzhin gyis yid tshim mdzad pas dngos 'bul kyang de lugs ltar sgo kun nas smrin dpung bzhin gang 'dus tshad rnam dkar chos ldan gyi bgyi ba 'ba' zhig tu gtsang dag mdzad/de mtshams dgung grangs zhe drug skor zhig nas nyid sku bslung ba'i tshul bstan pa nas bzung gang gi zhabs brtan du rnam dkar gyi bsod nams rlabs po che yun ring bar bsags sgo kun nas rgya 4/rdod na'ang

gtsang pa khong nyid dgung lo zhe brgyad (spyi lo 1837 rab lo 14ci31)me bya'i lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin snga dro nyid mdun du thugs sras bu chen ngag dbang chos 'phel/ sku dbon bdemigashegs/ mdzod pa dpal 'byor sogs 'bod te/ khong gi zhal snga nas/ nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu ngag dbatha chos 'phel bsko bzhag dang khyed rnams nas da phan bstan pa legs skyong dang dgon gzhi'i sgrub mchod rnams ma 'chag par mdzad thabs dang rten gsum 'azo 'os ci rigs su sgrub pa la rem mdzod/khong gi snang ngor nangs tho rengs khar slob dpon chos 'byor yin zer ba zhig gi bum chu dkar po'i rgyun blugs pas mtsho chen zhig tu gyur nas de'i khar kho bo bde stong gi nyams ches 'thug po rang bzhin brjod mi shes pa dag snang 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bzhin dga' bde zla dang bral bas kun nas myos te chu bya ltar rol par gnas pa sogs ltas mang po mi nyams lta bu zhig ma yin par dngos gnas kyi snang ba ches gsal po byung 'dug pas da lta rang nyid dbyings kyi snang ba de dag dang dbyer med rdo mnyam du 'gro bar chas gyir khyed cag gis mya ngan ma byed dang rjes sor lo gcig tsam las mi 'gyangs par slob 'bangs kyi grwa ngo shes pa'i bstan pa la sgo kun nas phan 'dogs nus pa zhig tu rten 'brel legs par smon 'dun byed pa yin/zhes gsungs nas tshes de'i nyi nub kyi dus tshod tsam na gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su zum par mdzad pa'i mod mkha' dbyings kun tu 'ja' smrin gyis go mtshams med par gang zhing gdung la zhugs mchod kyi skabs su me lce 'od lnga'i mdangs can gyi dbus su lha sngags kyi rnam pa 'khyug 'khyug byed pa thugs ka'i thad du rtsa gsum gyi rtse mo pi wang gi rgyud ltar drang shad du ja sbyor phyed tsam mes ma tshig cing dbu thod yar ba'i nang logs su hūṃ yig ljang sngon dang phyis ngos su thig le lnga ldan re khā skum po'i gzugs sogs byung zhing de 'dra'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas dgongs mchod legs sgrub dang gdung rten sogs kyi tshul nyid kyi rnam thar logs su yod pa las ji skad byung ba ltar ro/ /(4)sku zeng bzhi ba ngag lo/de nas lo shas tsam na rje gtsang pa rang gi sgar gyi mnga' 'og gi gtsang sde'i ta shul sang gi mi khyim la yabakhyi lo zhes pas khyim thab mo chen ma dang chung ma gnyis blangs ba las rjes ma'i sras su gzugs sku na phra'i me tog gsar pa dus su mngon par bzhad pa'i tshe dang po ma'i lhums nas grod pu lta bu'i nang du sku btsas de ma thag zhal nas/ ma yum la bos te/ yi ge drug ma dang / rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi snying po sgra tshig dag gsal du yang yang gsungs/ de skabs sku na phra khong rang gi steng du 'od dkar gyis yi ge drug ma'i gzugs gsal pa mkha' dbyings su mngon gsal mthun snang du nye bar dod pa dus rtag par sbrul pa'i sku skyes na chung de la 'od dkar po me long tsam pa zhig rgyun par kun gyi mthong snang du byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i legs mtshan ches mang po kun nas mnga' ba zhig ste bar bar rnams su rang khyim sbra'i tshab kyi steng du sku skyes nam mkhar 'phags te rdo rje skyil spung gis bzhugs pa der gnas gzhan dag gi mig sngar yang yang mthorji ba ༵༵ 'phags kyi rtags mtshan lhag par che na'ang de la chen ma'i sdang sems phrag dog gis mnol

btsog dma' 'beebs che bas ma rungs par byas rkyen sprul pa'i sku nyid la glo bur sku grib phog pas de 'phral mi khyim des mngon shes rtogs pa mchog mnga' rje lha ba bla ma kun dga' dpal ldan zhabs pad gdan 'dren byas nas sku skyes la grib sel zhus skabs gzungs chu'i snod rdzo ma mchu lo zhig gis byas pa na/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas/ da lan sku skyes 'di nyid mtshan ci zhes dris pa'i tshe/ khyim bdag des 'di ming la ngag lo zer/ zhus pas/ 'o na 'di nyid khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bla mar gyur pa gtsang chen sku zeng gsum pa'i yang sprul du nges kyang pha khyi lo bu ngag lo khrus chu'i snod rjo ma mchu lo rnams 'dzoms pa dang da lta bdag dang nyi nub tu 'phrad pa sogs gang thad nas rten 'brel legs po ma byung bas sku skyes 'di nyid kyis 'dir bstan 'gro'i don re zhig mi bzhugs par zhing gzhan du myur du 'byon nges su 'dug go/ ces pa'i bka' lung legs rtsal gyi sgo nas sku skyes la khrus byab bsrung ba re mdzad kyang phan pa ma byung bar bskung nad de la brten nas mi ring bar 'phral du gzugs sku'i me tog yal song bas rje gtsang chen gsum pa'i yang srid 'di'i gdul zhing gi skal ba re 'ig ma yod do/ /de nas bzung lo 'ga' zhig gi ring la gtsang ba'i sku skyes slar ma byon pa la rje gtsang ba sku chen du grags pa mtshan dngos ngag dbang rig pa mchog gi rnam par rgyal ba'i sde 'am ngag dbang 'jam dpal mthu stobs rnam rgyal zhes 'bod pa gang de rgyal dbang lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sprul par don la grags mod kyang 'dir phyi tshul tsam du gtsang chen sku phreng lnga par mtshan gsol ba tsam ste/de yang gtsang ba'i sde 'bangs gang dag gi 'brog sde'i nang du yab a rigs lha skyabs dang yum ri za gnyis kyi sras su nyid sku legs 'khrungs kyi skabs thog mar ma'i lhums su zhugs dus na ma yum gyi snang ngor po la'i nags su mi rgan dung gi 'azeng ba can mthong ba sogs sngas las gnas 'gyur gyi snang ba byung ba legs pa gzhan phal las phyi nang gi rtags mtshan khyad par ba mang po yod pa yin la/ de nas sku skyed bsrings te rim pas cher skyes skabs sku 'ang ri 'phongs dge 'phel sogs drung du klog yig slob pas yig 'don ji bzhin shes pa dang gzhan phal ba las 'phags pa'i mthong snang sna tshogs pa thugs la shar ba dang chos skyong khyab 'jug chen pos sku bdag bar bar byed pa sogs mdzad sgo khyad par ba'i sku skyes rigs bzang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin stabs 'di skor gtsang ba'i thob bdag med pas grwa tshang gi dbu chos drag bsdus dag gis gtsang ba dngos kyi sku skyes ma byon bar du a rigs sku skyes gzhon nu la gtsang ba'i mtshan gsol nas re zhig bar gtsang pa sgar ru 'dzin bdag byed po nyid du bsko bzhag byas pa nas bzung gtsang chen sprul pa'i sku ru mtshan snyan gyi grags pa je rgyas su song ba yin/ de mtshams re zhig tu gtsang ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dag dbang chos 'phel rgya mtsho gang drung du sprul pa'i sku skyes gzhon pa des 'dus pa brgya phrag lhag tsam dang mnyam du thog mar chos kyi sgo mi 'khrugs pa dang spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rjes gnang rnams legs par gsan zhing / de rjes mi ring ba na rje bla ma de nyid kyi drung du sku skyes khong gis 'dus pa lnga bcu tsam dang lhan du/ rdo rje 'chang / rdor sems/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser — 415 —

rnams kyi bzlas lung dang / gcod kyi dbang thad zil gnon/ kong sbrul gcod khrid/ paṇa cheṣkagacod kyi lung khrid rnams legs mnos mdzad/ khyad par bla ma gang gi mdun nas/ sku skyes nyid kyis rtswagasadzwa'aga' dang chabs cig zhang ston 'dul chog gi steng nas dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul sogs kyi sdo lung nod skabasmo mtshan ngag dbang rig pa mchog gi rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gsol/ 'di skor zhig namirje dge slong rin po che nyid kyis dag zhing gzigs rjes tsam na 'dzi stod 'brim shar ri khrod du skyabs rjesgromakhar ba rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bsam gtan dpal bzang po bzhugs pa'i sku tshe smad kyi cha dgung grangs spya lnga bzhes stabs su rje gang gi mdun du/ sprul pa'i sku skyes grwa 'khor 'ga' bcas phebs nas nyid kyi sbyor ba yan lag drug gi zab khrid dbang lung bcas yongs su rdzogs pa rim pas zhus te nyams len gnad 'khel gyis rtogs pa bogs bskyed thon pa byung zhing / gzhan yang chos bka' mang tsam legs gsan mdzad/sbyor drug khong gis zhus dus su bla mas btags pa'i mtshan ngag dbang 'jam dpal mthu stobs rnam rgyal yin nam snyam/ de rjes lo gnyis tsam nas skyabs rje mkhar ba rin po che'i gzugs sku chos dbyings subasdus rjes su gtsang pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ngag dbang chos kyi 'phags pa'i sku mdun du/ sbrul pa'i sku nyid kyis 'dus pa mang tsam dang mnyam du kun mkhyen dol po'i bka' pod drug rnam thar bcas dang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsungs 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa'i bklag lung ma lus pa gsan la/ yang de phyis tsam na rje bla ma chos 'phags pa'i sku drung nas/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs rje btsun gyi bka' 'bum las byung ba'i rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbang bka' yongs rdzogs/ phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang bskur cha lag bcas sogs chos bka' mang po zhig legs nod mdzad/de nas yang yun mi ring ba na bla ma de nyid gtsang pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bzhes skabs yar thang rgya bla ma dang lha tshe gcod pa gnyis kyis rkyen sbyar la brten nas grwa tshang 'du khang steng du spyor drug sgrub grwa legs 'dzugs skabs kyi sgrub sde pa thog ma'i gral du sprul sku 'di nyid kyis rnal 'asnyor yan lag drug nyams bzhes skabs rje chos kyi 'phags pa gtsor gyur skyes chen du ma'i drung nas chos bka' ci dgos zhus nas sgrub pa lhur bzhes la nan tan dang rje dam pa gang dag la nyams len 'dri gtugs zhib tig sogs kyis zab chos sgom sgrub lo gsum du byas pas nang rtogs kyi 'phel kha sngar las ches cher 'beel ba byung zhing / de—mtshams re zhig nas rje chos 'phags sku gshegs te rgyal tshab lha ba bla ma kun dga' dpal ldan zhabs pas gtsang pa'i gzims khang du rdo rje slob dpon mdzad skabs su de nyid drung nas kyang sbrul pa'i sku gang gis gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos sgo gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos kyi bka' rgya che ba yang yang zhus nas de lugs kyi nyams bzhes gnad smin ci rigs pa re'ang mdzad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i zab chos nyan bsam gyi mdzad pa sgo gang thad la mi dman pa'i ngang nas sprul pa'i sku nyid gtsang chen sgar gyi dbang cha 'dzin bdag tu gyur te sku zhang dge 'phel dang sku dbon lung rigs sogs 'khor drag bsdus mang zhing rlabs che ba 'dzi ka'i grwa tshang mang phyogs kun gyi gtsug nor du gyur pa sbrul pa'i — 416 —

sku gang nyid la sngon gyi las shugs bka' tha tshig dam po'i dbang gis ched du ma bsgrubs kyang khyab 'jug rā hu la bka' yi bsrung ma'i tshul du bran bzhin bkol ba khong nyid yi dam la mnga' brnyes shing rtogs pa'i nang bcud rgyas pas nam mkho ba'i tshe 'phrin las nyer bskul bka' tha tshig bsgrag tsam gyis pha rol gang la'ang rtags mtshan rno byur dus su thon nus gyir mgo log a skyong dpon sogs phyogs kyi sde dpon dbang che ba du mas rje gtsang pa la gus 'dud che ba bcas kyis bar bar skyes 'bul dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag zhabs 'degs ci dgos thams cad nges par sgrub pa sogs mdzad sgo gang thad nas zla dang bral zhing khong nyid lugs gnyis gang thad la thugs dpyod rab tu yangs pa 'dus pa grwa tshang spyi dang 'bangs lha sde bcas kun la skyong lugs kyi thabs nye bar mkhas pa zhig ste/ mtshams shig nas khong dpon slob sgar gzhi cha tshang gis bod smongs chos kyi gnas yul lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang jo shāka rnam gsum dang rang gi ma dgon jo nang rtag brtan rnams su legs phebs kyis gnas mjal phyag mchod thugs smon gzab ldan bcas kyis rang yul du phebs kar jo nang nas rje btsun rin po che'i gsung 'bum cha tshang blus te sprul sku 'dis gtsang pho brang du spyan drangs par mdzad la/ 'di skor ci rigs su sbrul pa'i sku gang gis phyis su rdor slob kyi go sar bzhugs pa khyi lo ma'i bla ma ngag dbang chos 'byor sogs bla grwa 'dus pa ches mang po la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang mo che sta gon/ byis 'jug mchog dbang / mchog dbang khyad par can/ bdag po bdag chen bcas dang / thams cad rig pa'i dbang sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis/bde mchog lha lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gsum la sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis re/ gzhan yang rjes gnang sna tshogs pa 'ga' re bcas legs par gsungs shing / de rjes gnas skabs ci rigs su sprul sku nyid kyis 'dus pa mang 'tshogs la ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud las bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa cha tshang gnang ba dang / gtsang grwa'i lo bstar gyi sa zla'i dus 'khor sgrub mchod kyi dus skabs rnams su dge 'dun mang du 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du dgongs te slar nang du 'dus nas gsung bsgrag byed rtsol de dam pa 'dis mdzad par grags pa sogs gdul bya rjes 'dzin gyi mdzad sgo de 'dra mang tshod du 'dug kyang ji bzhin gyi khungs ma rnyed la/ spyir ni lugs gnyis thad la thams cad kyi yid kun mthun zhig gang nas 'ong thabs dka' bas dus skabs 'dir yang sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid kyi sgrub grwar mtshams sgrub mdzad rjes tsam na gtsang pa 'gab ma'i dbon rig rtsal gyis 'khu ldog gis khong nyid gtsang pa parnyi ta'i phyogs su 'phral pebs mdzad dgos re byung yang slar yang rang re'i bstan pa'i 'dzin bdag tu mi ring bar byon skabs 'grig pas mchog sprul nyid rang cag la sgo kun nas bka' drin lhag par che/ de yang skabs gong 'og ci rigs par gtsang pa'i dgon lag rnga yul gyi rtsi nang dgon pa'i don la gtsang pa dang byang bla brang phyogs gnyis kyi 'khon pa byung ba slar bsdums kyi rgyal kha chen po'i ngang nas mtshan snyan yongs la khyab pa byung zhing de 'dra'i rang re'i gtsang sgar gyi bstan pa'i sgo kun nas rgyas byed kyi bla ma mchog gyur che ba'i mdzad sgo legs par mnga' ba zhig yin la/ mtshams re zhig nas rgyal mo tsha rong — 417 —

phyogs su gtsang chen sku phreng lnga pa'i sku skyes rtags mtshan can zhig legs par 'khrungs pa gdan 'drin gyi dus su babs na gtsang grwa yongs kyis rje mchog sprul 'di 'phrin las dang mtshan snyan kun nas rgyas stabarshakhong nyid gtsang pa'i sku phreng lnga par gzhir bzhag gi steng nas tsha yul du 'khrungs pa'i sku skyes nyid don la gtsang pa'i thugs sprul du re yul byas te phyi ngor tsam la gtsang pa dge slong gi yang sprul gyi mtshan nye bar gsal bzhin dus mi ring bar 'dzam thang gtsang chen pho brang du khri 'don sogs kyi legs sgo byas shing /de skabs su khong gis thugs legs dgyes kyi ngang sku skyes gzhon pa blus yon gyi dngos rdzas gang dgos sogs thams cad thugs khur bzhes te mdzad sgo kun mthun gyi spyod pa rlabs tshe ba nye bar gnang la/ de nagabazung rim pas mchog sbrul gong ma nyid la gtsang sku chen zhes mtshan chags/'di skor khong nyid nang thugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa che rab byung zhing rtsa rlung thig le la dbang cher son pa thugs dmigs la nus pa nye bar che ba zhig tu gyur te nyin cig sbrul pa'i sku gang gi drung du a skyong dpon rin chen byams kyi ma rgan lo lon nad kyis gzir ba 'pho lung zhu bar 'ong ba la rje nyid kyis 'pho ba btab pas gson po'i rnam par shes pa skad cig de nyid la gnas dngos su spar bar mdzad pa sogs rlabs che ba'i nus mthu mnga' zhing / de phyis bar bar rnams su sde dgon rten gsum che ba gang dag bzhengs pa dang phyag mchod byas pa dang bstan 'gro'i don la mgo log sogs phyogs phyogs rnams la khong grwa 'khor bcas gdul byar phebs te skabs shig tu lha sprul gyis dgon gsar 'debs skabs mi dpon 'ga'i gegs byas skabs gtsang sku chen la khyed kyis bdag la dgon 'debs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar na dgon gyi bdag po gtsang pa las ga'an med tshul gyi chad mdo byas nas de lugs ltar a skyong dpon khag rnams la dgongs zhu byas te pe yul dgon gsar 'debs byung ba ni dam pa 'di kho na'i drin yin no/ de nas dbang chen stod pa'i yul sde la khong gis mgon po tshogs bdag gi sgo nas dmag mdos mdzad skabs las mtha' gtor zor gyi dus su mdos gtor la me dpung rang 'bar byung ba dang / yang bar 'gar sku tshe smad la nye skabs rnams su sprul sku 'di nyid kyis grub dbang dpa' bo'i brtul zhugs bzung ste khong gis me mdas nad gzhi che ba'i mi 'ga' zhig dang smyo nad kyis btab pa gang dag la dngos su legs bsnun gyis nad dang smyo ba sangs drag tu byed pa dang / nyin zhig mgo log phyogs kyi a bo tshang zer ba'i mi khyim zhig la phyugs la god nad byung skabs khong gis rgyang ring po nas me mda' 'phangs pas khyim tshang de'i nor phyugs yod sar me mda' sgra dang bcas thon nas bgegs bsal gyi mdzad sgos nor nad de mtshams nas rgyun chad pa sogs de 'dra'i mdzad pa ci rigs pa bar bar gnang zhing / 'di skor gong 'og ci rigs par rje nyid sku 'khor nyung shas bcas rdzogs chen gangs khrod du phebs nas khong gis der zla ba gsum tsam gyi ring la skrub pa nyams len lhur bzhes kyis sngags kyi rtogs pa 'phar te rtsa rlung thig le la dbang thob pa'i tshad du rsāb skabs nas rdza ra nyag sku rgod kyi sras mo bud med mtshan ldan chos sman zer ba rig mar bsten pa'i sngags 'chang gi mdzad sgo gnang zhing de skor snga phyi gang yang rung bar dpal bka' brgyud phyag chen phyogs nas skyes chen 'ga'i drung —— 418 —

nas gsang chen gyi chos bka' ci rigs sbrul sku nyid kyis legs gsan mdzad dus shig na khong la karma zhes pa'i mtshan snon gyi skal ba thob bo/ /gtsang sbrul 'dis sku tshe smad nye ba tsam nas bzung rim pas 'dzam thang gtsang pho brang gi thugs 'gan de tsam du bzhag pa'i tshul gyis phyogs nges med rnams su phebs pa mdzad cing / khyad par sku tshe snad kyi dus mgo log phyogs la bzhugs skabs a skyong gong ma'i dpon grongs rjes su khong gis a skyong dpon sus khri ston byas skabs nyid kyi mtshan la gras te karma mthu stobs rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan gsol ba dang / sprul sku gang gis da lan mgo log yul sde dang zi ling gi rgya gnyis bar 'khon legs bsdum ma byas na rjes sor mi ring bar dus 'khrugs kyis mgo log phyogs la chag god che tshul zhib rgyas kyi bka' lung yang yang byung na'ang de lugs gang thad nas ma 'dzoms stabs sbyis su de ji lta ba bzhin gyi dus zing mngon gsal du byung la/de nas re zhig gi tshe khong nyid dag pa mkha' spyod du phebs la nye ba'i skabs kyi thugs snang sngar dang mi 'dra ba byung bar brten de mtshams shig nas khong gis 'dzi yul yan gyi ser skya pho mo mang tsam khrid nas gnas chen pad ma bkod du legs phebs kyi tshul mdzad de stod rdza ra nyag phyogs su thon tsam na yin lugs de ka las skabs ma byung bar de phyogs su re zhib/ bar bzhugs dgos byung zhing de rjes tshod cig nas khong nyid kyis yum yang rang khyim du gtad cing nyin gcig tu 'al gsung las/ nye 'khor dag la/ da ni rang yang 'chi ba'i dus su babs 'dug rang gi shul du yod pa'i dngos rdzos dag gis kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po'i sku brnyan legs pa zhig khyed cag gis nges par bzhengs dgos nam ig de'i bdag po byed mkhan zhig thon yong bas de dus su de'i lag tu sprod cig ces gsungs nas khong nyid gzim gur logs pa zhig gi nang du gcig pur bzhugs te sku bzhugs stangs khyad par ba'i sgo nas ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa ya mtshan pa dang bcas dgongs pa dbyings su thim zhing de nas grwa 'khor gang dag gis gdung mchod legs sgrub bcas kyis gang gi zhal bkod ltar dngul las dol po'i 'dra sku yang khyad mtshar can zhig bzhengs grub kyi mjug mi ring ba na 'dzam thang phyogs nas sku brnyan gdan 'dren la thon te rim pas de dag gis gdan drangs nas gtsang chen pho brang gi gser khang du mchod gnas su bzhugs su gsol lo/ /(5)sku zeng lnga ba 'jigs med phyogs las rnamasgyul/de la'ang sngon gtsang pa gong ma'i yang sprul 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang gtsang 'gab ma'i lcags mdud sprul pa'i sku zung gi 'khrungs yul du gyur pa rgyal mo rong phyogs kyi char gtogs yul bag kos shog zhes par yab yon tan dang yum snyi 'bu thar gnyis kyi sras su shing khyi'i lor yang sprul 'di nyid thog mar ma'i lhums su yod skabs ma yum gyi snang ba sngar dang 'dra min gyi 'char sgo dang bar snang nas ṭā dril gyi sgra thos pa rang khyim thog tu 'ja' 'od zug pa sogs kyi legs mtshan mthun snang du byung zhing sku bltams pa'i dus su grod pu lta bu'i nang nas lte gzan dang bcas mgo mjug ma log par zhabs sems skyil byag gnyis rdor bldams dang bcas ji bzhin legs bzhugs mdzad ces grags skani / — 419 —

de nas rim pas sku na bskyed skabs sku lus ngos su sngon gyi gtsang sprul gong ma dag gi sha mtshan gas po dod cing sku skyes na phra'i dus su steng la 'od dkor rgyun par 'khor zhing lha chen khyab 'jug gis sku bdag yang yang byed par mngon gsal du yod la/ chung du smra shes tsam na zhal gsung las/ yi ge drug yongs rdzogs gsal por gsungs shing bar bar du/ nga ni bla ma gtsang pa yin/ zhes pa'ang rang shugarnakyis yang yang smra ba byung zhing tshul de lugs kyis yul phyogs de'i dpon sde kun gyi brtsi bkur gyi snyan pa phyogs su khyab pa 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i legs gsan kyi sku bdag byas/ de nas dgung lo bcu la smrebs skor sogs su gtsang pa'i dbu chos rgan pa bser pa chos dbyings sogs drag bsdus 'ga' zhig gis sku yon rgya che ba dang bcas sprul pa'i sku skyes legs blus kyi bya ba la 'ong skabs sang thon pa'i snga nub nas sku skyes rang gis ji bzhin mkhyen te ma la smras pa/ de ring khyod kyis snga mo nas khyim phyag bdar dang zas g.yos sogs legs par mdzod cig nga rang gi bdag po thon la khad du yod/ ces gsungs pa ltar 'dzam thang nagagatsang pa'i sku bdag de'i nyin legs par byung nas sku skyes dang phan tshun bka' mol gyi skabs gtsang chen gong ma 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi bzhugs gdan dang rdor dril spu skyes nyid nas ngos 'dzin mdzad pas kun yid lhag par ches te dga' spro'i ngang sku bdag gang dag gis blu yon gyis yab yum mgu bar byas nas sbrul pa'i sku gang nyid 'dzam thang du gdan 'dren mdzad skabs rim pas dgon de'i nye 'dabs smrebs dus sbyangs pa bla ma kun dga' nges don zhabs pa 'dzam thang phar ngos sgrub khang du bzhugs pa'i gzigs ngor sprul pa'i sku gdan drangs pa 'phags mchog 'jigs rten dbang phyug gi rnam pa 'od zer gyis ljongs 'dir khyab pa legs gzigs mdzad cing sku skyes 'khor bcas 'dzam thang du skebs pa dang grong sde dag gis gnag phyugs kyi khyu chen po mdun du ded 'ong ba dang 'phrad de gdul bya dar zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi legs sgo dang bcas gtsang pho brang du 'jigs med rdo rje'i khri la mnga' gsol/ de'i skabs dge ltas khyad par ba sprul pa'i sku nyid kyi bzhugs khri'i 'og tu me tog mdog sna mi 'dra gsum kun gyi mthong snang du byung zhing ga'an yang bla chen du ma'i gzigs snang du skyes nyid sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam par mthong snang 'dra min sna tshogs kyi tshul kyang ci rigs pa'i lo rgyus dang / gtsang pa gong ma'i yang sprul yin tshul gyi gsungs sgo yang 'ga' re yod/de nas rim pa bzhin du sku skyes nyid la bser pa chos dbyings dang khyi lo ma'i bla ma sogs gyis klog yig kyang legs bslab mdzad rjes de mtshams shig na gtsang pa'i rdo rje slob dpon kun dga' dpal ldan zhabs pas bla mchan gyi mdzad sgo dang bcas sprul sku gzhon pa nyid gtsang sde'i dge skor zon thar shi ba'i gshen chog tu phebs skabs bla ma de nyid kyi byin rlabs dang sku skyes rang gi sngon las zab mo'i byed pas las dang po pa'i dus su mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang chog lho sgo'i skabs su sku skyes dam pa'i thugs nyams su gshen po lu ba dkar po gyon pa'i rnam par gsal bor mthong nus pa'i bar srid gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa mnga' zhing /de dus na~X 2༵tshan snyan kyang yongs la rgyas pa zhig ste de nas mi ring bar gtsang chen phyogs de nyid du rje bla ma

dzwa rje 'chang kun dga' dpal ldan gyi mdun nas sku nyid kyis chos grogs rdo rje'i spun bla ma bstan dar dang /blam mchog 'phel sogs don gnyis mchog mnga' du ma dang lhan cig zab lam sbyor ba yan lag drug gi sngon 'gro nas bzung dngos gzhi yan lag gsum pa srog rtsol yan chad kyi dbang khrid mtha' dag zhus te nyams len mdzad skabs rje bla mas sku skyes khong la mtshan ngag dbang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes gsol/ khong gis dngos gzhi nyams len skabs nang rtogs kyi 'char sgo yang bzang zhing 'khrul 'khor dus mnyam bzhag ngor skog gyur gyi gnas 'ga' zhig ji bzhin mngon shes byung ba sogs gang thad du yon tan gyi cha kun nas 'aṣpel ba'i ngang tshul gyis lo gnyis ring tsam la sbyor drug yan lag gsum yan nyams su blangs pas lam rtags rang rang gi thad du myong ba dus su thon la/ de nas bzung bdag bskyed gtor chog gang 'os rgyun khyer gyi zhal 'don sogs dang bcas mtshams de skor du gtsang pa'i yul lha stong dpon gsol mchod kyi ched sprul sku grwa 'khor bcas phebs dus khong nyid chibs rta la chibs bzhin yob g.yas pa nas 'ja' 'od der gnas kun gyi mthong snang du byung ba yul lha'i dpa' mkhar du gsol mchod ma zin bar zug bzhin gnas shing de nas phyir la phebs te sde 'bangs kyi 'brog sde dag la dkar bsod mdzad skabs 'od zer sngar ltar gyis mi khyim 'ga' la zug pa sogs kyi legs mtshan byung zhing 'di skor zhig la mgo log tu a skyong rje rgan ma dus las 'das pa'i gshen po rjes 'dzin gyi ched du rje rdo rje 'chang gis bla mchan mdzad bzhin sprul sku 'khor bcas phebs dgos byung zhing de lugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ de rjes tsam na sprul pa'i sku nyid mched grogs 'ga' bcas kyis sngar sbyor drug gi mjug yan lag lhag ma rnams ji bzhin nyams len gyi ched gtsang pa'i sgrub grwa gong du lo gcig la rdo rje'i rnal 'byor legs bsgoms mdzad cing de dus mchog sprul nyid la thugs nyams sngar las rgyas shing bla ma dang yi dam gyi zhal gzigs kyi snang ba ci rigs kyang byung la/ spyir na sprul sku 'di nyid kyis yi dam rte/tso bo thugs rje chen po la sku tshe gang bor mdzad nas yi ge drug ma'i gzungs sngags dung phyur du ma zhig snga phyi ci rigs la ljags bzlas kyi sgo nas 'phags pa mchog gi zhal ras lan yang yang mjal zhes grags shing du mtshams shig tu sbrul sku khong gis spros med kyi spyod pas rgya nag glang chen dang lha sa sogs gnos chen du ma la byon nas mjal phyag thugs smon gzab rgyas ji ltar 'tsham pa de yang mdzad/de nas bar skabs shig tu mkhas pa'i dbang phyug thub bstan dge legs rgya mcho gang la chos skyong khyab 'jug chen po'i las tsogs byang gter man ngag 'bod rbad bsad pa'i srog sgrub chog bsgrig gi rtsom bskul kyang sbrul pa'i sku 'di nyid kyis ched gnyer bcas kyi legs par mdzad la/ yang khong nyid kyi bla mchan 'dzong bo skyabs mgon gyis mdzad bzhin mgo log tu a skyong dpon nor dgra gshegs pa'i dgongs chog tu phebs skabs khrus chog gi 'pho ba'i dus su sprul sku 'di nyid skad cig la nam mkhar 'phags te bar snang du mi g.yo skyil mo krung gis bzhugs bzhin 'pho lung chos sku snang mtha' ma tshar gsum gyi ring du der gnas kun gyi mthong snang du ya mtshan che ba'i rtags mtshan de nyid kyis dus 'da' ba byung zhes graga~X2 /dardo/ de

skabs su khong gis dpon 'das pa la phan ji ltar thogs tshul nam zhig rang skad 'don pa sogs kyiyi lugs gang gsung mtha' dag rjes sor de lugs bzhin bros lha zhes pa la lha 'beebs pa'i sgo nas sngon gtsa rnapas gsung mdzadasnyeji bzhin thog tu khel bas yul sde de phyogs su sbrul sku 'di nyid mtshan snyan gyi gragasamimi shin tu che zhing dpon sde kun gyis gzhan su las dbu bla mchog tu gtsug gis gus bkur byed pa yin lami sprul sku 'di nyid kyis gtsang pho brang du lha khang ka ba dgu ma zhig gsos legs par mdzad nas nyid rgyal rogathugs rje chen po'i gnas mjal la phebs skabs de phyogs kyi yul mi zhig shi ba'i gshin chog la byon dusamirdo de bam chen langs la khad du song nas 'jigs zil bzod dka' ba'i gnas su red tshe sprul skus gcod dang bka' bsgo 'pho lung mdzad pas mi rdo de nyid rang zhir song bas der gnas kun ches dad par rtser nas gdul bya dar rgyas che ba byung la de phyogs su yig drug gtso bor gyur pa'i rdo 'bum bcu gsum bsgobazhengs kyi bdag rkyen khong nas legs gnang mdzad pa sogs bstan 'gro la mdzad sgo mi dman pa byamimatshams shig nas khong gis gtsang pho brang gi bdag byed mkhan rnga ba'i se bla byang chub kyi yang sprul du grags pa'i sku skyes des byed du bcug nas sprul sku rang gi sgar 'dzi stod dar lnga'i ri khrod du rgyun bzhugs kyi tshul du bar bar nyid kyis gdul bya phyogs med bskyang bzhin bzhugs skabs su snga phyi ci rigs par yig drug bskos ma'i rdo 'bum du ma yon bcos kyis mdzad sgo dang 'dzam thang du 'khor khang legs mdzes kyi nang du dung 'khor byin ldan zung dang / gyang ris kyi lha tshogs gser tshon gyis mdzes cha rdzogs par bskrun te/ 'og tu rdo bcal dang steng du zab gos sna tshogs kyis mchod tshus byas pa dril snyan gyis sgra mchod rgyun mar gragaspopa can de rjes su dung 'khor las ring bsrel rgyun mar byung ba 'gro kun gyi bsod nams zhing mchog tu thugs bskyed gnang nas bsgrun pa dang bar bar rnams su tsha rong dang mgo log sogs yul phyogs so sor khong grwa 'khor bcas gdul bya yang yang lebs pa dang 'dzi yul 'di phyogs su sgar khag su las mang phyogs la dad mos che zhing khong gis dus su gshen po'i rnam shes kyi 'gro lugs gson po dag la legs nyes ji ltar yong dang bla 'bod kyi snga rtags sogs lkog gyur gyi gnas mang po ji bzhin thugs kyis mkhyen nas de lugs kyi zhal gsung yang yang mdzad pa'i lo rgyus mang / gong 'og ci rigs su 'dzam thang du yul sde phan tshun dme 'khon gyis grol zhes pa'i mi zhig gri ru shi ba la sprul sku 'di nyid kyis gshen chos mdzad skabs ro de nyid la gdon zhugs te chu ser gyis ha cang gang bas bam ros yan lag lnga kun nas bskyod de ro langs kyis 'jigs gzugs cher ngoms pa'i dus su khong gis zab mo gcod kyi dbang sdud stobs dang ldan pas skad cig la zil gyi mnan nas ro'i phung po las chu ser kun nas rdol de dbugs shub pa lta bu'i bajid chung bar gyur nas der gnas phal ba dag la 'jigs skrag gi snang ba legs bsal mdzad/sprul sku gang gis a skyong gong ma'i dpon so/gas dad can 'ga' la bsrung mdud gnang ba gang dag kyang phyag mdud de sems can gang gis lus la yod pa de tshor me mda' kha gtad kyi brgyab kyang cung tsam ma bsnyad pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang khong gis na bza' gzhan la gnang ba dag kyang 'go ba'i yams nad kyis mi — 422 —

tshugs pa sogs kyi byin che zhing / nyin zhig rong phyogs su nyid gdul bya la phebs dus shig tu khong chibs rta laso g.yang sa ches mtho bar tsung yang thugs mnyam bzhag gi ngang du ci dgar bzhugs pa las sku grongs sgyun du ma song bas kun snang ba ha mis pa'i ngo mtshar skyes shing khong grwa 'khor bcas dus lan cig mgo log phyogs su gdul byatha rtson lam dbu rgyan yar gsang la sgar btabs nas bzhugs skabs nag phyogs mi min gyis 'tshe bas gnam lcags phabs kyang nyid sku la gnod pa spu tsam ma byung ba ma zad gnam lcags me zhags jil shugs che ba de nyid sku gzan gyis btums nas bzung ste ci dgar rang dbang gis bkol du byas pa sogs kyi mdzad sgo khyad mtshar can du ma sprul sku 'di nyid kyis yang yang gnang ba'ilo rgyus bshad du yod la/sbyir sbrul sku 'di nyid sngon rigs phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang gis sku na chung byis pa'i dus nas kyang lha mo sku mdog sngo sangs ma zung gis dus dus su thugs 'dod nye bar sgrub cing legs nyes gang byung gi bskul brna bar bar mdzad pa yod cing sbyis khro skyabs thugs rje chen po'i gnas na gang nyid bzhugs skabs sngon gyi dus nas yang yang brtse gzigs mdzad pa'i lha mo gang nyid zhig gis khong la dgung grangs kyi tshe tshad gsal bor lung bstan pa dang / skabs gong 'og ci rigs par nyid gyi thugs snang ngor phyogs gzhan gyi gnas chen rnams dang rang yul phyogs kyi gnas so sor mi ma yin gyi bkod pa sna tshogs kyi tshul dang byams sku gser gyi rdo rje ngo mtshar ba sogs mi las 'das pa'i gter rdzas khyad par can du ma bar bar sgrib med du gzigs shing sprul sku nyid kyis snga phyi ci rigs par 'dzi stod dgon leb tu gtsang pa'i dgon lag 'dzin bdag byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bsko bzhag dang bcas der rdor slob bzhugs gnas kyi mtshams khang gsar bzhengs dang thugs chen gyi lcags zam zhig gsos sogs kyi mdzad sgo gnang la/ sngon gtsang pa'i pho brang 'dzin bdag gtsang pa sku chen gyi rjes nas sprul sku khong nas thugs 'gan re ba tsam gyi ring nye bar mdzad cing de nas se sbrul gdan sar bsko ba'ag gi mtshams nas sprul pa'i sku nyid la gtsang pa sku 'bring zhes pa'i mtshan yongs la grags pa nas bzung da bar mdzad sgo gong smos bzhin gyi ngang sku tshe'i smad tsam na ri khrod dar lnga'i ri brgyud du gtogs pa'i 'dzi chu dang nye ba'i nyin ngos phyogs kyi ri ngor khong nyid kyis gzim spyil 'og ma zhig gsar bsgrun mdzad nas der sku tshe smad du gtso bor rgyun bzhugs kyi gnas mdzad bzhin sngar khong gis a skyong gong ma'i nang du gtsang pa'i bla tshab kyi sgar gzhi'i cha rkyen gsar bsgrig kyang byas shing 'di skor ci rigs su sme ba'i 'brog sde'i phyogs su khong grwa 'khor gdul bya la phebs skabs mi khyim zhig gi byis pa bor nas gar song cha med pa'i dus su gatreng pa 'di nyid kyi thugs snang ngor byis pa de chus khyer ba ji bzhin gzigs pa ma zad de'i sko rgyan chu khar lhag yod tshul tshun gyi thugs la gsal snang byung zhing / yang 'dzi smrad rab kha zhes pa nas mi zhig chus khyer nas ro chur nub nas zhag ring zhig tu ma rnyed skabs gtsang sprul 'di nyid der phebs te khong gis gcod dang 'pho lung mdzad tsam gyis skad cig la mi ro de nyid chu khar thon nas rnyed pas der gnas dag gis yid ngo mtshar dang bcas bstod bsngags sgrog par byed bzhin sngar las dad gus kyang che rab 'phel gyin 'dug— 423 —

sngon gig tu gtsang pa gang 'di nyid 'brog sde'i mi khyim zhig tu gshin chog sogs 'gro phan gang ya rung ba mdzad skabs shig la skyes chen rtogs pa can gzhan 'ga'i thugs snang ngor rgya gar gyi srub chen mchornagi sku'i rnam par bar bar gzigs snang byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod/ gzhan yang khong dpon slob mgo logatu a spyong gong ma'i dpon kar mthu 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs gdan 'dren gyi ched du nye bar phebs gsogs gdul bya phyogs med kyi mdzad pa rgya che zhing dzam ngos bla ma kun dga' ngag gi dbang po'i ma yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su gtsang pa 'di nyid byon nas khong gis der dgongs chog mdzad skabs gshin po'i rna shes bde ba can du skye ba'i mtshan gsal por gzigs pa sogs nyid gshin chog gar rtsebs rnams su tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bzang ngan cir 'gyur gyi lkog gyur dag kyang gzhan dag las mkhyen spya nges par che sru tsam du 'dug cing khong nyid sku tshe snad du phyi tshul ngor thugs dam zhag 'ga' las mi mdzad par rgyun du gdul bya gtso bor skyong ba lta bu zhig yin kyang nang thugs rtogs kyi rim pa ni sgo kun nas mngon par mtho ba la tshegs mi dgos pa'i rigs mthon po zhig yin nam snyam mo/ de nas khong nyid kyis mtshams shig tu gtsang sde'i na mo che'i nye 'dabs su mchod rten bzhengs skabs cha rkyen ci dgos nyid nas thugs 'gan bcas kyis yul phyogs der rdo dkon pa la rdo gter blang ste mchod rten cha tshang gi zhabs phyi legs sgrub kyi bgyi ba zla bral gyi mdzad sgo khyad 'phags gnang zhing gtsang sbrul nyid dgung grangs drug cu re gsum du smrebasposkabs khong gi mdun du a gter dpa' bo chos dgyings rdo rje phebs nas tshe sgrub dbang bka' bcas kyis zhabs brtan legs 'bul gyi sgo nas gter ston mchog gis tshe mda' 'phel bskyed dang mkha' dbyings nas gter sgrom nor bu'i rigs blangs te gtsang pa khong la legs gnang mdzad pa dang snga phyi ci rigs la khong gi sku mdun du gtsang pa'i rdo rje slob dpon a mgon bla ma ngag dbang bstan pa gsal byed dang ngag dbang rdo rje bzang po rnam gnyis sogs skyes chen du ma byon bzhud kyis phan tshun thugs mnyes bka' mol gzab spyas bcas thugs kyi nyams len la 'dri bzhugs dus phyag na rdo rje'i gyang ris sgo phyogs mjug tu yod pa dbu sngas phyogs su thugs 'dun tsam gyis gdan 'dren mdzad ces grags skad/skabs 'gar 'di skor du khong nyid sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen mtshams la'ang bzhugs shing dgung lo re brgyad skor zhig nas gtsang pa khong gi sku mdun du yar thang rgya sprul sku skyabs zhu ba la phebs nas khong nyid kyis de la rkyen sel bsrung rim gang dgos mdzad pa'i re zhig na rkyen des khong la sku bskun thebs nas rang gi bzhugs yul ri khrod 'og ma'i gzims khyil du rgyun bzhugs kyi tshul mdzad de dgung lo re dgu chu mo rta la gleb dus su sku 'khor gyis zhabs brtan la gsung sgrog sgan sgrub ci rigs re byas kyang phan pa ma byung bar khong gi zhal nas/ sku 'khor ba grwa btsun dag la rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i zhal ta sna tshogs kyi bka' 'phros dang / rang dang gtsang pa sgar khog gi bca' lag dbye bsal dang / 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i pho brang gi mgon po sogs chos skyong la snyan dar legs bskur gyis 'dod don gsol ba sogs bgyi ba gang dgos mtha' dag mdzad nas lo de'i dbyar zla'i nang skor tsam na sku gshegs par mdzad de/ de nas — 424 —

shul 'dug sku 'khor gang dag gis dgongs mchod gzab ldan gyis gdung bzhu legs byed dang rjes sor gdung rten dngul gyis byang chub mchod rten bzhengs pa sogs de lugs kyis gtsang sprul 'di'i mdzad pa spub la/ de rjes mi ring bar khong gi yang srid sku skyes su slar byon la mtshan gsol ba se sprul gyi sku tsha ngag dbang 'jigs med rdo rje dang 'dzi rong sku skyes ngag dbang bsod nams dpal ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal gnyis da lta bzhugs bzhin pa 'di ga ltar ro/ /de rjes gtsang pa pho brang gi gdan sa mdzad pa gtsang pa se sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun dga' phun tshogs sam mtshan gzhan sngags 'chang pad ma dbang drag rtsal gyi lo rgyus mdo tsam 'chad pa la 'di'i 'khrungs gnas rnga yul phyogs yin zhing de yang thog mar wa shul rigs la me sprel lor sku 'khrungs pa nas bzung byis pa phal dang mi 'dra ba'i rigs khyad par can rtags mtshan ci rigs dang bcas pa zhig ste sku chung ngu na bskyed de rang mgo thon tsam nyid nas spyir chos la thugs mos che ba khyad par za ba'i se dgon gyi bla grwa yongs la thugs blo lhag par spro ba sogs tshul de 'dra du ma'i rkyen gyis byis pa chung skyes 'di nyid se bla ma byang chub zer ba'i mkhas btsun bzang po'i mnga' bdag cig yod pa de'i yang sprul du grags so/ dgung grangs drug cu re gnyis me mo bya'i lor yan mar tsam las ma bzhugs par snang lo rgyus rgyas pa spyo jo nang chos 'byung bla ba'i sgron me〉 zhes pa shog ldeb (265)la gzigs rogs/ /bzhi ba/ gtsang ba 'gab ma yag mdo'i dgon gyi lorgyus/na mo gu ru pra dzha nd+ra dza na ma tā ra nā tha ya/'phrin las spya mcho sbyin pa rgya mtsho dang / karma bstan nyi 'jigs med phyogs rgyal dang / grub byesdudī ṭākā ṭwāṃsdo/ rgya mtsho sras ral gri/ rgya stod sprul sku da lta sku ngag sogs/ skye phreng rim byon rnams la de la 'dir 'dzam thang sgar khag bzhi zhes pa'i ya gyarṣa/ gtsang pa 'gab ma'i lo rgyus/(1)sku phreng dang bo cha lung ba ngag dbang 'azin las/sprul pa'i sku cha lung ba ngag dbang 'phrin las zhes pa ni rigs gsum mgon po'i gyin gyis rlabs pa dang / sku skyes 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos lta bu'i rnam thar nyung bsdus zhig brjod pa la/ de yang kun mkhyen chen pos/ glo bur du 'byung ba'i sprul pa'i sku gcig gis nga dang 'dra bar nges don gyi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad ces gsungs ba'i lung bstan pa de/ cha lung pa ngag dbang 'azin las yin par grags pas/de yang yul chos zur ru shing pho rta la 'khrungs/ chung dus nas dam pa'i chos la dga' ba spyod pa bzang po ga'an las khyad du 'phags par/ dgung lo bcu drug tu a khu blo gros rnam rgyal gyis rgyal tshab tu rab byung zhus/ thog ma nas cha lung rdo rje brag btsan khong gis sku bdag byas pas skyel bsu sogs byed de/ lo nyi shu'i bar 'dul mdzod dbu phar sogs gzhung lugs la sbyangs bas dka' tsheg med par mkhyen nas rgyal dbang gong sa lnga pa'i drung du rgyug phul/ blo kros rnam spyal gyi drung du dus 'khor bskyed rdzoga~X2 ṭwāṃgag zab

bka' mang po gsan/ sbyor drug bsgoms pas bshad tshed dang methun pa'i nyams rtogs shar/ 'dzam thang gtsang ba 'gab ma bla ma gong ma'i rgyal tshab tu bkod pa gnang yang / yab yum gnyis kyis bshol btab pas phebs par ma 'dzom/ dgung lo nyer bzhi'i bar khu bo'i zhabs phyi mdzad nas rtags brtan du bzhugs/ de nas khu bo gshegs nas dgon yang ming bsgyur ba sogs kyis bzhugs gnas nges med mdzad/ gsang 'dus rgyud shog ring mda' tshad ma ldeb bco brgyad nub gcig tu thugs la bzungs nus/mi lam 'od gsal ngang nas ri bo rtse lngar phebs te 'jam dpal lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs/gzim chung a mi ta ru lo drug rdo rje rnal 'abhor bsgoms phyag drug pas longs spyod kyi 'azin las sgrubs/tshar dgon phunatshogs lhun grub 'dzin bdag lo bzhir mdzad/ 'brog dge dbon po sogs la zab khrid dbang sogs gnang / sngon 'gro chos bdun gyi ngag 'don mdzad/ rig 'dzin chos dbyings rdo rje la byang gter chos skor mang po gsan khong la zab lam jo nang lugs kyi chos mang phul/ me phag lor cha lung rdo rje brag gi gdan sar phebs nas sbyor drug sogs kyi 'dzin grwa btsugs nas 'chad nyan mdzad/ de nas kun spangs dam pa de dbus gtsang kun tu rgyal ba blo bzang rgya mtsho drung du dge lugs skor dang / rmog tsa sprul sku sogs la bka' rgyud kyi dbang dang rjes gnang mang po/ sangs spyas bzang po sogs la sa skya dang 'brug pa'i chos skor mang du gsan/ gzhan ris med kyi skyes bu dam pa du ma la chos zab bka' phar tshur zhu gnang mang po mdzad/ lcags 'brug lor 'bras zhungs dge ldan gnyis su khong gi bstan gzhi btsugs/phun tshogs gling nas mi 'tshams par bya ba la rtags mngon tshan can bstan pas mthu nus che ba'i grags snyan 'byung / dgon gnas mang po chos kyi zab bka' gsung pa'i dgon bdag yun ring mdzad/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs shing lung dang ldan pa byung / de nas chos rjes kun bzang dbang po sogs la sbyor ba yan lag drug gi dbang khrid sogs gnang bas jo nang rang lugs kyi snyan pa grags shing / ye shes phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur kun mkhyen chen po'i skabs ltar byung / phag gi lor gsang stabs su 'dzam thang la phebs chas mdzad kyang yang ma'adzoms pas gser mdog can du beebs nas dus 'khor dbang khrid ga 0ri bas ye shes phebs pa sogs bla ma'i rgyud sde'i byin rlabs/ tshab chen zhugs pas thams cad kyis bla ma grub thob zhes mtshan gsol/ de nas lho 'broms phyogs su phebs/ gsang ri'i kun dga' rin chen rgya mtsho'i gdan sa mdzad/ dga' ldan rtser grub chu bston/ drag shed kyi chos skor gsan/ bsam rtse sogasal dbang khrid gsung skabs phyis su sog yul du byon rgyu'i mi ltas shar/ paṇa chen la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhus/ lha khang zhig gso dang gzhan grwa slob mang po la chos gsungs/ sog po'i gdan 'dren pa rnams 'byor/ rgyal po lha bzang dang pan chen rnam gnyis kyi rang bla ltar bdag rkyen byed dgos par byung bar brten shing pho rta'i lo la sog yul du phebs te lo gcig lhag gi ring la chos bka' zab mos bsrung ba rgya cheb sogs mdzad nas rgyal po 'khor bcas la legs tshogs kyi mdzad sgo spel te yon gyis 'byor ba bzang po dang bcas rang yul dbus gtsang du phebs chas su yu shum du snebs tshe dzijun gar dus zing’’ zhes rab — 426 —

byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya lor jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyis rang sde dmag dpung khrid de lha (1717)sar gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi yang tsha lha bzang han bsad pa dang / tā la'i bla ma drug pa rjes ma ngag dbang ye shes gnas dbyung ba sogs dus 'khrugs khel bas 'bri chu khar lo gcig bzhugs te 'dan chos 'khor yan la chos zab bka' mang du gnang / slar sog yul du lo gcig gi ring dgon sde zhig gsos grwa tshang gsar btsugs sogs bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas mchod yon mnyam du dbus gtsang du phebs/ dgon sde so sor mkhu ja sogs mi sde bcas kun la 'dod chos zab rgyas kyi re ba bskangs/ bkra shis lhun por rtsebs nas sog rgyal 'khor bcas la zla ba gcig lhag la dbang lung man ngag ci rigs gnang / paṇa chen gyi bla ma drung ram pa tshe brtan rdo rje la khong lugs kyi chos sngar ma gsan pa thams cad phul/ der mchod yon so sor phebs/ ting su phun tshogs dge legs 'apel gyi dgon pa btab zin thag nye ring la chos zab bka' zla ba 'gar gsungs rjes phun tshogs gling du phebs grab tu dgongs pa 'da' tshul byas skabs/ slob bu rnams kyis bzhugs zhus gsol ba btab pas ngor sngar ltar sku sangs pa'i sgos zhag gcig bzhugs nas zhal chems lung stan sogs gnang nas/ dgung grangs bdun cu chu yos lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad la dgongs pa rdzogs/ 'di'i slob ma dbon ngag dbang rnam spyal/ kun bzang dbang po/ 'khon chags pa chos 'phel/ 'brog dge chos skyong don spub sogs mang ngo / de ltar grub chen ngag dbang 'azin las ni dbus gtsang jo nang rtag brtan dang cha lung dgon zung gi 'dzin bdag byed mkhan thub chen ngag dbang 'azin las te/ de yang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob dang /sku tsha gnyis ka yin pa mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal gang nyid sku tsha thugs slob gnyis ka yin zhing de 'dra'i rje thub pa'i dbang phyug cha lung ba ni rang re'i nges don sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la bshad sgrub zung gi rgyal mtshan gzhi nas smong bzhin mkhas pa dang thub pa'i go 'phang gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen phul du gyur pa mtshan snyan gyi grags pa beed ljongs yongs dang sog yul sogs sa chen po la khyab rgya nges par che zhing de 'dra'i rje nyid mdo khams smad phyogs 'dir yang chibs kha legs bskyod kyis phebs chas yang yang mdzad kyang bod 'bangs chos sde gang dag gis bshol 'debs nan mos 'di phyogs kyi yul sde dag gis sku dngos kyi 'al bzang nye bar mjal ba'i skal ba re zhig ma yod kyang khong nyid kyi sku tshab ngag dbang rnam rgyal mchog gis khams 'di phyogs su bstan 'gro'i don la ched mngags kyi bka' drin gyi mdzad sgo dang rje grub chen rang nyid gzugs sku chos dbyings su zum pa'i rjes nas yang sprul mchog gis mdo khams dang rgyal mo rong la phan pa'i brtse gzigs rgya che ba nam yang 'dor med kyi ngang nas khong gi sku dngos bzhugs gyi skabs mdzad sgo ji ltar byung tshul 'di'i chos 'byung gzhung du cung rgyas tsam brjod zin no/ /(2)sku zeng gnyis pa ngag dbang 'azin lasasgyu mtsho/rje gang las sku zeng gnyis pa ni/ sprul sku ngag dbang 'azin las rgya mtsho zhes bya ba ste/ de yang thog mar dbus gtsang phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ de dus su sku chung ngu'i dus nas kyang rtags mtshan gang thad — 427 —

nas ches khyad du 'phags pa'i sgo nas rje gtsang pa cha lung ba'i yang sprul 'khrul med kyi grags pa phyogasakun la legs khyab mdzad pas mdo snad khams rgyal mo rong yan chod snyan pa grags shing sku skyes gang nyid kyisan gzhon gyi skabs nas klog yig legs bslab bcas kyis chos grwar zhugs te rje gong bla kun dga' rnam spyalasogs bshes gnyen du ma'i zhal lung las gsung gi bdud rtsi dus su thob cing lung dang rtogs pa gang thad nas sngon song ring phun sum tshogs pa'i mthu shugs nye bar che ba sogs mdzad sgo khyad par du 'phags pa mngon gsal lhang nger gyur pa'i dus skabs na mdo khams rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi sa chen skyong ba'i mi dbang lugs gnyis srid dbang nges par che ba nga shu tsa tshe dbang drag rgyal zhes gnam skos gong ma chen po'i sa chen gyi sgo legs skyong mdzad mkhan gang giso dbus su 'khrungs pa'i gtsang pa cha lung grub chen mchog gi yang sbrul gyi snyan pa gsan bzhin sa dbang nyid kyis dbus gtsang gi cha lung ba'i yang sprul de nyid rang gnas rgyal mo rong phyogs su gdan 'dren gyi bkod 'doms mdzad de dbus gtsang du bsu ma ched mngags kyi sgo nas thabs gang drag bcas kyis sku skyes gang dang nyid kyi slob dpon yongs 'dzin gong bla kun dga' rnal rgyal bcas gdan legs drangs kyi skal ba ldan par brten rje grub chen gyi yang sprul mchog gi chibs kha mdo khams rgyal mo tsha ba rong du bsgyur te sa dbang gang nyid kyi dbu blar legs phebs dang sku bdag kyang mi dbang rang gis mdzad de rgyal sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal phun tshogs rdzong dang de phyogs kyi yul dgon ci rigs par rje gong bla dang gtsang pa cha lung pa'i yang sprul dang bcas lo 'ga' zhig gi ring du bzhugs te khong rnams kyis chu 'pho nor bu gling du dus 'khor dang bde mchog gi blos bslangs sogs bstan 'gro'i don gyi bya ba ngo mtshar ba che rab mdzad pa dang mnyam du 'dzam thang chos rje spyan drangs
