te/ rgyal kha bkra shis gling du dus 'khor mchod rten dgu thog can dang / 'jigs med rnam rgyal phun tshogs rjong du sku gsung thugs rten khyad 'phags can mang po dang gser bris kyi dpe cha mang po mdzad byang dang ldan pa skor zhig pe cin dpe mdzod khang na da lta yod pa dang / lho nub mi rigs slob ga chen mo na'ang rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi gna' rdzas mang po da lta mthong rgyu yod pa lta bu'o/ de nas dus re zhig gi tshe gong bla kun dga' rnam rgyal nyid sku ha cang bgres stabs dgongs pa dbyings su thim par mngon la de rjes shig nas rdzong rgyal nga shu tsa chu yos lo'i dus 'khrugs kyi skabs su yo krung chi dang lhan du btsan la sgo me chab tsha sogs pham myongs bas byas rjes yod na'ang / gong ma lhas skyong drung du zhu log byed rkyen gyis/ jur chen lhas skyong gis thog mar am bhan tshe lang dang ya'o krung chi sogs dpung dang bcas pa phud de phyogs gsum nas rgol ba'i mthar/ (1752)lor tshe dbang rgyal po gong mas chad las kyis sku ma 'tsho stabs gtsang pa chos rje sprul sku drung 'khor bcas yar 'dzam thang du phebs dgos byung ste der yang gtsang pa cha lung ba'i sprul sku gang nyid kyis 'dzam thang gtsang 'gab mas sku phreng gnyis pa 'grin las rnam rgyal gyis gtsos dam pa 'ga' la chos bka' ci rigs pa legs par gsungs shing / de mtshams shig nas cha lung sprul pa'i sku'i gzugs sku'i me tog 'phral du 'thor bar mdzad pas der gnas thugs slob gang dag yid mya ngan gyi khang bur chud pa na dus phyis 'dzi — 428 —

stod 'brim shar ri khrod na bzhugs pa'i lha tshe bla ma rtogs pa'i dbang phyug thugs rdo rje'i mngon shes mchog mnga' ngag dbang spyal mtshan zhabs pa sku na gzhon gyi skabs tsam ste khong gi thugs snang ngor rje sprul sku de nyid kyis khong gser ri la byon rgyu yin pas myur du mjal lo/ gsung ba'i thugs nyams byung ba ltar lha tshe bla ma gang gis thugs slob gang dag la khyed cag gis byu ngan ma byed par gser ri zhes pa'i sa phyogs de rtsar rdotā /ṭwāṃ/ //nga /der sprul sku khong nyid slar 'khrungs nges su 'dug go zhes pa'i bka' lung gsal bo legs (2)skuzing gsum ba ngag dbang sbyin pasku mtsho/de ltar gyi lung bstan dang mthun par sbyis mi ring ba na smra chu'i 'gram dang nye ba la brag gser nya 'dra ba zhig yod pas de la gser ri zhes zer zhing dus phyis su de'i ming zur chag tu gyur nas bse'i ri zhes pa'i ming chags pa de na rigs rus wa shul gyi mi zhig tu gtsang pa cha lung ba'i sku phreng gsum pa sprul sku ngag dbang sbyin pa rgya mtsho zhes bya ba ngo mtshar rtags bcas legs par 'khrungs pa yin la/ de yang sku na chung byis pa'i dus nas nyi zer la gos dang ska rags 'phang na de ka ltar sdod thub pa'i rtags mtshan sogs ches mtshar khyad can zhig te sku chung ngu'i dus su gtsang pa gong ma'i dbon lhun grub rgya mtshos sku bdag byas te rang gnas yag mdo'i sgar du khri 'don dga' ston dang bcas sku skyes gzhon nu khri khar legs 'khod mdzad pa nas rim bzhin klog sogs bslab kyi sgo nas khong nyid chos grwar zhugs skabs dbon lhun grub rgya mtsho gang dang gtsang pa gong ma'i sku phreng gsum pa sogs skyes chen du ma snga phyi ci rigs su sku skyes 'di nyid kyis gus par bla mar legs bkur mdzad nas rang lugs kyi chos bka' dbang lung man ngag zab khrid ci dgos mtha' dag gsan sgom khyad par ba mdzad nas chos srid gang thad nas cha lung sku phreng gsum pa 'di nyid mdzad 'azin rgya nges par che zhing dus bar skabs su gtsang sprul gang nyid kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag ma skyong dpon ngag dbang zhes pas dad gus mchog gis dbu blar bkur nas mchod yon zung 'brel gyis sku tshe gang bor bzhugs nas phyis a skyong mi dbang gang gis rtse ba rgyal po 'bangs sde yongs rdzogs drag po'i g.yul chen gyis dbang bsgyur te thams cad chom la 'beebs skabs kyi klad dbu bla bsrung skyobs pa gcig chog kyang gtsang pa 'di nyid yin pas mdzad 'phrin gyi sgo phyogs su grags snyan rab tu rgyas pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa rgya cher mnga' la/ gtsang pa sprul sku 'di'i sku rigs 'phrin las kyi mdzad sgo rgyas shing de bar zhig tu khong gtsang pa grwa 'khor bcas dbus gtsang du rten gsum khyad 'phags gang dag la mjal phyag mchod 'bul sogs bsags sbyangs khyad par can gyi ched du nye bar phebs su gtsang paṇa chen rin po che dang mjal phrad byung zhing phan tshun thugs mnyes dgyes tshor bcas kyi chos dang mthun pa'i bka' mol yang dag gi skal ba ldan te/ paṇa chen mchog gi zhal nas/ gtsang sprul 'di nyid rgyal ba jo nang pa'i nges don bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu che gsol kyang mdzad/ gtsang pa nyid dbus gtsang du rang re'i chos gzhi'i mnga' bdag tu phebs nges kyi zhal bzhes dang / de mthun paṇa chen khong nas bka' lung gsal po'i thob yig gi skyes — 429 —

bzang 'ja' sa legs gnang gi bka' drin gyi sgo nas gtsang pa 'khor bcas mar rang yul du re zhig log pa'i tshul gyis rang gnas sgar du bzhugs skabs kyang gtsang sprul gang nyid kyis bstan pa'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo yang yag mdor rgyal ba'i thugs rten khyad mtshar ba phyi nang gi bkod pa yongs rdzogs nang bzhug rab gnas dga' ston bcas legs mdzad kyi sgo nas bstan la phan pa'i bya ba byas pa sogs de 'dra'i mdzad pa gzhan yang mang tshod du 'dug kyang ji bzhin gyi khungs ma rnyed/de lta bu'i mdzad pa rlabs po che nye bar khong nas bskyang skabs sngar dbus gtsang du pan chen mdun nas zhal bzhes ji skad mdzad pa bzhin gyi don rjes sor de lugs ltar ma byung la/ gtsang sbol gang sku tshe hril bor mdzad pa mthar phyin par rang gnas su bzhugs dgos byung zhing nyin cig lha bzo bla ma'i mdun du khong phebs nas rang gi yang srid phyi ma khyed gyi thugs slob mdzad dgos tshul zhib rgyas su bka' mol gnang ba'i re zhig gi mthar nyid sku dbyings su thim la nye ba'i dus khong gis sngar gyi dam bca' zhal bzhes ltar ji bzhin ma 'dzoms pas da lan nam zhig smon lam re'i ched 'phral du chibs rta la sga chas byas bzhin khong nyid chibs te dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs shig kyang mdzad nas de mtshams glo bur gzims khang du nyer lhab/ sa/ kyi ngang nas sku bzhugs stangs khyad par ba'i sgo nas dgongs pa chos dbyings su nyer bsdus mdzad (4)sku zeng bzhi bkarma bstan pa'i nyis/de rjes mi ring bar sku greng bzhi pa sku ngag karma bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bya ba khong nyid gtsang gong ma'i lha 'bangs su gtogs pa ta shul gyi mi khyim zhig tu rtags mtshan bcas sku legs 'khrungs mdzad nas de cher na tshod bskyed bsring gi gnas skabs shig nas yi ge slob pa sogs rim pas byas shing skor ci rigs su skyes na phra ba gang gi snyan pa yag mdo'i sgar gyis gsan te sku bdag khri 'don sogs mdzad sgo gang 'os dag sgar de nyid kyi mdzad cing de nas mi ring bar 'dzi nyin phyogs kyi ri khrod bkra shis lha ri'i gnas su lha bzo rdo rje 'chang bzhugs pa'i drung du/ sku skyes 'di nyid kyis rang lugs kyi zab chos rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi chos bka' mtha' dag zhus nas sgom sgrub gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin legs par thugs nyams su lhar len mdzad pas nyams rtogs phul du byung ba thugs la 'khrungs shing de nas rim par gtsang pa sprul sku 'di nyid kyis yag mdo'i sgar 'gab ma sngar sku gong ma gang dag gis ji ltar legs bskyangs mdzad pa'i srol nye bar bzung ste lugs gnyis gang thad la thugs khur bzhes nas lo bstar gyi sku rim sogs mdzad sgo ci dgos thams cad dus su mdzad bzhin bar bar rnams su khong gis mtshams sgrub bsnyen bzlas re yang mi 'chag par byed pa dang khyad par yi dam gtso bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nā~Xsdo /phyug gi sgo nas gsung mchog gzungs sngags kyi rgyal po yi ge drug ma dung phyur du ma zhig ljags bzlas —sprudī ༵ ḍidi nyid kyis bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa lhung bshags kyi sangs rgyas so lnga'i gser sku rgya

nag ma khru gang re yod pa mdzes khyad phul du byung ba'i sku gzugs sum cu so lnga rgya dngul rdo tshad re res blu yon dang bcas gtsang pa rang gi pho brang du gdan drangs mchod khang du bzhugs su gsol ba sogs kyi mdzad sgo gnang zhing / yang nyid kyis gser khang gyi nang gi khyad bkod/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bris thang bcas dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gyi glegs bam yongs rdzogs bzhengs blus ci rigs mdzad cing yar thang dgon du'ang bka' 'gyur yi ge blus nas bzhagakhong nyid kyis lo bstar bzhin 'dus pa mang tshogs pho brang du sbyan drangs nas de dag la bar 'ga' rgyal ba'i bka' chos chen mo dang bar 'ga' bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi gsung bsgrag dus dus su klog 'don zab mos chos zhal phye bar 'jug pa'i bdag rkyen yon 'bul gyi bsod nams legs sgo bgyi ba don dang ldan pa yang yang mdzad pa sogs sku tshe gang bor chos srid zung du 'brel ba'i spyod khyad bzang rab kyis dus 'da' ba'i sgo nas mdzad pa legs mthar phyin pa la nye skabs shig na nyin cig khong gi zhal nas/ da rjes sor rang gi skye srid cig slar 'ong skabs mi khyim dbul bo zhig gi khyim du skye ba blang rgyu yin tshul dang /gzhan yang zhal chems sna tshogs pa re mdzad kyis bzhugs shing de mtshams sku bskung bzhes pa'i skabs zhabs brtan rim gro ci rigs dang bcas re zhig na de 'phral du nyid sku glo bur gzims nas thugs dgongs dbyings su 'pho tshad pa na nye gnas kyis bzhengs bskul drag pos slar sangs pa'i tshul mdzad pa'i re zhig gi dus kyi tshe sku gshegs pa'i mdzad sgo khong nas nye bar gnang ste shul 'dug gang dag gis thugs dam dgongs bkrol gshegs mchod byed skabs su nyin cig gtsang pa gong ma'i lha sde las mi khyim dge skor tshang zhes pa dbul bor yod pa zhig gi chung ma gtsang 'gab ma'i sku gdung la mjal phyag gi ched 'ong ba la sku gdung de nyid las 'od zer zhig lam gyis byung / chung ma bud med de nyid la thim song ba'i snang ba mi mo rang la byung zhes grags so/ /(5)skuzingasnga ba ngag dbang 'jigasamedaphyogasalas rnamasgyul/de nas mi ring bar sku zeng lnga pa ngag dbang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes pa de nyid dge skor gyi khyim de'i chung ma la mngal chags te ma'i rmus la rim pas nar son skabs dud tshang de'i khyim thab tu gyur pa des 'phral du thang zhig la gnad logs pa dkar yol rtags baspyad bris skug bcas legs par rnyed pa'i legs mtshan dang bcas zla zhag rdzogs tshe chung ma de'i bu chung 'brug lo'i dgun gyi dus bltams pa'i skabs grod pu lta bu'i nang du yod cing mkha' la 'ja' zer gyi snang ba dang char bab pa sogs kyi dge ltas kyang byung zhing / de nas bu chung de chos skyong khyab 'jug gis sku bdag yang yang byed pa dang bar skabs shig tu nam mkha' nas dar dkar 'ig lhung nas mi khyim de'i mda' dar ngos su bskon pa sogs legs mtshan ci rigs pa re mngon par byung ba'i sgo nas bu chung sku cha/ bskyed de gtsang sgar 'gab mas sku bdag bcas klog yig ji bzhin bslab rjes 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i pho brang du sdo rje slob dpo na ngag dbang bstan pa gsal byed dang / ngag dbang rdo rje bzang po zung gi mdun dwa sku skyes de nyigal ngag rjong 4dī/garji med

phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan gsol ba nas bzung rim pas rang sgar gtsang 'gab ma'i mnga' thade sku skyes gang gis ji bzhin bdag bzung mdzad nas las shugs rlung rta mdzad 'phrin yang che rab tsam dar bzhin da lta'i bar bzhugs pa 'di ka ltar ro/ /gzhan yang gtsang pa 'gab ma'i sgar du bar bar rnams su dbon rig rtsal gyi sku skyes rgya sprul dang /bla dpon 'ga' re sogs mdzad sgo skyong mkhan ci rigs byung zhing / sgar 'di la bar skabs su sngon byusda gu ru'i rje 'bangs kyi grabs tshan grub dbang dran pa nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa gtsang pa'i sku skyes gnas yul rta shul zer bar sku mtshan rtags khyad par ba dang bcas legs 'khrungs gyi sgo nas gtsang sgar 'gab mas sku bdag che 'don sogs dang bcas rim pas chos la gsan sgom khyad par bas spub rtags dus dus su ston par mdzad nus pa'i sku skyes grub rigs mchog cig tu gyur te nyin cig sprul sku khong gis ral shang sogs lcags 'ga' re bal thag ltar phyag mdud mdzad pas mtshan la'ang lcags mdud du grags shing de 'dra'i mchog sprul gang nyid rim pas gsang ba gsum gyi mdzad pa rgya je cher song gshis dus skabs shig nas khong gis sku rten thub dbang gi zab thang chen mo dang / thugs rten bdud 'dul mchod rten/ gsung rten bka' dang bstan bcos bod gangs ri'i ljongs su 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam yongs su rdzogs pa dngos rdzas 'byor pa kya nom pa'i yon thang chen po'i sgo nas legs blus byas te gtsang pa 'gab ma'i pho brang du spyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol ba sogs kyi mdzad sgo che rab ngang nas sku tshe'i mdzad pa mthar phyin to/de nas gtsang pa lcags mdud de'i sku phreng gnyis pa ni rgyal mo rong gi (rgyal gtsos) zhes par sku 'khrungs te de la ngo mtshar bas rtags bcas kyis gtsang ba lcags mdud kyi yang sprul du grags nas gtsang sgar 'gab mas de lugs kyi sku bdag mdzad bzhin gtsang sgar de nyid du gdan 'dren gyi skabs nam mkha' nas rnga dang rol mo'i sgra snyan pa der gnas gang dag gi rna lam du mthun snang mngon gsal du gyur pa sogs rtags mtshan che rab tu grags shing / de nas sku skyes de nyid bstan pa'i chos sgor legs zhugs kyi sgo nas nyid kyis dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i rgyan du lhur len gyis rang lugs kyi zab chos gsan sgom cher mdzad cing sku'i spyod pa rjes sor tsam nas ha cang mi mdzes kyang rtogs mthon brtul zhugs mchog gi mdzad 'chang gang gis bar bar ga'an la me mda' sogs mtshon gyis bgegs bsal mdzad pas gzhan de dag gnod 'gal che ba las legs skyobs kyi mthu nye bar mnga' ba sogs mdzad tshul khyad 'phags de 'dra'i ngang nas khong nyid bzhugs shing / spyir gtsang lcags mdud sprul sku 'di nyid yongs kyi ngor lcags mdud yang sprul du de ltar grags kyang don la rdo bla'i dngos slob sku phyogs mkhyen sprul gyi skul sras ral gri'i yang srid du nges pas na da lta'i lcags mdud sku sprul zhes pa de spub pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ya mtshan ngo mtshar bar bar rnams su gzhan ngor mthong chos su nye bar ston nus pa'i 'gro 'dul dus su babs pa'i zla bral 'ig khongadzee da ༵kā morji kyang phyi ngor tsam na spyod tshul gtsang dag cig gi rnam pa ma yin gshis gzhan dag gis

bstod smad kyi gnas sna tshogs su ci rigs par gyur na'ang khong nyid ji ltar yang thugs kyis lkog gyur du ma ji bzhin gzigs pa dang / sku lus kyis bar bar mtshar khyad nye bar ston pa legs pa'i mdzad sgo gang thad nas ches 'phags shing khong gis sku rten tshe lha rnam gsum gyi gser sku khru gang ba re re gsung rten glegs bam ci rigs thugs rten mchod rten chung ba re sogs bsod nams zhing gi bsags sgor yang yod pa ste nyid kyi sku tshe tha ma'i mdzad pa la gnas skabs su khong sku mi g.yo skyil mo krung gis bzhugs bzhin zhal nas phaṭa sgra dang bcas dgongs pa dbyings su thim par mdzad de thugs 'od gsal mchog gi ngang du g.yo ba med par thugs dam la nyin zhag 'ga' zhig tu bzhugs mthar thugs dam de las grol tshe sku gdung las sgra chen po zhig byung ba de phyogs kyi yul mi kun gyi rna bar go nus pa lta bu'i ngang nas rje khong nyid lcang lo can gyi zhing du phebs zhes grags skad/de rjes su lcags mdud sku phreng gsum pa dus phyis su rnga yul rgya stod tshang la 'khrungs nas gtsang ba sku ngag phyi mas sku bdag che 'don re yang mdzad de sku skyes gzhon dus su chos grwar zhugs pa sogs kyis rim pas legs skyong la phyogs khul bgyis kyang dus dbang ris de mtshams nas phyi tshul tsam la bstan 'gro'i don ji ba'in 'grub pa ma byung ba deng dus su dngos gsal de ka ltar lags/ de dag gis 'dzam thang gtsang pa gong 'gab bcas kyi gdan rabs sogs mdzad sgo legs skyong gi bla sprul bstan pa'i rtsa lag rags bsdus tsam gyi lo rgyus sa bon gyi char gyur pa re legs par song zin to/ /lngab/ zayul gyi sedagon pa'ilorgyus/sngon dbus gtsang rtag brtan dgon du rje btsun tā ra nā tha sku dngos bzhugs pa'i dus dang gang gi dngos slob spyal tshab kun dga' rin cheno rgya mtsho'i dus kyi rim par mdo khams smad rnga yul phyogs su chos nges don sgrub brgyud bstan pa ji ltar rim pas dar tshul chos 'byung dkyus su byung ba bzhin las 'dir gal che ba 'ga' zhig cung gsal tsam brjod par bya ba ste/ de yang rnga yul du rang re'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dgon sde thog ma rim pas byung ba ni se dgon dang 'brog dge dgon gnyis te chos sde chags tshul gyi go rim ni/ deng dus kyi se dgon las 'brog dge dgon pa snga shos yin kyang sngon thog mar se 'brog gi rang re'i chos grwa ba jo nang du byon pa rnams las snga ba ni se dbon lhun grub sogs dang / de nas rim pas 'phyi tsam na 'brog dge kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyang de lugs bzhin gyis jo nang du phebs pa yin pas khams phyogs nas jo nang dpal du rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku dus man nas chos zhu rim phebs kyi tshul las brtsams te 'dir chos 'byung gzhung las cung rgyas su brjod par bya ba yin la/ de yang rnga yul gyi se sang gi gnas tshul thog mar sngon gyi dus su rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub pa mchog gi gnas su legs par son pa zhi sgom chen po 'khrul zhig grags pa zhes bya ba gang nyid yar 'brog mtsho mo'i gnas na mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i rnam 'byor la legs bzhugs mdzad skabs shig tu nyin zhig rje rnal 'byor chen po grub thob mchog gi thugs snang ngor ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' lung las/ khong mdo khams rma gnyan /sdus su song

dang 'gro don legs nges 'byung ngo / zhes pa'i lung bstan byung bar brten rje grub thob de nyid khamaspophyogs su phebs te rma rgyal sbom ra dang shar gnyan po g.yu rtse zung gi gnas rnams su rim pas bzhugs nasporjes khong gis de dag tu gdul bya dang ldan pa gang dag rjes su bzung ste sgom btab pas rang rang gis nyams su blangs nas gnas lugs sems kyi gshis ji bzhin rjen char du ngo 'phrod de rnam par rtog pa rdzun ris kyi 'khrul pa kun nas zhig par gyur thub pa'i sgom pa zhig chen bco brgyad tsam the grub thob mchog gi thugs slob tu 'dus shing de skabs shig tu smra se le thang phyogs nas se 'bum skyabs rgyal zhes pa'i mi zhig shar gnyan g.yu rtse phyogs su 'ong bas shar gnyan gyi gnas der pha bong bon mo'i gug tu rje sgom chen grub pa'i dbang phyug nyid bzhugs pa dang mjal bas se 'bum skyabs kyis de la dad gus snying thag pa nas skyes te sgom phog pa'i thabs zhus pa na rje grub thob de nyid kyis skad cig de la se 'bum nyid rjes su bzung ste sgom btab pa ltar lo bcur 'bad brtson gyis bsgoms pas kho la rig ngo lhag ger 'phrod de rtog pa nying 'khrul tu song zhing grub rtags la mnga' brnyes te se 'bum skyabs rgyal sgom pa zhig chen du gyur nas khong gnas nges med rnams su rgyu bzhin spyod pa ri dwags rnams la khal bka' bzhin gsa' g.yi rgyang gu rnams res mos su zhon pa byas te nyin gcig la se le thang bskor nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul grub thob khong gis der gnas gzhan dag gi mthong chos mthun snang du legs par bstan pas de kun yid ha las shing se 'bum sgom chen la sngar gyi ming 'gyur te se tshang zhig so g.yung drung 'bum rgyal du grags skad/de nas se tshang zhig so khong la'ang sgom chen pa'i thugs slob mang tsam 'dus shing de 'dra'i se g.yung drung 'bum gyi gdung rgyud phyis rim par byung ba las gdung rabs 'ga' zhig song mtshams su se grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba byung ste de dbus gtsang du song nas dam pa chos kyi sgor legs zhugs mdzad de rang don spub zin skabs phyir rang yul du phebs nas mtshams ring chos rje bya ba'i bla dpon zhig yod pa la phyag rten phul te mgo 'dren zhus nas se grags rgyal rang gis rnga stod srib phyogs bo dong zhes par chos lde dgon btab ste der rgyun bzhugs kyi ngang nas khong gis dgon der sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ de nas de dang gdung rigs gcig pa'i se 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes chen zhig kyang byung / de rjes su sku skyes kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes pa sde snod la sbyangs pa can bslab gsum mchog mnga' ba gang de byung zhing / de nas se dbon lhun grub spyal mtshan zhes bya ba byung ste de rang re'i ma dgon jo nang rtag brtan du rje btsun tā ra nā tha sku dngos bzhugs kyi drung du song nas rje btsun rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ se dpon de dbon de nyid kyis zab mo chos kyi bka' sa skya'i lam 'bras chen po'i zab dbang cha tshang dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi chos skor yongs rdzogs bcas legs par gsan zhing zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan rtsom bskul kyang mdzad nas rang re'i mdo khams phyogs su jo nang nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa lung rigs rgya mtsho dpon slob gdan 'dren legs mdzad dang bcas pa'i sgo nas rang yul du phyir 'ong bar chas tshe rje btsun mchog gi bka' lung las/ mdo smad — 434 —

khams phyogs su nges don gyi chos gzhi'i dgon pa 'debs yul gyi gnas ji bzhin gsal por lung bstan pa ltar se dbon lhun kub 'khor bcas rang gnas su slar lebs nas sngon bee ro tsa na rgyal mo tsha ba rong du phebs skabs rdzu 'phrul gyis zhabs bcags pa'i sa gnas rnga dbus gur nang du se dbon lhun glub rang gis nges don gyi chos gzhi'i dgon sde gsar btab byas te der khong gis zab mo nges don gyi chos bka' gdul bya legs bskyangs bcas se dbon dang dme the nyi don grub cis pa'i mi dpon gnyis phan tshun chos kyi 'azel ba'i mchod yon gyis bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'byor ldan bsod nams bsags pa can du lo 'ga'i ring la mdzad/skabs shig tu lcags ge rgyal po zhes pas se dbon rang gi chos sde la gnod 'tshe byas rkyen slar khong nyid jo nang rtag brtan du phebs te/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas/ chos skyong gur mgon khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i gdams ngag yi ger bkod pa khro bcu'i rten thang bcas gnang sbyin gyi skal ba dus su thon nas slar rang yul log ste khong gi gdams ngag de dag la brten nas skabs de'i bstan dgra dngos gnas chom la phabs shing de'i bdun brgyud tshun gtan nas brlag par mdzad do/ /de nas de dag gi gdung rabs ci rigs las byung ba se snying po rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yin zhing / de las cung 'phyi tsam na se dbon 'phrin las snying po rgyal mtshan bya ba byung zhing / de yang jo nang du song ste rje btsun chen po sku mi bzhugs kyang mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal gyi drung nas nyid kyis rang lugs chos bka' ci dgos thams cad zhus nas rang yul du log ste bstan 'gro la phan pa nye bar byas shing / de nas lo 'gar song rjes tsam na sngon gyi gong ma dag gi gdung rabs ci rigs las byung ba se lha dbang rgyal mtshan dang / 'azin las rgya mtsho gnyis ste de gnyis kyis kyang gtsang pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal 'dzam thang chos rje'i go rgyal gyis gdan drangs pa'i rjes tsam na gtsang pa de nyid kyi drung du rang re'i chos bka' gang dgos dag legs par zhus nas rang gnas rnga yul la se lha dbang rgyal mtshan de nyid se nyin phyogs su bzhugs nas de'i brgyud 'dzin la se kun dga' chos 'byor dang / dbon po ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gnyis rim pas byung ba las sbyi ma dbon de nyid la rang dang gducho rus gcig pa'i bse khri rgan gyi gnod sbyin bgyi bka' yis nyer gtad byas pa nas bzung se sang brgyud 'dzin gang dag gi lha de'i rten thang sgrub gzhi bcas bsrung mar legs bsten mdzad pa yin la/ de rjes shig nas rim par byon pa se bong dge sbrul pa'i sku dang /se dpal rdor sprul sku/ se dge bshes byang chub chos dar/ se sprul sku ngag dbang bstan pa/ se mchog sgrul yon tan lhun grub kyi bar dag gis nges don sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa sgo kun nas legs bskyangs mdzad la/ sngon se 'phrin rgyam de nyid se srib phyogs su bzhugs te khong gi sku ring tsam nas mthar nyid kyis gzhi'i sgar kha'i cha rkyen mtha' dag 'dzi yul yag mdo'i gtsang pa 'gab ma'i bdag bzung mkhan kun bzang 'azin las kyi sku dbon lhun grub rgya mtsho'i phyag tu legs gtad mdzad nas de phan chad du se phyogs la chos gzhi dang brgyud 'dzin gang yang ma byung ngo / / — 435 ge

spyir gong smos ltar se bla rabs dang me'u dpon rabs gnyis bstan 'dzin dang sbyin bdag gi 'brel che 'ing tshul de lugs kyis se me'u mchod yon du gyur ngos nas 'di skor de mtshams kyi the'u rgyal lcags thar 'bum bka' blon mo ba phun tshogs bcas dang a skyong bde sgrol sogs lhan rgyas nas bka' mol zhal mthun gyis rnga yul dgon sde se nyin sribs/ mkhar sog po/ rtsi yag bcas kyi grwa sde thams cad phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i chos gzhi dgon pa zhig gsar 'debs kyi gros 'cham byung ba nas bzung 'brog dge kun dga' yon tan rgya mtsho gtsor bzhugs kyi 'dus pa mang po rgyal blon bcas kyi bka' mthun sgo nas chos gzhi de lugs gsar 'debs kyi don thad 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon kun dga' ngag dbang dpal ldan zhabs pa 'jigs med rdo rje'i khri la zhabs sen nye bar 'god pa'i skabs su lung bstan zhu ba'i pho nya mngag mir btang bas rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi thugs brtag gi bka' lung gsal pos/ dgon de 'dra gsar 'debs byas na gnas skabs dang mthar thug bzang nges kyi 'gyur med lung bstan legs par byung ba'i gnang sgo dus su nye bar mdzad cing / de dang mthun par sngon byon gter chen gsang bdag ye shes mgon po'i thugs dag snang ngor dgon gzhi'i gnas de nyid du chos kyi 'khor lo chen po g.yon du 'khor ba gzigs pas de lugs bzhin ma 'ongs pa na gnas der ma rgyud sgrub pa'i sde bzhugs gnas kyi chos gzhi nges par chags tshul gyi gter lung yang khong nas stsal ba ltar phyis byon rig 'dzin rnam snang rdo rjes kyang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs legs sgrub kyi dgon gnas su tshul de gar bsngags pa'i tshig gi me tog mngon par 'thor ba dang / gzhan yang rdo bla'i dngos slob rig 'dzin 'jigs med rgyal mchog dbyings zhes bya ba'i gter lung las kyang dgon pa'i sa gnas 'di zhig tu rgyud sde'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub mchod che ba mdzad pa'i gnas su legs par 'gyur tshul gyi rdo rje'i lung zab mo nges par byung ba dang / bde phu chos rje byams pa dkon mchog bzang pos gnas de ma 'ongs par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gnas su red tshul sogs kyi sngon byon dam pa'i skyes chen gang dag gi bka' lung yang yang dus su byung ba ste/ dge ltas kyi mtshan ma yang dgon 'di ma chags pa'i sngon gyi lo 'ga' nas dbyar 'bring gi dus su me tog so sor khyad mtshar can rtsa ba gcig gi ngos nas gyes pa'i me tog 'dab ma bdun brgya lhag tsam gyi ze'u 'bru rab tu rgyas pa zhig dang / ze'u 'bru de tsam ma rgyas kyang 'dab ma lhag par rgyas pa zhig dang / cung zad kha 'bus pa tsam gyi me tog ste rigs mi gcig pa'i me tog gsum sdong bu gcig las 'khrungs pa lo dus bzhin bar skabs la byung ba'i legs mtshan dang bcas rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang tshan lcags pho 'brug gi gnam lo shar ba na rje dpal ldan bla ma kun dga' yon tan rgya mtsho khong nyid lesas phebs kyi sgo nas lo de'i hor zla dgupa'i nyin gza' skar sbyor byed phun tshogs kyi dus su rje bla ma de nyid kyis sa 'dul sbyangs bzung lto 'phye brtag pa sogs mdzad nas zhal gsung las kyang / spyir rang cag gi yul 'di rnga'i dbyibs su yod phyir rnga khog ces pa'i ming chags shing yul de'i dbus tsam na rang re'i dgon gnas 'di yod cing sa phyogs gang 'di la rgya nag lugs kyi bsrung bzhi dang gtsug lag rnams nas bshad —— 436 ge

pa'i gdan gsum gyi mtshan nyid sogs khyir gyi phyi'i legs mtshan dang khyad par gnas gzhi gru gsum chos 'byung e yig gi rnam pa dang gtsug lag khang 'di nyid de dbus su waṃ yig bde ba chen po mtshen byed kyi nang gi dge legs kyi mtshan ma nye bar tshang zhing / yang sgos su bde mchog rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa ltar gyi sman smongs chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag tu yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor nyer sgrub mchod pa'i gnas su 'os tshul dang mthun par zhib rgyas kyi bka' phebs kyang gnang ba sogs mdzad sgo rgya che ba dang bcas gnas gzhi de nyid du dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug lag khang legs bzhengs kyi dbu tshugs pa nas bzung rim pas lo du ma zhig gi ring chos gzhi'i dgon sde nye bar 'phel nges nas lo skor phyi ma chu 'brug gi lo tsam na dpal mgon drakkad ye shes kyi chos skyong mchog gi sgrub pa'i mgon khang gsar bzhengs kyi nang du dpal rig 'dzin rnam snang rdo rje gang nyid kyis rten thos rtag gtor btsugs te gtor sgrub rgyun gsol gyi sgo nas rim par lo ngo nyer lnga tsam song skabs pha rol 'gas phod gtsug 'gran zla byed pa la mgon khang der 'dus pa mang tsam gyis rbad bskul zhag nyer gcig tsam byas pas sgrub gnas kyi nang rnams su khrag gi thigs pa kun nas 'babs pa dngos gsal du byung ba sogs kyi nang rtags dang / cher ma 'gyangs par da dgra bdo ba dngos su chom pa'i phyi rtags kyi grags snyan kyang che rab byung la/ de 'dra'i nges don gyi chos gzhi'i dgon pa thub bstan phyogs las rnam rgyal gling zhes bya ba gang 'dir yang bde mchog lha khang du zab lam sbyor ba yan lag drug gi sgrub grwa tshugs shing yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshes bcu la rgyun srol bcas dang / dgon de'i mang tshogs kyis bar bar rnams la/ dus 'khor dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ mi 'khrugs pa rnams la rdul tshon gyi steng nas sgrub mchod byed pa lo bstar bzhin dang / gzhi gsum cho ga rgyun tshogs rnams dang / nang gses khang tshan bzhi la/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog 'jigs byed/ dus 'khor sdom chen bcas kyi rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgos mchod re yang lo dus bzhin 'chag med kyi srol sogs mdzad sgo de 'dra'i tshul gyis dgon der dus mthun gyi bstan rtsa rim par byung zhing chos tshogs sgrub sde bcas kyang rgyun ldan dar rgyas kyi ngang nas da bar ji bzhin nges par byudwa ba de ka ltar ro/ /drug pa/ yul gyi 'brogadagedagonapa'i lorghas/thog ma'i slob dpon 'brog dge kun dga' dpal bzang ste/ de yang sa sbrul la sku 'khrungs shing /de cher skyes kyi skabs pha mas khyim thab dang sbyar kyang bu chung gang des de ltar byed 'dod med par dbus gtsang phyogs su chos kyi ched du gcig pur bros nas dge lugs kyi chos sde 'bras spungs dang / dpal ldan sa skya'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gtso bor gyur pa thub bstan gser mdog can gnyis su rim pas song ste gzhon pa bu chung des chos grwar legs zhugs kyi sgo nas mtshan nyid phyogs kyi gzhung lugs la sbyang brtson khyad par ba mdzad pas ring por ma thogs par gzhung don thugs su chud cing / de nas nyid rgya bal phyogs su phebs nas khong gis bal yul mchod rten chen mo la mjal phyag dang gser gyi me tog mang po'i mchod 'bul dang / 'phags pa shing kun dang mchod rten go ma sa la garnyo rnams la'ang me tog tresbra ka mang po mngon — 437 —

par gtor ba sogs kyi bsags sgo rlabs po che'i smon tshig kyang nyid kyis rtsom par mdzad/de nas jo nang rtag brtan du rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho sku dngos bzhugs kyi drung du khong nyid phyin te rje rgyal tshab de nyid khong gis dad gus rgya che bas bla ma mchog tu bkur bzhin dam pa gang gi zhal snga nas/sdom gsum rim par nod cing gzhan dbang lung man ngag gi sgo mang po 'ig legs gsan dang / khyad par theg mchog dbu ma rnam nges sogs gzhan stong gi rnam par bshad pa du ma la gsan sbyang lhur len nye bar mdzad nas khong nyid kyis jo nang de nyid du rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan la 'grel bshad cig kyang brtsams te rje rgyal tshab mchog nyid kyis 'grel bshad de la gzigs rtog gis zhib tig kyang gnang / dam pa 'brog dge ba 'dis jo nang du dam pa de nyid kyi drung nas/ dus 'khor dang 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs la gsan sgom myongs rtags thon nges re dang / gur mgon sogs man ngag las tshogs ches mang yang gsan la/ de nas bdud rtsi phug tu rje btsun rin po che'i nye gnas rje grags pa dpal bzang gi mdun du/ 'brog dge ba 'dis chos bka' du ma dang / gnod sbyin bgyi'i rjes gnang sogs zhus shing / de bzhin du jo nang du blo gros rnam rgyal dang / rje btsun kun dga' 'azin las dbang mo gnyis la rim pas 'brog dge ba de nyid kyis zab chos gdams ngag ci dgos legs gsan gyi sgo nas rje btsun mas 'brog dge ba'i rang yul du chos gzhi 'debs gnas kyi lung bstan gsal po dang / dzo nang rgyal tshab kyis dad rten gnang sbyin dang bcas 'brog dge ba khong nyid rang gnas su phebs te chos gzhi dgon pa de lugs bzhin khong gis btab nas nges don bstan pa rje ltar bskyang tshul chos 'byung gzhung du brjod zin ltar las rje dam pa 'brog dge ba khong la sangs rgyas byang sems mang po dang khyad par rgyal ba tshe 'dzin dbang po'i 'al gzigs kyis da lan sku tshe'i tshad dang phyi mar skye 'gyur ji ltar gyi tshul sogs bslu med lung bstan dus su byung la/ khong nyid kyis chos skyong gur mgon dang gnod sbyin bgyi lcam sring ji 'dod kyis bran du bkol zhing / rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i nges don gzhan stong gi lta spub 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes chen mchog mdo khams sgad phyogs 'dir mdzad pa rlabs che bas nges pa don gyi bstan pa ches nye bar dar rgyas su byed pa ste khong nyid me bya'i lor dgongs grangs re brgyad du lo de'i dpyid zla ra ba'i nang la zhi bar gzims nas sku gshegs so/ /rje gang de'i thugs slob/ sku dbon chos skyong don grub/ dbon yon tan lhan grub la sogs pa'i sku tsha grags chen rnams dang / a dpa' 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ mkhar bla kun dga' dar rgyas/sog po bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs skyes chen bstan pa'i rtsa lag mang po nye bar bhon pa las 'dir smos rags bsdus kyi lo rgyus sa bon tsam brjod na/ rje 'brog dge mchog gi gdan sa legs skyong gi sku dbon chos skyong don grub ces bya ba'ang thog mar 'brog dge gang nyid kyi gdung rigs su sku 'khrungs/ de cher son skabs khu bo 'brog dge khong nyid kyi drung du dbang lung khrid sogs chos bka' mang tsam zhig sku tsha gzhon nus legs gsan gyis chos sgor zhugs pa nas bzung rim pas skabs shig tu sku tsha de nyid jo nang rtag — 438 —

brtan du rje cha lung ba spub chen ngag dbang 'phrin las bzhugs pa'i drung du song nas nyid kyis dus 'khor dbang chen dang / zab lam skyor drug gi man ngag khrid bshad sogs chos bka' mang po zhus te rang yul sogs su khong gi sgom pa nyams len gyi dus su bla ma dang yi dam lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing khyad par rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa la/ nyid kyis gur mgon khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen sgrub la brten nas ma hā ka la dung phyur bdun dang rtsa sngags bye ba ljags bzlas su mdzad cing / bgyi lcam sring las la 'khol ba zhig ste/ 'dis 'brog dge'i gdan sa bzung nas don gnyis rlabs chen gyi spyod sgo rgya cher mdzad bzhin pa'i skabs su rje dam pa gang 'di nyid tsha kho'i rdzong gi mnga' bdag sa skyong chos kyi sbyin bdag che ba nga shul stsa tshe dbang drag rgyal gyi dbu blar phebs dgos byung nas der khong dpon slob ring tsam bzhugs te nyid kyi bstan 'gro la nyer phan che ba mdzad cing rjes su rdzi 'gag phun /ṭwāṃtrī sbyadā rā nyi/ da/ du dag 'ing gzigs skabs 'ja' 'od ngo mtshar can sogs kyi rtags mtshan legs pa de rjes su'ang gdan rabs rim byung gang dag 'brog dge'i sku rigs su 'khrungs pa phal cher ste/de'i mtshams nas mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal nye bar mnga' ba 'brog dge grags pa bsam 'grub bya ba byung ste khong sdung doṭwāṃ gnyis ṭwāṃchog la spyopy-i baṭwāṃn pa gang des 'brog dge'i gdan sa reb tsam bskyangs nas bstan ༵ṭwāṃbye // ༵ sna /sna byeṭwāṃ /ṭwāṃ// na / /de nas sku dbon kun dga' lhun spub ces bya ba 'brog dge'i dbon rigs su sku 'khrungs nas dam pa du ma'i mdun du nyid kyis chos bka' mang tsam gsan sgom bcas kyis don gnyis gang thad la mdzad rgya che tsam byung zhing khyad par 'dra nang ri khrod du gtsang pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi dngos slob skyes chen dam pa mkhas btsun bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'i drung du/ 'brog dge lhun grub pa byon nas je de nyid kyi drung nas 'brog dge ba rang gis so thar rab byung dge tshul sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa ji bzhin legs mnos mdzad pa sogs dam pa ches mang gi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i sgo nas chos la gsan sbyang che rab byas shing / de mtshams shig nas 'brog dge lhun grub gang nyid rnga yul lcags rtsi mda' gnyis kyi ser sde gang dag gis dgon bdag tu mnga' gsol ba nas bzung rje 'brog dge 'di nyid kyis rtsi nang gi dgon bdag nye bar mdzad la gzhi der chos sde'i dgon pa gsar 'debs khye sgo nas cho ga sogs rang lugs bzhin gyi srol dang nges don gyi bstan pa la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bya ba rgya cher byas shing khong gi thugs slob yang gtsang pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal sogs don gnyis mdzad rlabs can du ma zhig kyang byung la/ bar skabs shig na a skyong dmag zor mgon po'i 'bangs sder gtogs pa chos skor rab brtan zhes pas gong ma'i bsko bzhag gi lha steng mkhan po'i rgyu nor sogs la jag chom byas pas rgya kyang lā'i sa sgo nas dmag dpung chen 'khrugs te stobs shed kyis a skyong dpon (khang gsar dpon dmag ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃgo/ po)

btsan bzung byas nas khyer song ba lam bar du dpon de nyid shi ba'i skabs de thad du kyang lā nas dpon gyi spur chos skor la sprad pa sogs don dag 'di 'thub thabs byas na go sa thob dbang khyad par ba gnang sbyin chog tshul gyi bka' yig rje dbon lhun grub pa la bskur gnang gi skabs su dbon khong nyid dang gtsang pa 'azin las rnam rgyal sogs kyis kyang lās sgos stu don de lugs bzhin thugs khur legs bzhes mdzad pas rje sku dbon nyid ha cang sku ngo che bar gyur te lugs gnyis gang thad la dbang cha sngar las che rtags su kyang lās sgo nas bka' rtags bka' yig bcas kyi 'ja' sa bzang po'i lung yang gnang 'ing 'brog dge sku dbon gang nyid la rgyal rong phyogs kyi dgon sde bdun dang grwa pa brgya phrag brgyad kyi khri 'dzin mchog tu sgo kun nas bstan pa yongs gtad mdzad/ de 'dra'i mdzad pa rlabs chen gyis khong legs bzhugs kyi dus skabs sku tshe smad tsam na dge lugs gsar ma ba'i chos brgyud 'dzin mkhan rgyal rong chu chen lha steng mkhan swā/zang ṭwāṃ dī ṭwāṃsdo /dro ṭwāṃḍi ṭwāṃ/sa/ lugs la gnod pa ma byung bar/ de yang 'brog dge gang nyid kyis mdzad yang bar 'ga' zhig tu nyid kyis gnam lcags dgon du gnod sbyin bgyi lcam sring gi srog gtad mdzad pas chos skyong 'khor ba'i rtags mtshan dngos su byung zhing nyid kyi thugs sras grags can a skyong bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / gos lha kun dga' chos dbyings sogs du ma zhig yod/ rje 'di nyid dbang ṭwāṃsdo /kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog cig yin nges nas nyid kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin rje 'brog dge ba 'di nyid kyi yang sprul smra rong phyogs kyi sa bar du 'khrungs pa a la sprul sku 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug ces bya ba byung zhing de nyid kyi gdul bya de phyogs su re zhig rdzogs rjes su/ de'i yang srid mgo log yo stag tu 'khrungasapa ni sprul sku 'jigs med chos kyi 'byung gnas te 'dis bstan 'gro la legs phan dus su byung bas khong nyid bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu rnam par nges pa'o/ /'brog dge kun dga' yon tan rgya mtsho/de nas rje btsun lha dbang grags pa'i sprul pa 'brog dge yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ yo stag sprul sku de nyid kyi sku tshar gyur pa'i sgo nas de phyogs su sa stag gi lor sku legs 'tshongs kyi rnam pa ste/ de yang sku na chung ba'i dus thugs rgya che zhing klog slob sogs ya rabs dam pa'i kun spyod la nye bar gnas bzhin de mtshams shig tu mkhar bla bstan pa chos 'phel gyi drung nas/ dam pa sku na gzhon pa des rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang dbang lung zab khrid mang du zhus shing de nas rim par skabs ci rigs su gos lha kun dga' chos dbyings kyi mdun du dam pa 'dis chos bka' lung khrid du ma dang / rig gnas dkyil 'khor bri thig nyi zla'i go la rnams gsan bslab ci rigs mdzad pa dang / sku dbon 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i drung nas/ jo nang rje btsun gyi bka' 'bum las byung ba'i sgrub thabs rin 'byung cha tshang gi dbang bka' rnamahūṃ datwe 4/0 dbon phun tshogs kyi zhal nas kyang lung khrid du ma zhig legs gsan mdzad do/ /

de mtshams shig nas rje 'jam mgon bla ma kun dga' snying po'i sprul par grags pa a mchog rin po che dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i sgrul sku mchog gi drung du/ dam pa 'brog dge 'di nyid legs phebs kyi sgo nas mchog sprul de nyid kyi mdun nas/ khong gis dbang lung mang po zhig legs par gsan skabs rje a mchog nyid la zhu ba sul ched/ nged rang tsho'i me tog lha babs kyi bstan pa'i chos skal dpal jo nang pa'i nges don bstan pa 'di nyid sngon chad dar rgyad ji ltar byung tshul/ da lta bstan 'dzin gyi sde nyung zhing grub mtha' la gzhan gyi gnod byed mang ba sogs sgo gang nas nyams ches dma' ba 'di la rje khyed nas thugs dgongs nyer 'jog gis rang lugs kyi chos 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thabs la bka' drin chung mi nyan tshul zhib rgyas su thugs yus chen po'i ngang nas snyan zhu legs par phul ba'i tshe/ rje a mchog gi zhal snga nas/ rang gis yang de lugs kyi sems khur bcas da lan jo nang lugs 'di nub la khad du 'dug mod 'on kyang deng skabs su rdo smad phyogs nas si tu yab sras kyi slob brgyud karma 'od gsal 'gyur med ces bya ba dpal srung phyogs nas byon te bzhugs yod pas bla ma dam pa khong nyid la rje tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung legs par bzhugs ngos nas da lan kho bo der song nas dbang lung mtha' dag gi rgyun blangs te khyed la legs bskur gyi skal ba byung tshe khyed rang gis jo nang chen po'i bstan pa la 'phel bskyed cher 'ong nges su 'dug nam zhig 'tshogs chos sgrub mchod kyi sde tshugs na rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gdangs dbyangs kho bo'i phyag len 'di khyed cag tshos slob dang yo ga rang lugs yin phyir gsar rnying gi dbye ba med/ bla med rgyud sde rnams dpal spung dus 'khor 'don lta 'di jo nang rang lugs nges par yin tshul sogs zhal bkod ches mang gi bka' phebs bcas thugs dgyes kyis rang re'i bstan pa la nyer phan gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher legs gnang gi sgo nas a mchog khong nyid rdo rmad du phebs pa ma 'dzoms kyang khong gi dod spub dbang bde mchog rdo rje lebs nas karma 'od gsal ba'i mdun nas rje btsun ta ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum cha tshang gi dbang lung khrid gsum gang dgos mtha' dag zhus skabs 'dzam thang gtsang pa dge slong dang / bla ma klu sgrub pa/ ngag dbang nor bzang sogs bla grwa ches mang lhan spyas su 'dzoms shing / 'di skor a mchog khong dang 'brog dge yon tan rgya mtsho dpon slob bcas kyis rgyal nong tsha kho bkra shis sgang gi dgon par byon pa'i bla ma dmawa rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i drung nas jo nang rje btsun rin po che'i gsung 'bum las byung ba'i gshen rje'i gshed rab 'byams kyi zab dbang rnams dang 'jigs byed sgrub chen lugs kyi zab khrid lag len sogs chos bka' mang po zhig legs gsan mdzad/de rjes mi ring ba na spub dbang bde mchog pa nyid kyis a mchog rin po ches rje btsun gyi bka' 'bum las chos bka' ci rigs pa legs 'bul spub rjes tsam na a mchog khong nyid byang bla brang dgon du beebs skabs shig la dgung grangs zhe lnga'i steng nas 'phral du gzugs sku chos dbyings su nyer thim byas rkyen sngar gyi thugs bzhed dang mdzad sgo ji bzhin 'thub pa'i skal ba ma byung stabs rje bla ma dam pa 'brog dge yon tan rgya mtsho gang gis rang re'i bstan pa la thugs bskyed rgya che bas 'dzam thang nas gtsang pa dge slong — 441 —

ngag dbang chos 'phel nyid thugasasras ngag dbang nor bzang dang chos kyi 'phags pa sogs dpon sgob mang trem zhig gdan 'dren mdzad de 'brog dge dgon dpal tshes kha bsam 'aspub gling du dpon slob lhan rgyas kyi ngang nas gtsang pa dge slong gi mdun nas bla ma dam pa yon tan rgya mtshe 'khor dang bcas kyis rjes btsun bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung mtha' dag gsan zhing khyad par sbyor ba yan lag drug gi zab khrid man ngag gi rim pa bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin gsan sgom khyad par ba mdzad la/ thugs sras bla ma nor bzang zhabs pa'i drung nas kyang de lhag gi dbang lung phran bu re re dang / shangs chos skor gyi dbang lung zab khrid mtha' dag legs gsan gyi sgo nas nyams bzhes lhur len gyis grub 'bras dus susmin nges byas te snga phyi lo du ma'i ring myong rtags rang lugs kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par ba'i g.yo thob gom pa mthar phyin pa'i ngang nas stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i rang gshis gsal stong 'dzin pa bral bar mjal tshabs che ba sogs nyams myong thun mong ma yin pa thugs nyams su legs 'khrungs kyis sgom pa mchog gi klong du gyur to/ /de nas re zhig gi tshe sngon 'brog dge kun dga' lhun grub nas bzung bla rabs lnga drug tsam byung bar mngon la rtsi nang dgon gyi zhal bdag mdzad mkhan gong smos ltar de dag gis rang tshod re yang byas pa yin pas 'dir yang de lugs ltar gyis rje bla ma 'brog dge yon tan rgya mtsho khong nyid la lcags rtsi mda' gnyis kyi mi dpon dag gis rtsi nang dgon zhal bdag gi mgo 'dren legs mdzad dgos tshul gyi zhu ba nan cher phul ngos nas rje bla ma gang nyid kyis thugs bskyed de ltar legs bzhes mchog gi ngang nas rtsi nang dgon du 'dus sde'i 'tshogs khang gsar bzhengs kyi nang du rgyud sde de nyid lnga pa'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgrub mchod dang / de nas rim bzhin dus 'khor dang / thams cad rig pa'i sgrub mchod rdul tshon can/ lo bstar gyi cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo sogs dus mchod du ma'i 'tshogs grwa legs 'dzugs mdzad cing /yang dag 'grig khrims kyi bca' yig legs bkod kyi sgo nas dgon pa de'i ming la dpal mi 'gyur nges don bde chen gling zhes btags nas der rang lugs nges don gyi chos grwa ring du bskyangs te bstan 'gro la phan pa rlabs chen kyang mdzad/de lta bu'i mdzad pa mchog gis dus 'da' bzhin rje bla ma nyid ring zhig tu bzhugs pa'i mod khong dgung lo nga gnyis chu sprel gyi lor rang gnas 'brog dge dgon khong gis kun spyod dag ther mdzad de dgon de'i bla grwa mchog dman thams cad 'dul khrims yang dag gis kun nas mdzes par byas shing / chu nyin du ma nyes thar mo dgon gsar 'debs kyi sgo nas dgon de la bkra shis phun tshogs gling zhes btags la/'di skor ci rigs par tshes mda' a dpa' dgon yang dag ther gyis bla grwa yongs la kun spyod gtsang nges byas te rim bzhin khong nyid kyis gong smos ltar se dgon pa'i chos gzhi gsar 'debs kyi dbu nye bar 'dzugs par mdzad ngos nas rang re'i bstan pa la sgo kun tu phan pa rgya cher yun ring po zhig la legs par mdzahūṃ rje~X sdu~X kyis dgung lo bdun bcu don gsum lcags stag lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas re

zhig phyogs 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs tshul mdzad do/ /rje gang gi thugs sras bu chen mchog gyur ni dpal rig 'dzin rnam snang rdo rje ste sngon rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul par grags pa a mchog rin po che dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid nyid du slar byon gyi mdzad sgo legs par gnang ba ni rig 'dzin rnam snang ba 'di nyid du grags shing / de yang— khong nyid sku chung ba'i dus nas jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal gzigs kyi snang bas yang yang jes su bzung ba dang / lha chen legs ldan drasprud kyis mdzad 'phrin dus su nye bar skub cing nges don rang lugs ga'an stong dbu ma'i lta grub kyi dgongs don dgyis gyin pa rim pas thugs su 'khrungs nas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i nyams myong gi klong nye bar rdol te khong nyid kyis rje rgyal ba gnyis pa jo nang pa chen po'i nges don rdzogs ldan chos mchog zab mo mdo sngags kyi gnas lugs mthar thug gi de nyid du lung dang rigs pas gzhan dag la rtsal thon mdzad bzhin rgyal bstan mdo dang sngags kyi gsang lam thugs nyams su byang chub ste gzhan don de lugs bzhin nye bar spyod pa'i rang re'i nges don gyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag che ba snyigs ma'i dus su 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes chen mchog tu gor ma chag par gyur te bshogs chung dge bshes kyis khong gi zhabs la gtugs pas jo nang dol chung ba zhes bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor ba'o/'brog dge yon tan rgya mtshe'i sku dbon 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'ang don gnyis mchog grub pa'i mkhas shing spub brnyes kyi skyes chen dam pa rang re'i chos bka' dbang lung gi brgyud 'dzin che ba khong gi zhal snga nas kyang / 'dus pa du ma la kun mkhyen dol po'i bka' pod drug gi bklag lung dang / rje btsun gyi bka' 'bum las byung ba'i sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi dbang bka' cha tshang sogs dang rang re'i chos bka' mang tsam legs spel mdzad/dbang nā rshasna ༵ju kā /la/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes pa rig pa'i gnas kun thugs su chud pa'i mkhas pa'i de'i rjes su byung ba'i 'brog sprul kun dga' 'gyur med chos kyi dbang phyug ni rje yon tan rgya mtsho yab sras kyi brgyud 'dzin che ba rang lugs bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa klong du gyur cing / de'i rjes su 'di nyid sde dge dpal spungs su phebs nas 'jam mgon kong sbrul dang mkhan bkra shis 'od zer sogs kyi mdun du/'brog sprul 'dis rje btsun bka' 'bum 'thor bu dang / grol mchog khrid brgya'i rgyab chos gdams ngag mdzod ces pa sgrub brgyud shing rta baspyad kyi skor dang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rgyab chos sgrub thabs kun btus sogs zab bka' ches mang zhus shing / de bzhin gzhan dag la legs spel gyi mdzad sgo nye bar mi //nā ṭī / kā kā sdorsha kārdoṅgi ma/chog mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa nas bzung da bar sprul dbon sngon gyi 'brog dge'i thog ma rje kun dga' dpal bzang gi sku dbon yon tan lhun grub ces bya ba'ang sku chung ngu'i dus nas 'brog dge gong ma sogs dam pa mang po'i zhabs rdul nyid kyis spra bo~X4 ༵na thagazhin

chos bka' rgya cher gsan sgom gyis rang don legs gub zin rjes nas gzhan phan gyi mdzad sgo yang khong gis 'dzam thang gtsang pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur rgyas pa stsal cing khong nyid sku tshe smad du rgyal rong tsha kho'i rdzi 'gag rgyal po tshe dbang drag rgyal gyis bla mar bkur zhing / nang so kun dga' bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi sku dbon 'di nyid lhar yag dgon gyi khri par bsko bzhag mdzad pa dang / 'di mdzad pa rgya che stabs mchog rtse'i rgyal pos 'brog dge'i dbon gang nyid la bka' yig gis thob dbang legs par gnang bas che bkur rgya cher mdzad pa sogs rje 'brog dge nyid lugs zung gi mdzad rgya nges par che zhing 'azin las kyi rlabs phyogs su khyab pa'i mtshan snyan can zhig ste gang nyid sku tshe smad du sngar gyi 'brog dge dgon pa la gzims khang gong 'og gnyis yod pa las gong mar rgyun bzhugs lta bur mdzad pa nas bzung 'brog dge gong ma zhes pa'i ming chags/ de nas rim par 'brog dge gong du gdan rabs kyang chos bka' dbang lung gi brgyud 'dzin 'brog dge kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rin chen/ dkon mchog yon tan rgya mtsho sogs dang / dbon dkon mchog blo gros/ dkon mchog chos bzang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab kyi bar rnams byung la/ 'di phyogs kyi sde dgon yang srib dgon bar dgon nyin dgon gsum yod pas snga ma srib dgon ni shar mtsho nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan zhig byung ba des gsar 'debs byas pa nas bzung dgon der brgyud 'dzin gyi bla rabs gsar dbon nam mkha' spya mtsho/ gsar dbon yon tan rgya mtsho/ gsar dbon bsam gtan rdo rje/a sdom mkhyen rabs ye shes kyi bar rnams rim pas byung zhing / bar dgon ri khrod kyi rnam pa zhig ste/de yang zhang chen zhi sgang rgya mtsho/ chu chos grags dbang phyug sogs skyes chen du ma rim bzhin du bzhugs la/ phyi ma nyin dgon du jo nang rgyal tshab kyi dngos slob mkhas spub gnyis ldan gyi khyi gu rab 'byams nas bzung bla rabs kyi brgyud pa rim pas byung ste dbon 'jigs med phun tshogs kyi bar du rgyun ma chad pa'o/ /yang 'brog dge thog ma'i slob dpon gang nyid kyi dngos slob 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin bzang bo ni/ sku na gzhon skabs 'brog dge chos rje nyid yun ring po tsam la khong gis bla mar bsten nas chos bka' mang po gsan sgom mdzad pa dang / khyad par 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo rnams dang de dag gi dgongs 'grel byams chos sogs nges don gzhan stong gi chos skor la sbyang ba che rab kyis rtsal thon mdzad pas 'di nyid rang lugs thun min gyi lta grub 'dzin pa la ches mkhas gnas khyad par ba legs par thob cing de mtshams ci rigs nas dam pa 'di nyid jo nang du phebs te khong gis/ grags pa dpal bzang gi dngos slob kun dga' rin chen gyi drung du/ gcod skor cha tshang dang / rje cha lung grub chen sku dngos bzhugs kyi zhal snga nas/ rang re'i chos bka' dbang lung khrid gsum ches mang po gsan la/ de nas nyid sa skyar phebs te sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' bsod nams bzhugs pa'i drung du/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin pa rang gis dbang lung mang po'i chos bka' legs thob kyi sgo nas sngags 'chang mchog gis 'brog dge'i dbon nyid la che ba'i bsngags brjod kyi bka' shog dus su gnang ba sogs rang don gyi rnam par thar — 444 —

pa rgya che zhing khong nyid sku tshe snad du rgyal rong tsha kho'i rdzi 'gag rgyal po tshe dbang drag rgyal gyis dbu blar bkur nas nyid kyis nang so bla chen snying po snang mdzad la zab bka' rgya cher stsal bas mtshon che dgu dpon du ma'i gtsug nor du gyur pa dang / khong gis chos sde bsam gtan gling gsar btab byas nas dgon der rdzogs ldan chos mchog gi 'chad nyan rgya cher btsugs shing de nas nyid sog yul du rgya nag ye shes rdo rje'am sog khal khal rje btsun dam pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la mjal bar phebs lam ri bo rtse lngar snebs trem na gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'jam dbyangs kyi dgongs chen dang ro mnyam du bzhugs pa'i mod gang gi sku dbon blo gros bzang po zhes ba de nyid rim pas sog yul du song nas ye shes rdo rje dang mjal phrad kyi skal ba dus su thob cing rje gang gis sku dbon nyid la chos gos snam sbyar zhig gnang ste bka' lung gis dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod mdzad pa ltar tsha kho rgyal po tshe dbang drag rgyal gyi dbu blar mdzad bzhin lo 'ga' zhig gi ring du rnam rgyal phun tshogs rdzong gi rgyal khab der bstan 'gro'i don la bzhugs rjes su'ang de'i sku dbon kun dga' bkra shis sogs bla brgyud mang po zhig kyang rim par byon no/ /yang 'brog dge slob dpon thog ma'i dngos slob mkhar bla ma kun dga' dar rgyas ni/ rje 'brog dge gong ma yab sras kyi thugs slob tu gyur te lung rtogs mchog gi yon tan mnga' ba'i skyes chen zhig ste nyid gyis gzhan gdul bya gang dag la rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs dbang lung gi chos bka' mang po 'char spel mdzad cing / dus skabs shig tu phyugs tshang stod 'dus pa rgya mtsho zer ba'i mi zhig gis sbyin bdag mdzad de rje de nyid kyis bshad sgrub rtag brtan gling bya ba'i chos sde che ba mdzad pa sogs byas rjes mi nyung ba yod la/'di'i gdan rabs pa yang sprul sku ngag dbang 'phrin las sogs sprul dbon du ma dang / khyad par 'di'i bla rabs su byung ba mkhar bla kun dga' bstan pa chos 'phel zer ba yang gling sgom chen bstan pa snying po dang / bya yur kun dga' chos 'byor zung gi thugs zin gyi slob bu mchog cig tu gyur te kun dga' chos 'byor bas thugs slob bstan pa chos 'phel nyid la rdol dril gyi gnang sbyin bcas gsang chen theg pa gzhan la ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu mnga' gsol kyang mdzad/ tshul de lta bu'i gzhan rjes bzung gi dus na'ang bar skabs shig tu mkhar bla bstan pa chos 'phel gang nyid kyis a mchog sprul sku dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor dbang dang skyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid gnang skabs mkhar bla rdo rje 'chang nyid a mchog sprul sku'i thugs dag snang ngor dus zhabs 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos su mthong nas brjod skabs su'ang dang po'i sangs rgyas dus zhabs pa chen po/ zhes thugs slob sprul sku mchog gis bsngags pa'i che brjod bcas thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog nyid du sgo kun nas gus 'dud 'bul ba dang /mkhar bla gang nyid tsha rong gi rgya khab 'jigs med rnam rgyal phun tshogs rdzong du phebs skabs khong gis sde dge ka thog pa dge rtse pagyi ta tshe dbang mchog grub la dus 'khor dbang bskur mdzad skabs su bla ma nyid dge rtse ba'i thugs snang du dus kyi 'khor lo dngos su gzigs shing / bla ma de nyid gos lha kun dga' chos dbyings kyi dag snang ngor rigs ldan pad ma dkar po'i rnam par mjal bas rje mkhar bla khong nyid la gos — 445 —

lha mkhas pa'i dbang pos rnam dag rtsis gzhung rtsom par legs bskul gyi zhu ba nan du phul zhing / rje mkhar bla 'di nyid 'brog dge yon tan rgya mtsho gang nyid kyis kyang rigs bdag gtsug gi rgyan gcig pur sgo thams cad nas legs bkur mdzad pa sogs rje bla ma gang nyid kyi zhabs rdul skyes chen mang pos spyi gtsug dad pa'i mdzes rgyan du nye bar 'god pa'i yongs kyi 'dren pa chen po zhig go/ /'di dag gi brgyud pa las sbrul dbon ci rigs da lta'i bar byung chog la/ yang 'brog dge'i slob dpon chen po thog ma gang dag gi thugs sras su gyur pa sog po bkra shis spya mtsho ste de yang thog mar sog rigs su 'khrungs shing de nas rim par 'brog dge chos rje mchog dang mjal te gsung gi gdams pa thugs slob gzhon pas ji bzhin nod nas nyams len gyis nang rtogs yon tan mchog gi glong rdol ba lta bur red song zhing / de nas re zhig gi tshe sku bsod rgyas shing mdzad 'azin gyi sgo nges par yangs pa'i dbu tshugs te rnga yul gyi bu nang smad du khong gis chos gzhi'i dgon sde smin grol gling zhes pa chags 'debs mdzad rjes sudagon gnas der 'dus sde'i gtsug lag khang dang nang rten byams chen sogs rten gsum mang po bzhengs shing / nya ras ser sde 'dus pa mang tsam rgyun 'tshogs bcas khong nyid kyis bar skabs su 'dus sde ches mang la rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur rgyas pa sogs chos bka' yang mang po bka' drin kyang mdzad/dgon der rje nyid kyis sa ga zla ba'i dus mchod sogs bar bar rnams su dus kyi mchod tshogs du ma legs 'dzugs kyi mdzad sgo gnang zhing / de sogs bstan 'gro'i don la byas rjes mi dman pa'i rang re'i bltan / /mcho/ ga gyur cig nges par byon pa nas bzung de'i rjes 'jug kyang 'ga' re dus phyis su yod par mngon de lta bu'i 'brog dge'i slob dpon thog ma gang gi gdung rigs dang slob brgyud du skyes chen mang po byon zhing gong du smos pa bzhin 'brog dge'i sku dbon kun dga' lhun grub pa'i ring nas bzung de phan bla rabs du ma'i bar rtsi nang dgon bdag tu nges pas rjes sor gyi skabs rnams su 'brog dge'i sku rigs dang slob brgyud du gtogs pa dag gis nge lugs bzhin gyis rtsi nang dgon 'di la zhal bdag gi thugs 'gan legs bzhes mdzad nges nas dgon 'di nyid kyi sgrub phug gi gnas su sngon chad 'dzam thang gtsang pa'i sku dbon lhun spub rgya mtsho'i thugs sras su gyur pa gcod pa kun dga' bstan gsal zhes bya ba phyag phebs nas sgrub phug der zab mo'i rnal 'abhor sgom bzhin bzhugs pa'i dus su gcod pa khong nyid kyi sgrub phug tu ma cig gi sku brnyan byin ldan legs bzhengs mdzad cing / de rjes su gcod pa de nyid kyi dngos slob grong mang bla ma ngag dbang 'jigs med ces bya ba sgrub gnas der bzhugs pa ni khong nyid kyis yi dam sbyan ras gzigs dang ma cig lab sgron gyi dngos zhal dag snang du mjal bas nyid ji bzhin rjes su bzung ba dang /bka' bsrung khyab 'jug chen po dang dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po khong gis ci dgar bran du bkol nus pa'i mthu nye bar mnga' la/ de nas rim pa bzhin rtogs pa dang mthu nus mnga' ba'i sgom chen pa rag bla ngag dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / stong tsha bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan sogs rnal 'byor mchog mnga' skyes — 446 —

chen mang dag cig legs bzhugs kyi sgrub gnas su nges par gyur phyir deng skabs ma cig gi sgrub phug ces pa'i tha snyad yongs grags su song ba 'di ka ltar te de 'dra'i gnas dang nye ba'i dgon sde chos gzhi ni rtsi nang dgon dpal mi 'gyur nges don bde chen gling zhes bya ba de yin zhing / dgon der sngon byon 'brog dge'i gdung slob gang dag gis 'dzin bdag gyi dang 'brog dge yon tan rgya mtsho nyid bka' drin lhag par che zhing rje khong nyid kyis dgon der mchog dman thams cad la kun spyod gtsang dag gi bca' khrims bsgrig yig legs brtsams kyi sgo nas yul dpon zung gis de lugs bzhin gyis bka' phebs legs sgrub gus 'dud bla med byas/ lam lugs gang thad du dgon de la zhabs 'degs khyad par bas chos khrid dang sgrub mchod rgyun 'dzugs rten gsum legs bzhengs sogs phun chogs legs byas kyi dpal kun nas rgyas bzhin rje bla ma mchog gang nyid kyis bar bar rnams su dgon gnas der mi ra bshogs chung dge bshes tshul khrims dbyangs can dang / a lags rnam snang rdo rje 'am grong mang dkon mchog chos bzang sogs bla grwa phal mo che la chos 'khor rgya chen legs bskor gyi mdzad bzang sogs sgo gang thad nas rje gang nyid kyi sku dus su dgon pa chos sde rab la 'gal rkyen kun bral lta bur gyur nges nas bde bar bzhugs kyi de rjes sku dbon thub bstan rgya mtsho'i ring rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags yos lor gnam bskos gong ma khang shes nyid dgung grangs bcu bdun bzhes skabs su rnga yul bsu stod pa dang byang bla brang ma mthun pa'i rkyen gyis bla brang de phyogs kyi 'go blon dpa' sher dang 'gyang gnyer sogs mi drag 'gas gting bskul gyi sgo nas dmag dpung che ba'i 'khrugs pa rnga yul du lhags nas zla 'gar dmag sgar btab nas 'jigs zing cher bskul ba dang bla brang gi sku tshab tshul khrims nag thos zhi 'jags su ma btang bar bstan la gnag sems can zhig gis rang re'i bstan dgon la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i chom po jag nyul lta bu'i bstan dgra'i bya ba 'dzem med byas te rtsi nang dgon pa la me brgyab cing bstan bdag sku dbon 'khor bcas mang tsam dmar gsod du btang zhing dbon dkon mchog blo gros sogs bla grwa 'ga' gson bzung byas pa sogs mi 'os pa'i bya ba ngan spyod byas kyang khag phan tshun bar gyi 'khon pa bsdum pa la re 'dun dang bcas lo 'ga' las ma 'gyangs par shing rta'i lo tsam na khag 'khon sel thabs kyi gzu bzhag pa klad rgya rigs yā zi dang / kyang lā gnyis kyi gtsor bod rigs gling sprul 'jigs med blo gros spya mtsho dang / a skyong dge bshes bla brang phyogs kyi sprul dbon mi drag du ma bcas lhan 'dzoms kyi gyod 'khon legs bsal mdzad nas phan tshun khag gi gyod gtsang dras legs mdzad kyi sgo nas rgya stod rdo ring la 'khon bsdum chod yig gsal po bskos nas de rjes su rtsi nang dgon de nyid sngar chag gor song ba rnams sngar bzhin bla grwa khyis slar yang gsar bzhengs mdzad nas dgon der bla ma ngag dbang don grub pas sgrub grwa ji bzhin du 'brog dge'i yang sprul mchog gi bka' drin las sgom grwa sogs mthar rgyas kyi skal ba byung nas de rim bzhin da lta'i bar du chos sde legs rgyas kyi 'phel kha yar ngos zla ba'i dpal la 'gran par gyur pa 'di ka bzhin no/ /— 447 —

le'u nyi shu ba/ dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' byung tshul/༄7ོ/ /ston pa tshad ma rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ / bstan pa tshad ma dge ldan grub mtha'i srol/ /bstan 'dzin tshad ma rnams kyis rgyas mdzad pa'i/ / lo rgyus tshad ma mdo tsam gleng bar bya/ /dang po/ dam pa'i chos la thos bsam mdzad nas mnga' brnyes pa'i tshul/dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' byung tshul ni/ de yang dge lugs pa'am dga' ldan pa zhes pa ni gdan sa'i ming gis btags pa ste/ rje rin po ches 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas sku tshe'i smad du der stan chags par bzhugs pa la brten nas/ rje'i ring lugs la chos rje dga' ldan pa'i lugs zhes 'bod pa byung / de tshig sna bsdus nas brjod pa'i tshe dga' lugs pa zhes zer ba ma bde bas/dge lugs pa zhes 'bod pa rgyun chags pa yin no/ /rje'i ring lugs la dga' ldan lugs zhes pa'i mtshan byung ba'ang bka' gdams gligs bam las lung bstan pa yin te/ pha chos kyi le'u nyer drug pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ tha mar bstan pa'i me ro dag / grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ / du ma'i phan bde sgrub par gyed/ / de yang gnas mchog dam pa yin/ / zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis pas rje'i mtshan zur dang / gnas mchog dam pa ni dga' ldan pa zhes gnas ming gis chos lugs la khyab pa bstan no/ / zhes rang re'i dam pa 'ga' zhig gi gsung ngo / /de ltar dge lugs pa'am zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i lugs zhes grags pa 'di nyid kyi byung ba mdo tsam zhig 'chad na 'di la bzhi/ bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba tsong kha pa 'jig rten du byon tshul dang /de'i ring lugs dri ma med pa bstan 'dzin rnams kyis rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul dang / lugs mchog de nyid gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul dang / zhar byung du lugs 'di la gzhan gyis log par 'khu bas glags ma brnyed pa'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /(1)rje ngakha ba chen po 'jigasten du phyon pa'i tshul/rje bla ma'i rnam thar dam pa so sos mdzad pa ches mang bas zhib tu shes par 'dod pa dag gis de rnams blta bar bya la/ 'dir ni rnam thar gyi gtso bo 'ga' tsam zhig bsnyad par bya ste/ 'di la gnyis/rang nyid gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul dang / rgyu des bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po la'ang gnyis te/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma sdom pa'i tshul khrims bzhes pa'i tshul dang / lung rtogs kyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa'i tshul dngos so/ /wadatwe ༵ ༵na tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma sdom pa'i tshul khrims bzhes pa'i tshul/ rang cag gi 'dren pa

dam pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rje btsun bla ma blo bzang grags pa'i dpal de nyid/ sngon rgyal sras stobs chen por gyur pa na rgyal ba'i dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar ma dag pa'i zhing du lus srokho la mi lta bar rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang rgyas par byed pa'i dam bca' mdzad pa dang / slar yang bdag cag gi ston pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su bram ze'u khye'ur gyur tshe ston pa la shel dkar gyi phreng ba phul te thugs bskyed cing smon lam btab pas mtshon/ sngon ring mo zhig nas lan gcig ma yin par rgyal ba du ma'i spyan sngar rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam rlabs po che yang dang yang du mdzad pa'i mthu yongs su smin par gyur pa na/ rab byung drug pa'i gser 'phyang zhes pa me bya (spyi lo 1357)lor shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du yab klu 'bum dge dang yum shing bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du bsam bzhin du skye ba 'dzin par mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo gsum par sha ba ri rdzong du karma rol pa'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol/ dgung lo bdun pa chu yos (spyi lo 1363)lor bya khyung du chos rje don grub rin chen gyi drung du rab tu byung ste mtshan blo bzang grangs pa zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu drug thog chos rje don grub rin chen gyis bskul cing bdag nyid kyang spro shugs drag po bablog tu med pa bskyed nas dbus su phebs par brtsams/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa chu glang (spyi lo 1373)lor dbus gtsang dag pa'i rdzongs su byon/ de nas rim pas bring gung dpal gyi nags khrod/gsang phu bde ba can/ myang stod/ zhwa lu/ snar thang / sa skya/ bo dong phyogs su slob gnyer gyi don du byon/ dgung lo nyer bzhi pa lcags bya (spyi lo 1381)lor yar klung tshogs chen mkhan po tshul khrims rin chen gyis mkhan po dang / shes rab mgon pos las kyi slob dpon/ bsod nams rdo rje gsang sde ston pa mdzad de/ dge 'dun grangs dang ldan pa'i dbus dge slong gi sdom pa mnos/(2)mang du thos palung giyonatan lasangal brnyes ba'i tshul/tshul bzhin sgrub pa rtogs pa'i yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa'i tshul gnyis so/ / dang po la/ thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang / bsams pas gdams par shar tshul gnyis las/dang po ni/ rje bla ma 'di nyid 'jigarten du byon pa'i dgos pa ni bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa 'ba' zhig gi ched yin la/ de yang phyogs re tsam ma yin par 'dul ba kā ri kā nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar gyi mdo dang bstan bcos mtha' dag gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du 'khyer shes pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i srol bzang po/ gangs ri'i khrod du sngar byon pa'i mkhas grub sus kyang gsal bar byed ma nus pa de nyid gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir yin no/ / de la rnam 'grel las/ thabs byung de rgyu zhog gyur pas/ de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/zhes gsungs pas na rang gis thog mar bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad la nges pa rnyed pa zhig dgos shing /de la thog mar mdo sngags kyi gzhung mtha' dag la phyogs rer ma song ba'i thos pa rgya chen po zhig dgos par gzigs nas/ bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i ded dpon la brten nas/ thos pa'i gru chen lhag bsam gyi ba — 449 —

dan dkar po 'phyar ba/ brtson pa'i rlung shugs drag pos bskyod de/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel darda btsas pa'i rgya mtsho chen por zhugs nas gzhung don yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'tshol ba la brtson pa rgyal slamirtag shu ngu dang mtshungs par mdzad do/ de'i tshul la gnyis las/ dang po mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las gsu bor brtsams pa'i thos pa mdzad tshul la/ gzhung lugs sbyi la thos pa mdzad tshul dang / khyad par du dbu tshad la thos pa mdzad tshul gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rje bla ma rang nyid kyis/ de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / / 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ / gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ / tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ chos grwa chen po bde ba can du byon/ snye thang ba bkra shis seng ge dang / gdan sa ba ye shes seng ge slob dpon yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma rin po che u rgyan pa rnams las bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa gsan pas zhag bco brgyad tsam gyis thugs su chud cing / bla ma 'jam rin pa las byams chos gzhan rnams kyang gsan/ khyad par du nya dbon kun dga' dpal ba'i drung du phar phyin gyi gzab bshad tshar gcig gsan pas thugs shin tu tshim/de yang deng sang gi slob gnyer ba bzhin du thal phreng nyog pa zhig gis chog shes mdzad pa ma yin te/ sher phyogs kyi 'grel ba la bod snga rabs pas shing rta'i srol 'byed du 'dod pa'i 'bum ṭika dang / brgyad stong don bsdus dang / dbu ma rigs tshogs dang / mngon rtogs rgyan bzhi dang / de'i nang nas kyang mngon rtogs rgyan la thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i de nyid rnam nges dang / dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i nyi khri gzhung 'grel dang / 'phags pagrol sdes mdzad pa'i nyi khri le'u brgyad ma'i 'grel pa nyi khri snang ba dang /btsun pa grol sdes mdzad pa'i le'u mang gi 'grel ba nyi khri rnam 'grel dang / seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'grel ba don gsal dang / brgyad stong 'grel chen dang / le'u brgyad pa'i bsdus don dang /sdud 'grel gsar ma dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sdud pa'i 'grel ba pañdzi ka dang /slob dpon shārnyi pas mdzad pa'i nyi khri dag ldan dang / brgyad stong pa'i 'grel ba snying po mchog dang /dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sher snying gi rgya cher 'grel ba dang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang /ka ma la shrī las mdzad pa'i rjes 'brang chos kyi bshes gnyen la sogs pa'i 'grel bshad rnams dang / mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / de'i 'grel bshad btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa dang / kha che dzñā na shrī'i bsdus don dang / blo brtan gyi 'grel chen dang bcas pa'i 'grel bshad rnams dang / rgyud bla ma la thogs med kyi 'grel ba dang / 'byed gnyis la dbyig 'grel dang /dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad blo brtan gyis mdzad pa bcas gzhung de dag gi tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad de lo gnyis kyi khongs su byams chos la mkhas pa'i pha rol tu son par gyur to/ /( 2)'dul mngonagyigazhung la thos bsamamadzad tshul/ —rje ༵rdospya kau mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros la mngon par mdzod rang 'grel gyi steng nas mdzub 'khrid

mdzad de gsan pas gsung bshad gzhung gi tshig ris tsam la brten pa ma yin par/ bstan bcos kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i don gyi khog legs par bsgrigs nas 'gangs chun pa'i go ba bogs chod du ster nus pa gig 'dug pas dad spro chen po 'khrungs/ gang gsungs thams cad lan re kho nas tshig don lhag ma med par thugs su chud cing / dka' ba'i gnad rnams la dri gtugs legs par mdzad pas/ rje btsun pa yang shin tu thugs 'phrogs par gyur te/ khyed la mdzub 'khrid byed pa la legs par bsgrim dgos par 'dug ces gsungs/ dbu ma 'jug pa'ang tshar gcig gsan cing / gyis su mngon pa kun btus gzab bshad dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rang 'grel zhib tu gsungs pas khyi'i go ba legs par 'khrungs/phar phyin dang 'dul ba rnams kyang gsan/ dbu tshad kyi rigs pa'i sgo dang por red mda' ba las brnyes pas 'di nyid 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma'i gtso bor mdzad/skyor mo lung pa'i mkhan po dka' bzhi ba blo gsal zhes pa 'dul mdzod la shin tu mkhas par byed pa la 'dul mdo rtsa'i rgya cher 'grel gyi dbu nas nyin re bzhin mda' tshad ma bcu bdun tsam re thugs la bzung / thos bsam mdzad pa'i 'dul mngon gyi gzhung gi skor ni/ mdo rtsa'i 'grel chung yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa dang / chos gyi bshes sanyen gyis mdzad pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba dang / mdo'i 'grel ba slob dpon shes rab 'byed kyis mdzad pa dang / lung gzhi'i rgya cher 'grel ba slob dpon dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa dang / phran tshegs kyi 'grel ba slob dpon tshul khrims bskyabs kyis mdzad pa dang / so sor thar ba'i 'grel ba slob dpon khyad par bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / so sor thar pa'i rgya chen 'grel ba dri med bshes gnyen mdzad pa dang / dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud dang / slob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa dang / slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lnga bcu ba la sogs pa 'dul ba'i 'grel ba 'grel bshad/ yan lag phran dang bcas pa gung bsgrigs pa'i lag len dang / gnang bkag gi khyad par rnams rdzogs par thugs su chud/ mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa dang / grags pa bshes gnyen gyi don gsal dang /gang spel gyi 'grel bshad mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang / kun btus 'grel ba rgyal sras ma rnams la brten nas theg pa gong 'og gi mngon pa'i don mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs par mdzad do/ /(4)tshad ma'i gzhung la thos bsam mdzad tshul/ rje rang nyid kyis/ khyad par tshu rol mthong ba'i dngos po yi/ / de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /yang dag rigs pa'i gzhung gi dka' gnas la/ /'bad pa du mas yang dang yang du sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngar bla ma rje btsun pa dang / phyis su lo tsā ba don bzang las kyang gsan pa la brten nas tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa snams la legagapas gzigs rtog mdzad cing /gung bsgrigs nas legs par gtan la phab pas/ bod kyi rpārtso/da srol 5la che ba 'grel ba dang mi mthun — 451 —

par gzigs nas/ tshad ma kun btus kyi rang 'grel 'grel bshad dang bcas pa dang / rnam 'grelagyi 'grel ba lha shāka gnyis dang / bram ze gnyis kyi 'grel ba dang / rgyan gyi 'brel ba dang / de'i 'grel bshad gnyis dang / rnam nges kyi rang 'grel dang / de'i 'grel bshad chos mchog gis mdzad pa dngakarigs thigs kyi 'grel ba chos mchog gis mdzad pa ste/ 'grel ba 'grel bshad yab sras kyi gzhung gran dang bcas pa legs par gtan la phab nas thugs sbyang mdzad pas/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gnyis kyi ṭāgo/ nga/sa pa dpyis phyin pa thugs su chud cing bod kyi tshad ma'i bshad srol phal che ba snying po med par byas (5)dbu ma'i gzhung la thos bsamasadzad tshul/rje rang gi zhal nas/ mdo sngags gzhung la ngal ba mang byas kyang / / zab don nyams su len dang smra ba na/ /gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes pa'i/ /lta ba'i tshul las ring du ma sob bar/ /marjong nas lhag par klu sgrub gzhung lugs kyi/ / zab mo 'byed pa'i phra ba'i rigs lam nas/ / yang dag lta ba 'dren pa'i gnad kun la/ /legs par sbyangs te the tshom chod par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de dus bod du dbu ma'i bshad srol shin tu nyam chung bas/ bla ma red mda' ba las 'jug pa'i bshad pa ma gtogs rtsa shes la sogs pa'i rigs tshogs gzhan gyi bshad pa gsan pa ma byung zhing / rigs tshogs kyi lung zhig snar thang mkhan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang / bde ba can pa'i bla ma 'jam rin pa las gsan/ mdor na de'i dus su khong dpon slob la rigs tshogs rnams kyi bshad pa lta zhog lung len pa'i yul yang dka' bar byung ngo / /dbu ma la sbyangs pa mdzad pa'i gzhung ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs rigs tshogs drug 'grel ba dang bcas dang / mdo kun las btus pa dang / rjes 'brang gi gzhung rtsa ba shes rab kyi don 'grel bzhi brgya pa dang / de'i 'grel ba zla bas mdzad pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi 'grel ba dang / slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba shes rab kyi don 'grel dbu ma snying po dang / de'i rang 'grel rtog ge 'bar ba dang / rtsa ba shes rab kyi tshig 'grel shes rab sgron me dang /de'i 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa dang / dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi don 'grel slob dpon zla bas mdzad pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa dang / de'i 'grel bshad dza ya ā nardos mdzad pa dang / rtsa ba shes rab kyi tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i dbu ma rgyan dang / de'i rang 'grel dang /de'i 'grel bshad dang / dbu ma bden gnyis dang / de'i rang 'grel dang / de'i 'grel bshad dang /gzhan yang dbu ma snang ba la sogs pa rnams so/ /(6)gsangasngagasakyitheg palathos bsam mdzadatshul/rtogs brjod las/ 'di na rdzogs sangs rgyas su bgrod pa la/ / zhab mo rdo rje theg dang phar phyin theg— /༵༵ pa ba/nyis yod gsang sngags phar phyin las/ /shin tu khyad par 'phags pa yin no/ /zhes

dang / nyi ma zla ba lta bur kun tu grags/ /tshig de bden pa'i tshig tu 'dod bzhin du/ /zab mo'i theg de ji lta bu zhig ces/ / tshol bar mi byed mkhas pa'i khur 'dzin pa/ / de 'dra de yang shes rab can yin na/ / de las gzhan pa'i dbang po spyol po gang / / shin tu 'phrad dka' gong na med pa'i lam/ /'di 'dra yal bar 'dor ba kye ma mtshar/ / de nyid phyir na rgyal ba'i theg pa mchog / sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje theg / dngos grub gnyis kyi gter gyur zab mo der/ / zhugs nas 'bad pa mang pos ring du sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de dus bod na mdo sngags gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa shas che bar/ pha rol tu snyin pa la mos pa rnams ni gsang sngags la mi 'jug sngags la mos pa rnams kyis pha rol tu phyin pa spong bar byed pa la/ rje 'dis sngon rgyal ba dbang po'i tog gi drung du stong nyid kyi lta ba dang gsang sngags zung du 'brel ba'i lam bzang rgyas par bya'o zhes dam bca' mdzad pa bzhin skal ldan rnams mdo sngags gnyis gcig gis gcig grogs su 'khyer shes pa'i lugs srol bzang po la 'god pa'i ched du thog mar rang nyid kyis gsang sngags kyi theg pa la phyogs re tsam ma yin pa'i thos pa rgya chen po mdzad par dgongs te/ zhal nas/ nga la sngags kyi phyogs la gzhan gyis bskul dgos pa med/chung ngu nas 'di la shes 'dod drag po yod cing / de yang rgyud sde mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par bslab dgos snyam pa zhig dang po nas yod ces gsungs shing / skabs shig bla ma rje btsun pa'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis sngags kyi rtsad gcod rgya chen po mdzad pa la yun ring 'gor/ de bas re zhig sde snod kyi bshad pa mdzad pa mi 'thad dam zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag sngags kyi phyogs la shes 'dod drag po yod pas sngags kyi rtsad gcod kyang bgyid pa lags zhes zhus so/de yang rje 'di nyid dgung lo so bzhi bzhes pa rta'i lo rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde gong 'og mtha' dag gi dbang lung man ngag bshad srol khungs btsun pa yod do cog gsan rgyu'i dgongs pa gtad pa'i skabs shig na mnal lam du khri chen po zhig gi steng na bla ma khyung po lhas pa yin zer ba bgres nyams can dbu rgyan gsol zhing rdor dril bzung ba zhig bzhugs 'dug pa de'i sku mdun na rje rang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bla ma bzhengs nas rdo rje 'gros kyis gar stabs dang bcas/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil nas rje rang la g.yas skor lan gsum mdzad cing / phreng ba nas byung ba'i e kā pa tsi kā pa zhes sgra bsgrags nas/ rje 'di'i dbu'i steng du rdor dril bzung nas karma badzra zhes bya ba'o/ /zhes gsungs nas khri la bzhugs song ba zhig mis/ mnal sad pa na thugs la bde nyams chen po 'khrungs/ gsang mtshan sngar nas don yod rdo rje yin pa dang mthun par byung dgongs pa zhig byung / de nas zha lu ri spug tu rin po che khyung po lhas pa la yo ga sogs gsan par 'byon dgongs nas yod pa'i nub cig mnal lam du/ khri chen po zhig gi steng na rin po che khyung po ba yin zer ba'i bla ma bgres po bzang po'i bzhugs stangs mdzad pa'i drung na rje rang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bla ma des phyag gnyis kyis thugs ka'i na bza' bsal nas rjen par bstan pa'i thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba ring po rim pa du mas bskor ba'i 'khor lo yig 'bru rnams khra hram me 'dug ge 453 —

pa'i sngags rnams phal cher klog khro zhig rmis/ ltas khyad par can de dag gzigs nas 'a lur phebs na bla ma de nyid mjal bas sngar mnal lam du byung ba'i dbyibs de kho na ltar 'dug pas dad gus smra mi she spulta bu 'khrungs/ de nas lab sgron las/ bya ba spyod sogs rgyud gsungs pa'i/ / gal te gsang sngag spyod 'dod na/ / de tshe slob dpon dbang bskur phyir/ / bsnyen bkur rin chen sogs sbyin dang / /bka' sgrub la sogs thams cad kyis/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya/ /bla ma mnyes par gyur pa yis/ /yongs rdzogs slob dpon dbang bskur bas/ / sdig kun rnam dag bdag nyid ni/ / dngos grub 'argyuglepa'i skal ldan 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsam pas rdo rje 'chang dngos su blta ba dang / sbyor bas lus ngag gi bsnyen bkur ba/ 'tsho ba nar ma dang / rin po che gos dar sogs 'bul ba dngakauskabs skabs dam tshig gi thes chogs kyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs pas mnyes par mdzad nas/ thog mar yo ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi dbang gis sna drangs te/ gdugs dkar/ dam tshig gsugabakod/ bcu gcig zhal/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ tshe dpag med sogs bya rgyud dang / rnam snang mngon byang sogs spyod rgyud de/ de skabs bod na yod pa'i dbang gi chu bo rnam par dag pa phal cher gsan cing bla med la yang gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa dang / bde mchog lha i pa dang / nag po ba sogs mtha' yasapa gsan nas khong la mnga' ba'i bka' lung phal cher bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs rgyud la gtams par mdzad nas lo gcig bzhugs/ de ltar chos gnang ba'i tshe dbang re re rdzogs pa'i mtshams su bla ma de'i zhal nas/ nga la 'di bla ma 'di zhes bya bas dgyes bzhin du gnang ba yin no bya ba re nges can du gsungs shing / bka' lung legs par rdzogs pa na da ni chos bdag po la 'phrod pas 'gyod pa med do zhes—gsungs te/ de ni rje btsun khyung po rin po ches/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis las sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu bzhes pa'i byin rlabs kyi bcud ma nyams pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs rje 'di nyid gyi phyag tu 'phrod nas phyogs 'dir skye dgu thams cad kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa 'di dgongs par gsal lo/ /nyang stod bde chen du dbyar ston gnyis tsam gyi bar du rin po che chos kyi dpal ba tshul bzhin bsten nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba paṇḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i legs bshad rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang chen bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang bcas pa'i dbang lung mdzub khrid bshad pa gar thig dbyangs gsum gyi phyag len dang bcas pa'i sgo nas rdo rje greng ba/ rnal 'byor rdzogs greng / 'od kyi snye ma ste phreng ba skor gsum la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs shing / gzhan yang phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po la sogs pa'i chos bka' marpā du gsan no/ /lhag par rnal 'byor rgyud la dbang thob pa tsam du ma zad/ nyang stod sgad kyi mtshams 'khris rtsa khang zhes par yo ga ba mgon bzang zhes pa gdan drangs nas/ rdo rje dbyings dang dpal mchog rtse mo la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi gar thig dbyangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i khrigs/ phyag rgya 'ching — 454 —

ba sogs bu ston rin po che'i phyag len ltar zhib tu sbyangs/ slar yang san gnam phag pa rir zha lu'i yo ga ba mkhas pa sde snod 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan grags pa spyan drangs nas/ yo ga'i dbyangs dang phyag len sogs la dag ther mdzad cing / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i rnam bshad chen mo/de nyid bsdus pa/ rtse mo/ dpal mchog sbyong rgyud sogs rgyud dang / de nyid snang ba/ ko sa la'i rgyan/ dpal mchog 'grel chen la sogs pa rgyud dang rgya 'grel gyi rigs du ma'i lung yang gsan no/rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi gzhung gang dang gang la sbyangs pa ni/ bya rgyud la/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang legs spub kyi rgyud dang / de'i bsdus don sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa sgyud dang / phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud chen po rig pa mchog dang / rdo rje gtum po'i rgyud dang / rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud ri rab chen po la sogs par brten nas bya rgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa rnams gtan la phab ste thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /spyod rgyud kyi skor bod du mang po ma 'gyur yang / gtso bor gyur pa rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i rgyud la de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ de'i rgya cher 'grel ba de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad pa dang /de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyas 'grel ko sa la'i rgyan ces bya ba shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / sangs spyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rgyud don la 'jug pa dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel ba stong
