phrag nyi shu co bzhi ba slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud dang / de'i 'grel ba partsi ta musti ka ko ṣas mdzad pa dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud dang / de'i 'grel ba snang ba'i rgyan la sogs pa ste/ mdor na rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi rgyud 'grel ba dang bcas pa mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /(7)bla medaspyirgyud sde la thosabasamamadzad tshul/rnam thar zur 'debs las/ zha lur bla ma khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams la rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rgyud man ngag phal cher gsan cing / khyad par du sa skya ba dang bu ston pa'i lugs kyi yo ga dang /bla med kyi skor ma lus pa de'i nang nas kyang gsang 'dus mar lugs/ 'gos lugs/ jo bo lugs sogs 'phags lugs dang / ye shes zhabs lugs/ kun snying gi lugs la sogs pa rgya bod kyi bshad srol dang bcas pa gsan cing thugs su chud par mjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi bshad srol ni rje btsun red mda' ba la gsan cing / gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba yang 'phags lugs kyi gsang 'dus skor gsan par mngon te/ mtha' gcod rin chen myug gu las/rje btsun dam pa ku mā ra ma ti'i zhal snga nas dang / bu ston zhabs kyi slob ma rje btsun dam pa khyung po lhas pa'i zhal snga nas dang / rje btsun dam pa chos kyi dpal ba gsum ka bsdoms pa la brten nas/ 'phags lugs kyi chos skor rnams bdag gis yongs su rdzogs par mnos zhes gsungs pas/ ye shes zhabs — 455 —

lugs kyi dbang sogs ni bu ston gyi thugs sras sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal la yang gsan no/ /ma rgyud bde dgyes sogs ni/ mdo smad du bzhugs skabs chos rje don grub rin chen pa'izhab drung nas/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ kyai rdo rje/ phyag rdor 'khor lo chenacasogs kyi dbang dang bshad pa man ngag ci rigs pa gsan/ zha lur mkhan tshen rin chen rnam rgyal laspobade mchog mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang gsan/ snye thang gi chos rdzong du bla ma dam pa bsod nams spyal mtshan la bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang dang / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gsan/'a lu ri sbrug tu khyung lhas par/ lca i pa dang / nag po ba'i dbang gsan/bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa ni/ khyud 'grel sbas don kun gsal las/ bla ma 'phags pa 'od ces pa jo bo lugs dang / lo chung dang sa skya ba'i lugs kyi dbang dang khrid dang bshad pa mnga' ba gig gis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la gnang / yang bla ma des mar do'i lugs kyi bshad lung yang rtse ba la zhus gsung ba'i bshad srol mnga'o/ /bu ston zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi rnam bshad chen mo'i bshad lung de'i slob ma bla ma bde chen pa chen po la bdag gis thos so zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / kyai rdor gyi rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa sa skya ba'i lugs bzhin sa skyar bla ma rdo rje rin chen pa la gsan cing / de'i man ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa dbang don nyams len gyi rim par bsgrigs pa'i 'khrid yongs su rdzogs pa bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag len ltar gdan sa mthil du spyan snga grags pa byang chub las gsan no/ /gsang 'dus dang bde dgyes skor gyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung gang dang gang sbyangs pa ni/ pha rgyud 'dus pa la rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / phyi ma le'u bco baspyad pa dang / zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus sgron gsal dang / pamyi ta sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi gleng gzhi'i bshad pa dang / thakhyu ka ra warmas mdzad pa'i rgyan bdun rnam par dgrol ba dang / slob dpon rab tu zhi ba'i ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel ba slob ma la phan pa dang / panyi ta dri med sbas pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyan le'u bcu bdun gyi 'grel bshad dang / pagyi ta ci lus pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi 'grel ba rin po che'i ljon shing / gsang 'dul gyi 'grel ba tha ga nas mdzad pa dang /pasnyi ta rdo rje bzhad pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus le'u bcu bdun gyi 'grel ba dang / shārnyi pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus bshad sbyar snyim pa'i me tog dang / yang bshad pa'i rgyud la rdo rje phreng ba dang / dgongs pa lung bstan dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa dang / lha mo bzhis zhus pa sogs yin la/ de'i nang nas dgongs pa lung bstan gyi 'grel ba thakhyu ka ras mdzad pa dang / lha mo bzhis zhus kyi 'grel ba shākhyu ka ras mdzad pa dang / lha mo bzhis zhus kyi 'grel ba slob dpon kun diga' snying pos mdzad pa dang /gsang ba 'dus pa'i don 'grel la/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang / mdo bsre dang / rim pa lnga dang /'phags ༵ ༵sa mdzad pa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron me dang / de'i bshad pa shākya bshes gnyen dang klu'i

byang chub kyis mdzad pa dang / slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa dang / slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel ba sogs rim pa lnga'i 'grel ba bdun dang / sgob dpon shārnyi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas kyi 'grel ba rin po che'i phreng ba rnams te rgyud 'grel ba 'grel bshad/yab sras lnga'i 'grel ba man ngag dang bcas pa gung bsgrigs nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud don sbyin ci ma log par gtan la phab bo /rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyai rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis dang / bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang / thun mong ba'i bshad pa/ dpal saṃ bu ṭa rgyud gyi ma dang bcas pa dang /'grel ba'i skor la/ kai rdo rje'i 'grel ba rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa dang / mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i padma can dang / mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i kur mu tī dang / shārnyi pas mdzad pa'i mu tig zeng ba dang /nā ro pas mdzad pa'i 'grel chen la sogs 'grel ba bcu gsum dang / iṣṭa bornyis mdzad pa'i gur gyi dka' 'grel zhal nas brtsed pa la sogs pa gur gyi 'grel ba bzhi dang / slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i man ngag gi snye ma la sogs pa dang / rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud dang /ṭwāṃ/grel/ ba man ngag dang bcas pa la brten nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsed kyi don phyin ci ma log pa gtan la phab ma rgyud bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud a snyi dha na dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa dang / mkha' 'gro spya mtsho dang / rdo rje 'byung ba la sogs pa dang /'grel ba la sbyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog bstod 'grel dang / laṅka rgyal bzang dang / skal ldan grags pa dang / skar rgyal zla bas mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel la sogs pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i 'grel ba bha wa lha dras mdzad pa dang / slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dka' 'grel dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel ba de kho na nyid brtan par byed pa partsi ta nor bzang gis mdzad pa dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel ba padma badzra gyis mdzad pa'i thu rdzing la sogs pa rtsa rgyud dang /༵// sdo/ rsha trī/ dī dī /kā /bcas pa la thugs sbyangs legs par mdzad de 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud don dus gyi 'khor lo la/ bcom ldan ral gri dang / bla ma red mda' ba sogs kyis dga' pa mdzad na'ang rje 'dis rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i shing rta'i srol chen du dgongs nas/ 'ba' 'u 'ba' gnyer du bzhugs skabs/ gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba la zhib tu gsan par dgongs pa'i tshe mnal lam du/ chos kyi dpalabs bu ston rin po che la dus 'khor 'grel chen tshar bcu bdun nyan pa yin no zer ba zhig byung / de nas nyang stod bde chen du bla ma de nyid dang mjal ba na sbyag rten dar ser po zhig phul/ sang nyin gos yug na tshe kha gcig phul nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen cha lag dang bcas pa gsung bar gsol ba btab pas thugs dgyes bzhin du da lta 'grel ba'i tsho'i'u ༵༵ po'i chos

mtshams/ gang zhig chen po'i mi rnams smin par bya ba'i don du zhes pa'i skabs la smrebs byung bsarten 'brel shin tu nas legs/ mdang gi dar ser po de sa'i khams sdud rim dang mthun par rdzogs par 'obabar 'dug da nang gi gos yug 'di ljang khu nam mkha'i khams yin pas bskyed rim rdzogs par 'ong brtswa'adug chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed gsungs te/ thugs dgyes bzhin du tshig gi 'alharig nas dbu btsugs te 'grel chen rdzogs par gnang nas slar yang dbu nas tshig mtshams bar gnang gingarkargyud 'grel gyi bshad pa phyag len gyi mdzub khrid spyor drug gi nyams khrid sogs rdzogs par gsan nas/ston dgun dpyid gsum tsam bzhugs/ bu ston rin po che la 'grel chen tshar du gsan zhus pas bcu bdun nyan pa yin gsungs/ de rjes san gnam phag pa rir slar yang rin po che chos kyi dpal ba'i drung du rdo rje snying 'grel/ phyag rdor stod 'grel/ nā ro 'grel chen la sogs pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i cha lag du ma dang / gzhan yang chos bka' mang du gsan cing / skyor mo lung du tshal ba rtogs ldan sngo nyal ma zhespogrags pa bla ma mkhas pa ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad pa zhib par gsan cingadirgyu mtshan rtsis dang lag len rnams la'ang mkhas par sbyangs/ jo nang du phyogs las rnam spyal ba la'ang sbyor drug gi khrid zin rgyas su gsan/ bsdus rgyud zeng ba 'dzin pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad stong sum cu ba dang / rgyud phyi ma dang / bkol ba'i rgyud la sogs pa dang / 'grel ba la/ 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu ba zla bzang gis mdzad pa dang / padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i 'grel chen dri med 'od dang /de'i go la'i 'grel ba padma can so ma nā thas mdzad pa dang / padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i 'grel ba don tāsna ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ḍāng pa/ra mgā / sdo/sa /mdzad pa'i dbang mdor bltan gyi 'grel ba rnams la legs par sbyangs te snga gyir mdo sngags kyi gzhung gang dang gang la sbyangs pa'i mtshan smos pa rnams ni bdag gis rang bzor bgrang ba ma yin gyi/ dngos slob 'ga' zhig gis mdzad pa'i rje'i rnam thar du bkod pa bzhin yin pa/ de yang bka' gdams gong ma'i zhal nas/ rnam grol sgrub pa la po ti mdzo khal tsam las bya ba ma byas par/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam pa re ston pa tsug sped pa tsug byas pas gar yang mi phyin/ zhes gsungs pas rjes 'jug grol ba don gnyer can rnams kyis gzhung chen mo de dag la thos bsam gyi gzhi byed dgos pa shes pa'i ched du bris so/ /gzhan yang chos rje don rin pa sogs las gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bshad man ngag rwa skyo gnyos sogs las brgyud pa mi 'dra ba rnams dang / bla ma dbu ma ba la brten nas yongs su ma grags pa'i nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa mang po rnams gsan cing / grub chen dza ba ri ba nas brgyud pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang dang man ngag gi skor/ spyon snga grags pa byang chub kyi drung nas mar pa dang / sgam po ba las 'ongs pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i man ngag gi snying po nā ro chos drugaphyagatram̐ che~X 5sdu lngatram̐ na dang / phag mo gru pa dang / 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs

pa'ang gsan la/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs las sa lugs kyi gdams pa'i snying po du ma yang gsan no/ /nang rig pa'i sde snod du ma zad/ tshal du lha rje dkon mchog skyabs las gso dpyad gyi skor dang /lo chen nam bzang dang / sa bzang ma ti pan chen sogs las sgra dang / snyan ngag dang / ldeb spyor sogs dang / rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan las rtsis kyi skor te/ mdor na thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas rnams kyang legs par sbyangs/ tshal du bzhugs dus rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos bod du 'gyur cog yongs su rdzogs pa la gzigs rtog zhib tu mdzad cing / mdor na mkhas bya'i gnas mtha' dag la 'di ma sbyangs bya ba med pas mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan gyi rgya mcho chen po'i pha rol tu byon no/ /(8)gzhung lugs thams da gdams bar shar tshul/zhib tu bye na rje rang gi rtogs brjod du gsungs pa ltar rgya che yang 'dir mdo tsam bshad na/ bla ma dbu ma ba la phul ba'i zhu yig las/ khyir da lta bod na gsang sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa zhig snang zhing / de rnams kyang sangs rgyas byang sems la ma brgyud pa mi snang bas yi dam res gsungs pa tsam gyi rgyu mtshan las gzhan 'god rgyu ma brnyed na thad ka'i blo ngo 'ba' zhig tu song nas lam gyi gnad ma 'phyugs pa zhig la nges pa rnam dag skye ba'i thabs mi 'dug des na gzu bor gnas pa'i sgo nas blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis lam 'phyugs med cig 'tshol na/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde rtsod med gang dang yang mi 'gal zhing de dag nas zin pa/ de yang shing rta tshen po gcig gi rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas drang nges legs par gye ste mtha' gzhan du drang du mi btub par rigs pas gnod med du 'aspub pa zhig med mi rung du snang bas/ gsung rab chen po rnams dang de'i dgongs pa 'tshol ba'i rigs pa'i sgo dri ma med pa la rtsis po cher bzung nas rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa sngar mang du byung yang de tsam la chog shes ma byas par bstan pa 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ yi dam dang bla ma tha mi dad par byas pa la rgyun mi 'chad du gsol ba btab/ bsag sbyang gi sgo du ma la 'bad pas da lta gsung rab spyi dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnams la khol bton re tsam min pa'i lus yongs rdzogs pa nyams len du 'gro ba'i phyogs su shes pa yod/ tshul de la nges pa bde blag tu ster bar byed pa ni bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' spya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son cing / nang rig pa'i sde snod gsum gyi snying po bslab pa gsum gyi gnad rnams phyin ci ma log pa shes nas khas blangs pa tsam la ma bzhag par nyams 'og tu tshud par mdzad pa mkhas la grub pa brnyes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas rjes su bzung ba/ lhag pa'i lha dpag tu med pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems dpa' chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi gdams pa byang chub lam gyi rim pas mtshan nyid dang sngags kyi theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa phyin ci ma log pa gtan la phab pa nyid ya mtshan par mthong nas slob ma bkri ba'i rim pa rnams de kho na'i steng nas gyed kyin yod/ gdams ngag de yang gsung rab dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos man ngag mthaḍi da~X ༵ma rngi rim

pa gcig tu dril nas ston par gnang bas 'chad shes pa dang nyan shes pa gnyis kyis bshad cing nyams tsoblangs na man ngag chung chung du ma zad/ gsung rab mtha' dag gi gung 'grigs nas 'ong bar snang ba khrid kyi rnam grangs mang po ston pa ma byas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/de yang mdo phyogs kyi thos pa phal cher mdzad zin nas/ gtsang rong gi chos lung du rtsebs nag de'i mkhan po grags pa bshes gnyen la bka' lung ci rigs gsan cing / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyisrasamubla ma dbu ma ba brtson 'grus seng ge gsang mtshan dpa' bo rdo rjer grags pa dang thog mar mjal/ khobagis 'jam dbyangs kyi bka' bzhin rje rin po che la dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang dang / dbu ma 'jugapa'i rang 'grel yang gsan/ khong rang la byis pa'i dus nas gzigs snang nar mar 'ong ba'i 'ja dbyangs kyi snang ba 'di la brtag dpyad cig mdzod gsung bar/ rje rin po ches gzhung lugs kyi dka' gnad 'dri ba sogs kyis brtags pas gzigs snang rang dga' ba min pa nges pa rnyed/ phyis su rong chos lung du slar yang dbu ma dang mjal nas 'jam dbyangs chos skor gsan/ bla ma dbu ma bas lo tsā mdzad nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi chos kyi dri ba mang du zhus/ de dus 'jagadabyangs kyis sbob pa la bskul bar brten/ sngags kyi gsan sbyong tshar nas sgrub pa la 'byon par bugasathag bcad/ de nas bshad zin pa ltar sngags kyi gsan bzhes thams cad spub nas/ dpon sbob gnyis ka skyid shod dga' ba gdong du phebs/ mtshams dam par mdzad nas bla ma dbu ma bas lo tsā mdzad nas rje btsun la mdo sngags kyi dka' ba'i gnad mtha' yas pa zhus/ 'khor ji ltar khrid zhus pa la dag pa rnam brgyad du grags pa rnams khrid gsungs/ 'di yan chad du rje bla mas 'jam dbyangs dang dngos su ma mjal ba'i tshul gyis bla ma dbu ma bas lo tsā byas nas dri ba sogs zhu bar mdzad la/ 'di dus rje rang gis 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad par brten/ 'ja' gur gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'jam—dbyangs a ra pa tsa'i zhal dngos su gzigs/ de nas bzung ste nam 'dod du gzigs nas mdo sngags kyi gnad zab mo rnams rje btsun las dngos su gsan pa yin no/ /de nas rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa la 'byon par chas te/ bla ma dbu ma ba mdo khams su 'byon pa'i skyel thung la dpon slob gnyis ka lha sar byon nas/ thog steng ma'i lho phyogs kyi bya 'dab 'og tu mchod pa bzang bar bshams nas gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas zhal dngos su bstan nas nyams len gyi gnad bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' gsungs pa zin bris mdzad/ dbu ma ba la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang phul/ gsung 'bum khrod na dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs shig bzhugs pa de 'jam dbyangs kha ches bskul ba'i mdzad byang can du snang na'ang / sngon gyi bris ma rnying ba 'ga' zhig na bla ma dbu ma ba dpa' bo rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten dzwas 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung bzhin mang du thos pa'i dge slong blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi rgya sgribs 'og tu bris pa'o zhes snang la/ sgrub thabs kyi tshig ris rnams ni mthun par snang ngo / /khong mdo smad du phyon/— 460 —

rjebla ma dgung lo so drug la babs pa na/ dpon slob dgu 'ol kha chos lung du sgrub pa la gshegs so/ /der phebs 'phral nas thog mar gnad che bar dgongs te dpon slob thams cad kyis stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom la shin tu 'bus par mdzad/ de nyid lhang bshags phyag dang bcas pa mdzad pas sbyag zhabs kyi sor mo rnams ser khar song zhing / rdo la phyag zhabs dang dbu'i rjes byung ba dang / rdo gru bzhi che zum rtsa ba brtan pa zhig la martsel mdzad nas sbyag ngar gyis phyis pas phyag ngar la sha zen chags shing rdo shin tu 'jam por gyur pa rnams deng sang yang mjal rtse yod do/ /de'i tshe mdo phal mo che nas 'byung ba'i byang chub soms dpa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba rnams la dmigs sug nas sbyangs pas snying stobs lhag par rgyas shing / dag pa'i gzigs snang dpag tu med pa byung / de nas sman lung rgya sog tu sgribs nas nyams len la brtson pas/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub sangs rgyas byang sems rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyi gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba mang du byung zhing thugs dam shin tu 'phel/ de'i tshe sbyag na rdo rje'i sras kyi thu bo lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ phan tshun dag pa'i snang bas chos bka' mang po gsan res mdzad/ khyad par du rje bla mas mkhan chen rin po che la bka' gdams gdams ngag pa nas brgyud pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dgon pa ba nas sne'u zur ba dang /spyan snga ba nas bya yul ba la brgyud pa gnyis ka'i nyams khrid dang / gnyal gra skor mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po las bka' gdams gzhung pa nas brgyud pa'i lam rim gyi khrid/ po sto ba nas shar ba dang dol ba la brgyud pa gnyis ka gsan/ gnyal lo rdor zla ba lnga tsam bzhugs nas byang chub lam rim gyi nyams len rtsal 'don dang gro lung pa'i bstan rim chen mo zhib gzigs mdzad pas/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi brjod bya mtha' dag gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag tu 'khyer ba'i tshul la go ba tsam ma yin pa'i nges pa khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / des mtshon nas tshad ma dang / byams chos gzhan dang / dbu ma'i gzhung rnams dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde ba'i'i gnad don mtha' dag gdams ngag tu shar ba'i tshul bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig yod pa ni/ rtogs brjod 'dun lags mar gsungs pa ltar yin pas 'dir mang du dogs nas ma spros so/ 'di dag kyang rje bla ma'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig te/ sngon byon gyi mkhas grub su la'ang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa gdams par shar ba'i rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu 'chad rgyud mi 'dug pas so/ /(9)bsgoms pas nyamasartogasashā yonatan bsnyes pa'i tshul/de ltar dgung lo bcu bdun nas so drug gi bar du thos bsam rgya chen po mdzad/ so drug gi tshe rje btsun gyis bskul nas bya bral la byon nas bla ma yi dam dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs pa sogs kyi rgyu tshogs mang po zhig bsgrubs pa la brten nas lo bzhi tsam song ba na gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag tu shar/ de nas lam phyogs re ba tsam ma yin par mdo sngags kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len la dgung lo so brgyad pa nas nga gsum pa'i bar du thugs gzhol mdzad pas/ gyi nang thun mong ba'i yon tan — 461 —

sna re tsam thob pa la rtogs pa mthon por song bar re ba dang 'dra ba ma yin par/ gzhung nas jiska༈bshad pa bzhin gyi nyams rtogs tshad ma thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin te/ rje rang gi zhal nas/ kho la gzhan gyis stan bzang po bshams pa dang / gus pas bsnyen bkur sogs ci byas pa tsam gyis ched sabasam mi dgos par dus de'i skabs rang du 'di thams cad mi rtag cing yid brtan du mi rung ba sgyumaji bsru brid dang 'dra ba yin snyam pa'i skyo ba shugs drag pos snang ba bun long du thongs pa yid gting nami'agyur ba rgyun ring por skye ba zhig dang po nyid nas rang chas su yod pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang / gnya smad song ge rdzong du 'dul ba'i chos mang du gsungs shing / lag len zan tshegs rung chu 'debs pa yan chad zhib par mdzad de/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims dag dgos pa yin/nged la so sor thar pa'i pham lhag sbom po dang bcas pa'i lhung ba 'ong ma myong / snang byed nyes byas da bcas pa'i 'ga' ri byung ba rnams bshags sdom la 'bad yod gsungs pa dang / 'ol kha chos lung du mdo phal po che la gzigs rtog mdzad cing / byang chub kyi sems dang / rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rnams la thags sbyangs pas/ mdo sde nas 'byung ba'i rgyal sras kyi snying stobs dang spyod pa gang rlabs po che rnams la re re nas dmigs su phug gin thugs sbyong ba'i dmigs rnam nar mar bsten pas/ dang po cung dka' tsam byung yang phyis legs par goms nas 'bad rtsol mi dgos par rang shugs kyis rgyal sras kyi snying stobs dang spyod pa rmad du byung ba ji 'dra'i dpag dka' ba zhig la'ang zhum pa nam yang mi skyo zhing / spro dga'i shugs drag pos ngang gis 'jug pa zhig byung zhes gsungs pa dang / skyor mo lung du bzhugs skabs tshogs su mdo gsungs ba'i don la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dge 'dun rnams tshogs grol na yang ting nge 'dzin las ma bzhengs pa dang / zhal nas/ gsung rab kyi don la dpyad pa zhib mo mdzad skabs sku mdun du gzhan gyis gtam smra ba dang / spyod lam ji ltar byas kyang de dag la thugs samo tsam yang mi 'azo ba snga mo nas /spya// dge sbyor la zhugs pa'i tshe de ltar 'ong ba 'ol kha byams pa gling nas bzung ste byung gsungs pa ltar khyad par du dbu ma'i lta ba dang sngags kyi bde stong gi rtogs pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/mkhas spub rjes mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar dngos grub snye ma las/ gtsang rdong du bla ma dbu ma bas lo tsā ba mdzad/ rje 'dis 'dri ba po mdzad nas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la chos kyi dri ba mang du mdzad/ khyad par du dbu ma'i lta ba 'di ma btsal na lam gyi srog mi rnyed/ btsal kyang shin tu rnyed dka' zhing / phyin ci log tu bzung na gol sa dang nyes dmigs gzhan las kyang che bar 'phags pa yab sras kyis gsungs 'dug pas/ 'di nyid 'ba' zhig yid la bcags pa'i thugs kyi bzhed pa rtag tu na chags pas de kho na nyid tshol ba la byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu dra dang 'dra b.ri yod pas/ de'i tshe yang rje btsun la lta ba'i dri ba rang shas cher mdzad/ de dus nged kyi lta ba 'di thal rang gang yin zhus pas gang yang min gsungs/ de dus rje 'di'i thugs la yang khas len ci yang med cing gang du zung mi nyan par lta — 462 —

ba de thugs la bde ba tsam yod par 'dug go/de nas lta ba'i skor la dri ba dang brgal brtag mang du mdzad pas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung nas/ snang phyogs dang stong phyogs la nye ring gtan nas byed mi nyan/ khyad par snang ba la gtsigs su byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs/ phyis dga' ba gdong du bzhugs dus kyang de 'dra ba mang du byung ste/ mdor na tha snyad tshad mas grub pa gzhag pa med par 'khrul ngor tsam la bsnyad nas gzhan ngor 'jog pa ma gtogs/ rang lugs la gang yang gzhag med par las 'bras la skur 'debs kyi chad lta chen po la dbu ma'i lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa de nyid 'gog pa'i ched du/ rje btsun gyis nan tan tshe bar mdzad do/ /de ltar dri ba dang brgal brtag mdzad pa'i skabs su rje btsun gyis thal rang gi khyad par/ lhan skyes dang kun btags kyi bdag 'dzin gnyis kyis ji ltar bzung ba ltar gyi/ bdag dang rtags kyi dgag bya'i tshad phra rags/ lta ba rtogs pa'i tshad/ thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba 'di'i lugs kyis kun rdzob rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul la sogs pa rnams kyi dpyad pa zhib tu mdzad pa'i sa bon shin tu 'dril ba re dang /sngags mtshan nyid kyi lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim pa lnga'i ngo dang / go rim/ grangs nges la sogs pa rnams kyi gnad thun mong min pa shin tu 'dril ba re gsungs/ mi go bar 'dug lags zhus pas/ 'di rnams ma brjed par gyis la zin ris su bris/ bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad du byas pa la gsol ba 'debs shing bsnyen sgrub byed pa dang / bsags sbyang gnyis la legs par 'bad pa dang / gzhung lugs kyi don la rigs pas rnam par dasnyod cing zhib tu sems pa rnams sum sgril du nyams su long la tshim ma sla bar/ rgyun bsrings la legs par daphyod cig dang / skabs su bab pa na/ ngas da lta sa bon btab pa 'di rnams kyis kyang rkyen byas nas legs par go ba zhig byur du 'ong bar 'dug ces gsungs so/ /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs kyi dbu ma dang gsang ba 'dus pa la shes 'dod shin tu che bar yod pas rtsad gcod sa'i bla ma bod na su drag zhus pa la/ red mda' ba las drag pa med/ 'on kyang khyod la mtha' ma lus par chod pa'i go ba rdzogs par skyed mi thub/ dbu ma bas lo tsā byas nas ngas khyod la bshad na de ga drag par 'ong na'ang / kho yang myur du mdo khams la 'gro dgos par snang / des na da lta nas bshad pa ma gyed par bya bral gyis la dben pa bsten/ gong du bshad pa ltar sum sgril du nyams su len pa dang / dmigs rnam skyong ba sogs la legs par 'bod dang / ring por mi thogs par de rnams kyi don rnyed par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ /zhes dang / las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar las/ dgung lo so drug bzhes pa chu bo spre'u lo'i ston/ bla ma dbu ma ba dang rje nyid lhan cig tu yul dbus kyi dga' ba gdong du phebs nas sku mtshams legs par bcad nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi chos skor mang du gsan/463de'i tshe bla

ma dbu ma bas lo tsā mdzad de rje btsun la dbu ma'i lta ba dang / sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par/ jig bla med kyi lam gyi dka' gnad/ rim pa lnga'i go rim grangs nges sogs mtha' yas pa zhig dri ba mdzad/lhag par rje 'di'i thugs la khas len ci yang med cing rang lugs la chos gang yang gzhag pa nad pa gzhan ngo 'ba' zhig la skyel ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba de cung bde bar yod pas/ rje btsun la nged kyi dbu rsā lta ba 'di lta ba rnam dag e yin zhus pas min te/ khyod rang gi ngos nas stong phyogs la nges pa 'dug gi snang phyogs la mi 'dug pa'i gyir ro gsungs/ dbu ma thal rang gi khyad par gang lags zhus pas/ sna ba tsam gyi mngon zhen ldog mi ldog ltos dang gsungs/ gzhung lugs gang la sbyangs na dga' zhus pas/spyir spyal ba'i bka' la bzang ngan med na'ang khyod rang gi las 'brel dbu ma la yod pas de la spyongaspogasungs/ sngags kyi rgyud lde gang la sbyangs na legs zhus pas slob dpon ba grags pa'i 'grel ba yod pa'i gzhung gcig la sbyongs gsungs/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa la gnas skabs thams cad du tshad mar bzung bas chog gam zhus pas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po de la 'khrul ba ga la mnga' zhes gsungs/zhes 'byung ngo / /mkhan chen phyag rdor ba ma mjal ba'i sngon tsam du bugs dgongs la kha ba can da lta yod pa'i bka' bstan bcos man ngag dang bcas pa legs par nyan cing khong du chud nas da dung sgro 'dogagathe tshom som nyi la sogs pa gcod pa dang / khyad par dbu ma dang sngags kyi skor/ bye brag tu gsang 'dugadang bde mchog gi skor rnams gtan la 'apebs pa'i ched du rgya gar du byon nas/ o tasto pu ri dang /nā lernga la sogs pa rnams saklu'i byang chub sogs la gtugs par dgongs te/ dpon slob bcu gsum tsam rtags mi lam sogs la dpyad nas smon lam dang 'brel gcig tu bsgrigs nas/ rgya gar shing gi ri na thub thob mi tra dzo ki bzhugs pa dang mjal nas/ ma ga ṅgār 'byor dgongs pa'i thugs 'dun ma bor bar yod pa thub chen gyis mkhyen nas/ khyed rgya gar du byon na rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i partsi ta chen po rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po byed pa gcig tu 'gyur na'ang sku tshe thung bas glob ma rnams la phan thog pa dka'/de bas bod du bzhugs nas 'jam dbyangs la gsol ba btab na myur du rjes su 'dzin par 'dug gsungs nas bshol btab pas/ rje 'dis kyang zhal gyis bzhes te mi 'byon par thag bcad/ de nas grub chen gyis bshol ma btab na rang re gangs can pa rnams la rje bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang gsang bde sogs kyi gnad zab mo bdud rtsi'i snying po rtsong ba'i skabs dben par 'gyur rgyu la/ bla ma'adi'i drin las rje bla ma ljongs 'dir brtan chags par bzhugs te chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba dang /dka' gnad legs bshad kyi yig 'jog mang du mdzad par brten/ da lta'i bar du skal ba dang ldan pa du mas zab gsang chos kyi bdud rtsi la longs spyod rgyu yod pa 'dir snang bas bka' 3na dran pa'i dad gus bsgom pa dang / khyad par rang rang gis rnyed pa'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bgo skal le lo dang 'du 'dzi'i rkun por ma shor bar longs spyod pa la brtun te brtson par rigs so/ /thal rang gi lta ba'i gnad rnams la bya bral la 'byon pa'i gong nyid nas 'di bar du dpyad pa nar — 464 —

mar mdzad na'ang / mthar thug gi gnad la mi bde ba gtan nas log pa'i nges pa 'dren ma thub/ 'di skabs 'o de gung rgyal gyi lha shol dben gnas lha rings su/ rje btsun gyis gsungs pa bzhin rgyu tshogs sum sgril gyi sgo nas lta ba'i dmig rnams skyong ba la 'bad par mdzad pas mtshan mo zhig mnal lam du 'phags pa yab sras lnga zab mo'i don la bka' bgro ba mdzad kyin 'jug pa'i nang nas slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs yin zer ba'i partsi ta sngo bsangs sku bong che ba zhig gis dbu ma'i rgya dpe dbu thog tu bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma byung / phyi nyin 'grel ba buca pā li ta gzigs pas mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyi lta ba'i gnad mthar thug pa dang / dgag bya'i mtshan 'dzin sogs la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i nges pa gting tshugs pa la 'khrungs shing / mtshan 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad thams cad zhig de kho na nyid kyi don la mtha' gzhan du dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par drung phyung bar gyur te/ ston pa la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i shugs kyis rten 'byung gsung ba'i sgo nas bstod pa legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'ang mdzad/'grel ba gzigs mtshams su gang du sgro 'dogs chod pa ni/ bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ rje rin po ches burtse pā li ta gzigs skabs/ rtsa shes rab byed brgyad pa'i/ brten nas 'byung ba med pa yi/ zhes sogs kyi thad kyi 'grel bar gzigs nas stong nyid gsar du rtogs pa'i tshul mdzad pa yin 'dra/ rtsa shes ṭīka chen du lung de lan mang po 'dren pa'ang mdzad 'dug ces gsungs/rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ de ltar kho na nyid kyi don la rigs pa'i stobs kyis sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par chod de stong pa nyid la thugs rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'i ting nge 'dzin lhur mdzad cing /yang dag pa'i dran shes kyis legs par bskyangs pa'i goms pa phul du phyin par mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ da lta legs par goms par rjes thob tu'ang sna tshogs pa'i snang ba 'di thams cad stong bzhin du snang ba'i sgyu ma ltar 'char gyi/ stong pa nyid kyi rgyas ma thebs pa'i snang ba rang dga' ba cher mi 'char bar 'dug ces gsungs so/ / tshul 'di ni mkhas pa mgu bar byed pa'i rnam par thar pa ches dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas kyang bstod pa'i phreng bas bsngags par bya ba'i yul yin na/bdag cag dag gis lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bas na bod 'dir sngon byon pa'i mkhas pa sus kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma thon pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba zab mo rje bla mas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drin las rnyed pa ste/ rgyu mtshan de bas na bka' brgyud pa dang / sa skya ba dang / jo nang ba dang / rdzogs chen par grags pa rnams kyi lta ba las rang re dge ldan pa'i lta ba khyad par 'phags par grub po/ 'o na bla ma red mda' bas kyang ji bzhin ma dgongs sam zer na/ bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ lta ba'i rnam gzhag phal cher red mda' ba dang rje bla ma'i bzhed pa gcig kyang snang bas yod mtha' dang / stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid rgyu 'bras su 'char ba'i tshul rje bla ma'i thun mong ma yin pa yin zhes gsungs twe/65/des na

sngar rje btsun gyis/ red mda' bas kyang khyed la mtha' ma lus par chod pa'i go ba rdzogs par da mi thub gsung ba yang gnad 'di yin par sems so/ / rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ gsang rnam las/ rje de nyid dgung lo zhe baspyadagledang zhe dgu ba'i skabs 'ol kha gsang sngags nang byams pa gling du/ rnam gzhag rim pa'i ṭī ka dgasngags rim chen mo mdzad pa'i tshe zhal nas/ khyir rim lnga'i don dang / khyad par du rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu lus kyi sgrub tshul sogs dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang / 'phags pa yab sras lnga'i gzhung nas 'byung ba'i don thun mong ma yin pa rags pa rnams dpyis phyin pa zhig legs par go nas de dus lo bcu lhag tsam song ba la de bar du smra ma nus/ de nas zur tsam thas pa yin zhes gsungs pa dngakadaka' brag tu 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen sgrub dang / ni gu chos drug gi khrid bskyangs pas de nas bshad pa'i nyams rtogs ngo mtshar can du ma 'khrungs pa dang / gnyal seng ge rdzong du dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug gi nyams khrid bskyangs pas/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/dus 'khor dpa' gcig zhal gzigs te/ dus kyi 'khor lo 'di la khyod zla ba bzang po byon ba 'dra ba zhig 'ong ba yod do gsungs pa dang / 'ol kha bsam gtan gling du/ gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / 'jam dbyangs dang byams pa gnyis chos kyi bka' bgro bar mdzad pa'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gnang ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen thub pa/ rin po che'i khri'i steng na byams bzhugs mdzad pas 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud gtad nas 'di'i bdag po gyis gsungs nas/ sngags dang phyag rgyas gyin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma gzigs pas/ lho brag mar pa'i gdams pa bsre ba skor dgu dang / 'pho ba la nges shes khyad par can rnyed pa dang / dga' ldan du sku mtshams dam par bzhugs pa'i tshe steng gi sna rtse'i phyogs nas a ba ji tī'i lam nas mar snar e waṃ gyi yi ge 'od kyi thag pa lta bu skya na ra ra 'ong ba gzigs pas/ de tshun chad thun mong ma yin pa'i zhi bde khyad par can dang stong nyid sbyor ba'i ye shes dga' ba bzhi dang stong pa bzhi'i bdag nyid can 'khrungs nas de phyin chad bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can nar mar basbyangs pas/ mnyam gzhag tu bde stong gi ye shes rgyud sde nas gsungs shing / grub chen gyi gzhung las 'byung ba/ phyi rol pa dang nang ba gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i ting ye 'dzin gyi char gtogs tsam re la bde stong gi ye shes su ming btags pa de lta bu ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing / rjes thob tu gang shar lha'i 'khor lo bde stong gi rol bar 'char bas dus 'da' bar gyur sto/ / zhes dang / skabs shig tu/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ da phyin chad gtso bor bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bzhes pa la 'grus par mdzad na sngags bla med kyi sgo nas rtogs pa khyad par can byur du rgyud la 'khrungs rshang / slob ma skal ldan bdun la yang lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can re skye bar 'gyur rdo/ /zhes lung bstan par mdzad pa la rje'i zhal nas/ nged khams ma snyoms pa'i skabs kyi nyams kyi snang ba la gtad pa cher med te/ rtogs ldan pa — 466 —

la'ang 'dri dgos gsungs nas bka' gnang bas/ rtogs ldan pa na re/ bskyar ma zhu dgos pa med/tsho blos btang snod du rung ba'i 'khor rnams la mdo sngags kyi lam rdzogs par bstan nas sgom du bcugarje'i zhal snga nas rang gis gtso bor sku mtshams kyi ngang nas sgrub pa lhur mdzad na/ thugs rgyud la lam myur du 'khrungs pa'i nang gi rgyu bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can la sogs pa sngar thugs rgyud la 'khyungs tshar zhing / phyi'i rkyen zhing skyes kyi pho nya mo rnams kyis grogs mdzad pa la sogs pa khyad par can byur du 'ong / lhag pa'i lhas kyang gyin gyis rlabs pas rgyu tshogs rnams tshang zhing / lam myur du thugs rgyud la 'khrungs ngo / / zhes rje btsun gyis gsungs/ zhes zer ro/ / zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /skabs der las rgya bsten na sku tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad rgyu yin na'ang /rjes 'jug rnams bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshangs spyod la gces spras yod pa'i ched du las rgya bsten pa ma mdzad cing / lhan skyes kyi phyag rgya mas lam gyi grogs mdzad pa rje btsun gyi gsung de dag dang / rtogs ldan pa'i gsungs las/ rje'i drung du bud med mdzes ma gos yid du 'ong ba gyon pa tha zhwa dmar po leb 'jog byas pa zhig dus rgyun du 'ong ste lha'i rnam par mi 'ong ba de snod min la sngags kyi gsang ba bstan pa'i skyon yin par snang / lu i pa'i 'grel ba 'dod 'jo brtsams phyin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i rnam par 'ong / grogs khyad par can mdzad pa yin 'dug ting 'dzin bir legs ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i glu 'di yang gdangs dang bcas pa gtsug lag khang gi blos bslangs bzhengs dus lha mo rnams kyis 'then gyin 'dug pa gzigs pa yin par snang / zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang / dbyangs can ma ni las rgya rgya ste/ zhes pa dang / rje rang gis kyang / tshul de sgrub la thogs med mthu ldan pa/ / 'dzam gling gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma ni 'khor bcas kyis/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs mdzad shog / ces dang / pho nya'i grogs dang myur du 'dus pa las/ / bde ba'i dga' ston 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog /ces gsungs pa sogs kyis shes par snang zhing / de'i gnad gyis bar dor mchog gi dngos spub brnyes pa yin te/ mkhas grub rjes/ 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad gyur pa/ /de tshe khyod sku 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ /bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pa sgyu ma'i sku/ /mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dag pa'i gzigs snang ni/ ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la gzigs pa yang bsam las 'das na/mtha' dag pa ni su zhig gis brjod par nus/ rags rim tsam ni gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs las shes par bya la/ 'jam dbyangs kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa ni/ rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ khyad par rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mngon sum du yang yang gzigs shing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ gsung rab mtha' dag gi don la 'tshol ba mi mnga' bar gyur pa yin pa/ ji 'dra ba'i rtogs dka' ba zhig yin na'ang / thog mar rigs pas 'ib tu dpyad pas phal cher dgongs 'ong / de ltar mdzad kyang thugs nges mtha' chod pa 'dren ma — 467 —

thub pa rnams la/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs tha mi dad la gsol ba drag tu brtabacibamartsel phul bas/ de ma khad 'bad med du dpyis phyin par dgongs nas 'ong ba bsnyon mi nus par yodagagazhan yang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba sogs kyi rnam par thar ba gib pararidangos su yongs la bsgrags par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang gsung rab kyi don la tshul ji ltar dasbyod/dpyad pa rdzogs ma rdzogs/ nyams len gyi gnad/ gdul bya ji ltar bkram/ 'khor ji lta bu ba na/ṭāpy-ipa tram̐ /ra rdi // ba/zhugs pa sogs phal cher rang bzos zhugs pa ma byas/ zhes gsungs so/ zhi gnyis pa/ bstan pa la bya bsadzad pa'i tshul/gnyis dīṭwāṃn/ pa'i rmang btsugs pa'i tshul dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis 'phel rgyas samadzad tshul (1)bstan ba'i rmang btsugs pa'i tshul/snga ma rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang nyams gsos grub nas lho brag bra bo dgon par bzhugs pa'i tshe/phyis 'dul ba'i bslab khrims rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod par dgongs nas/ chos gos gsum lhung bzed mkhar gsil sogs dang /bstod pa tshangs pa'i cod paṇa mdzad nas rdzing sbyi'i byams mgon la 'bul rgyu bskur ba gnang / de rjes gnyal smad seng ge rdzong du 'dul ba'i chos mang du gsungs/ lag len phran tshegs rung chu 'debs pa yan chad zhib par mdzad/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma mkhas blangs pa'i tshul khrims dag dgos pa yin/nged la ni so sor thar ba'i pham lhag sbom po dang bcas pa'i sang ba 'ong ma smong / snang byed nyes byas dang bcas pa'i 'ga' re byung ba rnams bshags sdom dang / 'khor rnams kyang tshul de nyid la sbyor bar mdzad/khyad par du phyis su rje bla ma dang / bla ma red mda' ba dang / lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang gsum gnam rtse lding du gdan 'dzom/ sde snod 'dzin pa du mas thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun drug brgya lhag tsam gyis dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes nas/ chos rje gsum kas kyang / bstan pa rin po che dag ther rnam par dag pa zhig mdzad par dgongs shing / de yang ji srid du rgyal ba'i nang mdzod 'dul ba rdzogs par yod pa de srid du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod la/ de med na med par gsungs pa de nyid thugs la snyi bar gyur nas bstan pa 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa thugs kyis 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i bshad pa rgyas pa re gsungs shing / de'i dus su gzhi bcu bdun nas gsungs pa'i bcas pa za mo gig yan chad da lta'i gang zag gi nyams su blang nus tsam rnams dang / rnam 'byed nas 'byung ba'i bcas pa rnams la 'das pa'i ltung ba thams cad rangarang gi ming rigs kyis phyir 'chos pa'i cho ga lja ltar bshad pa bzhin gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa'i srol legs par btsugs te/ de'i 'dul ba gsan pa phal che bas kyang rang rang dag rdotwe ༵ brtags nas/ lhang ba phra rags thams cad bshags yul mang nyung gi bye brag dang /

dngos po spangs pa'i chad las sngon du gtong ba sogs ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du phyag len la btab nas ra bcos mdzad do/ de phyin chad phyag phyi la gnyug mar gnas pa phal che ba nyin re bzhin rang rang gi da la brtags nas skung ba dang yun du mi 'grogs par phyir 'chos pa dang / yo byad byin rlabs rung khang gcod pa/ nub lhag nyal ba bsrung ba sogs kyi phyag len dag la'ang ches brtson par mdzad na/ de tsam du bsgrub mi dka' ba rnams la ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de bas na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar ba'i thang rdzogs par gsos pas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa zhig la 'di ya mtshan pa yin no/ /de'i byir rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ deng sang gi dus na thos bsam pa dag gis thos bsam la brtson pa lhar byed pa'i tshe yang bslab pa'i gzhi la gces spras su byed pa dang / khyad par du yang sde snod 'dzin pa cung zad drag par sgom phyin chad chang dang dus ma yin pa'i kha zas sogs 'chol nyog tu spyod pa la ngo tsha ba'i gnas su byed pa dang / sngon du grwa sa chen po dag gi rab tu byung ba phal che bas kyang /gding ba dang lhang bzed la sogs pa'i dge sbyong gi yo byad dag ngo shes pa'ang dka' bar gyur cing / bla gos dang / mthang gos snam phran glegs bur sbyar ba la sogs pa ni rna bas kyang thos par ma gyur pa las/deng sang kha che dang rgya nag gi bar thams cad dge sbyong gi rtags dang cha lugs rnam par dag pa de lta bu dang / chang dang gyi dro'i kha zas spong ba dang / byin len dang / rung chu dang / nub lhag nyal bsrung ba sogs bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo yan chad la nan tan du byed pa'i dge skyong tshul dang mthun pas khyad par rgyur pa 'di 'dra ba ni/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun rin po che 'di 'ba' zhig gi bka' drin ma yin na/ gzhan gang zhig la brten nas byung bar gyur pa soms shig ces gsungs shing /mkhas pa chen po 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal bas kyang / dus kyi dbang gis dge slong lhod pa'ang mang rabs byung ba na/ rje btsun dam pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis dang por skyor mo lung du mkhan tshen blo gsal ba las 'dul ba legs par bslabs/ sbyis dpen pa'i gnas rnams su sbob pa snying por mdzad pa'ang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa las ma 'das/ gyis 'khor skyong ba'i tshe na'ang drung na 'khod pa thams cad 'dul ba nas ji skad bshad pa'i chos gos gsum dang gding ba dang lhang bzed la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'dzin du bcug jo bo chen po lha gcig gi man ngag la brten nas skyes bu gsum la blo sbyangs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ba'i blos sdom pa thams cad so sor thar ba mtshan nyid pa la bkod/ de dag gi spyan stos la brten nas bod kyi khams 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar rgyur pa yin no/ / zhes don la gnas pa'i bsngags pa brjod par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang theg pa chen por khas 'che ba rnams kyis byang sems kyi tshul khrims dag par ma byas na theg pa chen po ba ming tsam du 'gyur ba dang / gsang sngags la 'jug pa rnams kyang dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba zhig ma byung na ngan 'gro'i sgo 'gyed pa las ma 'das par dgongs nas dga' ba gdong du sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la/ byang sa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ rtsa lhang bcu bzhi ba — 469 —

rnams kyi bshad pa rgyas par brtsal cing / tshul le dang bla ma lnga bcu ba'i rnam bshad/ rtsa sang rna bshad sogs mdzad par brten/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi bsrung sdom la 'bad cing / nyams na byir bcos pa'i rgyun deng sang gi bar du gnas pa yang rje bla ma'i bka' drin du shes par bya'o/ / (2)mkhas pa' bya ba gsum gyis 'azin las sa susadzad tshul/'di la gsum las/ dang po 'chad pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul ni/ mon mkhar bkra shis gdong du bzhugs dus rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar ci rigs gsungs nas/ dka' bgib sher seng gis chos thog gcig la po ti bcu gcig gsungs 'dug dus phyis bod du po ti dus gcig la gsungs pa de mang shos su 'ong ba 'dra gsungs/ de nas dge bshes sha ston sogs drung na 'khod pa kun gyis/ rje nyid nas kyang de tsam zhig dus gcig tu gsung 'tshal zhus pas/ rtsol ba byas na de tsam zhig 'chad thub pa 'dra gsung bar/ slar yang nan gyis gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te/ zla ba di'i tshes bcu nas gnam gang gi bar sku mtshams bcad nas phyag dpe la gzigs rtog mdzad/ gnam gang gi nyin phyag dpe thams cad kyi ska rags bcings/ tshes gcig nas chos 'dzugs par bzhed pa la/gsang phu sogs grwa sa so so nas 'byon pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa mang po sgug dgos byung ste/ nyi ma gsum tsam gyi bar du mar mi sogs kyi gsung rgyun thor bu ba 'ga' gsungs/ tshes lja nas nyi ma gcig la rgya gar skad bco lnga'i dbu dus gcig du btsugs nas/ nyin re bzhin tho rangs nas srod kyi bar la chos thun bco lnga re ma chag par gsung bshad mtshud/ de'i nang nas po ti chung ba gnyis rdzogs par gsungs tshar ba na/de'i dod du slar yang chung ba gnyis btsugs nas/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ phar gyin/ mngon pa gong 'og gnyis/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs lnga/ 'jug pa/bzhi baspya pa/ spyod 'jug ste bstan bcos bcu bdun gyi bshad pa/ dka' chen 'ga' zhig bod kyi ṭīka chen po re gzhir bzhag pa'i thog tu 'grel ba'i 'chad tshul du ma dgag sgrub dang bcas pas gtan la 5ba cing / gzhung gzhan rnams phal che ba rang gi 'grel ba'i steng nas gzhung phra rags ma lus pa la bshad pa zhib par mdzad de/ zla ba gsum la rdzogs par mdzad cing / de'i skabs su yang gsung chos grol nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug la sogs pa thugs dam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor rnams ma chag par mdzad/de'i tshe skye bo kun kyang 'di ni lhag pa'i lhas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig yin par nges kyi gzhan la 'di lta bu 'byung mi srid do/ /zhes mthun par gleng ngo / /'di ni thun mong ba'i rnam thar rnams kyi nang nas phul du byung ba zhig yin te/ snga phyir byon pa'i mkhas pa su la'ang de 'dra'i lo rgyus mi 'dug pas so/ / 4rwa sgrong du mdo sde rgyan dang / dbus mtha'/ kun btus dang / nyan sa la sogs pa gzhung chen mo rnams sdu 7sdung legs par bsgrigs te zhi gnas kyi bshad pa mtha' dag par gsungs shing bsgom du bcug

pas/ 'ga' zhig gi rgyud la gsung rab dang mthun pa'i zhi gnas kyi myong ba khyad par can 'khrungs/bka' gdams pa'i man ngag gi nying khu bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul gyi gdams pa nyams len gyi go rim gsal la 'dril ba dang / don dam byang sems la 'jam dbyangs kyi man hā/ hāsna zlo// ṭā / //ngas/ pas hor ston nam mkha' dpal gyis zin bris su btab pa blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od lhas gu dgon gsar du sde snod 'dzin pa du ma la/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo mtha' dag nyams len dang sbyar te gzhung don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs nas gsungs pas sngon med legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis yid rang dbang med par 'phrogs shing / sngon chad tshad ma ni phyi'i go rgya gcod pa tsam du zad kyi/ nang gi nyams len la mi mkho zer ba sha stag yin pa la/ de nas bzung nyams len ston pa'i bstan bcos mchog tu gyed pa byung / de'i dus kyi gsung la rgyal tshab rin po ches zin bris kyang mdzad/sher phyin gsungs par bzhed nas 'khor rnams la mar me re 'bul ba'i zhal ta gnang bar/ rgyal tshab rjes zangs chen po zhig mar khus bkang ba la sdong bu btsugs nas sbar ba gzigs te rten 'brel khyad par can du dgongs nas/ mar me gzhan thams cad kyang der bsdus/ rje bla ma rang nyid la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis 'doms par mdzad pa'i man ngag bzhin du sher snyin gyi don rnal 'byor ba'i nyams len dang sbyar nas gsungs/ de nyid rgyal tshab rjes zin bris su mdzad nas rnam bshad snying po rgyan zhes snga rabs kyi mkhas pa sus kyang ma thon pa'i legs bshad kyi gter chen po 'di nyid brtsams pa yin no/ /gsang sngags kyi skor yang dga' ldan du dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen dri med 'od rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin sras kyi thu bo ma ṭīka chen mdzad cing / gshed skor gyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung thams cad gung— bsgrigs nas gsungs pa bzhin 'jigs byed bskyed rim chen mo mdzad pa dang / bya rgyud rigs gsum dang / spyod rgyud gsungs pa rnams la 'dul 'dzin gyi yig cha mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang bde gsang gi bskyed rdzogs gsungs pa la slob ma rnams kyis zin bris byas pa'ang mang du bzhugs so/ /(2)gsung gi bdud :sa bskyang tshul/mdo smad du bzhugs dus sku na shin tu phra ba'i skabs su yang mdo sde rgyan 'chad par mdzad cing /bod du phebs nas gnas rnying du mngon pa kun btus bshad pa nas brtsams te 'on gyi lha khang ke rur tsha kho dbon po sogs la phar tshad dbu ma sogs chos mang du gsungs/ bde ba can dang dbus stod bya yul du phar tshad dbu ma/ mngon pa kun btus rnams dang / skyor mo lung / bde ba can/ stod lung mtsho sgad/ ngang dkar srin po ri'i rigs lnga lha khang rnams su sde snod mang du gsungs shing / skyor mo lung gi brag phug tu/ dus 'khor phar tshad dbu ma sogs mang du gsungs/ gnyal stod rab grong du sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la zab spyas kyi chos mang du gsungs pa la lung ra chen mor grags/ 'ol dga' mgar phuga.e'i te'u ra/ nyang po mdangs mdo rnams su chos mang du gsungs/ po ta lar gsang baṭwāṃ 7/nga kasum/

dga' skyon zul gsum gyi gdan sa ba rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i mkhas mang gtso bor gyur pa brgya grag du ma la/ dbu ma snang ba/ 'dul ba/ lam rim la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsungs/ 'di dus saskya'i bstan 'dzin rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan gyis kyang zhabs la btugs te lam rim gsan 'dug na'ang)shākya mchog pa sogs kyis brtsams pa'i rdong ston gyi rnam thar rnams su sa 'og gi gter bzhin mi mngon par byas 'dug dga' ba gdong du byas sa'i tshul khrims le'u/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ rtsa sang bcu bgi ba rnams kyi bshad pa rgyas par bstsal/ rwa sgrong du snga phyir lam rim la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsungs/'bri gung du gu shrī don grub rgyal po dang / 'bri gung lo tsā bganyis kyis gtsos pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa rnamaspol mang du gsungs/ 'on bde chen steng du lam rim gyi khrid dang / dbu tshad kyi dka' ba'i gnad mang po gsungs/ 'ol kha byams pa gling du bskyed rdzogs dang / byang chub lung du sngags kyi lam rim gsungs/se ra chos sdings su sku mtshams kyi khog nas gsang 'dus rim lnga dang / ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim 'ga' zhig gsungs/ se rar dge 'dun drug brgya tsam la/ rtsa shes/ drangs nges rnam 'byed/ bzhi baspya pa/gsang sngags lam rim/ rtsa rtsang rnam bshad dang / bla ma lnga bcu ba sogs zhib par gsungs shing lamorim gyi 'khrid kyang rgyas par gnang / de nas skyid smad grum bu lung du dge 'dun stong phrag 'ongs ba la/lam rim dang bde mchog ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim sogs mang du gsungs/ slar yang se ra chos sdings su lde snod 'dzin pa drug brgya tsam la/ rtsa shes/ tshul khrims le'u/ sgrub thabs kun bzang / lam rim la sogs pa chos mang du gsungs/ zang ri mchin du rgyan snga bsod nams bzang po sogs la lam rim sogs mdo sngags mang du gsungs/ 'ol kha bsam tshogatan gling du chos ci rigs gsungs/ de nas gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan du phyag phebs/ lam rim/ sgron gsal/ rim lnga/ mngon pa kun btus/sa sde dang tshad ma'i dka' gnad sogs mtha' yas pa gnang / slar yang 'on gyi bkra shis do khar sde snod 'dzin pa brgya phrag du ma la dbu tshad lam rim la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs/ de nas yang dge ldan du phebs/ lo grangs du mar gtso bor rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad srol sogs zab chos bgrangs las 'das pa gsungs/ lhag par du gsang ba 'dul ba'i 'grel ba sgron gsal mchan dang bcas pa dang / rim lnga'i 'khrid rgyas pa dang / sbyor drug gi 'khrid rgyas pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen dri med 'od rgyas pa dang / bde mchog gi skor mang po dang / dbu tshad kyi bshad pa dang / lam rim gyi khrid sogs dpag tu med pa gnang / de nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su lde snod 'dzin pa stong phrag gnyis tsam la lam rim gyi khrid/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor nas thub pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad do/ /'di la deb sngon las bstan pa'i bdag po yin pa'i phyir gzhan gyi bshad pa brgya tshar bas/ rje bla ma 'di'i bshad pa lan re yang mi nub pa'i spyal mtshan du gyur to/ / zhes sems dpa' chen po kun bzang bas gsungs/zhesatram̐ byutwe ḍi2 dorjo gnas pa'o/ /

(4)rtsod ba'ilhanas brton ba la bya bsapad pa'i tshul/dgung lo bcu dgu ba'i dus dbus kyi gsang phu dang bde ba can dang / gtsang rong gi sa skya/'dar bzang ldan/ ngam ring 'ga' rong chos sde/ chos grwa chen po e dang gnas rnying rnams su phar phyin gyi grwa skor dang / phyis su sa skya dang / gsang phu dang / rtse thang sogs su dka' chen lhag ma bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad cing / de dag gi tshe lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag du ma'i mdun sar gzhung lugs chen po rnams kyi don brgal brtags kyis gtan la 'bebs par mdzad nas dngos stobs kyi rigs pas rgol ba mtha' dag gi spobs pa bcom zhing / dul ba'i dpal gyis gzur gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams dad pa'i sgru long g.yos te gus 'dud lhar len par gyur/ de dag gi skabs mkhas grags kyis 'dzam gling khyab pa'i dbang gis dus nam du'ang rje bla ma'i mdun sar rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor bshams na'ang rtsod pa 'jug mkhan su yang ma byung / dang po rtsod par 'dod nas 'ongs pa 'ga' zhig kyang zhal mjal nas gsung gi legs bshad thob pa na yid rang dbang med par 'asrog te slob mar gyur ba yang mang ngo /gnam tseng ldeng du bla ma rnams gsum zhal 'dzom nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ karma dkon mchog gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba dang rang re gnyis red mda' ba dang tsong kha ba gnyis dpang du bzhag nas rtsod pa yin/ yang na red mda' ba dang nged gnyis brtsad pas 'thus/ da lam bla ma blo bzang grags pa dang rtsod rgyu med/ khong la snga mo nas byang chub kyi sems bzang po yod pas thub mtha' ngan pa re la'ang chags sdang mi mdzad par 'dug ces tshogs gtam btang bar grags shing / rnam thar zur 'debs rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshos mdzad pa las/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi grags pas gangs can gyi khrod 'dir khyab par gyur te/ karma dkon gzhon lta bu'i blo ya mtshan pa kun gyi'ang gus pas 'khur bar snang ngo zhes gsungs/ de lta na'ang lung rigs kyis sun ma phyung na yang dag pa'i lam gyi gol sar 'gro ba'i log par smra ba rgya bod kyi mkhas par grags pa su dang su'i gzhung na yod kyang mdzes lam gyis btang snyoms su mi 'jog par/ lung dang rigs pa brgya phrag gis sun 'byin par mdzad pa ni rje'i gsung rab rin po che rnams su gsal zhing rgyas pa lta bu sa rngog bu sogs gangs can na mkhas pa'i yang rtse rnams kyi gsung na'ang med pa mngon sum gyis spub la/ de bzhin du rje nyid kyi bzhed pa'i tshul la/ rtog ge la sbyangs pa'i rgol ba dag gis lan brgya phrag gi bar du brgal zhing dpyad na'ang dam bca' las cha tsam yang g.yo bar bgyid mi nus pas/ mkhas grub rjes/ rtog ge la sbyangs rgol ba mtha' dag gis/ / lan brgyar dpyad kyang mgon po khyod kyi gsung / /cha tsam rnam pa gzhan du g.yo ba spangs/ /dag pa'i thugs mnga' khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes gsungs so/ /phyis su rong ston smra ba'i seng ge dang / ngor ba kun bzang dang / go shākya stag lo sogs rang rang gi blo gros gang yod kyis rje'i gsung rab la rgol ba'i yi ge sgog tu mang po bris na'ang / mkhas grub rje dang /phyis kyi kun mkhyen rje btsun pa/ mkhas thub legs chos pa sogs dngos slob dang yang slob rnams kyis — 473 —

lung rigs rdo rje'i me char gyis thal bar brlags nas/ de dag gis spel ba'i dgag gzhag gi thag chulīrnams rang rang gi rnam dpyod kyi yan lag 'ching byed du gyur pa ni/ blo mig can rnams kyi mngon sum gyi yul du snang ba bzhin 'dir grub zin bsgrub pa'i ngal ba ma byas so/ /(5)rtsom pa legs bshadarghaṃ zeng ba sprel bas bstan pa la bya bsgotshod zul/rwa sgrong gi dgon pa gong du jo bo'i sku 'dra dbu yon ma che bar grags pa'i drung du nyin zhag mang po'i bar du gsol ba btab pas/ thub pa'i dbang po nas mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bar gyi bla thobargyud pa rnams dang / khyad par du jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba rnams ba gcig gi bar du gzigs shing gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa'ang mang du bstsal nas mthar po to ba gsum jo bo la thim/ a ti shas spyag gyi bor bzhag nas bstan pa la bya ba spya cher gyis dang / byang chub sgrub pa dang sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs bdag gis kyang bya yi gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/ lam rim brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam mchog sgo 'byed kyang de dus mdzad/ de ltar mtshan ma khyad par can byung bgarten 'brel legs par 'grigs nas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa tshen mo'i rtsom pa mdzad/ slar yang de nyid las/ dgag sbob dang / lung 'dren mang po rnams bzhag nas don gyi snying po gsal bar ston pa'i lam rim chung du mdzad/ de nyid khyad chos lngas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ bshad bya khyad par du 'phags pa rje rang nyid la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis gnang ba'i gdams pa lam gyi gtso gsum la/jo bo'i man ngag skyes bu gsum gyis brgyan pa/ 'chad tshul khyad par du 'phags pa lam gyi gol sa bcad nas ngo bo ma nor ba/ go rim ma 'khrugs pa/ grangs lhag chad med pa/ baspul ba po khyad par du 'phags pa mkhan chen zul gu ba dang / lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang / 'bri gung chos rje la sogs pa/ gnas khyad par du 'phags pa rwa sgrong rgyal ba'i dbeen gnas/ 'khor khyad par du 'phags pa sras kyi thu bo gnyis la sogs pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams so/ /bka' gdams pa'i lam rim mang po yod na'ang / de dag las kyang rje'i lam rim khyad par du 'phags te/ mkhas spub rjes/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdams pa lam gyi rim pa la'ang /gzhung pa dang / gdams ngag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dag gis mdzad pa'i gdams ngag gi yi ge'i rim pa du ma dang / sems dpa' chen po po to ba dang / spyan snga ba dang / 'chad kha ba'i gsung sgros la sogs pa snga sbyi du ma dang / dge bshes chen po mkhas pa lung pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba dge bshes chen po gro lung pa'i bstan rim che chung la sogs de dag thams cad la'ang rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam gyi rim pa/ gsung rab chen mo dag gi rjes su 'brang ba/ dam pa brgyud pa'i gsung gis brgyan pa/mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i 'jug ngogs rmad du byung ba yod mod kyi/ de lta na'ang rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis byang chub lam gyi rim pa che chung gi gdams pa'i gsung rab kyi glesas bam mdzad pa 'di dag la ni/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du 'gro ba'i — 474 —

lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i grangs dang go rim la sogs pa dang / da lta rgyud la skor ba'i dmigs rnams kyi rim pa myong thog tu 'khyer tshul sogs lam gyi lus sbyi dang / yan lag so so thams cad la sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sus kyang ma thon pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i phul du byung ba'i khyad par bla na med pa yod pa'i tshul la blo skyon ma zhugs pa'i dpyod pa zhib par byas nas nges pa rnyed pa dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de'i dus su gnyan chen thang lha dang / zhog lha rgyug po sogs srid pa chags pa'i lha chen dkar phyogs pa du mas kyang mthun rkyen sgrub cing dngos su'ang 'brog pa'i cha byad kyis 'ongs nas zho dang chur ba sogs phul nas/ smon lam du chud pa dgos zhes gsol ba btab par/ lam bzang bsgrigs pa'i mthun rkyen du sgrub cing / / 'gal rkyen sol gyed mi dang mi min kun/ / tshe rabs kun tu rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ / rnam dag lam dang 'bral bar ma gyur cig / ces pa mdzad/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ nged kyi gdams pa'i lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis ma 'thus sam gsungs pa la/ de gtso bor byas te a ti sha'i gdams ngag gis baspyan nas rgyas par bcas pa yin zhus pa sogs kyi lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba'ang yod do/ /tshal gung thang du phar sbyin 'grel ba legs bshad gser gyi 'azeng ba mdzad pas mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog par rgyur te/ stag tshang lo tsā bas kyang legs bshad 'di gzigs nas nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil te rje bla ma la chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa thob cing / khyod blo nyi ma gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ / mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /bdag blo khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes gzu bo'i blos bsngags brjod mdzad do/ /se ra chos rings su rtsa shes kyi rnam bshad mdzad par bzhed pa na/ rigs pa'i gnad phra mo 'ga' zhig thugs la 'char dka' ba byung bas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba drag tu btab pas sher phyin gyi mdo'i stong nyid nyi shu'i 'gres rkang rnams btso ma'i mdog can gyi yi ge bar snang gang ba gzigs pas dogs pa'i gnas lhag cha/ med par thugs su chud de rnam bshad rigs pa'i rgya mtsho mdzad/yang gnas der gsung rab kyi drang nges rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po yang mdzad pa yin la/ 'di'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams ni gzhung lugs mang du thos pa rngog lo dang / sa paṇa dang /bu ston sogs dang / rigs lam la ngal ba mang du bsten pa phywa pa chos seng sogs seng chen brgyad du grags pa dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis mi dman pa kun mkhyen dol bu ba sogs bod du sngon byon gyi mkhas pa sus kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma rtogs pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drin las rje rang nyid kyis gsal bar gzigs nas 'doms par mdzad pa yin te/ bstan bcos de nyid las/ gzhung lugs mang thos rigs pa'i lam du yang / / ngal ba mang bsten mngon par rtogs pa yi/ / yon tan tshogs kyis mi dman du mas kyang / /'bad kyang rtogs paras gyur gsan deni/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i drin gyis legs mthong nas/ shin tu brtse ba'i bsam pas bdag gigabasharda/ / ces gaṭwāṃ~Xs rji ltar

ro/ / (6)sngagasakli gzhung chenapo'i rtsom pasadzad tshul/rgya sog phur bzhugs skabs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ arya de ba/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ klu byangakazla ba grags pa/ thogs med sku mched/ phyogs glang / chos grags/ yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od/lha dbang blo/ rgyan mkhan po/ ka ma la shrī la/ a lha yā ka ra la sogs pa'i pasnyi ta du ma dang / rgyal po ind+ra ཿ ti/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ slob dpon lca i pa/ dril bu pa/ nag po spyod pa la sogs pa'i grub chen du ma'i sku'i snang ba dngos su gzigs/ nyams snang la gtad pa med las che dgongs nas rje btsun la zhus pas/ nyams snang rang ga ba min pas gsol ba drag po thob/ 'di rnams kyi gzhung la brten nas rang gzhan la phan thogs rgya chen po 'ong ba'i rten 'brel yin/ zhes gsungs/ byis 'od de gung rgyal gyi lha zhol byams pa gling na bzhugs dus/ rje btsun gyi gsung gi gnang bas slob dpon klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim pa la rnam bshad rtsoms/ phan thogs chen po 'ong zhes bskul bas de 'phral du mdzad/de yang spyir rim lnga'i don dang / khyad par rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu lus sgrub tshul sogs dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang / 'phags pa yab sras lnga'i gzhung nas 'byung ba'i don thun mong ma yin pa rnams dpyis phyin pa zhig legs par go nas de dus lo bcu lhag song ba la de bar du ma smras/ de nas zur tsam smras pa yin zhes gsungs/ gnas der lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos bskul ba dang /khyad par du dpal phag mo gru pa'i spyal tshab spyan snga bsod nams bzang pos bskul ba la brten nas rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po rdo rje 'chang gi lam rim chen po'ang mdzad cing / rje rang gi zhal nas/ sngar rgya sog sur grub chen rnams dang / ayobha ya'i gzhung la brten nas phan pa chen po 'thub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa de ma gastogs rtsom pa rang gi skabs su dus myur che/ gsol ba 'debs pa sogs yun ring ma grub pas rgyu mtshan khyad par ba gzhan cher med ces gsungs/ 'ol kha'i bsam gtan gling na bzhugs pa'i ring la sku mtshams dam po bcad nas bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad pa la gsol 'debs shugs drag mang du mdzad cing / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim lnga gsal sgron mdzad pa'i thugs 'dun btang / zin bris 'debs pa mdzad pa'i dus su mnal lam ngo mtshar can byung ba ni/ byā ghra'i gong gi tsand+ra ni/ zhes sogs yin la/ de dag gi don zhib par gsang rnam las shes par bya zhing / de'i don gyi snying po ni/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang /'khor lo bde mchog gi man ngag rje 'dis gsal bar mdzad pa'i ltas so/ /gsal sgron du/ gsol ba ring du btab pas gzhung rtsom par gnang baphyi mtshan ma khyad par can brnyed nas/ zhes dang / gdan rdzogs kyi khrid yig tu'ang / 'dod pa'i mtshan ma brtan po rnyed/ces gsung pa'ang / don de nyid la dgongs pa'o/ / don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas/ gnas der gsang 'dus rim lnga gsal sgron zhes bya ba legs par bshad pa'i gter chen po de nyid dang / rim lnga — 476 —

/ktashā ṭwāṃ /kā ṭī // ༵/sa da rdodza /da/ bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus pa dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus gdan sa chen po dga' ldan du/ gsang 'dus 'grel ba sgron gsal gyi 'gyur la dag ther zhib tu mdzad nas tshig don zhib tu 'chad pa'i mchan du/ le'u so so dang spyi'i dka' gnas la mtha' gcod/don tshan so so'i dmigs 'byed pa'i bsdus don rnams mdzad cing / bde mchog skor la lca i pa'i mngon rtogs/ de'i rnam bshad 'dod 'jo/ rtsa rgyud kyi ṭī ka sprus don kun gsal/ rdzogs rim chen mo rgyas bsdus/ rdzogs rim sbas don lta ba'i mig 'byed sogs kyi yig cha mang du mdzad do/ /rje bdag nyid chen pos gsung rtsom mdzad pa rnams ni/ gang 'dod du mdzad pa ma yin par bshad ma thag pa ltar/ thub chen rnams kyi sku'i snang ba gzigs pa sogs bstan 'gror phan pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzigs/ rje btsun gyis de dang de rtsom par bskul nas mdzad pa sha stag ste/ bstan bcos che ba lta zhog byams bstod tshangs pa'i cod paṇa dang / rin po che gsal ba'i sgron me/ bde ba can gyi smon lam rnams kyang don gyi ngo bo go rim sogs 'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pas so/ /bshad ma thag pa'i gzhung che ba de dag tu/ rim gnyis kyi gnad rnams bla med kyi rtsa rgyud rnams na sbas pa 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung la brten nas/ rtsa bshad legs par sbyar ba'i khongs nas thon pa'i gdams pa rmad du byung ba bod kyi mkhas grub sus kyang spyod yul du ma gyur pa rnams gsal bar mdzad de/sgron gsal gyi mchan bur/ dpal ldan 'dus pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ / sbas don gsal ba'i klu sgrub man ngag gis/ /rgyud rgyal gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang / /rigs lam phra mo 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /srub thag bzang pos dkris pa'i bshad rgyud kyi/ /srubs shing mchog gis yang yang bsrubs paglus/ /tshig gi zur phyin don gyi gnad gsal ba/ /sngon chad phyogs 'dir mngon du ma gyur pa'i/ /cug don bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa rnyed/ /ces gsungs shing / bde mchog gi rdzogs rim dngos grub snye mar yang / grub thob chen po'i rdzogs rim/ shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas/ / sngon chad phyogs 'dir rtsa bshad kyi/ /rgyud sdes legs par ma bkral ba/ / bdag gis brtson pa chen po yis/ /ring du 'bad las rnyed gyur pa/ /ding 'dir bshad par bya yi nyon/ /zhes gsungs so/ des na mkhas thub rjes/ phyogs 'dir sngon chad gzhan gyis ma myong ba'i/ / lam gyi mthar thug rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad/ /ji bzhin gzigs nas de don sgrub pa la/ /nyams len snying por mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa don la gnas yin gyi/ snyan ngag gi rab btags lta bu ma yin no/ /'o na de lta bu'i rim gnyis kyi zab gnad de gang zhe na/ bskyed rim la ye shes kyis bsgom pa nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar gyi dmigs skor de lta bu yang rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub chen gyis bkral ba'i sgrub thabs kyi don dpyis phyin pa bod kyi bla ma snga ma sus kyang ma thon pa mang du yod cing / khyad par du rdzogs rim la lus dpen nas brtsams te mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs tshul gyi dī~X ḍi lam gyi

rim pa re re la'ang legs bshad thun mong ma yin pa du ma dang / lhag par yang stong bzhi'i rlung sems sgyu ma'i sku bsgrub tshul zad du byung ba 'phags pa yab sus kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar mdzad dzi'adi lta bu/ mar 'gos dang / sa skya gong ma rnams dang / bu ston thabs cad mkhyen pa sogs kyi gsung rab na'ang mi gsal na/ gzhan dag la smos kyang ci dgos/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis rje yabasramikyi gsung rab rnams la ring du 'dris par byas nas khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams mthong ba na da gzod chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa skyes par gyur te/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i rnam thar las/ po tā lar chos rje'i zhal nas/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mngon rtogs ljon shing las/'di dag ston pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /bka' drin dran pas dad pa'i mchi ma lhangs/ /rtag tu bla ma rab mchog de dag gi /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ rje btsun chen po dang rje rin po che'i rgyud tshod ni nged rang tshes dpag par mi nus/brtsam chos ni/ mngon rtogs ljon shing dang / rim lnga gsal sgron gnyis khyad par chen po dpag tu med pas/ 'di dag ston pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' drin dran pas mchi ma lcang na/ rim lnga gsal sgron la ltung rgyu yin te/ legs par 'chad mkhan dkon pa 'dug bstan pa'i 'jug sgo rnam dag cig 'dug ste/ 'jug mkhan mi 'dug nged rang gi thabs ni 'dir song gsungs nas gsung 'dar/ spyan chab bton pas nang so dpon g.yog kun spyang spyan chab shor/ zhes 'byung ba ltar rdo/ /de nas stag tshang lo tsā bas kyang / mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje theg /khyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med don/ / rim gnyis mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces bstod pa mdzad pa'ang gzur gnas rnam daphyod can gyi ngang tshul yin par snang ngo / /zhib par ni rje'i gsung rab rnams la ring du 'dris par byas pa las shes par 'argyur gyi/ bdag lta bus ji ba'in brjod pa'i rngo mi thogs/ dge lugs pa'i bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba dag gis rje'i legs bshad thun mong ma yin pa rnams ngos zin pa tsam re ma mthar dgos rgyur 'dug rung / deng sang gi bstan 'dzin chon po'i go sar bzhugs pa phal che ba rnams ni dbu zhwa'i kha dog kho nas chog shes mdzad par snang ngo / /sa mo glang gi lor lha sar cho 'phrul mchod pa mdzad cing / de nas rgyal bas lung bstan pa bzhin shāṭwāṃ/ /ri chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas der yun ring po'i bar du chos kyi 'khor lo dgung lo re gsum pa sa mo phag gi lo la dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du skya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa mdzad cing / dga' ldan byams pa'i mdun du rgyal sras 'jam darshal snying po zhes bya bar sku'i skye ba bzhes pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga no zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs paratram̐ tshatwe /8 bar tshad ma'i lung las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /

de ltar rje bla ma'i sku che ba'i yon tan brjod pa 'di dag ni rnam thar kyi yi ge rnams dang / tshad ldan gsung las mthong thos su gyur pa gces gces rigs sna 'ga' tsam bkod pa yin la/ de yang dus kyi mtha' 'dir bod smongs su bstan pa rnam par dag pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul gtso bor byas te bris pa yin pas/ 'gangs che ba'i rnam par thar ba 'dir ma thon pa 'ga' zhig kyang mchis pa rnams gzhan du shes par byas nas dad pa bsgom par bya'o/ / zhib tu brjod pa ni lho brag grub chen la phyag na rdo rjes/ ma ti bha dra'i yon tan gyi mtha' nga lag na rdo rjes kyang rtogs par mi nus so/ /zhes rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa phyag na rdo rjes kyang mtha' dpag mi nus par gsungs na gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ rnam par thar ba'i gtso bo ni/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshos rje rin po che'i rnam thar zhus par/ rje'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ rnam thar gyi gtso bo chos rab tu rnam 'gyed kyis chos zab mo thams cad thugs su chud cing / dngos stobs kyi rigs pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad thugs su chud pa 'di yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang / yang rje 'di nyid kyis sngags mtshan nyid kyi phyogs rnams gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs su rgyab rten tshad ma can gyis spub par mdzad pa ni/ sems dpa' chen po 'di'i rnam par thar ba phul du gyin pa'i don gyi gtso bo yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / mdor na bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i spub mtha'i rnam bzhag chen mo las/ rje bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gig mchis kyang / de thams cad kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ni rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs pa'i don shing rta chen po rnams kyis tshul ji ltar gye ba rnams so sor ma 'dres par lung dang rigs pa dri ma med pa'i sgo nas 'khrul ba'i cha shas phra mo tsamayang med par rang gis nges shing / gzhan dag la 'doms par mdzad pas thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gyis nor 'dzin gyi khyon khyab par mdzad pa 'di kho na yin no/ /zhes blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /des na rje btsun 'di nyid kyis 'dul ba'i phyag len phra mo yan chod nas grub pa'i mtha' chen po rnams kyi bar dang / sngags kyi'ang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang lag len phra mo yan chad nas rgyud kyi 'grel ba chen po rnams kyi bar mtha' dag gang la'ang rung ste sla chos dang rang bzo'i nyes pas nam yang ma gos par rang rang gi srol 'byed pa po'i paṇa grub rnams kyi dgongs pa la gtugs shing / de yang rgyal ba'i bka' la legs par gtugs te/ gnad phra mo re la'ang lung rigs du mas dpyad de nges pa ster bar mdzad pa dang / tshul des bstan pa thams cad 'galab med par gcig grogs su gcig 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du bsgrigs par mdzad pas/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa gnyis char 'dzin cing spel bar mdzad pa'i rnam par thar ba 'di lta bu ni sngon byon pa'i gangs can gyi mkhas grub su la'ang med par ma zad rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi 'phags pa klu sgrub lta bu la'ang 'di bas lhag pa~X ṭwāṃd tram̐bs

med par rigs pa'i tshul dri ma med pas 'grub pa yin no/ /de'i gyir che ge mo dang ga ge mo zhig gis lung bstan pa'i skyes bu yin no zhes gzhan gyi lung bstan tsathol skyabs 'cha' ba'i rnam par thar ba dang 'dra ba'i go skabs ga la yod/ yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa du ma brnyes pa sogs las kyang bshad ma thag pa'i rnam par thar ba nyid gtso bo yin no/ /rje bla ma rang nyid kyis/ dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ / zhes thog ma kho nar rgyal ba'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i shing rta chen po rnams kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la 'ol spyi tsam dang phyogs re tsam ma yin par zhib tu thos pa rgya cun po btsal ba'i tshul dang / de la brten nas 'dul ba kā ri kā nas dpal ldan 'dus pa'i bar gyi mdo dang bstan bcos mtha' dag gang zag gcig 'tshang spya ba'i lam gyi gtso bo dang yan lag ci rigs par 'du ba'i tshul gyis gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba dang / de ltar shar ba'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa la dus rtag tu sgrub pa lhur len pa'i tshul gyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten nas lam gyi gnad la rigs pa dri ma med pa'i sgo nas myong stobs kyis nges pa drangs pas/ mi 'phyugs pa'i gzer thebs pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag pa ni bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du 'khyer shes pa'i mdzad pa spyi dang / khyad par du rje nyid kyi mdo sngags kyi gsung ba 'di dag yin te/ 'di dag la ci tsam brtags kyang ma 'bril ba dang / zlos pa dang / 'gal ba dang / tshad thub kyi gzhung las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i than ka 'byung ba'i gnas rdul tsam yang med par mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar te/ gsung 'di ni rnam thar gyi sdom khyad par du 'phags pa gig tu snang ngo / /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ mkhas sgrub smra ba'i nyi mas/ mtha' yas smon lam stobs mnga' thabs mkhas kyis/ / 'bad med lhun grub mtha' yas gdul bya'i tshegs/ / rgyal ba dgyis pa'i lam la khrid mdzad pa/ / 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshig sbyi'i bshad sgrub rtags kyi dge sbyong gis/ / thub bstan ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i tshe/ / bslab gsum lung rtogs rgyal ba'i dam chos kund+ra/snyi / khyod /sna nyin modī mdzadasdu gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes don gnas kyi bsngags pa'i me stog dad pa' sna ༵kā ṭā/ra baṭwāṃ shāṭwāṃ kākā tām/saspyi grangs 'dren/rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'di la slob ma yang sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrimasari la gnas nas skyes bu gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor lhur len cing / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bgi'i ja bo che brgyud mar sgrogs pa'i mkhas pa nam mkha'i dbyings su skar tshogs bkra ba'am/ nor 'dzin la skang 'thung 'khrigs pa'arda/ 4༵༵dpro 'i shing la me tog gis brgyan pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa'i nang nas gtso

che ba 'ga' zhig brjod na/ bla ma chos 'brel gsan pa bzhi ni/ dbu ma ba brtson 'grus seng ge mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ bra gor mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po'o /bya bral la ma beebs gong gi sras snga tshar bzhi ni/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa/ mdo stod pa grags pa blo gros/ ldong ston ston shrī/ dge bshes sha ston rnams so/ /phyi tshar gyi 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad ni/ bla ma 'jam dkar ba zhes grags pa 'jam dpal chos bzang / gnas brtan bzang skyong ba/ gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan/ gnas brtan byang seng ba ste dbus pa bzhi/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ dge bshes shes rab grags/ dge bshes 'jam dpal bkra shes/ dge bshes dpal skyong ba ste mdo smad pa bzhi dang brgyad do/ / de dag kyang lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing yi dam lhas rjes su bzung ba sha stag go/sras kyi thu bo gnyis zhes grags pa ni/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa dar ma rin chen dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'bri gung ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/gsang bdag gis lung bstan pa'i 'khor khyad par du 'phags pa gsum ni/ sras kyi thu bo gnyis dang bla ma 'jam dkar ba yin zhes gsungs/bka' ṭwāṃrdo shā/ ༵ ṭwāṃ shāspra ṭwāṃ// /pu /ni/ mkhas thub thams cad mkhyen pa yin te/ rje'i bstan pa la 'azin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi ni/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mtshungs med chos rje gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po/ rje btsun shes rab seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub po/ /dbus gtsang bstan pa'i sgron me bcu ni/ gsang phu ba chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims/ gnyal rgod rin chen bsam 'grub/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa bzang po/ gsang phu ba rgyal dbang kha che/gnyal chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal/ chos rje blo gros chos skyong / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan seng ge snar thang ba rab mchog rnams so/ /gzhan don lhan gyis spub pa'i sems dpa' drug ni/ byang sems rwa sgring ba shākya bsod nams/byang sems kun dga' bzang po/ byang sems bde mo thang ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byang sems tshul ṭwāṃm/ sa/ dpal bzang / byang soms gzhon nu rgyal mchog byang sems rgyal mtshan grags bzang rnams mi dbang gtsug na mjes pa'i ti shrī gnyis ni/ byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes dang / byang dar ma'o/ rgya chen mang du thos pa'i dbon sras gnyis ni/ ma cig dbon po nam mkha' dpal dang / yar rgyab dbon po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'o/ / — 481 —

dgartoṣas ༷/'i /shā /sa 'dzin pa'i cog che chung gnyis ni/ zha lu ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ chos rje zha tsob — rdosdu sa dkāwa rdel / ༵/kā/ ba'i mkhas pa gnyis ni/ mus sud pa blo gros rin chen seng ge dang / zhang zhung pa bzlo ༵ zlo baṃ/ ༵ ṭwāṃr rā/nga/ ba'i dar chen drug ni/ stod sher bzang / smad sher bzang / gu ge dnghakā bye~Xng/ /grags pa/ lho ba rgyal mtshan seng ge bla ma dpal ldan shes rab/ bla ma yon tan dpal ba stag lusdi kā //༵spra / ba/'i lo tsā ba gnyis ni/ 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal ba'am yid bzang rtse ba darda /sa skyong chos rje drug ni/ rin po che dpal ldan bzang po/ rin po che bsod nams bzang po/rin po che byang chub rdo rje/ rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan nam nyer gnyis pa/ 'bri gung rin po che don thub rgyal po/ stag lung rin po che bkra shis dpal 'od rnams so/ /gsung rab mang du mkhyen pa'i bstan 'dzin brgyad ni/ 'brom ston sher 'byung blo gros/ rgyal ba rin chen bsam 'thub/ byang gling ba grags pa rin chen/ mnga' ris pa bsod nams rin chen/trī~X dī / padnghadī ṭwāṃspya ṭwāṃkā gākā kātsha/na// gu ge sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/mdo rong gi mkhas pa bzhi ni/ mdo snad pa 'od zer/ mdo snad pa legs bzang / mdo snad bsod nams shes rab/ rdong po rtse nag rnams so/ /chen da~Xtrī kā ṭwāṃd/ gru/ ba pa'i gdung brgyud gnyis ni/ spre zhing rin po che byang chub dpal ba dang / rin nams sdi sdo sdu nam ༈/na/ can gnyis ni/ skyes mchog smon lam mtha' yas dang / ri mi 'bab pa bsod spyan snga baspyad ni/ spyan snga kun dga' blo gros/ spyan snga gzhon nu 'od/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga dpal bzang ba/ spyan snga nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga bsod nams lhun grub/spyan snga rin chen rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga rin chen 'phel ba rnams so/ /khri steng mdzes pa'i bla chen bzhi ni/ gung thang ba chos rje mdzis pa dpal/ nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan/stag phu gu shrī dpal ldan don grub/ te'u ra ba chos rje dpal rnams so/ /tshogs pa skyong ba'i mkhan po bzhi ni/ skyor mo lung mkhan chen chos rgyul dpal bzang / phag mo gru pa'i masdun chen spyas bzang ba/7 mkhan chen kun dga' rdo rje/ spyan g.yas mkhan po byang chub dpal ba rnamarjo sa/48/2 —

sde dgon khra mo'i chen po lnga ni/ chen po grags pa bzang po/ chen po dwags po 'od zer seng gechen po blo gros 'phel/ chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chen po bkra shis rgyal mtshan rnams so/ /dbang bskur ba'i chos sgo ba gnyis ni/ gdan sa mthil gyi chos sgo ba 'jam dbyangs kha che purtse shrī dang / 'bri gung chos sgo ba bkra shis rin chen no/ /'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan bsring ba'i slob dpon bzhi ni/ slob dpon brtson 'aspus grags pa//sdu ṭā byi/na /legs ldan pa/ slob dpon stag leb byang chub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon byang chub dpal ba rigs pa tha ba'i dka' bcu ba bzhi ni/ dka' bcu pa dar ma bzang po/ 'ba' ser dka' bcu pa/ co tsa dka' bcu ba yon tan rgyal mtshan/ lhu la dka' bcu ba legs pa dpal rnams so/ /tshig don 'dzin pa'i dka' bzhi ba bcu ni/ mthil chung dka' bzhi ba don yod/ brag dgon dka' bzhi ba rin chen dpal/ rgyal ba dka' bzhi ba rin chen chos rgyal/ gye re dka' bzhi ba sangs rgyas dbang rgyug stag phu dka' bzhi ba sangs rgyas bzang po/ g.yag sde dka' bzhi ba bsod nams bzang po/ gro ba dka' bzhi ba/ mtshur phu ba dka' bzhi ba/ dka' bzhi ba chos seng / dka' bzhi ba grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams so/ /baspyol zhugs 'dzin pa'i jo gdan bzhi ni/ jo gdan zla ba blo gros/ jo gdan bsod nams lhun grub/ jo gdan legs rin pa/ kong po jo gdan rnams so/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gnas brtan drug ni/ gnas brtan chos bzang pa/ gnas brtan rgyal sdings pa don thub dpal/ gnas
