brtan spya ma ba dge 'dun rgyal po/ gnas brtan 'od zer bkra shis/ gnas brtan gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ gnas brtan kun dga' 'bum rnams so/ /tshe blos btang gi rtogs ldan lnga ni/ ku cor rtogs ldan sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rtogs ldan /kṣiṃ ༵rdzuṭwāṃ / /// rna// ṭwāṃ/ga/ chos rje grags pa 'byung gnas/ rtogs ldan ral zhig pa/ bu le ba nam gzhan yang lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtsho/ rgya ston blo bzang grags pa/ drung gzhon nu dpal ba/mkhan po bsam rgyal ba/ bla ma gser thub pa/ yar sdings rin po che/ zhi blo dpon po/ drung nam mkha' ba/ bla ma mgon po byang chub/ bla ma bsod rin/ drung chos 'phags pa/ bla ma shāka rin pa/bla ma zla ba bzang po/ bla ma chos rgyal mtshan/ rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes rnams so/ /de dag las 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon bzhi ma gtogs pa rnams yid kyi mdzes rgyan ltar bris pa yin la/der ma gsal ba yang 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ snar thang mkhan chen bsod nams mchog kub/ zul phu ba mkhan chen dkon mchog dpal bzang / rgyal ba grags pa bkra shis/ bla ma kun bzang rin chen/ bla ma bsod dbang / 'jam dbyangs rdorashaṃ na4/ 83rgya 1 rin

sdi che kund+ra nd+rasduX rdo ṭwāṃs/ chos rje rgyal mtshan grags bzang / bya btang rin chen bzang po/ gtsang pa — bzaṭwāṃdo / ༵ wa rteng/ /bde gung gsum/ dga' skyor zul gsum/ lo bya yul rin tshen sgang gsum/rgyal glang thang gro pa gsum/ rwa sgrong 'chad kha skyel bu gsum/ 'bri stag tshal gsum/ e gnyal stag gsum gyi chos dpon/ thang po che sogs g.yor phyogs kyi chos dpon rnams kyis de dus rje rin po che'i zhabs drung du ma gtugs pa mi snang ngo / /de yang gong du smos pa thams cad ni lung rtogs dang / rigs rus dang / go sa mtho ba'i chen po rnams kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ dman pa dang bar ma chos kyi 'azel ba rgya cher mnos pa dang / chos 'brel tsam thob pa ni lo re'i nang du'ang bgrang du med do/ /sbyin bdag gi dbang du byas na sne'u gdong gong ma chen po/ gzhis ka sne'u rdzong ba/ gzhis ka brag dkar ba/ rgya ma khri dpon/ yar lung jo bo/ 'ol dga' rdzong dpon/ rdzing phyi grags pa rin po che/sgom pa chos rgyal/ stod lung dbon yon tan rgya mtsho/ rin spungs pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs dbus gyi che dgu thams cad kyis zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ rnyed pa dang / bkur stis mchod par mdzad cing / stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gong ma yung lo chen pos kyang spyal sa ru gdan 'dren pa'i snyan gsan sngul/ /te/ bdog pa'i dngos po du mas mchod cing / gser gyi lung gis bsngags pa brjod par mdzad gangs can gyi rdzongs 'dir rang rang gi grub mtha'i srol phye ste rang rkya thub par mdzad pa mang du byung 'dug na'ang / rje tsong kha pa chen po gangs can 'dir phebs pa ni/ ji ltar bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi khams su byon pa dang chos mtshungs pa zhig byung ste/ sku na phra mo'i dus karma ba rol ba'i rdo rjes dge bsnyen du bsgrubs nas/ dbus gtsang du phebs na thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la thub pa dang mtshungs pa'i 'phrin las 'byung zhes chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las bshad cing / tsa rir byon dus mo la'i la rtsar rje btsun byams pa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod sangs trīpa trīji/ ga/ rten du byon pa lta bu 'ong ba shes par gyis shig ces rje bla ma nyid la gsungs pa de de bzhin du de nas dpal yid bzang rtse bo chen pos deng dus sa chen po 'di rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gdugs dkar sdo /gci/ ga gis khyab par byas nas yod pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar don la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod bzhi ba/ bu slob de rnamosaspyos bstan pa rgyas par mdzad tshul/dngos kyi slob ma de thams cad dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyi mthu grub pa sha stag yin pa'i dbarji gi~X8/ 4 so so'i sku che ba'i yon tan dang / bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab

pas/ de thams cad bdag lta bus brjod par ga la nus/ 'di ni gtso bor gyur pa re gnyis tsam kyis rje'i ring lugs rgyas par mdzad tshul bshad na/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab rje/'dul 'dzin pa/ mkhas spub rje/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ byams chen chos rje/ rje shes rab seng gepaṇa chen dge 'dun thub rnams ni bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas dbus gtsang du rje'i mdo sngags kyi ring shāg/sa/ dar rgyas mdzad pa po dang / sher bzang gnyis ni bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i gtso bor snang khri la ba~Xwa/ shā sa/'izul tshab thams cad mkhyen pa dang mkhas grub tha ba'i seng ge gnyasarje bla ma'i chosashā de dag las rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa dang / mkhas grub smra ba'i seng ge gnyis rje bla ma'i chos kyi khri la rim bzhin bzhugs nas dge ldan bstan pa'i skang 'dzugs par mdzad pa yin te/ rgyal tshab rin po che la/ rje mya ngan las 'da' khar sku beer/ dbu paṇa gnang ste gdan sar bzhugs par don gyis go bar mdzad pa bzhin 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs bu slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa bzhin mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la dbang bskur/ mkhas spub rjes dpal ldan yon tan du ma'i bsngags brjod dang / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis snyan ngag kun bzang 'khor lo rmad du byung bas bstod pa mdzad/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i rnam thar bzhin du/ 'dul ba'i 'chad nyan dang gzhi gsum gyi phyag len sogs rnam par dag pa dang / des gzhi bzung nas mngon pa gong 'og tshad ma/ phar phyin/ dbu ma sogs mdo phyogs dang / gsang sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang bde dus 'khor kyi rdor 'jigs byed rnams kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa rim gnyis kyi khrid sogs/mdor na bod snga ma dag gi blo'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i rje bla ma'i legs par bshad pa mtha' dag rang gi nyams myong dang lung rigs dri ma med pas lo bcu gsum gyi bar du 'chad par mdzad pas rje'i dngos slob phal che ba dang / skal ldan rnam daphyod can mtha' dag rang dbang med par yid 'phrogs te rje rin po che dang khyad par med pa'i gus 'dud mdzad par brten/ pha rjes bus zin pa rje'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa skang tshugs par gyur/de rjes mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa gdan sar bzhugs nas rnam par thar ba de bzhin du nyams pa med par bskyangs/ khyad par du rje'i gsung gi zur phra mo re tsam yang gzhan dang ma 'dres par gsungs shing / gzhan phyogs nas rje'i gsung rab la rgol ba rtsom pa'i lugs su byed pa mtha' dag rigs pas tshar bcad par ma zad/ chos rje gung ru ba sogs rje bdag nyid chen pos lta ba'i dpyad pa ma rdzogs gong gi gsung sgros thos pa la brten nas stong nyid ma yin dgag tu 'chad pa dang / gzhan yang lta ba'i nges shes skyong tshul sogs la rje'i bzhed par ma song ba'i 'chad tshul byed pa thams cad kyang sun phyung nas/ rje bla ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i mdo sngags kyi ring lugs gri ma dang bral bar mdzad pas bstarda pa ༵༵ la hūṃka'

drin 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying bo ni/ rje bla ma'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig yin pa dang / de nibod dbus rang du skang tshugs pa zhig yod pa rang gi las su bya ba'i gtso bo'o snyam du khur gyis bzhes pas/mnga' ris dang / khams sogs nas chos bar la 'byon pa'i gsol ba nan tu btab pa dag la'ang 'asnyon pa'i zhal bzhes tsam yang ma gnang bar snang ste/ dge bshes sher bzang la gnang ba'i chab shog yab rje dam pa'i bka' srol zla med pa/ / yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa'i khur chen ni/ / shin tu snyi bas bdag snying ci yang non/ /'on kyang ngal ba'i 'du shes mchis ma lags/ /de phyir sngon chad thub bstan nyi ma'i 'od/ / gang du bral ba'i mtha' 'khob mun gling du/ / dri med bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzugs pa la'ang / /bdag ni nam yang zhum pa ma mchis mod/ /de lta na yang gangs can bstan pa'i gzhi/ /skyes mchog du mas gang du btsugs pa'i gnas/ / da lta'ang dam chos ma lus 'byung ba'i khungs/ / dbus gtsang dag pa'i ging zhes grags mod kyi/ / legs par brtags na bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam/ /'di yang snum zad mar me ji bzhin gyur/ / thub pa'i gces mdzod gang yin rtsa ltar 'dor/ / blo ngan log pa'i gzhung lugs nyin bzhin 'phel/ /rang dgar spyod pa bdud kyi pho nya ni/ /mang pos bkur ba'i bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin pa/ /bstan pa'i spyal mtshan bsnyil la cher brtson pa'i/ /dpung tshogs du mas mtha' gru kun tu khyab/ /tshul 'dir gyur kyang blo gros mig ldan pa/ /chos min 'byed la ma zhum pa'i/ /bstan pa'i khur khyer bshes gnyen ches cher dkon/ /de bas de rjes 'jug pa'ang shin tu dkon/ /tshul 'di yid la shin tu brnag dka' nas/ / bdag kyang 'bad pa du mas bstan pa'i khur/ / yab rje dam pa'i ring lugs yongs rdzogs pa/ /phyogs 'dir 'dzin la blo gros shin tu 'chel/ /phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i rdzon shing rtsa ba nas/ /chos min nyes bshad sta res bcad pa na/ /lan cig yal ga cung zad byogs gzhan du/ / 'phel yang dgos pa chung bar bdag gis mthong / / da lta phyogs 'dir chos min dpung tshogs dgra/ / legs bshad bstan pa'i ru mtshon kho bos 'dzin/ / de phyir kho bos phyogs 'dir btang ba na/ / thub pa'i gces mdzod su yis 'dzin pa smos/ / de phyir khyed cag lhag bsam dge mod kyi/ /bdag gis khyed kyi ji ltar bzhed pa'i don/ /khas blangs bgyid pa'i dam bca' rngo mi thogs/ /zhes pa'i bka' lan smrings par mdzad du gsol/rje bla ma'i bshad srol thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun chad kyis dogs nas gsang sngags kyi dka' ba'i gnad mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu gzhan la mang du spel na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad yod pa dag kyang / sku srog la mi lta bar bstan pa kho na thugs la brnag pas 'chad pa dang rtsom pa'i sgo nas gsal bar mdzad pa la/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i zhal nas/ sngags bshad tsa na mkha' 'gro rnams kyis snying khrag 'pho ba tsam gyi sdug bsngal yod par snang / 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos mi bcu bdun la brtag gnyis gsungs ༵ ༵/ /'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis mi btang nas/ khyod rdo rje'i tshe srog yod pa e yin gsungs

nas bka' bkyon gnang / mkhas grub rin po ches sku tshe blos btang nas sngags 'chad pa 'dug pa gsungs zhes rnam thar las byung ngo / / smra ba'i seng ge 'di nyid yab rje'i ring lugs gangs kyi ri bor gnas bcas ṭwāṃ/ trīng rigs gyi gad rgyangs kāsang rimathor bsgrags pas/ log par smra ba'i wa skyes /sdosdo ṭwāṃ kā trībyesdo rnyi byetrī / trī/ dī ra/ mdī/ sdo /'a/ na ci dwags tshogs rnams mgon dang ldan par gyur te/rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyi rnam thar zhib tu gzhan las shes par bya'o/bzhugashā sbyiṭwāṃm/thu stobs nus ba'i dbang skug zha lu ba legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dang rje blo gros chos skyong khrirade nes mthu stobs nub pa'i dbang myug zha lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan dang / de nas rje blo gros chos skyong gser khrir bzhugs/ 'di nyid rgyud sde gyi dang khyad par dus 'khor la mkhas par ṭīka chen gyi kha skong brtsams/ de nas mkhas grub gcung ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho bsten nas rje'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i bdag por gyur/ lta khrid dang / dus 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs sogs mdzad/ de nas rje blo gros brtan pa ste/ 'dis dwags po grwa tshang btab pa'i rje'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa byogs der dar rgyas kyi dbu tshugs/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel chen dang / byams chos gzhan bzhi'i ṭī ka/ rnam 'grel lam bsgrigs sogs legs bshad mang du brtsams/ de nas rje smon lam dpal ba gser khrir bzhugs/ 'di yan chad la 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud du grags la/smon lam dpal bas rje'i zhabs ma zin kyang mnal lam du rje'i zhal mjal nas chos gsan pas dngos slob trī gradris su 'dren par 'aspyag khu ston gyi skye bar zhal gyis bzhes/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭīka chen brtsams pa nga ḍi zlotrī nā sbyiṭwāṃ rshasnashā/rabs/rgyal tshab rin po che'i rjes su hor ston nam mkha' dpal ba sogs dang / shar rtse'i gdan sa ni/shar ba rin chen spyal mtshan/ dbon zla grags sogs mkhan brgyud rim par byon pa yin la/byang rtse grwa tshang dang / nyag rong grwa tshang gnyis ni/ mkhas thub rin chen khrir bzhugs skabs bshad grwa'i slob dpon bzhi bsgos 'chad nyan mdzad pa rjes su gnyis su 'dril nas/ byang rtse la nyan po chos kyi dbang byug dang / gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhan thub sogs dang / nyag rong la chos rje rab 'byams pa mtshe ma dbang rgyal/ chos rje rgyal dbang ba sogs bla brgyud ma chad par bzhugs nas rje bla ma'i ring lugs nyams pa med par skyong bar mdzad do/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje bkra shis dpal ldan la/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ khyod kyis chos sde phun sum tshogs pa zhig thob dang dgon ma las bu dga' ba'i dar rgyas che ba 'ong gsungs sheng / rje rang gis 'gog pa ri nas gter bzhes pa'i chos dung gnang bzhin/ sne'u dpon rin bzang gi~X8 /na rjodag

mdzad nas chos sde chen po 'bras spungs btab/ rje rin po cher po ti baspya blo thog nas shod gsungs pas/sngags mtshan nyid kyi po ti brgya dang brgyad kyi cug don mtha' dag thugs la bzung nas 'chad par mdzad/dbu tshad dang phar phyin sogs rje bla ma'i rig lugs kyi bshad srol dri ma med pa'i 'chad nyan rgyun mi chad du mdzad pas/ mus srad pa blo gros rin chen sogs gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byung / chos 'chad kyi slob dpon bdun so sor bskos pa rnams kyis so sor 'chad nyan mdzad par brten grwa tshang bdun byung ste/ sgo mang / blo gsal gling / bde yangs pa/ shag skor/ thos bsam gling ngam 'dul ba/ sngags pa spu tshang rnams byung ba sbyis su/ sgo blo bde sngags bzhir sgril/ 'jam—dbyangs chos rje'i rjes su/ dpal ldan seng ge ste/ 'di la grub chen sha ba ri dngos su byon nas dpal mgon zhal gyi gdams pa sogs gnang / de nas rin chen byang chub/ rje dbon blo bzang nyi ma/ nong ston blo bzang grags pa/ nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje smon lam dpal ba/ 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor/ 'dis 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs te/ khyod kyi blo groga'adi yod na dga' ba la zhes gsungs pas 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros su mtshan chags/ mkhas grub 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig ste/ gzhung chen mo rnams kyi bshad pa yun ring du gnang bas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs slob ma mang du thon/ mdo sde rgyan/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ rtsa shes/ 'jug pa/ tshad ma rnams kyi gzhung 'grel sogs legs bshad kyi rtsom pa mang / gor lan gnam snyags 'khor lo brtsams nas smra ba ngan pa tshar bcad/ dga' blo'i rjes su mkhan khrir thon pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang / de rjes thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun spya mtsho/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ 'di dga' ldan gser khrir bzhugs shing rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mkhan po mdzad pa sogs 'azin las shin tu che/ brtsams chos kyang 'dul mdzod dbu phar/ rnam 'grel gyi yig cha mdzad pa rnams deng sang blo gsal gling gi 'chad nyan gyi gzhung gi gtso bor byed/ gzhan yang gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs sogs sngags kyi skor dang / chos 'byung yid kyi mjos rgyan/ bstan rtsis sogs legs bshad mang du brtsams so/ /de nas rgyal bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po/ de nas bzung spyal ba sku na rim mkhan khrir bzhugs so/ /grwa tshang so so'i bla rabs rnams bris na mang bar 'gyur bas gtso bo 'ga' zhig smos na/ blo gsal gling du legs chos pa dang bsod grags pa gnyis smos zin ltar dang / bde yangs su/ grwa chung yon tan rgyal mtshan/ shāka skor du/ snar thang ba rab mchog thos bsam gling du nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan rnams khyad par du 'phags pa byung 'dug sgo mang du rin chen byang chub dang / byams pa lhan grub/ gzhu khang ba dge legs lhun grub/ gung ru sangs rgyas bkra shis rnams dang / khyad par du gung ru chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis yig cha mdzad cing / 'chad nyan kyang gzhan las lhag pa mdzad/ dus phyis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes rgya gar gyi 'dzam gling mdzes rgyan rnams dang mtshungs pa'i mkhas spub — 488 —

chen po des mdo sngags thams cad dang / khyad par du po ti lnga ku la mtha' dabhod kyi yig cha sngon med legs bshad kyi gter du gyur pa mdzad pas deng sang sgo mang gi 'dzin chos kyang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig cha kho na la byed la/ sgo mang bar ma zad mtha' dbus kyi rigs pa smra ba mtha' dag gi thos bsam gyi gzhir byed par brten/ yig cha gzhan phal cher ngal gso mdzad par snang ngo / /(4)byams chen chosarjes ser theg chen gling btabatshul/byams chen chos kyi rje shākya ye shes pa rgya yul du byon nas yung lo dang de'i sras zon te rgyal po gnyis kyi bla ma mdzad cing / rgya nag gi yul grur rje bla ma'i ring lugs dar ba'i dbu btsugs/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lo rje btsun tsong kha pa'i tshab byas nas pe cin du phebs/ rab byung bdun pa'i zhing rta lor pe cin du lan gnyis pa phebs nas gu shrī chen po'i go sa thob/ bod du byon nas rje bdag nyid chen po'i bka' phebs bzhin se ra theg chen gling btab nas slar yang rab byung bdun pa'i shing stag lor tā ming rgyal pos byams chen chos rje pa'i mtshan gnas bstsal/ rgya yul du 'byon skabs mkhan khrir dka' bcu ba dar spyas bzang po bskos/ de rjes mtshungs med chos rje zhes grags pa gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po bzhugs/ 'dis lta ba'i skor sogs la rje'i gsung dang mi mthun pa 'ga' zhig bshad pas/ mkhas thub rjes/ rgyan bzang ba khyod kyis gzhan yang zer nas bshad bshad mi mthun pa mang po byed kyin 'dug gsungs nas bka' bkyon pas/ rgyan bzang ba thugs mug ste/ blo bzang grags pa dga' ldan gnas su gshegs/ / byams chen chos rje mi dbang gtsug na mjos/ / spyal mtshan bzang po gangs ri'i khrod du lus/ /zhes sogs skyo ba'i gtam gsungs/ zha lu ba tshul khrims rin chen gyi rnam thar las/ tshul rin pa 'jam dbyangs chos je'i drung du chos gsan par byon pas rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pas/ se rar mtshungs med chos rje las chos gsan par/ lta ba'i 'chad tshul rje'i dngos slob rnams kyi bshad tshul dang mi mthun pa byung ba la rgyu mtshan zhus par/ rgyan bzang bas khong ga'an la ci gsungs ma shes/ nged la rje bla mas stong nyid ma yin dgag gi sgom tshul 'di bzhin gsungs pa yin/ zhes gsungs zhes 'byung /gung ru ba'i lta khrid na'ang 'chad tshul de bzhin byas 'dug ste/ rje nyid kyis lta ba'i dpyad pa ma rdzogs gong du gsungs pa yin nam sems/ gung ru bas mdo sde rgyan dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel ba/ dbu ma'i stong thun spyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa'i bstan bcos mang zhig mdzad 'dug gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang mkhas grub dpal ldan seng ge rin chen byang chub sogs mang du byon/ rgyan bzang ba'i rjes su mkhan khrir zha lu rab 'byams pa dang / de rjes kun mkhyen par grags pa blo gros rin chen seng ge bzhugs/ dbu ma sogs kyi yig cha phul du byung ba ma4da kyang / rje'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa'i bshad pa re gnyis yod pa/ phyis su rje btsun sogs kyisojagag pa mdzad/ deng sang dge bshes su rlom pa tshos spyan bzang ba dang kun mkhyen pa'i yig cha mig gis lta ba tsam yang rung ba'i tshod du byed mod/ blo gros can gyis mthong na mkhas pa sprugu ba'i legs bshad kyi gter du snang ngo / /— 489 —

de rjes gdan sar gnas brtan pa dang / lha phu chos rje dang / gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun spugarnams bzhugs/ 'di mkhas pa chen po zhig ste/ sa skya'i paṇa chen du byed pa'i shākya mchog ldan dang rtsod pas bcom pas mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ drang nges rnam 'byed legs bshad snying po'i dka' 'grelīmadzad/ de rjes mang thos dpal ldan blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs don yod dpal ldan/ rgyal ba dgi 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnams bzhugs/ 'di ni rigs pa'i dbang phyug 'gran dang bral ba zhig ste/ dbu ma la sogs pa'i yig cha legs bshad kyi gter du gyur pa mang po mdzad/ go shāka gnyis kyis rje'i gsung la dgag pa byas pa'i lan dang / karma ba mi bskyod rdo rje'i phar phyin gyi yig cha'i 'khrul ba sel ba'i bstan bcos mdzad nas karma ba la phul bas bugs shin tu mnyes nas bsngags brjod mdzad/ rje'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i 'chad nyan yun ring mdzad pas gsung las skyes pa'i sbob ma'ang mang du thon/ rje btsun pa'i rjes su mkhan khrir/ paṇa chen bsod grags/ chos grags bzang po/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ stong 'khor yon tan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po rnams bzhugs shing / de nas rgyal ba sku rim gyis 'dzin bdag mdzad/ dang po gwa tshang lnga yod kyang phyis su byed pa dang smad pa gnyis su sgril ba'i dang po ni/'jam dbyangs chos rje'i slob ma mus srid pa blo gros rin chen seng ge 'bras spungs su bzhugs pa 'ga' zhig gis log sgrub bgyis pas thugs sun nas se rar sgebs pa na/ slob ma mkhas pa brgya phrag tsam yang rjes su 'brangs nas byon pa rnams der stan chags pas byed pa grwa tshang du grags/smad pa ni kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum du grags pa byang chub 'od zer gyis 'chad nyan mdzad pa las rim gyis 'phel ba yin la/ phyis su sngags grwa yang tshugs so/ / 'dir ṭwāṃ kā ṭīkā /gnyi/ sa kyi gdan rabs dang mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa thams cad skabs de ltar gdan sa ri bo dge ldan la brten nas se 'bras gnyis dang / de nas bu dang tsha bo yang tsha'i tshul gyis bshad sgrub kyi sde mang du 'phel nas/ rje bla ma'i ring lugs mtha' dbus kyi sa'i khyon thams cad du khyab par gyur la/ de ltar 'gyur bar glegs bam rin po che sogs las lung bstan pa'i tshul yod kyang mang dogs nas ma bris so/ /rgyas sa sdu3/ /sdu/ cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub ba dpal bzangapos gtsang phyogs su rje' bstan pa dar dnghadaga' ldan btab nas lo brgyad pa na 'bras spungs/ lo bcu gcig pa na se ra/ lo nyer dgu lon pa na rje 'dis bla ma yi dam gyis lung bstan pa bzhin bkra shis lhun po'i chos sde btab/ zha lu ba'i rjes su dga' ldan khrir phebs dgos tshul nan tan zhus kyang / dgra mkhar dgra'i lung par spyag dgos pa yin/ngedatram̐ nga ṭwāṃ 9dīdir yang dga' ldan tsam zhig 'ong ba'i re ba yod gsungs nas ma phebs/ de dus chos sde

'di'i nye 'khor na rngon pa dang go shāka sogs rje'i ring lugs la log par lta ba mang bas de skad gsungs par snang la/ phyis su bkra shis lhan po rim gyis dar rgyas su song ba'i gzi bajid kyis/ ngor dang / rta py-i/ /༵ dro /na/ da/ nga / gser mdog can sogs nyi ma'i drung du me khyer bzhin snang mi rung gi mtshan nyid rje 'dis lo sum cu so brgyad kyi ring gtso cher gdan sa 'dir 'chad nyan mdzad cing / gtsang chu lho byang stod snad mang por chos par btegs nas bstan pa kho na thugs la dgongs te gzhung chen mo rnams kyi 'chad nyan mdzad cing / 'dul ṭīka/ gling 'bum/ rnam 'grel ṭīka chung / rigs rgyan sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ slob ma yang rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal ba/ 'dul dkar nag gnyis/ bya btang sems dpa' chen po/ paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ shangs ston dri med bshes gnyen/ rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal sogs snga tshar dang / paṇa chen lung rigs spya mtsho/ rje grags pa bsam thub/ stobs ldan 'od zer/ chos 'byor dpal bzang sogs bar tshar dang / gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs/ rje dbon blo bzang nyi ma/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo sogs phyi tshar gyi slob ma mkhas grub bgrang gis mi long ba byon no/ / gdan sar/ paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ 'di'i dus rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho bkra shis lhan por bzhugs pa la/paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos phrag dog gi rnam pa mdzad pas der ma bzhugs par 'bras spungs su phebs/ de nas chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon pa btab cing 'phrin las shin tu rgyas pa'i skabs/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos nan tan mdzad pa bzhin byon nas bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar bzhugs/ de nas mnga' ris lha btsun bstan pa'i nyi ma/ paṇa chen shārnyi pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod rgya mtsho/ shangs ston blo gros legs bzang / 'di nyid kyis legs bshad kyi yig cha mdzad/ gnas rnying chos rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shangs ston bsam 'aspub dpal bzang / nyang stod dam chos yar 'phel/ myang ston lha dbang blo gros/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de nas paṇa chen sku 'phreng rnams bzhugs so/ / sde 'dir grwa tshang gsum byung ba'i bla brgyud re re nas bris na mang bas ma sbos la/ shar rtse'i 'chad nyan pa dang po shangs ston dri med bshes gnyen dang / drug pa blo gros rgya mtsho dang / dkyil khang nas/ brgyad pa shārnyi pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / bcu ba bstan pa dar bzang / thos bsam gling nas/ dang po kun mkhyen chos 'byor dpal bzang / bzhi ba khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis rnams kyis dbu phar sogs kyi yig cha legs par mdzad 'dug rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyis sngags grwa 'dzugs pa'i dgongs gtad yod kyang ma grub pa la/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sngags grwa 'dzugs pa mdzad pas/ sngags chen rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs tshad ldan 'ga' zhig byung snang ngo / / de ltar dbus gtsang gi chos sde chen po bzhi la brten nas dge lugs pa'i dgon grub sde gsar ba mang du 'phel zhing / thub mtha' gzhan gyi chos sde du ma zhig kyang daṭwāṃ9 /garji par

gnas 'gyur te/ gangs can mtha' dbus med par rje bla ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pas khyab par gyur rte zhib par chos 'byung rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /(6)stodamonga' ris dang smad mdo khams kyi rjongs su 'i bstan ba dar ba ni thog mar ger bzang gnyisashā bka' drin yin par bstan pa/rje'i dngos slob stod shes rab bzang pos chu bo si tā'i chu brgyud mnga' ris mang yul du stag mo'i chos sde dang / de'i dbon shes rab pas khrig se'i chos sde btab pa dar spyas che zhing / zangs dkar chos sder yang rje'i chos lugs btsugs/ gzhan yang gu ge ngag dbang grags pa/ gu ge bdag po bkra shis 'od sde dang / khri rnam rgyal 'od dang / shā3 'od mched gsum gyi bla mar gyur te lo chen rin chen bzang po'i gdan sa mtho lding gser gyi lha khang dang / rtsa ram gyi chos sde 'bri ldan dang / blos stang sogs dgon rnying mang por rje'i lugs bzang btsugs te rgyas par byas/ mkhas bub rje'i slob ma gsang phu ba lha dbang blo gros kyis/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi gcen po 'od ldes bzhengs pa'i dpe thub kyi lha khang zhig gsos dang / bar skya chos nde dang / li ging chos sde gnyis btab/ de nas chos sde gsar ba mang du 'phel zhing / rnying ba phal cher dge lugs pas khyab par gyur/mdo khams su rje'i bstan pa thog mar dar bar byed pa po ni sgad shes rab bzang po yin te/ se ra theg chen gling du byams chen chos rje'i gdan sar/ chos rje dar rgyas bzang po bzhugs skabs/ snad byang sems shes rab bzang pos zur chos pa mdzad nas/ rje yab sras kyi phyag srol ltar bshad pas mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu 'dus pa'i tshe/ khong gi thugs la kho rang 'khrungs yul karma'i phyogs su pebs te 'dul khrims rnam par dag pa'i cha lugs 'di la gnas nas/ chos brgyud dang lta spyod rnams bcos na rje rin po che'i bstan pa dang / sems can la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung ngam dgongs pa zhig byung bas/ kun mkhyen byang 'bum pa'i mngon shes kyis mkhyen te/ byang sems pa gdan drangs zhabs stog bzang po gnang / snam bu dang dbu zhwa gnang nas/ 'phros gzhan gang yang med par khyed maspyogs tsam khams su phebs rgyu yin 'dug pas khams phyogs kyi bstan pa la gang phan mdzod gsungs/ shes rab bzang po'i thugs la nga khams phyogs su mgyogs par 'gro ba'i skad cha ci yang med pa la 'di ltar gsung ba/ nga 'dir bsdad pa mi 'thad pa yin nam/ gang ltar rgyal tshab rin po che la zhus na re zhig sdod gsung e yong snyam nas/ dga' ldan du phebs te rgyal tshab rin po che la gnas tshul zhus pas/ bshol 'debs pa lta ci smos/ khams la 'byor ba shin tu legs/ khams phyogs su ri bo zhes pa gig grags pa/ de'i nye skor gcig na khyod kyi gdul bya dang phrin las chen po 'ong ba yod gsungs nas lung bstan dang rdzong ba gnang /phyis chab mdo dgon pa btab/ mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwanee btsugs pas grwa ba sum stong tsam 'dus te bar khams mdo smad du 'gro don rgya cher byung bas/ kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pa'i mngon shes la nges pa brnyend+ra pa /༵ / /de nas rje'i dngos slob ku cor rtogs ldan pa'am rnal 'byor ba 'od dpag rdo rje'i sras

su rgyal ba 'phags pa lha 'khrungs shing / de nyid kyi sprul sku rim par byon pa dang / 'phags lha'i sbob ma zhig ba bzang po dang / lcags ra sprul sku dang / rgya ra sprul sku rnams kyi skye brgyud dang / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sgrul sku rta tshag rje rim byon dang / rje'i dngos slob gu shrī dpal ldan don grub kyi skye brgyud/stag gu sgrul sku rnams dang / rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ legs pa'i shes rab kyi skye ba brag g.yab sprul sku che tshang dang / chung tshang gnyis sogs dam pa'i skyes rabs kyi zeng ba 'dzin pa'i skyes chen du ma dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa dang spub pa'i skye ba mang du byon pa rnams kyis yul phyogs tha dad pa mang por dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad pas/ sgang drug rong dgu shod bcu/ ru gsum du grags pa'i khams kyi cha thams cad du dge lugs pa'i bstan pa dar bar gyur to/ /(7)mdo mda.asgodo' phyogs su chos don grub rin cun gyis byacung bragapho chos sde btab chul/rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i 'khrungs gnas su sku 'bum gyi mchod rten bzhugs par grong dang 'dres mar dge 'dun mi mang tsam chags pa/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho der phebs dus zhal ta mdzad pa bzhin/'dul ba chos rje 'od zer rgya mtshos gtsang dgon gyi grwa tshang btsugs/ bla rabs 'ga' song ba'i rjes su ṭīshā/ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ kyi/ 'chad nyan dang / ci rgyud grwa tshugs shing / phyis su gso ba rig pa'i grwa tshang zhig kyang rgyal dbang bzhi pa yon tan spya mtshes spyal ba'i sras po don yod chos kyi rgya mtsho mdo smad du chos sde 'dzugs par btang ba bzhin/ rgyal sras rin po ches dgon lung byams pa gling btab nas 'chad nyan 'dzugs pa mdzad pas phyogs 'dir mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa byung ba'i thog ma yin cing / phyis su rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas rgyud grwa btsugs/ chos sdi 'di nas bstan pa la phan pa'i skyes chen mang du thon/khyad par du lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan dang / rje thu'u kān pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/thams cad mkhyen pa rol ba'i rdo rje rnams rim bzhin shar phyogs 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i mchod yul bzhugs nas ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa'i sros 'dzin par mdzad/ dgon lung gi mkhan po bcu pa bla ma btsun po don grub rgya mtshos gser khog tu chos sde chen po dga' ldan dam chos gling btab pa/ sgo mang slob zur hor ngag dbang 'azin las lhun grub kyis bskyangs pas 'phel rgyas su gyur te mtshan nyid grwa tshang gong 'og gnyis/ sngags pa sman pa ste grwa tshang bzhi yod pa smin grol no mo han skye 'phreng rim pas skyong bar mdzad do/ /rong bo chos rje rin chen grags pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dbon po dka' bcu rin po cher grags pa skal ldan spya mtshe zhes sku tshe hril bor rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar la 'gran bzod pa'i sgrub pa snying por mdzad pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon po la mnga' brnyes pa des/ rang gi bla ma'i sgrub gnas su ri khrod bkra shis 'khyil btab/ rong bo dgon chen du 'chad nyan btsugs/ phyis su dus 'khor dang rgyud grwa yang tshugs pa da lta 'phel rgyas su yod cing / skal ldan spya mcho'i bu slob mang pos tram̐b /9 ༵co rjirgyad

sogs btab pas/ da lta'i dus sde mang du 'alel/rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs kyi slob ma'i gtso bor gyur cing / gsung rab spyi dang rgyud sde'i don la nang byan chud pa g.yer gshong sngags rams pa 'jam dbyangs blo gros des g.yer gshong du grwa tshang btsugs shing / gdan sa dang phyogs yas mas du mar dbang khrid man ngag mang du gnang / stong 'khor ba bsod nams rgya mtshe sogs slob brgyud dang / skye brgyud bzang po du ma zhig kyang thon no/ /(ra)'jam dbyangs bzhad ba'irdo sasado mad du chod sde po bkra gis 'khril btab tshul/mkhas grub gye ba'i gtsug rgyan 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdo snad lho khyud du chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil btab/ mkhas pa chen po ngag dbang bkra shis kyis legs par bskyangs shing yig cha mang du mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma de nyid slar yang bstan 'gro'i mgon du byon pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas yun ring skyong bar mjod pa nang gses thos bsam gling / rgyud pa/ dus 'khor ba/ sman pa bcas bzhi yod cing / deng sang mdo smad kyi ༵py-ispya ṭwāṃ // hā /dbu/sa na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par 'phags pa la bu dgon ba/da grwa dang sgrub grwa co ni'i dpon brgyud 'khrungs pa chos rje rin chen kun po bya bas co nir dgon pa btab pa/ phyis su grags pa bshad sgrub tu grags pa brtsams chos mang po can de nyid kyis 'chad nyan dang rgyud grwa btsugs/dgon der bka' bstan 'gyur gyi par sogs bzhugs shing bu dgon kyang mang ngo / / de ltar chos sde chen po de rnams las lus las yan lag dang nying lag gi tshul gyis grwa sgrub mang du 'phel bas mdo smad lho byang gi sa cha thams cad gang bar gyur/ a mdo'i yul du sngon gyi dus sa skya dang bka' brgyud pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa sha stag tu gyur to/ /(9)rje'i bshad skub② bstan pa mtha' dbus su dar tshulamadotsam/dge ldan ring lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog mang po nang nas sras snga tshar bzhi ba rgyal mo rong mkhan ngag dbang grags pas dgon sde brgya rtsa baspyad 'debs pa'i dam grub pas de tshang du thogs zer/ 'di pa sngar smos sbra rgan rnams khu jo'i rigs su btsan lha'i sum mdor nas chu phug sbyang mdor 'khrungs/ dbus su rje'i zhabs la gtugs/ man ngag rdzogs par zhus/ rje'i slob ma snga tshar bzhi'i nang tshan yin/'khrungs rabs yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang / mdo sgad chos 'byungs sogs kyi mdzad pa mang / rong ba lce nag pa rab tu byung ba'i las grwa ba mdzad/ rje nas 'di ba dang lce nag pa rnam gnyis la mdo smad du bstan pa spel ba'i bka' babs/ 'di pa lcags stag lo 'gor mdo smad du thon/phyi lo yongs kyi dbyar zla rab la lce nag pa yang byon/ phyogs 'dir bon gyis bzung yod pas bon dang mthurjo gra~X ṭwāṃr/—bon ston mang po bkrongs/ zhal nas nga rgyal shes 'dod blo ni ma mchis te/ /sangs

rgyas bstan pa'i don du nyams su blangs/ /lta log bon po'i mgo la tshad mda' brgyab/ / brgya phyed brgya gyed mkha' spyod gnas su badzramuḥ/ / zhes gsungs/ so mang khu jo 'og ma'i khyim kyi dpe rnying zhig tu/de skabs bdag gis 'khrul 'khor gyi las sbyor byas/ a rjo kyang phur ba'i sgrub pa tshugs zhes pa snang la/des na a jo stag gzig bstan pa nam zer/ tsha kho dgon 'di dang / sa mgo gam yag mgo dgon/tam mgo dgon gsum btab/ rab gnas la rong po rtse nag pa gdan drangs/ khong gis 'di nas gsang 'dus dang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsten sgrub mdzad/ rtags khyad par can brnyes te/ gser zhun 'ching ba 'jam mgon bla ma'i bka'/ tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i dgon sde chos srid kyi/ yon tan rgyas pa'i zin las can du 'ongs/ de phyir slob dpon grags pa'i thugs rje mdzod/ ces gsungs/thugs rje zhes pa thugs dgyes yin nam snyam/ rnam gnyis bka' bkros kyis rje 'dis dmu dge dgon yang btab/ da tshang dgon du mgon po'i sku bzhengs par brtsams pa na a tsa ra nag po zhig 'ong nas khos 'bag bzo shes zer ba byung / de la sku brnyan bzhengs bcug grub nas yon phul bar/ nged la ji srid dgon pa 'di gnas kyi bar du skal ba re thongs zer bas mgon po'i sku la thim/ da lta yang 'gyid phog nam yod la a tsa ra'i skal ba zhes gtong srol snang / rjes su khu jo bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang /dge 'dun rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bskyangs/ me khyi lor gi rti blo bzang bstan pa'i spyal mtshan gyis 'du khang sogs la zhig gsos kyi mthun rkyen dang / sgang du ri khrod btab/ de skabs shig nas cog tse'i bdag mo tshe ring lha mo bon la shin tu mos pas de dang / bon gyi 'dul ba bla ma gnyis bsdongs nas thub mtha'i sdang zhugs kyis 'khrugs pa bslangs/ sa bya lor skyabs 'tshol gyi ched skyabs mgon mchog la dgon pa phul/ lcags khyi lor zung 'phag tā zhen dang / tsha kho'i rgyal khag tu mi sna btang ste 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzad/ rje nyid rnga bar bzhugs pa'i drung du da tshang dgon gyi bla grwa brgya skor/ cog tse da ro gsum bcas kyis bon bla 'dus ba khrid nas 'ongs/ kho rang gis dge lugs kyi chos rgyun 'dzin par khas blangs/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung sogs gnang /thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs khrir bskos/ rje de nyid lan du mar phebs te dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de rjes rje 'jigs med nam mkha'/ rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i seng ge mkhan chen sirnyi'i mtshan can sogs bu chen du mas bskyangs/ kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa lam snga phyir byon/ gzigs khang gsar bsgrun dang / dbyar gnas kyi thebs su dngul srang bzhi brgya/ gtor chen gyi thebs su dngul srang dgu brgya/ gtor sgrub kyi thebs su dngul rta mig ma gsum/ ja che chung nyi shu/ rta nor lnga bcu/ zla re bzhin nya slong la mgon po'i gshegs gtor 'bul thebs sogs bstsal/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis kun mkhyen gong ma rnam gnyis kyi dus mchod thebs su rta nor brgya dang zhe gsum/ zam tsha khri chen sprul pa'i sku nas dbyar gnas thebs su dngul srang lnga bcu/ ja chen drug bcas spyir 'jogs mdzad pa'i steng nas so so'i rgyun mi nyams par gnas/ zhal grangs lnga brgyar nye zhing / lo mjug drag — 495 —

po'i sbyin sreg 'cham gtor rgyag dang bcas pa/ lo gsar tshes gtor sogs kyi 'don phyag len gang ci nas phyogs 'di'i dgon sde kun gyi dbus na khyad par du 'phags/ ser byes mkhan po rab 'byams pa bstan pa dar rgyas kyang 'di nas yin no/ rgyal dbang bdun pa mgar thar du bzhugs skabs bzo bo btang ste bzhengs pa'i byams sku/ rje'i tshems/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mcho'i zhabs dar/ kub chen na kha ba'i phyag mdzub/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs gtsang ba bdun brgyad sogs grub mtha' res med kyi dam pa mang po'i sku gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel mtha' yas pa nang kyi dkar chag can/ rje ngag dbang grags pa'i 'dra sku gsar rnying / byams gu pa'i mes gong ma zhig gis gzhung la zhus te gdan drangs pa'i jo sku rgya gar li ma khru gang ba/ phyogs bzhi chos mdzad la gzhung nas gnang ba'i jo bo lo gi sha ra/ser smad mkhan po byams pa dpal 'byor dang / dge bshes byams pa phun tshogs pa'i sku gdung /bka' bstan sogs rten mang / skya mgo'i lha rams par grags pa byams gu blo bzang dge legs la skye brgyud snang / ri khrod sems dpa' sogs ni/ mi 'gro lha rams sku mched kyis bskyangs/ 'di'i rtse na rgyal sras ba mgo yon tan gyi gdan sa ba mgo ri khrod/ de dang nye bar bka' gdams pa chen po chos 'asgel dar rgyas ba'i sgrub gnas rnams yod do/ /tsha kho dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling / yag mgo dgon 'di yin kyang zer/ 'dir mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa'i sku gdung nang bzhags kyi sa 'bum/ de'i sgo khyim du btsan po no min han nas gnang ba'i rje'i sku/ bye smad ta rdo dbang rgyal gyis bzhengs pa'i mkhan chen gyi 'dra sku/ gye smad ta no yon tan bkra shis kyis bzhengs pa'i jo sku/ stag gzig bstan pa'i gdung rten/ bka' bsrung ma mos mngon sum du gnang shing / bla ma padma zer ba sogs bon brgyud kyis skyongs de'i mdar mkhas grub thags sras chos kyi grags pa'i gdung gi sa 'bum bzhugs so/ / zangs dkar du khyom tsha ris kyi btab pa khang dmar dgon/ 'di pa bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa ba/ skyabs mgon mchog gar phebs kyi zhabs phyi dkar rams pa yin/ de'i sprul sku dmu dger 'khrungs pa bla brang nas chos grwar zhugs/ sgo mang sprul pa'i sku dang 'dzin grwa gcig rje rwa dza'i zhal snga nas dang / mkhan chen sidha'i mtshan can/ a mchog dge bshes sprul pa'i sku sogs la gsan pa mdzad/ 'di dang skya mgo'i dgon gnyis skyong bar mdzad/(1༷)rong chen dge 'dunasgyul mtshan nyidaspyi 'khrungs rabs/de nas 'jam mgon spyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs sras bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen bdun gyi nang tshan/ mdo rong gi mkhas pa mi bzhi'i ya gyal/ rong chen dge 'dun spyal mtshan de nyid kyi 'khrungs yul ni mdo smad rgyal mo rong gi bzhag shod pa la ces pa'i sa yin zhing / yab klu 'bum dang yum a sman gnyis shing pho stag gi lor sku 'khrungs shing ljags kyi mdog sngon po la dbus su a dkar po shin tu gsal zhing thugs kar hriḥdang hūṃ/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i ri mo gsal bar yod pa/ skabs rer lngags nag por snang bas lce nag pa zhes grags/ chung dus nas klog 'don sogs mkhas par sbyangs/— 496 —

thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma gnyis kyis lung bstan par/ yon tan dri med 'od kyi spyan snga ru/ / byur bar dbus gtsang phyogs su song nas kyang / /'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i dge slong zhabs gtugs nas/ /mdo sngags gzhung gi thos bsam sgom gsum la/ / ma g.yeng brtson pa gal cher 'bungs par rigs/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgong lo bcu drug la dbus su phebs/ rang byung lnga ldan gyi drung mchod 'bul dang macel sogs phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ re zhig byang phyogs su song / yun mi ring bar gtsang du byon na don chen 'grub gsungs pas 'phan yul du byon/ bka' gdams pa'i sku rnams la phyag bskor dang martsel sogs phul te gtsang du byon/ zhwa lur phebs nas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'jigs pa chen po khyung bo lha'i drung nas bde mchog dang rdor dbyings kyis gtsos/ bod na rgyud sde rnams kyi dbang bka'i brgyud yod pa phal cher dus gcig la gsan cing / khyad par bya spyod dang rnal 'byor byud kyi lam gyi rim pa ston pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag la nang byan chud par mdzad/ 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras la grub chen khyung bo lhas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gnang ba dang dus 'dzoms/ khong rang nas kyang 'jam mgon bla ma la dngul gyi macel/ dung dkar cha gcig gos chen sogs mang po phul te/'jam dbyangs kyi byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ rje nyid nas/ khyod kyi thugs bskyed kyi 'bras bu dus su smim pas rten 'brel shin tu legs/ shar phyogs kyi bstan pa spel na 'gro ba dbang du 'du zhing bstan pa /snyan grags khyab par 'ong gsungs/ de ltar mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la mkhas pa'i phul tu byung / rje bla ma'i drung du rab tu byung bas dge 'dun rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ de nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la zhib gzigs dang / bsnyen sgrub kyang mang po mdzad/ yang rje bla ma'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo so drug thog thugs rje chen pos nam mkha' nas zhal gzigs/mdun du rta mgrin gyi zhal nas/ mtha' 'khob log 'dren 'dul ba la/ /dbang chen bdag la gsol ba thobs/ / snang srid dbang du 'du ba la/ / las bzhi ma lus 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes lung bstan/de'i lo sngon ma la chung grogs kun bzang dang chos skyabs gnyis kyis gtsos rang yul nas dad ldan sum cu tsam byon/ de rnams mkhas thub dge legs dpal pa'i drung nas rab tu byung / sngar gyi chung grogs gnyis la kun bzang seṅge dang chos kyi seṅge zhes mtshan btags/ de thams cad rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi slob mar gyur/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i tshe/ rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs ji bzhin bsgrubs don mdzad pa dang / bstan 'gro'i don la bsngo smon rgya chen mdzad/ lo der dga' ldan dgon pa gsar 'debs byed pa'i tshe rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan khyod/mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i mdun du thugs dam brtags pa zhu bar song gsungs pa ltar phebs pas/ phyag rdor bas/ lce nag pa khyod rang gis kyang lo gcig la bla ma'i thugs bzhed sgrubs/ man ngag sogs longs la shar rgyal mo rong gi 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa shes par gyis shig gsungs nas 'di ltar/ thugs rje chen po sprul ba'i sku/ /rong chen lce nag mkhas dbang khyod/ /mdo rgyud zab gnad — 497 —

chos kun slobs/ /nang lo so brgyad lon pa'i tshe/ /rang yul rgyal mo rong gi cha/ /brag ri gcan gzan mche ba 'dra/ /nags spang 'brong gi rwa co'i dbyibs/ /gangs ri rtse la brag gi mtha'/ /mgon po gur gyi bla ri'i mdun/ / 'jam dbyangs ral gris mtshan pa'i lte/ / glang chen sa srung gdong gi dbus/ /thugs rje chen po'i grub gnas yod/ / rigs gsum mgon pos byin gyis brlabs/ / 'di yan gyis tsha kho'i ma dgon gyi sa dbyibs dang / kā la ri'i ri khrod/ mgon po rang byon gyi bla rdo dang bla shing sa dbyibs ri chu'i bkod pa bcas gsal bor bstan/ sngon tshe khri srong lde btsan gyi/ / blon po kha che skyes bzang yul/ / slob dpon padmas byin gyis rlabs/ / de ni khyod kyi 'dul zhing ste/ / dbang gi zla gam lung ba nas/ / chos sde chen po 'byung 'gyur kye/ / zhum pa ma byed spro ba skyed/ / 'gro don spya chen de na yod/ / nag po chen po dngos su 'byon/ / mngon spyod las la thogs pa med/ / sna chogs skye ba bcu gsum gyis/ /dbang phyogs 'gro ba'i kha lo bsgyur/ /bstan pa rim gyis dar zhing spyas/ /zhes pa 'dis/stag tshang lha mo kirti'i dgon sa zla gam gyi dbyibs dang 'dra ba sogs bstan/ yang / slob dpon padma'i lung bstan las/ brag srin 'dres pa nags 'dabs su/ zhes pa'i khri srong lde btsan gyi blon skyes bzang rin chen gyi 'khrungs yul la slob dpon padmas byin rlabs mdzad cing / de'i yang sprul kirti rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi 'dul zheng gtso bo yin pas/ der chos sde chen po grogs su 'byon pa dang bcas/mngon spyod las la thogs pa med pa'i girti rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan nas bzung sku zeng bcu gsum la dbang phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad nus pa'i lung bstan nas/ mkhan chen rang nyid kyi phyag dril/ lcags kyi rdo rje/ phyag rdor sku thang rnams gnang / sa mo glang gi lor rje rin po ches dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gsar 'debs mdzad/ rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis rje rin po che'i drung du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lung khrid man ngag thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob cing / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yang rtser phyin pa'i mtshan rtags thob ste/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po tshe dang /khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma shar tsong kha ba chen po'i ring lugs mi nyams dgung du skyod pa'i dar chen bdun gyi gras su tshud/skabs shig rje rin po che nas slob ma mang po la 'jigs byed kyi dbang gnang tshe bla slob mang po'i dbus su 'o rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan zhes 'bod pa gnang ste/ khyod mdo sgad rgyal mo rong du song la bstan pa spel ba'i dus su babs pa shes par gyis/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lcags yos bla ba dang po'i tshes gsum gyi nangs par sku mdun du shog gsungs/ byon pa'i tshe rje rin po che dang mkhas grub rnam gnyis bzhugs pa las rje rang nyid kyi zhal nas/ khyed la sngar smras pa ltar rgyal mo rong du song nas bstan pa spel ba la sngon tshe rabs mang po nas mtha' 'khob 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i smon lam thebs pa yin/ khyod kyis yi dam gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / khyad par 'jigs byed dang chos skyong mgon po gur zhal gnyis dngad / ṭwāṃ~X8 rgyal sogs bsten cing bsgom bsgrub byas na nag phyogs kyi dgra bgegs gang gis kyang gnod

pa mi tshugs par ci bsam 'grub par the tshom med ces gsungs nas lung bstan pa 'di ltar/ na mo ma na tha ye/ rtsa ba gsum po dbyer med 'dus pa'i lha/ khajam dbyangs zhi khro bcas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /skye mang sngon nas 'brel ba'i slob bu la/ / phan pa'i snying gtam thigs pa cung zad sbyin/ / bu khyod 'di nas shar phyogs rgyal mo rong / /rgya bod sa mtshams byin can btsal du song / /shar phyogs dung ri'i nub ngos dpag tshad gsum/ / smon zhes grags pa'i gnas srung mtha' rten yod/ / de yang byang phyogs rgyang grags lnga yi sar/ / nag po chen po'i bla ri nor bu'i gzugs/ / rgyab na gser gyi mchod rten bang rim can/ /rtse 'dzin gnyan zhes bya ba'i gangs ri yod/ /gnyan po gangs kyi rtse 'dzin khyad 'phags pas/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba dus kun 'byung / / smon pa brag gi mtha' rten bzang po nas/ / dpa' mdzangs bstan 'dzin skyes bu khyad 'phags shing / / sbyin bdag stobs ldan rgyal bas rtag tu bkur/ /g.yas ri senee gnam la bsnyegs pa 'dra/ /tshe 'phel pho rgyud bde zhing bkra shis brtan/ /g.yon ri g.yu 'brug dmar nag ru mtshon 'dra/ / snyan grags zis chen mtha' bzhi'i longs spyod 'du/ / mngon spyod zin las rno ñtsar dgra bgegs pham/ / shar lho khyung dang nub byang lha phrug dbyibs/ / steng 'og dgra bgegs dbang 'du rnam par rgyal/ / byang shar sa srung dar dkar bkal ba bzhin/ / phyogs bzhi khyad par dbang phyogs ma lus 'du/ /de 'dra'i gnas su 'gro don skyong bar gyis/ /gnas ni glang chen 'gying ba'i sna rtse'i dbus/ /nag po'i rten rdo rten shing ya mtshan yod/ /shar nas nub tu chu bo 'khyil ba la/ /gser na dung dang bkra shis ri mos mtshan/ /shug sdong 'dres pa'i dbus na 'od ldan gyi/ /shing gi rtsa bar nag po'i rten gyis shig /'di'i yan tsha kho'i ma dgon gyi dgon sa'i dbyibs/ ri chu'i 'bab yul dang dpal nag po chen po'i bla shing bla rdo sogs gsal bor lung bstan dang / chu bo chen po gnyis kyi g.yon rgyab skor/ / mdun du 'du ba'i rten 'brel khyad par 'phags/ / de 'dra'i gnas su grags pa'i dgon sde can/ /legs par bzhengs la bshad sgrub bstan pa skyongs/ /skye ba bdun du 'gro don ma lus pa/ /brtul zhugs tshul gyis ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gzugs/ /de nas rgyal po'i gzugs can rnam gsum gyis/ /dbang phyogs 'gro la gang mtshams chos 'khor bskor/ /yi dam gsang ba 'dus dang gshin rje'i gshed/ / bde mchog rnam gsum khyad par 'jig byed sgoms/ / sngar nas rigs dang skye bar nang ba'i lha/ / mgon po gur dang lha mo dung zol ma/ / mgon po gdong bzhi las gshin rnam thos sras/ / slob ma spred la lus grib bzhin du 'ong / / zhes stag tshang lha mo'i dgon dbyibs dang / dgon der 'byor pa'i sku zeng gi rim pa ni/ 'dul ba'i kun spyod kyi cha phra mo tsam yang ma nyams pa'i sku phreng bdun dang /rgyal po'i gzugs can sku phreng gsum bcas la gur zhal dang dung zol las gshin sogs lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar bstan pa srung ba'i grogs su 'byon pa sogs lung bstan mang po bstsal/ de nas dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dpon slob kun/ rang byon lnga ldan gyi drung du zla ba gsum la thugs smon rgya chen mdzad/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas zhal gzigs shing lung bstan mtha' mang po gsungs/ gsung rab — 499 —

dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la sgro 'dogs chod pa dang / mngon shes sogs yon tan thams cad khong du chud par gyur/ de nas lcags mo yos kyi dbyar zla la rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dpon slob so drug a mdor phebs/ sngar lung bstan pa'i sar thugs dpyad gnang skabs 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ 'di nas lho nub zhag gnyis sar/ lung bstan gnas yod deng sang ni/ bon dang khyim pa 'ga' yod kyang / rten 'brel zab mos rang gi bran/ zhes gsungs pa ltar pho rog gagyis kyis lam sna drangs te/ dpon slob so drug gis yul bdag rnams rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa byon te srog snying dang dung dkar sogs phul nas bran du khas blangs/ dung skad kyang 'khor mi kun gyis thos shing / deng sang lung ba de la dung zhes grags so/ / de phyogs kyi grong mi kun bla ma la shin tu dad cing bka' las mi 'da' ba'i dam bcas/ lo der dgon gnas sogs su zhib gzigs mdzad cing / dpal 'gyur med kā la ri'i ri khrod bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsugs lag khang rmang rten der lo nyi shu tsam bzhugs te sa gshis legs bcos dang / shar tsong kha pa chen po'i lung bstan ltar/ dgon gnas kyi mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon gyi gnam sa'i bkod pa la zhib tu gzigs shing dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad par sta gon legs po byas pa'i skabs der/ dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po'i sku rang byon gyis zhal gzigs te 'di ltar lung bstan pa/ skye mang sngon nas las 'brel bas/ mtha' 'khob skyong ba'i slob dpon khyod/ / dgra bgegs yongs kyis 'jigs mi 'tshal/ /zhes 'di yin gyis kā la ri'i ri khrod phyag 'debs byed pa la bar chad kyi 'jigs pa gang yod lhag med du gzhom pa'i bka' gnang / rgya gar dur khrod bsil tshal du/ /slob dpon padma'i bka' dang dam/ / mkha' spyod nye ru ka yi bka'/ / rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed po dngos/ /rdo rje bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /skye ba lnga'am bdun gyi mtshams/ /lho gling dbang bsgyur rgyal po gsum/ / phal pa gnyis kyi bar dag tu/ / gnas 'dir mdo sngags lugs gnyis kyi/ / bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /skad cig mi g.yel rtag grogs bgyi/ / chos nyid bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i/ /rang bzhin nag po chen po nges/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /rnam bzhi'i zin las dus kun bsgrub/ /ces pa 'dis stag tshang lha mor 'byon pa'i sku zeng gi rim pa dang / ris med kyi mtha' 'khob ma rungs pa'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa bskyang ba'i snying stobs kyi go cha zla med pa bzhes dgos pa'i bka' gsung gnang /yang mgon po gdong bzhi bram ze'i gzugs khyi rnam pa byung nas/ drug cu rtsa drug skye ba'i sngon/ / rtag par 'grogs pa'i slob dpon khyod/ /mtha' 'khob bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /'phral yun las kun bsgrub par gyis/ / de khyod byang chub sa dge bar/ / gsang sngags bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ / ji ltar dgongs pa'i don rnams kun/ / rtag bsgrub sems nyid gcig pa nyid/ / ces sogs lung bstan mang po gnang ba dang / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi zhal nas/ brag srin 'dres pa'i nags 'dabs su/ /'gro 'dul gling bas sa bon btab/ /mdo sngags bstan 'dzin bla ma 'khrungs/ /yul mi kirti sprul sku zhes/ /de la gus tshad shar bha lar/ / rigs ldan rgyal pos rjes su 'dzin/ / zhes sogs 'al gsung mang po — 500 —

gnang / de nas mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i lung bstan zugs la dran te/ dbang gi zla gam lung ba nas/ /chos sde chen po 'byung 'gyur kye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha mor byon pa'i lam bar du bzhag sdom sgo chen thang du sgar brgyab ste bzhugs/ de'i nub mo khong gi mtshan lam du bstan bdag rta dkar 'chib pa zhig 'ongs nas/ khyed kyis bstan pa spel dang nga la bstan bdag byed dgos pa'i lung bstan yod pa khyed nas e dran zhes sogs gtam mang po gleng ba mis/ phyi nyin slob ma rnams la khyed tshes ltos dang 'grub ba zhig 'ong nges gda' zhes gsungs ma thag rta dkar 'chib pa'i mi gzhan las khyad par 'phags shing sprug mdangs chags pa'i skyes pa zhig snebs nas/ a lags rin po che sku khams bde lags zhes dad gus tshad med skyes nas 'dug pa la/ khyed su yin ming la ci zer zhes dris ma thag nga ni bzhag sdom dpon po yin/ ming la bkra shis lhun 'grub zer zhus tsa na/ 'o lags so rten 'brel shin tu legs/ nged cag la bstan dang bstan bdag byed dgos pa'i lung bstan yid la shar bas rgyal ba shar tsong kha bas phyag gnang mdzad pa'i gur mgon zhal thang rang byon ma khyed kyi bstan skal dang / stag tshang lha mor lam khrid byed dgos pa'i bka' gsung gnang / rjes su zhal thang byin can de ba'ag sdom sbas mtsho tshang la yod cing khyim gzhi 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis sga ye shes dar rgyas rigs rus dpon nor bu bzang pos kyirti bstan pa'i spyal mtshan la phul bas mgon khang gi nang rten gtso bo yin pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar/ lo rgyus de dag da skabs bzhag sdom khog nas bshad mkhan 'dug de nas chos sde chen po'i gnas gzhi stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo'i gnas sgor ri khrod gsar 'debs mdzad cing der bzhugs nas dgon gnas la gzigs zhib bgyis/ sa'i dbyibs zla gam mam zla phyed 'dra ba zhes pa de da lta'i dgon gnas 'di yin la/ mtsho sngon po g.yu yi martsel 'dra/ zhes da lta'i dgon gnas kyi gling stod phyogs su yod pa'i mtsho shul de yin/ brag dmar po dar gyi cod pan 'dra/ zhes pa yang da lta mchod 'bul ma zhes 'bod srol yod pa de'o/ /bkra shis dzas brgyad kyis mtshan pa'i gnas khyad par can stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo 'dir/ khong gis phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i ri khrod du lo mang por bzhugs/ ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i grwa ba sum cu tsam lon pa dang / des ma gzhi byas nas dbang phyogs zla gam gyi dbyibs su grub pa'i sa gnas der phyag 'debs mdzad pa po'i mtshan ri khrod kyi ming du chags pas kirte ri khrod ces grub pa yin/der bzhugs pa'i thā la ri khrod pa zhes skyes khungs kyi khyim mang la thā la zer ba'i yul ming mi la chags pas thā la ri khrod pa zhes zer ba yin la/ de kirti rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi sras kyi thu bor gyur nas yab sras rnam gnyis kirti ri khrod kyi grwa btsun sum cu tsam la 'grig lam dang chos 'chad nyan/ sgrub mchod/'don rta dbyangs/ 'bud rdung dkrol gsum sogs khungs ldan gyi phyag len ji bzhin du 'dzugs gnyer byas pa dang / khyad par du dge tshul slong gi sdom pa shar tsong kha ba chen po rje blo bzang grags pa'i lugasasrol ma nor yar rgyas su spel te/ dge tshul slong gi bslab bya/ lam rim che chung dang / bskyed rdzogs sna tshogs/ dbang lung rjes gsum sogs man ngag zab khrid gang mang bstsal/ tshad mthun gyi 'du khang — 501 —

chung ba zhig dang / gur zhal gyi mgon khang bcas lha khang khang shag gsum can zhig bcas bzhengs/de nas skabs shig la/ spyal ba tsong kha pa chen po dag zhing du gshegs pa mkhyen nas mchod 'bul spya chen mdzad de sgyun chab 'don zhing gsol ba btab pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ slob ma khyod ngal bar ma byed cig skye ba kun du 'bral bar med gsungs nas bka' gnang ba 'di ltar/ gus slob tshogs gnyis shugs ldan khyod/ / zhum pa mi dgos dga' ba sgoms/ / nga la skye 'chi med mod kyang / /rtag 'dzin bskul ba tsam du zad/ / rtag tu 'o cag 'bral ba med/ / yi dam 'jam dpal gzhin rje sogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus nga nyid yin/ /chos skyong srung ma ma lus kyang / /rang gi bran g.yog rang nyid de/ / rtsa gsum thams cad nga nyid la/ / skye 'chi 'phel 'grib ma mchis so/ / zhes gsungs/'dis kirti'i skye phreng dang khyad par stag tshang lha mor lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas chos sde tshen po yar skyong dang der gnas kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu sku phreng bcu gcig rim byon gyis gdul bya smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i thabs ma nor ba sogs gsung bshad mang du gnang / de nas dgung lo don bdun pa lcags rta lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyer gcig nyin thugs chos dbyibs su bsdus te/ ring bsrel la rigs lnga'i sangs spyas kyi sku dang yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi rtsa sngags phyag mtshan sogs gsal bar yod pa skye dgu thams cad kyi mthong thos kyi yul du gyur/ khong la mdo sngags sgan rtsis/ sgra snyan dngags/ sum rtags dag gsum sogs gsang rtsom po ti bcu bdun lhag yod kyang slob ma'i dpal 'byor dang cha rkyen zhan pas dpar du sbun thub par ma byung ba'i tshul sogs kirti'i dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i shog dril las gsal/tsha kho'i giti'i kā la ri'i ri khrod de'i bu dgon tshong ru'i mdzod dgon/ bar ma'i dgon/ cha nang dgon/ gza' ru dgon pa/ blo dge dgon/ 'bring pa'i sum mdo dgon/ lha gso dgon/ spo shor dgon/ sngo che ri khrod/ rmog ru dgon/ hor tshang girti dgon/ grong dge dgon/ rnga ba kirti dgon pa/ gnas gzhi dgon/ tsha kho tsho bdun dgon sogs dgon ma lag bco brgyad du grags so/ /tshal/ (11)rje'i slobam gnam gyis sabakab pa lta bur phyon pa las nang sgos gsang sngags nyams su len dngha gzhan la 'chad pa bsam gyis mi khyab byung yang / 'dus pa'i bka' babs pas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa ni/ mkhas spub shes rab seng ge ste/ bla ma 'di ni zab mo'i lta ba thugs la 'khrungs pa/ slob ma gzhan la med pa'i man ngag zhal shes ye ge med pa mang po yang 'di la yod pa yin gsungs/'di nyid la rje bla mas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gtad nas spel bar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rje rin po ches byams chen rje la rgyud grwa 'dzugs pa'i zhal ta gnang skabs se ra rtse nas rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa chen po shin tu mang bar gsang bde gnyis kyi rtsa rgyud kyi dbu nas chos thun re gnangs nas/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi glegs bye~X2 phyag gis btegs nas/ 'di bdag thub pa su yod ces lan gsum gyi bar gsung kyang sus

kyang lan zhu ma nus pa la/ rje shes rab seng ge mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus bzhengs te bdag gis bgyi zhes zhus te phyag lan gsum mdzad nas glegs bam blangs/de nas sher seng la rje bdag nyid chen pos/ khyod skrag mi dgos/ ngas chos rgyal la gtod pa yin/khyod gtsang du song dang / ri dril bu kha srungs pa 'dra ba'i steng na gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor ba yod/des khyod kyi bstan pa spel bar byed/ srin po gan rgyal du bskyel ba 'dra ba'i steng na gnod sbyin mo yod/des kyang khyod kyi bstan pa smrel bar byed/ de nas khyod rang gis shes yong zhes lung bstan/ de nas dge 'dun spub pa dang bcas yab sras gnyis gtsang du phebs/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pas kyang yab sras gnyis las mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan cing / mkhas grub kyi slob ma mang du 'dus pa rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi skor sher seng mtshan nyid kyi skor dge 'dun spub pa la gsan/ 'dul 'dzin pas zur chos pa mdzad de 'chad nyan shin tu 'phel ba byung / mkhas spub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ nga ri khud na gzhon pa zhig gi dus na chos rje shes rab seng ge chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos rje 'dul ba pa/de dag gi bu chen dang bcas pa ri khud na lhan cig bzhugs 'dug pa mthong ste/ ston pa 'khor bcas 'jig rten du byon pa 'dra ba cig yod pa yin zhes gsungs/ de ltar 'chad nyan 'phel bar bzhugs pa'i skabs shig shes rab seng ge'i thugs dgongs la sngar rje'i drung du rgyud spel ba'i g.yar dam phul ba glo bur du dran pa ltar mdzad nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad nyan mdzad bzhin pa'i sgo nas lhun po rtser byon/ chos sde'i bla ma 'phags 'od yon tan spya mtsho 'khor bcas kyis chos zhus/ 'dis rgyud 'grel sgron gsal rnam nges bya ba brtsams shing rgyud kyi bshad srol legs par bskyangs/ rjes lung bstan pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor ba 'di yin par byed/ chos sde der/ rje'i lugs kyi sgrub dkyil phyag len dang rgyud kyi bshad nyan btsugs te/ rten 'brel zhig la dgongs nas/ rje rin po ches gter nas bzhes pa'i chos rgyal gyi zhal 'bag dbyug zhags dang bcas 'jog pa gnang ba da lta'ang der mjal rgyu snang /de nas seng ge rtser phebs/ de'i dpon mos sbyin bdag mdzad nas chos sder snga ma bzhin sgrub dkyil phyag len dang rgyud kyi bshad nyan btsugs/ rje'i lung bstan gyi gnod sbyin mo ni dpon mo 'di yin par snang /seng ge rtser bzhugs skabs snga ma'i lung bstan gyi 'phror/ de nas rang gis kyang shes yong gsungs pa dang mthun par sher seng rang gi dgongs bcad kyis 'dul nag par srad rgyud btsugs pa'i zhal phebs pa yin te/ nyin gcig sku mdun du ja gral gnang ba'i g.yas kyi gral mgor rje dge 'dun grub/ de nas 'dul dkar ba sogs dang / g.yon gyi gral mgor 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po bzhugs par/ rje sher seng gis 'dul nag pa la/ khyod kyi dgung snying gang yin gsungs pas rta yin zhus par/ de bzang /'jig rten gyi gtam dper g.yag shi sar rta 'khrab zer bas/ khyod song la g.yag shi lung par rgyud kyi 'chad nyan gyis shig gsungs nas rje'i paṇa zhwa dang gos beer gnangs pas/ 'di rje dge 'dun thub par 'os/ nged la rje'i 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang shog lhung gnang dgos zhus nas blangs/ g.yag shi lung — 503 —

rdzusdo ༵ ṭwāṃspya pa/ srad kyi lung pa'i phur byon nas/ srad dga' ldan pho brang du rgyud grwa tshugs pas gtsang stod 'dul nag pa'i rjes nas/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi bar gdan rabs nyer gcig byon kyang chos brgyud bar ma chad du byon pa'i brgyud rim ni/ 'dul nag pa/ 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis 'phags pa/ mkhas grub rdo rje bzang po/ rgyud chen sangs spyas rgya mtsho/rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi bar byon/ rgyud chen de rnams bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa mthon po brnyes pa sha stag tu snang zhing / rgyud kyi bshad pa gtso bor 'grel ba bzhi sgags dang / ṭī ka che chung dang / 'dul nag pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i lam bsgrigs kyang chad par mdzad la/ khrid chen brgyad du grags pa gsang 'dus rim lnga'i dmar khrid/ bde mchog lo dril gyi khrid gnyis/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ dus 'khor gyi sbyor drug phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi byin rlabs bzhi ldan/ nā ro chos drug 'pho khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed rnams 'chad par mdzad pa las/bar skabs shig nas 'khor chen dang 'pho khrid gnyis bzhag nas/ khrid chen gzhan drug 'chad pas/phyis su srad rgyud lugs kyi khrid chen drug dang / smad rgyud lugs kyi khrid chen brgyad ces grags so/ /yan lag gi khrid la/ drug cu ba gsum gyi khrid/ 'khrul 'khor gyi khrid/ sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mcho'i khrid de man ngag gsum du grags pa dang / mgon po'i gtor chen gyi khrid/ gdugs dkar sogs zlog chen bzhi'i khrid rnams yod cing / gzhan yang gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs gtso bo'i sngags kyi man ngag du ma dang / byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi gdams pa shin tu zab pa mang po zhig brgyud pa 'di la yod par snang ngo / /rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel la srad rgyud rang nas snga tshar gyi slob ma kha shas byung 'dug kyang chos brgyud zin pa 'ig ma thon/ sku tshe'i snad du me rgan bla ma ngag dbang blo gros dang / 'a lu mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gnyis zhabs la gtugs na'ang / gsang 'dus kyi dbang bshad sogs gnad che ba rnams ma gsan/ dgung lo brgyad cu'i skabs kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / gya gcig la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan dang / thang sag pa dngos grub rgya mtsho rnams dbus nas ched gtad kyis byon nas zhabs la gtugs pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa/ rim gnyis kyi khrid kyis gtsos pa'i srad rgyud kyi gdams pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis gnang / mi ring bar rgyud chen nyid zhi bar gshegs snang ste chos bdag po la sprod kyi bar du bsgugs nas bzhugs pa lta bur sems so/ /dam pa 'di gsum gyis smad rgyud dang dpen sa brgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rnams kyang ma tshang ba med par gsan nas gdams pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa la/ rje ngag dbang chos ldan dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyis yig cha'ang mang du mdzad cing / thang sag pas — 504 bhe

kyang 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs sogs mdzad/ de nas thub mchog 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/gur smon pa don yod mkhas spub/ rje phur bu lcog pa chen po/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa rol ba'i rdo rje sogs kyis mtha' dbus kyi yul gru thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ / mkhas grub shes rab seng ges srad rgyud tshugs nas slar dbus su byon nas rgyud snad pa btsugs te rgyud kyi rgyal po'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ gtso bor gsang ba 'dus pa dang /khrid chen brgyad sogs 'chad spel gyi sgo nas rje bla ma'i gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ de rjes rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal ba khrir bzhugs nas 'chad nyan dang rgyud ṭīka rtsom pa mdzad/ de nas brgyud pa zin nges kyi bla rabs mang du byon zhing khrid yig sogs brtsams pa'ang mang ba las dwags po nam mkha' grags kyi gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs dar rgyas che bar snang ngo / /rje sher seng zhabs la thug tsam gyi gnas rnying ba kun dga' don grub rgyud la phebs nas/ sbyin pa dpal ba las rgyud 'grel man ngag rnams gsan/ sbyin pa dpal ba'i rjes su/ grags bzang ba khrir bzhugs pas gnyis ka lo snga phyir gshegs pa na/ khyud kyi 'chad nyan pa khong la 'os sa yin kyang / dbu mdzad don yod sogs kyis kre'u bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa bskos pa thugs cung zad ma rangs pa'i rnam pas/rgyud pa'i nang rten mgon thang dang ka pā la bsnams nas dbus stod du byon/ thog mar dpon slob drug dang / de nas sum cu so gnyis byung bas 'dus pa'i lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/bkris rgyan pa'i rjes su brgyud pa'i slob dpon du rgyan drangs kyang ma byon par rgyud kyi bshad pa btsugs pas lo re bzhin grwa tshogs ji 'phel du song ba rgyud chen rang gis lo bcu gsum gyi bar bskyangs pas dbus kyi rgyud stod grwa tshang 'di byung zhing / bla rabs rim par byon pa las paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang /ktom/ sde/ nam mkha' rgyul mtshan/ rje dkon mchog chos 'phel sogs phrin las rgya che ba'ang 'ga' zhig byung bskre shis lhun po'i mtshan kyi bshad grwa chen po'i gzhi 'ding ba po yang rje sher seng yin cing / gtsang dbus su rgyud kyi bshad nyan btsugs pa deng sang gi bar du ma nyams pa 'di bzhin yin pas/ chos rje yid bzang rtse bas/ rje'i slob ma la snar thang ba shes rab seng ge las phrin las che ba ma byung zhes bsngags pa'ang don la gnas so/ /gsung rtsom yang rnam 'grel ṭī ka lta khrid/ rtsa rgyud ṭī ka sogs mdzad/ zhal slob kyang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun thub/ 'phags 'od pa/ rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal/ rje smon lam dpal ba/ 'dul dkar nag gnyis sogs mkhas thub grags che ba mang po snang ngo / / gzhan yang rje bzang po bkra shis kyis kyang rgyud 'grel mang du bshad/ gnas brtan don grub dpal gyis lho brag tu sgron gsal gyi bshad pa btsugs/ chos rje zla rgyan pas nyi ldirtes dang / rdzing phyi'i phyogs su rgyud kyi bshad nyan mdzad/ phyis su mdo khams su rgyud stod smad kyi rjersā 'brangaṭwāṃ ༵'i rji tshang

lhang/ /du 'phel te/ rje bla ma'i bshad srol gyi 'dul ba'i 'chad nyan phyogs thams cad du dar bar rgyur (12)dben sa bka' babyud phyon tshul/ri bo dge ldan du rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang / skal ldan gyi slob ma lnga drug tsam gyis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / rje bla ma nyid la zhus pa'i lung bstan mang po dang / yang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang rje nyid kyis gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag khyad par can sgrul pa'i glegs bam du gragaspopa'i don rags pa 'ga' zhig mkhas thub thams cad mkhyen pa la yang mnga' zhing / yongs su rdzogs pa sprul pa'i glegs bam dang bcas pa bla ma rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho kho na las gzhan su la'ang ma gnangs/ de nas paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mkhas grub rje la bzhugs pa rnams zhus shing / khyad par du rtogs ldan 'jam dpal spya mtsho nyid la yongs su rdzogs pa zhus/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/snod ldan gyi gang zag gsum ma gtogs pa su la yang ma gsungs shing / gsum po de la yang / tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang ba'i snod ldan gyi slob ma re gnyis tsam byung na gdams pa 'di shod/ gzhan su la yang ༵tā ༵byi / /ma/ tsa/ ma yang ma smra zhes/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpang btsugs kyi bka' spya shin tu dayoslob ma de gsum la rdo rje mched gsum du grags te/ grub chen chos kyi rdo rje/ stod lung ba dpal ldan rdo rje/ khams pa rin chen rdo rje dang gsum mo/ / phyi ma 'di'i mtshan rdo rje dpal zhes bris pa'ang snang / rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos tshe dbang rdo rje srog shing gi lo rgyus su/ spub chen chos kyi rdo rje nyang stod pa nam jo mo lha ri'i padma phug tu bzhugs/ stod lung pa dpal ldan/ rdo rje grib kyi spya brag rdo rje brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas su bzhugs/ khams pa ye shes 'phan yul 'jog po'i phu'i dbon gnas su bzhugs shing 'chi med rdo rje'i sku skal dman gyis bltar mi snang bar gsungs/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'bras spungs kyi dben dgon dge 'phel gyi gnas su bzhugs par bshad pa'ang 'dug pa/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du/ grub chen dpal ldan rdo rje zhes pa 'ja' lus brnyes pa de la gzims chung nyi 'od du bde mchog lu hi pa'i dbang gsan pa dang / grub chen rang gis slob dpon padma las dngos su gsan pa'i tshe dbang phul zhes 'byung / spub chen chos kyi rdo rje ni/ rnam dag 'od gsal lha'i lam las 'ongs/ khachi med rdo rje'i 'ja' tshon lus bzung nas/ / bzhed dgu'i rol pas 'gro sgyu 'dren mdzad pa/ / chos kyi rdo rje'i ༵dro kā dhi ṭwāṃṭwāṃl/ /ba 'debs/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pas da lta yang bzhugs thub chen des rgyal ba blo bzang don grub la snyan brgyud sprul pa'i glegs bam dang bcas pa gnang /thun mong gi snang tshod la/ grub chen chos rdor dang / spyal ba dben sa ba'i bar du lo mang song yang chos gyi rdo rje dīdīdī lus su bzhugs pa rgyal ba blo bzang don grub kyi dag snang gis mjal ba yin pas/ 'ga'

zhig gis cal col smra ba ni 'phags chen rnams kyi gsang ba'i gnas la skur ba 'debs par zad do/ /rje blo bzang don grub kyis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes dang / des paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnang / dam pa snga ma gnyis dang khyad par paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas snyan bakhyud kyi gdams pa 'ga' zhig yi ger 'god par mdzad do/ / de ltar snyan brgyud sprul ba'i glegs bam gyis gtsos pa'i rje bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi gdams pa'i snying po du ma zhig gtso bor rtogs ṭā kā/ /tā da/ ce/ trīsna / shā /rje/ las brgyud pa rnams rgyal ba dben sa ba yab sras kyi bar du byon pa la dben lnga ba/ sbyis su phyon pa rnamasarghaṃs 'i bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i tshul/phyis su byon pa rnams kyis rje'i bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i tshul ni/ de yang phyi ma'i dus su dge ldan patrīringalukās 'dzirī pa'i skyes mashāg ṭī ba khrag khrig byon pa'i nang nas/ nyi zla ltar 'gran zla dang bral ba kau ༵ /sna ṭān bye dro/sna shātsho dro rgyadī/ ma/tshan ni/ slob dpon padma dang / jo bo rje dang / mnyam med gam po ba rnams dang thugs rgyud gcig par zhal gyis bzhes shing / thub pa'i dbang po'i drung du 'dri zhing lan ldon pa'i mchog nyan thos rab 'byor dang / shasgyu lar dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i khyud sdud pa bo rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa dang /'phags yul du 'phreng ba skor gsum sogs brtsams nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa slob dpon a bha yā ka ra dang / bod yul du 'dus pa'i lam bzang gsal mdzad sgra bsgyur chen po rta nag 'gos dang / gsang sngags rnying ma'i mkhas spub g.yung ston rdo rje dpal dang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i thugs kyi sras gcig pu mkhas thub rin po che dang / mkhas grub chen po bsod nams phyogs kyi glang po dang / sku tshe de nyid la mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa rgyal ba blo bzang don grub rnams kyi sku'i skye 'phreng rim par brgyud de/ sku tshe 'di nyid la rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag dang / khyad par du rje bla ma'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i bdag po/ spyir thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / khyad par du rje bla ma'i ring lugs 'dzin spel gyi mdzad zin nam mkha' dang mnyam pa paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ sku skye ba phyi ma paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan ye shes dbang po dang / de nyid kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che da lta bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ gong sa lnga ba chen po'i 'khrungs rabs ltar na sngon gyi sku'i skye 'phreng shin tu mang yang grags che ba rnams ni/ 'phags yul du rgya dkon mchog 'bangs dang / bod du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mi rje'i rnam par bstan pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / bka' gdams kyi phyi mo 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' nga dkā ༵7 chen kun

dga' snying po dang / rje bla ma'i sras mchog thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dang / de nyid kyis/dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / rje khyod kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ / dus nam yang brtson pa bgyid par smon/ /zhes thugs smon mdzad pa bzhin skye 'phreng rim byon gyis rje bla ma'i ring lugs rgyas par mdzad pa ste/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos mkhas spub yongs kyi mgon du gyur te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzad/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos mtha' 'khob mun gling chos kyi snang bas khyab par mdzad do/ /rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtshos rje'i bstan pa la log par 'khu ba rnams tshar bcad/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos chos srid 'azin las kyi gdugs dkar gcig gis sa steng khyab par mdzad do/ /sku phyi ma rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshes gdul bya'i bsod nams dman pas mdzad mthar ma phyin pa la/ slar yang thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshos rgyal ba dge 'dun spub kyi rnam par thar ba bdag gir bzhes te ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin yongs kyi dpal mgon chen por gyur cing dka' gnad legs bshad kyi yig 'jog kyang mang du mdzad/ sku 'bum byams pa gling ni/ phamatsho sngon zhing chen hong spung rdzong khongs7 shar tsong kha'i yul du yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon chen zhig yin pa 'di nyid rab byung bcu pa'i sa byi 1588 lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams spya mtsho'i zhal bkod ltar rje tsong kha pa 'khrungs sar 'dul ba chos rje 'od zer rgya mtshos phyag btab pa dang / phyi rim gyis rgya bskyed byas nas bar skabs grwa tshang bzhir 'phel rgyas byung ngo / /(1)sharargyalastso rong gnas chen dmu mdunasbyo snang dgon chags tshul/shar rgyal mo rong gnas chen dmu rdo'i mdun du spro snang du dge rnying bon gsum tshogs pa'i dgon chung zhig yod pa gzhi byas te rab byung bzhi pa'i chu sprel (1212)lor bshes gnyen chen po blo bzang sangs rgyas dang / pa wam spyal po dkon mchog tshe brtan mchod yon gyis btab pa gling chen dgon chos 'khor gling zhes spro snang pa blo bzang smon lam dang / de'i sprul sku blo bzang mkhyen rab dpal bzang rnam gnyis kyis dga' ldan khri ba mdzad/ der bla ma blo bzang don grub kyi lha sa nas spyan drangs pa'i jo sku dang bka' bstan chos sogs rten khyad 'phags bzhugs su gsol lo/ /(2)chu chen rababartanal g.yung drung lhasnyeng gi mkhanarabs byon tshul/chu chen rab brtan nam mkha' rgyal pos rgyal sa bon gyi gnas chen du grags shing / 'di stobs dang dpa' rtsal che bas/ hor rgyal po'i dus ma thul bas phyis su chin rgyal rabs skabs su dmag dpon ā cang jun dmag dang bcas pas lo bcu gnyis kyi ring 'thab nas mnga' 'og tu bcug bon gyi mtshan nyid yod pa'i dgon chen g.yung drung lha steng / gong ma lhas skyong gi bkas dge lugs su bsgyur/ bstan 'phel gling zhes pen dang / dngul phog stsal/ mkhan po thog mar 'bras spungs sgo mang pa gtsang pa sangs rgyas 'od zer bskos/ 'dir phebs skabs bon gyi gtso bo mang po khrims la sbyar ba'i gshed 'dre mngon sum pa lta bus yul khams phung bar yod pa sbyin sreg mdzad pas zhi/ de nas rgyal rong spro snang ba blo —— 508 ——

gling blo bzang 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal kha pa ser snad ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nam dga' ba chen po/bkra shis lhan po blo bzang bstan ldan/ 'bras mu le ba 'jam dbyangs smon lam/ rgyal kha pa ser sgad ngag dbang lhun grub/ dge bshes tsa pa blo gling bstan pa rin chen/ dga' ldan co ni pa ngag dbang bzang po/ ser byas bya khyung pa grags pa chos 'phel/ gser khog pa sgo mang blo bzang chos 'phel/ser smad rgyal kha pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ spro snang ba blo gling 'jam dbyangs yar 'phel/ 'di yan gong ma lhas skyong nas btang ba'i mkhan rabs bcu gsum/ gzhung bskos/ ser smad rgyal kha pa blo bzang dam chos/ rab brtan sems li ba dga' ldan 'jam dbyangs sbyin pa/ dge bshes tsa pa blo gling 'jam dbyangs yar 'phel sogs byon nas bskyangs pa'i bka' drin gyis dgon ma lag kun zhwa ser gyi lugs dar rgyas che/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyi skye bar grags pa rgyal rong nam mkha' lhun sgrub kyang rab brtan pa yin/ khams mi nub rgyal po btsan la pa yin par grags/ gyes smad mi phu dgon bshad sgrub gling ni/ ser smad rab 'byams pa grags pa bzod pas rab byung bcu gsum chu byi (1792)lor btab/ 'du khang gsar rnying du brag mgo'i 'jim bzos bzhengs pa'i jo sku sogs dang li thang bka' 'gyur/ dgon rgyab tu the 'og sku mkhar/ ri rtse'i ja sag ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi sprul sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs kyis bskyangs/ tshogs pa nyis brgya bgal ba snang / byes smad/ bsod nams yag seng go rdzong / hwa nyong bzhi la btsan la khag bzhi zer/ bsod nams yag gcig pu la yang sde srid bco brgyad yod/ lhas skyong gyi yab nga ro 'brug thar gong ma khang shis kyis the wan mes rgyal gcig gyur ched du (1684)shing byi lor rgyal khab dang gong ma'i sku don du mngags te rgyal rong gi dmag dpung rnams rgya mtsho'i phar khar dmag la gyin nas rgya mcho'i 'gram nas gzhi chags pa dang rang srog blos btang ba mang /(2)rgyalayo nong 'dirgya che zhingarmokhan po dang dge bshes byung zul mang rabs/des mtshon nas rgyal rdong phyogs 'di rgya che zhing mi rnams blo rno bas mkhan po dang dge bshes thon pa yang mang / rgyud stod mkhan po btsan la ser sgad du 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las/ rgyud smad mkhan po rgyal rong blo gling ba blo bzang tshul khrims/ bsod nams yag pa blo gling rgya mtsho bstan dar/ blo gling rgyal rong 'jam dbyangs dam chos gsum/ ser byas mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang shes rab/ ser smad mkhan po rgyal rong pa bsod nams dar rgyas/ rgyal rong blo bzang dam chos dang blo bzang dpal ldan gsum/ dor e wam gyi mkhan po dang mdo pa rong po lnga bcu par grags pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ 'bras rgyal ba mkhan po spro snang ba blo bzang don grub/ pha bong kha pa'o mkhan po smad zur rgyal rong ba bstan 'dzin mkhas grub/ mgar thar mkhan po khyung po ser tsha bla zur blo gling blo bzang mkhas grub/ ser smad dge bshes rgyud smad ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ blo gling pa rgyud smad byang chub smon lam/ 'di gsum rgyal kha pa yin la gsum ga mgar thar mkhan po/ thang sag mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang chos 'phel/ sog tsardo gyi mkhan po seng ge rdzong pa ser smad 'jam dbyangs bsam gtan/ 'di smra khams bo bod dang / dbus — 509 —

stod byams gling sogs kyi khri yang mdzad/ smra khams bo bod dgon gyi bla ma rgyal rong ngag dbang dpal ldan/bri dar rgyas gling gi mkhan po rgyal rong bstan pa chos dar/ rgyal rong rab 'byams pa gnyis/ spyi snad sasbe grwa tshang gi bla ma rgyal rong bsod nams rdo rje/ dbus stod byams gling gi bla ma rgyal rong blo bzang spyal mtshan/ mal gro mkhan po rgyal rong 'azin las rgya mcho/ shag skor mkhan po rgyal rong ngag dbang 'azin las/ rgyal rong 'jam dbyangs yar 'phel gnyis/ gsar phu'i mkhan po rgyal rong zhabs drung grags pa dpal ldan/ dol gsung rab gling gi mkhan po rgyal rong dkon mchog lhun thub/ dga' ldan rgyal rong byang rtse mkhan po blo bzang sbyin pa/ sor snad mkhan po 'bar khams pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang ngag dbang theg mchog gnyis/ rtse lnga'i ja sag du ma/ gzhanayang sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po rong ston blo bzang grags pa/ 'phan yul na lend+ra 'debs mkhan rdong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ rong ston blo gros mtshungs med/ gshegs khar mkha' spyod grub pa tsha rong ba bsod nams bzang po sogs kyang rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad du grags pa gang rigs kyi mnga' nebs su gtogs par snyam mo/ / rdong ston gyi skye ba drug nyag rig ral gyis phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i mjug par brtsams/ rgyal ti'i zhabs drung yab yum ma mthun pa'i bar la byon pas dbu la gri phog dbu ska rags kyis bsdoms nas phar na rtsom mjug phud/ 'di zhu dag byed pa rang yod dam zhu dag byed gsung nas gshegs/ gri phog pa yang sngar se rar bzhugs dus rje btsun pa la cung ma dad pa'i rnam smin du gsungs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i (1775) (shing lug)lor nga ro 'brug thar gyi sras a zhen gyi bon bsgyur te seng ge bkra shis chos gling dgon btab/ song ge rdzong du nga ro a 'bum gyis bon bsgyur nas dge lugs kyi dgon chung zhig btsugs/ de rjes nga ro sa rgyal gyis sbyin bdag byas te 'bras blo gling dge bshes ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis mchod rten sgang chos gling btab/btsan lha'i rdzong shul du rgyas phog dpon dang / dmag dpon bzhag bon bsgyur te dgon sde chags pa spyal rtsa gling ngam mis bī dgon zhes grags/ dge 'dun brgya lhag gi rtsis kyi phog dngul kyang gtong /mkhas spub rje'i dngos slob chos grags/ khri yang steng blo bzang chos 'phel/ dga' ldan khri thog don bzhi pa blo bzang lhan grub/ khyung ngo ser tsha blo bzang mkhas thub sogs mkhan chen mang po'i 'khrungs yul yang yin no/ /rig gnas kyi skor/ rgyal rong phyogs 'dir mtshan nyid pa/ sgan pa/ ri mo pa/ glu gar pa/lo rgyus pa/ zlos gar pa bcas mod pa dper na/ tsha rong gso rig chos 'byung na yul 'dir 'khrungs pa'i gso rig pa phul byung can mang po yod cing / mdo smad chos 'byung sogs na cog tse'i sku rus drug pa rgyal po tshe dbang lhun 'grub dang bcas pa'i rig gnas pa'i skor/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa phag lor paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes pho brang du phebs te gong ma lhas skyong rgyal po dang lhan du tsha brol zhing nas rgya bod kyi glu gar rol mo'i dpal la rol tshe/ rgya'i khrang shi(zlos garatram̐rtsa~X ṭwāṃ~X/—sgyu ma mkhan dang / bod kyi lha mo dang rol dbyangs/ rgyal rong gi glu gar sogs yod

tshul 'jigs med dbang po'i gsungs na yod pa las/ da dung rgyal rong gi 'khrugs pa zhi rjes/ yul de'i glu gar dang zlos gar lta bu gong ma'i gser mkhar na'ang med phyir/ gar phrug mang po pho brang du khrid de/ bod rgyal rong gi zlos gar dang seng 'cham srol dod ces dang / pho brang nub phyogs kyi ri bo spos ldan na gnas pa'i da lta'i dar dmar sde pa ni spyal rong ba'i gar phrug rnams kyi gnas yul yin pa'i tshul bcas rgya'i deb ther na yod pa lta bu'o/ / (1769 )lor rgyal rong so mang rgyal mo sgrol ma mchos kun mkhyen 'jig med dbang po gdan drangs/ zab cing rgya che thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos/ /ma lus bdud rtsir 'dzags pa'i zla ba'i rigs/ /ris med kun la snyom pa'i spyod tshul gyis/ /'phags pa rigs brgya'i cod paṇa zhabs padmor/ / zhes sogs zhu don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa nam 'phang can
