zhus/ chos bka' ci rigs mnos te dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba phul/ rta thog nas gar 'khrab pa dang / tsha kho'i yul lugs kyi seng ge gnyis/ rdzi bo gcig dang bcas pa'i 'cham chas cha 'grig kha tshang zhig phul ba'i rgyun ni/da lta'i bla brang gi seng 'cham sogs yin pa dang / spyal rong gi rtsig pa ni ring mo nyid nas bzung tshoms chen dgu thog can yod ces rgya'i deb ther na yod cing / a mdo'i byang gi rdo rtsig gi rgyun yang de yin pa dper na/ 1772 chu 'brug lor bla brang gi tshogs chen 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu can de je cher gtong dus/so mang rgyal mos ched mngags kyi rtsis dpon bzhi sogs rdo rtsig pa du mas/ rtsig pa shin tu brtan cing mdzes par bsgrubs so zhes/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum na yod pa ltar ro/ / de las yul 'di'i 'bag dang gsob/ 'jum bzo/ gser dngul mgar ba dag ni lag rtsal khyad du 'phags shing bzo rtsal rmad du byung ba'o/ / bla brang gi khri gung thang ba'i tshoms dkar po'i nang gi/ gzhan yang dag pa'i dngul dkar 'ba' zhig las/ / lha ldan jo bo'i sku dang tshad mnyam pa'i/ / rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal po'i snang brnyan ni/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis kun nas mdzes pa bzhengs/ /zhes chos dungadakar po'i sgra dbyangs na yod pa'i dngul gyi jo sku de ni/ rgyal rong mgar chen sna brgyad ces pa'i bzo rtsal las grub pa dang / rgyal rong grags pa rgyal mtshan pas tā ming zon te rgyal por bka' 'gyur gyi ma dpe phul myongs shing / rdzi 'gag rgyal pong shul tsa tshe dbang drag rgyal gyi yul de'i lha bzo dang smyug thogs pa mang po bkug nas gser bris kyi dpe cha mdzad byang dang ldan pa skor zhig pe cin dpe mdzod khang na da lta yod pa tāṭwāṃ // / lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen po na'ang rgyal rong ba'i gna' rdzas mang po da lta mthong rgyu yod pa lta ༄ le'u nyer gcig pa/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi skor/de yang sa skya paṇa ṭi tas mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad pas/snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu rgyas/ dgung lo re gsum bzhes pa rab byung bzhi ba'i shing 'brug — 511 —

( 12 4)lo la hor rgyal go tan gyis gdan drangs/ 'dir hor rgyal gyi byung ba mdo tsam brjod na/hor jing gir rgyal po zhes grags pa'i dbang sdud can de rab byung gsum pa'i chu rta (1162)lo la skyes zer/khong lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon dus pe te zhes sog po'i sde chen po zhig gi rgyal por gyur/ kho ni thabs la mkhas shing dpa' rtsal 'dzoms pa zhig 'dug la/ kho la bu dpa' rtsal blo rig ldan pa bzhi dang / blon po mkhas pa dgu yod par bshad/ bu gnyis pa cha ga ta'i zer ba u ru su dang thod dkar yul gyi rgyal po byas/de la bu lnga yod pa'i che ba ab to zer ba rang gi pha'i spyal sar bskos/ bu lnga ba the mur zer ba o rod gyi rgyal po byas/ jing gir rgyal po'i bu gsum pa u go ta'i zer ba/ jing gir rgyal po rang gi rgyal sar bzhag 'di'i bu che ba go yug dang / go tan gnyis kyang rgyal sar bldad par ma zad go tan lang spu phyogs kyi khams rgyal po byas te/ bod kyi sa sne dag la'ang the gtogs byas/ jing gir rgyal po'i bu tho lo no yon zer ba mug tun mkhar du bsnad de man ju dang rgya'i khams rgyal po byas/ de la bu bzhi yod pa'i da~X po hoṭwāṃ ṭī chenā shāl po zeṭwāṃ ba des/ pha'i shul bzung bar ma zad rgya bod sog po kun la dbang bsgyur ba rgyawa tre tā/ byu bye ṭwāṃ dri~X/ cho/sa gridaspyi tshul/rab byung gsum pa'i shing mo yos (1195)lo la hor jing gir spyal po'i dmag bod kyi sa mtshams su tshebs skabs/ bod kyi lde dpon so sos dmag zlog thabs su dmag dpon rnams la rgyu nor gtos chen bskur te/ de dus so mang rgyal po'i tshab tu spyon po mda' mkhan sogs dpon 'khor bcu phrag tsam gyi 'dab nor phran bu re khyer nas ra ra kha che zhes thob blangs/ deng phyin chad hor la khral 'jal rgyu yin zhes sogs kyi 'azin btang nas re zhig bzlog de rjes lo skor gcig gi 'phror rab byung bzhi pa'i me yos (1207)lo la yang sog dmag bod du slebs pa 'gog thabs su 'dab nor phran bu re ster rgyu byas 'dug zer/hor jing gir rgyal po rang lo drug cu'i thog rab byung bzhi pa'i me phag gi (1227)lo la tsha ba'i nad byung nas 'das/ mu gi ta'i rgyal sar bkod/ bod gyis lo shas la 'dab nor te khral ma sprad stabs/khams rgyal go tan khros te rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags byi (1240)lo la dmag dpon li ci dang / dor rta nag po dmag khri gsum dang bcas gshar nas/ mdo stod smad kyi mi mthong tshad bsad/ grong sde mang po bcom/ bod kyi rgyal khams chab la phab/ slad nas mnga' 'og tu bcug kyang / chu chen rab brtan pa mnga' 'og tu ma tshud zer/ lung bsgyur ba ni sa skya ba dang mchod yon tu 'brel ba yin/ zhes paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas gsungs/de nas lang gru na yod pa'i khams kyi rgyal bo go tan gyis dor rta la/ deng dus bod na su bzang dris pas/ do rtas/ dge 'dun gyi sde bka' gdams pa mang / chos ni sa skya paṇa ṭi ta mkhas/ mi chos ni stag lung pa mkhas/ gzi brjid ni 'bri gung che/ zhes lan phul bas/ dge 'dun mang yang tshang ma gdan 'aṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༵ thub/ mi chos la nga yang mkhas/ gzi bajid ni nga che/ nga la dgos pa ni chos la mkhas

pa dgos zer nas/ gser yig pa rdo sri mgon dang / dpon jo dang gnyis bka' shog dang 'bul ba gtos chen po bcas gdan 'dren du mngags/ khong gis kyang khu bo grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi lung bstan thugs la shar nas/ dbon (tsha bu)'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dgung lo bcu lon pa dang / spyag na drug lon pa gnyis/ phyag phyir khrid de byon/ rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas chos kyis tshim par mdzad/de nas bzung ste hor rgyal dang sa skya ba mchod yon du 'brel ba'i 'go tshugs/ hor rgyal gyis 'dzam gling gi yul khams mang po dbang bsgyur pas/ bod sil bur 'thor zhing gcig gyur med pas/ hor rgyal gyi ngo ya mi yong bar ma zad/ ngo ma bltas na gyong chen po rag yong dgongs nas/ sa paṇa gyis bod yongs la hor gyi ngo blta dgos tshul gyi chab shog rgyas pa gnang / de'i stabs kyis re zhig hor dmag gis bod la gsod bcom chen po ma byung ba red/ dgu lo bdun cu bzhes pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag (1251)lo la gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ de'i skabs khong dbon (tsha bu)'gro mgon 'phags pa dgung lo bcu bdun yin/ de'i phyi lor go tan yang 'das/ hor dmag bod du slobs nas mon mkhar mgon po gdong bcom nas mi shin tu mang po bsad/ rgyal tsha dang jo 'ber zer ba'i bod kyi mi chen gnyis bsad/'phags pa rin po che dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog se chen rgyal bus gdan drangs te bla mchod mdzad/dgung lo nyer gcig thog mdo khams su phebs nas mkhan po grags pa seng ge las bsnyen par rdzogs/rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags spel (1260)lo la se chen rgyal po rang lo zhe drug thog rgyal sar 'khod de rgya sog man gsum sogs mi rigs du ma la dbang bsgyur/ 'phags pa rin po che gong ma'i rgyal sar phebs/gong ma'i ban sge shes skyed kyi 'ja' sa thog mar gnang / rgyal po dang btsun mos gtsos rgyal blon skal ldan nyer lnga la yi dam kyi rdor sogs kyi dbang lan gsum gyi bar bskur/ hor rgyal khams su gsang sngags bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ dbang dang po'i yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/ gnyis pa'i skabs su bod chol kha gsum phul/ gsum pa'i skabs su dbang yon du rgya'i mi yul chen po zhig phul/ rten gsum gser dngul dang dar gos sogs dngos skyes phul ba ni bgrangs kyis mi lang / dgung lo so gcig thog bod du phebs/ slar dgung lo so lnga'i thog gong ma'i pho brang du phebs/ lo bdun la bzhugs nas dgung lo zhe gnyis pa la sa skyar phebs/ sa skya ba bod chol kha gsum gyi bdag por gyur stabs/ bla mas bla ma'i bya ba mdzad/ dpon na rim du bskos pa rnams kyis 'jig rten rgyal srid kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /sa chen kun dga' snying po dang / khong gi sras slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gsum rten dge bsnyen yin stabs/ dkar po rnam gsum zer/ sa skya pakho chen dang /'gro mgon 'phags pa gnyis rten dge slong yin gshis/ dmar ra zhing / gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum sde dger shing dpar na yod/ sa skya'i chos sde chen po'i gdan sa ba thog ma ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun snying / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen rnams yin/ 'di rnams kyi dus su sa skya ba zhes snyan grags rab tu che ba las/ bod yongs la sa — 513 ge

skyas dbang bsgyur pa min la/ bod yongs la dbang bsgyur pa ni chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dus nas yin )/se chen rgyal pos bla ma 'phags pa la bod chol kha gsum phul nas bzung bod khams yongs la dbang bskur te/ dpon chen rim par bskos pa rnams kyis bod kyi srid dbang bzung / khri skor bcu gsum la khri dpon re ri bzhag mdo stod mad la dpon kha shas bzhag ste srid dbang brtan por bzung zhing / rgyab rten sog rgyal gong ma byas so/ /sa skya bas dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha ste/ bod chen po'i chol kha gsum la dbang bsgyur/ dbus gtsang du bod khri skor bcu gsum byas pa ni/ la stod lho byang / gur mo/ chu mig shangs/ zha lu ste gtsang gi khri drug rgya ma/ 'bri gung / tshal pa/thang bo che ba/ phag spu/ g.ya' bzang ste dbus kyi khri drug dbus gtsang gi mtshams su yar 'brog khri skor gcig ste bod khri skor bcu gsum du bgos/ khri skor re la dpon re dang / khri dpon re'i 'og tu stong dpon bcu re bskos shing / mdo stod du'ang dpon bzhag dbang bsgyur 'dug go/ /de ltar bod yongs la dbang byed pa'i dpon chen rim par bskos pa ni/ dpon chen dang po dpon chen shākya bzang po/ 'di sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i lcags ri phyi nang dang / khang gsar chen mo brtsigs/'di mdo smad bka' ma log gi mi yin gsungs/ de 'das nas dpon chen gnyis pa nang chen kun dga' bzang po dpon chen du bskos/ 'di'i skabs bla ma 'phags pa rin po che dang / dpon chen kun dga' bzang gi bar nye gnas kyis phra ma bcug nas/ bla ma thugs ma dgyes/ 'di khog tu bzhag nas nye gnas kyis lkog tu rgyal po la yi ge phul rkyen bla ma gshegs/ nye gnas kyis hor dmag bod du bos pa bla mas shes dogs nas nye gnas kyis bla ma dug gis bkrongs pa red/ ces kyang zer/ gang ltar bla ma 'phags pa dgung lo zhe drug thog gshegs/ rab byung dang po'i lcags sbrul (1281)lo la se chen gyi lung gis hor dmag bod du slebs te nyang smad bya rog rdzong phab nas dpon chen kun dga' bzang bo bsad/ kho 'chi khar gos dkar bo gyon nas zhwa nag po gyon pa/ nyes pa med pa'i brnar go nas/ se chen gyis zhib 'jug sgos dmag dpon rnams la chad las drag po btang 'dug zer/ dpon chen gsum pa 'ang btsun/bzhi ba phyug po sgang dkar ba/ lnga ba byang rin/ byang rin la se chen gyis shel dam gnang / drug pa dkon gzhon/ bdun pa gzhon dbang / 'di'i ring la che gsal chen 4 dang dbus gtsang gi khrims kyi zhib cha byas gsungs/ brgyad pa byang rdor/ dgu pa ang len/ dpon 'di gsum gyi ring la 'bri gung ba dang 'thab/ khyad par ang len gyi skabs/ rab byung lja ba'i shing bya (1285)lo la 'bri gung ba'i dmag gis bya yul dgon mer bsregs/ bla ma gtsang ston bkrongs/ stod hor gyi rgyal po hu la'i hu'i dmag khrid nas/ sa skyar dmag drangs te/ sa skya gtor nas dbang 'phrog rtsis byas skabs/ ang len gyis khri skor bcu gnyis kyi dmag bsdus te/ rab byung lnga ba'i lcags stag(1290)lo la 'bri gung ba'iwa bog /1 twemag drangs nas 'bri gung gi gzim spyil ma gtogs thams cad me la bsregs 'bri gung gling

log tu grags pa'i bcom khyer chen po de byung / dwags po sogs su dmag drangs ba'i sa mtshams kyi brag la ang len gyi ming bris 'dug zer/ sa skya'i dpon chen zhig la drag shul 'di las che ba ma byung zer/ang len gyi rjes su gzhon dbang yang bskyar dpon chen du bskos kyang lam nas gapog gis bsad/ de rjes dpon chen bcu ba legs pa dpal/ bcu gcig pa seng ge dpal/ bcu gnyis pa 'od zer seng gebacu gsum pa kun dga' rin chen/ bcu bzhi ba don yod dpal/ bco lnga ba yon btsun/ bcu drug pa 'od zer seng ge yang bskyar bskos/ bcu bdun pa rgyal ba bzang po/ bco brgyad pa dbang phyug dpal/ bcu dgu pa bsod nams dpal/ nyi shu pa yang bskyar rgyal ba bzang po skos/ 'on kyang 'di'i skabs/ dbang brtson pa'i dpon chen gyi go sa 'phrog rtsod byas stabs/ sa skya ba nang ma 'grig pa sogs phyi nang gi rkyen du ma byung nas/ bod kyi chab srid kyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi lag tu shor te/ sde srid phag mo gru bas bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur ro/ /de rjes sa skya'i rshapo/ na/ chen re bskos bzhag byas mod/ sa skya'i rang khongs bdag byed pa las spyi dbang med pa 'dug gnyis pa/ phag gru ba'i lorgyus/de yang phag gru'i gdung rabs chos srid gnyis kyi sgo nas yar ldan du gtong ba'i byed po gtso bo ni/chos rje spyan snga rin po che dang / gong ma ta'i si tu sogs dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung las rim par byon pa rnams yin la/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las/ lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye brgyud ma shes na/ nags khung gi spre'u dang 'dra/ mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na/ g.yu 'brug zol ma dang 'dra/ yab mes kyi che dge yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phrug yal bor dang 'dra bas/ skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/byas pa'i chos la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/ che ba'i mi la mtho ba'i rtags dgos/ bsgrub pa'i mthu la spub pa'i rtags dgos/ 'thab pa'i mi la dpa' ba'i rtags dgos zhes gsungs te/ thog mar mi'i rigs srid pa'i sgong nga las skyes par bshad/ zhes 3 bas pa rnams gyis gleng / de nas rim gyis brgyud de bod kyi rus chen bco brgyad dang / 'bras la dkar nag khra gsum sogs dang / bod kyi mi'u gdung drug sogs byung tshul nas/ mang ldom stag btsan gyi bar gyi mi rgyud byung tshul gsungs/ de'i mi rgyud la dpa' / ṭwāṃṣṭṛ // lha'i spyan gyis gzigs pa mang po byung bas/ gdung rigs la rlangs lha gzigs zhes grags pa de nas mi rabs du ma'i rjes su rlangs lha gzigs kyi mi rgyud la a mi byang chub 'dre 'khol byon/'di gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyis/ gling yul du lan gnyis gdan drangs/ de dag gi rgyud du chos rje spyan snga rin po che 'khrungs gsungs/bod kyi khri dpon phal che ba ni/ bla ma re'i phrin las kyi rgyun las byung bar bshad pas/ phag spu'i dpon rgyud 'di yang / 'gro mgon phag mo gru bas phag gru'i gdan sa btab pa las shārdo ṭwāṃ yin la/

bde gshegs phag mo spu ba ni/ rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag (1110)lor khams 'bri chu'i rgyud du 'khrungs nas/ dgung lo dgu ba'i thog rab tu byung ste mtshan rdo rje spyal por btags/ bla ma mang po bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ dgung lo zhe dgu ba rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag (1158)lor phag mo gru ba'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung / de'i chos rgyud 'dzin mkhan rnams la phag thu bka' rgyud zer/ de'i slob ma 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po ni khams nas 'khrungs/ phag mo gru pa sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/dgung lo so bdun pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa phag (1179)lor 'bri gung gi dgon pa btab/ de'i rgyud 'dzin pa rnams la 'bri gung bka' ba da zer/rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung rgyud 'gro mgon phag mo gru ba'i sku mched du gtogs pa yon chen rgyal ba skyabs la sras spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ dpon mgon po rgyal/ yon chen sangs rgyas skyabs gsum byung / che ba grags pa 'byung gnas gzhon nu'i skabs nas 'bri gung skyobs pa 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ lo bco brgyad nas sum cu rtsa bzhi'i bar 'bral med du chos rje 'bri gung ba 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar bzhugs nas sku g.yog zhus pas spyan snga ba zhes mtshan thogs/ dgung lo / sdo/ ṭā / dhi/// la 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' bzhin du phag spu'i dgon pa gdan sa thel gyi de nas bzung ste thel gyi gdan sa ba la sbyan snga zer zhing rlangs kyi mi rgyud cig dgos/ dgung lo re gcig thog 'bri gung gi gdan sar phobs/ yon chen sangarmo rgyas skyabs kyi sras rgyal ba rin po che grags pa brtson 'grus sam rgyal sras thog rdugs pa yang zer/ de nyid thel gyi gdan sar phebs/ 'di'i sngon du khri dpon gyi thob med/ bla ma rgyal ba rin po che grags pa brtson 'grus/ 'di thel gyi gdan sa ba yin skabs/ sog rgyal gong mas phag gru ba la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa gyin pas/ ldan ma sgom brtson spyi dpon byas na'ang / legs po ma byung stabs/ bla ma khong gi nye gnas rdo rje dpal khri dpon du bskos/ rgyal sa ṭwāṃ /spyazlo ༵ sdoṭwāṃ/ṭwāṃ snas// phag gru ba dang / sne gdong ba zhes grags/ sne gdong ni/ deng sang lho kha ༄rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung rgyud phag thu'i dpon phal cher rab tu byung nas slob gnyer mdzad de mkhas grags thob nas/ thel gyi gdan sar phebs te/ spyan snga'i mtshan gsol zhing lugs gnyis kyi bdag po lta bur byas/ 'ga' res sa skya nas khri dpon gyi bka' shog blangs te khri dpon byas/ gdung 'dzin skya bo rnams kyis khyim thabs bzhes te gzhis ka dang rdzong bdag gnyer byed cing gdung rgyud spel ba sogs byed pa red/ khri dpon rdo rje dpal gyis gzhis rdzong bcu gsum brtsigs pa sogs dar rgyas che tsam byung zer/ rdo rje dpal 'das rjes de'i gcung gzhon nu rgyal mtshan khri dpon byas na'ang / cha lugs ya ma zung byaṭwāṃ1/6 mtshan phyed bar du glu dang bro rdung / nyin phyed bar nyal bsdad pas/ lo gsum tsam las

dpon ma zin/ de rjes khri dpon rin rgyal/ byang gzhon/ gzhon nu yon tan rnams rim par khri dpon la bskos na'ang / nag chang la 'dzem med du spyod pa sogs/ dpon gyi 'dzin tshugs ma byung bas/sa dang ri sde mang po lag nas shor/ de nas mi drug gis re zhig khri dpon gyi tshab byas/ de rjes spyan snga grags pa rin chen thel gyi gdan sar phebs te khri dpon zur du ma bskos par bla dpon sgags ma mdzad/khong thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa'i mkhas pa yin stabs thabs mkhas kyis sngon shor ba'i sa dang ri sde rnams rdzas kyis blu ba sogs kyis tshul bsdus/ phag gru skor la bka' drin che zer/ de rjes rgyal mtshan bzang po dang rgyal mtshan skyabs gnyis rim par khri dpon byas kyang / khos ka chung bas kun gyis brnyas par byas te phag gru'i sde srid kyi bya ba nyag phra bar gyur/rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi lag nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis khri dpon gyi go sa blangs so/ /de yang dpon rin chen skyabs la lcam gnyis las chung ba 'bum skyed la chu pho stag gi (1302)lor byang chub rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum gyi thog nas klog bslabs te mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo dgu'i thog rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog sa skyar phebs/ slob gnyer byed pa dang chabs cig sa skya bzhi thog pa'i drung 'khor las bdag gnyer ba zhes ba'i las tshan nang ma'i las ka gnang yang /bdag chen pa thugs gtum pas gsol gzim dam gnyer sogs la bka' bkyon yang yang yong 'dug stabs/ las tshan la sdod rgyu dgongs pa zhus nas bla ma 'jam dpal dang / kun dbang / bla ma mnyam med pa sogs bsten nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung mang po dang sngags la sogs pa'i slob gnyer rgya chen po gnang / skabs de'i dus su khri dpon dang sde dpon khag gi bu phug dang / gzhan yang slob gnyer du byis pa mang po yod la/ byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis 'byor ldan dang / nga rgyal che ba'i slob phrug su la'ang spyal kha mi bskur zhing / gnyom chung rnams dang 'grogs shing / de tshor mthun sgril dang / mgo 'dren byed/ ston thog chu mig chos thog tu (slob sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs pa)phebs dus/ bla ma mnyam med pas slob gnyer ba rnams la gad dar/ chu len/ bud shing 'thu ba/ zas g.yo lto skol sogs res mo byed du bcug slob tshan gtso bo ston pa'i zhor la/ rta bzhon stangs/ mda' rdo mchong gsum tshogs pa'i dbus su gtam shod stangs/ tshogs pa dang mang po'i 'go khrid byed stangs la sogs pa spyangs pas bka' drin che gsungs/byang chub rgyal mtshan dgung lo nyi shur slebs skabs slob gnyer mthar phyin pa dang / sa skya bas khong la ta'i si tu zhes pa'i go gnas dang / stag mgo nor gsum pa zhes pa'i tham ka tsan dan las grub pa/stag mgo zer ba yu ba'i mgo la stag mgo yod pa/ gong ma tho gan ni mur gyis byin pa de gnang nas phag gru khri dpon du bskos/ rgyal mtshan skyabs kyis bya spyod ngan zhing / khri dpon gyi go sa sprod ma 'dod pa la/sa skya nas bka' phab ste go sa las phab/ chu khyi (1322)lo'i zla 9 tshes 5 nyin bca' hu bsgrags (khrims yig)/ bcu bzhi la sne gdong rtsis blangs/ de nas rim gyis gzhis ka rnams la nyams ga~X/7 yul gru

so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa/ chu chen la zam chen 'dzugs pa/ sne gdong pho brang rgya bskyed de pho brang yid du 'ong ba bzos/ sde 'bangs rnams tshul bzhin bskyangs pas mnga' thang rgyas/ khri dpon snga ma'i dugasu shor ba'i sde 'bangs 'ga' zhig tshur blangs/ de nas g.ya' bzang bas phag thu'i steng du dmag gis tshul 'gebs lan kha shas byas shing kha mchu gtugs bsher byas na'ang / kha mchu'i rtsa ba ma chod par g.ya' phag thang bar gyi sa char dmag 'khrugs byas skabs phag gru pham ste bros/ de nas sa skya'i dpon chen dbang phyug dpal ba'i drung du g.ya' phag gnyis gtug bsher byas/ phag grur bden che tsam byung yang tshal pa dpon kun rdor zer bas g.ya' bzang ba phyogs 'then byas stabs g.ya' bzang rgyal/ de nas sa skya'i nang gi las tshan pa'i gras bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa rlangs kyi mi rgyud yin zer nas phag spu khri dpon du bskos te/ sne gdong du song yang ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis go sa ma sprad/ de rjes mi ring bar sa skya'i dpon chen dbang brtson gyis si tu ston thog la bos nas/ bslu thabs kyis zhag bcu dgur gung thang du btson la bcug nas tsha 'jam sna tshogs kyis/ tham ga stag mgo gtod dgos byas kyang / si tus nga khri dpon las tsha len byed dgos don med/ ngas sa skya gong ma'i zhabs 'degs ma bsgrubs pa dang /mi ser la gnod pa'i bya ba 'di byas zer rgyu med par khri dpon gyi las ka sprod mi thub ces pa kho na bshad de/nga ma bsad bar du khri dpon gyi rtsis mi sprod zer/ dbang brtson thabs zad nas si tu byir btang /de rjes lcags yos(1351)lor g.ya' phag gtugs bsher byas pas si tu rgyal yang / g.ya' bzang bas slar yang dmag drangs te gtug pas phag spu rgyal nas/ g.ya' bzang dgon dang / g.ya' bzang gi gzhi ka rnams rtsis blangs/ de nas sa skya'i dpon chen rgyal bzang ba yar lung du song nas g.ya' phag gi gyod bshad rgyu byas skabs/ ta'i si tus rang gi blon po rnams la/ sang nged bzung nas pags pa dmar bshus byed kyin 'dug zer na'ang / sne gdong ma gtod/ ces sogs bkod chab btang / phyi nyin dpon chen gyis si tu bzung kyang thel tse me la bsregs nas len rgyu ma yod/ de nas dpon chen rgyal bzang ba rang nyid kyis sne gdong pho brang du skor g.yeng byas te/ sne gdong tshur sbod dgos zer na'ang /phag gru'i blon po rnams kyi zhal ngo (dpon chen)las sde srid gal che zer nas pho brang ma gtad/ de nas sde srid si tu la btson las byas shing / btson chas kyi rnam pas sa skyar khyer/ de skabs sa sbya'i nang tshan gi dbang brtson gyis hor rgyal dang 'brel ba byas te/ dpon chen rgyal bzang ba'i lag nas dpon chen gyi go sa 'phrog rgyu byas pa rgyal bzang bas shes nas/ si tu dang lkog gros byas te phan tshun gcig grogs gcig gis byed rgyu byas te shor ba ltar mdzad nas si tu btang / de ltar si tu zla ba gyed gsum tsam la sa skyas btson du bzung ste 'o brgyal mang du byung na'ang / zla ba gza' las grol ba ltar/ chu 'brug (1352)lo'i mjug phyir sne gdong du glebs te/ dmag btegs nas g.ya' bzang ba'i gzhis dgon sngar blangs pa'i 'phro ma rnams dpung shugs kyis blangs/ ring bo ma lon par thang bo cher yang dpung 'jug byasarjo duṭwāṃ18 —

de nas nang chen dbang brtson gyis glo bur du dpon chen rgyal bzang ba bzung nas btson la bcugadapon chen gyi las ka blangs nas/ bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag bsdus rte/ yar lung sne gdong ba'i thog tu song / si tus phag gru khri skor gyi dmag bsdus te 'thab pas spyal kha thob/ si tu rang yang dmag thog tu byon nas sa skya'i dmag rnams bsad bzung dang ded nas rgyal kha thob bzhin pa'i skabs su/ sa skya'i bla ma dam pa dang / dbus gtsang gi mi chen mang po bar 'dum la byon te/ rgyal bzang ba btson nas glod pa sogs nang 'grig byung tshul gyis sa glang(1349)lor gtsang gi jo mo mkha' reg bar du phag grus blangs/ de nas lo shas kyi rjes su/ sa skya dpon chen dbang brtson gyi rgyab tu lha rtse ba dang / nang chen nam mkha' bstan pa'i rgyab tu byang ba langs te sa skyar nang 'khrugs byung / de skabs rgyal bzang dug gis bsad pa yin yang zer/ chang 'thung ches nas shi ba yin yang zer/ gang ltar yang rgyal bzang ba 'das/ de dag si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gsan te/ dmag gi dpung chen btegs nas sa skya blangs/ sa skya'i gdan sa ba ta dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan khri las phab/ dpon chen bzung / las byed gnad che ba bgi brgya brgal ba khrims la sbyar ba dang / gnas nas dbyungs pa sogs byas te/ rab byung drug pa'i sa pho khyi'i (1658)lo la sde srid phag mo gru ba ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod chol kha gsum yongs su rdzogs par dbang bsgyur to/ / de nas sde srid phag mo gru ba'i dpon chen ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod yongs sa la dbang bsgyur nas/ chos kyi phyogs la bya ba rgya chen po bsgrubs/ srid phyogs nas/ ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa/chu chen la zam pa dang / ko klu gsar 'dzugs/ lam 'grang dbeen pa ci yod la 'jigs skyob/ tsa ri tra dang / gangs te se sogs gnas chen yod tshad la ja tshul chang tshul/ zhing pa dang / 'brog pa rnams la khral 'os 'babs shig las/ hor ltar khral chen mi bsdu bar/ mnga' ris nas bzung ste sa cha rnams su rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs pa dang sne gdong rgya bskyed/ sngon sa skya'i khrims lugs hor gyi shan zhugs nas sdig pa'i las shas che bas/ khrims kyi lugs srol bzang bo'i srol gsar du btsugs pa ni/ dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/ sdar ma wa'i zhal lce/ sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi 'al lce/bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/ nag can khrag spyor gyi zhal lte/ dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/hor 'dra za skang gi zhal lce/ bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/ rmas pa khrag gi zhal rtse/ smyon ham mna' dag gi zhal lce/ brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/ nye 'brel 'bral 'dum gyi zhal lce/ byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/rnam par tshur gyi zhal lce/ bco lnga'i sgo nas gtan la phab/ 'di dag la 'grel ba dang yang 'grel sogs khrims mang po thag bcad de/ phra zhing mdzang pa'i blos bka' khrims kyi 'jam dar yug gcig gis bskyangs pas rgan mo gser 'khur gyi dus/ zhes kun gyi bsngags brjod byed pa'i yul du gyur sto/ /skabs de'i sngon tsam la sprul sku bslu srol gyi thog mar karma rang byung rdo rje yu gur dang hor yul sogs su beebs/ de rjes lcags byi(1360)lor karma bzhi ba rang byung rdo rje yang hor gong ma'i pho brang du gdan — 519 —

drangs/ ban de rnams kyis gong mar phyag byed mi dgos pa'i 'ja' sa thob/ de dus hor gong ma tho gan the mur gyi khri lo nyer brgyad pa yin zer/ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dgung lo re gsum pa la phebs pa shing 'brug (1364)lor sne gdong pho brang du sku gshegs/ 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan nam 'jam dbyangs gu shri chen po yang zer 'di ba sne gdong gong ma'i khrir bzhugs/ bu ston rin po che sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas rsha rnyi dī dīṭwāṃ snaṭā/ sbyangs nas mkhas pa chen por gyur pas kun gyis bkur/ lo bcu gsum tsam la sne gdong sa sprel (1368)lo la sog jing gir rgyal po'i mi rgyud kyis rgya nag gi rgyal sa shor te hor yul du bros/rgya nag ta ming gi rgyal po dang po hung mu(glos)khrir 'khod/ rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po chu byi (1372)lo la mdo smad nas dbus phyogs su phebs/ de'i lo rjes mar 'jam dbyangs shākya spyal mtshan gshegs/de rjes shing stag (1374)lor grags pa byang chub dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog sne gdong gi khrir 'khod/rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/ rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen pos kyang 'di'i zhabs la gtugs/ 'di bas rtogs brjod dpag bsam kun po brtsams/ spyan snga 'di bas kyang rje bdag nyid chen po la bsngags brjod bla na med pa gnang / spyan snga grags byang ba 'di lo brgyad khri bar bzhugs/de rjes 'di ba'i gcung bsod nams grags pa lo lngar khrir bzhugs/ dpon 'di gnyis kyi ring la lo phyugs legs pas bsod nams can gyi rgyal por gragaso/ mkhas grags shin tu che/de rjes shing glang (1385)lor mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dgung lo bcu gnyis thog khrir bkod/skabs de tsam na grub thob lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal pos/ kong po sogs la lcags kyi slong mo mdzad de/dbus gtsang / mdo stod/ lho 'brug sogs kyi chu chen rnams la lcags thag gi zam che chung lnga bcu nga gsum tsam btsugs/ skabs de'i dus su blon chen rnams kyi nang nas sku zhang rdzong phyi ba grags rin dbang che bas blon po nang tshags phrag dog gi dbang gis rdzong phyi ba grags rin bkrongs stabs yo khyom che tsam byung ༵zlo ga/sa / kta/ lung rin po che bkra shis dpal rtsegs kyis zhi 'jags mdzad pas ring bo ma thogs par rgya nag tā ming gi (8shālko)rgyal po yung los(rsālnga)bod kyi bla chen rnams la che bstod kyi mtshan gnas dang / dgon pa khag la mchod 'bul byas/ mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan rgya nag tu gdan 'dren zhus kyang ma phebs/ karma de ba'in gshegs pa me khyi lor (1406)gdan drangs te rgya nag pho brang du phebs/ rje blo bzang grags pa snga phyir gdan 'dren pa mngags kyang ma phebs/ de rjes rgya yul du chos ston pa'i slob ma zhig gtong bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ sa byi (1408)lor byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes mngags pa rgya yul du byon/ rgya rgyal gyi bla mar gyur/ khong gis spya nag tu lha khang dang dgon pa kha shas btang / 5ṭwāṃ 0dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / dpon chen nam mkha' bzang po gnyis kyis/ mnyam

med tsong kha ba chen po gtsug gi nor bur bsten te/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lor (spyi lo 1409)lha ldan sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che rten dang brten par bcas nyams gso bsnyen bkur mdzad pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad de/ rje bdag nyid chen pos cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo 'dzugs pa'i lo de rang la rje tsong kha ba chen pos dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling phyag 'debs mdzad/ me sprel lo (spyi lo 1416)la rje'i thugs sras 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis tā~X ṭwāṃṭwāṃ rdzu~X ṭā shā dī /dīkā /bta/ ba/ sa phag (sbyi lo 1419)lor rje'i thugs sras byams chen chos rje mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan 'di gsan rgya che la sku yon che/ chos phyogs la zhabs tog blor mi shong ba mdzad/ chab srid phyogs nas dmangs la brtse/ khrims srol bzang po rgyun 'khyongs byas stabs/mchog dman kun gyis gong ma chos rgyal chen po zhes 'bod pas/ mtshan de ltar chags/ myang stod rab brtan kun 'phags kyi thog tu dpung 'jug lan gnyis tsam byas pa las sde gzar gang yang ma byung bar dbus gtsang mdo khams bcas pa 'jam dar yug gcig tu song bas mnga' thang mtho/ 'di'i blon po che ba/ gzhis ka rin spungs rdzong dpon nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs mang / mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dgung lo nga dgu'i thog chu bya (sbyi lo 1432)lor sku gshegs so/ /mi dbang gshegs rjes/ chu byi'i lo mjug tu khong gi gcung che sa sangs spyas rgyal mtshan gyi sras grags pa 'byung gnas lo bcu dgu'i thog rgyal sar bkod/ de rjes shing stag lor/ 'di'i yab che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis khri thog e yong gi re ba byas te bya ba mi legs pa mang du mdzad stabs yar lung du sde gzar langs/ de'i stabs che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpon g.yog la gsol skal byin nas yar rgyab tu thegs dgos byung / shing stag lo (spyi lo 1434)la phag gru nang zhig gi lo zer/ de la brten nas shing yos lo (spyi lo 1435)nas rin spungs pa'i shugs je rgyas dang / phag gru'i mnga' thang nyams rgud du song / phag thu'i rgyal srid nyams nas rin spungs pas bod yongs la dbang bsgrur ba'i 'go tshugs pa 'dra/lo de'i yas mas su dbus gtsang khams gsum la mu ge chen po byung zer/ gong ma 'dis mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sogs bla mar bsten/ chos phyogs nas mdzad pa mi nyung ba bsgrubs/ mkhyen pa rgya che zer/ byang phyogs kyi so kha srung ba'i gyir 'od yug gling dkar gyi rdzong brtsigs/ srid kyi zhabs zhur rin spungs nor bu bzang po dang / 'phyongs spyas pa hor dkon mchog bzang po gnyis kyis byas/ rjes sor yab che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan yang yar rgyab nas gdan drangs te bkur ste mdzad/ dgung lo so gnyis pa shing glang la (spyi lo 1445)gshegs/ tshes lnga la gshegs stabs/ phyis su spyan snga tshes lnga pa yang zer/ rgya nag gong ma dzi kyen tha'i’ yis dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang ba nas bzung dbang grags pa 'byung gnas yang zer/ grags pa 'byung gnas 'di ba'i gcung pha kun dga' legs’’ rab byung bdun pa'i mjug gi me stag (spyi lo 1446)lor sne gdong gi khrir bkod/ rin spungs nas bdag ༵2 /ga 51ngas

pas sras rin chen rdo rje dbang gi rgyal po 'khrungs/ kun legs 'di la sde dpon thams cad kyis gus bkur byas na'ang / rin spungs pa nor bzang gong ma 'di'i mdzad spyod la khog nas ma dga' ba dang gong ma kun legs rang nyid kyang ka ba'i ba sku mched kyi kha la nyan nas/ yab yum nang mi mthun pa byung ste/mi bde ba mang po byung / yum gshegs rjes rin sgrungs mtsho skyes rdo rjes mkhar thog bzung /rab byung brgyad pa'i shing khyi (khyi lo 1454)lor gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas kyi sras/ dpal ngag gi dbang bo dgung lo bcu drug gi thog thel gyi spyan sngar bskos/ spyan snga nyer gnyis pa gshegs nas shing khyi 'di yan gyi lo nyi shur gdan sa stong ba yin zer/ 'di nyid gzhon nu nas 'gos lo dpal ye bzang rtse ba sogs bsten nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum mang du mdzad kyang / nang mtshams su mi mthun pa byung ste/ dgung grangs nyi shu ba'i thog gong ma kun legs kyis thel gyi spyan snga'i go sa blangs nas lho khar bton te brag kha dang / rgyal gnyis rang du lo bcu drug tsam la bzhugs rgyu byung / slar chu sbol la mtshan jus rgyal te/ yang dgon pho brang du pebs nas 'azin las rgyas pa byung / de skabs nang gyod zhi 'jags skabs rin spungs don yod rdo rjes gtsang dmag dbus su drangs te/ sne gdong ba'i lag nas rdzong gzhis kā/sdo /zhi/ga blangs/ gong ma kun legs dang spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo gnyis kyi gyod bshad de nang 'dum lcags mo glang (spyi lo 1481)gi lo'i lo sar skabs rin spungs pa sogs dpon chen rnams kyis/dpon sa khu dpon gnyis mthun sgrig pa yin zer pa'i gtam bsgrags te/ spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo lho kha nas spyan drangs/ gong ma kun legs zur bzhugs byas te dgon gsar du gdan drangs/ spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo nyid sne gdong rtse'i spyal sar bkod/ rdzong kha ba'i bu mo zhig bdag mor phul/ lo 'dir 'gos lo dgung lo dgu bcu'i thog sku gshegs/ 'di nas lo gsum pa chu yos la (spyi lo 1483)sngar gyi gong ma kun legs gshegs/ de nas lo gsum pa shing sbrul la/ rin spungs pas rgyang rtse'i khar dmag drangs pa sogs sde gzar mang du byungan yang / gong ma ngag gi dbang bo nyid sde 'khrugs mi dgyes shing /spyi dpon drangs bor bzhugs/ khong dgung lo lnga bcu'i thog sras ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa 'khrungs/ dgu lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum thog gshegs/ sras sku na phra bas rin srungs mtsho skyes rdo rjes sku tshab byas/ sde gzar mang du byung / sa lug (spyi lo 1499)lo'i lo sar skabs/ rin sgrungs bas gtso bo byas/ sde dpon rnams kyis gdung rgyud ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dgung lo bcu gnyis thog rtse'i khri thog tu bkod/ 'di nyid kyi dus rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi e gnyal gyi phyogs su dmag drangs pa sogs sde 'khrugs bslangs/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi bas chings mdzad kyang thugs bzhed ji bzhin ma 'grub/de nas lo bzhi song ba sa 'brug la sras 'gro ba'i mgon po dang / de rjes sras spyan snga grags pa 'byung ba 'khrungs/ de'i phyi lo sa mo sbrul la sde srid dang bsam sde dpon gyi nang zhig sde gzar byung / gong ma 'di'i dus su rin srungs pa sogs kyis sde 'khrugs mang po slangs te/ dus mi bde ba shin tu mang po byung — 522 —

ba brjod kyis mi lang / ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa 'di'i sras/ spyan snga grags 'byung ba thel gyi gdan sar phebs/ phag spu'i gdung rgyud 'di la grags pa 'byung gnas zer ba gsum byung ba'i 'di ba gsum pa yin zer/ de'i gcung zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa sne gdong gi khrir bkod/ 'di'i dus yang sngar ltar sde gzar mang po langs nas dus mi bde ba byung 'dug de la sras bka' brgyud rnam rgyal dang /rnam rgyal grags pa gnyis 'khrungs/ bka' brgyud rnam spyal la sras tshi mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang’ sne gdong gi khrir bsdad do/de ltar sde srid phag mo gru ba'i dpon rgyud 'di'i khri dpon gyi thog ma rdo rje dpal nas bzung / rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi bar dpon brgyad ni phag spu khri skor gyi khri dpon trem yin/ ta'i si tu byang chub spyal mtshan gyis sa skya'i lag nas bod chol kha gsum gyi srid dbang tshang ma phrogs nas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur/de nas 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga grags pa byang chub/ spyan snga bsod nams grags pa/ mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan te dpon rabs 'di lnga'i ring la dbang sgyur brtan po gnas shing /khyad par du mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan snyan grags shin tu che/ de rjes grags pa 'byung gnas kyi ring nas/ rin spungs pa'i lag tu dbang sne shor te bod rgyal gyi ming yod cing / sa sde rnams sna shor sne shor dang / dus mi bde ba byung nas rim gyis rgyal srid nyams so/ /gsum pa/ rin srungs pa'i lorgyus/sde srid phag mo thu ba'i rjes su rin srungs pas dbang bsgyur ba yin la/ rin spungs pa'i mi rgyud ni sngon bod kyi rgyal po sha khri btsan po'i dus/ ma sangs la khar khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung ba la/dzi sger dpal legs 'od’’ zer zhing / de nas bzung ste/ phyi sger/ nang sger/ grub thob kyi sger zer ba'i mi rgyud gsum byung / de gsum gyi rgyud pa la chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi blon po byung la/de dag gi rgyud las byung ba sger dkar shākya 'bum gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la phag gru'i sde srid mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sa byi (1408)lor rin spungs rdzong dpon gyi go gnas dang / gtsang chu mig ring mo'i khri dpon/ sa skya lha khang chen mo'i dpon chen du bsko ba'ag gnang zhing / rjes su rin srungs su yun ring bor bsdad stabs/ rin srungs mi rgyud chags nas sne gdong gong mas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan shel dam gnang ste/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi mi rgyud la rin srungs pa zhes grags so/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sus nam mkha' rgyal bo ni phag thu gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan dang /grags pa 'byung gnas gnyis kyi zhabs 'bring che khag gi gras kyi go gnas bzuzu zhing / de'i sras rin spungs nor bu bzang po yab mes dus ltar rdzong dpon dang / khri dpon gyi go sar bsdad/ dpung gi sbyor bas rta g.yag gi rdzong dang / lcags thag mgo sprel du grags pa'i rgyal phran mngaci po mnga' 'og tu bsdus/thing yos (sbyi lo 1435)la nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon matred/ roṭwāṃ bo byams chen kyi chos sde btab/ rong bo byams chen sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzhethas/ rgya sar gyi paṇa ṭi ta nags kyi — 523 —

rin chen gdan drangs nas rab gnas mdzad/ gong ma sde srid phag mo spu ba'i gdong rgyud rnams dngakadabon zhang 'brel ba byung stabs chab srid kyi thog mthong bzos che/ rin spungs nor bzang 'di dang)'phyongs rgyas pa hor dkon mchog rin chen gnyis nas blon tshen gyi las ka skang 'dzin byas/nor bu bzang po la sras u ba si ka dang / kun tu bzang bo/ don 'thub rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/shākya rgyal mtshan dang lnga 'khrungs/ dang po chung dus nas gshegs/ gnyis pa kun bzang bas/ phag gru gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi zhabs la gtugs nas yab mes kyi 'ja' sa dang / las ka blangs shing / sa skya ba kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang / go rams pa bsod nams seng ge dang mchod yon du 'brel te/ 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi bshad grwa btsugs shing / rta nag thub bstan dgon 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ sras gsum pa don 'aspub rdo rjes bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon bzung /sras bzhi ba mcho skyes rdo rjes yar lung mkhar thog rdzong drag shugs kyis bzung / phag thu gong ma ngag gi dbang phyug gshegs te/ sras sku na phra skabs pho brang sne gdong gi dpon tshab byas nas dbang bzung /der brten rin srungs pa'i dbang thang je rgyas su song yang / phag gru sde srid gong ma'i nang blon de dag nang ma mthun par yar lung du sde 'khrugs mang du byung / rin zhungs pas bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs phyogs su 'then 'khyer byas te sno gdong phyogs su dmag drangs nas gzhis ka kha shas phrogs/ lcags rta (spyi lo 1510)lor mtsho skyes rdo rje 'das/ nor bzang ba'i sras lnga ba shākya rgyal mtshan gyis/ nyang khog gi rdzong bzung nas/ rgyal mkhar rtse ba la dgra 'thabi byas pa sogs dgra 'thab la mkhas par grags/nor bu bzang po'i sras gnyis pa kun bzang ba la/ sras rdo rje tshe brtan dang / don yod rdo rje gnyis yod/ dang po'i lo rgyus mi snang / gnyis pa don yod rdo rjes rdzong chen bcu gnyis kyi rdzong dpon bzung nas/ sa phag (spyi lo 1479)lor zhwa dmar chos grags dang mchod yon du 'brel te/ yangs pa can gyi dgon pa btab/ karma chos grags rgya mtsho'i 'dod pa ltar lha sa'i nye 'dab sa ma zhes pa'i sa char karma pa'i dgon zhig btab na yang se 'bras kyis bshigs pa sogs dus mi bde ba'i me chen 'bar zer/lcags byi (sbyi lo 1480)lor don yod rdo rje dang / g.yung ba tshe dbang gnyis kyis dmag gtos chen yar lung du drangs nas/ ka bzhi ba shar nub gnyer ba'i go sa nas phab/ gzhis ka brag dkar ba dang / chu shur lhun po'i rtse'i rdzong sogs snel ba'i lag nas phrogs/ la stod byang bdag pa nam mkha' rdo rje dang /la stod lho ba rdzong kha ba chos rgyal nor bu'i sde sogs kyi thog tu dmag kha yar drangs/ skyid shod du'ang dmag lan gnyis drangs shing / gzhan dbang gis phyir log byed rgyu byung stabs/ skyid shod dang se 'bras sogs la skyon ma byung zer/de rjes skyid shod du snang rtse khu dbon bsad pa'i rkyen byas nas/ rin spungs pas gtsang dpung gtos che ba dbus su drangs/ sde ba dga' ldan pa nam mkha' rgyal bos ngo ya byas/ karma ba dang / stag lung ཿba/ 5ṭwāṃ~X kha ba sogs kyis chings brgyab ste/ sa skyong ngag dbang lhun po sku mched sku skal blangs nas

skyor mo lung du phebs dgos byung ba dang / sne'u gzhis rtsis blangs/ lha sa dang / po ta la sogs kyi bdag po byas/ lo 'di nas bzung lha ldan smon lam chen mor se 'bras gnyis pebs mi chog par byas/don yod rdo the rang lo lnga bcu'i thog chu sbril (spyi lo 1512)la 'das skabs kha chems su/ sna dkar rtse nas zil gnon pa bos la/ zhal ngor zhog zer ba ltar/ sna dkar rtse stag lung nas sde ba zil gnon pa rin skungs su yong nas/ don yod rdo rje'i las ka'i mjug skyong byas/mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal ni rig gnas chung ba lnga dang sgyu rtsal la mkhas par grags/e gnyal phyogs su dmag drangs pa lam rgyug byung min gyi rkyen las dbus phyogs kyi gzhis ka sne'u gtsos rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig shor/ mnga' thang cung zad nyams/ 'on kyang gtsang phyogs kyi seng ge rtse ba dang /la stod sogs mnga' 'og tu bsdus/de la sras gsum yod/ che ba pad ma dkar bo nang tshegs nas bkrongs pas rin spungs dme khrag gi lo zer/ de 'og don 'grub tshe brtan rdo rjes sngar yab mes kyis ma lon pa'i dzi pa rnam lhun grub rje'i’’rdzong mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa rang dbang du byas/ karma mi bskyod rdo rjes gsung rab gling 'debs pa'i zhabs 'degs byas/ 'brug pa pad ma dkar po dang mchod yon du 'brel/ chos 'jig rten gang la'ang mkhyen rgya che zhing / mthun lam la mkhas pas sde dpon tshugs thub pa'i tshad du byed zer/ de'i gcung ngag dbang 'jig rten grags pa ni rig gnas bcu la sbyangs pa'i rgyal po paṇa ṭi ta yin la/ gos sku chen mo bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la kun dga' grol mchog gdan drangs/ daṇa ṭi'i dgongs rgyan 'jig med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro sogs rtsom pa mang du mdzad/ sa skya dang byang bdag ma mthun pas/sa skya'i rgyab tu rin zhungs pa langs te/ chu phag (spyi lo 1563)lor rin spungs pa'i dmag g.yas ru byang ba'i steng du chas pa'i tshe ngag dbang 'jig grags rang yang dpung bcas bsam 'grub rtser tshebs/ lo de ga'i nang rin zhungs pa rang gi zhabs 'bring ba chibs dpon du gtogs pa zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje zer ba bsam rtse'i rdzong dpon byas nas yod pa des 'bangs gyen log byas te/ sras pad ma dkar po bkrongs pa sogs rim gyis nyams rgud du gyur/ rin spungs pa yang dar ba'i tha ma rgud pas mjug bsdus so/ /bzhi ba/ sde brad gtsang ba'i losprus/rin spungs pa'i rjes su/ sde srid gtsang bas bod la dbang bsgyur ba yin la/ 'di la gtsang stod sde ba yang zer/ gtsang ba rgyal bo yang zer/ 'di ni gnyag dzha na ku ma ra sogs kyi gdong rgyud yin zer/gaspeng rgyal gyi thog ma/ zhing shaka pa tshe brtan rdo rje yin la/ kho ni rin spungs pa'i gnyen du gtogs la/ rin srungs pa dang / sne gdong ba gnyis ka'i 'bas 'bring gi khongs su bsdad/ rin spungs sde srid ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi skabs su chibs dpon gyi las ka bzung / de rjes las tshan du snebs te/ shangs dang / myang smad kyi yong 'bab sdud mkhan lo mang por byas/ sa sprel (spyi lo 1bya48)lor gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon gyi go gnas thob ste der bsdad/ rin srungs sde srid — 525 ge

ngag dbang 'jig grags kyi skabs su/ khong gi gcen che ba pad ma dkar bo zhing shag pas bkrongs stabs/rin spungs pas dmag drangs pa lam du ma song bar/ bsam 'thub rtse ba zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rjes 'bangs gyen log byas te/ rin thangs pa'i mnga' 'og nas bud/me sbrul (spyi lo 1557)lor/ zhing shag tshe brtan rdo rjes/ shangs don rab pa'i sa sde rnams dpung shugs kyis blangs/ shing glang (spyi lo 1565)lor ging shag pa rang nyid dmag dpon byas te/pa rnam lhun 'thub khyung rtse dang / rdzong gsar phag mo ri rnams blangs/ slar me stag (spyi lo 1566)lo'i lo sar mtshams gtsang rin gnyis kyis myang stod snad du dmag 'khrug bslangs mthar/ pa rnam rdzong yongs rdzogs gtsang bas thob/ zhing shag tshe brtan rdo rje gtsang gi rgyal bor gyur/zhing shag pa la bu dgu byung ba las/ karma mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ kun spang lha dbang rdo rje/ karma brtan srung dbang bo 'di gsum gyis gtsang phyogs su dbang bsgyur 'dug sras gzhan gyi lo rgyus mi snang /lha dbang rdo rje bsam 'aspub rtse'i rgyal sar bsnad/ bstan srung dbang bo pha pa rnam nor khyung rtser ’ bsdad/de rjes lha dbang rdo rje 'das rjes/ bstan srung dbang bo bsam 'akub rtse'i rgyal sar bsdad/de 'das rjes/ de'i sras phun tshogs rnam rgyal lo bcu bzhi'i thog lcags phag (spyi lo 1611)lor srid dbang bzung / de'i dus byi glang lo'i sde gzar zhes bya ba byung ste/ chu glang (spyi lo 1613)lor phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis mnga' ris rgyal po dang / lho ba byang ba rnams la dmag drangs nas mnga' 'og tu bcug pa de la zer/ kho bka' brgyud pa la mos khul byas mod/ 'brug pa pad ma dkar bo'i yang sprul ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang dpag bsam dbang po gnyis 'khrungs pa gdan sar gang 'god 'then 'khyer byung / ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis gtsang ba'i bka' chad phog dogs nas lho 'brug phyogs su bros byol byed dgos byung ba dang / gtsang dmag 'brug pa'i thog tu lan gnyis btang ba sogs 'brug pa bka' brgyud dang 'gres pa byung / 'on kyang karma ba'i sbyin bdag byas te/ karma chos dbyings rdo rje la dbus gtsang gi bdag po'i bka' shog dang tham ga dmar nag byin/ jo nang tā ra nā tha yang bla mar bsten/ karma ba la dad khul gyis dge lugs pa shin tu sdang / rab byung bcu ba'i sa rta (spyi lo 1618)lor dbus su dmag drangs nas sa lug lor se 'bras gnyis bcom/ dge 'dun rnams byang phyogs su ded/ skya ser baspya phrag mang po bsad/ bkra shis lhun po'i rgyab ri'i kha nas sa rdo drangs te bkra shis lhun po dang / gzhis ka rtse'i bar bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa gsar rgyag gi mkhar las byed skabs/ rbab rdo bsgril ba sogs paṇa chen rin po che dang bkra shis lhun po sogs la brnyas gtse byas pas 'o brgyal byung / lcags bya (sbyi lo 1621)lor dmag stong gnyis lhag glebs te/ gtsang dmag dang 'thab nas gtsang dmag pham/ paṇa chen rin po che sogs kyis bar 'dum mdzad/ se 'bras kyi mchod gzhis tshur sprad/ grub mtha' bsgyur ba rnams dang sa ris shor ba sogs rang babs su slog lcags lug la phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'das nas/sras karma bstan skyong khrir bkod zer/ gtsang rgyal gyis rgyal ba paṇa chen gnyis dang / bkra shis lhun po —— 526 —

dang se 'bras dge gsum sogs dang / skyid shod sde ba stag rtse ba sogs la yang yang brnyas gtser byas/sbyid shod sde ba sogs yul gzhan du bros/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i pha hor bdud 'dul rab brtan btson du bcug pa btson zhabs nas 'das/ stag rtse sde ba sogs mi chen 'gas gros thog nas sog po yo rod cung gur gyi dpon gu thi khang la rogs zhu mi byed ka med byung / gu thi bstan 'dzin khang gis chu rta (gyi lo 1642)lor gtsang ba'i srid gzhung rtsa med btang ste/ bod ljongs yongs kyi srid dbang dga' ldan pho brang ba'i lag tu 'byor/ thog ma'i char karma ba'i phyogs nas nang 'khrugs phran tshegs byung mod/ de ma thag zhi ste/ ser skya drag zhan thams cad sus bder gnas chog pa byung ngo / /lnga ba/ dga' ldan po brang ba'i lorghas/gtsang pa'i srid dbang mjug bsdus rjes rgyas dbang lnga ba'i dus nas dga' ldan pho brang bas bod la tāṭwāṃ~X ṅgi/kā/rjod ṭītrī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ga /mar rgyal dbang sku zeng rim byon gyi lo rgyus mdo tsam shes dgos pas mdor (1)rgyal dbang sku zeng dngapo paṇachenadage 'dun grub ba dpal bzangapo/de yang paṇa chen dge 'dun spub pa sku phreng dang por byas nas sku phreng rim par brtsi dgos la/ de yang dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug (spyi lo 1391)lor gtsang shab stod gur mo zhes pa'i yul du 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog snar thang chos sder phebs/ rab tu byung / slob gnyer dang gsan bsam rgya cher gnang ste mkhas grags 'bar/ shing lug (spyi lo 1415)lor rje tsong kha ba dang mjal te/ slob ma'i gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos (spyi lo 1447)lor bkra shis lhun po phyag 'debs mdzad/ dgon sde der 'chad nyan mdzad de yun ring bzhugs/ paṇa chen dge 'dun spub ces mtshan snyan rgyas/ de rjes bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa 'dzin mkhan rnams la paṇa chen zhes mtshan thogs/ tshad ma rigs rgyan sogs gsung rtsom mang / dgung lo gya ༵sdosbya ṭwāṃ/ga /gsungs mod gya drug yin dgos 'dra/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing rta (spyi lo 1474)lor sku (2)rgyal dbang sku 'phrengaganyisapadage'adunargyamatsho/sku nyid de'i phyi lo shing lug (spyi lo 1475)lor gtsang rta nag tu 'khrungs/ dge 'dun grub pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bkra shis lhun por spyan drangs/ karma ba la sprul sku ngos 'dzin pa'i srol 'di'i sngon nas yod mod/ dge lugs pa la sprul sku ngos 'dzin pa'i thog ma 'di yin/ de dus rin spungs pa don yod rdo rjes dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs yin pas sde gzar mang po byung / shing yos (spyi lo 1495)lor rgyal ba dge 'dun spya mtsho 'bras spungs su phebs/ bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo 'dir skyid shod du snang rtse khu dpon rkyen lam du btang / sa rta (spyi lo 1498)lor rin srungs dmag lha sar drangs/snel ba dpon sa ngag dbang lhun po mched gnyis skyor mo lung du phud/ de ga'i rdzong tram̐zhi~X ṭwāṃ~X ma rin

spungs don yod rdo rjes blangs/ lo 'di nas bzung sa stag (sbyi lo 1518)bar du lo nyi shu'i ring la se 'bras kyi dge 'dun pa rnams lha sa smon lam chen mor phebs mi chog pa byung / sa sprul (spyi lo 1509)lor rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos rgyal me tog thang gi dgon pa btab/ lha mo'i bla mtsho'i gnas sgo gyes/bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen bzhugs yod pa'i skabs/ sne gdong dpon sa ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dang lha rgya ri ba mchod yon/ 'bras spungs spyi so sogs kyis yang dang yang du gdan 'dren zhus stabs/me glang (spyi lo 1517)lor bkra shis lhun pori paṇa chen bsko bzhag gnang ste/ 'bras spungs su phebs nas/ 'bras spungs kyi chos khrir bzhugs/ 'bras sgrungs su bla brang dga' ldan pho brang bzhengs/rgyal dbang lnga bas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur pa nas gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes pa'ang / pho brang 'di'i mtshan srid gzhung gi mtshan du gyur 'dugame byi (/516)lo nas rin spungs pa'i mnga' thang rim gyis nyams te/ sa stag (1518)lo nas rje 'di'i zin las brten/ se 'bras kyi dge 'dun pa rnams lha ldan smon lam chen mor 'tshogs chog pa byung /me bya (1537)lor rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho phrin las shin tu rgyas/ 'on kyang chos 'khor rgyal du bzhugs skabs 'bri gung bas chos lugs 'then 'khyer gyis/ 'ol kha ba'i steng du dpung rgol byas te rdzong phyi shor/'od sna sogs dge lugs pa'i dgon pa bco brgyad 'bri gung bas phrogs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshe dgung lo drun cu re lnga'i thog rab byung dgu ba'i rgya stag (spyi lo 1542)lor 'das/(2)rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgyasatsho/rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho ni rab byung dgu ba'i chu yos (1543)lor stod lung mdar sku bltams/ gdan sar bkod nas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa sogs brten te/ gsan bsam rgya che po gnang stabs kun gyis gtsug tu bkur/ sde gzar khag la chings 'dum dang bka' bra sogs mdzad/me 'brug (/556)lor yang lung sne gdong ba dang / 'phyongs rgyas nang so ma mthun par sde gzar chen po langs skabs/ rje 'di nyid bar 'dum mdzad par phebs te zhi 'jags mdzad/ sa lug (1559)lor sne gdong gong ma chen po ngag dbang bkra shis grags pas rje bsod nams rgya mtshor kwan ding ta'i gu thi rwang hang gi mtshan dang / phyag dam dmar bo gnang chog pa'i bka' shog gnang ste/ sne gdong pho brang du gdan drangs nas chos 'brel rgya chen po zhus/ de'i phyi lo sne gdong gi zhal ngo rnams nang zhig byung ste sde 'khrugs byung skabs/ rje 'di ba bar 'dum du phebs nas g.yul 'thab bkagaslar yang sde srid phag thu ba nang zhig gi sde 'khrugs skyid shod phyogs nas langs par/ spub mtha' so so'i bla chen rnams bar 'dum du byon yang phan pa cher ma byung skabs/ rgyal ba bsod nams spya mcho gdan drangs/ khong gis chings mdzad nas bka' khras bcad de dmag rnams so sor gles/ chu khyi (1562)lor lha sar chu nyen chen po byung skabs chu rags gsar spyag dang / de nas bzung smon lam chen mo'i rjes thog dge 'dun rnams kyis rags rdo skyel ba'i srol bzang btsugs/ sa sbrul (1569)lor bkra shis lhan —— 528 —

por phebs/ gnas rnying ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen du bsko bzhag mdzad/gtsang phyogs kyi gnas chen rnams su phebs/ 'brong rtser rgyal byed tshal du 'brug pa pad ma dkar bo dang mjal phrad gnang / thugs nang gcig tu 'dres/ de nas bzung dge 'brug gnyis kyi mabun lam legs po byung /shing phag (1575)lor rin sgrungs pas dmag khri phrag yas mas btegs nas/ stod lung sgal bo na khar phab/ sgal byang smon gsum bcom/ rim gyis skyid shod lha sar 'ong rtsis byas skabs/ rgyal dbang 'di bas drag po'i las spyor mdzad pas phyir bzlog zer/sog po cha har hal thar rgyal bos gdan 'dren yang yang zhus pas rjes ma'i skabs phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes thog rab byung bcu ba'i me glang ( 1577)lo'i hor bla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer drug nyin/'bras spungs nas chibs kha bsgyur/ de nas rim gyis phebs pas/ rma chen spom ra'i gangs kyi nye 'dabs su skebs skabs/ al than spyal bo'i phebs bsu dang popha ba ku tha'i ji’’ sogs kyi gtso byas pa'i rta ba brgyad brgya 'byor/ a rigs dkar bo'i thang du pha se chen hong tha'i ji’’ sogs phebs bsu gsum pa rta ba stong gsum tsam 'byor/ de rjes nyin gsum gyi ring pha jo rigs thu tha'i ji7sogs phebs bsu gsum pa rta ba sum brgya skor dang / slar yang chos rje brtson 'grus bzang po dang lo tsā ba gu thi pakṣi sogs kyi gtsos rta ba lnga baspya skor phebs bsur 'byor/ rab phyogs sa stag (1578)lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin mtsho sngon gyi lho nub zad mtshams chab tsha zhes pa'i sa char al than rgyal bo yab yum 'khor khri phrag dang bcas phebs bsur slebs nas/ dad gus chen pos bsus te/ mchod yon thog mar mjal sa der sa 'dul mdzad de theg chen chos 'khor gling zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal bos 'bul ba rgya chen po phul/ de nas sog yul du dam pa'i chos rgya chen po spel/ sngar mi shi ba'i rjes su shi bor dmigs nas/ srog gcod pa'i srol ngan yod/ mchod yon gros thog nas srol ngan de mtshams bcad/gal te mi bsad pa byung na lus srog la khrims gcod/ rta phyugs bsad pa la nor thams cad 'phrog pa'i khrims bsgrags/ sngar pha ong bkod ces zer ba gshin po thams cad kyi gzugs byas te/ zla ba re re bzhin nya stong tshes brgyad gsum la phyugs bsad de khrag mchod byed/ lo dus kyi mchod pa la dbul phyug gi dbye bas phyugs shin tu mang po bsad de mchod pa byed pa'i srol ngan de'i rgyun bcad tshi ong bkod’’ ces pa'i rten brtan pa me la bsregs/ de'i tshab tu ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku re 'jog pa dang /de yang dkar mchod byed pa las khrag mchod byed mi chog pa'i khrims bkod/ rgya bod hor sog gi mi su la'ang 'phrog bcom byed mi chog pa'i khrims bcas/ mdor na dge ba bcu la gnas dgos pa'i khrims mang du bsgrags/ dbang rjes gnang sogs chos kyi char ba phab po/ /rgyal dbang lnga ba'i rang rnam pha dru ku la'i gos bzang gi rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar las/lha sras mu nee dang 'khrungs brgyud gcig pa / gnam sa'i dbang phyug al than chos kyi 15la ṭwāṃ~X darji blar

gyur te sa'i tshangs pa de nyid kyis mi rigs mi gcig pa du ma'i dbus su/ gser las grub pa'i dbu rgyan/bum pa/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ gser srang brgya las grub pa'i 'brug sder mo lngas mtshan pa/ kha ros la rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga rgyal/ zhes hor yig gser du yod pa/ yo byad 'gangs che tshad med dang bcas/ tā la'i bla ma badzra dha ra zhes khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi las ka phul/ rgyal bo la'ang lha'i tshangs pa chen po/ zhes mtshan gnang zhing / rgya nag gong ma wan yi rgyal bos/ rgyal khams thams cad kyi bla ma gyig ching thi'i mtshan dang / tham ga lung / las zhwa/ las gos/ 'ja' sa sogs kyi sngon du rgyal bo'i che ba'i rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas rgya nag gi mi dpon gsum gyis gtso bo byas te mi sna 'byor/ lu hang gsar ma'i na bza' cha tshang sogs dang / gser dngul gos dar sogs pho brang gi yo byad mang du phul/ nged rang gi 'bangs su gyur pa'i sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu dang / kan cu thang gi mi dpon sogs kyi re ba yongs su bskang ba legs shing / pho brang chen por yang rim gyis gdan 'dren zhus pa sogs kyi bka' shog gnang zhes gsungs so/ /dus de nas bzung rgyal dbang sku 'phreng rim byon la tā la'i bla ma zhes yongs su grags/ tā la ni sog po'i skad la rgya mtsho zer zhing / rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes pa'i go don ni/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs/snashāspya ṭwāṃṭwāṃ/ da/nga 'phrin las sogs/ rgya mtsho chen po ltar mtha' dang mu med par rgya che ba'i don yin par rgyal rigs gsum gyis gtsor byas pa'i sog po brgya phrag mang po rab tu byung nas 'ur bsdus kyi rgyal pos gdan drangs/ der phun tshogs gzhan phan sde zhes pa dgon pa btab/ yul du mar phebs/chos lan mang por gnang / cha har rnams kyis rgya'i lcags ri'i nang khongs kyi sde la gnod 'tshe che bas/rje 'di nyid sog po rnams la chos dang 'brel ba'i bka' slob gnang nas bzung rgya'i rigs rnams la gnod 'tshe mi byed par gyur/ sa yos (1579)lor 'ur bsdus dang / o rod nang 'khrug pa 'dum mdzad de bde bar bkod/ mchod yon bka' gros thog nas bod sog 'brel ba byed mi sog phyogs nas dpon kho lo che chung pa thur 'khor bcas mtsho khar 'jog rgyu dang / bod phyogs nas sku tshab stong skor yon tan rgya mtsho ༵/ ༵/ṭwāṃ rdzurdo spra ṭwāṃsna ༵/la du rdzong bda' mdzad/ sno gdong gong mar lo ltar mtsho kha'i phyogs nas rta khral ༄ lcags 'brurno (1580)lor khams stod li thang du phebs/ li thang dgon chen thub bstan byams chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par spyal ba'i sde btab/ lcags sbrul(1581)lor rmar khams/ brag yab/ chab mdo sogs su phebs/ ldan chos 'khor dgon du phebs skabs al than rgyal po'i sras du ring rgyalabo mi sna mang po dang bcas/ al than rgyal po gshegs pa'i bsngo zhu dang / gdan 'dren du byon pa ltar mcho khar chibs bsgyur/ ‘—chu ༵ṭwāṃ 0(1 83)lo sar skabs su sku 'bum du phebs/ der bshad grwa btsugs/ sku 'bum byams

gling zhes/ mtsho sngon zhing chen hong thung rdzong khongs shar tsong kha'i yul du yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon chen zhig yin pa 'di nyid rab byung bcu pa'i sa byi (1588)lor tā la'i bla ma gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i 'al bkod ltar rje tsong kha pa 'khrungs sar 'dul ba chos rje 'od zer mtshos phyag btab pa dang /phyis rim kyis rgya bskyed byas nas bar skabs grwa tshang bzhir 'phel rgyas byung / tsong kha'i phyogs su rgya dang hor 'khrug pa chen po yod par 'dum mdzad de kun bde skyid kyi lam du bkod/ de nas 'ur bsdus dpon se chen hong tha'i ji'i sde thog tu 'byor/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ rab tu byung ba stong phrag brgal ba byung / shing bya (1585)lor se chen ta'i ching gi sde thog tu phebs te/ phun tshogs dar rgyas gling gi dgon pa btab/ me khyi (1bya86)lor al than rgyal po'i sras pha du ring7gi gdan 'dren 'byor ba ltar/chibs bsgyur gnang ste al than rgyal bo'i rgyal sa/ mkhar sngon por lebs/ mang tshogs la dbang bskur byin rlabs sogs gnang ba dang / al than rgyal po'i gdung zhugs la phul/ bsngo smon mdzad/du ring khāng gi mchod yul du lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ du ring khang yang glo bur du gshegs/ rje 'di bas yang skung tshul cung zad bzhes/ sa byi (1588)lo'i hor zla dang bo'i zla mjug tu bro 'tshal ba'i tshul mdzad yod thog rgya nag gong ma'i gdan 'dren mi sna 'byor/ rten 'brel la dgongs phebs rgyu'i 'al bzhes gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin sku 'das/ dgung grangs zhe drug pa yin 'dra/gdung zhugs la phul nas gdung rus rnams zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyis 'bras spungs su gdan drangs so/ /(4)rgyal dbangaskya 'azeng bzhibayonatanargya mcho/rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho ni sog yul du yab thu med tha'i ji dang yum bā khen spur gyi sras su rab byung bcu pa'i sa glang (1589)lo'i zla 1 tshes 1 nyin 'khrungs/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yang sprul du ngos bzung / dgung lo gnyis bzhes skabs sog po'i dpon rigs dang / sbyin bdag rnams kyis mkhar sngon por gdan 'dren zhus/ dga' ldan khri zur rgyal khang rtse ba dpal 'byor rgya mtshos thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho zhesamatshan gsol/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog lcags glang (1601)lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi khrir 'khod/ de rjes dga' ldan khri zur sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mkhan po mdzad de rab tu byung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa paṇa chen lnga ba blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rgyal dbangamachog gis gtsug gi cod pan du bsten te mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mang du gsan/ gong du bshad pa ltar bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi gdan sar bzhugs mkhan rnams la paṇa chen zhes pa'i mtshan thog la/ paṇa chen lnga ba blo bzang chos rgyan sku tshe gang la paṇa chen du bzhugs stabs/ de nas rdzuṣṭṛng/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi sku 'breng rnams la paṇa chen rin po che zhes mtshan de rgyun 'jags su shing 'brug (/604)lor rjes 'dis bka' gnang ltar 'on rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos mdo — 531 —

smad a mdo'i yul du dgon lung btab/ me lug (1607)lor bkra shis lhun por phebs/ slob dpon paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos rgyan la brgya 'bul dang bcas zla ba rtsed gnyis lhag la chos bka' mang du zhus/ de skabs zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje'i bu sde ba karma bstan srung dbang bos gtsang phyogs la dbang ༵/ṭwāṃ /ba'i skabs yin la/ de dang phyogs lhung can 'ga' zhig gis mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byas par lcags khyi (1610)lor mtsho kha nas dpon 'khor lo che'i sras lha btsun che ba dang / se chen tha'i jis gtso byas pa'i sog 'grul dang / dmag dpon che ba byung / skyid shod sde ba bsod nams rnam spyal dang / 'dan pa 'tsho byed sogs kyis gtsang rgol gyi dus zing bslangs par/ gtsang dmag 'bor chen skyid shod lha sar 'ong / rdzong gzhis du ma phrogs/ chad las byas/ hor sog gi dpung chen po rang yul dubaskrad/ gtsang bas dbus la dbang bsgyur/ po twa la'i pho brang bzung / dge lugs pa la shin tu sdang stabs/ paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' bzhin/ lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pas gtsor byas nas drag po'i las sbyor mdzad pa dang / lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pas mu mthud nas las sbyor mdzad stabs/ gtsang rgyal gyi sras rnams gzhon nu nas gshegs/ gtsang rgyal khrir 'khod dag kyang dar ma dar thog nas 'das stabs/ gtsang rgyal khros nas/ lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa btson du bcug cimig rna ba sogs dbang bo rnams breg de ltar byas mod/phyis su mig sogs dbang po gsar pa skyes te/ ri phug ces pa'i khong gi gdan sa nas bka' lung dkon po mang po gnang ba dang mu mthud nas drag po las mdzad stabs/ de rjes lo gsum tsam las ma 'gor bar gu thi bstan 'dzin gyis gtsang srid lhag med du bcom ste/ gtsang srid ming tsam lhag mar ma lus pa rje 'di pa'i mthu nus yin zhes 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsung gi 'jig byed chos 'byung sogs rnam thar lo rgyus mang po'i nang du 'dug go/ /lcags phag (1611)lor rje 'dis paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos spyan 'bras spungs su spyan drangs te rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs dbang bka' rgya chen po gsan/ lo 'dir gtsang dmag gtos chen po yar rgyab pa'i thog tu 'ongs nas yar rgyab pa'i dbang cha tshang ma phrogs/ sku skal byin nas sa gzhan du phud/shing stag (1614)lor rgyal dbang rin po che paṇa chen rin po che'i drung las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ me 'brug (1616)lor rgya nag tā ming rgyal pos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes pa'i mtshan bstod phul/ lo der gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi karma ba yab sras gzhis ka bsam 'aspub rtser gdan drangs/ gtsang khul gyi ser mo yod tshad kyis chos 'brel zhu dgos pa dang / ser sbreng zhu bar 'dzoms dbos pa'i bka' bab/ lo der rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho dgung grangs nyer brgyad du skebs/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin sku 'das/ phyi lo nas lo shas ring la slob dpon paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan se 'bras kyi mkhan khrir phebs pa dang / lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur —— 532 —

rgyun du phebs 'dug go/ /(5)ta la'i bla ma sku 'azeng lnga bsgyuladabangablo bzangargya mcho/rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu ba'i me sbrul (1617)lo'i zla 9 tshes 23 nyin 'phyongs rgyas gying bar stag rtser/ yab za hor rgyal po'i gdung rgyud hor bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / yum khri lcam kun dga' lha mdzes kyi sras su 'khrungs/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis paṇa chen rin po che dang bkra rshas lhun por brnyas gtse chen po byed bzhin pa'i rkyen las/ sog po'i 'grul ba rgya che ba dbus phyogs su 'byor/ de tshes karma ba'i mdzo khyu jag 'der byas/ karma ba'i spyab tu gtsang ba langs te/ sa rta (1618)lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang / sde srid gtsang ba'i dmag dang / dwags gong gi dmag chen lha sar 'byor/ thu med tha'i ji'i sras lha btsun bgres gzhon gnyis dang / se chen ta'i ming sogs thu med kyi rgyal rgyud har hu la/ khun du lung cho khur sogs hal ha'i rgyal rgyud/ sde ba skyid shod pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs se 'bras kyi gros la dbang ba du ma 'dus te/ dga' ldan pho brang ba'i phyogs nas dmag 'khrugs bshol thabs mdzad cing / gtsang srid phyogs nas ma nyan par mthar sog dmag dang /gtsang ba'i bsdus pa'i bod dmag gis skyid shod lha sa'i phyogs dmag 'khrugs nyin mang por byas/gtsang dmag stong phrag lhag lha sar kha btags/ gtsang dmag mang pos 'bras spungs gtor rtsis kyis 'bras srungs rgyab ri'i rtser byin pa/ da'i chings kyis dmag sna drangs te/ sog dmag gtsang dmag gi thog tu brgyugs nas gtsang dmag gcig kyang ma lus par bsad/ de'i phyi nyin skyid chu'i 'gram du gtsang bas dmag sgar sngar las che ba brgyab pas/ sog dmag skug te 'bros 'go brtsams/ se 'bras kyi dge 'dun rnams dang / sde ba skyid shod pa sogs kyang skrag ste 'phan yul dang / byang stag lung sogs su bros/ gtsang dmag gis se 'bras bcom/ 'bras spungs rgyab rir skya ser shin tu mang po bsad/skyid shod pa'i rdzong gzhis thams cang blangs/ sde ba skyid shod pa yab sras mtsho khar bros/ dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' mang po bsgyur/ chos rje stag lung bas chings mol zhus te/ se 'bras kyi grwa ba rnams sngar rgyun bzhin grwa sar bzhugs chog par byas kyang / 'bras spungs la gser zho nyis brgya'i chad pa dang / se ra la gser zho baspya tham pa'i chad pa ba'ag se 'bras la gser ster rgyu med pas dga' ldan pho brang ba'i zhal ngo bsod nams chos 'phel gyis rgyal du mdzod cig yod pa las gser len dgos tshul brjod de/gtsang ba'i sku tshab dang mnyam du rgyal du 'gro skabs lam kha nas bros te nyang kong brgyud sog yul du 'byor/de rjes gtsang bas yar lung sogs kyi sde dpon rnams la ches mi 'tsham pa sha stag byas pa dang /dus mtshungs su rgyal dbang gi yab hor bdud 'dul rdo rje'i lag nas phying ba stag rtse'i rdzong blangs te/zug po nas la rtsis sprad/ rgyal dbang gi yum khri lcam la chu shur lha gshongs lto skal du gnang ste chu shur la'agro dgos byung / yab gtsang du khrid nas btson du bcug sa lug (1619)lor gtsang srid gzhung gis yum sras gnyis ka myur du gtsang du yong dgos zer yang / gzim khang sde ba sna dkar ṭwāṃ3 ༵sa hūṃtsang

la yar zhus dang khag theg gnang stabs/ yum sras gnyis ka sna dkar rtser bzhugs chog pa byung / spyal dbang dgung lo gsum gyi thog mtshan mor dpal 'bar sbar te bros bshol byed skabs mi ser rnams kyis kyang sems skyo ba'i ngu 'bod sogs byas tshul rnam thar du gsal/lcags bya (1621)lor lha btsun blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / gu ru hong tha'i jis gtsos hor sog gi dmag stong gnyis lha sar smrebs/ gtsang bas rkyang thang sgang du dmag sgar brgyab/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ glo bur du sog dmag gtsang ba'i dmag sgar thog tu brgyugs pas mi brgya phrag du ma bsad/ paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'bras spungs su mtshams la bzhugs yod pas thos ma thag tu thugs kyis ma bzod par mtshams har 'don gyis zhabs thang la sog dmag gis spe mda' dang / mda'i char 'bebs pa'i skabs su phebs/ bod dmag rnams lcags po rir 'khor ba la sog dmag brgyugs pa'i rgyug 'phro bcad/ mi stong phrag mang po'i srog bskyabs/ gtsang sog gnyis kas lha sa paṇa chen rin po cher phul/ paṇa chen rin po che/ dga' ldan khri ba tshul khrims chos 'phel/ glang smad zhabs drung dkon mchog chos 'phel/ stag lung zhabs drung rnams kyis chings mdzad de bcad khra bzhag dga' ldan pho brang bar chos 'khor lha sa'i gtso byas rigs min gyi sa cha byin/ se 'bras mchod gzhis rnams tshul sprad/ dbus gtsang dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' bsgyur ba rnams dang gzhis shor sngar ltar phyir slog sde ba skyid shod pa la yang bye ri stag rtse dang bde chen gyi sa tshab tu phan yul mkhar rtse dang bcas tshang ma byung /zhal ngo bsod nams chol 'phel 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du gzhis phab nas rgyal ba'i yang srid btsal bar ngos 'dzin gsal ba 'phyongs rgyas bying bar stag rtse'i de dang gzhan gnyis bcas paṇa chen rin po che dang / gling smad zhabs drung gnyis rwa sgrong du beebs nas jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i drung du zan brtag gnang ba/ 'phyogs rgyas sprul sku bab/ rab phyogs chu pho khyi'i (1622)lor dgung lo drug gi thog sna dkar rtse nas gdan drangs te 'bras srungs dga' ldan pho brang gi rgyal ba gong ma'i gdan sar bkod/paṇa chen rin po che la gtsug phud phul bar mtshan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes bstsal/ gtsang sde srid dogs pa chung ched sku tshab cig zhus pas/ sku tshab des sog po sogs kyi yig 'grul yod med rtsam khug nang tshun chad bsngogs bsher byas/ shing glang (1625)lor paṇa chen rin po che'i drung las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ yab bdud 'dul rdo rje gtsang ba'i khrims 'og tu 'das/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs /༵ ṭwāṃ~X ༵ṭwāṃsna rjes/ sras karma bstan skyong dbang bos srid dbang bzung / de'i skabs lo bco lnga yin rab drag chu pho sprel ( 1632) lor sog po hal has/ hor stod dang / a mi sger du bcom/gtsang sde srid kyis bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag bsdu ba sogs gra sgrig dang / dus mtshungs su paṇa chen rwaren ༵ 3ṭwāṃ dang dga' ldan pho brang gi zhal ngo bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis sog khrod chings la phebs

dgos zer ba ltar khong gnyis pebs pas/ sog dmag gis gsung brtsis te phyir rang yul du log bcug ste/ don 'khyol byung stabs/ gatreng ba dpon blon rab tu dga' ba byung 'dug der brten gtsang sde bar zhus te/ lcags pho ri'i bcad khra ltar lha sa dga' ldan pho brang bas rtsis blangs/ sngar rgyal ba rin po che twa la'i bla ma lha sar phebs skabs sger shag tu bzhugs dgos kyang / de tshun chad gtsug lag khang gi steng gi gzim chung du bzhugs pa yin 'dugasngar hal ha nang zhig byung nas chog thu dpon sde dang bcas pa mtsho sngon por 'ongs nas re zhig mnga' thang rgyas te mdo snad phyogs kyi bod sog la dbang bsgyur/ kho rgya'i ta'o rin la dad cing bod sog gi bla ser la shin tu sdang / mdo stod du be ri dpon don yod zer ba bon la dad cing / sa dge rnying gsum rnams la shin tu ldang / dbus gtsang du gtsang ba sde srid kyis dbang bsgyur te/ kho karma ba la dad cing /dge lugs pa la shin tu sdang / de gsum mna' 'brel gyis dbus 'grul dang chong 'grul gyi lam bkag 'gog sogs mdo dbus gtsang gsum la dka' tshegs chen po byung / de skabs a mdo dgon lung gi grwa ba dga' ru lo tsā ba dang / sems nyid kha che zer ba gnyis dbus su 'ongs nas/ skyid shod sde ba bye ri stag rtse/ sde ba mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs dang gros byas te/ dga' ru lo tsās dpa' res kyi dmag kha shas khrid de sog po jin gir du rgyab gnyen 'tshol du byin/ rgyu mtshan zhus/ sog po'i rgyal blon rnams kyis gros ༵/ṭwāṃ shātā /༵༵/ bod yul du rgyab gnyer la su 'gro byas pas gu shri han bstan 'dzin gyis nga 'gro zhes khas shing phag (1635)lor mtsho sngon nas chog thu dpon gyis rang gi bu ar sa lang tha'i ji khri dmag dang bcas dbus gtsang du mngags te/ sde ba gatreng ba dang karma ba la 'brel ba byas nas dge lugs pa med par gtong dgos pa'i bka' phab/ dbus su 'byor nas ar sa lang gis mtshur phu karma bar mjal rtsis byas pa/ sog por skug nas ngo ma bstan/ ar sa lang tha'i ji'i sems la phog ste/ kar gtsang la 'brel lam ma byung / me byi ( 1636)lo'i lo sar skabs ar sa lang tā la'i bla mar mjal phyag zhus/'bras spungs su tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun du bcar te dbang dang rjes gnang zhus/ de rjes 'dam gzhung brgyud nas phyir log de rjes zhwa dmar rab 'byams pa zer ba dang / blon po tha'i chin gnyis kyis gros thog nas chog thu'i sar bang chen pa mngags nas/ ar sa lang gis pha'i bka'i bzhin ma byas pa'i gnas sbyolha shā rsha sna zlo/ṭwāṃ dpa/sa chog thu zhe sdang 'phar te/ mi mngags nas rang gi bu ar sa lang dang / de'i de'i skabs shig nas mdo stod kyi dpon don yod kyis li thang dgon sogs gtor/ lo rjes mar kho dmag bcas dbus gtsang du 'ongs nas/ lha sa'i jo bo dang / se 'bras dge gsum med par gtong zhes 'phrin btang bar gtsang bas kyang der bskun dmag gra sgrig byas/me glang (1637)lo'i zla 1 bor gu thi han gyi dmag mtsho sngon du yod pa'i chog thu'i ste~X 3༵ bzla/gas

pas/ chog thu'i dmag sum khri yod pa pham par byas/ chog thu rang bros nas ma thar bar bzung naspobasad/ gu thi han gyis mtsho sngon sogs mdo snad la dbang bsgyur/ mtsho sngon du gzhis chags/ de rjes rim gyis od rod cung gar gyi gu thi han kyi ru sde rnams mtsho sngon du gnas spos/ de nas gu thi han sogs bod sog gi 'grul ba gtos che ba lha sar 'byor/ gu thi han gyis rgyal dbang rin po cher 'bul ba gtos che ba dang bcas chos mang po zhus/ me glang lo der paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi drung las rgyal dbang rin po che bsnyen par rdzogs/lcags 'brug (1640)lo'i dbyar thog gu thi han gyi sog dmag dang / a mdo'i dmag bcas be ri don yod kyi sa thog tu slobs nas g.yul bkyes te pe ri gson bzung byas chab mdor khri mon btson du bcug sa rnying / kar dge/ jo 'brug 'bru stag gi bla ma sum brgya lhag btson du bcug yod pa rnams btson las brton te mi 'jigs srog gi skyabs sbyin mdzad/ shar dar rtse mdo nas 'jang sa tham rgyal bo'i sa cha tshun chad mdo khams tshang ma dbang du bsdus/ de nas lcags sbrul (1641)lor gu thi han gyi dmag gtsang ba sde srid kyi thog tu chas/ gtsang ba'i bod dmag rnams kyis bkag kyang ma khog par phal cher gyi mgo sgur/ kha shas rang yul du bros/ chu rta (1642)lo'i zla ba lnga ba'i nyer lnga la sog dmag rnams chos sde gsar ba'i nang la 'dzul/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes shar la/ gtsang ba cham la phab/ sde srid kyi srog skyabs zhu bar sa skya zhabs brung dang / paṇa chen rin po che 'phral du phebs nas rgyal bor ched mjal gyis gtsang sde srid kyi zhabs 'degs su gang 'gyur byas kyang / sngon du bro dam por bkag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis srog skyobs pa ma gtogs phan thogs rgya che ba ma thub gsung 'dug gtsang rgyal karma bstan skyong dbang po dang / mgron gnyer bon gong ba/ rta nag 'o rlon pa/ sgang zug pa bcas sno'u rdzong du khrid nas khri mon du bcugargyal bos gdan zhus ltar rgyal dbang rin po che zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin 'bras spungs nas btegs te/ thob rgyal mda' bde chen du slebs nyin gu thi han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sogs ser skya gtos che ba phebs bsur 'byor/ rgyal po dang thog mar mjal skabs rin po che sna tshogs pa dang / bod khri skor bcu gsum dang bcas pa phul/ tshes nyer lnga'i nyin bkra shis lhun por phebs/ rab drug chu rta (/642)lo'i zla ba 4 tshes 5 nyin/ gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong gi tshoms chen nang ser skya bgrangs kyis mi lang ba'i dbus su gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por tā la'i bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs sor 'khod/ man ju'i gong ma rgyal po tshang dang 'brel lam btsugs/ de nas gu thi han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis man ṭal sku gsung thugs rten gyi thog drangs/ rgyal ba'i 'phel gdung sogs rten 'gang chen du ma dang rin po che sna dgu'i sne drangs te/ shar dar rtse mdo nas nub la dwags bar gyi sa cha rnams yul mi bcas 'bangs su phul zhing / rgyal po rang nyid rigs rgyud dang bcas pa mchod sbyin du 'bul bar mdzang)/ 5ṭwāṃṭwāṃ 'o bsod nams chos 'phel la sde srid kyi go gnas sul/ bod kyi sa gnas yongs la dril

bsgrags/ de nas bzung gtsang sde srid kyi srid dbang mjug bsdus/ bod srid dga' ldan pho brang ba'i spra/ ṭwāṃsdo ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ ba baṭwāṃkā / kā /gyis/ rgyal bo'i mtshan bzung ste rgyab phyogs dmag dpon byas/ sne srid kyis lo de'i zla ba dgu ba'i nang nas/ gtsang phyogs kyi dgon sde dang sde dpon dag gis lkog nas 'brel ba byas te ngo log rgya chen po byas stabs/ sog rgyal gu thi han khros nas/ gtsang ba'i rgyal blon gnyis ka khri mon du yod pa srog chad bcad/ kar gtsang dgon sde rnams med par btang bas/ bka' rgyud pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa'i rkyen de ltar byung ngo / /chu lug (1643)lor karma ba chos dbyings rdo rje dgung grangs zhe bdun thog lho brag nas bros te 'jang yul du phebs nas yun ring por bzhugs/ shing bya (1645)lo'i zla 3tshes 28nyin lto 'asbyi'i thig btab ste pho brang chen po po ta la bzhengs rgyu'i gra sgrig gi 'go bzung nas pho brang tshen po rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs/ de rjes sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos pho brang dmar po rten dang brten par bcas bzhengs pa snga rjes sdom pas lo zhe gsum gyi ring la legs par grub pa yin 'dugasngar shing sprel (1644)lo la bod kyi gzhung dmag 'brug pa'i thog tu song skabs/ pakho chen rin po che blo bzang chos rgyan dang / sa skya bdag chen bsod nams dbang phyug gnyis kyis chings brgyab mod/yun ring ma gnas par sa byi (1648)lor slar yang bod gzhung gi dmag 'brug thog tu song bas g.yul 'gyed skabs pham khur 'dug zer/ dmag 'khrug langs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bod gzhung gi mnga' khongs su gastogs pa'i mon pa bla khag lnga dang lho 'brug ma mthun pa dang / 'brug pas bod gzhung la lo re bzhin 'bras 'bul dgos pa/ gtsang bas srid dbang bzung skabs phul mod/ dga' ldan pho brang bas srid dbang bzung ba nas ma phul ba'i stabs kyis yin 'dug lo 'di la dga' ldan pho brang nas/ rgyal rong dar rtse mdo lcags la sogs mdo smad du dud tshang grangs len dang / gzhung khrol sogs kyi yig khra thel dam can deb lnga bcu nga drug bzos zer/tā ming rgyal po'i rgyal sa phrogs nas/ de'i tshab tu dbang bsgyur ba'i man ju'i rgyal bo'i thog ma shin kris lo snga phyir yang dang yang du gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin/ chu 'brug (16bya2)lo'i zla 3 tshes 15 nyin rgya nag phyogs chibs kha bsgyur/ lam bar spya sog bod rigs kyi dpon 'bangs dang / spya dang ma ju'i blon chen dmag dpung bcas kyis phebs bsu dang dngos 'bul rgya tshe ba mdzad/chu sbrul (1653)lo'i zla ba dang bor gong ma shin kri dang mjal 'phrad byung / mjal dar rtse sprod gnang / slar zla gnyis par gong ma'i pho brang du gdan drangs nas dngos 'bul gastos che ba phul ba sogs mjal 'phrad thengs kha shas gnang / gong ma dang sog po'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin rgya nag dang / sog yul gyi dgon sde rnams la bca' yig dang bka' slob sogs bstsal/ de nas zhi drag gi blon chen rnams kyis phebs skyel dang bcas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyind pe cipy-i3 kās :ngebs

kha bsgyur/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin ta'i kha zhes pa'i sa gnas su phebs skabs/ shin tu rgya che ba'i mdzad sgo'i thog gong ma'i dmigs bsal gyi mi snas gser gyi tham ga dang / gser gyi glegs bu bco lnga la mig dang 'brel nas lteb chog pa'i nang / man ju/ hor/ bod yig 'bur dod du brkos pa'i nang /nub gyi lha gnas ches dge ba bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur ba 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes mtshan bstod phul/ tā la'i bla ma rin po che nas kyang gong dang 'dra ba'i gser gyi glegs bu'i thog bod/ man/ hor gsum gyi yi ge 'bur du dod pa bskos pa'i nang gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po zhes mtshan bstod gong ma'i mi sna'i phyag tu phul/ de nas mkhar sngon brgyud zi ling sku 'bum sogs a mdo'i dgon gnas rnams dang / mtsho sngon gyi sa gnas khag chab mdo sogs mdo stod kyi dgon lde dang / yul sde sogs kyis bsnyen bkur bla na med pa zhus thog chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas cum par byas te/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin lha ldan du 'byor 'dug go/ /shing rta (1654 )lor zla 12 tshes 7 nyin gu thi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dgung grangs don gnyis thog gzim khri'i mtha' can du gyur/ sa khyi (1658)lor gu thi han gyi sras bstan 'dzin rdo rje la spyal bo'i thob gnang / yab kyi dus ltar sog dmag gi 'go 'dzin mdzad/ lo de'i zla gsum par sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel gshegs/ lo gcig la gsang rgya mdzad/ lcags byi (1660)lo'i zla 7 tshes 13nyin ji sang sde ba zer ba grong smad 'phrin las rgya mtshor sde srid kyi cho lo gnang ba dang / de dang mnyam rgyal bo bstan 'dzin rdo rje la yang / bstan 'dzin dā yan khāng zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal te/ mchod yon gyis mdzad sgo dus gcig la gnang / lcags glang (1661)lor bal bo'i dpung dmag gis bod khongs glang bu mkhar du tshur rgol byung bar bod dmag gis 'phral du sa mtshams nas phar bskrad/ chu stag(1662)lor paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan sku 'das gsungs 'dug lo 'dir 'bras rgyal sras bstan srung rnam rgyal rgyal sar 'khod pa chabs cig tā la'i bla ma rin po cher mjal bar lha sar phebs/ sde srid kyang mjal te khrims yig zhig zhal lce bcu drug skor la slob ston mang po zhus gnang mdzad/shing sbrul ( 1665)lor man ju gong ma gnyis pa khang shi rgyal bos/ dal gel dge slong dang /shes rab 'od zer gnyis dza drag gis mi snar mngags te tā la'i bla ma rin po cher zhus don/ sog po tshos rgya'i sa mtshams brgal nas rgya grong rnams la rtag tu gnod pa byed kyin 'dug pas/ rgya sog sa mtshams kyi dpon sde rnams la zhal ta bka' slob gnang mi sku tshab ched gtong gnang rgyu thugs rje che zhes zhus pa ltar/sa mtshams kyi dpon sde rnams la/ sa mtshams gtan khel ba'i rang sde rang 'dzin dang / sa mtshams brgal nas spya sdo rnams la bsun gtser mi byed par sngar lugs ltar tshong 'brel yag po byas nas 'dug dgos/ zhes bka' slob gnang mkhan byams gling mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / khang gsar rab brtan pa rnam gnyis gtong gnang mdzad pas rtsod gzhi zhi 'jags dang / 'brel ba sngar lugs — 538 —

bzhin yag po byung /me lug (1667)lor paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po/ bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon por sku gong ma'i khrir bkod/ de'i phyi lor sde srid grong smad pa zin las rgya mcho khri lo dgur gnang ste gshegs/ de rjes bstan 'dzin dā yan rgyal po 'das/sa sprel(1668)lor mon pa a lcog pa'i steng du 'brug dmag byung bar/ a lcog pa'i rgyab gnyer la bod
