gzhung gi dmag song nas 'brug pa pham par byas te chings bzhag shing yos (1675)lor mon 'brug gnyis 'khrugs pa dang / me 'brug (1676)lor 'brug pas mon dang 'bras ljongs la btsan 'dzul byas pas/ bod gzhung gi dmag song nas 'bras ljongs nas 'brug dmag gyir 'phud btang /sa cha shor ba rnams phyir blangs/ sa rta (1678)lor bod 'brug bka' mol byas mod chings legs po ma byung / sa bya (1669)lor mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs sde srid du bsko bzhag gnang / 'di la zangs ri blo bzang mthu stobs yang zer/ de'i phyi lor od rod kyi nang du sde gzar langs par/ rgyal ṭwāṃdrong/ dang sde srid kyis gangs can mkhan po dkon mchog rin chen mngags ste phan tshun lugs mthun pa lcags phag (1671)lor paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis rgyal dbang mchog la dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhu ba/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang po zhu ba'i don du lha sar phebs/ gu shri han gyi sras chung ba dkon mchog da la'i la bstan 'dzin da la'i cho lo dang bcas rgyal po'i go sar khri 'don mdzad/chu byi (1672)lo sar skabs nas rin chen rgyan cha spras pa'i srol btsugs/ de yang bod rgyal sku dus kyi chas gos gzhi byas nas gser ga sog rna/ sog sgor/ rnam rgyangs/ shal dkar dmar/ tsi gos/ tsi beer/ gtsug zhwa ste rin chen spyan spros su grags pa sde srid sngon rabs dag gi dus bzhin mdzad/sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyal/ hal ha sde gzhung gi bla mar mdzad/bar khams phyogs su dpon mkha' 'gro dang sgar ba sku nyer 'brel ba byas te/ bod kyi bstan srid la gnod pa byung stabs/ mtsho sngon nas tā la'i hung tha'i jil dmag dpon byas/ dga' ldan dar rgyas tshe dbang rab brtan sogs kyi dpung dmag bar khams su 'byor ba tsam gyis dgra phyogs kyis mgo sgur/dmag dpung phyir log da la'i hung tha'i ji 'khor bcas gnas tshul zhu bar lha sar byon/shing stag (1674)lor mdo khams rgyal thang phyogs su bod gzhung sku tshab kyi bka' mi brtsi ba byung stabs/ mul jo'i tha'i jis dmag dpon dang / de'i rogs par bka' brgyad nor bu/ mas chags pa dpung bcas rdzong bda' mdzad pa ltar song nas dpung 'jug tsha nan byas/ shing yos (1675)lo'i zla 1 bor gte bo nyi shur srog chad bab ste lha sar khrid 'ong ba la/ gong nas sros sbyin mdzad de tshe btson byas/ gzhan 'ga' la'ang nyes bskun gyi chad las bkal/ ci me 'brug (1676)lor sde srid mthu stobs dgongs zhus kyi zur ba//gas mdzad/ 5/༵ rgyal grwa

tshang gi gnyer ba blo bzang sbyin pa sde srid du bskos/ me sbrul (1677)lo 'ba' chos sde dgon la phog thob sngar yod thog 'phar snon chos gzhis gsar snon mdzad/ mu li (mi li)sde spyi nas lo ltar sde gzhung la gser khral 'bul rgyu byas/ dar rtse mdor dga' ldan 'gro phan gling gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dar mdo'i dgon sne dag dang / mgo log dgon gsar bcas la phog thebs mchod gzhis skor gnang ba dang /khungs so sor slob dpon dpon bcas brdzong bda' mdzad/ rgyal thang dgon grwa ba lnga brgya sum cu skor la yang gtong thebs mchod gzhis thag bcad/sa lug (1679)lor sde srid blo bzang sbyin pa lo gsum la bzhugs te dgongs pa zhus/ grong snad pa a war sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sde srid du bskos stod mnga' ris kyi dgon sde khag la/ la dwags pas gnod 'tshe yang yang byas par brten/ bod sog gi dmag la dwags su dpung 'jug byas/ la dwags pham yang kho tsho kha che'i rgyal bor mgo btags te kha che'i dmag khrid 'ongs nas g.yul thengs mang bor bkyis mod/mthar la dwags pham ste/ la dwags spyal bo go sa nas phab/ la dwags chos rgyal rnying khungs kyi rgyud pa blo ༵/rsha pad ma rgyal bor bskos/ lo ltar dga' ldan pho brang bar gus 'dud zhu bar yong rgyu'i mna' 'gan rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu pho khyi (1682)lor tā la'i bla ma rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dgung lo ri drug thog sku gshegs/ de ltar tā la'i bla ma rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po ni/ 'chad pa'i phyogs nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas kun dang grub mtha' ris med kyi chos gsan zhing gzhan la 'chad pas/ bod dang /rgya sog gi che dgu chung dgu mtha' dag slob mar gyur pa dang / rtsom pa'i phyogs nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas spub mtha' ris med kyi chos gsung rtsom pod sum cur long ba yod la/ rtsod pa'i phyogs nas/gzhon nu dus nas rtsod gleng rigs pa 'gran zla dang bral bar grags pa dang / chab srid phyogs nas/chab srid 'gan bzung ba nas/ nang 'khrug sde gzar sogs med par yul khams 'jam thengs kyis song ba sogs ni nges don bden gtam mo/ /rgyal dbang lnga ba sku 'das rjes/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gsang rgya yun ring byas/ gsang rgya byed dgos don ni/ rgyal dbang sku gshegs kha'i zhal chems yin zer ba dang / rgyal dbang mi bzhugs par shes na rgya sog gi dpon rigs dag bod gzhung la de tsam mi gus snyam pa'i dogs pa byung ba dang / pho brang po ta la yang bzhengs ma tshar ba dang / sde srid rang yang khrir 'khod nas lo gsum tsam las ma 'gor bas/ srid dbang brtan min la'ang bsam blo btang ba red zer ba sogs sna tshogs smra/ gang ltar lo bco lngar gsang rgya byas te zhabs gras sbyi la'ang gsang zhing / rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi grwa ba pha sde ba bkras rab zer ba/ zhal ngo sogs rgyal dbang dang 'dra ba dgung na mnyam pa de rgyal dbang du brdzus nas/phyi nas 'ongs ba'i sbyin bdag dang dpon rigs rnams gal che la mjal kha gtong dgos tshe des rgyal dbang gi tshab byaṭwāṃ4/0 sde srid kyis spyal dbang gi yang srid rtsad gcod byed par/ chos rje zil gnon rdo rje dang /

rdo ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis sogs gastong gnang gis/ mon yul nas yang sgrul 'khrul med rnyed zer/ thugs brtag bcad tshul ni/ chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes mngon chung brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin zhus par/ yid ches gsal bo rnyed pa dang / sde srid mchog nas lha blar gsang lung phul ba dang / zan brtag sogs la rtse mthun bzang phebs byung zer/ gzhan paṇa chen rin po che sogs sa dge rnyingagasum gyi bla chen sus kyang ma gsan 'dug(6)rgyal dbangasku zengacog pa tshangs dbyangs0sa /de ltar yang sprul tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni/ mon la 'og yul gsum zhes pa'i sar/ yab sngags rgyun rig 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin dang / yum tshe dbang lha mo gnyis la chu phag (1683)lo'i zla 3sdo lda shā spya/ /sku bltams/ gsang rgya dam par byas te mtsho snar gdan drangs/ mtsho sna rdzong sde gnyis kyis shing byi (1684)lo tsam nas sog yul nang mi mthun pa byung ba dang / rgya rgyal dang sde srid mthun lam ma byung pa sogs dka' tshegs byung zer/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags rta (1690)lor gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig bzhengs rgyu'i las grwa btsugs pa dang / tshogs mchod chen mo ser sbreng dang bcas pa btsugs/ rab nyi me byi (1696)lor gsang rgya grol te/ rgya nag dang sog po byings la'ang dril bsgrags me glang (1697)lo'i zla 4 tshes 15 nyin yang srid sna dkar rtser gdan drangs/ lo de'i zla dgu par paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang ye shes spyan drangs nas yang srid la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang / mtshan blo bzang rin cun tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes bstsal/ lo de'i zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin/ pho brang po ta lar gdan drangs te ṭīdri ༵shā//sa makā/ /chen rin po che sogs yab sras rnams kyis gser gyi mchod sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig rab nyi sa yos (1699)lor bstan 'dzin da la'i khāng gi sras bgres pa bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal dang / gzhon pa lha bzang gnyis nang ma mthun pa yin yang zer/ sde srid kyis lha bzang bar dug drangs yang zer/ gang ltar sde srid kyis lha bzang ba gsol skal byin nas mtsho sngon du phud/ mtsho sngon gyi sog dpon nang ma 'cham par nang dme sogs byung / o rod cung gar gyi rgyal po tshe dbang rab brtan gyis sde srid kyi bya spyod la ma dga' ba'i gtam mang du byung ba sogs dang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khri 'don skabs/man chen gong ma'i sku tshab la lcang skya ngag dbang chos ldan gtong gnang mdzad de/ khyed gong ma'i sku tshab yin pas sdi srid la phyag 'tshal mi chog ces bka' gnang na'ang / lha sar sbobs skabs sde srid kyis mi mngags nas khyod kyis nga la phyag ma 'tshal na nged dang bod kyi srid don rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku don yang 'aspub dka' zer ba byung bas/ khong gis rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku don du song na nga la ci byung yang rung thugs la dgongs nas/ sde srid la phyag 'tshal/ phyir pe cin du slabs nas gong ma'id bkaṭwāṃ sdu/da phog ste

bla ma'i go sa nas phab/ gnam bde sgo mo che'i mdun du brgya 'aspul stong 'grul gyis mthong sar phyag lag thal sda tram̐bye /dngha / pus btsugs kyis nyin gsum gyi bar du 'dug bcug pa'i chad las phog khong gi rnam bye bye sa |༵nga/ nyin mor rdzong rgyab sogs mda' rtsed sogs la phebs pa dang / mtshan mor grong khyim bud med dag gi khyim du bzhugs pa sogs dag snang sbyong dka' ba'i mdzad spyod la brten/ bod sog gi mi rigs mang po dang / se 'bras sogs su dad pa log pa'i gtam mang bar gyur/ sde srid kyis drung 'khor mthar rgyas kyis sku zhabs bslad pa yin pas kho med par bzos na phan che ba yod zer nas/ sde srid dang /mda' dpon dga' chags pa/ dar byung ba/ drung yig bstan 'dzin dbang po/ a pho lnga 'dzoms sogs bka' gros mdzad/ sku zhabs rdzong rgyab tu mda' 'phen la phebs/ mun rub mtshams su glu len bzhin phebs skabs mthar rgyas lam nas gsod rtsis byas/ de nyin sku zhabs kyi na bza' mthar rgyas la bkab/ mthar rgyas kyi gos g.yog por spyon bcug pas/ nor te dga' chags pas g.yog po der gris brgyab nas bsad/ de nor ba shes nas gzhan zhig gis mthar rgyas la gris brgyab pas cher rmas te 'gyil yang gsod ma thub/ sku zhabs sogs nas rim gyis shes te/ a pho lnga 'dzams zangs rta me 'bar la bskyon te khrom skor la khrid/ gzhan rnams khrag sbyor byas/ de nas sde srid la sku zhabs mi dga' bar gyur/'di dag gi lo rgyus gsal bo pha che swāchog 'dus pa rtsal’ gyi rnam thar byung ba brjod pa gdung ba'i mun sel zhes bya bar yod 'dugarab nyi shing bya (1705)lor sde srid dang rgyal bo gnyis ma 'chams pas/ sku zhabs la mo chos rje/skyid shod sde ba/ gdan sa'i mkhan po/ gzhung zhabs gnad yod khag paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab rnams kyis gros bsdur byed skabs/ sde srid kyis bla ma tsho la rgyal po bzung na ji ltar yong dris par/'jam dbyangs bzhad pas 'dzin rgyu yin na nga de'i gros nang med ces gsungs pa ltar/ mkhan po gzhan rnams kyis kyang de ltar brjod/ mjug tu gros chod la/ sde srid kyis dgongs zhus gnang ste/ gsol skal du gong dkar rdzong 'bul rgyu dang / lha bzang rgyal bo'i mtshan gnas rang 'jog thog mtsho sngon phyogs su bzhugs te gzhung gi rgyal bo'i thab rten dang / su byug khag gi 'bab sgo rnams bdag gnyer byed rgyu byas/ sde srid kyis dgongs pa zhus/ khong gi sras ngag dbang rin chen sde srid kyi go sar bzhag rgyal bo mtsho khar chas mod/ 'dam sogs su dal bgrod kyis phyi nyin phyi bzhin song / sde srid gong dkar du ma spos par pho brang du bzhugs pa lha bzang gi rna bar song ba dang / mthar rgyas kyi sku zhabs tshangs dbyangs pa'i yi ge yin tshul gyi yig rdzun bzos te rgyal bor sde srid med par gtong dgos zhes byung ba brjod pa gdung ba'i mun sel las bshad 'dug gang ltar lo de'i zla lnga ba'i nang rgyal bos sde srid gros chod la ma gnas par/ dmag khag gnyis byas nas khrid yong ba la/ dbus gtsang gi dmag bskul yang /sngaratram̐ sha~X ṭwāṃng pya mi ser la khral 'u lag sogs kyi dka' ngal che ba dang / gsang rgya yun ring ba dang /

rgyal dbang dang sde srid nang mi mthun pa sogs ngan dgu 'dzoms pa lta bu'i dbang gis g.yul pham nas/rgyal bo'i dmag skyid 'phan phyogs su slebs nyer skabs/ gdan sa khag rgyud grwa'i dpon slob/ paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab sogs bar chings la phebs te sde srid gong dkar du phebs rgyu dang gzhung spyal bo la gtod rgyu byas nas/ sde srid glo bur du gong dkar du spos/ rgyal bo rang nyid dmag dpung bcas 'phan yul brgyud lha sar yong yod dus/ rgyal mo tshe ring bkra shis dang / ja'i sang khag dpung khag gcig bcas yangs pa can brgyud stod lung sna rtser snga thon byung dus/ sde srid gong dkar du yod pa thos 'phral/dmag mngags nas bzur ste stod lung sna rtser khrid 'ongs nas de ma thag tu bsad do/ /sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ni rten khyim pa yin te chung dus rab tu byung bar 'dod nas rgyal dbang rin po cher zhus kyang ma gnang / zhes bee ser du gsungs/ khong chung dus nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ gsung rtsom sgra snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag snan sogs dpar du 'khod ma 'khod kun bsdom na pod bcu phrag long ba yod la/ sgra snyan pi wang / glu dbyangs sogs kyi sgyu rtsal la'ang shin tu mkhas par grags/dgung grangs nyer bdun thog sde srid kyi las 'gan 'khur/ srid jus la zhib cha che zhing las khungs so sor dngos phebs kyis zhib 'jug dang / mi dmangs kyi gnas tshul dang drag zhan gyi spyod tshul shes phyir/mi dkyus ma'i zol gyis dbus gtsang shar nub lho byang kun tu nyul bskyod dang / rtse pho brang chen po'i ar bo'i mjug skyong dang / gser gyi mchod sdong chen mo sogs sku gsung thugs rten sogs la jus 'god bkod/ chab srid sogs rnam daphyod mchog tu che ba'i rang rtags mngon gsal yin mod/paṇa chen rin po che dang se 'bras sogs dge lugs phyogs la/ chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang bstun/phyi'i rnam pa gus tshul mi byed mthu med tsam las rnying ma las gzhan la dad zhen mi che ba khong gis gsung /du kū la'i gos bzang gi kha skong sogs la bltas na shin tu gsal lo/ rjes sor sku dbang che ba'i skabs su mdzad spyod je lod du song ba ni che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar las/ sde srid mchog sku dbang che zhing /bde yangs gsum skas mgo'i bka' shog tu/ rgyun tu bag med kyis jo mo bzhes pa sogs mdzad mi chog par gsungs pa la/ dus phyis 'chi med dga' tshal dang / dpal rab khang gsar gyi bdag mo gnyis bzhes te che 'don bdag rkyen yongs grags mdzad pa dang / de dus lha sa dang / phyogs nas yong ba'i skyes dman kha stabs drag tshad sde srid rang nas ma bzhes pa gcig kyang med/ phar phebs tshur phebs dus lam 'gag la mi tshos yang mngon mtshan chen por bltas mi chog pa'i tsha nyams dang / bla khag rdzong gzhis/phyi nang gi las tshan sogs gang la yang bdag mo gnyis kyi zhu dbang btsan po bcas de tsho'i gnas tshul gter ston rin po ches gsan nas shin tu thugs khrel ba'i rnam pa dang / thugs zhen bzhes nas/ da mi byed dgu byed de kha gyis/ mgyogs por rang bla ma de'i rkang 'dren yong zhes thugs 'phar 'phar gnang /zhu yig tsha bo rkyang ba 'bul gnang mdzad nas/ sde srid rang yang gter ston rin po cher thugs dad chung — 543 —

du song / rgyal bos stod lung sna rtser sde srid kyi mgul bcad pa gsan dus spyan chab dang sbrags/ da zhus pa la rkang nas gsan ma byung zhes thugs dbyung ba'i gsung gcong chen po gnang 'dug ces che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar las gsungs so/ /rab nyi shing bya (1705)lo nas lha bzang bas bod rdzongs yongs la dbang bsgyur/ gong du brjod pa ltar rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i snang tshod kyi mdzad spyod la/ phyi nang gi mi mang po zhig gis dad log dang zhen log byed pa dang dad zhen byed mkhan yang los yod/ rgyal bo sogs kyis la mo tshangs pa'i sku rten la lung bstan zhus par rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sprul sku min zhes lung bstan pa red zer ba sogs lab gleng mang / gang ltar me khyi (1706)lo'i zla 5 tshes 1 nyin po ta la nas lha klu dga' tshal du gdan drangs/me khyi (1706)lo'i zla 5 tshes 17nyin rgya nag gi dbang chen pa sogs kyis rgya nag tu gdan drangs pa ltar phebs rtsis kyis chibs kha bsgyur/ mtshan nyid gling khar thab skyel steng du bzhugs yod thog 'bras srungs gyi grwa ba kha shas kyis 'go byas nas phebs ma bcug par dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs te bzhugs su bcug de nas mi kha shas kyis dathugs te 'bras zhungs gling du 'ur zing chen po byung yang mthar rang zhir song / slar rgya nag gong ma dang lha bzang gi 'dod pa ltar rgya nag tu chibs kha bsgyur/mtsho sngon phyogs su phebs lam du kun dga' nor du smrebs skabs mgrin 'cham lta bu bzhes nas der sku 'das/ der sku gdung zhugs la phul te/ gdung rus dang sku chas rnams gsol dpon grags pa rgya mtsho dang blo gros dbang phyug mchod dpon ngag dbang dpal 'bar/ em rje sangs spyas srid sgrub rnams ṭīrdzu ṭwāṃ/ shāsdo/ lha sar 'byor ba'i lo rgyus 'di ni rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar sogs rnam thar yang no mo han ngag dbang lhun 'aspub dar rgyas sam/ ming gzhan lha btsun ngag dbang rdo rjes mdzad pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lha'i tasbya ra'i rgyud kyi sgra dbyangs/zhes bya ba las/ sog po shi ma thag pa'i ro nyos te drang don la mya ngan las 'das tshul tsam las nges don gcig pur bros te a rigs 'aspul ba dang sdebs nas sog yul du bzhugs shing / zhes sogs dang /mdo smad a mdo'i yul du rgyal rong dang gser khog dzag rung sogs su gdan sa mdzad cing / 'gro don rgya chen po bskyangs mthar sog yul a lag sha ru sa lug (1739)lor sku gshegs pa sogs bshad 'dugarnam thar rtsom pa po a lag sha wang gi sras red/ rnam thar 'di la 'ga' zhig gis tshangs dbyangs pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar zer/ deng sang 'di pe cin nas lcags dpar btab yod/ 'ga' zhig gis lo rgyus snga ma nges don yin/ gyi ma ni tshangs dbyangs pa rdzus ma red zer/ chab srid skor 'di rnyog dra che bas/ ngo ma gang yin sus shes/tshangs dbyangs rgya nag tu drangs pa'i lo der/ ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i skur ngos bzung ste/—po sbya4 dīr gdan drangs/ de yang ye shes rgya mtsho 'di ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i drug cu ba me

stag la tshangs dbyangs pa dgung lo bzhi ba'i skabs su bar khams tsha rong kha ba dkar bor 'khrungs/ sku na sna sdo3/ lcags po ri la bzhugs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi ba sa yos la 'bras spungs su phebs nas slob gnyer nde lung rje drung blo bzang zin las kyi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan la rin po che ye shes rgya mtsho gsol/ gar phebs la tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring por khyab pas 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po zhig yin par cha 'ijog byed pa red zer/ dgung grangs nyer gnyis pa'i me phag (1707)lor po tā la'i khrir 'khod/ zla gnyis nang paṇa tshen rin po tshe gdan 'dren zhus te/ tshes 25 nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo rin po che'i mdun du rgyal ba pad dkar 'dzin pa la dge tshul dang / bsnyen rdzogs chab cig tu gnang ste/ mtshan ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bstsal/ yongs grags la rgyal ba pad dkar 'dzin pa zhes zhu ba de 'di ba red/ rje 'di'i dgung lo so gnyis pa me bya (1717)lor o rod cung gar gyi tha'i ji dga' ldan tshe ring don 'grub kyis cung gar gyi dmag mang po khrid de bod yul du slebs nas lha bzang bsad/ me bya lo 'di nas lo bzhi pa lcags byi (1720)lor rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho gdan drangs/pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho bod nas zhe hor du rgyan drangs/ zhe hor du/ lha khang ljang gu zhes pa bsam yas la dpe blangs nas bzhengs pa dang / po ta la'i pho brang zhig kyang bzhengs nas/der bzhugs su bcug sog yul nas grwa ba stong gnyis tsam bsdus nas mtshan nyid kyang btsugs/ sog po rnams kyis khong la zhe hor tā la'i bla ma zer zhing / chin gong mas mkhan po ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes/zhes zhu ba 'dra/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa me rta lo'i rnam thar du/mkhan po ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho sku gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus byung ba la dgongs rdzogs kyi dge ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo bar mdzad/ ces pa de/ zhe hor du bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang de nyid yin na/dgung lo zhe gcig pa'i skabs su gshegs pa 'dra'o/ / zhes cha har dge bshes kyi gsung bde legs 'byung gnas las gsungs/zhe hor(྾’swo)la deng sang khrin te (rsāṣṭha) zer gyin 'dug der bkra shis lhun po dang /bde mchog lha khang sogs lha khang mang po 'dug bde legs 'byung gnas las rje ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho ni/ rgyal bo lha bzang gis rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i drung du gsung brtag zhus nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ ces zer ba sogs kyi gtam rgyun yod/ de bden na ye shes rgya mtsho de nyid rgyal dbang rin po che'i sprul ba gcig gam/ ji ltar sgrul ba yin pa ngos bzung mdzad pas dgos pa chen po yod par nges shing / rje de nyid rgyun gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba/ gang zag khyad par can zhig yin zhing / tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring por bro ba yin/ zhes de dus kyi zhabs phyi ba sogs nas thos pa'i gtam yod par 'dug go 'di la zhe hor tā la'i bla ma zhes phyogs 'dir grags shing / 'di bzhugs pa'i lha khang ljang gu zhes pa deng sang yang zhe hor na yod do zhes gsungs/ da 545 da

tshangs dbyangs pa rgya khrid skabs su la mo tshangs pa'i sku rten gyis/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i sprul sku min par gsungs pa dang / sprul sku gzhan zhig yod ces lung bstan pa red zer srol yod/ lung bstan de yongs rdzogs ma mthong la/ mgo'i cug rkang gnyis mthong ba ni/ phyi mun nang du ye shes sgron me 'bar/ /nga ni gong ma dbyer med 'dun pa byed/ /ces 'dug de ni phyi mun nag ste mi dkyus ma'i nang du/ ye shes rgya mtsho bzhugs yod pa/ gong ma lnga ba chen mo dang dbyer med yin/ zhes pa e yin snyam pa dang / de rjes da lta gzhung gi gnas su yod pa las/ lha dang mkha' 'gros btsal kyang rnyed par dka'/ zhes gsungs pa de/ da lta gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi gnas 'bras srungs su yod pa las sbas pa'i tshul grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs su yod stabs sus kyang mi shes/ zhes pa'i don du go ba yin snyam/rgyal po lha bzang ba'i lo bcu gnyis yas mas la dbang bsgyur/ se ra'i tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo gsar bzhengs dang byams sku chen mo bzhengs/ 'du khang rnying ba'i nang du 'dam du yod pa'i gu thi bstan 'dzin gyi ur ge grwa tshang spos te sngags pa'i grwa tshang btsugs/ blon 'khor gtso bo ni da'i ching pa thur bsod nams mgon po/ drung yig pa pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas/ 'bum thang ba sogs shin tu mang /rgyal po 'di'i dus/ hor spra nag khag bzhi'i 'brog rigs rnams kyis/ bod gzhung la lo dus kyi dpya khral ma phul bar brten/ drung chen pho lha dang / lha rtse skyid spug pa dpung bcas song nas mtha' bskor te/ lo thang 'bul rgyu dus las mi yol bar bya rgyu byas/ tha'i ji la rta bzang lnga bcu tham pa'i chad pa bcad/ de tsam las cung gar gyi btsan 'dzul yong ba'i bar du nang 'khrug byung ba'i lo rgyus mthong rgyu mi 'dug go/lha bzang ba dang / cung gar tshe dbang rab brtan ni sngar mthun yang / phyis mi mthun pa'i rkyen ni 'ga' zhig gis/ de'i skabs cung gar dang / man chen gong ma gnyis kyis dmag 'khrug yang yang byed pa'i skabs yin la/ lha bzang nas chin la ngo rgol gyi shed ma thon pas/ sngon la dbus gtsang blangs te/de nas mtsho sngon phyogs nas chin gong ma la dpung 'jug byed bsam pa red zer/ la las zer ba ni/lha bzang gi bu che ba dga' ldan bstan 'dzin cung gar gyi dmag 'gro skabs sgam gyi nang du byad 'khor bcug pa dang / rim 'gro ba'i tshurme du byad ma kha shas kyang mngags pa tshor nas dmag btang ba red zer/gang ltar rgya nag tu khang shi nga drug pa me bya (1717)lo'i zla bdun pa'i nang cung gar dmag 'dam du 'byor/ zla 8 tshes 29 nyin/ bod dmag gis cung gar gyi dmag sgar thog dpung 'jug byas kyang /nyams nyes chen po byung / de nas cung gar bas bod kyi dmag dang dmangs mi rnams la/ nged cag bod la dmag rgyag par yong ba min/ bod kyi spyi don dang / rgyal dbang gi sku don la yong ba yin sogs mgo skor gyi gtam sna tshogs lab pas/ bod 'bangs rnams phar rgol byed pa'i shugs nyams te/ de nas cung gar gyi dmag lha sa'i phyogs su bskyod nas/ bod kyi sa srung rnams kyis 'gog ma thub par/ ra mo che'ishaṃ gabye 4kās tram̐ sa'i nang du 'dzul/ lha bzang gi sras chung ba sur ya g.yog gnyis bcas mtsho sngon

phyogs su bros bcug lha bzang 'khor nyung shas bcas pho brang po ta la'i nang du 'dzul nas sgo gdan/zla 11 tshes 1 nyin lha bzang dang blo bzang chos 'phel dpon g.yog gnyis/ rtse zhol gzhung sgo nas bud de rta bzhon nas cung gar ba'i dmag sgar thog brgyugs nas cung gar ba kha shas bsad/ kha shas rmas pa'i mthar dmag mang bos bskor te dpon g.yog gnyis ka bsad/ / de rjes pad dkar 'dzin pa khri las phab po/ de ltar rgyal po lha bzang bas lo ngo bcu gnyis la bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur to/ /rab nyi me bya (1717)lo'i zla 11 tshes 16nyin gdugs dkar ja'i sang gis dmag brgya skor khrid de/po ta lar song nas rnam rgyal grwa tshang gtor/ tshes 22 nyin rdor brag dang / smin gling gi zhal ngo rnams dang / spyal bo lha bzang ba'i dus kyi mi drag rnams btson du bcug zla de'i tshes 24 nyin/ tshe ring don 'aspub/ gdugs dkar chos 'phel te/ ja'i sang gsum gyis/ bla brang steng du dbus satsang gi bla dpon bsdus te/ rnying lugs gtan nas gyed mi chog rnying ma'i sku gsung thugs rten rnams 'dor dgos/ zhes bsgrags/ de nub smin gling lo chen dang / blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gdung sras 'gyur med rgya mtsho sogs rnying ma'i bla chen khag gcig skyid chu'i 'gram du khrid de bkrongs/ de nas yang smin gling gdung sras gzhon pa dang / phyag mdzod zhabs drung legs grub/ gzhung 'bas gtso che ba/dngos gzhi ba/ pad ma tshe ring / rgyal rtse lcang lo can/ chang khyim pa/ gnyam nang lcags ra sbug pa sogs mang po bsad/ rdo rje brag smin grol gling / chu shur thar ba gling / gsang sngags byang chub gling sogs rnying dgon rnams bshigs so/ /de dus cung gar gyi dpon rnams kyis gros thog nas stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan bod kyi srid 'dzin dpon du bskos/ pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas yang lha bzang gi gser yig pa (drung yig)yin stabs/ 'bras srungs su gab yod pa shes nas bzung / srog chad gcod nye skabs/ sde srid stag rtse ba dang / sog po cung gar pa 'bras spungs sgo mang mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs gnyis kyis ngo chen zhus te btson grol btang / de ltar cung gar gyis me bya (1717)lo'i zla 11 pa nas bzung /lcags byi (1720)lo'i lo mjug bar du lo ngo gsum tsam la dbus gtsang yongs rdzogs bzung na yang mdo smad du shugs ma slebs 'dug go/(7)rgyal dbang sku zeng bdun pa skal bzangasgyu mtsho/rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho ni khams li thang byams pa gling gi zhol gyi grong sde'i nang du sa byi— — (1708)lo'i zla 7 tshes 19 nyin sku bltams/ gnas chung chos skyong sku rten gyis tshangs dbyangs pa'i sprul skur ngos bzung / shing rta (1714)lo dgung grangs bdun thog sde dge rdzong gsar dang lcang ra dgon sogs su phebs skabs sde dpon bstan pa tshe ring gis kyang sne len gzab rgyas zhus/ de rjes mtsho sngon gyi ching wang ba thur tha'i ji dang / dpon ching wang 'ju dang / blo bzang bstan skyong rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos 'phel sogs kyis thos te gdan zhu'i mi sna btang ste/ shing rta (1714)lor der ching wang — 547 —

dga' ldan er te ni 'ju nang gi ager gdan drangs/ 'ju nang gis 'bad brtson gyis chin gong mar zhus pa sogs la brten/ chin gong mas kyang mi sna mngags te/ sog bod kyi dpon chen rnams kyis sku 'bum du gdan drangs/sa phag (1719)lor gong ma khang shi'i rgyal sras bcu bzhi ba sku 'bum du yang srid skal bzang rgya mcho'i mdun du bcar ba dang / bstan 'dzin ching wang dang / dga' ldan 'ju nang gi gtsor byas dpon rnams kyis sku 'bum nas yang srid rin po che dbus phyogs su gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i gros 'cham byung nas gong mar zhus te gong mas kyang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sprul sku yin par khas blangs/ sku zeng drug pa yin pa'i 'ja' sa dang / gser gyi glegs bu tham ga bcas bstsal ba sogs rnam thar du gsal/de nas lcags byi (1720)lo'i zla 4 tshes 22 nyin rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho ston 'khor rnamasabod sog rgya gsum gyi dpon dmag gtos chen po bcas sku 'bum nas chibs kha bsgyur/ de skabs yo rod cung gar phyogs su/ o rod dang chin gong ma'i dmag gis dmag 'khrug byed pa dang / mdo snad nas rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho bod sog rgya gsum gyi dmag 'bor chen bcas byon gyin yod pa sogs 'ur sgra dbus phyogs su khyab pas dbus dpon kha shas kyis cung gar ngo log byas pa sogs la brten/ cung gar gyi dmag rnams 'dug ma bzod par rang yul du bros so/ /lcags byi (1720)lo'i zla 9 tshes 15 nyin rgyal dbang ston 'khor bcas lha ldan du 'byor te/ pho brang po ta la'i sku gong ma dag gi khrir 'bas sor 'khod/ dga' ston rgya chen po byas so/ /de nas bod phyogs nas/ nga phod pa dang / lum pa ba gnyis/ man chen gong ma'i phyogs nas/da'i si cang jun/ gung tse dbang nor bu gnyis/ sog po'i phyogs nas/ don 'grub wang / bstan 'dzin wang / e sbos pa'i mi gsum bcas mi bdun gyi zhib dpyod lhan tshogs shig btsugs nas zla ba kha shas ring chab srid bskyangs/ sde srid stag rtse ba sogs cung gar phyogs gastogs la zhib rtsad byas/mthar sde srid stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan dang / gung blon bkra shis/ a chos sogs mang po zhig skyid / sbya /ga/ sa rgyab tu khrid nas srog chad bcad/ stag rtse'i sras dang / lcam/ sras chung ba bcas rgya yul lcags glang( 1721)lo'i lo sar skabs/ stod sgar dpon khang chen nas bsod nams rgyal bor/da'i ching pā thur gyi cho lo byin/ thab rten du ('tsho rten)yar 'brog gling gi 'dzin dbang bstsal/ bod spya sog gsum gyi mi bdun mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs phyir bsdus/ da'i ching pā thur khang chen nas la/srid rogs blon lta bur pe se nga phod pa/ lum pa ba/ sbyar ra ba/ pho lha ba bcas mi lnga lhan 'brel gyi srid gzhung btsugs/ bod ljongs su dbang bsgyur/ po ta la'i zhol du de dus btsugs pa'i rdo ring yod/man chin gong ma'i sku tshab la da'i si cang jun dang / tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung lta bur cang jun tshe dbang nor bu/da daṭwāṃ~X ༵zhi stong bcas lha sar bzhag ste/ phebs skyel du bcar ba'i rgya sog gi dpon rigs 'khor

bcas phyir log pa red/de'i skabs su mdzad sgo dga' ston sogs la rgya mi'i dpon rig dang / bod kyi dpon rigs rnams mdun gral dang / sog po'i dpon rigs rnams rgyab gral du ba'ag pa blor ma bab pa dang / sde srid stag rtse bar srog chad gcod rgyu zhus kyang / don smin ma byung ba dang / sngar bod du gu thi han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud cig bod kyi rgyal bor bsko ba'i srol yod mod/ de skabs rgyun srol de med par byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ sog po'i dpon rigs nang tshogs kyis mtsho sngon du phyir log rjes rgya mir ngo rgol byed rgyu zhes gser gdung chen mo'i mdun du bro bor dam bcas/rab nyi chu yos (1723)lo nas mtsho sngon bstan 'dzin wang sogs kyis man chen gong mar ngo rgol byed pa'i 'khrug zing bslangs pa dang / lha sar sdod pa'i spya dmag mi ser thog za rngam che ba sogs kyis mi ser rnams gyis kyang mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur yang yang bstan pa'i stabs/ shing 'brug (1724)lo chin gong ma yung krin khri lo dang por lha sdod am ban dang rgya dmag tshang ma phyir mthen byas/ matso sngon phyogs mdo smad byang rgyud du/ bod sog gis chin gong ma la ngo rgol byed pa'i zing 'khrug chen po langs/ rgya dpon 'ga' gsod rmas dang / rgya mkhar kha shas gtor bshigs sogs ngo rgol mi chung ba tsam byung /der brten rgya dmag chu rdol ba bzhin byung ste/ bod sog gi mi 'bum phrag mang po bsad/ mi sde khri phrag mang bo brlags/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i bla ma sku zhabs chu bzang rin po che sogs bla chen mang po gson sreg byas/ 'dan ma grub chen sogs bla grwa mang bo 'ig gi dbu me tog bzhin du bcad/ dgon lung gser khog 'ju lag sogs mdo smad byang rgyud kyi dgon pa phal cher gtor sreg byas/ 'di dag ni lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dang / dgon lung dkar chags gdan rabs sogs rnam thar lo rgyus mang por gsal/ 'di'i skabs thu'u bkan chos kyi rgya mtsho pe cin du rgyal khab kyi dbu blar bzhugs yo da pa dang/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje pe cin du gdan drangs yod stabs/ khong rnam gnyis gyis thabs mkhas kyis zhu ba dang / mdzad sgo gang gzab gnang ba'i bka' drin las/ dgon sde rnams rim gyis 'tsholas thub pa byung / bstan 'dzin wang od rod cung gang du bros pa slar 'ongs nas mgo btags/ gong ma'i mdzod nas dgon khag nyams gso byed pa'i rgyu nor gnang / bod sog byings nas kyang 'bad brtson byas te/ sa bya'i lo nas dgon sde rnams slar chags pa'i mgo tshugs thub pa byung 'dug go/de rjes dbus kyi bod srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin da'i ching pā thur khang chen nas dang / pho lha ba gnyis phyogs gcig tu chad/ nga phod pa/ lum pa ba/ sbyar ra ba ste nga lum sbyar gsum phyogs gcig tu chad nas/ phyogs ris dang / phyogs 'then byas te/ srid 'khyol ba'i lugs ngan khyab brdal du gyur/pho lha bas nga lum sbyar gsum gyis spyod ngan zhig byed 'ong snyam ste/ khang chen nas la srog byol du songan legs tshul bshad kyang snang rtog mi gtong bar bsdad/ pho lha rang nas lcam la nad byung par khag ba'ag nas dgongs zhus kyis gtsang phyogs su song ste rgyal rtser bsdad/ nga lum sbyar gsum dzees ༵༵9 chen nas

dang / pho lha ba gnyis 'khor nye du dang bcas pa gsod rgyu'i gros byas te/ me lug (1727)lo'i zla 6tshes 13nyin lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi gzim chung khams gsum nang du khang chen nas dang / nga lum sbyar gsum tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs/ yol ba'i phag tu gshed ma sbas yod pa des glo bur du khang nas pa'i lha nas 'jus shing nga lum sbyar gsum gyis gri byung ste lag rub kyis bsad/ sgo na yod pa'i khang nas pa'i srung dmag rnams gzhan gsum gyi dmag gis lag rub kyis bsad/ de'i phyi nyin gshed ma btang ste khang nas lcam gnyis ka bsad/ yang gshed ma btang ste/ nag chu mkhan po dang / ja'i sang gnyis ka bsad/ de nas gshed ma bkra shis dpal rab sogs pho lha ba 'khor bcas gsod par gtsang du btang yang / pho lha bar bya shor ste/ sras gnyis dang 'khor kha shas bcas gtsang stod du song ste/ mda' dpon lcang lo can dang / bsam 'grub gling ba gnyis la yi ge btang ste/ da'i chang pā thur khang nas pa'i dgra sha len phyin dbus phyogs su dmag bskyod dgos pa'i bka' bskul btang / de bzhin spo rong gi dpon a jo dang / mnga' ris kyi sgar dpon dga' bzhi ba sogs bskul te pho lha rang gi dmag bcas gtsang dmag 'bor chen gyis/ me lug (1727)lo'i zla 7 tshes 17 nyin dbus phyogs su dmag bskyod byas/ dbus phyogs nas nga lum sbyar gsum gyis dbus dmag stong phrag kha shas khrid gtong gis gtsang dmag la rgol 'gog byed du gtsang phyogs su lhags/ de'i tshe gtsang ngam ring gi dpon dzi nu ma pas ’ nga lum sbyar gsum la gsang yig bskur ba pho lha ba'i lag tu 'byor/ de ma thag dmag mngags nas ngam ring nas kho bzung ste/ rkang lag dang lus thams cad thag pas bcings nas/ g.yang gzar ngos nas bab la bsgril te bsad/ de nas 'brong rtse dang 'bras khud rgyud du gtsang dbus kyi dmag gis g.yul 'gyed thengs kha shas byas kyang rgyal pham cher ma byung / dbus dmag gis gtsang gi mi ser dang dgon sde 'ga' la 'phrog bcom gyis gyong rgud chen po byung zer/ slar yang lo de'i zla 10 ba nas gtsang dbus kyi dmag 'khrugs te phan tshun gsod rmas chen po byung / de skabs rgyal dbang rin po ches kyang bde 'jags kyi don gsung bka' nan mo bskur ba dang paṇa tshen rin po che'i mgron gnyer sa khud pa dang / sa skya bdag tshen rin po che'i mgron gnyer ngag dbang sogs kyis re zhig dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig bzhag ste/phan tshun gyis dmag mi bzung ba rnams glod bkrol btang / sa sprel ( 1728)lor slar yang gtsang dmag dbus phyogs bskyod de 'phan yul brgyud/ lum pa ba dpung bcas la 'thab bzhin dmag bskyod byas pas nga lum sbyar gsum gyi dmag pham ste/ po ta la'i nang du 'dzul nas rgyal dbang la skyabs zhus/pho lha ba dpung bcas/ sa sprel (1728)lo'i zla 7 tshes 26 nyin lha sar 'byor te dbus gtsang gi bdag por gyur/ rgyal dbang sogs bla ma rnams kyi ngo chen zhus par brten/ re zhig gung blon nga lum sbyar gsum rang shag tu srung dmag bzhag nas 'dug bcug pho lha bas man chen gong ma la zhu yig phul te/don gcod kyi ra mdar bos/ de rjes man chen gong ma'i mi sna a li khan am ban dang / me ring dzam gi sog dmaspu 'bum phrag gcig dang bcas dbus su 'byor/ nga lum sbyar gsum khong gtogs bcas btson — 550 —

du bcug nyin gcig mi drag zhan brgya phrag mang po 'chogs pa'i dbus su/ nga lum sbyar gsum/skyor lung bla ma/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gnyer ba/ nga lum sbyar gsum gyi gnyen nye du bu phrug sogs mi grangs bcu dgu dmar gsod byas/ bud med phu gu kha shas rgya yul du rgyang 'bud btang ngo / /me tā rin dang / seng tā rin zer ba'i am ban gnyis dmag stong gnyis dang bcas pa bsdad/gzhan rnams gyir log rgyal dbang bskal bzang spya mtsho'i mdzad spyod bka' gdams gong ma nang bzhin gnang bas mi dmangs mtho dman skya ser tshang mas dad gus lhur blangs stabs/ pho lha ba phrag dog 'phar te/ rgyal dbang rin po cher/ lo rjes mar man chen gong ma mjal 'phrad kyi don du khams la song zhes bka' phab/ sa sprel (1728)lo'i zla 11 tshes 23 nyin mdo khams su chibs bsgyur gnang /sa bya (1729)lo'i zla 2 tshes 8nyin sla thang du 'byor/ lcags sprel (1730)lo'i zla 1 tshes 21 nyin spyal rong mgar thar phyogs su chib bsgyur te/ mgar thar du dgon pa btab/ lo ngo mthong bdun tsam la mgar thar du bzhugs/ de'i ring la'ang khri ngag dbang mchog ldan yongs 'dzin du bsten nas slob gnyer dang mdo sngags kyi gsan pa rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas bod dbus su lha ldan du phebs rgyu gtan khel te man chen gong ma'i rgyal sras bcu bdun pa dang / lcang skya rin po che rol ba'i rdo rje dpon g.yog phebs rdzong du phebs/ rgyal sras kyis spyal dbang la chos zhu rjes phyir log ho thog thu lcang skya rong ba'i rdo rjes phebs skyel zhus te/ shing yos (1735)lo'i zla 3tshes 21nyin mdo khams phyogs kyi dpon dmag skya ser rgya chen pos phebs skyel zhus te dbus phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang / zla 7 tshes 11 nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang du zhabs sor 'khod de/ mi dbang pho lha bas snar thang bka' 'gyur dpar brkos pa'i dpar phud kyi gtso byas pa'i 'bul chen btegs/chu phag(1743)lor yo nod cung gar gyi dpon dga' ldan tshe ring dbang bos mi sna sum brgya skor yong ste rgyal dbang rin po cher 'bul chen dang dbus gtsang gi rten khag la mchod 'bul byas/shing byi (1744)lor sde dge'i dpon gyis bka' 'gyur dpar brkos pa'i dpar phud 'bul mkhan gyi mi sna 'byor ba la bsngags brjod dang / gsol ras 'bor chen bstsal/shing byi (1744)lo der chin gong ma chan lung gis/ yang hwa gung du mtshan nyid grwa tshang / rgyud pa grwa tshang / rig gnas grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs par bla ma las sne bcas brdzong bda' mdzad/lcags bya (1741)lo nas 'go btsugs te lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas kyi shing dpar phud/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos (1747)lo'i zla 2 tshes 2 nyin sde srid pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas gnya' bar gnyan 'bur byung ba ma sos par tshe las 'das/ de ltar mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs spyas kyis lo ngo mthong nyi shu tsam la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho la rgya sog bod gsum sogs kyis dad 'dun che zhing gus 'dud lhur blangs par sde srid pho lha ba bsod namaṭwāṃ 5rdobs rgyas

phrag dog rgyas nas dngos su log sgrub mang du byas pa dang / lkog nas rgyal dbang dang lcang skya rnam gnyis la mthu byad byas pa'i lo rgyus yang snang ngo / (lcang skya'i rnam thar du'ang gsal)pho lha ba sras gnyis yod/che ba gung 'gyur med tshe brtan mnga' ris kyi spyi dpon du bskos/ chung ba 'gyur med rnam rgyal la da la'i da'i ching pā thur gyi cho lo dang bcas bod kyi rgyal bor bskos/da'i ching pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis lo bzhi tsam la srid dbang bzung / kho'i spun che ba mnga' ris gung 'gyur med tshe brtan dang ma mthun par mnga' ris phyogs su dmag drangs/ mnga' ris kyi mi drag zhan mang po bsun gtser gyis dus mi bde bar byas/ dga' ldan khri ba nam mkha' bzang la drag po'i las sbyor mdzad de mnga' ris gung bsgral dgos zhus kyang / khong gis dga' ldan khri bas mi gsod mi thub gsung pas kho ma dga' bar/ khri las phab ste rgyud pa dri med gser khrir bskos/ mthar mnga' ris gung lha sar bka' mol gnang ba yong skabs mi mngags te lam nas zhog gsod byas/ lcags rta (1750)lor/ smon lam chen mo'i skabs kho'i gcen mnga' ris gung gi dge rtsa yin zer nas rgyal dbang rin po che tshogs dbur gdan 'dren zhus nas bsngo smon zhu ba sogs byas/ gzhan yang mdo mkhar zhabs drung la/khyed dang dpon slob byams pa rin po che sogs kyis mnga' ris gung spru dmag bskul byed kyin 'dugaces pa sogs gzhi med gling 'gel gyis 'dri gcod byas/ dbus gtsang gi dpung chen bskul nas byang phyogs kyi ri dwags yod dgu bsad/ gzhon nu pho mo rnams bsdus te glu len bro gar gyis dus 'da' bar byas pa sogs la brten nas drag zhan kun kyi yid sun par byas/ de'i skabs mdo mkhar zhabs drung gi chibs rta la mda' brgyab par ma zad/ 'khor gzhon nu zhig kyang don med du mda' brgyab ste bsad/sa sbrul (1749)lor paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan ye shes/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mdun du bsnyen rdzogs zhu bar pebs te/ zla 4 tshes 15nyin jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar bsnyen par rdzogs/yab sras gnyis ka'i thugs bzhed la gzhan yang bka' chos mang tsam gnang zhu'i re ba yod kyang / srid skyong 'gyur med rnam rgyal 'dis g.yo thabs kyis bdun phrag gsum tsam las bzhugs ma bcug par phyir phebs dgos byung /sa 'brug (1748)lor srid skyong 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis/ bod du yod pa'i rgya dmag rnams kyis bod mi ser la brnyas gtse dang rgyu nor za rngam che bas/ man chen gyi dpon dmag gcig kyang med par phyi 'then byed dgos zhes lha sdod kyi rgya dpon gnyis la yang yang zhus par brten/ gong ma chan lung gis bod sdod am ban gyi sku srung lta bur dmag brgya tsam las 'phro ma tshang ma phyir 'then byed rgyu dang / am ban ngo g.yog dang / dmag 'phro ma bcas kyis/ bod mi ser la 'phrog bcom dang / brtabs bsig mi 'byung ched phog thob dgos mkho 'dang nges gnang rgyu yin tshul khas len byas/lcags rta (17bya0)lor da la'i pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis slar yang / chin gong ma la bod sdodad mam zlopy-i2 gnyis dang dmag 'phro ma gcig kyang ma lus par phyir 'then dgos zhes/ yi ge phul 'dug

zer/ gzhan yang cung gar mthun lam byed pa'i mi sna gtong yong byas pa'i gnas tshul am ban sogs kyis shes te/ bod nang gi mi drag du ma zhig srid skyong la mi dga' ba sogs kyi rkyen las/ am ban gnyis kyis g.yo thabs kyis da la'i pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal g.yog gnyis bcas bsad/ 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi mgron gnyer blo bzang bkra shis sogs kyis dmag khrid de 'ongs nas/ am banaganyis sogs rgya mi mthong tshad bsad/ tha na tshong ba/ za khang / sprang po sogs rgya mi mi grangs pho mo nyis brgya bzhi bcu lhag pho brang po ta lar skyabs zhur song ba dag la rgyal dbang dngos su phebs te srog skyob zhus par ma zad/ bka' shog kyang sbyar 'on kyang bka' shog kyang gtad/ yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan phebs te srog skyob zhus kyang bka' brtsi rgyu phar zad/ blo bzang bkra zhis sogs kyis khri rin po che la tshig ngan mang du brjod de/ po ta la'i ra ba'i nang du 'dzul ba'i rgya mi thams cad bsad de/ po ta la'i ra ba khrag gis dmar bor byas 'dug ces rnam thar lo rgyus kha shas su 'dug go /de rjes gong ma chan lung gis/ dga' bzhi rdo ring gung paṇa ṭi ta mgon po dngos grub rab brtan zer ba der gnas skabs su 'gan khur dgos shing / blo bzang bkra shis sogs gte bo shor mi chog ces bka' bab/ mgron gnyer blo bzang bkra shis sogs cung gar phyogs su bros 'gro rgyu byed skabs/ gung paṇa ṭi tas de dag gang du smrebs kyang 'dzin dgos zer ba'i bka' bsgrags pa ltar/ 'dzin bzung byas te/ blo bzang bkra shis/ dpal grong shar ba/ srang skug pa sogs mi mang po zhig la lha ldan lcang lo can gyi sgo ra'i nang du srog bcad/ da la'i pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi sras dar spyas tshe ring dang / lcam chen chun sogs rgyang 'phud btang ngo / / mi ring bar chin gong mas mngags pa'i a li am ban dang /tsong thung tshe gung ye rnam rgyal am ban/ srung dmag lnga brgya dang bcas 'byor ro/ /de nas gong ma'i bka' lung dang rgya bod gros mthun gyis lcags lug (1751)lor rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshor bod kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha tshang ma phul/ 'di'i sngon rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus nas bzung / rgyal bo sde srid logs su yod pas de dag gis srid basbyang / rgyal dbang rin po ches gtso cher chos kyi bya ba mdzad/ srid la dbang ba'i rgyal bo 'gyur med rnam spyal gyi bar du yod mod/ 'di nas bzung ste rgyal dbang nar ma son pa'i bar du rgyal bo'am srid skyong bsko bzhag dang / rgyal dbang nar son zhing slob gnyer mthar phyin rjes srid dbang rgyal ba rin po che la 'bul rgyu'i srol de dar bar snang /de nas bka' blon bzhis btsugs pa'i bka' shag btsugs/ bka' blon bzhi ni/ gung paṇa ṭi ta/snado/ mkhar zhabs drung / thon pa sri chod tshe brtan/ ser mo ba mgron gnyer dar han rnams bsko bzhag de nas bzung bod gzhung bka' shag gis srid don mtha' dag gi bkod 'doms mdzad de dga' ldan pho brang ba'i chab srid sra brtan byas/ spyal dbang rin po che la bod sog gi drag zhan ches mang bo dad 'dun shin tu che stabs/ de nas bzung bod kyi srid dbang 'asbog ris kyis khyod gsod nga gsod kyi nang ge 553 dngha

dme re zhig mtshams chad nge/ mi ser byings bde 'jags sos dal ngang gnas thub pa byung ngo / / 'ji dag gi skor rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar sogs su shin tu gsal/ /chu sprel (1752)lor paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dbus su phebs nas/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las bka' lung dbang khrid bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/shing khyi (1754)lo'i zla ba 2 pa'i nang rtse slob grwa btsugs te slob dpon tshag sgur ba bskal bzang 'phrin las bsko ba'ag mdzad/ rtse zhol du sku rten bris 'bur bzhengs pa'i bzo grwa gsar 'dzugs mdzad/de ltar chos srid gnyis kyi cha nas 'gran zla bral ba'i mdzad pa 'od dkar gyis nor 'dzin sgeg mo dkar chab tu btang /me glang (1757)lo'i zla gnyis par dgung lo lnga bcu'i thog sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /khong gis sku tshe gang bor sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du bzung nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ dge sbyong gi chos bzhi dang du blangs nas/ srid skyong snga rjes kyis snyad 'dog gi 'o brgyal ci snyed cig byung rung / chags sdang mgo snyom mdzad/ khyim mtshes kyi rgyal khag dag la drang snyoms drang 'brel gyi mthun lam 'dzad/ mnga' 'bangs rnams kyang bu bzhin bskyangs stabs/ nang 'khrug sde gzar dang / spyal khag bar gyi 'khrug zing gang yang ma byung bas/ bu rta nor gsum brlag ma dgos shing dmangs byings kyis bde 'jags ngang 'tshe ba brgal thub pa byung ngo / khongs 'das ma thag bka' blon rnams dang / sku bcar khag gdan sa gsum gyi slob dpon/ drung yig ser skya sogs gros bsdur byas te/ gcig mthun sbyi mos ltar/ de mo sprul sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshor no mo han gyi cho lo dang bcas rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ bla sprul khongs nas rgyal tshab tu bzhugs mkhan thog ma khong yin zhes gsungs/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho la/ chin gong ma'i bka' shog dang /gser gyi glegs bur spyal dbang drug pa zhes bkod yod mod/ bod yongs grags la/ drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho/ bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ zhes 'dren par byed do/ /(ra) rgyal dbang brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mcho/lcags sbrul (1761)lo'i zla 1 nang thob rgyal lha ri sgang du sku 'khrungs/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis/ gtsug phud bzhes te blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mcho zhes mtshan gsol/ chu rta (1762)lo'i zla 7 tshes 9 nyin pho brang po ta la'i gser khrir zhabs sor 'khod/shing sprel (1764)lor lha sa dbang ldan dpal 'bar du 'brug pa'i slob gnyer ba'i don du dmigs bsal slob grwa btsugs/ bla ma chos rdzong ba dang / rab shag dge rgan gnyis dge rgan du bskos/shāsbyasdu rngo/ rnams slob gnyer ma thon bar du zur chas rgyun gtong dang / sdod gnas bcas kyi sku drin /me ṭwāṃṭwāṃ 4(1767)lor mchod gzhis/ mi chen gzhis ka'i lam lugs/ phyi yong mi sna la sne len

byed lugs/ lam yig ster lugs sogs gsar ba gtan la phab/gong ma chan lung gis zhe ho ( za)ru po ta la dang / bkra shis lhun po zhes pa'i chos sde gsar rgyag gnang ba'i mkhan po dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa kha shas gtong dgos zhes zhus pa ltar/ sgo mang dge bshes srad rgyud mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer/ sgo mang mdung nag zhabs drung ngag dbang chos grags/ blo gling blo bzang chos grags/ dbu mdzad rgyud smad dge slong ngag dbang rin chen dang / dge slong ngag dbang skal ldan bcas brdzong bda' mdzad/lcags yos (1771)lor sngar rgya dang o rod 'khrug skabs/ bros byol gyis u ru su'i sa mtshams su bsdad pa'i cung gar ba rnams rang yul du yong chog pa dang gong ma'i rgya dmag gis gnod pa mi byed pa'i don la spyal dbang mchog gis bka' drin yang dag pa bstsal/rgyal tshab de mo no mo han ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshos chab srid kyi thugs 'gan lo nyi shu rtsa gcig la gnang ste/ me bya (1777)lo'i zla 1 tshes 23 nyin bstan rgyas gling du sku gshegs/ de 'phral bka' shag sogs mi drag rnams dang / gdan sa'i mkhan slob sogs ser skya spyi mgrin gcig gis/rgyal dbang rin po che dgung lo nyi shu bzhes yod gshis/ chab srid kyi 'gan bzhes dgos zhes zhus na'ang /khong gis gsan bsam gyi 'phro skyong dgos gsungs nas zhal gyis ma bzhes/ de nas rgyud stod mkhan zur tsha rdor ngag dbang tshul khrims rgya nag tu chos spel bzhin bzhugs yod pa la gong mas no mo han gyi mtshan gnas gnang ba dang 'brel gdan 'dren zhus te srid skyong rgyal bor bskos/ khong gi 'khrungs yul ni a mdo co nee red/ dbus slob gnyer byed du phyin nas se ra smad du grwa sar zhugs/ bzhugs gnas tsha rdor khang tshan yin 'dug slob gnyer bgyis te slar rgyu stod du phebs/ bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes mkhan po mdzad/ rjes su pe cin la slob dpon du gzhung gis mngags/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje dang thugs nang mthun pa la brten/ gong ma chan lung gis kyang gzigs pa che/ me bya (1777)lo'i zla 7tshes 5 nyin lha sar phebs skabs lha sa'i mi dmangs khri phrag mang bo ltad mor 'dus nas sngar gyi rgyud pa'i dge bshes grwa rkyang zhig glo bur du bod srid skyong du phebs 'dug ces ha las nas blta bar yong ba red zer/rjes su dga' ldan khri bar yang phebs/ khong gis srid 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi blon po ni/ gung paṇa ṭi ta/gung kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ thon pa sri zhi dbang 'dus/ mdo mkhar bsod nams dbang rgyal sogs red ces 'dugs phag (1779)lor chan lung gis zhe hor bkra shis lhun po bzhengs ba'i rab gnas dang / gong ma rang nyid dgung lo bdun bcur phebs pa'i dga' ston dang 'brel chos rgya che ba zhu rgyu'i don du/ paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan ye shes pe cin du gdan 'dren ltar chibs bsgyur kanang /de nas rim gyis sku 'bum du phebs nas zla ba bzhi dang / zhas nyi dhe tham pa bzhugs te lcags byi (1780)lo'i zla 3 tshes 10nyin sku 'bum nas chibs bsgyur/ de skab 5 'jam dbyangs ༵kād sprul ma

ha paṇa ṭi ta dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo'i phyag mdzod chen mo sogs zhabs gras lha 'brum gyis ma thar ba sum brgya skor 'brum sman btab pas lam slong chen po byung / de nas pe cin du gong ma chan lung dang mjal 'phrad gnang / tshes 22nyin zhe hor bkra shis lhun por pebs/ rab gnas mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin zhe hor bkra shis lhun po nas pe cin du chibs bsgyur/ tshes nyer bdun nyin gong ma chan lung la mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' ci rigs gnang / lcags byi (1780)lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin nyi rgas tsam la gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su jim/ lcags glang (1781)lo'i zla 2tshes 23nyin sku gdung gdan 'dren zhus te sku 'khor rnams pe cin nas chas te/ zla 8 tshes 20 nyin gdan sa bkra shis lhun por 'byor to/ /sa ngan ri kha zhi ba zhes sde dpon bcas nas rkun jag tshod med byas te/ mjal ba dang 'grul ba'i lam thon dka' ba byung stabs/ gung paṇa ṭi ta dang / mda' dpon lcang lo can sogs kyis bod dmag gtos che ba drangs nas lcags byi (1780)lo'i zla 9 nang sa ngan rdzong 'bur mo me bsregs/ jag gtso sde rong a tshogs dang / ru shod rta rgod byams pa pha bu sogs nyes can rnams sa gnas de gar srog chad khrag sbyor dang gzhan mang po zhig spyang 'gud btang /lo der hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku thugs rtags bcad/ lcags glang (1781)lo'i zla 6tshes 1 nyin rgyal dbang mchog gis gsan bsam 'grub par brten chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes/ de'i phyi lor skyid grong bsam gtan gling nas mkhas shing spub pa'i dbang phyug dka' chen yi shes rgyal mtshan yongs 'dzin du gdan 'dren zhus nas rgyun du rtse pho brang chen mor bzhugs nas bka' chos na ma chad par gnang / pe cin nas rgyal dbang rin po cher gser gyi glegs bu bcu bdun thog yig rigs dīṭwāṃ zloṭwāṃtrī tram̐ //ja' sa 'bul mi 'byor/ shing 'asgeg (1784)lor nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gsar tsha rdor no mi han zhes bod kyi rgyal po grags pa can 'di ni lo ngo bcur bod kyi rgyal srid skyong bar bzhugs shing / khong ni chos srid gnyis char mkhyen rgya che la rgya bod kyi dpon rigs non zil che zhing mi ser la shin tu byams pa sogs kyi dbang gis mtho dman kun gyis brtsi mthong che/ 'di ba'i ring la tshong las sogs dpal 'byor dar rgyas che zhing / dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'ang ha cang bzang ba dang / sde gzer 'khrug zing sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang mi snang / de skabs pe cin du lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje sku gshegs stabs/pe cin chos kyi slob grwa'i dbu 'dzin dang rgya nag gi nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i dgon pa yongs la bka' slob kyi ched du rgya nag pe cen du gdan drangs pa ltar/ me rta (1786)lo'i zla 5tshes 28la lha sa nas btegs te pe cin du phebs/ gong mas sa ma ti pakṣi zhes pa'i go gnas gnang te pe cin du bzhugs/bod du rta tshag rje drung bstan pa'i mgon po la no mo han gyi cho lo dang bcas rgyal bor bskos 'dug go/—me sbyabye 6(1 87)lo'i zla 6 pa'i nang zhwa dmar ba sku zeng bcu ba chos 'grub rgya mtsho'i g.yog po karma

mchog sbyin zer bas lam khrid byas te glo bur du bal bo gor ṣa'i dmag gis btsan 'dzul byaspote gnya' nang / rong shar/ skyid grong ste rdzong gsum blangs/ rim gyis sa dga' sogs kyang blangs/ bod dmag gis mu mthud nas 'gog rgol byas/ rgya nag nas kyang dpon dmag 'bor chen 'byor yang 'gog rgol ma byas par chings brgyab/ chings don rdzong gsum tshur blu rin la rgya dngul rdo tshad sum brgya thams pa 'phral du sprad na rdzong gsum 'khregs bzung mi byed par bod la rtsis sprod byed byas te chings bar du rgya dpon rnams bsdad nas/ btsan shed kyis chings yig cig bod kyi mgo thog la bzhag blu rin kha shas srud nas gor dmag rnams phyir log lo gsum gyi ring gor dmag gis 'dzog bcom byas pa'i mi dmangs la skyob gso byas/ skyid grong bsam gtan gling gor dmag gis bcom ste dge 'dun pa phal che ba lha sar phebs yod stabs/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dgongs ltar lcags khyi (1790)lor lha sa'i skyid chu'i lho phyogs tshe mchog gling gi dgon pa btab/bod du stod phyogs gor dmag gis bcom pa dang / dbus gtsang mdo khams sogs kyi rgya dmag gi 'gro lam gyi mi ser rnams 'thor ba dang / lhag par bod gzhung gi chab srid dpal 'byor gang thad nas nyams rgud byung stabs/ rgyal dbang mchog dang bka' shag sogs nas gros bsdur byas te/ slar yang tsha rdor no mi han ngag dbang tshul khrims pe cin nas gdan drangs te/ lcags khyi (1790)lo'i zla 10tshes 9 nyin lha ldan du pebs te slar yang bod kyi rgyal bor bzhugs/ rta tshag no mi han bstan pa 'i mgon po pe cin chos slob dbu 'dzin du phebs rgyu byas/ lcags phag (1791)lo'i zla 6 tshes 22 nyin gnya' nang zhes sar gor dmag gis g.yo thabs kyis/ bod kyi mi sna gor ṣar gros mol du song ba rnams mtha' skor/ zhabs pad rdo ring ba bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor dang / zhabs pad g.yu thog pa bkra shis don 'thub gnyis dang / mda' dpon lcang lo can bcas gson 'dzin byas/ shod drung sgo mkhar ba sogs mi sna dang zhabs gras sum cu so lnga bsad/ bcu skor rmas/ gor dmag yang brgya lhag bsad/ gor dmag gis zhabs pad gnyis bal yul du khrid/ gor dmag gcig dang stong brgyad lhag gis bod yul du btsan 'dzul byas te/ bkra shis lhun po gzhis rtse yan chad du slobs te 'phrog bcom chod med byas/chu byi (1792)lo bod gzhung dngul lor gsar bzo byas te gtong 'grem dang 'brel 'gro rgyug dgos pa sogs kyi rtsa tshig sbyar/ lo 'dir chin gong mas nang blon gnyis dang / rgya dang a mdo rgyal mo rong gi dmag sogs khri gnyis btang ba bal yul phyogs su song nas bod dmag dang zla bsgril/ yang man ju dang rgya'i dmag khri gcig 'ongs nas shis da7ra du yod pa'i bod dmag dang zla bsgril nas gor dmag la 'thab 'dzing byas pas/ gor dmag gis pham kha chen po khur/ de nas rgya bod gyio dmag rnams bal bo'i sa thog tu smrebs 'dug bal bo'i sa thog tu rgya bod kyi dmag rnams sa gzhir ma skor bhā 'byor/ gor ṣa'i spyal bos gnas spos/ bla ma zhwa dmar bas rang gnong gis dug gso la te shi geded zer/chu byi (1792)lo'i zla 6 tshes 27 nyin bka' blon gnyis tshur bamakha ba dang mnyam du gor ṣa'i sku — 557 —

tshab rnams 'ongs te mgo btags/ chings yig bzhag go 'di dag ni rdo ring paṇa ṭi ta'i rang rnam sogs su ches gsal bas zhib cha ma bris/ de nas rim gyis bod rgya'i dmag 'then nas/ chu glang (1793)lo'i zla 3 tshes 25 la rgya dmag rnams phyir log rgyal mo rong gi dmag mi la la yongs lhadzi/ na/ ye shis rgyal mtshan sogs mjal zhing bka' slob nos pas rang yul du ma log par bod du bsdad shing stag (1794)lor rgyal sprul rta tshag no mo han nas kun bde gling btab/lcags bya (1801)lor paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dbus su 'ebs nas/ lha ldan jo bo rin po che'i mdun nas/ rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtshos mkhan po mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ chu phag (1803)lor hal ha rje btsun dam pa sprul sku bsnyen par rdzogs/ sheng khyi (1804)lo'i zla 10tshes 18nyin rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sku 'das so/ /(9)rgyal dbang dgu bablo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug lungartogs mtsho/sku nyid mdo stod khams ldan chos 'khor dgon gyi nye 'gram du/ yab bstan 'dzin chos skyong dang /yum don 'grub sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing glang (1805)lo'i zla 12 tshes 1nyin 'khrungs/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi mas rgyal ba'i sprul skur thugs brtag bcad/rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa 'brug (1808)lo'i zla 9 tshes 21 nyin pho brang po ta lar zhabs sor 'khod/ tshes 22 nyin sku gong ma'i khrir 'khod/ mdzad sgo rgyas sbos byas/ lo 'dir mgo log khang gsar dang khang rgan gnyis kyis gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang ba'i bka' ma brtsis par/ zhib daphyod du zhabs pad bshad sgra don 'aspub rdo rje dang / las bya phogs dpon yi shes rgya mche sogs kyis dmag khrid de dbus dmag thog sde dge chu shar nub nas yul dmag mi nyung ba bcas kyis mgo log tu dpung 'jug byas/ dmag 'khrug rgya chen po byed ma dgos par/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi bka' brtsi bkur byed rgyu khas len dam bca' byas/ byed gte 'ga' zhig yul 'phud btang / mtsho sngon phyogs su 'ga' zhig gis rku jag byas stabs/ mdo stod smad gnyis kar bde 'jag gi don du sgar dpon re bzhag go/lcags rta (1810)lo'i zla 12tshes 3 nyin bod kyi srid skyong rta tshag ho thog thu bstan pa'i mgon po sku gshegs/ lcags lug (1811)lo'i zla 4 tshes 11 nyin de mo sprul sku no mi han thub bstan 'jigs med srid skyong gi khrir 'khod/sdom pagā trī shā/1812)lo'i zla 9 tshes 22nyin paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi mas rgyal dbang mchog la rab byung gi shing khyi (1814)lor bal bo'i gor ṣa dang dbyin ji gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug byung /zhing phag (1815)lo'i zla 2 tshes 15nyin rgyal dbang lung rtogs rgya mcho nyid dgung grangs bcu tsam gyi thog ma/ḍi8 cham bzhes te sku mya ngan las 'das so/ /

(1༷)rgyal dbang sku zing bcu ba tshulatsāmasasgyu mtsho/rgyal dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni me byi (1816)lo'i zla 3 tshes 29 nyin li thang du 'khrungs/ sa yos (1819)lo'i zla 3tshes 3nyin srid skyong de mo rin po che dag zhing dgongs/ tshe sgron gling tsha rdor rgyal thog gnyis pa sa ma ti pakṣi ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims srid skyong gi go sar gdan drangs/chu rta (1822)lo'i zla 1 tshes 15 nyin paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs kyis gsor bum daspug khul gyis rgyal dbang rin bo che thugs brtag bcad/ de 'phral zla 1 tshes 18nyin paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i nyi mas rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po che'i gtsug phud bzhes te/ ngag dbang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ zla 2 tshes 13 nyin rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/lo de'i zla 3 tshes 18 nyin pho brang po ta la'i gser khrir 'khod/ nyin nyi shu'i ring rgyal khab phyi nang gi dpon po rten 'bul ba che dgu mang 'dzom thog dga' ston chen po byas/chu lug (1823)lor rma khams dang / sa ngan gyi gyod don du bka' blon bshad sgra don 'aspub rdo rje sogs phebs/ shing sprel (1824)lor rgyal mo rong lha steng dgon nyams gso dang 'brel/ gzhi gsum gyi nyams len gsar 'dzugs dang mkhan po ser smad slob zur 'jam dbyangs dam chos dang / grwa ba bco lnga bcas brdzong bda' mdzad/ lcags yos (1831)dang chu 'brug (1832)lo gnyis su maḥ sngon phyogs su dgra jag tshod med byed stabs zhib gcod byed mkhan dang 'brel dmag btang yang dmag 'khrug byed ma dgos/ de rjes spo bo phyogs su yang dmag bskyod byas 'dugachu sbrul (1833)lor rtse pho brang gi 'khrungs rabs lha khang du paṇa chen rin po che'i mdun nas rgyal dbang mchog gis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me mo bya (1837)lo'i zla 9tshes 1nyin rgyal dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dgung grangs nyer gnyis thog sku gshegs so/ /(11)rgyal dbangasku phreng bcu garig pamakhas grub rgya mcho/tā la'i bla ma rgyal dbang sku 'azeng bcu gcig pa ni/ shar rgyal mo rong gi mgar thar phyogs man chod kun brtsegs gshis tshang la/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa khyi (1838)lo'i zla 9 tshes 1 nyin sku bltams/lcags glang (1841)lo'i zla 6tshes 4nyin gung thang bde ba can du kun gzigs thams cad mkhyen pa paṇa chen blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gis gtsugs phud bzhes te mkhas grub rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/chu stag (1842)lo'i zla 4 tshes 14 nyin pho brang chen po po ta la'i gser khrir zhabs sor 'khod/ zla ba drug ring rten 'bul zhus/ lo 'dir mdo stod hor khog gling tshang / ru dam/ sde dge sogs su sa 'gul chen po byung ste mi phyugs nor gsum la gyong rgud chen po byung / bod gzhung nas sku tshab mngags te skyob gso dang / 'bul dngul gyi rogs ram rgya che ba gnang 'dugal dwags ni bod yin mod/ lo bcu phrag tsam gyi sngon nas kasmir gyi mnga' 'og tu shor 'dugalcags glang (1841)lo bod dang la dwags kyi tshong lam bcad nas/ la dwags dang / sig (sing ba)— 559 —

gi dmag gis mnga' ris su btsan 'dzul byas stabs/ bod dmag la dwags phyogs su bskyod nas g.yul 'gyed mang po byas/ kasmir gyi dmag dpon chen po dzo ra wa sing bsad/ la dwags sa cha rgya che ba blangs mod/ chu stag (1842)lor kasmir gyi ma hwa ratshu sgug lab sing gis dmag stong phrag brgyad khrid de 'ongs nas gtug 'thab byas pas bod pham/ de thes bka' mol gyis chings yig bzhag ste/ la dwags kyi bod dmag gyi 'then byas/ mda' dpon bshad sgra dbang phyugs rgyal bo la byas rjes su bka' blon go gnas bstsal ba sogs/ dmag 'khrug skabs kyi dpa' spyol rnams kyis bya dga' thob/chu yos (1843)lo'i zla 7 nang bod kyi srid skyong tshe smon gling ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims rgya mtsho bod kyi rgyal bo byas lo nyi shu lon yang khri nas phab/ tshe smon bla brang la sgo thel brgyab/ srid skyong zur ba khong chos rwa'i nang du bzhugs bcug phyag mdzod dza sag ltag sgo rab bsal du btson 'jug byas te/tsha 'dri btang ba dang / nyin gcig zhabs pad rnams tshe gling chos rwar yi gi sogs la zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs skabs/ ser snad grwa shar mang bo 'ongs nas/ zur khang ba dang / spyi khang lcags grong bar brdung degs byas gshis bka' shag 'tshogs ma thub pa dang / srid zur tsha rdor tshe smon gling ba de se rar khrid nas mkhregs bzung byas pa sogs kyi rkyen las zing cha langs yang / sbyin bdag khag nas bar 'bud 'grig thabs kyis zhi 'jags tsam byung 'dug tshe smon gling khri las phab pa'i zla phyi ma'i nang paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i nyi ma gdan drangs te/ srid skyong gi 'gan bzhes na'ang / zla ba dgu tsam nas dgongs zhus gnang ste bkra shis lhun por phyir phebs/ shing sbrul (1845)lor rwa sgrong ho thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan srid skyong gi go sar bzhagame rta (1846)lo'i zla 4 tshes 7 nyin paṇa chen rin po che gdan zhus kyis rgyal dbang mchog gi dge rdokā // sdom pa bzhes/ sa smrel (1848)lor nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gi gzim chung gsar rgyag chu byi (1852)lor paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dgung grangs bdun cu'i thog thun mong gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus/shing yos (1855)lo'i zla 1 tshes 13 nyin rgyal dbang rin po che mkhas grub rgya mtshos gsan sbyang / trīshā ṭīn/ stabs rgyal srid kyi las 'gan bzhes/ srid skyong rwa sgrong ho thog thu dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgrong de lor gor dmag gis gnya' nang / skyid grong / rdzong dga'/ rong shar/ spu hreng sogs 'phrog bcom byas/ dbus mda' dpon rang byon rdo rje don 'grub/ gtsang mda' dpon dpung bcas song nas rgol na'ang g.yul ngo bzlog ma thub 'dug de nas zhabs pad dpal lhan 'khor bcas/ sde dge dim chu nyer lnga/ ri chab dpa' gsum gyi sa khur/ zhabs pad bkra shis khang gsar 'khor bcamu / 5dī~X'ad/ li thang / spyal rong / rgyal thang / lcags la/ bee ri sogs su dmag bskul byas

te/ bkra shis khang gsar lha sar 'byor nyin dpung 'jug gi spyi khyab par bsko bzhag byas/me 'brug (1856)lo'i zla 2 tshes 12 nyin bal bo'i rgyal sa nas bod dang bal bo'i bar gyi gi ba'i chings yig la gros 'cham byung nas gor ṣi'i dmag rnams kyang dus bcad kyis phyir slog byas mod/chings yig de ni gor rgyal la rgyal kha thob 'dug pa zhig red zer/(12)rgyal dbang sku zeng bcu gnyas pa 'azin las mtsho/spyal dbang bcu gnyis pa 'azin las rgya mtsho ni/ 'ol dga' phyogs su me 'brug (18bya6)lo'i zla 12 tshes 1 nyin 'khrungs/ sa rta (1858)lor thugs brtag bcad/ lo de'i zla 1 tshes 15 nyin srid skyong rwa sgrong ho thog thu rin po ches gtsug phud bzhes te/ blo bzang bstan pa'i spyal mtshan 'azin las rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ sku gong ma'i khrir mnga' gsol/lo 'di'i yas mas su 'bras krongs la dbyin jis dmag gis btsan 'dzul byas byung / 'bras / rshakā rsha trīkā kāṭwāṃnā ṭwāṃ sdodī trī/sbyi /ma/ rgyal la rim bzhi'i go gnas dang / 'tsho rten gsol ras su gzhis srid skyong rwa sgrong ho thog thu dang / bka' blon bshad sgra gnyis nang ma mthun par/ zhabs pad bshad sgra go gnas thams cad las phab nas/ gnas dbyung byas te/ snye mo smon mkhar gyi bshad sgra'i sger gzhis bya sgor zer sar tshul mthun byas te sdod dgos byung / bshad sgra snye mor 'dug ring / bal yul gyi srid blon 'jang sba thur rwatna'i 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge zhig 'byor ba srid skyong gi rna bar son stabs/rwa sgrong srid skyong gis bka' shag gros thog nas/ mda' dpon thon ba dmag mi dang bcas la bshad sgra phyir ldog rgyu med par gyis ces pa'i bka' yig dang bcas mngags/ mda' dpon thon pa ba snye mo smon mkhar du 'byor te/ bshad sgra'i khang bar mtshan mor dmag gis bskor/ mda' dpon nang 'dzul tshe/bshad sgra skug dngangs med par sngon gyi byas rjes dang nag med tshul sogs thabs mkhas kyis bshad par brten/ mda' dpon thon pa bar kun rtog sna tshogs shig shar te gsod ma nus par/ snye mo rgyal byed dgon pa'i khang chung zhig tu sku bzhar btson gzugs byas te btson du bcug su dang yang thug 'phrad byed mi chog par byas te do dam pa bzhag de rjes lo gcig tsam gyi rjes su bshad sgra'i mched mchog dga' ldan gyi grwa ba kha shas kyis bshad sgra snye mor btson khang lta bur yod pa shes te/ dga' ldan shar rtse'i mkhan po'i phyag mdzod dpal ldan don 'grub zer ba blo stobs che gshis dga' ldan nang gi gnad yod tshang ma 'brel ba byas te/ srid skyong rwa sgrong la ngo log byed rgyu byas/ de skabs rwa sgrong gis 'bras spungs rig grwa'i mchod phog dngul bsgyur te/ phran bu chag pa'i rkyen las/ 'bras spungs dang srid skyong rwa sgrong bar la 'khon gzhi byung / 'brasaspungs pa'i rgyab tu dga' ldan langs nas srid skyong la ngo rgol byas stabs/chu khyi (1862)lo smon lam chen mo dang tshogs mchod kyang dus thog tu tshugs ma thub par phyis zla ba dgu bar btsugs/ dga' 'bras kyi grwa shar btab ste snye mo nas bshad sgra lha sar gdan dranga~X/1 nga ga'

'bras drung spyi zer ba zhig btsugs/ de ni dga' ldan/ 'bras spungs/ rtse shod drung 'khor bcas yod pa'i tshogs 'du zhig la zer/ de nas nyin shas nas srid skyong gi phyogs la ser byas grwa tshang gcig bu las med par gyur 'dug srid skyong rwa sgring phyogs gtogs kha shas bcas tham ga bsnams te se ra la bros kyang der yang 'dug ma bzod par rgya nag tu bros byol du song /de ma thag dga' 'bras drung spyi'i gtso byas nas zhus te/ chu khyi (1862)lo'i zla 3 tshes 12 nyin rgyal dbang phrin las rgya mtsho dgung grangs bdun las ma lon kyang / rgyal srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i tshul dang / nang don bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal bo sde srid du bsko bzhag byas/ bshad sgra rten skya bo grong ba yin yang skra bzhar ba'i grwa gzugs byas na legs zhes btsun chas smras zhes bshad 'dug ste/ chab srid 'di'i don la ci byed 'di byed med chod red/rwa sgrong 'khor bcas rgya nag pe cin du phebs nas gtug bsher byas/ gong ma'i gzi chings ltar phyir 'khor te rwa sgrong du bzhugs chog par byas nas phyir phebs lam zi ling nas sku 'das so/ rwa sgring gi phyogs zhabs pad bkra shis gsar khang dang 'khrungs gzhis dngos grub lding gi gzhis ka rnams kyang gzhung bzhes byas nas mthar 'bras spungs blo gsal gling grwa tshang gi mchod gzhis byas/bshad sgrar srid skyong gi go gnas thob ste/ phu lung ba la zhabs pad kyi go gnas/ mkhan chen blo bzang dpal ldan la spyi mkhan dar han gyi go gnas byin pa dang / dga' ldan shar rtse mkhan po'i phyag mdzod dpal ldan don 'grub la gzhung gi zhabs sdod kyi thog bla phyag mkhan chung gi go gnas bstsal zhing //sna ṭwāṃbye sdu /trī dro/ra dpal ldan don 'grub la bka' blon dang sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po sogs byas dbang dus skabs 'di'i lo kha shas sngon nas/ mdo stod ri nang dpal mgon gyi bu rgyud mgon po rnam spyal dang / mgon po tshe brtan pha bu gnyis kyis/ nyag rong sde drug hor ma zu/ brag 'go khang gsar/dre hor/ stong skor/ be ri/ gling tshang sogs btsan shed kyis dbang du bsdus par ma zad/ sde dgelcags la/ dge bzhes tsa/ khro skyabs/ li thang / 'ba'/ mgar thar sogs la btsan 'phrog mang bo byas rkyen/ brag 'go dpon dbang chen dgra 'dul dang / dpon mo nor bu/ ja'i sang bla 'khos kyis gtsos dud khyim brgya skor dang / khang ga dngos grub phun tshogs/ ma zur gnyer ba zhu gu bkra shis sogs dud khyim sum brgya skor rang yul du 'dug ma thub par bod gzhung la skyabs zhur song / sde gzhung gis sde ba mi ser de rnams chu shur/ gong dkar/ stod lung khul du skyob gso dang bcas 'jog par mdzad/ slar phring nyag dmag gis/ 'ba'/ li thang / phyag 'phreng / rdza khog mi nyag rgyal thang khul la'ang bcom 'phrog byas par ma zad/ bod gzhung gi mdo sgar dpon khongs rtse'i ja dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mang ja'i mthun rkyen mdzod ja sogs tshang ma 'phrog bcom byas te/ rgya bod tshong lam bkag pa sogatram̐ kyi ṭwāṃ~X zhu gcig mjug gnyis mthud du phul bar ma zad/ nyag dmag sde dger 'byor nas dgon

chen bzung / sde dge'i gzhis ka rnams la dbang bsgyur/ sde dge rgyal bee yab sras bcas dang /kaḥthog dpon sprul sogs btson du bcug pa sogs byas stabs/ bod sde gzhung gis dmag dpon khyi khyab zhabs pad phu lung ba tshe ring rdo rje bsko bzhag byas te/ dbus mda' dpon khri smon pa 'chi med rdo rje dang / dbus mda' dpon mdo mkhar ba tshe dbang nor bu dmag dpung bcas dang / phogs dpon 'khor bcas sogs chu phag (1863)lo'i zla 2 tshes 9 nyin lha ldan nas chas/ lam bar nas sho srar lho gsum/ ri chab dpa' gsum sogs nas yul dmag 'gug bzhin maspyogs shad kyis zla 9 ba'i nang nyag rong la dpung 'jug byas/ rmar khams dang / brag g.yab nas dang blangs yul dmag gi 'go 'dzin gdong kram sprul sku ngo ma dmag thog tu phebs pa dang / kong sprul yon tan rgya matso sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang rim 'gro rgya chen po gnang / mda' dpon khri smon ba'i dpung gis rdo rdzong / bya rgod rdzong / nyag chu rdzong sogs rim par blangs te/ shing glang (1865)lo'i zla bdun pa'i nang nas ri nang rdzong la mtha' skor gyis zla ba baspyad pa'i tshes gcig mgon po rnam rgyal pha bu/tsha rigs sum cu skor dang / blon po drag gras bzhi bcu skor bcas khang ba me 'bar ba'i nang du gson sreg byung ste/ lhag ma rnams kyis mgo btags so/ /shing byi (1864)lo'i zla 4tshes 13 nyin yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri zur blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi drung las rgyal dbang mchog gis rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ bka' blon bshad sgras lo gsum ring chab srid kyi 'gan bzung nas/ lo 'di'i zla 8 tshes 28 nyin 'das/ zla 9 tshes 29 nyin yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri zur sde drug blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug bod rgyal gyi khrir phebs so/ /de nas zhabs pad phu lung ba nyag rdong du phebs nas/ phogs dpon phun rab pa tshe ring dpal ldan la'i tha'i ji'i go gnas dang bcas dar mdo yan nyag khog dang bcas pa'i spyi khyab par bskos/ khams khul gyi nyag dmag gis gnod skyon byung rigs la ngo yod phyir slog dang / gyong tshab byin/ dpon gyi go gnas sogs kyang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus ltar sor bzhag byas thog bcad khra gsar ba'ang bkod/me yos (1867)lor pe cin nas chin gong mas nyag rong dmag don thag chod par bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i spang leb shing byang chen po phul/ sa 'brug (1868)lor dpal ldan don 'thub la sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po'i go gnas thob/ skabs der srid 'dzin sde drug blo bzang mkhyen rab thugs gshis 'jam pas/ spyi khyab dpal ldan don grub dang / dga' 'bras drung sbyi'i dbang shed kyis gzhung sa'i zhabs 'bring dang 'bangs la brdab gsigs chen po byung yod zer/dpal ldan don 'aspub zer ba ni khams rmi li nas yin zhing / dbus su grwa sar yong nas dga' ldan shar rtse grwa tshang du tshogs zhugs byas/ khang tshan rdo khang dang / mi tshan mi li mi tshan khongs red zer/smon lam skabs shig bshad sgrar bka' 'gyur dang / sgrol ma 'bum ther tshugs skabs ja ma byed du yong nas bshad sgra dang 'brel ba byung / skabs shig rgyud stod du zhugs te rgyud stod chos thog gnyer ba lo — 563 —

gsum tsam byas/ de rjes dga' ldan shar rtse mkhan po'i phyag mdzod du bskos/ bka' blon zur ba bshad sgra snye mo rgyal byed tshal btson du bcug skabs srid skyong rwa sgrong la ngo log gi las 'gul shugs chen brtsams te bshad sgra bskyar log gi las ka'i gtso bo kho red zer/ bar skabs shig la dga' ldan sbyag mdzod sna bo che zhes grags pa che zheng dbang shugs che bar gyur/ sngar kho rang gi phyogs gtogs yin pa'i zhabs pad phu lung ba de yang / khams phyogs nas nag yig 'ga' 'byor ba'i stabs kyis red kyang zer/kho'i gong du shor dogs pa red kyang zer/ gang ltar srar rdzong rdzong dpon la bka' shog phab nas chur bskyur te bsad/dga' ldan phyag mdzod sna bo che dpal ldan don 'grub kyis dga' ldan dang 'bras spungs kyi mi chen dag kho'i rgyab la yod snyam nas bod ljongs yongs la dbang bsgyur rgyu'i ham sems skyes te/ rgyal dbang rin po che pha bong kha lta bu'i ri khrod cig la gsol phogs dang bcas 'jog rgyu gyed rtsis dang / srid skyong sde drug blo bzang mkhyen rab gyi srid skyong gi go gnas bshol thabs kyi bya ba byas/ zhabs pad gsar byung bskal bzang dgra 'dul dang mtsho sgo ba mig dmar tshe ring / bshad sgra tshe ring dbang phyug byum pa rnam rgyal rdo rje bcas kyang dpal don gyis zil gyis mnan yod/ nyin gcig mtshe sgo bas srid skyong sde drug tshang la dogs zon byed dgos tshul zhus pa/ srid skyong phyag mdzod kyis dpal don la bshad de bya shor nas/dpal don gyis mtsho sgo ba la dogs pa zos pa dang / byum pa la yang dogs pa zos nas de gnyis med par byed snyam pa skyes/ lcags lug (1871)lo'i zla 1 pa'i zla mjug tu nyin gcig rtser tshogs 'du zhig gi skabs khyi khyab mkhan po dpal don gyis srid skyong sde drug tshang gis chab srid kyi las don la nus pa mi thon pas/ dgongs zhu gnang dgos zhes/ nga tshos bskul ma btang na ji 'dra zhes bsam 'char dris par/mtsho sgo bas nga ni srid skyong gi phyag las la skyon brjod zhu rgyu med ces bshad/ nyin shas kyi rjes su g.yo thabs kyis mtsho sgo ba gshed ma la sgrud nas lkog gsod byas/ rjes sor zhog gsod byas pa ha go nas/srid skyong sde drug tshang gi bkod 'doms 'og dpal ldan don 'grub kyi phyogs gtogs kyi sku drag mi drag rnams btson du bcug dpal ldan don 'grub bcon du 'jug grab skabs bya shor nas dga' ldan phyogs su bros te/ rang yul du 'bros grab byas kyang / dga' ldan gyi mi chen dag gis/ dga' ldan du drangs nas srung skyob byas mod/ sde gzhung bka' shag gis lha sar yod pa'i dmag dngos bzhi btang ste dga' ldan mtha' bskor nyin shas la dmag 'thab byas mthar/ dpal don dang kho'i spun mgron gnyer mgon po gnyis khang steng nas lcebs te bros pa dmag gis ded pas/ mthar thabs zad nas dpal don gyis mgron gnyer mgon po la nga gsod rogs zer ba ltar bsad/ mgron gnyer mgon po'i rkang ba la me mda' phog nas dmag gis bzung ste/ dpal don gyi ro dang / mgron gnyer mgon po khyer nas lha sar khrom skor byas/ dga' ldan dgon par yang dmag 'khrug gis gtor bshig dang nyes skyon mi nyung ba phogabashahūṃ sgra ṭwāṃ 6dīng dbang phyug gnas dbyung byas pa dang / nyes can gzhan dag la 'os bab kyis thag gcod

shārdzu /ra 'dug de'i phyi lo chu sprel (1872)lo'i zla 9 tshes 18 nyin srid skyong sde drug tshang sku gshegs chu bya (1873)lo'i zla 2 tshes 14 la rgyal dbang rin po ches bod rdzongs chab srid kyi las 'gan bzhes na yang / lo ngo gnyis tsam las ma 'gor bar/ shing phag (1875)lo'i zla 3 tshes 20 nyin dgung grangs bco brgyad thog mdzad pa'i mtha' ma bstan no/ /de nas kun bde gling rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan lugs gnyis chab srid kyi khrir 'khod do/ /(12)rgyal dbang sku zeng bcu gsum pa thubabastanasku ma /rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho ni/ snang rdzong 'og glang mdun zhes pa'i yul du yab kun dga' rin chen dang / yum blo bzang sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su me byi (1876)lo'i zla 5 tshes 5la sku 'khrungs/ da stod mkhan zur blo bzang dar rgyas mchog grwa ba dang bcas lha mo bla mtshor gzigs su phebs par/ mtsho nang nas rgyal dbang 'khrungs sa'i yul phyogs/ 'khrungs khang sogs shin tu gsal bar shar ba dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che/ rgyal tshab rta tshag rin po che/ gnas chung rdo rje grags ldan/ dga' gdong gnas srung chen po/ la mo tshangs ba/ bsam yas tse'u dmar bo sogs bla ma dang lha srung tshang ma zhal mthun par rgyal ba'i yang srid du thag bcad/ me glang (1877)lo'i zla 11tshes 1 nyin gung thang bde ba can du gdan drangs/ sa yos (1879)lo'i zla 6 tshes 13 nyin pho brang chen swā ṭwāṃr ta/ la'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol/ tshes 15 nas spyi sger so sos legs 'bul sa yos (1879)lor dbyin ji'i lta zhib pa 'beeng 'gol gyi mi rigs sa ra can dhar dha se zhes pa dang / de dang mnyam du 'bras ljongs bla ma o rgyan spya mtsho bkra this lhun por 'byor ba/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i phyag mdzod seng chen sprul sku sogs kyis sne len byas/ bod gzhung gis dogs pa zos te 'dzin bzung gyed rgyu byas kyang bros byol gyis rgya gar du log de la 'brel 'dres yod zer nas seng chen sprul sku sogs la nyes chad bcad/ de'i stabs dang sku drag 'ga' zhig gi byed las la brten nas/ bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang gi zhabs 'bring ba rnams dang bod gzhung gi bar sel zhugs/chu rta (1882)lo'i zla 6 tshes 16 nyin paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i dbang phyug sku mya ngan las 'das/ me khyi (1886)lo'i zla 4 tshes 8nyin srid skyong rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu srid skyong lo bcu gnyis pa'i thog sku 'das/ bstan rgyas gling bde mo ho thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas srid khrir phebs/ lo 'di'i zla 10 tshes 14 phyi dror 'bras spungs 'jigs byed rang byon gyis me bzhes/ gsar bzhengs mdzad rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ lo 'di'i yas mas nas dbyin ji'i bod la btsan 'dzul gyi 'go tshugs/sa byi (1888)lor kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dade/ leṭwāṃṭwāṃ5 rnam rgyal

dpal bzang po thugs brtags gtan khel byung nas rgyal dbang mchog la gtsug phud phul/kong bo zho kha khul du dngul lor bzo grwa btsugs nas/ lcags stag (1890)lor ṭam dkar bco lnga nyer bzhi dpar ba dang / de'i phyi lor bco lnga nyer lnga 'khod pa'i dngul lon gsar ba dpar 'debs ṭwāṃ dzākā/masachu/ 'brug (1892)lor smon lam chen mor dngul phud sku 'gyed gnang ste/ de nas yongs khyab shing rta (1894)lor rtse skor nas zhabs pad ser skya mang nyung 'dra mtshungs dgos tshul snyan zhu la zhib dpyad gnang ste/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dus bzhin du bka' blon skya bo gsum dang ser mo gcig bsko bzhag gnang rgyu dang / de yang gzhung don la lhag bsam byas rjes can la gzegs bstod dmigs bsal can ma gtogs gzhan yig rtsis sogs kyi yon tan dang / nyams myongs mi gshis dang 'byon stangs/ kun spyod legs shing spyi mos drang tshugs che ba sogs la bskun te bsko bzhag byed rgyu las/sngar lugs bzhin khang pha gzhis rgyud 'dzin lam 'jags gnang rgyu med pa'i rgyas dpyad dngos gtsang gnang ste/ las 'dzin mtho dman bsko bzhag gsar ba gnang / gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos dge 'dun rnams kyi 'dul khrims tshul bzhin dgos tshul las sne rnams la bka' bsgyur dang / chos sde so sor dpyad khra sogs bstsal/shing lug (1895)lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs rgyal dbang mchog gis yongs 'dzin phur rtsog rin po che'i sku drung las dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/shing lug (1895)lo'i zla 8 tshes 8 la lugs gnyis chab srid kyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ chab srid kyi las 'gan bzhes pa'i thog mar/ rtsa tshig don tshan lnga ba zhig bstsal/ don tshan dang po gtsug lag khang rnams mi nyams gong 'phel dang / nyams gso byed dgos skor/ gnyis pa/ dge 'dun gyi 'dul khrims dang / khyim pa rnams kyis pha ma dang gla g.yog rgan khog rigs la bsnyen bkur dang / rta khal sogs tshad las brgal ba ljid 'gel byed mi chog pa sogs/ gsum pa/ phyi nang zhi drag gi gzhung zhabs rnams kyi byed sgo'i skor/ bzhi ba/ lam thog rdzong gi rta khal mi gsum gtong phyogs la byams yangs gang che'i rgyas bsdus bstsal ba dang / lnga ba/ sa stong bed med rnams la gsar sbol dang / shing 'dzugs pa sogs dpal 'byor gong spel skor sogs so/ /de mo ho thog thus chab srid kyi las 'gan dgongs zhu gnang / khal kha u cu mu chin wang la 'ja' sa dang tham ga dang cho lo gnang / khal kha'i yul du (hal ha)srid don don gcod du sku bcar mkhan ye shes chos 'phel dang / rtse mgron bstan 'dzin chos grags/ shod drung snang dkar ba dbang phyug mthar phyin bcas bsko bzhag gis byed sgo'i lag 'dzin bcas rdzong bda' gnang / skabs 'dir nyag rong spyi khyab sa mi zhib dbyod drang min byung lugs kyi rtsod glong thog mar byung /da me ṭwāṃ~X6 ( 1896)lor la dwags me ho sprul sku bka' shog dang / tham ga rta dar sogs kyi cho lo

gnang / 'di lo nas gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling du tshes bcu'i dus ston btsugs/ khams nas gter ston bsod nams rgyal po gdan drangs/ gter bzhes sku brnyan la mjal bcar dang / gter ston rang nyid kyis gter bzhes rnams gsan bsam dang ljags bsnyen sogs gnang /nyag rong spyi khyab pa dang / lcags la dpon mi drin thu si gnyis ma mthun par/ lcags las khrin tu nas rgya dmag khrid 'ongs nas rgya bod dmag 'khrugs langs/ me bya (1897)lor nyag rong dang lcags la'i gyod gzhi thag chod/ rgya dmag 'phral du phyir 'then byas thog byed gte rnams la nyes chad drag po bcad/ de'i lo rjes mar nyag rong gyi khyab la dbus mda' dpon dza sag hor khang ba gtong bar mdzad/sa khyi (1898)lor gdan sa se 'bras dge gsum du rgyal dbang mchog gis grwa skor gnang / sa phag (1899)lor rgyal dbang mchog gis lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i grwa skor mtshan bzhes gnang /lo 'di'i zla 3 par gnas chung sku rten gyis rgyal dbang la mnan gtad yod tshul gyi lung bstsal ba dang / yang zla bya ba nang yang mnan gtad yod tshul gsungs zer/ sngar me sprel lor gnas chung gis mnan gtad yod tshul lung bstan pa ltar/ spyan g.yas gnas srung rwa mgo can gyi sku rten gyis pho brang po ta la'i phyogs bzhi nas srog chags sdig sprul gyi gzugs brnyan g.yo bsgul byed pa bton zhes zer gyin 'dug ces grags/sa khyi lor bstan gling bde mo bla brang gi gsol dpon chos 'byor gyis 'ja' lham sna ril zhig rgyal dbang la phul/ nyin gcig khong gis lham
