de gyon rtsis byas par sna khrag byung bas dogs pa skyes nas/gter ston bsod rgyal dang / gsol gzim mchod gsum sogs tshang ma yod sar lham de gtad pas/lham mthil gyi bar nas gshin rje tshe bdag gi srog sngags la sbyar ba'i gtad 'khor zhig thon song zer/spel tshig la/ me byi lo ba thub bstan rgya mtsho khug ces bris yod sogs zer/ de'i rkyen gyis srid skyong zur ba de mo ho thog thu shar chen lcog tu bkag bskyil dang / srun mched sogs zhog las khungs su bkag sdom byas te/ de mo tshang rang la 'dri gcod byas par/ kho rgyal sar 'jog dus lo chung stabs/ gzhung zhabs ser skya mi drag mang bos brnyas bcos yang yang byas stabs slar yang chab srid kyi las 'gan thob tu re nas de 'dra byed dgos byung / zhes dngos su khas blangs song zer/ gros khongs su gtogs pa tsha bo nor bu tshe ring dang / dpal chos mkhan po blo bzang don ldan/ las sbyor byed mi mi nyag sprul sku/ nyag sprul gyi dge rgan pad ma tshe ring / dpal ra'i sprul sku/ bla ma lhag bsam pa/ blo bzang chos 'byor/gsol zur bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ dpal sprul gyi bu mthu stobs bcas ngo yod rnams la tsha 'jam gyi dri ba byas pas mnan gtad byas pa ngos len gsal byung zer/ khrims thag bcad don/ de mo rgyal zur bstan gling chos rwar tshe btson lta bu byas pa dang / slar sprul sku byung rung rgyal bzur gyi go sa med pa dang /bla brang gi 'dzin dbang / de mo 'jam dpal rgyas mtsho'i skabs kyi 'dzin dbang ji yod dang / ban grwa tshang gi mchod gzhis ji yod rang 'jags las/ ga'an tshang ma gzhung bzhes dang / nor ༵ ༵7 ring dang /

dpal chos blo bzang don ldan gnyis rag rgyab btson khang du tshe btson byas/ nyag sprul gyis btson khang nang du rang srog bcad/ dpal sbrul de'i sngon tsam du 'das/ nyes can gzhan rnams la'ang nyes chad gcod pa sogs/ lha zhol du khrims thag gcod pa'i tshogs chen 'tshogs pa dang / sa gnas so sor rtsa tshig kyang sbyar ro/ / de mo ho thog thu yang bkag sdom 'og nas 'das song zer/'on kyang bstan gling bla brang gi zhabs 'bring ba kha shas dang / ban tshang grwa rigs kha shas kyis lha sdod chin gong ma'i gzhung tshab am ban brgyud nas rgya gtugs byas mod/ don smrin ma byung 'dugaphyis su chu byi (1812)lor lha sar rgya bod zing 'khrug byung skabs bstan gling bla brang gis rgya dang lag 'brel byas stabs bstan gling bla brang ming tsam med par byas par red 'dugs byi (1888)lo'i zla 2 tshes 11 nyin bod kyi sa lung thur zhes par dgra 'gog rdzong zhig yod par bod kyi mtha' srung dmag mi nyung ba zhig yod pa'i thog dbyin ji'i dmag 'bor chen zhig thon te/ bod dmag pham par byas pa ni/ bod la dbyin ji'i drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyi thog ma red/chu yos (1903)lo'i zla 12 tshes 16 nyin dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag stong phrag lnga tsam ma leb la brgyab ste gro mo rin chen sgang dang sna gdong khul du 'byor/shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla 2tshes 15nyin snga dro dbyin dmag btsan 'dzul bas dud sne dang / rgu ru'i grong gseb bar bod dmag sa srung gi mtha' bskor te bod dmag khyon che ba bsad rmas byas/ de nas nyin shas nas dbyin dmag btsan 'dzul ba rnams kyis 'tshum phreng sa'u sgang gnas rnying dgon pa bcas la dmag 'khrug rgyag bzhin sbyi zla 4 tshes 11 nyin rgyal rtser 'byor/ dud sne dang rgyal rtse'i bar du yod pa'i bod dmag phal cher bsad/ lo de'i zla 7 tshes 14 nyin dbyin dmag rgyal rtse nas sna dkar rtser 'byor/tshes 25 nyin gam pa la brgal te lcags zam spu khar 'byor/ lcags zam gru kha nas lha sar rta lam nyin phyed tsam red/ rgyal dbang rin po che de'i skabs dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lo mtshams bcad rgyu'i skabs yin kyang glo bur du phebs dgos byung stabs sku mtshams bar chad byung ste/ shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla 6 tshes 15 nyin rtse pho brang nas chibs bsgyur te rwa sgrong phyogs su phebs/ tshes 19 nyin dbyin dmag lha sar 'byor/ de'i skabs grwa ba keb kran gra'i sba'i zer ba dang / kug yung zer ba gnyis glo bur dbyin ji'i dmag sgar du 'dzul te/ btsan 'dzul dmag dpon gnyis la gri btab ste rmas skyon chen po bzos/ grwa ba de gnyis dbyin dmag gis ngan gsod byas/shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla 7 tshes 17 nyin rtse pho brang chen po'i nang bod dbyin zhi ba'i chings byisnas cig bzhag zla 8 tshes 3 nyin dbyin dmag phyir log pa'i mgo brtsams te rim gyis tshang ma phyir dbyin ji'i dmag lha sar 'byor nye'i skabs rgyal dbang rin po che rwa sgring du phebs nas bzhugs/de nas rim gyis phebs te me rta (1906)lo'i zla 8 pa'i nang sku 'bum du phebs 'byor byung / sku 'bum — 568 —

du lo gnyis bzhugs ring sku 'bas zhwa dmar rin po che/ bde yang rin po che/ mkhas dbang dpal ris rab gsal/ bka' bcu sngags rams pa bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas sogs las mdo sngags rig gnas kyi chos bka' mang du gsan/ me lug (1907)lo'i zla 11 tshes 25 nyin ri bo rtse lnga sogs su gnas gzigs ched chibs kha bsgyur/ sa sprel (1908)lo'i zla 5 bar ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs/ lo de'i zla 8 tshes 3 nyin pe cin du 'byor/ tshes 20 nyin gong ma kong shu'i dang / yum hong thi'i hu (tshi rshas tha'i hu)la mjal 'phrad gnang / zla 9 tshes 6 nyin spyal dbang 'khor bcas nan nye (lho mtsho)zhes pa'i skyed tshal pho brang du spro seng gsol ston du gdan zhus thog rtse rigs zlos gar sna tshogs pa gzigs 'bul zhus/ nyin rjes ma nas gong ma dang / gong yum (tshi this)la sger mjal kha shas dang zhi drag dpon rigs dag tshur bcar gyi bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi srid don sogs la bka' mol dang / sngar srol ltar gyi bka' shog dang / gser gyi glegs bu'i thog nub phyogs kyi snying rje tshen po'i skyes bu sangs rgyas/ zhes pa/yig rigs bzhi shan sbyar gyis bskos bris phul/ phar yang sho lo ka lnga can gyi bstod tshig phul/ 'on kyang de'i skabs chin gong ma'i chab srid nyams rul du 'gro bzhin pa mngon gsal du mthong /sa sprel (1908)lo'i zla 9 tshes 18 nyin gong ma gong shu'i 'das/ gong yum (cu shis)kyis rgyal sras tā chin cu yung gi sras phu yi gong ma bsko bzhag byas/ zla de'i tshes 20 nyin gong yum tshi shis tha'i hu yang 'das/ lo de'i zla ba bcu bar gong ma shon thong (phu yi)khrir 'khod mdzad sgo byas skabs rgyal dbang mchog kyang mdzad smor zhugs/ 'di skor la/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig dang dpon rigs 'ga' 'ig gis dbyin lugs kyi gsar brje byed dgos tshul gong ma kong shu'i la zhus par kong shu'is khas blangs par tshi shis tha'i hus ngo rgol byas te gong ma bzang btson du bcug bzi sbring kyi dug drangs te tshor dbang nyams par byas/ gsar brje'i gros 'don mkhan gyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig phyi rgyal du bros/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig dang dpon rigs 'ga' zhig bzung nas bsad pa sogs kyis gsar brje'i bya bar pham nyes byung ba sogs bris 'dugargyal dbang mchog rgya sog gi yul du lo ngo bzhi lhag la bzhugs skabs phyi spyal gyi dpon rigs mang bor thugs 'phrad bka' mol gyis srid don mi nyung ba re thag bcad pa dang / gsar brje mi byed thabs med kyi thugs dgongs shar na yang / dpon rigs 'ga' 'ig nas chos phyogs la gnod zer ba sogs kyis bkag 'gog gis thugs dgongs ji ba'in ma 'grub/sa sprel lo de'i (1908)zla 10 ba'i tshes 18nyin pe cin nas zhal bsgyur/ zla 12 tshes 23 nyin sku 'bum byams pa gling du zhabs sor 'khod/ 'di lo sde dge'i sras rgan gzhon gnyis ma mthun par 'khrug zing langs/ sras rgan pa a skya'i rgyab la kra'o ar phung langs te sde dger rgya dmag gis dpung 'jug byas/sras gzhon pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal 'khor bcas sku 'bum du rgyal dbang la srog skyobs zhu bar byon/de nas bzung sras gzhon pa gzhung sa'i 'bas 'bring khongs su bzhag 'dug da 569 da

sa bya (1909)lo'i lo gsar ba'i dga' ston dang smon lam mdzad sgo sogs sku 'bum rang nas mdzad/ zla 4 nang bya khyung sogs su gnas gzigs dang chos 'brel gnang / lo snga mar sku 'bum dgon gyi chos khrims la dag ther gnang ste las sde 'ga' re gnas dbyung byas pa sogs kyi rkyen las 'ga' zhig gis lkog tu gros byas ngo rgol byed rtsis byas na'ang zi ling gi rgya dpon bcas kyis rgyab skyor 'og zing cha cher ma byung / zla 4 tshes 18 nyin sku 'bum nas btegs/ zla 8 tshes 2 nyin nag chur 'byor/ kunaglugazigs paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma sogs phebs bsur 'byor/zla 11 tshes 9 nyin pho brang chen po po ta lar 'byor/ de skabs zi khron nas khrims srung rgya dmag 'dzugs rgyu yin zer nas/ lu'u chun rgya dmag khri phrag brgal ba mdo stod brgyud mi gsod rgyu 'azog dgon sde sogs gtor bzhin du yong ba lha sar smreb nyer yod pa'i dza drag gi ngang du gnas yod/lcags khyi (1910)lo'i zla 1 tshes 3 nyin rgya dmag gi rta dmag rnams lha sar snebs/ de'i nub mor rgyal dbang 'khor bcas bros byos mi gyed mthu med byung / rgya dmag gis ra mda' rjes 'ded byas kyang ma rin par rgya gar du skebs/ lo 'di'i dgun thog rgyal dbang rin po che 'khor bcas rgya bal gyi gnas rten khag dang / sangs rgyas sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas bal yul gyi mnga' khongs su luzi ni dang /sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan sogs su gnas mjal du phebs/lcags phag (1911)lo'i zla 9 ba nas rgya'i dpon dmag nang tshags 'khrug zing gsod res yang yang byed pa dang / rgya nag pe cin du sun krong hran gyi gsar brje byung ste shon thong khri las phab pa'i gsar 'gyur thon byung stabs ko lo'i hu'i khongs gtogs kyi rgya dmag rnams kyis man chin dpon rigs tshor ngo log brgyab/ kra'o ar phung gi las khungs lte ba chab mdor brgyab yod kyang 'dug ma bzod par khrin tur song / de'i gyi lo kho rang khrin tu nas bsad/ bod kyi sa gnas so so nas rgya dmag la rgyab rten med par shes nas ngo rgol dang dpung 'jug byas/ rgya dmag rnams kyang rgya yul du 'gro 'dod skyes te bod gzhung la lam dngul sogs dgos zer ba ltar bod gzhung gis lam gyi mi ser la bsdabs bsigs mi 'byung ched dngul srang chig 'bum brgyad khri byin/ dngul lag tu 'astsor mtshams nga rgyal skyes te 'gro rgyu phar zad bcom 'phrog byed rgyu'i gros ngan byas te/ chu byi (1912)lo'i zla 2tshes 5 nyin se rar dpung 'jug byas nas nyin gsum la gtugs kyang se rar 'dzul ma thub/ se ra'i mtha' skor gyi ri khrod dang dgon chung rnams la me btang nas bsregs/ dmag rnams se ra nas 'then te lha sar 'dzul/ rgya bod kyi dmag gi g.yul 'gyed drag po zla ngo kha shas la brgyab/ sa ga zla ba'i nang du grwa ba kha shas dang / bod dmag kha shas rtse pho brang nang du bka' shag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs yod pa'i thog tu brgyugs nas bka' blon rnams bzung /rtse zhol du khrid nas/ tsha rong ba dbang phyug rgyal bo dang / tsha rong sras/ bka' drung tsha gur zhag pa/mkhan drung phun rab pa/ bla phyag mkhan chung bsam mkhar ba/ rtse drung blo bzang rdo rje rnams la me mda' brgyab nas bsad/ bka' tshab bla ma bstan 'dzin chos grags/ bka' tshab ram pa ba/ glang gdong — 570 —

ba bcas kyang re zhig zhol las khungs su bzang btson byas nas bzhag pa red zer/ 'di dag gis rgya mi shādī /'brel ba byas pa red zer nas bsad pa dang / btson 'jug byas pa ded zer 'dug zhib cha sus dus de tsam na yon hri khe'i srid gzhung gis lha sar sdod pa'i man chin a ban lin yu 'phral du phyir log dgos pa dang / dmag dpon cung yun gyis a ban gyi las 'gan sngar ltar 'khur dgos pa sogs kyi bka' bab/ rgya dmag rnams la dmag snon dang dmag rgyags sogs med par dka' tshegs ha cang che stabs phyir log 'dod tshe ba byung / rgya'i zhi drag dpon rigs rnams kyis bod dmag la mgo sgrur/ mgo btags chings yig bzhag mthar chu byi (1912)lo'i zla 12 tshes 5 la rgya dmag yongs rdzogs 'gro dgos byung ba red/ brtan rgyas gling bla brang gis rgya dmag dang lag 'brel byas par brten/ bla brang dang ban grwa tshang bcas gtan med byas pa red/ lo 'khor gcig la dmag 'khrug brgyab stabs lha sar grong khyer sum cha gcig tsam gastor bshigs byas pa sogs skyon chen po byung /chu byi (1912)lo'i zla 12 tshes 16 nyin rgyal dbang rin po che rtse pho brang chen por phebs 'byor byung /bye spra py-i /lo /ngo gsum yas mas shig la rgya gar sogs su beebs mthar slar gdan sar zhabs spor 'khod rgyu lha sar phebs nas 'azal du rtsa tshig cig bsgrigs nas/ chu glang (1913)lo'i zla 1 tshes 8 nyin sbyar 'grems gnang ba dang 'brel/ gzhung zhabs go gnas sogs bskyar 'dems dang tshar gcod jes 'dzin skabs su gang bab gnang zhing shog lor gsar ba bzo 'grems byas/ chu glang (1913)lo nas yig skyel sprag zam gsar ba btsugs/ gzhung zhabs kyi phru gu bzhi ing lan rag sba'i zhes pa'i slob grwar slob sbyong du btang / de ni dga' ldan pho brang ba'i skabs bod mi snyi rgyal du slob sbyangs la 'gro mi dang bo red/ sgog mkhar ba bsod nams mgon po dmag las slob sbyong la 'jar man du mngags/ chu glog gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ grwa bzhi thang du me mda'i bzo grwa/ dngul dpar khang / shog dngul dpar 'debs khang sogs btsugs/ lha sa'i dar 'azin las khungs yang yar rgyas btang /shing stag (1914)lo rgya bod dbyin gsum gyis chings yig bzhag shing yos (1915)lor dmag dpon dang dmag gi 'god sgrig gnang / lo 'di'i yas mas su paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi nyi ṭwāṃ zlordo kā /kā sprasdi /kā snaspya / kā snatram̐ṭwāṃ /zangs las spub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan 'dzam gling du sngar me 'brug (1916)lor dmag sbyong dang dmag dpung lam lugs gsar ba gsar 'dzugs byas/de mtshungs mi drug tsam zhig rgya gar du dmag 'thab lag rtsal sbyong du mngags/ bstan rgyas gling gi nye 'gram du sman rtsis rig gnas khang gsar sgrun gnang / se ra sman sbyin mkhyen rab nor bur sman rtsis mkhan chung du bsko bzhag gnang ngo / de lo nas mdo khams stod du bod dmag dang tram̐ daṭwāṃṭwāṃ 1gi tha yul

ṭwāṃ/ rsha ṭwāṃ~X kā shā //ra byas/ mthar gyod bshad de chings yig bzhag bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum lcags sprel (1920)lor bu ston gsung 'bum dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dpar spun rgyu'i 'go bzung / bka' 'gyur rin po che'i dpar shing bzhugs yul rtse pho brang chen po'i zhol du gtsug lag rten gtso byams sku chen po bcas lo 'khor bzhi'i ring la legs par spub/gzhung sa'i dpon rigs dag gis byed las sna tshogs la brten/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma ston 'khor bcas/ chu phag (1923)lo'i bla 11 tshes 15 la bkra shis lhun po nas rshasdo tram̐ /sog yul brgyud rgya nag tu phebs pa dang / sog yul dang mdo khams rnams su 'gro don rgya chen po chu phag (1923)lor rgyal rtser dbyin yig gi slob grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ste lo gsum tsam song rjes/ gdan sa gsum gyi slob dpon las snes dbyin yig gi slob grwa btsugs na mi 'grig tshul shugs chen po zhus pa ltar slob grwa phyi 'then mi byed mthu med byung / shing bya (1945)lor lha ldan drung spyi'i gling khar slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis/ dbyin yig dang bod yig slob pa'i slob grwa btsugs mod/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul mi shes pa dag gis chos lugs la gnod ces ngo rgol byas rkyen slob grwa phyir bsdu gnang ste/ bu phrug skya ser 'ga' zhig bod gzhung gi 'gro song btang nas rdo rje gling gi san jo seb ces pa'i slob grwar gtong gnang mdzad/ skabs de dus shig nas deng rabs kyi dmag sbyong dang dmag sgrig sogs la ched gnyer mdzad/ shing byi(1924)lor lha zhol grong khyer nang khrims srung dmag mi gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/'phrod bsten gtsang sgra dang / rkun jag bde 'jags sogs la blta rtogs byas pas phan pa chen po byung / me stag (1926)lor phag ri nas rgyal rtse bar rlangs 'khor 'gro lam bzos te rlangs 'khor bzhi tsam slebs pas/ mi ser sogs nas phyugs zog rta drel sogs 'drog nas brnab chag dang bor stor 'byung 'dug rlangs 'khor phyir 'then byed rogs zhes nan zhus byas pa ltar rlangs 'khor phyir 'then mi byed mthu med byung /sa 'brug (1929)lo nas lha sa dang grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs sogs su pebs skabs rlangs 'khor che chung bzhi tsam beed bcad de rim gyis bod mi'i mig lam du 'dris cha byung mtshams rgya khyab tu spel rgyu'i thugs dgongs gnang / lcags lug (1931)lo nas grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ zangs dang dngul gyi ṭam kha dang shog dngul tshon khra ma sogs dpar 'debs dang / me mda'/rdzas mdel sogs bzo bskrun gyi grwa rgya che btsugs shing / sa sbrul (1929)lo yas mas su sa 'du tshang dang be ri dpon ma mthun par dmag 'khrug langs nas be ri dpon gyis rgya dmag khrid 'ongs nas rgya bod dmag gis 'khrug zing langs te/ bod dmag re zhig rgyal/ lcags lug (1931)lor slar yang zi khron rgya dmab sleṭwāṃ~X spra bod dmag gis ma thub par hor brag mgo spya lag tu shor/ rgya dmag gis dar rgyas dgon

pa rtsa gtor btang / hor khog dang / nyag rong gnyis ka sa shor te bod dmag la pham nyes che ba byung stabs chu sprel lo'i zla 2 pa'i nang chings mi rgyag mthu med byung / skabs de dang dus mtshungs su zi ling nas mā pi phang gi dmag nang chen sa khul du 'byor te bod dmag dang 'thab rtsod byas pas thog mar bod dmag rgyal ba 'dra yang phyis su bod dmag pham nas phyir 'then byed dgos byung / chu sprel (1932)lo der bla 3 pa'i nang ldan khog tu zi khron rgya dmag smrebs nas/ bod dmag la pham nyes byung /chu sprel (1932)lor gnas chung chos skyong chen pos lung bstan bzhin brtan bzhugs phul ba'i gsung lan rnam thar du 'dug chu bya (1933)lo de'i zla ba bcu ba'i tshes shar nas sku bskun bzhes pa rim gyis je snyir song ste/ zla bcu ba'i tshes sum cu'i nyin gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim mo/ /de ma thag rnyog dra langs te/ sku bcar kun 'alel lags kyis rgyal dbang sku bskun pa gsang rgya byas nas/ gzhung zhabs la ma bshad zer ba sogs kyi nag nyes btsal nas/ sku bcar kun 'phel dang /bkra shis don 'aspub/ em che byams pa/ gnas chung sku rten sogs gnas dbyung byas pa sogs chab srid nyams rgyad kyi rtags mtshan mngon du gyur 'dug go/spyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po gshegs nas zla ba gnyis tsam la srid bka' lhan rgyus nas gzhung don bsgrubs/ de nas srid 'dzin rgyal tshab cig dgos tshul gros bsdur byas te/ dga' ldan khri ba las thog pa mi nyag a mi ye shes dbang ldan dang / rwa sgrong ho thog thu 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phur lcog yongs 'dzin sprul sku thub bstan byams pa tshul khrims gsum gyi mtshan shog zan ril bsgril nas rtse 'phags mchog lo ge sha ra'i spyan sngar srid bka'/ drung rtsis/ tshogs 'thus bcas pa'i dbus su dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags sang gis thugs smon bden tshig brjod bzhin zan rtags bsgril bas rwa sgrong ho thog thu thon pa ltar shing khyi (1934)lo'i zla 1 tshes 10 nyin spyal tshab kyi khrir phebs/de nas ring bo ma song bar/ rtsis dpon lung shar gyis 'go khrid pa'i gzhung zhabs mang po zhig zura'achogs byed pa'i gnas tshul thon/ de ni lung shar phyi rgyal du 'dug myong bas yar thon rgyal khab kyi lam lugs mthong stabs/ gsar brje'i bcos bsgyur byed rgyu byas pa red ces zer srol 'dug gang ltar rtsis dpon lung shar sogs 'dzin bzung dang / lung shar gyi mig bton/ gzhan dag gnas dbyung sogs kyis khrims bcad/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i gser gdung rin po che thog tshad lnga yod pa lo 'khor gnyis la legs par grub/rgyal dbang bcu gsum pas spom mda' stobs spyas la rmar khams khul gyi yul dmag gi ru dpon du bsko bzhag gnang ste sa mtshams su yod par/ rgyal dbang gshegs rjes sku bcar kun 'phel do dam thog rgyang 'phud btang tshul thos 'phral ma dga' bar shing khyi (1934)lo'i zla 10 nang kho rang gi 'og la yod pa'i yul dmag rnams khrid de zar khams sa srung cha dang mda' dpon nor rgyal nang ba'i dmag sgar thog mtshan 'geb ngo log byas te brgya dpon dang / dmag mi kha shas rmas skyon dang / sdi sgeṭwāṃ ༵ rgyu tram̐ngos

dang mtshon cha sogs phrogs/ ru dpon stobs rgyas dang / zhun rgan pa rab dga' gnyis kyis khams phyogs tshang ma bod gzhung 'og nas 'bud dgos pa'i yi ge bkrams mod don 'bras smin khom ma byung 'dug la/ chab mdo nas bod dmag thon skabs 'ba' phyogs su bros/ de skabs 'ba' phyogs de rgya lag tu yod stabs bod dmag der 'gro thabs bral/rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba rtsad gcod ched/ shing phag (1935)lo'i zla 5 nang rgyal tshab rwa sgrong ho thog thu sogs lha mo'i bla mtshor gzigs zhib la phebs/ mtsho nang nas dbu can gyi yi ge a dang / kam zhes dang / dgon pa thog sa sum rtsegs bar thog g.yu rtsi can gyi yang steng gser zangs kyi rgya sgribs yod pa/ dgon pa de'i shar phyogs 'gro lam skya thal le ri chung zhig gi rtsar thug pa/ de'i thad khang ba thog gcig ma thog sngon po byas pa gcig shar 'dug gsungs/shing phag (1935)lor bod gzhung gi gtso bo dag gis gros bsdur gyis paṇa chen rin po che rgya yul du bzhugs pa gdan 'dren zhus pa yin mod/ go min tang srid gzhung gis paṇa chen rin po che bod yul du phebs skyel du rgya dpon che ba kha shas dang / sku srung dmag mi lnga brgya bcas gtong rgyu yin tshul dang /paṇa che rin po cher nub phyogs kyi yon tan khyad par can gyi mnga' bdag ces pa'i mtshan gsol sogs bod gzhung gis khas ma blangs pa sogs 'gal rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis paṇa chen rin po che bod du phebs rgyur 'aspyangs 'gor byung zhing / me glang (1937)lo'i zla 10 tshes 28 la paṇa chen rin po che skye dgu mdo'i don 'grub gling zhes pa'i dgon par sku byu ngan las 'das so/ /de skabs nyi hong (ri pin)gis rgya yul du btsan 'dzul byed sgang yin pas paṇa chen sku gdung rin po che hor khog tu gdan drangs nas dkar mdzes dgon du bzhugs/ sa stag (1938)lor sla'u lun hus dang / paṇa chen zhabs 'bring ba rnams ma mthun par ring 'khrug langs te sku chas rnams rgya dmag gi lag tu shor yang / sku gdung rin po che gdan sa bkra shis lhun por gdan 'dren thub pa byung / sa stag (1938)lo'i zla 2 tshes 30 nyin srid 'dzin rwa sgrong ba'i thugs dgongs ltar srid blon glang mdun zur bzhugs byas te/ rwa sgrong gis srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzung ngo / /(14)rgyal dbang sku zeng bcu bzhi ba bstan 'a nazu mtsho/rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba ni/ sku 'bum byams pa gling gi nye 'dab stag 'tsher zhes pa'i sde ba'i nang du yab chos skyong tshe ring dang yum bsod nams mtsho gnyis la rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phag (1935)lo'i zla 5 tshes 5 la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan lha mo don 'aspub zer/ 'di ba lha mo mtsho gzigs kyi lung bstan dang / chos skyong dang / paṇa chen rin po ches kyang thugs dgongs yod pa dang / ke tshang sprul sku sogs kyis brtag dbyad sogs gang cha nas ngos 'dzin 'khrul med byung zer/ de nas bod ljongs su gdan 'dren zhu skabs 'khrungs yul mā pi phang gi 'og tu yod gshis/ mā pi phang la blu yon dngul sgor 'bum ba'irjo rjeṭwāṃ7 / sprand+ra nas gdan drangs te/ sa yos (1939)lo'i zla 8 tshes 25 nyin nor gling skal bzang

pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ zla 10 tshes 13 nyin gtsug lag khang du rwa sgrong ho thog thus gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan rje btsun 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang baḥr mtshungs pa med pa'i sde dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsol/ lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i zla 1 tshes 13 nyin pho brang po ta la'i khrir phebs/ khri phebs kyi mdzad sgo lugs srol bzhin mdzad/lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i zla 12 nang rgyal tshab rwa sgrong gis las khur dgongs zhu gnang / lcags sbrul (1941)lo'i zla 1 tshes 1 nyin yongs 'dzin stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab mthu stobs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid skyong gi khrir phebs/ chu rta (1942)lo'i zla 1 tshes 10 nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi mdun du rgyal dbang gis srid skyong stag brag gi drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ shing bya (1945)lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa a ri dang dbyin ji mthun phyogs dang bcas par rgyal kha thob par/a ri dang / dbyin ji dang / go min tang srid gzhung rnams la rgyal kha thob par dga' ston zhu mi dza sag thub bstan bsam 'phel sogs mngags/ spyi sger gyi bun skyed shin tu lci bas mi sor rnams ni bya rgan sgro zad du gyur te 'tsho thabs bral ba'i skabs su shing sprel (1944)lor bod gzhung tshogs 'du nas mi ser la brdab gsigs de 'dra byed mi chog pa sogs kyi bka' spya bkrams/ shing bya (1945)lo'i ston dus 'phan po lhun 'aspub rdzong du ser byas grwa tshang dang / sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'bru len rnams kyis snga dus bzhin gyi skyed kha chen po len pa mi ser rnams kyi bod gzhung gi bka' gsar ltar las ma sprad par lhun 'grub rdzong dpon la gtug bsher byas pas rdzong dpon gyis bka' gsar ltar byed dgos zhes mi ser gyi rgyab rtsa byas stabs 'bru gnyer rnams kyis rdzong dpon nyes brdung btang ste bsad/ byed gte rnams la nyes chad bcad par/ se ra byas sngags gnyis kyis de dag gi rgyab rtsa byas sogs kyis zing cha byung zer/lo de'i zla dgu bar lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje la rdzong rgyab tu lkog mda' 'phangs te rta bsad zer/ me phag (1947)lo'i smon lam skabs srid skyong stag brag tshang la 'bul rgyu'i sgam chung zhig gi nang nas 'gad mdes zhig gad de srid gzhung la snyan zhu phus bar brten/ bka' blon zur khang dang / lha klu gnyis kyi dmag brgya skor zhig khrid nas rwa sgrong dgon nas rgyal zur rwa sgring ho thog thu 'khor bcas bzung ste rtser khrid song zer/ rwa sgring gis go min tang la'ang lag 'brel byas te srid skyong stag brag khri las 'phen thabs byas song yang zer/ gang ltar de nyid rwa sgrong bla brang dang / yab gzhis phun tshogs khang gsar dang /sa 'du tshang rnams la sgo rgya byas song zer/ se ra byas sngags gnyis kyi mkhan po snga ma gnyis tsha len byas te gsar bzhag byas yod stabs/ tshes 25 nyin ser byas mkhan po gsar ba blo bzang bstan dar ngo g.yog bzhi ser byas grwa ba kha shas gyis bsad zer/ tshes 27 nyin rgyal zur rwa sgrong dang / mkhar rdo sprul sku/ nga gnas bla ma blo bzang ye shes rnam rgyal/ rwa sgrong sku tsha dza sag sogs la 'dri gcod byas par rgyal zur tshang nas/ sgyung mkhar dza gsum gyis snga rjes su srid skyong la lkog ngan byed rgyu'i bskul ma btang ba/ rgyal zur tshang gis de ltar byed mi nyan gsungs par ma zad kha ta go bskon byas pa'i yi ge phar tshur bskur ba — 575 —

rnams sgyung gnas bla ma'i sgo chung nang nas thon te/ spyal zur tshang nas khas len dngos gtsang gnang ba dang / khong la nag nyes med 'dug zer gyin 'dug zer/ lha klu ldog gsod du mi mngags mkhan kho yin zhes mkhar rdo sprul skus khas blangs pa dang / lag 'bom yod pa'i sgam de 'bul mkhan kho yin/ zhes sgyung gnas bla mas khas blangs song zer/ zla 3 tshes 28 nyin rgyal zur rwa sgring bkag sdom khang nas sku 'das song zer/ se ras rgyal zur tshang gi phyogs bzung ste sde gzhung la ngo rgol byas stabs/ se rar dmag 'jug byas te gte bo 'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung byas zer/ rwa sgring dgon du srung dmag bcu bdun ba'ag yod pa/ rwa sgrong rgyal zur tshang gi zhabs gras rnams kyis tshang ma bsad 'dug zer/ sa glang ( 1949)lo'i zla 10 tshes 1 nyin krung go gung khran tang gis rgyal yongs la dbang bsgyur ba yongs bsgrags byas/ sa stag (1950)lo'i zla 11 tshes 11 nyin rgyal dbang ston 'khor rnams gro mor phebs bskyod byas/ lcags yos (1951)lo'i zla 5 tshes 23nyin pe cin du bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gyi chings yig don tshan bcu bdun bkod do/ /le'u nyer gnyis pa/ paṇa chen eng ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rags tsam/paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ (1938)lo'i zla 2 tshes 3 (rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa stag lo'i zla / tshes 31)nyin mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs su zhun hwa rdzong be'u mdo'i zhing pa'i khyim tshang zhig la yab gur mgon tshe brtan dang / yum bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis las sku bltams/(1941)lor paṇa chen nang ma sgang gis chos lugs kyi 'gro lugs dang chos lugs kyi cho ga ltar ser skya dpon rigs las spub pa'i yang srid brtsad 'tshol pa btang nas skabs der dgung lo gsum las son med pas mgon po tshe brtan zhes mtshan gsol/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin byas thog (1944)lor mtsho sngon gyi sku 'bum byams pa gling du gdan drangs nas bkur skyong gnang ba dang 'brel paṇa chen nang ma sgang gi dza sag blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan thog nas skabs de'i krung dbyang srid gzhung rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung nas chog mchan gnang rogs zhes zhus pa red/( 1949)lo'i zla 6 tshes 3 nyin rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gi tsung thung las tshab le tsung ren gyis bka' rgya bkram nas mgon po tshe brtan paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng bcu ba yin pa dang / gser bum dkrug 'don mi dgos pa'i chog mchan bkod pa red/ de rjes rgya yag blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yongs 'dzin gyis mdun nas chos lugs kyi rgyun srol ltar dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes thog sdom pa mnos shing /mtshan la blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gsol/ de lo'i zla 8 tshes 10 nyin rgyalarwa babyeṭwāṃ 6srid gzhung gis ched du bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang kon ci yus bang chen du

btang nas mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sku 'bum byams pa gling du khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas pa dang 'brel rgya bod gnyis kyi yi ge shan sbyar gyi pha paṇa chen bzhugs sgar mkhan po'i tshogs 'du7zhes 'khod pa'i tham ga zhig kyang gnang ba red/ de nas bzung chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis paṇa chen sku zeng rim byung gi khrims mthun go gnas dang dbang cha rgyud 'dzin dngos su gnang ste paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par gyur cing /rgya che'i ser skya kun gyis dad mos dang gus bkur byed pa red/(1)dgung lo bcu gcig (1949)lo'i zla 9 par zi ling bcings 'grol thob rjes/ paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis lam sang bang mi btang nas krung go'i gung khran tang dang 'brel gtug gnang zhing / zla 10tshes 1nyin krung hwa mi dmangs khyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes ma thag khong gis gru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang dmag spyi chen po ku'u te rnam gnyis la glog 'azin phul nas krung go gung khran tang la brtsi bkur dang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu yin zhes gsungs pa dang / bod ljongs bcings 'grol snga tsam gtong rgyu'i re ba zhus pa dang 'brel mes rgyal gong bu gcig tu 'gyur ba'i bya gzhag legs par 'grub ched rang gi nus pa 'don 'dod yod ces zhus par ma zad 5 bod la log 'thus kyi bka' ngang sgug byed kyin yod7 ces kyang gsungs pa red/ ma'o spu'u zhi dang kru'u tes bka' lan glog 'phrin bstsal nas bsngags bskul dang 'tshams 'dri gnang ste khong gi rgyal gces ring lugs kyi spyod bzang la bstod bsngags chen po mdzad/(2)dgung lo bcu gnyis(1950)lor paṇa chen er te ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gus 'dud tshogs pa pe cin du mngag gtong gnang nas krung dbyangs mi dmangs srid gzhung la gus 'dud zhus pa dang 'brel krung dbyang la bod ljongs kyi gnad don thag gcod rgyu'i jus gzhi zhig dang re 'dun don tshan bcu grangs shig bton nas bod ljongs bcings 'grol gang snga gtong rgyu'i re ba phul ba red/ (2)dgung grangs bcu gsum (1951)lo'i zla 4 par paṇa chen rin po che sku ngo mas nang ma sgang gi dpon rigs gtso bo rnams khrid de pe cin du phebs nas kung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la lhag bsam rnam dag gis brtsi bkur zhu ba'i chod sems bstan pa dang 'brel/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mol byed par hurabartson chen pos skul 'ded dang spyab skyor gnang ba red/ zla 5 tshes 23 nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun/〉thog ming rtags dngos su bkod pa dang / zla 5 tshes 24 nyin paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis nang ma sgang gi dpon rigs tshang ma khrid par gnang ste kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung la gus 'dud zhus nas ṭwāṃ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉 gtan la phab par rten 'brel zhus shing / zla bya tshes 28nyin paṇa chen nang ma sgang gis gsal bsgrags spel nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyigros mthun la lhag bsam rnam dag gis brtsi bkur zhu rgyu dang / bod mi rigs la bcings 5kā/la zugathar

phyin dang yar rgyas chen po yong ba dang / spung go'i mi dmangs kyi rgyal kha sra brtan dang 'phel spyas yong phyir slad phyin blo thag gtsang bcad kyis ma'o kru'u zhi'i mgo khrid la brtsi bkur dang / spung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang spung go'i gung khran tang gi mgo khrid la brtsi bkur zhus nas gros mabun cha tshang lag bstar yang dag pa bya rgyu dang / bod mi rigs dang spung go'i mi rigs khag bar gyi mthun sgril dang bod rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril je dam du gtong rgyu'i ched du 'bad 'thab bya rgyu yin zhes gsungs yod/ zla 5 tshes 30 nyin khong gis tā la'i bla ma la rten 'brel gyi glog 'phrin phul nas ṭwāṃ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉gtan la phab pa de ni bod ljongs ser skya mi dmangs kyi rgyal kha rlabs po che zhig yin pas/ phran gyis nus shugs phra mo gang yod bton te rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis thung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang ma'o thu'u zhi'i mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i mgo khrid 'og gang nyid dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung la gzhogs 'degs byas nas gros mthun lag bstar dpyis phyin pa byed re yod/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong phyir 'bad 'bungs bya rgyu yin zhes gsungs pa red/ kung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thugs khur dang rogs ram gnang 'og paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang nang ma sgang gi dpon rigs tshang ma (1951)lo'i zla 2 par zi ling nas rdog thon te bod ljongs su gyir log phebs shing / spu'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis skabs de'i nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi spu'u zhi gzhon pa blo mthun zhi kung zhun sku tshab tu zi ling la phebs skyel zhu bar mngags gtong mdzad pa red/1952 lo'i zla 4 tshes 28 nyin paṇa chen rin po che mchog 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar phebs 'byor skabs bod sdod spung dbyang gi sku tshab krang cin lu sogs 'go khrid dang ser skya mang tshogs tshos spro sems chen pos dga' bsu gzab rgyas byas shing / de nyin gyi phyi dror paṇa chen rin po che rtse pho brang du phebs nas tā la'i bla ma dang nyi 'od pho brang du lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i mjal 'phrad gnang zhing / zla 6 tshes 23nyin gzhis ka rtse'i gdan sa bkra rshas lhun por phebs 'byor byung ba red/ paṇa chen rin po che bod du phyir phebs rjes thog mtha' bar gsum du mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyong bya rgyu dang / rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi mthun sgril dang mi rigs khag bar gyi mthun sgril dam zab che ru gtong rgyu/ bod nang khul du mthun sgril yong ba bya rgyu bcas kyi don du 'bad brtson lhod med gnang ste mdzad rjes ha cang chen po gnang yod/ 1954lo'i zla 9 par paṇa chen rin po che tā la'i bla ma dang lhan du pe cin du phebs nas rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i chogs chen skabs dang po'i gros tshogs thengs dang por zhugs shing / khong rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gyi rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang chab gros rgyal yongs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon par bdams thon byung ba red/ de'i ring la khong gis ma'o tse tung dang /kro'u in la'i/ li'u hra'i chi sogs tang dang rgyal khab kyi 'go khrid pa gtso bo rnams thengs mang po mjal phrad byung / mjal 'phrad gnang tshe rim bzhin du khong gis mes rgyal gcig gyur dang mi rigs mthun sgril srung skyong mtha' gcig tu bya rgyu dang / mes rgyal stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa dang mi rigs yar thon — 578 —

yong bar nus shugs gang yod 'don rgyu'i dgongs bzhed bstan pa red/(4)dgung grangs bco brgyad (1956)lo'i zla 4 par bod rang skyong rdzongs gra sgrig u yon lhanakheng btsugs shing / paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis rang skyong rjongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi spu'u rin u yon gzhon pa dang po'i go gnas bzhes pa dang / lo de'i zla 11 par gyin rdu srid gzhung gi gdan zhus ltar khong tā la'i bla ma dang mnyam du gyin rdu shākya thub pa sbya ngan las 'das nas lo 2500 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba'i mdzad sgor zhugs par ma zad/ gyin rdu'i sa gnas khag tu gnas mjal dang gzigs skor gnang bar phebs/ gyin rdu bzhugs ring khong gis yul dus gang du yin rung krung gyin rgyal khab gnyis bar dang rgyal khab gnyis po'i mi dmangs bar gyi srol rgyun gyi mdza' mthun la bstod bsngags chen po mdzad pa dang / ṭwāṃ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun〉la brtsi srung zhu dgos lugs nan gyis gsung nas bya spyod dngos kyi thog nas khong nyid kyi phyi gsal nang gsal gyi rgyal gces langs phyogs mngon par mtshon pa red/(5)1959 lo'i zla 3 par/ bod ljongs kyi gong rim mi sna log spyod tshogs khag gis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs srung skyob byed ched/ 'dzem bag med par bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun rtsis med btang ste bod ljongs su khyon yongs nas drag po'i zing 'khrug bslangs pa red/ paṇa chen rin po ches rgyal khab la dga' zhen dang / mthun sgril/ yar thon bcas kyi dar cha mthon por bsgrongs te/ zing 'khrug zhi 'jags gastong gin bcos bsgyur byed kyin byed dgos pa'i skor gyi krung dbyang gi byed phyogs la brtsi bkur gnang nas/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod sdod dmag dpung gis zing 'khrug zhi 'jags gtong bar hur thag 'bad thag gis spyab skyor gnang ba red/lo de'i zla 3 pa'i tshes 28 nyin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tsung li kro'u in la'i yis de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung mi dgos pa bzos te/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'gan dbang spyod rgyu'i bka' phab pa dang 'brel paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin u yon gyi las tshab tu bsko gzhag gnang ba red/ paṇa chen rin po ches de'i phyi nyin lam seng ma'o kru'u zhi dang kro'u in la'i la glog 'phrin phul te/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi gtan 'bebs la brtsi bkur zhus par ma zad/ mgyogs myur gzhis ka rtse nas lha sar phebs te bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi las ka'i gtso 'gan bzhes pa red/ de'i rjes su khong gis gtso 'gan bzhes 'og tu/ rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gis zing 'khrug zhi 'jags gtong rgyu dang dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i skor gyi byed phyogs srid jus sogs gal 'gangs che bas gros chod dang gtan 'bebs rab dang rim par gros 'cham byung ba red/ khong gis 'don pa gnang ba'i rtsa khrims dgon sder lag len bstar rgyu'i dgongs pa yang dag pa de dgon sde'i dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skor gyi gros chod nang bkod pa red/ bod ljongs su bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs mgo rting bslogs te/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas nas mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i srid dbang 'dzugs pa'i — 579 —

lo rgyus kyi bsgyur bcos rlabs po che nang / paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas krung go gung khran tang lhag bsam rnam dag dang / mdza' mthun sel med kyis mnyam las gnang ste/ bod ljongs mi dmangs yar langs bcings 'grol 'thob pa dang / bod ljongs kyi spyi tshogs yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ched dge mtshan ldan la phan 'bras che ba'i mdzad rjes gnang ba red/ 1959 lo'i zla 4 par/ spyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshegs chen thog khong rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang gzhon par bdams thon byung ba red/ lo rabs 60 pa'i dus dkyil la/ pha g.yon7 gyi nor 'khrul gyi rkyen pas khong la 'os min gyi spyod tshul bzung ba khyi dang / lhag par du/ pha rig gnas gsar brje chen po’’ zhes pa'i lo bcu'i zing cha'i skabs su/ paṇa chen rin po tshe ya nga snying rje med pa'i gnod 'tshe tshabs chen 'khel nas nyams sad nan po theg pa red/ 'on kyang khong gis gung khran tang la yid ches dang mes rgyal la dga' zhen gnang ba de mtha' gcig tu g.yo 'gul zhu tsam yang byung med/dzi mi bzhi shog khag’’ rdul du brlags rjes paṇa chen rin po che krung go gung khran tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros chogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun gyi lam phyogs dang / byed phyogs/srid jus bcas la snying thag pa nas gong bkur dang hur brtson chen pos dril bsgrags lag bstar gnang gi yod pa red/ dgung grangs zhe gnyis(1980)lor khong yang bskyar rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen rgyun las mu yon lhan khang gi u yon krang gzhon par bdams thon byung / de lo zla brgyad par blo mthun teng zho'i sgring gis khong dang bka' mol gnang skabs khong ni pha rang re'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal gces pa bla na med pa zhig’’ dang pha rgyal khab gcig gyur srung skyong byed mkhan zhig red7 ces gsungs yod/sgyur bcos dang sgo 'byed kyi gnas tshul gsar ba'i 'og khong dus rabs 'phel rgyas kyi rjes 'brangs mdun bskyod gnang ste/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas mes rgyal gyi khe phan dang / mi rigs kyi khe phan la thugs khur chen po gnang ba dang / mi rigs khag bar thun mong du dar rgyas gong 'phel yong bar thugs khur chen po gnang gi yod pa red/ mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyong bya rgyu dang / bod rigs sa khul dang mi rigs khag gi sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi 'dzugs sgrun gong 'phel gtong rgyu/ rgyal nang gi mi rigs khag du/ khong gis rgyal khab la dga' zhen gnang ba'i dgongs pa rnam dag dang mdzad 'phrin don duganyer ba'i 'dun pa drag po bcangs te nus shugs yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyis phyag las lhar len gnang ste krung dbyang la dgongs 'char dang gros gzhi sna tshogs 'don pa gnang ba red/ khong gis lhag bsam rnam dag gis krung dbyang gis bod ldongs kyi las kar gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i byed phyogs dang srid jus rab dang rim par rgyab skyor dang brtsi srung gnang ba red/ da phan lo bcu'i ring / khong rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas khag dang bod rigs sa khul du las kar gzigs zhib gnang bar thengs mang po phebs te khong gi 'bas sor ha lam bod ljongs dang de min gyi bod rigs sa khul yongs su 'khod yod pa rid/khongagang du phebs na'ang de gar lhag bsam rnam dag gis krung dbyang gi byed phyogs srid jus dril bsgrags — 580 —

dang / krung go gung khran tang gi mi rigs dang / chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur bcas kyi srid jus dril bsgrags/ mes rgyal gcig gyur dang / mi rigs mthun sgril/ mi rigs khag thun mong du dar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba byed dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin dril bsgrags bcas gnang gi yod pa red/de mtshungs khong gis nam yin rung sa gnas khag nas mang tshogs kyi 'bod sgra dang re ba gsan pa rnams spung dbyang dang 'brel yod zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs la gsung gi yod pas/ des las ka legs bcos byed par skul 'ded kyi nus pa ha cang chen mo thon pa red/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / khong gis sku tshab chogs pa khrid nas phyi rgyal du 'tshams 'dri thengs kha shas phebs myong ba dang / rgyal nang du phyi mgron la mjal 'phrad thengs mang po gnang khyong ba red/ byed sgo de dag gi nang du/ khong gis dngos thog bden 'tshol bya rgyu rgyun 'khyongs gnang ste phyi rgyal nas phebs pa'i grogs po tshor rang rgyal gyi srid jus sna tshogs 'grel bshad dang phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi las ka mtshams spyor gnang ba ste/ grub 'bras gsung gi yod la mi 'dang sa dang dka' ngal yang gsung gi yod par ma zad/ rang rgyal gyis bsgyur bcos dang sgo 'byed rgyun 'khyongs bya rgyu'i chod sems dang krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skun byed thub pa'i yid ches yod tshul yang gsal po gsung gi yod pas/ phyi rgyal nas phebs pa'i spun zla rnams kyis khong la bsngags brjod dang yid ches chen po byed kyi yod pa red/(6)paṇi chen rin po che mchog gis bod rigs 'phel rgyas dang yar thon yong rgyu dang / bod rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur thugs khur tshad med gnang gi yod pa red/ khong gis bod ljongs su mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims〉 lag len mthar phyin bstar rgyur thugs khur chen po gnang zhing / hur thag gis tang dang srid gzhung la ram 'degs gnang ste/ mi rigs dang / chos lugs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur bcas kyi srid jus dngade min gyi srid jus gzhan dag khag rnams don 'khyol gang thub gnang ba red/ khong gis rgya bod mi rigs bar dang rang rgyal mi rigs khag bar gyi mthun sgril la srung skyong dang brtsis mthong chen po gnang gi yod pa red/ khong gis gros 'go 'don pa gnang ba ltar dzi bod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa'i stan tshogs ’gsar 'dzugs gnang bar ma zad/ sku ngo mas spu'u rin u yon gyi las 'gan yang bzhes pa red/ khong gis bod rigs kyi dngos yod gnas tshul gzhir bzung nas slob gso'i bya ba yag po bsgrubs rgyu'i gnad don dang bod kyi skad yig beed spyod bya rgyu'i gnad don thag chod yag po byed dgos zhes snga phyi bar gsum du nan tan gyis gsung gi yod pa red/ bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang beed spyod bya rgyur skul 'ded gtong ched/ dgung lo zhe dgu'i (1987)lo'i zla 7 par khong gis u yon krang gzhon pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang mnyam du gros 'go gnang ba bzhin/ bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thog bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang beed spyod/ 'phel rgyas bcas gtong rgyu'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs kha shas〉 zhes pa'i gros chod la gros 'cham byung ba red/— 581 sdi

(7)paṇa chen rin po che mchog ni rang rgyal gyi bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gtso 'dzin khyad du 'phags pa zhig red/ khong sde snod gsum la mnga' brnyes pas/ 1956 lor gyin rdu ru 'tshams 'drir lebs skabs/ pho lo nee si sangs rgyas chos kyi slob grwa che bas khong la nang rig pa'i mtshan 'dzin paṇa ṭi ta'i mtshan snyan gsol ba dang / 1958 lor bod smongs gzhis ka rtse'i bkra shis lhun po'i rtags gsal chogs chen thog dzi bka' chen’ zhes pa'i mtshan gdags thob pa red/ 1958 lo nas bzung /mtsho sngon sku 'bum byams pa gling dang bkra shis kun po ru ṭwāṃ byang chub lam rim chen mo〉 dang ṭwāṃ dus 'khor dbang chen〉 sogs mdo lugs kyi gzhung ljags khrid mdzad cing / rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i gsung rtsom la brtson zhib zab mor gnang nas ṭwāṃ byang chub lam rim chen mo'i sdom 'grel〉 dang / dgyes rdor yab yum gyi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim〉 sogs rtsom gnang mdzad pa red/ nye ba'i lo shas ring khong gis sbyi tshogs ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi cha rkyen 'og gang 'dra byas nas dgon sde bdag gnyer dang grwa btsun gso skyong bya rgyu sogs gnad don gal chen rnams la zhib 'jug kur len gnang thog khong gi ma dgon bkra shis lhun po ru dngos su lag len bya rgyu'i tshod lta'ang gnang nas/ rin thang bral ba'i nyams rtsong cha tshang phyogs sdom mdzad pa red/ khong gis gros 'go gnang ba dang sku ngo mas gtso 'gan bzhes nas pe cin du thung go bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gsar 'dzugs dang 'brel sku ngo mas yon krang gi 'gan bzhes te/chab srid thog mes rgyal la dga' zhen byed pa dang / chos lugs thog sde snod gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs gyi shes yon can gso skyong byed par mig dper 'os pa'i srol lam bzang po zhig mdzad rjes gsar btod gnang ba red/paṇa chen mchog gis rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen skabs dang po'i rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang / rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen skabs gnyis pa dang / lnga ba/drug pa/ bdun pa bcas kyi rgyun las mu yon lhan khang gi u yon krang gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa dang /rgyal yongs srid gros skabs gnyis pa dang / lnga ba bcas kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang / rgyal yongs srid gros skabs gsum pa dang bzhi ba'i rgyun las mu yon/ bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin mu yon gzhon pa dang po/ kru'u rin mu yon las tshab bcas kyi 'gan bzhes pa red/ 1963lo shāsna ṭābyātrī sdo/gongs pa ma rdzogs bar krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtso'i 'gan (ra)paṇa tshen rin po che mchog gis sku tshe gang por mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyong byed ched 'bad thabs lhod med mdzad pa dang / rgyal khab stobs 'byor ldan pa dang mi rigs dar rgyas yong ched sku ngal 'dzem med kyis phyag las gnang ba dang / krung go gung khran tang dang mdza' btsugs sel med dang kha zhe gnyis med kyis mnyam las gnang ba/ nang bstan dar spel btang ba dang / chos byed mang tshogs khrid nasarda da~Xs pyi don du phan bde gnang bas/ khong ni rlabs chen gyi rgyal gces ring lugs pa dang /

snyan grags che ba'i rgyal don sgrub mkhan mkhas pa chen po yin/ krung go gung khran tang gi grogs po blos shāṅgi/nga mi sdirshaṭwāṃ / / gab /// sangs rgyas chos lugs khyad du 'phags pa'i gtso 'dzin bcas yin par ngo (9)khong dgung grangs lnga bcu nga gcig (1989)lo'i zla 1 tshes 28 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs kyi grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i dam pa nyid kyi pho brang gsar pa bde chen skal bzang pho brang du gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim yang rang rgyal mi dmangs kyi sems su ji srid bar mi nub par gyur ro/ /le'u nyer gsum pa/ mdo smad du bla brang bkra shis 'khril gyi gdan rabs/dang po/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku zeng rim byon/(1)'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ni sku zeng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus zhes rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi (1648)lo'i chin gong ma hrin tsi khri lo lnga ba/ zla 1 tshes 8 nyin a bkan rgya thang pha deng seng kan su zhing chen kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong bkan rgya zhang’ du yab dpal 'bum skyabs dang / yum thal mo byams gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bcu gsum thog tu chos mchog ye shes rgya mtsho'i mdun du dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus te mtshan blo bzang rgyal mtshan gsol/ sa sprel (1668)lo'i chin gong ma khri lo bdun par/ dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs/ gzhung mang po thos bsam rgya chen mdzad pas/ dgung lo nyer drug steng du dge bshes kyi go gnas blangs//trīsdo ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ rno// sdus/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i mdun du dge slong gi sdom pa zhu ste mtshan ngag dbang rab byung gnyis pa'i sa glang (1709)lo'i chin khang zhi'i khri zhe brgyad zla 6 par lha sa nas rdog thon te zla 9 par bla brang sog po dbang rgyal po'i pho brang du byon nas/ de'i lor rje tsong kha ba chen po blo bzang grags pas dga' ldan dgon pa btabs nas lo 'khor sum brgya 'khel ba'i lo yin pas/ khong mchod sbyin gnyis kyis lo de ni gza' skar bzang po mchog tu dge ba'i nyin zhig dgongs nas bla brang dgon pa bzhengs rgyu'i gra sgrig mdzad/sa yos (1711)lor gzhi khyon ka ba brgya cu ma thog khang dang ldan pa'i 'dus khang chen po thog ma'i 'dzugs sgrun byas pas/ bod shing rta (1714)lor gegs med du grubs song / bod me spre'i (1716)lo'i snad rgyud grwa tshang btsugs nas dgon 'di mdo sngags gnyis ldan gyi dgon chen snyan grags can du gyur/lcags byi (1720)lo'i zla 6 par gong ma khang zhi'i ngag dbang brtson 'grus la pha chos skyong slob dpon pan ṭi igru te ni no mo han zhes cho lo dang / gser gyi byang bu dang tham ka sogs bstsal lod/ //8༵nga 'o /don

bzhi pa lcags glang (1721)lo'i zla 2 pa'i tshes 5 nyin wa shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/(2)'jam dbyas bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dkon mchog dbang bo ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa sprel (1728)lor chinagong ma yon krin khri lo drug mtsho sngon zhing chen thung rin rdzong hrang ri'i (deng sang mtsho sngon zhing chen can bkra rdzong khongs su gtogs)yab dpon po ngag dbang rnam spyal dang yu ma bsod nams skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum (1740)lor khu bo stong skor sprul sku'i mdun du dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu phag lor (1743)chin chan lung khri lo brgyad pa)dgung lo bcu drug thog bla brang dgon gyi khrir 'khod/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa sbrul (1749)lor mkhas dbang chen po lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i mdun du dge slong gi sdom pa zhus nas mtshan dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo ye shes brtson 'grus drag dpal zhes gsol/dgung grangs nyer lnga (1752)lo'i zla ba 2 pa'i tshes 17 dbus su phebs/ de ni sku zeng sngon ma dbus nas a mdor chibs bsgyur gyi nyin 'khel yod/ dbus su byon nas lo brgyad kyi ring la 'bras spungs su dge bshes kyi mtshan gsol/ dgung lo so gnyis sa yos (1759)lo'i zla 5 tshes 23 nyin nas chas te zla 9 tshes 15 la bla brang du 'byor/ dgung lo so lnga rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta (1762)lor chin chan lung khri lo nyer bdun pas 5 bstan 'dzin chos 'phel er rto ni no min han’ zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/ chu 'brug (1772)la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bstan pa gong du 'phel bas grwa pa sum stong lhag tu rgyas pa'i sngon gyi 'dus khang las ka ba brgya dang bzhi bcu ldan pa'i 'dus khang chen po zhig bzhengs nas/da dung gzhan lha khang mang po sngar bzhugs su dus 'khor grwa tshang dang / sman pa grwa tshang / nang chen sogs bzhi bcu lhag bzhengs yod/ bod kyi sa bya (1789)lo chin chan lung khri lo nga bzhi la bya khyung dgon gyi khri ba mdzad par byon/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags phag (1791)lo chin chan lung khri lo nga drug zla 10 pa'i tshes 28nyin bla brang du phyir phebs pa'i lam bar mtsho sngon shin hwa rdzong kan 'dus dgon du dgung grangs drug cu re bzhi thog tu sku byu ngan las 'das/(2)sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu byi (1792)lo'i chin chan lung khri lo nga bdun/ zla 8tshes 10nyin a mdo reb kong gser mo ljongs gnyan thog yul tshor/ yab gnyan thog stong dpon rin chen rgya mtsho dang yum rgyal mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su bltams/ bod sa rta (1798)zla 1 po'i bla brang dgon du gdan drangs nas khrir thog bkod/ thu bkan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i mdun du rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus/ dgung lo bco brgyad sa sbrul (1809)lo'i dbus su phebs te 'bras srungs sgo mang du mdo sngags sogs chos sbyong legs par mdzad/ bod lcags lug (1811)lor paṇa tshen rin po che'i mdun du dge slong gi sdom pa mnos/bod (bye bya 5༵༵13)lor bla brang du phyir phebs/ bod rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa glang (1817)lor chin

kya chin khri lo nyer gnyis/ 'tshogs chen gyi sergo'i khri la mnga' gsol nas/ chos srid kyi khrims srol dang dge 'dun pa grwa mang rnams 'dul khrims brtsi srung gi skul ma dang 'bad brtson sogs tshar du dngar ba zhig legs sgrigs mdzad/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa sa smre'u (1848)lor chin to'u kang khri lo nyer baspyad la pha bstan skyong slob dpon7zhes gser gyi byang bu dang tham ka bcas cho lo bstsal/ dgung ṭwāṃ/ngas/ drug cu re bzhi rab byung bcu bzhi'i shing yos (1855)zla 9 par tshes 6 nyin mya ngan las 'das (4)sku zeng bzhi ba bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi'i me 'brug (1856)lo'i zla 1 po tshes 25nyin khams sde dge 'bri chu'i 'gram bkris brag khung mdun lha lung yul chor yab g.yang phan bde segs khyung legs dang yum g.yang phan chos mtsho gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ bod lcags smrel (1860)chin zhan sprung khri lo bcu'i thog tu/ a lags bde ba tshang dang hor tsha tshang gnyis kyis bla brang du gdan drangs de rdo rje'i khrir bkod/ dge rgan shes rab rgya mtsho'i mdun nas dge tshul zhus/mtshan skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug ces mtshan gsol/ bod rab byung bco lnga shing phag (1875)chin kang zhe'u khri lo dang por khong dgung lo nyi shu'i steng dbus su phebs te 'bras srungs sgo mang du sde snod gsum sogs chos sbyong bya ba mthar phyin pa mdzad/ dge rgan byams pa mdun nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ bod chu lug (1883)chin kang zhe'u khri lo dgu pa'i lor bla brang dgon tshogs chen khri ba dang mtsho sngon sku 'bum dgon gyi 'tshogs chen khri ba mdzad pa dang / dgung lo zhe gsum rab byung bco lnga sa byi (1898)chin kang zhe'u khri lo nyer bzhi la/ pe cin du gong ma kang zhe'u dang mjal phrad gnang / gong ma shin tu dgyes pas bka' shog dang tsan 'dan las bzos pa'i thub sku sogs rin po che mang po gnang bar ma zad/ pha'agro phan rgya chen gyi slob dpon7 zhes cho lo bstsal/ rab byung bco lnga dgung lo drug cu re gcig (1916)lo'i zla 2 pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin sku chos dbyings su dzim/(5)'jam dbyang bzhad pa sku zeng lnga ba blo bzang 'jam dbyang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/bod rab byung bco lnga me 'brug lo'i (spyi lo 1916 krung hwa men go lo lnga) zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis su khams li thang rdzong yun kwan pā tsha'e ma yul tshor yab mgon po don 'thub dang yum gu ru lha mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ pakho chen sku phreng dgu pas ngos 'dzin byas te ming blo bzang 'jam dbyang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ces gsol/ 1920lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin (sku nyid lo lnga)bla brang dgon pas a lags bde ba tshang dpon 'khor khams phyogs su yang sbrul bsu bar ched du mngags/lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes drug nyin yang sprul dang khyim tshang kun po ser skya brgya stong mang po'i dga' skyel nang li thang nas chas te/ lo de'i zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin bla brang dgon du phebs/ ser skya khri stong mang pos dga' bsu zhu/ lo de'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lngar sku nyid khri thog tu phebs/phyir lo zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nyin sku nyid kyis dge rgan mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i mdun du dge bsnyen gyi — 585 —

sdom pa bzhes/ 1922lor a lags bla kho tshang mdun du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo bco brgyad (gyi lo 1933 )kyi skabs su go men tang srid gzhung gis pha rgyal skyong chos spel slob dpon 'jam dbyangs ཿ thog thu7 zhes cho lo bstsal/ spyi lo 1936 lo'i dbyar khar paṇa chen rin po che bla brang dgon du byon skabs 'jam dbyang bzhad pas dge sbong gi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo gyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi steng (1937 )dbus su phebs te 'bras spung sgo mang grwa tshang du bzhugs rte gzhung pod lnga lo gsum gyi ring la sbyong mthar phyin/ 1940lo'i zla drug par lha sa nas bla brang du phyir log nas/ rgyal mo rong a mchog mtshan nyid dgon dang zangs dkar khang dmar dgon du pebs nas spu mang dang bcas/so mang rgyal bo rdo rje dpal bzang yab yum dang blon kun dga' yar 'azhil yab yum dang / rdzi 'gag rgyal sras mgon po rnam spyal/ blon 'chi med dbang rgyal dang dge legs rnam rgyal sogs mjal phrad dang dbang rjes gnang sogs mang po gnang ba ma zad/ khro bcu'i sde dmag rnams la'ang phyag nas gtor bar mdzad nas dmag rtsed sogs la gzigs mol mdzad par/ rgyal khag gnyis kyi dar gos dang gser dngul sogs 'bul chen byas/ sku nyid tshe gang bor mi rigs slob gso dang tshan rig khyab spel chen po mdzad de rgya bod kyi skad yig gnyis ka mkhas pa'i phul byung rig gnas pa mang po gso skyong mdzad/ de'i mi tshad mes rgyal gcig gyur dang btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol thad nas kyang byas rjes rlabs po che mdzad yod/dgung grangs so gnyis (1947)lo'i bla 4 pa'i tshes 14nyin sku nyid cham nad zhig phog mthar 'brum thor 'gos pas bla brang dgon byang chub chos gling du sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /(6)'jam dbyang bzhang pa sku zeng drug pa 'jam dbyang blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma ni/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa sa byi (1948 )lo'i zla 4 pa'i tshes 1 nyin mtsho sngon ging chen sgang tsha rdzong kong ma lde bar mib stobs lha lha dang yum tshe brtan sgrol ma gagyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ paṇa chen rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis 'jam dbyang bzhad pa'i yang sbrul ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ mtshan la blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma zhes mtshan gsol/ 1952 lo'i zla 2 pa'i tshes 11 nyin bla brang thub bstan pho brang du khrir mnga' gsol/ rgyal ba sku phreng bcu bzhi pa yong 'dzin snang tshang sbrul sku'i mdun du so thar gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan la 'jam dbyang blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes gsol/ deng sang rgyal yongs srid gros rgyun las u yon dang / krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi chogs gtso gzhon pa dang / kan su'u zhing chen gyi nang bstan mthun chogs kyi tshogs gtso/ kan su'u zhing chen dmangs chen spu'u rin gzhon pa sogs kyi 'gan bzhes gyin yod par 'dug go/ /gnyis pa/ khri chen gung thang sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam tharasador bsdus/(1)sku zeng dang zatsā cun dge 'dun lun gas/—rje ṭwāṃ~X sku'i skye 'phreng ni grub chen te lo ba dang na ro ba/ rje btsun shes rab sergo/ gnyan lo

dar ma grags/ rong bo'i chos pa rin po che bcas yin tshul gdan rabs lha'i ja chen na gsal/ khri chen gang ni mdo snad gling yul rma chu'i nye 'gram gyi gca' khog dar re'i rtse rgyal zhes pa ru/ ldong gi rus kyi rtse dbus byams shul las 'phros pa/ yab 'bum phyug dang yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro las rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi (1648)lo'i dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ dgung lo bco lnga ba chu ltag lor khu bos dbus su gdan drangs nas/ dpal ldan 'bras zhungs kyi sgo mang grwa tshang la zhugs te/ bsdus phar dang zur bkol bzhi bcas bzung / skabs dang po dang gnyis pa bskyar du sbyangs/ rwa ba stod du 'dul ba dang rnam 'grel ched du sbyong bar byon/ gong sa lnga ba chen mo/ slob dpon don 'grub rgya mtsho/ khri blo gros rgya mtsho sogs las bka' chos du ma gsan/ khyad par du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i dgongs don smra ba la 'gran bla med pa'i bla mar bzung ste bka' pod lja la sbyangs sbyir/gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i dgongs don smra ba la 'gran zla med pa'i shes rab rgyas/ de dus har ldong dang bya bral gnyis nas rje 'di'i khang tshan brtsad de sho 'phangs pas bya bral rgyal/ de yang smon lam mtshan btags spub zal nag chu'i khar khu bo skyel bar byon pa la rje bzhad pa'i rdo rjes 'phral tu slar shog ces pa'i bka' ltar/ rang yul du mi 'gro ba'i thugs thag bcad de smad rgyud nas sngags la cher sbyangs bar/mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bshes gnyen chen por gyur ba bya bral dge 'dun phun tshogs zhes/ tshogs dang tshogs par thams cad du ting nge 'dzin kho nar 'tshams kyi 'gro ba zhig yin phyir/ snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga gsang lding ba bzhin du byung /sa yos (1699)lor rgyud sgad bla ma dbu mdzad dang / me khyi nas rgyud smad mkhan por bskos/lha sa'i rgyud khang gsar du brgyab/ rgyal dbang drug par dngul srang sum stong lnga brgya dod du phul nas zhus pa ltar phyis su glang ra'i gzhis ka rgyud smad la gzhung nas gnang / sgos su 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi dpar shing lug (1715)lor gsar du bsgrun te/ sngar mtshan dkyus su shor ba sogs bris nor rgyun 'byams su song ba/ so sor dbye dka' ba dag kyang rje bla ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du dag ther mdzad pas/gsang chen bla na med pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i srog mthud par gyur ba'o/ /sa glang (1709)lor 'di ba byang rtse chos rje yin skabs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje slar sku yul du byon tshe rnam pa gnyis kyis drug pa'i bco lnga'i nyin jo mdun nas mdo smad du bstan pa spel ba'i thugs smon gzab nan gnang / yab rje zhal nas/ ngas a mdo nas dgon pa zhig btab 'jog rgyu yin/ rjes sospobadag byed mi byed khyod rang chos ltos zhes gsungs/ chibs thog la thon nas dam pa 'dis dung dkar legs pa zhig phul bas/mdo smad du chos kyi dung chen po sgrog pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ stag lo nam rje pad dkar 'dzin pa'i yongs 'dzin du po ta la nas bzhugs te zapa chos mang du spel te slob ma ma du bskyangs/shing lug (1715)lor rje 'di ba rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyalo tshab ga' ldam khri rabs lnga bcu ba'i gser gyi khri la mnga' gsol te/ 'chad nyan dang bsgrig lam satong sgo dang 'jin ṭwāṃ~X 7bcas ni

dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas/ me bya lor jun gar gyi dmag dbus su 'byor tshe/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes mchog dang rje 'di ba sogs zhu chings la byon na'ang ma phan par/ rgyal bo lha bzang bsad cing rje pad dkar 'dzin pa khri las phab/ gzhung gi chos srid kyi mnga' bdag ni khri rin po che zhes bzung thabs med par rje 'di bas mdzad dgos pa byung / sa khyi lor rtsod pa mkhas shing btsun pa'i dge bshes mang po las dpal 'khor chos sde sogs dgon pa brgya lhag gi bla ma bsko ba'i rtsod pa'i dbu 'dzin gnang / sa phag lor jun gar bas ser 'bras dag ther gyi dus su grwa ba lnga baspya rje 'di bas bslab khrims su bkod par dge 'dun lnga baspya zhes grags pa'i khrod nas kyang dge 'dun bde chen sogs mkhas pa mang po byon/ lcagagabyi (1720)lor rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mcho'i zhal dbus su 'khor ba la/ rje 'di bas ser 'bras dge gsum gyi slob dpon/ las sne dang drung 'khor sogs khrid de kun 'grub rdzong nas chibs bsu ja thab tshed du zhus shing / 'go zla'i tshes bco lnga la rtse po ta lar paṇa tshen mchog nas slob dpon/ rje 'di nas go ba mdzad de rgyal dbang nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ rje bla ma'i sku gdung sngar dngul yin pa de/ rje 'di bas gser sbyang brdung gis phyi nas brgyan phyir dga' ldan gser gdung chen mo zhes gangs can mdzes pa'i spyan gcig de byung / dga' ldan gser khang du gser dngul las spub pa'i byang chub mchod rten nang bzhugs nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring bsrel rnam bzhi/ rin chen nor bu'i 'phras byug pa gsar du basbrun/ jo khang du tshe dpag med/ mi 'khrugs sogs thog po nyis brgal tsam gyi sku brnyan drug sgo mang grwa tshang du gser zangs gyi rgyal mtshan cha/ rje dngul sku/ bya bral la spyi khang gsum bcas bzhengs/ da dung tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa la zhig gsos rgya chen mdzad cing / chos khri lho lcogs pa gsar du btsugs te dge lugs spyi sde bzhin du bca' yig bstsal ba'i mthu las/ dgon sde gzhan pa'i mig spyan du gyur stabs gung thang sde dgon gsum zhes grags/ sku mjug de nas mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor mtha' yas pa bskor bas/ sku'i 'greng ba kun la khri chen gung thang pa zhes grags/ de ltar chu stag lor khri kha gang na'ang mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs dbang gis chu yos lo mjug bzhugs/de nas sku dngos kyi gdul bya phal cher rdzogs pa na dgung lo don bdun pa shing 'brug (1724)lor gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/ sras kyi thu bo khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs kyis gung thang g.yu gzhong zhes pa nas gdung zhugs su phul bar lus dkyil lha gnas bde mchog gi lha yongs rdzogs snyon no/ / zhal slob kyang / rje pad dkar 'dzin pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ mkhan po dge 'dun lhun grub/ sgo mang blo bzang dam chos/ rgyal sras ye shes grags pa/grub dbang don yod don grub/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bse ngag dbang bkra shes/ sde ba blo bzang don grub sogs mtha' yas so/ /dar sgang yin zhing / sku smad du dus 'khrug rgod phyir bla dpon rnams la 'gyur ldog mang na'ang / rje 'di kun la nye ring dang ya yo med par lhun po ltar brtan zhing bajid stabs/ gzhung gi las don pa kun gyis kyang blo phugs gtod sar gyur te/ lha sa'i khri thog khang gi — 588 —

rje 'di bar gzhung sa rang nas bsgrun/ dbu gdugs ser rkyang gsum gyi bdag po zhes brjod las 'das pa'i mdzadaspu mang / de ltar chos srid gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong la/ dus de'i skya ser rnams kyang dad zhen shin tu che stabs/ dus phyis kyi mkhan bla rnams kyi mig ltos 'cha' ba'i gnas su gyur ro/ /(2)khri chen gung thang sku zeng gnyas pa ngag dbang bstan pa'irgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/khri chen ngag dbang bsnan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yul dbus kyi 'brog ri bo che dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi nye 'dabs su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug (1727)lor 'khrungs/dgung lo gsum pa'i tshe gung thang du phyag mdzod ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs kyis gdan drangs te bzhugs shing / dgung lo lnga ba'i tshe bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa rgyal sras yi shes grags pa'i drung du gtsug sud phul te mtshan ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du btags/ dgung lo bdun pa'i tshe mkhan po de nyid las dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos shing / lo der bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar phebs/ rgyal mo zangs dkar gyi rab 'byams pa bsod nams dar rgyas dge rgan du bsten nas bsdus gzhung la sbyangs/sgo mang dpon slob blo bzang dam chos kyi drung brtsi bzhag dang bka' chos 'ga' zhig kyang gsan/ dgung lo dgu ba'i tshe spyal dbang bdun pa mgar thar nas lha sar phebs par mjal kha zhus pas rgyal dbang mchog ṭāpy-i da// khri cher ngag dbang mchog ldan/ lca skya rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyis bkur bzos shin tu che ba de yang / sngar khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje mdo snad du chibs bsgyur skabs/ bstan pa spel ba'i thugs smon gcig tu gnang ba'i dus la babs pa na/ yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri rgan tshang dang sde gen tshang rnam pa gnyis nas dpon mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma la yang yang snyan bskul zhus par brten/ rje 'di gdan 'dren zhu ba'i ched du dpon tshang nas dar han the'i ji dbus su mngags te/ mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi drung du da res cis kyang gnang dgos zhes dpon ju nang gi bskang ra'i rnam pa'i zhal chems dang / de mtshungs dpon mo rnam spyal sgrol mas kyang zhu yig dang ngag mnan can phul bar mi dbang nas/ dpon dā'i ching ho shu'i chi yab yum bden kyang sngon chad paṇa chen rin po che'i brtag pa ma chud/ da reb chud na gang gsung ltar las med ces bka' phabs/ paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang ye shes nas gung thang sprul sku da lo phebs na/ mdo snad du bstan 'gror phan thogs yong gsungs pas mi dbang nas dgongs pa khrol/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshor thon phyag zhus par khyed kyi sku gong ma gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / sku tshe 'di yang sngon gyi thugs smon khyad par can yod pas/ lo gsum nas yar phebs te thugs gnyer bstan 'gro la phan nges shig mdzad dgos pa'i bslagebya mang po mdzad/ nyid kyi phyag gis tshe dpag med kyi sku byin can zhig gnang zhing / gzhan yang thon phyag spam mtho ba bstsal/de ltar me 'brug (1736)lor 'bras spungs nas chibs bsgyur skabs grwa tshang nas thal skad dang dar — 589 —

yug sogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs shing / lha sar mchod mjal zhib rgyas mdzad de rim gyis mdo sgad du byon/ lo de'i ston ka bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/sa rta'i lo sde khri rin po che khrir phebs pa'i drung nas bsdus grwa'i 'phro dang blo rtags dbu phar bcas gsan te/ dgung lo nyi shu ba me stag bar du rmado sngags kyi gsan bsam rgya chen po mdzad/ rje 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas byams chos lnga/ 'jug pa/ rigs chogs/ mdzod dang rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba sogs kyi lung gsan cing / de dag gi 'grel ba dang 'grel bshad spyi thal dag la zhib tu gzigs nas dpyad pa 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ thos bsam ci mdzad rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du rgyur ba zhig yod pa'o/ /tshad ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon du ma bsten te yi dam du ma'i dbang dang rjes gnang bskyed rdzogs du ma'i bshad pa dang khrid mtha' yas pa gsan cing / de'i yan lag gar jig dbyangs gsum/rol mo rdung lugs tshun chad kyang zhib tu bslabs pas gsang sngags mkhas pa'i tshad du snyin/ rong po mer gan chos rje ngag dbang rgya mtshe dang / 'tsho rgyud ngag dbang nor bu sogs tha snyad rig pa'i slob dpon du ma bsten te/ sgra dang snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag sgan dang sdeb sbyor sogs zhib tu sbyangs phyir kun bshad kyi mtshan ni/ tshangs sras dgyis pa'i rdo rje zhes lnga rig smra ba yongs kyi dbus na/ mkhas pa'i snyan pa mngon par mtho zhing gsung rtsom gyi rim pa mang du mchis pa'o/ /dgung lo nyi shu ba me stag (1746)lor/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i thugs sras dam pa gnyan rtse dpon slob ngag dbang chos 'phel las thugs rdzogs bzhes pa dang / zab chos du ma gsan ched rna yul du chibs bsgyur/ rim gyi sku gong ma'i 'khrungs yul gca' khog brgyud nas gnyan rtser 'byor/brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'dus 'dzin chen po de nyid kyis mkhan slob sgrags ma mdzad de/ dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ dbang rjes gnang sogs chos bka' yang mang du gsan/ khyad par bde mchog gi dbang gi skabs khri chen gyis rang la gnang ba'i spub chen nā ro ba'i rus rgyan yongs rdzogs sku la bsgron nas/ sngon khri chen de nyid kyis kho bo la bde mchog gi dbang gnang skabs/ nyid kyi sku la bzhes pa'i rus rgyan yongs rdzogs gnang nas/ 'di slar khyed kyis nga la gtad dgos pa yod ces gsungs yod pa ltar/ da res khyed bdag po la 'dzod pa yin/ zhes gsungs nas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por mnga' gsol bar mdzad/lo de'i ston nas sa 'bug lo'i brgyad pa'i bar du/ rje 'jigs med dbang po'i bka' dang grwa tshang gi 'dun pa ltar sgad rgyud grwa tshang gi khrir (khri rabs brgyad pa)phebs te/ snga sor khri chen drug gi khrid skyong srol yod kyang / 'jam rdor 'khor chen dus 'khor sogs kyi cho ga khyab bdal med stabs yun ring du gnas dka' bar dgongs te/ smad rgyud (dbus)ltar rim lnga'i dmar khrid gcig dril du skyong ba'i srol tshugs pa da lta'i bar du yar rgyas su yod/ gung thang tshoms chen dkar po bzhengs/dgung lo nyer gnyis pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug lo'i hor zla dgu pa nas chu sprel lo'i dpyid — 590 —

kyi bar bkra shes 'khyil gyi tshogs chen khrir (khri rabs lnga ba)zhabs son nye bar bkod/ sa 'asgrug lor rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho nas/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs ni lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gzi byin mngon par mtho bar ma zad/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla mgacig pu yin stabs/ rgyal mchog dang nyid kyis kyang bla ma dang 'dra bar bkur bzos 'os tshul sogs kyi bsngags brjod zhib 'khod kyi bka' shog dang / she re ge thu no mon han gyi cho lo dang / mkhan chas sogs kyi gzengs bstod mdzad pa 'byor/ khyad par du sngar grwa tshang phyogs gnyis su gyes pa'i 'ur zing che na'ang / rje 'dir nye ring chags ldang mi mnga' ba'i btang snyoms kyi rgyu mthun gsal bar bshad te/dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang gis 'chad nyan 'thel ba kho na byung /dgung lo nyer drug pa chu sprel gyi dpyid khri zur nas gnya' gong brag dkar dgon du mtshan nyid grwa tshang zhig yod pa cher ma gnas pa'i rkyen gyis/ rgan gya'i skya ser tshang nas zhus pa ltar phebs te/ chu bya'i lor sngar gyi bshad grwa pa rnams kyi steng du grwa rgyun bsdus nas/ smad rgyud dang cha mtshungs pa'i rgyud grwa gsar du tshugs nas lo gsum gyi bar du skyong bar mdzad/dgung lo nyer brgyad pa shing khyi (1754)lor khri gnas brtan pa lo de'i dgyid khri thog nas gshegs/rje 'jigs med dbang po dbus na bzhugs pas/ bla grwa tshang mas mgrin gcig tu gsol ba ltar slar yang tshogs chen khrir (khri rabs baspyad pa)pebs te/ 'chad nyan gyi srog bzung / dgung lo nyer dgu pa la yang 'chad nyan dmar bar mdzad cing / rigs grwa sogs 'char can dang 'phar ma'i gastong sgo yang mang du gnang nas khri zur bzhugs mdzad/dgung lo sum cu ba shing phag lor/ dgon pa'i byang phyogs rgyab yol gyi gnas su ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin btab ste/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i lha grangs su bcad/ chu med par khron pa bton/snaṭwāṃṭwāṃdī sprardo kā kā trītrī /sdo /yang gsar du basbon/ sdom gsum gyi phyir bcos rgyas pa sogs smad rgyud kyi dgung lo so gsum pa sa yos lor/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje dbus gtsang du bzhugs pa la/ gong ma lha skyong chen po nas bka' ched du bab ste/ ba so rta tshag rje drung dpal ldan rgyal mtshan pho brang nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshab tu/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi 'og nas rtse thon gyi bla ma zhig rgya nag tu phebs dgos tshul byung bar/ rtse 'di ba sku yod go bab gang nas kyang 'os tshul gong ma'i gser snyan du sul bar brten/ gong nas rgya'i mi drag ched mngags kyis gser yig pa bla brang du babs pa ltar/ lo de'i sa ga zla bar chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te sku 'bum du phebs par khri rin po che so gnyis pa chu bzang thub bstan dbang phyug pa nas tshogs dbus su gdan drangs te/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la lam gtso'i bshad lung dang zhal gdams mgur ma sogs bstsal/ de nas dgon lung / a lags sha ortu su sogs brgyud nas zla drug pa snga ma'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin pho brang chen por pe cin du phyag babs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsan ༵ ༵sa gong ma

lhas skyong dgyes te/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin zhal mjal gnang zhing 'tshams zhus kyi kha dar phyag gis bzhes/gong ma'i phyag gis kha dar dang / rin chen khyad mtshar las spub pa'i cod pan bstsal zhing gos yug 'ga' yang gnang / drug pa byi ma'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gong ma lhas skyong mchog la zhabs brtan phul bar/gong ma rang gis bzhes pa'i bu la han gyi dā hu/ mang nog gi lu ba/ las 'azeng / gos yug chen mang po dang / jir bla chen re gnyis tsam ma gtogs gdan ser po'i thob gnang srol med rung / de nyin nasagadan ser po'i thob dang / bzhugs gdan ser po'i rgyab yol dang bcas gnang ba'o/ /ston gong ma ri dwags kyi sar snyon te slar pho brang du phebs nyin/ rje 'di chibs bsur byon tshe gong ma chen pos gung thang hu thog thus nged la pus mo 'dzugs mi dgos/ zhes che 'don gyi bdag rkyen gzhal du med pa gnang /de nas yung hu gung ngam dga' ldan byin chags gling nas/ lo 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas gsar du bzhengs pa'i rab gnas su/ rje 'dis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa la 'don pa chosastod 'grig po byung zhes gong nas bka' bzang po bstsal/ mdor na snga gyi gser zhal nam mjal la spyan bskyang gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing thugs dgyes pa'i bkur bzos ni/ khrims kyi lugs sbol spyas yod rnams ha las par gyur/ de nas bzung rgyal sa'i hu thog thu rnam brgyad kyi nang tshan khri gung thang tshang zhes jur gyi deb ther na yod cing /pho brang gi gzim khang da lta'ang lus yod pa lta bu'o/ /dgung lo so gsum pa yos lo de'i dgun sku bskun par gong mas kyang bla sgan du ma dang / khyad par lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje bod nas phyir 'byor ma thag gong nas bka' babs pa ltar/ dngos phebs kyi sgo nas sku'i rim gro mdzad na'ang ma phan par spyal zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum par zhi bar gshegs pa'o/ / lcags 'brug lor gsol dpon rab 'byams pa zhes gung thang phyag mdzod dge 'dun grags pas sku gdung gi ring bsril pho brang nas bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs shing / chu rta lor gang gi sku gdung mchod rten la/ rje 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ rje 'di bar gsung rtsom pod gcig mchis so/ /(2)khri chen gung thang sku zeng gsumapa dkon mchog bstan ba'isgronadzee dbal bzangapo/de yang khri chen gung thang sku zeng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta'i (1762)lor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin yul mdo smad kyi shar lhor gtog pa mdzod dge smad du 'khrungs shing rus dga' yin/ rje 'jigs med dbang bo ched gnyer gyis mdzod dger sgebs tshe lo lnga zin byis pa de khri'i steng du 'jus shing na bza' 'thams pas kun mkhyen mchog kyang thugs dgyes te ljags bsngags ka ra thum zhig bstsal te rten 'brel gyi / /mar/ phye/ dgung lo bdun pa sa byi (1768)lor bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs te khrir bkod —de spya~X 2kun mkhyen gyi drung nas rab byung bsgrubs pa'i mtshan dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes

gsol/ bshes gnyen blo bzang rin chen klog gi dpon slob tu bsten/ lcags yos (1771)lor gong sa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho nas mkhan chas/ cho lo/ bka' shog sogs sku gong ma'i rus ltar bstsal ba 'byor/ chu sprul lor chos grwar zhugs tshe 'brug gis thog ma grags pa ni ngo mtshar gyi yul du byed/ sog po rab 'byams pa bsten nas btsan po dang bla brang gi bsdus grwa dag la sbyangs par/ byugs rig rno zhing zab pa'i rnam daphyod can du grags/ yab rje'i drung nas dbang lung rjes gnang mang po gsan/ dgung lo bco lnga par 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar du byon te thal phreng gi yig cha skyor sbyangs mdzad par/ rig pa sngar las zab cing rtsod par 'gran zla med pa kun gyi mngon du gyur pa ma zad/ lha bris dang ri mo/ rgya sog gi skad dang yi ge yang thugs su chud par byung /dgung lo bcu bdun pa sa khyi (1778)lor dbus su mdo sngags kyi gnas sbyong du byon par/ thar ba rtse nas the 'jigs med dbang po mchog gis dgyes ston dang bcas phebs rdzongs gnang ste/ mdor na dbus su sku yon gsan sbyong mthar phyin pa gnang nas slar mdo smad du byon te/ dgon pa 'dir phan grogs bzang po gnang dgos/ nga yang lo mthon po 'di ltar song ba'i tshegs len res byed dgos/zhes dbu lo dkar po ston par mdzad/ brgyad pa'i tshes la lha ldan du 'byor/ 'bras srungs sgo mang chos grwa'i 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar du zhugs shing slob dpon skal bzang dngos bub dge rgan du bsten/ jo shākya la phyag mchod/ rgyal ba paṇa chen la dngos 'bul/ ser 'bras dge gsum la sku 'gyed sogs kyi mchod sbrin bstar/ gzhi 'dod chung chog shes la gnas nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung thams cad rang rgyud 'dul ba'i nyams len du 'khyer bzhin par dgung lo nyer gcig pa chu stag (1782)lor pad dkar 'chang ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ tshongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan bsten/lo gsum gyi ring la gung tshegs chos grwa gcig las chag ma myong bar/ chos mtshams kyi dgong rer shog bu brgya dang sum cu yan re nges can du byas nas gzhung chen mo'i dpyad pa sum sgril la 'bad de/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba me rta (1786)lo'i smon lam grwa skor gyi nyin rgyal dbang rin po che 'khor bcas kyang khyams ra'i steng du bzhugs/ se 'bras dge gsum gyi dge bshes yang rtser zer tshad kyi blo'i rtsal yod sprugs lta bu byas par/ sus kyang 'khor gsum ma song ba tsam du ma zad/ bgro gleng gang btang la tshad ma'i lam nas drangs pa'i lan thogs pa med cing / lung 'dren la byams chos sa sde/ rje yab sras kyi gzhung phal cher thugs thog nas thon pa'i tshe na/ mchog dman kun gyis rjes su yi rang gi ngang nas dus kyi mtha' 'dir rje yab sras kyi gral du 'os pa'i mkhas btsun bzang 'dzoms kyi skyes chen dam pa spedi 'dra phebs pa skal ba bzang zhes/ sgrom tsam ma yin par yon tan la ched du bsngags pa'i rol mo lhan du dkrol/ rje'i drang nges rnam 'byed kyi dka' gnad kyi mchan/ 'dul ba'i sdom tshig rtenanyi 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod/mdzod gnang brgya dang phar phyin skabs bzhi'i sdom cug sogs rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad du ma 'bras rgyangs nyid du spel/ de nas rje skyabs mchog 'jigs med ngabang po ngabus sukhyon nas/ nga'i skra sngar — 593 —

las kyang dkar ba 'di ltar na tshod mtho yang / khyed len pa'i gyir 'ongs pa yin pas/ gang ci'i gra sgrig mdzod ces gsung ba bzhin yab sras gnyis mdo snad du chibs bsgyur te bcu gcig pa'i tshes dgu'i sprashā/ bla /brang du 'byor zhing / tshogs chen 'du khang du gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan cha gcig 'jog pa gnang me lug (1787)lo'i dpyid la yab rje 'jigs med dbang po mchog nas rje 'di dang bla brang gi zhabs phyi drag bgres dag dang / gung thang dbon po/ rje 'di'i khu bo dge legs seng ge sogs 'dzoms nas/ snga mo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa tshang gis khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs par/ ngas a mdo nas dgon pa zhig btab 'jog rgyu yin/ rjes sor bdag byed mi byed khyed rang tshos ltos gsungs pa ltar/spyir bkra shis 'khyil 'dir yang dga' ldan gser khri gsum/ gzhan khri gdan zur sprul sku sogs bla chen nyi shu lhag tsam yod mod kyang / nga la yang rjes sor sems la 'dzin rgyu zhig yod pa khyed gcig pu yin e go zhes sngon byung dang phyis 'byung gsal ba'i sgo nas thugs gtad pa'i gsung byon no/ /dgung lo nyer drug pa'i dbyar tshogs chen khri zur bsod nams grags pa/ rgyud pa slob zur nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs kyi gtsos/ dgon pa'i dge bshes rigs smra til gyi gang bu ltar gcer zhing /ri khrod kyi 'du khang sgo 'byor dang bcas par mi shong tsam la/ lam gtso'i bshad lung thog mar gnang bas/sngon chad rna bas thos ma myong ba lta bu'i legs bshad kyis mkhas mang gi yid 'phrog ste/ lo gcig gi slob gnyer la yang 'di 'dra'i blo skyed thon pa dka' zhes gleng ba'o/ / skabs 'di dag tu yab rje'i drung nas rtsis dang sdeb sbyor/ chos 'byung dang lo rgyus/ reb tsa'i sman rgan las sman gyi skyor sdeb dang dngos 'dzin sogs gsan zhing / rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtha' daphyod/ bden bzhi'i mtha' dpyod sogs gsung rtsom mang du spel/ khyi lor spyal mo rong gi sa'i cha rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dngos slob mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa'i gdan sa da tshang lhun grub gling du byon te/ bla mchod khrid sogs bka' chos mang po gnang zhing / lcags phag lor yab rje mchog gi bka' ltar rnga ba'i phyogs su sgo mang sgar bde chen gling gsar 'debs kyi ched du phebs te rgyud grwa btsugs/ khri mdzad de skyong khur gyi dka' ba dang du blangs/yab rje mchog dgongs pa gzhan du gtad pa'i gtam gsan phral/ de ma thag tu gdan sar byon te gdung mchod rgya cher mdzad cing / sprul sku myur 'abhon sogs brtsams pa'o/ /chu byi (1792)lo nas sa rta'i bar tshogs chen khrir (gdan rabs nyer gcig pa)lo drug la bzhugs/yab rje'i gdan sa skyong bzhin mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu spyan drangs pa yin la/ de yang snga sor sa khyi (1778)lo nas bzung tshogs chen 'don pa je nyung je myur dang / chos grwa'i yun je thung dang / char zim tsam 'du khang du tshogs pa'i gu yangs batrel srol dod/ de'i shan grwa tshang gzhan la zhugs pa sogs yod pa la/ las sne 'ga' res khur du blangs rung grogs ma 'dzoms pa dang / las sne phal cher gyis rgya yan la btang ba'i shugs kyis chos sde chen po 'di'i bshad sgrub kyi skor cung zad nyams par rtsom pa'i dus — 594 —

yin stabs/ rje 'dis 'dun ma mtha' ru 'don pa'i snying pa'i snying stobs kyi shugs brtan pos gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs zhi drag sna tshogs mdzad pas/ chos mthun gyi 'grig lam je zhib je brtan du song
