ste/tshogs chos grwa'i yun tshad/ zhal 'don gyi dal brel/ chos mtshams kyi skyor sbyangs sogs snga sor sgrig lam zhib pa'i dus ltar sor chud/ lha sde khag gsum du gtogs pa'i ser skya spyi la jag rkun kyi gnas tshang tsam yang byas mi chog pa'i bldam/ khyi so'i bre srang ma gtogs 'grim mi chog tshul sogs skya ser so sor nan can gnang / gzhan yang / dka' rams 'dzin grwa'i bgro gling ni dbu phar rtsod lugs su song ba dang / bsdus grwas rig pa bdar sha mi gcod par rtags gsal nyog ring 'phen pa'i mig ltos sogs dgag pa'i ched du/ rlubs bzhud phal cher mtshan mor mthud de/ chos thog la brtsi bzhag chag med/'phros pa dang dogs gcod/ gsung bshad sogs 'chad nyan dmar ba kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad pas/ rgyal sras po to ba dngos su byon kyang 'di las lhag pa gsung tshul med ces dpyod ldan dag gis gling bar mdzad/ rtsod grwa yang shin tu rgyas shing khyad par 'dul mdzod kyi slob gnyer shin tu dmar ba 'di 'dra zhig chos sde 'di tshul nas bzung byung ma myong zhes/ grwa thog des dka' spyad dang du blangs te/ zas gos gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes dang / 'dzin skyor dang dpe klog khas len 'dzin lugs/bgro gling gtong tshul sogs slob cing / dogs gcod dang gsung rgyun gleng mos dus gda' zhing / dam pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba ma gartogs tshe 'di snang gi mis 'phya smod sogs la cir yang mi brtsi ba'i chos mthun gyi skyes bus sde 'di'i pad mo'i tshal la me tog gsar bas khebs te/ chos sde chen po gang gi bshad sgrub kyi 'od snang mkha' khyab rgyal kun dgyes pa'i mchod sbrin du gyur pa lta bu'o/ /de nas pha nor gnyen la bcol ba 'bogs pa bzhin du mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che sa rta (1798)lor khri la bkod de bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba na/ tshogs chen la chos rgyal gyi gos thang khyad 'phags (da lta gnas)dang / bzang gos kyi bla bre sogs spyor 'jags gnang ste/ re zhig gdan sa'i khur bzhag nas dgon lung byams pa gling du dge 'dun gyi sde skyong zhor du/ bla brang gi mdzod 'dul dbu phar gyi rigs smra mang po byang gi chos sde so sor grwa bskor la mngags pa'o/ / gdan ma bkra shis 'khyil gyi gzhi mdzad de/ byang gi dgon lung nas lho'i da tshang dgon bcas mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa dag tu bka' pod lnga gtsor gyur gyi 'chad nyan spel ba ni bstan pa'i gzhi rtsa rmang nas gsos pa'i mdzad rjes rmad du byung ba'o/ /mdzod dge sgad nas sa rta (1798)lo'i zla gsum par byon te dga' snun rab rgyas gling gsar du btabs/ bla brang dgon pa'i tshogs 'du rgyas pa nas mchog sprul rin po che'i yongs 'dzin gnang dgos zhus pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes/ dgung lo so dgu pa lcags smrel(1800)lo'i dbyar dngul rwa dang / tsha gan bee shing / byams me/ gling ba/ skya mgo rong bcas su byon zhor du dpu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi khri ba gling dkon mchog dgyes pa'i blo gros sogs kyis zhus pa ltar bhon te bka' rtsom thor bu ci rigs gnang / lcags bya'i lor gdan sa'i smon lam la gung thang 'gyedatshen zhes/ dge 'dun sum — 595 —

stong la dngul srang brgyad stong bzhi brgya lhag gi 'gyed gnang / mu to ba sum brgya lhag la ja thug dang ja mar rtsam gsum gyi sbyin gtong rgya cher mdzad/ lnga ba'i nyer lngar brag lung ri khrod/ a 'khor brag dkar ri khrod brgyud nas khya dge dgon du bde mchog sogs kyi dbang dang / mang ja/ gyi 'jog gnang /mdzod dge sgar sar nas gang gi sras kyi thu bo dbal mang panyi ta yis zhus pa ltar phebs/ rgyal rong rgyal khag so sos sngar nas gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar cog tse'i rgyal po rgya dkar 'bum 'das pas der byon )/sa dge rnying gsum/ jo nang / bon sogs bdun brgya'i tshogs dbur phebs nas bsngo ba yon bshad rgyas pa gnang bas/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa la grub mtha' ris med thams cad gcig tu dad par gyur/ a mchog dge bshes sprul sku lo gsum lon pa dge bsnyen bsgrubs shing rjes gnang bstsal/ rdzi 'gag rnam rgyal 'jigs med phun tshogs rdzong du byon/ chu 'pho nor bu gling du rgyal blon 'khor bcas sogs nas dbang dang rjes gnang bstsal/ rim gyis da tshang du phebs te gang gi sngags phyogs kyi gsung rtsom gal chen rig byed ma'i bstod 'grel phal cher bcad rgya'i ngang nas brtsams pa'o/ /chu khyi lor mchod rten mthong grol chen mo bzhengs 'go bzung ste smad kyi su nyid nas gser zangs kyi chos 'khor bcas bsgrubs shing / gdan sa nas ar las kyi rmang bzung / shing las kha dang dkyil 'khor dgon zung mang 'gyed spyi 'jog gnang / rdzong dkar ri khrod/ mgon shul/ mang nge dag gis zhus pa ltar byon/rgan gya'i brag dkar du gnas gzigs phebs/ phag lor gdan sa'i khri las thog pa rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nan tan zhus pa ltar tshogs chen 'du khang nas dge 'dun sum stong tsam la rdor zeng gi dbang rdzogs par gnang ba'o/ / mchod rten gyi sar lto 'gye'i thig btab ste gsung bkod rgyun du gnang zhing dgon par bcad bzhugs mdzad/ shing byi lor bde thang dgon/ chas pa dgon/ chas pa ko'u nang dag gis zhus pa ltar byon te dbang lung rjes gnang gang 'dod bstsal/ girti'i tshogs mang la dbang dang kiti rin po cher tshe dbang sogs bka' ci rigs gnang / bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga'i nyin so mang spyal sar smyun drangs/ rje 'di ba'i rnam thar springs yig zhu ba'i rgyal mo bsod nams sgrol ma/ rgyal po nang so/blon chen bzhi la sogs par dbang rjes gnang bstsal cing gsung 'phros zhib par gnang bas/ dad gus kyis yid brlan te 'dren byed nas chu rgyun rtsol med du 'bab pa byung /dgung lo zhe bzhi ba shing glang (1805)lo'i mchu zla'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i nyin nas bzung ste/ kun 'khyen yab sras rnams kyis gtsor mdzad/ gzhan bsnyen song sum cus bkra shis snye ma'i phyag len ltar/ mchod rten mthong grol chen mor rab gnas mdzad/ de yang mchod rten bzhengs pa gong ma ñtsa chen rgyal pos gsan tshe/ dkon mchog thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling kun tu khyab/ ces gser gyi phyag bris kyang bstsal lo/ /de yang zhal nas/ dge sbyor bzang po zhig byed bsam kyang zang zing gi 'du long gis byed du ma bcuhūṃ gabyi~X 6chen mo 'ga' rtsom bsams kyang so so'i 'dod bstun gyi rtsom pa phran tshegs skul mkhan mang

song bas thog tu ma 'khel/ dgung lo zhe lnga pa me stag nas chu lug bar du dgon dang ri khrod gnyis na res mos su bcad rgya'i tshul du bzhugs te/ bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i sgrub pa snying por mdzad/dbang bka' chos cung tsam bris na 'di ltar lags te/ dgung zhe drug pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me yos (1807)lor rma lho'i jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas 'das par/ dpon mos nan gyis skul bas byon te gdung mchod dang bslab bya mdzad/ sa 'brug lor girti thub bstan nye mched du byon par rdor 'greng gi dbang dang / skabs der dka' rams dang dge bshes bgres gzhon che hrag mang du 'dzoms par bde lam gyi khrid rgyas pa lung rigs ri bong bsnyil ba lta bu gnang / spyir bshad bya'i gnas dka' sla gang 'chad na yang / sku tshe stod la byams chos sa sde rig tshogs dang / sku tshe smad la de'i steng du mdo rgyud dang / grub chen gyi gzhung thogs med du 'dren pas bka' bstan thugs la bzung yod pa lta bu 'chad cing / de'i mthus gzhung gi khog la go ba ster phul che ba/ dpe dang gtan tshigs/ 'jig rten gyi kha ngag tshun chad dang sbyar nas gsungs pa nges pa rnyed sla ba/ nyams len dang sbyar te sems rgyud bskor nas gsungs pas rdo rus thug par ngo sprod pa zhig yin pa ni nyid kyi phul du byung ba'i khyad chos so/ / sa sbrul la kun mkhyen ri khrod du spyan drangs te dadul srang stong lhag gi dbus rdzogs phul/ mdor na kun mkhyen gong ma rnam gnyis kyi sku yon ltar dbus gtsang nas 'byung dgos tshul sogs bslab bya zab cing brling ba zhus so/ /brgyad pa'i bcu gsum nas gnang mjal gyi mgo bzung ste dre'u kha shas las med pa'i bya bral gyi tshul ltar thog mar dge ldan bstan pa'i chu mgo bya khyung dar rgyas gling du glo bur byon/ chos rje don rin pa'i sku gdung bcas la mchod mjal dang tshogs mang nas nan zhus ltar lam gtso'i khrid gang rgyas gnang / lusri na'i tshal gnyis pa sku 'bum byams pa'i gling du snyon/ mchod sdong chen po sogs la zhib mjal dang /lung dang rjes gnang zhus pa ltar phul/ dam bca' tshugs par gzigs rtog mdzad/ gser khog dang chu bzang dgon gnyis la mjal/ dgon lung du (thengs lnga pa)zhag nyi shu lhag bzhugs te thu'u bkwan mchog sprul rin po cher dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/ de nas dmar gtsang brag tu byon te bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal ba'i sku dngos kyi mdun du mchod pa dang snyan shal phul/ gro tshang dgon du phebs te go tam sde/ rdo rje 'chang / rin chen 'od 'bar/ ston pa dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs la mchod mjal dang / tā'i ming rim byon gyis bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus dang gsung 'phros zhib ngo 'phrod pa mdzad/ rgyal ba bla ma rin chen pa'i thang ring bshad sgrub gling / man ju'i thog ma'i bla ma se chen chos rje'i gdan sa ba jo dgon/ mdzo mo mkhar du byams chen chos rje'i sku gdung sogs la rten mjal gang zhib mdzad/ dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la bde mchog chos 'byung na yod pa'i pham mthing ba chung bas bsgrun pa'i bha ddha ta'i gtsug lag khang ngam/ spya skad du lo kya turtswazhes par byon te bde mchog cho ga gsungs/ smon tshig bka' rtsom mdzad/ de nas mchod rten dkar po/ a 'gang dgon/ byams sprin dgon/ rdzong thog lha khang / byams pa 'bum gling rnams su gnas gzigs mdzad/ stag lung — 597 —

dgon/ a 'bo'i sgar/ a mtsho'i sgar bcas la dbang lung rjes gsum bstsal/ de ltar mdo smad tsong kha sbrul ba'i zhing zhes pa'i sngon gyi gnas chen dag dang rten 'gangs can rnams su mchod 'bul bsngo smon/ lam bar dgon grong so sos chos 'brel gang zhus 'dod mos ltar bstsal/ dgon pa che phra dag gi dngos 'bul gyir slog pa'i steng du mang 'gyed dang gyi 'jog phul te/ bcu pa'i nyer gnyis la hor gtsang khog brgyud nas gdan sar snyon no/ /lcags rta (1810)lor sku 'bum/ 'bru gu/ bis mdo dgon sogs phyogs nas byon pa'i bla chen/dge bshes bcas nyis stong drug brgya lhag la 'dul khang chen mo nas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang rgyas pa gnang /spyi 'bul phyir slog ste slob gnyer gal che tshul bcas kyi bslab bya nan du mdzad/ de yi dus na rgyal tshab rje drung bstan pa'i mgon po nas/ bla ma khyed rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin pa phebs dgos tshul gyi yi ge gnang bar/'jig rten gyi spro ba bskyangs te lung skyog nas ma ṇi 'don mkhan yin pas/ skyabs mgon gong ma de'i zhabs la mnyam du gtug pa'i chos dam tshig gi 'brel zab la dgongs nas/ de 'dra thog tu mi yong ba'i mgo 'dren cis kyang gnang dgos nan tan zhus/ yang na/ gong ma chen pos kyang zi ling am bhan brgyud nas bka' lan gnyis trem babs kyang sbas pa'i thabs kho na mdzad/ lcags lug lo'i zla lnga par rgyal ba sergo nga ro rten dang brten par bcas pa rab gnas kyi nyin gang gi mdo phyogs kyi gsung rtsom gal chenarje'i bstod 'grel gsar rtsom gyi mjug lha khang de nyid du 'grub par mdzad pa'o/ / chu bya la kun mkhyen dbus nas slar byon par yab sras lhan rgyas gsung sgros zhib par gnang / mkhar sngon hu thog thu dang chas pa rgya mkhar sprul sku sogs bsnyen rdzogs pa brgya dang brgyad cu la bslab pa bstsal/dgung lo nga bzhi ba shing phag (1815)lo'i zla brgyad par the bo'i chab tshan du byon zhor du kirti sprul ba'i sku dbus su byon par zhal bkod dang phebs rdzongs bstabs/ rwa brgya'i shing bza' blo bzang dar rgyas pa zam tsha nas ched du byon te rnam gnyis nas chos srid kyi bka' mchid 'byams thas pa mdzad de zla mjug gdan sar 'byor/ nyid kyis skya thig btab pa'i thub dbang dang 'od dpag med kyi gos sku gnyis (da lta yod)snga ma mdzod dge'i sgar sar dang phyi ma bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang du spyan drangs/ tsha mdo/glu chung / bde thang dgon sogs tshe phra mang po zhabs kyis bcags te/ zhal nas/ deng sang brel ba bcad nas dge sbyor gyi khul yin rung / dgos pa'i dbang gis chab tshan gyi zhor la lho phyogs kyi dgon pa thams cad la re re song ba yin/ 'bul ba blangs na grong chog dang don gcig pas ri khrod kyi tha snyad zhig 'gro/ zhor la dge 'dun pa thams cad la mang 'gyed kyi 'brel thebs skal ba bzang gsungs so/ /dgung lo nga bdun pa sa stag (1818)lo'i zla lnga par/ dgon lung nas gdan drangs pa ltar byon te thu'u bkan mchog sprul gtsos sum pa gro tshang 'dan ma sprul sku bcas la dbang bka' chos ci 'dod bstsal/bdun pa'i nyer gsum nas zhus pa ltar sku 'bum/ bya khyung nas dbang rjes gnang dang / ka kyā'i dgon du smyung ga/༵8 thebs bzhag ste rong bo bkra shis chos sder babs/ thub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku gdung

sogs la mchod 'bul dang / dge 'dun rnams la bla mchod kyi khrid/ kun rig gi dbang bcas gnang zhing smon lam gyi thebs bzhag thar ba gling / se chang dgon/ brag dkar dag tu gang zhus kyi dbang rjes gnang dang mang 'gyed bcas phul bzhin par gdan sar 'byor/ lcags 'brug (1820)lor co no yongs 'dus rgyal khab kyi dgon chen du byon par 'byor ston rgya cher zhus/ yer ba dgon/ gong so dgon/ nags mdo dgon/ khya dge dgon/ se bo rong sogs rgya nag bkra shis khri sgo dang zi khron tshun chad nas bla grwa lnga stong lhag byung bar bdun pa'i tshes dgu'i bar du rdor 'azeng gi dbang gnang / 'bul ba phyir slog tshogs su mang ja dang spyi 'jog bstar te chos srid kyi dga' ston rgya chen spel bar mdzad/gdan sa nas snga phyir ched du byon pa'i mdzod dge'i gro pagyi ta ngag dbang 'azin las/ a mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ jun gar dge slong chos 'phel/ rgyal rong tsha kho'i da ro sangs rgyas 'bum/ hal ha tho yon bla ma/ khams kaX thog dgon gyi sprul sku thugs mchog rdo rje/ ni man wangaspas 'jam dpal rdo rje bcas phyogs 'bul dag la 'dod mos ltar gyi dbang dang bka' chos mang po gnang / chu rta'i lor sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma smad nas slar byon te 'byor phyag zhus pa la/ zhal nas ngo thug nas sems bde lam gyi khrid smin rgyas pa bstsal/ bzhi pa'i bco lngar dkon mchog tshul khrims dag bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs chos bka' dang gsung rtsom bar ma chad par mdzad pa ni/ dbal mang rin po che'i zhal nas/ri dwags khrod na gdong lnga'i dbang bo bzhin/ / gangs can mtha' dbus bstan 'dzin bye ba'i khrod/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar rmad byung dang / /legs bshad gtam gyi sbyor bas khyod nyid 'phags/ /zhes pa'am/ yang na/ gang gi drin las mdo smad yul krongs 'dir/ / thub bstan bshad sgrub nyi ma dgung du 'bar/ / chos 'dul dri med lag len spyod tshul 'phel/ / bslab gsum sde snod 'dzin pas sa steng khyab/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar sku dngos kyi gdul bya phal cher rdzogs te lnga pa'i bcu gsum nyin gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyangs su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/ gdung rus la sku dang yig 'bru bhon pa'i ring bsrel snying por gyur pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten de/ shing gling (1985)lo'i bla brang me skyon gyi dus na yang phyi'i dngul zhu ba las nang rten ring bsrel ni/ sngar ltar ma 'jig par dad ldan rnams kyi mchod pa'i gnas su bzhugs so/ /(4)khri chen gung thang sku zeng bzhi bdakonasachogabastanapa'i rgya mcho dpalabazangapo/'jam dbyangs bla ma rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i spya mtsho dpal bzang po ni/ bla brang nye ba'i tsa yul zhes i a ra pa tsa na rnyi sa ming du grub pa'i yul der shing sprel (1824)lo'i 'go zla'i bcu gcig la 'khrungs shing rus ldong yin/ sa glang sgron zla'i bco lnga'i nyin kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya matso yab sras lhan rgyas nas brtag bsgril mdzad de rje bla ma bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang sprul 'khrul med du thag bcad/min zla'i tshes gsum la bkra shis 'khyil nas gung thang bla brang thub bstan skyed tshal gyi chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol/ dgung lo bdun pa lcags stag (1830)lo'i cho 'phrul zla bar kun gzigs mchog gi drung nas — 599 —

rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ rje gang ma'i drung yig dkon mchog kun dga' las gsal byed rgyas pa'i klog tshul bslabs/ hor tshang rdo rams pa ngag dbang rab brtan yongs 'dzin du bskos te nang nas rigs lung tshugs/ lo der spyi bye brag yan gyi rtsod pa rdzogs/ lug lo'i dpyid chos grwar zhugs/bsdus grwa blo rtags bcas thugs la bzung ste rgal brtags gyi sgo nas rigs lam la nges pa rnyed/me bya lor a mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas bsdud mar gdan drangs pa ltar phebs nas dpal ldan smra seng gling du 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang / rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ spyi 'jog la gser zangs las grub pa'i sman bla'i sku mi tshad zhig phul nas gdan sar phebs/ rigs grwa grol rjes dme bo'i dpon bstan 'dzin gyis zhus nan bzhin dgon sar rab rgyas gling du yab rje rwa dza'i mtshan can mchog dang brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas/ res tsha'i bka' 'gyur ba bcas ser skya'i khrom la 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang / dgon grong so so'i re 'dod yid bzhin du bskangs/ sa khyi'i rigs grwa'i steng ba rin tho yon dang mnyam du blo rigs kyi tshogs gling mdzad/ sde khri rin po che nas bka' chos gang gnang chag med du gsan/dgung lo bcu bdun pa lcags byi'i dpyid chos kyi gzhung gsar du 'dzin grwa gtug skabs/ gzhung kun bzhi'i steng nas lung rigs kyi zeng ba spel bas pha rol bo dag gi spobs pa mig med du bcom/ kun mkhyen mchog kyang thugs shin tu dgyes pa'o/ de'i dbyar da bus su phebs kyi dus su/ sog ngo /dngul rwa/ dbal shul stod smad/ byams thang / a mchog mtshan nyid rnams dang / chob brgyad/tsa yul bcas la phebs/ gdan sa'i nang chen khag dang mdzod dge co ni sogs kyis gsol ston dang phebs rdzongs rgya chen bstabs so/ /dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags glang (1841)lor dbal mang rin po che nas gsol ston dngos 'bul dang bcas pa'i thog sku gong ma'i mdzad pa ji ltar bzhin gnang dgos kyi zhu nan mdzad/ dbus su phebs par rtse'i mgron gnyer/ kun bde gling / tshe smon gling sogs kyis sku tshab mngags nas mtshams zhu mdzad/ hor tshang bstan pa'i nyi ma dang lhan rgyas sogs jo mjal dang / rgyal dbang mkhas grub rgya mtsho po ta lar khrir bkod pa'i bzhugs gral dgyes ston gyi rigs la bhon par ma zad/ dngul rdo tshad lnga/chibs chen sum cu/ gung mdzo nyi shu sogs rnam grangs stong phul/ srid skyong tsha rdor/ 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ rta tshag rje drung dpal ldan ye shes/ de mo tshang bcas la dngos 'bul gzabs/ dgun chos steng 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ chu stag (1842)lo'i lha ldan smon lam chen mo zhes dge 'dun khri rwa can la ja thug gi steng dngul zho re'i sku 'gyid btang / lcang skya ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bod du byon par me drod spya tshigs nas mjal bar bkur bzo che/ rta tshag yongs 'dzin 'dul ba mkhan po blo gros bsnyen nas dpe khrid zhus/ dpyid chos gsum pa'i 'dzin grwa gtug tshe/ go rigs zung 'brel gyi sgo nas rigs lung btang bas/ gyi rgol dag gi khas blangs zeng ba'i rgyun thag chad pa ltar gyuratram̐ nga 6/00darngi bshes bgres gzhon kun bzhad gad kyi ngang la gda' ba byung / de nas rtsod pa bzang

ba rnams dang mnyam du rgyun par 'phros pa dogs gcod dang / tshogs chos chag med kyis gzhung la thos bsam sgro 'dogs chod pa mdzad/chu yos (1843)lor drung par dpal 'khor chos sde/ rgyal rtse'i mchod rten sogs la mjal/bkra shis sgun po la mang ja'i steng dngul 'gyed btang / gro zla'i tshes gcig nyin palachen bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ dngul srang brgya dang rta mdzo lnga bcu phul/ snar thang /sangs rgyas ye shes gyi gdung rten/ rong byams chen dag la mjal/ rigs grwa la blo gsal gling gi sems dpa' sprul ba'i sku dang tshegs gling gnang bar 'phags tshogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i thugs spro la bsang nges pa'i brgal brtag chos kyi mchod thin bla na med pa spros/ tshogs grol tshe/ rtse shod kyi sku drag bstan spyas gling / kun bde gling gi mgron gnyer/ sgo mang phyag mdzod sogs kyis sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa'i dga' dar gul/ ston mjug mdo snad nas dbon po dar rgyas sogs gdan 'dren du 'byor ba'i gdong du dbal mang rin po che nas rang yul du phebs dgos kyi gsung shog nan can yod phyir/ paṇa chen mchog la dris/ rgyud grwa rang yul gsum las gang legs zhus par rang yul du phebs par lung bstan/bal bo'i mgar pas dngul srang lnga bcus bskun pa'i sgrol ljang gi sku brnyan la ba so rta tshag dpal ldan ye shes kyis gzungs 'jug phul zhig paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi mas rab gnas mdzad/ mdo snad nas sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma (da lta bzhugs)zhes gar phebs sar 'khyer bde bzhengs pa'o/ / dgun chos la phar phyin gyi dga' ston du 'dzin grwa so sor dam bca' bzhag par/ khor gsum mi 'gro ba'i dge bshes zhes gzu bor gnas pa tshos bsngags brjod lha'i me tog mgrin gcig tu 'thor ba'o/ / rgyal zla nas gtsang /sa skya/ zhwa lu/ 'ol kha/ zangs re mkhar dmar/ yar lung rten gsum gnas gsum/ bsam yas/dga' ldan/ se ra bcas la mchod 'bul zhib mjal gnang /shing sbrul (1845)lo'i sa ga zla bar hor gtsang rin po che dang lhan rgyas su mdo smad du byon par/bod gzhung nas nag chu'i bar rta 'ul zhag babs sogs kyi bsnyen bkur phul/ kun mkhyen mchog kho tsher bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal 'dzoms mdzad cing / de nas bsang gzhung nas rma bya chen mo jib ste zam tsha gser khri/ khri bsod grags tshang bcas kyis dgyes ston bcas gdan sar 'byor/ gzhung du 'cham lham cha tshang dang / grwa tshang so so/ phyogs kyi dgon sde du mar gnang skyes yid tshim pa bstsal/ de nas hor tshang rdo rams pa'i drung nas dbu ma la 'phros pa dang dogs gcod/ sngags kyi khyi don thugs 'dzin mdzad/me rta'i sgron lam la/ phyag mdzod mkhan po snyan grags rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen thub bstan rgya mcho gtsos bla grwa lnga baspya skor la sgrol lngang sogs kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ gung thang tshoms chen ser po bsgun te dge legs 'byung gnas bkra shis rnam rgyal khang zhes pa'i ming bstsal/ gro tshang 'phrin las lhan grub pas zhus pa ltar gro dga' bo lung dang gza' ru la phebs/sa sprel lor/ zam tsha khri chen bsam 'thub rgya mtshe/ sgo mang tshul khrims rgyad patsho/601nyang tshang

bcas bla grwa nyis brgya lhag la bde yangs nas lho brag snyan rgyud du grags pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa bstsal zhing / khrums zla'i tshes brgyad la rgan gya'i khri ston mdzad/ 'grig lam nyams gso'i rteng bskul sogs gang ci'i 'dzin skyong hur thag mdzad/ sa bya lor gdan sa'i rdo rams pa reb gong don spub gyis zhus pa ltar/ sa ga zla bar zam tsha gser khri/ rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgya mtsho/ sgo mang tshang / gyo ra don grub rgya mtsho/ thar ma dge 'dun spya mtsho/ brag dkar tshang sogs bla grwa nyis brgya la 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi bshad lung gnang / mgo zla'i tshes skor la de ka'i khri'i dgongs pa zhus/dgung lo nyer bdun pa lcags khyi (1850)lor wang bkra shis dbang rgyal gyis zhus pa ltar smon 'i yar tshes la u ge'i khrir phebs/ bla brang gi dge bshes khong gi bla sgan pa chos rje bla grags pa las sa ris cha lag dang bcas pa'i skor la ri mo rdzogs par mdzad/ rdzong dkar blo bzang bstan 'dzin gshegs par gdan drangs/ rdzong dkar/ reb gong stod smad/ hor zo nag gi mjal ba stong zag du mar chos 'brel bsngo smon gyis yid cum par mdzad/ ston gdan sa rta nor nyis brgya sum cu'i 'gyed dang bla sprul phal cher la rta bzang re phul/chu byi'i chu stod zla bar a mchog mtshan nyid dgon nas/ bde mchog sogs kyi dbang dang gyi 'jog la sgrol dkar byin can gnang / cog tse'i nga ro tshe dbang nas mkhar dgu dang / nga ro rdo rje 'bum nas sna dag seng ge yang rdzong / a mchog stod smad/ skya mgo rdong ru dag tu zhus pa ltar lebs te 'brel tshad don ldan mdzad/ lo mjug nas chu glang lo'i smon zla'i bar rje dgon bstan pa rab rgyas kyi drung nas sgra'i gsan sbyong legs par rdzogs/ de nas sog po'i wang zur bkra shis dbang rgyal/ wang sar bkra shis chos rgyal/ la kha grub chen/ thu med gser khri bcas la gsang 'dus sogs kyi dbang bsul te/ gro zla'i bco lngar de'i khri'i dgongs pa zhus/ mgo zlar chu bzang thub bstan rab rgyas reb gong dang bla brang gi 'khrugs long 'dum ched byon te/ skye bo'i byings rnams mthun pa'i bka' drin bskyangs par bsnyen bkur dang len/ legs so'i dga' ston phul/dgung lo so gnyis pa shing yos lo'i brgyad pa nas sa lug lo'i ston gyi bar/ gdan sa'i chogs chen khrir (khri rabs zhe brgyad pa)zhabs sen nye bar 'khod/ de yang bye brag gi cha nas cung tsam bkod na/yos lo'i zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin kun mkhyin mchog nas hor tshang bstan pa'i nyi ma tshang la srid skyong gi khur dang / rje 'di la khyed kyis dgon pa 'di'i chos 'chad nyan/ 'grig lam kun spyod bca' yig ltar du nyams su mi 'jug par 'phror gcig gi phyag tu 'jog rgyu yod pa zhig gyis/ zhes zhal chems ri ltar lci ba bstsal te/ tshes drug nyin khong zhi bar gshegs tshul bstan par thugs dam gsal 'debs dang /myur 'byon gsol 'debs ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas chos sde 'dir bca' khrims re re bzhin yang dang yang du dgos pa mtha' dag dang bsgrags te/ 'grig lam gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims gtsang ba yin tshul dang /sgosatram̐ grwa6 ṭwāṃ~X grwa pa/ rta thog rte'u zer ba'i dpe ltar/ rjes sor dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ bstan

'dzin gyi skyes bu/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i thugs sras kyang 'di nas 'byung nges yin phyir/ de'i do dam gyi las khur rang la babs yod cing / las shor du 'gro mi 'gro dge 'dun mang gis gzigs rgyu zhig yin/zhes tshogs gtam gnang ba la tshogs pa rnams thugs gting nas mgu zhing 'dun pa byung /me 'azug (1856)lo'i smon lam la gsung bshad 'di 'dra sngar thos ma rtsong / sku gong ma dang nges par khyad med ces gcig kyang ma lus par phebs pas tshogs shin tu rgyas pa ni/ nye 'khor gyi khyim pa rgyus yod dag gis kyang da lo'i gsung chos 'di 'dra zhes phan tshun dga' ba'i gleng mol byed pa lta bu'o/ yang na/ phar sbyin man la bla rgyud pa yod mi chog pa dang / de yan nas slob gnyer mi yong na'ang / ma mtha' yi ge dkar nag dpar lta bu yon tan ci rigs zhig dkor 'ju ba'i ched du cis kyang slob dgos pa'i bka' bcad mdzad/ las sna bsko 'jog la bla ma khri pa nas ja ma do dam pa su yin yang 'tshang mi chog par/ tshogs 'dus grwa tshang gi las khur la phan thogs babs 'os can gyi 'os tho bsgrigs pa ma gtogs nye dga' phyogs 'byer mi chog pa dang / sngar 'grig yig na bka' bcad mdzad pa'i mi bco lnga las phu thung spyon mi chog pa skyar du bsgrags so/ /de nas/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i nang na sbal ba khrag can zhes/ 'grig khrims pa dang zhabs phyi'i khrod kyi mtho sa dma' sa kun na gnas pa'i nag chang rkus gsum gyi dogs pa can gsum ni gal thel shog tho byas shing / skor ming gi bzung nas gtan gud byas tshe/ phal cher gyis ma bzod pas gnang ba gtan du zhus/snga phyin khrims 'chal can chig brgya lhag dgon pa'i gling sdod mi chog par grong chas spyon du bcug ste/ chos sde chen po dri mas spags pa la gad dar gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i dag gtsang mdzad/ gling bar dang gnas khang gi gad dar 'di/ byang chub lam rim gyi spyor ba'i chos drug gi thog ma'i nyams len yin tshul gsung ste/ rgyun du las snes gling skor blta rtog byed par rteng gnon dang bdag gir 'gyur ba med pa bzhes sbyir/dge 'dun pa'i thugs spro seng nge ba'i dad gus kyis dpal la bkod cing / na bza' mnabs lugs legs dgos zhes rgyun du skul ba sogs kyi dbang gis rjes su chos sde 'di'i gad dar dang na bza' zhes sdo/rsha / //ṭwāṃ zloṭwāṃ/ mi/ga ltos 'cha' ba'i gnas su gyur/ de la gung thang btsan po ma'i bstan pa'i gad lo ngo mthong lnga'i ring chos grwa bcags nas phebs bzhud gnang ma myong bar zla chos re la shog lnga brgya/bar chos re la shog sum brgya re nges can du 'gro zhor du/ brtsi gzhag gi rgyugs/ rigs lung gi rgyugs/dus nges pa med pa'i rig gnas kyi rgyugs/ skad grwa ba'i rgyugs dpar gyi rgyugs rnams zhib par blangs te ma 'phrod pa rnams la chad las lci bas rim gyis mi 'phrod mkhan je nyung du song / grwa tshang gzhan gsum po yang de bskun gyi 'chad nyan dmar zhing / grwa pa'i mtshang dang rus nas 'bod mi chog pa mdzad/ grwa pa su yin na'ang / de'i grwa shag rwa skor/ yul phyogs nye rigs tshun chad mkhyen pa'i chos grwar mi 'gro bar rang gar 'dug mi nus so/ tshong ra nas/ gzhung nges cha'i steng nas khas len don mthun ༵༵bas pa ma

gtogs/ rigs lung 'gog thabs byas mi chog ces bslab ston zhib par bstsal zhing / 'dzin grwa gong 'og bsres nas dam bca' khyun ring / skyor sbyangs/ skyor khel 'dzugs pa/ tha na 'khor gsum dang /rnam daphyod slob pa sogs rtsod pa 'phel thabs kho na mdzad pas/ gsar bu rnams la go rigs zung du 'brel ba'i/ thos bsams kyi rkang tshugs shing / rgan pa rnams kyis daspre gzigs dang brjed gsos kyis rtsod pa la yar skyed kyi ngo thon phul du phyin pa mig mthong lag zin zhig yin stabs/ dge bshes mang du 'phel zhing rig gnas bslab pa'i khrod nas kyang / sgra'i slob dpon gyed thub pa brgyad/ sa ris kyi slob dpon thub pa bco brgyad/ dpar yig gi dge rgan thub pa lnga tsam de dus nas byung zhing / gyis su dedus kyi gsar slob mthar phyin pa'i grangs nas kyang mang du byung ba'o/ / se cid rin chen zhes rtsis dkar nag la mkhas pa'i tshad du brtsi ba des/ kho bo sngon chad bong bu ded nas rang yul dang gdan sa 'dir phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas te mar zhag btsong bas ming la de ltar chags/ ma mtha' yi ge mi chod/khyim pa dang khyad med pa la/ grwa tshang rin po che'i gral mjug zin/ khri rin po che 'di bas btsan thabs byas nas rtsis dkar nag slob tu bcug pas/ rjes su gsar slob kha shas kyi dge rgan 'dra ba nyan song bas/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs de skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bamyur ba bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rang yin/bka' drin che zhes zer/ ris med skye bo mchog dman kun gyis gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' gnang ni/ phyogs lhang / g.yo zol gyi skyon dang ma 'dres shing don gyi 'babs legs pas nges par 'khur dgos zhes su yang bka' las mi 'da' ba zhig yin no/ /sprul lo'i dbyar chos kyi chos khri spyan gcig yin par je cher btang ste/ gyan gsum byas/ spyang ris la sngar sku bdun las med pa'i steng du rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs pir thogs dbang po 'jam—dbyangs la zhal bkod mdzad nas/ sku'i cha tshad dang babs 'grig cing nyams dod pas mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren pa bzhengs shing / thog yol gyi ngos la slob gnyer bslatho bya rgyang ring nas klog thub pa bris/ dpe mdzod kyi kha yig skyar du bsgrigs chad pa kha gsab/ dpe thum phul/ bsdus grwa tshar mang po dpar nas gsar du bsnan/ dpe mdzod bkram tshe 'dzin grwa so so'i thal zeng zur bkol/ rtsod pa dang 'brel dgos pa'i bkod khyab zhib mo mdzad/ gdan sa'i dpar khang / mchod rten mthong grol chen mo'i dpar khang / mdzod dge'i dgon sar gyi dpar khang bcas kyi dpar dang dpar yig la do dam gyis 'khyongs pas skyed chen po thon/rje 'di bzo ba 'dra/ sman dang gos kyi bzo gcod/ rgya bod kyi ri mo bcas la'ang phyag 'gro phyir/sa rta lor rje bstan pa'i sgron me'i bde yangs zhes mdo sgad du grags pa de'e tshon rtsi rnying bar/ slar bcos kyi bzo bkod phra zhib thugs kyi 'char ston ltar gsar du bskun/ sku gong ma'i phyag dpe'i dkar chag nor bu'i me long ltar dpe rnying bskyar bsgrigs dang dpe gsar gyi tho bkod sogs zhib tu mdzad/wada~X ༵ngashaṃ sa gsum la'ang / snga phyir rgya mkhar tshang / sgo mang tshang / dpa' ris rwa lo mkhan

po/ gling blo gros rgya mtsho/ snyan grags lung rtogs nyi ma/ ortu su'i bka' 'gyur ba/ hal kha bsam gtan rab 'byams pa/ cha har lha btsun mkhan po sogs gdan sa dang phyogs nas byon pa'i slob ma'i tshogs la dbang lung rjes gnang mang po bstsal zhing / me 'brug lor mdzod dge mid kyi dgon grong /sprul lor khya dge reb tsha pha ri'i dgon gsum/ brag dkar dgon/ rta lor rgya mkhar dgon/ bde thang dgon/ mdo dgon/ lung nag steng / rgyal te'u dgon/ baspya mched dgon/ sa dmar phu mdo/ klu chung rgya mkhar/ rgyal mo dgon sogs dgon grong gis gdan 'dren pa ltar byon te dbang khrid man ngag lung rjes gnang ci 'dod ltar bstsal/rje 'di la cug sbyor rmad du byung ging dgongs pa'i gnad zab pa'i legs bshad kyi bka' rtsom ni/rgyan 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i sa bcad/ 'jug pa'i sa bcad/ gling bsre'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ sde khri tshang nas bskul ba'i skyes rabs kyi kha skong / rje bla ma dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab gnad cha tshang / kun mkhyen gsum pa'i dus mchod dang 'brel ba'i rnam thar/ gsang 'dus bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi 'don thabs dang bcas pa/ mdo sdud pa'i smon cug sogs gsol 'debs smon tshig tshegs gtam gyi skor/ su nyid g.yar ru'i dgon bshad sgrub dar spyas gling gi bca' yig nor bu'i do shal/ sde khri rin po cher phul ba'i brtan bzhugs bshad pa/ don rgyan so lnga'i rtsa sbyong / sgra gzhung rtsom 'asro/gnas stod sogs rnam grangs mang po bzhugs/ nyid kyi sku tshar gyur pa'i grwa rgyun dag ni yang gang gi mthu las bla chen drung gi dkor zan zhes pa min par/ rig gnas spya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dkon mchog blo gsal/ gtsug lag blta ba'i blo mi g.yengs pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po gung thang blo gros tshang zhes grags pa sogs so/ /de yang / dgung lo so drug pa sa lug (1859)lor/ gan go'i khang rgya/ spu gu'i bang rgya/tun rgya zhes/ spya phyug dad ldan gsum gyis bod kyi ri bo pad ma can nam spya'i hā shan zhes pa'i gnas ri'i lha khang zhig gso 'grub pa'i rab gnas/ ma ṇi ril sgrul tshugs pa'i tshogs dbu la/ rje 'di yang yang gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar lebs pa la/ shing kun (thu'u ci)sa sgo'i rgya dpon gyis gung thang ho ye 'dir bzhugs ring la/ rgya bod kyi mjal 'thul sus kyang 'khon 'dzing chang 'thung sogs mi chog cing / ril sgrub gyi ring la sha chang sgog btsong tha ma kha bcas spongs dgos/ zhes yig bsgrags dang / zla phyed sngon nas gtsang spra la gnas shing / smon zla'i tshes gcig la gru gu'i dgon khag bco brgyad/ ('bras spungs thob khungs)sho / khang thog stod ma/ khya dge bcas kyi sor zeng dang / khrom byings nas dar sna tsogs 'phyar ba'i bsu ma dang bcas gnas rir phebs te ril sgrub kyi tshogs dbu mdzad/ tshes gsum la ri rtser byon tshe 'ja' tshon rma bya'i sgro gur ltar phug cing / rtse lnga'i gnas ri dang u rgyan sbob khang sogs ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gru gu'i bla ma gnyis dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis ri rtser gzims khang gsar du bsgrun pa 'bul bar de bzhin byas chog pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad de/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhenga~X0 sdu/ /zhag

bdun la ril bu sgrub pa 'phel te 'jam dbyangs 'chab ma can gyi martsekha steng du kha shas phebs pa kun gyis mthong bas/ rgya mi rnams lhag par dga' dad che bar 'phel/ hwa shang tā zhin dag gis na mo a mi tā bha zhes me mchod phul zhing / spu gu dgon (lcang lung dgon)pa'i 'cham gajigs phul/ gu gu'i bla ma ngag dbang dar rgyas dang yer ba dge bshes bcas nas dam bca' tshugs/ der the bo tshun chad/ shing kun yan gyi rgya bod mjal mi khri phrag lhag la phyag dbang chos 'brel bstsaspyote bkra shis bde skyid kyi dpal la bkod do/ / de nas sho ba dang khang thog stod ma rnams brgyud nas gdan sa'i dbyar chos chen mor chos ra'i brtsi bzhag chag med mdzad/ rigs grwa lo bzhi bor sbyin bdag bzang 'gran/ 'gyen zur bcas ༵ṭwāṃ /skul/ mi dgos par tshur khas len pa 'tshang kha byas pas/ dge 'dun pa'i mthun rkyen mod par gyur ston chos kyi brgyad pa'i tshes lnga'i chos grwar brtsi bzhag gnang nas slar snyon tshe sku bskun bzhes pa rim lod du song bar/ bcu drug nyin khri'i dgongs pa zhus te bcu dgu'i nyin gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/ sems dpa' chen po snyan grags lung rtogs nyi ma nas sku gdung zhugs la sbyangs shing /sku gong ma'i gdung rten dang cha 'dra ba'i dngul gyi byang chub mchod rten bzhengs so/ /(5)khri chen gung thang sku zengalja ba 'a ma dbyangs bstan pa' nyam dbal bzang po/de yang khri chen gung thang sku zeng lnga ba/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gter mdzod dam pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po ni/ sngon khri chen dge 'dun phun chogs pa'i rigs rus kyi 'brel ba ldong byams shul rtse dbus kyi rus pa chad nas kho tshe na yod pa las/ yab bde chen dar rgyas dang yum bsod nams skyid zung gi sras su/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags sprel (1860)lo'i lnga pa'i bzhi rgyal la 'khrungs shing / chu phag lo'i gsum pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin kun mkhyen bzhi pa mchog gtsos/ hor tshang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ zam tsha bsam grub rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyis thogs drangs pa'i khri gdan zur dge 'dun mang bcas kyis gdung mdun nas gzan bsgyur ba rje 'di la babs shing / shing byi (1864)lo'i dgun zla ra ba'i bco lnga'i nyin bsu ba ser sbring gi bkod pa dang bcas/ gung thang bla brang thub bstan skyed tshal gyi khri la mnga' gsol/ lha babs dus chen gyi nyin mang thos 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes par/ mtshan 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes gsol zhing / lnga mchod chen mor lung rigs smra ba'i dbang po rje dkon mchog seng ge pas thog mar ka kha rgyas pa gzigs su bcug rjes/ dge slong skal bzang rgya mtsho klog gi slob dpon du bsten/ dgung lo bdun pa me stag sa zla'i dus chen la rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i drung nas bsod grags sbrul pa'i sku dang lhan du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes shing / dbyar rje de nyid gung thang bla brang du spyan drangs nas skyabs khrid sogs kyi dbang lung rjes gnang zhus pa nas bzung / bka' chos ci gnang chad med du gsan pa la/ rje de'i chos rgyun phal cher bum pa gang phyo'i tshul du bstsal ba'o/ /— 606 —

dgung lo bcu gsum pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu sprel (1872)lo'i 'bras ldan zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin/ tshogs chen khri pa rje sgo mang tshul khrims rgya mcho mchog la ngo ston zhus te rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ rigs pa'i dbang byug rdo rams pa don yon rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten te/ bka' pod lnga'i tshig don la sud lhag ma lus pa'i gsan sbyang dang / chos thun tsam yang ma chag par grwa rkyang dargyus ma'i 'gro stangs bzhin/ gnyom chung tshul mthun kho nas thugs gnyer la brtson pa mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa me byi (1876)lor brtags rigs su phebs tshe/ bsod grags sbrul pa'i sku bsod nams spya mtsho dang rnam gnyis nas blo rig gi tshogs gleng gnang ste/ lung rigs me tog bsil ma'i 'azeng bas mkhas dgu'i yid kyi brtan pa 'dzog par mdzad cing / dam bca' che chung gang gi dus su'ang sgrigs bzo lta bu'i zer zlos mi dgos par/ phyi rgol gyi khas blangs la 'khris pa'i gdon byed lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs pas/ 'phral dang 'phral du phas kyi dam bca' zig med du gzhom nus pa zhig legs so/ / dgung lo nyer gcig pa lcags 'brug (1880)lor 'dul 'dzin chen po bra nye mkhan chen rje ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gung thang dge legs bde yangs su spyan drangs te/ bslab gzhi yongs rdzogs dge slong gi dngos por bsgrags/ dgung lo nyer bzhi pa 'dzin grwa mdzod du phebs te mdzod rtsa thugs 'dzin gyi steng du kun la zhib gzigs kyi thugs 'dun che na'ang / wang gi pho brang sa ṭākyār/ sde/ pas bsreg pa sogs bla brang nang 'khrugs kyi dbang gis dpe gzigs ni thugs bzhed ltar ma byung dgung lo nyer lnga pa sheng sprel (1884)lor/ dbus gtsang gnas su zhib mjal/ dad 'bul gyi nor sna gang yod dkon mchog mchod pa dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur kho na'i ched du bzhed de/ smon zla'i bco lnga'i nyin dbus su phyag btegs lha ldan nas bla ma dkar bo'am tsha kan ho thog thus bod ljongs zil gyis gnon pa'i dus dang 'grad gyir/ tshe smon gling du bzhugs te thugs mos ltar gyi 'dod chos mang du spel dgos pa byung / bya bzhag kun la rje de nyid kyi drin las bcos sla bya bde 'ba' zhig byung ngo / /smin zla'i nyer gcig nas gnas mjal gyi rim pa ni/ tshal gung thang / brag yer ba nas rin chen sgang /chos 'khor rgyal/ lha mo bla mtsho/ zangs ri mkhar dmar/ gdan sa mthil/ dpal bsam yas/'phyong rgyas/ lho brag sna bo spyogs/ sras mkhar dgu thog de nas spyal rtse/ bkra shis lhan po/ snar thang / dpen sa/ rong byams chen/ snye thang / rwa ba stod bcas su phebs te rten mjal gnas gzigs/ mchod 'bul bsnyen bkur/ bsngo smon nan tan mdzad bzhin par rgyal zla'i nyer lngar slar dbus su 'byor/ shing bya (1885)lo'i lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i dkar phyogs bzang ba gsum pa'i nyin/ phyag na pad mo rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog tshogs dbur gdan grangs te brtan bzhugs rje (sbyin bdag)rang gis phul zhing dngul rdo tshad nyer brgyad kyi dngos 'bul dang / dge 'dun khri ra can la ja thug nyin khyong dngul ṭa re'i 'gyed dang / tha na sprang sbyin yang mngadra patang / chogs mchod — 607 —

grol rjes su slar mdo snad du chibs bsgyur/ de nas dbyug zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin kun mkhyen bzhi pa'i drung du lca i ba'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha re gnyis kyi dbang gsan par byon/dgung lo nyer bdun pa me khyi (1886)lo'i dbyar rigs smra dkon mchog bstan pa dang sdebagate 'dus ba'i chogs gling mdzad par/ bstod bsngags dbyar skyes rnga gsang mkhas dgu'i ngag las lhan du skyes so/ /ston dgon sar rab rgyas gling gi khrir byon/ sho ba khang thog lcang lung dgon dag tu phebs nas 'dod chos ci rigs spel/ phag lo'i smon lam grol rjes slar gdan sar phyon te/ rje ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho las snga phyir nyid kyis zhus pa ltar/ bka' gdams pa chos bu chos/ rwa pod dpal pod sogs chos rgyun dkon pa mang po'i zhal lung gi khrid gsan/ nag zlar pu rad tho yon gyis zhus ngor gsang ldan gyi dbang dang / sa blar/ pā rin zhabs drung gis zhus ngor nyid nas byams chos lde lnga'i klog lung / ru stod ma'i khri yang mdzad/ sgos su dgon sar nas 'don chos dbyangs rta dang / dpar gyi rgyug nan mo bzhes shing / dgon phan tshun gyi 'chad nyan la do dam gang drag mdzad/ a 'khor/ wa ṣṭṛ rnyiṭwāṃ// khya dge sogs su zhabs bskyod de 'brel tshad don ldan dang / skyi thang ma ṇi pa 'das pa'i mgon dgung lo nyer dgu pa sa byi (1888)lo'i smon lam skyi sger gyi mdzad sgo kun sngar ltar mdzad de khri'i khur bzhag dbo zla'i bco lngar she'u tshang sgar sar gyi khri ston gnang ste 'char can gyi brtsi bzhag sogs 'grig lam che phra dag le shor med pa mdzad/ dbyar sog po nas chin wang dpal 'byor rab brtan la dbang rjes gnang sogs bstsal/ slar byon nas dgon de'i cug rgyug dang rtsod rgyug sogs dmar par mdzad de/ chas pa dbyis kyis zhus pa ltar phebs bzhud gnang ste gang mos kyi chos rgyun spel ba'i bka' drin bskyangs/ dgung lo sum cu pa sa glang lor sku bskun par kun 'khyen mchog gi bslab ston ltar phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi lo mtshams mdzad/ khrums zla'i mjug la rje ngag dbang mtshan can gyi sku chos dbyings su bskyod par mchog khrus dang dgongs rdzogs kyi thebs kyang phul/ she'u tshang sgar sar la sbyi 'jog gnang ste khri mtshams zhus/ stag lo'i dbyar rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon nas tshogs chos 'grig lam la dag thon dang gtong sgo 'char can bcas gang ci'i 'dzin skyong mdzad de/ yos lo'i dbyar nyin ma'i rtse dbus ri khrod sogs su 'phrod bsten byed par byon/dgung lo so gsum pa chu 'brug (1892)lo'i smin zla'i nyer lnga la gdan sa'i kyai rdor grwa tshang gi (khri rabs dgu pa)mdzad de/ tshogs chos 'grig lam gyi rim pa zhib gtsang gnang / skul lo'i mchu zla'i bcu gcig nyin rigs ldan nyer lnga'i 'al thang gsar bzhengs der yab rje drung nas rab gnas zhus te/nyid jun gar dang hal ha'i phyogs su 'byon bzhed yod pa'i snyan sgron phul bar/ bod zla'i yar tshes la kun mkhyen yab sras lhan rgyas nas sgod smad la phebs na bstan 'gror sman pa'i gsung grol/de ni kun mkhyen bzhi pa'i rang rnam las/ shing rta (1894)lo dgung lo so bzhi pa'i dpyid hal — 608 —

ha'i hung the jis gdan drangs pa'i re ba skong sbyir chibs kha bsgyur par/ sku 'bum brgyud de u chen thor god du 'byor/ de nas hal ha'i hung the ji'i yal nas 'jam sna pos mtshams sbyar te dbang lung rjes gnang ci zhus bstsal/ lug lor jun gar gyi al tha dang / thor god khag bzhi (da lta'i shin cang gi sog po'i khul dang dzong)nas skul ba'i ngor/ al tha gser ri'i lho byang kun zhabs kyis bcags te/gang la gang 'tshams kyis 'gro phan rgya chen bskyangs shing / 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i sgron lam gyi mtshams sbyar yang dag pa mdzad/ phyogs de'i skya ser dag kyang rje 'di la mi gyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'o/ / me bya'i mchu zla'i bcu dgu'i nyin/ rnga mong brgya la dkar po zhig gi mgo 'dzin dang bcas tshal 'go nas gdan sar babs/ de la sgad beebs thog ma zhes so/ /de nas kun mkhyen la dngul srang stong dang bzhi brgya'i 'byor phyag bla sbrul khag la sku skal bsngo rten/dge 'dun gyi sde la dngul 'agled kyi bsnyen bkur bcas mdzad/dgung lo bzhi bcu ba sa phag (1899)lor slar yang u chen zong god brgyud de drung beed (sbyi sog)du byon/ lcags byi (1900 )lor a ta han (da lta su'u len)du byon te 'dod chos mang po spel/ thur me 'ga' thu (shin cang tha khrin)mu mi ri bcas nas dbang dang rjes gnang yid tshim pa gnang zhing / sgos su phar me ga thu'i dgon par phyag rdor gtum chen gyi dbang bstsal/ dur bed du slar byon nas spyi la sman bla dang bsgrub bya so bzhi lhag bsnyen rdzogs su bkod/ thor god dpon po la seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang bstsal/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa lcags glang (1901)lor gung thang mchod rten skyar gso'i ched du ta rig gang ga'i (byi sog)phyogs su phyag btegs te/ dgon spyi la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang / 'ga' zhig la dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ o li ho thog (su nyin g.yas ru'i)dgon nas mngon rtogs spyan gyi lung dang rjes gnang du ma spel te mtsho mdun du phebs/ nye ba'i sras brgyad sgrun pa'i bzo grwa btsugs te yas mas kyi 'gro phan rgya chen bsgrubs/ chu stag lo thor god dgon nas 'khor chen gyi dbang gnang ste hal ha'i phyogs su bhon/ ta chen bī si'i dgon nas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang dang mang po snga phyi'i bslabs par bkod/bee ra han am lhan gyis gdan drangs te dngos 'bul rgya chen bstar/ khrums zla slar gdan sar byon/lam nas zhwa lu ba'i sprul sku sogs la dge tshul bsgrubs/ mgo zla'i yar tshes la gdan sar 'byor/ de la smad phebs gnyis pa zhes so/ /dgung lo zhe bzhi ba chu yos (1903)lo'i dpyid khri reb re dgu ba'i khri ston mdzad/ dbyar yab rje mchog khams phyogs su byon shul nas/ gdan sa'i 'chad nyan dang spyi sger gyi sgrig lam gtsang thon pa yong re kun la mchis shing / nyid nas kyang de mthar gyi bzhed dgongs zab na'ang / shing 'brug lo nas sku gzugs ma bde bar yod pas rigs grwar 'char 'phar gyi gtong sgo'i rigs dang 'du khang chen mor gos chen gyi gnam rgyan phul ba sogs bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas mdzad de khri'i las khur phog dus der/dbus gtsang du phyi gling gis 'khrugs zing rkyen gyis rgyal dbang mchog kyang dbang phyogag su ṭwāṃ~X pa dang /

khams phyogs dge ldan gyi dgon pa 'ga' zhig la chags nyams byung /dgung lo zhe bdun pa me rta (1906)lor dbo zlar gdan sa nas lan jo/ lang rjo'i sde bzhi brtsed de/ chu stod zla bar as tha thor god (da lta shin cang)du byon/ me lug deka'i wang gtsos che sauhrag bsdus la tshe dbang dang / 'ga' zhig bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrubs/ bee se'i dgon/ tsog chen (phyi sog)gung dgon bstan pa'i mu lu so sor chos kyi bdud rtsi bstsal zhing / de nas ba ra han (da lta su lan)du phebs te 'dod chos ci rigs spel/ 'du khang la rab gnas dang yul lha'i lab tse gsar du bzhagakhrums zla slar zhal bsgyur tshul kun mkhyen zhal nas/ rgyal zla'i tshes gnyis la gung thang sprul pa'i sku rin po che nged dbus 'gro'i ched snad phyogs su 'bul sdud phebs pa sbyir 'asnyor zhing / tshes lnga'i gyin dngos mjal thog gsung gling dmar/ dbus 'gro'i cha rkyen du dngul srang nyis khri 'byor pa sprad ces gsung ba ni smad phebs gsum pa zla ba'o/ /sa sprel lor gung thang mthong grol chen mo'i bum pa'i steng dang logs kun gser zangs kyi nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyis brgyan te/ tshoms chen gnyis/ dge legs bde yang bskyar gso dang bde yang zhol lam mdo sngags chos kyi dga' tshal basbon pa spub/chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil btabs nas lo nyis brgya zin pa/ gang nyid dgung lo lnga bcu pa sa bya (1909)lo'i nag zla'i tshes lngar yab rje mchog nang chen du rgyan drangs te gser dngul/ na bza' nye spyad sogs rnam grangs stong dbus rdzongs su bstab/ de nas khong kho tsho'i gur sgar gyi khri bar bskos pa dang len mdzad/ khro kho smad ma/ chu kha ma byams me dgon grong gis zhus pa ltar byon te chos 'brel gnang / lcags khyi lor/ gur sgar gyi dgon sa nyin nas slar sngar gnas su spos par dge ltas mang phyir der 'khor kun dga' dad mchog tu rgyas/ 'du khang dang gzim khang bcas lo der spub na'ang /sku skun drag po bzhes pas gdan sar byon zhing / sku'i 'phrod bsten gyi ched du dngul rwa'i mes tshal nags klung nas rma chu bzhes te dgun bzhugs gnang / lcags phag (1911)lor khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i skye ri gnyan po a skya rtse drug tu grags pa'i rtser phebs pa mkha' ngos su 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo rgyas shing / bsang dang dar cog gter 'bul gnang / dme rgyal blon sogs bar gyi grong sde kun nas bsu ba dang bkur bzos phu dud cher byas/ mtshan nyid dgon nas ja thug steng dngul srang re'i 'gyed dang /khyi la bzang gos kyi ka 'phan che legs gser mgo can bzhi phul zhing dong dang rjes gnang du ma bstsal/a mchog rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho mchog nas sems bskyed pa'i sa su shel dkar gyi 'azeng ba brgya rtsa gcig phul/ de nas rgyal rong da tshang dgon pas nan zhus 'byor bar cog tse pas rta thab dang bcas dgon nas 'dod chos ci zhus gnang / dkar chen dgon/ sgang ba ri khrod/ kiti'i dgon sar/ kha shul ri khrod rnams su byon nas chos 'brel dang / sgo mang ra nas mtshan nyid gsar tshugs kyi rtsodashaṃ ga ༵༵sa te dbu phar 'dul gsum rtsi bzhag tu gnang / rgyud grwar 'brel ba dbu tshugs/ dbal

shul gca' tshang dang chu kha ma'i nang ma 'cham pa la 'dum mdzad de/ tha skar bla bar 'bo ra/ a mchog tsa yus/ mdzo dge'i gir sar dag la pebs bzhud dang / gur sgar du byon nas bya bzhag kun la 'azal yun du phan pa'i zhal gdams gnang / chu byi lor gdan sa'i sman pa grwa tshang gis zhus ngor rta mgrin padma gar dbang sogs kyi dbang lung rjes gnang dang / thu'u bkwan dam chos nyi ma pas skul ngor mi tra'i dbang / krang gya zhabs drung dkon mchog rgya mtsho pas zhu ngor zur bka'i dbang gang yod pa phal cher gnang ba'o/ / dbyar gur sgar nas yab rje tsong khar byon yod par mjal bzhed kyis chibs btegs te/sog po/ mgar rtse/ hor so nag bdud shul/ 'ba' mang ra/ sgo me chab tsha brgyud de stong skor nas zhal 'dzoms pa kun mkhyen rang rnam las/ khrums stod zla ba'i bco lngar gung thang mchog sprul 'tshams zhu dang smad phyogs su phebs rgyu'i don skor zhu ba gcig 'thus su phebs pa khong ngo 'khor la mjal zhus phul zhing gsung 'phros mang du 'phel/ phebs khar gtso cher sku tshe yun brtan dgos tshul gyi zhu nan phul// rnyi rdo'o/ / /de nas sku 'bum du mchod sdong chen mor mchod 'bul dang rten mjal gnang ste slar gur sgar dgung lo nga bzhi pa chu glang (1913)lo'i nag zlar kun maspren dbus nas gdan sar byon pa'i sri zhu la/ mang nyug ser po las grub pa'i gzim gur gtsos ras gur brgya/ gdan cha ca lag sogs ltad mo che ba'i bkod pa tshar du dngar bas se chang sa sne nas tshes gsum nyin gyi zhag babs bsnyen bkur dang / sku gsung thugs rten/ chibs chen ngang ba gser mdog dngul dang gos phrug sogs legs skyes kyi dngos 'bul bstabs/ chu stod zla bar yab rje mchog gur sgar bde chen chos 'khor gling du byon par bsu ba dang bcas gzim khang du sbyan drangs te khri'i dgongs pa zhus/dgung lo nga lnga pa shing stag (1914)lo'i mchu zlar gdan sa nas nag zla'i bcu dgu la hal ha'i phyogs su 'byor/ har shin kun tā le dgon par 'khor chen gyi dbang dang lha khang la bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor/ hal ha thi the sprul pa'i sku rab tu byung / de nas byon lam du hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul brgyud pa dang mjal 'dzoms thog dngos 'bul btegs/ u ru si'i am bhan dang 'phrad pas lam yig dang rgya gser gos chen sogs kyi skyes dang bcas dga' bas mthun grogs gang legs byas/ de nas pu rad su ke la(zegs med) dgon du 'byor bar bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas dang bcas zhus ngor/'jigs byed kyi dbang / drag po gsum sgril kyi rjes gnang / bsgrub bya drug cu lhag cugs snga phyi bslab pa la bkod/ mkhon khu re nas bsgrub bya dgu bcu tsam dge tshul slong bslab par bkod de/ gser chos bcu gsum gyi dbang / po ti lnga'i rtsa lung bcas bstsal/ tsa bu su'u dgon/ cho lo ti'i dgon/ a na dgon/ i gu thi'i dgon/ shis chang gu dgon/ a wol dgon chen/ co ka la'i dgon rnams la byon nas gang mos kyi chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ dgon pa sum cu lhag gis dgon mgo phul ba zhal bzhes mdzad/ de nas rang rgyal byang shar gyi har pen brgyud de me gru nas pho brang du phebs/ byang ri'i rtse nas — 611 —

bsang dang dkar gtor phul/ de ltar bzhed don rnams legs par thub nas slar gdan sar mgo 'i tshes gcig la 'phyor ba de ni smad phebs bzhi pa'o/ /de yang / dgung lo nga bdun pa me 'brug (1916)lor kun mkhyen bzhi pa'i dgongs pa chogadabyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan par/ thugs ngal bzod med dang bcas myur 'byor gsol 'debagaljags rtsom mdzad/ 'on kyang de'i dbyar nas bzung srid skyong dbal mang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho pa dang phyag mdzod brtson 'grus gnyis ma 'chams par tshong ra'i gyang yig zer ba'i don dag bud par/ mā chi tshang gis thong shi dmar ldang gzu bar mngags mod/ 'on kyang / srid skyong tshang nas bla brang gi don dag ni sngon ltar las gzhan pas the gtogs byed mi dgos zhes/ thong shi phyir bskud pa sogs byung /dgung lo nga dgu ba sa rta (1918)lo'i dpyid ma chi tshang gi dmag glo bur du 'ong bar/ bla brang naspodrag tu 'thab kyang ma thub par a mchog dgon pa 'jig srid skyong tshang zhal ma bzhugs pa sogs dus log byung bas na/ srid skyong gi las khur gzur thabs med par rje 'di la babs pa'o/ / de dus/lcags phag lo'i dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis gsar rnying gi phyogs zhen che ba spyi dang / yang sgos su bla brang na rgya bod kyi rtsod pa che gyir/ srid skyong ba ni bzung na lag pa/ phud na spo ma'i dpe bzhin yin rung /sngar shing stag lor yab rje mchog nas/ stod paṇa chen mchog gi gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dang / snad na rang re'i dgon pa bkra shis 'khyil 'di gnyis po rkyen ci la thug rung lag chu mi len pa dang / ser dmag ma byas pa'i dbang gis 'chad nyan dang 'grig lam sogs lugs gnyis char nas yar rgyas su 'gro ge'adi byung ba yin/ zhes bslab ston gnang ba ltar rje 'dis dka' las sku tshegs mang po khyad du bsad de/gang la gang 'tshams de la de ston gyi thabs dang shes pas/ gdan sa yul sde skyong khur dang / gdan sa'i bla sbrul mang po mdo khams dbu gtsang 'grims nas yab rje yang sprul gyi don gnyer pa la bkod khyab rgya chen mdzad/dgung lo re gcig pa lcags sprel (1920)lor gong sa paṇa chen mchog nas yab rje yang sbrul tu thugs thag bcad pa ltar/ mchu zlar rje nyid gyis gtsor mdzad pa'i mi sna khams spo 'bor sgang gi li thang mtshe ma grong du byon te/ bod zla'i bco lnga'i nyin li thang byams chen mdun nas mchog gi sprul ba'i sku la gtsug phud 'breg cing ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan phul/ de nas zhal myur du gdan sar sgyur dgos tshul skul ba'i tshe na/ yab chen mgon po don spub nas/ gal te nga tsho 'gro dgos na/ bla brang gi dbang ni gang gi khu bo ngag dbang don spub la sprod pa dang gcig lha sde mi sdes sku gong ma'i dus ltar bkur ba dang / ma chi tshang gi dmag slar zlog pa dang gsum ni yong thub pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos zhes gros gzhi bton pa la/nyid nas mā dmag slar zlog pa ni rang lag min pa las gzhan gnyis po ni ci gsung ltar sgrub ces par gros mthun/ de nas khrums zlar kun mkhyen lnga pa chen mo yab sras lhan rgyas kyis zhal gdan sar phyogs pa lha sde mi sde dī ṭwāṃ~X rta thab kyi bkod bsu dang / rje nyid kyang rma klung du bsu bar phebs te lha babs dus chen

gyi nyin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i ser sbreng dang bcas bla brang thub bstan pho brang gi chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol/bla ma khri gdan zur/ sku rtsa sku bdag gsar rnying/ chogs 'du las sna/ yul kha'i mi sna bcas zhal lhan gcig 'dzoms pa'i dbus su/ mtshel dang bcas rnam grangs stong gi dngos 'bul dang / bla brang gi thel tham ka sogs phul te srid skyong gi las khur phogs so/ /dgung lo re gnyis pa nas gdan sa dang ri khrod res mos su gang 'dod dag la dbang lung rjes gsum bstsal/ sku'i 'phrod brten ched du gnas skor mdzad dus kyang der 'khod rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsis re ba bskangs ba'o/ / gsung rtsom gyi rigs la/ rgyal dbang thub bstan spya mcho mchog bcas la phul ba'i brtan bzhugs dang martsel gyi bshad pa'i skor/ kun mkhyen bzhi pa sogs kyi yang sbrul byur 'byor gyi skor/lcang skya'i rnam thar kha skong / khrid bshad kyi skor/ a mchog mtshan nyid sogs nas gnang ba'i bslab ston dang gsung bshad kyi skor/ dngul rwa'i gser legs sogs yul lha'i gsol mchod kyi skor/ gsan yig chab shog dang chings yig sogs rnam grangs mang ba'o /gyi ba'i lor gong sa paṇa chen mchog gi zhal lang jo ru bsgyur bar ched du mjal te chos rgyun dkon pa du ma phul ba sogs sku dngos kyi gdul bya phal cher rdzogs pas na/ dgung lo re drug pa shing glang (1925)lor/ ma chi tshang gis bla brang la gnod 'tshe ba pa'i lo der/ nyid kyi sku skun nas kho tshe na bzhugs pa khri chen zam tsha lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mtshan lam du/ shel dam chen po'i nang nas g.yu 'brug cig lho phyogs su 'phur ba rmis te da ni zhal mi 'tsho ba kho thag red gsung na'ang / ston rma chu bzhes par rtse dbus ri khrod du chibs ba ra/ dbyug zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i nyin be shin dgon dga' ldan rab rgyas gling gi rgyal mkhan chen gyi gzim khang ra ba thang shing gis brgyan pa de nas/ zhal lho ru phyogs shing byams bzhugs mdzad par skung zug med kyang thugs dam la bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas gser khri rnam gnyis kyis gtsor mdzad de bee shing dang gur rgar nas mchod smrin rgya chen bstar bzhin par sku gdung gdan sa nas gdung zhugs su phul/ gung thang blo gros rin po che nas yang sprul tshad ldan zhig 'byon ba'i rten 'brel du/rin chen phra rgyan dag dngul gi rgyab tu bkod pa bcas kyi phyag las gnang ste/ gung thang bla brang thub bstan skyed tshal du dge legs bde yangs su bzhugs su gsol nas rab gnas zhus pa'o/ /(6)khri chen gung thang sku zeng drug pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs bral phyogs las rnamachul dpal bzangapo/'jam dbyangs bla ma je btsun 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo ni/ rje gnya' khri btsan po'i rgyal rgyud las 'phros pa dga' ye shes dar rgyas zhes pa'i rgyud nas mdzod dge'i dpon rgyud rgyas pa'i nang tshan byams me'i dpon po dga' 'jig med rdo rje dang bzhag bza' pad dkar skyid gnyis kyi sras su/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me stag (1926)lo'i mchu zla'i bcu gsum gyi tho rangs stag gi dus su nya gang zla ba lta bu'i 'od lhang zhig nam mkha' nas khyicad du ṭwāṃ~Xng ba dang

lhan sku bltams/ gtsang bla dga' chen pas paṇa chen skyabs zhes mtshan gsol/ dgung lo drug pa lcags lug (1931)lo'i dbo zla'i bcu gcig la kun mkhyen lnga ba mchog gis bla brang 'bum stod jo bo'i mdun nas thugs thag bcad de/ nag zla'i bco lngar kha dar phul zhing chu bla'i bco lngar sde khri mkhyen rab rgya mtsho mchog nas na bza' phul/ lha babs dus chen la bsru ba sor zeng dang bcas bla brang bkra shiga'akhyil du gung thang bla brang gi khri la mnga' gsol/ dgung lo bdun pa chu sprel(1932)lo'i co 'phrul zla tshes brgyad la/ gung thang dge legs bde yangs nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po rje 'jigs thed 'azin las rgya mtsho 'al snga gnas kyi mkhan po/ bshes gnyen chen po paṇa chen sku zeng bcu pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin bsang khog 'jigs med tshang nas las slob bcas mdzad de rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan la 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes gsol/skyabs 'gro dang rten 'brel bstod pa'i lung bstsal/ klog slob pa'i dbu tshugs/ nag zlar dge ba'i bshes gnyen dmu dge thub bstan rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ dgung lo bcu ba sheng phag (1935)lo'i dgun chos chen mor tshogs chen khri ba sde khri mkhyen rab rgya mtsho mchog la ngo ston zhus te sgad byung thos bsam gling gi chos sgor zhugs/ me byi lor/ gong sa paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma mchog gis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ba gsan/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i steng ge'u dug nas sku bskun tshabs chen bzhes par/ byams me dpon bla'i mtshan lam du/ rje sesgye yi rnam 'phrul byang du byon/ rta bdun bdag po'i bgrod pa mkha' la byur/ /stod du sgyur ba'i mdzad bzang khams kun bde/ /nag phyogs chu 'dzin bslad pa mkha' la yal/ / zhes yong ba dang dam po'i lung bstan ltar mimachog mtshan nyid dgon du byon rjes sku bskun dwangs/ a mchog rin po che nas tshe dbang / gza' nad pa rjes 'dzin gyi dbang bde mchog bong zhal gyi dbang sogs ched du bstsal/ kun mkhyen mchog la dbus bsu las cher ma byon par tshogs chos grwa chag med du rgyugs brtsi bzhag 'dzin sbyong mdzad/ rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog la dbang bka' rjes gnang khrid lung sogs mang du zhus/ gzhan gyis zhus la'ang chad med du gsan par byon pa la/ gang gi chos rgyun phal cher bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal/dgung lo bcu dgu ba shing sprel lo'i phar na dam bca' 'jog par thugs rig rno zhing yig cha nges pa zhes mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan thob/dgung lo nyi shu ba shing bya (1945)lor a mchog rin po che zhal ma bzhugs pas sngon khong nas bcol dam gnang ba ltar dpal ldan smra seng gling la 'dzin skyong lo mang po mdzad/ sa khyi (1946)lor sog po'i khag gsum tsho hur 'dus spyi nas zhus pa ltar/ drug pa'i bco lngar gad dmar thang nas skya ser khri lhag la/rje 'di bas dus 'khor dbang chen thengs dang po bstsal/ mtshan nyid du zhal ngo dang rdo rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog pa'i srol tshugs/ me phag lor yab rje dgongs pa gzhan du gtad par gdan sar ched bskyodzee kyi~X ༵gongs rdzogs mchod sbyin phul/ zla bcu par rgyal rong khro skyabs thugs rje chen po'i mdun

nas 'jigs byed bdag 'jug gsung skabs/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas bdud rtsi chu bzhin babs pa der pod kun gyis mthong / sa byi lor rdzi 'gag rgyal bos zhus pa ltar rje bee ro tsa nas btab pa'i chu 'pho nor bu gling nas/ rgyal blon chen po brag bar 'chi med dbang rgyal dang da ro sogs skya ser sum stong lhag la/ dbo zla'i bco lnga nas dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs gnyis pa) bstsal te yul de'i dud nag 'debs pa'i srol bcad/ phyir phebs nas rje 'jigs med 'azin las rgya mtsho mchog gi dgongs pa chos dbyings su thims par gdung mjal bsgrags mchod sprin rgya chen bstar/ zi ling ched du byon te gong sa pan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog la snyan zhu phul ba ltar a mchog rin po che'i yang sprul thugs brtag bcad/ dgung lo nyer bzhi pa sa glang (1949)lor sku yul byams me nas zhus pa ltar/ khrums zla'i bco lngar dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs gsum pa)bstsal/ sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mcho bcas skya ser gyi tshogs pa khri 'dus/ mdzod dge stod sgad gyi dpon po tshor bcing 'grol dmag ka chur lebs pa la 'brel ba dgos pa'i skul ma gnang ngo / /yos lo'i tshogs mchod la gdan sa'i bla ma las sna/ yul shog gi mi sna'i tshogs 'du la rje 'di bas gtso skyong mdzad nas/ paṇa chen mchog gdan drangs te skyabs rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku zeng drug pa thugs brtag bcad/ lo mjug pe cin du mi rigs bya ba'i tshogs 'dus byon te mi rigs 'dra mnyam/sa gnas rang skyong / chos dad rang dbang / dgon sde srung skyong zhes pa'i srid jus ni rtag tu dgos pa nan gyis gsungs/ 'brug lo'i dbo zla'i bcu gcig la kun mkhyen drug pa rin po che khrir bkod par dngos 'bul bstar/ dbyar ska khog na bzhugs par khro bcu da dung bcing 'grol ma thob par dmag mang po 'dus tshe/ mi shi rgyu spyong che ba thugs kyis ma bzod par zung chu/ sku nye(mong win)pha shul (win khron)sogs su byon te zhi ba'i thabs su rem dgos tshul bsgrags/ sbrul lor ska khog tu bzhugs nas bstan dar gling bskrun/ dmag sar ma dang gser khri ru ba der yod tsod rku dang jag khrims bsdams/dgong lo nyer dgu ba shing rta (1954)lor gdan sa'i bla spyi gzhung gsum gyi mi sna bstan dar gling du yong ste/ kun mkhyen mchog sprul rin po che'i thugs bzhed ltar tshogs chen khri ba mdzad dgos pa'i snyan zhu phus bar thugs dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes/ lha babs dus chen la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs lnga ba'i khri ston mdzad/ de dus kun mkhyen bla ma gtsor mdzad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnam pa'i sku tshe brtan zhing / grwa stong phrag gsum dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri 'dra brag 'dra mang po zhal 'tsho ba'i bla brang dar sgang yin stabs/ gzhan gyis phul ba'i dngos 'bul gang mchis bla ma grwa tshang la bsngo ba mdzad de rigs grwa gsum la bsnyen bkur gyi mchod thin spya chen bstar/ shing lug lor khong bla brang khri'i khur bzhes pa'i ring la rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis bkra shis 'khyil du byon skabs skal bzang ldan zhing thugs rje chen po dang 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang gsan/ dbyug zlar yong 'dzin mchog zhal 'tsho bar thugs nges mdzad cing dgongs rdzogs chen po bsgrubs/ me sprel lor sog po'i mda' tshan gyis zhus ngor khrums zla'i bco — 615 —

lngar thang skya lkob nas dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs bzhi ba)bstsal ba la/ zhing chen gsum/ rdzong khag nyer gcig las 'dus pa'i tshogs pa khri las brgal/ dbyar ska khog nas sman chu rnyed pa dang da ltagung thang man chu zhes nad pa mang po la sman/ me bya lor co no'i chas bu gshis dgon grong gnyis nas nan gyis zhus pa bzhin/ rje rab brtan rgya mtsho mchog gtso mdzad pa'i slob ma khri lhag la nag zla'i bco lnga dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs lnga ba)bstsal/ de nas bdun pa'i bco lnga'i nyin ched du gdan sa'i grwa ba re'i phyag tu ta khug gang / dngul skor dgu skyabs 'jug gi yi ge re phul te khrums zla'i bco lngar khri mtshamamimadzad/ de nas ska khog tu chibs bsgyur/ sngar mi dmangs dang rgyal khab la phan ched du btsugs pa'i gung thang zhi bde'i 'o phye bzo grwa phal cher spub/ rje 'dis mdzad pa'i gsung mgur gyi par shing mdzod dge'i sgar sar gyis phud do/ /dgung lo so gsum pa sa khyi (1958)lo'i bod kyi lo sar ska khog nas mdzad cing zhabs zhu ba chos kyi rgyal po lhan skyes rol ba'i rnam thar gyi zlos gar 'khrab/ de dus mi mang bos da ni khyed re zhig la phyi rgyal du phebs na bzang zhes zhus par/ zhal nas bstan 'gro'i don du/ bla ma grwa tshang / sbyin bdag slob ma tsho dang lhan du skyid sdug mnyam khur byed rgyu yin zhes gsungs/ de nas 'jam dbyangs smra song gling gis sngar nas zhus pa ltar/ a mchog dgon grong gi ser skya khri lhag la dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs drug pa)bstsal/ de tsam na si khron zhing chen nas khyed khri 'du phebs dang gros zhig yod ces pa'i brda ltar snyon zhor du/ glang chen 'gying rir mjal nas bstan 'gro'i don thugs smon gzab nan gnang / bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bzhi la gsar brje ngo log pa red ces zhes si khron khri 'du nas khrims su sbyar te lan spu'u mkhar gyi btson khang du lo ngo nyer gcig btson khang du bsam pa'i bcos bsgyur byas nas ma zad/ khong gis dbon gnyer kyang khrims rtsar lhung nas gdan sa'i gung thang bla brang du las byed ru khag gis mdzod dang dngos rdzos tshang ma gzhung bzhes byed do/ dgung lo nga bzhi ba sa lug (1979)lo'i bcu gsum la mtho rim mi dmangs khrims khang nas rje 'di ba nag nyes ci yang med zhes btson las krol te dka' 'don legs par mdzad do/ de nas kan lhor byon par lam du dad ldan gyi mjal ba stong phrag du ma ched du yong /khrin 'du/ lu han/ hang kru'u/ hwang lha sogs su lta skor ru byon no/ /dgung lo nga lnga ba lcags sprel (1980)lo'i spyi zla gsum pa'i nyer gcig slar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du byon tshe ser skya stong phrag du ma 'dus shing lam thar dka' ba la/ sgan pa'i 'du khang nas mjal kha gnang / de nas kun mkhyen rim bhon dang rje 'jigs med 'azin las rgya mtsho'i sku gdung bcas la mjal te sgor khri lhag dgon pa zhig gso'i thebs su phul/ gung thang bla brang dang mchod rten gyi shul yang bkra mi shis par dgon pa'i sum cha'i gcig las lus med pa'o/ / bsang kho tshe/ 'bor a mchog tsa yu rdo dkar/ mdzod dge kha gya/ hor tshang mda' med bcas kung hre mang bor phebs/ sa rtsod che zhing slob grwa zhan tshuṭwāṃ1 sdugarji pas slob gso gal che tshul dpe dang don du sbyar ba'i gsung mang du gnang ste/ mjal

dar gyi sgor khri lhag slob grwa bcu la gnang / ston paṇa chen rin po ches bla brang dgon pa la gzigs rtogs mdzad dus/ 'di ba dgon pa'i do dam khang gi kru'u rin la bzhugs dgos pa'i bka' gnang / lcags bya'i lor bla brang dgon du bla grwa nyis brgya lhag la khang sa bgos pa dang / lha khang zhig gso/ gna' sa do dam bcas kyi gros 'go mdzad/ kan snyo'i tang srid nas ging chen la zhus/ zhing chen gyis bskul ba ltar/ mi bsad rta 'khyig che ba'i mdzod dge dang co ni/ kho tshe dang mda' tshan/ nyi ma lung dang ma nges bar la byon te gyod ya phan tshun la go ston dang ro bdag la chos sbyin gnang ste sa rtsod kyi spyod gzhi bsdum nas chings yig so sor ming rtags bkod/ dngul rwa dgon pa'i chos sgo phyes/ dgun rgyal yongs srid gros u yon du bskos/ chu khyi lo'i dbyar chu kha ma dme ru ma'i sa don (kan su'u dang si khron bar) zhes lo mang po'i 'thab rtsod de zhi ba'i tshed du sgebs par phyogs so so nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba mang bor mthun sgril dang dus bde yong ba'i gsung nan po gnang / ring nas dad pa dang dam tsheg gis 'brel ba'i a mchog mtshan nyid du zhal bsgyur pas na ska khog gi dmag sar ma dang 'o ma'i bzo grwas kyang ched du gdan 'dren zhus/ ston gong sa paṇa chen mchog bla brang du byon dus/ 'di bas lo gnyis dgon pa do dam gyi snyan zhu sbrags/ da ni do dam gyi las khur de bstan pa'i bdag pos mdzad na legs tshul zhus pas/ kun masgon mchog nas dgon pa do dam mdzad pa'i khur bzhes/ gong sa paṇa chen rin po che kan lho rdzong bdun dang / si khron gyi mdzod dge dmar thang / rnga ba/ 'bar khams sogs su gzigs rtogs su byin pa'i zhabs su lhur len mdzad/ chu phag lor kan su'u dang mtsho sngon bar gyi bee si dang mdzod dge nyin ma'i bar gyis sa rtsod la mi she khyim 'thor gyi gnod pa sel bar zi ling / sog po/ rma chu sogs su byon te sku tshags mang po bzhes/ shing byi lo'i dbyid srid gros kan su'u spu'u zhi gzhon par 'dems/ shing glang lor bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang gis me bzhes/ thung dbyang dang zhing chen la zhus par kun mkhyen mchog dang khyed nas 'go khrid de bskyar du bzhengs dang ma dngul rgyal gzhung nas phud chog pa'i bka' krol/skyar gso khang gi spu'u rin gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes thugs khur cher gnang / spyi zla bcu bar dbus su byon par bod ljongs kyi 'go 'dren rnam pas sne len gzab rgyas gnang ste/ lha ldan jo khang / ser 'bras dga' gsum bcas la mchod 'bul rten mjal gnang bar mjam dbyangs gyang ris mas snyan dad bzhes/sgo mang chos ra nas bgro gleng mdzad tshe char 'babs shing 'brug grags/ 'bras spungs kyi grwa rgan gzhon tshang mas dga' dad kyi mig chu 'thor/ dga' ldan nas grwa tshang la dga' ldan lha brgya sogs kyi lung gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad rjes mang du byung / gtsang nas gong sa paṇa tshen mchog la tshe dbang zhus/dngos 'bul bstar/ gong sa paṇa chen mchog nas na bza' cha tshang / thub pa thos thub ma'i sku brnyan sogs gnang / de ltar dpal sa skya/ zhwa lu/ rgyal rtse/ bsam yas sogs su rten mjal/ gnas gzigs mdzad de dge 'dun gyi sde la mang ja dngul 'gyed/ khyi 'jog dang lha khang gser khang zhig gso'i thebs bcas la sgor 'bum gnyis lhag dang mar rgya ma khri lhag phul ba sogs bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas mdzad — 617 —

do/ /dgung lo re gcig pa me stag (1986)lo'i dbyar a mchog rin po che dang zhal 'dzoms/ sbyi brgyad pa mtsho sngon por mcho gter phul/ bcu gcig par rje 'di bas krung go nang bstan tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso mdzad de/ bal bo'i rgyal sa nas 'dzam gling nang bstan mdza' 'brel thengs bco lnga par zhugs/ 'phags pa shing kun/ lum pi'i tshal la mjal te bstan 'gro'i don du thugs smon rgya chen gnang / rab rgyal bcu bdun pa'i me yos lor gdan sa'i dge bshes dge 'dun rgya mcho bcas nas zhus pa ltar/ spyi zla bdun par ser skya bzhi stong lhag la rdor phreng gi dbang bstsal/ lugs rnying gi bla drug pa gyi ma'i tshes bzhi la tshogs chen 'du khang gi gdung ma rje 'di bas spyag gis btegs tshe/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog dang chos sde chen po 'dis bskal ba ma stong bar du bstan pa'i chos kyi gdung ma 'degs par shog ces smon lam gnang / dgun a mchog bde mo thang gi rgyud pa'i 'du khang grub ston du byon te dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung bstsal/ sa 'brug (1988)lor dbal paṇa tshang ru dgon gsum gyis zhus pa ltar/khri 'dus srong mang po rjes zhabs kyis bcags pa'i yul gong gser kha mdo nas/ bla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gnyis nas dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs bdun pa)gnang ba la/ mdo khams dbus kyis grub mtha' ris med kyi dge 'dun pa chig khri nyis stong dang dgon pa brgya lhag bcas tshegs pa 'bum 'dus/ dbang bshad kyi zhor la 'char gzhi'i 'gog khab/ bod kyi slob gso dag la rem dgos tshul gsungs/ slob grwa bdun la sgor khri bzhi lhag gnang / thur bye zhang du snyon nas tshe dbang gnang / sa sbrul (1989)lo'i gyi zla dang bor gtsang bkra shis lhan po nas gong sa paṇa chen mchog nas bzhengs pa'i mchod khang bkra shis rnam spyal spub ston du snyon te rten 'brel gyi dngos 'bul bstabs shing gong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs ched du phul/ zhal ma bzhugs pa gsan tshe kun mkhyen mchog gtsang dang 'di ba bla brang dgon du byon nasaskedagongs rdzogs kyi mchod sprin rgya chen sul/ spyi zla gnyis par pe cin nas gong sa mchog gi dgongs rdzogs tshogs chen ched du zhugs/ gong rim la yang sprul tshad ldan zhig dgos pa'i skor gyi dgongs 'char zhus/gdan sa'i kyai rdor 'du khang la gser tshon 'bul ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ sku yul byams me'i 'du khang grub ston du phebs shing mtshan nyid dgon nas kun rig sogs dbang gnang / rgyal rong tsha kho'i da tshang dgon skyar gso'i thebs su rta nor drug cu phul lo/ /dgung lo re lnga pa lcags rta (1990)lo'i spyi zla dang po'i bco lnga'i nyin/ su'u len mo si kho nas skye rgu'i khor yug dar ba'i 'dzam gling bshad ra zhes pa'i tshogs 'dur byon/ khi las mur pho brang nas tsung thung karba cho hos tshogs 'dur gsol ston phul/ sog po phu rad pa'i mi sna mjal du yong bar rje 'di bas rang spyal gzhung tshab khang nas sne len mdzad/ bod zla bzhi ba'i bcu gsum la tshogs chen 'du khang gsar ba nas sems bskyed mchod pa gnang ste slar yang tshogs chen khri ba (khri rabs go gcig pa)mdzad/ bod zla brgyad par 'dzam gling chos lugs pas zhi bde srung skyob tshogs 'du dbyi ta le spyal khab nas 'chogs par — 618 —

phyon rte/ pa lu'i chos lugs slob grwa nas gsung bshad dang gsar 'gyur ba mang bor dris lan phul/gnam bdag chos kyi lte ba'i gna' rdzas khang du byon/ bod zla dgu par mtsho sngon gyi rdo sris/ dkyil 'khor/ ka ring bis mdo/ shing las kha sogs su/ lcags lug lo sar gyi dus ston bla brang dgon nas gnang ste smon lam gsung chos/ gos sku/ 'cham chen sogs su phebs/ gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la sngar me lug lor 'jig pa'i gung thang mchod rten gyi shul btsal cing / gsum pa'i tshes gcig la sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig brgyab/ nye sngar sgan pa'i 'du khang nas gdan sa rang dang phyogs nas byon pa'i bla grwa sum stong lhag la mi tra'i dbang stsal bar dri chab la me tog dkar bo 'dab ma lnga can babs shing / dbang grol ba'i nyin nam mkha' 'ja' tshon kun la mthong snang mi 'dra ba mang bo shar/ sog po'i thor god 'dus tshogs khyi nas zhus pa ltar/ sha la'i bzhugs khri'i thang nas rgya bod sog gi ser skya'i tshogs pa 'bum lhag 'dus pa'i khrom la lnga ba'i bco lnga nas dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs brgyad pa)bstsal/ drug pa'i bcu gcig la gdan sa'i mchod rten chen mo'i ka mgo rtseng bar byon/ bcu gsum la khri mtshams mdzad/bdun par mtshan nyid nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / rta phyag khyung gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs gnang / byams me ru dgon zur nas yang zhus pa'i ngor/ brgyad pa'i bcu gnyis la dmar mo thang nas dus 'khor dbang chen (thengs dgu pa)gnang / ser skya'i tshogs pa chig 'bum brgyad stong lhag 'dus/ dgu ba'i tshes gcig la tshogs chen gdung nas kun mkhyen rin po che gtso mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams pa lhan rgyas su hor gtsang tshang / zam tsha tshang / khya dge tshang bcas kyi yang sprul thugs thag bcad/ rngog rgyal mo dgon/ klu shod dgon zung nas 'dod chos mang du spel/ dgu pa'i nyer gnyis la khri chen hor tshang mchog gi khri ston du byon/ tshe sku dang rta phrug dngul gsum gyi dngos 'bul bstar/chu sprel lo'i bzhi bar sman pa grwa tshang gi gdung nas mtsho sngon po'i g.yon ru tshang gi yang sprul thugs brtag bcad/ lnga bar slob dpon padmas byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas ri bo padma can du gnas gzigs su byon/drug pa'i tshes 'gor bzhag sdom khang sar dgon nas gsung bshad dang sbrags sgor khri phul/ be shang dgon/ khro kho'i mtshan sgrogs dang zhal shul/ chu kha ma'i dgon bcas la bhon/ mtsho sngon gcig sgril rdzong gi jo dge rnying gsum du mar byon te 'bul ba phyir slog te sku dang gsung gi rten phul/ bcu dgu'i nyin gnyan po g.yu rtse'i phyi mtsho'i kha nas khang rgan sar la lab rtse gsar du btod par char babs 'brug grag 'ja' shar/ dgu pa'i nyer gnyis la gdan sa nas dbal mang tshang gi khri ston la a blo tshang dang lhan rgyas su byon/ lo 'di'i dgyid mda' tshan dang bla ri mgul gnyis kyis rtsod brgyab te mi bcu gsum brlags pa'i gyod chen ni gzu chings su bkod pas dus bde yul 'jam du gyur/ dgung lo re brgyad pa chu bya (1993)lo'i spyi zla dang po'i tshes gsum la/ a ma ri kha'i sbyin bdag dang nang bstan chos tshogs khag gis zhus pa ltar byon te/ lo hran ci nas mi dkar ser nag gsum gyi rigs las dad ldan slob ma stong du nye ba la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ a ri'i tsung thung khe len tong gi khri ston gsol — 619 —

cug la rje 'di ba sbyin bdag dang lhan du gdan drangs/ bod chu bya lo'i dus ston de nas gnang ste nyer bdun la slar pe cin du zhal bsgyur/ slar yang / skabs brgyad pa'i rgyal yongs srid gros rgyun las/skabs bdun pa'i zhing chen srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon par 'dems/ nag zlar spu 'bum mchod sdong tshen mo'i mdun nas 'tsho 'du tshang gi yang sprul thugs thag bcad/ dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur zhus/sa zlar gdan sar phyon te kun mkhyen mchog nas khyed kyis 'du khang chen mo gsar ba'i nang nas dbang lung gnang dgos pa'i gsungs ltar/ hor tshang tshang / zam tsha tshang / dbal mang tshang / bde thang tshangadagling tshang / khyad dge tshang bcas yang sprul rnams pas chos 'brel thog mar zhus par/ tshogs tshen 'du khang gsar ba nas/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig sogs kyi dbang bskur/ bla ma grwa tshang nas rje 'di bar brtan bzhugs ched duci phul/ mchod rten mthong grol chen mo'i nang gi lha khang bzhi sogs grub pas/sgron zla'i bcu gsum la rje bstan pa'i sgron me'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel gdan sa'i bla ma las sna grwa tshang dang bcas der gdan drangs/ bal bo'i bzo bos bajin pa'i mgon po 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan lalhad na dkon pa'i rten sna mang po gzungs gzhug tu phul/ da lta bla brang grwa tshang la rab gnas zhus pa'i las su meesdu ṭāzhi/ na/ skabs lags so/ /zhes mgon po gang gi mdzad zin mtha' yas pa las cung zad thos pa rnams le'u nyer bzhi ba/ mdo smadazul morong nas mkhas pa phul du byung ba dga' ldan gser khrir byon pa'i sku mtshan/mdo khams shar rgyal mo rong 'di rgya che zhing dpa' bo dang / mkhas pa'i gul du byung ba'i dga' ldan gser khri dang se 'bras dga' gsum nas thon pa'i mkhan po dang dge bshes mang po byung / dper na dga' ldan khri ba rim byon gyi khri rabs bdun cu don gnyis pa rgyal rong spro snang pa blo bzang smon lam/don bzhi ba rgyal rong cog tse ba blo bzang lhan 'aspubs/ don drug pa rgyal rong spro snang ba blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'di ba mthar bod rgyal po phyon dgos pas spyal po tha dkar kyang grags/ don brgyad pa rgyal rong 'jam dbyangs dam chos rgya mtsho/ brgyad cu spya gnyis pa rgyal rong dar rtse mdo pa ye shis chos 'phel/ gya gsum ba rgyal rong ba byang chub nam mkha'/ spya bzhi pa rgyal rong blo bzang tshul khrims dang bdun no/ / gzhan yang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi rgyud stod snad dang dbus kyi phyogs bzhi'i mtshams brgyad/ sog po dang rgyal mo rong sogs su mkhan po byon pa sum cu lhag dang dge bshes kyang stong phrag kha shas byon pa rnams ni brjod kyi mi longs/ rje'i bshad sbob kyi bstan pa mtha' dbus su dar bas dge ldan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog bye ba khrag byon pa'i nang nas mi 'da'o/ /— 620 —

lezhu nyer lja ba/ mdo mid du yang bskyarasharte stag tshang lha mo zhes pa'i don dang de'i sku zeng /gong du kirti rong dgon gyi lo rgyus zur tsam brjod kyang da dung kirti stag tshang lha mo zer don ni/sngar dgon sa de'i lung sugs na stag ma bu drug gi tshang yod zer lugs yod pas stag tshang dang / da lta stag ma bu'i tshang zer ba'i phug yang mchis pas/ 'brog dmangs rnams kyis ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod/lha mo zhes pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo'i sku rdo las khrub pa/ zhal byang phyogs su 'khor ba'i gnas chen nyer bgi'i ya spyal lha mo'i gnas zhes 'bod pa zhig yod la/ dzig bsdus na stag tshang lha mo zhes pa'i mtshan rnyed pa red/ girti zhes pa'i don grags pa'i skad dod yin la/ rje 'jam mgon bla ma'i mtshan gyi cha shas slob ma la btags pa yin zer lugs yod/(1)rong chen dge 'dun 'khrungs yul ni rgyal rong tsha kho bzhag shod pā la zhes pa'i sa dang 'brel ba'i kirti ka la ri khrod la chags pas/ sngar nas girte'i ri khrod ces 'bod srol yod zer/ phyis su ri khrod de dgon du bsgyur bas lha mo kirti dgon pa zhes mtshan de ka rang byung ba de gong bshad zin pas 'dir ma smras so/ / lha mo girti dgon gyi ma gzhi ri khrod rong chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis spyi lo (1413)lor phyag 'debs mdzad nas/ da bar lo lnga brgya don bzhi tsam song / de ltar yun ring du gyin mthar spyi lo (1450)lor gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim/(2)sku zeng gnyis pa bstan pa rin chen ni/ gyi lo (1452)lor rnga smad gdung sha tsho ba nas sku bltams/ yab dkon mchog skyabs dang yum skyid bde gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs nas/ mtshan la bstan pa rin chen zhes/ khong gis lugs gnyis kyis gtsos/ tsha kho'i rong dgon dang zhor du lha mo girti'i ri khrod pa rnams bdag skyong dam mthod dang / sa 'dul dpyad bcos sogs kyis lha mo'i girti'i ri khrod du yun ring por bzhugs shing / ri khrod pa rnams la dge tshul slong gi bslab bya'i slob khrid/ cho ga chos spyod ngag 'don nyams len gyi rim pa bskyar gso byas/ spyi lo (1536)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(2)sku phreng gsum pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyi 'khrungs yul ni/ a rigs kyi sa char yab yon tan dbang phyug dang yum skyed mo yag gnyis la spyi lo (1538)lor 'khrungs/ khong gyi lo (1576)lor lha mor thebs nas/ bde mchog sug pa'i gnas sgo phye/ gnas bdag dam la btags shing brag la zhabs rjes bzhag rje skal ldan rgya mtsho dang ma ṇi pa shes rab bkra shis sogs sngar gyi ri khrod du bzhugs te spyi lo (1617)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(4)sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang 'jam dbyangs ni/ smad tsha kho pā la sa cha nas yab 'bum thar dang yum me 'gyu gagyis la sbyi lo (1619)lor sku 'khrungs pa yin/ khong spyi lo (1634)lor stag tshang lha mo'i kirti'i ri khrod du beebs nas dgon gnas kyi mtha' 'dul yang 'dul sa gshis sogs gang dī~Xrdo ba:/bas

nas/ chos thog so so'i bskang gso dang / 'jig byed bdag 'jug sogs sngar med gsar 'dzugs mang po gnang / skabs der grwa btsun brgya yas mas su yod pas rig gnas chung ba lnga la sbyangs ba phul tu phyin pa'i grwa btsun gyis brgya cha nyi shu yod/ lo mang po'i ring sngar rgyun sor gnas su bzhugs/ gdul bya /ṭwāṃsna //na grol gyi lam la bkod pa sogs 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ spyi lo (1679)lor sku zhi bar (5)sku greng lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'khrungs yul ni mdo smad rnga ba'i yul stod du sbyi lo rkomi (1681)lor yab tshe ring dang yum skyed mo yag gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ khong spyi lo (1738)lor stag tshang lha mo'i ri khrod kyi bla ma thā la ri khrod pa yin pas bhā la'i ri khrod du grags pa der phebs/ thā la'i ri khrod dam kiti'i ri khrod kyis ma gzhi byas thā la nas sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / sras kyi thu bo lung bzang dbon chung sogs sras gsum gyi thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur nas thā la'i ri khrod girti dgon du bsgyur nas/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag kho shu'i ching
