wang gong ma bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / er khe no yon sogs mtsho sngon dang zung chu rgyal rong tsha kho bcas bod sog dpon che chung du mas mchod bkur dang /lugs zung gi mthun rkyen gyis bsgrubs pa kho nar gyur/ de nas bzhag sdom dpon po bkra shis bzang po/gza' ru khro rgyal dge phug nor bu bzang po sogs dad ldan rnams kyis bla ma dang dgon sde 'di la srung skyob skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar dam bca' byas/ sbyi lo (1755)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(6)sku phreng drug pa dge 'dun chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'khrungs yul ni reb skong bsos chu ma zhes pa'i nang tshan/ klu spyal gyi mi tshang zhes pa zhig la spyi lo (1757)'khrungs ba yin/ khong spyi lo (1764)lor stag tshang lha mor phebs/ skabs der dgon du rgyun bzhugs gnang nas/ 'grig lam/ kun spyod/sdom khrims/ 'chad nyan/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs sngar las lhag pa'i je rgyas su bskyangs/ rnam pa dkar ba'i mdzad phrin phyogs kun khyab par mdzad nas spyi lo (1781)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(7)sku zeng bdun pa skyabs mchog thub bstan nyi ma'i 'khrungs yul ni/ lha dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo'i nye 'dabs tshwa khog tu grags pa/ yab bzod pa dang / yum rje gong ma'i sku sring bkra shis skyid gnyis la spyi lo (1285)lor 'khrungs/ khong gis spyi lo (1801)lor 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi mkhan chen blo bzang phun tshogs gtsos/ gnas lnga rig pa'i rtser son pa'i dge bshes chen po bdun gdan drangs nas mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs byas pa red/ skabs der mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi mtshan grangs grwa btsun nyis brgya lhag yas mas su yod/ bsdoms pas girti dgon la grwa pa lnga brgya lhag la nye ba yod/ khong spyi lo (1855)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(ra)sku zeng brgyad pa kirti blo bzang 'phrin las ni spyi lo (1844)lor sku 'khrungs nas skye dgu thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur/ khong dgung lo drug gi thog dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo bcu gcig thog bshes gnyen bsten tshul sogs ljags rtsom gnang ba dang / dgung nyer bzhi'i steng spyi — 622 —

lo (1867)lor lha mo girte dgon gyi dus 'khor grwa tshang gsar 'debs mdzad/ dgung lo so drug gi steng spyi lo (1880)lor rnga ba'i kirte dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad/ khong gi sku ring la dge 'dun pa'i mtshan grangs gcig stong nyis brgya lhag tsam la nye ba yod/ khong gis gsung rtsom rags rtsis kyi po ti bco baspyad dang dpar du bkod pa po ti bcu gnyis can gyi mkhas pa chen por gyur/ skabs grwa tshang de'i nang nas mkhas pa gsung rtsom can bcu gsum lhag tsam yod/ khong gyi lo (1900)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(9)sku phreng dgu ba bskal bzang blo gros ni spyi lo (1902)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig gi thog bka' bstan bcos kyi gzhung lugs thams cad bugs su chud cing / dgon de'i chos 'chad nyan/bslab pa slob gnyer/ 'grig lam kun smyod kyi rim pa sogs bya ba gang thad la thugs khur rgya gsung rtsom can gyi mkhas pa mang du mchis/ khong spyi lo (1917)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/(1༷)sku zeng bcu ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring ni spyi lo (1919)lor ngo mtshar ba'i rtags du ma dang jes gnang bka' chos sogs nyin mtshan chos kyis dus 'da' bas phyag rjes chen po bzhag pa dang / skabs der dge 'dun gyi mtshan grangs stong lhag yas mas dang / gsung rtsom can gyi mkhas pa mang du mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sku 'khrungs/ khong gi sku ring la dgon der chos 'chad nyan/ bslab pa slob gnyer/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs nyams pa slar gso dang mi nyams gong 'phel du btang ba dang / khyad par sngags kyi bshad grwa'i dam bca' rab 'byams pa sogs la thugs khur rgya chen mdzad nas phyag rjes tshen po bzhag spyi lo (1960)lo nas bzung mdzod dge rdzong nas gyal stag tshang lha mo kirti dgon pas da ltar nyams pa slar gso dang sngar bzhin mi nyams gong 'phel gtong bar dus rtag tu 'bad brtson lhod med byed bzhin yod do/ /

brtan rgyal pos blon chen bzhi'i ya spyal mdo bzher dang 'phan bzher gnyis ni/ srong btsan sgam po'i blon mgar dam pas/ tshig bsdus pa'i dbang gis mdo bzher nag po'i rigs la rgyal nag de la bee ro tsa na phebs dus lcags nag gi mgon po'i sku rten gnang bas lcags mgon du grags pa'i rigs la rgyal nag gdung rgyud/ zhang zhung sbra rgyal la zhang rgyal rgyud dang / tsha rong rgyal po kho 'phan du grags pa byung bas de la tsha kho zer ba byung / 'di rgyal sa gsum mam bzhi'i yang mes yin no/ / khong gnyis so blon du bsgos/rab brtan pa ni yul gyi rgyal phran byed du bcugs/ rab brtan gyi rgyud nas chad zer ba dang / sngar khams phyogs su rus gcig pa'i sbra rje dpon gyi rigs 'ga' yod pa las rdo rol khang drug dang / lha mgo steng sogs su sgra klu bzher nag po dpon po'i skabs yul ngan byung bas klu bzher pha bu rgyal mo tsha ba rong du 'ongs/ bu che ba rus gcig pa da ro tshang la bu chung ba khyim tshang ya rab dang 'byor ldan zhig la byin nas de bzang po khag gsum las bzang po khag gnyis zhes grags/ klu bzher khong tsha rgyal la mgo btags pas blon por bskos/ blon po spra rgan du thogs pa zur chags pas rwa rgan zer/ de'i skabs tsha rgyal 'phan bzher lasras med pa'i mdo bzher gyi sras che ba lcags mo khri dpon dang chung ba khro bo skyabs zhes gnyis yod pa'i che bas 'phan mdo'i bdag po byas/ yang klu bzher lcags mo khri dpon dang ma 'cham par yul bud/btsan la'i sa sum mdor re zhig bsdad/ rgyal po ngasgyu bkra shis 'bum yul lha kha ba rta 'dra mchod du phyin/lam du bkra shis dung mtsho zer ba'i mtsho chung la grod pa 'dra ba zhes 'phyas pas mtsho bdag khros/ thog phabs pas yul gzhis mkhar bcas rjes med byas/ de nas khong gnyis so mang du 'ongs/ rgyal pos blon por bskos/ rus mthon dgu'i bu mo blangs pa la chen dgur grags/ rigs rgyud ma byung bas dman dgu'i bu mo bag mar blangs pa'i gcig la bu gsum skyes/ khu jo'i lung bar gzhi bzung bas khu jo gong 'og rwa rgan bcas byung / khu jo yi ras bu gsum kyang zer/ gong sgros rgyal srid la ma 'cham pa'i rgyal bu gsum gyi rgyud/ chu lnga ba/ chu chen/ (༅)//smeṣṭhaspa)gdung rabs nyer lnga pa khro bo 'bum zhes rgyal phran du gyur ba'i skabs nas bzung bsod nams 'bum mam bsod nams dbang rgyal (chin chan lung gis)med par btang ba'i bar gdung rabs nyi shu/ sngon mjug gdung rabs zhe lnga yin no/ de bcu ni deng sang rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul du gtogs/drug pa/ lcags la/ ( ṭha༅sngent+ra spa)ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ (yung lo khri lo lnga pa)sbyi lo 1407 da 1423 lo/ srid 'dzin lo bcu drugaganam ye shes/ (yung lo khri lo nyer gcig pa)gyi lo 1423 da 1495 lo/ srid 'dzin lo bcu drugadrug dpal 'dzin ye shes/ (kren bung khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1437 da 1453 lo/ srid 'dzin lo bcu brgyad/mgon 'phags pa ye shes/ (zhon kri khri lo brgyad pa)spyi lo 1453 da 1511 lo/ srid 'dzin nga mgon 'phags pa ye shes kyi rgyal4sgod skyong rjes lo rgyus deb ther nang la 'khod med/wan nyi khri lo so gsum pa (1610)nas bzung gong ma rgyal po la phog thugs song don rgyal srid 'dzin chog pas chog mchan thob par lo ngo bcu phrag kha shas song mtshams su/ da gzod bstan 'dzin grags pa/(khang zhi khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1666 da 1681 lo/ srid 'dzin lo bco lnga/dgu/ btsun mo gong dge'i/ (khang zhi khri lo nyi shu pa)spyi lo 1681 da 1701 lo/ srid 'dzin lo bcu bdunabu/ mo sangs rgyas/ (khang zhi khri lo nga drug pa)spyi lo 1717 da 1800 lo/ srid 'dzin lo bcu bdun/rgyal mtshan dar rgyas/ (yung krin khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 1725 da 1733 lo/ srid 'dzin lo btsun mo lha tshang dang bu chung rgyal mtshan bde tshang gnyis mnyam du/ (chin chan lung khri lo bcu pa)spyi lo 1733 da 1745 lo/ srid 'dzin lo nyi shu/rgyal mtshan nor bu/ (chan lung khri lo nga drug pa)spyi lo 1745da 1791 lo/ srid 'dzin lo zhe druga'adzin shā kā dī shākā /sa/ la rgyal/ (chin cwa chin khri lo bcu bzhi pa) spyi lo 1791 —1809 lo/ srid rgyal mtshan rdo rje/ (to'o kwang khri lo bzhi pa)spyi lo 1809 da 1833 lo/ srid 'dzin lo dguzhi rgyal mtshan bde chen/ (thung gri khri lo bcu gnyis pa)spyi lo 1833 da 1873 lo/ srid 'dzin lo ba bcu/ — 631 —

'dzin ṭwāṃ kā pardo/ mchog 'dzin/ (chin kwang zhus khri lo nyer brgyad pa)sbyi lo 1873—1902lo/ srid rgyal mtshan mchog 'beel/ (zhon thung khri lo gsum pa)(1911 )lcagasatang bas/ rgyal mtshan mchog 'phel gyi rgyal srid lo nyi shu 'dzin/ mthar dmangs rgyal lo bcu gcig pa/ gyi lo 1922lor spyal mtshan mchog 'phel btson du bzung nas btsun mo dang lhan du btson ra nas bros pas ya la chu 'gram du gshegs song / srid rgyud sdom bcu gnyis tsam song yod/ de nas lcags la rgyal po'i srid rgyud chad/bdun pa/ 'gag stod dam 'gag la/ (philhaṣṭhadzeespa)'gag la ni yi thung 'ang zer yi thung ni sa ming zhig yin pas/ rgyal chen mgon zhes mi phyi rgyal po rgyal 'bum gyi sras yin pas/ yab kyi chung ma dang ma mthun pa'i/ 'gag lar bros byol du song ba'i khyim gsar btsugs/ (to'o kwang khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1825lor rgyal chen mgon gyi a ma 'gag lar gshegs song / (to'o kwang khri lo bcu gsum pa)spyi lo 1833lo zla ba bcu gcig par)chin lhas skyong gis si khron tsung tu'u o hran gyis zhu ba ltar/ si khron mi phyi la pha'agag la dpon chen phasi'i’’go gnas lcags dril gnang bas/ de nas bzung / 'gag la rgyal po dngos su rgyal srid kyi 'go bzung nas/ (to'o kang khri lo bcu gsum pa nas zhon thung khri lo gsum pa'i) bar la/ lo ngo bdun cu don baspyad ring la rgyal srid bzung nas gdung rabs bzhis rgyud 'dzin byas/sin kri khri lo bco brgyad par/ sbyi lo 1661lo/ spyal mtshan nam mkhas srid 'dzin byas/khang zhis khri lo bcu dgu par/ spyi lo 1680lo/ dpal 'dzin gyi srid 'dzin/khang gis khri lo nyi shu par/ spyi lo 1861lo/ g.yung drung 'chi med kyis srid 'dzin/khang zhis khri lo zhe dgu par/ spyi lo 1710lo/ btsun mo sangs rgyas kyi srid 'dzin/yung krin khri lo bcu gcig par/ spyi lo 1825lo/ btsun mo wang dri yo yos srid 'dzin/chan lung khri lo baspyad par/ spyi lo 1773lo/ rgyal mtshan nam mkha' srid 'dzin/chan lung dus mthar bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos srid 'dzin/cwa chin dus 'gor de'i sras rgyal chen mgon gyi srid 'dzin/ yang yab kyi chung ma dang ma mthun pas/rang gi a ma dang mnyam du 'gag la nas gnas spor byas/ sngar bzhin mi phyi rgyal srid 'dzin/zhon thung khri lo gsum par/ spyi lo 1911lo/ 'gag la rgyal po'i sa spyod lam lugs bsgyur nas gzhung 'tshabs btang 'go tshugs/ dmangs rgyal dus 'gor/ gcung po rgyal rin gyi srid 'dzin byas/spyi lo 19bya1lor/ rgyal rin gyis ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs ba'i mthar rang srog bcad nas/ de nas 'gag la'i rgyal rgyud chad do/—ba~X pa—/ 'gag smad/ (zaṭwā〈dzeedzha)

dgu pa/ dge bshes tsa/ (po4ltalkotshoṣṭhabo)bcu pa/ po wam/ (tsho༅nt+ra spa)bcu gcig brag steg(16spodkunt+ra spa)bcu gnyis/ mi sbyis/ (kṣiltont+ra spa)bcu gsum/ mda'asado/ (ṣpelkosme7spa)bcu bzhi/ kṣiṃ skyabs/ ( spobasme7bo)khyi lo 1426 da 1441 lo(ming rgyal rabs krin thung khri lo dkyil tsam)tshe dbang nam mkha' nas bcings grol bar gdung rabs (so bdun)yin zer/btso lja/ rgyalakha bkra gis glingan (lkobi7rodzeespa)bcu drug 'og gzhi/ ( kṣaṭwāṃrṣatsho7za)bcu bdun/ btsan la bdag chen/ (sgru)ci༅ṣṭhadzeelha)bco brgyad/ mdo li/ (tshi)//grorshant+ra stuza)gdung rabs bcu gnyis yin/tshal/ bcu dgu dpal rtsal ldan pa'i rgyal rong dmag dbung gis mes rgyal srung skyob byas dngha 1855 shing yos lor 'jam ba'ad 'jigs med rgya mche 'das/ tā la'i sku zeng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho rang nyid nas srid kyi 'gan khur gnang yang ring min 'das/ slar yang rwa sgring sprul sku ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims srid skyong du bskos/ gor bod zing 'khrug byung / de lor gor dmag gis gnya' nang / skyid grong / rdzong dga'/ nong shar/ spu hreng sogs su 'phrog bcom byas/ dbus mda' dpon rang byon rdo rje don 'grub/ gtsang mda' dpon dpung song nas rgol na'ang g.yul ngo bzlog ma thub par 'dug de nas zhabs pad dpal lhun 'khor bcas/ sde dge dim chu nyer lnga/ri chab dpal gsum gyi sa khul dang / rgyal thang / li thang / 'ba' thang gsum dang / rgyal mo rong phug sa chen so mang mda' dar rtser lcags la yan chod rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad kyi dpon da ro 'brug thar dpung bcas song nas gor dmag bcom/ der dka' ngal gyi skyo glu zhig 'dug phastod lha sa'i bal dmag bskrad don/ bod kyi rgyang la bud song / bod kyi rgyang la bud song / ri nga tshos pha yul dran no/ ’zhes pha yul dran glu zhig red/ mthar rgyal mo rong gis dpon dmag rnams dpungabu chu4ṅkatshul du rkang 'gros rta las kyang mgyogs par bskyod de phas rgol ri nag su bros pa rnams la thag ring pha rdzu rshamada' dang / nye bar ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor thang la gnas pa rnams la nyag phran mida'a'as lha drugo tsame dzil byung du 'jigs — 633 —

pas sgo nas gor dmag mang po bsad/sa srung pa rnams tshang ma mtshan 'gebs kyis bcom thog skyid grong rdzong sogs srung du yod pa'i gor dpung dpung dmag rnams spyang kis lug khyu mthong ba ltar/ rdzong 'tshangs byas te re gnyis tsam bros thar ba las/ de dbyings tshang ma gtan brlag tu bcom ste g.yul las rnam par spyal ba'i drug 'thab drug spyal zhes pa'i dus su dpa' rtags 'jog mkhan gtso bo ni rgyal rong rgyal bo'i bod dmag red ces pa'i gtam dbyar rnga bzhin grags/ dpa' rtags kyi ru mtshon srid rtser bsgrong bzhin du bod kyi sa sne brgal nas bal po rdzong dang nye char phebs 'byor byung yod 'dug stabs gor kha rgyal blon tshang ma ci bya gtol med gnas su gyur ro/ / de la gzhan ma tshos bstod glu zhig phul bas phari bong steng du bya glag lding ba'am/ /lu gur sbyang gis ji bzhin gor dmag rnams/ / she mong btsan pos pha mthar sgrod pa la/ /so long sba dur rgyal rong dpung chogs dpa'/ /7zhes bstod glu sul 'dugachan lung khri rab sum cu so bdun lo/ spyi lo (1772—1777)lor lo lnga'i ring la da ro 'brug thar chin dmag dang lhan du btsan la bde 'jags su gtong bar byas rjes 'jog ched/ go gnas rim pa gsum pa'i sku srung du spar/ pha btsan pa pā thu lu’mi ces mtshan gnang bar ma zad rgyal sa pe cin du 'od sprug pho brang du dpe ris bris ste/ byas rje can thes ma lnga bcu'i khongs su 'jog pas (7trī )brgyad zur mkhar gyi sa srung gi go gnas gnang ste/ chu gar man chod 'grab yan chod bsod nams yag gis dmag sdod zhing 'debs la lta skul gyi 'gan khur gnang ngo / /chan lung khri rab zhe drug lo/ spyi lo (1781—1784)lo bzhi'i ring la chin dmag dang mnyam du kan su zhing chen gyi hu'i rigs mā men zhin dang byu'u si hri san/ han ar/ then bos sogs kyis sde gzar slong bas skor bcom byed dus byas rjes 'jog pas/ dpon gnas rim pa gnyis pa spar/ si khron du mgo 'dogs sa gnas kyi 'dzin skyong dmag dpon gzhon par bskos/ sān gri blon chen gyi thob gnang / chan lung khri nga gcig spyi lo (1786—1787)lo gnyis kyi ring chin dmag dang lhan du the wan dang the wan lho phyogs/ ka'o zhong grong khyer du dmag bskyod kyis/ nin hro'u wun dang kro'ang kun then gnyis drag gnon byed pa'i byas rjes yod pas pe cin 'od srug pho brang du dpe ris thengs gnyis pa bris/sān gri blon chen 'brug thar zhes/ byas rjes can gong ma nyi shu'i khongs su bzhagachin chan lung khri rabs lnga bcu nga gsum lo (1788—1792)lo lnga'i ring la/ da ro 'byag thar khong gis rgyal mo rong gi dmag rnams 'khrid nas dbus kyi gnas lam dang rdzong skor/ dgyes lung sogs su gor dmag btsan 'dzul pa 'gog rgol byed pa la byas rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod pas/ dmag sbyi gzhon pa'i go gnas gnang / rgyal sa be cin du'ang 'od thag pho brang du byas rjes can rjes ma bco lnga'i khongs su 'jog ste dpe ris thengs gsum par bris so/ /—chakā ༵༵ khri rab drug cu lor (1795)yang chin dmag dang mnyam du ku'i kru'u thung rin gyi 'go pa hri

ni'u tin gyis 'os langs dmag rnams drag gnon byed par byas rjes thob pas dngul khug gnang / de rjes rang yul du log pa'i lam du nad kyi thebs pa'i si khron tsi yang rdzong du gshegs so/ /nyal dud dmag 'khrugs (1840) (lcags gyi)lor gong ma lhas skyong to kang gis bkas bzhin marda lu rgyal po bsod nams g.yung drung gis dmag dpon byas pas rgyal mo rong gi dpung dmag kre cang la dmag rogs song nas/ dbyin dmag dang 'thab nas bsad rmas brgya phrag kha shas byas nas/ ku hran dang /nin po/ ten ha'e sogs sa thams cad tshur blangs nas rgyal rong bde dmag gi dpa' rtags len myong ba ma tshad/ dmag mi rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas gzhi yang chags yod/rgyal nag a bzang / to'o kāng khrir nyer gcig lo/ sbyi lo ( 1841—1842) nyal tha'i dmag 'khrug skabs khong gis rgyal rong dmag gcig stong tsam khrid de kre cang zhing chen du dbyin ji'i dmag rgol gtong bar gyin nas/ 1842 lo'i zla 3 pa'i tshes bcu nyin kre cang nin po grong khyer rgol rdung byed dus nang rul bas g.yo 'tshong byas rkyen/ rgyal rong dmag lnga brgya dang khong bcas dpa' nyams kyi ngang nas rang srog blos btang ba red/ kre cwang mi dmangs rnams kyis/ dmag dmangs dang khong gi byas rjes la rjes dran zhes pa'i yi ge bris te gong ma lhas skyong snyan du gsol zhing / gong mas chog mchan gnang ste/a bzang gi gzugs brnyan 'jim sku de neen po tshi zha'i grong gi nub sgo nas spyi le gsum tsam la mes rgyal don du rang srog dor ba'i dmag dpon dgon pa bzhengs yod pa red/rgyal nag rnam rgyal/ spyi lo(1903—1904)lor khong rgyal rong gi dmag 'go byed nas dbus su rgyang rtse sogs dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul la/ 'gog rgol 'thab 'dzing gi byas rjes bzhag phyir/ bod lho phyogs su dpal ldan lha mo'i khang la rgyal rong dmag rnams kyi dbyin dmag gi mtshon cha blang ba rnams bshams ston bzhengs/ se 'bras dge gsum 'du khang mdun gral g.yas spya ba tu rgyal rong grwa sa ba rnams la grwa shag re re yod pa bzo/ rtse po tā la'i shar ngos su rgyal rong dmag gis dbyin dmag las rgyal bar dran saso'i rdo ring btsugs yod/ shar rgyal mo rong gi dmag sde'i spyi dpon rgyud 'dzin byed chog pa'i ṭāka/ 'a/ thob gnang / rgyal nag pho brang rgyas su btang nas dmag don khrims 'dzin las khungs btsugs le'u nyer bdun pa/ spyir bod gangs can ljongs sgos su si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi sa spyod pa'i lam lugs che long tsam brjod pa/dang po/ sikhron bod rigs sarṣal gyi sa spyod pa'i lam lugs/sa spyod pa'i (rgyal phran)lam lugs ni rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus thog bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i — 635 —

rgyal rabs kyis sa khul gyi sa gnas 'go gtso bsgyur bcos la cho lo byin 'jags byas pa brgyud sa gnas de ga'i mi dmangs la dbang sgyur byed pa'i lam lugs shig chags pa red/ si khron bod rigs sa khul du yon dang / ming / chin rgyal rabs bcas gyis cung yongs khyab gyi sgo nas sa spyod (yul gyi spyal phran)pa'i sgrig gzhi btsugs pa dang / ching rgyal rabs kyis pha sa khongs bcos sgyur dang / gzhung zhabs bsko mngags kyi7 byed phyogs thengs mang lag len bstar rung sa spyod pa mang che ba med pa ma thub pas bcings bkrol ma btang gong rang rgyal gyi grangs zhung mi rigs nang sa spyod pa sngar bzhin cung mang ba gnas pa'i sa khul zhig yin/ yig cha 'di'i nang 'brel yod tshad ldan gyi yig char gsal ba dang sa khul de nyid du brtag dpyad byas pa bcas gzhir bzung si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi sa spyod par cho lo byin 'jags dang /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs dang sa spyod pa khag bar gyi 'brel ba/ sa spyod pas kha lo sgyur ba'i sa khul gyi spyi tshogs gyi dpal 'phyor chags tshul dang / chab srid lam lugs la sogs pa che long tsam zhig gleng bar spro ba 'di ltar ro/ /gnyis pa/ bod rigs sa khul gyi sa spyod pa'i sgrigs gzhi'i skor/yon rgyal rabs gong du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis bod rigs sa khul 'jam 'brid byed thabs su kro'u dang shan (rdzong )'ga' shas 'dzugs rtsong ba de ni sa spyod pa'i lam lugs kyi thog ma'i thub cha de yin mod/ dngos su sa spyod pa'i sgrig gzhi ni yon gyi dus skabs su btsugs/ de yang spyi lo (1253 ) (yon zhan tsung khri lo gnyis pa)lor yon gyi dmag dpung lam khag gsum du khag bgos/deng skabs yun nan khongs ta li rgyal khab tu dpung 'jug gis deng skabs kyi rnga ba dang / dkar mjos/yon ya bcas kro'u khag gi khyab khongs su yod pa'i bod rigs sa khul rnams yon rgyal rabs kyi dmag don stobs shugs kyis bkag sdom byas shing / (1264 ) (kre yon khri lo drug pa)yon rgyal rabs thung dbyang gis 5 shon krang yon’’ zhes pa'i las khungs btsugs te rgyal yongs kyi nang pa'i dgon sde dang / bod rigs sa khul rnams gcig gyur kyi do dam byas/ bod kyi mtho rim bla ma dang sa gnas kyi 'go gtso rnams la go sa rgyud 'dzin chog pa'i cho lo byin 'jags byas shing /si khron bod rigs sa khul du thengs dang por bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs gyis dngos su cho lo byin 'jags byas pa'i sa spyod 'bor chen byung 'dug 〈 yon gyi lo rgyus dpon rigs sna tshogs skor bkod pa〉zhes pa'i nang bkod pa ltar na pha te'o man/ yu thung / li'i/ ya/ khrang rwa zhi/nying yon bcas kyi pha dmag dmangs shon bu'u si7 der deng than jon/ lcags zam kha/ dar rtse mdo/mgar thar/ li thang bcas tshud/ kha tas/ 'us/ rma'o bcas kyi pha dmag dmangs shon phu'u si’’der deng sang rnga ba bod rigs sa khul gyi nub byang dang rmin cang gtsang po'i stod rgyud yin pa de ni zung chu dang / mong wun/ li'i shan(rdzong )bcas tshud pa'i sa khul de rnams kyi sa spyod pa rnams ni shon grang yen /spre khya~X3 rdongs su gtogs/ yon rgyal rabs kyis da dung bod rigs sa khul du5 srol bskun 'jam

'gugs’’ kyi dbang sgyur thabs shes lag bstar thog nang ba'i chos lugs dar spel shugs tshen btang ste chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs btsugs nas chab srid kyi dbang sgyur dang chos lugs kyi dmigs bsal nus pa zung du 'brel bas spya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs rnams la bkag sdom gyed/ ming rgyal rabs kyi pha yon rgyal rabs srol rnying gi rjes su 'brang ba zhes pa'i nang yon rgyal rabs skabs cho lo gnang ba'i sa spyod pa rnams khas blangs par ma zad/ da dung cho lo byin 'jags byas pa'i sa spyod pa de bas mang ba byung 'dug ming gi lo rgyus sa spyod pa'i lo rgyus〉 nang 'khod par gzhigs na/ (1 )zung chu sogs sa khul du dmag dmangs bkod 'doms hre si dang / ling an phu'i si bzhi/ krang kon si bcu drug stong dpon zo'i gcig bcas btsugs yod pa der deng sang / rnga ba bod rigs sa khul mang che ba de rnams kyi khyab khongs su gtogs/ (2 )khrang rwa zhi/ yu thung / nying yon bcas kyi shon 'us hre si khyab khongs su deng sang dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul gyi shar rgyud dar rtse mdo dang / mgar thar sa khul tshud/ (3 )mdo khams 'ung tu'u kre hud hre si'i khyab khongs deng sang dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul gyi byang rgyud lde dge dang / dkar mdzes sa khul tshud/ (4 )tung phu'u han hu'u shon 'ud si'i lte ba ni deng sang pa'o ci shan (rdzong )yin cing / de snga mong lun dang / li'i rdzong sogs sa khul bar spya bskyed byas myong 'dug (5 )than jon li'u phan kra'o da'o si'i khyab khongs su deng sang tha'an jon dang / lcags zam rdzong sogs tshud yod/ ching rabs thog ma'i dus bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis si khron gyi mtha' khul dmag dpung thengs mang bed spyod kyis ming rabs rjes kyi si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi dbang sgyur khyab khongs rnams slar gso byas/ 1732 lor(yung krin khri lo dang por)slar yang nying cing ri bo dang / 'bri chu'i shar rgyud kyi bod rigs sa khul rnams si khron gyi khyab khongs su btsud cing / sa spyod pa rnams si khron tsung tu'u nas do dam byas te de'i thad gtogs nye 'dabs kyi phu'u dang / thing / kro'u bcas kyi khyab khongs su gtogs par byas/ ca' cin skabs bris pa'i 〈 si khron hril bu bkod pa〉 zhes pa'i nang gsal ba'i deng skabs dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul du yod pa'i sa spyod pa ni 'di lta ste/ (1 )bya lag shon 'u si'i khyab khongs su yul gyi stong dpon gcig dang yul gyi brgya dpon bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod pa de rnams ni deng skabs dar rtse mdo sogs kyi sa khul du yod/(2 )sde dge shon 'u si'i khyab khongs su yul gyi brgya dpon drug yod cing / mnga' khongs ni sde dgeldan khog ser shul/ dpal yul/ 'jo mda' sogs sa khul yin/ (3 )li thang shon 'u si (rgan gzhon gnyis)yi khongs su da dung / kwang kon si bzhi dang / yul gyi brgya dpon gnyis yod cing /mnga' khongs deng sang gi li thang sogs yin/ (4 )'ba' thang shon 'u si(rgan gzhon gnyis)yi khongs su da dung yul gyi brgya dpon bdun yod cing / mnga' khongs ni deng gi 'ba' thang / sde rong / stag shod/ tsha ba sogs sa khul yin/ de min shon 'u si gnyis yod pa ni/ brag steg pa dbang gnyis so/(deng sang rong mi'i brag khul)an phu'u si bcu gnyis yod pa 'di lta ste/ dge bshis tsa/ (mda' — 637 —

mdo de gnyis ni mda' mdo'i sa spyod pa yin zhing deng sang rong brag la yod)zla gon/ (deng sang nyag rong )hor gru pa/ (deng sang brag 'go hor phrang gu deng sang brag 'go)hor gung sla/ (deng sang dkar mdzes)hor dkar mdzes ma' zu/ (deng sang dkar mdzes)hor / (deng sang ldan khog wa byu'u yus pha/ deng sang rta 'u)phun kha/ (deng sang ldan khog)gling tshang / (deng sang ldan khog)hrang na mdo/ (deng sang 'dzo mda')sha kran tud/ (deng sang nyag rong )hor pe ri/ (deng sang dkar mdzes )hor rong pa tsha/ (deng sang dkar mdzes)dbang dru keng rlung / (deng sang brag 'go)dba' cu se da/ (deng sang gser thar)ka'o ni/ (deng ldan khog)hrang kran hung ru (deng sang nyag rong)spung kran tud ru gsar/ (deng sang nyag rong )mong ka'o cas/ (deng sang ser shul)bcas so/ da dung yul gyi stong dpon dang / yul gyi brgya dpon 'ga' zhig kyang yod/ chin rgyal rabs kyi (kwang shi'i khri lo rting mar)deng sang gi dar rtse mdor ta can klu thing zer ba btsugs nas sa spyod pa rnams la do dam byed kyi yod cing / deng dus pa'o shing gi rmo'o thang tung pu'u han hu'u shon 'u si dang / lcags zam rdzong gi lan pan krang kon si gnyis ni bod rigs sa spyod pas byed/ deng sang gi rnga ba bod rigs sa khul du yod pa'i sa spyod pa gtso bo 'di lta ste/ (1 )mdo li (wa si )shon 'u si/ (deng sang lun khron)so mang shon 'u si/ cog tse krang kon si/ rdzi 'gag krang kon si/ bstan pa krang kon si/ (de rnams deng sang 'bar khams)bcas de rnams ni rdzo ku thing gi khyab khongs su gtogs/ (2 )'og gzhi an phu si/ drug zur ram khro skyabs shon 'u si/ (deng sang btsan la dang / chu chen)gnyis ni rma'o ku thing gi khyab khongs su gtogs/ (3 )zung chu ni chin rabs kyi dmag mi bod rigs sa khul du bca' sdod byed yul gyi grong brnal gtso bo de yin zhing / khul de'i bod rigs rtsa pa khag gi 'go pa rnams ni yul gyi brgya dpon dang / stong dpon sha stag yin pa de rnams zung chu thing gi khongs su gtogs/ de'i nang gsel su gyur pa dbra'u dang / a se kang / sha nye pa la sogs pa'i yul gyi brgya dpon dang / stong dpon bcu ni deng skabs zung chu'i lho ngos su yod pas/ han phun dang / chis rmin/ pa'o tso gong 'og pan g.yi'u/rnga ba stod smad bar gsum la sogs pa'i yul gyi brgya dpon dang / stong dpon lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa rnams deng sang zung chu shan (rdzong )gi nub phyogs mdzod dge dang rnga ba sogs kyi sa khul du yod/ mtsho sngon gyi mgo log dang / kan lho'i sa khul khag gcig bcas kyang de rnams kyi khongs su gtogs/ te'u ku sogs yul gyi stong dpon gsum ni zung chu'i shar lho'i phyogs su yod/ yang thung gi krang kon gnyis ni deng sang lan than gi sa khongs su yod/ mu li bod rigs sa khul du yod pa'i an phu'u si gcig yod pa de ni can khrang ta'o (deng sang shis khrang )hus yan ying gi khyab khongs su gtogs/gong du sbos pa rnams don mdor dril na/ chin rgyal rabs kyis si khron bod rigs sa khul du btsugs pa'i sa spyod pa tshe chung bsdoms na nyis baspya lhag tsam zin pa tshang mar thob 'os pa'i ming dang dbang cha cha tshang ba yod par ma zad/ da dung dzi sa bgos dbang 'dzin gyi byed thabs lag bstar gyis sa ge 638 —

spyod pa'i cho lo zhu mkhan yod tshad la cho lo ma sprad pa med cing / sa spyod pa che ba'i khyab khongs nang sa spyod pa chung ba btsugs pa'am yang na sa spyod rgan gzhon gyi khar ༷ sa spyod las 'phar7 btsugs pa'ang yod/(1)bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis pha khag bgos dbang sgyur7gyi byed thabs lag len bstar ba 'di'i dmigs yul ni/ stobs shugs kha gyes 'dod tshul tha dad pa'i dbang gis phyis 'byung mi mthun pa'i bya ba rtsom thabs bral zhing / gal srid log lam du zhugs na gzhan gyis de mur mi 'jog pa de yin la/ da dung go skabs dang bstun te nam zhig cha rkyen smin pa'i tshe som nyi mi dgos par gong ma'i spyal rabs kyis pha sa khongs bskur bcos dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags7 kyi byed phyogs lag bstar thub pa'i ched yang red/ si khron bod rigs sa khul du sa khongs sgyur bcos dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags bya rgyu de ni ming rgyal rabs skabs nas 'go tshugs shing ching rgyal rabs dus su rim bzhin lag len bstar 'dug 1728 lor(yung krin khri lo drug par )than jon li'u phan kra'o da'o si than jon thu'u la skur ba dang / chen lung gi lo rabs nang dmag dpung 'bor chen brten nas snga rjes su lo ngo nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring la cin khron che chung dang rdza skye sku sa spyod pa'i gyen ldog la drag gnon gyis de rnams mig med bzos te tun chu'u sid kyi dbang bsgyur las khungs btsugs 'dug ca chin gi rabs nang zung chu rgyud kyi brgya dpon dang stong dpon gyi gyen ldog la drag gnon gyis sa gnas de'i zhing khul gyi sa spyod pa mang che ba med par bzos te bca' sdod 'gog srung dmag btsugs pa red/ 'brog khul tsho pa khag gi 'go pa tshor yul gyi stong dpon spyi khyab dang / sba dzung / dbas ud bcas kyi go gnas sprad/ ching rgyal rabs kyi dus mjug si khron dang / yun nan gyi mtha' khul las don blon chen kra'o 'ur phung gis dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul du drag shugs la brten nas gzhi rgya che ba'i sa khongs sgyur bcos dang / gzhung zhabs bsko mngags kyi bya ba khyab spel btang ba der 'gog rgol byed pa'i sa spyod pa mang che ba mtha' la sprug pa'am yang na snga lam du btang 'dug bya ba de ltar byed par khas 'che ba'i sa spyod pa tsho yang ming yod la dbang med pa'i pha gzhung zhabs’’ su bsgyur cing / lcags phag lo'i gsar brje des ching rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur 'go rteng slog stabs gnas nas dbyung ba'i sa spyod pa rnams kyis gcig rjes gnyis mthud du ro langs baspyabs pa dang / pe yang dmag shed can dang go men tang gis dbang sgyur byed pa'i dus skabs su log spyod srid gzhung gis cha rkyen yod pa'i sa khul du sa spyod pa med par bzos tshab rgyal yongs gcig gyur sa gnas srid 'dzin gyi lam lugs btsugs mod/ sa khul khag la da dung nus dziyod pa'i sa spyod pa rnams la dmag mi'i ying grang dang / mi dmazas tsogs pa'i bkod 'domagapa/ dmag 'bru skyel dpon/nges med rgol rdung dmag gi si len/ tshan g.yi krang / tang pu'u byu'u ci krang sogs bskos te kho tsho'i nus pa beed spyod gang legs btang ba de don dngos nas bshad na sngar miskespyo da pa'am yang na kho tsho'i khyim rgyud kyis sngar mus dbang sgyur gyed pa zhig go/ ci 6 (2)bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal bas nga sa sbyod tha rṣalhar gyi 'brel ba/ bkas — 639 —

bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du sa spyod pa 'dzugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin na/ ming gi lo rgyus sa spyod pa'i rnam thar〉 nang pha srid jus de ni 'jam 'gug byed pa'i ched du'o ’ khyim tshang chen po de tshos phan tshun dbang cha 'phrog res kyi bya bar zhugs kyang / kho tshor lo mang ring la thob pa'i dbang grags yod pa'i rkyen gyis phan tshun rtsa med bzo mi thub pa rang sor gnas thub pa der brten rgyal khab gyi go gnas dang phogs thob—la mi brten 'thus med chags stabs kho rtsar mtshan snyan gyi bzos sgo gnang na gong ma'i bka' gnang gsung sgrub zhu ba dang / kha lo yang sgyur stabs bde bar 'gyur ces 'khod pa'i don ni grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyi 'go gtso rnams ni stobs shugs shin tu che bas tshang ma dbang du bsdus te thad ka'i dbang sgyur byed dka' bar brten sa gnas 'go gtso'i sngar yod dbang sgyur gyi go gnas khas len mi bya 'thas med thog kho cho nang khul gyi 'gal ba de yang bed spyod byas na phan tshun 'gog rkyen bzo res yong thub pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sa gnas kyi 'go gtso'i stobs shugs 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur tshod 'dzin byed thub pa/ de ltar byas tshe kho tshos mtha' khul du gnod pa skyel mi thub pa ma zad/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyi bka' gsung ci sgrub zhu ba dang / khral rigs gtsang 'jal dang / nga'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa zer ba de red/ si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi gnas tshul dmigs bsal can dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po dang nang pa'i chos lugs bcas kyi stobs shugs che la bod dang / kan su/ mtsho sngon bcas pa'i bod rigs sa khul rnams dang yug gcig tu 'brel bar brten/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis drag shugs brten nas thad kar tshod 'dzin byed stabs mi bde la/ thag gcod byed stangs 'tshams po zhig ma byung phyin mtha' khul du zang zing yong bar sla/ ming rgyal rabs kyi bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur mkhan gyis dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul 'di 'dra bar bsam gzhigs byed myong ste/ pha nub phyogs kyi bod ni sa rgya che la mi ngar bar brten kho tsho rang nyid kyi stobs gcig tu sgril mi thub pa nyams dmas btang tshe mtha' khul tu zing cha thon mi srid pas rten 'bul zhu bar bcar 'dod mkhan la go sa sprod cing /kho tsho sha za rgyur dga' po yod cing 'thung ja mkho che bar brten thān jon bod tshes drug gang sar ja 'don gong si btsugs te ja dang rta brje tshong dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / rten 'bul zhu mkhan la ja dang ras kyi gsol ras gnang ba bcas bod mi tshor rten 'bul dang / tshong las nang thob pa'i khe phan la zhen chags kyis rang gi brgyud 'dzin dpon gnas srung phyir zing 'khrug slong gi phod/ (ming gong ma)khrang tsu'u nas sngar las lhag par kho tshor chos rgyal dang / go thi chen po/ nub phyogs bde ldan gyi dbu bla bcas pa'i cho lo byin 'jags dang / bka' slob dang 'khrid ston brgyud thun mong gis spung gor gus brtsi zhu ba'i nub phyogs kyi mtha' mtshams su bde 'jags byung zhes pa ltar no/ / gong gsal gnas tshul de'i thog nas gsal por mngon pa 'di lta ste/ sa spyod pa 'dzugs pa/ ja rta brje tshong / nang pa'i chos lugs la rgyab skyor byed pa bcas ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis bod rigs mi — 640 —

dmangs la dbang sgyur byed ched lag bstar byed pa'i sna gsum gzugs gcig gi thabs shis de rid/bod rigs zhing bran bdag po tshos der spro ba'i sems gyis dang len byed cing / rmang gzhi de'i thog bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs dang sa spyod pa khag gi bar phan tshun 'brel ba byed pa'i lam lugs cha tshang ba zhig chags so/ /dang thog sa spyod pa rnams ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis cho lo byin 'jags byas pa sha stag red/ bod rigs sa khul ni yon rgyal rabs nas bzung rang spyal gyi mnga' khongs kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas shig yin stabs bod rigs sa spyod pa che chung tshang mar rim byung bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs re re nas 'ja' sa dang cho lo sprad pa zhig las/ rang rgyal bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin srid dbang gi khongs su ma gastogs pa'i/ pha rang btsan rgyal po'i rgyal khab7 ga la yin/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis sa smyod par cho lo byin 'jags dang de rgyud 'dzin byed pa bcas la gtan 'bebs nges can zhig yod pa ni/ pha nges par du 'di ga'i sus btang ba'i dpon rigs rnams kyis brtag dpyad byas par dang len byed dgos pa dang / brgyud 'jon gyi dbang char gzhan rtsod mi chog pa rang gi brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i snyan zhu do bdag ngo ma'i rtags bkod pu'u la phul rjes sngar srol ltar brgyud 'dzin chog pa de rjes tham ga dang / bka' shog bstsal rjes gzhi nas lugs dang mthun par brtsi ba red/ bod rigs ni gnas yul mtha' mtshams yin stabs rgyal sa dang sa khad rgyang bas 'gro lugs cha tshang ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos nges su 'dug gong du smos pa'i gnas tshul de rigs ni sa spyod pa'i khyim ṭwāṃṭā shā/nga /rgyun ring nyar tshags byas pa'i 'ja' sa dang / tham ga bka' yig sogs kyis bden dpang sa spyod pa khag gis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyi bkod gtong bka' 'gug la dang len zhu dgos shing / bkod gtong bka' 'gug gi thabs shes de ni yon gyi skabs su lag len bstar ba dang / ming gi skabs su tshi yon spyal rabs skabs kyi go gnas sngar 'jags ngos/ gcun 'doms nan du btang ba dang / khral bsdu'i lam lugs gtan 'beebs byas pa’ ltar ro/ ching gi dus skabs su de bas 'thus tshang du song ste bkod gtong bka' 'gugs dang len byed dgos pa ni sa spyod pa khag gis bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs la 'khur 'os pa'i bkas bkod khyud 'dzin gyi 'os 'gan zhig yin par ma zad/ kho tshos go skabs de dang bstun nas stobs shugs rgya cher gtong ba dang / rang gi dbang sgyur go gnas gong mthor gtong ba bcas la brten spyir btang der dga' po'i ngang khas len mi byed mkhan med/ si khron bod rigs sa khul ni khron bod 'grim 'aspul gyi 'gag rtsar gnas gathis/sgrub cha'i khral rigs shin tu snyi bas skad grags chod pa'i dzi khral 'ul’’ lam lugs chags shing / lhag par ching gi dus skabs ching dmag bod bzhud thengs mang byas myong bas pha 'ul lag’’ phon chen bskul bar brten mi dmangs kyi 'khur po ha cang lci rung / sa spyod pa rnams kyis go skabs de darjo basbya~X1 narji khyal

mang brtsas pas mi dmangs rnams sdug bsngal gyi 'obs su lcangs/ thengs gnyis pa'i nyal tha'i dmag 'khrug nang du hu pe dang cin khron gyi bod rigs dmag mi bskongs pa rnams kyi kre cang mdun phyogs su bskyod de nying pho'i g.yul 'gyed nang kho tshes dpa' ngar chen pos byi rgyal btsan 'dzul dmag la phar rgol gyis gtum zhing drag la shi rgyur mi skrag par srog dang bsdos te mes rgyal srung skyobs bla na med pa'i snying stobs mtshon par byas pa 'di ni nges par khas len byed dgos mod/ 'on kyang mang che ba'i dus tshod ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs la gzhogs 'degs kyis mi dmangs gyen langs kyi bya bar drag gnon byas/ sa spyod pa de dag gis dmag dang srid kyi bya ba'i nang byas rjes bzhag par bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis kho tshor bzos sgo bdag rkyen sprad cing / bod rigs sa khul de rnams su thon skyed gong 'phel byung med pa dang / dpal 'byor dang rigs gnas rgya rigs sa khul dang bkur na cung zad rjes lus bcas la brten sa spyod pa rnams ni gajigs bzos bdag rkyen thob rgyur 'gram chu ldang zhing / gong ma'i spyal rabs nas kyang skabs de dang bsnan te bsru thabs dang / bed spyod byed do/ /(2)gzhan yang sa spyod pa khag phan tshun 'khrug rkyen byung tshe bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyi sa gnas srid dbang nas 'khrun thag gcod cing / phyi nas btsan shugs kyi nyer 'tshe 'byung skabs kyang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs nas srung skyobs byed/ ming mjug ching rabs thog ma'i dus si khron bod rigs sa khul ni sog po od rod tsho ba'i go thi han gyis kha lo skur cing / dar rtse mdo dang / li thang / 'ba' thang rgyud bcas go thi han dang bod kyi ta li'i bla ma mnyam 'brel gyis mngags gastong byas pa'i pha sgar dpon’ gyis grong brdal srung zhing / sa gnas kyi sa spyod pa tshos de'i lugs dang bstun dgos/ 1700 lor dar rtse mdo'i sgar dpon khrang rtse spyi las kyis bya lag sa spyod pa'i mnga' khul btsan bzung thog nang sar yang btsan 'dzul bya rtsis bcas la brten ching rgyal rabs kyis zi khron des tu'u la dmag mi gtong ba dang / sa spyod khag dang mnyam 'brel gyis mig med bzo dgos pa'i bka' phab ste sgar dpon gyi ngo log zhod 'jags btang bas dar rtse mdo'i phyi nang gi sa spyod pa rnams snying 'jags pa byung / chan lung gong ma'i skabs skad grags che ba'i btsan la dang chu chen g.yul 'gyed ni sa spyod pa khag bar gyi 'gal ba de ching gong ma'i rgyal rabs dang chu chen sa spyod pa bar gyi 'gal bar 'gyur te gzhi rgya che la dus yun ring ba'i dmag 'khyug byung ba de red/ ching gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis 'gro song 'phongs med btang ste sa spyod pa'i ngo log zhod 'jags btang ba des dmag gron gsab thub pa dang / sa gnas snying 'jags pa'i phyir du'o/ /(4)bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i spyal rabs kyis bod rigs sa khul du sa spyod pa btsugs pa des chab srid thog 'jam 'brid dang / dmag don thog gi bkod gtong bka' 'gug thub pas ma tshad/da dung kho pa tsho nas khral rigs bsdu thub pa dang / mi rigs bar gyi tshong don 'bril ba gong 'phel gtong — 642 —

thub pa bcas so/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis tshod 'dzin byed pa'i saspyod pa khag gi sa khul nas lo ltar 'jal dgos pa'i khral rigs byu po tshad gzhi ltar phud/ da dung lo gsum mam lnga re'i mtshams su sa spyod pa rnams nas rten 'bul thengs re zhu dgos/ gal srid rten 'bul ma zhus tshe der gshe gshe gtong ba dang / tha na dmag mi btang ste gtor pham gtong gi yod/ yin na'ang mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba je nyer song ba des dpal 'byor thog phan tshun yod med brje res bya rgyu'i re 'dun ni rang shugs su yong 'gro ba zhig red/ gong ma'i rgyal rabs la rten 'bul zhu rgyu des phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi tshong las gong 'phel 'gro ba'i rnam pa zhig thon par brten bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs la des mtha' khul du jing cha bzos mi yong ngam snyam pa'i zhed snang byung ste thengs gcig min gnyis min de dag mtshams 'jog stodagos pa'i bka' phab rung / phan nus ma thon pa dper na/ja rta brje tshong bya rgyu de thog ma'i char bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis bod rigs mi dmangs tshod 'dzin bya rgyu'i khog rtsis su snang yang / gyis su de las ldog ste rgya bod mi rigs bar rgyun srol rang bzhin gyi tshong las zhig chags shing ming rgyal rabs kyi dus 'gor ja 'don mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' nan po thengs mang phab rung / nyin bzhin rgya cher song 'dug sa spyod pa khag dang bla ma rnams kyis rten 'bul gyi go skabs dang bsnan te tsheng las kyi bya ba rol cing / (rten 'bul ba)nyung na brgya phrag kha shas dang / mang na stong phrag 'ga' zhig rgyun mi chad par 'gro ba'i lam bar bod kyi rta dang yul zog gzhan ma khyer te ja dang tshwa ras chang sogs dang brje tshong byed pa des phan tshun dpal 'byor gyi 'brel bar shugs snon thebs pa dang / 'grim 'grul gyi 'gag rtsa'i lam rgyud du grong tsho gsar ba yang chags pa dper na/ dar rtse mdo sogs ni 'di 'dra'i lo rgyus kyi khor yug nang nas gsar du byung ba bcas 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyi bsam yul las 'das shing sa spyod pa'i lam lugs de ni skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen 'og gzhan ngos nas mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba rje nyer gtong ṭwāṃsdo ༵ rsha / rsha tho/ na pa phyis 'byung sa khongs bcos sgyur dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags bya rgyu'i ched du cha rkyen gsum pa/ sa spyod pas kha lo sgrur ba'i sa khul gyi dpal 'byor chags tshul/si khron mtha' mtshams bod rigs sa khul du sa spyod pa'i lam lugs 'gyur ba med par rgyun ring gnas thub pa ni rnyog 'dzings che ba'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen la brten nas byung ba zhig red/ de yang zhing bran bdag por thon skyed rgyu chas dang thon skyed kyi las ka byed mkhan cha tshang dbang bas cha rkyen ldan pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran spyi tshogs ni mes rgyal nang khul gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sa bdag gi thon skyed byed stangs las da dung rjes lus yin la o'u gling nub ma'i dus rabs bar ma'i mtshon byed rang bzhin gyi zhing bran lam lugs kyang gdod ma'i rang bzhin che ba yod/ tshong zog gi dpal 'byor shin tu skyo la zhing bran gyi 'tsho ba ni de bas skyo/ zhing bran bdag po dang zhing bran dbar thon zas bgo bsha'i 'brel ba de ni — 643 —

ha cang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog btsugs par brten zhing bran bdag pos zhing bran gyi ngal rtsol lhag ma mtha' dag btsan 'phrog byas par ma tshad/ rgyud ldan zhing bran tshor dgos nges kyi ngal rtsol la'ang btsan gnod byed pas zhing bran cho slar yang stabs bde'i thon skyed bya rgyu kho nar mi brten mthu nad byung bar brten spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor dus yun ring por 'phel med rang sor gnas 'dug pa'i 'gal ba de dag sa spyod pa'i lam lugs gnas pa'i lo rabs nang rang nyid la khyad gsod byed thub pa'i thabs shes med/ bod rigs sa khul gyi sa spyod pa tshang ma gzhi rkang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs nas byin 'jags kyi cho lo brgyud dzi lugs dang mthun pa’’yi dbang sgyur gyi go gnas thob mod/ 'on kyang bod rigs sa spyod pa rgyud bcas nas 'dzin pa'i mnga' khongs ches mang ba ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis byin 'jags byas pa zhig min pa de las ldog ste sa spyod pa 'di dag la cho lo ma thob gong snga mo nas sa gnas de'i zhing bran bdag po'i rgyud 'dzin gyi 'go gtso sha stag yin la bod skad du cung che ba'i sa spyod par dzi rgyal po’ dang / ching rgyal rabs kyi gong mar pha rgya nag rgyal po7 zer zhing / spyir btang sa spyod pa chung bar pha dpon ’ nam 'go dpon zer ba dang rgyal po gnyis ni khyad par mngon gsal can yod/ pha rgyal po7 dang dzi dpon po7'di tsho nang khongs chags rjes bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis khrims lugs kyi go rim brgyud kho tsho'i dbang sgyur gyi go gnas khas len byas pas go gnas sna tshogs pa'i sa spyod pa'i brgyud pa rnams chags/ sa spyod pa rnams kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'os 'gan sna tshogs sgrub dgos/ 'on kyang des kho pa tsho'i mnga' khongs sa cha brgyud pa bcas su dbang bar do phog mi 'byung zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis dmag don dang / srid 'dzin gyi bya thabs drag po ma spel phyin dbang cha 'di tshor spyir btang do phog yong thabs med/ ṭwāṃ ming gi lo rgyus zas nor skor bkod pa〉 zhes pa'i nang dzi sa spyod pa so sos sa de'i dpon byed la sa de dbang zhing / mi ser so sos sa spyod pa'i zhing rmo la de'i 'bangs byed ces 'khoda'adug si khron bod rigs sa khul du 'di 'dra ba'i gnas tshul nye rabs bar 'gyur ldog byung med/ nye rabs mi'i rtsom yig nang pha khams khul sa zhing khag gnyis yod/ de ni rmo zhing dang 'brog zhing gnyis su bsdu/ rmo zhing nyung zhing 'brog zhing mang / de thams cad sa spyod pa dang ho thog thur dbang zhing / de dag nyo tshong mi chog pa sa spyod pa brgyud pa bcas la rtag tu dbang zhes bkod 'dugs gnas gang zhig gi zhing bran bdag po che shos de ni sa gnas de'i sa spyod pa che shos yin la mnga' khul de'i nang gi dbang 'dzin pa mtho shos de red/ dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs brtag dpyad byas pa'i yig char gzhigs na/ cung dpe mtshon thub pa'i sa spyod pa'i dbang sgyur sa khul du sa spyod pa'i sa zhing rnams spyir btang khag gsum la dbye ba 'di lta ste/ zhing bran rnams kyis rgyags rang khur gyi 'debs skyong byed dgos pa'i rang gi gzhis ka'i sa zhing dang / 'go pa dang dgon par kha 'dzin byed du bcug pa'i sa zhing /zhing bran rnams la sprad pa'i skal zhing dang sasum mo/ dper na/ dkar mdzes ma zu sa spyod par shis — 644 —

ling sa cha yongs kyi sa zhing mu'u 8900 lhag tsam yod pa nas rang 'dzin gzhis ka'i sa zhing mu'u 1140 dang mnga' khongs 'go par khag 'dzin byed du bcug pa'i sa zhing mu'u 2268 bcas phud 'phros zhing bran rnams la sprad pa'i skal zhing 5000 lhag tsam 'dug 'go pa khag gis sa spyod pa nas blangs pa'i sa zhing dang bran g.yog rnams rang gi mi mus brgyud bcas su bdag chog pa dang sa spyod par khral rigs sbod dgos shing / 'go pa de tshos slar yang sa zhing de khag gnyis su dbye ste rang 'dzin gzhis zhing dang / bran g.yog tshor smrad pa'i skal zhing dang gnyis so/ dgon sder dbang ba'i sa zhing mang che ba ni sa spyod pa dang /'go pa khag nas pha sbyor 'bul zhus pa las byung zhing / sa zhing de rnams zhing bran rnams la bogs gtong byas pa'i bogs ma bsdu len byed/ zhing pa mang che ba ni skal zhing gi 'ching spyar tshud pa'i bran g.yog sha stag red/ kho tshos zhing bran bdag por sa bogs dang / khral rigs bsgrub rjes skal zhing rnams kyi kha 'dzin gyed dbang yod/ ching rgyal rabs thog ma'i tshad ldan yig cha'i nang bod rigs khul du pha yul dmangs kyi skal zhing thad la sa spyod pa'i bkod don la brtsi ba dang / sa spyod pas yul dmangs la rmon phyugs dang son/ khrab rmog sdod khang bcas sbyin nas kho tsho dmag mir brtsis te khral bskul ba dang ༵ko/ da/ gtong bka' 'gug zhu dgos pa’ zhes 'khod pa ltar/ nye rabs kyi gnas tshul yang nge ltar lags (1) sa zhing dbang ba'i gnas tshul 'di lta bu dang 'tshams pa'i ched sa spyod pa'i dbang sgyur sa khul du rim pa'i lam lugs ni de bas kyang dam po zhig yod/ sa spyod pa dang 'go pa/ mtho rim grwa pa bcas las bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po'i dbang sgyur ru tshogs shig chags shing / sa spyod pa ni ru tshogs de'i 'go gtsor gyur pa dang / mtho rim grwa par dmigs bsal gyi dbang sgyur go gnas yod cing / dbang sgyur myong mkhan gi gnas su ltung ba ni/ rgya che'i zhing bran kho na'o/ zhing bran de yang dkar mdzes sa khul du khag gnyis su dbye ba ni/ pha khral pa dang pha 'khor pa’’ gnyis so/ khral pas dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul byang rgyud kyi zhing bran mi 'bor spyi'i brgya cha drug cu zin pa de sa spyod parathad kar gtogs pa dang / 'khor pa brgya cha bzhi bcu zin pa de 'go pa dang dgon pa'i khongs su gtogs/ mi khag gnyis po 'di ni skal zhing gi 'ching rgyar tshud pas kho tshor gnas spo'i rang dbang ga la yod/ yul bud dam rgyud chad na zhing bran bdag pos mi ga'an khungs 'jug byas te/ kho tsho'i thob thang dang / khang ming / skal zhing / sdod khang / de min rgyu nor bcas shul 'dzin byed du 'jug yul bud du phyin pa'i zhing bran rtsad gcod thub tshe khrims gcod nan po gtong / zhing bran gyis zhing bran bdag por rang lus gzhan rten byed pa'i 'brel ba ni shin tu mngon gsal che ba yod/ de ni zhing bran bdagapos sa zhing dang chabs cig nang shugs su gtong ba dang / 'bul rten byed pa/ gang byung du gsod tha na zhing bran gyi gnyen sgrig gi khe dbang la yang jus gtogs byed/ de bzhin 'ing bran la zhing bran bdag pos phyir don te brtsad gcod bda' ded gtong gi yod/ zhing bran gyi nang nas pha khral pa’’ni spyi tshogs kyi — 645 —

gnas 'babs cung zad mtho zhing / gnas tshul dmigs bsal can gyi 'og khral pas tshun krang dang gros tshogs kyi tshogs gtso bcas kyi 'gan khur mkhan yang yod la khral pa phyug po tsho phyogs mthar skyod de chong yang brgyab chog gal srid sa spyod pas pha khral pa ’ 'go gtsor byin 'jags sam dgon par spyor 'jags byas rjes zhing bran gyi nang gses gnyis pa ste/ phaci'akhor par7 'gyur 'gro ba red/ dzi 'khor pa ni spyi tshogs kyi gnas babs cung dman pas zhing bran bdag por rang lus gzhan brten byed pa'i 'gyur ba med pa'i 'brel ba yod/ ha cang dbul ba'i pha 'khor pa’’ ni dper na/ dkar mdzes khyud du ‘ 'khor nag’’tu 'bod pa de rnams ni bran g.yog dang ha lam 'dra/ da dung sa gnas khag la rang dbang yod pa'i dbul po khag gcig yod pa'i mang che ba ni yul bud pa'i zhing bran dang / nyams rgud phyin pa'i 'brog pa/ thob thang shor ba'i pha khral pa’’ bcas dang / de min bod khul du yul gyar ba'i rgya rigs dbul phongs bcas yin pa de rnams kyi khyi tshogs kyi gnas babs ni ches mtha' mar gyur pa'o/ /(2)sa spyod pa dang / 'go pa/ dgon pa bcas kyis ngal rtsol mang tshogs la btang ba'i bshu gzhog ni shin tu gdug tsub che bas/ ching rgyal rabs kyi yig cha'i nang 'khod par gzhigs na/ 'ba' thang sa spyod pa'i khyab khongs nang pha sa gnas kyi lam bzo dang zam rgyag sa spyod pa'i sdod khang gsar rgyaga'abru rigs skyel 'dren bcas mang tshogs kyi stobs shugs bed spyod mi gtong ba med cing / ri thang nas rtsa shing bsdu ba dang / 'brog thang nas mar bsdu ba bcas zla rer grags tshad gtan 'beebs byed/ tha na rgun 'brum dang / star kha/ li sogs sa spyod par skyel mi dgos pa gcig kyang med pa de'i nang rgyun gtan gyi rten 'bul tshud med rnga ba bod rigs sa khul du lho nub rgyud la pha 'bru khral7 nang sa'i rgya rigs sa khul las lci chochi yod pa de ni sa zhing son 'gro'i rjes su 'khri/ lo nyes byung skabs kyang chags yang med cing / bu phrug btsong dgos par thug na cung zad chag yang gtong ba/ dpon po'i las grwar 'gro skabs rdo dang shing chas lam seng bzos chog chog gi lag cha rang khur kyis 'gro dgos/ ching rgyal rabs dus mjug gi yig cha'i nang khams khul gyi 'bru khral skor/ pha sa spyod pa dang ho thog thu bcas kyis 'bru khral gyi tshad gzhi mang nyung gcig tu ma nges pa bsdu gi yod/ gal srid sa spyod pa dang ho thog thu'i sa zhing dang mi ser gyi sa zhing mu 'brel yin na mi ser gyi rmo zhing de'i 'bru khral chag yang btang tshab mi ser nas son rtsa gra sgrig gis dpon zhing de rmo 'debs byed dgos pa'i bka' btang thog ston bsdu'i skabs sa spyod pa dang /ho thog thu bcas kyis dpon zhing gi thon 'bru tshang ma bsdu len byed/ 'bru khral de sprod ma dgos rung de'i dngul khral ni 'bru khral las ldab gcig gam gnyis kyis mang ba bsdu/ lo ltar 'bru khral bsdu ba phud da dung gnyen sgrig dang / dmag don gyi bya ba sogs thon na mi ser nas dngul khral bsdu zhing lo gcig nang bya ba gang 'phrad der gzhigs pa'i dngul khral bsdu/ lo gcig nas gnyis pa bya ba med par cha bzhag rung lo gsum par rten 'bul zhu ba'i bya ba thon gyi yod/ 'bru khral ni 'go gtso brgyud sprod dgos pas sa spyod pa'i 'bru khral khal gcig rer 'go pas 'phar du bre gcig gam phyed kas mang ba bsdu bas de gnyis mi 'dra/— 646 —

'brog khul nas rta dang g.yag lug gam yang na g.yag lug gi sha dang mar bcas bsdu zhing / de rnams nas dngul khral bku ba de ni zhing pa dang 'dra ba red/’’ ces 'khod 'dug yig lam 'di tsho'i nang nas mthong thub pa ni 'di lta ste/ mi ser gyis sa spyod pa dang / 'go pa/ mtho rim grwa pa bcas la 'u lag dang sa bogs rgyag rgyu gtso bor byas pa'i dngos po'i bogs ma dang rgyugs dgos nges kyi khral 'ul sna tshogs yod pa ni gzhir bcas shing / 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul ni bcing bkrol thob nye'i bar rgyun mthud du gnas so/ dmangs gtso'i bcos skur skabs brtag dpyad byas pa'i yig char gzhigs na/ sa spyod pa'i dbang skur 'og gi zhing las sa khul du zhing bran rnams kyis rgyags rang 'khur dang zhing chas rmo phyugs cha dzhang 'khyer nas zhing bran bdag po'i rang 'dzin gagis ka'i sa zhing rmo 'debs gyed dgos shing / de las byung ba'i ston 'bras rnams zhing bran bdag por bdag pa dang / rnam kun zhing bran bdag po'i ched du g.yog rgyugs dgos pa'i dper na shing gcod rgyu dang / rtswa brnga rgyu/ dos skyel/ zhabs phyi zhu ba/ 'tshems bu rgyag pa/ ar las sogs las khral hwa cang lci po yod/ dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul gyi byang phyogs su pha khral pa7them dud re res spyir btang lo ltar las khral zla bzhi nas brgyad bar rgyugs dgos/ cung lci bar them dud res ngal nus gcig nas gnyis bar lo 'khor mo yug tucangal ba gso longs med par zhing bran bdag por las khral dgos/ lko 'khor pa’’ ni spyir btang dpyid lcags sa 'og tu song ba nas ston lo tog bsdu ba'i bar las brel che ba'i skabs su nyin gsum re nas zhing bran bdag po'i tshed du las khral nyin gnyis re 'am yang na them re mi re lo 'khor mo yug tu 'gro dgos pa/ yang na rtag par las mi gtong ma dgos rung ga dus skad btang na de dus las kar 'gro dgos pa bcas las khral shin tu lci bas zhing bran rnams la dbugs kyang gtong longs med pa ltar gyi las brel che bar brten tha na rang gi skal zhing de yang 'debs khom med pa thal skya chags su lus/ zhing bran gyis zhing bran bdag po'i gzhis zhing thog rmo 'debs byed skabs spyir btang nas bshad na da dung las dpon gyis lta skul byed/ zhing bran bdag po'i gdug tsub kyi bshu gzhog btang ba'i 'og zhing bran ha cang mang po bu lon shin tu che bas mi tshe hril por 'jal thabs bral ba'i rkyen gyis yul gzhan du bros byol gyis slong mor brten nas 'tsho ba skyel dgos so/'brog las sa khul du rtswa thang gnas nges med 'brog las dpal 'abhor gyi khyad chos la brten nas thon skyed 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi ni 'brog rwa dang phyugs rigs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang ba'i lam lugs de red/'brog rwa'i phyi'i rnam pa ni tsho pa sbyi la dbang ba ltar mngon yang / nang don sa spyod pa dang 'go gtso/mtho rim grwa pa bcas kyis ham bzung dang de tshos stabs 'dzin byed/ 'brog dazangs kyis zhing bran bdag por rang lus gzhan brten bya rgyu zhing bran lta bu'i tshabs che ba rang med rung tsho pa'i 'ching rgyar tshud par brten rang 'dod ltar gyi gnas spo byed pa'i rang dbang med/ gal srid de las gzhan du bhol na sa spyod pa'am tsho dpon gyis zhing bran dang 'dra bar khrims gcod nan po gtong rgya garnocha mi za/ /gong smyos gnas tshul de dag las gsal por mthong thub pa 'di lta ste/ ngacimangatsha gtso'i bcos sgyur — 647 —

sngon dus sa spyod pas dbang sgyur byed pa'i sa khul gyi spyi tshogs dpal 'asnyor gyi 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs nang gnas pa gor ma chag bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis sa spyod pa btsugs pa de ni chab srid thog tshod 'dzin bya rgyu de las gzhan sa spyod pa'i nang khul gyi dpal 'byor lam lugs la thad kar the gtogs byed mi srid/ gal srid btsan shed kyis the jus byas pa yin na hur brtson dang rgyun ring gi phan 'bras thon mi thub/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhing bran bdag pos rang nyid rgyud pa dang bcas pa'i khe phan srung skyob bya rgyur mkhreg bzung dang / ches gdug rgyub che ba'i bya thabs la brten nas 'ing bran gyi gyen ldog la drag gnon/ chos lugs beed spyod kyis thon skyed byed pa'i lus sems thad kar bkag skyel bcas byed/ phyogs mtshungs bod rigs khul gyi thon skyed nus shugs ha cang dma' ba'i thog 'grims 'thul stabs mi bde la rig gnas kyang dbang sgyur pas sger sdom byed pa bcas kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis rang shed batren lugs kyis sgyur bcos gtong 'dod pa de ni bshu gzhog myong mkhan la phan thogs gang yang med pa sman chu brje ba las snan ma brjes pa'i ngang tshul der zhing bran rnams kyis brtsi bkur dang mos mthun ma thob/ de lta bu'i sgyur bcos bya rgyu ni nges par pham nyes 'gro rgyu the tshom med/ dper na/ ching rgyal rabs thog ma'i dus rnga ba bod rigs sa khul gyi chu chen sogs sa gnas su sa spyod pa'i gyen langs la drag gnon byas rjes btsan shed kyis dzi sa khongs bcos sgyur dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags7 kyi bya thabs lag bstar byas pa'i 'bras bur phyi'i rnam par sa spyod pa'i lam lugs med par bzos te dmag sdod sa srung lam lugs kyi tshab byas pa ltar snang yang / don dam ni/ zhing bran bdag po'i dpal 'byor la sngar bzhin srung skyobs thog dmag sdod sa srung sa spyod pa'i tshab byas pas gang ltar sa gnas de gar zhing bran bdag po che chung sna tshogs pa zhig tu 'gyur gyi yod pa red/ ching rgyal rabs dus mjug tu kro'o 'ur phung gis dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul du dzi sa khongs bcos bsgyur dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags’’ lag bstar byas pa dus skabs gcig ring de tshegs med legs sgrub byung nas sa spyod pa gcig kyang lhag med/ 'on kyang ching rgyal rabs 'thor zhig thub pa byung 'dug gnas tshul 'dis sa spyod pa'i lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi ni zhing bran lam lugs de yin cing / 'ing bran lam lugs mthar phyin pa'i rtsa med ma bzos gong sa spyod pa'i lam lugs rtsa med 'gro mi srid pa'i gsal bshad de ltar byas so/ /bzhi ba/ sa spyod pas kha lo sgrur ba'i sakhul gyi chab grid lam lugs/bod rigs sa khul gyi sa spyod pa che chung ji ltar yin rung tshang mar sa gnas de ga'i dpal 'byor dang 'tshams pa'i kha lo sgyur ba'i las khungs cha tshang re yod/ dkar mjos bod rigs khul byang rgyud kyi sde dge sa spyod pa'i mnga' khongs deng skabs ldan khog dang sde dge/ dpal yul/ ser shul/ 'jo mda' bcas shan (rdzong )khag lnga yod pa de ni bod rigs khul gyi sa spyod pa che shos kyi gras gcig red/ de yang ching rgyal rabs dus mjug ‘ sa khongs bcos skur dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags ’ rjes lhag lus chen po —— 648 ge

de kho na nyid do/ de'i kha lo sgyur ba'i las khungs ni cung cha tshang ba 'dug sde dge sa spyod pa'i 'og tu dzilding 'khor tshogs 'du7dang dzi las khungs7gnyis yod/ sngon ma ni sku drag gi gros tshegs dang 'dra bas der mnga' zhabs kyi gtso bo'i 'go pa dang / dgon pa'i sgrul sku gtso bo rnams zhugs dgos la sa spyod pa ngo mas gtso skyong byed/ phyi ma ni dmag srid/ nor/ khrims bcas kyi dpon chen bzhi las kub pa'i pha gnyer phyag lhan rgyas khang 7de ni rtsen tshugs kyi las khungs red/ dpon gras mdun skor nang du da dung las sna chogs pa'i dpon po yod/ dper na/ pha gzhis dpon7 pha 'bru dpon7 pha rta dpon7phagazan dpon7phakhrom khral dpon7phazog dpon phartswa dpon75 drung yig7pha bris pa7pha sku tshab pa7pha zhabs gras7 pha snan pa7 pha sogs yod do/ gzhi rim gyi srid 'dzin thad shan (rdzong )dang gzhis ka rim pa gnyis su nges/ sa gnas de ga'i 'go pas rdzong dpon nam gzhis gnyer gyi 'gan 'khur yod/ de min sa spyod khag gi dbang sgyur las khungs kyi sgrigs gzhi yang ha lam de dang 'dra la dpon rigs khag gi ming yang de dang 'dra ba 'dug 'brog khul du yod pa'i sa spyod pa'i dbang sgyur las khungs kyi sgrigs gzhi ni de snga tshe pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi rmang gzhi'i thog btsugs pa de ni cung zad stabs bde ba yod/sla thang g.yon ru 'brog khul la dper bzhag na/ sa spyod pa'i dpon gur de'i mnga' 'og tsho pa sum cu so drug gi 'go pa'i nang nas thengs rer 'go pa gsum re res 'khor gyi rgyun gtan gyi bya bar do dam byed cing /gal che'i gnas tshul byung na tsho pa khag gi 'go pa'am yang na 'brog dmangs kyi tshegs tshen thog nas thag gcod byed/ dpon gur de'i nang du phyag mdzod gcig nas gnyis bar dang / gnyer pa/ yig 'bri ba/ las bya sogs yod/ sa spyod pa'i gsham 'og tsho pa rnams ni 'go pa che chung rim pa dbye nas do dam byed pa las/ de min ched las gyi dpon po med do/ /sa spyod pa'i srid dbang gi khyad chos che shos ni chos srid zung 'brel de red/ srid dbang mtha' dag brgyud 'dzin dang / chos lugs kyi zhing bran bdag po'i lag tu bzung ba des drag shugs kyi dbang sgyur dang lha dbang bran bkol gnyis zung sbrel dam po byed pa'i rnam pa chags/ chos srid zung 'brel dbang sgyur gyi rnam pa mtshen che shos mi li sa khul la cha bzhag na/ mi li'i sa spyod gcig rtsog byed pa'i bla ma chen po des sa khul de yongs kyi chos srid kyi dbang cha chen po de 'dzin gyi yod/ sa spyod pa de'i las khungs ni lo gsum nang thengs re res 'khor khul de'i nang gi dgon sde chen po gsum so sor lo re sdod dgos/ srid 'dzin khul dang chos lugs khul gnyis ni yongs su gcig mtshus yin la ser skya dpon rigs ni gnyis nas gcig tu bsdu ba zhig red/ grwa pa'i gnyen sgrig byed mi chog pa dang / gcig lcog byed pa'i sa spyod de ni sa gnas de ga'i zhing bran bdag po chen po tshang gi bu phrug nas rgyud 'dzin byed dgos/ gzhan yang dkar mjes dang / rnga ba khul gyi sa spyod pa'i dbang sgyur gyi sa khul mang che bar sa spyod pa dang dgon pa'i dbang sgyur sgrig gzhi ma gzhi tha dad du chags mod/ phan tshun srung skyobs byed la 'brel ba yang shin tu zab/dgon pas rgyun tu mtho rim grwa pa btang ste sa spyod pa'i srid don nang zhugs pa dang / sa spyod pas kyang — 649 —

rang gi bu phrug gam yang na nye ltos grwa par bcug ste dgon pa'i las sne 'dzin thog dgon sde'i khyad dbang la srung skyobs byed/ sa spyod par bu srun kha shas yod tshe gcig gis sa spyod pa'i go gnas rgyud 'dzin byed pa phud/ de min rnams grwa par zhugs te dgon pa'i dbang cha thob par bya gi yod 'dug 'di lta bu'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi dbang sgyur lam lugs des zhing bran rnams las spyod pas tshab byid pa'i drag po'i stobs shugs kyi dbang sgyur snyong dgos pa dang dus mtshungs lha dbang gi gnya' gnon 'og rtag du gnas dgos/(1)sa spyod pa'i khrims lugs ni yongs su zhing bran bdag po'i dbang sgyur la srung skyobs byed pa dang / zhing bran bdag po'i 'dod blo mtshon byed kho na yin/ sa spyod par ngo rgol byed pa dang 'u lag mi rgyug pa dang / khril bun sprod 'gyangs sogs byung tshe tshang mar khrims gcod nan po gtong ba dper na/mgo bo gcod pa dang / mig 'don pa/ rta lcag gzhu ba/ gnam thag rgyag pa/ btson 'jug byed pa/sngog gsher byed pa/ rgyang 'bud gtong ba bcas so/ de min dper na/ rkun ma rgyag pa dang / nyes med nyes 'dogs/ btsan g.yem gyed pa/ lha la phog thug gtong ba/ grwa pa dma' 'bebs byed pa bcas la de bas khrims gcod nan po gtong zhing / zhing bran dang zhing bran bdag po'i dbar gtugs gsher byed pa'i 'brel ba sru tsam gnas med la/ rim gras mi 'dra ba'i mi ni khrims lugs mdun 'dra mnyam med/ dper na bod rigs sa khul du mi bsad par sbyir btang mi stong 'jal dgos par 'go pa dang bla ma'i mi stong ni gyir btang las nyung mthar ldab gnyis yan gyi mtho ba dang / sa spyod pa dang mtho rim grwa pa'i mi stong de bas mtho ba yod/ sa spyod pa 'ga' zhig da dung gtan 'apebs bzos par zhing bran nang gi skyes pa'i mi stong dang sa spyod pa'i khyim gyi sgo khyi gcig bsad pa'i nyes dang mtshungs par brtsi zhing / bud med kyi mi stong de ni skyes pa'i phyed cha las mi zin pas tha na khyi gcig dang mi do ba de red/yang rkun bu'i 'jal klub skor gtan 'beebs byas pa 'di lta ste/ rkun ma shor mkhan de grong tsho de rang gi zhing bran yin na rkus 'jal ltab gsum dang / 'go pa yin na rkus 'jal ltab dgu/ sa spyod pa dang /sprul sku yin na rkus 'jal ldab bcu yan sprod dgos/ nyes don 'dri gcod byed skabs chos lugs kyi khyad chos gting zab ldan cing / skabs 'gar chos lugs kyi byed sgo'i thog nas khrims gcod dang 'bril bar tsha 'dri byed pa bcas khrims 'dzin gyi bya thabs ni ches tha klo dang / ches gdug tsub thos pa tsam gyis skyi g.ya' ba'i snang tshul kho na 'byung ngo / /(2)sa spyod pa'i drag dpung la phayul gyi dmag mi’’zhes su grags/ spyir btang rgyun nyar dmag dpung btsugs med pa zhing khul la mtshon na skal zhing blang pa mang nyung dang / 'brog khul la sems can gyi bgo grangs mang nyung bcas la gzhigs pa'i pha mi khrol (dmag khral)rgyugs dgos shing / yul gyi dmag mi de rnams rnam kun thon skyed byed cing dmag 'khrug langs tshe dmag nang zhugs dgos pa/ go lagahūṃ nga /5 /garji bcas rang 'khur bya dgos/ dmag 'khrug cung gzhi rgya che ba byed dgos pa'i tshe gzhi

nas sa sbyod pas dmag don gyi gron dngul sbod kyi yod cing rim pa khag gi bkod 'doms dpon po ni sa spyod pas skabs bskun bsko gzhag byed/ sa spyod pa'i mnga' khongs nang gi dgon cung tshe ba tshang mar rang bdag gi drag dpung yod pa ni gyir btang grwa pas 'gan len byed dgos/ sa spyod pa che ba la lar rang sger gyi a phrug dmag dpung yod/ zhing bran dang 'brog pas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin bdag po'i ched du dmag mir zhugs te dmag rgyag dgos pa 'di ni gal che'i khral rigs gcig red/ sa spyod pas 'di trīsdo / rdo kā snyi sdo rsha /lug/ sa la brten nas dmangs khrod kyi dmag dpung stobs shugs la tshod 'dzin dang bed ( 2)sa spyod pa'i nang khul gyi chab srid lam lugs cha tshang ba de ni zhing bran lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi'i mtshon tshul zhig yin/ de yang zhing bran bdag po'i dbang sgyur dang bshu gzhog gi khe phan srung skyob gyed ched kyi nus pa dang ldan pa'i lag cha zhig yin/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyis sa spyod par cho lo byin 'jags byas pa de ni don dngos nas dmigs bsal gyi lam lugs cha tshang ba 'di khas len byas pa zhig dang / zhing bran bdag pos rgya che'i zhing bran drag gnon dang bshu gzhog gtong rgyur rogs ram byas pa zhig kyang red/ de dang phyogs mtshungs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyi dmag dpung dang / dpon rigs bcas sa spyod pa'i sa khongs su sdod skabs mjal zhu 'bul rten tshad med len pa bcas kyis bod rigs khul mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal je cher 'gro bas bod rigs mi dmangs kyi ngo rgol byed pa'i 'byung rkyen yang der thug rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas lo rgyus thog sa khongs bcos bsgyur dang gzhung zhabs bsko mngags thengs mang lag bstar byas pa tshang mar mthar thug gi gnad don thag gcod thub pa byung med/ bcings bkrol btang ba'i rjes bod rigs mi dmangs rnams gung khran tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'go khrid kho na'i 'og gzhi nas mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur lag bstar gyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gong ma'i rgyal rabs dang go min tang srid dbang gis mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi srid jus bcas med par bzos thogabakas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs rtsa med bzos pas gzhi nas sa spyod pa'i lam lugs gnas pa'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi dang spyi tshogs kyi cha rkyen rnams rtsa med btang ba des zhing bran rnams la mthar phyin pa'i bcings bkrol thob pa dang 'brel mi rigs rang nyid kyi rgyal gces mtho rim par mthun sgril gyis thun mong nas zhing bran lam lugs kyis bzhag pa'i za brgya bug stong bcos te spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam chen thog ha cang bkra shis gom chen zhig spo thub par 'bad brtson byas song / /

le'u nyer brgyad pa/ krung go bzo zhing dmar dmag༄nga bskyod bod rgyal mo rong sa khul du thon pa'i gnas tshul/1934 lo zla 10 par krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid 'og thung go bzo zhing dmar dmag gis spung go mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i las don dang byang skyod ri 'gog ched du rlabs chen gyi 'thab 'jus 'pho 'gyur mdzad te/ 'dzam gling du skad grags ldan pa'i spyi le nyis khri lnga stong gi rgyang skyod 'go tshugs pa red/dmar dmag rgyang skyod si khron nub byang rgyal mo nong sa khul brgyud dus/ dmar dmag bca' sdod byas te khyi spyod las don lo gcig lhag gi mdzad pa'i ring la/ rgyal rong mi dmangs rnams kyang krung go mi dmangs dang 'dra bar rang srog blos btang gi gsar brje'i las don du zhugs pa red/ rgyal rong mi dmangs ni gzi brjid ldan pa'i gsar brje'i lo khyus dang gsar brje'i srol rgyun bzang po yod la/ tang gi lo rgyus nang du'ang don chen 'ga' zhig yod pa de 'ang spyal rong sa khul du byung ba red/ de ni rgyal rong mi dmangs rnams kyi gzi bajid ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi le tshan gsar ba zhig bris pa red/(1)rgyalas dacal chu btsanasgol dngadi lcags zam kha dmag 'thab/1935 lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer gsum nyin/ dmar dmag gi sngon skyod dmag dpung rgyal mo dngul chur 'gram du thon/ sa der go min tang gi dmag khri bcu yan chod kyis dmar dmag sgug ste/ dmag spyag thengs gcig gis tshar gcod bsam pa red/ 'on kyang / zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nub mor/blo mthun le'u pe khrin dang nye rung krin gnyis kyis dmag thān gcig khrid de lcags zam rdzong an hri khrang du thon/ sa de'i gru ba rnams kyis rogs skyor byas nas/ shing spu chung chung gsum beed spyod pas rgyal mo dngul chu btsan brgal byas/ de'i phyir nyin/ mo'o tse tung dang ku in len/ thu te gsum gyis an hri khrang du lcags zam rgol rdung byed pa'i thag bcad nas/ chu brgal ba'i dmag dang chu ma brgal ba'i dmag rnams phyogs gnyis nas yar skyod de lcags zam du yod pa'i go min tang gi dmag dang dpung 'jug dza drag che ba'i ngang chu tshod gnyis tsam gyis lcags zam rgol ba'i rgyal kha thob/ gtso shugs dmar dmag myur du rgyal mo dngul chu brgal bar 'gal rkyen che ba zhig sel ba red/(2)ca rin3 bo brgal ba'i gnas tshul/lcags zam rgol ba'i rgyal kha thob rjes/ tang krung dbyangs gis lcags zam rdzong du gros mol ma'atshogs nas mu mthud du byang skyod ri 'gog byed pa'i lam phyogs gtan la phab/ 1934 lo zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin/ dmar dmag 'gag la ru thon/ tshes dgu nyin mi sbyis su thon/ tshes bcu gcig nyin mi phyis rdzong gi byang phyogs yu tse ru thon te/ sa de'i bod mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu chen po byas/ cwa cin gangs ri brgal dus grang ngar 'gog ched dmar dmag rnams la chang dang la cu mang po phul/ tsā cin gangs ri ni mcho ngos las mtho tshad smi bzhi stong chig brgya yod la/ ri gzar zhing mtho ba/ grang ngar che — 652 —

ging mkha' dbugs nyung ba zhig yin rung / dmar dmag rnams sra brtan 'gyur med dpa' ngar ldan pa'i ngang nas grang ngar brgyud nas ri bo brgal ste btsan la rdzong ta we'i ru smrebs/ zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin/ rgyung dbyang dmar gcig dmag dang dmar bzhi phyogs chen dmag ṭwāṃ dpung phyogs sgar tshen〉gnyis ta we'i zam du mnyam 'dzoms byed pa'i nub mor ta we'i dgon par mnyam 'dzoms kyi dgungam 'tshogs tshogs pa red/ tshes nyer gcig nyin mnyam 'dzoms 'tshogs 'du btsan la rdzong du 'tshogs/dmar dmag dpung phyogs sgar chen dang po krung dbyang las khungs dang dpung phyogs sgar chen bzhi pa'i cin sum cu'i gyi spya brgyad pa/ cin dgu'i hri nyer bdun gyi khag gcig dang mnyam du btsan la pa kyo zhes bsod nams yag dang lang ho khu'u 'am chu gar ru thon/(2)krung gungasprung dbyang chab grid cus chu gararu gas 'du 'a gas ba/'thab jus phyogs ston gcig gyur byed dgos pa'i ched dang gsar brje 'thab rtsod kyi gnas tshul 'gyur ldog byung ba la gzhigs nas/ tang krung dbyang gis dmar dmag gi 'thab jus gyed sgo bsgyur bcos dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang ste chab srid cus tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i thag bcad/ tang krung dbyang gis 'brel yod gnas tshul mong rdzong du yod pa'i tsang go tho'o la snyan zhu sul/ zla drug pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin/ tsang go tho'o mong rdzong nas li rdzong brgyud de btsan la chu gar ram chu bar ru thon/ tshes nyer drug nyin/ chu gar gyi kon ti'i lha khang du krung gung thung dbyang chab srid cus kyi tshogs 'du 'chogs/chogs 'dus la gru in len gyis krung dbyang dang krung dbyang dmag u'i tshab mdzad de ṭwāṃ mig sngar 'thab jus phyogs ston thad kyi snyan zhu〉 zhes brton pa de gros 'cham byung / tshes nyer brgyad nyin/ grung dbyang chab srid cus gyis ṭwāṃ dmar gcig dang dmar bzhi phyogs chen dmag 'dzoms rjes kyi 'thab jus phyogs ston〉 zhes pa bsgrags/ mu mthud du byang skyod dang si khron/ hran zhi/ kan su'u gsum du gsar brje'i gnas gzhi 'dzugs rgyu'i thag bcad/ de ni rgyal yongs su gsar brje'i rgyal kha brtson len byed pa de chu gar tshogs 'du'i nang don gtso bo red/ 'tshogs rjes/ thung dbyang dmar dmag byang phyogs su mu mthud du bskyod/ tsang go tho'o li rdzong du phyir log te byang skyod la ngo rgol byas so/ kung dbyang gis tsang go tho'i nor 'khrul de 'thab rtsod mtha' gcig tu byed pa red/ 1935 lo'i zla drug pa'i nyi shu bzhi'i nyin/ sngon skyod dmag dpung rgyang bskyod lam bar gyi gangs ri gnyis pa 'bum bre ri bo brgal te log spyod drag shugs gyi bkag 'gog gastor nas 'bar khams ra kyo lung par thon/ gyir nyin cog tser glebs te rgyal po'i log spyod drag shugs pham nas bros/ de'i skabs su chu rgyas dus skabs dag dag 'khel te cog tser dmag dpung ngal bso dang dag ther byas rjes zla drug pa'i zla mjug dang zla bdun pa'i zla mgor rim ༵ṭwāṃspya / ṭwāṃkā / //sa rdog thon byas te so mang / mkhar sgo/ lha rgyal gling nas khro bcu'i rdo mkhar phyogs 1935 lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i zla stod/ mo'i tse tung / spu te/ kru'u en ledzee so/ṭwāṃ3 'go khrid

rnams btsan la chu gnyis mdo kha nas rdog thon byas te ta pan (oṃcho7)hang tso spren ( pi)brtsed nas mu'u khrin (lke7)du thon/ 'bum bre la brgal te zu'u sto gyen (〉 tshi)ba da nas cog tser thon/ krung dbyang gi 'go khrid rnams der gza' 'khor gnyis tsam bsdad/ der bod 'bangs rnams la byang bskyod ri 'gog gi rgyal gces dril bsgrags phyogs yongs su mdzad/ de'i tshe/ mo'o tse tung / kru te/ kru'u en le'i sogs cog tse rgyal sar b.rid/ dmar bzhi phyogs chen dmag ni so mang / cog tse/spun chen/ dzi 'gag brag bar/ bstan pa/ 'brong rdzong / kyom gyo/ tsho bdun/ gdung brgyad/sa rdzong / da tshang bcas zhang bcu gnyis su khong tshos 'thab 'dzing gyed pa'i zhabs rjes lus yod pa red/1936lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu nyin/ tung krin thang gis 'go khrid nas dmar g.yas tsong tu'e ru khag 'bar khams brgyud nas mdzod dge po'i bzo dang pan yu'u phyogs su bskyod/ dmar dmag 'bar khams su sor gnas dang / 'gro 'ong gyed las ni lo 'khor gcig tsam du 'gor/(4)dmar dmag 'barakhams su sdodaskabasatpa gnas chul/rim pa so so'i mi sna dang rgya cher bod rigs mi dmangs rnams la krung go gung khran tang gi tsho 'dzin dang dmag gi chab srid bzhed don sogs khyab bsgrags mdzad nas mang tshogs kyis dmar dmag yod pa'i dogs sems kyang gzhi nas sel bar byas/ log spyod dbang baḥr pas bzo zhing dmar dmag la khrel med kyi dma' 'beebs dang skur 'debs ngan g.yo gang byas kyi mtshang brtol bas/ mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs rnams dbu khrid nas zhang bcu gsum gyi rim pa gcig gi su'u we a'i srid dbang btsugs/ mang tshogs rnams skul slong byas nas nges med rgol rdung ru khag lo chung gdong len ru khag gsar brje'i dmag sogs dmar po'i rtsa 'dzugs tshugs nas/ na gzhon mi nyung ba zhig gsar brje'i 'gro lam du zhugs/ mi rigs so so'i rang gi 'tsho ba dka' ngal yod kyang / dka' ngal khyad du bsad nas 'asgru rigs dang dngos sa sogs khong chos stobs 'byor yod tshad phud nas dmar dmag rnams rogs skyor rgya cher mdzad/ lo phyed tsam gyi dbar 'bar khams ni dmar bzhi phyogs chen dmag gi rgyab phyogs su byas/de'i ring la dmag dmangs blo sems gcig gyur ngang nas g.yul sar rdogs skyor gang nus dang / rgyab phyogs sra brtan du btang ngo / /(5)su'u welge'i gsar brje'i grid dbang dang gnas gzhi sakhul 'dzugasazu'i skor/dmar dmag rgyang bskyod rgyal mo rong sa khul du thon rjes/ rgyal rong mi dmangs rnams kyis mi shugs/ rgyu shugs/ dngos shugs sogs gang thad nas dmar dmag rnams rogs ram rgya cher mdzad ched dmag dmangs dbar la zab mthun gi brtse dung chags pa red/1935lor dmar dmag dmar bzhi phyogs cun dmag lho phyogs su bskyod/ btsan la chu chen dang rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'bab rgyun gyi rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad du su'u spe e'i srid dbang gang sa gang la 'dzusdas ṭwāṃ~X 4/ pya935lo zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin chu chen rdzong du pha dge legs bde sa

spyi mthun rgyal khab zhes krung dbyang gsar brje'i srid gzhung tshugs pa red/ srid gzhung des rong mi'i brag 'go dang btsan la/ spru pyan/ bstan pa/ rdzi 'gag so mang / cog tse/ khro skyabs/ chu chen/ tshong hwa/ mi gyin/ dar rtse mdo sogs kyi sa khul du rdzong / chus/ zhang sogs rim pa so so'i gsar brje'i srid gzhung btsugs nas/ rim pa so so'i su'u we e'i 'go khrid 'og rgyal rong mi dmangs kyis rgyug bcom dbul skyor dang sa zhing bgo ba sogs sa zhing bcos bsgyur gyi bya 'gul mang po spel ba red/1936 lo zla gnyis par/ krung gung krung dbyang chab srid cus pha wa co po tshogs 'du'i7 snying don ltar/ dge legs bde sa spyi mthun rgyal khab kyis las don gtso bo de mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs mang tshogs rnams mthun sgril gyed nas/ ri 'gog dang cwang rgol gyi mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig sgril thog tu spor bas/ tang gi las don lte ba dang gom bgros gcig tu gyur/ tsāng ce hris dmar dmag med par bzo ched du/ dmar dmag rgyal rong du thon ma thag nas rgyal rong sa khul tu dpal 'byor bkag sdom dang log spyod kyi dkrog gtam bsgrags pas/ de'i thog tu si khron dmag shed can gyis kyang grangs nyung mi rigs rnams la drag gnon spel bas mi rigs dbar gyi 'gal ba je zab tu btang / de gar gnas pa'i mi rigs gong rim pa tshos spung khran tang / dmar dmag gi bzhed dgongs/ mi rigs srid jus kyi nang don mi go ba'i thog log spyod pa'i dkrog gtam kha la rgyugs nas/ tsāng phyogs kyi jus 'god dang bka' 'god 'og khong tshos rang nyid kyi gral rim gyi khe pan srung skyob byed ched phan tshun 'brel gtug byed nas drag po'i rtsa 'dzugs btsugs te dmar dmag rgyang skyod kyi bkag bcom tshad med byas/ dper na cog tse rgyal po bsod nams tshe ring gis kyang dmar dmag 'bar khams su thon grabs go ma thag nas rang gis mnga' 'og gi 'go mi da ro che chung bsdus tshogs byed de drag chas rtsa 'dzugs kyi dmar dmag bkag bcom gyed dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ khong gis mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i skyes pa rnams phyis sor 'gro mi chog pa dang dmar dmag la mgo 'dog mi chog pa sogs las 'gal mkhan tsho nyes chad drag po yod pa'i bka' phabs/ de dang mnyam du bod 'bangs rnams la dmar dmag ni rku 'phrog dang khang bsregs mi'i sha khrag za mkhan nag nyes dgu 'dzoms kyi dmag dpung zhig yin pa'i log spyod dril bsgrags byas/1935 lo'i zla snad zla ba lnga pa la/ bsod nams tshe ring gis deng sang 'bar khams mi dmangs 'tshogs khang gi mdun du grong sde'i tshogs chen 'tshogs nas skyes pa re la me mda' re dang zha mdel brgya re/ mi zi rgya ma lnga re/ sbrir sde'i skud pa smi bcu re grwa sgrig gyed nas dmar dmag bkag bcom chas grabs byas/sa so so'i rgyal po rnams rang gis mnga'oci khungs srung ched dmar dmag dang 'thab 'dzing dgos pa'i re 'bod byas/ so mang / bstan pa/ rdzi 'gag rnams kyis kyang phan tshun gzhogs 'degs byas nas/'go mi dang da ro che chung kun gyis stobs shugs yod tshad bsdus nas drag chas kyi rtsa 'dzugs byas/ rdzi 'gag rgyal pos btsan thabs kyis mnga' 'bangs rnams la rgya dang bod ni me chu ltar mthun thabs med pas dpa' ngar chen pos 'thab 'dzing byed dgos/ gal te rgya dmag rjes su 'gro mkhan yod na rtsa med gtong — 655 —

rgyu yin zhes/ dmar dmag si khron nub byang bod khul tu ma thon gong nas cwang ce hri'i gsang byul gyi 'go ba khang tshes tsha khor li'i lha lan mngag te gyed sgo sna tshogs spel/ tsāng ce hri'i khong nyid kyis kyang rgya bod yig gnyis ka yod pa'i pha bod dmangs la zhu yig bka' 'azin7 ces pa sa khul so sor bkrams/ cang phyogs dang si khron dmag shed can rnams kyis dkrog gtam bzo ba dang / bsru brid/ jan sru sogs ngan thabs rnam pa sna tshogs spyod nas/ bod rigs kyi gong rim pa'i nus shugs g.yar nas drag po'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis dmar dmag byang bskyod bkag bcom byed pa'i ri ngan dang bod rigs mi dmangs mang tshogs la 'jigs snang bskul ba red/(6)tsang go tho'olges 'barakhams sarṣal du gnas skabasaspyiza 'gul blong ba/tsang go tho'o nga bar gros tshogs 'tshegs te rgya chen po'i sgo nas lhor bskyod dgos pa'i bka' phabs lta dpung khag lho ru btsan thabs kyis bskyed du bcug nas 'bar khams rdzi 'gag kyom kyo ru thon rjes/ tang gi sgrig khrims snang med myur te/ 1935 lo'i zla 10 pa'i tshes lnga nyin kyom kyo bro shod dgon par pha tang gi hur brtson can7tshogs 'du ces pa zhig 'tshogs pas/ de ni mi rnams kyis shes gsal bzhin pha kyom kyo tshogs 'du7 ces pa de red/ tshogs 'du 'go 'dzin mkhan tsang go tho'o/ kru'u te/ nyi'o po khrin/shu'u shang chan/ khrin khrang ho'o/ lo pyin hu'i/ gyi khrang kong / kri'u khrin chan/ tsin khron nyi'u/ spru krong / li'i the/ hwang khra'o/ hphang chang / nyi'u krin can sogs chogs 'dur dngos zhugs tshogs mkhan brgya tsam yod/ tsang go tho'o tshogs 'du'i thog ham pa tsha po sgo nas gtam bshad de deng sang le nyen gyis rgyal spyi'i gnyis pa bcos nas 'phror/ rgyal gyi'i gsum pa'i dar dmar sgrong bzhin du spung go'i gsar brje'i dar dmar bsgrang rgyu yin zhes/ btsan po'i sgo nas tang krung dbyang dgos med du btang ba dang / blo mthun mo'i tse tung / spu'u in le'i/ tsang win then/ po ku/ yang hrang khin/ ye can yun sogs phyir 'bud dang / 'ju bzung / zhib gcod byed dgos pa'i gros thag bcad par ma zad/tang krung dbyang gis byang bskyod ri 'gog gi gyed phyogs de g.yas snang bros byol ring lugs kyi lam phyogs red ces sma 'beebs byas/ rtsa 'dzugs thog krung go gung khran tang gnas skabs spung dbyang yu yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i dril bsgrags dang / rang gis rang nyid spu'u zhi'i go sa bzhag nas spung dbyang dmag u dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung / krung dbyang chab srid cus/ krung dbyang byu'u gyi' khru'u/ thon krung dbyang sogs las khungs 'dzugs dgos rgyu'i dril bsgrags byas so/ /blo mthun gru'u te dang / le'u pye khrin/ shu'u shang chan sogs dmar bzhi'i phyogs chen dmag rgya che'i 'thab 'dzing pa rnams kyis/ tsang go tho'o tang rgol gyi nyes spyod la drang bden gyi khong khros khengs nas kho dang mdung rtse kha sprod lta bu'i 'thab 'dzing byed pa red/ tsang go tho'o kho rang dang bsam 'char mi mthun pa'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs rnams la zhe sdang gting nas 'khrug ste gsar brjer ngo rgol ba gtsang dag ཿbzo ༵༵ las 'gul bslangs pas/ kho rang gi nor 'khrul lam phyogs la thog mthar bar gsum du ngo

rgol byed mkhan sngon nub byang dmag don u yon lhan khang gi tshan mong krang blo mthun tsin krungahrin 1935lo'i zla bdun par cog tser zhog tu bsad/kyom kyo gros tshogs ni tsang go tho'o skabs 'chol ring lugs lam phyogs dang tang dang dmar dmag kha bral tu gtong ba'i bden rtags zhig red/ de'i skabs su cog tse'i kyom kyo chu chen sogs la nyes med kyi mang tshogs grangs med dmar gsod byas/ da dung
