phangs pa cig la lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad du po tā la gnyis pa zhes snyan grags can rdzi 'gag rnam rgyal 'jig med phun tshogs rdzong phyi nang thams cad bkod khyab kyi gna' rdzas bkang yod pa de rnams bsregs nas thal bar brlags/deng sang de'i shul tu sngon rabs dang nye rabs kyi mkhar gnyis las med par btang / tsang go tho'o krung dbyang rdzun ma bzos pa de sngar bzhugs nyin zhag brgyad cu gya gcig las med pa te/ 1936 lo'i bla drug pa tshes drug nyin tsang go tho'o krung dbyang dzun ma de phams par byung nas med par btang ngo /1936 me khyi (rab byung 16 )lor blo mthun gru'u te/ le'u pe khrin/ shu'u shang chan gtsor dmar bzhi phyogs chen dmag gis dkar mdzes sa khul gyi mi dmangs la su we e'i bod pa srid gzhung 'dzugs rogs gnang nas dge stag sprul sku u yon du bskos 'jog byas/ 1950 lo'i bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba la rgyal khab dang bod mi dmangs kyi don du lha sar phebs lam la yun ju'i gsang myul gyis dug drangs nas bkrongs/ dmar bzhi phyogs chen dmar dmag gis mi dmangs rnams la tang gi mi rigs srid jus yang dag pa lag len bstar ba'i mi rigs mthun sgril gyi sgo nas dkar mdzes mi dmangs dang dmangs gtso mi sna chos pa sogs kyis dga' bsu dang bstod bsngags kyi nus shugs gang yod phul/dmar dmag rnams byang skyod ri 'gog gi rgyang bskyod la dkar mdzes rta'u sogs kyi bod 'bangs chos mi rta mang po'i skyel ma dang rgyab skyor byas nas/ dkar mdzes nas bzung / gser rta/ 'dzam thang /smar rung / rnga ba/ a mchog hong yon/ zang dkar stod smad gong 'og nas dmar dmag rnams zang dkar stod ma'i sa thog lung zi gad dmar ru mnyam 'dzoms byed pa'i dbar/ gangs ri brgal ba dang rtswa thang brgyud rogs dang dmar dmag gis dgra bo'i bkag sdom rdul tu brlags nas rgyal kha thob pas/mdzod dge dang dmu dge'i phyogs skyod nas/ skad grags che ba'i dmu dge dang dpal skyid du 'tshogs 'du tshogs pa de ni/ tsang go tho'o tang krung dbyang kha bral ring lugs la dgag pa rgyag pa'i tshogs 'du red do/ dmar dmag mdo khams rgyal rong sogs nas phyir 'then rjes su/ log spyod stobs shugs kyis bod rgyal rong mi dmangs la smyo ba ltar phar rgol byed pas mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis de la dpa' ngar ldan pa'i 'thab rtsod byas pa de brjid nyams che zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i le tshan zhig 'bri gnang mdzad pa red/ dmar dmag gis mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs rnams la gaphar brje'i sa bon 'debs pas gang sa gang du zhing grong mang por gsar brje'i sbyar yigu 'bri sko byas tsho de dag dus rabs phyed tsam gyi char rlung gis bshud pa brgyud rung sbyar yig mi nyung ba zhig da dung tshang mang sasal b.raka nabye ༵/ hūṃ ni

dmar dmag dpa' ngar chen pos 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dpang rtags yin la dmar dmag rgyang bskyod kyi 'od stong 'phro ba'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che dril bsgrags byed pa dang gsar brje'i gom srol bzang po'i slob gso byed yul gson nyams ldan pa'i khrid bya dang / mi rigs rnam rang lus bcings 'grol byed pa'i rkang 'dzin pa spyong brnar byed pa la rmang gzhi brtan po 'dzugs 'debs byas pa red/(7)gangs rirtswa thang brgal nas gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing gi sems shugs shulatu bzhag pa/gangs ri rtswa thang brgal nas gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing gi sems shugs shul tu bzhag nas gsar brje'i sa bon 'debs de dge legs bde sa spyi mthun rgyal khab dang su'u we e'i srid dbang mu mthud du rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang blo brtan 'gyur med kyis gsar brje'i rtsa ba tshugs pa dang / myu gu skyed pa/me tog bzhad pa/ 'bras bu btag pa la brten nas rgya chen mi dmangs dbul phongs rnams dang lhan du rang srog blos btang gi 'bad brtson byas/ dper na/ 'bar khams rdzi 'gag brag bar ru/ rgya che dbul phongs mi ser rnams la gsar brje'i bden don dril bsgrags byed nas su'u we e'i srid dbang 'dzugs pas mi ser rnams mthun sgril dang rtsa 'dzugs kyi stobs shugs gal che ba'i rang bzhin shes rtogs byung / dmar dmag byir 'then rjes/ brag bar skon do'i mi ser rnams kyis dbang bsgyur gral rim dang kha log rgyag pa 'gog ched/ khong tshos rang 'gul gyis skon to gi tsā tā mu (skon to dbul bo'i 'brel chegs)zhes pa zhig btsugs/ 'brel tshogs nang du zhugs mi ni nges par du lo rgyus gtsang ba'i sa ging pa dang 'khor pa/ bran g.yog 'og rim mi ser yin dgos par byas/ de'i dus/ grong sde yongs su khyim tshang drug cu re gnyis las med rung khyim tshang bzhi cu zhe dgu 'brel tshogs nang du zhugs/ 'brel tshogs su zhugs mi rnams kyis dmangs gtsos 'debs bsko ngang 'brel tshogs kyi 'gan khur ba gtso bo ni bag yod tshul ldan gyi dbul bo bla ma thar nor bu bsko bzhag mdzad/ da dung gzhung thar 'bum 'bum zer ba zhig sngon phyug po zhig yin la de dus ma rtsa dib pas dbul bor gyur/ mi de rang nyid mngon thabs mkhas zhing kha bde bshad mkhas zhig yin pas de'ang 'brel tshogs kyi 'gan khur ba gzhon par bskos/ 'brel tshogs kyi dgongs don ni rgyal bo'i sa zhing lam lugs dang / bu lon bshu gzhog dpon pos mi ser rnams la gnya' gnon/ phyug pos drag btsan ltag khur gyis mi ser la brnyas bcos byed pa/ rnam grangs mang ba'i khral min sna tshogs/ drang bden min pa'i dgra zla bar gyi dmar 'dzing sogs ngo rgol byed pa dang / dbul bo phan tshun bar gyi mthun sgril dang mdza' mthun/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam dar spel gtong ba de red/ 'brel tshogs rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig khrims shin tu zab pas/ khyim tshang zhe dgu ni grong sder so sor gnas kyang / 'brel tshogs kyi 'tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs masgyugs myur du bsdu rub byed thub pa red/ 'tshogs 'dur gnyid log mkhan dang legs par mi nyan pa yod na 'tshogs mkhan rnams kyis nyes rdung gshe gshe gtong ba red/ tshogs 'du'i nang don dang gros mcham byung ba'i gros chod ni nges par du gsang srung byed dgos ste 'gal mkhan yod na 'brel tshogs las phyir — 658 —

'bud thebs/ zla rer tshogs 'du gnyis re 'tshogs ste/ 'chogs 'du'i nang don gtso bo ni las ka bkod sgrig dang mthun sgril gyi gal chen rang bzhin nan bshad byed rgyu de red/ spyod pa cung bzang ba'i sa zhing pa phyug po 'ga' res 'brel rtsags su zhugs bsam pa'i re ba bton na'ang chod bgam dang len byed dgos ste/ 'brel tshogs kyis cha rkyen 'dzoms byung 'dod dus 'tshogs zhugs kyi 'gro lugs 'grim chog pa red/ 'gro lugs ni 'azel chogs la re 'dun dngos gzhi bton pa/ 'azel tshegs kyi sgrig khrims dam srung byed pa/ 'brel tshogs la drang bden zol med gyed pa/ dbul bo'i khe phan srung ba la khag theg byed/ de nas 'brel chogs kyis gros bsdur thun mong byed nas zhib mchan gnang phyin 'brel tshogs su zhugs song ba red/ gal te phyug po tshang gis 'brel chogs la zur za dang 'phya smod byed mi yod na 'brel tshogs kyis tshogs 'tshogs nas rgol ngan slog pa red/ dper na/ sa zhing pa phyug po zhig gis bza' tshang la dbul bo'i 'brel tshogs du rgyu nor med pa'i dpon pos sa zhing med pa'i dbul bo khag gcig 'go khrid byed pa de red zer ba de 'brel tshogs kyis go byung nas 'phral tshogs 'du 'tshogs ste de ni tshig ngan dma' 'apebs dang dbul bo rnams la skur 'debs byed pa zhig red zer nas phyug po de gshe rdung byas par ma zad dngul gyi chad pa byas/rgyal bo dang dpon po/ dgon pa grwa tshang rnams 'brel chogs la skrag zhing sdang bas blo thabs gang yod spyod nas 'brel tshogs med par gtong ba la 'bad pa red/ dang 'gor/ khong tshos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bran bsgyur slob gso spyod nas 'brel tshogs kha 'thor ru gtong ba'i re ngan ma 'grub pas/khong tshos g.yo lhad dran 'phrul gyi sgo nas 'brel tshogs kyi zhugs mi rnams la nga tsho kun po lung ba gcig gi chu 'thung la ri rab gcig gi shing 'bud yod pa red/ nga tsho'i bar la mtho dman drag zhan gyi khyad par med pas 'gal zla yong don med zer ba sogs thabs mang spyod na'ang / dbul bo rnams kyis dbang bsgyur ba'i bsam don de shes pas kho tsho'i re ngan de yang stong med du btang ba red/ mthar/ 'brel tshogs nang nas gtor bshig byed pa'i blo ngan spyod nas rkon to'i da ro bsod nams kyis gzhung thar 'bum 'bum rngan slu byed/ kha 'phred 'phred gyid 'a zha'i mi ngan pa de lkog tu dpon po bsod nams rjes su rgyug ste blo thabs ngan pa bton/ des 'brel chogs nang gi zhan cha bed du spyod nas dpon po bsod nams dang phyi nang lag sbril byas nas/ 1939 lo'i zla 4 bar 'brel tshogs 'thor ru btang / 'brel tshogs kyi kru'u zhi'i bla ma thar nor bu nyes med nyes 'dzugs byas ste bsad/ de'i rjes/ a phag cu bsod nams zhes pa'i dbul bo zhig gis dbul bo rnams 'go khrid de zla cha re'i 'thab 'dzing rgyun 'khyongs byed na'ang / de dus 'brel tshogs kyi 'thab 'dzing gi stobs shugs shor song bas lo de'i lo mjug tu dbul bo rnams rang gi rtsa 'dzugs shor te dbul phongs kyi 'dam rjob du slar yang tshud pa red/brag bar rkon to'i dbul bo'i 'brel tshogs kyis 'thab 'dzing lo gsum gyi ring du rgyun 'khyongs byed pa de spyi tshogs su shugs rkyen mi chung ba zhig thebs pa red/ lo gsum gyi ring la/ hūṃba~X 5༵sgyur gral

rim gyi bshu bzhog lam lugs la chag sgo byung / rdzi 'gag dang kyom kyo'i 'go mi rnams kyang 'jigs skrag ༵ / zlobaisdo// dbang bsgyur gral rim la dbul bo rtsa 'dzugs kyi shugs chen stobs shugs mthong du bcug le'u nyer dgu ba/ tang gi byams brtse'i thugs khur gnang 'og tu/bcings gros dang mi rigs sa khulatu rang skyong srid dbang btsugs pa/de nas 1949 lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes gcig nyin grung hwa mi dmangs khyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas tang spung dbyang gi byams rtse'i thugs khur gnang 'og tu/ rnga ba'i sa khul ni 1950 lor bcings 'grol byas pa dang / /953 lor mi rigs sa khul tu rang skyong srid dbang btsugs/ khul yongs kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis de dus kyi dmar dmag gis gangs ri mthon por brgal ba dang mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang bskyod pa'i snying stobs rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel byas te/ rgyal khab gcig gyur dang mi rigs mthun sgril 'bad brtson dang dka' spyad las spel byas nas/ dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur bde blag ngang spub pa dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs rtsa ba nas dor te/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam chen thog bskyod par brten/ mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs mang tshogs spyal khab gyi bdag por dngos su gyur te/ khyad par tang gis skabs bcu gcig pa'i kung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshegs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa nas bzung / rgyal yongs kyi mi rigs khag gi rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor 'dzugs sgun lte ba bya rgyu rgyun 'khyongs dang / bsgyur bcos dang sgo 'byed rgyun 'khyongs byas par brten/ spyir bod gangs can ljongs yongs kyi sgos su rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong gyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/spyi tshogs sogs kyi rnam pa la gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba'i 'gyur ldog byung ste/ 1993 lo'i zla ba 9 pa tshes 1 nyin rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang rigs rang skyong khul dbu brnyes nas lo ngo bzhi bcu 'khor ba'i tshogs chen thog khul dpon tshe dpag skyabs kyis gsung bshad ltar/ zhing las dang rgyugs las bzo las la 'phel rgyas mgyog po byung bas/ 1992 lor khul yongs kyi zhing las thon rdzas rin thang bsdoms por sgor dung phyur 6 83 la bslebs pa dang / 1950 lo las ldab 3 8 yar mar 'phar yod/ 'bru rigs kyi thon tshad bsdoms 'bor tun 'bum 2 3 la basmrebs pa dang / 1950 lo las ldab 2 2 'phar yod/da yod phyugs grangs sa ya 3 2338 la slebs shing / 1950 lo las ldab 2 8 yar 'phel yod/ bzo las dpal 'byor med pa nas yod par mu mthud du shugs cher gtong gi yod/ da lta glog shugs dang /lcags bzhu/ rdzas 'gyur/ 'phrul chas/ glog rdul/ 'dzugs skun rgyu chas/ nags las/ bza' bcaḍi/ 6ḍi/la 'thag ko chas/ shog bzo sogs bzo las chung 'bring 580 lhag rim bzhin du

btsugs yod/ 1992lor bzo las thon sa rin thang bsdoms 'bor sgor dung phyur7 72la basbobs pa dang / 1952 lo las ldab 28 yar mar 'phar yod gsungs/ 'grim 'grul dang nus pa'i thon khungs kyi rnam pa legs su song yod/ bcing 'grol sngon gzhung lam lag mthil tsam yang med la da lta khul yongs su rlangs 'khor shar rgyug thub pa'i gzhung lam gyi ring tshad khyi le 5845tsam la basmrebs yod/ brgya cha 95 zin pa'i yul tsho (grong rdal)la gzhung lam bzos yod/ khul yongs su chu glog sa tshig chung 'bring 395 btsugs yod pa dang / glog 'don 'phrul 'khor gyi glog 'don tshad chan wa 'bum 55 la bslebs yod pa sogs kyis bcing 'grol sngon dngos rdzos mi rta kho nar brten nas skyel 'dren dang / mar me dang thang chu'i sgron mer 'tsho ba rol ba'i lo rgyus rdzogs song / ske(1)dpal 'abhor dngos shugs mu mthud nas je rgyas song yod/ 1992 lor khul yongs kyi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor thon skyed rin thang bsdoms 'bor sgor ther 'bum 1 27la smrebs pa dang / rgyal 'bangs kyi yong sgo sgor ther 'bum 1 06 la smrebs yod/ bzo zhing las thon rjos rin thang bsdoms 'bor sgor ther 'bum 1 45la slebs pa dang / 1952lo las ldab 9 6yar mar 'phar yod/ sa ṭā/sa/ nor srid kyi yong sgo sgor bye ba 9 907la smrebs pa dang / 1952lo las ldab 34yar mar 'phar (2)rig gnas slob gso dang sman bcos 'phrod bsten sogs kyi las don thad la yar rgyas chen po byung yod/ khul yongs su sngar med da yod kyi slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum khyon sdoms 1491dang / slob grwa'i slob sbyong byed gyin yod pa'i slob ma 'bum 1 149 yod/ da yod kyi sman bcos 'asrod brten las khungs 479dang / 'phrod brten ched las mi sna 3407 bcas yod/ de min tshan rig zhib 'jug las khungs 9 yod pa dang / der ched las so so'i lag rtsal mi sna khri 3 3 yod/ mi rigs las byed pa'i dpung sde mgyog myur du dar rgyas byung yod/ mig sngar khul yongs la grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa khri 1 41 yod pa dang / las byed pa bsdoms 'bor gyi baspya cha 45 26 zin yod/ grangs nyung mi rigs las byed pa mang po zhig mgo khrid kyi las gnas su zhugs yod pa dang / grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pas khul rim dang rdzong rim gyi las byed pa'i brgya cha 92 72 dang brgya cha 60 28 re zin yod/grangs nyung mi rigs kyi bud med las byed pas rdzong rim yan gyi las byed pa'i brgya cha 9 05zin yod/(2)mi dmangs kyi 'che ba je legs je skyid du song yod/ 1992lor khul yongs kyi zhing 'brog mi dmangs rnams kyi mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo ni sgor 53byal slebs yod/ grong sprer dang grong rdal las bzoba'i mi re'i lo re'i gla phog kyi yong sgo cha snyoms sgor 2583la skebs yod pa dang /snye grong khyer dang grong rdal gyi sdod mi'i gsogs dngul lhag ma sgor dung phyur 4 89'a/ skebs/ zhing 'brospu mi dmangs mang phyogs kyi lto rgyab gnyis phal cher lam 'jog byas/ trīrnga ba khul gyi lo rgyus la phyi mig gis bltas tshe/ 'gyur ldog ha cang chenapo byung yod pa dang / lo ngo — 661 bzhi bcu'i ring la 'od stong 'bar ba'i lo rgyus kyi shul lam las/ mi rnams kyi blo ngor 'di 'dra'i bden don zhig snang ba ste/ krung go gung khran tang med na spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rnga ljongs gsar ba 'di yong thabs med/ tang gi 'go khrid rgyun 'khyongs byed rgyu ni/ rnga ba khul gyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skun las don 'gan len bya rgyu'i rtsa ba yin pa dang / mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi yun ring bo'i da dbar 'thab rtsod byas pa'i lag len las thob pa'i gdam bya yang dag pa'ang yin/ krung go gung khran tang 'go khrid kho na'i 'og da gzod rnga ba khul gyi mdun lam la re ba chen po ldan pa dang / spyi chogs ring lugs kyi lam chen kho nar bgrod na/ da gzod rnga ba khul gyi 'byung 'gyur las yar rgyas gong 'phel yod zhing / mirigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams la bde skyid dang longs spyod ldan par 'gyur ro/ /tang gi mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig sgril gyi nor bu'i mthu ldan la brten nas mi rigs rim gras kyi chos pa mi sna dang dpon rigs mi rnams kyis kyang / rang khul tu gi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba la tang gi las byed tshogs pa dang bcings 'grol dmag lhan du phan tshun gces skyong bsam shis dang / phan tshun rogs ram phan tshun gzhogs 'degs phan tshun bzod sgom sogs zhi bas sgo nas spyi tshogs ring lugs su slobs thub pa'i phan 'bras rgya chen po byung yod pa ni mthong chos mngon 'gyur ro/ /

skub don bshad pas mjug bsdu ba/dam pa gong ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa khong rnams kyis bris pa'i lo rgyus thad kyi klog deb mi nyung ba zhig la khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod pa snga sa nas mi rnams kyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur yod pa red/ rang gis chu tshad la mtshon nas bshad na khong rnams pa'i zin bris legs sgrig dang mthud 'bri byed rgyu de las go 'pher ba zhig yong rgyu ha cang dka' mo red/ 'on kyang bsam blo yang yang btang rjes ngas las 'gan 'di dang du blangs rgyu'i 'gan yod 'dug snyam/nga rang gis las 'gan 'di dang du len pa'i rgyu mtshan ni rang nyid la'ang dus yun ring po nas na gzhon dang lo na chung ba'i klog pa rnams la rang gi mi rigs kyi lo rgyus ngo sprod byed pa'i go bde'i klog deb zhig 'bri rgyu'i 'dun pa yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin/ rang gi sems la krung go'i mi rigs zhig yin phyin spyir krung go'i lo rgyus dang khyad par mi rigs so so'i rang gi mi rigs kyi lo rgyus la rgyus mnga' tog tsam yod dgos pa 'dug snyam/ de shes na mes rgyal dang rang gi mi rigs kyi da lta dang 'byung 'gyur la dga' zhen de bas che ba skye gi red/ rang spyal dang rang gi mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thog don dang ldan pa'i lo rgyus dang sgrung mang po zhig yod pa de tsho lo na chung ba'i klog pa po rnams la klog tu bcug na kho tsho'i shes rgya che ru 'gro thub pa dang / gnad don 'dra min sna tshogs bsam gzhigs dang shes rtogs byed rgyu'i blo sgo phye thub pa yong ba red/ dus rabs mi 'dra na'ang lo rgyus thog gi don dag mang po zhig gis zur tshad mi 'dra ba re'i thog nas nga tshor slob gso dang yang na dpyad gzhi'i nus pa nges can zhig thon nges red/ de'i phyir rang gi skad yig spyod rgyu de ni shin tu gal che/ lhag par du lo rgyus kyi shes bya dang skad yig gi shes bya'i bar gyi 'brel ba ha cang dam po yod 'dug deng rabs kyi rgya bod kyi skad nang gi tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig dang /lhag par du gna' rabs kyi gtam dpe mang che ba ni lo rgyus kyi deb ther las byung ba zhig red/ gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi dper 'os rtsom rigs 'ga' zhig gi nang lo rgyus kyi don dngos bed spyod byas pa de bas kyang mi nyung ba zhig mthong rgyu 'dug der brten na gzhon rnams chung dus nas lo rgyus kyi dpe deb klog tu bcug na kho tsho'i klog 'don gyi nus pa dang rtsom rgyag gi chu tshad mtho ru gtong rgyur phan thogs yod pa ni the tshom med pa zhig red/ 'on kyang lo rgyus deb ther mang po yo da par ma zad/ gna' rabs kyilo rgyus kyi ma dpe tshang ma yig skad dang zur chag pa'i skad yod pas/ spyir btang lo na chung ba'i klog pa po tshos klog khag po yod pa smos ci dgos/ da lta slob grwa ba tshos tshan rigs rnams grangs de 'dra mang po slobasbyong byed dgos kyi yod pas thad kar ma dpe klog rgyu'i go skabs kyang yod kyi ma red/ gnad don 'di — 663 —

thag gcod byed ched ngas sems la lo rgyus deb ther nang gi dpyad gzhi phun sum tshogs pa rnams dpyad nas go sla la rgyud rim tog tsam ldan pa'i lo rgyus de ni dkar chag nang cung 'gangs che ba dang skad grags yod pa rnams gdam gses byed gang thub byed nas 'bri khul byas yod/ der brten ngas brtsams pa'i ṭwāṃbod spyal mo rong gi lo rgyus rab gsal me long〉zhes pa 'di yang lo rgyus slob spyong byed pa'i ram 'degs klog deb zhig byas chog pa red snyam/nga rang gi da dung dmigs su bkar nas bod kyi rgyal mo rong 'di bod rigs yin min nas bshad na/bod kyi thog ma'i mi brgyud ji ltar byung yod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ ya thog gi bod mi'i 'byung khungs gang yin rtsad gcod byed dgos pa de kho na yin la/ ya thog gi bod mi'i lo rgyus rtsad gcod byed pa la med du mi rung ba zhig ni/ bon gyi gna' bo'i lo rgyus rnams las ya thog zhang zhung gi thog ma'i mi brgyud kyi lo rgyus ji ltar bstan yod pa de dang nam yang 'bral thabs med pa de red/gna' rabs bod mi'i 'byung khungs ban bon gnyis kyi phyogs thun mong du shod srol yod pa zhig ni/bod kyi mi brgyud rnams/ spra dang / ldong / 'bru/ sga ste ru tshan bzhi'am/ dpal zla dang bcas pas rtsa ba'i rus tshan drug gam bdun las chad yod pa'i skor ni/ ya thog zhang zhung gi mi rabs byung tshul bstan pa'i skabs gsal bar bshad pa ltar ro/ spra'am/ khyung gi rus tshan las zhang zhung gi mi brgyud rnams mched pa phud/ rus tshan gzhan ldong dang / 'bru/ sga/ rgo/ dbal zla bcas pa'i mi brgyud rnams ji ltar mched pa dang / de dag gi gnas yul sogs bstan yod/ mdor na dus rim mi 'dra ba du ma'i nang du de dag la spyi chegs kyi 'pho 'gyur yang ji snyed pa zhig byung stong yod stabs/ rus tshan de dag lasamached pa'i dmangs tshogs kyi ming dang / yul gshis/ chas lugs/ kun spyod sogs la'ang 'gyur ba ci rigs shig thebs yod pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/dam pa khyung gi gdung rabs dngos las/ kun tu bzang po'i sprul ba rig snang 'od kyi rgyal zhes bya bas 'gro ba'i don la dgongs nas sku gsung thugs las sprul ba'i bya khyung gsum 'phur shul spar mo sa la reg pa'i drod rlangs las sgo nga dkar nag sogs khag bzhir 'dril ba'i brdol ba'i nang nas mtshan ldan pa khye'u re re byung ba'i ming yang khyung pho zhes btags nas/ che ba khyung dkar thog la 'bar/ de 'og khyung ser lha khyung / de 'og khyung 'phar khra mo/ chung ba dmu khyung rgyan zhes grags/ thang stag khyung 'phags khra mo ni tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pas zhang bod kyi rgyal rabs rim byon gyi bla yi mchod gnas mdzad pa'i mthar g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs su zhon te mdo smad rgyal mo rong du byon nas lha mo mdangs ldan ma khab tu bzhes/de lasabu 'bor bzhi 'khrungs bas g.yung drung bu bzhi ru grags so/ /rus rgyud de ni rgyal mo rong dang mdo smad du shin tu yang mang zhes so/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir bod kyi rgyal mo rong gi mi rigs de zhang zhung gi mi brgyud nang nas chad pa'i rus chen gyi gtso bo ni/ dzi bse khyung sbra zhes su grags pa de yin la/ spyir stangardzu ‘ ༵ṭwāṃ4 khyung sbra zhes pa de/ spra la bse khyung zhes pa'i khyad chos kyi tshig sbyar ba'i zol 'dra zhig snang

mod/ don du sbra'i nang khungs su gtogs pa'i rus chen bye brag pa 'ga'i tha snyad cig yin la/ zhang zhung gi mi bakhyud de dag gtso cher pha khyung ’ gi rus chen las gyes pa yin stabs/ yul la'ang khyung ste/ yul dpon la khyung ro/ zhang zhung gi skad du pha zhungami’ zhes pa de ni bod skad brda rnying du dzi khyung’ zhes bya dang don gcig pa yin/ pha khyung7 zhes bya ba'i tha snyad 'di bod kyi brda rnying ches rnying ma zhig yin pa ni/dus gyis bod du byon pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i mdo rgyud yongs grags kyi dpe rnams su khyung la dzi mkha' lding zhes pa'am/ pha mkha' lding7 zhes pa'i tha snyad byas yod pa las/ pha khyung ’ zhes pa'i tshig 'di rnyed dka' ba de tsam gyis kyang shes thub pa yin/khyung ni bon lugs su ya thog srid pa lha rabs kyi mched khungs shin tu gal chen po zhig tu'ang ngos 'dzin srol byung 'dug go/mdo mad chos 'byung las/ spyal rong rgyal khag thams cad kyi rus spra yin par bshad/ rigs der tsha kho rang skad du ngartsi zer de yang bod kyi rigs la bse rmu ldong stong bzhi rigs bzang rnams la sngarazhing po phyis lha rigs sgo zer/ bse rigs bzang rnams bse khyung spra/ rmu rigs bzang la mu tsha sga/ldong rigs bzang la a spo ldong / stong rigs bzang la a lcags 'bru/ lhag ma'i rigs ngan la tshan gnyis su gye ba dbal dang zla ste mi'u ldong drug tu grags/ sgrung las/ mi'u rus drug zhang bo sgo dang bdun zer/ de'i nang nas bse dang spra gcig par bshad/ sngon gyi rgyal rabs rnams su bse khyung dpra zer ba dang gcig gam snyam/ 'gag dog mo gsum de sru la thob/ sbra dpa' rtsal che ba de yi don/ zhes pa ltar/ mdo khams rong chen bzhi'i nang tshan rgyal rong 'gag dog sa gsum sbras thob/ yul der sngon rgyal po mdo bzher nag po byung dus bee ro tsa na phebs/ de'i slob ma g.yu sgra snying po yang tsha kho tshig bsdus pa'i dbang gis mdo bzher nag po'i rigs la rgyal nag gdung rgyud/ zhang zhung sbra rgyal la zhang rgyal rgyud dang / tsha rong rgyal po kho 'phan du grags pa byung bas de la tsha kho zer ba byung / 'di rgyal sa kha gsum dang khag bzhi'i yang mes yin no/ rab brtan gyi rgyud nas chad zer ba dang / yang bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud zhig so mang rgyal khab tu bzhugs so zhes kyang gsungs yod/mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod las/ shar rgyal mo rong gi rgyal po sngon ma byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i sprul ba mdo bzher nag po zhes pa de spra nag po'i rigs yin la/ bstan pa snga dar gyis dus susangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sprul pa lo tsā ba chen po pa gor bee ro tsa na yul rgyal mo rong der byon dus kyi rgyal bo de yin/ lo tsā ba chen po de'i slob mar gyur pa g.yu sgra snying po grags byung zhing / yul der bstan pa snga 'gyur gyi dam pa'i chos yang de nas bzung ste dar bar bshad do/ /gung khran tang gi dngos gnas thog mtha' bar gsum du lo rgyus jib 'jug byed rgyu de rtsis mthong chenapo mdzad kyin yod/ mo'o tse dung dang spu'u en len rnam gnyis kyi gsungs pa las/ bya dngos gsar ba thams cad rnying ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba ni 'jig rten chos nyid cig red/ rnying ba'i byarda ngo~X hūṃton pa de

ni mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyis rnying ba'i rtsa ba shes pa'i phan thog che ba red/ de ltar byas na lo rgyus gcod 'breg tu byed thabs med/ de ni lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i las don gyi rtsa ba'i rtsa don zhig red la slob ston bsam blo zhig kyang red/ lo rgyus rnal ma zhig dgos na rang nyid kyis dngos su brgyud snyong dang sa gnas de gar dngos su sleb pa/ dngos su mthong ba/ mi rgan pa bsam shes can la 'dri ba sogs don dngos ltar 'bri dgos/ de ltar bris na lta tshul dang rtsom lugs la lta rgyu med pa red/ rig gnas lo rgyus tshang ma zhig dgos na sngon rabs dang nye rabs deng rabs thams cad 'bri dgos/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ lo rgyus ni dngos yod kyi me long zhig yin pa'i nges par du shes dgos/ kha sang dang de ring / sang nyin ni so sor kha bral du gtong thabs med la/ kha sang gi rgyus mnga' ma lon na/ de ring gi gnas tshul la shes rtogs legs po zhig byung thabs med/ sang nyin ni de bas kyang shes thabs dang dpog thabs med pa red gsungs yod/ lo rgyus dpe sgrun gyed pa de ni mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyis de'i nang nas phan thog ldan pa'i bslab bya len rgyu dang lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhi'i rin thang yod pa red/ lo rgyus kyi tshan rig la zhabs 'degs zhu bar ma zad/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can bzhi la'ang zhabs 'degs zhu ba red/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma yis/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis brjod par bya gsungs pa bzhin du bris na/ rang gi ston pas gsungs pa yi/ /'khor ba'i 'thug ldog rim pa rnams/ /tshad mas grub tshul dngos stobs kyi/ /rigs pas gtan la legs phab pas/ /bstan pa kho na thar 'dod kyi/ / 'jug ngogs mchog dang ston pa nyid/ / bslu med tshad ma'i skyes bu ru/ / nges rnyed bstan dang ston pa gzhan/ / mi 'tshol srog gi phyir du yang / / dkon mchog gsum po mi spong bar/ / snying nas gtan gyi skyabs gnas su/ /'dzin pa 'dun ma kun gyi gzhi/ /de bzhin bod kyi ljongs 'dir yang / /chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs pa/ /rgya yi gos kyi ri mo bzhin/ /'dra dang mi 'dra rnam pa mang / /de dag rnams kyi lta sgom spyod/ /rnam gzhag ji lta bu yi tshul/ /ma 'dres shes nas lung rigs kyis /yang dag ltar snang dbye dgos kyang / / 'ga' zhig chags sdang dbang du gyur/ / la la rmongs zhen tsam gyis 'jug /gzhan dag kun la dag snang bsgom/ /phal cher chos la rtog dpyod med/ /blo ldan lugs ni de min te/ /phyogs lhang dor nas gzu bo'i blos/ /nor dang ma nor mchog dman gyi/ khyad par 'tshol bar byed pa yin/ / rgyal ba'i gsung rab dpang bzhag ste/ / dngos stobs rigs pas dpyad pa na/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs la/ / rgyu mtshan shes pas dad pa 'byung / / de ltar min par chags ldang 'ba' zhig gis/ / rang phyogs bstod cing gzhan phyogs smod pa yis/ / bstan la dgag sgrub byed par rlom pa dag /mkhas pa rnams kyis khrel ba'i gnas nyid do/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji snyed du/ /thar ba don du gnyer rnams la/ /nyams len dus su mi mkho ba/ / sna gcig tsam yang yod min te/ /drang nges sna chegasagasungs pa yang / /mthar thug dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab/ / theg pa tha dad bstan pa yang /mthar thug theg pa che la gzhol/ /de phyir kā ri kā nas bzung / /'dus pa'i bar gyi mdo bstan chos/ /— 666 —

jisnyed mchis rnams gang zag gcig / 'tshang rgya ba yi cha rkyen yin/ / des na skal ldan thar 'dod rnams/ /phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ / tshim min gzhung lugs rab 'byams la/ / gtan du 'gro ba'i thos pa btsal/ /thos don sgrub pa'i ched yin phyir/ /phyir ltas kho nar ma song bar/ /bsgom pas nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /gtan la 'bebs pa'i thabs su dril/ / sangs rgyas 'byung ba las kyang ches dkon pa/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dga' ston las/ /rang gi bgo skal cha tsam ma lon na/ /de ni bstan pa 'di la skal chad yin/ /lha yi sgrub thabs chung ngu tsam/ /shes shing nyams su blangs pa yis/ /sa chod ci yang mi 'byung bas/ /rgyud don gdams par 'char ba gces/ /dbang thob dam tshig la gnas nas/ / rim gnyis lam gyi bgrod lugs dang / / de las dngos grub rim pa yis/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sar bgrod tshul/ /rgyud kyis bstan rim legs shes nas/ /ji bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /de la sngags tshul gzigs pa yi/ /mkhas pas gsang sngags pa zhes zer/ / de lta'i tshul gyis bsgrub bya'i chos/ /nyams 'og chud pa'i skal ldan des/ / 'di snang sgyu ma'i ltad mo la/ / g.yengs bas mi tshe 'da' min par/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i dbeen gnas su/ /'dod chung chog shes la gnas pas/ /mdo sngags zung 'brel nyams len gyis/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par bya/ / de ltar yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /gnad du smin pa'i thos bsam sgom byed pa/ / 'di ni blo bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ste/ / dus gsum rgyal ba gshegs pa'i lam bzang yin/ / zhes pa'i mthar bkra shis so/ / / /mjug byang /nga rang gi shes tshad dman zhing 'chad rtsom gyi nus pa zhan pa'i phyir/ tshig rdzob mang la snga phyi bskyar zlos dang rnyog zing yod par ma zad go rim kyang legs po zhig byung med snyam/ 'di brtsams nas mjug tsam la slobs dus su rgas 'khogs kyis kha 'khum lag 'khum du thug mod/ 'on kyang utshugs kyis bsgrubs par bgyis/ zhu dag kyang yam me ba zhig las ma thub/ cizhib cha ma thon pas da dung nor 'khrul ṭwāṃ kā dī rshakā /yod/ nges pas klog mkhan mkhyen ldan rnams kyis skyon brjod dang legs bcos gnang ba re smon
